title: School Sales and Partnerships Intern
description:
Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfLXUl4lMoFZN9UgN5l-R\_w\_UkIJhbuiV5Q8cFKanbakipnxQ/viewform

**Company:**
BrainZym Private Limited, Whitefield, Bengaluru

**Role type:**
Full-time internship, field-based (travel to schools across Bangalore)

**Duration:**
6 months, with a possibility of a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)

**Stipend:**
Fixed stipend per month + incentive for every school signed + local travel allowance

**Joining:**
Immediate

**Reports to:**
Founders

**About BrainZym**

We track our children's marks, height, weight and screen time. Almost no one tracks how well their brain actually works: their attention, memory, reasoning and speed of thinking. BrainZym exists to change that.

BrainZym is a cognitive development technology company based in Bengaluru, founded by a team with decades of experience in learning gamification, game development, software engineering and research. We help schools measure and strengthen the core cognitive skills that sit underneath every subject i.e. attention, memory, reasoning and speed of thinking.

Our first product,
**SparkFinder**
, is a game-based cognitive assessment programme for schools. Students play short, engaging activities, and the school receives clear student-wise and grade-level reports on core cognitive skills, with practical action points as interventions for further improvement.

**Role:**

You will be BrainZym's face on the ground: find schools that should be using SparkFinder, get in front of the decision-makers, and convince them to sign up.

**What you'll do**

**1. Generate new school leads**

* Research and build a list of target schools (CBSE, ICSE, IB, Cambridge and state board) in assigned areas of Bengaluru
* Identify the right decision-makers: principals, academic coordinators, trustees and school owners
* Reach out through school visits, phone calls, WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn to book meetings
* Tap into local networks, school associations, education events and parent communities

**2. Visit schools and pitch SparkFinder**

* Meet principals and coordinators in person and run a clear, confident presentation and demo
* Explain what SparkFinder measures, how the assessment runs on the day, and what the school and parents receive
* Handle questions and objections on cost, timing, screen time, data privacy and curriculum fit

**3. Follow up and close**

* Follow up on existing leads and every new meeting until there is a clear yes or no
* Share proposals, brochures, sample reports and pricing, and negotiate within agreed terms
* Coordinate paperwork such as enrolment forms, partnership documents and NDAs between school management the BrainZym Sr. management.

**4. Support on-ground events**

* Organise and facilitate SparkFinder assessments in school: scheduling, setup, coordination with school staff and assist students during the session.
* Collect feedback and testimonials from principals, teachers and parents

**5. Keep the pipeline honest**

* Log every lead, call, visit and outcome in our CRM or tracking sheet the same day
* Share a short weekly report on meetings, conversions, objections heard and what is working
* Bring back market insights: what schools ask for, which competitors they mention, and how they decide

**What success looks like**

Targets will be agreed with you in the first week. As a guide, by the end of the first 3 months you should be:

* Contacting [40+] new schools a month
* Holding [12–15] in-person meetings with decision-makers a month
* Converting [X] schools to sign up for SparkFinder
* Keeping a clean, up-to-date pipeline that anyone in the team can read and understand.

**Who we're looking for**

**Must have**

* MBA graduate (or final-semester student available full-time) with a specialisation in Sales or Marketing
* Strong spoken and written English is a must; Kannada fluency is great to have.
* Comfortable meeting senior people such as principals and school owners, and holding your ground in a conversation
* Willingness to travel daily within Bengaluru (own two-wheeler preferred)
* Persistence: you see a "not now" as the start of a follow-up, not the end
* Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel, email and presentation tools

**A good value add for this role**

* Prior internship or project in B2B sales, field sales, education or edtech
* Contacts in the school ecosystem in Bengaluru
* Genuine interest in education, child development or how the brain learns

**What you'll get**

* Monthly stipend plus an incentive for every school you bring on board
* Travel allowance for school visits
* Direct mentorship from the founders on sales, negotiation and building a business from scratch
* Real ownership: your work directly decides how fast SparkFinder grows
* Internship certificate and letter of recommendation
* Pre-Placement Offer for strong performers

**Selection process**

1. Application review
2. Short phone screening
3. Pitch exercise: a 10-minute role-play where you pitch SparkFinder to a "principal" (we'll share material in advance)
4. Final conversation with the founders

**How to apply**

Fill out this application form:

Form Link: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfLXUl4lMoFZN9UgN5l-R\_w\_UkIJhbuiV5Q8cFKanbakipnxQ/viewform?usp=publish-editor

* Enter responses to the questions and details requested
* Upload your CV

Learn more at www.brainzym.com

*Look forward to your responses and getting you onboard, soon.*

This role goes beyond traditional infrastructure monitoring and production support. You will be responsible for building scalable, reliable and automated infrastructure capabilities, improving system observability, reducing operational toil and enabling engineering teams through reusable tools and self-service solutions.

We are looking for engineers who build platforms, automate repetitive processes and proactively improve system reliability.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Platform & Infrastructure Engineering

* Design, build and maintain scalable, reliable infrastructure and platform components.
* Develop reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules using Terraform.
* Automate configuration management and infrastructure provisioning using Ansible.
* Manage Linux-based infrastructure, system performance and troubleshooting.
* Build automation frameworks and reusable engineering utilities using Python.

2. Observability & Monitoring

* Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality and incident detection.

* Manage and troubleshoot Kafka clusters, topics, partitions, consumer groups and replication.

* Operate and optimise ClickHouse databases for performance, scalability and reliability.
* Troubleshoot query performance, storage, capacity and database-related issues.
* Ensure high availability and reliability of data infrastructure.

4. Automation & Reliability Engineering

* Identify repetitive operational activities and convert them into automated workflows.
* Develop Python-based scripts, tools and utilities to improve engineering productivity.
* Build reusable automation solutions for infrastructure provisioning and operational workflows.
* Identify recurring production issues and implement permanent preventive solutions.
* Improve system availability, scalability, resilience and operational efficiency.

* Independently troubleshoot complex Linux, infrastructure and application issues.
* Participate in production incident management and root cause analysis.
* Improve incident response processes through automation and better observability.
* Perform capacity planning, performance monitoring and infrastructure optimisation.
* Work closely with application, development and product engineering teams.

* Implement infrastructure security and access management best practices.
* Follow secure configuration and secrets management practices.
* Ensure infrastructure changes follow appropriate governance and change management processes.
* Promote standardisation, documentation and engineering best practices.

Mandatory Technical Skills

Candidates must have hands-on experience in all the following technologies:

1. **Linux:**
   Strong Linux administration, system troubleshooting, performance monitoring and shell scripting.
2. **Prometheus:**
   Metrics collection, PromQL, monitoring configuration and alerting rules.
3. **Kafka:**
   Production experience in Kafka administration, topic management, consumer groups, lag and troubleshooting.
4. **ClickHouse:**
   Hands-on experience in ClickHouse operations, query optimisation, performance and capacity management.
5. **Grafana:**
   Dashboard creation, alerting, data sources and observability dashboards.
6. **Terraform:**
   Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules and infrastructure provisioning.
7. **Ansible:**
   Configuration management, playbooks, automation and infrastructure orchestration.
8. **Python:**
   Strong scripting and automation skills, including developing reusable tools and utilities.

**Note:**
Hands-on implementation and production experience in all eight mandatory skills are essential for this position.

* Kubernetes and Docker/containerised workloads.
* PostgreSQL database administration and performance troubleshooting.
* HashiCorp Vault and secrets management.
* GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipeline automation.
* Apache Airflow.
* Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.

What We Are Looking For

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. Our work spans alignment methods, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across LLMs, agents, and tabular / structured-data models.

A core part of our work is turning advanced AI research into production systems. That means taking internally developed libraries and model workflows, such as
****AlignTune****

,
****TabTune****

, and
****DLBacktrace****

, and integrating them into scalable platform infrastructure that supports training, inference, evaluation, observability, and enterprise deployment.

The Role

We are hiring a
****Senior AI Platform Engineer****

to build the platform layer that operationalizes Lexsi’s core AI systems.

This role is centered on
****R&D-to-platform rollout****

: taking technically sophisticated model systems and making them usable, reliable, and scalable inside the product stack. You will work across model pipelines, training systems, inference infrastructure, distributed execution, and backend platform architecture.

This is not a thin integration role. It requires strong engineering depth and enough model understanding to work effectively with systems involving
****fine-tuning, RL, alignment, interpretability, agent execution, and inference optimization****

across
****LLMs, agents, and tabular foundation models****

.

Responsibilities

* Own the platformization of Lexsi’s internal AI libraries, turning research-heavy systems into robust platform capabilities with stable APIs, execution layers, observability, and deployment paths.
* Build and scale training and post-training infrastructure for workflows including
  ****SFT, RL, evaluation, model adaptation, and agent optimization****

  .
* Design the integration layer between research systems and product infrastructure, including job orchestration, artifact management, dataset versioning, experiment lineage, and runtime control surfaces.
* Build inference systems that can support complex model behaviors under production constraints, including latency, throughput, cost efficiency, debuggability, and safety.
* Design for
  ****multi-cluster and distributed execution****

  , including scheduling, fault tolerance, checkpointing, retries, workload isolation, and heterogeneous compute environments.
* Operationalize systems such as
  ****AlignTune****

  for fine-tuning and RL pipelines,
  ****TabTune****

  for tabular foundation model workflows, and
  ****DLBacktrace****

  for interpretability, tracing, and behavioral inspection.
* Build common platform primitives for model lifecycle management across training, evaluation, serving, rollback, and monitoring.
* Partner closely with research teams to translate model-science complexity into production architecture without flattening away the core technical value.
* Improve platform reliability for long-running and failure-prone AI workloads, especially where model behavior, system behavior, and infrastructure behavior interact in non-trivial ways.
* Ensure that alignment, interpretability, and auditability are embedded into system design, especially for enterprise and regulated deployments where model outputs and decisions must be explainable.
  
  

Example Problems You Might Work On

* Turn
  ****AlignTune****

  into a production-grade internal service for supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning across multiple model families, datasets, and evaluation loops.
* Build rollout infrastructure for new model-science capabilities so research systems can be exposed safely and incrementally inside the platform.
* Integrate
  ****DLBacktrace****

  into training and inference pipelines so model behavior can be traced, debugged, and surfaced through internal and external product surfaces.
* Build inference architecture for large models and agent systems that must balance cost, performance, explainability, and runtime control.
* Design distributed execution flows across clusters for long-running training, evaluation, and analysis workloads with strong guarantees around recovery and reproducibility.
* Unify workflows across
  ****LLMs, agents, and tabular models****

  without collapsing their distinct operational and scientific requirements into a one-size-fits-none abstraction.
* Build the platform interfaces that let downstream teams launch, inspect, evaluate, and deploy complex model workflows without needing to reimplement research infrastructure.
  
  

Requirements

* Strong experience building and shipping
  ****complex AI / ML systems in production****
* Deep backend and platform engineering experience, especially in
  ****Python****

  , distributed services, workflow orchestration, data systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Hands-on experience with one or more of:
  ****fine-tuning systems, RL pipelines, inference infrastructure, distributed training, model serving, evaluation systems****
* Strong understanding of the systems implications of modern model workflows across
  ****LLMs, agents, and structured / tabular model systems****
* Experience scaling workloads across clusters and production environments, with strong instincts around reliability, observability, and performance
* Ability to work across research code, systems code, and product infrastructure without losing rigor at either layer
* Strong technical judgment around the tradeoffs between model quality, infra complexity, scalability, interpretability, and operational cost
  
  

Strong Bonus Signals

* Experience with
  ****alignment, interpretability, or AI safety systems****
* Experience with
  ****multi-cluster scheduling****

  , inference optimization, or serving infrastructure for large models
* Experience converting internal research frameworks into reusable platform capabilities
* Experience debugging production failures caused by interactions between model behavior, orchestration systems, and infrastructure
* Experience with agent runtimes, tool orchestration, long-horizon execution, or stateful model systems
  
  

What This Role Is Not

* Not a prompt-engineering role
* Not a glue-code integration role
* Not a research-only role disconnected from deployment
* Not a junior role
  
  

This role is for engineers who want to work on the hardest layer in applied AI: the boundary where
****model science, platform architecture, and production systems****

collide.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

title: Software Engineer
description:
India is the world's second-largest producer of fruits and vegetables, and loses over a lakh crore rupees of it every year between the farm and the shelf. Fresh Platter exists to fix that – not with an app, but by running the supply chain ourselves and engineering every step of it. We are hiring software engineers to build the brains of that system.

**About Fresh Platter**

Fresh Platter is a technology-driven fresh-produce supply-chain company, founded in Bengaluru in 2022. Every day we source from farms, then ripen, grade, pack and deliver fresh produce, using technology and data to improve quality, ensure consistent supply, minimise wastage and bring predictability to pricing. Around 100 people run the chain end to end, and the business is profitable.

We are also building our own machines and systems, because the bottlenecks we find in our operations cannot be fixed with software alone. Our harvest-handling rig cut bruising from around 30% to around 3%. Systems for farm selection, field scanning, produce movement and a fully automated packhouse are in build and design, with IISc and partner engineering firms. Five patent applications are filed.

Everything is built in three layers: a physical layer that moves and conditions produce, a sensing layer that reads its state, and an intelligence layer that decides what happens next and learns from the result. The crop changes. The architecture stays.

**The role**

We are building a high-quality software engineering team to own the sensing and intelligence layers, and the applications that run the business around them. You will join an existing team under our Tech Manager, and you will be expected to raise its bar, not just fill a seat.

We build with a new generation of AI-assisted development tools, seriously and every day. A small, sharp team here ships what used to need a large one. We will train you from your first week. If you already use these tools, good. If you have never touched one, that is fine – what we need is the raw ability to learn fast, think clearly and get things done.

**What you will build**

**Machines and sensing**

•   

The software that configures and controls our machines – reading their sensors, turning that data into decisions, and sending the right instructions back.

•   

The data path from sensor to screen: collection, storage, monitoring and alerts.

•   

Prototype-to-production work with our mechanical engineers, IISc and partner teams, tested on real machines in a real packhouse.

**Products and applications**

•   

The applications that run the chain: farm sourcing and procurement, ripening, grading and packing, inventory, logistics, quality and farm-to-customer traceability.

•   

Dashboards and alerts so teams see problems as they happen, not in next month's report.

•   

Integrations with the systems we already run – accounting, projects, mail and messaging – so data is captured once and flows wherever it is needed.

**AI-driven automation**

•   

Automation of the repetitive work across procurement, accounts and operations – checking purchase orders and vendor bills against their supporting documents, reconciliations, reporting and follow-ups.

•   

AI agents that read documents, emails and system records, decide what to do and act on it, with a person approving where it matters.

**Engineering practice**

•   

Own what you ship after it goes live – monitoring, fixes and improvements.

•   

Work across the stack: front end, back end, APIs, databases, device communication and data pipelines.

•   

Write tests, review code, deploy safely and document what you build.

•   

If you join with experience, help set the team's engineering standards and mentor the engineers who join after you.

**Who we are looking for**

•   

B.E. or B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Electronics and Telecommunication, Electrical and Electronics, or a closely related engineering stream.

•   

0 to 4 years of experience. Freshers with a strong academic record and engineers who have shipped production software are both welcome. Title and responsibility will match experience.

•   

Solid programming fundamentals and problem-solving skills in at least one language.

•   

A working understanding of databases, web applications and APIs, and the ability to debug code you did not write.

•   

Someone who learns fast, goes deep rather than skimming, works around obstacles and stays steady when priorities change – humble enough to be trained from scratch, confident enough to question what does not make sense.

•   

You do not need to be from a top-tier college.

**What to know before you apply**

This is an on-site role at our facility in Cheemasandra, Bengaluru East, six days a week, with no remote or hybrid option – the machines you will work on are here. The team is lean, problems rarely arrive with neat specifications, and the hours are long. This is not a comfortable job. It is the fastest way we know to become an exceptionally capable engineer.

**Why join us**

•   

Your code runs real machines and a real supply chain the moment it is ready – no release queues, no waiting months to see your work in use.

•   

Patented systems co-developed with IISc and engineering firms, not another CRUD app.

•   

Learn AI-assisted development in your first job, not your fifth.

•   

Real ownership from your first month, working close to a founder who spent 18+ years in software and data systems before building this company.

•   

Grow as fast as you can prove yourself. We hire on potential and promote on delivery.

**What success looks like**

•   

Within 3 months, you are shipping features to production on your own.

•   

Within 6 months, you own one or more of our products end to end.

•   

Within 12 months, you can take any problem in the business and build the software that solves it.

**The details**

•   

Location: Cheemasandra, Bengaluru East, Karnataka

•   

Work mode: On-site, six days a week

•   

Employment type: Full-time

•   

Experience: 0 to 4 years (freshers welcome)

•   

Openings: Up to 2

•   

Reports to: Tech Manager

title: Founding Software Engineer
description:
About the role

Recruitcha.ai is sales intelligence for recruitment agencies. We watch the market for hiring signals so agency recruiters know which companies to call, who to talk to, and why now. Our products include Jobs Listener, Social Listener, ATS Graveyard and Market Mapping.

We're three people. We're bootstrapped and profitable, with 100+ agencies using our platform. The founders spent 10+ years running and selling into recruiting agencies, so we already know what our customers need. Our job is to build it well.

We built the first version fast, using AI heavily. It works, and customers pay for it. Some of it is held together with duct tape. We're hiring our first engineer to turn it into a platform that scales without losing the speed that got us here.

At a glance

**Location**
: Remote, with 2+ hours of daily overlap with US PST time

**Team**
: 3 people today; you'd be the first engineer

**Reports to:**
The founders

What you'll own

You'll decide what to refactor, what to rebuild, and what to leave alone. Here are the problems on the table today:

* **Signal ingestion.**
  We pull hiring signals from job boards, ATS pages, social activity and third-party data providers. Much of it runs on scheduled jobs that fail silently. It needs to become a reliable pipeline with monitoring, retries and deduplication.
* **Data model at scale.**
  Companies, contacts, jobs and signals have grown faster than our Supabase schema was designed for. Queries are slowing down and the data has duplicates.
* **Agentic workflows.**
  Our AI agents research accounts, find decision-makers and draft outreach. They work well in demos. Before we can trust them across every customer, they need evals, guardrails, cost controls and observability.
* **Engineering foundations.**
  We need CI, tests where they matter, staging environments, and a deploy process that doesn't depend on luck.
* **New product.**
  Customers ask for features every week. You'll work with the founders to decide what to build and then ship it across the full stack.

Your first 90 days

1. **By day 30:**
   You've shipped to production, sat in on customer calls, and mapped the codebase. You've told us what's fragile and what's fine.
2. **By day 60:**
   You've fixed the worst reliability problem, likely signal ingestion. Failures now alert someone instead of disappearing.
3. **By day 90:**
   You own deploys, monitoring and the technical roadmap. You're shipping customer features every week, and we make architecture decisions based on your judgment.

Our stack

* **Frontend:**
  Next.js, TypeScript
* **Backend:**
  Node.js, Python, Supabase (Postgres)
* **AI:**
  model providers, e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google

You don't need experience with all of these. We want a strong engineer first, and the stack can change if you make the case.

You'll probably be a great fit if you've

* Taken a prototype or MVP to production and kept it running under real customer load
* Owned features end to end, from the database to the UI
* Inherited a messy codebase and improved it without stopping to rewrite everything
* Built data pipelines, scrapers or integrations that had to be reliable
* Shipped something with LLMs that ran in production, beyond a demo
* Worked as a founding engineer, an early startup engineer, or a senior full-stack engineer

This probably isn't the role for you if you want

* Detailed specs before you start building
* A large engineering team to learn from
* A frontend-only or backend-only role
* Someone else to make the technical decisions

How we work

We're remote and open to great people anywhere. You'll need at least 3 hours of overlap each workday with the founders, who work on US PST time. During that overlap we talk directly with you, not through tickets. The rest of your day is yours to plan.

We care about clear communication, ownership, and what you ship. Priorities shift as customers teach us things, and you'll help decide what comes next.

Hiring process

We aim to go from first call to offer in about [2 to 3] weeks.

1. **Intro call (30 min)**
   with a founder about the role, the business, and what you want next.
2. **Technical conversation (60 min):**
   we walk through our architecture together and ask how you'd approach one of the problems above.
3. **Paid trial project:**
   a small, real piece of work in our codebase.
4. **Founder conversations,**
   then an offer.

title: Staff AI Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Staff AI Engineer, you will lead the architecture, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of our AI Agents and the underlying infrastructure that powers it. You will design and deploy AI agents and robust MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that standardize data connectivity, skills, and tools. You will also own the full stack, from design and clean code implementation to rigorous testing and production support. By balancing high-level system strategy with hands-on technical execution, you will ensure our agentic workflows are scalable, secure, and seamlessly integrated into the enterprise ecosystem.
  
  
You will partner with internal teams and external contractors to lead technical reviews, integrations, and delivery execution. You will delivery using Coding Agents, establish testing approaches for prompts and model performance, and implement observability for AI features. We value autonomy, continuous learning, and clear business impact. If you are excited by this work but unsure whether you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build AI-native application experiences
* Build AI Agents, MCP Servers, Tools and integrate LLM / generative AI capabilities into products, including structured prompting, memory management and context management.
* Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns (e.g., embeddings + retrieval) and contribute to context-aware and personalized user experiences
* Drive end-to-end execution of medium-to-large features with independence, contribute to technical direction within the team
* Mentor engineers; guide contractors and partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field
* 6+ years of experience using at least one general purpose programming language (Python [preferred], Java, or Go) and front-end experience with JavaScript/TypeScript
* Proven track record shipping production applications that incorporate LLMs, MCPs or AI services at scale
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and providing guidance to external contractors or vendors
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and advanced containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with technical oversight, code review processes, and quality assurance methodologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cloud Software Development, including architecture design, technical leadership, and system optimization
* Experience with Strands, ADK or Agent development frameworks.
* Experience with multiple LLM providers and advanced AI orchestration frameworks (e.g. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangChain)
* Experience with modern front-end frameworks (React, Vue, or Angular) and advanced state management
* Experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector) and embedding model optimization
* Experience with enterprise RAG architectures, semantic search optimization, and conversation memory management at scale
* Experience building and scaling AI-powered features for 100k+ users

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team offers the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive-scale, coordinated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant environment. OCI delivers cloud products that support customers tackling some of the world’s most complex and business-critical challenges.

OCI Infrastructure Delivery Engineering is a growing organization responsible for building services and tools that accelerate how OCI expands its compute and network capacity. Our platform supports the end-to-end lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. It enables OCI to scale efficiently in existing regions and launch new regions while meeting the high-capacity demands of large and hyperscale customers.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Software Development Engineer to help design, build, and operate this foundational platform. You will work on highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. This is a greenfield environment with significant autonomy to innovate, while integrating with OCI systems through established service contracts.

You will be a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging distributed-systems problems, values simplicity and customer impact, and takes ownership of quality in production. You will collaborate closely with engineers and partner teams to deliver reliable services that help OCI continue to grow its global footprint.

2.2. About You

* You are a cloud development engineer who has contributed to high-scale, high-impact solutions.
* You are customer-focused and consistently look for ways to exceed expectations.
* You communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with diverse partners.
* You hold yourself and your work to a high standard, continuously seeking better engineering outcomes.
* You are comfortable operating in an evolving environment and can bring structure to ambiguity.
* You are passionate about technology, able to advocate for your ideas constructively, and open to evidence-based alternatives.

2.3. Minimum Qualifications

* BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 1+ year designing, delivering, or operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; working knowledge of scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Experience contributing to products from the ground up through the full software development lifecycle.
* Understanding of microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication protocols, and techniques for building highly reliable services.
* Familiarity with service observability, including dashboards, critical service metrics, alarms, and operational health indicators.
* Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and programming paradigms.
* Experience with production operations and practices for safely deploying quality code, participating in on-call rotations, and troubleshooting incidents.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing through design documents, proposals, architecture diagrams, and presentations.

2.4. Preferred Qualifications

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Experience building control-plane or data-plane solutions for cloud-native platforms.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving performance, reliability, or scaling issues in complex distributed environments.
* Understanding of the physical asset lifecycle in a cloud-scale data center.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems or related tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Familiarity with modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.

2.5. Responsibilities

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Work with engineers and partner teams to define and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for the physical asset lifecycle.
* Investigate issues across the stack, resolve root causes, and improve service reliability, performance, and operational readiness.
* Apply sound distributed-systems and cloud-infrastructure principles to deliver resilient production services.
* Build and maintain meaningful service telemetry, dashboards, alarms, and runbooks to support operational excellence.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response; use operational learnings to drive durable improvements.
* Contribute to technical designs, architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering standards.
* Balance speed and quality through iterative, incremental delivery and thoughtful prioritization.
* Work independently on well-defined problems and provide technical mentorship and support to junior engineers.
* Communicate progress, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly, and help build consensus using data and sound engineering judgment.

title: Software Engineer - AI
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an AI-Native Software Engineers to help transform our software development process into an AI-first engineering model. In this role, you will use AI tools as a primary development partner to convert requirements into working software solutions faster, while maintaining strong responsibility for quality, correctness, security, and production readiness.
  
  
You will be expected to take business and technical requirements, create precise prompts and implementation plans, generate a significant portion of the initial solution using AI, and then carefully validate the output for hallucinations, prompt accuracy, missing logic, incorrect assumptions, and alignment with expected outcomes. The goal is not simply to generate code quickly, but to deliver reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software using AI as an accelerator.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience using AI tools for coding, design, testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring. You should be comfortable working with ambiguity, breaking down requirements into AI-executable tasks, reviewing AI-generated code, and taking full ownership of the final solution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Use AI-assisted development tools to generate, test, document, refactor, and improve software solutions.
* Convert product and business requirements into clear technical prompts, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Generate 80–90% of initial solution drafts using AI tools, then review, validate, and refine the output.
* Detect and correct AI hallucinations, inaccurate assumptions, invalid code, security issues, and gaps in requirements.
* Create automated tests to verify expected behavior and business outcomes.
* Ensure all AI-generated code meets company standards for architecture, security, maintainability, performance, and documentation.
* Build reusable prompt templates and AI-native development workflows for common engineering tasks.
* Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, architecture, and security teams to deliver production-ready solutions.
* Document prompts, assumptions, validation steps, risks, and final implementation decisions.
* Help educate and guide other engineers in adopting AI-native software development practices.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of software development experience
* Strong software engineering background with experience building production-grade applications.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages.
* Experience using AI coding tools or large language models for software development.
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, cloud services, testing, CI/CD, and secure coding practices.
* Ability to write precise prompts and evaluate AI-generated outputs critically.
* Strong debugging, testing, code review, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to identify hallucinations, incorrect logic, missing edge cases, and gaps between generated code and requirements.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Strong sense of ownership for final deliverables, regardless of whether the initial code was AI-generated.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools.
* Experience creating prompt libraries, AI development workflows, or internal engineering automation.
* Experience with LLM applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or workflow orchestration.
* Experience leading process transformation or helping engineering teams adopt new development practices.
* Knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage.

What We Expect From This Role
  
  
This role is designed for an engineer who can operate in a future-facing development model. You will not only write code; you will design the way software is created with AI. You will be responsible for accelerating delivery while ensuring that every final output is correct, tested, secure, and aligned with business expectations.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
**Autonomize AI**
is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients.
  
  
We're looking for engineers who don't just
*integrate*
AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end.
  
  
This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry.
  
  
**You're a Fit If You Have**

* AI-native engineering is your default mode
* You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
* You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
* You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing

title: Lead Software Engineer - AI Automation
description:
**AI Automation Engineer**
**Let’s be unstoppable together!**
At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.
  
  
Learn more at www.circana.com
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an AI Automation Engineer to join Circana’s AI & Automation transformation program. In this role, you will build and ship production automations that integrate Python, REST APIs, data stores, and Large Language Models into end-to-end solutions across Circana’s global Operations Division. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will take process specifications and turn them into deployed, monitored, production systems — working in short-cycle sprint pods that deliver a working automation within a single quarter. The program targets millions in run-rate cost savings across 17 operational value stream areas, and you will be a core part of making that happen.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Take process specifications from the Solutions Architect function and design the technical approach, including data flow, integration points, LLM components, error handling, and human-in-the-loop touchpoints.
* Build automations in Python: REST API calls, data store reads and writes, transformation logic, LLM integration, output validation, and the orchestration that ties it together.
* Integrate LLMs into production workflows — including prompt engineering, structured output parsing, and output validation against defined quality thresholds.
* Write tests that cover core logic, integration with external dependencies, and output quality checks for LLM components against defined acceptance criteria.
* Deploy solutions to production, monitor initial runs, and manage hypercare through to stable operation.
* Contribute to the program’s shared patterns library and component library as reusable patterns emerge across automation projects.
* Maintain code in a shared repository with branching, pull request review, and documentation standards established by the programme.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies (planning, daily standup, review, retrospective) and surface blockers early and constructively.
* Build lightweight full-stack tooling (React frontends, FastAPI backends) when automations require a human-facing interface such as review queues, exception dashboards, approval workflows, or configuration surfaces.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of multi-step agentic workflows, including tool use, memory, planning, and evaluation frameworks as the programme’s agentic automation capability matures.
* Hand off completed automations to operations teams with documentation that a non-engineer can follow.

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of Python development experience in a production environment — systems that run, fail, get fixed, and run again, not scripts on a laptop.
* Solid REST API integration experience: authentication patterns, rate limiting, pagination, error handling, and the debugging skills to diagnose integration failures without documentation.
* Working knowledge of relational and cloud data stores (PostgreSQL, Snowflake, S3/Blob storage): SQL for querying and writing, and enough understanding of schema to navigate one you did not design.
* Direct experience integrating Large Language Models into production workflows: prompt engineering, structured output parsing, output validation, and the discipline to handle hallucination as an engineering problem.
* Git proficiency: branching strategy, pull request discipline, meaningful commit messages, and the ability to review code constructively.
* The ability to read a process specification and ask the right questions before writing a line of code — identifying what is undocumented, what assumption is doing the most work, and where things will break first.
* Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and sprint-based tooling (Jira or equivalent).
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain what an automation does, what it cannot do, and what happens when it fails — to stakeholders who are not technical.

**Circana Behaviors**
As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:
  
  

* Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
* Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
* Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
* Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
* Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
* Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
* Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

**Location:**
This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote (Bangalore/Pune)
  
  
An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your consent.

title: Software Engineer (Data & AIML)
description:
**About Maersk**
Maersk is building the next generation of digital capabilities for the global supply chain.
  
  
We are re-architecting our platform with a data-first approach — building a trusted, scalable and reusable data foundation for current and future supply-chain use cases.
  
  
On top of this foundation, we will build ML models, intelligence, recommendations, GenAI and agentic AI to help customers and teams make better and faster decisions.
  
  
A key part of this vision is data democratization — making trusted and contextualised data easy to discover, understand and use across teams, products, models and AI agents.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Data, AI/ML, GenAI & Agentic AI Engineer to help design and build this platform from the ground up.
  
  
This role combines data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML and architecture. You will build reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions and work closely with engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams and supply-chain experts.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and build scalable data and AI architecture for data-intensive systems.
* Build trusted data foundations and reusable data products from multiple sources.
* Build reliable batch, streaming and near-real-time data pipelines based on business needs.
* Enable data democratization and self-service access to trusted data.
* Build capabilities for data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, security and observability.
* Establish common business context and semantics so data can be effectively used by applications, ML models, GenAI and AI agents.
* Develop and productionise ML solutions for prediction, forecasting, risk, anomaly detection, recommendations and optimisation

Build production-grade GenAI/LLM solutions using approaches such as RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling.
  
  

* Build agentic AI solutions that can reason over trusted data, use tools and APIs, provide recommendations and take actions.
* Design appropriate guardrails, access controls, monitoring and human oversight for AI and agentic solutions.
* Build reusable APIs, services and workflows that connect data, applications and AI capabilities.
* Use platforms such as Pipedream or similar workflow tools where they add value.
* Make architecture and technology decisions considering scalability, reliability, security, performance and cost.
* Establish strong engineering practices including testing, CI/CD and observability.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design and code reviews.
* Mentor engineers and help establish engineering and architecture standards

**About You**
We are looking for someone with strong engineering, data and AI fundamentals who can build production-ready systems.
  
  
You should have:
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related field.
* Experience designing and building scalable, distributed and data-intensive systems.
* Experience contributing to or owning architecture and technical design for data or AI platforms.
* Strong programming skills in Java and Python. Experience with Scala, Kotlin or similar languages is a plus.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, distributed systems and data processing.
* Experience building data pipelines, data products or data platforms at scale.
* Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Databricks, Flink or equivalent.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases
* Good understanding of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage and observability.
* Hands-on experience taking ML models from development to production, including deployment, monitoring and evaluation.
* Experience with GenAI/LLMs and building practical, production-ready applications.
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling and LLM evaluation.
* Experience or strong exposure to AI agents and agentic workflows.
* Understanding of AI security, guardrails, access control and human oversight.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* Strong software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD and production operations.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* A platform mindset — focused on building reusable capabilities rather than oneoff solutions.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in logistics, shipping, transportation or supply chain.
* Experience with real-time and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with MLOps and model monitoring.
* Experience with production RAG, AI agents or agent orchestration.
* Experience with MCP or similar agent/tool integration patterns.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic models or entity resolution.
* Experience with Pipedream or similar workflow/integration platforms.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience leading technical design or architecture for large-scale platforms.

**Why This Role**
This is a greenfield opportunity to help build the foundation for the next generation of supply-chain intelligence at Maersk. Our vision is: Data Foundation → Data Products & Context → ML & Intelligence → Recommendations → GenAI → Agentic AI The data foundation is the core layer, providing trusted, reusable and contextualised data to products, ML models, GenAI applications and AI agents.
  
  
The goal is to build a platform where new data and AI capabilities can be developed faster, reused across multiple use cases and scaled across the supply chain without repeatedly rebuilding the underlying foundation. You will help shape the architecture, data foundation, engineering practices and AI capabilities that will enable future digital supply-chain experiences at Maersk.

* Configure and manage checkpointing and savepoints in Apache Flink to achieve exactly‑once processing guarantees, supporting reliable recovery and zero‑data‑loss deployments.
* Develop Flink jobs with strong understanding of event‑time semantics, including watermarks, late event handling, and windowing strategies (tumbling, sliding, session windows).
* Optimize Flink pipelines for high throughput and low latency, tuning parallelism, task slots, state backends (e.g., RocksDB), and back‑pressure handling.
* Integrate Apache Flink with Kafka as source and sink, ensuring efficient offset management, schema evolution compatibility, and reliable end‑to‑end processing semantics.
* Apply best practices for fault tolerance and resiliency, handling task failures, job restarts, and state recovery in distributed Flink clusters.
* Support observability of Flink jobs, enabling visibility into job health, throughput, lag, checkpoint performance, and failure patterns through logs, metrics, and dashboards.
* Deliver software using Agile methodologies, actively participating in sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
* Champion engineering discipline, automation, and data‑driven decision making across delivery cycles.
* Strong familiarity with modern developer tooling including GitLab, DevSecOps pipelines, and secure CI/CD practices.

* Ensure test coverage and automation are embedded into CI/CD pipelines, not treated as post‑delivery activities.
* Working knowledge of AWS services relevant to event‑driven and streaming workloads.
* Experience deploying and operating workloads on Kubernetes (K8s), including container orchestration and scaling concepts.
* Demonstrate strong awareness and practical adoption of AI‑assisted engineering practices with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitLab Duo, Copilot or equivalent) to support code generation, refactoring, documentation, and test creation, while retaining engineering judgement and accountability.

title: System Software Engineer - Performance Verification Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Join NVIDIA's GPU Performance Infrastructure team and be part of a brand-new journey in validating and shipping next-generation GPU architectures. With our bold standards and extraordinary team, you'll have the chance to define a significant impact on the future of computing!
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Design and maintain automated chip performance verification pipelines spanning workload trace generation, multi-target test execution, results post-processing, and correlation with architectural performance targets.
* Develop performance monitoring and measurement infrastructure that provides consistent observability across simulation, emulation, and silicon environments.
* Build scalable data pipelines and full-stack dashboards to ingest, visualize, and compare performance metrics across builds and environments.
* Coordinate with GPU architects to craft infrastructure for performance verification of upcoming architectures.
* Work closely with HW teams to automate and accelerate verification workflows, enabling faster GPU build iteration.
* Empower GPU architects by providing insights to understand current performance and model industry-leading performance for future builds.
* Improve the daily workflows of the world's top chip architects, contributing to the creation of the next greatest generation of GPUs!

**What We Need To See**

* BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of software engineering experience, primarily in C++, with Python for tooling and automation.
* Strong CS fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, OOP, and system design.
* Full-stack experience with backend (Java/Python), REST APIs, and modern frontend (React/Ember) for data-intensive applications is a plus.
* Proficiency in databases (SQL, MongoDB) for metrics storage and querying is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and messaging systems (RabbitMQ) is a plus.
* Exposure to GPU/CPU/SoC chip performance verification is a plus.
* Familiarity with AI development tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.

description:

Euromonitor International leads the world in data analytics and research into markets, industries, economies and consumers. We provide truly global insight and data on thousands of products and services; we are the first destination for organisations seeking growth. With our guidance, our clients can make bold, strategic decisions with confidence.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The HR Systems Administrator manages and improves our global HR technology platform, with a primary focus on SAP SuccessFactors. The role provides reliable administration and support across Employee Central and Performance Management and supports the rollout of the Compensation module.
  
  
**Working within the Enterprise Applications team, the role manages key integrations, supports the recruitment platform and delivers system improvements that strengthen HR services, data quality and employee experience. The HR Systems Administrator works closely with HR, Technology and external partners to take requirements and tasks from inception through to successful completion.**
**Requirements**

* Performance Management support: Maintain and improve Performance Management processes, forms and system functionality to support effective performance cycles.
* Compensation module rollout: Support the design, testing, implementation and ongoing administration of the SuccessFactors Compensation module to enable an effective global compensation process.
* Integration management: Monitor, maintain and troubleshoot key integrations between HR and enterprise applications to protect data accuracy and operational continuity.

* Release management: Assess SuccessFactors releases, coordinate regression testing and document recommended actions.
* Reporting and data operations: Build and maintain reports; support data uploads, validation, reconciliation and controlled mass changes.
* Testing and deployment: Prepare test scenarios and evidence, track defects, coordinate retesting and support controlled production deployment.

* Strong practical knowledge of SuccessFactors Employee Central and Performance Management.
* Experience supporting the implementation or administration of SuccessFactors Compensation.
* Sound understanding of HR systems integrations, interfaces and data flows.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify root causes and deliver reliable solutions.
* Knowledge of HR processes, employee data, access controls and data governance.

* Strong stakeholder management, organisation and communication skills, with a record of taking work from inception through to completion.

* Experience with HR reporting, data validation, reconciliation and controlled mass changes.

**Job Description**
**Global Product Marketing Manager-DXR**
In this role, you will own and drive product marketing for the assigned Diagnostic X-ray (DXR) portfolio, shaping product positioning, value propositions and go-to-market strategies across the product lifecycle. * Engages with customers, clinicians, Key Opinion Leaders, and markets to capture insights and translate them into product messaging, commercial priorities, and future portfolio needs.
* Acts as a DXR product and market subject-matter expert, supporting sales teams in strategic customer opportunities with product expertise, competitive positioning, and clinical and economic value stories.
* Develops and maintains competitive intelligence for assigned portfolio areas, translating competitor products, claims, positioning, and market developments into actionable guidance for Sales and Markets.
* Partners with Product Management, Clinical, Regulatory, Service, Sales, and regional marketing teams to ensure customer-facing claims and materials are accurate, differentiated, clinically relevant, and compliant.
* Drives global-to-local activation, providing markets with adaptable campaign assets, sales tools, customer stories, and guidance while incorporating regional requirements and competitive dynamics.
* Identifies and develops growth opportunities across the installed base, including upgrades, replacements, software/features, and portfolio cross-sell opportunities.
* Tracks product marketing effectiveness and commercial impact, using market feedback, customer engagement, funnel performance, competitive developments, and business results to continuously improve activation.

**You Are The Right Fit**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Sales, Product Management or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree or 8+ years with a Master's degree in product marketing, brand management, B2B/B2C/B2G marketing or go-to-market execution in the medtech industry.
* Proven expertise in product positioning, portfolio management, product launches and integrated marketing strategies.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate customer, clinical and competitive insights into compelling value propositions and growth opportunities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across global and regional teams.
* Experience in omnichannel marketing, customer engagement, content strategy and sales enablement.
* Strong strategic thinking, project management and continuous improvement capabilities, with a focus on delivering measurable business impact.
* LEAN Six Sigma certification is desirable.

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  
  
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
This role is an office-based role.
  
  
**About Philips**
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  
  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: SEO Content Specialist
description:
**About Donorbox**
Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀
  
  
Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.
  
  
🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an SEO Content Specialist to help execute our content and AI-first search strategy. You'll build topical authority and create content that ranks on search engines and gets cited by AI answer engines like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Your work will be measured by its impact on traffic, AI visibility and sign-ups, not by how much you publish.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Write, edit and refresh content that meets E-E-A-T standards: real expertise, author credibility, accurate sources and first-hand insight.
* Collaborate and work closely with the content team to plan, brief and produce content that supports our search and AI visibility goals.
* Collaborate and work closely with the tech team to implement technical SEO changes, schema and site improvements, and make sure they ship on time.
* Create content frameworks, including templates, brief formats and structure guidelines, so content is consistent, AI-first and easy to produce at scale.
* Track AI visibility and citations against competitors, test new tactics, and adjust the strategy based on what works.
* Improve click-through rates from search by testing and optimising titles, meta descriptions and rich results.
* Make our content AI-first, so it's easy for both search engines and LLMs to retrieve, understand and cite. That means clear answers, structured formats, entity-rich copy and strong source signals.
* Research keywords, entities and search intent, and plan semantically complete content around business goals.
* Build topical maps and pillar-cluster (hub-and-spoke) content structures that establish topical authority in our core areas.
* Own on-page and technical SEO: internal linking, schema markup, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals and site architecture.
* Report monthly on traffic, rankings, CTR, AI visibility and conversions.
* Help execute our AEO and GEO strategy, supporting decisions on which topics, questions and platforms to prioritise so the brand shows up in AI-generated answers.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Excellent written and spoken English.
* 3-5 years of experience in SEO content writing or content marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Proven experience creating topical maps and content frameworks, and turning them into pillar-cluster content plans.
* Hands-on experience with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and a CMS such as WordPress.
* Solid technical SEO knowledge, including site audits, schema, internal linking, indexation issues and basic HTML.
* A practical understanding of AEO, GEO and how LLMs and AI search engines find and cite content.
* A strong grasp of topical authority, topic clusters, semantic SEO, entities and E-E-A-T.
* Experience executing SEO or content strategies with measurable results.
* Strong ownership, attention to quality and a record of delivering on time.

description:
**Description**
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a Business Development Manager to own end-to-end strategy and execution for three new verticals under the Associates program: AI Content, Shoppable Media and Monetization. This is a charter-building role. You will take these verticals from 1 to 10, partnering with cross-functional teams inside Amazon and influencing CXO-level stakeholders at India's top publishers to build Amazon's distributed commerce engine.
  
  
This role is part of the Amazon India Performance Marketing team.
  
  
What Makes This Role Exciting
  
  
You will build, not just manage. Shoppable Media, AI Content, and Monetization are new verticals with significant potential. You will define the strategy, build the partnerships, and shape how Amazon India approaches distributed commerce.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of media, commerce, and AI. This is one of the few roles where you get to work across publisher CXOs, Amazon Ads leadership, WW product teams, and Retail category heads, all in service of building something new.
  
  
The charter is real and the ambition is high. You are joining a team that is taking new verticals from 1 to 10 through strategy, meticulous execution, and fast experimentation. The opportunity to shape what comes next is wide open.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
You have deep knowledge of India's digital media landscape, publisher business models, and content monetization trends. You know the key players and how deals get done.
  
  
You have a track record of building partnerships or programs from the ground up, not just managing existing ones. You are comfortable with ambiguity and move fast through it.
  
  
You think strategically about long-term business trends while staying grounded in meticulous execution. You can see where the market is heading and build plans to get there.
  
  
You bring analytical rigor to decision-making. You can build compelling, data-backed value propositions and use numbers to tell a story.
  
  
You are effective at influencing without authority, working cross-organizationally across product, category, ads, and leadership teams to build alignment and drive outcomes.
  
  
You are willing to roll up your sleeves and operate with limited guidance. You bring curiosity, commercial instincts, and strong business judgment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own the strategy for AI Content development and Shoppable Media. You will set the direction, build the playbook, and drive execution through fast experimentation.
  
  
Build acquisition engine for Shoppable Media by partnering with India's largest Media and Lifestyle publishers. Define the value proposition, lead CXO-level conversations, and close partnerships that scale.
  
  
Partner with Ads, Category, and Finance stakeholders to build strong processes that scale monetization across Sponsored Products, Amazon Ads, and Co-op programs.
  
  
Develop and drive monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-term content acquisition objectives through Media and Lifestyle publishers. Own growth targets and path to get there.
  
  
Accelerate adoption of Amazon Storefronts and supporting tools - Advertising APIs, education resources, Automated Product Tagging and reporting to power AI and Shoppable Media at scale.
  
  
Work closely with leadership and World-wide product teams to inform the product roadmap, providing structured feedback on product requirements grounded in publisher and creator needs.
  
  
Bring industry insights, trends, and Voice of Customer into every decision. Partner with the Research and Insights team to build an outside-in view that shapes strategy and investment priorities.
  
  
Partner with Marketing, Ads, and Retail category leaders to support strategic Amazon businesses and unlock cross-functional growth.

Amazon Associates program sits at the intersection of customer intent and commerce, connecting shoppers with products through a large partner network of publishers and associates. The program is a core pillar of Amazon India's performance marketing engine.

* 4+ years of business development, partnership management, or sourcing new business experience

* Experience in setting up and managing a sales pipeline

Job Title
  
  
Marketing Operations & Events Manager
  
  
**Job Description**
**Marketing Operations & Events Manager**
The role will lead integrated marketing planning and execution across business and regional teams, driving consistent brand communication and impactful customer engagement. It will oversee marketing operations, campaigns, events, agency and budget management, and performance measurement, while ensuring cross-functional alignment, operational excellence and compliance within a medical technology environment.
  
  
**Your Role**

* Leads integrated marketing planning and execution across business and Regional/Zonal teams, translating marketing strategy into coordinated campaigns, communications, events and customer-facing activations.
* Drives marketing communications execution across relevant channels and touchpoints, ensuring consistent messaging, brand alignment and high-quality delivery of marketing assets and programs.
* Manages creative, communications, digital and event agencies, including development of briefs, scope of work, timelines, deliverables, cost management and performance against agreed objectives.
* Owns marketing budget planning and operational management, including budget allocation, forecasting, spend tracking and prioritization of investments to maximize marketing impact.
* Leads and coordinates events, congresses, exhibitions and customer engagement programs, from objectives and concept development through agency/vendor coordination, execution and post-event measurement.
* Establishes and manages the annual marketing planning process, providing frameworks, calendars, templates and toolboxes that enable business and regional teams to plan and execute consistently.
* Ensures effective campaign and program management, managing multiple workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies, timelines and resources to deliver agreed outcomes on time and within budget.
* Defines and monitors KPIs and marketing performance, using insights to evaluate campaigns, communications and events and recommend improvements to marketing effectiveness and ROI.
* Identifies and implements opportunities to improve marketing operations, processes, tools and ways of working, reducing complexity and improving speed and quality of execution.
* Builds strong relationships across business, regional marketing, product marketing, sales and external partners to ensure priorities are aligned and marketing programs are effectively executed.
* Ensures marketing activities comply with applicable brand, regulatory and organizational requirements, particularly important within a medical technology environment.

**You Are The Right Fit**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree or 7 years with a Master's degree, with demonstrated experience across several of the following areas:

+ Marketing Communications - translating strategy into practical campaign plans, briefs, content and activation programs

+ Agency Management - managing significant marketing budgets and complex marketing programs

+ managing significant marketing budgets and complex marketing programs

+ Events, Congresses and Exhibitions - delivering large-scale events, congresses, exhibitions and customer engagements

+ Experience working in a matrixed, international organization

+ Experience in healthcare, medical devices, medical technology or another regulated industry would be advantageous.

**Preferred Skills**




+ Agency & Vendor Management
+ Budget Management
+ Events & Congress Management
+ KPI Monitoring & Marketing Measurement
+ Brand Management
+ Legal, Regulatory & Brand Compliance

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  
  
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
This role is an office-based role.
  
  
**About Philips**
