Xometry seeks a strategic and results-driven International Partner Marketing Lead who owns and drives Xometry’s international Partner Marketing function end-to-end, across all current and future sourcing markets. Sets the strategy, standards and frameworks for partner messaging, lifecycle engagement, acquisition, activation and knowledge management, and ensures consistent execution across regions. Leads a small team of regional partner marketing managers, each holding a dual mandate — strong regional ownership combined with a defined international functional responsibility — developed in close partnership with this role. Owns the partner marketing budget and ROI, and partners closely with Partner Network Management, Product and Marketing leadership to keep execution aligned with business priorities
  
  
**How You'll Contribute:**
**Strategy & Team Leadership**

* Own the international partner marketing function end to end, setting strategy, priorities and quarterly objectives across all sourcing markets
* Lead, coach and grow the regional partner marketing managers, defining and evolving each person's international functional mandate alongside their regional ownership
* Own the partner marketing budget and drive ROI across paid and organic initiatives

**Partner Awareness & Acquisition**

* Define the international framework for partner targeting, acquisition and paid campaigns, ensuring regional teams adapt it to local market specifics
* Shape go-to-market marketing strategy for new region launches, tailoring positioning and channel mix to local ecosystems

* Set the strategy to drive partner activity and level advancement across the lifecycle (onboarding, probation, etc.)

* Own the international knowledge management and lifecycle enablement agenda: a scalable, consistent, multilingual knowledge base and educational infrastructure for partners

* Partner closely with the Partner Network Management teams in each region and with the US Partner Marketing team, so priorities, campaigns and messaging are shaped together

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Network Design & Planning
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Senior**
**Technical Program Manager for Network Design & Planning**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. Based in Bangalore, this individual will drive the planning and execution of the team’s most important cross-functional programs, including new market and ground station launches, core and RAN capacity expansions, vendor deliveries, regulatory capabilities, and service maturity initiatives. You will bring structure, visibility, and pace to complex technical work spanning engineering teams, vendors, satellite operators, and MNO partners across multiple time zones.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Own end-to-end delivery of Network Design & Planning programs, such as network expansions, new ground station and market launches, core and RAN capacity upgrades, and regulatory capabilities (e.g. Lawful Intercept, emergency alerts).
* Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans across engineering, operations, product, and partner teams.
* Manage technical deliveries from network vendors (including our 5G core vendor), tracking scope, releases, acceptance testing, and contractual milestones.
* Coordinate with satellite operators, MNO partners, and ground station providers on joint technical plans and launch readiness.
* Identify and manage program risks, issues, and decisions, and drive timely escalation and resolution.
* Establish program operating rhythms, including status reporting, steering reviews, and dashboards for engineering leadership.
* Drive service maturity initiatives with Operations, including launch readiness checklists, runbooks, and handover from design to operations.
* Track network capacity and budget plans alongside engineering leads, and support vendor and procurement processes.
* Continuously improve the team’s planning, intake, and delivery processes and tooling (e.g. Jira, Confluence).
* Communicate clearly across time zones (India, Europe, and the US) to keep stakeholders aligned.

**What We Look For**

* 8+ years of experience in telecom, with at least 4 years in technical program or project management of network deployments, expansions, or vendor deliveries.
* Solid technical understanding of mobile networks (RAN, 4G/5G core, IMS, IP transport) sufficient to engage credibly with engineers and vendors.
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi-team technical programs on time, including with external vendors and partners.
* Strong skills in program planning, dependency and risk management, and executive-level status reporting.
* Experience managing network equipment or software vendors, including release tracking and acceptance testing.
* Experience working across distributed, multi-time-zone teams.
* Proficiency with program management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* Experience with satellite communications or Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) is a plus.
* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong stakeholder management and facilitation abilities.

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive occupational health coverage
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends multi-national characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
**About the Role**

You will own end-to-end delivery of private label programs for our key US big-box retail partners. You'll be the single point of contact for the retailer's cross-functional teams: Sourcing, Product Development, Quality, Packaging and Logistics. Internally, you'll drive PlayShifu's design, packaging, quality and operations teams so that every deliverable lands on time and to spec. You will run each program from product shortlisting to PO release, production and shipment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and run the Time & Action (TnA) plan for every program, working backwards from retailer calendars. It covers design freeze, tooling, T0/T1/T2, packaging, testing, production, inspections and ship dates.
* Lead weekly calls with retailer Sourcing, Quality and Logistics teams. Publish status updates and escalate risks early.
* Hold internal teams accountable to TnA milestones, and flag dependencies and delays before they become misses.
* Manage the retailer's PD portal: create product IDs, track design feedback and revisions, and coordinate sample requests and timelines with internal teams against retailer ETDs.
* Work with our Toy Design team so that every feedback loop closes within the agreed timelines.
* Consolidate documentation from internal teams, including BOM, measurements, claims and Manufacturing Variability. Get it submitted and approved on time.
* Translate the retailer's structural packaging guidelines and feedback into clear briefs and deadlines for our internal packaging team.
* Consolidate all packaging content (copy, claims, warnings, specs, imagery) from internal teams and submit it to the retailer.
* Lead the retailer-side proofing process with the retailer's artwork agency. Review soft and hard proofs for UPC/EAN, regulatory copy, battery instructions and font requirements, and route corrections through the internal packaging team.
* Track testing, inspection and audit milestones (DUPRO, FRI, TOP, quality and responsible sourcing audits) against the TnA. Work through the internal quality and operations teams, who manage labs, inspection agencies and factories.
* Act as the retailer's point of contact on quality and compliance. Make sure that issues, corrective actions and approvals are closed on time.
* Represent PlayShifu in placement and production-readiness reviews alongside the operations and quality team.
* Work with the operations team's systems & item setup function to keep vendor portal data (costing, item setup, case pack, vendor order points, factory mapping) accurate and consistent with what's been agreed with the retailer.
* Track item-wise progress from costing to PO release, and flag gaps or delays that could hold up a business award or PO.
* Support cost submissions and cost-change management, working with the Head of Sales.

**Requirements**

* 8–12 years in program management, merchandising or sourcing for consumer products. Toys, juvenile, hardlines or seasonal/outdoor preferred.
* Hands-on experience delivering private label programs for US big-box retailers. Buying house, sourcing agency, export house or vendor-side experience is ideal.
* Working knowledge of retailer vendor portals, product development workflows, packaging development and product compliance and testing. You need enough depth to review the work and challenge it. Hands-on vendor management is not required.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional teams without direct authority. You set the timelines, hold teams accountable and escalate early.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. You'll be the face of PlayShifu to senior retailer stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, comfort with structured trackers, and the ability to run several programs in parallel.
* Willingness to work with a US time-zone overlap, and to travel occasionally to retailer offices and production-readiness reviews.

**What We Offer**

* Visibility and ownership from day one, working directly with leadership.
* A fast-growing business with some of the world's largest retailers as partners.
* Freedom to build processes for a program that is set to scale significantly.

title: Senior Project Manager, Qualitative
description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.
  
  
Konovo provides healthcare organizations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients—the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. Our customers include over 300 global pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research agencies, and consultancy firms.
  
  
As we shift to a more product- and technology-driven organization, delivering best-in-class service to our customers is more important than ever. We're expanding our remote Client Services team and are looking for an experienced Senior Market Research Project Manager to own the full project lifecycle, from bid to invoice. In this role, you'll collaborate across the business, act as a connector between teams, and help us delight customers while growing our impact.
  
  
Our client base is primarily located in the US and EU, and in order to support those clients you will work 6:30pm-3:30am IST, our US coverage shift. If you're a Bengaluru, India-based, client-focused, results-driven market research professional who thrives in a hybrid fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* End-to-end project leadership: Lead multiple global market research projects from proposal acceptance through final invoicing, delivering on time, on budget, and to scope
* Client partnership: Serve as the primary point of contact—clarifying objectives, managing expectations, and providing proactive recommendations throughout the engagement
* Risk management & problem-solving: Identify risks early, remove blockers, and keep projects moving while surfacing opportunities to expand or deepen client partnerships
* Bid & proposal development: Partner with Sales and Research to build compelling proposals, pricing, and feasibility assessments that set projects up for success
* Operational execution: Oversee survey programming, translations, data collection, third party vendor management and field reporting to ensure smooth delivery and high-quality outputs
* Quality control: Implement best practices that protect data integrity and raise the bar on accuracy, reporting quality, and client satisfaction
* Budget & financial ownership: Track budgets, manage costs, and ensure accurate, timely invoicing and financial processing
* Cross-functional coordination: Align internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders to ensure seamless execution across time zones and functions

**What We're Looking For:**

* Experience: Minimum of 5-7+ years of market research project management experience in a client-facing role; prior healthcare experience is a must. Specific experience with healthcare consulting companies is a plus.
* English: Professional-level English (verbal and written)
* Communication skills: Clear, confident communicator who can translate needs into action and present recommendations to internal and external stakeholders
* Client-first mindset: Strong relationship builder with a focus on outcomes, responsiveness, and long-term value creation
* Technical skills: Proficiency with market research tools, methodologies, and project management systems (e.g., Decipher, Confirmit, Salesforce, MS, Excel, etc.)
* Attention to detail: Highly organized with strong analytical skills; able to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously
* Problem-solving ability: Resourceful and data-driven; able to navigate ambiguity and make sound decisions under pressure
* Results-driven: Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and accountability
* Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* AI-enabled tools: Comfortable leveraging AI-enabled tools to streamline workflows, improve response quality, and increase speed without compromising data integrity or customer experience.

**Why Konovo?**

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation that is empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI-enabled platform — so insights aren't just collected, they're connected.
* Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility.
* Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance.

Sr. Consultant - SAP BTP Job
  
  
Date: Oct 16, 2026
  
  
Job Requisition Id: 66657
  
  
Location:
  
  
Bangalore, KA, IN
  
  
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire SAP BTP Professionals in the following areas :**
**Job Description:**
Project Delivery Manager (PDM)
  
  

* External Role: Project Delivery Manager – SAP BTP
* Function: BTP Demands & Projects Management
* Reporting To: Head of BTP Demands & Projects / BTP Portfolio Management

Role Purpose
  
  

* The Project Delivery Manager (PDM) is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of SAP BTP projects across the complete BTP Operating Model.
* The role ensures predictable, governed, and high-quality delivery of BTP demands by acting as the single point of accountability between:

+ Business
+ Sector IT
+ BTP CoE teams (Design, Development, Platform)
+ Architecture
+ Governance
+ Validation
+ AMS teams

* The standard project execution within the BTP is primarily Agile Scrum based. In specific cases, it may be a Waterfall approach as well.
* The role will be involved in both types of project execution and therefore needs to be flexible between the models.
* Depending on skills, assignments will be done. An Agile project will include the Scrum Master role as well.

Role Objectives
  
  
**The Project Delivery Manager Is Responsible To:**

* Ensure consistent execution of the BTP Operating Model.
* Own delivery from Demand Intake to Closure.
* Reduce delivery friction, escalations, and stakeholder dissatisfaction.
* Provide clear accountability and transparency to Business and IT leadership.
* Enable development and platform teams to focus on execution by removing coordination overhead.

Scope of Accountability
  
  
The Project Delivery Manager owns delivery across the entire BTP lifecycle:
  
  

* Requirements
* Feasibility
* Design
* Estimation
* Approvals
* Preparation
* Build
* Test
* KT
* Deploy
* Hypercare
* Closure

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Demand Intake & Requirement Management
  
  

* Act as the single BTP coordinator for assigned demands/projects.
* Drive and coordinate URS requirement workshops.
* Ensure requirement clarity, completeness, and formal sign-off.
* Prevent duplication of requirement discussions across teams.

Feasibility, Design & Estimation
  
  

* Coordinate feasibility assessments across:

+ BTP Design Team
+ Development teams
+ Platform & Integration teams
+ Architecture and Governance

* Plan and chair design workshops and design demos.
* Consolidate effort estimates, capacity, timelines, and cost inputs.
* Coordinate estimation outcomes and validate feasibility with stakeholders.

Governance, Approvals & Readiness
  
  

* Coordinate approvals with:

+ Business Leads
+ Sector IT
+ BTP IT Leadership

* Ensure governance, architecture, security, validation, and compliance readiness.
* Track dependencies, constraints, and approval milestones.
* Maintain delivery readiness before build start.

Build, Test & Deployment Control
  
  

* Own delivery control during build and test phases.
* Run weekly status and dependency calls.
* Track milestones, risks, issues, and mitigations.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies (Design, Dev, Platform, ERP, Non-ERP).
* Ensure test readiness, defect tracking, and deployment coordination.

KT, Hypercare & Closure
  
  

* Coordinate AMS knowledge transfer and hypercare.
* Ensure smooth transition from Project to Run.
* Drive formal project closure:

+ Deliverable confirmation
+ Lessons learned
+ Final reporting

Communication & Reporting
  
  

* Provide consistent status reporting to Business and IT leadership.
* Maintain delivery dashboards, risks, issues, and action trackers.
* Proactively escalate risks and decision points.
* Ensure leadership visibility across the BTP portfolio.

Meeting & Coordination Ownership
  
  

* The Project Delivery Manager is the owner and coordinator for all project lifecycle engagements, including but not limited to:

+ Intake & prioritization meetings
+ Requirement & design workshops
+ Feasibility & estimation discussions
+ Governance & approval forums
+ Weekly delivery reviews
+ Hypercare & AMS KT sessions

* The PDM ensures one coordinated engagement model, replacing fragmented, multi-team coordination.

Key Interfaces
  
  
**The Project Delivery Manager Works Closely With:**

* Business Requestors & Business Project Leads
* Sector IT Project Leads
* BTP Demands Team
* BTP Design Team
* BTP Development Teams
* BTP Platform Services Team
* BTP Integration Team
* ERP Workstreams
* Non-ERP & AppTech Team
* Architecture & Governance Teams
* GxP / Validation Teams
* AMS / Run Teams

What This Role Is NOT
  
  
**To Avoid Ambiguity, The Project Delivery Manager Role:**

* Is not limited to Jira task or dashboard management.
* Is not scoped only to development teams.
* Is not responsible for Agile coaching or ceremonies.
* Agile Masters remain methodology-specific roles for Agile-qualified initiatives.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
Core Skills
  
  

* Strong project delivery and governance expertise.
* Experience with Waterfall or Hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to manage complex, cross-team enterprise projects.
* Stakeholder management across Business and IT.
* Risk, dependency, and issue management.

Functional Knowledge
  
  

* SAP BTP landscape and services (high-level understanding).
* Enterprise integration environments (ERP, Non-ERP, ABAP).
* Governance, security, and validation driven IT environments.
* Demand and portfolio management concepts.

Organizational Skills
  
  

* Excellent planning and coordination capabilities.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills.
* Structured documentation and reporting approach.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Experience & Qualification
  
  

* 8–12 years of experience in IT Project / Delivery Management (enterprise context).
* Proven experience delivering cross-functional, governance-driven projects.
* Experience working with platform, architecture, and compliance teams.
* PMP / PRINCE2 / equivalent project management certification (preferred).

Success Measures (KPIs)
  
  

* On-time and in-scope delivery of BTP projects.
* Reduction in escalations and rework.
* Improved business satisfaction.
* Predictable milestone tracking and reporting.
* Consistent adherence to the BTP Operating Model.

Strategic Importance of the Role
  
  

* The Project Delivery Manager is a foundational role for scaling the SAP BTP Portfolio.
* It enables predictable delivery, improves stakeholder confidence, and ensures BTP projects are executed as enterprise initiatives, not ad-hoc development efforts.

We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  
**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Product Line Management III
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
**Experience**

* Demonstrated experience in component obsolescence management, project or product management, component engineering, engineering change management, inventory management, planning, change control, and/or manufacturing operations.
* Hands-on experience working with semiconductor manufacturing equipment and associated systems and components.
* Strong knowledge of parts and components used in semiconductor equipment, including an understanding of their basic functions, applications, interfaces, and impact on equipment performance.
* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to interpret technical data, engineering analysis, qualification results, and field performance data to support sound business and technical decisions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate effectively with Engineering, Quality, Safety, Component Engineering, Supply Chain, Materials, Field Support, and other stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex issues, evaluate risks and trade-offs, and drive timely solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to define strategy, scope, qualification requirements, and execution plans for new or replacement parts, while building organizational alignment around the proposed approach.
* Strong organizational and project management capabilities, including maintaining clear project status, qualification documentation, decision records, risk assessments, and technical data packages.

**Requirements**

* Strong knowledge and practical experience in product lifecycle analysis, Product Change Notification (PCN), component obsolescence management, and supply chain management.
* Proven problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to proactively identify risks, develop solution options, and drive decisions aligned with organizational priorities and business requirements.
* Experience in project and/or program management, including cross-functional planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Good understanding of Bill of Material (BOM) structures, component relationships, product configurations, and change impacts.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions across cross-functional organizations, including situations where direct authority may be limited.
* Working knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to analyze data and communicate complex information clearly.
* Detail-oriented with strong analytical, prioritization, and multitasking skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with component engineering and lifecycle-management tools such as Silicon Expert, or equivalent platforms.
* Working knowledge of SAP, ERP, and/or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.
* Strong technical foundation in electrical, mechanical, materials engineering, or a related discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**
Component Obsolescence & Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Perform comprehensive technical, supply chain, and business assessments for incoming and ongoing obsolescence projects, including review of SPS, ATOM, historical shipments, forecasted demand, part usage, material availability, inventory position, and projected stock-out dates.
* Develop and execute component obsolescence and lifecycle strategies that balance supply continuity, technical requirements, customer expectations, cost, inventory exposure, and implementation risk.
* Own and execute component roadmaps covering part obsolescence, replacement parts, alternate suppliers, redesigns, qualification requirements, and cost-reduction opportunities.
* Proactively identify lifecycle and supply risks and develop mitigation plans to minimize potential impact to manufacturing, installed-base support, and customer commitments.

Qualification & Change Implementation
  
  

* Define the strategy, scope, qualification plan, resources, milestones, and implementation approach for replacement and newly qualified parts.
* Lead cross-functional teams through technical evaluation, onsite qualification, approval, and implementation, ensuring actions and deliverables are completed according to plan.
* Manage the cut-in/change implementation process, including readiness reviews, material transition, stakeholder alignment, and post-implementation monitoring.
* Monitor field performance following implementation and coordinate corrective actions when performance, quality, reliability, or customer issues are identified.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the central point of coordination across Engineering, Quality, Safety, Component Engineering, Field Support, Materials, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, escalation paths, and communication mechanisms to drive projects to completion.
* Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and build consensus on complex technical, supply, cost, and customer-related issues.
* Maintain accurate and organized project plans, status reports, technical data packages, qualification records, risks, decisions, and action items.

Product & Common Module Roadmap
  
  

* Own the common-module roadmap and implementation activities following Phase 5 of ePLC, ensuring lifecycle, cost, supply, and product requirements remain aligned.
* Facilitate intercompany and cross-business-unit alignment on product and component strategies, product roadmaps, market proliferation, pricing guidance, spare-level content, and restricted-part ordering.
* Drive alignment between product strategy and component lifecycle plans to support long-term product availability, serviceability, and cost competitiveness.

Cost & Supply Chain Management
  
  

* Develop and execute cost-reduction roadmaps in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain, Commodity Management, and other functional teams.
* Identify opportunities involving alternate suppliers, component redesign, part substitutions, standardization, and sourcing strategies while ensuring technical, quality, and reliability requirements are maintained.
* Manage strategic supplier issues, coordinating cross-functional teams to address supply continuity, quality, capacity, cost, lifecycle, and technical risks.
* Evaluate trade-offs among cost, inventory, qualification investment, customer impact, and supply continuity to support fact-based business decisions.

**Functional Knowledge**

* Demonstrates strong conceptual and practical expertise within the discipline, with working knowledge of related areas such as component engineering, product lifecycle management, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, materials, and field support.
* Applies technical and business knowledge to evaluate component lifecycle risks, qualification requirements, supply constraints, and implementation strategies.

**Business Expertise**

* Understands industry best practices and how the function integrates with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Product Management, and customer-facing organizations.
* Understands key business drivers including cost, supply continuity, inventory, quality, product lifecycle, customer commitments, and time-to-implementation.
* Maintains awareness of market, supplier, and competitive factors that may influence product and component strategies.

**Leadership**

* Serves as a subject-matter resource and trusted partner for colleagues and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Leads complex cross-functional projects with defined resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and business objectives.
* Drives accountability across functional boundaries and influences decisions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Provides guidance to less-experienced team members and promotes consistent processes and best practices.

**Problem Solving**

* Solves complex, cross-functional technical and business problems by integrating multiple sources of information and evaluating technical, supply, cost, schedule, and customer impacts.
* Takes a fresh perspective on existing solutions and identifies alternatives when traditional approaches are insufficient.
* Exercises sound judgment under time constraints and makes data-driven recommendations with clearly understood risks and trade-offs.

**Impact**

* Influences a broad range of customers, operational, supply chain, cost, product lifecycle, and project outcomes across multiple teams.
* Drives successful execution of component transitions and lifecycle strategies while minimizing supply disruption, customer impact, excess inventory, and business risk.
* Contributes to improvements in product availability, cost competitiveness, operational efficiency, and long-term serviceability.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Communicates complex, technical, and sensitive information clearly and effectively to stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* Builds productive relationships across functional and organizational boundaries.
* Effectively facilitates discussions involving competing priorities and works to build consensus, resolve conflicts, and drive timely decisions.

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 10% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
No

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Trust CX Innovations
description:
**Description**
Trust depends on two things being true at once: that every piece of customer data is governed, controlled, and provably compliant, and that the organization can move fast enough to keep up as products evolve in the era of AI. TCI's AI Enablement & Data Governance charter owns both. On the data side, we make sure data is classified, its handling is enforceable, and compliance can be proven rather than asserted. On the enablement side, we use AI-driven automation to take operational load off the entire organization so builders spend their time building trust, not maintaining it by hand.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive the programs across this charter. You will own complex, cross-functional initiatives that span product, engineering, and science teams, and often multiple organizations, from data governance and enforcement programs to the automation efforts that reduce operational burden at scale. Operating with significant autonomy, you will set the plan, map dependencies across teams, surface risks early, and keep a broad set of stakeholders aligned on a shared bar and timeline, including partners in privacy, legal, and other organizations we depend on. You will operate at a technical level, understanding the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions and drive sound decisions, and you will bring the judgment and influence to hold teams that do not report to you accountable to their commitments. Above all, you will be the connective tissue that turns provable data governance and AI-driven efficiency from goals into delivered outcomes.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs across both data governance and AI enablement, spanning multiple engineering, product, and science teams and often multiple organizations.
* Build the program plan from ambiguity: define scope, milestones, and success criteria, and translate a broad charter into an executable roadmap with clear owners.
* Map and manage cross-team and cross-org dependencies, including partners in privacy and legal, surface risks early, and drive them to resolution before they affect delivery.
* Drive data governance programs so that data classification, handling enforcement, and retention obligations are met and provable, and make those requirements a prerequisite for new services rather than an afterthought.
* Drive the AI enablement and automation agenda that reduces operational burden across the organization, and track its impact on capacity and delivery.
* Establish the bar for what "done" and "compliant" mean in this space and embed it into how programs are planned and run.
* Keep a diverse set of stakeholders aligned, from individual builders to senior leaders, through clear written narratives, status, and decision documents.
* Operate at a technical level: understand the systems and trade-offs well enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and drive sound decisions.
* Define and track the metrics that show whether governance is provable and whether automation is actually returning capacity, and use them to prioritize.
* Influence and hold teams that do not report to you accountable to shared commitments and timelines.

**About The Team**
The Trust CX Innovation team drives advancements across Amazon Devices & Services (D&S) products. Our mission focuses on maintaining trust as the foundation while ensuring universal access as AI technology evolves. Our team develops essential privacy safeguards and accessibility features that serve millions of customers globally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
* - Understanding of AI architecture and integration patterns
* - Expertise in privacy regulations and accessibility standards
* - Ability to drive technical decisions across teams
* - Advanced program management capabilities
* - Experience defining technical metrics
* - Track record of process optimization
* - Experience with rapid technology adoption

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com.

Reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager on the MLP Solutions team, you’ll work at the intersection of Data Science and DevOps, building the infrastructure and systems that enable SurveyMonkey’s products to leverage technologies such as Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and real-time classification. You’ll play a key role in evolving our ML platform, driving innovation, and delivering reliable solutions that support the needs of our growing AI ecosystem.

* Partner with application engineers to integrate, test, and monitor ML model services across SurveyMonkey’s microservices architecture.
* Serve as a technical consultant to internal feature teams, providing guidance and influencing decisions around ML tooling, infrastructure, and platform capabilities.
* Implement telemetry and monitoring capabilities to support complex failure analysis and maintain reliable, real-time services that support millions of daily survey responses.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers on the MLP team, promoting high standards in code quality, documentation, and architectural best practices.

* 8+ years of professional experience in machine learning engineering or development, including designing and implementing ML infrastructure in AWS.
* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, along with experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Expert-level proficiency in Python and experience with large-scale data processing technologies such as PySpark.
* Experience deploying and operating end-to-end machine learning solutions for real-time applications, such as spam detection, personalization, or ranking systems.
* Strong working knowledge of Unix/Linux environments and experience supporting production machine learning systems.
* Experience designing and building scalable, reliable cloud infrastructure for machine learning workloads using AWS.

title: Applied Scientist III, Advertising Trust
description:
**Description**
Amazon Advertising Trust is on a mission to redefine how trust is enforced at internet scale, and we are looking for exceptional scientists to help lead the way. We are building systems that reason about advertising content the way a trained human would, at a industry leading volume and speed, and that keep working when the rules change underneath them.
  
  
At Ads Trust Science we leverage machine learning, generative AI, and large-scale retrieval to solve some of the most complex decision problems for ads worldwide. Every ad shown across Amazon's owned-and-operated properties and third-party networks, in every format and every global marketplace, depends on decisions our systems make. We are just getting started.
  
  
As a Senior Applied Scientist you will be at the forefront of this work. You will own science problems end to end, bridging the gap between research and production impact. You will not be handed a specification. You will be given a customer problem, a system that partly solves it, and the latitude to decide what to build next.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of multimodal understanding, large language models, and large-scale retrieval, on a problem where the science is genuinely unsettled. You will work alongside scientists whose models run in front of hundreds of millions of customers, at a scale that changes which approaches are even possible.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Ship a model into production, then find and document where it fails once real traffic reaches it.
* Drive the technical discussion, inside your team and with partner teams, on how to close that gap.
* Bring a fresh angle to a problem that is not yours and help a peer get further than they would have alone, building trust across the team in the process.
* Mentor while staying hands-on. At this level the design and the code are both yours.

**About The Team**
Ads Trust Science is a group of scientists who would rather change what the team measures than optimise the wrong number. We value curiosity, rigour, and a bias for action. We expect people to disagree with evidence, to say clearly what did not work, and to iterate quickly toward the solutions that matter.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability
* PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
**Autonomize AI**
is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients.
  
  
We're looking for engineers who don't just
*integrate*
AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end.
  
  
This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry.
  
  
**You're a Fit If You Have**

* AI-native engineering is your default mode
* You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
* You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
* You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing
* You've instrumented AI systems for observability - latency, token usage, hallucination rate, drift
* You can reason about model tradeoffs (context length, cost, latency, accuracy) and make architectural calls accordingly
* You've worked with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
* You build robust backend systems
* 6 + years building production web applications from scratch
* Deep Python proficiency; comfortable with FastAPI, Django, or Flask in production
* Experience designing APIs that serve both humans and AI agents (tool schemas, structured outputs, streaming)
* Async-first thinking: asyncio, task queues, event-driven architectures
* Kafka, Redis, or ActiveMQ for real-time data movement
* Postgres, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in production
* You operate at cloud scale
* Docker and Kubernetes in production - this is a hard requirement
* At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) with real operational experience
* Microservices and cloud-native design patterns
* You've been on-call. You know what a bad deploy feels like at 2am.
* You can ship a frontend when the product demands it
* React, TypeScript, or modern JS frameworks
* Enough frontend fluency to build clinical interfaces without a dedicated frontend handoff

**Bonus Points**

* Led a small engineering team - mentored, reviewed, unblocked
* CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes certification
* ML/DL model deployment experience (PyTorch, scikit-learn)
* Built evaluation harnesses or used MLflow, LangSmith, or similar for AI observability
* Healthcare domain experience (FHIR, HL7, clinical workflows)

**What We Value Above Credentials**
**Bias toward action**
- you ship, then iterate. You learn by doing, not by planning.
  
  
**Owner mentality**
- you don't wait for permission. You identify what needs to exist and build it.
  
  
**Intellectual honesty**
- you'd rather say "I don't know, let me find out". When unsure, seek the right information from your peers or leaders.
  
  
**Async-first communication**
- you write clearly, document decisions, and work well across time zones.
  
  
**What You'll Get**
**Ground floor equity**
in a VC-backed healthcare AI company growing fast
  
  
**Full-stack ownership**
- no handoffs, no silos, no "that's not my team"
  
  
**Direct access to founders and customers**
- your technical decisions will be seen and felt
  
  
**Professional development budget**
- conferences, courses, certifications, books
  
  
**Flexible, remote-friendly culture**
built around output, not hours
  
  
*If you've been waiting for a role where AI isn't a feature - it's the foundation - this is it.*

title: Senior Software Engineer I - Full Stack
description:
**SurveyMonkey is the world’s most popular platform for surveys and forms, built for business—loved by users.**
We combine powerful capabilities with intuitive design, effectively serving every use case, from customer experience to employee engagement, market research to payment and registration forms. With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.
  
  
Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer I who enjoys solving new and interesting technical challenges and brings fresh perspectives to building and improving our platform. In this role, you’ll join our engineering team and contribute to solutions that support both our internal systems and customer-facing experiences. Your technical expertise and contributions will play an important role in the team’s success, while giving you opportunities to continue expanding your own skills and influencing engineering excellence. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful work, collaborate across teams, and help shape the continued evolution of our platform.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-quality front-end and back-end code to deliver reliable, scalable web applications.
* Build and maintain scalable services across multiple data regions, supporting the performance and reliability of our platform.
* Own feature components end-to-end, from contributing to technical specifications through implementation, testing, and delivery, while following software engineering best practices.
* Build observable systems and establish meaningful metrics to monitor service health, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform product decisions.
* Develop and maintain robust APIs and integrations that support our platform and customer-facing experiences.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement through testing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the engineering team.

**We’d love to hear from people with**

* 6+ years of professional experience in web application development, with strong full-stack engineering expertise.
* Experience contributing to and delivering components of large-scale, cross-functional engineering projects.
* Proven experience designing and building scalable services and APIs, including working with REST and/or GraphQL and integrating with internal and external services.
* Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Java or Python, along with relevant web frameworks such as Spring Boot, FastAPI, or Flask.
* Hands-on experience with modern front-end technologies, including JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, along with a strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot as part of your daily development workflow. This includes applying these tools to multi-file refactoring, executing technical specifications, and managing context to support effective development.
* Familiarity with integrating AI/LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or building AI-powered features into modern web applications is a plus.

SurveyMonkey believes in-person collaboration is valuable for building relationships, fostering community, and enhancing our speed and execution in problem-solving and decision-making.
**As such, this opportunity is hybrid and requires you to work from the SurveyMonkey office in Bengaluru 1 day per week.**
*- Hybrid*
**Why SurveyMonkey? We’re glad you asked**
At SurveyMonkey, curiosity powers everything we do. We’re a global company where people from all backgrounds can make an impact, build meaningful connections, and grow their careers. Our teams work in a flexible, hybrid environment with thoughtfully designed offices and programs like the CHOICE Fund to help employees thrive in work and life.
  
  
We’ve been trusted by organizations for over 25 years, and we’re just getting started. Our milestones include celebrating a quarter-century of curiosity with 25 acts of giving, opening new hubs in Costa Rica and India, crossing the threshold of 100 billion questions answered, and earning recognition as one of the Most Inspiring Workplaces across North America and Asia.
  
  
We live our company values—like championing inclusion and making it happen—by embedding them into how we hire, collaborate, and grow. They help shape everything from our culture to our business decisions. Come join us and see where your curiosity can take you.
  
  
**Our commitment to an inclusive workplace**
SurveyMonkey is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities.
  
  
**Your data**
For more information on how SurveyMonkey (including its subsidiary and affiliated companies) processes your personal data as a job candidate or applicant, please see our Global Applicant and Candidate Data Privacy Notice. Please note that we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as sourcing candidates, reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or summarizing interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment.

title: Software Engineer II - Full Stack
description:

With built-in research expertise and AI-powered technology, it’s like having a team of expert researchers at your fingertips.
  
  
Trusted by millions—from startups to Fortune 500 companies—SurveyMonkey helps teams gather insights and information that inspire better decisions, create experiences people love, and drive business growth. Discover how at surveymonkey.com.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
We’re looking for a Software Engineer II who is passionate about solving new and interesting technical challenges and brings fresh perspectives to help grow our team and platform, both internally and for our customers. In this role, you’ll contribute to building and improving our platform through high-quality engineering work, technical ownership, and collaboration across the team. You’ll have opportunities to expand your technical expertise, take ownership of meaningful features, and contribute to engineering excellence as we continue evolving our products and customer experiences.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable services across multiple data regions, supporting the reliability and growth of our platform.

* Build observable systems and establish meaningful metrics to monitor service health, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform product decisions.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement through testing, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the engineering team.

**We’d love to hear from people with**

* 4+ years of professional experience in web application development, with strong full-stack engineering expertise.
* Experience contributing to and delivering components of large-scale, cross-functional engineering projects.
* Experience designing and building scalable services and APIs, including working with REST and/or GraphQL and integrating with internal and external services.
* Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Java or Python, along with relevant web frameworks such as Spring Boot, FastAPI, or Flask.
* Hands-on experience with modern front-end technologies, including JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, along with a strong understanding of object-oriented programming and design patterns.
* Demonstrated experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot as part of your development workflow. This includes applying these tools to multi-file refactoring, executing technical specifications, and managing context to support effective development.

**Nice To Have**

* Familiarity with integrating AI/LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or building AI-powered features into modern web applications.

SurveyMonkey believes in-person collaboration is valuable for building relationships, fostering community, and enhancing our speed and execution in problem-solving and decision-making.
**As such, this opportunity is hybrid and requires you to work from the SurveyMonkey office in Bengaluru 3 days per week.**
*- Hybrid*

At SurveyMonkey, curiosity powers everything we do. We’re a global company where people from all backgrounds can make an impact, build meaningful connections, and grow their careers. Our teams work in a flexible, hybrid environment with thoughtfully designed offices and programs like the CHOICE Fund to help employees thrive in work and life.
  
  
We’ve been trusted by organizations for over 25 years, and we’re just getting started. Our milestones include celebrating a quarter-century of curiosity with 25 acts of giving, opening new hubs in Costa Rica and India, crossing the threshold of 100 billion questions answered, and earning recognition as one of the Most Inspiring Workplaces across North America and Asia.
  
  
We live our company values—like championing inclusion and making it happen—by embedding them into how we hire, collaborate, and grow. They help shape everything from our culture to our business decisions. Come join us and see where your curiosity can take you.
  
  
**Our commitment to an inclusive workplace**
SurveyMonkey is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. title: Software Development, Staff
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years building enterprise applications that actually run the business, not just satisfy a spec.
  
  
You are comfortable moving between C# backend work, Angular front ends, Power Apps configurations, and Python scripts without losing sight of what the business actually needs. You have built integrations that connect systems no one thought could talk to each other, and you have done it in a way that the next person can actually maintain.
  
  
You do not wait for perfect requirements. You sit with the GTM team, figure out what they are trying to accomplish, and start building something they can react to. At Synopsys, you will work on applications and AI-enabled workflows that directly affect how our go-to-market teams operate every day, and the solutions you build will matter.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Design and build business applications using C#/.NET, Angular, Power Apps, Python, and Azure that support go-to-market workflows across Synopsys
* Develop AI-enabled applications and automation using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, and Power Automate
* Build and maintain integrations across enterprise systems, APIs, business data sources, and AI solutions
* Own solutions end to end, from gathering requirements and writing technical designs through deployment, monitoring, and production support
* Modernize legacy applications by migrating them to current full-stack, cloud, automation, and AI technologies
* Partner with GTM business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions
* Write and maintain technical documentation that helps the team understand, support, and extend what you built

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve productivity across the go-to-market organization by automating manual workflows and delivering AI-enabled business applications
* Modernize business-critical applications so they are more reliable, easier to support, and aligned with current technology standards
* Turn AI prototypes and business ideas into production-ready solutions that teams actually use
* Build reusable components, integrations, and frameworks that accelerate future development across the team
* Expand the practical use of AI, Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure across GTM operations
* Contribute to Synopsys' broader AI transformation and business application strategy
* Reduce technical debt and improve long-term maintainability of the GTM application portfolio

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of hands-on enterprise application development experience
* Strong proficiency in C#/.NET and modern web technologies such as Angular, React, JavaScript, or TypeScript
* Experience building and deploying solutions using Power Apps, Power Platform, REST APIs, SQL, and Azure
* Track record of supporting applications through the full lifecycle, from development through deployment and production support
* Exposure to Generative AI, Copilot, AI agents, or intelligent automation
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, security best practices, monitoring, and modern development workflows
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Python, Power Automate, or Dataverse is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can sit in a room with a business stakeholder who has a half-formed idea and walk out with a technical plan that actually solves their problem
* You write code that other people can read, debug, and extend six months later without calling you
* You know when to build something custom and when to configure an existing platform, and you are not precious about either
* You are comfortable working across time zones and overlapping with US Pacific hours when the team needs to align
* You push back when a requirement does not make sense or when a proposed solution will create more problems than it solves
* You treat production support as part of the job, not an interruption, because you know that is where you learn what actually matters

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, developing and supporting business applications, automation, and emerging AI capabilities for Synopsys' go-to-market team.
  
  
You will work closely with GTM business and technology teams across full-stack development, Power Platform, Azure, Copilot, and agentic AI to modernize business workflows and deliver practical solutions.
  
  
This onsite role is based in Bengaluru and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific time hours.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
**Autonomize AI**
is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients.
  
  
We're looking for engineers who don't just
*integrate*
AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end.
  
  
This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry.
  
  
**You're a Fit If You Have**

* AI-native engineering is your default mode
* You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
* You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
* You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing
* You've instrumented AI systems for observability - latency, token usage, hallucination rate, drift
* You can reason about model tradeoffs (context length, cost, latency, accuracy) and make architectural calls accordingly
* You've worked with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
* You build robust backend systems
* 6 + years building production web applications from scratch
* Deep Python proficiency; comfortable with FastAPI, Django, or Flask in production
* Experience designing APIs that serve both humans and AI agents (tool schemas, structured outputs, streaming)
* Async-first thinking: asyncio, task queues, event-driven architectures
* Kafka, Redis, or ActiveMQ for real-time data movement
* Postgres, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in production
* You operate at cloud scale
* Docker and Kubernetes in production - this is a hard requirement
* At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) with real operational experience
* Microservices and cloud-native design patterns
* You've been on-call. You know what a bad deploy feels like at 2am.
* You can ship a frontend when the product demands it
* React, TypeScript, or modern JS frameworks
* Enough frontend fluency to build clinical interfaces without a dedicated frontend handoff

**Bonus Points**

* Led a small engineering team - mentored, reviewed, unblocked
* CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes certification
* ML/DL model deployment experience (PyTorch, scikit-learn)
* Built evaluation harnesses or used MLflow, LangSmith, or similar for AI observability
* Healthcare domain experience (FHIR, HL7, clinical workflows)

**What We Value Above Credentials**
**Bias toward action**
- you ship, then iterate. You learn by doing, not by planning.
  
  
**Owner mentality**
- you don't wait for permission. You identify what needs to exist and build it.
  
  
**Intellectual honesty**
- you'd rather say "I don't know, let me find out". When unsure, seek the right information from your peers or leaders.
  
  
**Async-first communication**
- you write clearly, document decisions, and work well across time zones.
  
  
**What You'll Get**
**Ground floor equity**
in a VC-backed healthcare AI company growing fast
  
  
**Full-stack ownership**
- no handoffs, no silos, no "that's not my team"
  
  
**Direct access to founders and customers**
- your technical decisions will be seen and felt
  
  
**Professional development budget**
- conferences, courses, certifications, books
  
  
**Flexible, remote-friendly culture**
built around output, not hours
  
  
*If you've been waiting for a role where AI isn't a feature - it's the foundation - this is it.*
