title: Product Builder
description:
**Product Builder**

**Department:**
Product & Technology

**About Navigator**

Navigator is a travel-focused ad tech platform built for scale, precision and impact.

Following our recent Series A funding round, we're evolving from a digital consultancy into a data-driven advertising platform that sits at the intersection of travel intelligence and multi-channel media execution.

We ingest second-party data from leading travel companies, including OTAs, airlines and metasearch platforms. We use this data to build sophisticated audience segments and activate them across all major advertising platforms. Wherever our clients' travellers are, we have a way to reach them.

We're building towards an agentic advertising future, where AI-driven automation handles execution, supported by expert human decision-making. This is an opportunity to help shape that platform while working with leading hospitality and travel brands at the forefront of digital advertising.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Builder to join our team and help shape, design and build the next generation of advertising technology products and solutions.

Working at the intersection of product, design, engineering, data and digital advertising, you will take ownership of initiatives from initial idea and customer discovery through to design, development and production.

You will work across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and build products that make advertising smarter, more effective and more efficient. This could include developing internal tools, automating campaign workflows, building data-driven solutions, improving reporting and measurement capabilities, or creating new technology to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between identifying a problem, understanding the user, designing a solution, building a prototype and writing production-ready code.

You will be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking and making independent decisions. You will combine strong product judgement with excellent design and technical skills, using emerging technologies, including AI and agentic systems, to accelerate how we build and deliver value.

Ultimately, you will turn opportunities into working products that create measurable value for our business, our people and our clients.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Product Discovery & Ownership**

* Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through to design, development, launch and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with client-facing teams, internal stakeholders and users to identify opportunities to improve advertising products, services and workflows.
* Understand the challenges facing advertisers, publishers, agencies and internal teams, translating these into practical technology solutions.
* Challenge existing processes and assumptions, identifying where technology can simplify operations, improve efficiency or create new commercial opportunities.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, behavioural analysis, data exploration and experimentation.
* Define clear objectives and success measures for every initiative, ensuring products deliver measurable business and customer value.
* Evaluate whether a new solution needs to be built or whether existing platforms, tools and capabilities can solve the problem.
* Identify and implement improvements across the products and systems you own.

**2. Product Design & User Experience**

* Translate complex business and advertising challenges into intuitive, user-friendly digital products and experiences.
* Lead the design process, from user journeys and wireframes through to polished interfaces and interactive prototypes.
* Apply strong UX and UI principles to create products that are simple, accessible and effective.
* Prototype and test ideas early, using feedback and evidence to validate solutions before investing in full development.
* Develop consistent experiences that align with our design standards and contribute to the evolution of our design systems.
* Balance user needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints when making design decisions.

**3. Technology & Product Development**

* Design, build and launch production-ready applications, tools and technology solutions.
* Write clean, scalable and maintainable code, taking responsibility for the quality and performance of the products you deliver.
* Build solutions with security, reliability, testing, monitoring and future scalability in mind.
* Work across APIs, data integrations and third-party platforms to connect systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Explore opportunities to improve advertising operations through automation, workflow optimisation and intelligent technology.
* Understand the technical and commercial implications of third-party tools, platforms and vendors, including costs, scalability and potential dependencies.
* Take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving issues within your products and technical domain.

**4. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology**

* Identify opportunities to use AI, machine learning and agentic technologies to improve products, services and operational efficiency.
* Build and integrate AI-powered tools and workflows that solve real business and client challenges.
* Understand when to use traditional software logic, automation, APIs or AI models to deliver the most effective solution.
* Develop appropriate testing, evaluation and safeguards to ensure AI-powered solutions are reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Consider the cost, scalability and performance implications of AI technologies when designing solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to bring innovation into our products and ways of working.
* Share knowledge and help colleagues understand how AI and automation can improve the way we work.

**5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively across product, design, engineering, data, media and client teams to deliver cross-functional initiatives.
* Communicate product decisions, technical considerations, progress and potential challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships across the business, understanding different perspectives and translating them into effective solutions.
* Take ownership of decisions within your area of responsibility, knowing when to act independently and when wider input is needed.
* Support and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge and encouraging best practice across product, design and engineering.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our technology, processes, tools and ways of working.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively and encourage a culture of experimentation, innovation and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a naturally curious, commercially minded and technically strong individual who enjoys solving problems and building things.

**Product & Commercial Thinking**

* Experience taking digital products or technology initiatives from concept through to launch.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
* An understanding of digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology or data-driven digital businesses.
* The ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
* Experience using data, research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can drive business performance and efficiency.

**Design & User Experience**

* Experience designing digital products and intuitive user experiences.
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, user journeys and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.
* Familiarity with design systems and modern design tools.

**Technical & Engineering Skills**

* Strong software development experience and the ability to build and ship production-ready products.
* Experience working with modern development frameworks, APIs, databases and integrations.
* Understanding of software architecture, testing, security and scalable application development.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
* Experience connecting systems and working with complex data environments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Practical experience using AI tools, APIs, LLMs or agentic technologies to build products and automate workflows.
* Understanding of how to integrate AI capabilities into real-world products.
* An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to identify where they can create genuine business value.
* A pragmatic approach to innovation, balancing experimentation with reliability, security and commercial viability.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.
* Equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting hands-on with delivery.
* Curious, analytical and able to challenge assumptions.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and with people at different levels.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.
* Pragmatic and commercially minded, with a focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* Enjoys learning, experimenting and continuously improving.

**How We'll Measure Success**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:

* **Build products that matter:**
  Deliver solutions that address genuine customer, client and business needs.
* **Create measurable impact:**
  Improve advertising performance, operational efficiency, user experience or commercial outcomes through the products you build.
* **Own delivery end to end:**
  Take initiatives from initial problem discovery through to successful production launch.
* **Raise the quality bar:**
  Deliver well-designed, reliable and scalable products that people enjoy using.
* **Make smart decisions:**
  Use evidence, commercial awareness and technical judgement to prioritise the right problems and solutions.
* **Drive innovation:**
  Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging technologies to create competitive advantage.
* **Improve how we work:**
  Help build a more effective, collaborative and innovative product and technology culture.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how an ambitious advertising technology business builds and uses technology.

You will have the freedom to identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and take ideas from concept to reality. Rather than being restricted to one discipline, you will have the opportunity to work across product, design and engineering, building solutions that have a direct impact on our clients, our people and our business.

You'll be joining Navigator at an exciting stage of its growth, helping shape the technology, products and AI-powered capabilities that will define the future of travel advertising.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new technologies and building products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Engineering Architect - Full Stack / MERN
description:
Lead architecture, design and delivery of enterprise-scale MERN applications while remaining deeply involved in solutioning, coding, reviews, performance optimization, cloud-native implementations, and engineering governance. The role balances technical leadership with business and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Required Experience:**
14-20 Years
  
  
**Team Management- Yes**
**Key Relationships**
: Product, Delivery, Architecture, Security, DevOps / SRE
  
  
A senior role accountable for target architecture, engineering practices and delivery governance across a polyglot engineering platform spanning React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose, GraphQL Federation, Kafka, Python/FastAPI and n8n-based automation. You set target architecture and engineering standards, and stay close enough to the code to assure designs you approve. You own identity, data, event-driven and AI-assisted engineering architecture, translating strategy into a funded roadmap for the engineering team and its sub-pods.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Define the target technical architecture for the platform, including architecture principles, reference patterns, and the roadmap from current to target state.
* Govern architecture decisions through documented decision records, design review, and conformance checkpoints, escalating material trade-offs for approval.
* Architect the React/TypeScript frontend, covering component structure, state management, performance budgets, and accessibility standards.
* Direct backend service architecture in Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS), including service boundaries, API contracts, resilience patterns, and versioning strategy.
* Define the data architecture across MongoDB, covering schema and access-pattern design, indexing strategy, data lifecycle, and integrity controls.
* Own the GraphQL Federation architecture: supergraph composition, subgraph boundaries, schema contracts, entity resolution, and breaking-change policy.
* Establish event-driven architecture on Kafka, defining topic and event contract design, partitioning, delivery semantics, and schema evolution rules.
* Set the identity and access architecture, covering authentication and authorization flows, token handling, session policy, and least-privilege service access.
* Guide the Python/FastAPI service architecture, defining where it is the correct tool, its contract and packaging conventions, and its integration with the wider platform.
* Scope and constrain n8n usage to workflow automation and integration orchestration, defining the guardrails that distinguish automation workflows from engineered application services.
* Own the AI architecture, covering model integration and routing, prompt and tooling boundaries, evaluation criteria, and safety and cost controls.
* Assure evidence-based application readiness for Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring applications correctly consume platform-owned Helm charts and GitHub Actions pipelines rather than duplicating them.
* Set runtime performance and observability standards, including Azure Cache for Redis caching patterns and Application Insights instrumentation, tracing, and alerting.
* Partner with the engineering team and its sub-pods to raise engineering practices, embed the testing strategy across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers, and sustain predictable delivery flow.

* Proven technical leadership of an engineering team at Lead Technical Architect or Principal Architect scope.
* Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose and Web Components/micro-frontends.
* GraphQL schema design and federated graph architecture (GraphQL Federation), including subgraph composition and contract versioning.
* Experience with event-driven architecture using Kafka, Schema Registry and Avro, including schema evolution and compatibility governance.
* Experience with identity and access architecture: OAuth2/OIDC, Okta, service-account token exchange and ABAC.
* Working knowledge of Python/FastAPI in a polyglot service environment.
* Experience integrating AI capabilities in production systems, including Azure OpenAI and Anthropic model routing, with attention to prompt governance, token-cost control and PII safeguards.
* Strategy and architecture governance in a cross-functional environment.
* Cloud-native, distributed systems design with deployment readiness ownership for Docker/Kubernetes applications consuming platform-owned Helm/GitHub Actions.
* Demonstrable accountability for delivery, reliability and security outcomes.
* Established testing and quality practice across Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright and pytest.
* Track record of establishing engineering practices and architecture governance that scale across a complex organization.

Utilizes software engineering principles to deploy and maintain fully automated data transformation pipelines that combine a large variety of storage and computation technologies to handle a distribution of data types and volumes in support of data architecture design. title: Quantitative Risk & Credit Analytics – Associate / Senior Associate
company: ALP (Computational Finance, AI and Data Engineering)
description:
**Quantitative Risk & Credit Analytics – Associate / Senior Associate**

Bengaluru, with frequent travel to the GCC | 4–8 years

**About ALP**

Angel Lane Partners is a computational finance, data engineering and AI/ML firm with offices in Dubai, London, Bengaluru and Riyadh. We work with banks, financial institutions and regulators across the GCC on risk, credit, treasury and regulatory analytics. We also build our own platforms for credit and risk management.

**The role**

You will build and validate risk models for client banks and turn that work into tools people use day to day. The role sits between our risk advisory and technology teams. You will work directly with client risk, treasury and model validation teams, and with ALP’s engineers on getting models into production.

**What you will do**

*Model development and validation*

* Develop credit risk models: PD/LGD/EAD, scorecards, rating models and master rating scales, IFRS 9 expected credit loss
* Validate models in line with regional model management requirements (CBUAE, QCB, SAMA). This covers conceptual soundness, data quality, performance testing, benchmarking and backtesting.
* Write model documentation and validation reports to the standard regulators and internal audit expect
* Contribute to market and counterparty risk work (VaR, Expected Shortfall, PFE/CVA), treasury pricing reviews and portfolio optimisation

***Credit decisioning and analytics***

* Design and backtest rules for automating credit decisions, and estimate their benefit to the bank
* Work with large loan-level and transaction-level datasets: extracting, cleaning and reconciling data from bank systems
* Build monitoring for models and portfolios so that issues are flagged early

***Platforms and delivery***

* Work with ALP’s engineering and AI teams to put models into ALP platforms and client environments
* Build working prototypes and internal tools where a full engineering build isn’t needed yet
* Apply LLM-based tools where they make the work faster or better

***Client and team***

* Present findings to client risk committees, validation teams and senior stakeholders
* Support proposals and scoping for new engagements
* Review the work of junior analysts and help them develop

**What we are looking for**

* 4–8 years in quantitative risk, credit modelling or model validation at a bank, financial institution or consulting firm
* A degree in mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics or another quantitative field
* Strong Python and SQL, with hands-on experience taking a model from data preparation through to documentation
* Working knowledge of model risk governance (SR 11-7 or equivalent)
* Ability to explain what a model shows, and where it falls short, to people who are not modellers
* Comfortable working on more than one engagement at a time to client deadlines
* Willingness to travel regularly to the UAE, Qatar and Saudi Arabia

**Good to have**

* A completed CFA or FRM
* A PhD in a quantitative field such as mathematics, statistics, econometrics, financial engineering or physics
* Market or counterparty risk experience
* Experience with GCC regulators or banks
* ML models (gradient boosting, SHAP) or LLM/agentic tools built and running in production
* Some software development experience on both back end and front end. You don’t need to be an expert; what matters is being able to:
* build a simple API or service around a model (for example FastAPI or Flask)
* work with relational databases
* put together a basic front end (for example React or Streamlit) so users can run and view results
* use Git and work alongside an engineering team
* PySpark, SAS or Teradata
* Has led a small team or worked directly with clients

* 3+ years’ experience in corporate Data Science, Analytics, Pricing & Promotions, Merchandising, or Revenue Management .

title: Senior Data Analyst + microsoft fabric: 10+ Years Experience (Part-time)
description:
***Company Description Antern Technologies is a product and engineering services company with over a decade of experience building scalable digital platforms and enterprise solutions. The company focuses on AI-driven products and custom technology solutions that help organizations modernize systems, improve efficiency, and achieve measurable business results. Its platforms, including IamInterviewed, SkillTest, and DelOrg360, address real-world challenges in technical hiring, skill assessment, and delivery management.***

**Role Description**
The Senior Data Analyst (10+ Years) will work in a remote, part-time, supporting data-driven decision-making across Antern Technologies’ products and services. Day-to-day responsibilities include collecting, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources, performing advanced analyses, and building statistical models to support product performance, hiring platforms, and delivery management insights.

The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and business teams to translate complex findings into actionable recommendations, and will help define best practices for data governance, quality, and reporting standards.

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Senior Data Analyst:**

This is the most critical role on the engagement. The project’s acceptance test is a per-unit product cost that the client’s BU Controller must sign off, and it has to reconcile to the JD Edwards General Ledger. The client has no existing costing system to match against, so this person is defining and proving the numbers, not copying them.

You’ll work alongside a North American Solution Architect who owns the costing method with the client. You’ll do the analysis, build the cost model in Power BI, and lead the reconciliation that proves it.

**Responsibilities**

* Prepare for and take part in costing workshops with the BU Controller, translating material, conversion and applied overhead rules into documented, testable logic.
* Profile JDE cost, production and GL data to confirm what the source can support. Identify gaps such as yield and scrap held outside the ERP.
* Build the certified Product Cost semantic model in Power BI (star schema, DAX measures, plant-level row-level security) and the acceptance and reconciliation views.
* Build cost component detail so any per-unit figure can be traced to its contributing transactions.
* Lead the reconciliation of per-unit cost to the JDE General Ledger for a closed period. Explain and attribute every variance outside the agreed tolerance.
* Support UAT with the client’s finance team and present results clearly to non-technical Finance stakeholders.
* Help the Data Engineer with Silver and Gold SQL during peak build weeks.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years in data analysis or BI, with significant time spent on manufacturing cost or finance data.
* A strong manufacturing cost accounting background: standard and weighted average costing, material, labor and overhead absorption, cost rollups, and yield and scrap effects. A finance or accounting degree or a cost accounting background is highly valued.
* Proven experience reconciling analytical figures to a general ledger and explaining variances to controllers.
* Expert Power BI semantic modeling and DAX, and strong SQL.
* Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse or Direct Lake semantic models).

title: Analyst, Customer experience
description:
**Analyst - CX (**
**Operations and Data)**

**About the role**

More of our customer experience now runs on systems rather than people: automated decisions, automated conversations, automated outreach, and rules that close a request without an agent. You will be the day-to-day owner of these systems, build the smaller ones yourself, and own the customer experience data underneath all of them.

Product and engineering build the core of each system. You own what happens around it: the rules and settings, the data it reads and writes, the testing before a change goes live, the monitoring after, and the weekly answer to "is it working, and what did it save?"

You will work across our ticketing, telephony, messaging and bot platforms, and our order, pharmacy, vet consultation and clinic data. You work in SQL, Python and scheduled jobs, with version control and code review. You report to the Senior Manager, Customer Experience.

**What makes this role hard**

* **One customer, many identities.**
  A pet parent can show up under two phone numbers, several orders, a pharmacy prescription, a vet consultation and a clinic visit, each in a different system with its own id. Every profile, call list and measurement you build depends on joining them correctly and saying how much of the data each join covers.
* **Systems you do not control.**
  Much of the stack is vendor platforms. Fields get renamed, new values appear without notice, and records are edited days after they are created. You work through their consoles and APIs, inside their limits, and you catch the change before a report goes wrong.
* **Every rule cuts both ways.**
  A threshold that stops bad claims can also slow down a genuine customer. An automated answer that handles more questions can also get some of them wrong. You measure both sides, every week, and bring the trade-off to your manager with numbers.
* **Measuring what a system really did.**
  Operations teams want every customer treated the same way. You set up holdout groups anyway, so impact is measured rather than assumed.
* **Rules that apply to every call and message.**
  Consent, do-not-disturb and telecom rules apply to automated outreach. Prescription and pet health data are sensitive. You build these rules into every campaign and every table, not as an afterthought.
* **Spikes.**
  Sale days and festival weeks double the load in hours. The systems and the data pipelines have to hold, and you are the person who notices first when they do not.

**What you'll do**

**Run the CX systems day to day**

* **Decision systems:**
  keep the scoring and rules that decide customer requests working as agreed, apply approved changes, log every automatic decision, review wrong approvals and wrong declines every week, and flag drift before it costs money or trust.
* **Conversation systems:**
  maintain the content and logic of our automated conversations once changes are approved, and track quality, resolution and handover rates.
* **Outreach systems:**
  own the call flows, routing and campaigns on the CX side, and produce the daily work lists for customer-facing teams, measuring what each list produced.
* **Customer profile:**
  maintain one view of each customer across orders, conversations, calls, pharmacy, consultations and clinic visits, so every system and every person reads the same history.
* Hold every automated conversation and call to the same standard: full context on handover, an outcome on every session, a record for every call. Find and fix a broken flow before customers notice.

**Change and measure them safely**

* Test every rule, prompt or flow change on test records, test numbers or a small slice of customers before it goes live, and read back what was stored.
* Report each system every week: what it decided, how often it was right, what it saved, and what it cost when it was wrong, against the impact assumed when it was approved.
* Be first on call when a system misbehaves: pause it, tell the owner, find the cause, and write down the fix, with a named second on call and a written runbook for each system.

**Build the smaller systems yourself**

* Build tools and automations in Python, spreadsheet scripting, internal-tool builders or with AI coding assistants: quality audits on chats and calls, ticket automation rules, alerts, and small integrations through APIs and webhooks.
* Take over and maintain integrations and prototypes once they are live.
* Make sure automated flows write the right fields into each record: define the payload, test it, check what was stored and alert on failures.
* Keep code in our repositories, reviewed before release and documented. Back up before you overwrite, and read back after you write.
* Review the output of AI coding assistants as carefully as you would a colleague's.

**Own the CX data**

* Own the customer experience tables from source to report: grain, keys, coverage dates, and the pipelines that fill them, with backfills, run logs and look-back reconciliation for records edited later.
* Define metrics in writing (population, date anchor, rule, denominator) and build the CX dashboards on them. When two dashboards disagree, find out why and take the fix to your manager.
* Own the mappings from platform fields, channels, queues, statuses, campaigns, dispositions and agents to analytics columns, with a check after every change and a visible bucket for unknown values.
* Reconcile tables to each source per day and per team, check freshness, catch schema changes, duplicates and blank rates, and handle timezones and late records explicitly.
* Work with least-privilege access, keep secrets out of code, and collect only the personal data a table needs.

**Turn requests into shipped work**

* Write the requirement notes for new automations and changes: problem, rules, data, test plan and how success is measured. Your manager signs them off before they go to Product.
* Take your own projects from first request to rollout: a pilot, then coordination with engineers and vendors.
* Keep the weekly review numbers dependable, and answer ad hoc questions with findings and a recommendation.

**What we're looking for**

* 3 to 6 years in analytics, analytics engineering or product operations, including at least a year owning tables, pipelines or a live system other people depend on.
* Strong SQL: joins, CTEs and window functions, with queries you can explain and tune.
* Python for pipelines, scheduled jobs and automation, and comfort with version control and code review.
* You have run or changed a live automated system (a bot, a rule engine, an outbound calling campaign, a scoring model) and measured what it did.
* You can turn a vague request into a requirement note an engineer can build from, and explain results to non-technical teams.

title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-PYTHON and SQL-STAFF
description:

**Staff – Software Engineering**

Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
* Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
* Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
* Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
* Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
* Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
* Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
* Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
* APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
* Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
* Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to explain technical findings and data issues clearly to both engineering and compliance stakeholders.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Finance Business Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
The ERDM (Enterprise Reporting and Data Management) Business Analyst is responsible for ensuring that Sales & Finance AI solutions operate with the highest levels of trust, accuracy, control, and compliance.
  
  
We are seeking a detail-obsessed, data driven expert to serve as the guardian of accuracy for our Sales & Finance AI chat assistants. You will design validation frameworks, partner with data engineering teams, and ensure every metric the AI surfaces - especially Bookings and Revenue - is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy. You will lead incident response on any data accuracy or hallucination even
  
  
The role also serves as the bridge between Finance users and technical development teams. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into AI-enabled solutions and ensuring that Finance AI capabilities align with business goals and leadership needs.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
**Requirements & Solution Definition**

* Gather and document Finance business requirements through interviews, workshops and feedback; write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria

**AI Quality Assurance**

* Monitor response quality through periodic spot-checks and audits

**Executive Use Cases**

* Support design and testing of executive use cases and prompt frameworks for C-suite and SVP users
* Verify that curated queries, guided flows and personalized dashboards produce accurate, polished outputs
* Identify ways to make the executive experience more intuitive, actionable and insightful

**Adoption & Change Management**

* Lead user onboarding: guided walkthroughs, sandbox environments, office hours
* Deliver training (live demos, workshops, drop-in sessions) for analysts, managers and directors

Education & Experience

* Experience with AI-powered tools, chatbots, or conversational AI interfaces
* Understanding of Finance metrics and rep orting (Bookings, Revenue, or related areas)
* Working knowledge of SQL and Snowflake
* Understanding of AI/LLM fundamentals - how large language models retrieve, process, and present information; awareness of common failure modes (hallucination, data staleness, context window limitations)
* Prompt Engineering Certificate or related experience

title: AI-Native Business Analyst / Forward Deployed Engineer
description:

* Engage directly with business stakeholders to understand processes, challenges, and desired business outcomes.

👤

🛠️

* Experience gathering, analysing, documenting, and refining business requirements.

title: Quality Control Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Raaha Garments is a Tiruppur-based apparel export house with over four decades of experience, known for dependable quality, reliable delivery, and long-term partnerships with leading global brands. Certified by WRAP, Sedex SMETA, Oeko-Tex, BCI, GOTS, GRS, and RCS, Raaha Garments continues to invest in quality, sustainability, and operational excellence to serve global apparel partners.

**Role Description**
The Quality Control Assistant is a full-time, on-site role based in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu. This role involves inspecting garments at various production stages to ensure they meet internal quality standards and customer specifications, including fit, construction, labeling, and packaging. The Quality Control Assistant will support testing activities in coordination with washing labs and other quality facilities, document inspection findings, and report non-conformities to supervisors for corrective actions. Day-to-day responsibilities include sample checking, monitoring adherence to quality protocols on the production floor, maintaining records of inspections and test results, and assisting in implementing continuous improvement initiatives. The role requires close collaboration with production, finishing, and compliance teams to help maintain consistent product quality and timely delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills, with experience in garment inspection and adherence to quality standards.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret test results, identify defects, and support root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to coordinate with production teams, report issues clearly, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Candidates should possess relevant Laboratory Skills for basic testing procedures in washing labs or quality labs, following safety and compliance guidelines.
* Knowledge of garment construction, fabrics, and finishing processes is beneficial.
* Attention to detail, ability to follow structured procedures, and a focus on continuous improvement are expected.
* Prior experience in apparel manufacturing or quality-related roles is an advantage.
* A diploma or degree in textiles, apparel manufacturing, quality management, or a related field is preferred.

title: Sales Counselor
description:
**Sales Counsellor / Aesthetic Clinic Counsellor**

**Location:** Sarjapur Road, Bengaluru  
**Industry:** Dermatology, Skin, Hair & Aesthetic Treatments  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | 6 days a week

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, confident and target-driven **Sales Counsellor** to join our skin and aesthetic clinic.

This is a revenue-focused role. The counsellor will be responsible for converting enquiries and leads into consultations and treatments, counselling clients on suitable treatment plans, following up consistently, and ensuring that the clinic meets its daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets.

The ideal candidate should be an excellent communicator, comfortable discussing premium aesthetic treatments, persistent with follow-ups, highly organised and able to take ownership of numbers rather than wait for clients to walk in.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Sales & Revenue**

* Take ownership of the clinic's **daily, weekly and monthly revenue targets**.
* Follow up aggressively and consistently on new leads, enquiries, past consultations and existing clients.
* Convert incoming leads from calls, WhatsApp, digital campaigns, social media and other sources into clinic appointments.
* Counsel clients on relevant skin, hair, laser and aesthetic treatments based on their concerns and the doctor's recommendations.
* Explain treatment plans, packages, pricing, offers and payment options clearly and confidently.
* Identify opportunities for **cross-selling, upselling and treatment upgrades** without compromising the client's experience or clinical appropriateness.
* Follow up with clients who have consulted but not yet purchased or started treatment.
* Reactivate dormant clients and encourage repeat treatments, maintenance plans and package renewals.
* Track upcoming package expiries, incomplete treatment plans and potential repeat business.

**Lead Management & Follow-up**

* Respond promptly to all incoming leads and enquiries.
* Maintain a disciplined follow-up system so that no potential client is lost because of delayed or missed communication.
* Understand the client's concern, establish intent and guide them towards booking a consultation or treatment.
* Maintain detailed notes on every lead, including treatment interest, objections, follow-up dates and conversion status.
* Handle common objections around pricing, treatment concerns, downtime and decision-making confidently and professionally.

**Client Counselling**

* Client experience and feedback

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly sales-driven and target-oriented**
* Extremely proactive and persistent with follow-ups
* Confident speaking to clients over phone, WhatsApp and in person
* An excellent communicator with strong persuasion and negotiation skills
* Comfortable asking for the sale and closing conversations
* Well organised and disciplined about maintaining follow-up records
* Comfortable working with daily, weekly and monthly targets
* Able to analyse their own pipeline and identify what needs to be done to achieve the target
* Presentable, professional and client-focused
* Able to work independently and take ownership rather than wait for instructions
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced clinic environment

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum **4-5 years of experience in sales, counselling or client conversion**.
* Previous experience in an **aesthetic clinic, dermatology clinic, cosmetic surgery centre, wellness clinic, premium salon or healthcare sales environment** is strongly preferred.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. As the Partner Delivery Excellence Lead, you will serve as the principal embedded delivery authority based out of one of our primary tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai or Gurgaon). Your core objective is to ensure active GSI-led customer deployments are executing flawlessly without risk of failure, milestone slip, or architectural drift.  
  
Bringing deep technical depth in Google Cloud, Data & Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (GenAI/Agentic Workflows), you will monitor project health telemetry, identify early delivery friction, and serve as the critical bridge to internal Google stakeholders, mobilizing Professional Services (PSO), Customer Engineering (CE) and Partner Leadership to deploy rapid remediation before issues escalate to the customer. Additionally, you will advocate delivery upskilling across thousands of GSI practitioners, driving adoption of Google Cloud’s Delivery Readiness Portal (DRP), Delivery Navigator (DelNav), reference architectures, and safeguarding programs.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Identify technical roadblocks and delivery risks early, mobilizing cross-functional Google Cloud teams (PSO, Support, Partner Development Managers, Customer Engineering) to execute closed-loop remediation before issues impact customers.
* Provide authoritative architectural guidance across Data & Analytics and AI/ML (Vertex AI, agentic workflows), validating partner delivery approaches on complex, mission-critical workloads.
* Drive programmatic enablement across partner delivery benches utilizing Google Cloud readiness assets, Delivery Navigator runbooks, and safeguarding programs.
* Synthesize delivery patterns and partner capabilities back to Center of Excellence (CoE) and PSO teams, informing joint service offerings and governance policies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Licensing & Installation Support
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19733 **Date posted** 11/11/2026

### **Alternate Job Titles**

* EDA Licensing and Installation Support Engineer
* Technical Application Engineer, Licensing Infrastructure
* Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Tools Support
* Licensing and Deployment Applications Engineer
* CAD/EDA Support Engineer, Staff Level

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years keeping the infrastructure running that everyone else depends on to do their jobs, and you know that when a license server goes down at 3 a.m. in Tokyo, someone's tapeout schedule just became your problem. You are the person who can look at a FlexNet debug log, spot the misconfigured options file or the firewall rule that is blocking port 27000, and have it fixed before the customer finishes explaining what went wrong.

You do not just troubleshoot, you think in systems. You understand how a three-server redundant licensing setup should behave, why a migration from on-prem to cloud changes the MAC address binding, and what happens when someone upgrades RHEL without testing the environment variables first. You have been in enough customer environments to know that "it worked in dev" means nothing until it works in production.

You are comfortable talking to a senior CAD engineer about daemon logs and then turning around to explain to a procurement lead why their license count does not match their headcount. You move fast, you document what you learn, and you do not wait for perfect information to start solving the problem. At Synopsys, you will work with global customers who depend on you to keep their design environments operational, and the problems you solve will directly enable the next generation of chips.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Support and troubleshoot Synopsys Common Licensing (SCL) and FlexNet licensing environments for global enterprise customers across Americas, EMEA, Japan, and APAC
* Perform root-cause analysis on complex licensing, installation, deployment, migration, and failover issues, working directly with customer IT, CAD, and engineering teams
* Design, validate, and implement licensing architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments, including three-server redundancy setups and cross-platform configurations
* Lead on-site and remote installation, upgrade, and migration activities for customers deploying or expanding Synopsys EDA toolsets
* Mentor applications engineers and provide technical leadership across support and customer success organizations
* Collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success teams to escalate critical issues, influence product roadmaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable improvements
* Build and maintain technical articles, runbooks, and self-service documentation in the Synopsys Knowledge Base to scale support and reduce resolution time

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Keep customer design environments operational during critical tapeout windows, directly enabling revenue and preventing schedule slips
* Reduce escalation time and resolution cycles for high-priority licensing and deployment issues across Synopsys's largest accounts
* Influence product development by surfacing real-world deployment challenges and customer needs to R&D and product teams
* Scale support effectiveness by creating reusable documentation, automation scripts, and training content that empower frontline engineers and customers
* Strengthen customer relationships by acting as a trusted technical advisor who understands both their infrastructure and their business pressures
* Drive adoption and expansion of Synopsys technologies by ensuring smooth deployments, migrations, and upgrades across diverse customer environments
* Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the broader applications engineering team through knowledge sharing and hands-on collaboration

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or related field with 6+ years of experience, or Master's degree with 4+ years in EDA tool support, CAD/CAE engineering, IT operations, or software application support
* Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration (RHEL, CentOS, SLES), including process management, file permissions, environment variables, and shell scripting
* Hands-on expertise with FlexNet/FLEXlm licensing architecture, including debug logs, options files, daemon configuration, and redundant server setups
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, firewalls, DNS, host IDs, and MAC addresses as they relate to client-server licensing communication
* Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash, Python, Perl, or PowerShell for log parsing, automation, and troubleshooting
* Experience with Windows Server administration for cross-platform EDA tool environments is a plus
* Familiarity with EDA product flows, Synopsys toolsets, or Agentic AI usage is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk a customer through a three-server licensing failover scenario and then write a two-paragraph summary for their VP of Engineering without losing the technical thread
* You stay calm under pressure, especially when a licensing issue is blocking a customer's critical milestone and multiple time zones are waiting for your answer
* You think like a detective when diagnosing issues, you do not stop at the symptom, you trace it back to the root cause even if it means digging through daemon logs and network packet captures
* You are detail-oriented and organized enough to manage multiple high-priority escalations across global accounts without dropping threads or missing follow-ups
* You are curious and self-motivated, you do not wait to be told what to learn, you dig into new licensing models, deployment architectures, and automation opportunities on your own
* You value collaboration and knowledge sharing, you document what you learn, mentor others, and contribute to the collective expertise of the team

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of Synopsys's Technical Sales and Applications Engineering organization, which serves as the critical bridge between customers, sales teams, R&D, and product groups. This team is responsible for enabling customers to successfully adopt, deploy, and expand their use of Synopsys EDA technologies while driving revenue growth and operational excellence. You will work closely with global support engineers, customer success teams, and product engineering across multiple regions, and you will have direct visibility into how the infrastructure you support powers the design workflows behind self-driving cars, AI accelerators, 5G chipsets, and the next wave of smart everything.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification
description:
**Date posted** 11/12/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19736****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/12/2026**

**Job Title**: - Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You are a recognized technical leader who thinks in systems, not individual IP blocks. You understand where interoperability challenges emerge at architectural boundaries, configurations, initialization sequences, protocol interactions, firmware dependencies, clock and reset domains, implementation constraints and assumptions made between independently developed IP. Deep hands-on verification expertise combines with your ability to define technical strategy, influence architecture, and lead engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. You are equally comfortable defining a subsystem verification architecture, reviewing SystemVerilog/UVM environments, analyzing coverage, debugging a challenging Controller-PHY interaction in Verdi, developing automation in Python and presenting technical direction to senior R&D leadership. You don't simply debug interoperability problems. You architect them out of the system. The most complex cross-IP technical investigations energize you because solving them well means preventing entire classes of failures before they reach customers. At Synopsys, you will help build the next generation of subsystem interoperability verification across high-speed interface IPs, and you will pioneer how GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows transform verification from reactive debugging into continuous intelligent qualification.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define the technical vision for subsystem interoperability spanning Controller, PHY, firmware, VIP, verification environments, and customer configurations across multiple high-speed interface IP families
* Architect a scalable Interop Verification Platform that enables continuous integration, verification, and qualification across IP releases, solving the configuration challenge across Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Protocol Mode × Customer Configuration using intelligent risk and coverage-based qualification
* Establish reusable verification architectures, methodologies and golden reference environments covering functional verification, protocol compliance, error and stress scenarios, coverage, assertions, CDC/RDC and system initialization
* Lead the most complex cross-IP technical investigations and drive systemic solutions across RTL, PHY, firmware, VIP, testbench and implementation boundaries when interoperability issues surface
* Partner with Controller and PHY architects and R&D teams to influence interfaces, observability, design-for-verification and subsystem architecture early in the development lifecycle
* Pioneer an AI-native verification architecture that applies GenAI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows across the verification lifecycle: specification to verification intent to environment to tests to regression to debug to qualification to learning
* Architect AI-assisted generation of environments and tests, intelligent regression selection, automated log and failure clustering, coverage-gap analysis, protocol and waveform debug, root-cause recommendations, engineering knowledge retrieval and automated qualification evidence

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Transform interoperability from a late-stage integration activity into a continuous product capability that accelerates subsystem bring-up and qualification across Synopsys IP portfolios
* Scale verification across increasingly complex IP configurations, enabling Synopsys to deliver subsystems that work together seamlessly before they reach customer environments
* Convert field issues into permanent prevention tests and reusable engineering knowledge, reducing repeat failures and building institutional memory into the verification platform
* Establish common interoperability methodology across multiple IP families including UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB and AMBA/CHI, creating consistency and reuse across product lines
* Create an AI-native verification architecture capable of scaling engineering expertise across products and organizations, fundamentally changing how Synopsys qualifies complex subsystems
* Define compatibility matrices and qualification criteria that provide clear, evidence-based confidence that a specific Controller-PHY combination is customer ready, reducing integration risk and time-to-market
* Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical authority for subsystem interoperability, raising the bar for verification excellence across the organization

**What You'll Need**

* 15+ years of ASIC/IP/SoC verification experience with demonstrated technical leadership on complex verification programs where you defined architecture, influenced direction, and delivered results across organizational boundaries
* Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, functional and code coverage, verification closure and complex debug, with hands-on experience building and reviewing sophisticated verification environments
* Proven experience architecting reusable verification environments for IP, subsystem or SoC designs that scaled across multiple projects or product lines
* Strong expertise in one or more high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB or AMBA/CHI, with deep understanding of protocol interactions, initialization sequences, and interoperability challenges
* Hands-on expertise with industry-standard simulation and debug tools, VIP and coverage infrastructure, specifically VCS and Verdi or equivalent toolchains
* Strong automation expertise in Python, Tcl or equivalent scripting languages, with a track record of building tools that improve verification productivity
* Experience with CDC/RDC, formal verification, emulation/prototyping, CI/CD or distributed verification infrastructure is highly desirable, as is experience or strong interest in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI and AI-assisted verification

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room where a Controller-PHY integration is failing in a customer configuration, debug the waveforms in Verdi, identify the root cause across firmware, RTL and protocol assumptions, and define the systemic fix that prevents similar issues across all future configurations
* You influence technical direction and align teams without relying on organizational authority, using technical credibility, clear communication and a track record of solving hard problems to drive consensus
* You mentor senior engineers by showing them how to think about verification architecture, not just how to write better tests, raising the technical bar for everyone around you
* You balance deep technical work with strategic thinking, moving fluidly between reviewing a UVM testbench, defining a three-year verification roadmap, and presenting technical direction to R&D leadership
* You see AI and LLMs not as hype but as tools that can fundamentally change how verification scales, and you are ready to architect how GenAI integrates into the verification lifecycle from specification to qualification
* You push back when an interface design creates unnecessary interoperability risk or when a qualification plan lacks evidence, because you care more about building systems that work than making everyone comfortable

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will work within the IP R&D organization at Synopsys, partnering closely with Controller and PHY architects, verification teams, firmware engineers, and VIP developers across multiple high-speed interface IP families. Your role sits at the intersection of these teams, defining the technical architecture and methodology that enables subsystems to work together seamlessly. You will collaborate with engineers in Bangalore and across global R&D sites, influencing technical direction and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. This is a highly visible technical leadership role with direct impact on how Synopsys delivers complex IP subsystems to customers.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
**Req ID:** 384631
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Middleware Systems Integration Senior Analyst to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**MQ IIB Job Description:**  
Middleware - Enterprise Messaging and Integration Administrator
  
Role Summary
  
NTT DATA is seeking -- years of experienced Enterprise Messaging Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise-grade messaging, integration, and workload automation platforms. This role ensures secure, reliable, high performance communication between distributed applications using IBM, Apache, and open source messaging technologies. The engineer also manages complex scheduling environments and contributes to automation, observability, and continuous improvement of mission critical integration systems.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Messaging Platform Administration (IBM MQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ)
  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and secure messaging platforms.
* Create and manage messaging artifacts: queue managers, queues, topics, channels, listeners, security settings, retention policies.
* Implement HA/DR, clustering, replication, and multi-node failover strategies.
* Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning.
* Monitor health metrics using dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Splunk) and handle incidents proactively.
* Troubleshoot message flow failures, dead-letter queues, consumer lag, stuck messages, and network bottlenecks.

2. Integration Engineering (IBM IIB / ACE)
  

* Design, develop, and deploy message flows using ESQL, Java, mapping nodes, REST/SOAP connectors, MQ/Kafka nodes.
* Build and manage BAR files, integration nodes, servers, policies, and environment overrides.
* Implement integration security: TLS/mTLS, OAuth/JWT, Basic Auth, certificate management.
* Troubleshoot and optimize integration flows for latency, throughput, parser efficiency, and memory footprint.
* Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, unit testing, and environment migrations.

3. IoT Telemetry Messaging (IBM MQXR / MQTT)
  

* Configure and support MQXR Telemetry listeners, MQTT topics, subscriptions, and QoS policies.
* Secure MQTT clients using TLS certificates, access control, and throttling policies.
* Monitor MQTT client connections, sessions, retained messages, and message routing to backend MQ systems.

4. Workload Automation (IBM TWS / IWS)
  

* Install, upgrade, configure, and administer TWS/IWS masters, controllers, and agents.
* Build job streams, calendars, dependencies, event triggers, and SLA monitoring.
* Troubleshoot job failures, optimize schedules, and implement recovery workflows.
* Integrate workload scheduler with MQ, REST APIs, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications.

5. Security, Governance Compliance
  

* Implement end to end security for messaging and integration technologies:

TLS/SSL, mTLS, JAAS, CHLAUTH policies, RBAC, OAuth/SASL.
  

* Perform auditing reporting for security compliance frameworks.
* Ensure platform hardening, certificate rotation, and vulnerability remediation.

6. Automation, DevOps Observability
  

* Create automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for deployments, housekeeping, and monitoring.
* Build IaC templates (Ansible, Terraform) for consistent provisioning.
* Integrate platforms into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
* Maintain dashboards for real time system health and SLA adherence.

7. Documentation Collaboration
  

* Create runbooks, SOPs, operational guidelines, and architectural diagrams.
* Work closely with application teams, architects, network, cloud, and security teams.
* Participate in on call rotation and production support responsibilities.

Required Skills Experience
  

* Strong working knowledge of:

o  IBM MQ (Distributed / MQ Clustering / Security)
  
o  IBM IIB/ACE development administration
  
o  IBM TWS/IWS job scheduling
  
o  MQTT / MQXR messaging
  
o  Apache Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, ACLs, Schema Registry)
  
o  Apache ActiveMQ (Classic/Artemis)
  
o  RabbitMQ (AMQP, mirrored/quorum queues, federation/shovel)
  

* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Strong debugging skills across messaging, network, TLS, and application layers.
* Good understanding of networking (TCP/IP, firewalls, load balancers, proxies).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Good-to-Have Skills
  

* Experience with Kubernetes (OpenShift/EKS/AKS) for containerized messaging platforms.
* Cloud messaging equivalents (Azure Event Hub, AWS MQ/Kinesis/SNS/SQS, GCP Pub/Sub).
* Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Exposure to CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code.
* Monitoring tool exposure

title: Senior Facilities Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Position Overview
  
The Housekeeping Executive is responsible for overseeing and managing all housekeeping operations within the facility to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and presentation. This role involves supervising housekeeping staff, coordinating cleaning schedules, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations while maintaining cost-effective operations.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Operational Management
  
Oversee daily housekeeping operations across all facility areas including offices, restrooms, common areas, conference rooms, and exterior spaces. Develop and implement efficient cleaning schedules and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain consistent quality standards. Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with cleanliness standards and identify areas requiring attention or improvement. Coordinate deep cleaning activities, specialized cleaning projects, and periodic maintenance tasks.
  
Team Leadership and Supervision
  
Supervise and manage housekeeping staff, providing clear direction, training, and performance feedback. Develop work schedules ensuring adequate coverage across all shifts and facility areas. Conduct regular team meetings to communicate expectations, address concerns, and promote continuous improvement. Monitor staff productivity and performance, implementing corrective actions when necessary.
  
Vendor and Inventory Management
  
Manage relationships with third-party housekeeping service providers, ensuring contract compliance and service quality. Monitor inventory levels of cleaning supplies, equipment, and materials, coordinating timely procurement. Evaluate and recommend cleaning products and equipment that balance effectiveness, safety, and cost-efficiency. Negotiate contracts and pricing with suppliers to optimize operational costs.
  
Quality Assurance and Compliance
  
Implement and maintain quality control systems including inspection checklists and audit procedures. Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations including OSHA standards and local requirements. Maintain Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for all cleaning chemicals and ensure proper handling protocols. Address complaints and service requests promptly, implementing corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
  
Budget and Cost Management
  
Develop and manage the housekeeping department budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-saving opportunities. Prepare regular reports on operational costs, staffing levels, and service metrics. Analyze consumption patterns and implement initiatives to reduce waste and improve efficiency.
  
Emergency Response and Special Projects
  
Respond to emergency cleaning situations including spills, accidents, or unexpected events requiring immediate attention. Coordinate housekeeping support for special events, conferences, or facility activities. Participate in facility improvement projects, providing input on housekeeping requirements and standards.
  
Qualifications
  
Required
  
Bachelor's degree in Facility Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 3-5 years of housekeeping management experience in commercial facilities, corporate offices, or hospitality environments. Proven track record of managing teams and delivering high-quality housekeeping services. Strong knowledge of cleaning chemicals, equipment, and best practices. Understanding of health and safety regulations related to housekeeping operations. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and facility management software.
  
Preferred
  
Professional certification in Facility Management (CFM, FMP) or related credentials. Experience with green cleaning practices and sustainability initiatives. Knowledge of LEED or other green building standards. Experience managing vendor relationships and contract negotiations. Six Sigma or Lean management training.
  
Essential Skills and Competencies
  
Strong leadership and team management abilities with the capacity to motivate and develop staff. Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to prioritize competing demands. Detail-oriented approach with commitment to maintaining high standards. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, for interacting with staff, vendors, and facility occupants. Problem-solving mindset with ability to address issues proactively. Customer service orientation with focus on occupant satisfaction. Budget management and cost control capabilities. Ability to work flexible hours including occasional evenings or weekends as needed.
  
Physical Requirements
  
Ability to walk and stand for extended periods during facility inspections. Capability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Ability to climb stairs and access all facility areas for inspection purposes. Comfortable working in various environmental conditions including temperature variations.
  
Working Conditions
  
This position operates in a professional office facility environment with regular inspections throughout all building areas. The role requires flexibility to respond to urgent situations and may occasionally require work outside standard business hours to address emergency situations or support special events.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: HR Assistant
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To manage end-to-end recruitment and HR operations for blue-collar employees, including carpenters, helpers, machine operators, painters, welders, electricians, installers and other factory and site workers.

The HR Executive will be responsible for ensuring timely manpower availability for factory production and project site requirements, maintaining employee discipline, managing attendance and supporting employee welfare.

**2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Blue Collar Recruitment & Manpower Planning**

* Handle end-to-end recruitment of blue-collar employees for factory and project sites.
