* Labour contractors and manpower agencies.
* Employee referrals.
* Local recruitment networks.
* ITI institutes and vocational training centres.
* Job portals, WhatsApp groups and social media.
* Direct walk-in interviews.
* Recruit carpenters, helpers, CNC operators, edge banding operators, painters, polishers, welders, fabricators, electricians, plumbers and installers.
* Coordinate with Production Heads, Project Managers and Site Engineers to understand manpower requirements.
* Maintain a database of skilled, semi-skilled and unskilled workers.
* Conduct initial screening and coordinate trade tests with the respective department.
* Ensure timely deployment of workers based on factory and site requirements.
* Maintain a ready manpower pipeline for urgent requirements.

**B. Joining & Onboarding Formalities**

* Complete joining formalities and collect necessary documents.
* Verify Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, photographs and other required documents.
* Explain company policies, attendance rules, working hours and leave procedures.
* Coordinate safety induction and PPE issuance.
* Maintain employee personal files and joining records.
* Ensure new employees are introduced to their respective supervisors.

**C. Attendance and payroll process of workmen& Workforce Management**

* Monitor daily attendance of factory and site workers.
* Track absenteeism, late coming and unauthorised leave.
* Coordinate with supervisors regarding manpower shortages.
* Prepare daily manpower reports.
* Maintain overtime and weekly-off records.
* Follow up with absent employees and understand reasons for absenteeism.
* Coordinate with payroll for attendance and wage processing.

**D. Employee Discipline & Grievance Handling**

* Ensure workers follow company rules and regulations.
* Handle complaints, grievances and workplace conflicts.
* Issue warning letters for misconduct, absenteeism and repeated violations as authorised.
* Monitor workplace discipline, punctuality and behaviour.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve worker-related issues.
* Conduct counselling sessions wherever required.

**E. Employee Welfare & Retention**

* Maintain good relationships with factory workers and site employees.
* Identify reasons for worker turnover and take corrective action.
* Conduct regular interaction with workers.
* Support employee engagement activities and welfare initiatives.
* Ensure timely resolution of worker concerns.
* Maintain communication with employees regarding salary, leave and company policies.

**F. Statutory Compliance & HR Documentation**

* Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund documentation, as applicable.
* Maintain employee records and statutory registers in coordination with the compliance team.
* Support wage and salary processing.
* Maintain records of employee joining, resignation, termination and full-and-final settlement.
* Coordinate contractor labour documentation and compliance.
* Support factory inspections and statutory audits.

**G. Exit & Manpower Replacement**

* Handle resignation and exit formalities of workers.
* Conduct exit discussions to understand reasons for leaving.
* Coordinate replacement manpower requirements.
* Ensure company assets, tools, uniforms and ID cards are returned as applicable.
* Maintain employee turnover and exit records.

**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
WFM Capacity Planner

**DEPARTMENT : Workforce Management**

**EMPLOYMENT : Full-time**

**REPORTS TO : Assistant Manager/Lead WFM**

**Position Summary**

The WFM Capacity Planner converts demand forecasts into practical, financially responsible workforce plans across programs, sites, channels, and skill groups. The role owns long-range and medium-range capacity views, headcount requirements, hiring and training demand, attrition and shrinkage assumptions, staffing-risk scenarios, and executive-ready recommendations.

The successful candidate connects Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Human Resources, and WFM so that hiring and workforce actions are initiated early enough to protect client service commitments, employee readiness, and cost targets.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**Maintain a clear view of future workforce demand and supply, quantify risks early, and recommend the right staffing action at the right time.**

Key Responsibilities

Capacity planning and modeling

* Build rolling capacity plans by program, site, channel, skill, and planning horizon.
* Translate volume, AHT or productivity, SLA, backlog, shrinkage, occupancy, and hours of operation into required FTE and headcount.
* Maintain base, upside, downside, and contingency scenarios with transparent assumptions.

Hiring and training demand

* Calculate weekly and monthly hiring needs, class timing, training capacity, nesting, learning curves, hiring yield, and production-readiness dates.
* Track approved demand against recruiting supply, training graduation, deployment, and productive headcount.
* Identify the decision deadlines required to prevent staffing gaps.

Headcount supply and staffing risk

* Reconcile rostered, budgeted, scheduled, and productive headcount with approved positions.
* Incorporate attrition, absenteeism, leave, internal movement, shrinkage, training, and productivity ramp into supply plans.
* Quantify surpluses and deficits and recommend hiring, overtime, redeployment, cross-skilling, schedule changes, or other mitigations.

Scenario and sensitivity analysis

* Model changes in demand, AHT, productivity, service targets, channel mix, automation, site allocation, shrinkage, attrition, and hiring performance.
* Explain the FTE, cost, service, and timing implications of each scenario.
* Present a recommended option, alternatives, risks, assumptions, and decision dates.

Financial and stakeholder governance

* Connect capacity decisions to labor cost, overtime, contractors, idle capacity, recruitment, training, transitions, and budget outlook.
* Lead recurring capacity reviews with Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, HR, and WFM.
* Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and unresolved assumptions; escalate missed lead times promptly.

Planning quality and continuous improvement

* Maintain version control, assumption logs, model documentation, data-quality checks, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
* Automate recurring reporting and reduce spreadsheet risk through Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Python, or approved tools.
* Protect confidential workforce and financial data and follow contractual, policy, and labor requirements.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in Workforce Management, capacity planning, workforce planning, forecasting, financial planning, or resource planning in a contact-center, BPO, shared-services, or operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to convert demand forecasts into FTE, headcount, hiring, training, and cost plans across multiple time horizons.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including structured models, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, scenario analysis, data validation, and executive-ready outputs.
* Strong knowledge of contact-center and back-office metrics, including volume, AHT, productivity, shrinkage, occupancy, attrition, service level, backlog, utilization, schedule efficiency, and cost per FTE or transaction.
* Experience with a WFM platform such as NICE IEX, Verint, Alvaria / Aspect, Genesys WFM, Calabrio, or an equivalent planning solution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain assumptions, trade-offs, financial impact, and workforce risk to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work with incomplete data while documenting limitations, confidence levels, and improvement actions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting multi-site, multi-skill, multilingual, omnichannel, or global operations.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other analytics and visualization technologies.
* Understanding of Erlang-based staffing, simulation, backlog planning, deferred-work capacity, and skills-based routing.
* Experience partnering directly with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Operations, and client-facing leadership.
* Recognized WFM, analytics, finance, Lean, or Six Sigma certification.

How Success Will Be Measured

**KPI**

**CADENCE**

**Capacity-plan accuracy**

FTE and HC reconcile to approved demand, productivity, shrinkage, and service objectives.

Monthly / quarterly

**Hiring-plan attainment**

Classes, training capacity, yield, and production-ready dates are tracked against plan.

Weekly / monthly

**Staffing-gap control**

Material deficits and surpluses are identified early, quantified, assigned, and escalated.

Weekly

**Plan-versus-actual variance**

HC, attrition, shrinkage, productivity, and cost variances include root cause and action.

Monthly

**Scenario quality**

Scenarios are complete, traceable, timely, and explain assumptions and trade-offs.

As required

**Governance quality**

Models are controlled, documented, reproducible, accurate, and delivered on schedule.

**Monthly**

What a Strong Candidate Demonstrates

* Clearly distinguishes demand, workload, required FTE, scheduled FTE, productive headcount, rostered headcount, and budgeted headcount.
* Builds transparent models with an auditable assumption chain rather than unexplained or hard-coded outputs.
* Understands that hiring plans must include lead time, hiring yield, training capacity, graduation, nesting, attrition, shrinkage, and productivity ramp.
* Challenges unrealistic assumptions constructively and quantifies the cost, service, and timing consequences.
* Communicates one recommendation, viable alternatives, key risks, owners, and decision deadlines in a concise executive format.

**READY TO SHAPE THE FUTURE WORKFORCE?**

Apply through the official Movate careers channel. Candidates may be asked to complete a capacity-planning case study as part of the selection process.

* Develop Fire Alarm layouts, riser diagrams, device schedules and battery backup calculations.
* Coordinate BMS, EMS and lighting control interfaces.
* Design cable trays, conduits, sleeves and cable containment pathways.
* Prepare single-line diagrams, riser diagrams, wiring schedules, installation details and engineering documentation.
* Ensure compliance with NEC, NFPA, project specifications and applicable healthcare design guidelines.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams and review vendor submittals and technical specifications.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* B.E. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering or a relevant engineering discipline.
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Low Voltage / ELV system design.
* Experience in healthcare, hospital or commercial infrastructure projects.
* **Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; working knowledge of Autodesk Revit MEP is preferred.**
* Practical design experience in Structured Cabling, Nurse Call, CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm and other ELV systems.
* Experience in IT room design, server rack sizing, UPS requirements and cable containment systems.
* Ability to independently prepare engineering drawings, riser diagrams, wiring details, calculations and technical documentation.
* Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA and relevant international engineering standards.

Preferred Experience

* **Experience in international healthcare, hospital or commercial infrastructure projects.**
* **Candidates with project exposure in Qatar, Dubai (UAE), Taiwan and Singapore will be preferred.**
* Exposure to US healthcare infrastructure projects will be an added advantage.
* Experience in new construction as well as renovation and retrofit projects.
* Familiarity with vendor systems such as Johnson Controls (JCI), Siemens and other relevant manufacturers.
* Additional experience in Revit MEP and multidisciplinary MEP coordination.

What We Are Looking For

A technically strong design professional who can independently handle Low Voltage engineering design activities, understand project requirements and deliver coordinated, specification-compliant engineering drawings for international infrastructure projects.

title: Supplier Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
**Intuitive**
. As a global leader in
**robotic-assisted surgery**
and
**minimally invasive care**
, our technologies—like the
**da Vinci surgical system**
and
**Ion**
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
In this role, a Supplier Engineer is responsible for ensuring suppliers meet ISI requirements for quality, service, delivery, and cost. Drive suppliers to continuously improve business and manufacturing processes. Evaluate and select suppliers. Guide Engineering in choosing suppliers for new products and provide DFM input to new designs to support NPI projects. Executes detailed projects with suppliers to ensure excellence across quality, cost, capacity, risk management, and sub-supplier management.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Drive PCBA manufacturing qualification at contract manufacturers, including readiness requirements and milestone reviews.
* Provide PCB/PCBA DFM feedback and escalate manufacturability risks early in product development.
* Complete project/ part qualification deliverables including: Supplier pFMEA, Process Validations (IQ/OQ/PQ), Inspection Reports, Gage R&R, and Process Capability Analysis
* Develop and implement manufacturing technologies and process improvements to enhance quality, reliability, throughput, and cost.
* Work with suppliers to execute cost reductions, capacity improvements, and risk mitigation
* Select the right process and supplier for the part, considering long term fit and total ownership cost
* Manage supplier changes including manufacturing process changes, production optimization, facility changes, new equipment qualification, and new line validations
* Drive changes to ISI requirements as necessary by initiating and managing changes to specifications and drawings through the engineering change order process
* Own and drive to closure supplier variances from symptom through root cause analysis to corrective action, including careful CAPA documentation
* Effectively prioritize and advance multiple concurrent projects and tasks
* Clearly communicate project status to key stakeholders
* Build, own, and relentlessly pursue a vision for developing suppliers
* Understand proper level of documentation detail for tracking of actions and justification of decisions
* Generate key metrics for the team and suppliers, and continually drive for timely achievement of those metrics
* Drive suppliers to continually improve their business and manufacturing process performance to meet Intuitive’s requirements for supplier excellence using a collection of best practices in project management, Six Sigma, Lean, SPC and negotiation. Lead these efforts without managerial guidance at several suppliers simultaneously
* Implement corrective and preventive actions for supplier process by driving supplier’s investigations and root cause analysis
* Provide effective and timely supply base health information and recommendation to management by creating and delivering data-driven supply base information to any level of management at ISI with little or no guidance
* Prepare and deliver supplier communications as required by independently working with suppliers on scorecard creation
* Work with suppliers and ISI design engineering for the new product introduction to:
* Create product supplier landscapes to determine launch readiness and report to management
* Develop supplier ramp readiness plans by judging business risk based on forecast, supplier capacity, quality performance, and process capability.
* DFM by engaging suppliers early in development cycle to feedback manufacturability improvements in the designs prior to production
* Influence and guide Design Engineering in choosing suppliers by determining selection criteria for preferred suppliers and leading the team effort to evaluate preferred suppliers
* Review, analyze and close customer complaints, manufacturing variance requests, and first article inspections by judging risk analyses and justifications
* Evaluate corrective and preventive actions at suppliers, looks for opportunities with suppliers to eliminate recurrence

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**

* Minimum 3 yrs related experience in engineering/manufacturing of Electronics (PCBA, PCA, cable assemblies, wiring harnesses, etc.) preferred.
* Experience with board assembly processes and equipment, including stencil, paste print, SPI, pick and place, SMT reflow, AOI, AXI, selective solder, flying probe, wash, and conformal coating.
* PCBA DFM experience
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including presentations to executive level management
* Excellent Interpersonal, team building and project management skills
* Demonstrable knowledge in evaluating and challenging supplier technical, quality, and business capabilities
* Demonstrable knowledge of a wide range of manufacturing processes including understanding of key input variables for quality, cost, and capacity
* Excellent knowledge of 21 CFR part 820 and ISO 13485
* Significant computer experience using Windows, Word, Excel, Project, Access, and ERP Information Systems, preferably SAP or Agile

**Required Education And Training**

* Minimum Education: BS degree in Engineering or equivalent experience, advanced degree preferred
* Experience with SMT/PCBA manufacturing and process development
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to travel to suppliers on an as-needed basis – domestic and international.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Medical Device experience is a plus
* Supplier management experience is a plus
* Advanced degree preferred
* DFM tools experience, such as Valor or Allegro, is a plus.
* Experience with statistical analysis software such as Minitab is a plus
* Experience in a high-volume medical device company is a plus

Additional Information
  
  
Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.
  
  
We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch

The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.

At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every

aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.

With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

How will we do it?

There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:

Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.

Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.

Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.

Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:

* Individuals & Families
* Landlords & Second Home Owners
* Developers & RWAs
* Corporates

*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family*

A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences & behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family & its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient & a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family & thus, the most important link between the company & the customer.

*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager*

1. Customer Onboarding

* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold & onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.

2. Solution Deployment

* Define & agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day-to-day chores, & undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.

3. Partner Management

* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.

4. Customer Lifecycle Management

* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight & transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.

5. Customer Feedback & Service Improvement

* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify & work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise & highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.

Who are we looking for?

* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start-up
* Self-motivated & loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, & is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity & uncertainty
* Focused on problem-solving, has a solution-oriented mindset
* Hard-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Position Summary
  
  
Ford Powertrain Manufacturing is seeking a skilled and hands-on Controls Engineer with 3 to 10 years of experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The role is responsible for improving, troubleshooting, validating, and supporting plant floor control systems, automation equipment, robotics, CNC/machining systems, data collection platforms, error-proofing systems, and industrial networks.
  
  
The successful candidate will work closely with production, maintenance, process engineering, safety, IT, suppliers, and plant leadership to improve equipment uptime, support engineering changes, resolve chronic downtime issues, and ensure robust controls integration across Ford Powertrain operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Controls Engineering and Equipment Support
  
  

* Develop, implement, and sustain improvements to manufacturing control systems, automation equipment, and production processes.
* Troubleshoot PLC, CNC, robot, vision, motion control, safety, and industrial network issues to reduce downtime and improve equipment reliability.
* Lead or support structured problem solving for equipment performance issues, including root cause analysis, validation of fixes, and recurrence prevention.
* Modify, debug, and validate control logic for engineering changes, process improvements, product changes, and quality initiatives.
* Maintain current and accurate program backups for PLCs, robots, CNC systems, HMIs, drives, and related automation equipment.

Powertrain Manufacturing Systems Integration
  
  

* Support integration of plant floor controls with Ford manufacturing systems such as FIS, QWX, QTS, error-proofing systems, WMA, OBL, SMART, VTAG, GPTS, IIoT, and related applications.
* Use Factory Information Systems and plant monitoring tools to analyze cycle time, downtime, throughput, fault history, and equipment performance trends.
* Support integration of CNC controls, gantries, auxiliary equipment, RFID systems, traceability systems, and complexity management solutions.
* Validate PLC logic, station numbering, data collection, Andon functionality, error-proofing logic, and communication interfaces.

Project Launch and Installation Support
  
  

* Review and coordinate controls-related activities for equipment installations, upgrades, commissioning, and launch support.
* Participate in controls design reviews, risk assessments, machine safety reviews, and project readiness reviews.
* Support cost study, design, build, debug, installation, commissioning, launch, and production ramp-up phases.
* Work with internal teams, equipment suppliers, and system integrators to ensure controls deliverables meet Ford standards and plant operational requirements.
* Support virtual commissioning activities when applicable to validate control logic and software before physical installation.

Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Apply lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, 8D, FMEA, DMAIC, 5S, Kanban, Poka-Yoke, Kaizen, and value stream improvement methods to support manufacturing performance.
* Use industrial engineering concepts such as constraint analysis, cycle time analysis, and productivity improvement to optimize system throughput.
* Capture lessons learned and provide feedback to improve controls standards, component selection, equipment maintainability, and future program execution.
* Support standardization of controls practices, machine safety processes, useful life planning, and deviation management.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Training
  
  

* Collaborate effectively with production, maintenance, plant electricians, process engineering, safety, IT, quality, suppliers, and plant leadership.
* Assist in training manufacturing personnel, maintenance teams, and electricians on controls systems, troubleshooting methods, and safe equipment operation.
* Communicate technical issues, risk items, recovery plans, and improvement opportunities clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* 3 to 10 years of controls engineering experience in a manufacturing, powertrain, automotive, machining, assembly, or industrial automation environment.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting and modifying PLC logic, HMI screens, automation systems, robots, drives, sensors, actuators, and industrial communication systems.
* Experience with one or more PLC platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Bosch, or equivalent industrial control systems.
* Working knowledge of robotic systems such as ABB, FANUC, or similar industrial robots.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, controls, and automation prints.
* Understanding of industrial communication networks, fieldbus protocols, and plant floor data interfaces.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CNC controls, machining cells, gantries, transfer systems, assembly lines, torque systems, and auxiliary automation equipment.

title: ENGINEER - CMDB DATA QUALITY
description:
Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
  
  
GCL: C1/C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
  
  
In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
  
  
From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
  
  
CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
  
  
Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
  
  
Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
  
  
CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
  
  
Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.

title: DE - Cloud - Senior Data Platform Engineer - GDSN02
description:

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure security best practices: manage secrets, network isolation, encryption, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and ML teams to enable seamless integration and workflow automation.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices: integrate security scanning and compliance checks into DataOps/MLOps pipelines.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for Databricks platform issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Document architecture, processes, and best practices for knowledge sharing and operational excellence.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Expertise in Databricks/Snowflake administration, including workspace, cluster, and job management.

* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep) and automation scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell).

* Deep understanding of DataOps and MLOps concepts, including orchestration, versioning, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with data governance tools and frameworks (Unity Catalog, Purview, AWS Lake Formation, etc.).
* Ability to design secure, compliant, and scalable data architectures in multi-cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills for distributed data and ML workloads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive platform adoption.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and integrating security tools into data pipelines.
* Ability to mentor and upskill teams on Databricks, DataOps, and MLOps best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to assess risks and propose mitigation strategies.
* Experience with regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in cloud data environments is a plus.
* Capability to identify software packages and solutions that could meet client solution requirements and develop requests for proposal (RFP’s) from these vendors. Assist clients in the evaluation of the resulting proposals, including the package capabilities and fit to the requirements (business and technology), vendor proposals for pricing and support.
* Capability to design and developed AI infused DevOps and Platform Engineering framework.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CI/CD Automation Tools – Azure DevOps/ Bamboo/ Team City/ Harness/ Octopus

You will own the full product lifecycle, from purchasing new products and managing stock on a first in, first out basis, to product maintenance, identifying stock due for retirement, coordinating refurbishment and grading, fixing prices, listing products, finding buyers, closing sales, and arranging delivery and payment collection. You will build purchase channels with manufacturers, dealers, and partners for new rental fleet products, and build sales channels for retired products from the ground up. * Coordinate with technicians to inspect, refurbish, and grade each product by condition
* Set prices based on condition, age, and market rates, and review them regularly
* Create clear product listings with photos and descriptions across online and offline channels
* Respond to enquiries, show products, negotiate, and close sales
* Build and manage a network of dealers, bulk buyers, and B2B partners
* Arrange delivery, collect payments, and ensure proper invoicing and records
* Maintain accurate stock records and share weekly stock, sales, and recovery reports

**Who should apply**

We are looking for a candidate preferrable with 1–3 years of work experience. Experience in the furniture or consumer durables industry, or in related fields such as appliance and furniture servicing, will be an added advantage. Hands-on exposure to warehouse management, procurement, inventory control, retail sales, pre-owned goods sales, inventory liquidation, dealer management, or online marketplace selling will be valued. The ideal candidate is a confident negotiator with strong communication and relationship-building skills, a good eye for product value, a sharp sense of pricing, and the discipline to run stock and records with precision.

payrentz is a rental platform offering flexible and affordable monthly rental plans for home appliances, furniture, and fitness equipment. title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch

The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.

At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every

aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.

With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

How will we do it?

There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:

Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.

Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.

Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.

Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:

* Individuals & Families
* Landlords & Second Home Owners
* Developers & RWAs
* Corporates

*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family*

A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences & behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family & its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient & a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family & thus, the most important link between the company & the customer.

*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager*

1. Customer Onboarding

* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold & onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.

2. Solution Deployment

* Define & agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day-to-day chores, & undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.

3. Partner Management

* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.

4. Customer Lifecycle Management

* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight & transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.

5. Customer Feedback & Service Improvement

* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify & work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise & highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.

Who are we looking for?

* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start-up
* Self-motivated & loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, & is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity & uncertainty
* Focused on problem-solving, has a solution-oriented mindset
* Hard-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

title: Functional Expert - Process Governance & Change Transformation
description:
**Create a better future!**
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future.
  
  
**Functional Expert - Process Governance & Change Transformation**
We are seeking a strategic governance and change expert to help ensure that business transformation creates lasting value. The mission is to establish the standards, controls and knowledge structures that allow a global organisation to change with consistency, confidence and discipline.
  
  
As a Functional Expert, you will shape how processes are governed, how changes are controlled and how organisational knowledge is protected. You will advise Process Owners, project teams and functional leaders on readiness, compliance, adoption and governance risk.
  
  
This role goes beyond maintaining documents or coordinating communications. It is an opportunity to become a recognised authority on process integrity and sustainable change, influencing how new policies, systems, data and ways of working are adopted and retained across the enterprise.
  
  
**Essential Functions & Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
**Build the Governance Backbone: Enterprise Standards & Knowledge (30%)**

* Governance and Knowledge Architecture: Define how processes, SOPs, work instructions, templates, playbooks and knowledge assets are created, approved, controlled, reviewed and retired. Establish clear accountability for the quality and integrity of enterprise process knowledge.
* Outputs: Process-governance framework, controlled SOP library, standards catalogue, document lifecycle model, process-owner accountability matrix and enterprise knowledge architecture.

**Protect Process Integrity: Change Control & Organisational Readiness (25%)**

* Strategic Change Assurance: Assess the organisational effect of changes to processes, policies, systems and data. Establish the readiness, approval and adoption requirements needed to protect operational continuity and expected business value.
* Outputs: Change-impact assessments, readiness evaluations, approved change records, stakeholder-impact maps, adoption strategies and implementation assurance reports.

**Create Visibility Before Risk Becomes Failure: Compliance & Control Intelligence (20%)**

* Governance Risk Leadership: Maintain an enterprise view of process risks, compliance gaps, documentation weaknesses and overdue obligations. Use automated alerts and structured escalation to enable early management intervention.
* Outputs: Risk and control register, compliance assessment, governance heatmap, automated alert framework, exception reports, escalation papers and corrective-action tracker.

**Make Change Last: Process-Owner Advisory & Adoption Governance (15%)**

* Strategic Governance Partnership: Advise Process Owners, project teams and functional leaders on governance expectations, adoption risks and control requirements. Ensure material changes are supported by clear decisions, ownership and evidence.
* Outputs: Governance review packs, process-owner decision records, adoption reports, audit evidence files, policy-alignment assessments and management action updates.

**Preserve What the Organisation Knows: Governance Culture & Knowledge Transfer (10%)**

* Governance Capability Leadership: Build awareness of process ownership, document control and change responsibilities. Capture lessons and strengthen the organisation’s ability to retain knowledge through business and workforce changes.
* Outputs: Governance learning pathway, role-based guidance, onboarding content, knowledge-transfer plans, lessons-learned repository and standards-awareness sessions.

**Parameters for Success**

* Process Integrity: Approved standards and processes remain current, controlled and clearly owned.
* Change Assurance: Material changes enter the business with complete assessment, approval and adoption plans.
* Governance Visibility: Management has early visibility of control gaps, expired documents and overdue actions.
* Sustainable Adoption: New ways of working are understood, applied and retained after implementation.
* Knowledge Resilience: Critical organisational knowledge remains accessible and protected through change.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Organisational Development or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years of experience in process governance, change transformation, document control, compliance, Quality Systems or operational governance.
* Proven experience designing governance frameworks and advising senior stakeholders.
* Experience controlling enterprise documentation, process standards and knowledge assets.
* Demonstrated involvement in complex digital or organisational transformations.

**Technical & Certifications**

* Prosci, ADKAR or equivalent change-management certification preferred.
* Strong knowledge of process governance, document control, risk registers and compliance monitoring.
* Experience with SharePoint, workflow tools and knowledge-management platforms.
* Familiarity with EPICOR, Coupa, D365 or equivalent systems.

**Personal Capabilities**

* Strategic governance judgement and strong personal integrity.
* Confidence to challenge control gaps and non-compliance constructively.
* Ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong documentation discipline and attention to detail.
* Clear communication and consistent follow-through.

**What We Offer**

* A global and inclusive workplace focused on sustainability and innovation
* Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities
* Competitive benefit package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. title: BIM Coordinator / Senior BIM Lead
description:
**Summary**

We are looking for an experienced
**BIM Coordinator / Senior BIM Lead**
to own and govern end-to-end Building Information Modeling (BIM) deliverables across our development lifecycle. Acting as the central technical authority between our internal project management team, external design consultants, precast manufacturers, and MEPF contractors, you will drive model accuracy, clash-free coordination, and information compliance from initial concept design (
**LOD 100**
) through precast factory fabrication (
**LOD 400**
) to field-verified As-Built and Facility Management handover (
**LOD 500**
).

**Key Responsibilities**

* **BIM Governance & Execution Planning (ISO 19650).**
  Author, implement, and enforce the project-specific
  **Employer’s Information Requirements (EIR)**
  and
  **BIM Execution Plan (BEP)**
  across all consultants, precast vendors, and subcontractors.
* **Design Consultant Auditing (LOD 100 – LOD 350).**
  Audit and validate Architectural, Structural, and MEPF models submitted by external design consultants at every stage gate to ensure geometric accuracy, naming compliance, and constructability before tender or GFC release.
* **Precast & Multi-Discipline Coordination (LOD 350 – LOD 400).**
  Lead weekly multi-discipline clash detection and resolution workshops using
  **Navisworks Manage**
  . Enforce strict
  **MEP freeze milestones**
  prior to precast casting, auditing
  **Tekla Structures**
  models and Cast Unit drawings for exact embedded plates, lifting anchors, grouting sleeves, and MEP penetrations.
* **Construction & Fabrication Oversight (LOD 400).**
  Track precast piece marks, erection sequencing (4D BIM), and shop drawing approvals between design consultants, precast plants, and site execution teams to eliminate on-site rework.
* **As-Built & Asset Handover Management (LOD 500).**
  Oversee the transition from LOD 400 to
  **LOD 500**
  , ensuring all approved site RFIs, redline markups, and field-verified deviations (via laser scan/point cloud or site surveys) are captured. Enforce structured
  **COBie**
  asset data, serial numbers, warranties, and O&M manuals for seamless handover to Facility Management.
* **Common Data Environment (CDE) Administration.**
  Manage project folder structures, model versioning, approval workflows, and issue tracking on
  **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360**
  .
* **Quantity Take-Offs (5D BIM Support).**
  Extract and validate accurate model-based Quantity Take-Offs (QTO) and precast element schedules to support procurement, billing, and cost control teams.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* **Education.**
  Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Civil or Structural Engineering, B.Arch, or equivalent technical qualification with deep construction execution knowledge.
* **Experience.**
  5 to 10 years of progressive BIM experience, including at least 3+ years leading BIM coordination on commercial, residential, or industrial projects involving
  **precast concrete structures**
  .
* **Core Software Proficiency.**
* **Autodesk Revit**
  (Architecture, Structure, MEP) – Advanced model auditing and family standards.
* **Navisworks Manage**
  – Advanced clash matrix setup, rule-based clash detection, and 4D simulation.
* **Tekla Structures**
  – Strong working knowledge of precast elementization, cast-in embeds, MEP sleeves, rebar cages, and IFC coordination.
* **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360**
  – CDE administration and issue management.
* **Standards & Handover Expertise.**
  Proven hands-on experience with
  **ISO 19650**
  workflows, BIMForum LOD specifications (LOD 100–500),
  **COBie**
  data standards, and Scan-to-BIM / As-Built verification protocols.
* **Leadership & Communication.**
  Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to hold external consultants and precast/MEP contractors accountable to project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on the
  **Client / Project Developer**
  or
  **PMC**
  side rather than purely in a modeling production role.

Job Location - Chennai

title: Product Steward Specialist
description:
Under the supervision of the Global Product Stewardship Manager, the
**Product Stewardship Specialist**
will be responsible for supporting product stewardship efforts to ensure Ascend Performance Materials (APM) products comply with applicable chemical control laws and regulations in the markets in which we operate.
  
  
This position works across Ascend businesses to gather data and information supporting compliance and registration activities, while actively collaborating with supply chain, technology, and commercial departments.
  
  
Targeted Outcomes
  
  

* ESSH Excellence: Drive Environment, Safety, Security, and Health (ESSH) excellence across the development, production, marketing, and overall lifecycle of APM’s growing global product portfolio.
* Continuous Improvement: Support internal process improvements, integration, and compliance efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* SDS & Label Management: Author Safety Data Sheets (SDSs) and assist with the maintenance and management of SDS software to keep documentation and product labels fully up to date.
* Customer Reporting: Author International Material Data System (IMDS) and CDX reports for automotive and industrial customers.
* Database Management: Build and manage internal raw material and chemical databases to ensure compliance with internal requirements and applicable global regulations.
* Regulatory Correspondence: Draft regulatory letters and compliance statements for customers.
* Regulatory Tracking: Track emerging regulations in Asia and collaborate with team members to proactively ensure full compliance.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor of Science (BS) or higher in Chemistry or related sciences.
* Technical Proficiency: Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SAP.
* Experience: 5 years of product stewardship experience (e.g., SDS authoring, transportation, chemical regulations such as TSCA, EU REACH, Japan CSCL/ISHL, China regulations, K-REACH, etc.) within the chemical or similar manufacturing industry.
* Software Experience: Prior experience with IMDS and SDS authoring software is preferred.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both oral and written.
* Highly organized with significant attention to detail.
* Self-motivated individual with the ability to interpret and apply complex laws, regulations, and standards.
* Strong willingness to continuously learn and grow in the field of product stewardship.
* Ability to work effectively across multiple functional groups internally and externally (including commercial, technology, operations, ESSH, customers, regulatory agencies, and consulting groups).
* Solid analytical and project management skills.

Our global workforce makes the materials used to make safer vehicles, cleaner energy, better medical devices, smarter appliances, and longer-lasting apparel and consumer goods. We are committed to safety, sustainability, and the success of our customers and our communities.

title: Manufacturing Process Engineer
description:

This position works closely with design engineers, equipment vendors, program managers, marketing, and quality engineers to support the development of new electromechanical products. They are responsible for providing the overall process design and suggesting measures to improve product design for manufacturability. This includes the development of new equipment and process flows as well as developing cost estimates for labor and capital. They will also provide ongoing sustaining support to production lines at our global make sites.
  
  
**General Responsibilities**

* Key participant in the development of new production processes and/or adapt existing production processes for assembly, calibration and testing
* Define specifications for production equipment and interact with mechanization (in house) and/or equipment suppliers to ensure equipment will meet specifications
* Key participant in global new product development project teams to enable successful launch of new products
* Collaborate with other departments on process specifications, quality aspects, product specifications and continuity of equipment
* Influence product designs during new product development phase to ensure economical and defect free manufacture
* Developing new or improved manufacturing and testing processes that are necessary to achieve the performance and cost requirements of future device applications
* Organize the arranging of sample lines and process development equipment
* Key participant in advanced quality planning activities
* Coordinates all functional requirements, the reviewing of designs and debugging /qualifying new high volume assembly /test equipment or tooling
* Transferring knowledge to make site personnel
* Support improvement projects to reduce cycle time, defects and manufacturing costs
* Work with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure processes are capable, have sufficient controls in place, can meet out delivery requirements, and meet our cost targets
* Evaluate technical capabilities including tooling design, build experience, maintenance program, processes and process controls, cell automation- if required, quality control systems, and material knowledge

**Experience / Qualifications**

* A university degree required (i.e. Bachelors degree) or equivalent relevant work experience
* Must be a team player able to work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing tasks and demands
* Strong communication skills; oral, written and presentation
* Strong organization, planning and time management skills to achieve results
* Strong personal and professional ethical values and integrity
* Holds self-accountable to achieving goals and standards
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel)
* Strong interpersonal & collaboration skills to work effectively with all levels of the organization including suppliers and/or external customers

**Additional Hiring Requirements / Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in manufacturing process development and NPI, including transitioning new products from design through production ramp-up.
* Experience developing, qualifying, and improving assembly, calibration, and test processes for high-volume manufacturing.
* Strong understanding of DFM, process validation, equipment qualification, and production readiness, working cross-functionally with Product Development, Quality, and Operations.
* Proven ability to improve process capability, yield, cycle time, and manufacturing cost using data-driven problem solving and continuous improvement methods.
* Strong hands-on equipment troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, including corrective actions to maintain stable production.
* Hands-on experience with ICT/test equipment, laser welding equipment, and industrial robots such as ABB, Epson, and/or Mitsubishi.
* Experience with PLC programming using Siemens, Mitsubishi, and/or Omron; experience with LabVIEW-based test or automation systems is preferred.

title: Solution Cost Manager

The successful candidate will own the cost framework and baseline of each reference solution that will serve as the templates for individual bids as well as the basis for analysis and decision making as each reference solution is developed. This manager will drive the use of these cost baselines, support bid and execution teams in the correct application while coordinating contributors from various fields (NPI, Value Proposition, Sourcing, etc). A special focus shall be given on improving competitiveness, controlling risk, and protecting profitability.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Own and develop reference solution cost baselines, templates and deployment packages, ensuring the baselines are clearly defined, accurate, user-friendly and well maintained.
* Drive the use of these cost baselines and ensure they are readily available and accessible to all users and stakeholders
* Define, maintain, and govern standard cost baselines for end-to-end reference solutions
* Work with Global Sourcing and others to keep costs up-to-date, identify any gaps and obtain costings as needed
* Operate in close coordination with the OTR cost controllers to understand actual costs from projects and use this information to refine the reference solution cost baselines
* Work with Proposal Managers to ensure that ITOC models are used correctly and efficiency
* Participate in the tender review process to support, review and ensure the consistency of the data presented
* Support bid and project teams during tender and execution phases by ensuring the correct cost baselines are used in line with intended standards and assumptions
* Coordinate Solution Line and Regional stakeholders involved in sourcing, finance and cost control ensuring alignment between processes and regional business needs
* Provide cost input for analysis and decision making associated with the development of the existing reference solutions and the establishment of new solutions as needed
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cost-related risks early in the lifecycle to improve execution readiness, reduce delivery uncertainty, and protect profitability
* Continuously evolve the reference solution cost baselines based on market needs, lessons learned, tendering and execution feedback, and business priorities
* Contribute to improving win rate, execution consistency, and margin performance by strengthening the quality, competitiveness, and use of reference solutions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* Demonstrated experience in cost analysis, bid management, proposal management or Finance in an engineering and/or project environment
* Proven experience developing, governing, or deploying standardized cost tools and references or reusable frameworks in a multi-project or multi-region environment
* Strong understanding of project cost control processes and industry-standard methodologies
* Experience with cost analysis tools and the ability to develop specific tools as needed to support the work
* Demonstrated ability to drive use of standardized tools and references and process improvement across cross-functional teams
* Stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, tendering, regional, commercial teams
* Proven ability to identify risks, resolve cross-functional issues, and drive alignment in complex business environments
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in power systems, grid solutions, power conversion technologies, or other industrial infrastructure businesses
* Experience working in global organizations with regional execution models
* Familiarity with bid management, project execution, and lifecycle support processes
* Experience defining cost models, lead time assumptions, standard terms, or deployment methodologies for standard solutions
* Experience driving continuous improvement, lessons learned, and return-on-experience integration into standard offerings

Yes

title: Embedded SW Quality Test Engineer

Define & develop test strategies and perform extensive tests to test every hardware and software component of the control platform of GE PC drives & ensure that products are bug-free while delivered.

title: Fiber Growth : Host Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
A flexible team of passionate developers working on real-time embedded software applications for broadband access products.
  
  
We interact closely with our colleagues in Shanghai and have started contributing to the development of device virtualization that simulates and runs real world physical Nokia products on a cloud in a pure software based virtualized form. We work in an agile manner.
  
  
As a team we also possess a deep understanding of the end-to-end functionality of our products, as our deliverables are gating for other SW application teams. The team consists of a mix of Software development and test engineers.
  
  
Our goal is to bring our product innovations and evolutions to the market faster and at higher quality than the competition as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team of senior experts, supported by state-of-the-art development and test technologies, tools and processes.
  
  
Getting Started with Us
  
  
You’ll get ample opportunity to get acquainted with the organization, our way of working, and our products. During the training period, the team will support you with specific on-hands / on-the-job training. On top of that, you will have a wide variety of high-quality on-line training material at your disposal. Additionally, we make time to support each other when facing a next challenge and to celebrate achievements.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
As part of our team, you will:
  
  

* Acquire an overview of the broadband access products that Nokia offers and of the wide variety of hardware components present in our systems.
* Work on device virtualization that simulates and runs real-world physical Nokia products on a cloud in a pure software-based virtual platform.
* Collaborate with colleagues in Shanghai on the host framework development.
* Model new Hardware functionality in the host environment.
* Write test cases to validate the host simulation platform and automate them.
* Be accountable for the long-term quality of the software delivered.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* An engineering degree or a degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics (or 5 years of relevant experience).
* Knowledge of real-time operating system concepts (interrupts, tasks, concurrency, etc.).
* Ability to work fluently with Unix/Linux as an operating system. in particular Basic understanding of Linux networking: L2 forwarding, L3 routing, packet format, Linux bridge, Terminal Access Point /Virtual Ethernet interfaces.
* A high-level understanding of the hardware and software architecture of embedded Linux systems (e.g., U-Boot, device tree, basic system buses like I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit), (Quad)Serial Peripheral Interface, PCIexpress, Linux kernel, drivers, etc.).

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Knowledge of C/C++, Python, and Bash, Knowledge of virtualization and containers (e.g., Docker).
* Eagerness and agility to learn quickly and embrace daily challenges and "Out-of-the-box" thinking.
* Capability of working independently after the necessary training.
* Fluency in English.
* Familiarity with Golang/Rust and Kubernetes (K8S) is a plus.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
  
  
**Required**

* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
* Strong programming skills: Apex (classes, triggers, batch, queueable), SOQL/SOSL, JavaScript, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
