title: Fiber Growth : Host Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
A flexible team of passionate developers working on real-time embedded software applications for broadband access products.
  
  
We interact closely with our colleagues in Shanghai and have started contributing to the development of device virtualization that simulates and runs real world physical Nokia products on a cloud in a pure software based virtualized form. We work in an agile manner.
  
  
As a team we also possess a deep understanding of the end-to-end functionality of our products, as our deliverables are gating for other SW application teams. The team consists of a mix of Software development and test engineers.
  
  
Our goal is to bring our product innovations and evolutions to the market faster and at higher quality than the competition as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team of senior experts, supported by state-of-the-art development and test technologies, tools and processes.
  
  
Getting Started with Us
  
  
You’ll get ample opportunity to get acquainted with the organization, our way of working, and our products. During the training period, the team will support you with specific on-hands / on-the-job training. On top of that, you will have a wide variety of high-quality on-line training material at your disposal. Additionally, we make time to support each other when facing a next challenge and to celebrate achievements.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
As part of our team, you will:
  
  

* Acquire an overview of the broadband access products that Nokia offers and of the wide variety of hardware components present in our systems.
* Work on device virtualization that simulates and runs real-world physical Nokia products on a cloud in a pure software-based virtual platform.
* Collaborate with colleagues in Shanghai on the host framework development.
* Model new Hardware functionality in the host environment.
* Write test cases to validate the host simulation platform and automate them.
* Be accountable for the long-term quality of the software delivered.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**

* An engineering degree or a degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics (or 5 years of relevant experience).
* Knowledge of real-time operating system concepts (interrupts, tasks, concurrency, etc.).
* Ability to work fluently with Unix/Linux as an operating system. in particular Basic understanding of Linux networking: L2 forwarding, L3 routing, packet format, Linux bridge, Terminal Access Point /Virtual Ethernet interfaces.
* A high-level understanding of the hardware and software architecture of embedded Linux systems (e.g., U-Boot, device tree, basic system buses like I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit), (Quad)Serial Peripheral Interface, PCIexpress, Linux kernel, drivers, etc.).

**It would be nice if you also had:**

* Knowledge of C/C++, Python, and Bash, Knowledge of virtualization and containers (e.g., Docker).
* Eagerness and agility to learn quickly and embrace daily challenges and "Out-of-the-box" thinking.
* Capability of working independently after the necessary training.
* Fluency in English.
* Familiarity with Golang/Rust and Kubernetes (K8S) is a plus.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Now (Tez)
description:
**Description**
Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.
  
  
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

**About The Team**
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience

description:
**Job Summary**

* App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
* Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Application Development**

* Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
* Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
* Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
* Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**

* Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
* Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
* Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

**Secure Development & Technology Risk**

* Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
* Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
* Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
* Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**

* Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
* Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
* Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**

* Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
* Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.
* Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.
* Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**

* Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
* Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
* Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
* Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
* Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**

* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
* Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
* Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

* Distributed Systems
* DevOps
* Software Testing
* Secure Coding
* Web Application Security
* Mobile Security

* Platform Management

* Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.

* Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.

description:

**#DFO&I2027**

You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Integrate and learn from talented colleagues who specialize in core domains.
* Adopt a growth mindset and invest in expanding your understanding of Deloitte’s integrated solutions and marketplace offerings.

* Support post-deployment activities, including maintenance, enhancements, and client communication.
* Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement through adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.
* Conduct testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality and resolve issues.
* Deliver high-quality work, ensuring timely completion of tasks and adherence to requirement.
* Demonstrate openness and initiative in learning Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, recognizing their importance for innovation and market competitiveness.
* Strong focus on data-driven decision-making and use of agile methodologies.
* Take ownership of deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or innovation.
* Uphold Deloitte’s values of integrity, client focus, and making an impact that matters.

**The team:**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Understand functional requirements translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designs using standard patterns. Should also be able to communicate this effectively to the team.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Analyse and identify gaps in functional/business requirements and should be able to effectively communicate this to both Business and Functional analysts
* Experience in configuring core Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud)
* Familiarity with declarative tools (Process Builder, Flows, Validation Rules, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modelling, governance, and security within Salesforce
* Should be able to assess the impact on technical designs caused by changes in functional requirements
* Should be able to perform independent code reviews and execute unit tests on modules developed
* Experience in Salesforce.com Development environments (VS Code)
* Knowledgeable in Apex, Visual force, Lightning Components, Lightning Web Components, SFDX
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external AI APIs and managing custom AI deployments within CRM processes
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Einstein features, AI-driven insights, and bot configuration
* Hands-on experience leveraging Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to drive automation.
* Ability to configure and optimize workflows that integrate Agentforce automation with human agent processes.
* Certifications

+ Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) certification (or equivalent experience)
+ Salesforce.com Platform Developer certifications
+ Salesforce.com Domain Certifications

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

title: Founding Engineer - Delivery
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to run delivery like it's their own company — not manage tickets, but own outcomes. You'll sit at the center of client relationships, technical architecture, and team growth. This isn't a management role in the corporate sense — it's a build-and-own role for someone hands-on who's ready to stop being told what to build and start deciding it.

If you've been doing solid work for 5-8 years but feel like you're capped, coasting, or just executing someone else's roadmap — this is the opposite of that.

**What you will own.**

* **Client relationships**

  — run requirement calls directly, translate business needs into technical specs without a middleman
* **Architecture decisions**

  — make the calls on how things get built, not just how they get coded
* **Code quality**

  — review the team's work, set the bar
* **Team growth**

  — unblock junior developers, mentor them into stronger engineers
* **Hands-on development**

  — when bandwidth allows, build features yourself; this isn't a pure-management seat
* **Project health**

  — track delivery status, catch issues before the client does, fix them fast

**What we are looking for**

* 5-8 years of full-stack experience (MERN preferred); comfortable across the stack, not siloed
* Real client-facing experience — you've sat in requirement calls and owned the outcome, not relayed messages
* A track record of
  **building and owning**

  something end-to-end — not just maintaining what others designed
* Startup or small-team background preferred — you're used to ambiguity, not process for its own sake
* Some experience mentoring or leading other developers, even informally
* Still writes code regularly — if you haven't shipped anything hands-on in 2+ years, this isn't the fit
* Low job-hop history — we're looking for someone who wants to build something over years, not months

**What this isn't**

* Not a pure people-management role — you'll still write code
* Not a ticket-execution job — we want judgment, not just delivery against a spec
* Not a place for "20 years of experience, comfortable in my lane" — if the title matters more to you than the ownership, this probably isn't it

Competitive, based on experience — with room to grow as the role and the company do.

Chennai, in-office.

title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.

* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, enterprise engineering environment.
  
  
* Passion for automation, engineering excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
This role supports the technical solution design for Operational Transfer Pricing and other Tax capabilities or part of a cross functional component. The role is a key position on the Axial Programme IT design team taking a central role in defining the global design template for AstraZeneca in line with our ambition of Fit to Standard using SAP best practice as far as possible. You will be a member of a wider Axial IT Design Team that will lead on defining the IT solution that will support our global standardised business processes. Ensuring integration between business process definition, SAP solution definition and SAP data objects definition.
  
  
In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that the global standard solution is fully and accurately documented and tested according to project standards and will guide the core design through the required governance forums. You will work closely with IT Enterprise Business Partners, others IT Product Managers and SMEs across the design team to ensure that solutions are efficiently integrated into a wider AstraZeneca global standard design. This will also include working with SMEs from our external partners to ensure that the AZ solution adopts standard and groundbreaking technology in fulfilling business capabilities and outcomes.
  
  
As the project moves to the deployment phase you will continue to play a pivotal role in ensuring that the localisation requirements of individual operating units are properly represented in the solution, whilst retaining the integrity of a fit to standard best practice template. You will also support the deployment teams with deploying the business change journey and ensuring successful migration and cutover to the standard design for each entity. You will be a key participant in hypercare management, ensuring that any issues related to your capability are resolved in a timely and effective way.
  
  
In the role of SAP PaPM Consultant, you will apply knowledge of SAP best practices to enable core business capability and a standard global template for your respective domain.
  
  
PaPM is a new SAP capability and as such not all potential candidates may have the necessary skill sets. However, if you have a good functional knowledge within the domain or experience with other technologies mentioned in this role profile, then please apply as AstraZeneca can support your career development.
  
  
**Essential For The Role**

* Good functional knowledge/experience in Operational transfer pricing, financial performance and analytics and financial allocation processes
* Experience and knowledge in one or more mentioned SAP technologies: SAP PAPM (Required), SAP Datasphere (Preferred), SAP SAC (Optional) and SAP HANA Modelling (Optional)
* Understanding of defining the data models in PaPM, integration of finance actuals, forecasting (SAP and non-SAP systems), standard capabilities in PaPM and design of business rule
* Handle multiple data sources, data objects and integrate them effectively
* Creation and review of technical design documentation addressing user requirements
* Confident to challenge the status quo and facilitate different perspectives to drive solutions
* Able to think out of the box, thrive in ambiguous and stressful situations
* Understanding of Cost and Revenue allocation process design and implementation

**Desirable for the role**

* Comfortable with ambiguity and possessing an agile and open approach.
* Self-motivated with the ability to prioritise efficiently to ensure project goals are achieved.
* Skilled in business operations, communications, customer and partner engagement.
* Understanding of various transfer pricing calculation methods , P&L Segmentation, monitoring, true-ups process design and implementation
* Understanding of supply chains of multinationals and how they are reflected in system landscapes
* Understanding of SAP FICO, SAP SD & MM pricing

**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
**So, what’s next?**

title: Rental Asset Manager
description:
**Role Description**

You will own two connected areas of the business:

1. Warehouse and rental fleet: Manage the warehouse to ensure the right stock of appliances and furniture is always available for the rental fleet.
2. Used products division: Lead the sale of products retired from the payrentz rental fleet.

You will own the full product lifecycle, from purchasing new products and managing stock on a first in, first out basis, to product maintenance, identifying stock due for retirement, coordinating refurbishment and grading, fixing prices, listing products, finding buyers, closing sales, and arranging delivery and payment collection. You will build purchase channels with manufacturers, dealers, and partners for new rental fleet products, and build sales channels for retired products from the ground up. These include online marketplaces, Meta platforms, B2B buyers such as PGs and hostels, walk-in sales at our warehouse, and existing payrentz customers who wish to buy the products they use.

**What you will do**

* Plan and purchase new appliances and furniture for the rental fleet
* Identify and maintain relationship with manufacturers, dealers, and partners
* Maintain adequate stock levels and manage warehouse dispatch on a first in, first out basis
* Ensure products in the warehouse are maintained and ready for rental
* Track retired and soon-to-retire products across the rental fleet and plan their sale
* Coordinate with technicians to inspect, refurbish, and grade each product by condition
* Set prices based on condition, age, and market rates, and review them regularly
* Create clear product listings with photos and descriptions across online and offline channels
* Respond to enquiries, show products, negotiate, and close sales
* Build and manage a network of dealers, bulk buyers, and B2B partners
* Arrange delivery, collect payments, and ensure proper invoicing and records
* Maintain accurate stock records and share weekly stock, sales, and recovery reports

**Who should apply**

We are looking for a candidate preferrable with 1–3 years of work experience. Experience in the furniture or consumer durables industry, or in related fields such as appliance and furniture servicing, will be an added advantage. Hands-on exposure to warehouse management, procurement, inventory control, retail sales, pre-owned goods sales, inventory liquidation, dealer management, or online marketplace selling will be valued. The ideal candidate is a confident negotiator with strong communication and relationship-building skills, a good eye for product value, a sharp sense of pricing, and the discipline to run stock and records with precision.

**Company Description**

payrentz is a rental platform offering flexible and affordable monthly rental plans for home appliances, furniture, and fitness equipment. We help customers create comfortable and functional living spaces without the upfront investment of purchasing products. With convenient doorstep delivery, installation, and maintenance support, payrentz makes renting simple and hassle-free. Our focus is on flexibility, convenience, and customer satisfaction, helping people make their everyday lives better.

title: Solution Cost Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova is seeking a Solution Cost Manager to join our HVDC team. This role is responsible for managing the cost baselines for all the HVDC reference solutions to ensure a concise, accurate and competitive cost basis is available and can be applied consistently across regions and tenders/projects. The Solution Cost Manager sits at the intersection of solution strategy, sourcing excellence, design improvement and cost competitiveness.
  
  
**Job Description**
The successful candidate will own the cost framework and baseline of each reference solution that will serve as the templates for individual bids as well as the basis for analysis and decision making as each reference solution is developed. This manager will drive the use of these cost baselines, support bid and execution teams in the correct application while coordinating contributors from various fields (NPI, Value Proposition, Sourcing, etc). A special focus shall be given on improving competitiveness, controlling risk, and protecting profitability.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Own and develop reference solution cost baselines, templates and deployment packages, ensuring the baselines are clearly defined, accurate, user-friendly and well maintained.
* Drive the use of these cost baselines and ensure they are readily available and accessible to all users and stakeholders
* Define, maintain, and govern standard cost baselines for end-to-end reference solutions
* Work with Global Sourcing and others to keep costs up-to-date, identify any gaps and obtain costings as needed
* Operate in close coordination with the OTR cost controllers to understand actual costs from projects and use this information to refine the reference solution cost baselines
* Work with Proposal Managers to ensure that ITOC models are used correctly and efficiency
* Participate in the tender review process to support, review and ensure the consistency of the data presented
* Support bid and project teams during tender and execution phases by ensuring the correct cost baselines are used in line with intended standards and assumptions
* Coordinate Solution Line and Regional stakeholders involved in sourcing, finance and cost control ensuring alignment between processes and regional business needs
* Provide cost input for analysis and decision making associated with the development of the existing reference solutions and the establishment of new solutions as needed
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cost-related risks early in the lifecycle to improve execution readiness, reduce delivery uncertainty, and protect profitability
* Continuously evolve the reference solution cost baselines based on market needs, lessons learned, tendering and execution feedback, and business priorities
* Contribute to improving win rate, execution consistency, and margin performance by strengthening the quality, competitiveness, and use of reference solutions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* Demonstrated experience in cost analysis, bid management, proposal management or Finance in an engineering and/or project environment
* Proven experience developing, governing, or deploying standardized cost tools and references or reusable frameworks in a multi-project or multi-region environment
* Strong understanding of project cost control processes and industry-standard methodologies
* Experience with cost analysis tools and the ability to develop specific tools as needed to support the work
* Demonstrated ability to drive use of standardized tools and references and process improvement across cross-functional teams
* Stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, tendering, regional, commercial teams
* Proven ability to identify risks, resolve cross-functional issues, and drive alignment in complex business environments
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience in power systems, grid solutions, power conversion technologies, or other industrial infrastructure businesses
* Experience working in global organizations with regional execution models
* Familiarity with bid management, project execution, and lifecycle support processes
* Experience defining cost models, lead time assumptions, standard terms, or deployment methodologies for standard solutions
* Experience driving continuous improvement, lessons learned, and return-on-experience integration into standard offerings

The company supports projects that require strong technical expertise in structural design, detailing, and building information modeling (BIM). SWT Career Catalyst emphasizes professional development, offering exposure to industry-standard tools, workflows, and international project requirements. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai for a Steel Designer, Steel Detailer/Modeler/Checker & BIM specialist. The role involves preparing detailed steel fabrication and erection drawings, 3D models, and connection details using relevant CAD/BIM software. description:
**Date posted** 11/12/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19735****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/12/2026**

**Job Title: -** Engineering Director - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent two decades building verification teams and solving the problems that live between IP blocks, where clean interfaces meet messy reality and independently verified components refuse to cooperate. The gap between a Controller that passes all tests and a Controller-PHY-firmware combination that actually works in a customer SoC is where you live, and you have built the instincts to close it.

You are technical enough to review a UVM testbench, debug a protocol violation three layers deep, and make the call on whether a coverage hole is real or academic. But you also know that verification at scale is not about heroic debug sessions, it is about building systems that catch problems before they become customer issues. You think in factories, not fire drills.

What excites you now is ing AI to verification work that has resisted automation for years. You see LLMs, agentic workflows, and intelligent orchestration not as buzzwords but as tools that can finally turn interoperability from a bottleneck into a continuously running capability. You are ready to build that capability from the ground up at Synopsys, where the IP portfolio is real, the customer stakes are high, and the technical challenge is exactly the kind you have been preparing for.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and lead the Central Interoperability team from scratch, defining its technical strategy, organizational structure, verification methodology, execution model, and success metrics across high-speed interface IPs including UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, and USB
* Own end-to-end Controller-PHY interoperability qualification, from UVM environment bring-up and configuration management through verification execution, functional and structural coverage closure, protocol compliance, debug, and generation of customer-ready release evidence
* Establish an always-on Interop Factory where new Controller, PHY, or firmware releases automatically trigger integration, regression suites, qualification workflows, and evidence generation without manual intervention
* Drive interoperability verification beyond basic connectivity into protocol compliance, stress and error injection scenarios, CDC/RDC checks, timing constraints validation, and implementation readiness across the Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Configuration state space
Make the factory AI-native by* ing LLMs, AI agents, RAG, MCP, and intelligent workflow orchestration to environment generation, test plan development, regression selection, failure clustering, root-cause analysis, debug acceleration, and knowledge reuse across releases
* Build a continuous learning loop where customer issues feed directly into root-cause analysis, prevention test creation, regression integration, and future release qualification, systematically converting field learning into improved product quality
* Partner across Controller and PHY R&D teams, architecture, VIP development, firmware, methodology, applications engineering, and product management to create one accountable, transparent subsystem-readiness view for every release

**The Impact You Will Have**

* You will create a new verification capability that shifts interoperability left in the development cycle, reducing subsystem bring-up time for customers and increasing the number of qualified Controller-PHY-firmware configurations available at release
* You will transform interoperability from a customer integration exercise into a continuously verified product capability, with reusable qualification evidence and clear release gates that reduce field issues and support escalations
* Your factory will establish a scalable blueprint for subsystem verification across the broader Synopsys IP portfolio, creating reusable infrastructure, methodology, and AI-enabled automation that other teams can adopt
* You will build a team culture that attracts top verification talent, mentors engineers into technical leadership roles, and keeps the organization technically engaged even as it scales
* You will make AI-assisted verification real and measurable, demonstrating how LLMs and agentic workflows can accelerate debug, improve coverage strategies, and turn tribal knowledge into reusable intelligence
* You will create predictable, data-driven subsystem readiness visibility for executives and customers, replacing subjective assessments with objective qualification metrics tied to real verification evidence
* You will reduce the time from IP release to customer-ready subsystem from months to weeks by automating the integration, qualification, and evidence-generation workflows that currently require manual coordination

**What You'll Need**

* 20+ years of semiconductor design and verification experience with significant technical leadership responsibility building and scaling verification teams
* Deep expertise in ASIC, SoC, IP, or subsystem verification using SystemVerilog, UVM, verification planning, functional and code coverage analysis, assertions, regression infrastructure, and complex multi-IP debug
* Strong hands-on experience with high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, USB, or SerDes, including protocol compliance, Controller-PHY integration, and interoperability challenges
* Proven track record integrating independently developed IP blocks and driving complex cross-functional technical programs across R&D, product, and applications teams
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl, or equivalent for building verification infrastructure, regression frameworks, and intelligent workflow orchestration
* Experience with CDC/RDC verification, formal methods, emulation or prototyping platforms, CI/CD for verification, or physical implementation flows is highly desirable
* Exposure to LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, MCP, AI-assisted verification or debug tools, or intelligent engineering automation is strongly preferred and will differentiate your application

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a technical review with verification engineers debugging a CXL protocol failure and walk out with a clear action plan, then turn around and explain the customer-readiness risk to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
* You do not wait for perfect alignment across teams to get started, you define the interoperability strategy, build the initial environment, and prove the value before asking for full organizational buy-in
* You recruit engineers who are better than you at specific things and you create the conditions for them to do their best work, whether that is deep UVM expertise, AI automation, or protocol-level debug
* You have a point of view on what good verification looks like and you push back when a test plan is too shallow, a coverage model is missing critical scenarios, or a release gate is being bypassed without real justification
* You are energized by building new capabilities from scratch, not inheriting mature organizations, and you are comfortable with the ambiguity, cross-functional negotiation, and technical problem-solving that comes with that
* You stay technical, you still read code, review testbenches, understand coverage reports, and debug failures alongside your team, because that is how you earn credibility and make good decisions

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will build the Central Subsystem Interoperability team from the ground up, establishing its charter, hiring its engineers, and defining its relationship to Controller R&D, PHY R&D, VIP, firmware, and product teams across Synopsys. This is a new capability being created to transform how independently developed IP becomes qualified, customer-ready subsystems. You will report into senior engineering leadership and work closely with architecture, methodology, and product management to establish the vision, execution model, and success metrics for this organization. Your team will become the accountable owner of subsystem readiness across high-speed interface IPs, with the mandate to build an always-on, AI-enabled interoperability factory that scales across the portfolio.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Fullstack Lead
description:
* Role Overview

WalkingTree is hiring a Full Stack Lead to own the design and delivery of enterprise web platforms built on Java microservices and Angular microfrontends.
  
  
You will lead a team of full-stack engineers, act as the technical voice to US-based stakeholders and customer teams, and stay hands-on in code, reviews and architecture.
  
  
The platforms you will work on are data-heavy, workflow-driven products used by operations and planning teams: real-time dashboards, rule-based decision engines, integrations with ERP and telematics systems, and event-driven backends.
  
  
Domain knowledge is picked up on the job; engineering depth and customer-facing maturity are what we hire for.
  
  

* Job Details

Attribute Detail Role Full Stack Lead (Java and Angular) Reports To Delivery Head / Engineering Head Team Size 5 to 10 engineers (frontend, backend, QA) Experience 9 to 14 years total, with at least 3 years leading a team Location Hyderabad (hybrid); overlap with US Eastern / Central hours required Employment Full time
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Technical Leadership
* Own the architecture of Java (Spring Boot) microservices and Angular microfrontends, including service boundaries, API contracts, shell and remote composition, and shared design systems.
* Lead design reviews, code reviews and technical decision-making; set coding standards, testing strategy and definition of done.
* Stay hands-on: build critical components, prototype solutions, and unblock the team on hard problems.
* Drive non-functional quality: performance, security, observability, resilience and scalability.
* Delivery and Team Management
* Plan sprints, break down epics, estimate with the team, and commit to delivery dates you can keep.
* Mentor engineers, run hiring interviews, and grow senior developers into future leads.
* Own CI/CD, release readiness and production support practices with the DevOps team.
* Track risks, dependencies and technical debt, and raise them early.
* Customer and USA Stakeholder Engagement
* Work directly with US-based counterparts (product owners, architects, program managers) in regular working-hour overlaps, including daily or weekly calls, demos and sprint reviews.
* Work with customer team members to gather requirements, clarify integration points, walk through designs, and resolve issues together.
* Present architecture, progress and trade-offs clearly to both technical and business audiences.
* Communicate status, blockers and change requests in writing with clear, concise updates that a US stakeholder can act on without a follow-up call.
* Mandatory Requirements

**Candidates who do not meet the first three points below will not be shortlisted.**

* Direct USA counterpart exposure: At least 3 years of working daily with US-based clients, product owners or architects, including regular calls in US time-zone overlap, demos, and written status communication. Candidates must be able to describe specific engagements.
* Direct customer team collaboration: Proven experience working side by side with customer engineering, QA and business team members on requirements, integrations, UAT and production issues, not only through a project manager.
* Microservices and microfrontends as daily work: Hands-on delivery of Spring Boot microservices and Angular microfrontends in production, treated as the normal way of building, not a recent experiment.
* Overall experience: 9 to 14 years of total software experience, with at least 5 years in Java and 4 years in Angular (version 12 or later).
* Team leadership: At least 3 years leading a team of 5 or more engineers, with ownership of design, delivery and mentoring.
* Communication: Strong spoken and written English, suitable for customer-facing and executive communication.
* Technical Skills

Area Expectations Backend Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, REST and OpenAPI, JPA/Hibernate, async processing, Kafka or RabbitMQ Microservices Domain-driven design, API gateway, service discovery, resilience patterns (circuit breaker, retry, idempotency), saga and event-driven patterns Frontend Angular 14+, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx or similar state management, reactive forms, Angular Material or equivalent Microfrontends Module Federation or Native Federation, shell and remote apps, shared libraries and design system, independent versioning and deployment Data PostgreSQL or similar relational database, query tuning, Redis or other caching, familiarity with time-series or analytical data Integration ERP, telematics or third-party REST and event integrations, contract-first design, adapter patterns DevOps Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab or Azure DevOps), Git branching strategy, environment promotion Quality JUnit and Mockito, Jasmine/Jest, Cypress or Playwright, contract testing, SonarQube, static analysis Security and Ops OAuth2 / OIDC, JWT, role-based access, logging, metrics and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) Cloud AWS, Azure or GCP fundamentals for deploying and operating containerised services
  
  

* Good to Have
* Experience with optimisation, forecasting or rule-engine-backed products, or with map and real-time dashboard UIs.
* Exposure to open-source, monorepo-based platforms and multi-team release management.
* Familiarity with Python-based services that your Java services consume.
* Cloud or Kubernetes certification; experience with GitOps.
* Prior experience as a technical interface on enterprise accounts in logistics, manufacturing or supply chain.
* Behavioural Competencies
* Clear communicator who can explain a design trade-off to a US product owner and a customer developer in the same week.
* Ownership mindset: raises risks early, follows through, and does not wait to be chased.
* Calm under production pressure, with a blameless, root-cause-first approach.
* Coaches rather than dictates; builds a team that can ship without the lead in every review.
* What Success Looks Like in the First Year

**Within 90 Days**

* Understands the platform, the customer landscape and the delivery rhythm.
* Is trusted as the main technical contact by the US counterparts.

**Within 6 Months**
– Microservice and microfrontend standards, CI/CD and review practices are documented and followed by the whole team.
  
  
**Within 12 Months**

* Releases are predictable.
* Customer escalations fall.
* At least one engineer has grown into a tech-lead role under you.

title: Senior Java Full Stack Software Developer-NetSuite

We’re looking for a Senior Application Software Engineer who combines strong technical fundamentals with curiosity about better ways to build software. You’ll design and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for enterprise customers, collaborate across engineering, product management, and help improve how the team develops and operates software.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Associate-Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING
  
  
The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.
  
  
Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE
  
  
Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.
  
  
Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
  
  
Please note that our firm has adopted a COVID-19 vaccination requirement for employees who work onsite at any of our U.S. locations to safeguard the health and well-being of all our employees and others who enter our U.S. offices. This role requires the employee to be able to work on-site. As a condition of employment, employees working on-site at any of our U.S. locations are required to be fully vaccinated for COVID-19, and to have either had COVID-19 or received a booster dose if eligible under Centers for Disease Prevention and Control (CDC) guidance, unless prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Principal Engineer (MERN)
description:
**Design it, build it, and own it in production.**
Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later.
  
  
Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products
**JustInterview.ai**
(AI hiring) and
**Sparrow**
(API testing). Our systems handle sensitive patient data and real financial transactions at scale. We’re looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape how these platforms are built, write code alongside the team, and stay accountable for how they perform in production.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the architecture: System design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cloud cost.
* Build security in: Design PHI and payment flows with compliance part of the architecture, not a retrofit.
* Drive cloud-native delivery: MERN platforms on AWS/GCP/Azure with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and secrets management.
* Make the hard calls: Monolith vs. microservices, event-driven design, integrations, build vs. buy. Decide, document, and stand behind it.
* Own reliability: Uptime, latency, and throughput as usage grows; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Set the standard: Reference architectures, reusable patterns, and practical engineering guidelines.
* Stay hands-on: Write code, run design reviews, and review PRs every week.
* Think like the client: Translate business goals and constraints into architecture that fits.
* Grow leaders: Mentor senior engineers and develop future tech leads.

**Your First 90 Days**

* Days 1–30: Learn our products, codebases, and infrastructure, and identify the biggest architectural risks and opportunities.
* Days 31–60: Lead a significant design decision from proposal to production and take a visible role in design reviews.
* Days 61–90: Introduce standards or patterns that teams adopt, and become the go-to technical authority on a core platform.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years in software engineering with clear ownership of architecture decisions
* Experience running a production system with 100,000+ users
* Proven track record of solving serious scale and performance bottlenecks
* Strong hands-on Node.js and React (MERN preferred) with TypeScript
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure

**Nice to Have**

* HIPAA/PHI, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2 compliance experience
* Stripe, Braintree, Adyen, or tokenization experience
* High-availability, event-driven, or microservices systems
* Consultancy or product-studio experience across multiple clients
* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

**Why Techdome**

* Independent and profitable: No investor pressure. We play the long game.
* Real influence: Set engineering standards for an 80+ engineer team.
* Fast path to production: Your designs ship quickly and reach real users.
* Global team: Engineers across India, Dubai, and the US.
