title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
**About QualMinds**

At QualMinds, we design and develop world-class digital products and custom software solutions for Startups, Scale-ups, and Enterprises. Our engineering teams specialize in Frontend, Backend, Full Stack Development, QA Automation, UI/UX, DevOps, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agile Delivery. We are passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest standards of quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
8+ years (3+ years in production LLM/agentic systems, with proven multi-agent architecture experience)

**Job Summary**

We are building
**multi-agent AI systems**
for the automotive dealership ecosystem — networks of specialized, collaborating agents spanning
**customer-facing conversational experiences**
(voice and chat agents on dealership websites that handle inventory search, payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offers, test drive and service scheduling, and lead capture) and
**internal business agents**
(conversational and autonomous operation of campaign management, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — with proactive insights, recommendations, and human-approved actions).

These are not single-chatbot solutions: you will architect
**orchestrated teams of agents**
— planners, retrievers, domain specialists, action executors, and reviewer/critic agents — that coordinate, hand off, and share context to complete complex business workflows reliably. You will own these systems across the
**entire agentic development lifecycle**
: use-case scoping, multi-agent architecture and tool design, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Proven experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures**
  : supervisor/orchestrator patterns, hierarchical and peer-to-peer agent topologies, planner–executor–critic loops, agent handoffs, task decomposition and delegation, shared state/memory design, and failure isolation between agents.
* Hands-on with current agent frameworks and SDKs with strong multi-agent support:
  **LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI, or Vercel AI SDK**
  — including subagents, handoffs, and graph-based orchestration.
* Deep experience with frontier model APIs:
  **OpenAI (GPT-5.x, Realtime API), Anthropic (Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.x), Google (Gemini 3.x, Gemini Live)**
  ; familiarity with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) for per-agent cost/latency routing (e.g., small fast models for routing/critic agents, frontier models for planning).
* Expert in
  **tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  — designing and building MCP servers that expose business systems (inventory, CRM, campaigns, payments, reporting) as governed agent tools; working knowledge of
  **A2A (Agent2Agent)**
  for cross-platform agent interoperability.
* **Realtime voice AI**
  : speech-to-speech pipelines (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live, LiveKit Agents, Pipecat), STT/TTS providers (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia), barge-in/interruption handling, sub-second latency optimization, WebRTC and telephony integration — including voice agents that delegate to backend specialist agents mid-conversation.
* Production
  **RAG and context engineering**
  : vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and reranking, context window management across agent hops, shared and per-agent memory (short-term, long-term, episodic), and freshness strategies for fast-changing data (inventory, offers, pricing).
* **Agent evaluation and observability**
  : LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, or custom harnesses — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge,
  **multi-agent trajectory evals**
  (correct delegation, handoff quality, loop/runaway detection), eval-gated CI/CD; OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions with distributed tracing across agent boundaries.
* **Guardrails and AI safety**
  : prompt-injection defense, jailbreak resistance, PII redaction, content moderation, inter-agent trust boundaries, human-in-the-loop approval flows for consequential actions (payments, campaign sends, customer messaging), and compliance-aware messaging (TCPA).
* Strong
  **Python and TypeScript**
  ; modern backend (FastAPI, Node.js) and frontend (
  **React/Next.js**
  ) development, including streaming and realtime UX (SSE, WebSockets, WebRTC) and generative UI patterns.
* Cloud-native delivery:
  **GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager)**
  or equivalent on AWS/Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; durable execution for long-running agent workflows (e.g., Temporal) is a plus.
* Modern engineering workflow: GitHub (Actions, PR reviews), Jira/Linear, prompt and agent versioning, feature-flagged and eval-gated releases.
* Effective daily use of
  **AI-assisted development tools**
  (GitHub Copilot, coding agents, Claude Code, Cursor) and the judgment to review their output critically.
* PostgreSQL and modern data tooling; event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) for agent-triggered and agent-to-agent workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present AI risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* **Architect multi-agent systems end-to-end**
  : decompose business workflows into specialized agents (routing, retrieval, domain reasoning, action execution, review/critique), choose the right orchestration topology per use case, and define agent contracts, handoff protocols, and shared memory/state.
* Design and build customer-facing voice + chat agent teams covering the full public website capability surface: inventory search and comparison, finance/payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offer discovery, appointment scheduling, and lead capture/qualification — with low-latency realtime voice, streaming chat, graceful fallback, and human handoff.
* Ground all agent responses in live business data with strict accuracy guarantees — no hallucinated prices, VINs, or offers — and implement brand-safe guardrails for public surfaces (prompt injection, jailbreaks, off-topic containment, PII handling).
* Build internal multi-agent workflows that operate backend business platforms conversationally and autonomously: campaigns, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — following the
  **insight → recommendation → approved action**
  pattern with specialist agents collaborating under an orchestrator.
* Expose business capabilities as MCP tools with role-based permissions, audit logging, and approval policies scaled to action risk (read vs. draft vs. send vs. pay); enforce least-privilege tool access per agent.

At RTX, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 people come together with a shared purpose: to solve the world’s most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference. Through our three industry-leading businesses, advanced engineering capabilities, and significant investments in research and development, we are pushing the boundaries of science and technology to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace delivers technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of aerospace technologies, we help customers navigate the evolving demands of global aviation.
  
  
Be part of a team that is advancing aviation safety, reliability, and innovation through world-class engineering.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Avionics Software Verification & Validation (V&V) Engineer / Technical Lead**
to drive the verification, testing, debugging, and certification of safety-critical avionics software.
  
  
In this role, you will work on requirement-based testing, structural coverage analysis, host- and target-based verification, and compliance with DO-178B/C certification objectives. You will collaborate with global engineering teams, contribute to certification reviews and audits, and help develop innovative tools and processes that improve software quality and engineering efficiency.
  
  
This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with technical leadership, mentoring, and continuous improvement while contributing to avionics systems that support safe and reliable flight operations.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Avionics Software Verification & Certification
  
  

* Design, develop, review, and execute requirement-based test cases, test procedures, and unit tests for safety-critical avionics software.
* Perform software verification and validation across host and target environments, including unit, integration, and system-level testing.
* Conduct Structural Coverage Analysis (SCA) and support the achievement of applicable software coverage objectives.
* Ensure compliance with DO-178B/C processes and objectives for applicable software assurance levels, including Levels A, B, and C.
* Support certification activities, including Stages of Involvement (SOI), technical reviews, compliance submissions, and internal and external audits.
* Maintain adherence to established software development, verification, quality, and documentation standards.

**Technical Problem-Solving & Tool Development**

* Debug and troubleshoot software issues across host and target platforms, including software-software and hardware-software integration environments.
* Analyze system capabilities, software behavior, and reported issues to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Develop and maintain Python-based automation and common engineering tools to improve development and verification efficiency.
* Apply engineering principles to design, develop, and implement technologies, components, subsystems, and systems that meet defined requirements and specifications.
* Contribute to continuous improvement in test automation, verification methodologies, and engineering workflows.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams to deliver project milestones and engineering commitments.
* Lead or coordinate moderately sized engineering teams, as applicable, ensuring quality, timely execution, and alignment with project objectives.
* Coach and mentor junior engineers, review technical deliverables, and promote engineering best practices.
* Lead or contribute to innovation initiatives, quality improvement activities, and CORE workshops to deliver measurable product and process improvements.
* Identify novel technical solutions and ensure innovations are appropriately captured and protected through applicable intellectual property processes.

**What You’ll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related STEM discipline.
* Understanding of avionics systems and software architecture, particularly in areas such as Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), and cockpit displays.
* Strong proficiency in Python for scripting, test automation, and engineering tool development.
* Sound knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and DO-178B/C processes for safety-critical avionics software.
* Hands-on experience in software Verification & Validation, Structural Coverage Analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and requirement-based testing.
* Experience in unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and software verification activities.
* Experience with software-software and hardware-software integration and debugging.
* Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.
* Working knowledge of version control and project tracking tools such as Git or Subversion and Jira.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6-9 years of avionics engineering experience, particularly in safety-critical software verification and certification.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as PyATE, Rapita, Coverity, and Jama.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and tools or environments such as Docker, Visual Studio Code, and Artifactory.
* Sound programming knowledge of C/C++.
* Knowledge of avionics data link applications and protocols, including: Controller–Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC).Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Contract (ADS-C).ATN Context Management (CM).FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN).Airline Operational Control (AOC) and Flight Management System (FMS) flight-planning applications.
* Familiarity with data link industry standards such as DO-258A, ED-110B, and DO-351.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and engineering review experience.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with an interest in Lean principles, innovation, and engineering excellence.

**Why Join Collins Aerospace?**

* Make a real-world impact: Contribute to safety-critical avionics software that supports the future of aviation.
* Solve complex engineering challenges: Work with advanced technologies, rigorous certification processes, and sophisticated verification environments.
* Collaborate globally: Partner with experienced engineers and cross-functional teams across international locations.
* Grow your technical leadership: Mentor engineers, influence engineering practices, and contribute to innovation.
* Drive engineering excellence: Help improve product quality, verification efficiency, and software reliability.

The recruiting team will provide further details regarding the role type and current site arrangements during the hiring process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned location is the employee’s responsibility.

This position typically requires a university degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) and relevant professional experience. Equivalent experience or an advanced degree may be considered in accordance with the role’s requirements and applicable local regulations.
  
  
The level of responsibility and experience required will depend on the final position scope and assigned engineering responsibilities.

+ Identifies repeated errors and compliance risks and escalates to compliance oversight from CTC and regular quality reviews.

* Manages and responds to QC review disputes and makes necessary corrections if needed

+ Reviews and closes disputes in a timely manner and responds to Operations accordingly.
+ Demonstrates attention to detail to objectively review cases and provide feedback that is constructive and considers the operational agent’s perspective.

* Arrange and lead calibration sessions for QC Specialists

+ Owns calibration sessions and is responsible to ensure team alignment on how to use the Quality Control Framework for consistent reviews and results.

- Is responsible to organise and run bi-weekly calibration sessions, assess how well the team is calibrated, work with peers to ensure all teams (including internal / vendor) are calibrated.
- Is responsible for maintaining comprehensive documentation on calibration discussions including but not limited to: cases calibrated, final decisions and actions items proposed.

+ Works closely with QC Specialists by collaborating on difficult cases and contributing constructively to discussions to improve alignment and performance across the team.
+ In situations where consensus is challenging to achieve and team members are indecisive or calibration is misaligned, QC Senior Specialist is responsible for making well-informed decisions and upholding the grading guidelines.

* Training & mentoring

+ Assists in onboarding new joiners and mentoring specialists.

- Creates structured training plans that help new employees understand the QC processes and their specific roles. This includes developing schedules that cover necessary training sessions, workshops, and introductory meetings.
- Prepares and leads training sessions that might include job-specific skills, software tutorials. These sessions aim to equip the new joiners with the skills and knowledge necessary to perform their duties efficiently.
- Organises training sessions to equip new joiners with domain specific knowledge.
- Ensures that newcomers receive all necessary materials, such as manuals, guidelines, and access to online resources, to assist them in their learning and integration process.
- Acts as a mentor to new employees, offering support and guidance. This might involve answering questions about grading guidelines and QC procedures, providing feedback, and assisting with problem-solving during the initial phases of their journey.
- Introduces new joiners to key team members and stakeholders within the organization. Facilitates networking opportunities can help new joiners build important relationships and integrate more quickly into the team.

+ Evaluates the knowledge, skills, and capabilities of new team members to determine their readiness to undertake their roles and responsibilities (accreditation).
+ Facilitates knowledge transfer sessions to share expertise, industry insights, and lessons learned with team members, contributing to their professional development and growth within the organization.

**Qualifications**

* You’re experienced — with at least 1 year in a FinCrime, Quality Control or Quality Assurance role.
* You’re knowledgeable — you understand procedures and processes, stay up-to-date, and understand Wise's products, tools, and policies.
* You proactively solve problems — identifying and addressing issues to implement improvements that benefit customers and the team.
* You’re customer-centric — always prioritising customer satisfaction and advocating for their needs within the organisation.
* You embrace adaptability — readily accepting change and quickly integrating new processes while maintaining quality.
* You’re a team player — sharing knowledge and resources to ensure team success and actively engaging in discussions.
* You’re a strong communicator — tailoring your communication to suit diverse audiences with clarity and respect.
* You make data-driven decisions — leveraging data to inform your actions and enhance your impact.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Category Manager – Travel Business**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
6–12 years

**About Thrillophilia**

Thrillophilia is one of India’s leading experiential travel platforms, helping millions of travellers discover and book curated holidays and experiences across India and international destinations.

We are building destination-led travel businesses where each category is managed with clear ownership across product, pricing, suppliers, marketing, sales, customer experience, revenue, and profitability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

This is not a procurement-only or operations-only role.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

A strong Category Manager should be able to say:

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**What You Will Own**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Create clear product USPs that make the category easier to sell and harder to replicate.
* Ensure the product portfolio serves different customer segments, budgets, and travel styles.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality suppliers, hotels, DMCs, transport partners, and experience providers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.
* Ensure the sales team has the right products, pricing, and information to close effectively.

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, CRM, and Brand teams.
* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

**Customer Experience**

* Track customer feedback, NPS, complaints, cancellations, and service failures.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.
* Identify recurring issues and fix them at the product or supplier level.
* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in category management, business ownership, travel product management, P&L management, or a related role.
* Experience in travel, consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, hospitality, or a high-growth business.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, margins, pricing, and profitability.
* Ability to analyse market demand and translate insights into products and business decisions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
* High ownership and comfort working across multiple teams.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience owning a destination, category, geography, or business line.
* Experience in outbound or domestic holiday packages.
* Exposure to sales-led or high-consideration customer journeys.
* Experience managing both product and commercial outcomes.
* MBA or equivalent business education is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Category revenue
* Contribution margin and profitability
* Booking conversion
* Product performance
* Supplier competitiveness
* Customer satisfaction and NPS
* Cancellation and refund rates
* Sales productivity
* New product success
* Market share growth

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:

* Build a clear understanding of the assigned destination or category.
* Identify the biggest gaps in product, pricing, suppliers, and conversion.
* Create a structured category growth plan.
* Improve product quality, supplier competitiveness, and sales readiness.
* Establish clear performance dashboards and operating reviews.

Over time, you should build and scale the category into a significant, profitable business with strong customer trust and clear market differentiation.

**Why Join Thrillophilia?**

* Own a business, not just a function.
* Work directly on revenue, margins, products, suppliers, sales, and customer experience.
* Build destinations and categories at meaningful scale.
* Work closely with senior leaders across business, marketing, sales, product, and operations.
* Get the opportunity to grow into a Category Head, Business Head, or P&L leader.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a founder, acts like an operator, and takes complete responsibility for outcomes.

title: VP, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**
****VP, Product Management****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Vice President, Product Management**
**Cornerstone OnDemand | Executive Leadership**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone helps organizations unlock the potential of their people through technology, content, expertise and specialized focus. Its solutions span learning, talent management, performance, recruiting and workforce development, serving millions of users across thousands of organizations worldwide.
  
  
Cornerstone is embarking on a transformative journey to build WorkforceOS, a next-generation, AI-native Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that unifies the employee lifecycle into a single, intelligent operating system for the modern workforce.
  
  
WorkforceOS will connect employee data, skills intelligence, learning, performance, talent and workforce capabilities to help organizations make smarter workforce decisions, develop their people and build the capabilities needed for the future.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Vice President, Product Management to be a founding member of the WorkforceOS leadership team.
  
  
This is an opportunity to shape and lead the product strategy for a new generation of enterprise HCM software. You will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for WorkforceOS, translating market opportunities, customer needs and emerging AI capabilities into a differentiated product offering.
  
  
You will build and lead a high-performing global Product Management organization, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to bring the vision to life.
  
  
As a key member of the WorkforceOS leadership team, you will partner directly with the GM to define the product's strategic direction, establish its market positioning and drive its commercial success.
  
  
Beyond WorkforceOS, you will work closely with GMs and product leaders across Cornerstone's business lines to identify strategic opportunities, drive portfolio alignment and create synergies across the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.
  
  
This role requires a combination of product vision, strong execution discipline, customer obsession, commercial acumen and the ability to build a product organization from the ground up.
  
  
**In this role you will...**

* Product Vision & Strategy
* Define and own the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for WorkforceOS, aligned with the overall business strategy and growth objectives.
* Shape the evolution of WorkforceOS into a unified, AI-native HCM platform connecting the employee lifecycle, workforce data, skills intelligence and organizational capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate WorkforceOS in the competitive HCM landscape through innovation, simplicity, intelligence and superior customer experiences.
* Translate market insights, customer needs, competitive intelligence and emerging technology trends into clear product strategies and investment priorities.
* Drive a platform-first product philosophy, balancing foundational capabilities, reusable services and differentiated application experiences.
* Establish clear product principles, prioritization frameworks and decision-making mechanisms to guide product investments.
* AI-First Product Innovation
* Champion an AI-first product philosophy, embedding AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics and agentic capabilities into the WorkforceOS experience.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for workforce intelligence, skills inference, personalized employee experiences, talent recommendations and intelligent HR workflows.
* Drive the evolution from traditional systems of record and systems of engagement toward intelligent systems of action and decision-making.
* Partner with AI, Data Science and Engineering teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into meaningful, commercially viable customer outcomes.
* Ensure responsible AI principles, transparency, trust and governance are embedded into product design.
* Product Portfolio & Roadmap Management
* Own the end-to-end product portfolio and roadmap, balancing new capabilities, platform investments, customer commitments and technical modernization.
* Define product requirements, outcomes, success metrics and investment priorities across product areas.
* Establish a disciplined product development lifecycle, from discovery and validation through delivery, launch and continuous improvement.
* Drive prioritization across competing customer, market and business needs, making clear trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term platform strategy.
* Ensure seamless experiences and interoperability across WorkforceOS modules and the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.
* Define and track product KPIs, including adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, time to value, retention and revenue contribution.
* Customer & Market Leadership
* Build a deep understanding of the global HCM market, including customer needs, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Engage directly with CHROs, HR leaders, customers and strategic prospects to understand their challenges and validate product direction.
* Establish strong customer feedback and product discovery mechanisms to continuously improve product-market fit.
* Develop relationships with industry analysts, advisory groups and thought leaders to understand and influence the evolution of the HCM market.
* Partner with strategic customers to validate new capabilities, lead design partnerships and accelerate product adoption.
* Develop compelling product positioning and differentiation in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
* Commercial & Go-to-Market Leadership
* Partner with the GM and business leadership to define product packaging, pricing, tiering and monetization strategies.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to develop and execute go-to-market strategies across new customer acquisition, upsell and cross-sell.
* Ensure product investments are aligned with commercial opportunities, customer value and business growth objectives.
* Support strategic customer engagements, executive briefings and major sales opportunities.
* Partner with Customer Success to drive adoption, customer satisfaction, retention and expansion.
* Translate product capabilities into compelling value propositions and measurable business outcomes.
* Product Organization & Leadership
* Build, lead and develop a world-class Product Management organization, including product leaders and individual product managers across multiple product domains.
* Establish clear product ownership, organizational structure, accountability and decision-making frameworks.
* Develop a strong product management culture grounded in customer obsession, data-driven decisions, speed, innovation and execution excellence.
* Set high standards for product discovery, strategy, roadmap management, product specifications and outcome measurement.
* Develop future product leaders and create an environment that attracts and retains exceptional talent.
* Foster strong partnerships with global Engineering, Design, Data Science and business teams.
* Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
* Work closely with the GM of WorkforceOS to translate business strategy into product priorities, investment decisions and measurable business outcomes.
* Establish strong partnerships with the GMs of Cornerstone's business lines to align product strategy, identify synergies and drive opportunities for integration, collaboration and portfolio-wide innovation.
* Work across business lines to identify opportunities for WorkforceOS to leverage, extend and unify existing Cornerstone capabilities, while defining clear product boundaries, ownership and investment priorities.
* Partner closely with the VP of Engineering and engineering leadership to jointly drive product delivery, platform evolution, technical feasibility and customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with Cornerstone's global Product, Technology and executive leadership teams to ensure alignment between WorkforceOS and the broader company strategy.
* Drive effective operating cadences, portfolio reviews, roadmap governance and executive communication across relevant stakeholders.
* Represent WorkforceOS in executive forums, strategic customer engagements and industry events.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have**

* 15+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience building and scaling enterprise B2B SaaS products.
* 8+ years of experience leading and developing Product Management teams, including senior product leaders.
* Proven experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for complex, multi-product enterprise software platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to build products from early-stage concepts through market launch and global scale.
* Strong understanding of enterprise HCM, HR technology, workforce management or adjacent enterprise SaaS domains.
* Experience building AI-enabled products and translating AI, machine learning, intelligent automation or agentic capabilities into customer value.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience partnering on pricing, packaging, monetization and go-to-market strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to engage with senior executives, customers, industry analysts and strategic partners.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex product portfolio decisions across multiple business lines.
* Excellent strategic thinking, communication, influencing and organizational leadership skills.
* Experience leading global, distributed and cross-functional teams.

Leadership Attributes
  
  

* Product Visionary: Able to see where enterprise HCM and workforce technology are heading and translate that vision into differentiated products.
* Customer Obsessed: Deeply understands enterprise customers and consistently advocates for solving their most important problems.
* AI-Native Mindset: Thinks beyond incremental AI features and understands how AI can fundamentally transform enterprise workflows and experiences.
* Commercially Minded: Connects product decisions to revenue growth, customer adoption, retention and business outcomes.
* Strong Operator: Balances long-term strategy with execution discipline, prioritization and measurable results.
* Enterprise Influencer: Builds strong relationships across business lines, influences executive stakeholders and navigates complex portfolio-level decisions.
* Organizational Builder: Has the ability to attract, develop and lead exceptional product talent.
* Collaborative Leader: Builds strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and the broader executive organization.

**The Opportunity**
This is a unique opportunity to build a category-defining enterprise platform and shape the future of how organizations understand, develop and activate their workforce, while helping define the next chapter of Cornerstone's broader product portfolio.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

title: Product Manager, UK Practice Software
description:
**Job Description**
Thousands of UK accountancy practices rely on our software every day to run their firms, serve their clients and meet their compliance obligations. As Product Manager, you will own part of that portfolio and help take it from a set of well-run products to a connected, AI-enabled platform that practices and partners can build on. This is a build-and-converge mandate, not a maintenance role.
  
  
The Product Manager role is changing. AI is changing the way we work: the time from idea to working software is shrinking, prototyping is moving towards real development with tools like Claude Code, and the lines between product, engineering and design are blurring. The successful candidate will be flexible and willing to lean into that change, and will partner heavily with engineering and design, shaping, prototyping and building alongside them rather than handing over documents.
  
  
You will use the latest AI tools to move from idea to validated prototype faster than traditional product management allows, in a team that treats AI as part of its everyday toolkit.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Practices are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
* Clients expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive finished work.
* Document data extraction, preparation and review are going AI-native, and practices are adopting agentic tools now.
* Practices increasingly want open APIs, so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
* Regulatory change, such as Making Tax Digital, keeps raising the bar for reliability at filing peaks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision and roadmap. Balance customer needs, regulatory change and commercial priorities into a clear, evidence-based plan, and own the commercially consequential decisions that follow from it.
* Deliver the portfolio, season over season. Own your products end to end, at the reliability and scale that filing deadlines and compliance peaks demand.
* Converge products without disrupting customers. Bring overlapping products and capabilities together into one connected experience for every practice and client, and migrate existing customers without breaking what they rely on.
* Componentise the portfolio. Turn each part of the product into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the practice workflow and the wider platform, rather than locked inside a single application.
* Open the platform through APIs and orchestration. Expand the API surface (open APIs, events and integrations) as a first-class capability, so practices and partners embed our products in their own portals and workflows, and AI agents and partner systems can coordinate work programmatically.
* Bring agentic, AI-driven workflows to practices. Work with the platform team to bring AI-driven extraction, preparation and review into the product experience, so more of the work shifts from practice staff to the platform while the practice stays in control.
* Turn customer problems into well-defined solutions. Use AI tools to turn customer problems into clear, testable requirements that engineering and design can build from with confidence, in whatever form works best for the team.
* Prototype early, then build. Use Claude Code or similar tools to build working prototypes that test ideas with customers and stakeholders before significant engineering investment is made, and increasingly contribute real, reviewed code alongside engineering.
* Partner heavily with engineering and design. Work side by side with engineers and designers, often shaping ideas together in prototypes and in the build itself, to prioritise the backlog, clarify requirements and remove blockers, so valuable releases reach customers predictably.
* Listen to customers and use data to decide. Run discovery with accountants and practice staff, work with large practices as design partners, and use usage analytics and support insight to measure whether what we ship delivers real outcomes.
* Keep stakeholders informed and aligned. Communicate progress, trade-offs and decisions clearly to senior leaders, sales, support and customer-facing teams.
* Raise the team's AI capability. Share effective prompts, skills, workflows and lessons learned so that AI-assisted product practice becomes the norm across the team.

What success looks like
  
  

* Practices experience one connected workflow, whatever mix of products they run today.
* Our APIs are something practices and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
* Practices reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through our products, season over season.
* Clients get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience, and practices see measurably less manual work.
* Releases land predictably, and roadmap decisions are backed by customer evidence and usage data.
* Colleagues across the team are using AI-assisted ways of working because you showed them how.

**Required Qualifications**
Education and experience
  
  

* Degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 or more years as a Product Manager or Product Owner in a software product environment, delivering in an agile/scrum setting.
* Demonstrable experience turning customer problems into clear requirements and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can deliver against.
* Experience working on platform, API or developer-facing capabilities, not only features on top of them.
* A track record of converging, migrating or replacing product capabilities without disrupting existing customers.

Technical skills and tools
  
  

* AI tools for product work (such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot) for drafting requirements, analysis and synthesis.

title: Product Manager | Payments & Cards
description:
**About The Company**
****Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase plc****
is a privately held Fintech Group that operates in Investment Services, Fund Administration, Online Investing, and Payments. With roots dating back to 1971, the Group today is evolving at a fast pace whilst keeping the same core principles, that of providing clients the best service using the latest technology and the top professionals in their field, whilst ensuring the strong governance and ethics.
  
  
We are committed to attracting and selecting the very best people to join our team and to creating a workplace that promotes individual career growth; we value our people and their well-being. The group employs over 210 people from over 27 countries around the world with Assets Under Management and Administration of over 3 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**Product Manager**
to own the product vision and roadmap for our
**Payments & Cards**
portfolio. Working in a fast-moving and cross-functional environment, we are looking for solid experience in owning and guiding the design and delivery of products and services as well as team leadership background. This position forms part of an agile development team, building and working on enterprise-grade software systems. The Product Manager will serve as a subject matter expert, acting as a central point of reference for both the team and other stakeholders within the organisation.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for the Payments and Cards portfolio aligned to company KPIs and customer needs.
* Define, prioritise, and ship features that improve activation rates, usage and engagement, and retention across the payments and cards journeys.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure products meet card scheme rules (Visa/Mastercard), PCI-DSS, and relevant financial regulation (e.g. PSD2) from design through to launch.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to translate customer problems into shipped, measurable product improvements.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with third-party partners, e.g. card issuers/processors, payment service providers and card schemes.
* Own the customer experience for card servicing, including freezing/unfreezing cards, replacement, PIN management, and in-app card controls as well as payment solutions, including traditional payment rails (SEPA/SWIFT) as well as fintech payment features (e.g. pay by link and P2P via mobile). Collaborate with UX/UI designers to this effect.
* Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadership, including regular reporting on delivery status and product KPIs.
* Stay close to the competitive landscape — challenger banks, neobanks, and card issuers globally — to keep the product proposition sharp and differentiated.
* Accountable for the on-time and quality delivery of assigned projects
* Conduct team appraisals, identifying training needs, motivating and performance managing the team in collaboration with the Team Lead
* Implement mechanisms to monitor, manage and provide progress on all delivery activities within the team. Develop and maintain an appropriately prioritized product backlog for the team.
* Act as an ambassador for the product internally and externally and as a point of reference for queries related to the product

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is a plus
* Formal certification in product management (e.g. CSPO) is beneficial

**Required Experience**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally within a digital bank, fintech, card issuer, or payments company
* Direct experience owning a card product (debit, credit, or prepaid) end-to-end, including working with card processors/issuers and scheme relationships (Visa/Mastercard) and payments vertical, including working with service providers
* Track record of shipping customer-facing features in a fast-paced, agile environment, with clear evidence of measurable impact (conversion, activation, NPS, revenue)
* Experience operating within a regulated environment, working alongside Risk, Compliance, and Legal teams on product decisions
* Experience working in a scale-up or high-growth fintech environment, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration
* A background in software development would be considered an asset

**Skill Requirements**

* Strong product sense: ability to translate customer pain points and business goals into a clear, prioritised roadmap.
* Analytical and metrics-driven: comfortable interpreting data, and using it to make and defend product decisions.
* Deep understanding of card payment rails, authorisation flows, settlement, and the wider card issuing ecosystem as well as the payments landscape within the EU.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to influence engineering, design, risk, and leadership alike.
* Strong commercial acumen — understanding of interchange, unit economics, and how card products drive revenue and cost.
* User-centred mindset, with experience running user research, usability testing, or working closely with design teams.
* Comfortable operating autonomously, owning outcomes rather than outputs, in a culture that values speed and iteration over process.
* Knowledge of fraud prevention, dispute management, and chargeback processes is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and tools such as Jira, Linear, or similar.

**What We Offer**
As a HR certified employer, we invest seriously in our people through clear career paths, strong benefits, and an environment built for high ownership and high performance.
  
  
We are offering a competitive package designed to support your health, personal development, and performance, alongside the opportunity to drive growth for a brand that is growing fast in our market.
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance and fitness allowances
* Study leave
* Fully funded sponsorship schemes for further studies and professional development
* Clear opportunities for career growth and progression
* Variable performance bonus linked to KPIs
* Mental health support package

**All applications will be treated with strictest confidentiality.**

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase Plc. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase Plc may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Calamatta Cuschieri Moneybase Plc's Candidate Privacy Notice*

title: Senior Digital Product Manager - Procure To Pay
description:
**About Amgen**
If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach millions of patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
  
  
**About The Role**
Role description
  
  
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This role is the business product owner for technology, data and AI across Amgen’s Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, from intake and requisition through purchase order (PO), receipt, invoice and payment. It translates the Global Procurement roadmap into a prioritized portfolio that improves automation, user experience and financial control.
  
  
Based in Hyderabad, this role connects intake and guided buying, SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, supplier onboarding and contract management. It leads business priorities, requirements and acceptance with P2P process owners, Finance/AP, Technology and delivery partners across the US, Europe and JAPAC.
  
  
Finance/AP and Treasury retain payment authorization and execution; Technology leads architecture, engineering and technical operations. The P2P Technology Lead aligns partners on outcomes, commitments and escalations.
  
  
Roles and responsibilities
  
  
P2P technology strategy and roadmap
  
  

* Own the P2P product vision and technology roadmap within the Global Procurement technology and AI plan; prioritize investments against business value, risk, total cost of ownership and delivery dependencies.
* Lead delivery of P2P automation priorities such as touchless PO and invoice processing, AI-enabled AP recovery and overpayment detection, payment-term harmonization, card program enhancements and catalog expansion.

* Define touchless processing by process stage, with agreed eligibility, exclusions and controls. For invoices, distinguish processing without manual intervention from invoice receipt to ready-to-pay status from payment authorization and execution.

Platform integration and ERP readiness
  
  

* Lead business requirements for connected intake, procurement, supplier and contract workflows; ensure accurate transfer of approvals, purchasing data and transaction status across systems.

AI automation and data foundations
  
  

* Shape and scale P2P automation and AI use cases, including requisition validation, invoice capture and matching, receipt workflows and duplicate-payment detection; define baselines, acceptance criteria and pilot-to-scale decisions.
* Partner with Technology and control owners to define AI access limits, evaluation criteria, human review and audit trails; monitor errors and false positives, with escalation and fallback procedures.
* Manage technology vendors and pilot partners through scoping, value validation and scale decisions; review business performance, service commitments and ongoing costs with the relevant owners.
* Define P2P data requirements for the enterprise data platform; work with data owners on quality, common identifiers, lineage and access so requisition, PO, receipt, invoice and payment records can be reconciled and analyzed.

Portfolio governance and delivery
  
  

* Represent P2P in Source-to-Pay portfolio and program increment (PI) planning; maintain a prioritized backlog with clear business requirements, acceptance criteria, capacity, dependencies and committed or deferred scope.
* Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* ;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.;">Balance run work (platform operations, upgrades, controls, mandatory changes) with transformation capacity, and govern each accordingly.
* Agree KPI baselines, definitions, targets and owners with P2P and Finance/AP. Track touchless invoice rate, e-invoice adoption, first-pass match rate, cycle time, cost per invoice and on-time payment, alongside adoption and service performance.

title: Manager – ERC Innovation Product Assurance

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Technology Product & Platform Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Product Management
  
  
**Job Category**
People Leader
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Johnson & Johnson JJT India Capability Center, Hyderabad is seeking an experienced Mgr, Forward Deployed Engineer focused on AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and cloud architecture. This role will work closely with business, product, data science, engineering, architecture, security, and compliance stakeholders to translate high-value healthcare, clinical, scientific, and enterprise technology needs into production-grade AI solutions.
  
  
The Mgr, Forward Deployed Engineer will operate at the intersection of business problem-solving, hands-on engineering, solution architecture, and rapid delivery. The role will define and implement cloud-native, AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and responsible AI architecture patterns; build and deploy prototypes and production solutions; and guide engineering teams in delivering reliable, compliant, and high-performing solutions across AWS and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience in clinical development, life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical R&D, or regulated data environments will be highly preferred.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India |
**Organization:**
Johnson & Johnson, JJT India Capability Center |
**Function:**
Technology, AI/ML, Generative AI, Cloud Engineering and Digital Solutions
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Partner directly with business, product, clinical, scientific, data science, engineering, and technology stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases and translate them into deployable AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
* Rapidly prototype, validate, iterate, and deploy AI-enabled products, workflows, and platform capabilities in close partnership with users and delivery teams.
* Design scalable and reusable cloud architecture patterns across AWS and GCP, including serverless, containerized, microservices-based, event-driven, data lake, lakehouse, and hybrid cloud patterns.
* Design and implement Generative AI solutions leveraging large language models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation architecture patterns, semantic search, knowledge graphs, and enterprise knowledge integration.
* Architect Agentic AI solutions, including autonomous AI workflows, multi-agent orchestration, agentic frameworks, tool integration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise use cases.
* Embed with global product, data science, engineering, security, infrastructure, architecture, and business teams to convert ambiguous business requirements into secure, scalable, and production-ready technical solutions.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud-native AI/ML services, data platforms, compute options, integration patterns, and automation frameworks aligned to enterprise architecture standards.
* Establish prompt engineering, prompt management, evaluation, versioning, reuse, and lifecycle practices for scalable Generative AI delivery.
* Ensure architecture decisions meet requirements for performance, reliability, scalability, security, privacy, compliance, cost optimization, and operational resilience in a regulated healthcare environment.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership to engineering teams at the Hyderabad capability center and across global delivery teams through implementation support, reference architectures, design reviews, code-level guidance, and technical standards.
* Drive adoption of DevOps and MLOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, model deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, and release governance.
* Collaborate with governance, privacy, cybersecurity, quality, and compliance stakeholders to ensure AI/ML solutions align with Johnson & Johnson enterprise standards and regulatory expectations.
* Implement responsible AI and AI governance practices, including AI risk assessments, model explainability, transparency, validation, monitoring, and regulatory readiness for AI systems.
* Support solution roadmaps, technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, MVP delivery, user feedback cycles, production rollout, and modernization initiatives for AI/ML, data platforms, and digital solutions.
* Act as a trusted technical partner for stakeholders by bridging strategy, architecture, engineering execution, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Hands-on experience with AWS and GCP cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, security, data platforms, AI/ML services, and observability capabilities.
* Strong experience delivering enterprise-grade AI/ML solutions using modern cloud architecture patterns within large, global technology organizations.
* Deep understanding of cloud architecture patterns such as microservices, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, event-driven architecture, API-based integration, data lake/lakehouse, and distributed processing.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle concepts, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and governance.
* Experience designing Generative AI solutions using LLMs, including RAG architecture patterns, vector search, semantic search, enterprise knowledge retrieval, and knowledge graph-based architectures.
* Hands-on knowledge of Agentic AI architecture, including agent frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, autonomous workflow design, tool use, planning patterns, guardrails, and enterprise integration.
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, prompt evaluation, reusable prompt patterns, and operational controls for Generative AI applications.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools, including CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, automated deployments, infrastructure as code, containerization, and environment management.
* Experience with MLOps concepts and tooling for automated model deployment, model registry, experiment tracking, model monitoring, and drift detection.
* Ability to design secure, compliant, and resilient cloud solutions with appropriate identity and access management, encryption, network controls, logging, and auditability.
* Knowledge of AI governance practices, including responsible AI implementation, AI risk assessment, model explainability and transparency, human-in-the-loop controls, validation, monitoring, and regulatory readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to work in forward-deployed or embedded engineering models, including rapid discovery, solution shaping, prototyping, user validation, production delivery, and adoption support.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architecture decisions to both technical and business audiences.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working in clinical development, pharmaceutical R&D, healthcare, life sciences, medical technology, or other regulated domains relevant to Johnson & Johnson’s business environment.
* Understanding of clinical development workflows, clinical trial data, regulated data platforms, privacy requirements, GxP considerations, and compliance-driven technology delivery.
* Experience with AWS services such as SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, Glue, Redshift, IAM, CloudWatch, and related data or AI/ML services.
* Experience with GCP services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring.
* Exposure to data engineering platforms, lakehouse architectures, Databricks, Spark, orchestration tools, and modern analytics platforms.
* Cloud or architecture certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer.

Education and Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of overall technology experience, including significant experience in hands-on engineering, solution architecture, cloud platforms, data engineering, AI/ML, Generative AI, or enterprise solution delivery.
* 10+ years of experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions on AWS, GCP, or multi-cloud environments.
* Prior experience leading hands-on solution delivery, architecture discussions, design reviews, technical roadmaps, MVP development, and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Prior experience of working in Innovative Pharma company in R&D domain would be added advantage.

Key Competencies
  
  
Forward-deployed engineering mindset with strong ownership, rapid problem-solving, and hands-on delivery orientation
  
  

* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous business environments and convert user needs into scalable technical solutions
* Cloud-native solution design across AWS and GCP
* AI/ML platform architecture and MLOps enablement
* Generative AI, RAG, semantic search, knowledge graph, and Agentic AI architecture capability
* DevOps' mindset with focus on automation, reliability, and continuous delivery
* Security, compliance, and governance orientation
* Responsible AI, AI governance, explainability, validation, monitoring, and regulatory readiness orientation
* Strong collaboration with global product, engineering, data science, architecture, security, quality, and business stakeholders
* Ability to influence technical direction, establish reusable enterprise patterns, and drive adoption through hands-on execution

Success Measures
  
  
Delivery of scalable, secure, reusable, and production-ready AI/ML solutions and reference architectures.
  
  

* Successful conversion of ambiguous business problems into validated prototypes, MVPs, and production deployments with measurable stakeholder impact.
* Delivery of enterprise-ready Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures using LLMs, RAG, semantic search, knowledge graphs, and autonomous workflow patterns.
* Successful implementation of cloud patterns that improve speed, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Effective adoption of DevOps and MLOps practices across delivery teams.
* Strong alignment of AI/ML solutions with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance expectations.
* Effective implementation of responsible AI controls, AI risk assessments, model explainability, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, validation, monitoring, and regulatory readiness practices.
* Improved adoption, usability, and measurable value realization across global business, clinical, data science, engineering, platform, and Hyderabad capability center teams.

title: Manager, Engineering (Commerce)
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**This role requires working from our office 2-3x a week
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Engineering Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead and manage software engineering teams responsible for building and maintaining business-critical Commerce services.
* Own end-to-end engineering delivery, from technical planning and solution design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define priorities, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and establish realistic delivery commitments.
* Drive predictable execution while maintaining high standards for software quality, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify delivery risks, technical dependencies, and execution bottlenecks, taking proactive measures to address them.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, and engineering standards across the team.
* Balance feature delivery, technical debt, production stability, and platform modernization.
* Use engineering metrics such as cycle time, lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and operational reliability to identify improvement opportunities.

**Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence**

* Provide technical leadership and direction to engineering teams, ensuring architecture, design decisions, and engineering practices support scalable, secure, and reliable solutions.
* Partner with Principal Developers and Architects to evaluate architectural trade-offs and establish technical direction aligned with product and business priorities.
* Establish accountability for engineering quality, including clean code, automated testing, security, system reliability, and maintainability.
* Coach and develop engineers in technical problem-solving, architectural thinking, and engineering best practices, building stronger technical decision-making capabilities across the team.
* Guide technical risk management, complex issue resolution, and root cause analysis, engaging directly when necessary while empowering engineers to own solutions.
* Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape technical roadmaps, manage technical debt, and balance delivery priorities with long-term platform health.

**People Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams with a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide actionable feedback, and support individual career development.
* Own performance management, goal setting, coaching and development planning
* Identify and develop future technical leads and engineering leaders through mentoring and delegation.
* Lead hiring, technical interviews, onboarding, and workforce planning to build strong engineering capabilities.
* Foster psychological safety, constructive technical discussions, and an inclusive team environment.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback and coaching, and address performance gaps promptly and constructively to build a high-performing engineering team.
* Promote knowledge sharing, cross-team collaboration, and reduced dependency on individual contributors.

**AI Adoption & Engineering Innovation**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across development, testing, documentation, and operational workflows.
* Demonstrate a practical understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI coding assistants, and agentic engineering workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI to reduce repetitive engineering work, accelerate delivery, and improve software quality.
* Encourage teams to experiment with AI tools while maintaining appropriate engineering review, security, privacy, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with technical leaders to evaluate AI integrations, orchestration patterns, and automation opportunities.
* Establish measurable outcomes for AI adoption, including improvements in engineering productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Build team capabilities through technical learning sessions, experimentation, and practical AI-enabled engineering initiatives.

**Operational Excellence & Production Ownership**

* Ensure services meet established reliability, availability, performance, and security expectations.
* Drive production readiness, observability, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Lead incident reviews and root cause analysis, ensuring preventive actions are implemented and tracked.
* Improve operational metrics such as Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR), incident frequency, and service availability.
* Establish effective CI/CD practices, automated quality gates, and reliable deployment processes.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement through retrospectives, technical reviews, and engineering metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Strategic Execution**

* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, Platform, QA, Security, and business stakeholders to align engineering execution with organizational priorities.
* Communicate delivery progress, technical risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, technical roadmap planning, and long-term platform evolution.
* Support cross-team initiatives and influence decisions beyond the immediate team.
* Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing business priorities, engineering investment, team capacity, and operational risk.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience directly managing software engineers and engineering delivery.
* Strong software development background with hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and enterprise application development.
* Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures, with the ability to engage confidently in technical discussions.
* Experience leading engineering teams responsible for building and operating cloud-based applications, ideally on AWS or comparable platforms.
* Working knowledge of relational databases, messaging systems, API integrations, and containerized applications.
* Proven experience managing engineering delivery, technical priorities, dependencies, and production responsibilities.
* Experience hiring, coaching, developing, and managing the performance of software engineers while building high-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile development practices, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps principles.
* Experience establishing engineering standards and improving delivery predictability, software quality, reliability, and operational performance.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI and AI-assisted software engineering practices, including opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering workflows.
* Ability to partner effectively with Architects, Principal Engineers, and Technical Leads to evaluate architectural trade-offs, manage technical risks, and guide sound engineering decisions.
* Ability to communicate technical priorities and trade-offs clearly, build cross-functional alignment, and resolve competing priorities.
* Demonstrated ownership of engineering outcomes, balancing people development, technical quality, and business priorities.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE:**

* Experience leading engineering teams supporting Billing, Payments, Collections, or Commerce platforms.
* Previous experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or in an architecture-focused role, bringing additional depth in technical design and engineering decision-making.
* Experience leading large-scale modernization, platform migration, or technical transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed engineering teams or multiple engineering workstreams.
* Exposure to AI-enabled applications, AI-assisted software development, or emerging agentic AI technologies.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

description:

First Shift (Days)

Office

to lead multiple engineering teams and projects, strengthen our software capabilities, and deliver high-quality solutions.

.

* Strong understanding of software architecture, design principles, and modern engineering practices.
