title: Sr. Delivery Consultant, Customer Experience, Professional Services
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Delivery Consultant specializing in Amazon Connect Customer Experience to join AWS Professional Services. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver complex customer experience solutions on Amazon Connect, serving as the technical authority for enterprise-grade contact center transformations. You will spend \*\*80% of your time\*\* hands-on — architecting and implementing CX solutions — while leading pre-sales engagements, driving team capability development, and integrating AI-native approaches into every engagement.
  
  
This is a customer-facing delivery leadership role that combines deep technical execution with strategic consulting, pre-sales leadership, and practice development.
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

## Required Qualifications
  
  
### Technical Expertise
  
  

* \*\*10+ years\*\* of hands-on experience designing and implementing Amazon Connect solutions (or equivalent enterprise contact center platforms with 3+ years on Connect)
* \*\*Deep proficiency\*\* in Amazon Connect ecosystem: Contact Flows, Routing Profiles, Contact Lens, Amazon Q in Connect, Lex, Outbound Campaigns, Tasks, Cases, and Customer Profiles
* \*\*Strong software engineering skills\*\* — Python, TypeScript/Node.js, AWS CDK/CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures (Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS)
* \*\*AI/ML competency\*\* — practical experience implementing generative AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, LLM-based agents, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and conversational AI (Lex, Q in Connect)
* \*\*Integration expertise\*\* — building production integrations with CRM/ITSM systems (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk), telephony (SIP/PSTN), and workforce management platforms
* \*\*Architecture at scale\*\* — designing multi-region, multi-tenant, highly available contact center architectures handling 10,000+ concurrent contacts

### Consulting & Leadership
  
  

* \*\*Pre-sales experience\*\* — led or co-led 5+ customer proposals/SOWs including effort estimation, delivery planning, and technical presentations to senior stakeholders
* \*\*Delivery leadership\*\* — managed end-to-end delivery on engagements with 5+ team members, navigating scope changes, customer escalations, and go-live coordination
* \*\*Stakeholder management\*\* — demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with VP/C-level customer stakeholders
* \*\*Mentoring track record\*\* — coached or mentored 3+ junior consultants; contributed to team hiring decisions

### Certifications (Required or within 6 months of hire)
  
  

* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner or ML Specialty
* Amazon Connect Specialty (or equivalent demonstrated expertise)

\* \* \*
  
  
## Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with \*\*Amazon Connect Agent Workspace\*\*, \*\*Step-by-step Guides\*\*, and \*\*Connect APIs\*\* for custom CRM embedding
* Hands-on with \*\*agentic AI frameworks\*\* — multi-agent orchestration, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AgentCore, Strands SDK
* Knowledge of \*\*contact center operations\*\* — WFM, quality management, compliance recording, PCI-DSS, HIPAA considerations
* Experience \*\*migrating legacy platforms\*\* (Genesys, Avaya, Cisco, NICE) to Amazon Connect
* Background in \*\*voice AI\*\* — real-time STT/TTS, voice biometrics, IVR modernization, voicebot design
* Published \*\*thought leadership\*\* — blogs, conference talks, whitepapers, or reference architectures in the CX/contact center domain
* Familiarity with \*\*ProServe delivery mechanisms\*\* — PDLC, engagement management, CSAT frameworks, utilization tracking

\* \* \*
  
  
## Working Model
  
  

* \*\*80% Delivery:\*\* Hands-on customer engagements — designing, building, deploying Connect CX solutions
* \*\*10% Pre-Sales:\*\* Discovery workshops, proposals, estimations, customer presentations
* \*\*10% Practice:\*\* Team mentoring, capability uplift, TFC contributions, product team collaboration

\* \* \*
  
  
## About the Team
  
  
AWS Professional Services works with enterprise customers to accelerate cloud adoption and realize transformational business outcomes. title: Risk Manager II, TSI SCI & Res-Q
description:
**Description**
Millions of Selling Partners trust Amazon's marketplace to grow their businesses, and hundreds of millions of customers depend on us every day. Behind that trust is a network of systems, tools, and workflows designed to detect and resolve fraud and abuse at scale — and our team builds them.
  
  
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will drive end-to-end program execution for risk reduction initiatives across TSI SCI and Res-Q. In this role, you will own cross-functional program delivery — building roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving process automation to eliminate defects and improve operational efficiency at scale.
  
  
You will partner with engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams to define program scope, manage trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll own root cause and preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects, drive process automation initiatives that reduce manual investigation effort, and ensure programs are delivered on time, at quality, and with measurable impact.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon protects seller and customer trust by combining structured program management with process automation expertise that fundamentally improves how our organization operates.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own end-to-end program management for risk reduction initiatives — defining scope, building roadmaps, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across Risk Managers, Operations, Science, Legal, and Policy stakeholders to define program scope, prioritize features, and manage trade-offs — with defect elimination and operational efficiency as the primary lens.
* Identify, design, and implement process automation opportunities that reduce manual investigation effort, eliminate repetitive workflows, and improve investigator productivity — partnering with engineering teams to translate operational pain points into automation solutions.
* Own root cause / preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects — when defect pattern analysis reveals recurring failure modes, document root cause findings, define preventive actions with measurable closure criteria, and track implementation through to validated defect elimination.
* Build and manage program roadmaps for automation and process improvement launches, tracking dependencies, identifying risks, and driving escalation management across multi-team initiatives.
* Conduct defect pattern analysis to identify systemic abuse trends, process gaps, and opportunities for automation coverage expansion — translating findings into prioritized program requirements.
* Lead escalation triage for program-impacted workflows — rapidly diagnosing whether issues stem from process gaps, system failures, or policy misalignment, and routing to the appropriate team with clear severity assessment and remediation path.
* Define and instrument success metrics to measure program impact, automation coverage, defect escape rates, process cycle time reduction, and seller experience improvement.
* Drive process improvement initiatives using structured methodologies (DMAIC, Kaizen, or equivalent) mapping current-state workflows, identifying waste and bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
* Manage stakeholder communication and program governance - preparing and presenting program updates, launch readiness reviews, and impact assessments to senior leadership, quantifying the value of risk reduction investments.
* Own change management for new process launches and automation deployments — ensuring smooth adoption across operations teams through documentation, training, and feedback loops.
* Conduct deep dives into escalation data, process metrics, and system gaps to identify launch blockers and ensure seamless program implementation.

A day in the life
  
  
You'll start your day reviewing program dashboards and defect metrics — checking milestone progress, flagging blockers, and identifying where process automation can reduce manual effort. You'll meet with investigators and Risk Managers to understand which workflows are creating friction and translate those insights into program requirements.
  
  
You'll drive sprint planning and stakeholder alignment meetings — prioritizing initiatives by defect elimination impact and operational efficiency gains. You'll analyze escalation data to spot systemic issues that process automation should solve, and work with operations leaders to validate that deployed solutions are actually reducing investigation workload.
  
  
Your week includes cross-functional program reviews with Science, Legal, Operations and Policy, launch readiness assessments, RC/PA deep dives on systemic defects, process mapping workshops for automation opportunities, and presenting program progress at WBRs and MBRs.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Res-Q team operates as the central command for abuse-related escalations, conducting investigations and driving systemic improvements across Amazon's global stores. Through our various intake channels, we handle the most complex and sensitive cases that require expert judgment and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 2+ years of experience in risk management, trust & safety, fraud prevention, or marketplace integrity domains
* Experience driving process automation or process improvement initiatives that delivered measurable operational efficiency gains
* Experience managing programs across technical and non-technical teams with competing priorities
* Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision making
* Experience with defect analysis, root cause investigation, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Experience writing program requirements, process documentation, and stakeholder communications
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with interdependencies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with process automation tools, workflow orchestration, or RPA (Robotic Process Automation) platforms
* Experience defining and tracking program metrics, and driving data-informed prioritization
* Experience launching automation solutions that directly reduced operational defect rates or manual investigation workload
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to influence technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and sprint-based delivery
* Experience with change management and driving adoption of new processes/tools across operations teams

description:
Accountant

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Department: Finance & Accounts

Experience: 1.5-3 Years

Qualification: MBA (Finance) OR Semi-Qualified CA (Mandatory)

About Landeed

Landeed is a technology-driven company transforming how people access land records and property-related information through digital solutions. We are looking for an experienced and qualified Accountant to manage financial transactions, accounting operations, statutory compliance, GST and TDS filings, and financial reporting.

Job Overview

The candidate will be responsible for managing the company's accounting and financial operations, ensuring statutory compliance, maintaining accurate financial records, handling service invoicing, and overseeing accounts payable and receivable.

We are specifically looking for someone with practical experience in GST and TDS compliance, Tally ERP, financial reporting, and reconciliations, preferably from a service-sector organisation.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain accurate financial records, including income, expenses, assets, and liabilities.
* Prepare financial statements, such as balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.
* Prepare and assist in GST filing (GSTR-1/GSTR-3B) and TDS returns, using Tally ERP for invoicing and reconciliations.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable to ensure timely payments and collections.
* Oversee vendor payments, compliance in service-sector transactions, and develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for GST/TDS processes.

Mandatory Requirements

Candidates must meet all the following criteria:

* MBA in Finance OR Semi-Qualified CA (Mandatory).
* Minimum 2 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in service-sector companies.
* Strong practical knowledge of GST return filing, including GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B.
* Hands-on experience in TDS calculations, return filing, and challan payments.
* Expert working knowledge of Tally ERP.
* Practical experience in service invoicing, bank reconciliation, and vendor management.
* Ability to prepare balance sheets, cash flow statements, and financial reports.
* Fluency in any TWO of the following languages, including reading and writing:
* Telugu
* Hindi
* English
* Strong numerical accuracy, analytical skills, and attention to detail.

Preferred Skills

* Experience working in service-based organizations.
* Ability to independently manage accounting and statutory compliance.
* Experience coordinating with auditors, vendors, and management.
* Good communication, leadership, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and meet financial reporting deadlines.

Location Eligibility – Important

* Candidates must currently reside in Hyderabad.
* This is a full-time, work-from-office position.
* Candidates must be comfortable commuting to the office regularly.

Important Application Instructions

Please apply only if you meet all the mandatory educational, experience, technical, and location requirements mentioned above.

Candidates who do not possess an MBA in Finance or Semi-Qualified CA qualification, lack practical GST and TDS filing experience, or are not currently residing in Hyderabad will not be considered.

Only candidates meeting the specified eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview process.

title: Marketplace & Quick Commerce Ads Manager
description:
Own paid growth on marketplaces and quick commerce for the consumer brands we work with: Amazon, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto and the platforms that come next.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, in office

**Reports to:**
Head of Marketing

**Experience:**
3 to 6 years

**Type:**
Full time

**About ExactMatch**

ExactMatch is a performance marketing agency. We run search, social, marketplace and quick commerce growth for consumer brands, and we’re judged on one thing: profitable sales. Small team, real ownership, no layers between you and the numbers.

**The role**

You decide where the budget goes, run the campaigns hands-on, and answer for total sales and TACOS on every platform you own. You’ll work with platform account managers, our creative team and the brands’ operations teams.

**What you’ll do**

***Amazon***
*:*

Run Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands (including video) and Sponsored Display across full catalogues: targeting, negatives, bids, placements and budgets.

* Keep brand defence and new-customer growth clearly split.
* Work the levers ads depend on: Buy Box, deals, coupons, listings, A+ content and stock.
* Use Brand Analytics, search term and placement reports to decide where to scale and where to cut.

***Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto and more:***

* Run search, listing and banner ads on each platform, city by city and dark store by dark store.
* Plan budgets around launches, festive moments and stock, with the platform account managers.
* Track availability, ratings, pricing and share of search, and fix what blocks sales.

***Reporting and experiments:***

* Own the weekly tracker for every account: spend, sales, ROAS, TACOS, CPC, conversion and Buy Box, by platform and product line.
* Run at least two structured experiments a week, each with a hypothesis, a review date and a decision.

***Creative and coordination:***

* Brief the creative team on what each platform needs: images, videos, banners and listing content.
* Present performance and next steps clearly, with numbers, not adjectives.

**What success looks like**

* **3 months:**
  clean account structures on Amazon and each quick commerce platform you own. Weekly reporting on time. Wasted spend cut.
* **6 months:**
  TACOS falling month on month while total sales grow. A tested playbook for each quick commerce platform and city. A steady run of experiments with documented results.
* **12 months:**
  marketplaces as the most predictable growth channel for the brands you run. Budgets planned by platform, product and season. Every new platform or city launched with a proven plan.

**Who you are**

*Must have:*

* 3 to 6 years running Amazon Ads hands-on, managing ₹5 lakh+ a month for consumer brands.
* Live experience running ads on Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart or Zepto, and working with their account managers.
* Fluent in Seller Central and the Ads console: Business Reports, search term, placement and advertised product reports, Brand Analytics.
* Thinks in TACOS and total sales, not just ROAS.
* Strong with spreadsheets: builds your own reports and spots a trend before it costs money.
* Can handle several accounts at once and push back with data.

*Nice to have:*

* Food, baby, FMCG or personal-care experience.
* Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud or Flipkart Ads exposure.
* Has set pricing, deals and stock plans with supply and operations.
* Comfortable with SQL or Looker Studio.

**How to apply**

Send your CV to vishal@exactmatch.in with the subject line
**Marketplace & Quick Commerce Ads Manager, ExactMatch**
. In 3 to 4 lines, tell us about one account you grew: the platform, the monthly spend, what you changed, and what happened to sales and TACOS.

Shortlisted candidates get a short take-home task: build a strategy and implementation roadmap for a consumer brand’s marketplace and quick commerce ads.

title: Business Analyst-Data Insights, Translation Services Operations
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about transforming operational processes through data-driven insights? Are you motivated to have a direct impact on customers around the world? Do you have a business analytics background and love for continuous improvement and finding creative solutions to challenging problems? Amazon's Translation Services team is responsible for providing translation tools and solutions to support the localization and translation needs of all Amazon businesses. At Translation Services Operations, we partner with other internal Amazonian teams to translate and deliver content for users of Amazon's tools and services around the world. We obsess over finding the optimal balance between quality, speed, and cost for customers we serve.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to own end-to-end analytical work for our centralized metrics and reporting function — from understanding complex data dependencies to delivering actionable insights that drive business decisions. You will own problems from start to finish: partnering with business teams to understand their needs, building the reports and tools that surface meaningful patterns, and explaining the "why" behind the numbers. You will build dashboards, create new metrics, develop analytical frameworks, and leverage existing data sources to keep stakeholders informed and empowered. You will be comfortable working in an international, dynamic environment, where change is present as we constantly grow, improve, and innovate.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own and develop key operational metrics end-to-end — from understanding data sources and dependencies, to designing metric logic, building reporting solutions, and delivering insights that drive action
* Partner hands-on with business teams (Operations, Quality, Business Development, Customer Success) to understand their data needs, translate them into structured analytical approaches, and deliver reporting that enables informed decision-making
* Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth for organizational performance
* Dive deep into data to identify patterns, trends, and root causes — then clearly communicate the "what," the "so what," and the "now what" to stakeholders and leadership
* Proactively identify opportunities to leverage Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) to optimize data insights generation, automate reporting workflows, and surface patterns at scale
* Create new metrics, implement new measurement logics, and develop analytical tools that evolve with the business — ensuring our reporting capabilities stay ahead of organizational needs
* Conduct root cause analyses on performance variations and develop scalable frameworks to monitor, explain, and improve business outcomes

A day in the life
  
  
In the morning, you'll review performance dashboards ahead of a business review, identifying any anomalies or trends that need attention — preparing clear narratives around the data to share with leadership. Mid-morning, you'll partner with an operations team to understand a new reporting need, mapping out data dependencies and designing the logic for a new metric they've requested — collaborating with data engineering teams to ensure the right data is available. After lunch, you'll dive into a dataset to investigate why a key performance indicator shifted month-over-month, slicing the data across multiple dimensions to isolate the driver and document your findings. Later, you'll work on building an automated reporting solution that replaces a manual process, leveraging AI capabilities to surface insights that would otherwise require hours of manual analysis. Throughout the day, you'll balance immediate stakeholder requests with longer-term projects that strengthen the organization's data foundation.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Vendor Management & Data Insights (VMDI) team, within Translation Services Operations, consolidates vendor management operations with centralized reporting functions — including invoicing, pricing, and metrics — under one leadership. We are responsible for providing the data foundation that drives decision-making across the organization, while building and maintaining excellent relationships with external vendors to deliver results at scale for our customers. We collaborate closely with Quality and Content, Business Development, Customer Success, and Products teams to provide a seamless experience for both vendors and clients. We value a collaborative, inclusive, innovative, and data-driven culture as we work to optimize processes, improve quality, and drive cost efficiencies across Amazon's translation ecosystem.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Knowledge of databases (querying and analyzing) such as SQL, MYSQL, and ETL Manager and working with large data sets
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Python or R for data analysis or statistical tools such as SAS
* Experience with reporting and Data Visualization tools such as Quick Sight / Tableau / Power BI or other BI packages
* Master's degree or above in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field, or 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
* Comfortable working in an international, dynamic environment, where change is present as we constantly grow, improve, and innovate

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Nextpower is seeking a Staff Reliability Engineer to build the quantitative foundation for reliability decisions across the product lifecycle. The role will focus on the early and late stages of new product development: translating operating missions and product architecture into reliability models and targets, then connecting test, manufacturing, warranty, and field evidence to a clear view of fleet performance and cost.
  
  
In this role, you will work with Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Power Electronics, Validation, Quality, Service, Product Management, Finance, and Data teams. Your analyses will help teams make design and launch decisions, understand uncertainty, identify emerging field risks, and feed operational learning back into future product requirements and architectures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Reliability Analytics and Modeling**

* Translate customer use conditions, service-life expectations, availability needs, and business objectives into measurable reliability requirements, metrics, assumptions, and evidence plans.
* Develop and maintain product mission profiles that describe geography, ambient and internal conditions, operating states, duty cycles, load levels, and exposure over time; document data sources and uncertainty.
* Build and maintain system and subsystem reliability models, including Reliability Block Diagrams and fault trees, to evaluate architecture, redundancy, dominant contributors, reliability allocations, and sensitivity to assumptions.
* Develop component and system reliability predictions using applicable parts-count, parts-stress, supplier, test, and field evidence. Select methods appropriate to the available data and product maturity, and clearly state limitations.
* Apply reliability statistics to life and event data, including Weibull and other life distributions, censored data, confidence bounds, accelerated-life relationships, reliability growth, and Bayesian updating where appropriate.
* Integrate analytical outputs with DFMEA, architecture reviews, design trade studies, and development gates so that quantified risk informs design priorities and readiness decisions.

**Warranty and Field Reliability Analytics**

* Develop and maintain a field reliability data model that connects product configuration and serial or cohort information with exposure, telemetry, service events, returns, failure analysis, and warranty claims.
* Define consistent metric definitions and denominators for field performance, including failure rate, cumulative failures, availability or downtime measures where applicable, and warranty incidence and cost.
* Analyze warranty, service, return, and field data to identify trends, shifts, recurring failure modes, affected populations, and emerging risks; quantify uncertainty and distinguish confirmed findings from hypothesis.
* Develop warranty life and cost analyses that estimate claim frequency and cost over time, assess sensitivity to assumptions, and support product, finance and business planning.
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that present reliability performance by product, configuration, region, age, exposure, and failure mode, with clear definitions and decision-focused interpretation.
* Track early-launch performance and reliability growth using pilot and field evidence; update predictions as exposure accumulates and communicate material changes to forecasts and risk outlooks.
* Feed field findings into future mission profiles, reliability requirements, model assumptions, design priorities, supplier actions, and validation evidence plans.

**Data, Tools and Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Data Engineering and business system owners to improve data availability, traceability, quality, and repeatability across engineering, manufacturing, service and warranty sources.
* Use statistical and analytical tools such as Python, JMP or R and visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau to develop reproducible analyses and practical reporting workflows.
* Present results to technical and business audiences, explaining methods, assumptions, confidence, data gaps and recommended actions in clear written reports and product reviews.
* Coach engineering and business partners in the interpretation of reliability metrics and statistical evidence, including the implications of exposure, sample size, censoring and model uncertainty.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Applied Statistics, Data Science or a related quantitative field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 10+ years of experience in reliability engineering, reliability analytics, product quality analytics, or a related quantitative engineering role.
* Demonstrated experience with reliability modeling and statistics, including mission profiles, reliability block diagrams, MTBF or failure-rate analysis, life-data analytics, and confidence intervals.
* Strong proficiency with statistical and modeling packages like JMP, Minitab, Reliasoft Weibull++, BlockSIM plus experience creating dashboards with Python or R and SQL and recurring analytical reports using business intelligence tools.
* Experience analyzing product, test, manufacturing, warranty, service, or field data and translating results into engineering or business decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical results, assumptions, and uncertainty to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* Experience with utility-scale power conversion, inverters, renewable energy systems, industrial electronics, or other complex products deployed in large fleets.
* Experience developing warranty cost or life projections, early-launch forecasts, reliability growth models, or field performance dashboards.
* Familiarity with Bayesian methods, accelerated life modeling, reliability allocation, availability modeling, and product genealogy or configuration data.
* Experience with ReliabSoft, JMP, Minitab, PowerBI, Tableau, or comparable tools; Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) or equivalent certification.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
  
  
**We are Nextpower**

Position Overview

Cleint’s is seeking an experienced Associate to support the CFO and CEO in the day-to-day oversight, performance management, underwriting, and execution of both the Lending portfolio and Property Asset Management function. This individual will help monitor portfolio performance, identify risks and opportunities, drive business plan execution, oversee draw administration for both the lending and property portfolios, and coordinate with internal teams and external stakeholders to protect and enhance portfolio value. The ideal candidate will have strong commercial real estate market knowledge, experience working with lenders and investors, strong underwriting capabilities, and the ability to manage relationships with insurance brokers, real estate tax advisors, legal counsel, leasing brokers, property managers, borrowers, and other third-party professionals. This role requires strong negotiation skills and high-level communication in a changing environment. This role reports to the CFO and works closely with the CEO and senior leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

* Support the CFO in overseeing day-to-day performance across client’s lending and property asset management portfolios, ensuring each asset is aligned with approved business plans, investment objectives, risk parameters, and return expectations.
* Serve as a day-to-day execution support to the CFO by tracking portfolio issues, coordinating follow-ups, preparing performance updates, escalating material risks, and helping ensure timely accountability across internal departments and third-party service providers.
* Monitor property-level performance, including leasing activity, occupancy, NOI, operating budgets, capital expenditures, tenant issues, insurance requirements, real estate tax matters, and market positioning.
* Monitor lending portfolio performance, including borrower compliance, collateral performance, loan covenants, maturity timelines, insurance compliance, tax issues, and asset-level business plan execution.
* Lead and support underwriting efforts for new and existing lending and property portfolio matters, including financial analysis, waterfall calculations, valuation review, risk assessment, business plan evaluation, and investment or credit recommendation support.
* Oversee draw administration for both lending and property portfolios by coordinating draw requests, reviewing supporting documentation, tracking approvals, monitoring budget compliance, and ensuring timely communication with internal stakeholders, borrowers, project teams, lenders, and third-party advisors.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with lenders, investors, borrowers, leasing brokers, property managers, insurance brokers, real estate tax consultants, attorneys, and other external advisors.
* Use market knowledge to evaluate asset strategy, leasing assumptions, financing alternatives, refinancing opportunities, disposition timing, borrower risk, valuation trends, and portfolio-level performance.
* Prepare and present asset performance updates, risk assessments, recommended action plans, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership, investors, and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with Acquisitions/Dispositions, Property Management, Project Management, Development, Legal, Accounting, Finance, and Lending teams to ensure coordinated execution across the portfolio.
* Support due diligence efforts for acquisitions, dispositions, refinances, loan modifications, extensions, workouts, and other asset-level transactions, including financial reviews, market analysis, legal coordination, and documentation review.
* Track asset performance using Yardi, financial models, lender reporting packages, internal dashboards, and other portfolio management tools; recommend strategic pivots when needed to protect value and maximize returns.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Business, Accounting, or related field; MBA, MSRE, CFA, or other relevant designation preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in commercial real estate asset management, portfolio management, lending asset management, investment management, or a related real estate finance role.
* Demonstrated ability to oversee both property-level operating performance and debt/lending portfolio performance, including underwriting, draw administration oversight, risk monitoring, borrower or tenant issues, business plan execution, and stakeholder reporting.
* Strong commercial real estate market knowledge, including leasing dynamics, capital markets, financing structures, valuation methods, insurance requirements, real estate tax considerations, and legal documentation issues.
* Experience working directly with lenders, investors, insurance brokers, real estate tax advisors, attorneys, leasing brokers, property managers, borrowers, and other third-party professionals.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel financial modeling, asset-level reporting, budget variance analysis, loan performance tracking, and investment return analysis.
* Required software proficiency includes Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Yardi or similar property management/accounting platforms, loan servicing or portfolio management systems, virtual data rooms, PDF/document review tools, and dashboard or reporting tools such as Power BI or similar platforms.
* Experienced and understanding of AI tools and automation concepts, including the ability to use AI-assisted platforms to improve reporting, summarize documents, identify portfolio risks, streamline workflows, and support faster, more informed decision-making while maintaining appropriate judgment and data.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to interact confidently with senior leadership, investors, lenders, borrowers, professional advisors, and internal teams in a fast-moving and changing environment.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize competing asset-level issues, and drive accountability in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

title: Salesforce Developer – Sales & Service Cloud
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Salesforce Developer - Sales, Service & Revenue Cloud
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Experience Required:**
4–6 years
  
  
**Technical Knowledge:**
Salesforce Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura Components, SOQL/SOSL, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud, Flows, Triggers, Batch/Queueable/Scheduled Apex, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, Named/External Credentials, Salesforce DX (SFDX), Git, CI/CD (Copado/Gearset/Jenkins), Visualforce, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Data Loader, Change Sets, JIRA.
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a Senior Salesforce Developer with 4 to 6 years of hands-on experience, you will design, code, integrate and deploy enterprise-grade solutions on the Salesforce platform for real client projects. We are looking for someone who has delivered live implementations end to end, not only support or enhancement work. Your primary focus will be hands-on coding in Apex and LWC and building integrations with external systems. You will also contribute to solution design, choosing between declarative and code and defining the data model, integration pattern and security model. Experience with Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud is preferred; strong Sales Cloud and Service Cloud development experience is also welcome. Exposure to Media Cloud, Agentforce and Data Cloud is a strong added advantage, as our upcoming projects include AI agents and connectors for media and advertising customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-on Core Coding: Write, optimize and unit-test complex Apex code (enterprise trigger frameworks, batch jobs, queueables, schedulables, platform events) and build reusable, performant Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Integration Development: Design, build and consume REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven integrations (Platform Events, Change Data Capture) and middleware patterns to connect Salesforce with ERP, billing, ad-tech and other external systems. Implement authentication (OAuth 2.0, Named/External Credentials), error handling, retries and logging.
* Revenue Cloud / CPQ Development: Extend Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud with custom Apex, CPQ plugins (QCP), pricing and quote automation, and integrations to billing and order management systems.
* Solution Design: Contribute to technical solution design documents covering data model, integration pattern, security and sharing model, automation choice and deployment approach. Document declarative vs code trade-offs (Flow vs Apex, standard vs custom objects, OmniStudio vs LWC).
* Database & Performance Tuning: Write highly optimized SOQL/SOSL queries, design large data volume (LDV) data models and implement governor-limit mitigation strategies.
* Sales & Service Cloud Extensions: Develop custom UI components and backend logic for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Service Console, Omni-Channel, Open CTI and complex entitlement processes where declarative tools fall short.
* Platform & Admin Ownership: Configure and maintain profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, OWD, sharing rules and Flows without depending on a separate admin.
* DevOps & Release Management: Manage source-driven development using SFDX, Git version control and automated CI/CD pipelines (Copado, Gearset or Jenkins).
* Code Quality & Technical Standards: Perform code reviews, enforce secure coding standards (CRUD/FLS enforcement, sharing enforcement, injection prevention) and maintain unit test coverage above 85% across all deployments.
* Troubleshooting & Defect Resolution: Debug, profile and resolve production bugs, performance bottlenecks and integration failures.

title: Salesforce Functional Consultant - Revenue Cloud (CPQ) / Sales & Service Cloud
description:
**Job Title:**
Salesforce Functional Consultant - Revenue Cloud (CPQ) / Sales & Service Cloud
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**Experience Required:**
4–6 years
  
  
**Role Summary**
As a Salesforce Functional Consultant with 4 to 6 years of real-time, end-to-end implementation experience, you will own the functional side of Salesforce projects from discovery to go-live and hypercare. You will independently run discovery workshops, manage client communication, translate business needs into solution designs and user stories, and configure the solution yourself. Experience with Salesforce CPQ / Revenue Cloud is preferred; strong Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementation experience is also welcome. Exposure to Media Cloud, Agentforce and Data Cloud is a strong added advantage, as our upcoming projects include agentic implementations for media and advertising customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Project Ownership: Drive the functional workstream across the full project lifecycle: discovery, requirements, solution design, build, UAT, go-live, hypercare and handover.
* Discovery Workshops: Independently plan and run discovery and requirement workshops with client stakeholders. Map current-state (As-Is) and future-state (To-Be) processes, identify gaps and recommend Salesforce-native solutions.
* Client Communication: Act as the day-to-day functional point of contact for clients. Run status updates, solution demos and sprint reviews. Manage scope clarifications, change requests and stakeholder expectations without escalation for routine matters.
* Requirements & Documentation: Write clear business requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria in JIRA, process flows and fit-gap analyses.
* Revenue Cloud / CPQ Configuration: Configure product catalogs, bundles, price rules, product rules, discount schedules, quote templates, approvals, amendments and renewals.
* Sales & Service Cloud Configuration: Configure lead-to-cash and case-to-resolution processes, including opportunity stages, forecasting, case management, Omni-Channel, entitlements and Lightning Knowledge.
* Declarative Automation: Build Flows (screen, record-triggered, scheduled), validation rules, approval processes, dynamic Lightning pages and custom metadata, keeping custom code to a minimum.
* Security & Data Management: Configure OWD, roles, profiles, permission sets and sharing rules. Plan and execute data migration, upserts and deduplication using Data Loader.
* Reporting & Analytics: Build custom report types, reports and dashboards for business users and leadership.
* Developer Collaboration: Identify where Apex/LWC or integrations are needed, write technical-ready stories for developers, and validate the delivered solution against requirements.
* UAT & Training: Prepare UAT scripts, run UAT sessions with clients, track defects to closure, and deliver end-user training and documentation.

**Requirements**

* Experience: 4–6 years of hands-on Salesforce functional consulting experience, with at least 2 full-lifecycle implementations delivered for real clients (not only support or enhancement work).
* Client-Facing Delivery: Proven experience independently leading discovery workshops and managing client communication on live projects.
* Declarative Mastery: Strong hands-on proficiency in Flows, validation rules, approval processes, assignment rules and permission structures.
* Domain & Process Expertise: Solid understanding of quote-to-cash, lead-to-cash and/or service center operations.
* Documentation Skills: Ability to produce clear BRDs, functional specs, process flows and user stories.
* Data & Tools Proficiency: Hands-on experience with Data Loader, JIRA, Confluence and Agile/Scrum delivery.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* Certifications Required:
* Salesforce Certified Administrator
* At least one of: Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, or Revenue Cloud / CPQ certification

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications (Added Advantage)**

* Revenue Cloud / CPQ: Hands-on implementation of Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud, including pricing, quoting, contracts, amendments, renewals or billing.
* Media Cloud / OmniStudio: Exposure to Salesforce Media Cloud/Vlocity, OmniStudio (OmniScripts, DataRaptors, FlexCards), subscriber management or digital ad sales processes.
* Agentforce: Understanding of Agentforce agents, topics and actions, and the ability to gather requirements and design conversation flows for AI agents.
* Data Cloud: Exposure to Data Cloud data streams, unified profiles and segmentation.
* Specialized Certifications: Revenue Cloud / CPQ certification, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Media Cloud Accredited Professional.
* Extended Ecosystem: Experience Cloud portals, CTI tools (e.g., Amazon Connect, Genesys) or CRM Analytics.

**Information Security & ISO 27001 Compliance**
Security is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will be strictly required to uphold our Information Security Management System (ISMS) policies in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Responsibilities include safeguarding sensitive asset data, completing mandatory security awareness training, reporting potential security incidents or vulnerabilities immediately, and ensuring that daily operations comply with our rigorous data protection protocols.

The Manager will also maintain accurate sales pipelines, report on performance metrics, and support strategic partnerships that strengthen ResQPol’s market presence.

* Candidates should possess strong polymer and materials knowledge, preferably with experience in high-performance polymers, additives, and reactive extrusion-based solutions.
* Candidates should possess proven business development and sales skills, including opportunity identification, customer acquisition, account management, and negotiation.
* Candidates should possess a solid understanding of relevant end-use industries such as wire and cable, flexible packaging, automotive, engineering plastics, and recycling.

* A bachelor’s degree in Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field is preferred; an advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in polymer additives, compounding, or specialty chemicals business development is highly beneficial, along with willingness to travel for customer visits and industry events.

title: Senior Community Lead, Managed Offices | Workplace Experience
description:
****About us****

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 85 centres, 9.8 million square ft (operational area) (as of October 2026). WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our

website

****About Job****

As a Lead / Sr. Lead – Managed Offices, you will own the end-to-end client, operational, commercial and workplace experience for a dedicated Managed Office account in Hyderabad. This role will serve as the single point of accountability for the client throughout the entire lifecycle—from sales closure and project execution to operational handover, ongoing account management and future business growth. You will drive seamless transitions across Sales, Projects and Operations, ensuring continuity of communication, accountability and service delivery at every stage. You will build strong client relationships, oversee day-to-day operations and workplace experience, proactively resolve issues, and identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling and revenue growth. The role requires a strong customer-centric leader who can balance operational excellence,

commercial performance, stakeholder management and exceptional workplace experience while ensuring long-term client satisfaction, retention and business success.

****Roles and Responsibilities****

**1. End-to-End Account Management & Client Relationship**

* Own the complete client lifecycle, acting as the primary point of contact and single point of accountability for the client.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client SPOCs, senior stakeholders and key decision-makers.
* Understand the client’s business objectives, workplace requirements, evolving needs and expectations.
* Drive regular client reviews, business reviews and stakeholder engagement to ensure alignment and satisfaction.
* Proactively identify service gaps, risks and opportunities to strengthen client relationships and retention.
* Manage client escalations with urgency, accountability and effective resolution.
* Ensure commitments made to the client are tracked, communicated and delivered within agreed timelines.
* Develop a deep understanding of the client’s organisation, culture and business priorities to deliver a tailored workplace experience.

**2. End-to-End Transition & Lifecycle Management**

* Own and manage the entire transition journey from Sales closure to Projects, Projects to Operations, and Operations to ongoing Account Management.
* Establish a structured transition framework with clear milestones, deliverables, timelines, responsibilities and communication protocols.
* Ensure complete and accurate transfer of client requirements, commercial commitments, scope of work, design specifications and service expectations between teams.
* Partner closely with Sales, Projects, Operations, Client Solutions, Finance and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless transitions.
* Drive project readiness, operational preparedness and client onboarding to ensure a smooth move-in and commencement of services.
* Ensure all handover documentation, checklists, approvals, commitments and outstanding items are completed before transitioning between teams.
* Identify potential gaps, risks and dependencies early and drive timely resolution to prevent disruption to the client.
* Maintain continuity of client communication and ownership throughout every transition, ensuring the client does not experience gaps in service or accountability.
* Own post-move-in stabilisation, snag closure and transition into business-as-usual operations.
* Continuously improve transition processes, handover mechanisms and stakeholder coordination based on client and internal feedback.
* Own the overall workplace experience and day-to-day operational delivery for the client’s Managed Office.
* Ensure the workplace remains operationally ready, well-maintained, safe, compliant and aligned with WeWork standards.
* Drive exceptional workplace experience by balancing client expectations, member experience, facilities management and operational efficiency.
* Conduct regular workplace walkthroughs, operational reviews, audits and service assessments.
* Own operational dashboards, ticketing, issue resolution, service delivery reviews and client commitments.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation mechanisms across Community, Operations, Projects, Finance, Security, Facilities and other internal teams.
* Ensure timely closure and communication of operational issues, service requests and client commitments.
* Drive operational standardisation, continuous improvement and adherence to ROEs, SOPs and service standards.
* Proactively identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Drive client and workplace engagement initiatives, ensuring a consistently high-quality experience.

**4. Revenue Growth, Upselling & Cross-Selling**

* Own the identification, development and conversion of incremental revenue opportunities within the client account.
* Proactively identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on evolving client requirements, business growth and workplace needs.
* Explore opportunities across events, F&B, community support, workplace experience, technology, parking, customisation, additional services and other relevant offerings.
* Partner with Sales and internal teams to develop and position value-added solutions for the client.
* Ensure Workplace Experience services and relevant business offerings are effectively presented and pitched to the client.
* Build a strong understanding of the client’s expansion plans, headcount growth, additional space requirements and future business needs.
* Drive commercial discussions, proposals, negotiations and follow-through to convert opportunities into revenue.
* Ensure all commercial opportunities are aligned with client requirements, business objectives and profitability.
* Contribute to account growth, revenue enhancement, retention and long-term commercial success.

**5. Commercial, Financial & Business Performance Management**

* Own the commercial and financial performance of the assigned Managed Office account.
* Drive billing accuracy, invoice reviews, budget finalisation, financial reporting and post-sales P&L management.
* Monitor revenue, costs, profitability, financial commitments and business performance.
* Work closely with Finance and the relevant BOB owner to ensure financial accuracy, visibility and performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, optimise costs and enhance operational efficiency without compromising workplace experience.
* Track commercial commitments made during the Sales and Projects stages to ensure alignment with actual operational delivery.
* Ensure timely resolution of billing discrepancies, financial escalations and commercial issues.
* Provide regular updates on account performance, revenue opportunities, financial risks and business outlook.

**6. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Build strong working relationships across Sales, Projects, Operations, Client Solutions, Finance, Community, Events, Security, Facilities and other internal teams.
* Drive cross-functional alignment and accountability throughout the client lifecycle.
* Ensure teams understand client requirements, priorities, commitments and service expectations.
* Establish clear ownership, timelines and escalation mechanisms for all client-related deliverables.
* Lead discussions to resolve cross-functional challenges and prevent issues from impacting the client.
* Ensure effective communication between internal teams and the client at every stage of the account lifecycle.
* Drive a collaborative, customer-first approach while ensuring business priorities and operational standards are met.

**7. Communication, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Provide structured account updates covering client experience, operations, revenue, P&L, risks, compliance and key actions.
* Prepare and present regular client business reviews and internal performance updates.
* Maintain clear documentation of client requirements, commitments, escalations, transition milestones and commercial opportunities.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, service issues and commercial opportunities.
* Use client feedback, operational insights and business performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement across client onboarding, transition management, operational delivery and account management.
* Develop scalable processes and best practices that enhance client experience, operational efficiency and business performance.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business Administration, Marketing, Operations or a related field.
* 5–8+ years of experience in Managed Offices, co-working, hospitality, workplace experience, operations, strategic account management or customer-facing roles.
* Experience managing large enterprise clients or dedicated client accounts is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in end-to-end account management, client relationship management and operational delivery.
* Strong experience in managing cross-functional transitions, project handovers, client onboarding and operational stabilisation.
* Proven ability to manage complex client requirements, operational escalations and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in upselling, cross-selling, revenue generation, billing, budgeting and P&L management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail.
* Proficiency in digital tools for ticketing, reporting, dashboards, communication and business reviews.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, drive accountability and deliver results in a dynamic environment.

**Key Competencies**

* End-to-end client and account ownership
* Client-centric mindset and relationship building
* Transition and lifecycle management
* Operational excellence and workplace experience
* Commercial acumen and revenue growth
* Cross-functional stakeholder management
* Escalation management and problem-solving
* Accountability, ownership and execution
* Strategic thinking and continuous improvement

The ideal candidate is a customer-centric, commercially driven and operationally strong leader who can independently manage a strategic client account, ensure seamless transitions across the entire client lifecycle, deliver exceptional workplace experience and drive long-term client retention and business growth

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that  you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

title: Marketplace & Quick Commerce Ads Manager
description:
Own paid growth on marketplaces and quick commerce for the consumer brands we work with: Amazon, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto and the platforms that come next.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, in office

**Reports to:**
Head of Marketing

**Experience:**
3 to 6 years

**Type:**
Full time

**About ExactMatch**

ExactMatch is a performance marketing agency. We run search, social, marketplace and quick commerce growth for consumer brands, and we’re judged on one thing: profitable sales. Small team, real ownership, no layers between you and the numbers.

**The role**

You decide where the budget goes, run the campaigns hands-on, and answer for total sales and TACOS on every platform you own. You’ll work with platform account managers, our creative team and the brands’ operations teams.

**What you’ll do**

***Amazon***
*:*

Run Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands (including video) and Sponsored Display across full catalogues: targeting, negatives, bids, placements and budgets.

* Keep brand defence and new-customer growth clearly split.
* Work the levers ads depend on: Buy Box, deals, coupons, listings, A+ content and stock.
* Use Brand Analytics, search term and placement reports to decide where to scale and where to cut.

***Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto and more:***

* Run search, listing and banner ads on each platform, city by city and dark store by dark store.
* Plan budgets around launches, festive moments and stock, with the platform account managers.
* Track availability, ratings, pricing and share of search, and fix what blocks sales.

***Reporting and experiments:***

* Own the weekly tracker for every account: spend, sales, ROAS, TACOS, CPC, conversion and Buy Box, by platform and product line.
* Run at least two structured experiments a week, each with a hypothesis, a review date and a decision.

***Creative and coordination:***

* Brief the creative team on what each platform needs: images, videos, banners and listing content.
* Present performance and next steps clearly, with numbers, not adjectives.

**What success looks like**

* **3 months:**
  clean account structures on Amazon and each quick commerce platform you own. Weekly reporting on time. Wasted spend cut.
* **6 months:**
  TACOS falling month on month while total sales grow. A tested playbook for each quick commerce platform and city. A steady run of experiments with documented results.
* **12 months:**
  marketplaces as the most predictable growth channel for the brands you run. Budgets planned by platform, product and season. Every new platform or city launched with a proven plan.

**Who you are**

*Must have:*

* 3 to 6 years running Amazon Ads hands-on, managing ₹5 lakh+ a month for consumer brands.
* Live experience running ads on Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart or Zepto, and working with their account managers.
* Fluent in Seller Central and the Ads console: Business Reports, search term, placement and advertised product reports, Brand Analytics.
* Thinks in TACOS and total sales, not just ROAS.
* Strong with spreadsheets: builds your own reports and spots a trend before it costs money.
* Can handle several accounts at once and push back with data.

*Nice to have:*

* Food, baby, FMCG or personal-care experience.
* Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud or Flipkart Ads exposure.
* Has set pricing, deals and stock plans with supply and operations.
* Comfortable with SQL or Looker Studio.

**How to apply**

Send your CV to vishal@exactmatch.in with the subject line
**Marketplace & Quick Commerce Ads Manager, ExactMatch**
. In 3 to 4 lines, tell us about one account you grew: the platform, the monthly spend, what you changed, and what happened to sales and TACOS.

Shortlisted candidates get a short take-home task: build a strategy and implementation roadmap for a consumer brand’s marketplace and quick commerce ads.

We are looking for a results-driven LinkedIn Lead Generation & Growth Specialist who understands how to transform LinkedIn from a professional networking platform into a consistent source of qualified business opportunities.
  
This is a hands-on, outcome-oriented role focused on identifying and engaging high-potential senior professionals, generating qualified enquiries and building a sustainable LinkedIn-led acquisition channel for AlfaDux.
  
The selected professional will also serve as an internal LinkedIn subject-matter expert, sharing practical insights and best practices with our experienced Executive Education Advisors to help them maximise the platform's potential.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
A. LinkedIn Lead Generation & Prospect Engagement
  
- Own and execute AlfaDux's LinkedIn organic lead generation strategy.
  
- Identify and engage relevant professionals, including senior managers, directors, VPs, CXOs, entrepreneurs and business leaders.
  
- Leverage LinkedIn Sales Navigator, advanced search and prospect research to identify high-potential audiences.
  
- Build targeted prospect lists based on professional experience, career progression, leadership aspirations and program relevance.
  
- Develop personalised, professional outreach strategies that initiate meaningful conversations.
  
- Generate qualified enquiries and schedule consultations with AlfaDux's Executive Education Advisors.
  
- Build and nurture professional relationships through consistent, value-driven engagement.
  
- Maintain accurate lead records, prospect interactions and follow-up information within the designated CRM.
  
- Ensure all prospecting activities comply with LinkedIn's platform policies and applicable privacy requirements.
  
B. LinkedIn Growth, Content & Thought Leadership
  
- Develop strategies to strengthen AlfaDux's LinkedIn visibility, credibility and engagement among senior professionals.
  
- Identify relevant industry trends, leadership discussions and professional communities for meaningful engagement.
  
- Recommend high-impact content themes, thought-leadership approaches and engagement opportunities.
  
- Optimise LinkedIn profiles, positioning and content strategies to enhance professional credibility.
  
- Explore organic growth opportunities through professional networking, relevant communities and strategic engagement.
  
- Evaluate opportunities for targeted LinkedIn paid campaigns where commercially justified.
  
C. LinkedIn Advisory & Best-Practice Enablement
  
- Act as AlfaDux's internal LinkedIn subject-matter expert.
  
- Guide experienced Executive Education Advisors on effective LinkedIn usage for professional networking, relationship building and prospect engagement.
  
- Demonstrate advanced Sales Navigator features, search techniques and relevant platform capabilities.
  
- Share practical recommendations for profile positioning, content engagement, personalised outreach and relationship nurturing.
  
- Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions on LinkedIn best practices, emerging features and effective engagement techniques.
  
- Provide actionable insights that help advisors strengthen their individual professional presence and maximise LinkedIn's business potential.
  
D. Lead Quality, Analytics & Business Outcomes
  
- Take ownership of personally generated qualified leads and consultation opportunities.
  
- Track prospect engagement, meaningful conversations, qualified enquiries, consultations and resulting enrolment outcomes.
  
- Analyse lead quality and conversion feedback to continuously refine targeting and outreach strategies.
  
- Maintain transparent reporting on lead generation activities, pipeline development and business contribution.
  
- Collaborate closely with Executive Education Advisors to improve the quality and relevance of generated opportunities.
  
- Continuously optimise strategies based on measurable business outcomes rather than vanity metrics.
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
- 3–6 years of relevant experience in LinkedIn lead generation, social selling, B2B prospecting or digital demand generation.
  
- Demonstrated success in generating qualified business opportunities through organic LinkedIn strategies.
  
- Strong hands-on expertise in LinkedIn Sales Navigator, advanced prospect research and audience segmentation.
  
- Proven ability to engage senior professionals, decision-makers or high-value customer segments.
  
- Excellent written English, professional communication and personalised outreach skills.
  
- Strong understanding of LinkedIn profile optimisation, content engagement and professional networking.
  
- Experience working with CRM platforms, lead tracking and performance analytics.
  
- Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative and deliver measurable lead generation outcomes.
  
Preferred Experience
  
- Lead generation experience in executive education, premium professional services, management consulting, executive search, SaaS or high-ticket B2B solutions.
  
- Experience engaging CXOs, directors, senior executives, entrepreneurs and business owners.
  
- Familiarity with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, paid lead generation campaigns and conversion optimisation.
  
- Experience sharing LinkedIn best practices with experienced sales or advisory professionals.
  
- Exposure to AI-assisted prospect research, content development and workflow productivity tools.
  
What Success Looks Like
  
Success in this role will be measured by:
  
- Consistent generation of relevant, qualified LinkedIn prospects.
  
- Meaningful engagement and qualified consultations with prospective learners.
  
- Quality of the lead pipeline and contribution to actual enrolment revenue.
  
- Sustainable improvement in AlfaDux's LinkedIn-led demand generation.
  
- Effective knowledge sharing that enables senior advisors to use LinkedIn more strategically.
  
Qualified opportunities, meaningful relationships and measurable business outcomes matter more than impressions, likes or connection counts.
  
Why Join AlfaDux?
  
- Represent a premium executive education brand serving accomplished professionals and future business leaders.
  
- Engage with an influential audience of senior executives, entrepreneurs and decision-makers.
  
- Take ownership of a strategically important growth channel with visible business impact.
  
- Work alongside experienced Executive Education Advisors.
  
- Contribute to building a scalable, high-value executive education business.
  
- Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and performance-linked rewards.
  
Apply Now
  
If you have demonstrated success in turning LinkedIn connections into meaningful business opportunities, we would like to hear from you.
  
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate actual lead generation results, qualified consultations and business outcomes from their previous LinkedIn campaigns.
  
Join AlfaDux – Leader of Leaders.

* Partner Relationship Management
* Revenue Growth Management

* Customer Focus

* Ownership & Accountability

description:
**About Inspire Brands:**

Inspire Brands is disrupting the restaurant industry through digital transformation and operational efficiencies. The company’s technology hub, Inspire Brands Hyderabad Support Center, India, will lead technology innovation and product development for the organization and its portfolio of distinct brands. The Inspire Brands Hyderabad Support Center will focus on developing new capabilities in data science, data analytics, eCommerce, automation, cloud computing, and information security to accelerate the company’s business strategy. **Network & Systems Senior Analyst**

**Position Summary:**

At Inspire Brands, our network connects thousands of restaurant locations, support centers, cloud platforms, and business-critical systems across a large, distributed enterprise. As a Network & Systems Senior Analyst, you'll play a key role in maintaining the performance, stability, and security of that environment.

This position is responsible for the day-to-day engineering, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of enterprise network infrastructure across cloud environments, and restaurant locations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, improving network reliability, and delivering exceptional experience for end users and business partners.

**What You'll Do:**

* Support and maintain large-scale enterprise network environments across cloud environments, and restaurant locations.
* Monitor network health, availability, and performance using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues impacting connectivity, application performance, voice services, and business operations.
* Implement network infrastructure changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities in accordance with change management processes.
* Configure and support routing, switching, wireless, VPN, firewall, and WAN technologies.
* Partner with Information Security teams to ensure network compliance, segmentation, and adherence to security standards.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvements that increase stability and operational efficiency.
* Analyze network utilization and performance trends and recommend improvements to capacity, resiliency, and reliability.
* Coordinate with telecommunications providers, vendors, and managed service partners to resolve service issues and support network initiatives.
* Participate in major incident response, root cause analysis, and problem management activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, standards, and operational procedures.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members and support organizations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi-site environment.
* Hands on experience configuring, troubleshooting, and optimizing Cisco and Fortinet routers, firewalls, switches, and wireless access points.
* Experience supporting dynamic routing protocols, including BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP.
* Experience with network monitoring, performance analysis, and incident response.
* Experience working with network service providers and telecommunications carriers.
* Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, VPN, and firewall technologies in Cisco and/or Fortinet environments.
* Advanced knowledge of TCP/IP and network services, including DNS, DHCP, NAT, QoS, SNMP, and secure remote access.
* Advanced knowledge of routing and switching protocols and technologies, including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, Spanning Tree, route redistribution, high availability, and network segmentation.
* Strong documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting Cisco Meraki and Fortinet environments.
* Experience with Cisco SD-WAN, Meraki, or cloud networking technologies.
* Experience supporting distributed retail, restaurant, hospitality, or franchise environments.
* Experience with firewall technologies Cisco Meraki and Fortinet Fortigate
* Experience supporting enterprise data center environments.
* Experience with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar).
* Experience with Microsoft 365, cloud networking, and collaboration or voice platforms is preferred.
* Experience operating networks in regulated environments, including PCI, HIPAA, and SOX, with strong understanding of audit, control, and evidence requirements.

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Senior IAM Support Analyst:**

The Application Subject Matter Specialist – IAM Support Analyst is responsible for the operational stability, security, and resilience of Zurich’s Identity and Access Management (IAM) services.

The role provides expert Level 2 / Level 3 operational support for IAM platforms, ensuring reliable authentication, authorization, and access control in line with Zurich’s security, risk, resilience, and control standards.

title: Junior AI Functional Consultant
