SendClean
  
  
An Email Platform by Route Mobile Limited
  
  

* Proximus Group

**Email Deliverability Engineer**
Location Hyderabad, India (on-site)
  
  
Function Email Deliverability & Platform Operations
  
  
Experience 4–7 years in email deliverability / MTA operations
  
  
Type Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Route Mobile Limited is a publicly listed Cloud Communications (CPaaS) provider, in the business since
  
  
2004, serving enterprises, OTT players and mobile operators across BFSI, retail, travel and e-commerce.
  
  
SendClean is our high-volume email platform.
  
  
SendClean is Route Mobile’s high-volume email platform. We push billions of transactional and
  
  
marketing emails a month for banks, fintechs, retail and OTT customers across India, LATAM, the
  
  
Middle East and now the US market. At that scale, deliverability is not a marketing checkbox – it is an
  
  
engineering problem. Every point of inbox placement we lose is revenue our customers lose.
  
  
We are looking for a Deliverability Engineer who can live in both worlds: someone who understands
  
  
sender reputation, ISP policy and authentication as deeply as any deliverability consultant, but who is
  
  
also comfortable on a Linux box at 2 AM reading MTA logs to find out why a sending IP suddenly started
  
  
getting 421s from Google. If you can read a bounce log, tell the difference between a real block and a
  
  
transient defer, and explain to a customer why their list quality is killing their reputation – in the same
  
  
afternoon – you are the person we want.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will own inbox placement for a large book of enterprise senders, work
  
  
directly with the SRE and platform teams on the sending infrastructure, and be the person the delivery
  
  
team escalates to when something is genuinely on fire.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Do**
– Own deliverability end-to-end. Own inbox placement and sender reputation across our sending IP
  
  
pools and domains – monitor it, defend it, and recover it when it drops.
  
  
– Debug on the server. Read the logs. Dig through MTA logs (receiving and sending nodes), SMTP
  
  
transaction logs and bounce data to root-cause why mail is deferring, bouncing or landing in spam.
  
  
You should be able to tell a 4xx defer from a 5xx block and know what to do about each.
  
  
– Warm-up & IP hygiene. Manage IP warm-up schedules for new ranges and new customers, and
  
  
know when to slow a sender down before they burn a range.
  
  
– Authentication. Set up and read SPF, DKIM, DMARC (and BIMI where it applies). Diagnose
  
  
alignment failures and fix authentication issues for customers who bring their own domains.
  
  
– ISP & mailbox provider policy. Stay ahead of Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft sender requirements
  
  
and enforcement changes, and translate them into concrete actions before they hit our customers –
  
  
not after.
  
  
– Blocklist monitoring & remediation. Watch Spamhaus, SURBL, Barracuda and the other
  
  
blocklists. When we get listed, you find out why, fix the root cause, and drive the delisting.
  
  
– Bounce & complaint handling. Classify and act on bounces and FBL/complaint feedback, keep
  
  
suppression clean, and use complaint and bounce signatures to catch list-quality and spamtrap
  
  
problems early.
  
  
– Metrics & reporting. Build and read dashboards (Kibana / Grafana or similar) for delivery, bounce
  
  
and latency metrics. Turn raw delivery data into something a customer or an account manager can
  
  
act on.
  
  
– Customer-facing deliverability. Work directly with customers on their sending practices – list
  
  
hygiene, content, cadence, authentication – and hold the line on our compliance and anti-abuse
  
  
standards.
  
  
– Cross-team work. Partner with SRE, platform and support engineering on MTA config, queue
  
  
behaviour and infrastructure changes that affect delivery. Deliverability doesn’t happen in isolation
  
  
from the platform.
  
  
– Audits & compliance. Run regular audits of our sending infrastructure and practices against
  
  
industry standards and mailbox-provider requirements, and keep us compliant with anti-spam
  
  
regulation (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL and the rest).
  
  
– Vendor & postmaster relationships. Own the external relationships that decide our fate – blocklist
  
  
operators, feedback-loop and seed-list / inbox-placement providers, and mailbox-provider
  
  
postmaster channels – to troubleshoot issues and push delistings through.
  
  
– Documentation. Keep deliverability SOPs, runbooks and playbooks current so the delivery and
  
  
support teams can handle the routine cases without escalating every time.
  
  
– Mentoring & training. Coach the delivery and support teams on deliverability fundamentals – turn
  
  
tribal knowledge into something the whole team can actually use.
  
  
– Tooling & continuous improvement. Evaluate new deliverability, monitoring and inbox-placement
  
  
tooling, and make the call on what’s worth adopting – we’re actively investing in better tooling, not
  
  
standing still.
  
  
**What we’re looki**
**ng for**
– Real email-industry exposure. 4+ years working hands-on in email deliverability, ideally at an ESP,
  
  
CPaaS or a serious high-volume sender – not just campaign-side marketing.
  
  
– You understand SMTP properly. Solid working knowledge of SMTP: response codes, bounce
  
  
codes, deferrals, connection behaviour, and what mailbox providers do and don’t tell you.
  
  
– Server-level comfort. Comfortable on Linux. You can SSH into a box, grep through logs, follow a
  
  
message through the pipeline, and use basic scripting (bash / Python) to pull the answer out of a
  
  
large log file.
  
  
– Authentication in your bones. Hands-on with SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNS records, and comfortable
  
  
diagnosing them when they break.
  
  
– You know the ecosystem. You know Postmaster Tools, SNDS, feedback loops, blocklists and the
  
  
reputation systems that actually decide inbox placement.
  
  
– Analytical and evidence-driven. When mail is going to spam, you form a hypothesis, test it against
  
  
the data, and fix the actual cause instead of guessing.
  
  
– Clear communicator. You can explain a deliverability problem to a customer, an account manager
  
  
and an engineer – three different audiences – and influence stakeholders at every level without
  
  
losing any of them.
  
  
**Nice to have (not deal-breakers)**
– Hands-on experience with MTA –Postfix, PowerMTA or similar.
  
  
– Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana or another log-analytics stack for delivery monitoring.
  
  
– Exposure to AWS (or another cloud) and how sending infrastructure runs on it.
  
  
– Working knowledge of Redis, message queues (RabbitMQ ) or the moving parts of a sending
  
  
pipeline.
  
  
– HTML email and rendering know-how – enough to spot when the content is the problem.
  
  
– Prior time in a deliverability lead or expert role – if you’ve owned this for an organisation before, that
  
  
counts.
  
  
– A bachelor’s in marketing, CS/IT or a related field – or equivalent real-world experience.
  
  
**Why PXS Global?**

* 🌍 Global & Inclusive – Work with diverse teams across 100+ countries, embracing a truly international culture.
* 📈 Growth-Focused – Develop your career through tailored learning, leadership programmes, and internal mobility.
* 💡 Innovation-Driven – Contribute to cutting-edge projects in 5G, IoT, and next-gen communication technologies.
* 🏠 Flexible Workstyle – Enjoy hybrid working with the option to work remotely and even from abroad for up to 10 days a year.
* 🚀 Efficient & Scalable – Be part of a company that values simplicity, operational excellence, and smart growth.
* 🎁 Comprehensive Benefits – Enjoy a competitive and thoughtfully designed salary package, with a wide range of benefits.

A bachelor’s in marketing, CS/IT or a related field – or equivalent real-world experience.

title: Lead SAP ABAP Development & Security Specialist [T500-30751]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**SAP ABAP Developer – GRC Specialist (Access Control)**

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Developer with knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control to join our SAP Security team. This role focuses on developing, enhancing, and troubleshooting ABAP-based solutions across GRC Access Control processes — including User Access Management (UAM), Emergency Access Management (EAM), and User Access Review (UAR) — as well as Fiori/UI5 applications and SAP authorization concepts.
* The successful candidate will serve as the go-to technical expert for diagnosing and resolving complex GRC issues at the code level, bridging the gap between functional GRC configuration and deep ABAP development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ABAP Development & GRC Customization
* Develop and maintain ABAP enhancements, user exits, BAdIs, and custom reports within SAP GRC Access Control.
* Build and extend GRC workflows, approval processes, and provisioning logic using ABAP and SAP Business Workflow.
* Implement custom risk rules, mitigation controls, and role management logic to meet business and audit requirements.
* Develop ABAP programs to automate access governance tasks such as bulk role assignments, periodic reviews, and audit reporting.
* Create and maintain RFCs, function modules, and BAPIs used by GRC connectors and integration scenarios.

**GRC Debugging & Incident Resolution:**

* Perform end-to-end ABAP debugging of complex GRC incidents — from authorization failures to provisioning errors and workflow breakdowns.
* Analyze and resolve issues across all GRC modules: ARM provisioning workflows, EAM firefighter sessions, and UAR campaign processing.
* Use SAP debugging tools (ABAP Debugger, ST05 SQL trace, SM50/SM66 process monitoring, SLG1 application logs, STAD) to pinpoint root causes.
* Investigate GRC connector failures, RFC destination issues, and LDAP/HR trigger integration problems.
* Support SAP Notes analysis and implement corrections or workarounds at the ABAP level when standard configuration is insufficient.

**Fiori / UI5 & OData Development:**

* Develop and enhance SAP Fiori applications and SAPUI5 solutions supporting GRC processes.
* Build and maintain OData services (SEGW / CAP) consumed by GRC Fiori apps and custom launchpad tiles.
* Troubleshoot authorization failures in Fiori launchpad, OData service errors, and backend ABAP permission issues.
* Analyze browser traces, gateway logs, and ABAP backend dumps to resolve Fiori security issues end to end.

**Authorization & Security Architecture:**

* Design and implement SAP authorization concepts for custom ABAP objects, transactions, and Fiori applications.
* Create and maintain authorization objects, checks (AUTHORITY-CHECK), and role assignments aligned with GRC ruleset definitions.
* Support security reviews of custom ABAP developments to ensure compliance with least-privilege principles.
* Collaborate with GRC functional consultants to translate business risk rules into technical authorization controls.

**Integration & Automation:**

* Develop ABAP-based integrations between GRC Access Control and SAP/non-SAP systems via RFCs, BAPIs, and REST/SOAP APIs.
* Build automation scripts and tools (ABAP, Python, or Power Automate) to reduce manual effort in access governance operations.
* Support AI-assisted automation scenarios where agents interact with SAP systems via APIs, RFCs, or MCP protocols.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong ABAP development skills: ABAP, classical ABAP, enhancements framework (BAdIs, user exits), ALV, Smart Forms/Adobe Forms.
* Deep hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, UAM/ARM, EAM, UAR) at both functional and technical levels.
* Proficient with SAP debugging tools: ABAP Debugger, ST05, SM50/SM66, SLG1, STAD, and system traces.
* Experience developing and consuming OData services (SEGW or CAP) for Fiori applications.
* Knowledge of SAP authorization architecture: authorization objects, profiles, roles, AUTHORITY-CHECK, and SU53/SU22/SU24.
* Familiarity with SAP Workflow (SWI\*, SWIA) for GRC approval process troubleshooting and enhancement.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to debugging complex multi-layer issues.
* Ability to work independently on ambiguous problems and communicate root cause clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Detail-oriented and comfortable owning an issue end to end — from log analysis to fix deployment.
* Collaborative: works closely with GRC functional consultants, security architects, and business process owners.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with AI/ML tools applied to SAP operations (LLMs, prompt engineering, Python scripting, Claude Code, MCP servers).
* Knowledge of SAP BTP, Cloud Foundry, or SAP Integration Suite for hybrid landscape scenarios.
* Exposure to SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS) integration with GRC.
* Contributions to SAP Notes analysis, OSS messages, or custom patch development.
* Experience with abapGit and modern ABAP development practices (clean ABAP, unit testing with ABAP Unit).

title: Manager - Vendor Management
description:
**Overview**
Role Details
  
  
Job Title: IT Vendor Management Analyst – Software Asset Management
  
  
Level: 7
  
  
Experience: 8–12 years
  
  
Main Purpose of the Role
  
  
The IT Vendor Management Analyst – Software Asset Management is responsible for supporting the effective governance, management, compliance, performance, and optimization of PepsiCo’s technology vendor and software portfolio, with Software Asset Management (SAM) as the primary area of responsibility.
  
  
The role will manage and analyze software licensing, entitlements, consumption, compliance, renewals, software spend, and optimization opportunities while also supporting broader IT Vendor Management activities including vendor governance, performance management, contract compliance, financial management, risk management, and strategic vendor engagement.
  
  
The Analyst will partner with Global and Sector stakeholders, Vendor Management, Procurement, Finance, Technology teams, Information Security, IT Controls, Service Owners, and external vendors to provide accurate data, meaningful analysis, and actionable insights. The role is intentionally designed to build capability across both SAM and IT Vendor Management, enabling flexibility to support broader vendor portfolio responsibilities as business priorities evolve.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Accountabilities
  
  

* Software Asset Management – Primary Responsibility
* Support and manage end-to-end Software Asset Management activities across the software lifecycle, including procurement, entitlement, deployment, utilization, renewal, optimization, and retirement.
* Maintain and validate software inventory, licensing entitlements, subscriptions, deployments, and consumption information.
* Perform reconciliation of software entitlements against installations, deployments, subscriptions, and actual usage.
* Identify license compliance gaps, unused or underutilized licenses, over-deployment, and software optimization opportunities.
* Drive license harvesting, reallocation, rationalization, and optimization activities in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate software product, entitlement, contract, renewal, and vendor records.
* Partner with application owners, technology teams, Procurement, Finance, and vendors to investigate and resolve licensing and inventory discrepancies.
* Support software compliance assessments, license reviews, true-ups, and software publisher audits.
* Develop and maintain reliable software license positions and supporting documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement of SAM processes, controls, data quality, governance, and documentation.
* Work with enterprise SAM/ITAM platforms and data sources such as Flexera/FlexNet Manager Suite, ServiceNow SAM Pro, SCCM/MECM, Intune, or equivalent tools, as applicable.
* IT Vendor Governance & Relationship Management
* Support governance activities across strategic and preferred IT vendors and software publishers.
* Coordinate and prepare vendor governance and Strategic Business Review (SBR) discussions, including performance, commercial, risk, financial, and contractual insights.
* Maintain vendor profiles covering contracts, products/services, spend, performance, risks, renewals, commitments, and key stakeholders.
* Work with Global and Sector stakeholders to provide insights and reporting for vendor portfolio management.
* Support onboarding of internal and external stakeholders into established vendor governance processes.
* Collaborate with stakeholders on agenda shaping and preparation to enable effective vendor governance and business reviews.
* Track decisions, commitments, risks, issues, and action items from governance meetings and drive follow-up through closure.
* Conduct relevant vendor, market, commercial, and technology research to support sourcing and Vendor Management decisions.
* Identify opportunities for vendor consolidation, optimization, improved commercial value, and stronger operational outcomes.
* Vendor Performance Management
* Track, analyze, and report vendor performance against contractual SLAs, KPIs, business outcomes, and agreed performance measures.
* Identify performance trends, exceptions, recurring issues, and areas requiring management attention.
* Partner with Vendor Managers, Service Owners, and suppliers to ensure performance issues and improvement actions are appropriately tracked and driven to closure.
* Support the definition and refinement of consistent KPIs and management reporting across the assigned vendor portfolio.
* Prepare performance insights and executive-ready reporting for leadership and stakeholder reviews.
* Support business satisfaction measurement and incorporate relevant feedback into vendor performance discussions.
* Contract Compliance, Renewals & Sourcing Support
* Maintain visibility of software and IT vendor contracts, subscriptions, commercial commitments, key obligations, and renewal dates.
* Interpret relevant contractual and licensing terms and translate them into operational tracking and compliance requirements.
* Support software and vendor renewal planning using consumption, utilization, performance, contractual, and spend analysis.
* Partner with Procurement and Vendor Management by providing data and insights for sourcing activities, commercial negotiations, renewals, and contract decisions.
* Coordinate stakeholder inquiries relating to contracts, licensing, entitlements, consumption, and vendor obligations.
* Coordinate contract change-management activities within the assigned portfolio, ensuring changes are documented, evaluated, tracked, and communicated.
* Monitor contractual commitments and identify potential compliance or commercial risks.
* Maintain appropriate contract documentation and evidence required for governance and audit activities.
* Vendor Financial & Consumption Management
* Validate software licensing and vendor consumption data using established processes and controls.
* Verify quantities, resource units, calculations, pricing assumptions, and applicable volume or contractual adjustments.
* Analyze software utilization, vendor consumption, and spend trends; identify anomalies, risks, and optimization opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for license optimization, demand management, cost avoidance, and improved commercial efficiency.
* Provide Finance with accurate inputs for budgeting, forecasting, accrual validation, financial business cases, and portfolio planning.
* Support analysis of vendor invoices and consumption against applicable contractual and commercial information.
* Develop actionable insights across vendor spend, utilization, consumption, and financial performance.
* Risk, Compliance & Audit Support
* Support compliance reviews associated with software licensing and IT vendors.
* Coordinate preparation of entitlement, deployment, usage, contract, and supporting evidence for software publisher audits and internal control reviews.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails for key SAM and Vendor Management activities.
* Partner with IT Controls, Information Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Technology stakeholders as required to address vendor and software-related risks.
* Track identified issues, risks, and remediation actions through closure.
* Support broader third-party/vendor risk and compliance activities based on portfolio requirements.
* Reporting, Analytics & Power BI
* Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and supporting data models for SAM and Vendor Management.
* Provide reporting across software entitlement and consumption, license utilization and optimization, renewals, software/vendor spend, contract milestones, vendor SLA/KPI performance, risk, compliance, and action tracking.
* Analyze complex data from multiple sources and translate it into clear, actionable business and commercial insights.
* Implement appropriate data-quality checks, controls, and repeatable reporting processes.
* Prepare executive-ready reporting and insights for senior stakeholders and vendor governance forums.

**Qualifications**
Key Skills / Experience Required
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 8–12 years of overall professional experience across Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, IT Vendor Management, Technology Procurement, Contract Management, or related technology/commercial functions.
* Strong hands-on experience in Software Asset Management, including entitlement management, license reconciliation, software consumption analysis, compliance, optimization, and renewals.
* Experience working with enterprise SAM/ITAM platforms such as Flexera/FlexNet Manager Suite, ServiceNow SAM Pro, or equivalent tools.
* Good understanding of enterprise software licensing and subscription models, with exposure to major publishers such as Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, SAP, Adobe, VMware/Broadcom, Salesforce, or similar vendors preferred.
* Experience supporting software contract renewals, license true-ups, compliance reviews, and software publisher audits.
* Experience analyzing software spend, utilization, entitlement, consumption, and contractual data to identify optimization and cost-avoidance opportunities.
* Experience in broader IT Vendor Management, including vendor governance, SLA/KPI performance management, contract compliance, financial management, risk management, and vendor relationship management.
* Experience coordinating vendor governance or business reviews, preparing performance insights, identifying risks/issues, and driving actions to closure.
* Strong experience with Power BI, Excel, data analysis, visualization, and executive-level reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple vendors, global stakeholders, priorities, and deliverables in a complex environment.
* Ability to interpret complex commercial and licensing information and translate it into clear, actionable recommendations.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of Software Asset Management (SAM) and IT Asset Management (ITAM) concepts and practices.
* Knowledge of software licensing, entitlements, installations, subscriptions, consumption, utilization, and software lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of SAM/ITAM platforms, preferably Flexera/FlexNet Manager Suite and/or ServiceNow SAM Pro.
* Strong analytical, data-reconciliation, and problem-solving capability.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and strong capability in Power BI and data visualization.
* Good understanding of commercial contracts, contractual obligations, sourcing, procurement, and renewal processes.
* Understanding of Vendor Management, SLA/KPI performance management, financial management, and third-party risk concepts.
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Power BI.

title: Risk Manager II, TSI SCI & Res-Q
description:
**Description**
Millions of Selling Partners trust Amazon's marketplace to grow their businesses, and hundreds of millions of customers depend on us every day. Behind that trust is a network of systems, tools, and workflows designed to detect and resolve fraud and abuse at scale — and our team builds them.
  
  
We are looking for a Risk Manager II who will drive end-to-end program execution for risk reduction initiatives across TSI SCI and Res-Q. In this role, you will own cross-functional program delivery — building roadmaps, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and driving process automation to eliminate defects and improve operational efficiency at scale.
  
  
You will partner with engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams to define program scope, manage trade-offs, and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll own root cause and preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects, drive process automation initiatives that reduce manual investigation effort, and ensure programs are delivered on time, at quality, and with measurable impact.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon protects seller and customer trust by combining structured program management with process automation expertise that fundamentally improves how our organization operates.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own end-to-end program management for risk reduction initiatives — defining scope, building roadmaps, tracking milestones, managing dependencies, and driving delivery across engineering, science, operations, legal, and policy teams.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across Risk Managers, Operations, Science, Legal, and Policy stakeholders to define program scope, prioritize features, and manage trade-offs — with defect elimination and operational efficiency as the primary lens.
* Identify, design, and implement process automation opportunities that reduce manual investigation effort, eliminate repetitive workflows, and improve investigator productivity — partnering with engineering teams to translate operational pain points into automation solutions.
* Own root cause / preventive action (RC/PA) for systemic defects — when defect pattern analysis reveals recurring failure modes, document root cause findings, define preventive actions with measurable closure criteria, and track implementation through to validated defect elimination.
* Build and manage program roadmaps for automation and process improvement launches, tracking dependencies, identifying risks, and driving escalation management across multi-team initiatives.
* Conduct defect pattern analysis to identify systemic abuse trends, process gaps, and opportunities for automation coverage expansion — translating findings into prioritized program requirements.
* Lead escalation triage for program-impacted workflows — rapidly diagnosing whether issues stem from process gaps, system failures, or policy misalignment, and routing to the appropriate team with clear severity assessment and remediation path.
* Define and instrument success metrics to measure program impact, automation coverage, defect escape rates, process cycle time reduction, and seller experience improvement.
* Drive process improvement initiatives using structured methodologies (DMAIC, Kaizen, or equivalent) mapping current-state workflows, identifying waste and bottlenecks, and implementing scalable solutions.
* Manage stakeholder communication and program governance - preparing and presenting program updates, launch readiness reviews, and impact assessments to senior leadership, quantifying the value of risk reduction investments.
* Own change management for new process launches and automation deployments — ensuring smooth adoption across operations teams through documentation, training, and feedback loops.
* Conduct deep dives into escalation data, process metrics, and system gaps to identify launch blockers and ensure seamless program implementation.

A day in the life
  
  
You'll start your day reviewing program dashboards and defect metrics — checking milestone progress, flagging blockers, and identifying where process automation can reduce manual effort. You'll meet with investigators and Risk Managers to understand which workflows are creating friction and translate those insights into program requirements.
  
  
You'll drive sprint planning and stakeholder alignment meetings — prioritizing initiatives by defect elimination impact and operational efficiency gains. You'll analyze escalation data to spot systemic issues that process automation should solve, and work with operations leaders to validate that deployed solutions are actually reducing investigation workload.
  
  
Your week includes cross-functional program reviews with Science, Legal, Operations and Policy, launch readiness assessments, RC/PA deep dives on systemic defects, process mapping workshops for automation opportunities, and presenting program progress at WBRs and MBRs.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Res-Q team operates as the central command for abuse-related escalations, conducting investigations and driving systemic improvements across Amazon's global stores. Through our various intake channels, we handle the most complex and sensitive cases that require expert judgment and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 2+ years of experience in risk management, trust & safety, fraud prevention, or marketplace integrity domains
* Experience driving process automation or process improvement initiatives that delivered measurable operational efficiency gains
* Experience managing programs across technical and non-technical teams with competing priorities
* Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision making
* Experience with defect analysis, root cause investigation, and structured problem-solving methodologies
* Experience writing program requirements, process documentation, and stakeholder communications
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent programs with interdependencies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with process automation tools, workflow orchestration, or RPA (Robotic Process Automation) platforms
* Experience defining and tracking program metrics, and driving data-informed prioritization
* Experience launching automation solutions that directly reduced operational defect rates or manual investigation workload
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to influence technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Familiarity with agile development methodologies and sprint-based delivery
* Experience with change management and driving adoption of new processes/tools across operations teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Description:**

Tytan Technology is hiring an Agentic AI Engineer to build AI agents on enterprise platforms. You will build agents inside ServiceNow HRSD and connect them to other enterprise systems, starting with SAP SuccessFactors, using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

**What you will do:**

* Build and test AI agents and agentic workflows for HR use cases
* Build MCP servers and tools so agents can read from and act on external systems
* Integrate ServiceNow with SAP SuccessFactors and evaluate SAP Joule
* Define guardrails, approvals, and monitoring for agents that touch HR data

**What you need:**

* 5+ years in software or AI engineering, including 2+ years building LLM applications or agents in production
* Hands-on with tool calling, orchestration, RAG, and multi-agent design
* Working knowledge of MCP, or strong experience building API and tool layers for agents
* Python or TypeScript, plus REST and OAuth integration skills

**Nice to have:**
ServiceNow (Now Assist, AI Agent Studio), SAP SuccessFactors or SAP BTP, HR domain exposure.

**Skills:**
AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMs, Python, RAG, API Integration, ServiceNow, SAP SuccessFactors, LangChain, TypeScript

title: Applied AI Engineer - Firm Enterprise Solutions Director
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Director, Applied AI Engineering**
**Role Overview:**
As a Director, Applied AI Engineering , you will shape and own the engineering strategy and technical direction for your service line—translating business objectives into engineering strategy, mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape, and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver. You will develop and execute a forward-looking technology roadmap that drives simplification, scalability, and efficiency—rationalizing the landscape and integrating the service line’s portfolio within the wider enterprise across multiple upstream and downstream systems. Leading across product groups and the service line, you will stay hands-on in your craft—shaping architecture, integration, design, and code—while driving the standards and enterprise reference architectures that engineers build against.
  
  
Your leadership will be pivotal in delivering tangible value across the service line’s product and AI investments, aligning technical solutions with business and technology strategy, and advancing Applied AI engineering across the organization. You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across software and data engineering, enterprise and integration architecture, and AI/ML and GenAI, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing —owning strategy, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to senior executives and service-line leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Accountable for defining, communicating, and continuously refining the engineering strategy for the service line—translating business objectives into actionable strategy, mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape, defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver, and shaping how those products integrate within the enterprise across multiple upstream and downstream systems—in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders and executives, including businesses and enabling areas as well as product, engineering, experience, delivery, security, and infrastructure teams, across all organizational levels.
* Champion, own, and execute the integrated Applied AI engineering, architecture, and technology strategy and its implementation roadmap across the service line—driving simplification, scalability, and efficiency, and actively rationalizing the landscape by removing unnecessary systems, integrations, and bottlenecks. Ensure the organization is well-informed about objectives, KPIs, maturity, compliance, and progress. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed—keeping an eye on leverage of existing assets and on the inference, token, and cloud cost of what we build, to maximize outcomes and minimize total cost.
* Define, measure, and drive the achievement of KPIs and NFRs spanning system performance, scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, auditability, and maintainability, and own engineering health and delivery KPIs across the product groups and the service line. Establish and evolve Applied AI engineering, enterprise and integration architecture, and AI/ML/GenAI reference architectures, standards, and best practices—including spec- and context-driven development, evaluations, AI agent orchestration, and the AI and Agentic SSDLC that carries work from discovery to production to operations with full automation and quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Remain hands-on with design, architecture, integration, and code—contributing to product group and service line velocity and staying engaged with engineers across the SSDLC—while reviewing standards and code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology.
* As a recognized engineering leader, mentor and develop engineers and emerging leaders, building the engineering talent bench across the product groups and the service line. Coach modern Applied AI engineering practices—full-stack and micro-services, integration tools and practices, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI and agentic systems, data engineering, application-level infrastructure-as-code, and advanced deployment techniques (Blue-Green, Canary, A/B testing) that minimize downtime. Lead by example through thought leadership—showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia and communities. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the organization.
* Embrace an iterative and incremental approach to Applied AI product engineering and integration architecture, favoring action and rapid learning over extensive upfront planning. Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, ensuring each iteration delivers value and stays aligned with customer and business goals.
* Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical challenges faced by customers and users, aligning technical solutions with business outcomes. Minimize unnecessary technical complexity and avoid overengineering—features, functionality, and integration approaches that do not add value—and drive teams toward peak performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution. Collaborate, challenge, and own technical decisions advocated by business or other groups that do not fit or advance the enterprise ecosystem.
* Possess deep expertise in modern Applied AI engineering and architecture practices, with a keen ability to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for innovation across the technology landscape and the product lifecycle. Continuously enhance the engineering operating model to be lean, adaptable, and responsive—guiding and transforming the organization to embrace lean principles and foster a culture of innovation.
* Establish and evolve enterprise reference architectures, coding standards, and engineering and quality benchmarks that ensure robust, secure, scalable, and reliable/resilient solutions. Ensure appropriate, responsible technology adoption—developing explainable, scalable, reliable, and secure AI and agentic products—and proactively identify technical risks, developing mitigation strategies through proactive problem-solving and contingency planning, ensuring operational excellence and resilience across the product groups and the service line.
* Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making across the organization. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms, crafting clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs supported by evidence.
* Engage stakeholders at all levels—from team members and middle management to senior executives and service-line leadership—building collaborative, constructive relationships and co-creating momentum and value across the organization.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 12+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, REST/SOAP/GraphQL, SSO/MFA, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks.
* 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise solutions on modern technology stacks (e.g., API Gateways, Message Brokers, Queuing Services, Workflow Automation & Orchestration, ETL/ELT, Event Streaming, Real-Time Data Processing, Service Mesh) and cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, and micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including leveraging their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability).
* 5+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration.
* 5+ years of experience in establishing enterprise engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding large engineering teams in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards.
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
**About QualMinds**

At QualMinds, we design and develop world-class digital products and custom software solutions for Startups, Scale-ups, and Enterprises. Our engineering teams specialize in Frontend, Backend, Full Stack Development, QA Automation, UI/UX, DevOps, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agile Delivery. We are passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest standards of quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
8+ years (3+ years in production LLM/agentic systems, with proven multi-agent architecture experience)

**Job Summary**

We are building
**multi-agent AI systems**
for the automotive dealership ecosystem — networks of specialized, collaborating agents spanning
**customer-facing conversational experiences**
(voice and chat agents on dealership websites that handle inventory search, payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offers, test drive and service scheduling, and lead capture) and
**internal business agents**
(conversational and autonomous operation of campaign management, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — with proactive insights, recommendations, and human-approved actions).

These are not single-chatbot solutions: you will architect
**orchestrated teams of agents**
— planners, retrievers, domain specialists, action executors, and reviewer/critic agents — that coordinate, hand off, and share context to complete complex business workflows reliably. You will own these systems across the
**entire agentic development lifecycle**
: use-case scoping, multi-agent architecture and tool design, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Proven experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures**
  : supervisor/orchestrator patterns, hierarchical and peer-to-peer agent topologies, planner–executor–critic loops, agent handoffs, task decomposition and delegation, shared state/memory design, and failure isolation between agents.
* Hands-on with current agent frameworks and SDKs with strong multi-agent support:
  **LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI, or Vercel AI SDK**
  — including subagents, handoffs, and graph-based orchestration.
* Deep experience with frontier model APIs:
  **OpenAI (GPT-5.x, Realtime API), Anthropic (Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.x), Google (Gemini 3.x, Gemini Live)**
  ; familiarity with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) for per-agent cost/latency routing (e.g., small fast models for routing/critic agents, frontier models for planning).
* Expert in
  **tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  — designing and building MCP servers that expose business systems (inventory, CRM, campaigns, payments, reporting) as governed agent tools; working knowledge of
  **A2A (Agent2Agent)**
  for cross-platform agent interoperability.
* **Realtime voice AI**
  : speech-to-speech pipelines (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live, LiveKit Agents, Pipecat), STT/TTS providers (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia), barge-in/interruption handling, sub-second latency optimization, WebRTC and telephony integration — including voice agents that delegate to backend specialist agents mid-conversation.
* Production
  **RAG and context engineering**
  : vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and reranking, context window management across agent hops, shared and per-agent memory (short-term, long-term, episodic), and freshness strategies for fast-changing data (inventory, offers, pricing).
* **Agent evaluation and observability**
  : LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, or custom harnesses — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge,
  **multi-agent trajectory evals**
  (correct delegation, handoff quality, loop/runaway detection), eval-gated CI/CD; OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions with distributed tracing across agent boundaries.
* **Guardrails and AI safety**
  : prompt-injection defense, jailbreak resistance, PII redaction, content moderation, inter-agent trust boundaries, human-in-the-loop approval flows for consequential actions (payments, campaign sends, customer messaging), and compliance-aware messaging (TCPA).
* Strong
  **Python and TypeScript**
  ; modern backend (FastAPI, Node.js) and frontend (
  **React/Next.js**
  ) development, including streaming and realtime UX (SSE, WebSockets, WebRTC) and generative UI patterns.
* Cloud-native delivery:
  **GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager)**
  or equivalent on AWS/Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; durable execution for long-running agent workflows (e.g., Temporal) is a plus.
* Modern engineering workflow: GitHub (Actions, PR reviews), Jira/Linear, prompt and agent versioning, feature-flagged and eval-gated releases.
* Effective daily use of
  **AI-assisted development tools**
  (GitHub Copilot, coding agents, Claude Code, Cursor) and the judgment to review their output critically.
* PostgreSQL and modern data tooling; event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) for agent-triggered and agent-to-agent workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present AI risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* **Architect multi-agent systems end-to-end**
  : decompose business workflows into specialized agents (routing, retrieval, domain reasoning, action execution, review/critique), choose the right orchestration topology per use case, and define agent contracts, handoff protocols, and shared memory/state.
* Design and build customer-facing voice + chat agent teams covering the full public website capability surface: inventory search and comparison, finance/payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offer discovery, appointment scheduling, and lead capture/qualification — with low-latency realtime voice, streaming chat, graceful fallback, and human handoff.
* Ground all agent responses in live business data with strict accuracy guarantees — no hallucinated prices, VINs, or offers — and implement brand-safe guardrails for public surfaces (prompt injection, jailbreaks, off-topic containment, PII handling).
* Build internal multi-agent workflows that operate backend business platforms conversationally and autonomously: campaigns, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — following the
  **insight → recommendation → approved action**
  pattern with specialist agents collaborating under an orchestrator.
* Expose business capabilities as MCP tools with role-based permissions, audit logging, and approval policies scaled to action risk (read vs. draft vs. send vs. pay); enforce least-privilege tool access per agent.
* Build natural-language analytics: NL-to-SQL/semantic-layer querying, automated forecasting summaries, and scheduled executive digests.
* Own evaluation end-to-end: golden datasets per use case, offline regression suites,
  **multi-agent trajectory and delegation evals**
  , eval gates in CI/CD, A/B testing, and production quality monitoring (containment, conversion, CSAT).
* Establish LLMOps/AgentOps practices: prompt and agent versioning, per-agent model routing and semantic caching for cost control, token/latency budgets across agent chains, and observability dashboards with cross-agent distributed tracing.
* Lead root-cause analysis for agent failures (bad tool calls, wrong delegation, runaway loops, hallucinations, unsafe outputs) with durable systemic fixes and new guardrails.
* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and platform teams to translate business workflows into agent capabilities and clear delivery plans; mentor engineers on multi-agent patterns, context engineering, and evaluation discipline; report AI system health, risks, and trends to leadership with supporting data.

title: Principal Engineer – AI Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova is embracing cutting-edge technologies to streamline operations, improve customer experiences, and drive growth. As part of this vision, we are building a dedicated team to leverage Generative AI and redefine how we engage with our industry. The ultimate goal of the team is to automate prompting, develop a framework for prompting across use cases to maximize reuse as well as sharing across businesses.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and talented AI Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will be responsible for creating and optimizing prompts for LLMs, collaborating with domain experts and end users to develop software solutions that address both internal and external needs. This position offers a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced technology and traditional industry, making a tangible impact on our business processes.
  
  
We are driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Collaborate with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into clear and effective LLM prompts.
* Develop, test, and refine prompts for a variety of use cases, ensuring high accuracy and relevance in generated outputs.
* Work closely with software developers to integrate LLM solutions into existing or new applications.
* Contribute to the development of a scalable framework for prompt engineering, promoting reuse and knowledge sharing across different business units.
* Assist in gathering and analyzing user feedback to continually improve prompt effectiveness.
* Stay up-to-date with advancements in LLM technology and contribute to strategic decisions on tool and platform selection.
* Document prompt engineering processes, best practices, and use case outcomes to build a comprehensive knowledge base.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science,, AI Engineering, Mathematics, or related field with 15+ years' relevant experience.
* Experience with prompt engineering and familiarity with tools such as OpenAI’s GPT models, Hugging Face, etc.
* Proficiency in Python or other programming languages commonly used in AI/ML development.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and adapt to changing project requirements.
* Candidate must be willing to travel a minimum of 2 weeks per year

**Ideal Candidate Characteristics**

* PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, or related field
* Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and data processing libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy).
* Previous experience or internships involving NLP or machine learning projects.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of traditional industry operations and challenges.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Applied Scientist II, Sheriff Team- Payroll tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Tech's Sheriff team develops and maintains ML and Generative AI applications that support Payroll Operations and Amazon employees at scale. Our portfolio includes Pay-Input Anomaly Detection, which improves the pay experience by identifying pay input irregularities such as leaves and insurance discrepancies; Percept, which improves ticket resolution by providing intelligent ticket prioritization via sentiment scoring, ticket summarization, defect classification, and categorization; Penny, a Virtual Assistant that enables payroll operations teams to efficiently retrieve information from multiple sources including policies, Percept data, vendor data, and HR data via Xylem through a single browser interface; Pay Ticket Genie, in process of being integrated with Amazon AZA(A to Z Assistant); Niyam, our rule engine; and Policy as Code Extraction (PoCo), a critical component of SPACE (Single Payroll Autonomous and Computation Engine) Amazon's in-house payroll system built to eliminate third-party vendor dependency for payroll processing. PoCo ensures data accuracy by validating that pay instructions are correct and performing calculations when required. It consists of two components: policy-based rule creation, where business owners select a pay code and provide policy links to generate rules for specific business processes, and rule evaluation, where upstream services send real-time validation or calculation requests and receive results along with rationale for any failures. Sheriff team owns policy-based rule creation and powering the rule evaluation system with rules generated.
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that power these systems: driving model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across the payroll ecosystem.
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will operate across three core dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
  
  
Invent
  
  
You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches as well as emerging technologies from the research community. You practice customer-obsessed science : working backwards from the needs of Amazon employees and payroll operations teams to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methodologies for anomaly detection, sentiment analysis, ticket classification, prescriptive analysis, intelligent virtual assistance, and automated policy extraction. You identify and define the research agenda for expanding Percept's capabilities including prescriptive analysis feature; lead the scientific strategy for the Penny-AZA integration enabling accurate and low-latency responses to Amazon employee payroll queries, and drive the ML strategy for Policy as Code extraction(PoCo), developing models that extract, interpret, and codify payroll policies into structured, executable rules that power real-time pay instruction validation and calculation within SPACE. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues that validate the novelty of your work, when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
  
  
Implement
  
  
The ML components you develop are directly integrated into production systems or directly support large-scale applications serving Amazon's global payroll operations. You make appropriate tradeoffs between model accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and immediate versus long-term solutions; favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the correct level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI frameworks largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with data sources including USC (Unified Central Service), Xylem, SIM-Ticketing, Pay Code Governance system, and PoCo's rule evaluation engine.
  
  
Influence
  
  
You contribute to tactical and strategic planning for the Sheriff team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for the global expansion of Percept, driving both feature growth and country-level launches own the complex AI track for Penny-AZA integration collaborating across partner teams including Reflect and GREF to ensure seamless data integration and robust ML pipeline workflows, and drive the scientific roadmap for PoCo's expansion to 100K US employees, ensuring the ML models powering policy extraction, rule generation and testing scale reliably to meet this growth. You mentor scientists and engineers on the team and across teams, championing best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) to rapidly increase developer productivity and delivery velocity. You provide peer feedback on research procedures and results within and across teams, help recruit and develop bar-raising talent through interview drives, and grow the team's organizational knowledge of Sheriff team ML solutions. You are visible in the broader internal and external scientific communities as a subject matter expert and regularly serve as a Program Committee (PC) member at peer-reviewed conferences or review articles for journal publications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Experience communicating research findings and analysis in both written and spoken channels
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
* Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda
* Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Engineer
description:
TJX Companies
  
  
At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. * Enable AI and Generative AI solutions through semantic enrichment, contextualised data models and ontology-driven knowledge assets.
* Support GraphRAG, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, enterprise search, semantic search and intelligent agents.
* Design semantic frameworks that improve LLM grounding, explainability, traceability and enterprise knowledge retrieval.

* Define enterprise standards, policies and governance frameworks for ontology management, semantic models, taxonomies and knowledge graph assets using platforms such as Microsoft Purview and Collibra.
* Provide technical leadership across architecture, engineering, AI, governance and business teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews and establish best practices for semantic technologies, enterprise data modelling and AI-ready data ecosystems.

* Governance and metadata - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Metadata Management, Business Glossaries, Data Lineage, Data Quality Rules, Ontology Lifecycle Management, Semantic Governance.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: Guide / 10+ years
* 10+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Enterprise Information Management or enterprise data modelling-led architecture roles.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in semantic technologies, knowledge modelling and enterprise data modelling.

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Associate-Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING
  
  
The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.
  
  
Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE
  
  
Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.
  
  
Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

title: Senior Manager AI/ML Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead the development and execution of the Virtual Workspace AI and Automation strategy, driving innovation, productivity, operational excellence, and user experience improvements across enterprise digital workplace platforms
* Establish and lead a team responsible for identifying, developing, and deploying AI-powered solutions that automate engineering, operational, and support processes across Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop, Enterprise Browser, Endpoint, and related Virtual Workspace technologies
* Partner with engineering leaders, product managers, architects, operations teams, and business stakeholders to identify high-value AI use cases and develop scalable automation solutions that improve service quality, reduce operational costs, and accelerate delivery
* Develop AI-enabled capabilities leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic frameworks, machine learning technologies, and enterprise data platforms
* Drive adoption of software engineering and automation best practices, including API-driven automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), workflow orchestration, self-service capabilities, and intelligent remediation
* Lead the creation of operational analytics solutions that transform telemetry, monitoring data, and engineering metrics into actionable insights, predictive capabilities, and automated decision-making
* Follow the established framework for Responsible AI, ensuring compliance with security, privacy, regulatory, and ethical standards
* Build and maintain partnerships with technology vendors, internal AI organizations, cloud providers, and platform teams to accelerate delivery of innovative solutions
* Measure and communicate business outcomes, including productivity gains, operational efficiencies, cost savings, risk reduction, and employee experience improvements
* Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering talent while fostering a culture of innovation, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement
* Develop and manage the AI and Automation roadmap, aligning investments with organizational priorities and business objectives
* Present strategic recommendations, business cases, and program updates to senior leadership and executive stakeholders
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of engineering, infrastructure, software development, automation, or technology leadership experience
* 3+ years of leadership experience managing engineering or technology teams
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise automation solutions using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, workflow platforms, or equivalent technologies
* Experience working with AI technologies such as Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, OpenAI technologies, or machine learning platforms
* Experience leading cloud-based technology initiatives within Azure and/or AWS environments
* Experience managing technology roadmaps, budgets, priorities, and cross-functional delivery programs
* Solid understanding of enterprise security, compliance, governance, and risk management requirements
* Proven excellent communication and executive presentation skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AI/ML, Azure, cloud, or automation-related certifications
* Experience supporting Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), VMware Horizon, Enterprise Browser, or Digital Workplace platforms
* Experience implementing AI solutions in IT Operations (AIOps), engineering productivity, automation, observability, or service management environments
* Experience with Azure Machine Learning, DataBricks, Snowflake, Kafka, or enterprise data platforms
* Experience building AI agents, copilots, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, or autonomous workflows
* Experience with GitHub, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native engineering practices
* Experience leading large-scale digital transformation initiatives

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
