description:
**Job Title: Expert D&T - Senior Semantic Data Modeler - Procurement**
**Location: Hyderabad, India**
This role involves responsibilities as a Senior Semantic Data Modeler and help create the data foundations that enable scientific innovation, analytics, and AI across our Research & Development organization. In this role, you will design, govern, and evolve enterprise data models that transform diverse scientific, experimental, laboratory, and operational data into trusted, discoverable, reusable, and AI-ready assets. Working closely with scientists, business stakeholders, data engineers, architects, and governance teams, you will translate complex research and business requirements into clear, scalable, and reusable data structures. You will play a key role in establishing shared business definitions, semantic consistency, and data standards across domains such as Research, Product Development, Formulation, Ingredients, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Finance. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in data modeling, a practical understanding of modern data platforms, and a passion for enabling better decisions through high-quality data. Experience with FAIR data principles and data management in scientific domains is a plus. Success in this role comes from combining technical expertise with curiosity, collaboration, and the ability to bridge scientific, business, and technology discussions. You are building on a green field.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain semantic data models across scientific, research, and enterprise business domains. You will work across data domains.
* Partner with scientists and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable and reusable data structures.
* Define the semantic layer, source-to-target mappings and support data integration, migration, and transformation initiatives across research and enterprise platforms.
* Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and platform teams to implement and operationalize data models in modern cloud and lakehouse environments.
* Apply and help in defining data modeling standards and best practices, including metadata management, semantic consistency, data lineage, and reusable data design.
* Promote data quality, consistency, and governance by establishing common definitions, business rules, and traceability across data products.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation by simplifying data structures, advancing modeling practices, and enabling analytics, reporting, and AI use cases.

**We Bring**

* Unique career paths across health, nutrition and beauty, explore what drives you and get the support to make it happen.
* A science led company, cutting edge research and creativity everywhere, from biotech breakthroughs to sustainability game-changers, you'll work on what's next.
* Growth that keeps up with you, you join an industry leader that will develop your expertise and technical depth.
* A culture that lifts you up, with collaborative teams, shared wins, and people who cheer each other on.
* A community where your voice matters, it is essential to serve our customers well.

**You bring**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Data, Computer Science, Informatics, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline, with relevant experience in data modeling or information management.
* Experience in data modeling, information architecture, metadata management, FAIR data and/or related data management disciplines.
* Hands-on experience in semantic and graph data modeling, including approaches such as Entity Relationship, Dimensional, Data Vault, and Semantic Modeling -triplet stores as well as LPGs.
* Experience working with scientific, research, laboratory, manufacturing, or other complex data-intensive environments, or a strong interest in applying data management practices within these domains.
* Working knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data quality, lineage, and FAIR data principles, with an understanding of how these practices enable trusted and reusable data assets. Experience working with life sciences ontologies.
* Familiarity with modern data platforms and technologies such as Databricks, cloud data platforms, RDF, OWL, JSON, LPGs, Cypher, SPARQL, SQL, Python, lakehouse architectures, data products, AI concepts, prompt engineering and vive coding
* Strong communication, out of the box thinking and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align scientists, business teams, engineers, and architects around a common data language and operating model.

- The role reports to the CEO
- The company follows a hybrid model of services moving towards product (Services as a Software)

Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong AI Forward Deployed Lead/Architect Profile owning the full journey from client discovery to production, hands-on and client-facing

* Mandatory (Experience 3): Must have 4+ years client-facing as a trusted AI advisor to CXOs/VPs of Operations/IT leaders, with a proven presales/solution-consulting track record (technical discovery, use-case scoping, solution design, ROI framing, PoC demos, blueprints, RFP/RFI responses)
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have run workshops, AI readiness assessments and value-stream-mapping sessions, navigated ambiguous problem spaces, and built long-term client relationships that lead to referrals and expanded mandates
* Mandatory (Experience 5): Must have designed and deployed end-to-end AI systems (ingestion, pipelines, deployment, monitoring, iteration), owning production constraints, integration, change management, go-live, client acceptance and post-deployment success, owning outcomes and fixing what breaks
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Must have worked directly with enterprise-level clients in a client-facing capacity
* Mandatory (Experience 7): Must have built and led their own team, creating a pod structure per project, and mentored junior AI engineers and consultants
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must be hands-on with Python, LLM frameworks (LangChain/LlamaIndex/HuggingFace) and cloud AI (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Mandatory (Skill 1): Must have strong storytelling, making complex AI accessible to business audiences without dumbing it down, and define AI architecture patterns and bring emerging frameworks/research back to the team
* Mandatory (Skill 2): Must take strong ownership, be genuinely enthusiastic and client-facing (not a pure-research or low-energy profile), thrive in ambiguity and 0 to 1 environments, and want to join long-term as part of the company (ESOP pool)

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Generative AI
description:
**About PMGlide**

PMGlide builds AI-powered project management automation that helps organizations steer projects to success with less manual effort and greater reliability. Our platform automates the entire project lifecycle, enabling seamless delivery from planning through execution and reporting. By leveraging generative AI to streamline workflows and remove operational friction, we make advanced AI capabilities practical, accessible, and highly impactful for real-world project environments. Customers also benefit from direct access to our experts, ensuring AI solutions are uniquely tailored to accelerate their specific business goals.

**The Role**

As a Forward Deployed Engineer for Generative AI, you are the technical bridge between PMGlide’s core AI platform and our customers' operational realities. In this highly collaborative, remote role, you will work directly with client stakeholders to understand their unique workflows and translate complex business requirements into scalable technical designs. You will be hands-on in building the back-end services, APIs, and data pipelines that connect enterprise project management tools to PMGlide’s generative AI models.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Customer Integration:**
  Lead technical discovery sessions, collaborate directly with client stakeholders to gather requirements, and translate business needs into robust AI-driven solutions.
* **System Architecture & Development:**
  Architect, build, and maintain production-ready back-end services, APIs, and microservices connecting client environments to PMGlide’s models.
* **AI Operationalization:**
  Build scalable pipelines for structured and unstructured data, utilizing vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
* **End-to-End Ownership:**
  Take production-grade AI solutions from conception through programming, debugging, performance optimization, and launch, ensuring the highest standards of reliability and security.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gather user feedback, document solutions, support pilot onboarding, and work closely with internal product and AI teams to continuously refine the core platform.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of software development experience, with high proficiency in Python or similar coding languages.
* Strong foundation in Computer Science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming) and back-end web development.
* Proven experience building enterprise data pipelines using vector databases and RAG architectures.
* Hands-on experience architecting and deploying AI/ML systems on major cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), utilizing containerization and CI/CD practices.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to work effectively in a remote team and confidently interface directly with enterprise customers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi-agent systems using modern frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and complex reasoning patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Deep knowledge of LLM-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management, granular tracing, and model performance.
* Track record of successfully steering enterprise clients through technical discovery and early-stage product pilots.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Client is a part of an international logistics group with presence in the GCC, Africa, and the UK. The Head of HR will lead all people functions across the pan-India network from the corporate office in Vashi, Navi Mumbai, building the people strategy, systems, and culture that enable business growth while ensuring full compliance with Indian labour law.
  
  
Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and deliver an HR strategy aligned with the company’s business plan and group HR policies.
* Design the organisation structure, grading, job architecture, and delegation of authority across head office and branches.
* Lead workforce planning and manpower budgets with the CEO and Finance.
* Run end-to-end hiring for all levels, from branch operations staff to senior leadership.
* Build a strong employer brand in the logistics sector and manage campus, referral, and agency channels.
* Control hiring cost, time-to-fill, and quality of hire.
* Own the pay structure, salary benchmarking, annual increments, and incentive schemes, including sales incentives.
* Ensure accurate, on-time payroll for all locations, including PF, ESIC, professional tax, LWF, gratuity, and TDS on salary.
* Manage group medical, accident, and term insurance and other employee benefits.
* Run the annual performance cycle with clear KPIs and goal-setting for every role.
* Identify high-potential employees and build succession plans for critical roles.
* Drive retention programmes and conduct exit analysis.
* Build training plans for operations, customer service, sales, compliance, and leadership.
* Ensure mandatory training and certifications, such as dangerous goods (IATA DGR / IMDG), customs, and safety, are current.
* Run induction and onboarding for all new joiners.
* Ensure compliance with the four Labour Codes (Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions) and applicable state Shops and Establishments Acts.
* Manage registers, returns, inspections, and licences for all branches and contract labour.
* Handle grievances, disciplinary inquiries, and union or worker relations at sites and warehouses.
* Run the Internal Committee under the POSH Act and keep the policy and training current.
* Maintain the employee handbook and HR policies, including leave, travel, code of conduct, and whistleblowing.
* Implement and manage an HRMS for attendance, payroll, records, and self-service.
* Provide accurate HR MIS and dashboards to the CEO, Board, and Group HR.
* Build a culture of safety, integrity, accountability, and customer focus.
* Run engagement surveys, recognition programmes, and wellbeing initiatives.
* Promote diversity and inclusion across all locations.
* Manage manpower agencies and outsourced staff, including contracts, rates, and compliance audits.
* Ensure contractors meet statutory obligations for their workers.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, or a Master’s in Personnel Management / Labour Welfare / Industrial Relations.
* 15+ years of HR experience, with at least 5 years leading the HR function for a multi-location company in India.
* Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, transportation, or a similar operations-heavy sector.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, the Labour Codes, payroll statutory compliance, and POSH.
* Track record of handling large field and contract workforces, and employee relations at sites.

**Preferred**

* Law degree (LLB) or certification in labour law.
* Experience implementing an HRMS (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR).
* Experience in a group or multinational structure with reporting to overseas HR.
* Exposure to M&A integration or setting up new branches.

Benefits & Culture Highlights
  
  

* Competitive fixed CTC plus annual performance bonus.
* Medical insurance for self and family.
* Statutory benefits.
* Travel and communication allowances.

title: Lead Functional Consultant
description:
**Company:**
ColdStar Logistics
  
  
**Experience:**
8–12 years
  
  
**Department:**
Digital Transformation / Technology
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time, on ColdStar Logistics payroll
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-person, onsite role), with visits to warehouses and operational facilities
  
  
**Reports to:**
Top management / C-suite
  
  
**Compensation:**
Industry standard
  
  
**About The Company**
India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.
  
  
**About The Role**
ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.
  
  
The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.
  
  
The role will act as the
**primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,**
ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.
  
  
The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management
* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.
* Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight
* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.
* UAT and Solution Acceptance
* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
* Coordinate retesting with Technology Teams and relevant ColdStar users.
* Obtain formal UAT acceptance from authorized business process owners.
* Recommend production readiness based on functional completeness and business acceptance.
* Technology Adoption and Change Management
* Ensure delivered solutions are adopted effectively across ColdStar’s operational teams.
* Develop training, communication and adoption strategies for new systems and features.
* Coordinate user onboarding, demonstrations and operational training.
* Monitor adoption, usage patterns, manual workarounds and user feedback.
* Work with department heads to embed new systems into standard operating procedures.
* Identify and address resistance to change, usability problems and process gaps.
* Measure the operational value realized from technology investments.
* Innovation, Competitive Intelligence and Digital Roadmap
* Proactively research digital innovations, emerging technologies and competitive practices in logistics, cold-chain operations, transportation and warehousing.
* Identify opportunities involving process automation, IoT, analytics, AI, GenAI and agentic AI.
* Evaluate technology opportunities based on business value, feasibility, implementation effort and return on investment.
* Work with engineering and innovation teams to evaluate potential solutions.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of business improvements and innovation initiatives.
* Recommend quarterly technology priorities to ColdStar’s leadership.
* Align technology priorities with ColdStar’s business strategy and identify operational problems that can be solved through technology.
* Use AI/ML and analytics to make sense of the data generated by ColdStar’s systems and turn it into insights for operations and leadership.
* Help build technology into ColdStar’s culture and everyday ways of working.
* Track industry developments and identify opportunities to improve ColdStar’s operational efficiency, customer experience and competitive positioning.
* Technology Team Leadership
* Build and lead ColdStar’s in-house technology team as the company grows.
* Mentor team members and set clear standards, priorities and ways of working.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in business analysis, techno-functional consulting, enterprise application implementation or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of logistics, warehousing, transportation, supply chain or distribution operations.
* Proven experience working with software development teams or external technology implementation partners.
* Experience independently preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience managing UAT, business acceptance and technology adoption.
* Working understanding of APIs, databases, SQL fundamentals, integrations, cloud applications and enterprise software architecture.
* Familiarity with WMS, TMS, ERP, fleet management, inventory management or related enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work closely with both business users and technical engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Cold-chain logistics and temperature-controlled supply-chain operations.
* Experience with IoT, real-time tracking, warehouse automation or fleet analytics.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Power BI or enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI and automation use cases in logistics.
* Experience with operational change management and technology adoption programs.

**Role Overview**

The IT Security Operations Analyst will support the CISO in day‐to‐day security

operations, monitoring, and incident handling. The ideal candidate should have a strong

inclination toward modern security technologies such as EDR/XDR, ZTNA, SIEM, along

updates.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field.

o ZTNA concepts and identity‐based access

o SIEM tools (Splunk, QRadar, etc.)

o Firewalls, VPN, and basic network security

o Google Workspace and O365 security features

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

**Key Attributes**

- High integrity and strong sense of responsibility.

- Curiosity and willingness to learn modern security technologies.

- Ability to work collaboratively with IT, DevOps, and business teams.

- Strong communication and reporting skills.

**What This Role Offers**

- Direct exposure to enterprise‐level security operations under the CISO.

- Hands‐on experience with modern security tools and frameworks.

- Fast‐paced learning environment with opportunities for growth.

title: Student Success Manager
description:
**Location**
: Pedder Road, Mumbai |
**Type**
: Full-time

**Pay**
: Rs. 25,000 per month for freshers, can negotiate based on past experience

**Date of Joining**
: Immediate

**Company**
: Karan Gupta Consulting (KGC)

**About KGC**

Karan Gupta Consulting (KGC) is a leading education and career consulting firm helping students and families with career planning, university selection, profile building, applications, essays, testing, scholarships, and visas.

We are looking for a Student Success Manager to become a trusted point of contact for our enrolled students and their families.

**The Role**

The Student Success Manager will ensure that every student feels heard, supported, informed, and confident throughout their KGC journey.

You will conduct regular meetings with students and parents to understand their progress, satisfaction, concerns, changing goals, and expectations, and coordinate internally to ensure the right action is taken.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Student & Parent Management**

* Conduct regular student and parent meetings.
* Build strong, trusting relationships with students and families.
* Understand student goals, concerns, challenges, and changing priorities.
* Ensure students and parents feel comfortable raising issues or concerns.

**Progress & Satisfaction**

* Track student progress against their academic and profile-building plans.
* Identify students who are falling behind, disengaged, or need additional support.
* Regularly assess student and parent satisfaction.
* Proactively identify concerns before they become larger problems.
* Collect and communicate actionable feedback to the internal team.

**Issue Resolution**

* Act as the first point of contact for student and parent concerns.
* Listen objectively and empathetically and take ownership of issues.
* Coordinate with counsellors, editors, mentors, and other KGC teams to resolve concerns.
* Follow up to ensure issues have actually been resolved.
* Escalate sensitive matters when required.

**Internal Coordination**

* Maintain clear communication across KGC teams.
* Ensure important student updates and decisions are documented.
* Track action points and follow-ups.
* Provide management with visibility on student progress, satisfaction, and potential risks.

**What We Are Looking For**

The most important requirement is exceptional people and communication skills.

The ideal candidate is:

* Extremely warm, approachable, and people-friendly
* Highly empathetic and emotionally intelligent
* An exceptional listener and communicator
* Comfortable speaking with both young adults and parents
* Patient, calm, and mature
* Proactive and solution-oriented
* Highly organised with excellent follow-through
* Comfortable handling difficult or sensitive conversations
* Able to build trust quickly
* Comfortable managing multiple students and families

This is not a back-office coordination role. We need someone who can listen deeply, understand student and parent needs, communicate thoughtfully, and take ownership of finding a solution.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Prior experience in student counselling, education, customer success, client servicing, relationship management, hospitality, or another people-facing role preferred, freshers are encouraged to apply
* Experience working with students and/or parents is an advantage
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Strong organisational and follow-up skills

Personality, empathy, communication, and relationship-building ability will matter more than academic qualifications.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Student Success Manager will ensure that:

* Students know what they need to do and feel supported.
* Parents feel informed and confident.
* Concerns are identified and addressed early.
* Internal teams understand changing student needs.
* Students and families consistently feel that KGC genuinely understands and cares about their journey.

**Ideal Candidate**

A warm, emotionally intelligent, exceptionally articulate people-person who makes every student and parent feel heard, supported, and confident that someone is taking ownership of their journey.

**Position Summary**

Women’s World Banking is looking for a team member to join a forward thinking, cross-functional, high-performing, collaborative team focused on delivering innovative customer experiences, banking services and products, that create business and customer value to serve low-income women.

The Sr. Specialist will lead the design & implementation of advisory solutions in the field in collaboration with our Financial Service Partners. The candidate will be expected to understand business and customer needs, design solutions across functional teams, coordinate and lead sales/ channel teams, last mile marketing & sales agencies and bank stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation and drive project results. This role is responsible for managing project and providing excellent service delivery for our clients and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have either a background in banking / insurance / financial services or in management consulting. You must be a strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and propose new ideas for ways of engaging Women’s World Banking’s target audience.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Design of Financial Solutions**
in the space of savings, micro-credit, micro-insurance, digital financial services, or last mile solutions for low income women that are viable and scalable for Financial Service Providers:

* Develop research based perspective on financial products for low income women - the current context, challenges for women, trends and solutions for increasing financial inclusion of women in this sector.
* Conduct industry assessments that provide detailed insights into the competitive landscape and best practices; Collect and analyze complex data in the sector that can help define solutions.
* Establish relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and customer needs, continually enhance project processes, service offering and delivery for partners.
* Identify, scope and find implementation paths for needed product and/or customer experience enhancements;
* Develop business cases for new product and product enhancements to enable prioritization and justify investments into new and existing products.

**Delivery of Solutions in Field**
across various initiatives, locations and stakeholders to ensure project milestones and metrics are met. Drive execution of solutions for low income women with institution partners.

* Able to implement project in field across multiple geographies and last mile channels.
* Establish relationships and work with a cross-functional teams (internal and partner bank's) to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
* Coordinate among various external support organisations such as last mile agencies (training, sales promotions etc.) and local government bodies (state / region level) to drive project success.
* Lead project management including the development, delivery and monitoring of work plans, milestones, targets, budgets, and both internal and external reporting. Projects may vary in number, size and complexity.

**Mange & Deepen Relationships with Institutional Partners:**

* Develop, and drive execution of high priority business initiatives, financial products and services for the partner FSPs
* Establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with key client contacts
* Initiate and hand hold the project through all stages of the project
* Ensure positive client satisfaction results.
* Be the “voice of the clients” by interpreting the clients’ business plans and strategic intent into the Women’s World banking organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* MBA or Master’s degree in related field
* 8+ years or more experience in banking, financial services, consulting or other relevant role.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and successfully manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Proven collaborative, negotiation, and persuasion skills to influence field teams and senior management at partner institutions.
* Must be willing to travel extensively within India, and be on-site for 6-8 days a month.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Interest in the field of women’s financial inclusion and economic empowerment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present fact-based recommendations in a clear, logical and concise way to tell a story with the data.
* Track record of superior creativity and problem solving abilities.

**Measure of Success**

**Success within the first 75 days:**

* Embrace Women’s World Banking’s values – Think Big, Own and commit to it, Smarter together
* Assume full responsibility of the position;
* Forge positive working relationships with cross-functional staff and fully integrate in the India team
* Become trained in and fully integrate the use of Women’s World Banking systems and policies into your day-to-day activities;
* Learn and comprehend the Women’s World Banking business model and work closely with the team to understand and build upon existing plans.

title: Accounts Receivable Executive- Retail
description:
**Position: Retail Finance Executive – Vendor Accounts & Receivables**

**Location: Mumbai HO**

**Function: Finance & Accounts**

**Reporting To: Finance Manager / Head of Finance**

**Experience: 3–5 years in accounts payable / receivable, with working experience of accounting software / ERPs**

**Industry: Retail / FMCG / D2C / E-commerce**

**Education: B.Com / M.Com, CA Inter / CMA Inter, or equivalent finance qualification**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**About The Health Factory**

At The Health Factory, we are rethinking everyday food to make real health effortless. Born in Mumbai, we created India’s first Protein & Zero Maida Bread and are now present in 100+ cities across general trade, modern trade, quick commerce and e-commerce.

Bread is just the beginning. We have expanded into FMCG with a growing range of digestive biscuits, rusks, mini cakes, snacks and peanut butter – all backed by our Clean Label Promise: no maida, no colours, no emulsifiers and no chemical preservatives.

**About the Role**

The Retail Finance Executive will own vendor-side adjustments and receivables for our retail business. The role covers posting short-supply, cancellation and Return to Vendor (RTV) entries in Odoo, following up with vendors to recover money on time, keeping ledgers reconciled, and giving leadership a clear, regular view of what is owed to us and what needs attention.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on finance professional with strong reconciliation skills, working experience of an ERP, and the persistence to follow every open item through to recovery.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Odoo Bookings – Short/Cancel and RTV**

* Collect short-supply, cancellation and RTV data from vendors, warehouse and store teams, and validate it against POs, GRNs and invoices.
* Post debit notes, credit notes and adjustment entries in Odoo accurately and on time.
* Keep supporting documents (vendor confirmations, RTV challans, GRN copies) filed and audit-ready.
* Flag mismatches between vendor claims and internal records before posting.

**2. Vendor Communication & Recovery**

* Act as the main finance contact for vendors on debit notes, RTV credits and outstanding dues.
* Share statements and follow up by email and phone so payments and credit notes are received within agreed timelines.
* Resolve disputes on quantities, rates and deductions with vendors and internal teams.
* Maintain a follow-up tracker with commitments, dates and status for every open item.

**3. Receivables Working & Leadership Reporting**

* Prepare a receivables working at a regular cadence (weekly / monthly): vendor-wise outstanding, ageing buckets, recoveries made and expected.
* Present the receivables position to leadership with clear highlights: top overdue vendors, high-value disputes and expected cash inflows.
* Track recovery trends and suggest actions to bring down overdue balances.

**4. Ledger Reconciliation**

* Reconcile the company's vendor ledgers with partner (vendor) ledgers / statements on a regular basis.
* Identify and resolve differences such as missing debit notes, unposted RTVs, duplicate entries and timing gaps.
* Pass correction entries in Odoo and obtain balance confirmations from vendors.
* Support month-end closing and statutory / internal audits with reconciled balances.

**5. Problem Identification & Escalation**

* Spot recurring issues early: chronic short supply, delayed credit notes, unresponsive vendors and process gaps in RTV handling.
* Escalate to leadership in time with the facts, amounts at risk and a proposed course of action.
* Work with procurement, warehouse and category teams to fix root causes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**The role will be measured on:**

* Posting turnaround: short/cancel and RTV entries posted in Odoo within 48 hours of receiving validated data
* Recovery timeliness: vendor dues and credit notes recovered within agreed credit terms; overdue (60+ days) balance trending down
* Reconciliation: all active vendor ledgers reconciled with partner ledgers monthly; balance confirmations on file
* Reporting: receivables working shared with leadership on schedule, accurate and decision-ready
* Escalation: issues raised with facts and a proposed action before they turn into write-offs

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 3–5 years in accounts payable / receivable, preferably in retail, FMCG, D2C or e-commerce.
* Working experience of accounting software / ERPs is mandatory: Odoo or a similar ERP such as Tally, SAP B1 or Zoho Books (journal entries, debit/credit notes, partner ledgers).

**Category Experience**

Candidates from retail, FMCG, D2C or e-commerce businesses will be preferred; experience with marketplace or multi-store retail operations is a plus.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Clear understanding of POs, GRNs, debit notes, RTV and vendor reconciliation, plus basic GST implications on returns and credit notes.
* Strong Excel skills: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, ageing analysis.
* Confident, polite and persistent communicator in English and Hindi (written and verbal) for vendor follow-ups.
* Able to turn numbers into a short, clear summary for leadership.
* Detail-oriented, organised and comfortable owning deadlines.

**Good to Have**

* **Hands-on Odoo Accounting experience (vendor bills, refunds, reconciliation module).**
* **Exposure to Power BI, Google Sheets dashboards or Odoo reporting.**

**Education**

* **B.Com / M.Com, or CA Inter / CMA Inter, or equivalent finance qualification.**

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a hands-on finance professional who can own vendor-side adjustments and receivables end-to-end — from Odoo bookings and ledger reconciliation to vendor recovery and leadership reporting.

The candidate should be equally comfortable working through reconciliations in Odoo and Excel and following up firmly but politely with vendors until every open item is closed.

description:

title: Principal Technician -Roads
description:
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking to recruit an ambitious and dynamic Principal Technician to join the ‘UKGCC
  
  
Highway’ team in Mumbai/Noida/Bengaluru to work alongside our UK discipline.
  
  
The successful candidate will be working in a team environment to develop and deliver projects
  
  
through various stages of design from feasibility to planning/detailed design and onto construction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will be working on a range of infrastructure schemes and will be responsible for the work prepared by a team of Technicians and assists with their development to improve knowledge and strengths.
* You will be expected to play a proactive part in the design process and to be active on several projects at any given time.
* You will ensure that all drawings are produced in accordance with the relevant technical standards, in adherence to WSP's and the Client's CAD Standards documentation.
* You will actively develop the CAD and BIM skills and capabilities of a team and ensure deployment is appropriate to highways business and projects.
* You will assist in the development of strategic BIM documentation, including BIM Execution Plans, BIM Standards and protocols.
* You will contribute to our Lean approach to driving efficiency and removing waste from our processes.
* You will work under the guidance of the project manager or designated discipline lead.
* You will be involved with resource management, utilisation forecast, production of fee proposal and recruitments as required.
* You will read, adher and ensure compliance to all relevant policies and procedures for Health and Safety including the H&S Policy, H&S Manual, and Local Procedures Manual.
* Take responsibility for own personal development with the support of line manager and follow an agreed development plan.

Key Competencies / Skills:
  
  
Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Ability to utilise AutoCAD or MicroStation in adherence to defined CAD standards to lead and develop engineering drawings.
* Ability to liaise with the design teams as necessary to coordinate design and drawing production.
* Capable of multi-tasking and managing multiple projects with the ability to accurately predict the time required to fulfil the individual scopes of work required.
* Assists with establishing, maintaining and enforcing the use of proper CAD standards and procedures.
* Undertake reviews of work produced by others to ensure high quality of CAD output.
* Ability to customise and automation of programs and menus to increase drawing productivity
* UK Highways project experience and knowledge of UK design standards
* You should be able to demonstrate some experience and working knowledge of relevant technical design guidance and standards, such as DMRB, MfS, TSRGD, HCD, and IAN 184.
* Ability to understand and communicate BIM and CAD standards for use on Civil engineering projects and possessing an appropriate overall level of knowledge of the UK infrastructure design sector.
* Proficient in use of standard office software
* Proficiency in the use of Bentley ProjectWise and Navisworks. You should be able to set up BIM models to the project standards and liaising with Model Managers.
* Experience of using and optimising CAD resource libraries (cells / blocks, objects, seed files, etc).
* Experience of supervising and coordinating the CAD output of others (either directly or indirectly) within a multi-disciplinary project environment.
* A passion for quality and continuous improvement with a focus on delivery.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Effective time management and strong organisational skills.

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge of basic design using Civil 3D or MX
* A clear understanding of Building Information Modelling and its benefits to the design and
* construction Industry.
* Experience of using a variety of design engineering modelling packages (CAD) and their interoperation, including applications such as MX, OpenRoads, Civil3D, AutoCAD and MicroStation.
* Have a good working knowledge of industry standards such as the BIM Level 2 Document suite, Uniclass, CIC BIM Protocol etc.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science / information technology / or equivalent stream.

* Technical Skills: Strong understanding of Unix/Linux operating systems, scripting, and associated technologies.
* Additional Skills: Strong problem-solving skills, experience with performance tuning, and optimizing server configurations.
* Experience: 3 years of proven experience as a System Administrator in a similar role.
* Communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
* Documentation: Proven ability to document work and work in a process-driven development environment.

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
**Job Description**
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:
  
  

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Identify and Prioritise Risk
  
  

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
* Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.

Coordinate Remediation
  
  

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
* Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.

Improve Security Practices
  
  

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
* Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.

Report and Govern
  
  

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate.
* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About BharatNXT**

BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch.

**The role**

A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often.

**What you'll do**

* **Own founder priorities**

  - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships.
* **Launch things**

  - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked.
* **Build partnerships**

  - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track.
* **Turn numbers into decisions**

  - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation.
* **Know the market**

  - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now.
* **Run experiments**

  - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill.
* **Strengthen operations**

  - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support.
* **Make us faster**

  - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved.
* **Take on special projects**

  - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet.

**What we're looking for**

* 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions.
* Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased.

**Bonus:**

an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

**Why take it**

You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does.

If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.

title: ServiceNow Developer, Aladdin Platform Engineering, Associate
description:
**About This Role**
**Your team**
Join our growing ServiceNow Centre of Excellence and Innovation (CoEI), where people, process and technology come together to deliver effective, scalable solutions across the enterprise. Working with global business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects and technology teams, you will help evolve the platform, strengthen delivery practices and support digital transformation.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
We are seeking a collaborative ServiceNow Developer to join our Centre of Excellence and Innovation. In this role, you will configure, develop, test and deploy secure, scalable and maintainable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. You will translate business requirements into well-engineered technical solutions, working closely with Enterprise Architects, business stakeholders and delivery partners to ensure development aligns with platform architecture, governance and ServiceNow best practices. You will also support platform upgrades, troubleshoot and resolve incidents and defects, and contribute to the adoption of emerging capabilities such as UI Builder and Now Assist.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Design, configure, develop, test and implement scalable ServiceNow solutions, including workflows, Flow Designer, business rules, UI policies, access controls, catalogue items and platform administration.
* Partner with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects, IT teams and delivery partners to translate requirements into solutions aligned with platform architecture, governance and change-control standards.
* Integrate ServiceNow with third-party systems and applications using appropriate integration frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
* Provide application support by monitoring ticket queues, troubleshooting incidents and defects, performing root-cause analysis, and supporting platform upgrades and performance optimisation.
* Guide developers, administrators and delivery partners in applying reusable patterns, development standards and ServiceNow best practices.
* Apply knowledge across ServiceNow architecture and modules including Information Technology Service Management (ITSM), Information Technology Operations Management (ITOM), Information Technology Asset Management (ITAM), Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) and Customer Service Management (CSM), while evaluating emerging capabilities such as UI Builder, Now Assist and artificial intelligence-powered workflows to improve platform value.

**Your Experience**

* 5+ years of ServiceNow platform experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions, with strong knowledge of platform architecture, JavaScript, application programming interfaces (APIs), integrations, security, governance, scalability and maintainability.
* Experience translating business requirements into solution designs and technical architectures, including architecture review and design assurance.
* Working knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes and ServiceNow products such as ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and CSM.
* Experience in application or IT support, with strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities in a customer-focused environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to take initiative, collaborate effectively and balance business value, technical constraints and risk.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD) and relevant Implementation Specialist certification(s).
* Experience with platform strategy, modernisation or digital transformation initiatives, with exposure to Now Assist, AI Agents, AI Specialists or related intelligent automation capabilities.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Software Engineer, Big Data (829)
description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data. As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn’t just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe.
  
  
Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Our software product development team builds the enterprise data security ecosystem that global organisations rely on to protect their most sensitive data. In this role, you will contribute to research, feature design, and implementation in a fast-paced Agile environment, helping deliver data platform and cloud capabilities from concept to release.
  
  
You will learn the technologies behind modern data security while working alongside talented engineers on end-to-end product delivery. This position is ideal for technically strong individuals who enjoy building technology and collaborating across teams. Your work will directly shape how customers secure data across hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain new and existing products and features that strengthen Protegrity’s enterprise data security platform.
* Deliver well-engineered, production-quality software by independently applying the team’s development standards, design patterns, frameworks, and tools.
* Participate in Agile practices as both an individual contributor and a team player.
* Grow expertise in data security and the product’s technical environment, including operating systems, cloud technologies, container orchestration, and native programming languages.
* Review the work of peers and junior engineers to raise code quality while contributing independently.
* Collaborate within and across teams to resolve technical requirements and product module dependencies, communicating clearly.

**What You’ll Need**

* 3–7 years of hands-on software engineering experience, preferably in data platforms, cloud platforms, distributed systems, or data security. A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Knowledge of one or more modern, scalable cloud data platforms, such as Databricks, Amazon EMR, Cloudera Data Platform, or Microsoft Fabric.
* Knowledge of one or more large-scale data processing technologies, query engines, and table or storage formats, such as Apache Spark, Hive, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Parquet.
* Strong programming experience in Java or Python, with the ability to design, build, debug, and profile production-quality large-scale data and cloud software, and experience with Linux and shell scripting.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools for code analysis, debugging, test generation, documentation, and design exploration while ensuring secure, reliable, production-quality outcomes.
* Hands-on experience with one or more cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and an understanding of containerised platforms such as Kubernetes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical content clearly through documentation and presentations and to collaborate effectively with teammates.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of setting up and operating distributed data clusters in the cloud, such as Spark on Kubernetes or Hadoop/CDP, including networking and IAM concepts.
* Knowledge of performance tuning of large-scale data workloads.
* Understanding of software security requirements and standards, such as NIST, OWASP, and PCI DSS, and knowledge of cryptography and cryptographic algorithms.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality tools, and release processes, within Agile development and the software development life cycle (SDLC).

Should you accept this position, you will be required to consent to and successfully complete a background investigation. This may include, subject to local laws, verification of extended education and additional criminal and civil checks.
  
  
We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits with generous vacation and holiday time off. All employees are also provided access to ongoing learning & development.
  
  
Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All qualified applicants and current employees will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability or veteran status.
  
  
Please reference Section 12: Supplemental Notice for Job Applicants in our Privacy Policy to inform you of the categories of personal information that we collect from individuals who inquire about and/or apply to work for Protegrity USA, Inc., or its parent company, subsidiaries or affiliates, and the purposes for which we use such personal information.

title: Application Developer-SAP ABAP HANA
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Developer specializing in SAP ABAP HANA, you will design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on the HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP). You will work on designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components, integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Develop Application Solutions: Design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on HANA version of ABAP, ensuring high-quality and efficient solutions that meet business requirements.
* Integrate Software Packages: Integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms, utilizing knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture.
* Re-engineer Application Components: Re-engineer highly complex application components to optimize performance and efficiency, applying Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA.
* Utilize Development Tools: Leverage ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and HANA Studio for data modeling and development, ensuring effective use of tools and technologies.
* Ensure Data Services: Develop and implement ABAP Core Data Services, Database Procedures, and Text Search, ensuring seamless data integration and management.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to SAP ABAP HANA: Experience working with HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP), including designing, developing, and supporting application solutions.
* Knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture: Familiarity with SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture, including data modeling using HANA Studio and integration of software packages, programs, and reusable objects.
* Proficiency in ABAP Development Tools: Experience working with ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA.
* Understanding of Data Modeling and Integration: Exposure to data modeling using HANA Studio and integration of data services, including ABAP Core Data Services, Database Procedures, and Text Search.
* Familiarity with HANA Live Models Consumption: Basic understanding of HANA Live models consumption and ALV on HANA.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Working Knowledge of ADBC: Experience with ADBC, including its application in SAP HANA environments, would be beneficial for this role.
* Familiarity with Native SQL: Exposure to Native SQL, including its use in SAP HANA, would be advantageous in designing and developing application solutions.
* Understanding of HANA Text Search: Basic understanding of HANA Text Search, including its integration with ABAP Core Data Services, would be valuable in this position.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
* Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
* Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
+ Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: ERP Integration Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer – ERP Integrations & AI**

**Experience: 8+ Years**

**Location: Remote**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Software Engineer – ERP Integrations & AI**
with strong backend development expertise and hands-on experience integrating major ERP and accounting platforms.

The ideal candidate should have deep knowledge of accounting and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workflows, along with experience designing, developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting production-level ERP integrations.

This role requires strong expertise in Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and third-party integrations, along with practical experience using AI-powered development tools in everyday engineering workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and manage ERP and accounting integrations from architecture to production.
* Build and maintain scalable, reliable data synchronization frameworks.
* Integrate third-party ERP and accounting platforms through REST APIs, webhooks, and other integration methods.
* Troubleshoot complex API, data-mapping, synchronization, and production issues.
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, reconciliation, and error recovery across integrations.
* Translate accounting and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Handle customer-specific ERP requirements while maintaining scalable product architecture.
* Conduct code reviews, write automated tests, and ensure clean, secure, maintainable code.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement long-term technical solutions.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Leverage AI-powered coding tools for development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and documentation.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience.
* Strong proficiency in
  **Ruby / Ruby on Rails**
  .
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
* Experience with Sidekiq or equivalent background processing tools.
* Knowledge of Redis, JavaScript, and React.
* Experience with RSpec and automated testing.
* Familiarity with AWS, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD.
* Experience with Git/GitHub and application monitoring tools such as New Relic.
* Strong understanding of B2B SaaS and multi-tenant architecture.

**Mandatory ERP & Accounting Integration Experience**

Hands-on development and integration experience with
**all the following platforms is required:**

* NetSuite
* Sage
* Xero
* QuickBooks Online (QBO)
* QuickBooks Desktop
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

Candidates must have experience building and maintaining production integrations, rather than simply using or configuring these platforms.

Knowledge of integrating vendors, suppliers, purchase orders, invoices, bills, payments, chart of accounts, taxes, and other accounting-related data is essential.

Strong understanding of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JSON/XML, API authentication, rate limiting, pagination, retries, idempotency, and data synchronization is expected.

AI Development Skills – Mandatory

Candidates must actively use AI-powered development tools as part of their regular engineering workflow.

Relevant tools include:

* OpenAI Codex
* Claude Code
* GitHub Copilot
* Cursor
* Other equivalent AI coding tools

Practical experience using these tools for development, debugging, code reviews, refactoring, test generation, codebase exploration, and technical documentation is expected.

Experience with OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, AWS Bedrock, LLM integrations, RAG, AI agents, Prompt Engineering, or Document AI/OCR will be an added advantage.

Domain Knowledge

**Strong understanding of accounting and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) workflows, including:**

* Purchase Requests and Approvals
* Purchase Orders and Receiving
* Accounts Payable (AP)
* Invoices and Expenses
* Vendor Management
* Chart of Accounts and GL Coding
* Taxes and Payments
* Budgeting

Experience in Procurement, AP Automation, ERP, Accounting, FinTech, or B2B SaaS products is highly preferred.
