title: AI Agent Engineer Intern
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe AI systems for real-world deployment. Our work spans agentic AI, alignment, interpretability, evaluation systems, enterprise AI, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data.

We build AI systems where transparency, auditability, robustness, and controllability are first-class constraints. Our environment is fast-moving, research-driven, and highly hands-on. We value people who bring open ideas, take ownership, and turn ambiguity into meaningful outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for
****AI Agent Interns****

to work on high-impact agentic AI problems across applied, research, and product directions.

This is not a narrow internship focused on building small internal bots. You will work on real agentic systems, evaluation infrastructure, enterprise use cases, research prototypes, and product tooling that can shape how AI agents are built, tested, aligned, and deployed.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may contribute across one or more of three tracks:

1. Applied Agentic AI

On the applied side, you will work on high-impact enterprise agentic use cases. This may involve building agents that reason over complex workflows, interact with tools and data systems, execute multi-step processes, evaluate outcomes, and operate reliably in real-world environments.

Example work may include enterprise workflow agents, agents over structured or proprietary data, human-in-the-loop agent systems, decision-support agents, and applied prototypes that can evolve into production-grade components.

Success in this track means building useful, reliable, and high-value agentic systems that solve real enterprise problems.

2. Agent R&D and Evaluation

On the R&D side, you will work on new ideas in agent architecture, harness design, evaluations, long-horizon reasoning, alignment, and interpretability.

This may include building new agent harnesses, designing evaluation frameworks, studying agent failure modes, benchmarking tool use and planning, or contributing to research papers, technical reports, and reusable research infrastructure.

Success in this track means producing research-quality insights, evaluation systems, benchmarks, or technical contributions that improve how agentic systems are understood and assessed.

3. Product and Tooling Agents

On the product and tooling side, you will help build agents that improve how researchers, engineers, and users interact with Lexsi systems.

This may include an
****AlignTune Agent****

for alignment workflows, AI Scientist-style agents for hypothesis generation and experiment execution, tools for evaluating and debugging agents, or product prototypes that turn research capabilities into usable workflows.

Success in this track means building tools that compound the productivity of researchers, engineers, or enterprise users.

Responsibilities

You will explore open-ended agentic AI problems and convert promising ideas into working prototypes, experiments, research artifacts, or product capabilities. You may build applied agents, design evaluations, create harnesses, experiment with planning and memory architectures, analyze failures, document findings, and collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams.

The expected outcome may be a production-grade applied component, a research contribution, a paper, a benchmark, an internal tool, or a product prototype.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with strong programming skills, preferably in Python, hands-on experience with LLMs or AI systems, and a strong interest in agents, evaluation, alignment, interpretability, or enterprise AI.

You should be comfortable working on ambiguous problems, building prototypes quickly, reading papers or technical material, documenting findings clearly, and independently identifying high-value directions.

Bonus signals include experience with agent frameworks, long-horizon agents, evaluation pipelines, research projects, open-source tools, backend systems, enterprise data, or AI safety and interpretability.

Our Culture

We move quickly and value substance over polish. This internship is for people who want to work near the frontier of agentic AI, bring original ideas, build seriously, test honestly, and create work that matters.

description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
* Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
* Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
+ Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai

The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Engineer –**
IT Factory - Python Data Engineer
  
  
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a python data engineer, to own the data foundation of the application. As every control result, every dashboard figure and every application screen reads from the curated data model you build and maintain. If the data is wrong, late or unexplained, nothing above it can be trusted.
  
  
The platform ingests from several enterprise sources into a raw layer that preserves exactly what each source sent and then transforms that into a curated model. You will build and operate the data pipelines, implement the reconciliation and data-quality checks that prove each load is complete, and extend the model as new controls and modules require it.
  
  
You will also implement the control rules themselves. These are written primarily as versioned SQL against the curated model, reviewed like application code, and executed by the controls engine. This is where data engineering meets the business purpose of the platform, and it is a significant part of the role.
  
  
This is not a pure pipeline role. You will also contribute to the application services, and you are expected to be able to pick up backend work when delivery requires it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ingestion pipelines — scheduled extraction from enterprise source systems into the raw layer, including change detection, load history and the recording of source data provenance.
* The curated data model — transformation from raw to a conformed, keyed and de-duplicated model of entitlements, applications, users and their relationships.
* Reconciliation and data quality — checks that prove each load is complete and consistent, with results written to an append-only evidence store and discrepancies raised rather than silently absorbed.
* Pipeline orchestration — scheduling, dependency management, retry and alerting, with a run history that can be interrogated when a question is asked about a past load.
* Control rules as code — the rule base for the control catalogue, written as versioned SQL with accompanying metadata, peer-reviewed and promoted through the same pipeline as application code.
* Reporting data layer — the curated views that the reporting dashboards consume, designed as a stable contract that survives changes to the underlying model.
* Backend services — contributing to the Python application services alongside the Technical Lead.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, at depth. This is the core of the role. Complex joins, aggregation, window functions, set operations; reading and acting on query plans; indexing and performance tuning on large tables. You should instinctively solve a data problem in SQL before reaching for application code.
* Relational data modelling. Designing schemas for analytical and operational use: keys, grain, slowly changing data, handling of deletions and deactivations in source systems. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Python for data engineering. Writing maintainable, tested Python for ETL — not notebooks. Experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable toolkit, and with pandas or Polars for in-flight transformation.
* Pipeline construction and operation. Building pipelines that run unattended: idempotent loads, failure handling, retries, alerting and the ability to re-run a failed load safely.
* Data quality and reconciliation. Practical experience proving that a data load is complete and correct, and designing the controls that detect when it is not.
* Backend development. Sufficient experience building API services in Python — FastAPI, Django or Flask — to contribute to the application layer.
* Testing discipline. Automated tests for transformation logic. Experience with pytest.
* Version control. Disciplined use of Git and pull request review. Treating SQL and pipeline definitions as code, held in a repository rather than on a server.
* Communication in a distributed team. Clear written English, and the judgement to flag a data discrepancy rather than work around it.

**Nice To Have**

* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow in production, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, functional role codes, segregation of duties, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Reporting tools — Power BI, including semantic modelling and designing the views that sit behind a dashboard.
* Regulated-environment experience — working with personal or otherwise sensitive data under data-protection controls, including masking of non-production environments.
* Linux and CI/CD — comfortable deploying and troubleshooting on Linux servers with an automated pipeline.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. title: Management Information System Executive
description:
**Experience (Only Immediate Joiners Apply or max 10 days joiners)**

Typically 2–5 years in MIS, project reporting, client coordination or field execution reporting. Experience handling multiple locations and vendor-generated information is preferred. Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Information Technology or a related discipline. Relevant Excel or data reporting training is desirable.

Advanced Excel, Macros and Micros - entire excel is must - we are not looking for Power BI skills , we are looking clearly for excel skillset

**Advanced Excel, Excel Test will be conducted - Please read below JD and then apply, or send cvs on WhatsApp on 72494725679, maximum budget up to 40k monthly**

**A. Job Description Summary**

Maintain accurate, timely and evidence-supported project information for Brandola’s recce and installation assignments. Collect and validate site updates from vendors and internal personnel, consolidate store-wise progress, and prepare reports in each client’s prescribed format. Act as the client-facing contact for routine reporting, status clarification and reporting documentation, coordinating with Operations and Client Servicing to resolve discrepancies and secure complete closure records.

**B. Key Result Areas**

• Project master data and reporting setup

• Collection and validation of field updates

• Recce reports and technical information coordination

• Installation progress and completion reporting

• Client communication and reporting service

• Exception tracking and closure follow-up

• Documentation control and billing support

• MIS analysis and reporting improvement

The performance standards below are proposed starting expectations. Agree client formats, reporting cut-offs, response times and project-specific targets before assignment. Measure this role on reporting accuracy, timeliness, validation and escalation; operational execution remains with the responsible teams.

**C. Duty Statements and 5 Performance Standards**

Project master data and reporting setup

1. Create the project master from the approved brief, store list and scope; assign unique project and store identifiers and map client, location, vendor or internal team, planned dates and deliverables.
2. Agree report templates, status definitions, mandatory fields, evidence requirements, submission frequency and distribution with Operations, Client Servicing and the client.
3. Maintain controlled revisions to store lists, quantities, dates and scope; retain approvals and communicate changes to affected teams.
4. Performance standards: Set up the tracker before field reporting starts; map 100% of assigned stores without duplicate identifiers; use only approved scope revisions; record every authorised change with its date and source.

**D. Collection and validation of field updates**

1. Obtain daily updates from vendors and Brandola personnel using standard forms or approved reporting systems; follow up missing, late or incomplete submissions.
2. Check store identity, activity date, quantities, dimensions, remarks and photographs against the brief and reporting checklist; identify duplicate, mismatched or unclear evidence.
3. Reconcile conflicting updates with the responsible field owner; label unverified information clearly and maintain a record of corrections.
4. Performance standards: Check 100% of received submissions before client issue; target at least 98% accuracy in mandatory report fields; log all missing inputs by the reporting cut-off and escalate overdue inputs the same working day. Never present unverified work as verified completion.

**E. Recce reports and technical information coordination :**

1. Compile store-wise recce reports covering measurements, site conditions, photographs, branding positions, access restrictions, installation constraints and other client-required information.
2. Check completeness and internal consistency; obtain missing details through Operations and route technical uncertainties to Design or the authorised technical owner.
3. Maintain the recce submission and approval tracker, including client comments, clarifications, revisions and handover of approved information for execution.
4. Performance standards: Submit complete recce packs within the agreed client timeline after validated inputs are received; include every mandatory field or an explicit exception; obtain authorised technical clarification before treating disputed measurements or specifications as final.
5. Installation progress and completion reportingMaintain store-wise planned, completed, pending, on-hold, rework and cancelled status using agreed definitions; record actual dates, installed quantities and balance scope.
6. Compile before-and-after photographs, installation checklists, site acknowledgements and other required completion evidence; distinguish field completion, internal verification and client acceptance.
7. Reconcile daily and cumulative totals by project, region and vendor or internal team; release approved progress reports and completion packs through the agreed channel.
8. Performance standards: Issue all scheduled reports by the agreed cut-off; reconcile store and quantity totals before issue; record completion only against the agreed evidence checklist; show acceptance and pending documentation separately.

**F. Duty Statements and Performance Standards Continued :**

1. Present clear daily, weekly and milestone reports; explain progress, pending work, data limitations and exceptions factually.
2. Acknowledge reporting queries, coordinate verified responses with Operations and Client Servicing, and record client comments and agreed reporting actions.
3. Participate in client reviews when assigned; circulate minutes and update action trackers. Obtain approval before communicating changed delivery dates, scope or commercial commitments.
4. Performance standards: Acknowledge queries within four working hours during agreed service hours; provide a verified response or committed response time within one working day, unless a different client requirement applies; circulate meeting actions within one working day.

**G. Exception tracking and closure follow-up :**

1. Maintain an exception register for inaccessible stores, permission issues, missing data, delays, damaged materials, rejected work, rework and client observations.
2. Assign each exception to the responsible Operations, vendor, Design or Client Servicing owner with a target closure date; track ageing and follow up until supported closure.
3. Flag critical delivery risks immediately to the responsible manager and communicate approved client updates; verify closure evidence before changing status.
4. Performance standards: Log all known exceptions on the day reported; every open item must have an owner and due date; escalate critical issues immediately and overdue actions daily; close items only with supporting evidence or authorised confirmation.

**H. Documentation control and billing support**

1. Maintain organised project folders with consistent naming, store codes, document versions and approved access; keep reports and supporting photographs traceable to their source.
2. Compile agreed billing support, including recce or installation records, installed quantities, acknowledgements and client acceptance where required; reconcile them with Operations and Finance.
3. Protect client information, maintain approved backups and retention practices, and retrieve documentation for queries, audits and dispute clarification.
4. Performance standards: Ensure every submitted report and completion record is traceable to its store and source; provide billing documentation by the agreed deadline; flag missing approvals explicitly; use authorised access and sharing channels for all client data.

**I . MIS analysis and reporting improvement**

1. Prepare dashboards showing planned versus actual progress, pending stores, ageing, rework, documentation gaps and reporting compliance by vendor or internal team.
2. Analyse recurring delays and data errors; highlight actionable trends and recommend improvements to collection methods, templates and reporting controls.
3. Use Excel or approved tools to reduce manual duplication; check formulas, filters and dashboard totals before release and document changes to reporting logic.

Performance standards: Provide weekly analysis and a monthly consolidated dashboard by agreed dates; reconcile every dashboard to the master tracker; explain material variances and identify action owners; review recurring errors monthly and track corrective actions.

 Job Factors:

1. Exposure to offline branding, POSM, retail rollouts, signage, recce or installation is desirable. Candidates from other industries may be considered if they demonstrate strong reporting and client communication skills.

**K. Functional skills**

1. Strong Excel skills covering PivotTables, lookup functions, SUMIFS, data validation, conditional formatting, charts and reconciliation. Ability to prepare clear PowerPoint or PDF reports, organise photographic evidence, manage large store databases and work with shared folders or client portals. Power Query and Power BI are desirable. Ability to read basic recce sheets, measurements and installation checklists without assuming technical approval authority.

**L. Behavioural competencies**

1. Attention to detail; analytical thinking; clear written and spoken communication; client service orientation; persistent follow-up; planning and prioritisation; ownership; teamwork; integrity and confidentiality. Ability to remain accurate under deadline pressure and report adverse facts promptly.

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
**Job Summary**

The Sales Support Executive will be responsible for preparing and maintaining MIS reports, sharing stock availability and pricing details, coordinating vendor purchase orders (POs), managing dispatch coordination, preparing Bills of Quantities (BOQs), and coordinating stock allocation across brands. The role involves providing daily sales and inventory updates, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring smooth coordination between internal teams, vendors, warehouse teams, and brand partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. MIS Reporting & Data Management**

* Prepare and circulate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
* Maintain sales, stock, inventory, order status, dispatch, and allocation reports.
* Track sales performance, stock movement, pending orders, and deliveries.
* Ensure timely and accurate sharing of reports with all relevant brands and internal teams.

**2. Stock Availability, Pricing & Allocation**

* Share updated pricing details and stock availability with respective brands.
* Coordinate stock allocation across brands based on requirements and available inventory.
* Maintain stock allocation trackers and monitor allocated versus available stock.
* Identify stock shortages, discrepancies, and inventory-related issues and coordinate for resolution.

**3. Vendor Purchase Order (PO) Coordination**

* Prepare, share, and coordinate vendor purchase orders as per business requirements.
* Follow up with vendors for PO confirmation, order processing, and delivery timelines.
* Track PO status and maintain updated records of issued and pending purchase orders.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve PO-related discrepancies.

**4. Dispatch & Delivery Coordination**

* Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, vendors, and internal teams to ensure timely dispatch of orders.
* Track dispatch schedules, shipment status, and delivery updates.
* Share dispatch details and delivery status with the concerned brands and sales teams.
* Follow up on delayed shipments, pending dispatches, and delivery-related issues.

**5. BOQ Preparation & Management**

* Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs) based on project, brand, or customer requirements.
* Coordinate with sales teams and relevant departments to collect product specifications, quantities, and pricing details.
* Verify item descriptions, quantities, rates, and product availability before finalizing BOQs.
* Revise and maintain BOQs as per updated requirements and approved changes.

**6. Brand & Internal Team Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between brand partners, sales teams, vendors, warehouse, and logistics teams.
* Share regular updates on pricing, stock availability, purchase orders, allocations, and dispatches.
* Respond to queries related to order status, inventory, BOQs, and delivery schedules.
* Ensure timely communication and follow-up to support smooth business operations.

**7. Inventory Monitoring & Reconciliation**

* Monitor stock levels, inventory movement, and allocated quantities.
* Reconcile stock data with warehouse and internal inventory records.
* Maintain accurate records of stock receipts, allocations, dispatches, and pending orders.
* Highlight stock discrepancies and coordinate corrective action with the concerned teams.
* Outstanding payment follow-up with partners.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and report preparation.
* Good knowledge of MIS reporting, inventory management, purchase orders, dispatch coordination, and BOQ preparation.
* Strong communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, maintain records, and meet deadlines.
* Prior experience in sales support, commercial operations, or supply chain coordination will be an advantage.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
M1xchange is India’s leading RBI-licensed Trade Receivables Discounting System (TReDS) platform, launched in 2017 to connect corporates and MSMEs with banks and NBFCs. The platform enables fully digital transactions, from invoice raising and buyer validation to competitive bidding by financiers. Once a bid is accepted, payments are typically processed within 24 hours and credited directly to the MSME’s bank account. By offering collateral-free access to finance at competitive rates, M1xchange supports MSMEs in improving cash flow and business growth.

The Sales Specialist role at M1xchange is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. title: Senior sales specialist | Personal Care Chemicals
description:
**About Elchemy**

Elchemy is a tech-enabled, cross-border specialty chemicals distribution platform helping companies across the US and Europe source high-quality chemical raw materials from trusted manufacturers across Southeast Asia and beyond. We operate at the intersection of discovery, quality assurance, and fulfillment, simplifying what has traditionally been a fragmented and opaque procurement process. By combining deep industry expertise with a technology-first approach, we enable faster sourcing, greater reliability, and scalable global supply chains for our customers.

In just 3 years of operations, Elchemy has scaled rapidly, serving customers in over 55 countries and building active partnerships with 200+ suppliers across more than 15 manufacturing geographies. Our platform supports a wide range of specialty chemical applications, helping businesses access the right materials with confidence and speed. Our vision is to build the world’s largest global specialty chemicals distributor, reimagining the industry through technology-led discovery, seamless fulfillment, and data-driven decision-making.

Elchemy is backed by marquee investors and has raised over $7.5 million to date. Our team brings together alumni from IITs, IIMs, and NITs, along with professionals who have built and scaled startups and worked across global multinational organizations. We are here to fundamentally transform the $800B specialty chemicals industry - making it more transparent, efficient, and globally connected through new-age technology.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Generate new business opportunities for Elchemy’s products & services for the global market focusing on the Personal Care and Home Care  Industry.
* Strive to achieve the revenue targets, work with cross-functional teams to deliver and execute sales and market strategy in line with global directives for Chemical Sales
* Negotiate long-term contract and develop key accounts
* Manage existing customers, handle key accounts and explore to upsell opportunities
* Ensure customer satisfaction by being process oriented, with operational efficiency and excellent communication skills

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 4+ years experience in sales/business development of Personal Care and Home Care raw material along with extensive industry exposure and a strong network within the Chemical sector.
* Experience of International Sales in the Global Markets
* Should have an excellent verbal communication & presentation skills
* Should have an excellent proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint
* Should have an ability to work in high-energy, fast-paced cross-functional teams. Should have an entrepreneurial bent of mind, strong business acumen and good network.

title: Sales - OEM
description:
The role involves managing the complete sales cycle, from identifying potential OEM customers and understanding their technical requirements to product approvals, price negotiations, order execution, payment collection, and long-term relationship management.

Below is a detailed, professional job description suitable for a Sales Manager / Senior Sales Executive / Business Development Manager – OEM Segment.

1. Key roles and responsibilities1. OEM Business Development & New Customer Acquisition

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the OEM segment.
* Identify potential OEM customers, manufacturers, fabricators, assemblers, and industrial companies.
* Conduct market research to identify target industries, customer requirements, and business opportunities.
* Develop a database of prospective OEM customers and key decision-makers.
* Approach purchase managers, sourcing managers, design engineers, R&D heads, project managers, and business owners.
* Generate leads through market visits, references, exhibitions, industry networks, and online platforms.
* Arrange customer meetings, product presentations, and business discussions.
* Convert prospective customers into active business accounts.
* Develop new product and application opportunities within existing and potential OEM accounts.

2. Existing Customer Account Management

* Manage and maintain relationships with existing OEM customers.
* Regularly visit customers to understand their business requirements and future plans.
* Maintain strong relationships with purchase, technical, quality, production, and management teams.
* Understand customer production schedules, consumption patterns, and material requirements.
* Ensure customer satisfaction through timely responses and effective problem resolution.
* Identify opportunities for increasing business volume and product penetration.
* Develop long-term business relationships and ensure customer retention.
* Conduct periodic business reviews with key accounts.

3. Sales Planning & Revenue Generation

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual sales plans.
* Achieve assigned sales targets in terms of revenue, volume, and profitability.
* Develop customer-wise and product-wise sales forecasts.
* Prepare sales budgets and business development plans.
* Identify high-potential customers and prioritize business opportunities.
* Monitor actual sales performance against assigned targets.
* Develop strategies to increase market share and business contribution.
* Track order pipeline, pending enquiries, expected closures, and future business opportunities.

4. OEM Customer Requirement Analysis

* Understand the technical and commercial requirements of OEM customers.
* Study customer drawings, specifications, product applications, and quality standards where relevant.
* Coordinate with technical and engineering teams to identify suitable products and solutions.
* Understand customer production processes and consumption requirements.
* Recommend appropriate products based on application, performance, quality, and cost.
* Identify opportunities for product customization and value engineering.
* Coordinate product trials, sample submissions, and technical evaluations.
* Ensure that proposed products meet customer specifications and application requirements.

5. Pricing, Costing & Commercial Negotiations

* Prepare quotations based on customer requirements and company pricing policies.
* Coordinate with costing, finance, procurement, and management teams for price approvals.
* Negotiate product pricing, discounts, payment terms, and commercial conditions.
* Analyze customer costing requirements and competitor pricing.
* Ensure healthy contribution margins and profitability.
* Handle price revisions based on raw material fluctuations, currency movements, and market conditions.
* Negotiate annual rate contracts and long-term supply agreements.
* Finalize commercial terms while maintaining a balance between customer satisfaction and company profitability.

6. RFQ, Enquiry & Quotation Management

* Receive and analyze RFQs (Request for Quotations) from OEM customers.
* Understand technical specifications, annual volume requirements, delivery schedules, and commercial conditions.
* Coordinate with internal departments to prepare accurate quotations.
* Submit competitive techno-commercial offers within agreed timelines.
* Follow up regularly on submitted quotations and pending enquiries.
* Participate in commercial discussions and negotiations.
* Track enquiry conversion ratios and reasons for lost business.
* Maintain records of quotations, revisions, and customer feedback.

7. Product Development & New Project Coordination

* Identify new product development opportunities with OEM customers.
* Coordinate with R&D, engineering, production, and quality departments.
* Understand customer drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
* Arrange product samples and prototype submissions.
* Coordinate product testing, validation, and approval processes.
* Follow up on customer trials and technical feedback.
* Ensure timely completion of product approval procedures.
* Support new product introduction (NPI) and new project launches.
* Develop business opportunities from customer product redesigns, expansions, and new manufacturing projects.

8. Order Management & Execution

* Coordinate with customers for purchase orders and order confirmations.
* Ensure purchase orders are received with accurate pricing, specifications, and delivery terms.
* Coordinate with production and planning teams for order execution.
* Monitor order status and ensure timely delivery.
* Communicate delivery schedules and dispatch updates to customers.
* Coordinate with logistics and dispatch teams.
* Resolve order-related issues, shortages, and delivery delays.
* Ensure smooth coordination between customers and internal departments.
* Monitor pending orders and maintain an updated order execution tracker.

9. Payment Follow-up & Receivables Management

* Monitor customer outstanding payments and credit limits.
* Coordinate with customers for timely payment realization.
* Follow up on overdue invoices and pending receivables.
* Coordinate with finance and accounts teams for payment reconciliation.
* Resolve payment disputes, debit notes, credit notes, and invoice discrepancies.
* Ensure compliance with approved credit terms.
* Monitor customer credit exposure and highlight potential risks.
* Support the company in maintaining healthy working capital and reducing overdue outstanding amounts.

10. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Monitor industry trends and market developments.
* Identify competitor products, pricing strategies, and market positioning.
* Analyze customer purchasing patterns and market demand.
* Identify new OEM industries and application segments.
* Track competitor activities and new product launches.
* Collect market intelligence through customer interactions and industry visits.
* Recommend strategies to improve market share and competitive positioning.
* Identify potential threats and opportunities in the OEM business.

11. Internal Coordination & Cross-functional Management

Coordinate with different departments to ensure smooth business operations.

**Department**

**Coordination responsibilities**

Production

Production planning, capacity, and delivery schedules

Purchase

Raw material availability and cost updates

Quality

Customer complaints, quality issues, and corrective actions

R&D / Engineering

Product development, technical specifications, and trials

Finance

Pricing approvals, credit limits, and payment collection

Logistics

Dispatch planning and delivery commitments

Customer Service

Order status, customer queries, and issue resolution

Management

Sales reviews, forecasts, business plans, and key account updates

12. Customer Complaint & Relationship Management

* Handle customer complaints and escalations professionally.
* Coordinate with quality and production teams to identify root causes.
* Ensure timely corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Follow up on customer feedback and satisfaction levels.
* Coordinate 8D reports and corrective action reports wherever applicable.
* Maintain customer confidence through timely communication.
* Prevent repeat complaints and protect long-term business relationships.

title: Salesperson
description:
Job Description – Jewellery Sales Executive

**Company:**
A.E. Motiwala Jewellers

**Location:**
Byculla, Mumbai

**Working Hours:**
11:00 AM to 8:30 PM

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

1. Company Description

A.E. Motiwala Jewellers is a well-established fine jewellery brand in Mumbai, known for its quality craftsmanship, timeless designs, transparent dealings and attentive customer service. With a strong legacy and a focus on innovation, the company offers an exclusive range of gold, diamond and precious gemstone jewellery.

Our collections include traditional and contemporary jewellery, bridal sets, everyday wear, statement pieces, solitaire diamonds and investment-grade gold coins. We believe in building long-term customer relationships through trust, transparency, product knowledge and personalized service.

2. Role Description

We are looking for a confident, enthusiastic and customer-oriented Jewellery Sales Executive to join our team at our Byculla showroom.

The candidate will be responsible for welcoming customers, understanding their requirements and recommending suitable jewellery based on their preferences, occasions and budgets.

The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of jewellery, strong mathematical and calculation skills, excellent communication abilities and the confidence to handle customers professionally. The candidate should also be comfortable explaining gold purity, diamond quality, jewellery pricing, making charges and other product-related details.

3. Key Responsibilities

* Welcome customers and provide a warm, professional shopping experience.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable jewellery pieces.
* Demonstrate and explain gold, diamond, gemstone and other jewellery collections.
* Have a good understanding of gold purity, diamond quality, jewellery designs and current market trends.
* Accurately calculate jewellery prices based on prevailing gold rates, weight, making charges, wastage and applicable taxes.
* Explain pricing and billing transparently to customers.
* Handle customer queries, negotiations and customization requests.
* Build strong customer relationships and encourage repeat business.
* Achieve individual and showroom sales targets.
* Maintain jewellery displays, counters and product presentation.
* Ensure proper handling, security and accountability of high-value jewellery.
* Assist with billing, documentation and inventory management.
* Coordinate with the back-office team for customer orders, repairs and other requirements.

4. Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Jewellery Knowledge:**
  Good understanding of gold jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, purity, weights, designs and jewellery pricing.
* **Mathematical Skills:**
  Must be very good at mathematics and calculations, especially gold rate calculations, weight conversions, making charges, discounts and billing.
* **Language Skills:**
  Must be able to speak Gujarati fluently. Good communication skills in Hindi and English are also required.
* **Sales Skills:**
  Ability to convince customers, negotiate effectively and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
* **Communication:**
  Clear, confident and professional communication with customers.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  Accuracy in calculations, billing, documentation and jewellery handling.
* **Integrity:**
  High level of honesty, responsibility and professionalism when dealing with customers and high-value products.
* **Computer Skills:**
  Basic knowledge of computers and billing software.

5. Experience & Education

* Previous experience in jewellery retail or the jewellery industry is preferred.
* Candidates with experience in gold and diamond jewellery sales will be given preference.
* Minimum educational qualification: 12th Pass.
* Candidates with a background in commerce or business studies will be preferred.
* Freshers with excellent communication, mathematical and learning abilities may also apply.

6. Working Conditions

* **Work Location:**
  A.E. Motiwala Jewellers, Byculla, Mumbai.
* **Working Hours:**
  11:00 AM to 8:30 PM.
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-Time, On-Site.
* Must be willing to work on weekends and during festive and peak business periods as required.

7. Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is confident, presentable, trustworthy and passionate about sales. The ideal candidate should have a genuine interest in jewellery, be exceptionally good with numbers and calculations, communicate comfortably in Gujarati and be capable of handling customers independently.

title: Key Account Management - Partner
description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)**
is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
  
  
At FICO, we are always looking for exceptional talent to drive our ambitious growth strategy. While we may not have an immediate opening, this is a general posting for outstanding Key Account Managers who specialize in enterprise technology sales and client relationship management within the financial services sector. If you’d like to learn more, we encourage you to introduce yourself so that we can begin a conversation and consider you for opportunities as they arise.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Are you ready to take your sales career to the next level by leading one of FICO’s most critical client accounts? This role is your chance to lead a cornerstone account for a global leader in analytics and decisioning technology. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a premier client’s business while achieving significant personal and professional growth. With over 60 years of consistent growth, FICO’s world-class solutions empower thousands of businesses worldwide to make smarter fraud, risk, and customer management decisions. As a senior member of our Sales organization, you will leverage your deep expertise, strategic acumen, and consultative-selling prowess to strengthen and expand a marquee client relationship. This is not just another sales role—it’s an opportunity to make a significant impact by partnering with a global financial institution to address their most urgent challenges with FICO’s advanced technologies. If you’re a results-driven, senior-level professional with a passion for delivering innovative solutions and driving exceptional outcomes, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**What You’ll Contribute**

* Strategic Leadership: Build and nurture relationships with C-suite and senior client stakeholders to uncover and address their most critical business challenges, demonstrating the value of FICO’s solutions at every turn.
* Solution Innovation: Collaborate with internal teams across sales, product, delivery, and marketing to design tailored, enterprise-grade solutions that align with client needs and long-term strategies.
* Complex Deal Structuring: Lead high-stakes negotiations for multi-million-dollar contracts, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes that protect and expand FICO’s footprint within the account.
* Client Advocacy: Serve as the voice of the client within FICO, influencing product roadmaps and solution strategies to address evolving market demands.
* Business Growth: Develop and execute comprehensive business plans that drive account expansion and long-term profitability, while achieving quarterly and annual sales targets with significant upside potential.
* Market Leadership: Represent FICO as a trusted advisor, staying ahead of industry trends and positioning the company as the go-to partner for advanced analytics and decisioning solutions.

**What We’re Seeking**

* Proven Senior-Level Experience: Demonstrated success in building and managing strategic relationships with senior executives, particularly within large financial institutions.
* Enterprise Solution Sales Expertise: A track record of structuring and closing complex, multi-million-dollar deals, including SaaS-based solutions that expand existing offerings or integrate into larger solution bundles.
* Industry Knowledge: Deep familiarity with banking, credit risk, fraud prevention, account management, or consumer lending. Experience in applying technologies such as machine learning, AI, decision management, and optimization is highly desirable.
* Strategic Vision and Execution: Ability to craft and execute joint business plans that align with client objectives and FICO’s strategic priorities.
* Growth Mindset: A Passion to learn and educate customers and FICO colleagues through presentations, and conversations. Strong soft skills, and a genuine interest in people and a desire to help them be wildly successful.
* Resiliency: Able to maintain focus and effectiveness under pressure, adaptable to change, and recover quickly from setbacks.
* Collaborative Leadership: A team-oriented mindset that values collaboration and leverages the collective strengths of colleagues to deliver exceptional results.
* Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 50% to maintain a close partnership with the client and foster meaningful, face-to-face interactions.
* Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent commercial experience.

**Our Offer to You**

* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
  
  
FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
  
  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
  
  
Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
  
  
FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

title: Fleet Supply Executive - Mumbai
description:
**Fleet Supply Executive**

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Department:**
Fleet Ops. - Supply

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Fleet Supply Executive to drive the acquisition, onboarding, activation and ongoing

management of delivery partners across assigned locations. The role will focus on building a strong and reliable delivery partner fleet by identifying area-wise supply requirements, sourcing new partners, managing the onboarding funnel, improving activation and retaining existing partners. The executive will work closely with field recruiters and internal teams to ensure a consistent pipeline of delivery partners and healthy fleet availability across key areas.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target-oriented and comfortable managing field teams and engaging with delivery partners in a fast-paced environment.

**1. Fleet Acquisition & Sourcing**

* Drive delivery partner acquisition to meet location-wise and area-wise fleet requirements.
* Identify high-potential sourcing locations, rider catchment areas and relevant acquisition channels.
* Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective delivery partners through field sourcing, referrals, local networks and other channels.
* Plan and execute on-ground acquisition activities to generate qualified partner leads.
* Set daily and weekly acquisition targets and ensure consistent progress against them.
* Track lead generation, follow-ups, conversion and joining performance to improve acquisition efficiency.

**2. Onboarding & Activation**

* Own the delivery partner onboarding journey from initial enquiry through registration, verification and activation.
* Coordinate with onboarding and verification teams to ensure timely completion of partner documentation and formalities.
* Drive newly onboarded partners to complete their first order and become active on the platform.
* Monitor the onboarding funnel and identify reasons for partner drop-offs at each stage.
* Follow up with pending and partially onboarded partners to improve conversion and activation rates.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, onboarding status, activation and first-order completion.

**3. Existing Fleet Management, Engagement & Retention**

* Manage and build relationships with the existing delivery partner fleet across assigned areas.
* Track partner activity levels and identify inactive, low-activity and at-risk partners.
* Drive partner reactivation initiatives to bring inactive partners back onto the platform.
* Conduct regular partner interactions and field visits to understand concerns, expectations and reasons for inactivity.
* Communicate partner earning opportunities, incentive programmes, referral schemes and relevant policy updates.
* Develop engagement initiatives that improve partner participation, satisfaction and long-term retention.
* Identify recurring reasons for partner churn and recommend initiatives to improve fleet stability.

**4. Field Team & Recruitment Management**

* Coordinate and manage field recruiters or acquisition executives to achieve assigned fleet acquisition targets.
* Allocate sourcing areas and daily activity plans to the field acquisition team.
* Monitor individual team performance across lead generation, partner onboarding and activation.
* Conduct regular reviews, provide guidance and support the team in improving conversion and productivity.
* Ensure field team members maintain accurate lead and partner acquisition trackers.
* Identify hiring or sourcing capacity gaps and escalate requirements to the relevant team.

**5. Area-wise Fleet Planning & Supply Growth**

* Understand area-wise fleet requirements and identify locations where additional delivery partners need to be acquired.
* Maintain visibility of active, inactive and newly onboarded partners across assigned areas.
* Prioritise acquisition efforts based on identified supply gaps, partner availability and business growth requirements.
* Recommend local sourcing strategies to strengthen fleet coverage in priority areas.
* Work with internal stakeholders to align acquisition plans with changing supply requirements.

**6. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Maintain daily and weekly trackers covering leads generated, partners onboarded, activated and retained.
* Prepare regular updates on acquisition pipeline, conversion rates, activation performance and field team
* productivity.
* Track key performance indicators and take corrective action where targets are not being achieved.
* Highlight sourcing challenges, onboarding bottlenecks and partner churn trends with supporting data.
* Share progress against assigned acquisition and fleet growth targets with the reporting manager.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to acquire, onboard and engage delivery partners at scale.
* Experience in field recruitment, lead generation and target-driven sourcing.
* Strong team coordination and the ability to manage field acquisition teams.
* Good understanding of delivery partner behavior, fleet supply and last-mile delivery ecosystems.
* Strong follow-up, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and basic performance trackers.
* Self-driven, organized and comfortable working towards daily and monthly targets.
* Willingness to travel locally for field visits and partner acquisition activities.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in fleet acquisition, delivery partner onboarding, field recruitment, logistics, e-commerce, food delivery, quick commerce or similar sectors.
* Experience working with delivery partners, riders, drivers, field recruiters or on-ground acquisition teams.
* Prior experience in managing sourcing targets, onboarding funnels or partner engagement initiatives will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an aptitude for field acquisition may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New delivery partner leads generated against assigned targets.
* New delivery partner acquisition and joining rate.
* Onboarding completion and verification rate.
* New partner activation and first-order completion rate.
* Onboarding funnel conversion and drop-off rate.
* Active fleet growth across assigned areas.
* Existing partner retention and reactivation rate.
* Reduction in partner inactivity and churn.
* Field recruiter productivity and target achievement.
* Area-wise fleet supply gap closure.

title: SAP FICO Executive – Accounts & Finance Operations
description:
We're Hiring! | SAP FICO Executive – Accounts & Finance Operations
  
  
Company: ONBV Textiles India Pvt. Ltd. / ONBV Buildcon
  
Location: Ulhasnagar / Kalyan, Maharashtra
  
Experience: 2–5 Years
  
Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance)
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented SAP FICO Executive to join our Accounts & Finance team.
  
  
The candidate should have practical experience in day-to-day accounting operations, SAP S/4HANA, purchase and sales accounting, vendor and customer reconciliation, GST, TDS and other statutory compliance activities.
  
  
The role involves handling routine accounting transactions in SAP, ensuring accuracy of financial records and supporting monthly financial closing activities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Purchase Accounting (Accounts Payable)
  
  
- Booking purchase invoices through SAP MIRO and FB60.
  
- Verifying invoices against Purchase Orders (PO), GRN and supplier bills.
  
- Checking invoice rates, quantities, GST rates, HSN codes and taxable values.
  
- Booking job-work, service, freight and expense invoices.
  
- Processing vendor debit notes, credit notes and advance adjustments.
  
- Vendor ledger reconciliation and outstanding tracking.
  
  
2. Sales Accounting (Accounts Receivable)
  
  
- Sales invoice and credit/debit note accounting.
  
- Customer receipt entries and advance adjustments.
  
- Customer ledger reconciliation and outstanding follow-up.
  
- Verification of GSTIN, HSN and applicable GST rates.
  
- Coordination with sales and dispatch departments.
  
  
3. General Ledger & Bank Accounting
  
  
- Posting journal entries, expense entries and provisions.
  
- Bank receipt and payment entries.
  
- Bank reconciliation (BRS).
  
- Loan, advance, deposit and fixed asset accounting.
  
- GL scrutiny and ledger reconciliation.
  
  
4. GST & Statutory Compliance
  
  
- Preparation and reconciliation of GSTR-1 data.
  
- Purchase register reconciliation with GSTR-2B.
  
- ITC verification and identification of missing or mismatched invoices.
  
- GSTIN, HSN/SAC and GST rate verification.
  
- E-invoice and E-way bill generation/cancellation coordination.
  
- TDS deduction, accounting and reconciliation.
  
- Assistance in TDS returns and challan reconciliation.
  
- Knowledge of Professional Tax (PT), PF and ESIC compliance.
  
  
5. SAP & ERP Operations
  
  
- Practical working experience in SAP S/4HANA and Fiori Launchpad.
  
- Hands-on knowledge of SAP FICO transactions such as MIRO, FB60, FB50, F-28, F-29, F-53, FBL1N, FBL5N and other relevant T-codes.
  
- Business Partner (BP) master data maintenance.
  
- Vendor/customer open-item clearing and reconciliation.
  
- Identifying routine SAP posting errors and coordinating for resolution.
  
- Basic understanding of SAP MM and SD integration.
  
  
6. Tally, Excel & Reporting
  
  
- Practical working knowledge of Tally Prime.
  
- SAP versus Tally reconciliation.
  
- Preparation of purchase, sales and outstanding reports.
  
- Advanced Excel knowledge including VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables and SUMIFS.
  
- Preparation of MIS reports and supporting monthly closing activities.
  
  
Candidate Requirements
  
  
- B.Com / M.Com / MBA in Finance.
  
- 2–5 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
  
- Preferably 1–2 years of hands-on SAP S/4HANA experience.
  
- Strong knowledge of accounting fundamentals, GST and TDS.
  
- Practical experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and General Ledger.
  
- Good working knowledge of MS Excel and Tally Prime.
  
- Strong analytical, reconciliation and problem-solving skills.
  
- Good communication and coordination skills.
  
- Ability to handle accounting transactions independently and accurately.
  
  
Important Note
  
  
This position is primarily focused on hands-on SAP accounting operations and financial data entry. We are looking for an operational SAP FICO user with practical accounting knowledge, not an SAP implementation, configuration or ABAP consultant.

title: Real Estate Salesperson
description:
New Business Developer (Existing Customers) – Job Description Oct 16, 2026 · @Akshit Parmar The New Business Developer (Existing Customers) brings in bookings from people who have already bought from us: repeat purchases, referrals from their family and friends, and introductions to new projects. Success is measured in bookings and referral leads from the existing customer base, backed by a disciplined weekly contact schedule. How this works for a real estate developer Our customers rarely buy every year; most buy a home once or twice in a lifetime. So this role does not wait for reorders. It earns business from existing customers in five ways: Source What it looks like Typical timing Referrals Buyers introduce family, friends, colleagues and neighbours. This is the largest and most reliable source. Any time; strongest at possession, registration and the first year after moving in Upgrade A buyer moves to a bigger home as the family grows, or from an older project to a new one. 5+ years after purchase Investment and second homes A buyer adds a second unit to rent out or hold, or buys for children or parents. When their first unit has appreciated; at each new launch Pre-launch access Past buyers get first access and a loyalty offer before a project opens to the public. 4–8 weeks before each launch Societies and communities Residents and committee members of our completed and redevelopment projects introduce neighbouring buildings and societies. After handover, once the society is satisfied Untitled Page 1 of 7Untitled The nurturing work matters as much as the selling. A buyer who felt looked after through construction and possession refers others; one who felt ignored does not. This role keeps in touch at every stage, while our CRM team handles payments, paperwork and possession. Role summary Title: New Business Developer (Existing Customers) Department: Sales, based at head office with regular client meetings and site visits Reports to: Managing Director, with a weekly review Works with: CRM team (post-booking service), Sales Coordinator and telecallers (lead handling and site visit scheduling), sales executives, marketing (launch campaigns), accounts Purpose: turn our past buyers into a steady source of new bookings, through referrals, repeat purchases and pre-launch sales, while keeping every customer relationship warm. This is a selling role. You meet customers, present our projects, and close bookings from the existing customer base, with support from the Sales Coordinator on scheduling and paperwork. Responsibilities Selling to existing customers 1. Meet past buyers who show interest in upgrading, investing or buying for family; present the right project and close the booking. 2. Run the pre-launch programme for every new project: invite past buyers first, hold private previews, and book them before public launch. 3. Ask every customer for referrals at the right moments, and personally follow up every referral lead within 24 hours. 4. Work with society committees and residents of our completed and redevelopment projects to get introductions to neighbouring buildings. Nurturing relationships 1. Keep the customer database: every buyer, their unit, family details, investment profile, last contact and next reason to call. Page 2 of 7Untitled 2. Contact every customer at least once a quarter, and at each key moment: construction milestones, possession, registration, possession anniversary, new launches. 3. Host customer events: possession ceremonies, site tours of new projects, festival gatherings, resident meet-ups. 4. Listen for problems and pass them to the CRM team; follow up until the customer confirms they are resolved. 5. Collect customer feedback at possession and once a year after, and share testimonials and video stories with marketing (with the customer's permission). Weekly 1. Plan the week's calls and meetings from the database. 2. Share the weekly report by Monday 10 am: contacts made, meetings, referral leads, site visits, bookings and booking value. 3. Review the week with the MD: deals in progress, upcoming triggers, customers at risk of going cold. Not part of this role New enquiries from portals, ads and walk-ins (telecallers and sales team). Payments, agreements, registration and possession paperwork (CRM team). Pricing beyond the approved loyalty and referral offers (MD approval). KRAs and KPIs A home purchase takes months, so bookings alone can't tell us week to week whether the role is working. Performance is measured on two levels: results (bookings, referrals, revenue), reviewed monthly and quarterly, and activity (contacts, meetings, follow-ups), reviewed weekly. Activity is what produces results six months later. The result this role drives can be broken down as: \text{Bookings value} = \text{Customers contacted} \times \text{Meeting rate} \times \text{Conversion to booking} \times \text{Average booking value} The same applies to referrals: referral leads received × conversion to booking. Growth comes from improving any one of these numbers, so each is tracked separately. Weekly scores are the percentage of planned work not done, or not done on time. If 40 calls were planned and 30 were made, the score is −25%. The aim is −10% or better. Incentive. Variable pay is linked to bookings value from existing customers and referrals (KRAs 1–3), with a qualifying minimum on the activity scores (KRAs 4–6). Referral leads received from any of the above.
