title: Telecalling Executive – Lead Qualification & Walk-in Conversion
description:
Telecalling Executive – Lead Qualification & Walk-in Conversion

Company: Awdiz Institute

Industry: Training & Placement

Department: Sales & Business Development

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Bandra West, Mumbai

Experience: 0–3 Years

Salary: ₹2,00,000 – ₹3,00,000 Per Annum

About Awdiz Institute

Awdiz Institute is a Training & Placement Institute focused on helping graduates build successful careers in the IT industry.

With 12+ years of legacy, 8,000+ career transformations and 100+ hiring partners, we help aspiring professionals develop industry-relevant skills and explore employment opportunities in the IT sector.

We offer career-oriented courses across Full Stack Development, Data Science & Analytics, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Networking and IT Infrastructure, with a strong focus on mentor-led training, practical learning and placement support.

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly energetic, aggressive and target-oriented Telecalling Executive who is comfortable handling high-volume outbound calling and converting raw databases and digitally generated leads into qualified walk-in prospects.

The individual will be responsible for connecting with prospective students, understanding their educational backgrounds and career aspirations, generating interest in relevant IT courses and convincing them to visit our training centres at Bandra or Vashi.

The primary objective of this role is to generate maximum qualified walk-ins and ensure that confirmed candidates actually visit the centre.

This is a calling-intensive, performance-driven role that requires excellent communication, persuasion, follow-up and objection-handling skills.

Key Responsibilities

1. High-Volume Outbound Calling

* Make 200+ outbound calls every working day across raw databases and digitally generated leads.

* Maintain a minimum of 100 successful connects per day.

* Maintain 5–6 hours of productive daily talk time.

* Initiate conversations with prospective students through cold calling.

* Follow up consistently with prospects who show interest but have not yet committed to visiting the centre.

* Maintain high calling productivity and ensure effective utilisation of working hours.

2. Level 1 Lead Qualification

* Understand the prospect's highest educational qualification and graduation year.

* Identify whether the candidate belongs to an IT or Non-IT background.

* Capture relevant information such as city, work experience, current employment status and career aspirations.

* Understand the candidate's interest in entering or transitioning into the IT industry.

* Identify the candidate's preferred course or career domain.

* Evaluate the prospect's seriousness, interest level and willingness to explore IT career opportunities.

* Maintain accurate and complete lead information in the CRM.

3. Course Awareness & Interest Generation

* Introduce Awdiz Institute and its career-oriented IT courses to prospective students.

* Generate interest in relevant courses based on the candidate's educational background and career aspirations.

* Explain the benefits of mentor-led training, practical learning, industry-relevant skills and placement support.

* Create awareness about career opportunities across Full Stack Development, Data Science & Analytics, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Networking and IT Infrastructure.

* Handle basic objections related to course relevance, fees, location, duration and career opportunities.

* Build enough interest and confidence to encourage prospects to take the next step.

4. Walk-in Generation & Conversion

* Make walk-in generation the primary objective of every qualified conversation.

* Convince interested candidates to visit the nearest Awdiz Institute centre at Bandra or Vashi.

* Communicate the benefits of an in-person counselling session and detailed course discussion.

* Secure confirmed walk-in appointments with a specific date and preferred time.

* Understand the candidate's availability and address any concerns preventing them from visiting the centre.

* Coordinate with the counselling team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified walk-in prospects.

5. Walk-in Confirmation & Pre-Visit Follow-ups

* Take complete ownership of confirmed walk-in appointments.

* Conduct reminder calls and WhatsApp follow-ups before the scheduled visit.

* Reconfirm the candidate's availability, preferred time and willingness to visit.

* Share the centre location and relevant visit details wherever required.

* Follow up with candidates who do not respond to initial reminders.

* Identify potential drop-offs and proactively address concerns that may prevent the candidate from visiting.

* Coordinate with the counselling team regarding upcoming confirmed visits.

* Track confirmed walk-ins against actual centre visits.

* In case of a no-show, immediately reconnect with the candidate, understand the reason and attempt to reschedule the visit.

Important: The responsibility does not end when a candidate agrees to visit. The executive is accountable for consistent follow-ups and maximising actual walk-in attendance.

6. Lead Management & CRM Updates

* Maintain accurate call records and lead details in the assigned CRM.

* Update lead status after every interaction.

* Categorise leads into Interested, Not Interested, Follow-up Required, Not Connected and Walk-in Confirmed, as applicable.

* Record reasons for rejection and common objections.

* Maintain a structured follow-up pipeline to minimise lead leakage.

* Ensure that no qualified or interested lead is left unattended.

* Maintain proper records of confirmed, attended, rescheduled and missed walk-ins.

Daily Performance Expectations

This role comes with clearly defined daily productivity expectations.

Performance Parameter Daily Target

Outbound Dials 200+

Successful Connects 100+

Productive Talk Time 5–6 Hours

Lead Qualification Consistent daily activity

Walk-in Appointments Target-driven

Pre-Visit Follow-ups 100% of confirmed appointments

CRM Updates 100% of interactions

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on both calling productivity and actual walk-in generation.

1. Calling Productivity: Number of outbound dials and successful connects.

2. Talk Time: Ability to maintain 5–6 hours of productive daily talk time.

3. Lead Qualification: Number of relevant and properly qualified prospects.

4. Walk-in Generation: Number of confirmed appointments generated.

5. Walk-in Attendance: Number of candidates who actually visit the centre.

6. Walk-in Show-up Rate: Percentage of confirmed appointments converted into actual centre visits.

7. No-show Recovery: Ability to reconnect with missed appointments and reschedule visits.

8. CRM Discipline: Accuracy and consistency of lead updates and follow-ups.

Primary KPI: Actual qualified walk-ins generated at the Awdiz Institute centres.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication skills.

* Strong convincing, negotiation and persuasion abilities.

* Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling and cold calling.

* Ability to work extensively with raw databases.

* Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills.

* Ability to generate interest among candidates who may not initially be looking for IT courses.

* Target-oriented mindset with a strong sense of urgency.

* Ability to handle rejection without losing motivation.

* Good listening skills and ability to understand candidate requirements quickly.

* Basic understanding of CRM systems and lead management.

* Fluency in English and Hindi. Marathi will be an added advantage.

Eligibility & Experience

* Graduates and undergraduates with strong communication skills can apply.

* Freshers with excellent communication and convincing abilities are welcome.

* Candidates with 6 months to 3 years of experience in telecalling, outbound sales, education counselling, lead generation or inside sales will be preferred.

* Experience in EdTech, education sales, BPO outbound calling or admission counselling will be an added advantage.

Who Should Apply?

We are specifically looking for individuals who:

* Are confident, energetic and comfortable speaking to new people throughout the day.

* Can consistently make 200+ outbound calls every day.

* Are comfortable maintaining 5–6 hours of daily talk time.

* Have the ability to turn a cold conversation into a genuine sales opportunity.

* Can confidently convince prospective students to visit our centres.

* Understand the importance of follow-ups and appointment confirmations.

* Take ownership of ensuring that confirmed prospects actually show up.

* Thrive in a target-driven environment and are motivated by performance.

Why Join Awdiz Institute?

* Opportunity to work with a growing Training & Placement Institute.

* Exposure to the IT education and career development industry.

* Develop communication, persuasion and sales skills.

* Opportunity to grow within the Sales & Business Development team.

* Work in a performance-driven environment with measurable targets.

Important Note: This is not a customer support, reception or inbound calling role. This is a high-volume outbound telecalling and lead conversion position. The primary responsibility is to generate qualified walk-ins, follow up with confirmed prospects and maximise actual centre footfall.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Quality Management System (QMS)
description:
**VACANCY FOR**

**MANAGER – QMS**
(
*Quality Management System and Process Owner*
)

**Company Description:**

Established in 2009, Revata Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer of high-performance elastomers, sealing solutions, precision-machined components and oilfield products, serving customers primarily in the oil and gas sector. The company's head office and manufacturing facility are located at M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune. Revata is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and operates its own NABL-accredited material testing laboratory.

**Role Description:**

We are seeking an experienced
**Manager – QMS**
to take complete ownership of the company's Quality Management System. The incumbent will build the QMS around the actual flow of an order, from enquiry and contract review through purchase, production and inspection to dispatch. This includes defining what information each department receives, records and hands over, so that orders move through the plant without delays and every failure can be traced to its root cause.

A key objective of the role is to
**take the company through API Spec Q1 certification**
. The role covers the design, implementation and maintenance of the QMS in line with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001:2015, including processes, SOPs, forms and formats, internal and external audits, customer QMS requirements and root cause analysis of nonconformities. The position reports to the Director, Operations & Technology, with direct access to the Managing Director on audit results, customer nonconformities and management review. Product inspection and release will continue to be handled by the QC team.

**This is a hands-on role that requires close interaction with all departments and a regular presence on the shop floor.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

·      Own and maintain the company-wide QMS in accordance with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001:2015, and drive its continual improvement.

·      Lead the company to API Spec Q1 certification, including the gap assessment against the 10th Edition, the implementation plan and timeline, internal readiness audits and the certification audit.

·      Map the end-to-end business process from enquiry to dispatch, covering contract review, engineering, planning, purchase, stores, production, inspection and dispatch, and define clear inputs, outputs and responsibilities at each interface between departments.

·      Prepare and maintain all QMS documentation, including system procedures, work instructions, SOPs, master lists, forms and formats, and ensure they are practical and easy to use on the shop floor.

·      Establish and manage document and record control, including numbering, revision, approval, distribution, control of obsolete documents and record retention as per API Spec Q1.

·      Define ownership for every procedure, form and record, and conduct training for each department on its applicable documents.

·      Ensure contract review is carried out for every purchase order, and establish order-level quality planning, including inspection and test plans, material traceability and the documentation package issued by QC (inspection reports, material certificates and certificates of conformance).

·      Manage the nonconformance and CAPA system across all departments, lead cross-functional root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, fishbone) and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions before closure.

·      Handle customer audits and respond to customer complaints and QMS nonconformities with root cause and corrective action reports within agreed timelines, including completion of customer supplier-qualification questionnaires.

·      Plan, coordinate and face ISO 9001:2015 surveillance and recertification audits, as well as API Spec Q1 audits once certification is achieved, and ensure timely closure of all findings.

·      Plan and conduct internal audits as per the annual audit schedule, ensuring auditor independence.

·      Prepare inputs for management review, conduct the review with the Managing Director and track action items to closure.

·      Establish and maintain the risk assessment, contingency planning and management of change (MOC) processes as required by API Spec Q1.

·      Work with Purchase on supplier evaluation and approval, maintenance of the approved supplier list, supplier performance monitoring and supplier corrective action requests.

·      Ensure calibration, preventive maintenance, training and competency records are maintained by the respective departments as per the QMS.

·      Define quality objectives and present a monthly QMS performance report covering nonconformities, CAPA status, customer complaints, audit findings, on-time delivery and cost of poor quality.

·      Support the ERP implementation team in moving QMS forms and records onto the ERP platform.

·      Coordinate with the NABL-accredited laboratory, which operates under ISO/IEC 17025, to ensure clear interfaces between the laboratory and the QMS.

·      Raise nonconformities against any department where required and escalate unresolved issues to the Managing Director.

**Who Should Apply:**

Candidates who have independently established or restructured a QMS in a manufacturing organization under API Spec Q1, IATF 16949 or ISO 9001:2015, and led it through certification and customer audits. The candidate should have experience in defining cross-functional processes and preparing procedures and formats that are used across departments.

Experience in a make-to-order, low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment such as oilfield equipment, valves, sealing products, forgings or precision machining will be preferred. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to present sample procedures or formats prepared by them, with confidential information removed.

**Must Have Qualifications:**

BE / BTech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Polymer Engineering, or equivalent.

10 to 15 years of experience in manufacturing quality, with at least 5 years in a role responsible for the company's QMS.

Proven experience in establishing a QMS from scratch or restructuring an existing one within the last seven years, including leading the certification audit.

Has led, or played a key role in, taking an organization through API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949 certification, along with hands-on experience in implementing ISO 9001:2015.

Experience in facing customer audits and responding to customer complaints and nonconformities through 8D / CAPA reports.

Strong skills in process mapping and preparation of QMS documentation.

Internal auditor training in ISO 9001:2015, API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949.

Working knowledge of root cause analysis tools, FMEA and control plans.

Proficiency in MS Excel for tracking and analysis of quality data.

Ability to communicate in Marathi or Hindi with shop floor staff, and good written and spoken English for customer communication and documentation.

**Optional / Preferred Qualifications:**

Experience in oilfield equipment, valves, wellhead equipment, elastomer seals, forgings or precision machining industries.

Experience as Management Representative or Deputy Management Representative for API Spec Q1.

Experience with API Spec Q1 10th Edition certification, or exposure to the API Monogram Program.

Lead Auditor certification in ISO 9001:2015, API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949.

Exposure to customer-specific QMS requirements of oil and gas operators or OEMs.

Experience in implementing an ERP-based or digital QMS.

Exposure to NABL / ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory systems.

**Location:**
M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune - 411026

**Office Timings:**
Monday - Saturday (8:30 AM to 5:30 PM)

**Remuneration:**
CTC will be as per industry standard.

**Interested candidates, please email your resume to**
**revata.hr@gmail.com**
**.**

description:
**Job Title:**
Inside Sales Team Leader
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
**Previous Experience:**
3-4 years of experience in leading Inside sales, account management, or business development.
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
6:00 PM to 3:00 AM/8:00 PM to 5:00 AM - Should be willing to work from the office. Willingness to work from office and stretch when business requires.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Inside Sales Leader is responsible for leading a team of Inside Sales Associates (ISAMs) to drive account growth, manage customer relationships, and ensure efficient sales pipeline management. This role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, and the ability to coach and develop team members. The Team Leader will collaborate with branches, field representatives, and internal teams to align sales strategies, drive sales campaigns, and improve overall team performance. Additionally, the Team Leader will own the budget for the respective region and territories, manage Accounts Receivable (AR) due on accounts, and analyze performance, including corrective actions for lost accounts or underperformance. The role also requires strong technical sales skills to effectively communicate and sell complex products/services to customers
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership & Performance Management:

oLead, mentor, and develop a team of Inside Sales Associates, ensuring they meet sales targets, maintain strong customer relationships, and adhere to company standards.
  
  
oSet clear expectations for team performance, implementing corrective actions and training initiatives to drive both individual and team success.
  
  
oFoster a collaborative and high-performing culture, providing regular feedback, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
oConduct performance evaluations and identify growth opportunities for team members through structured development programs.
  
  

* Driving Sales Campaigns: Lead and execute sales campaigns within the assigned region, collaborating with the team to implement strategies that drive revenue and growth.
* Account & Pipeline Management: Oversee and support the team in managing assigned accounts, ensuring that each account is touched quarterly for relationship-building and account growth.
* AR Management: Ensure proper follow-up and management of Accounts Receivable (AR) due on accounts, coordinating with the finance team to resolve payment issues promptly.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as the key liaison between the inside sales team, branches, and field representatives, ensuring alignment of sales strategies and optimizing customer engagement.
* Customer-Centric Approach: Guide the team to provide exceptional service, foster long-term relationships with customers, and proactively address their evolving needs. Ability to handle customer escalations and resolve conflicts in a calm, professional manner.
* Lost Reason Analysis & Corrective Actions: Analyze lost sales or account closures, identify key reasons for losses, and implement corrective actions to improve retention, reduce churn, and enhance conversion rates.
* Process Improvement & Strategy Execution: Identify opportunities for process improvement, introduce best practices, and ensure the execution of sales strategies to achieve team and organizational goals.
* Project Participation: Actively engage in cross-functional projects that contribute to team performance improvements and alignment with business objectives.
* CRM & Reporting: Ensure accurate tracking of sales activities, customer interactions, and team progress through CRM tools, providing regular updates and performance reports to leadership.
* Technical Sales Skills: Demonstrate a strong understanding of the technical aspects of products/services and communicate them effectively to customers. Provide insights into how the products/services can meet specific customer needs and solve challenges. Collaborate with technical teams for product demonstrations, customized solutions, and resolving complex customer queries.
* Conflict Resolution & Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills to address challenges effectively and provide actionable solutions, both for the team and customers.

**Qualifications**
**Skills Required**

* Proven experience in inside sales, account management, or business development.
* Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to coach and motivate a diverse team.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
* Ability to drive and manage sales campaigns, aligning with overall business objectives.
* Experience in performance management, including identifying areas of improvement and implementing corrective actions.
* Proficiency in CRM software and MS Office.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a customer-focused mindset.
* Knowledge of environmental science and waste management is a plus.
* Strong technical sales skills and understanding of the products/services being sold.
* High integrity, strong work ethic, and results-driven approach.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in sales or a related field.

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

**About The Role**
The
**Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations**
will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies.
**12 to 16 years**
of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise
  
  
**Role**
The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:
  
  

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In This Role, You Will**
1. Service Ownership and Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.
* Architecture and Design Governance
* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.
* Technology and Engineering Leadership

Maintain Sufficient Technical Depth To Guide Engineering Teams, Challenge Vendor Recommendations, Approve Designs And Support Critical Escalations Across The Following Domains
  
  
**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging
* Operations, Delivery and Problem Management
* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**
**Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

**Support Engineer**
who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this

A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. * Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
* Technical & Diagnostic Skills:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

* Cloud & Monitoring Systems:

+ Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

* AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* Triage & Operations:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
+ Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:

+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
+ Jenkins & Git
+ Kubernetes and Docker
+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
+ JavaScript

title: Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting**
**Position Overview**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology, as we
*invent for life*
on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision making, that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Within our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.
  
  
Market Access Insights and Forecasting (MAIF) is a global function encompassing long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across the product lifecycles of all assets within Human Health (Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital Specialty / Primary care). Assets include early and late-stage molecules in clinical development, companies under considerations by business development for partnering and/ or acquisition as well as currently launched products. Forecasting deliverables support division planning and decision making across multiple functional areas such as finance, manufacturing, product development and commercial. In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across divisions, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes. As we endeavor, we are seeking a dynamic talent for the role of “Senior Manager – Strategic Forecasting”
  
  
We are looking for a team member within strategic forecasting team based out of Pune. Robust forecasting is a priority for businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines. While forecasting of realistic potential can be arrived through both qualitative and quantitative methods, the challenge lies in selecting and deploying the right methodology. Thus, it is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement advanced analytics techniques such as Monte Carlo simulations, agent-based modeling, conjoint frameworks, NLP, clustering etc. within forecasting vertical.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Responsible for conceptualizing and delivering forecasts and analytical solutions, using both strategic as well as statistical techniques
* Drive continuous enhancements to evolve the existing forecasting capabilities in terms of value-add, risk/ opportunity/uncertainty - identify and elevate key forecasting levers/insights/findings to inform decision making
* Collaborate across stakeholders – Human Health, Finance, Research, Country, and senior leadership – to build and robust assumptions, ensuring forecast accuracy improves over time to support decision making
* Drive innovation and automation to bring in robustness and efficiency gains in forecasting/process; incorporate best-in-class statistical forecasting methods to improve the accuracy
* Communicate effectively across stakeholders and proactively identify and resolve conflicts by engaging with relevant stakeholders
* Responsible for managing team and delivery of forecasts in a timely manner with allocated resources
* Determine the optimal method for forecasting, considering the context of the forecast, availability of data, the degree of accuracy desired, and the timeline available
* Contribute in evolving our offerings through standardization/ automation of various offerings, models and processes
* Participate in selection, talent development and trainings of employees

**Qualification And Skills**

* Engineering / Management / Pharma post-graduates with 8+ years of experience in the relevant roles; with at least 8+ years of experience in pharmaceutical strategic forecasting or analytics
* Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques (expertise in Spotfire will be added advantage)
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across large and diverse functions and stakeholders
* Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of business
* Strong analytical skills; an aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking
* Hands on experience on Monte Carlo simulations and range forecasting
* Exposure/sound understanding of advanced modeling techniques like Agent based and dynamic transmission model
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights
* Proven ability to communicate effectively across all levels of stakeholders
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, supply chain and marketing functions

**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**
**Required Skills**
Agent Based Modeling, Biopharmaceutics, Business Analysis, Business Management, Business Partnerships, Immunotherapy, Manufacturing, Marketing, Numerical Analysis, Oncology, Pharmaceutical Development, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Forecasting, Strategic Planning, Veterinary Medicine, Veterinary Pathology, Waterfall Model

description:

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a
**VMware Virtualisation Infrastructure Specialist**
with advanced VMware administration and troubleshooting expertise to support complex virtualisation environments. The role focuses on VMware vSphere 7.x and 8.x, VCF 9.0, VxRail, vCenter and ESXi, alongside disaster recovery and infrastructure operations. The successful candidate will also bring Windows Server administration capabilities and work collaboratively on critical incidents, service requests, changes, escalations and continuous service improvements. The role operates within a
**24x7 operational environment, including night shifts**
.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Administer and troubleshoot VMware vSphere 7.x and 8.x, VCF 9.0 and VxRail environments
* Support VMware SRM (Site Recovery Manager) 8.1 and VMware Aria administration and troubleshooting
* Diagnose and resolve critical VMware ESXi and vCenter issues, and support vCenter and ESXi upgrades
* Work with DRS, HA, vSwitch, dvSwitch, ESXCLI and ESXTOP.
* Extract and analyse vCenter reports and produce performance-analysis reports across virtualisation components.
* Troubleshoot hardware issues involving HP ProLiant and Dell servers and work with HP OneView.
* Support disaster-recovery operations, including production failover to alternate data centres and third-party sites.
* Manage incidents, service requests, changes, problems and escalated technical issues, engaging vendors where required
* Administer Windows Server environments, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
* Support Windows Server upgrades and understand Microsoft Windows Server patching lifecycle activities.
* Use PowerCLI and PowerShell scripting to support infrastructure administration and operational activities
* Identify continuous-improvement opportunities and contribute to improvements in service delivery.
* Create clear technical documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs)

**Who You Are**

* You have advanced administration and troubleshooting experience with VMware vSphere 7.x/8.x, VCF 9.0 and VxRail
* You have working knowledge of VMware SRM, VMware Aria, HP OneView, vCenter, ESXi, DRS, HA, vSwitch and dvSwitch.
* You understand virtualisation performance analysis and can use command-line tools including ESXCLI and ESXTOP.
* You have experience supporting disaster-recovery operations and infrastructure incident, change and problem management
* You have Windows administration experience covering Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPOs, server upgrades and patching
* You have experience with Windows PowerCLI and PowerShell scripting. Knowledge of TrueSight BladeLogic and VMware vRA is advantageous
* You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams and can produce detailed technical documentation.
* You can handle critical and complex issues while working collaboratively under the guidance of a delivery lead
* You are comfortable operating within ambitious timelines in a dynamic environment while maintaining a customer-focused approach.
* You hold a graduation qualification (10+2+3/4)
* You are able to work in a 24x7 operational environment, including night shifts

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
This role offers the opportunity to work across enterprise virtualisation and infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, VCF, VxRail, disaster recovery, Windows Server and infrastructure automation. You will gain exposure to complex production environments, critical troubleshooting, service improvement, vendor collaboration and international stakeholder interactions.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise in
**VMware virtualisation, VCF, VxRail, vCenter and ESXi troubleshooting, disaster recovery, infrastructure performance analysis and service improvement**

title: Assistant Crewing Manager (Ship Management)
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To ensure effective and compliant management of seafarers assigned to the designated tanker fleet, maintaining high standards of crew competence, safety, operational readiness, and service delivery in accordance with applicable international regulations, Flag State and Oil Major requirements, and Crestline’s crewing standards.

The Crewing Manager oversees crew planning, recruitment, retention, deployment, certification, training compliance, travel coordination, and cost control to ensure a continuous supply of qualified and competent personnel across the assigned fleet.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

A. Crew Planning, Recruitment and Retention

* Recruit, select, and deploy suitably qualified officers and ratings in accordance with vessel-specific requirements and company standards.
* Develop and maintain crew rotation plans to ensure timely relief, adequate manpower availability, and uninterrupted vessel operations.
* Maintain a dedicated pool of competent seafarers, focusing on the retention of experienced officers and key personnel.
* Develop succession and career progression plans for senior officers, including Masters, Chief Engineers, Chief Officers, and Second Engineers.
* Maintain contact with officers during leave periods, as appropriate, to monitor availability, engagement, and future deployment.
* Identify crew shortages, retention risks, and succession gaps, implementing appropriate mitigation measures.
* Coordinate with approved manning agents to ensure timely sourcing and deployment of suitable personnel.

B. Regulatory Compliance, Certification and Training

* Ensure all crew joining assigned vessels hold valid certificates of competency and proficiency, medical certificates, visas, Flag State endorsements, and other required documentation.
* Maintain compliance with applicable STCW, MLC 2006, Flag State, Port State, and collective bargaining agreement (CBA) requirements.
* Review and maintain the crew training and competency matrix for each rank and vessel, ensuring compliance with company, shipowner, charterer, and applicable Oil Major requirements.
* Monitor certificate validity, endorsements, medical fitness, and mandatory training, ensuring timely renewals and completion.
* Verify crew qualifications and joining documentation before deployment.
* Coordinate tanker-specific training, familiarisation, and competency development with relevant departments.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date crew records in Shipmate.

C. Crew Travel and Deployment

* Arrange and coordinate crew sign-on and sign-off travel through appointed and approved marine travel providers.
* Ensure inbound and outbound travel is booked promptly and cost-effectively, considering vessel schedules, joining ports, visa requirements, and operational priorities.
* Manage travel changes and emergencies to minimise delays, additional costs, and operational disruption.
* Liaise with vessels, manning agents, travel providers, and internal departments to ensure smooth crew movements.

D. Crew Cost Control and Budget Management

* Prepare and maintain a rolling 12-month crew cost budget and rotation plan for the top four officers on each assigned vessel, aligned with fleet and key account requirements.
* Monitor monthly crew costs in Shipmate, identifying budget variances, cost trends, and savings opportunities.
* Submit monthly crew cost reports with variance analysis, explanatory comments, and corrective actions where required.
* Maintain accurate forecasts covering crew changes, salaries, travel, training, and other crewing expenses.
* Optimise costs without compromising crew quality, safety, regulatory compliance, or operational readiness.

E. Audit, Vetting and Operational Support

* Monitor crew-related audit and vetting performance and coordinate preparations for inspections and assessments.
* Work closely with Marine, Operations, Technical, and HSEQ Departments to address crew-related findings and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure crew qualifications, training records, and competency evidence are readily available and compliant.
* Monitor applicable Oil Major, charterer, and vessel-specific requirements to maintain operational eligibility.
* Visit assigned vessels whenever practicable, particularly when calling at Singapore, to engage with seafarers and address crew-related matters.

F. Crew Management Systems and Data Administration

* Ensure effective adoption and consistent use of Shipmate across all assigned crewing activities.
* Maintain ownership of crew data, rotation schedules, certificates, training records, and related documentation.
* Ensure crew movements, costs, and documentation status are accurately recorded and promptly updated in Shipmate.
* Improve system utilisation, reporting accuracy, and crewing administration efficiency.

G. Crew Welfare, Medical and Claims Administration

* Coordinate crew medical and P&I claims, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and submitted promptly.
* Liaise with internal departments, insurers, P&I correspondents, and medical providers on crew-related claims.
* Support the handling of crew welfare concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.
* Maintain appropriate communication with seafarers to facilitate timely resolution of personnel matters.

H. Manning Agent Management and Performance

* Conduct periodic visits and performance reviews of approved manning agents.
* Conduct or coordinate audits covering recruitment practices, crew qualifications, certification, documentation, and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor agent performance in crew quality, availability, retention, responsiveness, and cost effectiveness.
* Document audit findings, agree corrective actions, and ensure timely follow-up.
* Maintain effective working relationships with manning agents to ensure reliable crew supply and continuity across the assigned fleet.

**Requirements:**

* Relevant maritime qualification, degree, or professional certification in maritime studies, crewing, human resources, or a related discipline.
* Substantial crew management experience in commercial shipping, preferably involving oil, gas, chemical, or product tankers.
* Sound knowledge of STCW, MLC 2006, Flag State requirements, tanker-specific training, crew certification, and applicable CBAs.
* Proven experience in crew planning, recruitment, retention, budgeting, and manning agent management.
* Familiarity with Oil Major vetting requirements and tanker crew competency standards.
* Experience with Shipmate or similar crew management systems.
* Strong organisational, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing operational priorities.

title: Senior System Engineer- Digital Platform
description:
Are you ready to turn machine data into real-time insights that strengthen manufacturing operations worldwide? We’re looking for a hands-on Senior System Engineer with deep expertise in industrial connectivity, automation and IoT to create seamless connections between production equipment and our digital platform.
  
  
**Here, you get the opportunity to:**

* Work with advanced digital solutions and data generated directly from the shop floor.
* Gain broad exposure to global manufacturing technologies and information flows.
* Join a product environment offering varied challenges and opportunities to grow.

**About Your Job**
In this global position, you ensure reliable connectivity between industrial machines at our production units and the digital platform. By collecting, transferring and integrating machine data, you enable real-time analysis, informed decision-making and improved machine performance.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Establish and maintain reliable data connections between industrial machines and the digital platform.
* Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.
* Develop, test and deploy protocols, interfaces and APIs that connect machines with backend systems.
* Integrate machine-generated data with digital platforms and cloud services in collaboration with data engineers and IT teams.
* Diagnose connectivity issues across Ethernet, Modbus and industrial networks, both remotely and on-site.
* Drive connectivity best practices and identify improvements that strengthen data integrity, machine uptime and infrastructure performance.

Location
  
  
This is an on-site position based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden or Pune in India. As close collaboration with production is essential, you need to be located near one of these manufacturing sites.
  
  
Your profile
  
  
You’re an experienced engineer with a strong background in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. Combining broad technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, you independently drive connectivity activities across a global manufacturing environment.

* A bachelor’s degree om electronics and communication engineering, instrumentation, computer science or a related field.
* Extensive experience in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT.
* Hands-on knowledge of Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, RESTful APIs and protocol converters or gateways.
* Experience with industrial systems such as PLCs, SCADA, DCS and sensors, as well as computer networks and TCP/IP.
* Experience with cloud platforms and data integration tools, such as Azure.
* Strong communication skills in English.

A master’s degree is beneficial. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, cybersecurity, Jenkins, Jira or databases such as SQL Server, Redis, NoSQL or DB2 is also considered an advantage.
  
  
Taking ownership comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable guiding others within your area of expertise. With patience and curiosity, you ask the right questions, understand stakeholder requirements and work through complex technical issues. Clear communication helps you collaborate across functions, segments and production units while keeping data flowing accurately and reliably.

description:

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As a Release and Environment Management Specialist you’ll manage application releases, production changes, deployment activity and environment stability across enterprise platforms. This role sits at the point where change meets operational resilience - ensuring deployments are controlled, evidenced and safe and that environments remain stable before and after change. You’ll own delivery from planning through implementation, validation and handover while partnering closely with application, infrastructure and support teams. Day to day success is measured through high-quality change documentation, controlled deployments and clear stakeholder communication. You’ll also play a key role in reducing deployment failures, build issues and repeat incidents through strong troubleshooting and practical preventative actions. The work requires disciplined change management and the technical depth to execute deployments and site switching with care.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own release and environment delivery from planning through implementation, validation, closure and handover
* Create and manage change orders with 100% quality assurance against approved change requirements
* Execute code and configuration deployments across relevant environments including retrofit activities after fixes and emergency change
* Perform site switching using F5 load-balancing technology including pre-change checks and post-change validation

title: Senior System Engineer- Digital Platform
description:
Are you ready to turn machine data into real-time insights that strengthen manufacturing operations worldwide? We’re looking for a hands-on Senior System Engineer with deep expertise in industrial connectivity, automation and IoT to create seamless connections between production equipment and our digital platform.
  
  
**Here, you get the opportunity to:**

* Work with advanced digital solutions and data generated directly from the shop floor.
* Gain broad exposure to global manufacturing technologies and information flows.
* Join a product environment offering varied challenges and opportunities to grow.

**About Your Job**
In this global position, you ensure reliable connectivity between industrial machines at our production units and the digital platform. By collecting, transferring and integrating machine data, you enable real-time analysis, informed decision-making and improved machine performance.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Establish and maintain reliable data connections between industrial machines and the digital platform.
* Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.
* Develop, test and deploy protocols, interfaces and APIs that connect machines with backend systems.
* Integrate machine-generated data with digital platforms and cloud services in collaboration with data engineers and IT teams.
* Diagnose connectivity issues across Ethernet, Modbus and industrial networks, both remotely and on-site.
* Drive connectivity best practices and identify improvements that strengthen data integrity, machine uptime and infrastructure performance.

Location
  
  
This is an on-site position based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden or Pune in India. As close collaboration with production is essential, you need to be located near one of these manufacturing sites.
  
  
Your profile
  
  
You’re an experienced engineer with a strong background in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. Combining broad technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, you independently drive connectivity activities across a global manufacturing environment.
  
  
Your background includes
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree om electronics and communication engineering, instrumentation, computer science or a related field.
* Extensive experience in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT.
* Hands-on knowledge of Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, RESTful APIs and protocol converters or gateways.
* Experience with industrial systems such as PLCs, SCADA, DCS and sensors, as well as computer networks and TCP/IP.
* Experience with cloud platforms and data integration tools, such as Azure.
* Strong communication skills in English.

A master’s degree is beneficial. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, cybersecurity, Jenkins, Jira or databases such as SQL Server, Redis, NoSQL or DB2 is also considered an advantage.
  
  
Taking ownership comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable guiding others within your area of expertise. With patience and curiosity, you ask the right questions, understand stakeholder requirements and work through complex technical issues. Clear communication helps you collaborate across functions, segments and production units while keeping data flowing accurately and reliably.
  
  
Our culture
  
  
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

title: Sr Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**Sales & Business Development Manager - Industrial Automation**

About the Company: A leading automation MNC with twenty sites worldwide, offers a broad range of solutions,

including assembly and test automation in Pune is looking for Business Development Manager for Pune

headquarters.

Department: Sales & Business Development Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India

Experience: 10-15 years Reporting To: General Manager / Managing Director

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for driving business growth, developing strategic

customer relationships, identifying new market opportunities, and achieving annual order intake and profitability

targets for industrial automation solutions. The role requires a combination of technical sales expertise, strategic

business development, commercial negotiation, and team leadership, with a strong focus on customized assembly

lines, special-purpose machines (SPM), robotic automation, and testing systems.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

A. Sales Strategy & Business Development

Develop and implement sales and business development strategies aligned with the company's growth objectives.

Identify new business opportunities, target industries, and potential customers in India and international markets,

where applicable.

Develop new accounts and expand business with existing customers.

Establish and maintain relationships with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and customers in automotive

electronics, electrical and electronics, medical technology, and other relevant industries.

Identify upcoming customer investments, new manufacturing programs, plant expansions, and automation

requirements.

Build a robust sales pipeline and ensure a healthy portfolio of short-term and long-term opportunities.

Achieve annual targets for order intake, revenue, and profitability.

B. Key Account Management

Develop strategic relationships with key customers and decision-makers across engineering, manufacturing,

purchasing, and management functions.

Understand customer requirements, investment plans, technical challenges, and long-term automation strategies.

Conduct regular customer visits, business reviews, technical presentations, and commercial discussions.

Develop account plans to increase customer penetration and secure repeat business.

Resolve escalated customer concerns and maintain long-term business relationships.

Business Development Manager - Job Description Page 1 of 3

C. Technical Sales & Solution Development

Understand customer RFQs, technical specifications, manufacturing processes, and automation requirements.

Coordinate with engineering teams to develop competitive automation concepts and technical solutions.

Lead technical and commercial discussions, including project scope, feasibility, costing, pricing, and delivery

schedules.

Ensure timely submission of high-quality technical and commercial proposals.

Promote solutions such as customized assembly lines, special-purpose machines (SPM), robotic automation and

material handling systems, assembly and testing equipment, end-of-line testing systems, automotive electronics &

sensor assembly automation, and turnkey manufacturing solutions.

D. Commercial Management & Order Closure

Lead commercial negotiations with customers to achieve competitive pricing and targeted project margins.

Review quotations, costing assumptions, risk provisions, payment terms, and commercial conditions before

submission or final negotiation, in line with company approval procedures.

Drive quotation follow-ups and convert opportunities into confirmed purchase orders.

Evaluate project profitability, commercial risks, customer creditworthiness, and contractual obligations.

Coordinate with finance and management for customer financing requirements, advance payments, and payment

milestones.

Ensure proper handover of confirmed orders to project management and engineering teams.

E. Market Intelligence & Strategic Planning

Monitor market trends, customer investment plans, competitor activities, and industry developments.

Identify new sectors, technologies, and geographical markets with growth potential.

Prepare market development plans and recommend strategic actions to strengthen the company's market

position.

Analyze lost orders and competitor quotations to identify areas for improvement.

Support management in preparing annual budgets, sales forecasts, and business growth plans.

F. Sales Pipeline & Performance Management

Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity tracking, and customer records in the CRM/ERP system.

Conduct regular pipeline reviews and report order intake forecasts, probability of conversion, expected order

timing, and major business risks.

Track quotations, customer feedback, order conversion rates, and sales performance against targets.

Prepare monthly and quarterly sales reports for management. Ensure systematic follow-up of all active RFQs.

G. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Coordination

Lead, guide, and develop the sales and business development team. Define individual sales targets and

performance objectives.

Coach team members on technical sales, customer engagement, negotiation, and opportunity management.

Coordinate with engineering, project management, procurement, production, and finance teams to ensure

alignment between customer commitments and execution capabilities.

Represent the company at customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and business development forums.

**3. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management will be an added advantage.

10-15 years of experience in industrial automation sales, technical sales, or business development.

At least 3-5 years of experience in a sales leadership or business development management role is preferred.

Proven experience in selling customized automation equipment, assembly lines, SPMs, robotic systems, or testing

equipment.

Established relationships with automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, or industrial manufacturing customers will be an

advantage.

**4. KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

Strong technical understanding of industrial automation and manufacturing processes.

Excellent business development, networking, and strategic account management skills.

Strong commercial negotiation, pricing, costing, and contract management capabilities.

Ability to understand technical RFQs and coordinate the development of competitive solutions.

Proficiency in MS Office, CRM, and ERP systems. Willingness to travel extensively as required.

5. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS) & DELIVERABLES

Order Intake & Pipeline: Achievement of annual order booking targets and maintenance of a qualified sales

pipeline.

Conversion & Profitability: Improvement in quotation-to-order conversion rate and achievement of targeted
