title: Fleet Supply Executive - Pune
description:
**Fleet Supply Executive**

**Location:**
Pune

**Department:**
Fleet Ops. - Supply

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Fleet Supply Executive to drive the acquisition, onboarding, activation and ongoing

management of delivery partners across assigned locations. The role will focus on building a strong and reliable delivery partner fleet by identifying area-wise supply requirements, sourcing new partners, managing the onboarding funnel, improving activation and retaining existing partners. The executive will work closely with field recruiters and internal teams to ensure a consistent pipeline of delivery partners and healthy fleet availability across key areas.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target-oriented and comfortable managing field teams and engaging with delivery partners in a fast-paced environment.

**1. Fleet Acquisition & Sourcing**

* Drive delivery partner acquisition to meet location-wise and area-wise fleet requirements.
* Identify high-potential sourcing locations, rider catchment areas and relevant acquisition channels.
* Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of prospective delivery partners through field sourcing, referrals, local networks and other channels.
* Plan and execute on-ground acquisition activities to generate qualified partner leads.
* Set daily and weekly acquisition targets and ensure consistent progress against them.
* Track lead generation, follow-ups, conversion and joining performance to improve acquisition efficiency.

**2. Onboarding & Activation**

* Own the delivery partner onboarding journey from initial enquiry through registration, verification and activation.
* Coordinate with onboarding and verification teams to ensure timely completion of partner documentation and formalities.
* Drive newly onboarded partners to complete their first order and become active on the platform.
* Monitor the onboarding funnel and identify reasons for partner drop-offs at each stage.
* Follow up with pending and partially onboarded partners to improve conversion and activation rates.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, onboarding status, activation and first-order completion.

**3. Existing Fleet Management, Engagement & Retention**

* Manage and build relationships with the existing delivery partner fleet across assigned areas.
* Track partner activity levels and identify inactive, low-activity and at-risk partners.
* Drive partner reactivation initiatives to bring inactive partners back onto the platform.
* Conduct regular partner interactions and field visits to understand concerns, expectations and reasons for inactivity.
* Communicate partner earning opportunities, incentive programmes, referral schemes and relevant policy updates.
* Develop engagement initiatives that improve partner participation, satisfaction and long-term retention.
* Identify recurring reasons for partner churn and recommend initiatives to improve fleet stability.

**4. Field Team & Recruitment Management**

* Coordinate and manage field recruiters or acquisition executives to achieve assigned fleet acquisition targets.
* Allocate sourcing areas and daily activity plans to the field acquisition team.
* Monitor individual team performance across lead generation, partner onboarding and activation.
* Conduct regular reviews, provide guidance and support the team in improving conversion and productivity.
* Ensure field team members maintain accurate lead and partner acquisition trackers.
* Identify hiring or sourcing capacity gaps and escalate requirements to the relevant team.

**5. Area-wise Fleet Planning & Supply Growth**

* Understand area-wise fleet requirements and identify locations where additional delivery partners need to be acquired.
* Maintain visibility of active, inactive and newly onboarded partners across assigned areas.
* Prioritise acquisition efforts based on identified supply gaps, partner availability and business growth requirements.
* Recommend local sourcing strategies to strengthen fleet coverage in priority areas.
* Work with internal stakeholders to align acquisition plans with changing supply requirements.

**6. Reporting & Performance Tracking**

* Maintain daily and weekly trackers covering leads generated, partners onboarded, activated and retained.
* Prepare regular updates on acquisition pipeline, conversion rates, activation performance and field team
* productivity.
* Track key performance indicators and take corrective action where targets are not being achieved.
* Highlight sourcing challenges, onboarding bottlenecks and partner churn trends with supporting data.
* Share progress against assigned acquisition and fleet growth targets with the reporting manager.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong communication, interpersonal and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to acquire, onboard and engage delivery partners at scale.
* Experience in field recruitment, lead generation and target-driven sourcing.
* Strong team coordination and the ability to manage field acquisition teams.
* Good understanding of delivery partner behavior, fleet supply and last-mile delivery ecosystems.
* Strong follow-up, negotiation and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and basic performance trackers.
* Self-driven, organized and comfortable working towards daily and monthly targets.
* Willingness to travel locally for field visits and partner acquisition activities.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in fleet acquisition, delivery partner onboarding, field recruitment, logistics, e-commerce, food delivery, quick commerce or similar sectors.
* Experience working with delivery partners, riders, drivers, field recruiters or on-ground acquisition teams.
* Prior experience in managing sourcing targets, onboarding funnels or partner engagement initiatives will be preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an aptitude for field acquisition may also be considered.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* New delivery partner leads generated against assigned targets.
* New delivery partner acquisition and joining rate.
* Onboarding completion and verification rate.
* New partner activation and first-order completion rate.
* Onboarding funnel conversion and drop-off rate.
* Active fleet growth across assigned areas.
* Existing partner retention and reactivation rate.
* Reduction in partner inactivity and churn.
* Field recruiter productivity and target achievement.
* Area-wise fleet supply gap closure.

title: Proposal Associate
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Our global team continue to our focus on building relationships and delighting our clients (90% of our business is repeat business). In return we have opportunities to work on unique and exciting projects, and a stable platform upon which to develop your career, and a diverse workforce culture where we truly encourage you to bring your whole self to every aspect of your work.
  
  
By working together in international teams and with different perspectives, we gain the experience that is our collective strength. In Jacobs, every day is a chance to make the world a better place - let's design your career with us!
  
  

* As Proposal Associate you will provide ownership of the end-to-end opportunity, working with Subject Matter Experts to develop value propositions that position to win work.
* You own the quality and presentation of our submissions and work with the teams to determine the best approach and style of response.
* The working environment is fast paced, and it is essential to have the ability to balance technical and commercial differentiation to support the Sales Lead in presenting the perfect balance that wins projects which fit our vision.
* You are to be effective at bringing the ideas of others to market; have good judgment about which ideas and suggestions could work; and be able to coordinate the work winning and creative process of others as part of an opportunity team either in a lead or coordinator capacity.
* Working with a high degree of autonomy, you have excellent communication skills and are comfortable with managing priorities and deadlines.
* Highly developed soft skills relating to facilitation, conflict resolution, time management, and instilling an inclusive culture within the opportunity team are all of value.
* Assertiveness and influencing skills ensure your success working with stakeholders in this high-pressured environment. In addition, an ability to work and train team members to use Microsoft, CRM Salesforce, SharePoint, and InDesign are all considered advantageous.
* This is the perfect role for someone who enjoys leading proposal sessions and developing outstanding content.
* Jacobs’ Relationship-Based Sales methodology -
* Champion and lead the implementation of our Relationship-Based Sales (RBS) methodology - especially in Middle Game and End Game for Tier 1 & 2 pursuits. - Apply best practice RBS process to pursuits.
* Work with Sales Leads and Capture Managers/ Operations to develop B&P estimate, gain approval, regularly monitor B&P spending, and report any significant variances of the specific opportunities.
* SOX and ISO certification compliance for the entire proposal is adhered too as it related to the RBS/sales process as part of the opportunity close-out.
* Particularly in relation to governance and recording of Bid/No Bid decisions, Green Reviews, and Sales to Operations handover.
* Develop understanding in review of client terms & conditions, pricing strategies and Jacobs’ financial metrics.
* Work within core Sales Systems and Tools (e.g. CSP, SharePoint and Knowledge Centre). Sales and Marketing Materials & Knowledge
* Develop and maintain qualification materials including project descriptions, experience matrices/overviews, safety and quality statistics, capability statements. Work with Operations to capture and develop performance proofs and client testimonials relevant to the opportunity/proposals.
* Collaborate with Sales Lead and Capture Manager/ Operations in developing distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position relating to Opening Game.
* Share sales materials, information, knowledge, and best practices with other Sales Operations team members company wide.
* Jacobs’ Brand Representative
* Lead by example, be proactive in ensuring health and safety of opportunity team throughout.
* Be an advocate of our BeyondZero culture and company values.
* Lead compliance with our Corporate Identity Program and client confidentiality requirements for all sales documents relating to the opportunity/proposals.
* Provide support to Global Sales e.g., timely preparation of press releases, providing input to our Annual Report, and support of Global Sales initiatives as appropriate.
* Champion Jacobs brand, including working within Brand Guidelines for visual identity and brand voice.
* Opening Game/ Market & Account Strategy - Partner with Market Sales Director, Head of Sector and S&T in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor & market research, development of Market Roadmaps.
* Support Sales Leads and Client Account Managers (CAMs) in key Opening Game activities, e.g. client, competitor and market research, development of documented Core Client Strategies, participation in 101s, development of Executive Summaries and White Papers.
* For the industry sectors pursued by your team, develop an understanding of our corporate, regional, and office qualifications including technical, managerial, commercial and competitive strengths that differentiate Jacobs in the marketplace.
* Leverage global network to identify & convey Jacobs’ unique capabilities & resources. Collaborate with S&T and Outside Sales to develop Capability Statements and White Papers. -
* Client Go / No Go and Account Reviews and Focus Windows as required.
* Conduct/ facilitate 101 meetings for key accounts, in partnership with outside Sales. Middle Game (Opportunities)
* Organise, direct, and motivate a multidiscipline opportunity team to develop Middle Game win plans and strategic sales actions and deliverables, or stimulate the assignment of teams for assigned opportunities.
* Actively initiate and partner with sales leads, CAMs and Capture Managers to develop and implement Middle Game action plan, e.g. document due diligence in project brief, develop Win Plan (G to VP), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary, conduct initiate Go/No Go and strategy review, and identify delivery team.
* Actively work with Sales and Operations to develop, implement and monitor Middle Game actions, using Client Success Platform (CSP) [Salesforce] & SharePoint. - Conduct Opportunity Go/No Go and strategy reviews in CSP. - Develop Win Plan (Gaps to Value Proposition), SWOT analysis, and Executive Summary.
* Identify execution/delivery teams, coach and support them in the win strategy.
* Challenge concepts, solutions and assumptions in constructive ways to truly differentiate and develop unique value propositions. End Game (Bids & Proposals)
* Arrange or lead the planning and of all elements of End Game, e.g. analyse client request, develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance check-list, response outline, schedule), initiate Go/No Go, conduct Pink Team, conduct kick-off meeting, manage and work with team to develop response sections, refine Executive Summary, conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, schedule Pricing Reviews, ensure on-time delivery of response
* Champion use of Client Success Platform (CSP) for approvals & linked SharePoint for End Game document collaboration.
* Analyse client requests & develop response plan (B&P budget, response team, compliance checklist, writing plan, response outline, schedule).
* When leading an opportunity; initiate Opportunity Bid/No-Bid meetings, conduct Pink Teams, conduct kick-off meetings and record all approvals in CSP, or else check compliance of opportunities assigned to you.
* When leading an opportunity, manage and work with team to develop response sections, especially value propositions and Executive Summaries or else check compliance of opportunities.
* When leading an opportunity conduct in-progress reviews, prepare Red Team package, incorporate Red Team input, Schedule Pricing Reviews. Conduct and record approvals in CSP or else check compliance of opportunities /proposals.
* Ensure on-time delivery of any response within the assigned opportunity. - Support or check if the opportunity close out processes after submission including collaboration with knowledge management is completed.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or any relevant Degree with around 9+ years of experience. \* Solution-selling strategy development
* Writing skills
* Marketing/sales coordination
* Facilitation, influencing and group process
* Opportunity/ bid / proposal management
* Business acumen
* Time management and task coordination
* Influencing stakeholders

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: Reservations Associate (Hospitality)
description:
**US Shift Timings : 4PM - 2AM**

**Location - Pune (Yerwada)**

**Work From Office (Mon - Fri)**

**Job Description: Reservations Associate**

**About Us:**

Atica is a leading, tech-first remote sales & revenue management company for Hotels and Hotel operators in the US, enabled by a unified tech-led solution. We are a startup, funded by the top investors in the country, like Titan Capital, DIBS. As innovators at the forefront of the industry, we strive to deliver the highest quality service to all our clients while setting new standards for efficiency and effectiveness. We aspire to build high-quality, innovative & robust software that makes an impact!

**Find more about us!**

https://www.aticaglobal.com

https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica-global

**Role Purpose**

The Reservations Manager at Atica acts as the virtual reservations hub for multiple US hotel clients simultaneously. You are responsible for maximizing revenue captured from every incoming reservation inquiry — through calls, emails, OTA platforms, and direct website bookings — while ensuring seamless reservation operations for the hotel's front desk and management team.

This is not a passive, reactive role. You will proactively identify upsell opportunities, ensure rate parity across all booking channels, manage group and corporate reservation blocks, and be the first point of escalation for reservation-related client concerns. Your work directly feeds into the hotel's RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy numbers — the metrics Atica is hired to move.

Because hotel clients are on month-to-month contracts with 30-day exit clauses, the Reservations Manager must deliver consistent, visible value every single month.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Reservations Operations & Conversion

\* Handle all incoming reservation inquiries across channels: phone, email, OTA platforms (Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda, etc.), and the hotel's direct booking website.

\* Convert every qualified inquiry into a confirmed reservation — maximizing conversion rate while upselling room types, packages, and add-ons where applicable.

\* Respond to all reservation queries promptly (within SLA) to minimize lead leakage and lost revenue.

\* Manage waitlists, room-type availability, and booking modifications or cancellations professionally and accurately.

\* Ensure all reservations are entered correctly into the Property Management System (PMS) with complete guest details, rate codes, and special requests.

**2. Rate Management & Channel Parity**

\* Monitor and maintain rate parity across all OTA channels and the hotel's direct booking website — no undercutting, no discrepancies.

\* Work in close coordination with the Revenue Manager to implement rate strategies and ensure the right rates are loaded and live across all channels at all times.

\* Identify and flag rate loading errors, missing promotions, or channel-level discrepancies that could cause revenue leakage.

\* Update seasonal rates, promotional packages, and special offers across channels as directed by the Revenue Manager.

**3. Corporate & Group Reservations**

\* Manage all corporate account reservations — ensuring contracted rates are correctly applied, rooming lists are accurate, and billing instructions are set up correctly.

\* Handle group booking blocks: cut-off dates, pickup tracking, attrition management, and coordination with the hotel's front desk for arrival readiness.

\* Respond to group RFP inquiries and coordinate with the Sales Manager on quotes, contracts, and follow-ups for group business conversion.

\* Liaise with in-house guests and corporate bookers to identify opportunities for extended stays or recurring negotiated business.

**4. OTA & Distribution Channel Management**

\* Ensure accurate hotel listing content on all OTA platforms: room descriptions, photos, amenity listings, policies, and content scores.

\* Monitor OTA dashboards for booking trends, cancellation rates, and competitor positioning — flagging insights to the Revenue Manager.

\* Manage allotments and stop-sell/open-sell decisions in real time based on occupancy levels and Revenue Manager guidance.

\* Support the launch and optimization of the hotel on new distribution channels (wholesalers, meta-search, B2B platforms) as Atica expands the hotel's distribution footprint.

**5. Client Communication & Relationship Management**

\* Act as the day-to-day reservations point of contact for assigned hotel clients — responding professionally and promptly to all reservation-related queries.

\* Build strong working relationships with hotel GMs and front desk teams to ensure smooth coordination between Atica's remote reservations function and on-property operations.

\* Provide weekly and monthly reservations performance summaries to hotel clients: bookings by channel, ADR, cancellations, and pick-up trends.

\* Navigate cultural nuances when communicating with US-based clients — professional, confident, and clear at all times.

**6. Ancillary Reservations Support**

\* OTA Reconciliation: Review monthly OTA invoices and flag any erroneous charges or commission discrepancies for resolution.

\* OTA Revenue Recovery: Track and charge Virtual Credit Cards (VCCs) from past bookings to ensure all realized revenue is collected.

\* Reputation Management Support: Flag guest concerns surfaced during reservation interactions that may impact online reviews; coordinate with the team on service recovery.

\* Direct.com Bookings: Support the hotel's direct website bookings by responding to queries, applying promotions, and tracking booking engine performance.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualifications**

\* 0–3 years of experience in hotel reservations, front office operations, or a related hospitality role.

\* Strong working knowledge of OTA platforms (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Hotels.com) — listing management, extranets, and rate loading.

\* Hands-on experience with a Property Management System (PMS) — Opera, Cloudbeds, Mews, or similar.

\* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills — you will interact with US-based hotel clients and guests daily.

\* High attention to detail: rate codes, rooming lists, billing instructions, and reservation accuracy are non-negotiable.

\* Ability to multitask across multiple hotel accounts simultaneously without compromising quality.

\* Comfortable working the 7 PM – 5 AM IST shift to align with US business hours.

\* Working on weekends as per requirement

\* Work-from-office commitment at our India headquarters.

**Good-to-Have**

\* Experience with Revenue Management Systems (RMS) — understanding how rates and inventory are managed in real time.

\* Familiarity with branded hotel systems — Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Wyndham, or Choice Hotels platforms and standards.

\* Prior experience handling corporate RFPs, group blocks, or negotiated rate contracts.

\* Understanding of B2B distribution channels — wholesalers (HotelBeds, WebBeds), travel management companies, or GDS.

\* Startup mindset: adaptable, proactive, and comfortable building processes in an evolving environment.

**Why Join Us**

Build a vertical from scratch—not just manage one.

Competitive salary + performance-linked bonus.

CTC aligned with experience & market benchmarks.

Direct exposure to demand partners, US hotel stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Clear career growth path in Distribution & Operations leadership

title: Senior Staff SDET
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We're looking for a Senior Staff SDET to set the technical direction for test engineering across our Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) products. You'll be a hands-on technical leader. You'll design and build scalable test frameworks and infrastructure, influence product architecture for testability, and raise engineering quality standards across several teams.
  
  
You'll work closely with Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Product leadership so we can ship reliable, secure, high-performance identity solutions to enterprise customers at speed.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test architecture: Define and own the test architecture and automation strategy for the IGA platform, spanning unit, API, contract, integration, UI, and end-to-end testing.
  
  
Frameworks and infrastructure: Design, build, and evolve reusable test frameworks, tools, and test environments that scale across teams and microservices.
  
  
CI/CD quality gates: Embed automated testing deep into CI/CD pipelines. Push for fast, reliable feedback, parallel execution, and fewer flaky tests.
  
  
Domain test coverage: Lead test design for complex IGA flows, including:
  
  
Identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver)
  
  
Provisioning and deprovisioning
  
  
Access requests and approvals
  
  
Certification campaigns
  
  
Connectors to systems such as Active Directory, Entra ID, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, and SaaS apps
  
  
Technical leadership: Act as the senior technical authority on quality. Review designs and code, mentor SDETs and developers, and set best practices and standards across the division.
  
  
Shift-left and developer productivity: Partner with development teams to improve testability, contract testing, mocking and service virtualization, and test data management.
  
  
Observability and metrics: Define quality metrics and dashboards such as coverage, flakiness, defect leakage, and pipeline health, and use the data to drive decisions.
  
  
Innovation: Evaluate and introduce new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted testing, test impact analysis, and chaos engineering.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
8 or more years in software engineering or test engineering
  
  
Strong coding skills in one or more of Java, C#, Python, TypeScript, or Go, with solid software design principles.
  
  
Deep experience building automation frameworks with tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, REST Assured, Pact, TestNG/JUnit, or pytest.
  
  
Excellent communication skills and a track record of mentoring engineers.
  
  
Experience with IAM or IGA platforms (for example SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, One Identity, or Microsoft Entra).
  
  
**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Java Tech Lead
description:
Join us as a Java Tech Lead at Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful Java Tech Lead you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Strong hands-on expertise in:

+ Java (Core Java, Java 8+) and Spring Boot
+ Microservices architecture & REST APIs
+ SQL/NoSQL databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)

* Experience with:

+ Distributed systems, event-driven architecture (Kafka/MQ)
+ CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows
+ Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes / OpenShift)
* UI technologies (Angular / React) for full-stack exposure
* Knowledge of risk, finance, or investment banking domains
* Exposure to AI/ML integration or data platforms
* Performance engineering, observability, and monitoring tools

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards.
* Creation and execution automated test scripts, leveraging testing frameworks and tools to facilitate early detection of defects and quality issues.         .
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to analyse requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to the development of acceptance criteria, ensuring a thorough understanding of the software being tested.
* Root cause analysis for identified defects, working closely with developers to provide detailed information and support defect resolution.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

* Own and drive the testing strategy across the project lifecycle.
* Define and manage test approaches, test plans, test readiness criteria, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with project requirements, system specifications, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational scenario validation to ensure the system performs effectively under realistic operating conditions.
* Approve test readiness and ensure required prerequisites are in place before testing activities commence.
* Lead and coordinate FAT, IHT, SFT, SAT, and other system acceptance activities as applicable.
* Monitor overall testing progress and provide clear reporting to project leadership.

* Lead customer test workshops and facilitate technical discussions related to system testing and acceptance.
* Act as the key testing interface between the customer and internal engineering teams.
* Present test results, issues, risks, and mitigation plans to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and ensure alignment between customer requirements and testing outcomes.
* Participate in engineering discussions, design reviews, and system-level technical meetings.

* Coordinate testing activities across software, controls, electrical, mechanical, simulation, and other engineering disciplines.
* Drive system integration activities and ensure interfaces between disciplines are properly validated.
* Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues.
* Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team.
* Support and mentor junior engineers and promote consistent testing practices.

* Identify testing-related project risks and support the development of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Drive defect investigations and ensure critical issues are followed through to resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, methodologies, and system validation.

**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**

We are seeking an experienced
**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**
to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.
  
  
This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.
  
  
The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. * Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.
* The successful candidate is expected to incorporate approved AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day engineering activities, including:
* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.

title: Emulation Verification Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Invent the future with us.**
Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.
  
  
As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications.
  
  
Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we’d love to have you apply!
  
  
**About The Role**
As a part of the Emulation Team at Ampere, you will be part of verification of the next generation of microprocessor cores on hardware emulation platform by developing and deploying new capabilities and test content to accelerate bug finding in pre-silicon.
  
  
Design Verification is an integral part of the chip design process that ensures our customers get the absolute highest quality products that meets their functional and performance requirements. The Emulation Team at Ampere Computing comprises of stellar folks who have dedicated themselves to the art and fun of design verification. We are a tight knit, fast-paced team who work extremely closely with our design and architecture partners to ensure no bug is left behind.
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**
Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Builld emulation models from RTL to run test content, using industry standard emulation platform technology.
* Develop enhancements to emulation framework and testbench using SystemC, Python and System Verilog
* Contribute to enabling and development of new emulation capabilities in the domains spanning from In-Circuit emulation to Simulation acceleration.
* Collaborate with team members and vendor to optimize emulation capacity and performance of different design models
* Contribute to triaging of failures in the domain of emulation technology and work with vendor to resolve those.

**About You**
Demonstrated experience in more than one of the following areas:
  
  

* Emulation technology of Zebu, Palladium or Mentor Veloce is strongly recommended .
* Experience on Prototyping (Cadence Protium, HAPS) solutions, Speedbridge would be preferred.
* Good understanding of modern SystemVerilog for design and verification.
* Strong software development experience in compiled (C/C++) and interpreted (Python, Tcl) languages
* Strong hardware/software co-debug skills.
* Experience with synthesizing and optimizing designs and verification components developed in synthesizable Verilog.
* Experience in using Palladium, Protium, CadenceEmulation
* Self-motivated engineer with passion for innovation and demonstrated out-of-box thinking is strongly required.
* M.Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 3+ years of semiconductor experience or B.Tech in Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering with 5+ years of semiconductor experience

**What We’ll Offer**
At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits.
  
  
**Benefits Highlights Include**

* Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work.
* Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance
* Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day.

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
  
  
Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

title: Non-Functional Testing Manager - Vice President
description:
**IT Quality Manager – Non-Functional Testing (NFT)**
**Role Summary**
The IT Quality Manager is responsible for leading Non-Functional Testing (NFT) initiatives across multiple technology programs, ensuring application stability, scalability, performance, resilience, and production readiness. The role requires deep expertise in performance engineering, test strategy, environment coordination, and stakeholder management. The individual works closely with development teams, QA teams, infrastructure teams, production support teams, DBAs, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of testing objectives and quality outcomes.
  
  
The position requires strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills to manage testing activities across multiple projects, influence stakeholders, drive quality improvements, and ensure adherence to enterprise testing standards and controls.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead Non-Functional Testing (NFT) activities across multiple applications and strategic technology initiatives.
* Define and implement performance, scalability, resilience, capacity, and reliability testing strategies aligned with project objectives.
* Develop NFT test plans, schedules, execution approaches, success criteria, and reporting metrics.
* Coordinate testing activities across development, QA, infrastructure, environment management, database, middleware, and production support teams.
* Drive performance engineering best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Analyze application performance trends and identify optimization opportunities to improve system stability and user experience.
* Manage NFT environments, test data requirements, execution schedules, defect triage, and issue resolution activities.
* Provide leadership during performance testing cycles, including bottleneck analysis, root-cause investigations, and remediation planning.
* Ensure adherence to Citi testing standards, governance requirements, and quality controls.
* Collaborate with project managers and technology leadership to assess testing scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, risks, and delivery timelines.
* Manage NFT resource planning, workload balancing, and allocation across multiple concurrent programs.
* Produce testing dashboards, executive summaries, risk assessments, and quality metrics for stakeholders and senior management.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, process optimization, test efficiency, and quality outcomes.
* Support staffing, onboarding, mentoring, and career development activities for testing resources.
* Partner with global and regional teams to ensure consistent delivery standards and operational excellence.
* Participate in release readiness reviews and provide NFT sign-off recommendations based on testing outcomes.
* Proactively identify and escalate risks that could impact application performance, stability, or production readiness.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in Software Testing, Quality Engineering, or Non-Functional Testing.
* Strong experience with performance testing and performance engineering methodologies.
* Hands-on knowledge of NFT tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Grafana, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with capacity planning, resiliency testing, performance monitoring, and production readiness assessments.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile, and Quality Engineering practices.
* Proven ability to manage testing activities across multiple concurrent projects.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Experience coordinating with development, infrastructure, database, middleware, and production support teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to manage complex issues and drive resolution.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.
* Lead end-to-end Quality Engineering and Non-Functional Testing (NFT) strategy for the LMS GCE platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, resiliency, and production readiness across critical business services.
* Partner with application development, architecture, DevOps, infrastructure, and production support teams to establish quality gates and drive shift-left testing practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Drive adoption of CI/CD-based quality controls by integrating automated functional, API, performance, and regression testing into deployment pipelines, reducing release risk and accelerating delivery timelines.
* Define and implement automated test execution frameworks within CI/CD pipelines using industry-standard tools, enabling continuous validation and rapid feedback for development teams.
* Establish release-readiness criteria, quality metrics, and deployment governance processes to support frequent and reliable production releases across LMS GCE applications.
* Lead performance engineering initiatives, including capacity planning, workload modeling, bottleneck analysis, and production performance validation to ensure business-critical applications meet SLA commitments.
* Develop quality dashboards and executive reporting that provide visibility into test coverage, defect leakage, release health, pipeline efficiency, and overall application stability.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to drive modernization of testing practices through test automation, AI-assisted quality engineering, continuous testing, and DevSecOps adoption.
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual testing effort, improving deployment success rates, and increasing automation coverage across LMS GCE technology portfolios.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to quality engineering teams, fostering a culture of innovation, automation-first thinking, and operational excellence.
* Partner with engineering leadership to define testing roadmaps, resource strategies, and quality objectives aligned with LMS GCE business priorities and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise risk, audit, and control requirements by embedding quality controls, traceability, and automated validation checkpoints throughout the CI/CD delivery process.

title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-PYTHON and SQL-STAFF
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Staff – Python & Advanced SQL**
**Staff – Software Engineering**
**Experience: Strictly 2+ years**
**Eligibility requirement:**
Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
* Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
* Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
* Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
* Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
* Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
* Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
* Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
* APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
* Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
* Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to explain technical findings and data issues clearly to both engineering and compliance stakeholders.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Senior System Engineer- Digital Platform
description:
Are you ready to turn machine data into real-time insights that strengthen manufacturing operations worldwide? We’re looking for a hands-on Senior System Engineer with deep expertise in industrial connectivity, automation and IoT to create seamless connections between production equipment and our digital platform.
  
  
**Here, you get the opportunity to:**

* Work with advanced digital solutions and data generated directly from the shop floor.
* Gain broad exposure to global manufacturing technologies and information flows.
* Join a product environment offering varied challenges and opportunities to grow.

**About Your Job**
In this global position, you ensure reliable connectivity between industrial machines at our production units and the digital platform. By collecting, transferring and integrating machine data, you enable real-time analysis, informed decision-making and improved machine performance.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Establish and maintain reliable data connections between industrial machines and the digital platform.
* Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.
* Develop, test and deploy protocols, interfaces and APIs that connect machines with backend systems.
* Integrate machine-generated data with digital platforms and cloud services in collaboration with data engineers and IT teams.
* Diagnose connectivity issues across Ethernet, Modbus and industrial networks, both remotely and on-site.
* Drive connectivity best practices and identify improvements that strengthen data integrity, machine uptime and infrastructure performance.

Location
  
  
This is an on-site position based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden or Pune in India. As close collaboration with production is essential, you need to be located near one of these manufacturing sites.
  
  
Your profile
  
  
You’re an experienced engineer with a strong background in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. Combining broad technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, you independently drive connectivity activities across a global manufacturing environment.
  
  
Your background includes
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree om electronics and communication engineering, instrumentation, computer science or a related field.
* Extensive experience in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT.
* Hands-on knowledge of Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, RESTful APIs and protocol converters or gateways.
* Experience with industrial systems such as PLCs, SCADA, DCS and sensors, as well as computer networks and TCP/IP.
* Experience with cloud platforms and data integration tools, such as Azure.
* Strong communication skills in English.

A master’s degree is beneficial. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, cybersecurity, Jenkins, Jira or databases such as SQL Server, Redis, NoSQL or DB2 is also considered an advantage.
  
  
Taking ownership comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable guiding others within your area of expertise. With patience and curiosity, you ask the right questions, understand stakeholder requirements and work through complex technical issues. Clear communication helps you collaborate across functions, segments and production units while keeping data flowing accurately and reliably.
  
  
Our culture
  
  
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Microsoft Power BI Professionals in the following areas :**
We are looking forward to hiring Power BI consultant who thrives on challenges and desires to make a real difference in the business world with an environment of extraordinary innovation and unprecedented growth. * Strong hands-on experience designing and supporting complex enterprise Power BI solutions, including dashboards, reports, semantic models, and advanced analytics.
