title: Director, Analytics
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Analytics team is seeking a Director to join and lead the team. The Analytics team is a globally distributed team core to Addepar's transition to next-generation data and analytics with a scalable global operating model. Its mission is to empower analysts, researchers, and internal teams to create and share data and insights - driving data driven decision making at scale. The Director will define and execute the strategic vision for the function, while driving operationalisation, governance, and platform maturity across regions.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute a unified analytics strategy in partnership with key stakeholders, with a published roadmap reviewed quarterly
* Serve as a culture carrier and visible leader for the APAC region, bridging local teams with global priorities
* Lead BI and platform strategy, including persona-driven architecture and enablement paths for power users, consumers, executives, and producers
* Lead global expansion of the analytics platform - hardening existing regional implementations and validating a repeatable architecture for new regions
* Drive the operationalisation of the data estate - establishing observability, SLOs, and handoff standards so that ops teams can own production feeds
* Own and drive Data Governance outcomes for Analytics - identifying Critical Data Elements, automating publisher responsibilities into workflows, and building an AI-ready data estate in partnership with the broader Data Governance function to establish Analytics as the pace-setter for governance standards across the organisation

**Who You Are**

* B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Mathematics, Statistics, or similar numerate field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Minimum 12+ years of overall relevant working experience.
* Experience in leading Analytics functions in a global SaaS context.
* Strong Leadership and Strategic skills - Strategic Influence, Change Leadership, Prioritization Discipline
* Experience as a regional leader — visible presence, local culture building, bridging regional and global priorities
* Minimum 10+ years in Data Analytics, with significant experience leading teams and functions
* Deep data platform experience, Databricks strongly preferred
* Data Governance leadership - experience driving governance outcomes ahead of the organisation, setting standards and securing stakeholder alignment
* AI fluency — understands what makes data AI-consumable (lineage, schema, quality, ontology) and has a vision for how AI accelerates analytics outcomes
* A confident and positive outlook with low ego; high degree of ingenuity, resourcefulness, and problem-solving skills.

***Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (hybrid work model)***
**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Oracle EDMCS/Lead Business Analyst
description:
Ready to build Oracle Cloud EDMCS that strengthens Finance data governance?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Lead Business Analyst**
Join HSBC as a Senior Software Engineer focused on Oracle Cloud Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS) delivery for Finance. This role partners with finance users, data owners and technical teams to shape requirements and translate them into well-governed solutions. You’ll own solution design and full-lifecycle delivery for EDMCS with FCCS (Financial Consolidation and Close Cloud Service) configuration and support as a secondary area. The work spans configuration, integration, migration and controls in an audit-conscious environment. Success looks like stable EDMCS applications with clear governance, robust data-quality controls and well-run deployments and updates. You’ll also ensure documentation and audit evidence are maintained to support ongoing operational needs.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own requirements gathering, solution design and end-to-end delivery for Oracle Cloud EDMCS
* Configure EDMCS applications, subscriptions and security including node types, hierarchies, properties and viewpoints
* Build validations and Expression Builder logic and implement governance, workflows, permissions and data-quality controls
* Deliver integrations using REST APIs and manage associated technical delivery across teams
* Migrate metadata, data and business processes from Oracle DRM or other platforms including mapping and mock migrations
* Perform reconciliation and exception resolution to ensure accurate and controlled migrations
* Execute functional, integration, user acceptance and regression testing and support deployments and quarterly updates
* Maintain solution documentation, run books and audit evidence and support production issue resolution including FCCS

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring strong hands-on Oracle Cloud EDMCS implementation and configuration experience across security, hierarchies, viewpoints, validations and workflows
* Demonstrate delivery of end-to-end EDMCS implementation experience
* Show practical experience migrating from Oracle DRM or other data-management platforms to EDMCS including loading, mapping and reconciliation
* Apply robust metadata governance and data-quality controls supported by solid testing practices and operational documentation
* Bring working knowledge and practical experience with FCCS configuration, metadata, hierarchies, integration and testing as a secondary capability
* Use established experience in change, incident and problem management within a regulated or audit-controlled environment
* Communicate clearly with finance users, data owners and technical stakeholders and manage outcomes across geographies
* Hold relevant Oracle certification or equivalent certification or bring equivalent demonstrable experience

Building trusted Finance data platforms
  
  
If you want your work to improve how Finance data is governed and used across the organisation this role gives you the scope to make that happen. You’ll take ownership of EDMCS delivery from design through migration, integration and ongoing support. The outcomes are practical and measurable - stronger controls, cleaner hierarchies and smoother close and reporting processes. Apply to help build solutions that stand up to scrutiny and keep teams moving with confidence.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by – HSBC Software Development India

title: Analyst - Product Control
description:
Join Barclays as an Analyst - Product Control role, where you'll play a pivotal role in working with Line PC team for completeness and accuracy of the books and records that comprises of P&L (Profit & Loss) and Balance Sheet substantiation and reporting. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:
  
  
  

* Financial Reporting Expertise.
* Risk Management Knowledge.
* Basic understanding of financial markets and products.
* Proficiency in Microsoft office suite, especially excel.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**

* Financial engineering would be an advantage.
* Article ship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms.
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role will be based out of Pune and Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Manager- FPNA
description:
****Who We Are****
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**Abhout this role**
We are seeking an Opex & Capex Financial Analyst to support the Vodafone Business International (VBI) function in managing opex and capex budgets. The individual will play a critical role in delivering high-quality financial reporting, analysis, forecasting and insights by partnering with regional finance teams and cross-functional stakeholders. This position suits someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex data across a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Manage, review and report monthly opex and capex within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and adherence to financial controls
* Partner with FinOps teams to deliver timely and accurate month-end results
* Provide variance analysis, commentary and insights to explain performance and inform business decision‑making
* Act as a financial translator for business leads by presenting clear commercial and analytical narratives
* Deliver baseline forecasting, working closely with regional teams such as HR and Sales
* Support annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, gap tracking and performance challenge discussions with business leads
* Handle large data sets from multiple systems, ensuring accuracy while meeting tight deadlines
* Independently manage multiple priorities and maintain strong stakeholder engagement across levels

****Who You Are****

* Experienced in operating within a multi-functional, complex matrix environment
* Curious, collaborative and someone who challenges traditional approaches to drive better ways of working

description:

**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, AXIS modeller, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering AXIS modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* As a Senior within the Life AXIS actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US/Canada product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on LDTI/ IFRS 17 implementation experience in a modeler or tester capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands-on or Advance level experience in AXIS actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3-6 years of AXIS modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on AXIS) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Data Engg with Databricks - Technical Lead-Data Engg
description:
Area(s) of responsibility
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled Azure Data Engineer with strong hands on expertise in Azure Databricks, PySpark, ADF, and SQL. The role requires strong experience building enterprise-grade data pipelines, enabling ingestion from diverse sources, implementing complex transformations, and supporting scalable analytics initiatives.

* Data Solution Design & Architecture

Design end to end data engineering solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and other Azure-native services.

Work with architects, product owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to align technical delivery with business objectives.

title: Assistant Manager - Reg. Process Engg & Productivity (Pune)
description:
About DHL Blue Dart Express India:
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.

Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
Position Overview:
  
  
The Assistant Manager – Regional Process Engineering & Productivity supports the execution of process engineering, productivity improvement, and standardization initiatives across regional operations. The role is execution-focused and works closely with operations teams to implement defined process improvements, productivity enhancements, and safety initiatives across hubs, delivery centres, and surface-linked operations.
  
  
Job Purpose:
  
  
To support regional operations by executing process engineering initiatives that improve productivity, service quality, safety, and operational consistency, using structured industrial engineering and data-driven improvement approaches.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Process Mapping & Standardization
  
  
  

* Support end-to-end process mapping across regional operational activities including first-mile, hub, surface interface, and last-mile operations.
* Assist in documenting and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure process uniformity across locations.
* Support identification of inefficiencies, rework, and non-value-added activities through structured observation and data collection.

Productivity & Workflow Optimization
  
  
  

* Assist in conducting time and motion studies to improve throughput and reduce handling time.
* Support implementation of optimized workflows, layouts, and manpower deployment models.
* Track productivity metrics at site level and support improvement initiatives.

Ergonomics, Safety & Service Quality
  
  
  

* Support ergonomic assessments and implementation of safer work practices across operational sites.
* Assist in safety audits, risk identification, and closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure process improvements are aligned to service quality, shipment integrity, and TAT requirements.

Cost Efficiency & Resource Optimization
  
  
  

* Support identification of cost-reduction opportunities through process simplification and productivity improvement.
* Assist in tracking benefits realization from implemented process changes.
* Support data collection for cost-to-serve and efficiency analysis.

Technology & Automation Enablement
  
  
  

* Support rollout and adoption of process improvement tools, automation aids, and digital solutions.
* Coordinate with IT, vendors, and operations teams during pilots and deployments.
* Assist in monitoring adoption effectiveness at site level.

Performance Monitoring & Governance
  
  
  

* Collect and maintain operational data related to productivity, efficiency, and safety.
* Support preparation of MIS, dashboards, and reports for regional reviews.
* Escalate deviations, execution gaps, and risks to the Manager for corrective action.

Capability Building & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
  

* Support training and awareness sessions on SOPs, productivity tools, and process changes.
* Act as a process support resource for site operations teams.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders for smooth execution of improvement initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:
  
  
Education:
  
  
  

* Essential: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Logistics, or Supply Chain Management.
* Preferred: Postgraduate qualification or diploma in Operations, Industrial Engineering, or Logistics.

Experience:
  
  
  

* 5–7 years of experience in process engineering, productivity improvement, operations excellence, or similar roles.
* Exposure to express logistics, courier, e-commerce, or other high-volume, service-driven operational environments preferred.
* Hands-on experience supporting time & motion studies, SOP execution, and site-level productivity initiatives.

Skills & Capabilities:
  
  
Technical Skills:
  
  
  

* Process documentation and SOP execution
* Productivity and time-motion analysis support
* Operational data analysis and MIS
* Site-level process implementation and follow-through

Key Competencies:
  
  
  

* Strong execution discipline and attention to detail
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Effective coordination with site and regional teams
* Ability to work in field-intensive, fast-paced environments
* Clear communication and structured reporting

Key Performance Indicators:
  
  
KRAs
  
  
KPIs
  
  
Process Execution
  
  
Timely implementation of defined process improvements
  
  
Productivity Improvement
  
  
Measurable productivity gains at site level
  
  
SOP Compliance
  
  
Adoption and adherence to standardized processes
  
  
Safety & Ergonomics
  
  
Reduction in process-related safety deviations
  
  
Data Accuracy
  
  
Accuracy and timeliness of productivity and process MIS
  
  
Capability Enablement
  
  
Training coverage and on-ground adoption
  
  
Why join DHL Blue Dart?
  
  
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
  
  
Here’s what makes us stand out:

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

title: Senior Research Scientist
description:

title: Sr Associate Support Engineer, Adaptive Planning AI, ML & Platform Operations
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
  
  
Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused
**Support Engineer**
who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this
**high-visibility, customer-facing role**
, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
  
  
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
  
  
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
**Location & Shift**

* Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
* Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
* Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
* On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**

* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
* Technical & Diagnostic Skills:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

* Cloud & Monitoring Systems:

+ Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

* AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* Triage & Operations:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
+ Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:

+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
+ Jenkins & Git
+ Kubernetes and Docker
+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
+ JavaScript

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.

title: Senior Associate - Continuous Improvement
description:

This job also analyzes metrics to measure the impact of process enhancements after they are implemented by the organization. title: Senior Manager, Credit Card Portfolio Management
description:
A leading financial services organisation is looking for an experienced credit risk leader to drive credit card strategy across the customer lifecycle. This role is responsible for portfolio performance, credit policy, growth initiatives, and risk management.

You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Risk, and Operations teams to develop and execute strategies that support sustainable growth while maintaining strong risk controls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead credit card strategy across acquisition, underwriting, credit line management, pricing, instalment programmes, and collections.
* Manage portfolio performance and drive sustainable, risk-adjusted growth.
* Develop and refine credit policies, risk appetite, decision frameworks, and portfolio guardrails.
* Monitor portfolio health, including delinquency, utilisation, profitability, customer behaviour, and vintage performance.
* Use internal, bureau, and alternative data to identify opportunities and improve results.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to design, test, and scale new credit strategies.
* Drive structured experimentation through testing, monitoring, and performance reviews.
* Develop collections and recovery strategies to improve portfolio outcomes.
* Build and lead a high-performing credit strategy and analytics team.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.
* Present portfolio insights and recommendations to senior leadership.

**Qualifications:**

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, credit analytics, or credit strategy within banking, lending, or fintech.
* Strong experience managing credit card or revolving lending portfolios.
* Deep understanding of the consumer credit lifecycle, from acquisition through collections.
* Proven ability to manage portfolio performance and deliver strong risk-adjusted returns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with credit bureau data, scorecards, decision engines, and alternative data sources.
* Proven people leadership and stakeholder management experience.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

Preferred:

* Experience in a digital bank or high-growth fintech environment.
* Exposure to credit policy, portfolio governance, or expected credit loss frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI/ML-driven credit models and experimentation frameworks.
* FRM, CFA, or similar professional certifications.

title: Supply Planning Manager
description:
Position Name -
**Supply Planning Manager**

Location - Pune

Experience - 8 to 20

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**Supply Planning Manager**
to lead end-to-end supply planning operations across the EMEA region. The role will be responsible for ensuring product availability, inventory optimization, supplier performance management, capacity alignment, and service level achievement while supporting business growth objectives.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in
**Supply Planning, S&OP, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, Supplier Collaboration, Logistics Planning, Demand-Supply Alignment, and Team Leadership**
. The position requires close collaboration with Demand Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Commercial Teams, and Global Suppliers to drive OTIF performance, inventory health, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Supply Planning & Capacity Management**

* Lead end-to-end supply planning activities for the EMEA region.
* Develop and execute supply plans to ensure product availability while balancing inventory investment.
* Align production and supplier capacity with business demand forecasts.
* Drive capacity planning and network planning initiatives with manufacturing plants and suppliers.
* Identify supply risks and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**Inventory Management & OTIF Performance**

* Own and drive OTIF (On Time In Full), Fill Rate, and Inventory KPIs.
* Monitor inventory health including excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory.
* Lead inventory optimization initiatives while maintaining customer service targets.
* Implement preventive and corrective actions to address inventory imbalances and shortages.

**S&OP Leadership**

* Play a key role in the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
* Ensure alignment between demand forecasts, supply capabilities, inventory strategies, and business objectives.
* Present supply risks, capacity outlooks, and mitigation plans during executive S&OP reviews.
* Collaborate with Demand Planning, Commercial, Procurement, and Operations teams to build consensus plans.

**Supplier & Purchasing Collaboration**

* Partner with Purchasing and Strategic Sourcing teams to improve supplier delivery performance.
* Monitor Supplier OTD, capacity constraints, and supply risks.
* Drive supplier performance improvement and supplier development initiatives.
* Lead escalation management for critical shortages and supply disruptions.

**Logistics & Material Planning**

* Coordinate material planning and logistics activities across suppliers, manufacturing sites, and distribution centers.
* Ensure uninterrupted material flow to support production and customer demand.
* Improve logistics efficiency, replenishment strategies, and warehouse optimization initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Analytics**

* Lead RCA and CAPA activities for supply shortages, inventory issues, and fill-rate losses.
* Drive process improvements to enhance planning accuracy and supply chain efficiency.
* Utilize supply chain analytics and data-driven decision-making practices.
* Support automation and digital transformation initiatives within supply planning.

**Reporting & Business Planning**

* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and performance reports.
* Analyze OTIF, Supplier OTD, Inventory Turns, Fill Rate, Capacity Utilization, Forecast Accuracy, and Inventory Accuracy.
* Present performance reviews, risk assessments, and business insights to leadership teams.
* Support strategic planning initiatives through data-driven analysis.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and develop Supply Planning teams.
* Establish performance goals, development plans, and succession planning initiatives.
* Support hiring, onboarding, coaching, and capability-building activities.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Job Details**
Position Summary
  
  
The Insider Risk Manager will help to establish and lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, India. This role is responsible for overseeing daily insider risk operations, coordinating investigations, and ensuring the team provides timely, consistent, and effective response support. The Insider Risk Manager will strengthen insider risk detection and response capabilities across the full incident lifecycle, including triage, investigation coordination, containment, remediation, and process improvement. The role requires strong technical expertise in incident response, SOC operations, and security tooling, as well as the leadership skills to hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team in India.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership: Lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, including hiring, onboarding, training, mentoring, coaching, and performance management for analysts and responders.
* Incident Operations: Oversee daily insider risk detection and response activities, ensuring incidents are triaged, investigated, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner.
* Escalation Management: Serve as the escalation point for high-priority or complex insider risk incidents, coordinating response actions and communications with global stakeholders.
* Process Development: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve insider risk response playbooks, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and response workflows.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with HR, Legal, Privacy, CSIRT, IT, Compliance, and Corporate Security teams to align investigation processes, technology use, reporting standards, and stakeholder communications.
* Cyber Defense Collaboration: Collaborate with threat intelligence, vulnerability management, digital forensics, and CSIRT teams to support a unified cyber defense strategy.
* Reporting and Metrics: Provide executive-level reporting on incident trends, operational performance, key metrics, and emerging risks.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive ongoing enhancements to insider risk detection rules, automation opportunities, response processes, and operational effectiveness.

**Education And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Strong knowledge of incident response methodology, SOC operations, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE ATT&CK).
* Familiarity with global privacy and compliance requirements relevant to incident handling.

**Preferred Certifications**

* GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
* GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)
* GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

Work Experience
  
  

* 8+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, with at least 6 years focused on Insider risk reponse, data loss prevention triage and investigation, SOC operations or incident response.
* Minimum of 4 years in a people management role, leading incident response or SOC analyst teams.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, DLP, SOAR, and forensic tools.
* Proven experience responding to advanced threats, large scale data exfiltration campaigns, data loss prevention detection engineering and tuning, and insider incidents.
* Demonstrated success in building or scaling security operations and incident response teams in a global enterprise environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to brief technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.

* Manage and maintain enterprise network infrastructure consisting of Cisco Catalyst 3700, 3900, 4500 and 9000 series switches, Cisco Nexus 7000 and 9000 platforms, Cisco ASR, Cisco Catalyst Center and Wi-Fi 6/7 wireless networks
* Monitor network performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve stability, availability and capacity

* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and contribute to continuous service improvement initiatives
* Support and mentor Network Operations Centre teams through technical guidance and knowledge sharing
* Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, NOC, Security, Core, IPBB, Change Management, MIM and CSB teams
* Support the implementation of network changes, upgrades and new technology deployments

**Who You Are**

* Experience supporting and managing large-scale enterprise network infrastructures
* Strong technical expertise in routing, switching, wireless networking and data centre technologies
* Hands-on knowledge of Cisco Catalyst, Cisco Nexus, Cisco ASR, Cisco ACI, Cisco Catalyst Center and Wireless LAN technologies
* Strong understanding of network protocols including VRF, BGP, OSPF and EIGRP
* Experience with VSS switching environments and enterprise wireless solutions
* Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools such as SolarWinds, NetFlow and Wireshark
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

* Opportunity to work on complex enterprise and service provider-scale network environments

Kalpraag is a growing men's ethnic wear brand based in New Delhi, offering thoughtfully designed traditional and contemporary ethnic wear. Location: Delhi

Job Description:
  
Are you passionate about helping students achieve their educational and career goals? Do you have a knack for guiding students and families through academic programs and admissions processes? We are looking for a motivated Academic Counselor in Mumbai to join our team. This role is ideal for candidates with excellent communication, interpersonal skills, and experience in EdTech sales or student counseling.
  
As an Academic Counselor, you will provide essential academic counseling and career guidance to prospective students, helping them navigate course offerings, admissions requirements, and career opportunities in the analytics industry. • Industry Awareness:

• Experience: Minimum of 1 year in EdTech sales, academic counseling, or a related field.

title: Senior Manager Organization Development
description:
**About the role**

Hands-on practitioner. System builder.

You will lead delivery of OD work across two formats: client consulting assignments, and cohort programmes that strengthen many institutions at once.

Our OD work is growing on both fronts. We run client diagnostics and engagements for development-sector organisations. We also deliver cohort programmes such as the Emerging Leaders Program, and we are building multi-year institutional strengthening programmes for locally rooted climate organisations across Asia and the Global South.

You will make this work excellent in the room and repeatable at scale, building the systems, tools and team that let the practice double.

**What you will do**

**1. Lead client OD engagements**

* Scope and run diagnostics and strategy, structure, leadership and culture engagements for development-sector and climate organisations.
* Facilitate senior conversations with founders, CEOs and boards, and turn findings into a plan the client acts on.
* Own quality, timelines and client relationships, and spot follow-on work.

**2. Design and run cohort programmes**

* Design multi-month cohorts: session arc, pre-reads, faculty and coaches, evaluation.
* Run cohort operations end to end, from participant journeys to progress tracking.
* Report to funders on outcomes, not only activity, and shape differentiated support for organisations at different stages of maturity.

**3. Build OD products and knowledge**

* Turn engagement learning into reusable diagnostics, benchmarks, toolkits and frameworks.
* Work with the OD Atlas and product teams to make our OD knowledge a platform, using AI tools where they raise quality and speed.
* Contribute to proposals, concept notes and thought leadership that win new work.

**4. Grow people and standards**

* Coach associates and bring them into engagements as part of their growth path.
* Help build the practice's delivery standards, templates and review rhythm.

**What success looks like, twelve months in**

* Clients who come back. Engagements you led land on time, and clients can name the change that followed.
* A cohort that delivers. At least one programme you designed or ran shows outcomes against targets agreed at the start.
* Tools in use. Reusable diagnostics and frameworks are used across engagements and feed the OD platform.
* A stronger team. Associates you coach take on more and lead parts of engagements.
* New work won. You have helped win new OD work for the practice.

**What you bring**

* At least 8 years in organisational development, institutional strengthening, leadership development or management consulting, including at least 4 years leading engagements or programmes from scoping to results.
* Experience designing and delivering a cohort or multi-session programme, with evidence of what changed for participants and their organisations.
* Strong diagnostic skills: you can enter a messy organisation, find what drives its performance, and explain it simply to a founder or board.
* Skill facilitating senior and sensitive conversations, with presence and credibility in the room.
* Working knowledge of how civil society, philanthropic or climate organisations operate, including founder-led institutions, grant cycles and funder reporting.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with sharp, outcome-focused writing.
* A relevant degree or equivalent experience.

**It helps if you have**

* Experience in a re-grantor, accelerator, fellowship or capacity-building programme.
* Experience turning your methods into tools, frameworks or digital products, and comfort using AI tools in your work.
* Experience coaching and growing junior consultants.
* Fluency in Hindi or another South or Southeast Asian language.
* Lived experience in the sectors and communities we serve.

**How you work**

* You think in outcomes, not activity. You bring a point of view, speak up when something is not working, and hold yourself to measurable results. You move fast, keep high standards on quality, and enjoy building something new inside a growing practice.
* This is a Delhi-based role, with 4 days a week in the office. The role entails travelling for work every alternate month around India and South East Asia.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a one-page note on an OD engagement or programme you led, and what changed as a result, to aastha@climateasia.org by 14 December 2026.

**Equal opportunity**

Climate Asia is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, abilities and communities, and we select on skills, experience and potential.

description:

The posts are filled initially for three years and officers from central, state, union territory, autonomous, statutory and public sector bodies may apply, depending on the post. The
**National Testing Agency Vacancy 2026**
notice gives preference to officers with academic, technical, finance, administration or legal backgrounds and examination management experience. Applications must reach the agency through proper channel by

Understanding the Agency Behind the Notice

Its office is located in the Government of India Press Building on Minto Road, New Delhi. The agency conducts large-scale examinations, so applicants exploring

title: Senior Fashion Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
NEEDLEDUST is a luxury footwear brand that blends traditional Indian craftsmanship with contemporary design, specializing in handcrafted fine leather juttis created by some of India’s finest artisans. Founded in May 2014 by Shirin Mann Sangha, the brand focuses on reviving the classic jutti by combining royal-inspired moulds with modern embroidery and innovative patterns.
  
  
NEEDLEDUST has expanded its range to include mules and sandals, featuring vegan, 100% handcrafted styles with an international appeal and diverse color palettes. Each collection aims to challenge conventional design norms, offering powerful, story-driven aesthetics that resonate with customers around the world.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Fashion Consultant will serve as a style expert and brand ambassador, providing personalized fashion guidance to clients and ensuring a premium in-store experience. Responsibilities include understanding the full range of NEEDLEDUST products, advising customers on fit, styling, and occasion-appropriate selections, and presenting curated looks that reflect the brand’s aesthetic. The role involves driving sales through consultative selling, managing client relationships, handling customer queries, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. The Senior Fashion Consultant will collaborate with the store team to meet sales targets, support events or trunk shows, and share customer feedback with the design and management teams. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Saket.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Fashion Consulting and Product Knowledge skills, with the ability to understand materials, craftsmanship, and design details.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to deliver personalized, inclusive, and high-quality client interactions.
* Candidates should possess Sales skills, including consultative selling, upselling, and meeting or exceeding store targets.
* Candidates should ideally have experience in luxury retail, fashion or footwear consulting, and working with premium or handcrafted brands.
* Candidates should demonstrate strong interpersonal skills, attention to detail, a polished personal presentation, and the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
* Candidates should preferably hold a diploma or degree in Fashion, Retail Management, or a related field, or have equivalent relevant experience.

title: Learning Support Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Special Minds is a developmental support organization built on over a decade of expertise, headquartered in the United Arab Emirates and serving families across the UAE, Kuwait, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and India. The organization provides structured, high-quality education and intervention for children with autism, speech and language delays, ADHD, and other developmental needs in homes, schools, and community settings. Each child begins with an individual assessment and personalized learning targets, which are tracked against clear mastery criteria and shared with families monthly. Special Minds collaborates closely with families, schools, and specialists to ensure that skills learned carry over into everyday life. As the organization grows across the region, its ambition is to make accountable, evidence-based developmental support accessible to every family it serves.
  
**Role Description**
The Learning Support Assistant role at Special Minds is a full-time, on-site position based in Delhi, India. The Learning Support Assistant will provide individualized educational and developmental support to children with diverse learning needs in school and community settings, following structured programs and guidance from senior practitioners. Daily tasks include supporting lesson delivery, reinforcing learning targets, assisting with behavior and classroom management, and adapting materials to meet each child’s needs. The role involves closely monitoring student progress, documenting observations, and sharing feedback with the teaching team and families in line with established reporting practices. The Learning Support Assistant will also help promote inclusion, ensure a safe and supportive learning environment, and collaborate with teachers, therapists, and caregivers to carry skills into everyday life.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Assistant Teaching skills, including supporting lesson implementation, adapting learning materials, and reinforcing individualized learning goals.
* Candidates should demonstrate knowledge of Safeguarding and Safeguarding Children practices, with a commitment to maintaining a safe, respectful, and protective environment.
* Candidates should have well-developed Interpersonal Skills and Communication abilities to collaborate effectively with students, families, teachers, and specialists.
* Relevant experience working with children with autism, ADHD, speech and language delays, or other developmental needs is highly beneficial.
* A diploma or degree in Special Education, Education, Psychology, or a related field is preferred, along with openness to ongoing professional training.
* Ability to follow structured programs, accurately record progress, and work in alignment with organizational guidelines and multidisciplinary teams.

title: Assessment Expert (Psychometrics)
description:
**About ETS**
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.
  
  
Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.
  
  
****About ETS: Advancing Measurement to Power Human Progress****
Educational Testing Service (ETS) is a global education and talent solutions organization committed to helping learners thrive in a rapidly changing world. For
**more than 75 years**
, ETS has advanced the
**science of measurement**
, setting global standards for
**fair, valid, and reliable assessment across cultures, languages, and borders**
.
  
  
ETS is best known for world-class assessments such as
**TOEFL®**
,
**TOEIC®**
,
**GRE®**
, and
**Praxis®**
, serving millions of learners annually in
**more than 200 countries and territories**
. Through strategic acquisitions—including
**PSI**
,
**Edusoft**
,
**Kira Talent**
,
**Pipplet**
,
**Vericant**
, and
**Wheebox**
—ETS has expanded its capabilities across
**education, workforce, and digital assessment ecosystems**
.
  
  
Through the
**ETS Research Institute**
and
**ETS Solutions**
, we partner with
**governments, education systems, institutions, and employers**
to strengthen learning outcomes, promote equity and mobility, and enable lifelong learning at scale. With offices and partners across
**Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas**
, ETS delivers
**nearly 50 million assessments annually**
, supporting evidence-based decision-making worldwide.
  
  
In India, ETS plays a growing and strategic role in
**large-scale education assessment, policy-aligned measurement, and capacity building**
, working closely with public-sector and system-level stakeholders.
  
  
****Role Overview****
The
**Assessment Expert**
serves as a
**senior psychometric and educational measurement leader**
, providing technical and strategic direction for
**large-scale education assessment initiatives**
. This role is critical to ensuring that ETS-led and ETS-supported assessments are
**psychometrically sound, policy-relevant, and operationally successful**
for external clients—particularly
**government and public-sector education bodies**
.
  
  
You will lead and oversee
**statistical design, psychometric analysis, research studies, and technical advisory work**
, while representing ETS India as a trusted expert partner. The role includes
**team leadership, mentoring, capacity building**
, and close collaboration with
**ETS global experts and headquarters teams.**
****Key Responsibilities****
****Psychometric & Technical Leadership****

* Provide expert guidance in psychometrics, educational measurement, and large-scale assessment design.
* Define and lead the statistical and research components of education assessment programs.
* Frame complex technical and implementation challenges and propose evidence-based solutions.
* Design, conduct, and oversee research and psychometric studies, ensuring technical rigor, validity, and accuracy.
* Review statistical outputs and findings for reasonableness, quality, and policy relevance.

****Client Advisory & Representation****

* Serve as a senior technical advisor to external clients on assessment, measurement, and data-related topics.
* Translate complex psychometric concepts into clear, actionable insights for decision-makers.
* Prepare and deliver technical reports, policy-ready documentation, and executive-level presentations.
* Represent ETS India and ETS globally in client engagements, workshops, and review forums.

****Team Leadership & Capability Building****

* Coordinate and guide the work of Junior Psychometricians and subject matter experts in India.
* Collaborate closely with ETS global research and psychometric teams to ensure alignment to enterprise standards.
* Conduct seminars, workshops, and briefings for ETS staff, clients, test committees, and policy bodies.
* Coach and mentor staff, supporting professional development and technical excellence.
* Participate in interviewing, onboarding, and training of new team members.

****Knowledge Sharing & Professional Contribution****

* Support capacity building for client and ETS India teams on principles of psychometrics and educational measurement.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, and professional forums.
* Represent ETS through engagement with professional bodies and academic communities, as appropriate.

****Location Requirement:****
This role may require relocation to a designated location within North India, based on project requirements. Flexibility to relocate and work from the assigned location is required.
  
  

**Qualifications Required**

* Postgraduate degree in Education, Educational Measurement, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
* Formal certification or specialized training in assessment and psychometrics.
* 10+ years of professional experience in assessment development or educational measurement, preferably within large-scale or system-level contexts.
* Demonstrated experience working on government or public-sector education assessment initiatives.
* Proven ability to work effectively in multi-stakeholder environments, including with education boards, ministries, or system-level bodies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing technical reports and presentations.

****Preferred / Desirable****

* Experience with foundational or early-grade assessments.
* Experience developing and delivering training modules on pedagogy, assessment, or data use.
* Familiarity with Indian education institutions and structures, such as SCERTs, DIETs, or state education systems.
* Broad understanding of education and assessment frameworks.

****Why Join ETS in India****

* Contribute to high-impact education and assessment initiatives that shape learning outcomes at scale.
* Be part of a mission-driven, research-led organization with global credibility and public purpose.
* Work at the intersection of policy, research, and large-scale implementation.
* Collaborate with world-class psychometricians and researchers across ETS globally.
* Access professional growth opportunities supported by Business Resource Groups (BRGs) and learning communities.
* As a not-for-profit, ETS encourages social impact—employees may be eligible for additional paid volunteer time.

****Equal Opportunity Employer****
ETS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and providing equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Content Editor (Design & Video)
description:
About Fraghill

Fraghill is a direct-to-consumer fragrance brand based in Gurgaon. We sell through fraghill.com, and every order arrives as a pack of three 10ml perfumes.

Our content is how people discover us, so the visuals and videos we put out every day matter as much as the scents themselves.

About the role

We're hiring a Content Creator who can design in Canva and edit short-form video in Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro — and do both fast. You'll turn ideas, product shoots and raw footage into carousels, Reels, banners and ad creatives that go live within days, sometimes hours.

This role suits someone who thinks content-first: you care about what makes a person stop scrolling, not just what looks polished. You'll work closely with the marketing team and own a large share of Fraghill's day-to-day visual output.

What you'll do

**Design**

* Create Instagram carousels, static posts, stories and highlight covers in Canva.
* Design website banners, homepage hero images, product page graphics and email visuals for fraghill.com.
* Build and maintain Canva templates and brand kits so the team can produce on-brand content quickly.
* Design creatives for campaigns, launches, sales and festive moments.

**Video**

* Edit Reels, YouTube Shorts and ad videos in Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro: cuts, pacing, transitions, captions, text overlays, music and sound sync, basic colour correction.
* Turn raw footage — product shoots, UGC, influencer content, behind-the-scenes clips — into platform-ready videos.
* Resize and adapt one idea across formats and aspect ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9).
* Produce multiple variants of ad creatives for testing.

**Content and workflow**

* Deliver on quick turnarounds, including same-day or next-day edits for trend-led content.
* Pitch ideas for the content calendar and keep up with trending formats, audio and hooks.
* Keep a consistent visual identity across social, website and ads.
* Maintain an organised library of assets, footage and source files.
* Take feedback well and iterate quickly with the marketing team.

What we're looking for

* 1–2 years of experience in content design, video editing or social media creative work (in-house, agency or substantial freelance work all count).
* Strong Canva skills: layouts, typography, brand kits, templates, and resizing for different platforms.
* Working proficiency in Final Cut Pro or Premiere Pro for social-first video.
* A clear understanding of short-form content: strong hooks in the first few seconds, tight pacing, readable captions, and use of trending audio.
* A content-driven mindset — you think about the idea and the viewer first, then the design.
* Comfort with fast timelines and juggling several pieces of work at once without missing deadlines.
* A sharp eye for detail: alignment, spelling, colour and consistency.
* A portfolio that shows carousels, banners and edited videos.
* Ability to work from our Sector 42, Gurgaon office on in-office days.

Bonus points

* Experience working with a D2C brand, or at an agency handling D2C clients — especially in beauty, personal care, fashion or lifestyle.
* Experience making performance ad creatives (for example, Meta ads) and a sense of what drives clicks and sales.
* Comfort shooting simple product content on a phone.
* Familiarity with CapCut, After Effects, Photoshop or Lightroom.
* Ability to write short captions and on-screen text.
* A genuine interest in fragrance, beauty or lifestyle content.

What success looks like

By the end of your first 90 days, you'll be running most of Fraghill's day-to-day social and website creative on your own.

Timeline

What you'll have done

First 30 days

Learned the brand, products and visual style; set up or refreshed Canva templates for carousels, stories and banners; started delivering weekly social posts.

By 60 days

Owning regular Reels and carousels end to end on agreed turnarounds; delivering website and campaign banners.

By 90 days

Pitching content ideas proactively; producing ad creative variants; keeping a well-organised asset library the team relies on.

What we offer

* A negotiable salary, based on your experience and portfolio.
* Hybrid working, with office days at Sector 42, Gurgaon.
* Real ownership of a growing D2C brand's visual content — your work goes live fast and you see how it performs.
* Room to experiment with new formats and ideas.

How to apply

Email talk@fraghill.com with the subject line
**Application — Content Creator (Design & Video)**
and include:

1. Your CV.
2. A portfolio link (Behance, Google Drive, Instagram or a personal site) with carousels and banners you've designed.
3. Links to 2–3 videos you've edited, with a line on what you did on each.
4. Your current and expected salary, and your notice period.
