title: Business Strategy & AI Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy & AI Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Strong academic background; graduates from leading engineering or management institutes preferred. MBA is an advantage.

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

title: Senior Consultant - ML Engineering
description:
**About SiriusAI**

Sirius AI is a US headquartered AI Consulting services and products company with operations in India. Sirius AI focuses on Financial Services enterprises and solutions / services delivered across multiple geographies. We are an innovation-driven AI and data driven consulting services firm with a high focus on delivering business outcomes for our clients. The Sirius AI team is a mix of talent from a diverse background of Consulting, Industry and Product companies which bring together their Data, Platform, Ecosystem, Technology, Project management and AI skills to develop new solutions and deliver client engagements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly skilled
**Senior Consultant - ML Engineering**
with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for consulting clients across Financial Services and other industries. The ideal candidate will combine strong backend engineering expertise in Python with deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks, large language models, and cloud-native architectures, and will collaborate closely with data science, frontend, DevOps, and client-facing consulting teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and deploy end-to-end Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLM/Agents-based solutions, including classification, regression, fraud detection, anomaly detection, forecasting and predictive modelling.
* Build and operationalize end-to-end ML pipelines covering data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
* Develop enterprise GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and agentic AI frameworks.
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices covering experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, model registries, monitoring and reproducibility.
* Build scalable Python backend services, REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Flask or Django.
* Deploy and manage AI/ML workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP, leveraging containerization, Kubernetes and cloud-native AI services.
* Work with GPU-enabled infrastructure and distributed computing for model training, inference and performance optimization.
* Design and optimize data processing and pipeline orchestration workflows using PySpark, Airflow, Kubeflow or managed cloud services.
* Develop secure, scalable and reliable AI systems with appropriate observability, access controls, governance and cost optimization.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and client-facing teams on solution architecture, technical design, POCs and enterprise delivery.
* Drive engineering best practices, technical reviews, code quality and mentoring of team members.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with production-quality coding, Git-based development practices, hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow and Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask or Django, REST APIs.
* Train, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models where they outperform off-the-shelf solutions
* Strong understanding of ML algorithms, statistical modelling, feature engineering, model evaluation and optimization, also including model deployment, serving, monitoring, observability, and retraining in production
* Rapidly prototype and validate new ideas, then harden the successful ones into production-grade systems
* Understanding of transformer-based models, distributed or multi-GPU training, checkpointing, mixed precision, data loading, model serving and performance optimization for transformer-based models.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered applications using RAG, embeddings, vector databases and prompt engineering.
* Experience deploying scalable AI applications using containerization and cloud-native services and practical knowledge of cloud compute, storage, and GPU-enabled AI workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience designing and operating training, evaluation, batch-scoring and deployment pipelines using Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker or Vertex AI.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, model registries, experiment tracking and reproducible environments.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or Google ADK.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in Financial Services use cases such as credit risk, fraud detection, AML, transaction monitoring and customer analytics.
* Exposure to Foundation Models, domain-specific model development, fine-tuning and GPU infrastructure.
* Experience building production grade multi-agent systems (task delegation, coordination, and autonomous decision-making)
* Use AI coding tools and agents throughout design, development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience with computer vision, reinforcement learning and continuous self-learning.
* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake)
* Knowledge of responsible AI, AI safety, and model explain ability.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build cutting-edge AI, GenAI, Agentic AI and Foundation Model solutions for global enterprises.
* Exposure to complex, high-impact Financial Services AI transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to work on enterprise AI platforms, reusable accelerators and next-generation AI products.
* High ownership, technical challenges and collaboration with experienced AI architects and technology leaders.
* Competitive compensation, continuous learning and accelerated career growth.

title: Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Response
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our GIS Team at Marsh. This role will be based in Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Management**
**We Will Count On You To**

* To oversee and manage the security posture of the organizations entire cloud environment across all regions globally.
* This critical role requires a deep understanding of cloud security principles, Cloud Service Provide (CSP) platforms, and the ability to leverage sophisticated cloud tooling to proactively identify, detect, assess, report vulnerabilities and threats.

**What You Need To Have**
**Cloud Security Management**

* Multi Cloud Expertise: Possess in depth knowledge of leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and their security best practices.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive cloud security strategy aligned with industry standards and the organization’s risk tolerance.
* Proactively access and harden cloud infrastructure configurations to minimize attack surface and potential vulnerabilities.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM): Enforce and maintain granular IAM policies across all cloud environments to ensure least privilege access.

**Vulnerability Detection and Threat Response**

* Perform continuous asset discovery to identify and track all cloud resources, including servers, databases, storage, network devices, etc.
* Conduct regular, continuous, and adhoc vulnerability scanning to identify and prioritize security vulnerabilities and potential threats.
* Monitor for emerging threats and zero day vulnerabilities utilizing threat detection and response program.
* Identify and remediate misconfigurations that can lead to security breaches.
* Container Security. Ensure the security of containerized workloads by scanning images for vulnerabilities and enforcing best practices.
* Collaborate and lead remediation teams on plans for identified vulnerabilities, leveraging the security cloud vulnerability’s automation capabilities where applicable.
* Prioritization of security patch management to ensure timely patching of security vulnerabilities in cloud infrastructure and applications based on vendor recommendation.
* Generate regular reports on vulnerabilities, trends, remediation progress, and security cloud posture.

**Cloud Security VM Operations**

* Standardization: Enforce established security policies and procedures across all cloud environments.
* Compliance Management: Maintain compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, NYDFS, Privacy, etc.) and internal security policies.
* Security Incident Response: Assist in IR investigations and remediation of cloud security incidents, leveraging the security cloud system’s vulnerability tool to analyze activities, logs, and identify root causes.

**Security Cloud System’s Vulnerability Tool**

* Advance the tool’s configuration: Assessment of configurations policies, rules, and alerts to maximize its effectiveness in identifying and mitigating cloud vulnerabilities and security risks.
* Analyze data generated by the tool to identify trends, patterns, and potential security issues.
* Maintain and support custom automation workflows within the tool streamline remediations processes and improve efficiency.
* Integrate the tool with broader security tools (SIEM, CMDB, SOAR, SOC, etc.) to create a comprehensive security informed program
* Actively monitor the tool’s alerts and notifications, prioritizing critical security vulnerabilities and issues.
* Alert triage and prioritization to accurately assess the severity and potential impact of alerts, assigning appropriate priority levels.
* Ensure remediation management to create and manage remediation tasks to timely resolve identified vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Maintain SLA adherence to monitor and resolve alert response and remediation times.
* Conduct thorough root cause analysis through investigations to determine the root cause of vulnerability remediation failures and implement alternative solutions.
* Generate regular reporting and metrics on vulnerabilities and threats for alert trending and remediation effectiveness.

**What Makes You Stand Out**

* Security Cloud Tools: Assist with the evaluation and selection of vulnerability management tools that integrate seamlessly with various cloud environments and provide fine granular access controls and CMDB attributers such as asset ownership.
* Integration: Integrate the security cloud tools with other security tools and systems, including the SIEM solutions, change ticketing systems, etc
* Launch awareness campaigns to promote secure practices and vulnerability management, emphasizing the unique challenges of cloud environments.
* Collaborate with development, business CISOs, operations, and cloud teams to ensure effective vulnerability management practices throughout the SDLC, cloud, and production environments.

**Why Join Our Team**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Lead, On Demand, Digital Products
description:
**About us**

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 85 centres, 9.8 million square ft (operational area) (as of October 2026). WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our


website

**About the role**

The On Demand team operates within the Digital Products vertical. The portfolio includes Day Passes, Day Pass Plus, Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings, sold through the WeWork India app and website, myHQ, and other aggregator and corporate channels.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of the On Demand business: revenue and P&L, the product portfolio, pricing and promotions, inventory and day-to-day operations, the myHQ partnership and other channels, and the digital booking experience. It sits at the intersection of business, product and operations, working closely with Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI and Sales teams, as well as external partners.

The team member will be responsible for growing On Demand revenue profitably by improving how the business is priced, distributed, operated and measured, and by shaping the next set of On Demand products, while ensuring a seamless booking and on-site experience for members.

**Role and responsibilities**

 

**Revenue and P&L**

* Own the On Demand P&L and deliver monthly and annual revenue targets, tracking performance on both a gross booking value and a realised revenue (net of partner share) basis.
* Build and maintain the monthly forecast and revenue bridge, breaking performance down by product, channel, city and building to explain what moved, why, and what needs to change.
* Drive growth across every lever (volume, price, product mix and capacity) while protecting realisation on discounted and partner-led sales.
* Reconcile On Demand revenue across booking systems, partner reports and finance records, including monthly aggregator invoicing and partner settlements, and resolve revenue leakage, unbilled bookings and data gaps.

**On Demand products**

* Own the full product suite (Day Pass, Day Pass Plus, 5 and 10 Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings), including positioning, terms and policies, and lifecycle decisions.
* Track how each product performs and how it affects the rest of the portfolio (incremental revenue versus cannibalisation), and decide when to scale, reposition, reprice or retire a product.
* Grow B2B bulk bookings and Bookable Private Office demand from companies and teams, working with the All Access Sales team and myHQ’s B2B team.
* Identify frequent On Demand users and teams and work with the All Access Sales team to move them up the product ladder to All Access Plus, All Access Basic or All Access Pay Per Use.

**Pricing and promotions**

* Own building-level pricing for all On Demand products, including periodic price reviews, phased price revisions and measuring their impact on orders, revenue and realisation.
* Plan and govern offers and discounts across WeWork and partner channels: set budgets and approval rules, avoid discounting in buildings already at capacity, and run post-offer readouts on incremental volume and cost.
* Set up partner, co-marketing and member offers on the Offer Engine (coupon codes), and work with the Tech team on new offer formats where needed.

**Operations and inventory**

* Manage day-to-day operations. Member queries, coordination with myHQ. Responding to tickets etc.
* Own day-to-day On Demand operations across locations, including product and inventory set-up, building launches and exits, booking issues, cancellations and refunds, and escalations, in coordination with Community and Regional Operations teams.
* Manage inventory and capacity: monitor building-level utilisation, flag buildings that are at capacity or under-used, and work with Community teams on adding desks, reallocating inventory and opening new locations to On Demand.
* Manage the dynamic private office inventory behind Day Pass Plus and Bookable Private Offices, including planning ahead for upcoming private office move-outs.
* Monitor member experience through post-visit surveys (NPS), support tickets and on-ground feedback, and close the loop on recurring issues such as booking friction, crowding and service gaps.

**myHQ and channel partnerships**

* Manage the myHQ partnership end to end, covering joint business planning, inventory and pricing alignment, campaigns and offers, customer support and escalations, B2B opportunities and monthly revenue-share settlements.
* Run regular performance reviews with myHQ on volume, discount levels, new-user acquisition and revenue quality, and agree actions and governance for future offers.
* Manage other aggregator and API partners, from onboarding and booking flows to monthly invoicing and reconciliation, and build new distribution channels such as corporate, employer and HR benefits partnerships.

**Product and digital experience**

* Own the On Demand booking journey on the WeWork India app and website (discovery, product pages, checkout, payment and confirmation), working with Tech & Product teams to improve conversion, reduce drop-offs and grow the share of direct bookings.
* Write clear business requirements and user stories, prioritise the On Demand roadmap and backlog, run UAT and manage launches for new features and products.
* Own On Demand tracking and analytics requirements: define funnels and events (e.g. Mixpanel), make sure bookings, revenue and failed transactions are captured accurately and in line with data privacy requirements, and use the data to run experiments.
* Work with Marketing on demand generation, including website and in-app content, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, performance marketing and building-level activations.

**Strategy and new initiatives**

* Shape the On Demand strategy and annual plan, including targets, growth levers, business cases and the product roadmap.
* Generate and test new revenue ideas (new products, bundles, corporate offerings, partnerships and channels) through quick, low-cost pilots with clear success and stop criteria.
* Keep track of the market, including flexible workspace operators, aggregators, pricing and customer trends, and feed those insights into pricing, product and posit

  ioning decisions.

**Reporting and stakeholder management**

* Run the On Demand operating cadence: weekly performance checks and monthly business reviews that end in clear decisions, owners and timelines.
* Maintain the On Demand tracker and dashboards (revenue versus target; product, channel, city and building views; AOV and utilisation) and prepare leadership reviews and presentations.
* Partner with BI to fix data quality issues and close data gaps such as order counts, repeat rates, funnel conversion and utilisation.
* Act as the single point of contact for On Demand across Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI, Legal and Sales, keeping everyone aligned on priorities, timelines and one shared set of numbers.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree required in a related field; an MBA is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (preferably in Product, Category, Business Operations or Revenue Management within consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, travel/hospitality or flexible workspace)
* Proven ownership of revenue targets or a P&L, with a track record of moving business metrics
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and comfort working with large booking and revenue datasets
* Experience working with Tech & Product teams on requirements, prioritisation, testing and launches
* Good understanding of pricing, promotions and unit economics
* Experience managing external partners, aggregators or marketplace channels is a plus
* Exposure to product analytics and BI tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Tableau) is a plus; SQL is a plus
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills, including presenting to senior leadership
* Ownership mindset and comfort working across teams without direct authority in a fast-paced environment

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that  you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.
  
  
As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
  
  
**About The UK Business**
Fidelity’s Global Platform Services (GPS) business manages or administers c. £135bn of customers’ assets. The business supports the investment needs of more than one million UK customers across four channels: Personal Investing; Retail Funds; FundsNetwork and GPS. Already a leading provider in the mutual funds, advised platform, direct-to-consumer and DC pensions markets, the business has ambitious growth plans. By combining its distribution strengths with the investment expertise of the Fidelity group, the business is ideally positioned to fulfil its goal of becoming a leading UK provider of retirement solutions.
  
  
**About Your Team**
The primary purpose of the Global Transitions team is to ensure that new Fidelity Trust, Contract and Master Trust Pension Plans asset transfers into Fidelity are established to agreed timescales and also deal with relevant on going corporate actions.
  
  
**About Your Role**
The Global Transition Senior Associate should ensure that Asset Tansition (Corporate Actions and New Client Onboardings) projects meet Fidelity quality, efficiency and product definitions.
  
  
The role is focused on providing support for new and existing clients within GPS (Workplace Investing), whether it be the onboarding of new client assets as part of an Implmentation, or providing detailed analysis and execution of assets for existing client as part of a Corporate Action. There will also be the opportunity to be involved with all aspects of establishing DC Schemes within Fidelity for both investment only and full service relationships, from initial review and analysis of the DC product sold, undertaking a due diligence meeting with the clients, asset data collation, to ongoing asset re-engineering and support.
  
  
There will also be an opportunity to support a large project that Fidelity is currently going through to convert existing schemes already on our platform to Fidelity’s new MIFID entity, FPSL.
  
  
The Global Transition Senior Associate is responsible for all Fidelity services being delivered to the client during the Transition and will co-ordinate with the appropriate Fidelity departments to ensure services are delivered to the client in an agreed and timely manner e.g. legal, communications, administration and presentations.
  
  
They will identify any operational issues as they arise and make recommendations to Clients / Fidelity Management for any required changes. They will also be pro-active in determining any other needs or concerns of the client and Operations department and act on them accordingly.
  
  
During the Transition or Corporate Action phase the Global Transition Senior Associate will:
  
  

* Organise/Attend client/stakeholder meetings and update relevant documentation for the project

* Ensure client deliverables are identified and relevant funding strategies are designed

* Liaise with all Fidelity departments, external market counterparties and fund providers when required

Additional:
  
  

* Develop, monitor and update a strategy throughout the Transition and corporate action process.
* Assist client in understanding the project delivery process and Fidelity procedures.

* Provide management, sales, client management and admin with timely, concise status reports, as well as meeting notes for all client visits.
* Work with systems to identify, analyse, sponsor, and install any needed systems enhancements.
* Understand the market and its needs by keeping up with industry trends and developments in the market through regular client contact, trade press, and industry conferences.
* Understand the full array of Fidelity products and services, specifically, but not restricted to the Workplace Investing arena. Examples would be services related to all aspects of the defined contribution pension schemes and Fidelity funds offered to such schemes.
* Provide input in the decision making process to senior management when required.

In addition, it is essential that any TCF issues identified are fed back to line managers or TCF champions so the appropriate actions and decisions can be considered.

**About You**

* Basic knowledge of pooled fund operations and fund accounting.
* Self-starter, keen to take on responsibility and new projects.

**Feel rewarded**

And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. title: NetSuite Administrator
description:
**About The Position**
**About Coralogix**
Coralogix is a modern, full-stack observability platform transforming how businesses process and understand their data at scale. Our unique in-stream analytics architecture eliminates reliance on expensive indexing and hot storage, delivering APM, RUM, SIEM, Kubernetes monitoring, AI Observability, and more — helping customers reduce observability costs by up to 70% while gaining deeper operational insight.
  
  
We are a high-growth, 100M+ ARR business, and the systems that power our revenue engine need to match that pace. The companies winning right now are not the ones with the biggest sales teams — they are the ones with the smartest revenue systems. This team builds those systems.
  
  
**The Role**
Let's be direct about what this role is and is not. This is not a ticket-queue administration role where you grant access, run reports someone else designed, and escalate anything hard to a consultant. NetSuite is the system of record for revenue at Coralogix — every order, every invoice, every subscription, and every recognised dollar lives there. You will own it.
  
  
Today, most NetSuite work at Coralogix is done by third-party contractors. That is precisely the problem this role solves. We want this expertise in-house, sitting inside the GTM Engineering team, close enough to the business to anticipate what Finance and Sales need rather than wait to be told — the same way we own Salesforce expertise in-house today.
  
  
A significant near-term priority is our CPQ go-live and the quote-to-cash chain that runs through it. You will own the NetSuite side end to end: the sales order model, amendments and change orders, billing schedules, invoicing, and the handoff into revenue recognition. You will also own replacing our current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — designing and building it, not supervising someone who does.
  
  
**What You Will Build**
**Platform Ownership — Every Week**

* Own the NetSuite instance end to end — custom records, fields, forms, transaction types, roles, permissions, and the subsidiary and segmentation structure behind them
* Write production SuiteScript 2.x — User Event, Scheduled, Map/Reduce, Suitelets, and RESTlets — not as an exception, as the default
* Build and maintain SuiteFlow workflows and approval routing for orders, quotes, journal entries, and vendor records
* Design saved searches, datasets, and SuiteAnalytics workbooks that Finance and GTM leadership actually use to run the business
* Own sandbox refreshes, SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF) projects, bundle management, and the twice-yearly NetSuite release cycle — including regression testing ahead of every upgrade

**Quote-to-Cash & CPQ Go-Live**

* Own the NetSuite side of our CPQ implementation — item and pricing model, sales order creation, and the full downstream billing and revenue chain
* Build and maintain amendment and change-order flows: upsells, downgrades, co-terming, renewals, and mid-term pricing changes — the part that breaks first and is hardest to unwind
* Configure SuiteBilling subscriptions, billing schedules, and invoicing logic to match how we actually sell, not how a textbook assumes we do
* Partner with Finance on Advanced Revenue Management — revenue arrangements, revenue elements, and recognition rules — so recognised revenue reconciles cleanly to what was sold
* Support multi-subsidiary and multi-currency structures as we open new entities and enter new markets

**Integrations & Automation**

* Replace the current Workato-based Salesforce-to-NetSuite sync with a direct, observable integration — you design it, you build it, you own it
* Build and maintain SuiteTalk REST/SOAP and RESTlet integrations across the GTM and finance stack
* Instrument every integration with real error handling, retry logic, and alerting — a silent sync failure discovered at month-end is a failure of the system, not of the person who found it
* Automate the recurring manual work that consumes Finance's month-end and quarter-end close
* Feed NetSuite revenue data into our Snowflake data foundation in partnership with the Data Engineer, so ARR, churn, expansion, and contraction reporting runs off governed data

**Governance, Data Integrity & Support**

* Own data integrity across NetSuite — customers, items, orders, invoices, subscriptions — and treat a discrepancy as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* Design and maintain role and permission structures with segregation of duties in mind, and support audit and control requirements as the company matures
* Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks so the platform is never a single point of failure
* Act as the escalation point for NetSuite issues across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success — and fix the pattern, not just the ticket

**Requirements**

* 5–9+ years of hands-on NetSuite experience, including recent time as the primary administrator or technical owner of a production instance
* Production SuiteScript 2.x experience — you write it and you debug it; you are not describing work a partner did on your behalf
* Deep working knowledge of SuiteFlow, SuiteBuilder, SuiteAnalytics (saved searches, datasets, workbooks), and NetSuite's role and permission model
* Demonstrated understanding of the end-to-end quote-to-cash and record-to-report process — from order capture through billing, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition. This is the business process your system models; fluency with it is non-negotiable.
* Experience working directly with Finance teams — AR, revenue accounting, controllership — translating accounting requirements into system design rather than waiting for a written specification.
* Hands-on Workato experience — Workato is our current integration platform across Salesforce, NetSuite and the finance stack, and you will own both the flows running on it today and their migration
* Hands-on experience integrating NetSuite with Salesforce and other SaaS platforms via SuiteTalk, RESTlets, and middleware (Celigo, Boomi, or similar)
* Experience with SuiteBilling or an equivalent subscription billing model, and with CPQ-to-ERP order flows
* Working exposure to Advanced Revenue Management (ARM) or equivalent revenue recognition tooling
* OneWorld / multi-subsidiary and multi-currency experience
* Experience with SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), source control, and structured deployment practices rather than changes made directly in production
* SaaS or subscription-business experience strongly preferred — recurring revenue behaves differently from one-time sales, and it shows
* Exposure to commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ or similar) and the order-to-commission data flow is a plus, not a requirement
* NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteCloud Developer, ERP Consultant) preferred — a strong recent hands-on track record will outweigh certifications in our evaluation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

**The Non-Negotiables**

* You are hands-on in NetSuite today — configuring, scripting, and debugging in your primary role, not directing others who do it
* You can point to systems and integrations you built yourself, and explain both the decisions you made and the ones you got wrong
* You understand quote-to-cash end-to-end — you can explain how an order becomes an invoice, how a mid-term amendment changes a billing schedule, and how both land in recognised revenue. You have built systems that model this journey and you don't need it rephrased.
* You default to automation when you encounter a task you have done more than twice
* You treat a data discrepancy or a silent integration failure as an urgent problem, not an acceptable state
* You can hold a direct conversation with a controller and with a software engineer in the same hour, and be useful to both
* Systems thinking — you reason about how a change in NetSuite propagates to Salesforce, the CPQ, billing, commissions, and the data warehouse
* AI fluency — you use AI tools daily in your work and actively evaluate new ones

**Cultural Fit**
We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Coralogix is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Response
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our GIS Team at Marsh. This role will be based in Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Management**
**We will count on you to:**

* To oversee and manage the security posture of the organizations entire cloud environment across all regions globally.
* This critical role requires a deep understanding of cloud security principles, Cloud Service Provide (CSP) platforms, and the ability to leverage sophisticated cloud tooling to proactively identify, detect, assess, report vulnerabilities and threats.

**What you need to have:**
**Cloud Security Management**

* Multi Cloud Expertise: Possess in depth knowledge of leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and their security best practices.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive cloud security strategy aligned with industry standards and the organization’s risk tolerance.
* Proactively access and harden cloud infrastructure configurations to minimize attack surface and potential vulnerabilities.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM): Enforce and maintain granular IAM policies across all cloud environments to ensure least privilege access.

**Vulnerability Detection and Threat Response**

* Perform continuous asset discovery to identify and track all cloud resources, including servers, databases, storage, network devices, etc.
* Conduct regular, continuous, and adhoc vulnerability scanning to identify and prioritize security vulnerabilities and potential threats.
* Monitor for emerging threats and zero day vulnerabilities utilizing threat detection and response program.
* Identify and remediate misconfigurations that can lead to security breaches.
* Container Security. Ensure the security of containerized workloads by scanning images for vulnerabilities and enforcing best practices.
* Collaborate and lead remediation teams on plans for identified vulnerabilities, leveraging the security cloud vulnerability’s automation capabilities where applicable.
* Prioritization of security patch management to ensure timely patching of security vulnerabilities in cloud infrastructure and applications based on vendor recommendation.
* Generate regular reports on vulnerabilities, trends, remediation progress, and security cloud posture.

**Cloud Security VM Operations**

* Standardization: Enforce established security policies and procedures across all cloud environments.
* Compliance Management: Maintain compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, NYDFS, Privacy, etc.) and internal security policies.
* Security Incident Response: Assist in IR investigations and remediation of cloud security incidents, leveraging the security cloud system’s vulnerability tool to analyze activities, logs, and identify root causes.

**Security Cloud System’s Vulnerability Tool**

* Advance the tool’s configuration: Assessment of configurations policies, rules, and alerts to maximize its effectiveness in identifying and mitigating cloud vulnerabilities and security risks.
* Analyze data generated by the tool to identify trends, patterns, and potential security issues.
* Maintain and support custom automation workflows within the tool streamline remediations processes and improve efficiency.
* Integrate the tool with broader security tools (SIEM, CMDB, SOAR, SOC, etc.) to create a comprehensive security informed program
* Actively monitor the tool’s alerts and notifications, prioritizing critical security vulnerabilities and issues.
* Alert triage and prioritization to accurately assess the severity and potential impact of alerts, assigning appropriate priority levels.
* Ensure remediation management to create and manage remediation tasks to timely resolve identified vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Maintain SLA adherence to monitor and resolve alert response and remediation times.
* Conduct thorough root cause analysis through investigations to determine the root cause of vulnerability remediation failures and implement alternative solutions.
* Generate regular reporting and metrics on vulnerabilities and threats for alert trending and remediation effectiveness.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Security Cloud Tools: Assist with the evaluation and selection of vulnerability management tools that integrate seamlessly with various cloud environments and provide fine granular access controls and CMDB attributers such as asset ownership.
* Integration: Integrate the security cloud tools with other security tools and systems, including the SIEM solutions, change ticketing systems, etc
* Launch awareness campaigns to promote secure practices and vulnerability management, emphasizing the unique challenges of cloud environments.
* Collaborate with development, business CISOs, operations, and cloud teams to ensure effective vulnerability management practices throughout the SDLC, cloud, and production environments.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Company Description

The company’s expert nutritionists design meal plans tailored to individual fitness goals, making healthy eating convenient and sustainable. ParaFit focuses on combining taste with balanced nutrition and promoting a supportive, goal-oriented approach to health and fitness.

Role Description

ParaFit India is looking for a result-oriented Junior Digital Marketing Executive to support and execute digital marketing campaigns focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, website traffic, and business growth. The candidate will be responsible for assisting with Google Ads, Meta Ads, on-page and off-page SEO, campaign performance tracking, and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) analysis.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of performance marketing, paid advertising platforms, search engine optimization, and digital analytics, along with the ability to analyze campaign data and recommend improvements to maximize marketing effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Google Ads & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, and other relevant campaign types.
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify advertising opportunities.
* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, targeting, and ad performance.
* Optimize campaigns to improve clicks, conversions, lead quality, and customer acquisition.
* Monitor key metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, conversion rate, and cost per lead.

**2. Meta Ads Management**

* Create, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns on Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.
* Develop audience targeting strategies based on customer interests, demographics, and behavior.
* Conduct A/B testing of ad creatives, headlines, audiences, and landing pages.
* Monitor campaign performance and make data-driven adjustments to improve results.
* Focus on lead generation, website conversions, customer acquisition, and retargeting campaigns.

**3. Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**

**On-Page SEO**

* Conduct keyword research and identify relevant keywords for website pages and landing pages.
* Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, image alt text, and internal links.
* Improve website content structure, keyword relevance, and overall search visibility.
* Identify opportunities to improve website usability and landing-page performance.

**Off-Page SEO**

* Support ethical link-building activities to improve website authority.
* Identify relevant websites and opportunities for quality backlinks.
* Conduct backlink analysis and competitor SEO research.
* Monitor keyword rankings, domain authority indicators, and organic traffic growth.

**4. ROAS & Campaign Performance Analysis**

* Track and analyze Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) across Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
* Calculate ROAS by comparing attributable revenue with advertising expenditure.
* Monitor advertising spend, revenue, conversions, CPA, and overall campaign profitability.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend optimization strategies.
* Prepare regular performance reports highlighting campaign results, spending, and improvement opportunities.

**5. Website Analytics & Conversion Tracking**

* Use Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, and Meta Pixel where applicable.
* Monitor website traffic, landing-page performance, user behavior, and conversion data.
* Assist with tracking leads, purchases, and other important marketing actions.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and reduce customer acquisition costs.

**6. Reporting & Optimization**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports.
* Track campaign budgets and ensure advertising expenditure is monitored effectively.
* Conduct competitor research and identify new performance marketing opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for landing-page requirements, campaign offers, and marketing creatives when needed.

Qualifications & Skills

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.
* Understanding of performance marketing, paid campaign optimization, and lead generation.
* Knowledge of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, keyword research, and backlink building.
* Understanding of ROAS, ROI, CPC, CTR, CPA, conversion rate, and cost per lead.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and conversion tracking.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
* Ability to work with spreadsheets and interpret campaign performance data.
* Good communication, time management, and organizational skills.
* A degree or diploma in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, or a related field is preferred.
* Internship, certification, or practical project experience in digital marketing is an advantage.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Result-oriented and comfortable working with numbers and campaign data.
* Interested in paid advertising, SEO, website conversions, and performance optimization.
* Willing to learn new digital marketing tools and advertising strategies.
* Focused on improving lead quality, reducing acquisition costs, and increasing measurable business results.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
Job Description (JD)
  
  
Student Acquisition & Tutor Onboarding Executive
  
  
Company: Teach Door
  
Industry: EdTech / Education Technology
  
Department: Sales, Marketing & Operations
  
Job Type: Full-Time
  
Experience: 0–2 Years (Freshers Can Apply)
  
Location: Noida / Greater Noida
  
  
About Teach Door
  
  
Teach Door is an emerging EdTech platform focused on making quality education accessible, affordable, and personalized for every student.
  
  
We connect students and parents with qualified and experienced tutors through online classes and home tuition services, creating a seamless and flexible learning experience.
  
  
Our platform helps students find the right tutors based on their academic requirements, preferred subjects, learning goals, and schedules. We also empower educators by providing opportunities to connect with students, grow their teaching careers, and manage their tutoring services.
  
  
At Teach Door, we believe every student deserves the right guidance and every passionate educator deserves an opportunity to make an impact.
  
  
Our Mission: To simplify learning by connecting students with the right educators through an accessible, reliable, and technology-driven platform.
  
  
Our Vision: To become a trusted education platform that empowers students to achieve academic excellence while helping educators build successful teaching careers.
  
  
Job Overview
  
  
We are looking for enthusiastic, confident, and target-driven Student Acquisition & Tutor Onboarding Executives to join our growing team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be responsible for connecting with prospective students, parents, and tutors through outbound calling, generating leads, coordinating demo classes, converting student inquiries into enrollments, and onboarding qualified tutors onto the Teach Door platform.
  
  
This role is ideal for individuals interested in telecalling, inside sales, education counseling, customer acquisition, and EdTech operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Student & Parent Calling
  
  
- Make outbound calls to prospective students and parents.
  
- Explain Teach Door's online classes and home tuition services.
  
- Understand students' academic needs, preferred subjects, classes, and learning preferences.
  
- Generate student leads and convert inquiries into registrations and enrollments.
  
- Coordinate free demo classes between students and tutors.
  
- Follow up with interested parents and students to increase conversions.
  
- Build positive relationships with students and parents.
  
  
2. Tutor Recruitment & Onboarding
  
  
- Identify and contact potential tutors through calling, referrals, and other channels.
  
- Explain Teach Door's platform, teaching opportunities, and onboarding process.
  
- Assist tutors with registration, profile creation, and document submission.
  
- Coordinate tutor verification and profile activation.
  
- Encourage tutors to complete their profiles and become active on the platform.
  
- Maintain a pipeline of qualified tutors across different subjects and classes.
  
- Follow up with tutors to ensure successful onboarding.
  
  
3. Lead Generation & Conversion
  
  
- Generate student, parent, and tutor leads through outbound calling, referrals, social media, and marketing campaigns.
  
- Convert prospective students into registered and enrolled users.
  
- Convert interested tutors into successfully onboarded educators.
  
- Maintain regular follow-ups with potential leads.
  
- Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly calling, onboarding, and enrollment targets.
  
- Identify opportunities to improve lead conversion and customer acquisition.
  
  
4. Demo Class Coordination
  
  
- Explain the benefits of Teach Door's free demo classes.
  
- Schedule demo classes based on student and tutor availability.
  
- Coordinate with students, parents, and tutors to ensure smooth scheduling.
  
- Collect feedback after demo sessions.
  
- Follow up with students and parents to convert successful demo classes into paid enrollments.
  
  
5. CRM Management & Reporting
  
  
- Maintain accurate records of outbound calls, leads, and follow-ups.
  
- Update student and tutor information in the CRM system.
  
- Track registration, onboarding, and enrollment statuses.
  
- Prepare daily and weekly calling and conversion reports.
  
- Share customer feedback and improvement suggestions with management.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
- Minimum qualification: 12th Pass / Graduate.
  
- Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of experience are welcome.
  
- Excellent verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
  
- Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and convincing skills.
  
- Comfortable with outbound calling and regular follow-ups.
  
- Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM tools.
  
- Ability to handle objections and communicate professionally.
  
- Self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
  
- Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team.
  
  
Preferred Experience:
  
  
- Telecalling / Telesales
  
- Inside Sales
  
- EdTech Sales
  
- Education Counseling
  
- Student Admissions
  
- Customer Acquisition
  
- Tutor Recruitment & Onboarding
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
Performance will be evaluated based on:
  
  
- Daily outbound calls completed.
  
- Number of qualified student and parent leads generated.
  
- Student registrations and paid enrollments.
  
- Number of tutors successfully onboarded.
  
- Tutor profile completion and activation rate.
  
- Demo classes scheduled and completed.
  
- Demo-to-paid-enrollment conversion rate.
  
- Lead follow-up effectiveness.
  
- CRM data accuracy and reporting.
  
- Achievement of assigned monthly targets.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
- Competitive fixed salary based on experience and interview performance.
  
- Performance-based incentives.
  
- Professional training and onboarding support.
  
- Career growth opportunities in sales, marketing, and operations.
  
- Opportunity to work with a growing EdTech startup.
  
- Collaborative and supportive working environment.
  
- Hands-on exposure to student acquisition, tutor onboarding, and EdTech operations.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Interested candidates can share their updated resumes through Teach Door's official recruitment channel or send a mail to support@teachdoor.com
  
  
Join Teach Door and help us make quality education accessible to every student while empowering educators to grow their careers.
  
  
Teach Door — Connecting Students with the Right Tutors.

This is a broad, hands-on role spanning brand strategy, consumer insights, creative development, content, digital, dealer and regional marketing, product launches, PR, agencies and sales. The immediate priority is to build brand awareness and consumer demand across Deltic's existing dealer markets while strengthening its national brand presence.

The role will work closely with the Founders, leadership, sales, product, R&D and dealer network to turn market insights and business priorities into effective marketing initiatives and measurable outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Marketing Strategy & Growth**

**•**
Own annual, quarterly and campaign-level marketing strategy aligned with business and sales priorities.

**•**
Build market, channel and product-specific plans with clear KPIs and review mechanisms.

**•**
Identify growth opportunities and continuously scale, improve, test or stop initiatives based on performance.

**2. Brand & Communication**

Own Deltic's brand positioning, communication architecture and consistency across all customer and dealer touchpoints.

Translate product strengths into simple, differentiated consumer propositions relevant to Bharat, and develop original campaign ideas and creative direction that make the brand memorable.

**•**
Build long-term brand trust, relevance and differentiation.

**3. Consumer, Market & Competitive Intelligence**

**•**
Develop a strong understanding of customers, dealers, competitors and category trends.

**•**
Track buying motivations, customer objections, price sensitivity, financing needs, product perceptions and reasons for lost sales.

**•**
Translate market insights into recommendations for positioning, communication, product and sales.

**4. Dealer, Retail & Regional Marketing**

Build Deltic's dealer marketing programme across showroom branding and visibility, local advertising, digital campaigns, events, test rides, referrals, influencers and BTL activities.

**•**
Develop practical marketing toolkits and playbooks for consistent local execution by dealers.

**•**
Identify high-potential, inactive and at-risk markets and develop focused interventions.

**•**
Create regional marketing strategies suited to Tier 2, Tier 3 and Bharat markets.

**5. Content & Digital Growth**

**•**
Lead content strategy across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and relevant regional platforms.

**•**
Build a content engine around products, customers, dealers, creators, campaigns, education and brand storytelling.

Lead and guide performance marketing across Meta, Google, YouTube and other relevant digital channels, working closely with the existing digital/performance team.

**•**
Link digital activity to lead quality, dealer engagement, conversions and revenue.

**•**
Use AI tools for research, content creation, personalisation and marketing workflows.

**6. Product Launches & Go-To-Market**

**•**
Lead marketing strategy for new product launches, from pre-launch planning to post-launch campaigns.

**•**
Define product positioning, messaging, creative, digital, PR, influencer and dealer activation plans.

**•**
Work with product, R&D, sales and leadership to align product communication with market needs.

**7. PR, Agencies & Partnerships**

**•**
Manage creative, digital, PR, production, influencer, event and other external partners.

**•**
Brief, evaluate and hold agencies accountable for creative quality, timelines and outcomes.

**•**
Develop media, creator and industry relationships and support corporate and product communication.

**8. Marketing Operations, Budget & ROI**

**•**
Build marketing calendars, budgets, dashboards and review systems.

**•**
Oversee marketing spend and evaluate campaign effectiveness and ROI.

**•**
Ensure key initiatives have clear objectives, owners, timelines, deliverables and KPIs.

**9. Sales Integration & Team Leadership**

**•**
Work with sales and dealers to identify market and conversion challenges and develop marketing interventions.

**•**
Create feedback loops across customers, dealers, sales, marketing and product teams.

Lead, develop and align a high-ownership marketing team across brand, creative, content, digital, performance and regional marketing.

**What We're Looking For**

**• 6–12 years of relevant experience in marketing, brand, growth, consumer or related functions.**

**•**
Experience across automotive, EV, mobility, retail, FMCG, D2C or other consumer-facing businesses is valuable.

**•**
Strong strategy-to-execution experience across brand, digital, content, consumer insights and campaigns.

**•**
Experience managing agencies, vendors, budgets, teams and multiple channels.

**•**
Strong commercial, analytical and consumer understanding, with the ability to connect marketing to business outcomes.

**•**
Comfortable working across strategy, market visits, dealerships, customers and execution.

**Preferred Background:**
We will be particularly interested in candidates from advertising, creative, branding or small and mid-sized marketing agencies who are looking to move beyond working across multiple client accounts and take sustained, end-to-end ownership of building a brand within a business. Candidates who have played a meaningful role in building and scaling an early-stage or young company, shaping its brand, driving growth or launching new products or business verticals will also be especially relevant. Strong candidates from other backgrounds are welcome.

**Why Join Deltic?**

**Build a National Brand:**
Help shape a growing Indian EV brand with an established product portfolio and pan-India distribution.

**Strategic Involvement:**
Work directly with the Founders and leadership on brand, marketing, product, sales and growth priorities.

**A Large Canvas:**
Shape Deltic's brand strategy, creative direction, campaigns, marketing team and processes.

**Build for Scale:**
Establish the capabilities, partnerships and systems needed to support the company's next phase of growth.

**End-to-end Ownership:**
Take initiatives from strategy and creative development through execution and measurement.

**Visible Business Impact:**
Influence consumer awareness, dealer productivity, customer acquisition and business growth.

Deltic offers an opportunity to play a defining role in the next phase of a growing Indian EV brand. If you are someone who enjoys building, takes ownership and can combine creative thinking with strategic direction and hands-on execution, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**How to Apply**

Please email your profile, along with a short note (5–6 lines) describing a brand, campaign or marketing initiative that you personally conceptualised, led or executed, your specific contribution and the results achieved, to:

**careers@deltic.co | hr@deltic.co | aman@deltic.co | priyanka@deltic.co | ankit@deltic.co**

If you know someone who fits this profile, we would greatly appreciate an introduction.

title: Lead - Product Marketing
description:
**About the role**

**Lead Product Marketing Manager — Spyne**

**Location**
: Gurugram / Onsite · Type: Full-time, individual contributor · Reports to: CRO

**Work Timings - 3 PM to 12 AM**

Spyne builds AI that helps US car dealerships turn inventory faster. Studio AI handles visual merchandising, Vini AI runs conversational sales and service agents, and two human-in-the-loop lines, Lot Service and AI Contact Service, take on the physical and human last mile. More than 3,600 dealerships and automotive brands use Spyne, backed by Accel, Vertex Ventures and Storm Ventures, with 70+ integrations across DMS, CRM, inventory and service scheduling.

We are hiring a Lead Product Marketing Manager to own how Spyne is positioned, launched and sold. This is a senior individual contributor role with high accountability: you will own outcomes, not just deliverables. You will run product marketing across the full portfolio and own the sales enablement function end to end.

Our buyers do not buy "AI". A GM buys total gross, a used car manager buys days to line, and a fixed ops director buys absorption and retention. Your job is to turn what we build into a P&L story that dealers believe, and to make sure every rep can tell it.

**What you'll do**

Positioning and messaging

* Own positioning, value propositions and messaging architecture across Studio AI, Vini AI, Lot Service and AI Contact Service, anchored on one idea: the AI that turns inventory faster.
* Build distinct messaging for the dealer principal, GM, used car manager, fixed ops director, service manager, BDC manager and F&I. It should work for the person who signs, the person who benefits and the person who can block.
* Tell the platform story, not a bundle of products. Merchandising speed, lead response, appointment conversion and service throughput all feed one number: days to sale.

Go-to-market, launches and partners

* Plan and run tiered launches for new products, features and integrations, from beta through GA, with clear goals and post-launch reviews.
* Partner with product on packaging, pricing inputs and naming, using win/loss and customer evidence.
* Build segment-specific GTM plays for franchised rooftops, dealer groups and active independents.
* Package and launch integration and partner stories (DMS, CRM, OEM and platform partners) with partnerships and product.

Market, customer and competitive intelligence

* Own competitive intelligence across inventory merchandising, conversational AI, BDC outsourcing and the large incumbent platforms. Keep battlecards current and honest, including where we are weaker.
* Run a steady cadence of customer interviews, win/loss analysis and call reviews, and turn what you learn into product and messaging decisions.
* Track dealer economics, DMS and CRM ecosystem moves, OEM programs and regulation that affects how we sell.

Proof and content

* Build the proof engine: case studies, ROI models, reference customers and outcome data, with every figure clearly sourced.
* Shape flagship content and industry research with the content and demand teams, and own the narrative for moments like NADA.
* Own product and solution pages, decks, one-pagers and demo narratives.
* Brief analysts, press and partners with the wider marketing team.

Sales enablement (owned as a function)

* Design and run onboarding and ramp programs for SDRs, AEs, account managers and customer success, including dealer-industry fundamentals for people new to auto retail.
* Build and maintain the sales toolkit: pitch and discovery decks, talk tracks, objection handling, battlecards, ROI and business-case calculators, demo scripts and email sequences.
* Run ongoing training and certification on launches, competitive shifts and messaging updates.
* Own the enablement content system so reps find the right asset in seconds, and retire what is stale.
* Review call recordings and deal data with sales leadership to find skill and message gaps, then close them.
* Equip customer success to run business reviews and expansion plays across products.
* Success means reps lead with days and dollars, handle objections without escalating, and ramp faster.

**Your first 90 days**

* By day 30: Learn dealer economics and how a rooftop runs. Listen to at least 20 sales and customer calls, interview customers and reps, and audit current messaging and enablement assets.
* By day 60: Ship a refreshed positioning and messaging framework, an updated battlecard set, and a plan for the enablement function.
* By day 90: Run your first launch end to end, launch a structured onboarding and certification program for new reps, and put a measurement cadence in place.

**How we’ll measure success**

* Win rate and sales cycle on deals where your material is used
* New rep ramp time and certification completion
* Launch adoption and pipeline influenced
* Use of enablement content in active deals
* Quality and quantity of sourced customer proof

**What we look for**

* 7+ years of total professional experience, including at least 5 years in product marketing at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of owning positioning and messaging that sales teams actually used and that moved win rates.
* Experience running sales enablement: onboarding, training, battlecards, and measuring what worked.
* Multiple product launches shipped end to end, from brief to post-launch review.
* Strong customer and competitive research skills, including win/loss analysis.
* Clear, sharp writing and the ability to turn a complex product into a simple business case.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI tools in your work, with examples you can show us.
* Proven ability to run several priorities at once and to influence senior leaders without direct authority.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in automotive retail, dealer software, or another vertical SaaS market with a complex, multi-role buyer.
* Experience marketing AI products, especially conversational AI or computer vision.
* Experience selling to both enterprise accounts and the SMB long tail.
* Experience marketing services or tech-enabled services alongside software.
* Comfort working across US and India time zones.

**Perks**

* Real scope: Own the narrative and the enablement engine for a multi-product AI platform in a large market that is still early in adopting AI.
* A clear thesis: We sell a number on the dealer’s P&L, days to sale, not a feature list. That makes the marketing sharper and more measurable.
* Direct access: Work closely with founders, the CRO, product, CS and GTM leadership, and shape what we build next.
* A team that ships: We move quickly and expect the same pace and ownership from you.

Work Mode: In-Person / Field-Based

About EaseToLearn

EaseToLearn is an education-focused organisation offering technology-driven learning solutions designed to make education more accessible, engaging and effective.

We are looking for a motivated and customer-oriented Field Sales Executive who can drive customer acquisition, sales conversion and revenue growth through direct customer interactions.

Role Overview

The Field Sales Executive will be responsible for converting company-assigned enquiries and prospects into paying customers through outbound calling, follow-ups, product demonstrations and in-person home sessions.

This role primarily focuses on sales conversion and revenue generation, not lead generation. The company will provide prospects or customer enquiries, and the selected candidate will be responsible for engaging, following up with and converting them.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Calling and Follow-ups

Contact assigned prospects and customer enquiries through outbound calls.

Explain the company's educational products, services, pricing and benefits.

Understand customer requirements and respond to queries.

Follow up consistently with interested prospects.

Handle customer objections and guide prospects towards purchase decisions.

2. Field Sales and Home Demonstrations

Conduct customer visits across the assigned territory in Delhi NCR.

Arrange and deliver in-person product demonstrations and home sessions.

Present suitable educational solutions based on customer requirements.

Build customer confidence and address concerns.

Negotiate and close sales within approved company guidelines.

3. Sales Conversion and Revenue Generation

Achieve assigned daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.

Convert assigned enquiries into paying customers.

Drive sales closures through calling, follow-ups and in-person meetings.

Maintain accurate records of sales, payments and conversion status.

Consistently work towards improving sales performance and conversion rates.

4. Customer Relationship Management

Maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.

Provide accurate product information and ensure a positive customer experience.

Coordinate with internal teams for customer onboarding and post-sale requirements.

Escalate customer concerns to the reporting manager when necessary.

5. Sales Reporting

Update customer interactions, follow-ups, visits and sales closures in the CRM or designated reporting system.

Submit daily sales and activity reports.

Plan customer visits and follow-ups efficiently.

Follow company-approved pricing, sales processes and policies.

Eligibility Criteria

Graduation in any discipline.

Freshers with good communication skills and an interest in sales are welcome to apply.

Prior experience in field sales, direct sales, education sales or customer conversion will be an advantage.

Strong verbal communication, persuasion and negotiation skills.

Ability to handle customer queries and sales objections.

Comfortable working towards sales targets and revenue goals.

Basic knowledge of smartphones and digital reporting tools.

Familiarity with CRM systems or spreadsheets will be an advantage.

Mandatory Requirements

Must own and have regular access to a personal two-wheeler or four-wheeler.

Must possess a valid driving licence for the vehicle being used.

Must be comfortable travelling regularly across Delhi NCR or the assigned territory.

Must be willing to conduct customer visits and home demonstrations.

Must be comfortable with outbound calling, follow-ups and direct selling.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.

Number of successful sales closures.

Conversion rate of assigned enquiries into paying customers.

Effectiveness of follow-up calls and customer demonstrations.

Quality and completion of customer visits and home sessions.

Accuracy and timeliness of sales reporting.

Customer experience and compliance with company policies.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual CTC: ₹4,00,000–₹6,00,000 (₹4–6 LPA).

The compensation structure may include fixed pay and performance-linked incentives, depending on the approved salary structure and candidate suitability.

Benefits:

Cell phone reimbursement.

Commuter assistance, as per company policy.

Paid time off, as per company policy.

The detailed salary breakup, incentive structure and applicable benefits will be communicated during the recruitment process.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be confident, proactive and comfortable interacting with customers in person. Candidates with a strong interest in sales, the ability to build customer relationships and a results-driven approach are encouraged to apply.

This opportunity is suitable for individuals who enjoy fieldwork, customer engagement and achieving measurable sales outcomes.

Application Process

Interested candidates can apply by submitting their updated resume through the application form:

Application Form: https://tally.so/r/o99D7P

Shortlisted candidates will be assessed on communication skills, sales aptitude, customer handling, field readiness and their ability to convert assigned prospects into paying customers.

EyeMantra focuses on vulnerable groups such as children, older adults, and women through outreach camps, school screening programs, and permanent rural vision centers. Daily tasks include managing a sales pipeline, coordinating with operations and clinical teams, tracking performance metrics, and ensuring timely follow-up with prospective beneficiaries and partners.
