title: The Business Development Manager – Specification & New Accounts
description:
Business Development Manager – Specification & New Accounts

About the Company -

Innovative Lighting Designs Ltd. (ILDL) is a design-led architectural and decorative lighting company working with architects, interior designers, lighting designers, developers, consultants and project owners. For nearly two decades, ILDL has combined lighting design, technical expertise, product specification and project execution to deliver lighting solutions across luxury residential, hospitality, commercial, landscape, façade, heritage and public-space projects. Operating from New Delhi and Mumbai, ILDL represents leading international lighting manufacturers and has contributed to over 4000 projects. Our work extends beyond supplying products. We work with project stakeholders from the early design stage to understand the lighting intent, develop the correct technical approach, identify suitable solutions and support the project through specification and execution. ILDL is strengthening its market-development organisation and is looking for a professional who can open new accounts, build meaningful relationships within the architecture and design community, and create qualified project opportunities for the Company.

Role Description -

The Business Development Manager – Specification & New Accounts will be responsible for developing new relationships with architects, interior designers, lighting designers, developers, consultants and other project stakeholders. The primary purpose of the role is to create access to accounts where ILDL currently has limited or no business, identify projects at an early stage and develop ILDL’s involvement before the product specification or BOQ is finalised. The person will conduct presentations, understand project requirements, coordinate technical and design support, assist in developing specifications and convert initial relationships into qualified opportunities. Once an opportunity becomes commercially active, it will be coordinated with the designated Sales Manager or commercial account owner. The Business Development Manager will remain involved to maintain the relationship, protect the specification and support conversion, but will not independently issue pricing, negotiate unauthorised commercial terms or create competing product proposals. This is not a role measured merely by meetings, presentations or pipeline value. Success will be determined by the quality of accounts opened, specifications created and the eventual conversion of influenced opportunities into profitable business. The position reports to the Business Head.

Key Responsibilities

1. Identify and Develop New Accounts

* Identify high-potential architecture firms, interior-design practices, lighting-design studios, developers, hospitality groups, consultants and other relevant project organisations.
* Develop accounts where ILDL currently has limited, dormant or no meaningful business.
* Build relationships with principals, partners, design heads, senior architects, specification teams and project decision-makers.
* Understand the specialisation, project portfolio, client base and future business potential of every priority account.
* Map the important people within each account and develop relationships at multiple levels.
* Prepare a structured development plan for each assigned priority account.
* Convert initial introductions into regular engagement, active project discussions and repeat access.
* Re-engage dormant accounts and identify why they are not currently providing business to ILDL.
* Ensure that account development is systematic and does not depend only on social familiarity or a single contact.

2. Establish ILDL’s Position Within the Account

* Present ILDL’s company capabilities, lighting expertise, project experience and solution portfolio.
* Communicate ILDL’s value as a lighting-solutions partner rather than only as a product supplier.
* Understand how the account selects lighting partners, develops specifications and makes project decisions.
* Identify the design, technical, budgetary and service concerns that influence the account’s decisions.
* Arrange company presentations, technical sessions, product demonstrations, samples, mock-ups and showroom visits.
* Develop a planned engagement calendar for priority accounts instead of relying on occasional or unstructured follow-up.
* Build sufficient credibility for ILDL to be consulted during the early stages of relevant projects.

3. Identify Projects at an Early Stage

* Identify relevant projects during the concept, schematic-design or design-development stage.
* Avoid depending only on completed BOQs, general enquiries or projects that have already been commercially decided.
* Understand the project type, location, scale, design intent, expected timeline and budget direction.
* Identify the architect, interior designer, lighting designer, developer, PMC, electrical consultant, contractor, procurement team and final decision-maker.
* Map how the project is likely to be specified, approved, tendered, purchased and executed.
* Determine the expected lighting scope and ILDL’s realistic opportunity within the project.
* Confirm whether the project is genuine, active, commercially relevant and realistically influenceable.
* Avoid adding unverified enquiries, outdated projects or unsupported values to the official pipeline.

4. Develop Specifications and Design Influence

* Understand the architect’s or designer’s intended application, visual objective, technical requirements and budget expectations.
* Coordinate with ILDL’s lighting-design, product and technical teams to establish the appropriate solution direction.
* Arrange technical discussions, samples, mock-ups, calculations and product demonstrations where required.
* Assist the consultant or designer in preparing technically appropriate specifications, product schedules and application details.
* Ensure that recommended solutions are aligned with the design intent and commercial reality of the project.
* Monitor whether the specification remains active as the project progresses.
* Identify substitution risks, competing specifications and changing project conditions.
* Continue engagement after specification so that the opportunity does not disappear when it enters the commercial stage.
* Ensure that only one coherent ILDL solution is presented for each application unless an alternative has been internally approved.

5. Qualify Opportunities Before Internal Handover

* Confirm the project scope, stakeholders, budget direction, decision process and expected timeline.
* Establish whether ILDL has access to the people who can influence and approve the decision.
* Record the expected value based on credible project information rather than assumptions.
* Identify competition and the likely reasons ILDL could win or lose the opportunity.
* Determine the next specific action required to advance the opportunity.
* Ensure that substantial technical, design or quotation resources are requested only for properly qualified opportunities.
* Prepare a clear opportunity brief before involving the designated Sales Manager.
* Avoid transferring incomplete enquiries to the sales team without stakeholder, project and specification information.

6. Protect Specification-to-Order Conversion

* Track whether specified solutions progress into quotations, commercial evaluation and orders.
* Work with the Sales Manager to understand why important opportunities are delayed, substituted or lost.
* Re-engage architects and designers when a specification is being changed or commercially challenged.
* Help defend the design and technical rationale behind the recommended solution.
* Record the actual reason when a specification does not convert into an order.
* Use loss information to improve future account selection, project qualification and specification strategy.
* Remain accountable for the conversion quality of the opportunities created, even though final commercial ownership rests with the Sales Manager.

7. Develop Market Intelligence

* ﻿
  Monitor important developments across architecture, interiors, hospitality, real estate and construction.
* Identify upcoming design practices, developers, hospitality projects and project segments relevant to ILDL.
* Track competitive brands, specification activity and market approaches.
* Share relevant account and market intelligence with management and the sales team.
* Identify recurring gaps in ILDL’s product, technical or presentation capabilities.
* Represent ILDL professionally at design events, exhibitions, presentations and industry forums.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, architecture, interior design, engineering or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant experience may compensate for a different educational background.
* Approximately three to eight years of experience in business development, specification sales, architect relations, project sales or account development.
* Experience in architectural lighting, decorative lighting, electrical products, building materials, furniture, interiors, automation, façade products or another design-led project category is preferred.
* Existing professional relationships with architects, interior designers, lighting designers, developers or consultants will be advantageous.
* Demonstrated evidence of independently opening accounts and creating project opportunities.
* Ability to understand design and technical information and communicate it clearly.
* Strong presentation, relationship-building, follow-up and written communication skills.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets and structured reporting tools.
* Willingness to travel regularly for meetings, presentations, mock-ups and project visits.
* Strong professional integrity and respect for account ownership, pricing confidentiality and approved internal processes.
* A stable professional record and the ability to explain previous achievements using specific examples.

The Business Development Manager – Specification & New Accounts will be responsible for developing new relationships with architects, interior designers, lighting designers, developers, consultants and other project stakeholders.

The primary purpose of the role is to create access to accounts where ILDL currently has limited or no business, identify projects at an early stage and develop ILDL’s involvement before the product specification or BOQ is finalised.

The person will conduct presentations, understand project requirements, coordinate technical and design support, assist in developing specifications and convert initial relationships into qualified opportunities.

Once an opportunity becomes commercially active, it will be coordinated with the designated Sales Manager or commercial account owner. The Business Development Manager will remain involved to maintain the relationship, protect the specification and support conversion, but will not independently issue pricing, negotiate unauthorised commercial terms or create competing product proposals.

This is not a role measured merely by meetings, presentations or pipeline value. Success will be determined by the quality of accounts opened, specifications created and the eventual conversion of influenced opportunities into profitable business.

The position reports to the Business Head.

Key Responsibilities1. Identify and Develop New Accounts

* Identify high-potential architecture firms, interior-design practices, lighting-design studios, developers, hospitality groups, consultants and other relevant project organisations.
* Develop accounts where ILDL currently has limited, dormant or no meaningful business.
* Build relationships with principals, partners, design heads, senior architects, specification teams and project decision-makers.
* Understand the specialisation, project portfolio, client base and future business potential of every priority account.
* Map the important people within each account and develop relationships at multiple levels.
* Prepare a structured development plan for each assigned priority account.
* Convert initial introductions into regular engagement, active project discussions and repeat access.
* Re-engage dormant accounts and identify why they are not currently providing business to ILDL.
* Ensure that account development is systematic and does not depend only on social familiarity or a single contact.

2. Establish ILDL’s Position Within the Account

* Present ILDL’s company capabilities, lighting expertise, project experience and solution portfolio.
* Communicate ILDL’s value as a lighting-solutions partner rather than only as a product supplier.
* Understand how the account selects lighting partners, develops specifications and makes project decisions.
* Identify the design, technical, budgetary and service concerns that influence the account’s decisions.
* Arrange company presentations, technical sessions, product demonstrations, samples, mock-ups and showroom visits.
* Develop a planned engagement calendar for priority accounts instead of relying on occasional or unstructured follow-up.
* Build sufficient credibility for ILDL to be consulted during the early stages of relevant projects.

3. Identify Projects at an Early Stage

* Identify relevant projects during the concept, schematic-design or design-development stage.
* Avoid depending only on completed BOQs, general enquiries or projects that have already been commercially decided.
* Understand the project type, location, scale, design intent, expected timeline and budget direction.
* Identify the architect, interior designer, lighting designer, developer, PMC, electrical consultant, contractor, procurement team and final decision-maker.
* Map how the project is likely to be specified, approved, tendered, purchased and executed.
* Determine the expected lighting scope and ILDL’s realistic opportunity within the project.
* Confirm whether the project is genuine, active, commercially relevant and realistically influenceable.
* Avoid adding unverified enquiries, outdated projects or unsupported values to the official pipeline.

4. Develop Specifications and Design Influence

* Understand the architect’s or designer’s intended application, visual objective, technical requirements and budget expectations.
* Coordinate with ILDL’s lighting-design, product and technical teams to establish the appropriate solution direction.
* Arrange technical discussions, samples, mock-ups, calculations and product demonstrations where required.
* Assist the consultant or designer in preparing technically appropriate specifications, product schedules and application details.
* Ensure that recommended solutions are aligned with the design intent and commercial reality of the project.
* Monitor whether the specification remains active as the project progresses.
* Identify substitution risks, competing specifications and changing project conditions.
* Continue engagement after specification so that the opportunity does not disappear when it enters the commercial stage.
* Ensure that only one coherent ILDL solution is presented for each application unless an alternative has been internally approved.

5. Qualify Opportunities Before Internal Handover

* Confirm the project scope, stakeholders, budget direction, decision process and expected timeline.
* Establish whether ILDL has access to the people who can influence and approve the decision.
* Record the expected value based on credible project information rather than assumptions.
* Identify competition and the likely reasons ILDL could win or lose the opportunity.
* Determine the next specific action required to advance the opportunity.
* Ensure that substantial technical, design or quotation resources are requested only for properly qualified opportunities.
* Prepare a clear opportunity brief before involving the designated Sales Manager.
* Avoid transferring incomplete enquiries to the sales team without stakeholder, project and specification information.

6. Protect Specification-to-Order Conversion

* Track whether specified solutions progress into quotations, commercial evaluation and orders.
* Work with the Sales Manager to understand why important opportunities are delayed, substituted or lost.
* Re-engage architects and designers when a specification is being changed or commercially challenged.
* Help defend the design and technical rationale behind the recommended solution.
* Record the actual reason when a specification does not convert into an order.
* Use loss information to improve future account selection, project qualification and specification strategy.
* Remain accountable for the conversion quality of the opportunities created, even though final commercial ownership rests with the Sales Manager.

7. Develop Market Intelligence

* Monitor important developments across architecture, interiors, hospitality, real estate and construction.
* Identify upcoming design practices, developers, hospitality projects and project segments relevant to ILDL.
* Track competitive brands, specification activity and market approaches.
* Share relevant account and market intelligence with management and the sales team.
* Identify recurring gaps in ILDL’s product, technical or presentation capabilities.
* Represent ILDL professionally at design events, exhibitions, presentations and industry forums.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, architecture, interior design, engineering or a related discipline is preferred. Relevant experience may compensate for a different educational background.
* Approximately three to eight years of experience in business development, specification sales, architect relations, project sales or account development.
* Experience in architectural lighting, decorative lighting, electrical products, building materials, furniture, interiors, automation, façade products or another design-led project category is preferred.
* Existing professional relationships with architects, interior designers, lighting designers, developers or consultants will be advantageous.
* Demonstrated evidence of independently opening accounts and creating project opportunities.
* Ability to understand design and technical information and communicate it clearly.
* Strong presentation, relationship-building, follow-up and written communication skills.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets and structured reporting tools.
* Willingness to travel regularly for meetings, presentations, mock-ups and project visits.
* Strong professional integrity and respect for account ownership, pricing confidentiality and approved internal processes.
* A stable professional record and the ability to explain previous achievements using specific examples.

title: School Partnerships Manager (North)
description:
**We’re hiring a School Partnerships Manager - North (Delhi-NCR).**

Redwood designs experiential learning journeys for students - programs that take learning out of the classroom and into the real world. Over the last 4 years we’ve grown into one of India’s leading experiential learning companies, with 750+ journeys, 50+ partner schools, and 30,000+ students having travelled with us.

Every one of those journeys starts with a school deciding to trust us with its students. This role opens those doors across South India - finding the schools whose way of teaching fits ours, and building the relationships that turn a first conversation into a first journey. You’ll work mainly with international and progressive schools - the ones already looking for learning beyond the classroom.

What you’ll own:

* **New school partnerships**
  - find, approach and bring on new partner schools across Bengaluru and South India, from the first meeting to the first signed program
* **Relationships with school leaders**
  - principals, heads of school, coordinators and management, built on trust and kept over years, not one season
* **Program conversations**
  - presenting our journeys to school leadership and teachers, and shaping a proposal around what the school wants its students to learn
* **Handover**
  - bringing our program and school success teams in once a school signs, so what you promised is what gets delivered
* **Market insight**
  - what schools in your region are asking for and what else they’re being offered, fed back into the programs we build

This is school partnerships and outreach - not marketing or admissions. It’s a field role: most of the work happens in schools, across the city and the region. The role reports to our Senior Manager, Outreach.

We’re looking for someone with real experience building partnerships with schools - through edtech, publishing, assessments, school programs or similar - and relationships with school leaders in the region who already take your calls.

If you’ve built relationships with school leaders that turned into lasting partnerships - we’d like to meet you.

📍 Delhi / NCR · Full-Time

title: Assistant Manager Sales SMC
description:
**Role Overview**

Dudhi Industries Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an Assistant Manager–Sales to develop B2B sales of SMC/DMC/BMC moulding compounds and engineered composite components. The position requires hands-on industrial sales experience, technical customer interaction, OEM development and consistent conversion of enquiries into purchase orders.

The primary business focus is SMC/DMC/BMC compounds and electrical/switchgear components. Business development for non-structural tractor, earthmoving and construction-equipment components is an additional strategic responsibility. The role involves regular customer visits across North India and coordination with Technical, Quality, Production and Commercial teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Industrial Customer & Key Account Development**

• Identify and develop SMC/DMC/BMC moulders, component manufacturers, industrial OEMs, electrical manufacturers and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers.

• Build relationships with Purchase, Engineering, R&D, Quality and Supplier Development decision-makers to secure new and repeat business.

**2. SMC/DMC/BMC Compound Sales – Primary Focus**

• Develop compound supply business with compression moulders, electrical-insulation producers, enclosure manufacturers and industrial composite moulders.

• Understand existing material grades, monthly consumption, customer specifications and application requirements; identify suitable Dudhi grades or development opportunities.

• Coordinate samples and moulding trials, follow up technical evaluations and convert approved grades into regular commercial supply.

**3. Electrical & Switchgear Component Sales – Primary Focus**

• Develop OEM and industrial sales of busbar supports, insulators, terminal components, fuse bases, junction boxes, meter boxes, LT distribution boxes and customised SMC/DMC/BMC mouldings.

• Obtain relevant drawings, material specifications, expected volumes and customer approval requirements for standard and customised components.

**4. Tractor & Construction Equipment Component Business**

• Identify opportunities with tractor, earthmoving, construction-equipment and material-handling OEMs for non-structural SMC parts, including covers, panels, fenders and mudguards.

• Engage OEM engineering and procurement teams and coordinate technical feasibility, samples, tooling discussions and commercial proposals.

**5. Technical Sales, Sampling & Product Approvals**

• Understand customer performance, process and testing requirements; present suitable material or component solutions with internal technical support.

• Coordinate RFQs, product samples, customer trials, testing, technical clarifications and customer qualification or approval activities.

**6. OEM Registration & Supplier Development**

• Manage vendor registration, supplier qualification and technical documentation for moulders, OEMs and industrial purchasers.

• Maintain ongoing engagement with approved accounts to progress development opportunities into recurring orders.

**7. Quotation, Negotiation & Order Conversion**

• Prepare and follow up technical-commercial proposals and quotations using approved costing, pricing and commercial terms.

• Negotiate within approved company policies and convert qualified enquiries and successful trials into pilot orders, purchase orders and annual supply opportunities.

**8. Revenue Growth & Sales Pipeline**

• Achieve assigned sales and new-customer-development targets across the designated territory.

• Build a pipeline of qualified opportunities with expected product/application, monthly or annual volume, commercial value and anticipated order date.

**9. Order Execution & Customer Coordination**

• Coordinate order specifications, production commitments, dispatch schedules and customer requirements with internal teams.

• Follow up delivery performance and support timely resolution of technical or commercial customer concerns.

**10. Payment Collection & Commercial Discipline**

• Follow up outstanding receivables and support timely payment collection in accordance with agreed credit terms.

• Maintain accurate records of quotations, approvals, purchase orders, dispatches and customer commitments.

**11. Market Intelligence & Reporting**

• Track competitor materials, prices, major industrial buyers and emerging compound/component applications in target manufacturing clusters.

• Maintain CRM updates and submit periodic reports on meetings, enquiries, sample/trial status, order conversions, sales and collection follow-ups.

Requirements
  
  

**Preferred Background (Industry Exposure)**

Candidates with exposure to the following industries will be preferred:

• SMC/DMC/BMC compounds, thermoset moulding, FRP/GFRP composites or polymer materials.

• Electrical insulators, busbar supports, switchgear parts, meter boxes, distribution enclosures and engineered moulded components.

• Tractor, earthmoving, construction equipment, automotive OEMs or industrial component supply chains.

• Material sampling, moulding trials, product approvals and OEM vendor-development processes.

**Skills Required**

• Strong industrial B2B sales, account development and technical-commercial negotiation skills.

• Working understanding of SMC/DMC/BMC materials, compression moulding, component applications and basic performance requirements.

• Ability to discuss specifications, drawings, samples and trials with customer technical and procurement teams.

• Effective presentation, follow-up, CRM reporting and cross-functional coordination skills.

• Willingness to undertake regular field visits and travel across North India.

**Mandatory Eligibility Criteria (Strict – Non-Negotiable)**

**Experience**

• 5–10 years of relevant industrial B2B, technical sales or business-development experience with manufacturers, moulders, industrial OEMs or component suppliers.

• Demonstrated capability in customer acquisition, technical enquiries, commercial negotiation and order conversion.

**Mandatory Vehicle, Laptop & Mobile Requirement**

• Candidate must own a personal four-wheeler and hold a valid driving licence; fuel and travel reimbursement as per company policy.

• Candidate must be able to use a laptop, mobile communication and CRM tools for customer and sales reporting.

**Education**

• Continuous regular education; B.E./B.Tech, technical diploma or MBA with relevant industrial sales experience preferred.

Benefits
  
  

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Probation Period**

• Duration: 4–6 months.

**Compensation Structure**

• Total CTC: ₹5–7.5 lakh per annum, based on experience and suitability.

**Sales Incentive**

• 2% incentive on monthly sales generated, subject to the company incentive policy.

title: Government Portal (GeM) & Export Business Development Executive
description:
**Company Description**
FBD Cleaning is a leading manufacturer and supplier of high-quality house care and industrial cleaning solutions, serving corporate offices, commercial facilities, institutions, and households in Delhi and surrounding regions. The company focuses on bulk production and supply, enabling business clients to achieve strong margins while maintaining strict formulation and quality standards. Its portfolio includes advanced floor cleaners and phenyls, premium hand washes in multiple fragrances, and a wide range of high-efficiency detergents and surface cleaners. With direct-from-manufacturer advantages, robust quality control, and tailored B2B support, FBD Cleaning ensures reliable bulk fulfillment and competitive pricing. The organization is committed to promoting cleaner environments that support healthier and more productive workplaces and communities.
  
**Role Description**
The Government Portal (GeM) & Export Business Development Executive will be responsible for managing and expanding FBD Cleaning’s presence on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and exploring export opportunities for cleaning and hygiene products. This full-time, on-site role based in Faridabad involves handling product listings, tenders, and documentation on GeM, coordinating with government departments and institutional buyers, and ensuring compliance with applicable procurement guidelines. The executive will identify and pursue new business leads in domestic public sector and international markets, build and maintain relationships with distributors and partners, and track market trends and competitor activities. Daily tasks include preparing proposals, pricing and margin analysis, maintaining accurate records of bids and contracts, and collaborating with internal production and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfillment.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Government Relations and Public Sector familiarity to effectively manage GeM and institutional business.
* Candidates should possess Local Government understanding to navigate regional regulations and procurement procedures.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to interact with government officials, clients, and internal teams.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to assess tenders, pricing, margins, and market opportunities.
* Experience working with GeM or similar government procurement portals is highly beneficial.
* Knowledge of export documentation, INCOTERMS, and international trade practices is an advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic CRM or sales management tools is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Faridabad, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: Junior Manager Accounting (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
  
  
Flix is a leading green mobility provider, connecting millions of travellers through a smart, tech-driven network. In India, we are building a fast-growing intercity bus network with local partner operators. The Finance team ensures accurate, compliant and timely financial reporting that supports this growth. We are looking for a hands-on Junior Accounting Manager to support day-to-day accounting operations and the monthly close for FlixBus India. You will own core accounting processes such as accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliations and statutory compliance support, working closely with the Finance team, Group Accounting and external advisors.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments and provisions as part of the monthly, quarterly and year-end close.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes, including invoice verification, vendor payments and partner operator settlements.
* Perform bank, vendor, intercompany and balance sheet reconciliations, and follow up on open items.
* Ensure correct GST, TDS and other indirect and direct tax treatment; support timely filings and reconciliations (GSTR-2B vs books, TDS returns).
* Prepare MIS reports, variance analyses and schedules for management and Group reporting, including reporting under group accounting policies.
* Maintain fixed asset registers and support depreciation calculations.
* Support statutory, tax and internal audits by preparing schedules and responding to auditor queries.
* Maintain strong documentation and internal controls in line with company policies and the group control framework.
* Identify opportunities to improve and automate accounting processes using ERP features, Excel and reporting tools.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Operations, Revenue and external CAs/consultants for smooth finance operations.

**About You**

* Graduate (B.Com/BBA/BMS) or Postgraduate (M.Com/MBA Finance or equivalent) in Accounting/Finance. CA Inter, CMA Inter or equivalent qualifications are an added advantage.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in Accounting/Accounts Payable, with mandatory experience in Oracle ERP (preferably Oracle Fusion), ideally in a mid-to-large organisation. Experience in transportation, travel, e-commerce or technology sectors is preferred.
* Good understanding of Indian GAAP/Ind AS and Indian tax regulations, including TDS, Income Tax and GST.
* Strong technical proficiency in ERP and accounting systems, with advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas and reconciliations). Working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook is required.
* Familiarity with TRACES, e-invoicing and e-way bill systems. Exposure to BI tools and process automation, such as Power BI and Power Query, is an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and ownership, with the ability to manage tight deadlines, particularly during month-end and year-end closing.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and process improvement skills, with clear written and verbal communication in English and the ability to collaborate with global, cross-functional teams.
* High integrity, confidentiality and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career
  
  
**Why Join Flix?**
At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  
  
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
  
  
If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: Senior Agent Engineer
description:
**About Ethara AI**

Ethara AI is an Indian AI company with more than 2,000 engineers. We build reinforcement-learning environments, evaluation harnesses and post-training data for the world's leading AI labs.

About the team

Our Cyber AI team applies that expertise to security. We are building a sovereign, on-premise AI platform that finds, proves and fixes security weaknesses for Indian government departments and regulated enterprises in banking, insurance, telecom and healthcare. Models are trained in Ethara-built environments, never on client data, and every action runs under strict scope controls, human approval and full audit.

**The role**

Build the agent harness: planner, hunter, validator, exploitability and remediation agents, and the tools they call.

What you'll do

* Build the orchestrator and agent roles on a stateful framework such as LangGraph
* Define tool contracts (SARIF, JSON) and integrate scanners and analysis engines
* Build verification loops: independent re-checks of findings, patches compiled and tested in sandboxes
* Connect to source control, CI/CD, ticketing and SIEM systems

**Must have**

* 6+ years of backend engineering in Python or Go
* Built production systems with LLM agents that call tools
* Strong on reliability: retries, timeouts, idempotency, observability

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering (B.Tech/B.E. or equivalent)

**Nice to have**

* Experience integrating security tools

title: Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Response
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our GIS Team at Marsh. This role will be based in Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Management**
**We will count on you to:**

* To oversee and manage the security posture of the organizations entire cloud environment across all regions globally.
* This critical role requires a deep understanding of cloud security principles, Cloud Service Provide (CSP) platforms, and the ability to leverage sophisticated cloud tooling to proactively identify, detect, assess, report vulnerabilities and threats.

**What you need to have:**
**Cloud Security Management**

* Multi Cloud Expertise: Possess in depth knowledge of leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and their security best practices.
* Develop and implement a comprehensive cloud security strategy aligned with industry standards and the organization’s risk tolerance.
* Proactively access and harden cloud infrastructure configurations to minimize attack surface and potential vulnerabilities.
* Identity and Access Management (IAM): Enforce and maintain granular IAM policies across all cloud environments to ensure least privilege access.

**Vulnerability Detection and Threat Response**

* Perform continuous asset discovery to identify and track all cloud resources, including servers, databases, storage, network devices, etc.
* Conduct regular, continuous, and adhoc vulnerability scanning to identify and prioritize security vulnerabilities and potential threats.
* Monitor for emerging threats and zero day vulnerabilities utilizing threat detection and response program.
* Identify and remediate misconfigurations that can lead to security breaches.
* Container Security. Ensure the security of containerized workloads by scanning images for vulnerabilities and enforcing best practices.
* Collaborate and lead remediation teams on plans for identified vulnerabilities, leveraging the security cloud vulnerability’s automation capabilities where applicable.
* Prioritization of security patch management to ensure timely patching of security vulnerabilities in cloud infrastructure and applications based on vendor recommendation.
* Generate regular reports on vulnerabilities, trends, remediation progress, and security cloud posture.

**Cloud Security VM Operations**

* Standardization: Enforce established security policies and procedures across all cloud environments.
* Compliance Management: Maintain compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, NYDFS, Privacy, etc.) and internal security policies.
* Security Incident Response: Assist in IR investigations and remediation of cloud security incidents, leveraging the security cloud system’s vulnerability tool to analyze activities, logs, and identify root causes.

**Security Cloud System’s Vulnerability Tool**

* Advance the tool’s configuration: Assessment of configurations policies, rules, and alerts to maximize its effectiveness in identifying and mitigating cloud vulnerabilities and security risks.
* Analyze data generated by the tool to identify trends, patterns, and potential security issues.
* Maintain and support custom automation workflows within the tool streamline remediations processes and improve efficiency.
* Integrate the tool with broader security tools (SIEM, CMDB, SOAR, SOC, etc.) to create a comprehensive security informed program
* Actively monitor the tool’s alerts and notifications, prioritizing critical security vulnerabilities and issues.
* Alert triage and prioritization to accurately assess the severity and potential impact of alerts, assigning appropriate priority levels.
* Ensure remediation management to create and manage remediation tasks to timely resolve identified vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Maintain SLA adherence to monitor and resolve alert response and remediation times.
* Conduct thorough root cause analysis through investigations to determine the root cause of vulnerability remediation failures and implement alternative solutions.
* Generate regular reporting and metrics on vulnerabilities and threats for alert trending and remediation effectiveness.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Security Cloud Tools: Assist with the evaluation and selection of vulnerability management tools that integrate seamlessly with various cloud environments and provide fine granular access controls and CMDB attributers such as asset ownership.
* Integration: Integrate the security cloud tools with other security tools and systems, including the SIEM solutions, change ticketing systems, etc
* Launch awareness campaigns to promote secure practices and vulnerability management, emphasizing the unique challenges of cloud environments.
* Collaborate with development, business CISOs, operations, and cloud teams to ensure effective vulnerability management practices throughout the SDLC, cloud, and production environments.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

description:

An international software company is currently recruiting QA & Security Engineers to strengthen its software development and maintenance

capabilities in India.

The role will focus on ensuring the quality and security of multiple commercial software products, combining risk-based testing, test

automation, AI-assisted testing, and application security activities.

Depending on experience, successful candidates may specialise in quality engineering, test automation, or product security while contributing

to consistent release quality across the organisation.

Main Responsibilities

• Define product-specific test strategies covering functional, regression, compatibility, performance, and release testing

• Analyse specifications, APIs, architecture, and defect history to develop risk-based test plans and acceptance criteria

• Design and maintain automated unit, component, and API tests and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines

• Improve test coverage, execution speed, stability, and diagnostics

• Introduce and develop AI-assisted testing processes, including test case and test data generation and defect analysis

• Support application security through threat modelling, vulnerability scanning, static analysis, and security-focused testing

• Investigate security and quality issues, support remediation, and verify fixes

• Work closely with Product, Development, Architecture, and DevOps teams to improve product quality and testability

title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Linux / Azure Infrastructure Engineer**

**Location: Delhi, India**

**Salary: ₹7,00,000 – ₹12,00,000 per annum (depending on experience)**

**Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent**

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced Linux / Azure Infrastructure Engineer to join our growing technical team in Delhi.

This is an excellent opportunity for an infrastructure professional with strong Linux administration skills and experience working within Microsoft Azure cloud environments.

You will be responsible for supporting, maintaining and improving the organisation's IT infrastructure, ensuring systems remain secure, stable, available and performing efficiently.

Working across Linux-based servers and Azure cloud services, you'll play an important role in infrastructure management, system monitoring, troubleshooting and ongoing improvements. You'll work closely with other technical teams to resolve issues, support deployments and ensure the reliability of business-critical systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer, maintain and support Linux-based server environments, including Ubuntu, Red Hat and CentOS.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, storage, networking and associated cloud services.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, availability and capacity, identifying and resolving potential issues.
* Perform server configuration, installation, patching, upgrades and routine maintenance.
* Investigate and troubleshoot infrastructure, operating system, connectivity and performance-related issues.
* Manage Linux user accounts, permissions, groups, file systems and access controls.
* Support Azure networking, including Virtual Networks (VNet), Network Security Groups (NSGs), VPNs and connectivity.
* Manage backups, recovery procedures and disaster recovery processes.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure security measures, ensuring systems follow appropriate security standards and best practices.
* Monitor system logs, services and resource utilisation to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Support cloud infrastructure deployments, configuration changes and ongoing optimisation.
* Use scripting and automation to improve routine administration tasks and operational efficiency.
* Maintain accurate technical documentation, infrastructure records and operational procedures.
* Work alongside development, security and IT teams to support infrastructure requirements and resolve technical challenges.

**Skills & Experience**

* Around 3–5 years' experience in an Infrastructure Engineer, Linux Administrator, Systems Administrator or similar position.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Linux environments, ideally Ubuntu, Red Hat or CentOS.
* Practical experience working with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure.
* Good understanding of Azure Virtual Machines, storage, networking and cloud resource management.
* Experience with server monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimisation and system maintenance.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, including permissions, user management, processes, services and file systems.
* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls and VPNs.
* Experience with backup management, system recovery and disaster recovery procedures.
* Familiarity with infrastructure security, access management and vulnerability/patch management.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python or PowerShell.
* Ability to investigate technical issues independently and identify effective solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with wider technical teams.

**Desirable Skills**

* Microsoft Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate).
* Linux certifications such as RHCSA or RHCE.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or ARM templates.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerisation technologies.
* Exposure to CI/CD processes and infrastructure automation.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Nagios, Prometheus or Grafana.
* Understanding of high availability, scalability and cloud infrastructure best practices.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You'll be a technically capable and proactive infrastructure professional who enjoys working across both traditional Linux environments and modern cloud infrastructure.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of infrastructure issues, investigating problems methodically and identifying opportunities to improve system performance, reliability and security.

We're looking for someone with a hands-on approach, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively within a collaborative technical environment.

This is an opportunity to further develop your expertise across Linux administration and Microsoft Azure, while contributing to the stability and ongoing development of the organisation's infrastructure.

description:
**About Gartner IT:**
Join a world-class team of skilled engineers and analysts who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  
  
**About The Role**
Gartner information security teams are a group of passionate information security professionals dedicated to Protecting, Detecting, and Responding to threats. Our team is filled with lifelong learners who are consistently researching ways to better defend and stay ahead of the threats of tomorrow. We are a collaborative group, where good ideas come together whether they come from the most experienced or the newest members of the team.
  
  
Gartner is looking for a well-rounded and motivated Security Analyst to join its Governance Risk Management team which is responsible for providing IT Risk Management; IT Policies, Standards and Controls; and Audit/Governance oversight.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Manage Risks around client engagements from an InfoSec perspective
* Review and respond to client questions around their data and how we protect it
* Partner with IT and others in InfoSec to ensure accurate and consistent information is given to clients
* Review Information Security sections in contracts
* Partner with others in InfoSec to create a repeatable reporting process for vulnerabilities
* Partner with IT, others in InfoSec, legal, and contracts to review documents / contracts to understand what we can agree to
* Partner with the contracts administration team to handle all client requests
* Maintain accurate Q&A libraries within a tool and/or offline
* Prioritize requests to ensure deadlines are met
* Continuously look for ways to improve the process
* Take ownership of assignments and drive them to completion.
* Work collaboratively across functional areas for innovation to turn new ideas into reality.
* Heavy focus on Consulting clients. Next focus on overall client efforts and assist others on the team for Risk, Audit, Policy and Certification/Assessment efforts as time allows

**What You Will Need**
Ideal candidates have experience in IT with an overall understanding of Information Security and vulnerabilities. Candidates should have strong communication skills and attention to detail. Strong communication skills to partner with many departments within Gartner as well as occasionally working directly with clients. Strong attention to detail to ensure we provide accurate and consistent answers as well as thorough reviews of contracts/documents. Overall IT and Information Security knowledge.
  
  
**Must have**

* 2-4 years of experience in IT and/or Information Security
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail

**Who You Are**

* Proven communication, collaboration, and critical thinking skills
* Ability to define and communicate risk in a business-relevant language and to non-technical audiences
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a time sensitive operations environment
* Innovation mindset – Takes opportunities to make existing processes more efficient and thinks “automation first”
* Strong desire to improve upon and broaden their skills in information security

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.
  
  
**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and maintain Windows and Linux servers – provisioning, configuration, patching, hardening, monitoring and lifecycle management – and support Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and file services
* Administer VMware and/or Proxmox virtualization platforms – provision, migrate, resize and decommission VMs, and manage capacity, snapshots and resource allocation
* Manage enterprise backup and disaster recovery – backup jobs, restore testing, retention policies and DR drills
* Manage day-to-day data center operations – racks, power, UPS, cooling, cabling, asset records and physical access controls
* Maintain physical server infrastructure – installation, troubleshooting (RAID, disks, memory, NICs, firmware), vendor escalation and AMC/warranty coordination
* Manage Windows/macOS endpoint patching, ensure patch compliance and report on vulnerability remediation
* Work with Information Security and SOC teams to implement security recommendations, hardening and vulnerability remediation within defined timelines
* Support FortiSIEM-based monitoring – onboard servers, devices and applications, troubleshoot log collection and integrations, and analyze infrastructure-related SOC alerts
* Troubleshoot LAN/WAN and connectivity issues (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, VPN, NAT) and coordinate with the Network team on complex incidents. Support Cloudflare Zero Trust / ZTNA, WARP and access policies, and troubleshoot relatedconnectivity and access issues
* Monitor critical infrastructure, act as L2/L3 escalation point and resolve incidents within SLA; perform root-cause analysis and take part in change management, planned maintenance, upgrades and critical incident bridges
* Track infrastructure lifecycle – EOL/EOS, warranty expiry and capacity risks – and recommend refresh, consolidation and decommissioning initiatives
* Support ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST and internal audits; maintain evidence for patching, backup, access control and vulnerability remediation
* Maintain infrastructure documentation (SOPs, runbooks, KB articles, diagrams) and collaborate with Network, Security, SOC, Cloud and Application teams and external partners

title: Manager
description: * Network Automation & Orchestration: Develop low-level automation using Ansible, Terraform, Python, and Puppet to configure routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco, Arista, Palo Alto), and enforce policy-driven changes across hybrid environments. 2) Core Network Engineering: Hands-on expertise in Layer 2/3 protocols (MPLS, BGP, OSPF, VRRP, STP, VLANs) and physical/logical infrastructure design for large-scale, multi-region enterprise networks. 3) Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement version-controlled, repeatable network provisioning using Terraform modules, YAML-based configs, and Git workflows to manage complete network lifecycles. 4) Cloud Network Provisioning: Automate and manage cloud-native networking (VPCs, subnets, route tables, VPNs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, firewalls, NACLs, Security Groups) in AWS, Azure, and GCP. 5) CI/CD for Network Ops: Integrate network changes into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI) for test-driven deployments with linting, validation, rollback, and minimal operational downtime. 6) Internet & Perimeter Security: Configure and manage internet-edge security layers (firewall policies, DDoS protection, IPS/IDS, web proxies) and ensure secure ingress/egress traffic flows. 7) Monitoring, Telemetry & Auto-Remediation: Deploy NMS/telemetry tools (SolarWinds, Prometheus, InfluxDB) and write custom scripts for real-time alerting, anomaly detection, and event-driven remediation. 8) Troubleshooting & Packet Analysis: Perform low-level debugging using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump), flow telemetry, syslog, and routing table state analysis to resolve incidents in multi-vendor networks. 9) Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation: Collaborate with CloudOps, DevOps, Security, and platform teams to align network architecture with application needs. Maintain up-to-date HLD/LLD, runbooks, topology maps, and compliance records. 10) Innovation & Optimization: Evaluate SDN, SASE, Zero Trust, and AI-based networking solutions to continuously improve agility, reliability, and performance of the network ecosystem.

title: Program Manager - GeoAnalytics
description:
**About Us**
WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india.org
  
  
**Job Highlight**
WRI India is seeking a Manager – GeoAnalytics to strengthen the GeoAnalytics team's capabilities in geospatial analytics, software engineering and digital product development. This role will have a dual focus: leading the development and operationalization of Climate Lens, WRI India's integrated climate intelligence and decision-support platform, while managing and contributing to the development of geospatial software applications and analytical solutions across WRI India's programmes.
  
  
The position will combine product management, technical leadership, software development and project coordination. The successful candidate will work closely with research and programme teams to translate complex environmental, climate and urban challenges into robust, scalable and user-oriented digital solutions.
  
  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that analytical methodologies and research outputs are translated into reusable digital products, supported by sound software architecture, reliable data infrastructure and effective user experiences. The candidate will also contribute to building shared technical capabilities, reusable software components and engineering standards within the GeoAnalytics team.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The role will be structured around two complementary areas of responsibility.
  
  

* Climate Lens – Digital Product Development and Management (50%)

Lead the end-to-end development, implementation and continuous improvement of Climate Lens, ensuring that it evolves into a scalable and operational climate intelligence platform supporting evidence-based planning, adaptation and investment decisions.
  
  
Product Strategy and Management
  
  

* Lead the product development roadmap for Climate Lens, translating the platform vision, strategic objectives and programme requirements into defined product features, development priorities and implementation plans.
* Work closely with GeoAnalytics, Cities and other programme teams to identify user needs, define product requirements and translate climate research methodologies into digital workflows.
* Define product specifications, functional requirements, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and feature-level development plans.
* Coordinate product development activities across research, design, data science and software engineering teams, ensuring alignment between analytical requirements and technical implementation.
* Manage product priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies and delivery milestones.

Technical Development and Integration
  
  

* Lead the development and operationalization of Climate Lens
* Oversee the development of shared platform capabilities, including climate data integration, climate hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, adaptation planning, scenario modelling and decision-support functionalities.
* Drive the digital productization of WRI India's Climate Hazard Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) methodology into standardized, configurable and reusable analytical workflows.
* Coordinate the integration of the Urban NbS FinLink finance-search functionality into Climate Lens, ensuring that users can access project assessment and climate finance discovery capabilities across the three geographic applications.
* Work with software developers and technical partners to define system architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines and integration requirements.
* Ensure that the platform is modular, interoperable, scalable and designed for future expansion across cities, states and thematic applications.

Product Quality, Validation and Adoption
  
  

* Establish product development processes, including prototyping, technical validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), release management and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate pilot testing and stakeholder consultations with government agencies, urban local bodies and other intended users.
* Define product performance indicators and monitor platform adoption, user engagement, analytical utilization and institutional uptake.
* Translate user feedback and implementation experience into product enhancements and development priorities.
* Develop product documentation, user guides, technical specifications and onboarding materials.
* Support institutional partnerships, technical presentations and resource mobilization related to Climate Lens.
* GeoAnalytics and Software Development (50%)

Lead and contribute to the development of geospatial software applications, data-driven solutions and reusable technology components across WRI India's programmes and projects.
  
  
Application Development
  
  

* Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications, geospatial platforms, dashboards and digital tools to address programme and research requirements.
* Develop backend services, APIs and frontend applications using appropriate modern software development frameworks and technologies.
* Develop and maintain geospatial data services and workflows using technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL, GeoPandas and Google Earth Engine.
* Build reusable software components, libraries and modules that can be applied across multiple WRI India products and projects.
* Contribute to the development of open-source, interoperable and publicly accessible digital products, including platforms aligned with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) principles.
* Integrate geospatial analytics, data visualization and AI/ML capabilities into digital applications where relevant.

Engineering Standards
  
  

* Establish and promote good software engineering practices, including coding standards, version control, documentation, code reviews and testing.
* Support the implementation of pipelines, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure and application monitoring.
* Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies, open-source frameworks and AI-enabled development approaches for their potential application within WRI India.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, research associates and other members of the GeoAnalytics team.
* Maintain technical documentation, reusable code repositories and institutional knowledge resources.

Project Coordination and Collaboration
  
  

* Coordinate with programme teams to understand project requirements, define technical scope and ensure timely delivery of analytical and software development outputs.
* Manage technical work plans, development milestones, resource requirements and project dependencies.
* Provide technical guidance to project teams and support the integration of geospatial and software solutions into programme activities.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, proposals, presentations and other institutional knowledge products.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, Geography, Geospatial Science, Remote Sensing or a related technical discipline.
* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience in software development, geospatial technology, digital product development or a related field.

**Potential Salary and Benefits:**
*INR 18,00,000 to 24,00,000 Annum*
*“Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.”*
**Location: New Delhi**

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.

Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.
