title: Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Technical Program Manager III, AI & Data**
Our Technology Team partners with teams across Expedia Group to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. This role sits in the AI and Data Organisation, supporting the AI and Analytics Platform team which makes AI, ML, analytics, metrics, behavioural data and experimentation fast, governed, reliable, self-service and cost effective for every Expedia team.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager III, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs, connecting strategic goals to clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and predictable delivery. You will own integrated program plans from concept through completion and make scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and critical paths visible so teams can make timely, informed trade-offs. You will raise risks and blockers early, apply sound judgment to options and trade-offs, and create clarity on ownership, decisions, and next steps. This role also strengthens portfolio visibility and operating rhythms across teams and divisions by creating practical planning and reporting mechanisms, and applying AI, automation, and reusable delivery frameworks to improve how work gets done.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead strategic program delivery. Translate business objectives and product or technical requirements into integrated plans, milestones, workstreams, and execution priorities. Drive delivery end to end, adapting plans as scope, sequencing, capacity, or context changes.
* Connect work to business outcomes: Partner with Functional Area and team leaders to assess whether proposed work supports AI and Data and Expedia Group priorities. Define success criteria and measurable outcomes before execution, and use results to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Make the portfolio visible: Maintain an accurate view of programs including commitments, status, dependencies, risks, and changes. Develop roadmaps and concise leadership updates that provide the right visibility with minimal overhead and be candid when commitments are at risk or information is unresolved.
* Enable planning and prioritization: Support quarterly planning cycles that connect team commitments to Expedia Group goals. Facilitate prioritization and trade-off discussions so leaders and teams can focus capacity on the most important outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional alignment: Coordinate engineering, product, design, data, business, and partner teams. Build trusted working relationships and help surface and resolve program-level questions about system design, APIs, data, operating models, and delivery approaches; document decisions, owners, and their implications so teams can move forward with shared understanding.
* Manage risks, dependencies, and change: Identify issues and bottlenecks early, maintain clear ownership and mitigation plans, and escalate when needed. Track cross-team dependencies and critical paths, frame trade-offs, and communicate impacts to scope, schedule, and outcomes.
* Establish effective operating mechanisms: Create or improve governance, status reporting, decision forums, team communications, and delivery practices that support transparent decisions and reliable execution without unnecessary process. Use expertise to recommend practical approaches when teams face ambiguity.
* Advance AI & Data delivery frameworks: Use appropriate AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline program planning, synthesis, reporting, risk identification, and repeatable workflows. Develop reusable program frameworks and self-service paths that help teams spend more time on high-value work. Help teams safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled capabilities, applying foundational AI/ML concepts in real product and engineering contexts and using judgment about human review, data handling, and appropriate tool use.
* Measure and improve: Define and report program and team outcomes, delivery health, and relevant performance metrics. Monitor product or capability performance after launch, identify opportunities to simplify processes, and turn insights into actionable improvements. Use data and operational insights to improve predictability, workflow, and delivery quality.
* Build trusted partnerships: Develop strong working relationships with stakeholders who have varied perspectives. Communicate technical and business concepts clearly to delivery teams, partners, senior leaders, and executives.
* Stay curious: Keep learning about the AI and Data domain, the business, emerging AI tools, and better ways of working; apply relevant learning to continually improve program delivery.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* You have 5+ years of experience leading technical programs with cross-functional dependencies in platform, infrastructure, data, analytics, or similarly complex engineering environments.
* Prior technical background and core understand of SDLC is a foundational requirement for success in this role
* You have experience planning and delivering moderately complex programs across multiple teams, including managing timelines, dependencies, risks, milestones, and execution reporting.
* You are skilled at building clarity and accountability through dashboards, status communication, governance mechanisms, and structured operating rhythms.
* You are comfortable influencing without authority and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders around trade-offs, priorities, and next steps.
* You have strong technical fluency and can understand distributed systems, APIs, services, data flows, architecture discussions, and operational risks well enough to ask the right questions and surface gaps early.
* You use data and metrics to make program decisions, identify trends, surface risks, and tell a clear story to technical and leadership audiences.
* You have experience operating effectively in ambiguous environments and creating structure that helps teams move forward with confidence.
* You communicate clearly and concisely across different audiences and can translate complex technical or delivery topics into actionable updates and decisions.
* You bring a strong ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across teams, functions, and time zones.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience delivering complex, technical programs at scale, particularly where operational excellence, reliability, security, production readiness, or customer outcomes are central.
* Demonstrated ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across teams or domains without direct authority, including communicating trade-offs and helping teams reach alignment.
* Experience establishing program metrics, dashboards, or feedback mechanisms that surface execution challenges and improve predictability and delivery performance.
* Practical experience applying AI-assisted program or engineering tools, or AI/ML concepts, to improve product capabilities, delivery workflows, risk management, or business outcomes.
* Experience with one or more of the following: data platforms, semantic or metrics layers, experimentation platforms, BI or self-service analytics, or developer-facing platform products.
* You have experience driving platform adoption or consolidation efforts across multiple customer groups and partner organizations.
* Experience supporting data governance or management capabilities such as metadata, lineage, access control, certification, or data quality.
* Experience driving platform adoption or consolidation across customer groups and partner organizations, including programs supporting executive reporting, experimentation, or shared analytics at scale.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Field Research & Delivery Head
description:
Field Research & Delivery Head

Large-scale fieldwork | Survey quality | Multi-team delivery

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

This opportunity is for a field-operations leader who has successfully mobilised large survey teams and can maintain evidence quality under a demanding schedule. The programme combines resident and business interviews with operational inspections, route verification and measurement exercises.

Your mandate

Convert survey specifications into a working deployment model, achieve complete assigned-area coverage and ensure that only valid field records enter the final analysis.

What you will lead

* **Design an executable sampling rollout.**
  Prepare daily and weekly deployment against the agreed sampling frame. Ensure household interviews meet the greater of a 1% sample or 150 homes per local area, alongside at least 40 commercial interviews per area, without leaving coverage cells unrepresented.
* **Mobilise multiple specialist crews.**
  Direct enumerators, area coordinators, supervisors, station-assessment crews and independent quality-checkers. Organise day-and-night rosters where required, allocate devices and weighing equipment, and track field attendance against actual completed work.
* **Run controlled waste-transfer inspections.**
  Manage full incoming-load counts at operational transfer points over at least three randomly scheduled days, with weighing before discharge, supporting photographs, material-stream classification and cross-checking against available operator records.
* **Execute generator and service-provider verification.**
  Arrange verification of all generators producing 100 kg or more of waste daily, plus random checks of at least 30% of smaller generators. Coordinate full-day weighed observations for selected sites and evidence of their waste-service arrangements and final disposal paths.
* **Support vehicle and street-level validation.**
  Deploy trailing teams and observations to test GPS route traces against at least 10% of vehicle-days in each service area. Capture street coverage, missed pickups, operating-window deviations, hotspot locations and crew or muster discrepancies.
* **Standardise defensible mobile evidence.**
  Make each applicable observation traceable by coordinates, recording time and photograph. Train staff in respondent selection, location accuracy, acceptable photos, scale handling and daily upload procedures, including protocols for weak-connectivity situations.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Field Research & Delivery Head

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Operate independent back-checks.**
  Coordinate survey call-backs, repeat visits and spot checks covering at least 10% of records, supported by a quality team independent of frontline deployment. Investigate duplicates, impossible locations, suspicious timing and incomplete evidence before closing cases.
* **Enforce acceptance discipline.**
  Treat missing sampling cells, invalid station counts and unsupported records as incomplete work. Maintain correction and re-survey registers, and prevent the field MIS from reporting an area as complete until the relevant quality gates are passed.
* **Maintain field readiness and safety.**
  Issue simple SOP-style instructions for site access, traffic exposure, waste-contact precautions, photographs and portable equipment. Work with administration on compliant personnel onboarding, safe deployment and incident escalation.
* **Control progress with daily numbers.**
  Review team-wise output, staffing, cell coverage, station calendars, questionnaire rejection, GPS mismatches and back-check findings. Escalate delays quickly and redeploy staff before they threaten the interim and final reporting milestones.
* **Coordinate special studies and handover.**
  Arrange access and local support for authorised aerial measurements without operating the aircraft personally. Feed verified survey batches, field issues and final status notes to the geospatial, technical and programme teams.

What you will help deliver

* Field mobilisation, sample allocation, area calendars and duty rosters.
* Daily coverage and productivity MIS, with site-level audit evidence and traceable exceptions.
* Independent quality-check log, re-visit plan and acceptance-ready area completion records.
* Clean field batches and supporting proofs handed to the analytical and technology teams.

Who should apply

* Graduate qualification; civil engineering, geography, planning, environmental science, sociology and allied fields are relevant.
* At least 10 years leading major field research or public-service field operations.
* Proven management of 150 or more field staff on one assignment, with accountable supervisors and verification processes.
* Survey directors or operational delivery leaders comfortable with geotagged apps, daily productivity control and rapid mobilisation.

description:
**About us**

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. For more information, please visit our


website

**About the role**

The On Demand team operates within the Digital Products vertical. The portfolio includes Day Passes, Day Pass Plus, Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings, sold through the WeWork India app and website, myHQ, and other aggregator and corporate channels.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of the On Demand business: revenue and P&L, the product portfolio, pricing and promotions, inventory and day-to-day operations, the myHQ partnership and other channels, and the digital booking experience. It sits at the intersection of business, product and operations, working closely with Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI and Sales teams, as well as external partners.

The team member will be responsible for growing On Demand revenue profitably by improving how the business is priced, distributed, operated and measured, and by shaping the next set of On Demand products, while ensuring a seamless booking and on-site experience for members.

**Role and responsibilities**

 

**Revenue and P&L**

* Own the On Demand P&L and deliver monthly and annual revenue targets, tracking performance on both a gross booking value and a realised revenue (net of partner share) basis.
* Build and maintain the monthly forecast and revenue bridge, breaking performance down by product, channel, city and building to explain what moved, why, and what needs to change.
* Drive growth across every lever (volume, price, product mix and capacity) while protecting realisation on discounted and partner-led sales.
* Reconcile On Demand revenue across booking systems, partner reports and finance records, including monthly aggregator invoicing and partner settlements, and resolve revenue leakage, unbilled bookings and data gaps.

**On Demand products**

* Own the full product suite (Day Pass, Day Pass Plus, 5 and 10 Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings), including positioning, terms and policies, and lifecycle decisions.
* Track how each product performs and how it affects the rest of the portfolio (incremental revenue versus cannibalisation), and decide when to scale, reposition, reprice or retire a product.
* Grow B2B bulk bookings and Bookable Private Office demand from companies and teams, working with the All Access Sales team and myHQ’s B2B team.
* Identify frequent On Demand users and teams and work with the All Access Sales team to move them up the product ladder to All Access Plus, All Access Basic or All Access Pay Per Use.

**Pricing and promotions**

* Own building-level pricing for all On Demand products, including periodic price reviews, phased price revisions and measuring their impact on orders, revenue and realisation.
* Plan and govern offers and discounts across WeWork and partner channels: set budgets and approval rules, avoid discounting in buildings already at capacity, and run post-offer readouts on incremental volume and cost.
* Set up partner, co-marketing and member offers on the Offer Engine (coupon codes), and work with the Tech team on new offer formats where needed.

**Operations and inventory**

* Manage day-to-day operations. Member queries, coordination with myHQ. Responding to tickets etc.
* Own day-to-day On Demand operations across locations, including product and inventory set-up, building launches and exits, booking issues, cancellations and refunds, and escalations, in coordination with Community and Regional Operations teams.
* Manage inventory and capacity: monitor building-level utilisation, flag buildings that are at capacity or under-used, and work with Community teams on adding desks, reallocating inventory and opening new locations to On Demand.
* Manage the dynamic private office inventory behind Day Pass Plus and Bookable Private Offices, including planning ahead for upcoming private office move-outs.
* Monitor member experience through post-visit surveys (NPS), support tickets and on-ground feedback, and close the loop on recurring issues such as booking friction, crowding and service gaps.

**myHQ and channel partnerships**

* Manage the myHQ partnership end to end, covering joint business planning, inventory and pricing alignment, campaigns and offers, customer support and escalations, B2B opportunities and monthly revenue-share settlements.
* Run regular performance reviews with myHQ on volume, discount levels, new-user acquisition and revenue quality, and agree actions and governance for future offers.
* Manage other aggregator and API partners, from onboarding and booking flows to monthly invoicing and reconciliation, and build new distribution channels such as corporate, employer and HR benefits partnerships.

**Product and digital experience**

* Own the On Demand booking journey on the WeWork India app and website (discovery, product pages, checkout, payment and confirmation), working with Tech & Product teams to improve conversion, reduce drop-offs and grow the share of direct bookings.
* Write clear business requirements and user stories, prioritise the On Demand roadmap and backlog, run UAT and manage launches for new features and products.
* Own On Demand tracking and analytics requirements: define funnels and events (e.g. Mixpanel), make sure bookings, revenue and failed transactions are captured accurately and in line with data privacy requirements, and use the data to run experiments.
* Work with Marketing on demand generation, including website and in-app content, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, performance marketing and building-level activations.

**Strategy and new initiatives**

* Shape the On Demand strategy and annual plan, including targets, growth levers, business cases and the product roadmap.
* Generate and test new revenue ideas (new products, bundles, corporate offerings, partnerships and channels) through quick, low-cost pilots with clear success and stop criteria.
* Keep track of the market, including flexible workspace operators, aggregators, pricing and customer trends, and feed those insights into pricing, product and posit

  ioning decisions.

**Reporting and stakeholder management**

* Run the On Demand operating cadence: weekly performance checks and monthly business reviews that end in clear decisions, owners and timelines.
* Maintain the On Demand tracker and dashboards (revenue versus target; product, channel, city and building views; AOV and utilisation) and prepare leadership reviews and presentations.
* Partner with BI to fix data quality issues and close data gaps such as order counts, repeat rates, funnel conversion and utilisation.
* Act as the single point of contact for On Demand across Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI, Legal and Sales, keeping everyone aligned on priorities, timelines and one shared set of numbers.

title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst- Digital Channels for Sexual & Reproductive Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Overview**
Despite India’s rapid growth in digital adoption and e-commerce, the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) space remains relatively nascent online, with contraception and fertility products accounting for only $4.23M of the digital health market. At the same time, significant gaps persist the unmet need for family planning among married women stands at 8.5%, and modern contraceptive use has actually declined (from 56.4% to 52.7%), pointing to continued unmet demand for trustworthy information and access (NFHS-6, 2023-24). While users seeking FP-SRH information prefer a discreet, trustworthy path from awareness to action, the same is not achievable through traditional clinic-based counselling models and as a consequence, users often turn to digital channels where they encounter fragmented, stigmatising, or unreliable content. There is, therefore, a need for digital platforms which can offer comprehensive and reliable information.
  
  
Since 2024, WJCF has deepened its focus on Alternative Service Delivery (ASD), i.e., identifying, testing, and scaling non-traditional channels, beyond public health facilities and frontline workers, through which underserved populations can access SRH products, services, and information.
  
  
Our hypothesis is twofold. First, there is significant unmet demand for reliable, accessible FP-SRH information, and authoritative, cohort-tailored digital content can measurably shift awareness. Second, when users are offered trustworthy, stigma-free content alongside a discreet, low-friction path to purchase or counselling on platforms they already use, a meaningful share will convert from awareness to action — i.e., verified uptake of FP-SRH products and services.
  
  
Our ASD work began with a structured landscaping exercise that reviewed 56 service delivery and demand generation models across health and non-health sectors in India and globally, identifying digital and private-sector channels with the strongest potential for reach, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  
  
This approach was validated through a 2025 pilot with a leading e-pharmacy partner. WJCF co-designed and ran a 4-month, multi-channel FP-SRH demand-generation campaign which reached 0.98M users and achieved a 3% reach-to-conversion rate among new-to-category buyers. Monthly SRH purchasers rose 62% over the pre-pilot baseline - 64% of them new to the category - with growth across priority products (condoms +51%, ECPs +48%, and OCPs +57%). Average time on the campaign microsite was 4 minutes against a 1-minute benchmark, signalling strong content engagement.
  
  
Building on this foundation, WJCF has secured a multi-year grant to scale and diversify its digital SRH work across two parallel workstreams one that deepens and scales e-pharmacy partnerships into a structured, ongoing test-and-learn engine to drive users to category adoption, and another that expands into additional digital ecosystems to identify which channels can reliably move users from awareness to verified uptake, and overall, understanding the conditions under which such partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
  
  
**Position Overview**
WJCF is seeking a highly motivated
**Analyst/ Senior Analyst**
to lead analytical, strategic, and implementation workstreams for our ASD work. The Associate will drive high-quality analyses, design frameworks for intervention models, lead research activities, and manage relationships with donors and partners across digital ecosystems (e-pharmacy, e-commerce, and other consumer platforms). They will guide components of program execution, develop strategic documentation, and ensure delivery of key outputs. The role requires strong problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities, comfort working in complex environments, and the ability to independently own and drive major workstreams.
  
  

* Lead analytical workstreams for our ASD work, driving evidence-based decision-making and strategic planning.
* Lead partner scoping and due diligence efforts, defining engagement criteria and shortlisting frameworks to inform strategic partnership decisions.
* Design and run structured campaign test-cycles in partnership with digital platforms, building and testing hypotheses to optimize program performance.
* Oversee periodic reviews of campaign test-cycles to guide program strategy.
* Distil learnings from these test-cycles and develop the business case and conditions under which partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
* Design and steer scalable intervention models, frameworks, and implementation pathways in collaboration with partner organizations.
* Build and oversee measurement frameworks, dashboards, and reporting tools that track performance across the awareness-to-uptake funnel and enable data-driven decisions.
* Build and sustain relationships with digital platform partners, brand partners, donors, and technical stakeholders to strengthen alignment, negotiate partnership terms, and drive impact.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of program outputs, including strategic notes, donor reports, partnership documentation, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Mentor and supervise analysts and junior staff, providing guidance on research design, analytical approaches, and deliverable development.
* Provide operational leadership to ensure seamless planning, coordination, and execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Lead identification of new opportunities, contribute to proposal development, and craft compelling pitch materials to secure funding and partnerships across ASD, SRH, and allied areas.
* Ensure effective and prompt communication across internal teams and external stakeholders, including rapid response to critical situations with structured action plans.
* Represent WJCF in high-level forums and public engagements, leveraging strong communication and public relations skills to advocate for ASD and SRMNCH priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Public Health, Economics, Business, Population Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field

title: Senior Proposal Manager
description:
The primary function of this role is the leading and managing of international government and commercial proposals across Shield AI’s India business. The candidate should also have excellent verbal communication and team coordination skills to facilitate contributions from teams across the Shield AI team. In this capacity the proposal manager will be able to support our growing number of proposals and manage, write, and respond to requests for information.
  
  

* Leadership skills:
* Lead India proposal efforts, align stakeholders, and communicate key customer, market, and BD strategy insights.
* Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations.
* Attention to detail in a fast-paced environment: Be rigorous and go fast is one of Shield AI’s leadership traits and, possibly, the most relevant one for BD Ops. Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables.
* Organization and time management: Strong organizational and time management skills enabling the tracking and execution of multiple workstreams with stakeholders across Shield AI.
* BD Ops serves as the primary cross-functional lead for Bids/Proposals across product lines and geographic regions. We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. We are ultimately responsible for everything that does or does not happen in the Bid/Proposal process.
* The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to be flexible, work hard, hold themself and others to high standards, embrace teammates, and act with kindness.

**What You Will Do**

* Manage competing priorities across proposal and other deliverable (WPs, RFIs, ROMs, etc.) development in the fast-paced environment of the Int’l BD Ops team.
* Lead end-to-end proposal execution from pre-RFP planning through submission and closeout.
* Drive cross-functional proposal teams to deliver compliant, high-quality submissions on schedule.
* Continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Mentor proposal contributors and foster high-performing, collaborative teams.
* Support India GTM team with briefing and presentation development for customer engagements.
* Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and GTM events as required.
* Provide additional support to BD Ops and GTM team leadership as needed.

* 2-4+ years of Government of India / Indian Ministry of Defence or international government proposal development or BD operations experience.

* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, marketing, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* Strong record of academic achievement.
* Experience with proposal methodologies (e.g. Shipley), compliance matrices, and implementing project management tools and processes.
* Proven record of leadership in a professional setting.
* Ability to communicate complex, technical ideas effectively – both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly as part of a team, embrace the startup environment.
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels of an organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical background especially with unmanned/uncrewed systems and/or autonomy software. \
* Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of military operations and India defense acquisition processes.
* Understanding of international markets/geopolitical trends in aerospace / defense industry.
* Experience managing Foreign Military Sale and Direct Commercial Sale bids/proposals.
* Active Indian security clearance.

title: Senior Manager Organization Development
description:
**About the role**

Hands-on practitioner. System builder.

You will lead delivery of OD work across two formats: client consulting assignments, and cohort programmes that strengthen many institutions at once.

Our OD work is growing on both fronts. We run client diagnostics and engagements for development-sector organisations. We also deliver cohort programmes such as the Emerging Leaders Program, and we are building multi-year institutional strengthening programmes for locally rooted climate organisations across Asia and the Global South.

You will make this work excellent in the room and repeatable at scale, building the systems, tools and team that let the practice double.

**What you will do**

**1. Lead client OD engagements**

* Scope and run diagnostics and strategy, structure, leadership and culture engagements for development-sector and climate organisations.
* Facilitate senior conversations with founders, CEOs and boards, and turn findings into a plan the client acts on.
* Own quality, timelines and client relationships, and spot follow-on work.

**2. Design and run cohort programmes**

* Design multi-month cohorts: session arc, pre-reads, faculty and coaches, evaluation.
* Run cohort operations end to end, from participant journeys to progress tracking.
* Report to funders on outcomes, not only activity, and shape differentiated support for organisations at different stages of maturity.

**3. Build OD products and knowledge**

* Turn engagement learning into reusable diagnostics, benchmarks, toolkits and frameworks.
* Work with the OD Atlas and product teams to make our OD knowledge a platform, using AI tools where they raise quality and speed.
* Contribute to proposals, concept notes and thought leadership that win new work.

**4. Grow people and standards**

* Coach associates and bring them into engagements as part of their growth path.
* Help build the practice's delivery standards, templates and review rhythm.

**What success looks like, twelve months in**

* Clients who come back. Engagements you led land on time, and clients can name the change that followed.
* A cohort that delivers. At least one programme you designed or ran shows outcomes against targets agreed at the start.
* Tools in use. Reusable diagnostics and frameworks are used across engagements and feed the OD platform.
* A stronger team. Associates you coach take on more and lead parts of engagements.
* New work won. You have helped win new OD work for the practice.

**What you bring**

* At least 8 years in organisational development, institutional strengthening, leadership development or management consulting, including at least 4 years leading engagements or programmes from scoping to results.
* Experience designing and delivering a cohort or multi-session programme, with evidence of what changed for participants and their organisations.
* Strong diagnostic skills: you can enter a messy organisation, find what drives its performance, and explain it simply to a founder or board.
* Skill facilitating senior and sensitive conversations, with presence and credibility in the room.
* Working knowledge of how civil society, philanthropic or climate organisations operate, including founder-led institutions, grant cycles and funder reporting.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with sharp, outcome-focused writing.
* A relevant degree or equivalent experience.

**It helps if you have**

* Experience in a re-grantor, accelerator, fellowship or capacity-building programme.
* Experience turning your methods into tools, frameworks or digital products, and comfort using AI tools in your work.
* Experience coaching and growing junior consultants.
* Fluency in Hindi or another South or Southeast Asian language.
* Lived experience in the sectors and communities we serve.

**How you work**

* You think in outcomes, not activity. You bring a point of view, speak up when something is not working, and hold yourself to measurable results. You move fast, keep high standards on quality, and enjoy building something new inside a growing practice.
* This is a Delhi-based role, with 4 days a week in the office. The role entails travelling for work every alternate month around India and South East Asia.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a one-page note on an OD engagement or programme you led, and what changed as a result, to aastha@climateasia.org by 14 December 2026.

**Equal opportunity**

Climate Asia is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, abilities and communities, and we select on skills, experience and potential.

title: Deputy Director, Family Health
description:
**The Foundation**
We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.
  
  
**The Team**

* Division Summary

The Africa and India Offices include a diverse range of program areas aimed at finding creative ways to ensure solutions and products get into the hands of people in low-income countries who need them most. We work in areas with the potential for high-impact, sustainable solutions that can reach millions of people. Our focus is on innovative delivery, including an emphasis on strengthening primary health care systems.
  
  
Our efforts are aligned with India’s National Health Policy Goals (NHP, 2017) to - reduce preventable deaths among mothers and children and enable elimination of selected infectious diseases, and we work closely with India’s Central and State governments, and partner with community-based organizations, nonprofit organizations, academic and research institutions, the private sector, and development organizations, to achieve our shared goals. Our strong networks and ability to convene intellectual resources globally and across many sectors enable us to address emerging and complex challenges. Our efforts in India focus on key issues that affect the future of India’s most vulnerable communities: reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health and nutrition; urban sanitation; agricultural development; gender equality, and digital financial inclusion in several states of the country.
  
  
**Your Role**
India has made substantial progress in improving maternal, newborn, and child health outcomes, reflecting sustained national and state-level efforts. Building on these gains, opportunities remain to accelerate progress, particularly in states such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Assam, Meghalaya, Odisha, Jharkhand, and Chhattisgarh, where the foundation collaborates with the state governments and other partners in advancing these efforts. The foundation is committed to supporting India’s continued progress towards a future where no mother, newborn, or child dies from preventable causes. The
**Deputy Director, Family Health**
plays a key role in advancing this goal in partnership with India’s central and state governments.
  
  

* What you will be directly accountable

The Deputy Director, Family Health, holds direct accountability for the foundation’s Maternal, Newborn, Child and Nutrition Health (MNCNH) portfolio in India - its strategy, investment choices and results - and family planning and women’s health innovation to advance health outside of pregnancy, supporting advancement towards national goals and contribute to progress against the foundation's global goals in the areas described above.
  
  
You will lead implementation of the foundation’s health priorities through partners in the states assigned to you, currently Assam, Meghalaya, and Odisha (and other states of strategic importance as assigned). You will also prepare strategy for local institutional capacity building for national and state institutions and for comprehensive primary health care and implement them through the respective foundation’s state leads for the state work.
  
  

* What you will integrate or converge

You will connect the MNCNH portfolio with the foundation’s other health work - including Program Strategy Teams (PSTs) such as Women’s Health Innovation, Health Research & Development (R&D), Digital and AI, Measurement, Learning and Evaluation (MLE), and Partnerships and Communications - so that strategies, grants and investments fit together and trade-offs are made explicitly. Convergence with health (R&D) team is required to facilitate innovations development, testing, and integration into health systems to solve complex challenges. Where heath systems lever such as human resources for health, data systems, supply chains, strategic purchasing or comprehensive primary health care are needed to deliver MNCNH and state goals, you will draw on them in coordination with the teams that lead that work.
  
  

* Where accountability is shared

In your assigned states you will share accountability with the foundation’s state teams, working alongside the Deputy Directors for the Infectious Diseases and State Health Systems.
  
  
You will report to the Director - Health, India Country Office, and be a member of the India Country Office management team. This position partners closely with multiple Deputy Directors and Program Officers and is a member of a matrixed team, requiring collaboration with cross-domain program and functional teams in India and other foundation offices.
  
  

* What success looks like

Measurable, time bound programs on MNCNH goals in the portfolio and your assigned states; a well-chosen portfolio of investments with clear milestones and go/no-go decisions; strong relationship with government and local partners; and mentor a high-performing, well-developed team.
  
  
The role sits within the Foundation’s India Country Office (ICO) in
**New Delhi**
.
  
  

* What You’ll Do
* Strategy, Portfolio Leadership and Delivery
* Lead the strategy, development and delivery of the foundation’s grant portfolio in India, spanning MNCNH, Family Planning and Women’s Health Innovation. Drive measurable, time-bound progress against clearly defined outcomes and indicators aligned with maternal and child survival goals.
* Collaborate closely with the foundation’s Program Strategy Teams (PSTs) in Seattle to ensure alignment between global priorities and ICO strategies, while using evidence and local insights to advocate for context-specific adaptations.
* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the foundation’s health priorities in assigned states, currently Assam, Meghalaya and Odisha, as well as other states of strategic importance as required. Lead, manage and support the teams (two members) responsible for delivering these priorities.
* Shape and advance strategies to strengthen the capacity of local institutions and improve comprehensive primary health care, working through national and state-level teams and institutional partners to support effective implementation.
* Oversee the design, management and performance of strategic investments and grant portfolios in support of programmatic and policy objectives. Establish clear milestones and performance measures to inform investment decisions, assess progress, manage risks and make informed trade-offs across interventions, while promoting learning and knowledge-sharing across states.
* Cross-Functional Leadership and Health Systems Strengthening
* Share accountability with the foundation’s state health systems strengthening and infectious disease teams for achieving health outcomes in assigned states. Provide strategic direction, foster cross-team collaboration and resolve complex challenges requiring senior leadership engagement.
* Lead convergence between MNCNH, family planning, women’s health initiative PST teams, India Country Office’s Health Research & Development and Digital Health and AI for family health and state deliverables.
* Leverage critical health system enablers, including human resources for health, health information systems, supply chains, procurement and strategic purchasing, to accelerate progress towards MNCNH and state-level objectives, in close collaboration with the teams leading health systems strengthening.
* Foster effective collaboration across matrixed teams, ensuring alignment of priorities, coordinated execution and shared accountability for results.
* Partnerships, Policy Engagement and External Influence
* Build and sustain strategic relationships with senior government officials, technical divisions within relevant national ministries and state departments, and other key stakeholders to advance the foundation’s health priorities and influence policy and programme implementation.
* Monitor emerging policy developments, evolving government priorities and programme reforms to identify opportunities for strategic engagement and support. Leverage evidence generation, data analysis and technical expertise to inform policy dialogue and strengthen decision-making across MNCNH, Family Planning and Women’s Health.
* Develop and nurture high-impact partnerships with bilateral and multilateral agencies, philanthropic organisations, public health institutions, NGOs, private sector organisations and other stakeholders to accelerate progress towards the foundation’s goals in India.
* Maintain a structured and purposeful cadence of engagement with government counterparts, grantees and strategic partners. Lead periodic consultations, portfolio reviews and stakeholder discussions to assess progress, address challenges and continuously refine strategies.
* Serve as a trusted strategic partner and resource to grantees and foundation programme teams, providing guidance, facilitating collaboration and supporting the achievement of shared objectives.
* Measurement, Learning and Performance
* Partner closely with the Measurement, Learning and Evaluation (MLE) function to develop and advance a coherent learning agenda across states, ensuring that evidence and insights inform strategic decisions, programme adaptations and future investments.
* Oversee the monitoring, evaluation and synthesis of results from grants and contracts, translating performance data and implementation experience into actionable insights. Lead contributions to portfolio reviews, strategic assessments and presentations to senior leadership.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based decision-making and cross-state learning, ensuring that successful approaches are identified, adapted and scaled where appropriate.
* People Leadership and Organisational Contribution
* Build, lead and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, with direct management responsibility for two staff members. Provide coaching, mentorship and professional development opportunities that strengthen individual capabilities, team effectiveness and succession planning.
* Contribute actively to the ICO management team, helping shape organisational priorities, strengthen collaboration across functions and foster a culture of accountability, inclusion and high performance.
* Represent the foundation at high-level meetings, public events, technical forums and strategic engagements, effectively communicating its priorities, investments and impact.
* Lead or contribute to the development of strategic briefs, landscape analyses, policy papers and other thought leadership materials, and undertake special projects or strategic initiatives as required.

**Your Experience**
We are seeking exceptional leaders and strategic thinkers with a proven track record of developing innovative solutions and addressing complex challenges in the health sector in India. Ideal candidates will bring a hypothesis-driven, data-informed approach to problem-solving, alongside demonstrated experience navigating matrixed organizations and collaborating across diverse teams to deliver transformative, high-impact solutions.
  
  
The qualified candidate should have the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* MD in Obstetrics and Gynecology, or other advanced degree in Public Health, Global Health or related field. A doctoral degree (PhD/DrPH/MD) would be preferred.
* A minimum of 15 years of senior-level experience working within health systems at both state and national levels.
* Senior-level leadership experience in a health organization, either public or private, including responsibility for program strategy, design, and implementation, preferably in the areas of Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Nutrition Health.
* Deep, technical knowledge of family health domains, in Indian and global contexts.
* Demonstrated experience building and leading strategic partnerships with collaborators from diverse sectors including NGOs, government, and the private sector.
* Proven success using and communicating (verbally and in writing) evidence and data to inform policy, programming, and management decisions.
* Superior skills in critical thinking and planning.
* Comfortable with use of responsible AI for improving health
* Strong ability to work with efficiency and diplomacy, particularly as part of a multi-disciplinary team effort. Demonstrated ability to work in productive collaboration with diverse teams including scientists, business analysts, program implementers, and developing country partners.
* Demonstrated curiosity and comfort in areas beyond current areas of expertise with proven ability to rapidly acquire knowledge and implement good judgment in diverse scientific and political areas.
* Ability to plan, organize, and prioritize work of self and others in a fast-paced environment with multiple and competing demands, which requires the ability to see critical paths, measure and mitigate risk, and make trade-offs.
* Proven ability to structure and manage high-return, well-risk-mitigated investments, with clear benchmarks and outcomes; with experience in developing this skill in others.
* Demonstrated experience in building, leading and developing high-performing, highly skilled teams.
* Role model for courageous inquiry and intellectual integrity.
* Willingness to prioritize collective success over self.

**Other Attributes**

* Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behaviour with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity.
* Ability to travel locally and internationally, up to 40%.
* Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

**Application deadline:**
6 December 2026
  
  
**Hiring Requirements**
As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.
  
  
**Candidate Accommodations**
We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.
  
  
**Inclusion Statement**
We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.
  
  
All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: Proposal Specialist
description:
The role and impact
  
  
As a Proposal Specialist in Topsoe’s Global Commercial Proposal and Studies group, you’ll help develop competitive proposals for renewable and conventional hydroprocessing opportunities. You’ll bring together technical, commercial and operational input to deliver clear, complete proposals on time.
  
  
You’ll work closely with proposal segment managers, licensing managers, operations specialists, cost estimators and other stakeholders. Your work will support customer decisions and help strengthen Topsoe’s position in the market.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Prepare and coordinate technical proposal documents and inputs from relevant teams.
* Perform process design and simulation calculations using PRO/II or equivalent tools.
* Support proposal competitiveness through market research, trend analysis and cost considerations.
* Track proposal schedules and ensure assigned submissions are complete and delivered by agreed deadlines.
* Build your knowledge of Topsoe’s renewable and conventional hydroprocessing technologies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities to use AI-assisted solutions in workflows.
* Contribute to a safe working environment and complete required safety training and observations.

What you’ll bring
  
  

* B.E. or M.Tech in Chemical Engineering.
* Approximately 12–15 years of relevant experience.
* Hydroprocessing technology knowledge.
* Experience with process simulation tools such as PRO/II or equivalent.
* Strong coordination skills and the ability to work with multiple stakeholders.
* Clear judgement, adaptability and the confidence to respectfully challenge or decline when there is a sound reason.
* Programming or hands-on “vibe-coding” experience is an advantage.

Experience in plant operations and/or with technology licensors would be especially relevant.
  
  
Why join us
  
  
You’ll work on proposals that bring together technical expertise, customer needs and commercial considerations. In a collaborative, cross-functional team, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to competitive solutions and support work across renewable and conventional hydroprocessing.
  
  
At Topsoe, we’re problem solvers. In every role, across every office, you’ll find people passionate about finding the right answers. For over 80 years, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, always focused on solving some of the world’s biggest challenges together. We believe great results start with collaboration and respect, where every idea is heard and can drive real change. You’ll join a team of dedicated experts, united by a commitment to perfecting our craft and delivering real impact. We don’t just promise change – we make it happen. And with your contributions, we’re shaping a more sustainable future with solutions that truly matter.

title: Team Lead, App Support
description:
**Job Description**
Position Summary
  
  
Pentair seeks a Team Lead – App Support for IoT projects in the Smart Products & IoT Strategic Innovation Centre, India. This senior hands-on leadership role manages a team of about 10 support engineers, owns end-to-end mobile and web application support, and drives customer experience excellence and continuous improvement through automation and AI. The Lead partners with mid-management on KPI reporting, operational health and team performance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Team Leadership: Lead and mentor engineers across 24x7 shifts, covering workload balance, shift coverage, queue management, 1:1s, performance reviews, conflict resolution and onboarding; foster ownership and accountability.
* Customer Experience: Own end-to-end CX across Play Store, App Store, in-app feedback and email; ensure timely, empathetic responses; lead critical escalation bridge calls as senior point of contact; partner with Marketing on customer delight, launch readiness and app-store reputation.
* Application Support: Oversee triage, prioritization, routing and closure of issues from Play Store, App Store, in-app feedback and web channels; ensure SLA adherence; guide log analysis, bug identification and Jira/service desk ticketing; support AWS platform issue triage.
* KPI Reporting & Governance: Own weekly, monthly and quarterly KPI reporting to mid-management (SLA response/resolution, app ratings and review trends, ticket volume, backlog aging, reopen/escalation rates, productivity and quality); maintain dashboards and present trends with actionable recommendations.
* Innovation & Automation: Identify and implement automation; drive AI adoption (ticket triaging, sentiment analysis, smart routing, auto-responses); maintain SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices and the knowledge base; encourage a growth and innovation mindset.

**Qualifications – Mandatory**

* BCA/MCA, B.Sc. IT, any Bachelor's + MBA, or B.Tech (any discipline).
* 6–8+ years in managed services/application support (mobile & web), including 3+ years of hands-on Mobile App Support.
* 2+ years leading support teams (8–12 preferred), including work allocation, shift and performance management.
* Proven track record in customer satisfaction and in KPI reporting/operational reviews with mid/senior management.
* Strong conflict management and interpersonal skills; experience with US-based customers and time zones is a strong plus.

**Qualifications – Preferred**

* Degree in Electrical/Software/Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field; basic understanding of IoT products.
* App review tools, AI tools in support (ticket classification, chatbots, NLP auto-responses, sentiment analysis).
* Jira Software/Service Management, New Relic, AWS CloudWatch; ITIL certification; L2 support experience; IoT operations at scale (500,000+ devices).

**Skills & Abilities**

* Customer obsessed; data-driven reporting; people leader (team of 10+); innovation champion with an AI-forward mindset.
* Excellent verbal and written communication for customers and leadership; calm and decisive under pressure; flexible for a 24x7 shift environment.
* Process-oriented (SOPs, governance); self-driven with ownership; entrepreneurial, stays current on technology and proactively adopts new tools.

**About Us**
At Pentair, we believe the health of our world depends on reliable access to clean water. We deliver smart, sustainable water solutions to homes, businesses and industry worldwide. From approximately 130 locations in 34 countries, Pentair's 10,000 employees are united in our belief that the future of water depends on us. www.pentair.com
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Pentair is an Equal Opportunity Employer. With our expanding global presence, cross-cultural insight and competence are essential for our ongoing success. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes different perspectives and creative ideas that enable us to continue to improve every day.

description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
SYSTRA is a dynamic international consulting and engineering powerhouse in India, driving innovation across critical infrastructure sectors including Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for both public and private sectors.
  
  
We pride ourselves on our unparalleled expertise, consistently delivering cutting-edge technical solutions that transform infrastructure landscapes. Our comprehensive, end-to-end services leverage industry-leading methodologies to ensure project success.
  
  
***About Project :***
Systra is appointed to provide Project Management Consultancy Services for Works of Signalling & Telecommunication System, SCADA System, and Ticketing System Of Mumbai – Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project
  
  
**We Are Seeking Applications**
**Position:**
Section Engineer-Telecommunication System
  
  
Hiring for Project Management Consultancy Services for Works of Signalling & Telecommunication System, SCADA System, and Ticketing System of Mumbai – Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project
  
  
**Location:**
Ahemedabad/Delhi
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  
Assist Chief Expert and Dy. Chief Expert in performing tasks that includes the following but not limited to:
  
  

* Assist in Design review of Telecom System including sub systems for backbone of data transmission from field units to centralized control centres (DTS), Wireless Network, CCTV, Access Control, PIDS, PAS, Master Clock, EPBAX, Telecom SCADA etc.
* Assist in Installation, Integration, Testing & Commissioning of Telecom System.
* Assist in Interfacing of Telecom System with Rolling Stock, Signalling Subsystems, MEP, SCADA etc. and Interface document approval.
* Assist in verifying completed work and prepare request for payment to contractors.
* Assist NHSRCL in obtaining statutory approvals.
* Assist and coordinate with various agencies i.e. ISA, CMRS etc. for successful completion of the project.
* Assist in any other roles and responsibilities required to be performed to complete the project and assigned by PD and Client(NHSRCL).

Profile/Skills
  
  
**Min. Qualification:**
Engineering Graduate (B.E/B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical / Electronics stream or equivalent )
  
  
**Experience:**
Engineering Graduate with 07 years, or Engineering Diploma with 10 years of experience of implementing Telecommunication System during construction phase in Rail-based Transit System project(s)\*.
  
  

* Rail-based Transit System project(s) shall mean High-Speed Railways / Semi High-Speed Railways / Metro Railways projects as defined below:
* High-Speed Railways projects (ETCS based) with operational speed equal or greater than 250 Kmph shall only be considered for evaluation.
* Semi High-Speed Railways including Urban/Suburban/ Intercity/ Regional Passenger Transit Systems, projects with operational speed equal to or greater than 160 Kmph shall only be considered for evaluation.
* Metro Railways excluding LRT/Tram/Monorail Systems, projects shall only be considered for evaluation.

title: Associate Manager, Scripting
description:
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
We have Scripting Team in India, based in Gurgaon. This hub is part of our global Operations team, reporting into Operations Director based in the UK office. This team will focus on programming of ad hoc, tracking and syndicated quantitative studies, ensuring that survey instruments are tailored for precision and compliance with industry standards. The team will script and maintain online questionnaires enabling seamless data capture from healthcare professionals, patients, and key stakeholders. By integrating complex logic, customized routing, and validation checks, the team will ensure high-quality, error-free data. Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Scripting Team lead role will report into The Scripting Senior Manager position. The role will involve help with setting up the scripting function, working with Research and Project Management stakeholders to define the best practice and establish processes for scripting and data processing within the business, as well as managing actual scripting. This will include:
  
  

* Initial set up of the scripting and data processing function, working with a variety of senior stakeholders to understand requirements and suggest improvements.
* Implementation of new processes and policies, including preparing “the best practice” manuals and guides for Research and Project Management staff globally.
* Supporting a transition from an outsourced model to a blended in-house approach.
* Line management of Scripting Executives, including training, mentoring and involvement in recruitment and selection.
* Scripting and programming medium complexity online surveys using the Confirmit platform, incorporating logic, custom routing, and question validation to ensure seamless user experience and data accuracy
* Conducting rigorous testing of surveys before launch, identifying and resolving any programming or logic errors to ensure data integrity and smooth respondent experience
* Cleansing and validating data in the relevant software (SPSS or similar) and process survey data for tabulation
* Managing workloads of the team and delivery across projects
* Liaising with internal clients, advising on best practice, and assisting with problem solving

**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**

* More than 6 years of experience in a scripting role within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)
* Proficiency in using Confirmit’s scripting platform, including authoring, logic implementation, and deployment
* Solid understanding of scripting languages such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for customizing survey functionality and layout
* Experience working with survey data formats (e.g., XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management.
* Understanding of quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices.
* Demonstrable experience of working with senior and junior team members
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills
* Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**About Inizio Ignte:**
Inzio Ignite a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Project Manager – Museums, Exhibitions & Immersive Experiences
description:
**Company:**

Tagglabs

**Department:**

Projects Office

**Reports to:**

Head of Projects Office

**About the role**

Tagglabs delivers projects that bring together storytelling, spatial design, content, fabrication, audio-visual systems, software, interactive technology, and on-ground execution.

We are looking for experienced Project Managers to take ownership of the delivery and overall health of an assigned group of projects. You will translate project commitments into achievable plans, align internal teams and external partners, manage risks and commercial implications, and drive projects through to successful handover.

The role requires practical delivery experience, technical understanding, commercial judgement, and the confidence to make decisions within agreed authority. You will work closely with functional leads, client relationship teams, consultants, vendors, and site teams, connecting their work into a coordinated delivery effort.

As a member of the Projects Office, you will also contribute to resource planning, shared delivery standards, and improvements that strengthen execution across the organisation.

**Key responsibilities**

1. **Own project delivery:**

   Manage assigned projects from planning through handover, with clear scope, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
2. **Coordinate design and technical work:**

   Align drawings, content, specifications, and approvals across creative, engineering, fabrication, AV, software, and site teams.
3. **Lead teams and stakeholders:**

   Align internal teams, clients, consultants, and vendors; resolve competing priorities and drive decisions and actions to closure.
4. **Control budgets and scope:**

   Track costs and forecasts, assess changes, manage variation records, and support billing and commercial closure with Finance and Procurement.
5. **Oversee procurement and execution:**

   Monitor vendor commitments, production, logistics, and site readiness, ensuring installation follows agreed quality, safety, and delivery requirements.
6. **Manage project health and risks:**

   Verify progress, anticipate issues, implement recovery plans, and provide clear updates with recommendations and decisions required.
7. **Drive commissioning and handover:**

   Coordinate testing, acceptance, snag resolution, documentation, training, and transition to operations, including contractual defects obligations.
8. **Strengthen delivery practices:**

   Contribute execution inputs to tenders, coordinate resource needs across projects, and turn lessons learned into practical improvements.

**Ideal profile**

* Has managed complete projects or led substantial workstreams in design, architecture, interiors, fabrication, or technology integration.
* Ready to take broader responsibility for turnkey project delivery.
* Understands dependencies across disciplines and coordinates effectively with teams, vendors, and site partners.
* Brings ownership, practical judgement, commercial awareness, and clear communication.
* Anticipates issues, follows through on commitments, and actively builds knowledge beyond their own discipline.

**Experience and qualifications**

* **2–4 years of relevant experience**

  managing projects or independently leading substantial project workstreams in design, architecture, interiors, fabrication, AV, or technology integration.
* Experience contributing to museums, exhibitions, visitor centres, themed attractions, immersive environments, specialist fit-outs, or comparable multidisciplinary projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of a defined scope, including deliverables, timelines, coordination, and execution outcomes.
* Experience working across disciplines and coordinating with clients, consultants, vendors, contractors, or site teams.
* Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and project documentation relevant to your discipline, with a willingness to build understanding across others.
* Practical exposure to budgets, procurement, scope changes, installation, testing, or handover, depending on your previous responsibilities.
* Proficiency with relevant planning tools, spreadsheets, and shared documentation systems.
* A relevant qualification in project management, architecture, engineering, construction, design, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Willingness to travel and maintain an active site presence during critical delivery stages.

Experience with government or institutional clients, permanent public installations, and operational handover would be valuable. Project management certifications are welcome.

**What success looks like**

Your projects have credible plans, clear responsibilities, controlled commitments, and an accurate picture of progress. Teams receive the information and decisions they need in time to deliver. Risks surface early, changes are assessed properly, and corrective actions reach closure.

Completed projects meet agreed requirements for quality, functionality, cost, and timing, with a complete handover and clear arrangements for ongoing operation. The Projects Office has dependable visibility to make resource and priority decisions across the wider portfolio.

**Application**

Please include brief summaries of two or three relevant projects, explaining their scope, the disciplines involved, your personal responsibilities, and the delivery outcomes.
