title: Manager, Learning Design & Program Management
description:
**About ETS:**

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization driven by our mission to empower human progress through the science of measurement. We are at an exciting and pivotal moment, rapidly expanding our focus beyond traditional assessments into dynamic learning and skills development solutions, championing a future-ready, AI-powered, skills-based economy. Our Human Progress Commitment pledges to prepare over 100 million people for the next generation of jobs by 2035, leveraging our deep research in psychometrics, innovative solutions, and global partnerships to drive equity, opportunity, and impactful outcomes worldwide.

**Job Description:**

As Manager, Learning Design & Program Management, you will be the engine room of the Talent Management & Learning team. You will use AI to design and build personalized learning content, and you will run the operations behind every talent program (cohorts, calendars, communications, logistics, and participant tracking) so programs land on time across the portfolio. Where many organizations buy, ETS builds, and this role is how we build.

You will also own the day-to-day running of our talent systems once they are live, including the Workday talent modules, the learning platform, the survey platform, and our skills data, along with the compliance training campaigns that run on them. You will produce the data and reporting that the team, HR Business Partners, and leaders rely on, and over time you will take on the running of our existing assessments.

This is a transversal role by design. You will support every area the team owns (leadership and management development, AI and skills enablement, and employee experience and growth), with a growth path toward owning programs end to end. The role carries a strong cross-functional implementation mandate, partnering across HR functions, business units, and geographies. This role reports to the AVP, Talent Management & Learning.

**AI-Enabled Learning Design & Content**

* Design and build in-house learning experiences, learning paths, and program content (manager and leadership development, AI and skills enablement, onboarding, performance and growth), favoring internal builds over off-the-shelf purchases.
* Use AI tools to produce and personalize content quickly and to a high standard, turning source material such as guides, policies, and decks into engaging formats: short videos, audio, digital modules, and job aids.
* Apply sound instructional design and adult learning principles across live, digital, and blended formats, and develop facilitator guides and participant materials.

**Program Management Across the Talent Portfolio**

* Run the operations behind every talent program: cohorts, calendars, communications, logistics, vendor coordination, and participant tracking.
* Maintain one portfolio calendar across the team so programs land on time and do not collide.
* Manage several cohort-based programs running at the same time, such as people manager programs, emerging leader cohorts, and AI champion networks, from enrollment through completion and feedback.

**Talent Systems (Day-to-Day Running)**

* Once the systems are live, own their day-to-day running: the HR system's talent modules (performance, learning, talent), the learning platform, the survey platform, and skills data.
* Manage catalogs, assignments, user support, data quality, and release testing, working with HR systems, IT, and vendors.
* Work alongside the team's systems lead during the implementation of the new HR system and take over steady-state administration after go-live.

**Compliance Training**

* Deploy and monitor enterprise compliance training campaigns (e.g., information security, harassment prevention, workplace safety, and client-required programs) across ETS and its subsidiaries.
* Track completions, manage reminders and escalations, and maintain audit-ready records for internal and external audits.

**Data & Reporting**

* Produce the dashboards and reports the team, HR Business Partners, and leaders use: program participation and completion, learning activity, compliance status, survey results, and performance cycle progress.
* Keep data clean and consistent across systems so reporting is trusted.

**Assessments**

* Over time, take on the running of existing assessments (e.g., strengths and leadership assessments): access codes, scheduling, reporting, and participant support.

**Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Implementation**

* Gather feedback and results for each program and fold what is learned into the next cycle.
* Partner across HR functions, business units, and geographies to implement programs end to end, balancing enterprise consistency with local needs.

**Required Experience:**

* Significant experience (5+ years) in learning design, learning and development, or talent program management, ideally in a global or matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated instructional design capability, with a portfolio of learning experiences or content built in-house, including examples built with AI tools.
* Experience running cohort-based or enterprise programs at scale, including communications, logistics, and participant tracking.
* Hands-on experience administering a learning management system or the talent modules of an HR system.
* Strong data analysis and reporting skills (Excel or similar; dashboard tools a plus).
* Excellent written communication and organization.
* Ability to partner across HR, business units, and geographies to implement programs end to end.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Workday talent or learning modules.
* Experience running compliance training campaigns and supporting audits.
* Experience administering survey platforms or assessments.
* Video, audio, or multimedia production skills.
* Professional certifications in instructional design, project management, or HR (e.g., ATD, CPTD, PMP, SHRM, CIPD) are a plus but not required

**Knowledge/Skills**

* **AI-Enabled Content Creation:**
  Hands-on skill using AI tools to draft, design, and produce learning content (text, video, audio, interactive), with good judgment about quality and responsible use.
* **Learning Experience Design:**
  Strong instructional design across live, digital, and blended formats; able to take a program from concept to polished, ready-to-deliver materials.
* **Program & Project Management:**
  Runs several programs at once with clear plans, calendars, communications, and follow-through.
* **Talent Systems Fluency:**
  Comfortable administering HR and learning systems (HCM talent modules, LMS, survey tools) and solving user and data issues.
* **Data & Reporting:**
  Builds clear dashboards and reports and explains what the numbers mean.
* **Compliance Rigor:**
  Careful attention to tracking, documentation, and audit readiness.
* **Communication:**
  Writes clearly for program audiences and works well with facilitators, vendors, and participants.
* **Collaboration & Service Mindset:**
  Supports several internal partners at once and manages competing requests through clear priorities.
* **Adaptability & Resilience:**
  Pivots quickly as priorities shift while keeping quality high in a fast-moving, global environment.

**Ownership:**
Builds end to end in an environment where structures are still forming, and grows toward leading programs

title: Merchant Onboarding Lead
description:
**About Loop**

Loop is a subscription management platform built for e-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.

We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved ~3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025, followed by 2x growth again in 2026. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2027 as we accelerate toward our $100M goal.

**About the role**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own:**

**Onboarding Delivery and Governance**

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

**Cross Functional Partnership**

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

**Process, Tooling and Reporting**

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

**Merchant Experience and Retention**

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

**Team Leadership and Capacity**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

**What we are looking for**

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

: 7 - Manager

: Open
  
  
Must have skills: Generative AI, Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Multi-Agent Systems, Python, SQL, AI Agent Orchestration, Machine Learning,

**Job Summary**
: As an AI Decision Science Manager, you will lead cross-functional teams in the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI agents and multi-modal AI solutions that autonomously execute complex business workflows. You will be responsible for defining and implementing Gen AI and agentic AI strategies for clients, ensuring successful delivery of large-scale AI initiatives. Your expertise will drive innovation, build client relationships, and shape the roadmap for autonomous AI-driven business transformation.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
– Strategic Leadership & Project Delivery
  
  

* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI projects, from requirements gathering and solution architecture to deployment and post-implementation support
* Provide thought leadership and guidance to consultants and engineers on cutting-edge Gen AI and Agentic AI technologies
* Define and communicate a strategic vision for AI agent solutions, ensuring alignment with client business objectives
* Client & Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, translating complex AI concepts into actionable business solutions
* Drive discussions on Gen AI best practices, risk management, AI safety, and governance

* Design and implement sophisticated AI agents using frameworks like AI Refinery, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and custom agentic architectures
* Develop multi-agent systems that can collaborate, negotiate, and execute complex workflows autonomously
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for seamless communication between AI systems and external tools/APIs
* Build and deploy Generative AI applications with advanced reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities

– Leverage Advanced Data Science Techniques:
  
  

* Develop solutions using Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Define data requirements, clean, aggregate, analyze, and interpret data while conducting data quality assessments.

– Develop and Implement AI Models:
  
  

* Build and deploy AI models and Generative AI applications.
* Train and fine-tune LLMs using large-scale datasets to optimize performance and accuracy.
* Evaluate model performance and implement iterative improvements.

– Solution Integration and Deployment:
  
  

* Collaborate to integrate AI solutions into end-to-end workflows, ensuring scalability.
* Utilize cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP for model development and deployment.

– Innovation and Knowledge Sharing:
  
  

* Stay updated on advancements in AI and Data Science, exploring innovative techniques and frameworks.
* Document methodologies and findings for effective knowledge sharing.

**Job Purpose:**
The Executive - Project Planning is responsible for executing and supporting project planning activities on-site. This role involves assisting in project coordination, monitoring progress, ensuring adherence to specifications, managing material logistics, and supporting financial and reporting tasks. The position requires close collaboration with subcontractors, vendors, and project authorities to ensure seamless execution.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
3.1 Planning and Scheduling Support
  
  
 Assist in updating master schedules, look-ahead plans, micro schedules, and milestone
  
  
trackers under the guidance of the planning or PMO lead.
  
  
 Collect progress inputs from site teams, or other stakeholders for schedule updates.
  
  
 Track planned versus actual progress and highlight deviations for review.
  
  
 Support preparation of delay logs, dependency trackers, and action trackers.
  
  
3.2 Progress Monitoring and Reporting
  
  
 Prepare and update Daily Labor Reports, Daily Progress Reports, weekly progress reports,
  
  
and monthly project dashboards.
  
  
 Compile site photographs, progress quantities, manpower data, equipment deployment
  
  
details, and key observations etc. as per requirement.
  
  
 Maintain project trackers related to drawings, approvals, procurement, material delivery,
  
  
execution progress, and pending issues.
  
  
 Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and aligned with the approved reporting formats.
  
  
3.3 Coordination and Follow-up
  
  
 Coordinate with site execution teams, planning teams, consultants, contractors,
  
  
procurement teams, and internal departments for required inputs and updates.
  
  
 Follow up on pending drawings, technical clarifications, approvals, material requirements,
  
  
and site-related action items.
  
  
 Prepare meeting minutes, action item lists, responsibility matrices, and due-date trackers.
  
  
 Escalate delayed or critical items to the reporting manager with clear status and impact.
  
  
3.4 Documentation and Data Management
  
  
 Maintain organized records of project reports, meeting minutes, drawings, approvals,
  
  
correspondence, and trackers.
  
  
 Ensure proper version control and filing of project documents as per PMO guidelines.
  
  
 Support data compilation for management presentations, review meetings, audits, and
  
  
internal progress reviews.
  
  
 Assist in maintaining project MIS and ensuring data consistency across reports.
  
  
 Preparation, Maintain and tracking of Annual operation plan as per management
  
  
requirements.
  
  
3.5 Cost, Procurement, and other Supports
  
  
 Assist in tracking budget-related inputs, work order status, procurement milestones, and
  
  
material delivery schedules.
  
  
 Support collection of quantity and progress data required for billing verification and cost
  
  
monitoring.
  
  
 Maintain trackers for purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery timelines, and
  
  
pending vendor inputs.
  
  
 Highlight gaps between site requirements and procurement or billing status to the PMO
  
  
lead.
  
  
3.6 Quality, Safety, and Compliance Support
  
  
 Support documentation of quality observations, safety observations, inspection status, and
  
  
closure of non-compliance points.
  
  
 Coordinate with quality and safety teams for regular updates on open points and
  
  
corrective actions.
  
  
 Assist in preparing compliance trackers for audits, management reviews, and site
  
  
inspections.
  
  
 Maintain records of statutory approvals, permits, and project compliance documents as
  
  
required.
  
  

* Required Skills and Competencies

 Basic understanding of real estate project lifecycle, construction activities, and project
  
  
coordination process.
  
  
 Working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and basic project tracking formats.
  
  
 Ability to prepare clear reports, trackers, minutes of meeting, and follow-up records.
  
  
 Good communication skills for coordination with site teams, consultants, contractors, and
  
  
internal stakeholders.
  
  
 Attention to detail, timely follow-up, disciplined documentation, and ownership of
  
  
assigned tasks.
  
  

* Reporting and Supervision

The PMO staff member will report to the PMO Lead, Planning Manager, or Project Manager as
  
  
assigned. All reports, trackers, and project updates shall be reviewed by the reporting manager
  
  
before circulation to senior stakeholders.
  
  

* Exclusions

 The role does not include independent approval of schedules, budgets, contractor bills,
  
  
work orders, or technical submissions.
  
  
 The role does not include direct supervision of contractors or site labour unless
  
  
specifically assigned by the reporting manager.
  
  
 The role does not include final decision-making authority on project delivery, cost, quality,
  
  
or contractual matters.
  
  

* Performance Expectations

 Timely submission of assigned reports and trackers.
  
  
 Accuracy and consistency of project data.
  
  
 Effective follow-up on pending action items.
  
  
 Proper documentation and version control.
  
  
 Clear communication of delays, risks, and dependencies to the reporting manager

description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Excited by using massive amounts of data to develop Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) models? Want to help the largest global enterprises derive business value through the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI)? Eager to learn from many different enterprise’s use cases of AWS ML and DL? Thrilled to be key part of Amazon, who has been investing in Machine Learning for decades, pioneering and shaping the world’s AI technology?
  
  
At AWS ProServe India LLP (“ProServe India”), we are helping large enterprises build ML and DL models on the AWS Cloud. We are applying predictive technology to large volumes of data and against a wide spectrum of problems. Our Professional Services organization works together with our internal customers to address business needs of AWS customers using AI.
  
  
AWS Professional Services is a unique consulting team in ProServe India. We pride ourselves on being customer obsessed and highly focused on the AI enablement of our customers. If you have experience with AI, including building ML or DL models, we’d like to have you join our team. You will get to work with an innovative company, with great teammates, and have a lot of fun helping our customers.
  
  
If you do not live in a market where we have an open Data Scientist position, please feel free to apply. Our Data Scientists can live in any location where we have a Professional Service office.
  
  
A successful candidate will be a person who enjoys diving deep into data, doing analysis, discovering root causes, and designing long-term solutions. It will be a person who likes to have fun, loves to learn, and wants to innovate in the world of AI.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand the internal customer’s business need and guide them to a solution using our AWS AI Services, AWS AI Platforms, AWS AI Frameworks, and AWS AI EC2 Instances .
* Assist internal customers by being able to deliver a ML / DL project from beginning to end, including understanding the business need, aggregating data, exploring data, building & validating predictive models, and deploying completed models to deliver business impact to the organization.
* Use Deep Learning frameworks like MXNet, Caffe 2, Tensorflow, Theano, CNTK, and Keras to help our internal customers build DL models.
* Use SparkML and Amazon Machine Learning (AML) to help our internal customers build ML models.
* Work with our Professional Services Big Data consultants to analyze, extract, normalize, and label relevant data.
* Work with our Professional Services DevOps consultants to help our internal customers operationalize models after they are built.
* Assist internal customers with identifying model drift and retraining models.
* Research and implement novel ML and DL approaches, including using FPGA.

This role is open for Mumbai/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Gurugram
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Experience with popular deep learning frameworks such as MxNet and Tensor Flow
* Experience driving collaborative projects from conception to delivery, or experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations
* Experience with AI/ML technologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience

title: Strategy and Operations Specialist
description:
**Job title:**
Strategy and Operations Specialist

**Location:**
Gurugram

**About us**

We're building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East: fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. noon.com is our core marketplace and one of the region's leading e-commerce platforms. We're building at scale across categories from electronics to fashion, connecting millions of customers with sellers and brands every day. Fast-moving, data-driven and constantly evolving, it's where we test, learn and grow the business across the region.

**What you'll do**

Team noon has some of the fastest, smartest, and hardest-working people we've encountered. With a young, aggressive, and talented team, we're driving major missions forward.

As
**Strategy and Operations Specialist,**
you will be part of a team that shapes how sellers start, learn and grow on noon across the Middle East. It finds gaps in the seller journey, designs programs to close them and measures their impact, working closely with stakeholders across the company. The team also governs seller fulfilment programs, ensuring sellers hand over orders on time and to standard. It sets the program rules, monitors compliance and drives initiatives to improve how these programs perform.

Focus areas:

* Seller Ops and communications: launches, policy changes and updates across emails, help center articles and trainings
* Day-to-day operations of seller programs, from onboarding to fulfilment
* Program strategy and governance: the rules, metrics and compliance that keep programs on track
* Cross-functional work with product, tech, logistics and support teams

**Scope & responsibilities**

Seller Ops and communications (40%)

* Plan and run communications to sellers on program launches, policy changes and operational updates
* Write clear, accurate seller emails, notices and help center articles
* Coordinate seller trainings and webinars with internal teams
* Use seller feedback to improve what we tell sellers and how we tell them
* Track internal processes to spot missing communications and avoid over-communicating
* Track delivery metrics such as opens and clicks to learn what is working and what is not

End-to-end program delivery (40%)

* Own day-to-day program operations to ensure quick resolution of issues, minimum downtime for sellers and agreed service levels met
* Resolve program-specific seller issues end to end, coordinating with different stakeholders across product, logistics, support, risk and finance teams
* Track open items across stakeholders and see them through to closure
* Report on how programs are running and flag where things are slipping

Program strategy and governance (20%)

* Use data to monitor program health and spot gaps, including system, process and policy issues that affect sellers
* Define the rules, metrics and fixes that close those gaps, and drive compliance with stakeholders
* Run deep dives and business cases, and turn insights into clear recommendations for leadership
* Write clear requirements and work with product and tech teams to launch seller-facing fixes and tools

**What you'll need**

Must-have skills

* 3+ years in operations, seller or merchant operations, strategy or a similar role, ideally in e-commerce or marketplaces
* Hands-on experience running day-to-day operations: request queues, timelines, escalations and exception handling
* A seller-first mindset: you care about how each fix feels on the seller's side
* Strong problem solving: breaking down problems and fixing the process behind them
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for trackers, reconciliations and reports
* Ability to drive multiple open items with stakeholders across teams
* Detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritization across many open items at once
* Clear, simple written English for seller-facing communication
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline

Good to have

* Working knowledge of SQL to pull and check data
* Good understanding of how data flows between systems

**Who'll excel**

* We're looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

title: Manager - Data Management Strategy & Product

As a Manager within Global Servicing Data Management, you will play a key role in advancing our semantic, analytical, and data management capabilities to enable trusted, scalable, and reusable data solutions across Global Servicing.
  
  
You will partner with business, analytics, technology, and enterprise data teams to strengthen semantic modeling capabilities, enable the development of curated data products, and drive consistent data management practices that support reporting, self-service analytics, and emerging AI use cases.
  
  
The role requires a combination of strong technical understanding, data management expertise, product-oriented thinking, and cross-functional execution to help modernize our data ecosystem and improve the quality, reliability, and usability of data.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the evolution of Global Servicing's semantic platform capabilities, enabling scalable, consistent, and governed data consumption across business functions.
* Partner with business and analytics teams to design, develop, and enhance semantic models, including reusable metrics, dimensions, relationships, and business calculation logic.
* Establish and promote standardized semantic modeling practices, ensuring alignment with approved business definitions, underlying data products, and enterprise architecture standards.

title: Lead, On Demand, Digital Products
description:
**About us**

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 85 centres, 9.8 million square ft (operational area) (as of October 2026). WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our


website

**About the role**

The On Demand team operates within the Digital Products vertical. The portfolio includes Day Passes, Day Pass Plus, Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings, sold through the WeWork India app and website, myHQ, and other aggregator and corporate channels.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of the On Demand business: revenue and P&L, the product portfolio, pricing and promotions, inventory and day-to-day operations, the myHQ partnership and other channels, and the digital booking experience. It sits at the intersection of business, product and operations, working closely with Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI and Sales teams, as well as external partners.

The team member will be responsible for growing On Demand revenue profitably by improving how the business is priced, distributed, operated and measured, and by shaping the next set of On Demand products, while ensuring a seamless booking and on-site experience for members.

**Role and responsibilities**

 

**Revenue and P&L**

* Own the On Demand P&L and deliver monthly and annual revenue targets, tracking performance on both a gross booking value and a realised revenue (net of partner share) basis.
* Build and maintain the monthly forecast and revenue bridge, breaking performance down by product, channel, city and building to explain what moved, why, and what needs to change.
* Drive growth across every lever (volume, price, product mix and capacity) while protecting realisation on discounted and partner-led sales.
* Reconcile On Demand revenue across booking systems, partner reports and finance records, including monthly aggregator invoicing and partner settlements, and resolve revenue leakage, unbilled bookings and data gaps.

**On Demand products**

* Own the full product suite (Day Pass, Day Pass Plus, 5 and 10 Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings), including positioning, terms and policies, and lifecycle decisions.
* Track how each product performs and how it affects the rest of the portfolio (incremental revenue versus cannibalisation), and decide when to scale, reposition, reprice or retire a product.
* Grow B2B bulk bookings and Bookable Private Office demand from companies and teams, working with the All Access Sales team and myHQ’s B2B team.
* Identify frequent On Demand users and teams and work with the All Access Sales team to move them up the product ladder to All Access Plus, All Access Basic or All Access Pay Per Use.

**Pricing and promotions**

* Own building-level pricing for all On Demand products, including periodic price reviews, phased price revisions and measuring their impact on orders, revenue and realisation.
* Plan and govern offers and discounts across WeWork and partner channels: set budgets and approval rules, avoid discounting in buildings already at capacity, and run post-offer readouts on incremental volume and cost.
* Set up partner, co-marketing and member offers on the Offer Engine (coupon codes), and work with the Tech team on new offer formats where needed.

**Operations and inventory**

* Manage day-to-day operations. Member queries, coordination with myHQ. Responding to tickets etc.
* Own day-to-day On Demand operations across locations, including product and inventory set-up, building launches and exits, booking issues, cancellations and refunds, and escalations, in coordination with Community and Regional Operations teams.
* Manage inventory and capacity: monitor building-level utilisation, flag buildings that are at capacity or under-used, and work with Community teams on adding desks, reallocating inventory and opening new locations to On Demand.
* Manage the dynamic private office inventory behind Day Pass Plus and Bookable Private Offices, including planning ahead for upcoming private office move-outs.
* Monitor member experience through post-visit surveys (NPS), support tickets and on-ground feedback, and close the loop on recurring issues such as booking friction, crowding and service gaps.

**myHQ and channel partnerships**

* Manage the myHQ partnership end to end, covering joint business planning, inventory and pricing alignment, campaigns and offers, customer support and escalations, B2B opportunities and monthly revenue-share settlements.
* Run regular performance reviews with myHQ on volume, discount levels, new-user acquisition and revenue quality, and agree actions and governance for future offers.
* Manage other aggregator and API partners, from onboarding and booking flows to monthly invoicing and reconciliation, and build new distribution channels such as corporate, employer and HR benefits partnerships.

**Product and digital experience**

* Own the On Demand booking journey on the WeWork India app and website (discovery, product pages, checkout, payment and confirmation), working with Tech & Product teams to improve conversion, reduce drop-offs and grow the share of direct bookings.
* Write clear business requirements and user stories, prioritise the On Demand roadmap and backlog, run UAT and manage launches for new features and products.
* Own On Demand tracking and analytics requirements: define funnels and events (e.g. Mixpanel), make sure bookings, revenue and failed transactions are captured accurately and in line with data privacy requirements, and use the data to run experiments.
* Work with Marketing on demand generation, including website and in-app content, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, performance marketing and building-level activations.

**Strategy and new initiatives**

* Shape the On Demand strategy and annual plan, including targets, growth levers, business cases and the product roadmap.
* Generate and test new revenue ideas (new products, bundles, corporate offerings, partnerships and channels) through quick, low-cost pilots with clear success and stop criteria.
* Keep track of the market, including flexible workspace operators, aggregators, pricing and customer trends, and feed those insights into pricing, product and posit

  ioning decisions.

**Reporting and stakeholder management**

* Run the On Demand operating cadence: weekly performance checks and monthly business reviews that end in clear decisions, owners and timelines.
* Maintain the On Demand tracker and dashboards (revenue versus target; product, channel, city and building views; AOV and utilisation) and prepare leadership reviews and presentations.
* Partner with BI to fix data quality issues and close data gaps such as order counts, repeat rates, funnel conversion and utilisation.
* Act as the single point of contact for On Demand across Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI, Legal and Sales, keeping everyone aligned on priorities, timelines and one shared set of numbers.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree required in a related field; an MBA is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (preferably in Product, Category, Business Operations or Revenue Management within consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, travel/hospitality or flexible workspace)
* Proven ownership of revenue targets or a P&L, with a track record of moving business metrics
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and comfort working with large booking and revenue datasets
* Experience working with Tech & Product teams on requirements, prioritisation, testing and launches
* Good understanding of pricing, promotions and unit economics
* Experience managing external partners, aggregators or marketplace channels is a plus
* Exposure to product analytics and BI tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Tableau) is a plus; SQL is a plus
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills, including presenting to senior leadership
* Ownership mindset and comfort working across teams without direct authority in a fast-paced environment

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

WeWork India is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our employees and members. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to embody our values and all aspects of employment including the decisions to hire and promote, are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

Our total rewards philosophy is aimed at providing compensation that is competitive, performance linked and helps us attract and retain the talent we need to drive our business forward and serve our members. As part of WeWork India, our commitment to you is that  you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters collaboration, flexibility and inclusion.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst- Digital Channels for Sexual & Reproductive Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Overview**
Despite India’s rapid growth in digital adoption and e-commerce, the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) space remains relatively nascent online, with contraception and fertility products accounting for only $4.23M of the digital health market. At the same time, significant gaps persist the unmet need for family planning among married women stands at 8.5%, and modern contraceptive use has actually declined (from 56.4% to 52.7%), pointing to continued unmet demand for trustworthy information and access (NFHS-6, 2023-24). While users seeking FP-SRH information prefer a discreet, trustworthy path from awareness to action, the same is not achievable through traditional clinic-based counselling models and as a consequence, users often turn to digital channels where they encounter fragmented, stigmatising, or unreliable content. There is, therefore, a need for digital platforms which can offer comprehensive and reliable information.
  
  
Since 2024, WJCF has deepened its focus on Alternative Service Delivery (ASD), i.e., identifying, testing, and scaling non-traditional channels, beyond public health facilities and frontline workers, through which underserved populations can access SRH products, services, and information.
  
  
Our hypothesis is twofold. First, there is significant unmet demand for reliable, accessible FP-SRH information, and authoritative, cohort-tailored digital content can measurably shift awareness. Second, when users are offered trustworthy, stigma-free content alongside a discreet, low-friction path to purchase or counselling on platforms they already use, a meaningful share will convert from awareness to action — i.e., verified uptake of FP-SRH products and services.
  
  
Our ASD work began with a structured landscaping exercise that reviewed 56 service delivery and demand generation models across health and non-health sectors in India and globally, identifying digital and private-sector channels with the strongest potential for reach, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  
  
This approach was validated through a 2025 pilot with a leading e-pharmacy partner. WJCF co-designed and ran a 4-month, multi-channel FP-SRH demand-generation campaign which reached 0.98M users and achieved a 3% reach-to-conversion rate among new-to-category buyers. Monthly SRH purchasers rose 62% over the pre-pilot baseline - 64% of them new to the category - with growth across priority products (condoms +51%, ECPs +48%, and OCPs +57%). Average time on the campaign microsite was 4 minutes against a 1-minute benchmark, signalling strong content engagement.
  
  
Building on this foundation, WJCF has secured a multi-year grant to scale and diversify its digital SRH work across two parallel workstreams one that deepens and scales e-pharmacy partnerships into a structured, ongoing test-and-learn engine to drive users to category adoption, and another that expands into additional digital ecosystems to identify which channels can reliably move users from awareness to verified uptake, and overall, understanding the conditions under which such partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
  
  
**Position Overview**
WJCF is seeking a highly motivated
**Analyst/ Senior Analyst**
to lead analytical, strategic, and implementation workstreams for our ASD work. The Associate will drive high-quality analyses, design frameworks for intervention models, lead research activities, and manage relationships with donors and partners across digital ecosystems (e-pharmacy, e-commerce, and other consumer platforms). They will guide components of program execution, develop strategic documentation, and ensure delivery of key outputs. The role requires strong problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities, comfort working in complex environments, and the ability to independently own and drive major workstreams.
  
  

* Lead analytical workstreams for our ASD work, driving evidence-based decision-making and strategic planning.
* Lead partner scoping and due diligence efforts, defining engagement criteria and shortlisting frameworks to inform strategic partnership decisions.
* Design and run structured campaign test-cycles in partnership with digital platforms, building and testing hypotheses to optimize program performance.
* Oversee periodic reviews of campaign test-cycles to guide program strategy.
* Distil learnings from these test-cycles and develop the business case and conditions under which partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
* Design and steer scalable intervention models, frameworks, and implementation pathways in collaboration with partner organizations.
* Build and oversee measurement frameworks, dashboards, and reporting tools that track performance across the awareness-to-uptake funnel and enable data-driven decisions.
* Build and sustain relationships with digital platform partners, brand partners, donors, and technical stakeholders to strengthen alignment, negotiate partnership terms, and drive impact.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of program outputs, including strategic notes, donor reports, partnership documentation, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Mentor and supervise analysts and junior staff, providing guidance on research design, analytical approaches, and deliverable development.
* Provide operational leadership to ensure seamless planning, coordination, and execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Category Manager – Travel Business**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
6–12 years

**About Thrillophilia**

Thrillophilia is one of India’s leading experiential travel platforms, helping millions of travellers discover and book curated holidays and experiences across India and international destinations.

We are building destination-led travel businesses where each category is managed with clear ownership across product, pricing, suppliers, marketing, sales, customer experience, revenue, and profitability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

This is not a procurement-only or operations-only role.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

A strong Category Manager should be able to say:

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**What You Will Own**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Create clear product USPs that make the category easier to sell and harder to replicate.
* Ensure the product portfolio serves different customer segments, budgets, and travel styles.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality suppliers, hotels, DMCs, transport partners, and experience providers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.
* Ensure the sales team has the right products, pricing, and information to close effectively.

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, CRM, and Brand teams.
* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

**Customer Experience**

* Track customer feedback, NPS, complaints, cancellations, and service failures.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.
* Identify recurring issues and fix them at the product or supplier level.
* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in category management, business ownership, travel product management, P&L management, or a related role.
* Experience in travel, consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, hospitality, or a high-growth business.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, margins, pricing, and profitability.
* Ability to analyse market demand and translate insights into products and business decisions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
* High ownership and comfort working across multiple teams.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience owning a destination, category, geography, or business line.
* Experience in outbound or domestic holiday packages.
* Exposure to sales-led or high-consideration customer journeys.
* Experience managing both product and commercial outcomes.
* MBA or equivalent business education is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Category revenue
* Contribution margin and profitability
* Booking conversion
* Product performance
* Supplier competitiveness
* Customer satisfaction and NPS
* Cancellation and refund rates
* Sales productivity
* New product success
* Market share growth

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:

* Build a clear understanding of the assigned destination or category.
* Identify the biggest gaps in product, pricing, suppliers, and conversion.
* Create a structured category growth plan.
* Improve product quality, supplier competitiveness, and sales readiness.
* Establish clear performance dashboards and operating reviews.

Over time, you should build and scale the category into a significant, profitable business with strong customer trust and clear market differentiation.

**Why Join Thrillophilia?**

* Own a business, not just a function.
* Work directly on revenue, margins, products, suppliers, sales, and customer experience.
* Build destinations and categories at meaningful scale.
* Work closely with senior leaders across business, marketing, sales, product, and operations.
* Get the opportunity to grow into a Category Head, Business Head, or P&L leader.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a founder, acts like an operator, and takes complete responsibility for outcomes.

title: Senior Programme Manager
description:
Role purpose
  
  
The Senior Manager – Finance Systems will provide permanent, enterprise-level leadership for the Finance Systems & Transformation portfolio. The role combines programme delivery leadership with hands-on portfolio management, governance and PMO discipline, ensuring that strategic initiatives move from concept and approval through controlled execution, adoption and benefits realisation.
  
  
The role will maintain an integrated view across Finance transformation initiatives, including finance systems, planning and forecasting, reporting and analytics, controls improvement, process transformation and operating-model change. It will give Finance leadership clear visibility of priorities, delivery status, risks, dependencies, resources, costs and decisions, while holding workstream owners and delivery partners accountable for outcomes.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Programme leadership and execution: Translate the Finance Transformation strategy and roadmap into executable programmes, workstreams, milestones and outcomes. Drive delivery across multiple initiatives and intervene early where progress, ownership or quality is at risk.
* Integrated portfolio planning: Own the consolidated transformation roadmap, integrated plan, critical path and cross-workstream dependencies. Maintain a clear view of sequencing, capacity, funding and business availability.
* Governance and decision support: Operate the programme governance rhythm, including Steering Committee preparation, decision papers, status reporting, action tracking and follow-through. Ensure forums focus on decisions, outcomes and value rather than activity reporting.
* PMO and delivery discipline: Establish and maintain consistent planning, RAID, dependency, decision, change-control, financial tracking and document-management standards across the portfolio.
* Risk, issue and escalation management: Maintain an enterprise view of delivery risks and issues, ensure mitigations have accountable owners and dates, and escalate material matters with clear options and recommendations.
* Workstream assurance: Challenge plans, assumptions, RAG status, estimates and recovery actions. Confirm that scope, requirements, testing, readiness, controls, documentation and handover are adequate before stage-gate decisions.
* Stakeholder alignment: Build strong relationships across Finance, Finance Systems, Technology, Operations, Risk, Internal Audit and regional teams. Translate complex delivery information into concise, decision-ready messages for senior leaders.
* Supplier and resource coordination: Coordinate internal teams, contractors and delivery partners; monitor commitments, deliverables, costs and knowledge transfer; support mobilisation, onboarding and transition to permanent capability.
* Change, readiness and adoption: Ensure each initiative has a proportionate change approach covering communications, training, business readiness, operating procedures, ownership and transition into BAU.
* Benefits and continuous improvement: Define measurable outcomes and benefits, track realisation after implementation and ensure lessons learned are reflected in future delivery standards.

Key working relationships
  
  
Finance Transformation sponsors and Steering Committee; Head of Finance Systems; Global and Regional Finance leadership; Finance process owners; Technology and data teams; Risk, Controls, Internal Audit and external audit stakeholders; programme and project managers; business analysts; implementation partners and specialist suppliers.
  
  
Key deliverables
  
  

* Integrated Finance Systems Transformation roadmap and portfolio plan with milestones, dependencies, resources and critical path.
* Clear executive reporting, programme dashboards, decision papers and Steering Committee materials.
* Current RAID, decision, action, dependency, change and benefits registers with accountable ownership.
* Consistent delivery methodology, templates, stage gates and evidence standards across workstreams.
* Recovery plans for red or amber initiatives, with measurable actions and dates.
* Controlled programme financial and resource view covering budgets, forecasts, supplier costs and capacity.
* Business readiness, transition and BAU handover plans for each material initiative.
* Portfolio-level benefits tracking and post-implementation review.

**Essential**
Skills and experience
  
  

* Significant experience leading complex, multi-workstream Finance Systems or enterprise transformation programmes.
* Strong programme and portfolio management capability, including integrated planning, governance, RAID, dependencies, change control and benefits realisation.
* Experience preparing executive and Steering Committee reporting and converting complex information into clear decisions and recommendations.
* Proven ability to coordinate Finance, Technology, Operations and external delivery partners in a matrix environment.
* Experience challenging delivery plans, driving recovery activity and holding senior workstream owners accountable.
* Understanding of Finance processes, systems implementation, controls, testing, readiness and BAU transition.
* Commercial and financial discipline covering budgets, forecasts, resource plans and supplier commitments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, facilitation and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate hands-on, manage competing priorities and deliver through ambiguity.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Financial Services or another regulated, control-focused environment.
* Experience with Finance ERP, EPM, reporting, data, controls or operating-model transformation.
* Exposure to platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Anaplan, Power BI, Qlik or Azure DevOps.
* Experience establishing or maturing a transformation office, portfolio office or enterprise PMO.
* Experience working across global teams and delivery partners, including India-based delivery models.
* Recognised programme or project management qualification, such as MSP, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent.
* Finance, accounting, technology or transformation-related professional qualification.

Personal attributes
  
  

* Outcome-oriented, structured and able to combine strategic perspective with hands-on delivery.
* Calm and credible with senior stakeholders, while willing to challenge constructively.
* Highly organised, analytical and rigorous about ownership, evidence and follow-through.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and comfortable making recommendations with incomplete information.
* Collaborative across cultures, functions and locations, with a strong commitment to building internal capability.

Success measures
  
  

* Transformation initiatives delivered to agreed outcomes, quality, cost and key milestones.
* Leadership has a reliable, single view of programme status, decisions, risks, resources and dependencies.
* Material risks and slippage are identified early, with timely recovery action and escalation.
* Governance forums result in clear decisions, accountable actions and measurable follow-through.
* Improved consistency and maturity of programme planning, reporting and delivery controls.
* Successful business adoption, BAU transition and measurable benefits realisation.
* Reduced reliance on external programme leadership through sustainable permanent capability in India.

Role positioning
  
  
This is not a reporting-only PMO role. It is a senior, hands-on programme leadership position accountable for joining up the Finance Transformation portfolio, driving execution and maintaining the governance discipline required to deliver sustainable business outcomes. Individual workstream leads remain accountable for their solutions and deliverables; this role provides the integration, challenge, visibility and leadership that connect them into one controlled programme.
  
  
**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION

## E-Commerce Account Manager

\*\*Company:\*\* Garima Agarbatti

\*\*Department:\*\* E-Commerce & Online Sales

\*\*Position:\*\* E-Commerce Account Manager

\*\*Experience:\*\* 7-12 Years (Relevant E-Commerce Experience)

\*\*Job Location:\*\* Sahibabad, Ghaizabad

\*\*Salary:\*\* 40k-50k

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

### About Garima Agarbatti

Garima Agarbatti is a growing FMCG brand offering a wide range of agarbatti, dhoop, dry cones and other fragrance products. With a strong focus on quality and customer satisfaction, we are looking to expand our presence in India's rapidly growing e-commerce market.

We are looking for an ambitious and result-oriented E-Commerce Account Manager who can take complete ownership of our online business, drive sales growth, build a strong e-commerce team and establish Garima as a leading brand across online marketplaces.

### Role Overview

The E-Commerce Account Manager will be responsible for managing and expanding the company's online business across Amazon, Flipkart and other e-commerce platforms.

The candidate must have hands-on experience in marketplace management, sales growth, advertising, inventory planning, order management, account health and team handling.

The objective is not just to manage existing accounts but to build a scalable and profitable e-commerce business from the ground up.

### Key Responsibilities

\*\*1. Marketplace Management\*\*

- Independently manage Amazon, Flipkart and other online marketplace accounts.

- Handle complete account operations, including product listings, catalogues, pricing and inventory.

- Ensure account health, compliance, ratings and marketplace performance.

- Manage product launches and new SKU onboarding.

- Improve product visibility and search rankings.

\*\*2. Sales Growth & Business Development\*\*

- Develop and execute strategies to increase monthly and annual online sales.

- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

- Identify growth opportunities across different product categories.

- Analyse competitors, pricing strategies and market trends.

- Improve conversion rates, average order value and repeat purchases.

- Develop strategies to increase market share and brand presence.

\*\*3. Advertisement & Marketing\*\*

- Plan, execute and optimise Amazon PPC and Flipkart advertising campaigns.

- Manage advertising budgets and improve ROAS.

- Monitor ACOS, TACOS, CTR and conversion rates.

- Execute promotional campaigns, deals and seasonal offers.

- Coordinate with the creative team for product images, A+ content, banners and other marketing materials.

\*\*4. Complete E-Commerce Operations\*\*

- Monitor daily orders, dispatches, cancellations and returns.

- Coordinate with warehouse and logistics teams.

- Maintain inventory levels and prevent stock-outs or excess inventory.

- Manage product pricing, commissions, marketplace fees and profitability.

- Resolve seller account issues, customer complaints and operational escalations.

- Ensure smooth day-to-day functioning of all marketplace accounts.

\*\*5. Profitability & Business Reporting\*\*

- Prepare monthly sales and profitability reports.

- Monitor marketplace-wise and SKU-wise performance.

- Analyse gross margins, advertising expenses, returns and other operating costs.

- Prepare sales forecasts and inventory requirements.

- Identify opportunities to improve overall contribution margins.

\*\*6. Team Building & Leadership\*\*

- Build and manage a dedicated e-commerce team.

- Recruit, train and supervise team members.

- Define responsibilities, targets and performance indicators.

- Establish standard operating procedures for daily operations.

- Create a structured system for reporting, accountability and business growth.

- Take ownership of the overall e-commerce department.

\*\*7. Expansion & Future Growth\*\*

- Explore opportunities on Meesho, JioMart, ONDC and other relevant platforms.

- Identify new product categories and online business opportunities.

- Develop a long-term strategy to establish Garima as a strong online FMCG brand.

- Build systems and processes that support large-scale business expansion.

### Required Skills & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.

- 3–6 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce marketplace management.

- Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.

- Experience in FMCG, food, personal care or consumer products will be preferred.

- Knowledge of marketplace advertising and performance marketing.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Experience in handling sales targets, budgets and profitability.

- Previous experience in managing or building a team.

- Excellent communication, negotiation and leadership skills.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of business results.

### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

1. Monthly and annual sales growth.

2. Marketplace-wise sales target achievement.

3. Advertising efficiency and ROAS.

4. SKU-wise profitability and contribution margins.

5. Reduction in returns, cancellations and operational losses.

6. Inventory availability and stock management.

7. Product ranking, visibility and conversion improvement.

8. Successful launch of new products.

9. Team productivity and operational efficiency.

10. Expansion into new e-commerce channels.

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to operate Amazon Seller Central or Flipkart Seller Hub.

title: Manager - Data Management Strategy & Product
description:

You will partner with business, analytics, technology, and enterprise data teams to strengthen semantic modeling capabilities, enable the development of curated data products, and drive consistent data management practices that support reporting, self-service analytics, and emerging AI use cases.
