title: Business Strategy & AI Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy & AI Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Strong academic background; graduates from leading engineering or management institutes preferred. MBA is an advantage.

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

title: Director, Commercial Strategy // Consumer Insights
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
  
  
The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
  
  
Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.
  
  
The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go-to-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion.
  
  
The Director, Commercial Strategy // Consumer Insights is a credentialed industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the commercial agenda for the Consumer vertical within the firm's Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Enablement, this leader is the firm's sector SME and the source of market insight that equips MDs, Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and Account Teams to drive origination in the sector.
  
  
The role owns the vertical's commercial point of view (POV) – the market updates, sector analysis and origination-focused thought leadership that position the firm with prospects and clients – working closely with PLLs, MDs, Account Teams and Marketing to translate that insight into firm-facing content and external presence.
  
  
Success is measured by the firm's positioning in the Consumer sector, the quality and timeliness of the vertical's commercial intelligence, its presence in firm marketing and external content, and the degree to which market-facing teams treat the vertical as the firm's authoritative source for sector insight.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the commercial agenda for the Consumer vertical, serving as the firm’s sector SME
* Partner with senior team members across the firm to drive recurring deliverables, including sector POVs, quarterly outlooks, market maps, origination theses, account whitespace analysis, MD briefing packs and pitch / proposal support
* Equip MDs, PLLs and Account Teams with the sector context and briefings needed to pursue whitespace and cross-sell opportunities ahead of priority meetings and pursuits
* Monitor industry trends, market signals and competitive dynamics specific to the Consumer sector and translate them into actionable commercial direction
* Support business development efforts with sector-specific positioning, insight and supporting analysis
* Provide expertise to maintain a credible external presence in the Consumer sector by developing materials and content to be used for bylined content, conference participation and other public-facing channels
* Partner with Marketing to align vertical content, campaigns and external presence with firm go-to-market strategy and thought leadership
* Coordinate with peer industry vertical leaders to maintain a consistent commercial POV format and cadence across the CE function
* Partner with the VP, Account and VP, Pipeline to ensure sector insight is reflected in account plans and pursuit strategy
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high-performing and inclusive culture

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* 10 plus years in the Consumer sector, in commercial strategy, business development, consulting, investment banking or an industry-facing advisory role
* Recognized subject matter expertise in Consumer, with a credible origination, investment banking or advisory track record in that sector
* Demonstrated track record of producing credible, market-facing commercial content for an external audience
* Experience operating within professional services, consulting, investment banking or private equity environments
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and a process- and ownership-oriented mindset
* Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
* Experience within the middle market private equity and advisory ecosystem, preferably serving U.S. clients
* Familiarity with Intapp DealCloud, HubSpot or equivalent commercial platforms preferred
* Experience producing thought leadership or market commentary published in industry-recognized channels preferred
* Superior written and verbal communication, including executive-ready presentation and reporting, with the ability to influence stakeholder and work effectively across technical and non-technical teams
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

title: Consultant
description:
Role: Consultant

Location: Gurugram, Sector - 49

Mode of Work: On-site (5 Days)

Department: Research & Consulting

Reporting To: Engagement Manager/Project Lead

Employment Type: Permanent

**Role Summary**

**The Consultant is responsible for delivering high-quality research and consulting solutions by leading end-to-end project execution across syndicated research, custom research and Go-to-Market (GTM) engagements. The role requires hands-on expertise in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy.**

**The Consultant will present insights and strategic recommendations to clients, ensure client satisfaction, develop proposals and drive new and repeat business. Additionally, the role involves leading and mentoring a team of analysts, strengthening research methodologies and contributing to organizational growth through strategic insights and industry best practices.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Research Project Management & Delivery**

**• Lead and oversee multiple research projects, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.**

**• Define project scope, objectives, research methodologies and execution plans.**

**• Lead market sizing and opportunity assessment studies, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Available Market (SAM) and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM), using top-down and bottom-up approaches.**

**• Develop market forecasts through clearly defined assumptions, demand drivers, scenario analysis and validation of primary and secondary research findings.**

**• Develop actionable GTM strategies covering customer segmentation, target market prioritisation, competitive positioning, pricing and distribution channels.**

**• Conduct hypothesis building, model mapping and data validation.**

**• Perform sanity checks, proofread deliverables and develop strategic recommendations.**

**• Ensure alignment of deliverables with client expectations.**

**• Maintain communication with clients throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating feedback to refine deliverables.**

**2. Client Engagement**

**• Develop compelling client proposals, including responses to RFPs and tenders for government bodies.**

**• Present research findings to prospective clients and generate repeat business.**

**• Build strong client relationships to support long-term partnerships.**

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

**• Build and manage a high-performing team of Research Associates, Analysts and Senior Analysts.**

**• Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.**

**• Provide mentorship, skill enhancement and career development opportunities.**

**• Encourage a positive work culture centred on collaboration and innovation.**

**4. Research Innovation & Best Practices**

**• Integrate industry best practices into research methodologies.**

**• Use advanced analytics, automation and data-driven insights to improve research quality and efficiency.**

**• Introduce innovative techniques for data collection, analysis and reporting.**

**Qualifications & Skills Required**

**• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing or a related field.**

**• 4+ years of experience in Market Research, Consulting or Business Strategy.**

**• Demonstrated hands-on experience in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy, with the ability to explain methodologies, assumptions and resulting client recommendations.**

**• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies.**

**• Excellent client handling, presentation and business development capabilities.**

**• Proven leadership skills, with experience in managing teams.**

**• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management abilities.**

**• Proficiency in MS Office, CRM tools and data analytics platforms.**

title: Merchant Onboarding Lead
description:
**About Loop**

Loop is a subscription management platform built for e-commerce brands on Shopify. Our primary market is the US, with growing presence in Europe and ANZ.

We are scaling rapidly, driven by a strong product and exceptional merchant experience. We achieved ~3x growth in 2024, followed by nearly 3x growth again in 2025, followed by 2x growth again in 2026. Looking ahead, we are building the team and foundation to drive another 2x growth in 2027 as we accelerate toward our $100M goal.

**About the role**

You will own merchant onboarding at Loop from sales handoff to Success handover, across three regions. You will lead a team of Onboarding Specialists, set the operating standard for every onboarding, and be accountable for time to go live, onboarding quality, and early churn. This role is about building a predictable onboarding engine that scales with our growth. It is not about running onboardings yourself.

**What you will own:**

**Onboarding Delivery and Governance**

* Own end to end onboarding performance: kickoff SLAs, milestone adherence, and go live dates across the full merchant portfolio.
* Set the standards for kickoff, weekly touchpoints, configuration, migration validation and handover, and audit adherence.
* Step in personally on strategic, high value or at risk merchants.

**Cross Functional Partnership**

* Act as the primary escalation point for Sales, Implementation Engineering, Migration, Product and Success.
* Improve the sales to onboarding handoff so merchants are scoped correctly before kickoff.
* Agree SLAs and escalation paths with Implementation Engineering and Migration, and hold all sides to them.
* Turn recurring merchant feedback into prioritised product inputs and track them to resolution.

**Process, Tooling and Reporting**

* Own onboarding playbooks, templates and documentation standards.
* Keep Salesforce, Sheets and internal dashboards accurate, and remove manual tracking wherever possible.
* Report weekly and monthly on onboarding health to leadership, with risks and corrective actions.
* Identify bottlenecks using data and redesign the process to remove them.

**Merchant Experience and Retention**

* Own the merchant experience during onboarding, including handling of delays, product gaps and escalations.
* Drive down churn during onboarding and in the first 30 days post handover.
* Ensure every handover to Success is complete, documented and accepted by the Success team.

**Team Leadership and Capacity**

* Lead, coach and grow a team of Onboarding Specialists across regions
* Plan capacity and allocate merchants by region, complexity and specialist bandwidth.
* Hire, onboard and ramp new specialists. Set clear performance goals and run regular 1:1s and reviews.

**What we are looking for**

* 7+ years in customer onboarding, implementation or customer success at a B2B SaaS company, with 3+ years managing teams of 10 or more.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Strong track record of running onboarding at scale with measurable improvement in time to value and early retention.
* Comfort with technical setups: integrations, data migration, configuration. You do not need to code, but you need to hold your own with engineers.
* Hands on with Salesforce and dashboarding; data driven in how you run the team.
* Calm, clear communicator in escalations with merchants and senior internal stakeholders.

title: Sr Eng Pgm Supervisor
description:
**Job Description**
Sr Engineering Program Supervisor for Airport airside/ATM software/Hardware system is responsible for full Software/Hardware Project Deployment and Delivery including Requirements Management, Software Product Adaptation, software solution architecture, Feature Driven Development, Interface Development, Software customization and Implementation, Testing, & Commissioning including Change Management.. This role requires extensive experience in implementation of Communications, Navigation, Surveillance / Air Traffic Management / Ground Traffic Management (CNS/ ATM/GTM) projects for major airports globally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Establish professional relationships and communications with Customers, End Users (Airside engineering, ATNS, ATC and Airside Operators), consultants, Project Management, Sales, Proposal & Estimation, Services, R&D, HAB-Global engineer services (GES) etc.
* Provide day-to-day consultation, leadership and direction to project team comprising professional engineering staff.
* Provide technical leadership for solution architecture based on airports concept of operations, architecture and design, analysis & development leading to delivery of innovative solutions addressing customer business requirements.
* Good working knowledge on latest technologies, Object oriented and distributed architecture, high performance system deployment and mobility solutions.
* Good knowledge on regulatory requirements such as ICAO, IATA, FAA and regional regulatory requirements for airport aerodrome design and operations, ATM system design and operations. Applying regulatory knowledge on system solution design.
* Provide execution guidance and practical engineering support to the project team & assist in the creation of prototypes, presentations and supporting design collaterals.
* Provide leadership in liaising with customers to derive functional and non-functional requirements related to technical delivery of the project/s and develop high level requirement specifications and design documents.
* Serve as a leading technical expert on AGLCMS, ATC/ATM technology and promote creative & innovative approaches to solving the challenges.
* Acts as key technical interface to customers and is responsible to ensure that projects are executed within agreed schedule and budget to meet the customer requirements.
* Ensures that prerequisites (e.g. design inputs, tools, documentation, deliverables, schedule, budget, low cost engineering content) are in place prior to start work.
* Monitors and controls assigned work scope against the project plan, ensures effective change control and identifies risks / opportunities.
* Ensures that the engineered solution meets project requirements by monitoring and controlling assigned scope against the project plan.
* Responsible for meeting productivity / utilization targets, on time to request (OTTR) and 1 st time right deliverables within the engineering team.
* Manages challenges related to readiness & manages customer expectations (requirements management and validation).
* Interface with Project Management on technical risks and delivery schedule.
* Responsible for technical Implementation, documentation review and approval.
* Planning and coordinating engineering activities and R&D activities.
* Evaluation of internal and external change requests and transfer those to the system/product requirements.
* Technical risk management for systems, components and processes.
* Focal point for technical clarification and coordination with the customer.
* Define requirements for subcontractors, coordinates and ensures success of deliverables.

**Qualifications**
The position would require traveling on site for managing technical aspects of a project on short and long term basis.
  
  
**Education Level And/or Relevant Experience(s)**
Bachelor’s degree, Master’s Degree, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Instrumentation, Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  
  

* An ideal candidate should have 12+ years of relevant work experience in airports business
* Requirements management / Systems Engineering
* Customer facing experience
* Preparation of technical and material submittals
* Software Development
* (Agile) Project Management
* Requirements management
* Planning and coordination of project activities, familiar with MS Project
* Familiar with PMBOK or similar project management standards

**Knowledge and skills**
(general and technical)
  
  
**Language**

* Very good English written and communication

**Airports**

* Experienced with AGL, ILCMS, VDGS, ASMGCS, ATM, A-CDM, Follow the Greens and Tower Operations

+ Good understanding of regulatory standards ICAO, DGCA CAR Annexure 14, FAA, EUROCAE, EASA

- Airfield Ground Lighting Control and Monitoring systems (AGL CMS)

* Firm knowledge of electrical safety roles

**Soft Skills**

* Leading without authority

+ Motivate people to get things done

- Communication

* Negotiation

**Technology Skills**

* Good understanding and working knowledge on Linux operating system, Object oriented design, distributed architecture.
* Designing high performance systems
* Good working knowledge on network design, basic knowledge on TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast communications
* Knowledge on Mobility solutions and deployment of the same.
* Good understanding on Cyber security implementation, cyber security standards such as ISA 62443-4-2 mandates.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

: 7 - Manager
  
  
**Location**
: Open
  
  
Must have skills: Generative AI, Agentic AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Multi-Agent Systems, Python, SQL, AI Agent Orchestration, Machine Learning,
  
  
Good to have skills: AI Refinery, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Crew AI, Spark, Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), NLP, Computer Vision, Vector Databases, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Function Calling, Tool Integration
  
  
**Job Summary**
: As an AI Decision Science Manager, you will lead cross-functional teams in the design, development, and deployment of advanced AI agents and multi-modal AI solutions that autonomously execute complex business workflows. You will be responsible for defining and implementing Gen AI and agentic AI strategies for clients, ensuring successful delivery of large-scale AI initiatives. Your expertise will drive innovation, build client relationships, and shape the roadmap for autonomous AI-driven business transformation.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
– Strategic Leadership & Project Delivery
  
  

* Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of AI projects, from requirements gathering and solution architecture to deployment and post-implementation support
* Provide thought leadership and guidance to consultants and engineers on cutting-edge Gen AI and Agentic AI technologies
* Define and communicate a strategic vision for AI agent solutions, ensuring alignment with client business objectives
* Client & Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, translating complex AI concepts into actionable business solutions
* Drive discussions on Gen AI best practices, risk management, AI safety, and governance

– Advanced Generative AI & Agentic System Development
  
  

* Design and implement sophisticated AI agents using frameworks like AI Refinery, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, and custom agentic architectures
* Develop multi-agent systems that can collaborate, negotiate, and execute complex workflows autonomously
* Implement Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for seamless communication between AI systems and external tools/APIs
* Build and deploy Generative AI applications with advanced reasoning, planning, and execution capabilities

– Leverage Advanced Data Science Techniques:
  
  

* Develop solutions using Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Define data requirements, clean, aggregate, analyze, and interpret data while conducting data quality assessments.

– Develop and Implement AI Models:
  
  

* Build and deploy AI models and Generative AI applications.
* Train and fine-tune LLMs using large-scale datasets to optimize performance and accuracy.
* Evaluate model performance and implement iterative improvements.

– Solution Integration and Deployment:
  
  

* Collaborate to integrate AI solutions into end-to-end workflows, ensuring scalability.
* Utilize cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP for model development and deployment.

– Innovation and Knowledge Sharing:
  
  

* Stay updated on advancements in AI and Data Science, exploring innovative techniques and frameworks.
* Document methodologies and findings for effective knowledge sharing.

* Proven consulting skills, including project management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong client management skills, with a focus on building lasting relationships and delivering exceptional service.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
* Role: Junior Data Analyst
* Reports to: Senior Analyst or Analyst (UK)
* Location: New Delhi, India
* Contract: 24 months fixed term contract.
* Date updated: Nov 2026

**About CPI**
CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change.
  
  
With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
  
  
**About The Role**
CPI’s data science team operates at the intersection of climate finance and advanced data analytics. We partner with climate finance analysts to develop rigorous methodologies to track climate finance trends and inform policy analysis, build repeatable data pipelines, and deploy cutting edge AI/ML techniques to ingest and analyze data. Much of the team’s work focuses on large, data-intensive projects to track climate finance flows at a global level and assess financial institutions’ transition to net zero, such as our widely recognized Global Landscape of Climate Finance and Net Zero Finance Tracker. However, data science team members contribute to quantitative analyses and scaling of analytical workflows across the organization.
  
  
CPI works at the cutting edge of climate finance and policy analysis, and this means that our data analysts must effectively combine technical rigor with a strong interest in the financial and policy questions that motivate our analytical work, and have the creativity and judgement needed to deal with ambiguity and incomplete/inconsistent data.
  
  
We are seeking a junior data analyst who is enthusiastic about developing their skills while contributing to CPI’s mission. The successful candidate will work on well-defined components of projects, with close mentorship from senior researchers and data analysts, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to the development of quantitative methodologies and conduct exploratory data analysis under the guidance of more senior colleagues, primarily supporting projects related to the tracking of climate finance flows and financial institutions’ net zero transitions. Help assess how structured and unstructured data sources can be used to produce analytical results.
* Develop and maintain robust data pipeline components that ingest, clean, validate and process raw data according to defined standards, with code review and guidance from senior team members. Data sources will include structured datasets as well as unstructured/nontraditional sources. Our team works primarily in Python and PySpark, and manages data assets in Amazon Web Services.
* Support the application of AI/ML and statistical techniques to enhance data analysis, including ingestion of unstructured/nontraditional data; imputation of data where sources are incomplete; resolution of entities and transactions across inconsistent data sources; and classification of financial flows, commitments, and policies where labelled training data are scarce. You will apply these techniques under supervision while developing an understanding of their strengths and limitations.
* Assist research teams in querying, analysing, and interpreting data outputs, including by helping to build data dashboards and visualizations (sometimes in partnership with CPI’s Communications team). Contribute to narrative reports and presentations to disseminate analytical results.
* Support continuous improvement of the data science team’s best practices and data infrastructure, including by maintaining documentation and assisting with quality assurance processes.
* Effectively use AI assistants (primarily Codex) to enhance productivity, while critically evaluating their output.

Competencies and Experience
  
  

* A strong commitment to CPI’s mission and values.
* A university degree in a quantitative field, such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, economics, or finance. Candidates with degrees in other fields who can demonstrate strong data science/analytics skills will also be considered.
* Minimum of two years of professional experience in data science or analytics. Relevant internship, academic research, or capstone project experience will be considered.
* Demonstrated understanding of or interest in climate finance, public policy, financial institutions and markets, and/or international macroeconomics and finance.
* Proficiency in writing and understanding Python for data analysis and visualization and familiarity with SQL. Comparable experience and skills in another language, such as R, will also be considered when candidates are willing to translate those skills into Python.
* Foundational understanding of statistical and machine learning concepts. Relevant coursework or project experience might include econometrics, natural language processing, classification and clustering methods, or applied ML.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, or willingness to learn.

Personal Attributes

title: Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager
description:
Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

GIS and spatial analytics | Digital evidence | Data assurance

**LOCATION NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS 01**

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

title: Lead, On Demand, Digital Products
description:
**About us**

Launched in 2017, WeWork India is one of India’s leading premium flexible workspace operators - GPTW certified (Nov 2024 – Nov 2025, Dec 2025 – Dec 2026). WeWork India has been the largest operator by total revenue for the past three fiscal years. Since its inception, WeWork India has expanded across 8 cities in Chennai, New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, and Hyderabad, with 85 centres, 9.8 million square ft (operational area) (as of October 2026). WeWork India has played a significant role in the growth of the flexible workspace sector and contributed to the evolution of its products and services, providing customized and curated solutions for various office space needs.

For more information, please visit our


website

**About the role**

The On Demand team operates within the Digital Products vertical. The portfolio includes Day Passes, Day Pass Plus, Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings, sold through the WeWork India app and website, myHQ, and other aggregator and corporate channels.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of the On Demand business: revenue and P&L, the product portfolio, pricing and promotions, inventory and day-to-day operations, the myHQ partnership and other channels, and the digital booking experience. It sits at the intersection of business, product and operations, working closely with Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI and Sales teams, as well as external partners.

The team member will be responsible for growing On Demand revenue profitably by improving how the business is priced, distributed, operated and measured, and by shaping the next set of On Demand products, while ensuring a seamless booking and on-site experience for members.

**Role and responsibilities**

 

**Revenue and P&L**

* Own the On Demand P&L and deliver monthly and annual revenue targets, tracking performance on both a gross booking value and a realised revenue (net of partner share) basis.
* Build and maintain the monthly forecast and revenue bridge, breaking performance down by product, channel, city and building to explain what moved, why, and what needs to change.
* Drive growth across every lever (volume, price, product mix and capacity) while protecting realisation on discounted and partner-led sales.
* Reconcile On Demand revenue across booking systems, partner reports and finance records, including monthly aggregator invoicing and partner settlements, and resolve revenue leakage, unbilled bookings and data gaps.

**On Demand products**

* Own the full product suite (Day Pass, Day Pass Plus, 5 and 10 Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings), including positioning, terms and policies, and lifecycle decisions.
* Track how each product performs and how it affects the rest of the portfolio (incremental revenue versus cannibalisation), and decide when to scale, reposition, reprice or retire a product.
* Grow B2B bulk bookings and Bookable Private Office demand from companies and teams, working with the All Access Sales team and myHQ’s B2B team.
* Identify frequent On Demand users and teams and work with the All Access Sales team to move them up the product ladder to All Access Plus, All Access Basic or All Access Pay Per Use.

**Pricing and promotions**

* Own building-level pricing for all On Demand products, including periodic price reviews, phased price revisions and measuring their impact on orders, revenue and realisation.
* Plan and govern offers and discounts across WeWork and partner channels: set budgets and approval rules, avoid discounting in buildings already at capacity, and run post-offer readouts on incremental volume and cost.
* Set up partner, co-marketing and member offers on the Offer Engine (coupon codes), and work with the Tech team on new offer formats where needed.

**Operations and inventory**

* Manage day-to-day operations. Member queries, coordination with myHQ. Responding to tickets etc.
* Own day-to-day On Demand operations across locations, including product and inventory set-up, building launches and exits, booking issues, cancellations and refunds, and escalations, in coordination with Community and Regional Operations teams.
* Manage inventory and capacity: monitor building-level utilisation, flag buildings that are at capacity or under-used, and work with Community teams on adding desks, reallocating inventory and opening new locations to On Demand.
* Manage the dynamic private office inventory behind Day Pass Plus and Bookable Private Offices, including planning ahead for upcoming private office move-outs.
* Monitor member experience through post-visit surveys (NPS), support tickets and on-ground feedback, and close the loop on recurring issues such as booking friction, crowding and service gaps.

**myHQ and channel partnerships**

* Manage the myHQ partnership end to end, covering joint business planning, inventory and pricing alignment, campaigns and offers, customer support and escalations, B2B opportunities and monthly revenue-share settlements.
* Run regular performance reviews with myHQ on volume, discount levels, new-user acquisition and revenue quality, and agree actions and governance for future offers.
* Manage other aggregator and API partners, from onboarding and booking flows to monthly invoicing and reconciliation, and build new distribution channels such as corporate, employer and HR benefits partnerships.

**Product and digital experience**

* Own the On Demand booking journey on the WeWork India app and website (discovery, product pages, checkout, payment and confirmation), working with Tech & Product teams to improve conversion, reduce drop-offs and grow the share of direct bookings.
* Write clear business requirements and user stories, prioritise the On Demand roadmap and backlog, run UAT and manage launches for new features and products.
* Own On Demand tracking and analytics requirements: define funnels and events (e.g. Mixpanel), make sure bookings, revenue and failed transactions are captured accurately and in line with data privacy requirements, and use the data to run experiments.
* Work with Marketing on demand generation, including website and in-app content, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, performance marketing and building-level activations.

**Strategy and new initiatives**

* Shape the On Demand strategy and annual plan, including targets, growth levers, business cases and the product roadmap.
* Generate and test new revenue ideas (new products, bundles, corporate offerings, partnerships and channels) through quick, low-cost pilots with clear success and stop criteria.
* Keep track of the market, including flexible workspace operators, aggregators, pricing and customer trends, and feed those insights into pricing, product and posit

  ioning decisions.

**Reporting and stakeholder management**

* Run the On Demand operating cadence: weekly performance checks and monthly business reviews that end in clear decisions, owners and timelines.
* Maintain the On Demand tracker and dashboards (revenue versus target; product, channel, city and building views; AOV and utilisation) and prepare leadership reviews and presentations.
* Partner with BI to fix data quality issues and close data gaps such as order counts, repeat rates, funnel conversion and utilisation.
* Act as the single point of contact for On Demand across Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI, Legal and Sales, keeping everyone aligned on priorities, timelines and one shared set of numbers.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree required in a related field; an MBA is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (preferably in Product, Category, Business Operations or Revenue Management within consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, travel/hospitality or flexible workspace)
* Proven ownership of revenue targets or a P&L, with a track record of moving business metrics
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and comfort working with large booking and revenue datasets
* Experience working with Tech & Product teams on requirements, prioritisation, testing and launches
* Good understanding of pricing, promotions and unit economics
* Experience managing external partners, aggregators or marketplace channels is a plus
* Exposure to product analytics and BI tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Tableau) is a plus; SQL is a plus
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills, including presenting to senior leadership
* Ownership mindset and comfort working across teams without direct authority in a fast-paced environment

title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst- Digital Channels for Sexual & Reproductive Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Overview**
Despite India’s rapid growth in digital adoption and e-commerce, the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) space remains relatively nascent online, with contraception and fertility products accounting for only $4.23M of the digital health market. At the same time, significant gaps persist the unmet need for family planning among married women stands at 8.5%, and modern contraceptive use has actually declined (from 56.4% to 52.7%), pointing to continued unmet demand for trustworthy information and access (NFHS-6, 2023-24). While users seeking FP-SRH information prefer a discreet, trustworthy path from awareness to action, the same is not achievable through traditional clinic-based counselling models and as a consequence, users often turn to digital channels where they encounter fragmented, stigmatising, or unreliable content. There is, therefore, a need for digital platforms which can offer comprehensive and reliable information.
  
  
Since 2024, WJCF has deepened its focus on Alternative Service Delivery (ASD), i.e., identifying, testing, and scaling non-traditional channels, beyond public health facilities and frontline workers, through which underserved populations can access SRH products, services, and information.
  
  
Our hypothesis is twofold. First, there is significant unmet demand for reliable, accessible FP-SRH information, and authoritative, cohort-tailored digital content can measurably shift awareness. Second, when users are offered trustworthy, stigma-free content alongside a discreet, low-friction path to purchase or counselling on platforms they already use, a meaningful share will convert from awareness to action — i.e., verified uptake of FP-SRH products and services.
  
  
Our ASD work began with a structured landscaping exercise that reviewed 56 service delivery and demand generation models across health and non-health sectors in India and globally, identifying digital and private-sector channels with the strongest potential for reach, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  
  
This approach was validated through a 2025 pilot with a leading e-pharmacy partner. WJCF co-designed and ran a 4-month, multi-channel FP-SRH demand-generation campaign which reached 0.98M users and achieved a 3% reach-to-conversion rate among new-to-category buyers. Monthly SRH purchasers rose 62% over the pre-pilot baseline - 64% of them new to the category - with growth across priority products (condoms +51%, ECPs +48%, and OCPs +57%). Average time on the campaign microsite was 4 minutes against a 1-minute benchmark, signalling strong content engagement.
  
  
Building on this foundation, WJCF has secured a multi-year grant to scale and diversify its digital SRH work across two parallel workstreams one that deepens and scales e-pharmacy partnerships into a structured, ongoing test-and-learn engine to drive users to category adoption, and another that expands into additional digital ecosystems to identify which channels can reliably move users from awareness to verified uptake, and overall, understanding the conditions under which such partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
  
  
**Position Overview**
WJCF is seeking a highly motivated
**Analyst/ Senior Analyst**
to lead analytical, strategic, and implementation workstreams for our ASD work. The Associate will drive high-quality analyses, design frameworks for intervention models, lead research activities, and manage relationships with donors and partners across digital ecosystems (e-pharmacy, e-commerce, and other consumer platforms). They will guide components of program execution, develop strategic documentation, and ensure delivery of key outputs. The role requires strong problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities, comfort working in complex environments, and the ability to independently own and drive major workstreams.
  
  

* Lead analytical workstreams for our ASD work, driving evidence-based decision-making and strategic planning.
* Lead partner scoping and due diligence efforts, defining engagement criteria and shortlisting frameworks to inform strategic partnership decisions.
* Design and run structured campaign test-cycles in partnership with digital platforms, building and testing hypotheses to optimize program performance.
* Oversee periodic reviews of campaign test-cycles to guide program strategy.
* Distil learnings from these test-cycles and develop the business case and conditions under which partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
* Design and steer scalable intervention models, frameworks, and implementation pathways in collaboration with partner organizations.
* Build and oversee measurement frameworks, dashboards, and reporting tools that track performance across the awareness-to-uptake funnel and enable data-driven decisions.
* Build and sustain relationships with digital platform partners, brand partners, donors, and technical stakeholders to strengthen alignment, negotiate partnership terms, and drive impact.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of program outputs, including strategic notes, donor reports, partnership documentation, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Mentor and supervise analysts and junior staff, providing guidance on research design, analytical approaches, and deliverable development.
* Provide operational leadership to ensure seamless planning, coordination, and execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Lead identification of new opportunities, contribute to proposal development, and craft compelling pitch materials to secure funding and partnerships across ASD, SRH, and allied areas.
* Ensure effective and prompt communication across internal teams and external stakeholders, including rapid response to critical situations with structured action plans.
* Represent WJCF in high-level forums and public engagements, leveraging strong communication and public relations skills to advocate for ASD and SRMNCH priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Public Health, Economics, Business, Population Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in demanding, result-oriented environments across public and/or private sectors; experience with digital platforms is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large projects, design interventions, and contribute to proposal/concept note development
* Excellent analytical (qualitative and quantitative) skills and strong written and oral communication abilities, including preparation of high-quality presentations and analyses for multiple audiences
* Entrepreneurial mindset with demonstrated ability to work independently on complex projects in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to multi-task with a high degree of ownership and commitment to excellence
* Strong diplomatic and interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain relationships across diverse stakeholders
* Fluency in English, written and verbal; working proficiency in Hindi is an advantage

**Advantages**

* Experience working with or within digital platforms (E-Comm/Q-Comm/E-Pharmacy/FinTech/Consumer Tech) in a partnerships, growth, or strategy capacity.
* Management consulting/experience in the healthcare industry or consumer health brands, or other relevant private or public-sector experience
* Experience designing or analysing digital marketing campaigns (channel strategy, cohort segmentation, A/B testing, funnel analysis, etc.).
* Familiarity with India's family planning and SRH landscape, including public sector supply chains and private sector market dynamics.
* Willingness to travel as and when required

***Last Date to Apply 13th December, 2026***

description:

**About The/Nudge Institute**

is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.

**Position Overview**
Sarathi is a livelihood tech platform for implementing and monitoring Economic Inclusion Programs (EIP) based on the Graduation Approach. As a national gov tech initiative supporting tech for good, Sarathi enables real-time tracking and decision-making for grassroots programs.
  
  
As we scale nationally, we are looking for a dynamic, detail-oriented Product Rollout specialist to manage rollout and adoption across centrally-supported programs and partner states. This role sits at the intersection of technology, program delivery, and government engagement - ideal for someone excited to help scale a national
**gov tech**
platform driving
**last-mile delivery**
.

Be part of The/Nudge’s tech team as an Associate Manager, supporting digital product adoption and field implementation to scale rural livelihood programs across India.
  
  

* Onboarding & Rollout: Ensure smooth and efficient rollout of Sarathi in all program states.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Coordinate with government stakeholders, program partners, and internal teams for alignment on adoption plans, program details and handholding.
* Training & Adoption: Spearhead product training sessions, demonstrations with all user groups, and provide continuous user support.
* Support & Troubleshooting: Act as the first escalation point for field issues; work closely with the tech and support teams to ensure quick resolution.
* Documentation & Communication: Maintain rollout trackers, SOPs, and communicate implementation updates internally and externally.

With 5+ states live and plans for national rollout in next 1 year, this role will ensure that our product is ready for use, users are trained and seamlessly adopt Sarathi for program delivery at the last mile.
  
  
**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Min 5 years of experience in product operations, field-facing program roles, tech implementation in a development sector or public tech environment.
* Strong communication skills and attention to detail – especially written communication and user empathy.
* Comfortable working across multiple communication platforms.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple moving parts.
* Language skills (Hindi and/or regional language) is a plus, given the field-facing nature of the role.
* Comfortable operating across teams and systems; a problem-solver with a strong bias for action.
* Able to make sense of programmatic processes and translate them into product features and workflows.
* Driven by impact, and able to work across ambiguity and scale.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

**Job Description**
**About the team:**
We have Scripting Team in India, based in Gurgaon. This hub is part of our global Operations team, reporting into Operations Director based in the UK office. This team will focus on programming of ad hoc, tracking and syndicated quantitative studies, ensuring that survey instruments are tailored for precision and compliance with industry standards. The team will script and maintain online questionnaires enabling seamless data capture from healthcare professionals, patients, and key stakeholders. By integrating complex logic, customized routing, and validation checks, the team will ensure high-quality, error-free data. Additionally, they will collaborate closely with the analytics and data management teams, facilitating the smooth flow of data for efficient analysis, reporting, and insights generation.
  
  
**Your primary role:**
The Scripting Team lead role will report into The Scripting Senior Manager position. The role will involve help with setting up the scripting function, working with Research and Project Management stakeholders to define the best practice and establish processes for scripting and data processing within the business, as well as managing actual scripting. This will include:
  
  

* Initial set up of the scripting and data processing function, working with a variety of senior stakeholders to understand requirements and suggest improvements.
* Implementation of new processes and policies, including preparing “the best practice” manuals and guides for Research and Project Management staff globally.
* Supporting a transition from an outsourced model to a blended in-house approach.
* Line management of Scripting Executives, including training, mentoring and involvement in recruitment and selection.
* Scripting and programming medium complexity online surveys using the Confirmit platform, incorporating logic, custom routing, and question validation to ensure seamless user experience and data accuracy
* Conducting rigorous testing of surveys before launch, identifying and resolving any programming or logic errors to ensure data integrity and smooth respondent experience
* Cleansing and validating data in the relevant software (SPSS or similar) and process survey data for tabulation
* Managing workloads of the team and delivery across projects
* Liaising with internal clients, advising on best practice, and assisting with problem solving

**About You…**
**Your skills and experience:**

* More than 6 years of experience in a scripting role within a market research agency (ideally healthcare but can be other market research sectors)
* Proficiency in using Confirmit’s scripting platform, including authoring, logic implementation, and deployment
* Solid understanding of scripting languages such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for customizing survey functionality and layout
* Experience working with survey data formats (e.g., XML, CSV), as well as knowledge of relational databases and data structure management.
* Understanding of quantitative research methodologies, questionnaire structures, and healthcare market research best practices.
* Demonstrable experience of working with senior and junior team members
* Problem-solving skills (particularly relating to situations requiring analytical judgement and establishing best practice solutions)
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills
* Strong communication skills, particularly in the ability to explain technical points to non-technical people in an international environment

**Ideal profile:**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**About Inizio Ignte:**
Inzio Ignite a trusted advisor for pharmaceutical and life science companies that turns science into strategy, supporting execution at every stage of the product and patient journey from early commercialization to launch and beyond. Offering market research and insights; strategy; people and transformation consulting; and commercial benchmarking delivered through sector specific connected solutions and intelligence, Inizio Advisory helps create long-term value for clients and their patients.
  
  
*Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.*

title: Business Strategy & AI Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy & AI Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Strong academic background; graduates from leading engineering or management institutes preferred. MBA is an advantage.

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

title: Assistant Manager - Operations, Investment
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL Investments manages approx. Euro 38 billion investment portfolio. AXA XL Investment has three strategic locations for its operations. New York, Bermuda and India. Investment Operations is responsible for maintaining a high degree of data integrity, multiple system maintenance, and high-end reporting delivery along with other operational tasks for AXA XL Investment Management. Consumers of this data include Fixed Income, Investment reporting, Investment Compliance, and Risk management teams.
  
  
The Data Integrity Team is a part of Global Investment Operation’s Group, It is a dedicated group of professionals who ensure that all AXA XL cash & positions data are accurate for critical processes including investment management, analytics, compliance, and regulatory reporting. Cash & Position types include, but are not limited to, equities, fixed income, OTC derivative positions (swaps, swaptions, FXs, and) and collateral. The roles and responsibilities will include actively executing data validation controls and related reconciliations by ensuring the Investment book of record is reconciled with the custodian, manager.
  
  
The position will be responsible for carrying out other controls including some specific to cash, position reconciliations and exception management processes ensuring that AXA XL Portfolio data is in line with custodians, counterparties and other prime record holders every day. The team member will Laise with data vendors, other internal investment functions like Fixed Income, Risk and Strategy team, Investment Accounting and Treasury to resolve data related issues. Your primary upward interaction will be with a direct supervisor or team lead and other Investment Functions across various geographical locations. In this role, you need to analyze and solve moderately complex problems.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Review reference data attributes of Fixed Income Bonds (ABS, MBS, Corporate Bonds Term loans, Sovereign Bonds), Listed Equity, Private Credit and Private Equity and work with data vendors & accounting team to record accurate data points across systems.
* Analyze Investment holdings reports, review key data points like Security Classifications, Ratings, Analytics, book yields etc.
* Establish good understanding of data feeds from market data providers like Bloomberg etc.
* Identify defects in data and ensure they are logged appropriately and work with relevant teams to ensure resolution.
* Support and Laise for new data requirements for internal and external reporting, including various regulatory reporting like BSCR and Solv II.
* Collaborate across various internal teams like Fixed Income, Risk, Reporting and external vendors, Custodian, and other data providers.
* Execute Solv II reporting.

AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
