AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.

* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

title: EP&P Senior Analyst, ESG Supplier Risk
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Enterprise Services (ES) was established in 2022 to provide efficient, resilient, and scalable
  
  
services to support the evolving needs and complexities of a more digital BCG. ES brings together
  
  
business-critical operations - such as Procurement & Payables, Global Finance Operations, and
  
  
Executive Support Services - alongside specialist expertise including Real Estate, Travel, and
  
  
Meetings & Events. United by a common service mindset, ES enables every BCGer to focus on the
  
  
work that matters most by giving time and energy back through streamlined, reliable service
  
  
delivery. In doing so, ES creates cost advantage and strengthens BCG’s market differentiation,
  
  
while reducing risk through consistent controls and business continuity. Through scalable
  
  
platforms and globally integrated ways of working across our strategic core global hubs, Enterprise
  
  
Services enhances agility and helps unlock the potential of those who advance the world.
  
  
As an EP&P Senior Analyst, Supplier Risk, you will support BCG's global ESG Supplier Risk
  
  
Management program by helping embed responsible sourcing practices and supplier due diligence
  
  
into our procurement processes. Working as part of the ESG Supplier Risk team, you will
  
  
contribute to the delivery of ESG risk management activities, support regulatory compliance
  
  
efforts, and help ensure the firm meets its evolving ESG obligations.
  
  
You will collaborate with colleagues across Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Sustainability, and
  
  
regional teams to support supplier due diligence, improve processes, and strengthen the quality of
  
  
ESG data and reporting. Through your analytical skills, attention to detail, and collaborative
  
  
approach, you will help scale the program globally while contributing to BCG's broader ESG
  
  
agenda by supporting supplier ESG due diligence, responsible sourcing initiatives, regulatory
  
  
compliance efforts, and responses to ESG reporting requests from clients and internal
  
  
stakeholders.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Sustainability, Environmental

Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in data and analytics across procurement including diversity, supply

chain, ESG, sustainability, or a related field.
  
  

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify trends, and

generate meaningful insights.
  
  

* Familiarity with ESG principles, supplier due diligence, responsible sourcing, or regulatory

compliance is preferred.
  
  

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with procurement, reporting, or supplier

risk management platforms is a plus.
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively

across global, cross-functional teams.
  
  

* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple

priorities while delivering high-quality work.
  
  

* A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning and process

improvement
  
  
Who You'll Work With
  
  
As an EP&P Senior Analyst, Supplier Risk, you will sit within BCG's Procurement function and
  
  
report directly to BCG's ESG & Diversity Supplier Risk Director.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with key participants within the Procurement team, particularly the
  
  
Third Party and the Data Analytics team, to ensure seamless integration and alignment with
  
  
BCG’s procurement strategies. Additionally, you will interact with other functions including
  
  
compliance, legal, and sustainability teams to ensure a comprehensive approach to ESG risk
  
  
management, and partner extensively with teams in our local geographies to support local
  
  
regulatory requirements.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
YOU’RE GOOD AT
  
  

* Data analysis and attention to detail – You are comfortable working with large datasets to

identify trends, validate information, and generate insights that support ESG supplier risk
  
  
management and reporting.
  
  

* Supplier due diligence and risk support – You can support supplier ESG due diligence

activities by coordinating information, tracking progress, and maintaining accurate
  
  
documentation.
  
  

* Cross-functional collaboration – You build effective working relationships and collaborate

with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Sustainability, and regional teams to deliver shared
  
  
objectives.
  
  

* Organization and execution – You manage multiple priorities, maintain high-quality

documentation, and deliver work accurately and on time in a fast-paced, global
  
  
environment.
  
  

* Process improvement – You look for opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of

working, and support the adoption of new tools and technologies.
  
  

* Communication – You communicate clearly and confidently, preparing reports,

documentation, and presentations while supporting responses to client and internal ESG
  
  
reporting requests.
  
  

* Learning agility – You are curious, adaptable, and eager to develop your knowledge of ESG

regulations, supplier risk management, and responsible sourcing practices.
  
  
"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

title: Socio-economic Expert_BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
  
  
SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: Director, Competitive Intelligence
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
  
  
The Digital Transformation practice is part of the Global Solutions Advisory business group, which is one of five strategic business groups at Ankura
  
  
**Practice Overview**
Ankura Consulting Group is recognized as one of the five fastest-growing consulting companies, with 2,500 employees across 32 offices in 4 continents. The Company provides services to its client on expert witness, bankruptcy and corporate restructuring, litigation support, forensic accounting, geopolitical risk assessment, and general management consulting services. Ankura Consulting Group's headquarters is based in Washington, USA.
  
  
Ankura's Digital Transformation practice helps clients modernize their organizations by leveraging data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. Within this practice, our Competitive Intelligence capability helps clients turn market, pricing, and customer data into decisions that grow revenue, protect margin, and strengthen enterprise value.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Director to lead the design and hands-on delivery of Competitive Intelligence solutions across multiple client engagements. This is a builder role, not a strategy-only role: the ideal candidate has personally built pricing models, elasticity curves, and forecasting pipelines — writing the queries, building the models, and validating the numbers. The Director will combine that hands-on technical depth with delivery ownership, solution design, and team leadership, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders while remaining able to get into the data personally when engagements demand it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Personally build and validate pricing, elasticity, and demand models - using tools such as Python or R, SQL, and statistical/econometric or machine learning techniques.
* Define and own the solution design for Competitive Intelligence engagements, including dynamic and elastic pricing models, competitor and market monitoring, and customer/segment analytics.
* Lead delivery of pricing and market intelligence programs for clients, tying each initiative to measurable business outcomes (revenue, margin, operating efficiency, working capital).
* Design, build, and continuously recalibrate price elasticity models by SKU, segment, and geography — including cross-elasticity and scenario simulation — to support data-driven pricing and promotion decisions.
* Build or directly oversee the technical build of competitor price/promotion scraping and monitoring pipelines, supplier and sourcing intelligence feeds, and demand/supply forecasting models.
* Apply and evaluate machine learning and AI techniques (e.g., demand forecasting models, customer segmentation/clustering, propensity and churn models, NLP-based market signal extraction) where they improve on traditional analytics.
* Establish reference architectures, delivery standards, and best practices for Competitive Intelligence solutions built on the firm's Enterprise Data Platform.
* Estimate, plan, and govern delivery across multiple client engagements and workstreams.
* Partner with client stakeholders to align Competitive Intelligence roadmaps with business objectives and timelines.
* Mentor, coach, and develop data scientists, analysts, and technical leads, staying hands-on enough to review code, models, and analysis rather than only reviewing slides.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for analytical rigor, accuracy, scalability, and time-to-value.
* Support pre-sales and business development activities, including hands-on proof-of-concept analysis, solution design, technical estimates, and client pitches.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, market/competitive intelligence, or advanced analytics, with significant leadership responsibility — including recent, genuinely hands-on technical work, not purely oversight.
* Bachelors in Engineering, computer science preferred.
* Certification in cloud platform or relevant data platforms
* Demonstrated, hands-on track record of having personally built dynamic pricing, price elasticity, demand forecasting, or revenue management models — able to speak to the data, methodology, and code, not just the resulting recommendations.
* Proficiency in a data science/analytics stack such as Python or R, SQL, and common ML/statistics libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, statsmodels), sufficient to build or debug models directly.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning and AI techniques relevant to pricing and market intelligence — forecasting, clustering/segmentation, propensity modeling, and increasingly, LLM-based tools for market/text signal extraction.
* Comfort working directly in data platforms and analytics tooling (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), including writing and reviewing data pipelines, not only architecting them.
* Demonstrated ability to estimate, plan, and govern complex delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, governance, and security principles as they relate to market and pricing data.
* Excellent communication skills and experience in senior, client-facing roles, including presenting to executive audiences — balanced with genuine willingness to be in the data day-to-day.
* Consulting experience in a front-ending, client-facing role: understanding and clarifying client requirements, setting and managing expectations, proactively anticipating needs and risks, and communicating clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong business acumen and results-oriented mindset, with a track record of connecting hands-on analytics work to business outcomes.
* Preferred to have experience leading multi-team or multi-vendor delivery models.
* Preferred to have experience working with private equity firms or portfolio companies.
* Preferred to have a graduate degree or equivalent depth in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, data science, or similar).
* Cloud or platform certifications (any major provider) is preferred.
* Must be fluent in English.

Ankura is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. Equal Employment Opportunity Posters, if you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening, submit an online application, or participate in an interview/assessment, please email accommodations@ankura.com or call toll-free +1.312-583-2122. This email and phone number are created exclusively to assist disabled job seekers whose disability prevents them from being able to apply online. Only messages left for this purpose will be returned. Messages left for other purposes, such as following up on an application or technical issues unrelated to a disability, will not receive a response.

title: Consultant
description:
Role: Consultant

Location: Gurugram, Sector - 49

Mode of Work: On-site (5 Days)

Department: Research & Consulting

Reporting To: Engagement Manager/Project Lead

Employment Type: Permanent

**Role Summary**

**The Consultant is responsible for delivering high-quality research and consulting solutions by leading end-to-end project execution across syndicated research, custom research and Go-to-Market (GTM) engagements. The role requires hands-on expertise in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy.**

**The Consultant will present insights and strategic recommendations to clients, ensure client satisfaction, develop proposals and drive new and repeat business. Additionally, the role involves leading and mentoring a team of analysts, strengthening research methodologies and contributing to organizational growth through strategic insights and industry best practices.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Research Project Management & Delivery**

**• Lead and oversee multiple research projects, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.**

**• Define project scope, objectives, research methodologies and execution plans.**

**• Lead market sizing and opportunity assessment studies, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Available Market (SAM) and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM), using top-down and bottom-up approaches.**

**• Develop market forecasts through clearly defined assumptions, demand drivers, scenario analysis and validation of primary and secondary research findings.**

**• Develop actionable GTM strategies covering customer segmentation, target market prioritisation, competitive positioning, pricing and distribution channels.**

**• Conduct hypothesis building, model mapping and data validation.**

**• Perform sanity checks, proofread deliverables and develop strategic recommendations.**

**• Ensure alignment of deliverables with client expectations.**

**• Maintain communication with clients throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating feedback to refine deliverables.**

**2. Client Engagement**

**• Develop compelling client proposals, including responses to RFPs and tenders for government bodies.**

**• Present research findings to prospective clients and generate repeat business.**

**• Build strong client relationships to support long-term partnerships.**

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

**• Build and manage a high-performing team of Research Associates, Analysts and Senior Analysts.**

**• Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.**

**• Provide mentorship, skill enhancement and career development opportunities.**

**• Encourage a positive work culture centred on collaboration and innovation.**

**4. Research Innovation & Best Practices**

**• Integrate industry best practices into research methodologies.**

**• Use advanced analytics, automation and data-driven insights to improve research quality and efficiency.**

**• Introduce innovative techniques for data collection, analysis and reporting.**

**Qualifications & Skills Required**

**• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing or a related field.**

**• 4+ years of experience in Market Research, Consulting or Business Strategy.**

**• Demonstrated hands-on experience in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy, with the ability to explain methodologies, assumptions and resulting client recommendations.**

**• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with expertise in primary and secondary research methodologies.**

**• Excellent client handling, presentation and business development capabilities.**

**• Proven leadership skills, with experience in managing teams.**

**• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management abilities.**

**• Proficiency in MS Office, CRM tools and data analytics platforms.**

title: Key Account Management Quickcommerce
description:
Role Summary
  
  
You will own Barosi's business on each quick commerce platform, from PO to dispatch, availability, growth, ads and profitability.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Operations
* Process and track purchase orders (POs) from each platform through to dispatch.
* Monitor days on hand (DOH) by SKU and location, and plan replenishment before stock runs out.
* Coordinate dispatches with the warehouse team and follow up on inwarding at platform warehouses.
* Track and improve fill rate; flag and resolve short or rejected supplies.
* Maintain on-shelf availability (OSA) and overall availability across darkstores through regular audits.
* Growth
* Drive expansion of SKUs, cities, clusters and regions on each platform.
* Track category share and competitor activity: pricing, assortment, promos and visibility.
* Plan and run promotions; manage debit notes (DN) and their reconciliation.
* Build strong relationships with platform category managers and POCs.
* Plan participation in platform events and sale days.
* Manage the SKU portfolio: listings, content, pricing and delisting decisions.
* Own SKU-level P&L and margins for each platform.
* Maintain the monthly provision sheet for platform claims, promo and ad spends.
* Marketing and Ads
* Plan and manage ad campaigns across platforms within budget.
* Track and optimise ACOS, TCOS and ROI.
* Improve funnel metrics: impressions, add-to-cart (ATC) and conversion.
* Manage SKU contribution so ad spend goes behind the right products.

Key Metrics
  
  
Success in this role is measured on fill rate and DOH, OSA and availability, category share and SKU and city expansion, SKU-level margin and DN recovery, and ACOS, TCOS, ROI and conversion.
  
  
**Skills And Requirements**

* 2–4 years of experience managing accounts on Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of the PO cycle, darkstore operations, the DN/CN process and platform ad tools.
* Strong MS Excel and Google Sheets skills (pivots, lookups); comfortable with SKU-level P&L.
* Clear communication and strong follow-up with platform teams and internal teams.
* Detail-oriented, with an ownership mindset and comfort with daily execution.
* Graduate; MBA preferred.

title: Senior Associate - GT Regulatory Reporting
description:
Join our GT Regulatory Reporting Team in Group Finance and you will have an opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment. Our team is responsible for driving change across systems, ensuring optimal solution design for risk calculations.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, you will be responsible to run the capital/credit risk process to generate exposures for credit risk, Related Party exposures, Risk weighted assets, Leverage ratio, large exposures, regulatory Returns, Pillar 3 disclosures based on the guidance issued by regulators and performing UATs for all regulatory & system driven changes. Additionally, you will play a pivotal role in creating & running the controls over the reporting processes and ensuring that control design is in line with Macquarie’s control framework and complies with all requirements. You will also contribute in responding to internal and external audit queries and ad hoc requests and queries from the regulators.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* CA fresher
* Knowledge of regulatory reporting requirements / developments, fundamental of accounting and consolidation. Previous experience in a Regulatory Reporting role is added advantage.
* Knowledge on financial instruments and products offered by investment banks
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Self-motivated and capable of working in a team environment
* Good analytical ability. Ability to work under pressure, report to tight deadlines and deal effectively with issues.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager
description:
Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

GIS and spatial analytics | Digital evidence | Data assurance

**LOCATION NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS 01**

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with production-quality coding, Git-based development practices, hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow and Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask or Django, REST APIs.
* Train, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models where they outperform off-the-shelf solutions
* Strong understanding of ML algorithms, statistical modelling, feature engineering, model evaluation and optimization, also including model deployment, serving, monitoring, observability, and retraining in production

**Good to Have**

* Experience in Financial Services use cases such as credit risk, fraud detection, AML, transaction monitoring and customer analytics.
* Exposure to Foundation Models, domain-specific model development, fine-tuning and GPU infrastructure.
* Experience building production grade multi-agent systems (task delegation, coordination, and autonomous decision-making)
* Use AI coding tools and agents throughout design, development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience with computer vision, reinforcement learning and continuous self-learning.
* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake)

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build cutting-edge AI, GenAI, Agentic AI and Foundation Model solutions for global enterprises.
* Exposure to complex, high-impact Financial Services AI transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to work on enterprise AI platforms, reusable accelerators and next-generation AI products.
* High ownership, technical challenges and collaboration with experienced AI architects and technology leaders.
* Competitive compensation, continuous learning and accelerated career growth.

The platform combines AI-assisted project scoping, verified creative contributors, bidding, project tracking and transparent invoicing to simplify the creative project execution process.

Building on IndiaPicture's network of 4,500+ corporate client relationships and the wider Mahatta network of 2,000+ creative contributors, StudioIP brings together technology and creative expertise. Currently, the platform has over 1,000 registered contributors and has successfully delivered 190+ projects.

About the Role

We are looking for a confident, customer-oriented professional to drive customer onboarding and product adoption at StudioIP.

In this role, you will introduce the platform to prospective and registered business customers, conduct product demonstrations and guide them through the onboarding journey. Your primary responsibility will be to help interested customers understand the platform, initiate genuine creative projects and successfully complete their first project scope.

You will work closely with the Product Adoption Lead and other internal teams to ensure customers have a smooth experience and receive the right guidance at every stage.

Prior experience in SaaS or the creative industry is not mandatory. We value strong communication skills, a customer-first approach, the ability to learn quickly and consistent follow-through.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Understanding & Demonstrations

* Develop a thorough understanding of StudioIP's features, workflows and AI-assisted project scoping capabilities.
* Conduct product demonstrations for corporate clients, brands and agencies.
* Explain platform features through relevant use cases across photography, filmmaking, design and animation.
* Address routine customer queries and coordinate with the product team whenever technical assistance is required.

2. Customer Onboarding & Product Adoption

* Guide interested customers from initial demonstrations or registration through their first project initiation.
* Assist customers with onboarding and AI-assisted project scoping.
* Help customers organise their creative briefs, requirements and reference materials.
* Ensure customers successfully complete their first usable project scope with minimal assistance.
* Proactively follow up with customers who register but do not initiate projects or leave their scopes incomplete.
* Encourage continued platform usage by providing timely support and guidance.

3. Customer Engagement & Activation Activities

* Coordinate product demonstrations, onboarding sessions and customer education webinars.
* Share approved product information, onboarding guides and relevant communication materials.
* Follow up with customers generated through planned marketing and activation campaigns.
* Maintain regular communication with registered and prospective platform users.

4. Tracking, Reporting & Customer Feedback

* Maintain accurate customer records, follow-up schedules and onboarding updates.
* Track key activation stages, including demos conducted, registrations, projects initiated, scopes completed and repeat usage.
* Identify customer drop-offs and take appropriate follow-up actions.
* Document recurring customer challenges and share actionable feedback with the relevant internal teams.

Team Collaboration

You will work closely with the following teams:

* **Product Adoption Lead:** Provides activation priorities, guidance and onboarding plans.
* **Relationship Managers:** Manage commercial relationships and negotiations and introduce relevant customers.
* **Product Team:** Manages product development and improvements; you will communicate customer challenges and feedback.
* **Marketing Team:** Manages campaigns and marketing materials; you will support customer engagement through planned activation activities.

**Please note:** This is a customer success and product adoption role, not an individual sales position. There are no individual sales targets.

What We Are Looking For

* 1–3 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as customer success, customer onboarding, client coordination, B2B support or digital platform operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confidence in presenting and explaining a digital product to business customers.
* Ability to understand new software or digital platforms quickly.
* A patient and helpful approach to guiding customers through step-by-step processes.
* Strong organisational skills and consistency in customer follow-ups.
* Basic proficiency in spreadsheets, reporting and customer tracking tools.
* Interest in AI-enabled tools, digital platforms and creative services.

Experience with SaaS products, B2B platforms or the creative industry will be an added advantage but is not essential.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number and quality of product demonstrations conducted.
* Customer onboarding and registration-to-activation conversion.
* Number of customers initiating their first genuine project.
* First project scope completion rate.
* Consistency and effectiveness of customer follow-ups.
* Improvement in platform engagement and repeat usage.
* Quality of customer feedback and internal coordination.

**This role will be measured on customer activation, platform adoption, scope completion and engagement rather than individual sales revenue or sales targets.**

Why Join StudioIP?

* Work with a growing AI-assisted creative services platform backed by an established creative group.
* Get hands-on exposure to AI-enabled workflows and digital product adoption.
* Interact directly with corporate clients, brands, agencies and creative professionals.
* Work in a collaborative and growing team where your contribution directly influences customer experience and platform growth.
* Build your career in customer success, product adoption and the evolving AI-powered creative services industry.

title: Commercial Account Executive
description:
**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

**Commercial Account Executive Summary:**

This position requires a motivated self-starter who will be responsible for all net new sales into a geographic territory for Commercial Accounts, as defined by Delinea based on annual revenue of $500M or less.

Travel may be required to visit customers, attend trade shows or field events, and for internal meetings such as sales kick-offs or quarterly business reviews. * Excellent written and oral presentation skills. Examples may be requested.

**Why work at Delinea?**

* We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.
* We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.
* What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

On-site, Monday through Friday

Chief Technology Officer

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

**Position Summary**

You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDox’s SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor.

**Key Responsibilities**

In this role you will:

* Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance.
* Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim.
* Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur.
* Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action.
* Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production.
* Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review.
* Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10 or more years building production software.
* 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery.
* Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact.
* Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations.
* Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems.
* Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data.
* Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team.
* Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines.

**Location and Schedule**

This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel.

**Compensation**

* Base salary of ₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience.
* Stock options.
* Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts.

**Benefits**

* Company cab service for all Noida employees.

https://careers.xpertdox.com/

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex ManageEngine/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise ManageEngine/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.

Enterprise Patch Management

* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.

Automation & Integration
  
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.

Client Engagement & Delivery Governance

* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.

* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)

* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)

title: Workplace VDI Specialist - EMEIA
description:
**Job Description**
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:
  
  

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Identify and Prioritise Risk
  
  

* Maintain an accurate view of application vulnerabilities, affected devices and remediation status using Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow.
* Assess and prioritise findings using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, exploit intelligence, asset criticality and business context.
* Monitor vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and security-baseline gaps across COTS and Microsoft 365 applications.

Coordinate Remediation
  
  

* Coordinate patching, configuration changes and other mitigations with End User Device, deployment, engineering and supplier teams.
* Manage findings from validation through remediation, verification and closure, with clear ownership and agreed service levels.
* Manage time-bound exceptions and risk acceptances, documenting compensating controls and reviewing them at expiry.

Improve Security Practices
  
  

* Support application hardening, security-baseline compliance and attack-surface reduction using recognised Microsoft, CIS and industry guidance.
* Promote least privilege and controlled elevation through endpoint privilege management practices and tooling.
* Contribute security and vulnerability requirements to the onboarding and review of business applications.

Report and Govern
  
  

* Provide clear dashboards and reports on exposure, remediation progress, SLA performance, ageing, recurrence and security-baseline compliance.
* Translate trends and technical findings into practical recommendations for management, audit and operational teams.
* Maintain proportionate procedures and evidence aligned with ITSM, ISO/IEC 27001 and relevant vulnerability-management guidance.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in an ITIL-aligned security or IT operations role, ideally in vulnerability management, endpoint security or business applications.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management and the Microsoft Defender portal.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, endpoint patching and deployment through Intune and/or Configuration Manager.
* Understanding of endpoint security, least privilege, privilege management and recognised security baselines.
* Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform to manage findings, remediation and service levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and work effectively across global teams.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience delivering vulnerability or remediation programmes across a large, global application estate.
* Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.

BGV:

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. title: Physiotherapist (BPT / DPT)
description:
BFLL Degenerative and Metabolic Clinic (Big Fat Logic Lifestyle Pvt. Ltd., ISO 9001:2015 certified) is hiring two Physiotherapists for Kolkata. Naktala (1/183, Ground Floor, Kolkata 700047) and Salt Lake (AD-222, Sector 1, Kolkata 700064), deployment by roster, with home physiotherapy visits within the branch catchment. Full time, 6 days a week, 7 working hours a day. Immediate joining.

About the work

BFLL runs physiotherapy inside a four-pillar preventive model: OPD physiotherapy, physiotherapy within our Therapeutic Strength Training (TST) community and clinical programmes, and home physiotherapy. Every session is documented the same day on our clinical record (CRSR) through the BFLL Ops app, vitals are checked at the start of every session, and members rate every session. You will work with a Physiotherapy Leader, strength therapists and a Holistic Health Consultant, with physician co-management where needed.

What you will do

Independent assessment, clinical reasoning and individualised treatment plans in line with BFLL protocols. Deliver OPD, TST and home physiotherapy sessions and monitor vitals and response in every session. Same-day documentation: assessment records, CRSR entries, progress notes and re-assessments. Escalate red flags, adverse responses and near-misses immediately. Patient education, home programmes and adherence follow-up. Coordinate with the front desk and therapists for scheduling and continuity of care. Keep equipment hygiene, therapy area readiness and infection-control standards.

What we look for

BPT or DPT from a recognised institution, registration where applicable. Minimum 1 year of hands-on practice after the degree; home visit experience is a plus. Experience in musculoskeletal and geriatric rehabilitation, electrotherapy, manual therapy and exercise therapy for lifestyle and metabolic conditions is preferred. Clear written English for records and official email; comfortable with app-based attendance and records. Punctual, disciplined, steady with patients, willing to learn our SOP and sit monthly examinations. CPR certification is required on the floor (BFLL arranges certification where missing).

What BFLL offers

Fixed monthly net salary, discussed at interview on experience, no deductions. Incentives on Basic Salary from month one under a written Incentive Policy: sessions mark, CRSR mark, session ratings, home physiotherapy at 15 percent of the pack value, TST plan sales at 2.5 percent, and a quarterly performance incentive. Written increment review at confirmation and at one year (2.5 to 10 percent of Basic). Structured induction, SOP training and monthly clinical examinations in a clinic that documents and reviews every case. Uniform provided. Six-month probation, 60-day notice both sides.

How to apply

Email your CV to hr@bfllwellness.com with the subject "Physiotherapist | Your Name | Experience in years", or call or WhatsApp +91 98009 00450 (Mon to Sat, 10 AM to 7 PM). Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview and a practical assessment at Naktala within 48 hours.

title: Site Operations & Inventory Control Manager
description:
**Job Description - Site Operations & Inventory Control Manager**

**Role Overview:**

The
**Site Operations & Inventory Control Manager**
will be responsible for managing end-to-end ecommerce fulfillment site operations, including inbound, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, stock reconciliation, vendor discrepancy reporting, manpower productivity, SLA adherence, and SOP compliance. The role will act as the
**single point of ownership for site performance, inventory accuracy, inbound quality, process discipline, and operational issue resolution**
. The person will ensure that the warehouse operates efficiently, stock records remain accurate, and all incoming and outgoing inventory movements are controlled as per brand standards.

**You should apply if you have:**

* A strong interest in Site Operations and Inventory Control Management.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations
* A problem-solving mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
* Ownership-driven attitude—comfortable taking charge of projects end-to-end
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines

**You should not apply if you:**

* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross-functional teams or external partners
* Avoid negotiation, communication, or vendor/brand interaction

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations.
* Good command over inbound, GRN, inventory control, dispatch, returns, and audit processes.
* Knowledge of SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, barcode, PO, invoice, ASN, GRN, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong attention to detail and counting accuracy.
* Ability to identify stock discrepancies, quality issues, and process gaps.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets / MIS reporting skills.
* Understanding of WMS, OMS, ERP, and courier systems; Vinculum knowledge preferred.
* Ability to manage third-party manpower and ensure SOP compliance.

**What you will do:**

**1. End-to-End Site Operations Management**

* Own daily warehouse / darkstore operations, including inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and inventory control.
* Ensure orders are processed within defined cut-off times and SLA timelines.
* Monitor daily order volume, pending orders, aging orders, SLA breaches, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with central operations, logistics, product, inventory planning, procurement, finance, and customer support teams.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.

**2. SLA & Performance Management**

* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.

**3. Inventory Accuracy & Stock Governance**

* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short/excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow-moving stock, and high-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high-value, fast-moving, fragile, and expiry-sensitive SKUs.

**4. Inbound Audit & GRN Control**

* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without a PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.

**5. Vendor, Transporter & Discrepancy Management**

* Report vendor-side and transporter-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.

**6. Putaway, Storage & Bin Discipline**

* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage/bin location within the defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin-level discrepancies with the warehouse team.

**7. Team & Manpower Management**

* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third-party manpower are following brand-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottlenecks.
* Ensure clear shift-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.

**8. Process Compliance & Site Audit**

* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.

**9. Returns & Reverse Inventory Control**

* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non-sellable return.
* Track return-to-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund-related dependencies.

**10. Issue Resolution & Escalation**

* Act as the first escalation point for site-level operational and inventory-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and a corrective action plan.

**Work Experience**

**3–5 years**
in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, inventory control, inbound operations, stock audit, darkstore operations, retail fulfillment, supply chain operations, FMCG, supplement, pharma-like product handling, or logistics operations.

Experience in a
**D2C, e-commerce, supplement, FMCG, pharma, beauty, or personal care warehouse**
will be preferred because these categories require tighter control over expiry, batch, MRP, damage, leakage, and return quality.

**Working days: 6 Days Working**

**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal (On-site)

**Perks:**

* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning & personal growth opportunity

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:

This role sits at the intersection of vendor marketing, digital acquisition, campaign management, analytics, and revenue generation. The successful candidate will translate vendor priorities, solution launches, offers, and business goals into integrated digital campaigns that generate qualified traffic, leads, meetings, pipeline, and measurable revenue impact.
  
  
The ideal candidate is not simply a campaign coordinator. We are looking for a data-driven, hands-on digital marketer who understands B2B technology audiences, can work closely with Vendor Business Units, Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, Content, Creative, and Web teams, and is comfortable being measured on business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Vendor Digital Marketing Strategy
* Develop and execute the digital marketing strategy for assigned vendor portfolios.
* Translate vendor priorities, go-to-market plans, product launches, funding programs, and business goals into actionable digital campaigns.
* Build quarterly and monthly campaign calendars aligned with Vendor BU and broader Marketing priorities.
* Understand vendor solutions, target audiences, personas, and customer pain points sufficiently to recommend the right digital channel and campaign strategy.
* Partner with Vendor Marketing Managers to convert solution positioning and campaign narratives into scalable digital activation.
* Integrated Digital Campaign Execution
* Own or coordinate end-to-end campaign activation across paid search, paid and organic social, SEO, email nurture, website and landing pages, retargeting, webinars, virtual events, content syndication, and account-based digital campaigns.
* Ensure every campaign has a clearly defined audience, offer, messaging, call to action, channel mix, budget, conversion journey, lead-routing mechanism, and success metrics before launch.
* Manage campaign timelines, dependencies, quality checks, and launch readiness across internal and external stakeholders.
* Paid Media and Digital Acquisition
* Plan and manage paid campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and other relevant B2B channels.
* Conduct keyword, audience, market, and competitor research to improve targeting and campaign relevance.
* Manage campaign structure, bidding, audience segmentation, retargeting, creative testing, and budget allocation.
* Optimize performance using CTR, CPC, CPL, landing-page conversion, lead quality, SQL/SRL conversion, cost per meeting, pipeline, and revenue contribution.
* Website, Landing Pages, and Conversion Optimization
* Partner with Web, Design, Content, and RevOps teams to build high-converting campaign journeys.
* Develop landing-page requirements covering messaging, calls to action, forms, proof points, and conversion paths.
* Drive continuous conversion-rate optimization through A/B testing and behavior-led improvements.
* Ensure campaign-to-landing-page message consistency and accurate tracking across the customer journey.
* Marketing Automation and Lead Nurturing
* Build nurture programs and campaign journeys using NetCom Learning’s marketing technology ecosystem.
* Develop segmented email programs by persona, industry, solution interest, buying stage, and engagement level.
* Partner with RevOps to ensure accurate lead capture, scoring, attribution, routing, and reporting.
* Monitor movement from inquiry through MQL, SQL/SRL, meeting, pipeline, and revenue; identify funnel leakage and recommend corrective actions.
* Vendor Campaign and Event Activation
* Digitally activate vendor campaigns, product launches, webinars, workshops, masterclasses, and other events.
* Create pre-event acquisition, live engagement, retargeting, and post-event nurture strategies.
* Support co-branded, partner-funded, MDF, and co-op campaigns with appropriate tracking, reporting, and Proof of Execution documentation.
* Coordinate with Vendor Marketing teams to maximize audience reach, engagement, and follow-up conversion.
* Analytics, Attribution, and Optimization
* Build a measure-learn-optimize rhythm across campaigns and channels.
* Track impressions, reach, website traffic, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversion rate, MQLs, SQLs/SRLs, meetings, cost per meeting, pipeline, influenced revenue, ROI, and ROAS.
* Conduct weekly campaign reviews and make clear recommendations on what should be scaled, optimized, tested, or stopped.
* Create dashboards and executive-ready performance summaries that connect digital activity to business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with Vendor Business Units, Product Marketing, Content and Creative, Web and SEO, RevOps, Inside Sales, Enterprise Sales, and vendor stakeholders.
* Establish a closed-loop model where digital engagement translates into qualified sales conversations and sales feedback informs campaign optimization.
* Align stakeholders on campaign objectives, responsibilities, timelines, follow-up SLAs, and expected outcomes.
* AI-Powered Marketing
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other generative AI tools to improve research, content development, personalization, reporting, and optimization.
* Identify opportunities to automate repeatable campaign, reporting, and analysis workflows.
* Test AI-assisted audience, content, and performance optimization while maintaining brand, quality, privacy, and governance standards.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Technology, or a related discipline; MBA/PGDM in Marketing is preferred.
* 4–7 years of experience in B2B digital marketing, preferably within Technology, IT Training, EdTech, SaaS, Cloud, Cybersecurity, or a technology partner ecosystem.
* Demonstrated experience planning and optimizing paid and organic digital campaigns.
