title: Senior Designer
description:
**Job Description – Senior Designer**

**Company:**
Kisah Apparels Pvt. Ltd.

**Position:**
Senior Designer – Men's Ethnic & Occasion Wear

**Department:**
Design & Product Development

**Location:**
Metropolitan, Kolkata, West Bengal

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Reporting To:**
Design Head

**About Kisah**

Kisah is a contemporary men's ethnic and occasion-wear brand focused on redefining Indian traditional fashion for the Next-Gen and Gen-Z consumer. With a strong digital-first foundation and an expanding omnichannel presence, Kisah combines traditional craftsmanship with modern aesthetics to create affordable premium couture.

The brand offers a diverse range of men's ethnic and occasion wear through its D2C platform, offline retail stores and leading marketplaces.

We are looking for a highly creative, trend-conscious and commercially driven
**Senior Designer**
who can contribute to the brand's design vision, lead collection development and create differentiated products aligned with evolving consumer preferences.

**Role Overview**

The Senior Designer will be responsible for conceptualising, designing and developing men's ethnic and occasion-wear collections. The role requires a strong understanding of Indian ethnic aesthetics, contemporary fashion trends, garment construction, fabrics, surface development, prints, embroideries and commercial product development.

The ideal candidate should be capable of translating design concepts and market insights into commercially viable collections while maintaining the brand's design identity, quality standards and product positioning.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Design Conceptualisation & Collection Development**

* Develop innovative and trend-led designs for men's ethnic and occasion-wear collections.
* Conceptualise seasonal collections, festive edits, wedding collections and special occasion ranges.
* Create contemporary interpretations of traditional Indian silhouettes and craftsmanship.
* Develop designs across categories such as Kurtas, Kurta Sets, Sherwanis, Indo-Western Wear, Nehru Jackets, Bandhgalas and festive ensembles.
* Build seasonal design stories, mood boards, colour palettes, inspiration boards and collection themes.
* Ensure design consistency while introducing fresh ideas and differentiated styles.

**2. Trend Research & Fashion Forecasting**

* Conduct regular research on domestic and international fashion trends.
* Identify emerging trends in colours, fabrics, prints, patterns, embroideries, silhouettes and styling.
* Study competitor collections, consumer preferences and market movements.
* Translate runway trends, fashion forecasts and cultural influences into commercially relevant products.
* Develop design directions aligned with Gen-Z and Next-Gen consumer preferences.
* Keep track of evolving wedding, festive and occasion-wear trends.

**3. Fabric, Surface & Print Development**

* Identify suitable fabrics, textures, trims and materials for different product categories.
* Develop innovative prints, embroidery concepts, motifs, textures and surface embellishments.
* Work on fabric swatches, colour combinations, placement prints and artwork development.
* Coordinate with vendors and manufacturers for fabric sourcing and design execution.
* Ensure the right balance between aesthetics, comfort, quality and cost.

**4. Technical Design & Product Development**

* Prepare detailed design sheets, technical specifications and garment construction details.
* Develop technical drawings, flats, artwork placements and measurement specifications.
* Coordinate prototype development, sampling and garment fit sessions.
* Review samples and provide necessary corrections to achieve the intended design outcome.
* Ensure design accuracy from concept stage through final production.
* Maintain design documentation, sample records and seasonal collection archives.

**5. Commercial & Business Orientation**

* Understand product costing, target price points and commercial feasibility.
* Develop collections that meet the brand's target consumer profile and pricing strategy.
* Collaborate with merchandising and sourcing teams to optimise fabric utilisation and product costs.
* Monitor market performance and incorporate feedback into future collections.
* Identify opportunities for product differentiation and category expansion.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with merchandising, sourcing, production, quality and marketing teams.
* Coordinate with external vendors, embroidery units, printing partners and manufacturers.
* Ensure timely development and execution of seasonal collections.
* Collaborate with the marketing team for collection launches, campaign themes and product storytelling.
* Support product presentation and styling requirements whenever necessary.

**7. Team Management & Ownership**

* Guide and mentor junior designers and design team members.
* Take ownership of assigned categories and seasonal design calendars.
* Manage multiple design projects and ensure timely delivery.
* Maintain design quality, consistency and execution standards.
* Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving ability and ownership throughout the design lifecycle.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Fashion Design, Apparel Design or Textile Design.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in fashion and apparel designing.
* Strong preference for candidates from men's ethnic wear, wedding wear, festive wear or occasion-wear brands.
* Demonstrated experience in collection development and product lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of Indian textiles, fabrics, embroidery, prints and garment construction.
* Experience working with vendors, sampling units and production teams.
* A strong and relevant design portfolio showcasing original work and developed collections.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop.
* Working knowledge of CorelDRAW and other relevant design tools.
* Strong skills in technical flats, design detailing and artwork development.
* Knowledge of garment construction, pattern understanding, fabric behaviour and fit.
* Ability to prepare mood boards, colour boards, technical sheets and design presentations.
* Understanding of sampling, costing and production processes.

**Key Competencies**

* Creative thinking and strong design sensibility.
* Excellent colour, fabric and silhouette understanding.
* Strong fashion trend analysis and forecasting capabilities.
* Commercial awareness and consumer-centric thinking.
* Strong planning, coordination and execution skills.
* Attention to detail and quality orientation.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving fashion retail environment.

**Preferred Industry Background**

Candidates from the following segments will be preferred:

* Men's ethnic and occasion-wear brands.
* Wedding and festive-wear fashion brands.
* Premium Indian designer labels.
* Contemporary ethnic and Indo-Western fashion brands.
* Organised apparel retail and fashion businesses.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on:

1. Timely development and delivery of seasonal collections.
2. Design originality, creativity and alignment with brand identity.
3. Sampling accuracy and reduction in design-related corrections.
4. Commercial viability and product cost adherence.
5. Trend relevance and consumer acceptance of collections.
6. Effective coordination with merchandising, sourcing and production teams.
7. Overall contribution to category growth and product differentiation.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is someone who combines creative excellence with strong commercial understanding. They should have hands-on experience in designing men's ethnic and occasion wear, an eye for emerging fashion trends and the ability to take a design from initial concept to final production.

We are looking for an individual who can bring fresh design perspectives, understand the evolving preferences of the modern Indian consumer and contribute to building Kisah as a distinctive contemporary men's ethnic-wear brand.

title: Illustrator & Textile Print Designer
description:
**Company Description**

Manaaf™ is an emerging premium fashion D2C brand in India
,
building a distinctive space in contemporary modest fashion and
with a vision to bring a fresh perspective to the modest and contemporary fashion industry in India and Southeast Asia.

We create thoughtfully curated fashion pieces for modern women, with a focus on design, craftsmanship, individuality and a refined brand experience
. As we continue to grow, we are building a distinctive visual identity through original illustrations, creative storytelling and thoughtfully designed textile collections.

🎨 Position: Fashion Illustrator & Surface Pattern Designer

📍 Location: Park Street, Kolkata, India

📅 Availability: In-office/Hybrid

Paid: Stipend will be decided based on portfolio/experience

**Work Arrangement and Engagement**

* Hybrid: Candidates based in Kolkata will follow a hybrid working arrangement.
* Remote: Candidates based in other cities can work remotely.
* Internship: Open to beginners, freshers and aspiring illustrators with a strong creative foundation.
* Freelance: Candidates with 1–2 years of relevant professional experience.

This is a single multidisciplinary creative position, not separate openings for illustration and textile design. We are looking for someone willing to explore both areas and contribute to the larger creative vision of Manaaf.

**Role description**

We are looking for a creative and passionate 
**Fashion Illustrator & Surface Pattern Designer**
 to join Manaaf's growing creative team.

This is a
***multidisciplinary, one-person creative role***
combining hand-drawn illustrations, character storytelling and conceptual surface pattern design for fashion scarves.

You will translate ideas, concepts and creative directions into original visual artwork, from illustrated characters and brand narratives to intricate textile patterns and scarf designs.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of sketching, illustration, colour theory, colour palette development and textile aesthetics, with an eye for detail and composition.

You should be comfortable experimenting with different artistic styles, developing concepts from scratch and bringing creative ideas to life through digital and hand-drawn mediums.

We value creative thinking, originality, curiosity and the willingness to explore beyond conventional design approaches.

This is an opportunity to work closely with the founder, contribute to the creative direction of an emerging fashion brand and grow alongside Manaaf as we build something distinctive.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. **Brand Illustrations:**
    Create original 2D illustrations, hand-drawn artwork and visual narratives aligned with brand's identity.
2. **Character Storytelling:**
    Develop illustrated human like characters, through expressive poses, fashion illustrations, environments and storytelling concepts.
3. **Surface Pattern Design:**
    Conceptualise and create original, detailed and meaningful surface patterns for fashion scarves and textile collections, as. guided by the Founder.
4. **Concept Development:**
    Translate creative briefs, references, themes and abstract ideas into unique visual concepts and design directions.
5. **Sketching & Exploration:**
    Develop initial hand-drawn sketches, rough concepts, compositions and design explorations before finalising artwork.
6. **Colour Development:**
    Create thoughtful colour combinations, seasonal palettes and colour variations, with an understanding of Pantone colour references.
7. **Textile Artwork:**
    Develop seamless repeat patterns, motifs, borders and print-ready artwork suitable for scarf production.
8. **Creative Collaboration:**
    Work closely with the founder to understand the brand vision, exchange ideas and bring creative concepts to execution.
9. **Design Adaptation:**
    Experiment with different illustration styles, artistic techniques and design formats while maintaining consistency with Brand's visual identity.
10. **End-to-End Execution:**
     Take ownership of assigned creative projects, from initial brainstorming and sketching to final digital artwork and production-ready files.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree, diploma or relevant background in Fashion Design, Textile Design, Illustration, Fine Arts or Visual Communication.
* Beginners with a strong creative foundation and a compelling illustration portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with 1–2 years of relevant experience in illustration, textile prints or surface pattern design are preferred.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating original illustrations, sketches, character development or surface pattern work is an advantage.

**Skills required**

* Strong proficiency in 
  **Procreate, Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop**
  .
* Good understanding of 2D illustration, hand-drawn artwork and digital painting.
* Knowledge of surface pattern design, motifs, repeat patterns and creative textile prints.
* Strong sketching abilities, colour theory and colour palette development.
* Basic understanding of Pantone colour systems and print colour selection.
* An eye for intricate details, composition, textures and visual storytelling.
* Ability to independently develop ideas and translate references into original artwork.
* Creative thinking, adaptability, attention to detail and willingness to learn.

We are not simply looking for someone who can execute a design brief. We want someone who enjoys creating, experimenting, sketching, exploring references and bringing ideas to life.

Someone who has a creative eye, a curious mind and the aspiration to build something meaningful alongside a growing fashion brand.

If you love illustration, storytelling, colours, patterns and fashion, and are excited by the possibility of contributing to a brand's creative journey from the ground up, we would love to hear from you.

**Manaaf is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace. Join us in creating the next generation of building a D2C fashion brand at Manaaf that will inspire millions worldwide.**

title: Kinder- en Jeugdpsychiater gebiedsteam Amsterdam Zuidoost
description:
*Ben jij de kinder- en jeugdpsychiater bij wie collega's aankloppen zodra het ingewikkeld wordt, en denk je graag mee over diagnostiek, behandeling en beleid? Kom samen bouwen aan jeugdhulp die werkt!*
**Jouw functie, jouw team**
Kinderen en jongeren met complexe psychiatrische problematiek hebben jou nodig. Als kinder- en jeugdpsychiater bij Levvel combineer je medische expertise met een brede, systemische blik. Je werkt nauw samen met gezinnen en multidisciplinaire teams en samen kom je tot oplossingen die écht werken. Zo lever je een directe bijdrage aan veilige, effectieve en samenhangende zorg voor kinderen, jongeren en hun omgeving.
  
  
Jouw kennis wordt ingezet voor consultaties bij de meest complexe vraagstukken. We zijn een erkende opleidingsplek voor verschillende hbo-functies, P-opleidingen en de opleiding tot kinder- en jeugdpsychiater. Wat ons bijzonder maakt, is dat we onderzoek en innovatie aan elkaar koppelen. Zo vinden we nieuwe oplossingen voor moeilijke problemen. Levvel heeft drie afdelingen met het TOP GGZ-keurmerk: het Expertisecentrum voor Dwang, Angst en Tics (DAT), het Centrum voor Trauma en Gezin, en de afdeling Complexe Gedragsstoornissen en Forensische Jeugdpsychiatrie. Daarnaast zijn er teams die begeleiding en behandeling bieden bij veelvoorkomende én zeldzame klachten. Samen zorgen we dat kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen weer verder komen.
  
  
Je werkt binnen het gebiedsteam dichtbij de kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen die jouw hulp nodig hebben. Je werkt in het team samen met basis- tot specialistische- psychologen en orthopedagogen, gedragswetenschappers, systeemtherapeuten en specialistisch ambulant hulpverleners, vaak een AIOS en onder leiding van een teamleider. Samen brengen we (hoog)specialistische jeugdhulp nabij en zo thuis mogelijk.
  
  
Fijn als jij erbij komt voor 24 tot 36 uur per week!
  
  
*Nieuwsgierig naar hoe de werkplek eruit ziet bekijk dit filmpje:*
*https://www.levvel.nl/locaties/bijlmerdreef*
**Jouw werkzaamheden**

* Je voert diagnostiek en behandeling uit. Je brengt diagnoses en indicaties in kaart en neemt de regie over behandeltrajecten binnen een multidisciplinair team. Samen met het kind, het gezin en betrokken professionals stel je een behandelplan op en je zorgt dat dit ook uitgevoerd wordt. Je voert specialistische behandelingen uit, waaronder psychofarmacologische interventies, en stuurt bij waar nodig. Zo krijgt ieder kind en gezin de best mogelijke zorg.
* Je geeft regie, biedt consultatie en werkt samen. Je geeft richting aan het behandelproces en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor collega's. Bij complexe casuïstiek vragen ze regelmatig jouw advies. Met ketenpartners zoals huisartsen, ziekenhuizen en jeugdzorgorganisaties zorg je dat de zorg goed op elkaar aansluit. In multidisciplinaire overleggen draag je bij aan belangrijke beslissingen en vertegenwoordig je de medische expertise, intern én extern.
* Je ontwikkelt beleid en deelt je kennis. Naast je werk in de directe patiëntenzorg draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de jeugdpsychiatrische zorg. Je denkt mee over beleid en brengt dit in de praktijk. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de zorg, vertaalt nieuwe inzichten naar de dagelijkse praktijk en stimuleert de professionele ontwikkeling van collega's. Waar mogelijk lever je een bijdrage aan innovatie, onderzoek en de doorontwikkeling van behandelmethodieken.
* Je geeft richting en stimuleert ontwikkeling. Je begeleidt en geeft supervisie aan artsen (ANIOS/AIOS) en andere behandelaren. Je neemt deel aan commissies, projectgroepen en vakinhoudelijke overleggen.
* Je blijft groeien voor jezelf én voor de ander. Je volgt ontwikkelingen in het vakgebied en levert een bijdrage aan wetenschappelijk onderzoek en innovatie binnen de kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie. In overleggen en teammomenten denk je mee en draag je bij aan de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Je werkt samen met partners binnen én buiten de organisatie en bouwt actief aan je netwerk. En je reflecteert op je eigen handelen en staat open voor feedback zo blijf je scherp en professioneel.

**Over jou**
**Diploma en registraties:**
Je hebt een BIG registratie als Kinder- en Jeugdpsychiater.
  
  
**Kennis en ervaring**
: Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met ontwikkelingspsychologie, diagnostische vaardigheden en crisisinterventie.
  
  
**Beschikbaarheid:**
Je bent in ieder geval beschikbaar op de donderdag en bereid om bereikbaarheidsdiensten te draaien. Werken in meerdere gebiedsteams behoort tot de mogelijkheden.
  
  
**Skills:**
Je hebt een verbindende werkhouding en kunt regie voeren. Daarnaast heb je vakinhoudelijke expertise met oog voor een breder perspectief en ben jij een echte teamspeler die waar nodig outreachend te werk gaat.
  
  
**Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden**
**Een goed begin**
: Je start met een jaarcontract, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  
  
**Salaris**
: Volgens de CAO GGZ Medisch Specialisten € 6.691 - € 11.292 (op basis van 36 uur).
  
  
**Extra’s die het verschil maken**
: Van een fietsregeling en collectieve zorgverzekering tot een thuiswerkvergoeding van €3,05 per dag.
  
  
**Toeslagen:**
Een ruime vergoeding voor bereikbaarheidsdiensten.
  
  
**Ruimte om te groeien**
: Met
*Het Goede Gesprek*
jaarlijks over jouw ontwikkeling en toegang tot het platform LEO voor trainingen en opleidingen.
  
  
**Werkplezier:**
Want naast het werk is er ruimte voor ontspanning: van sportactiviteiten tot gezellige personeelsfeesten.
  
  
**Benieuwd wat Levvel nog meer te bieden heeft?**
**Bekijk hier ons aanbod**
**Solliciteren?**
De vacature staat open tot we deze vervuld hebben. We plannen bij een match zo snel mogelijk een gesprek, wacht dus niet met solliciteren.
  
  
Inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Bojoura Maarbach beantwoordt ze graag: 06 24 19 31 28.
  
  
Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Mail dan met werving en selectie: werk@levvel.nl. Jamie Chapman is contactpersoon van deze vacature.
  
  
***Werken bij Levvel betekent werken met kinderen, jongeren en gezinnen in kwetsbare situaties. Daarom hoort een zorgvuldig en uitgebreid screeningsonderzoek bij onze sollicitatieprocedure.***

title: Income Maintenance Caseworker I- Family and Children's Medicaid
description:

**General Definition Of Work**
This position will be assigned to administer the application process and determine eligibility for Family & Children’s Medicaid and sub-programs. This caseworker will be one of two primary intake caseworkers responsible for taking applications from 8:00AM–5:00PM daily as scheduled on the intake calendar. Applications received by methods other than in-person will be assigned on a rotating basis. Responsibilities include interviewing clients to obtain required information, entering the applications in the North Carolina Families Accessing Services through Technology (NC FAST) system, verifying the information obtained, and determining ongoing eligibility for each application taken. This position will be required to interview applicants on a daily basis.
  
  
Participation in Shelter Management is required in the event of emergencies or disasters. This service, if required, will take precedence over duties described in this position vacancy announcement. This position is required to perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor and could be subject to overtime which is given in the form of compensatory time.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
Good mathematical reasoning and computational skills. Ability to communicate with clients, applicants, and the public to obtain data, and to explain and interpret rules, policies, and procedures. Ability to understand the needs and problems of clients/applicants. Ability to learn the program area of assignment and all agency programs and services which could affect the client/applicant.
  
  
**Education And Experience**
Graduation from an accredited associate degree program in Human Services Technology, Social Services Associate, Paralegal Technology, Business Administration, Secretarial Science, or a closely related curriculum; or graduation from high school and two years of paraprofessional, clerical, or other public contact experience which included negotiating, interviewing, explaining information, gathering and compiling of data, analysis of data and/or performance of mathematical or legal tasks with at least one year of such experience being in an income maintenance program; or graduation from high school and three years of paraprofessional, clerical or other public contact experience which included negotiating, interviewing, explaining information, the gathering and compiling of data, the analysis of data and/or the performance of mathematical or legal tasks; or an equivalent combination of training and experience.

**About the Organisation-**

The Institute of NeuroDevelopment (IND) is a mission-driven organisation dedicated to supporting children with autism and other neurodevelopmental differences. Through structured developmental programmes and specialised services, we aim to empower children and their families.

As we continue to expand our team, we are looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and result-oriented **HR Executive – Recruitment & Talent Acquisition** who can take ownership of bulk hiring activities while supporting day-to-day HR operations.

**Job Overview-**

The selected candidate will primarily be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment, particularly high-volume hiring for Sales and other operational profiles. The role involves candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, recruitment tracking, and joining follow-ups, along with assisting in general HR activities as and when required.

This is a suitable opportunity for HR professionals who enjoy recruitment, candidate interaction, target-driven work and handling multiple hiring requirements.

**Key Responsibilities-**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for bulk hiring across Sales and other non-sales profiles.

* Identify suitable candidates through active sourcing, resume screening and database management.
* Conduct initial telephonic screening and evaluate candidates based on job requirements.

* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Monitor daily recruitment activities, including candidate calling, screening, interview scheduling, selections and joinings.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly recruitment reports.
* Track recruitment performance, interview conversion and candidate joining ratios.

* Prior experience in bulk hiring, especially Sales recruitment, will be preferred.

* Strong communication, negotiation and candidate-handling skills.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and recruitment trackers.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and work within defined hiring timelines.
* Strong organisational skills, follow-up abilities and a result-oriented approach.

**What We Are Looking For-**

* Someone who is passionate about recruitment and talent acquisition.
* A proactive professional who can independently manage bulk hiring requirements.
* Someone comfortable working with recruitment targets and multiple job openings.
* A team player willing to contribute to other HR functions whenever required.

Job Title: Sales Officer Point of Sale (POS) Department: Retail Field Sales / Credit Card Acquisition Organization: SBI Card (via Authorized Channel Partner / Direct Sales) Location: South Kolkata, West Bengal

Role Overview

The Sales Officer (POS) is responsible for driving end-to-end credit card acquisition at assigned retail partner outlets, shopping malls, high-footfall commercial zones, and corporate kiosks across South Kolkata. The role requires proactive customer engagement, strict adherence to digital onboarding compliance, and consistent achievement of monthly issuance targets.

Key Responsibilities

* Point-of-Sale Customer Acquisition: Actively engage walk-in shoppers and prospective customers at assigned retail stores, brand outlets, and merchant tie-up locations to pitch SBI Credit Card variants tailored to their spending profiles.
* End-to-End Application Processing: Guide customers through the digital KYC and application journey on tablets/smartphones, ensuring accurate documentation and zero-error submission to minimize application drop-offs and rejections.
* Target Achievement & Productivity: Consistently meet and exceed daily login targets, monthly card activation benchmarks, and minimum net-issuance numbers.
* POS Visibility & Merchandising: Maintain brand visibility at assigned retail counters by ensuring promotional standees, tent cards, and QR displays are properly placed and updated.
* Stakeholder & Store Relationship Management: Build strong working relationships with store managers, cashiers, and retail floor staff at partner outlets to maximize customer referrals at the billing counter.
* Operational Discipline & Reporting: Attend mandatory daily morning gate meetings/huddles, adhere strictly to assigned store rosters and geo-tagged attendance protocols, and submit end-of-day login/conversion reports to the Team Leader.
* Compliance & Fair Practices: Adhere strictly to RBI guidelines and SBI Cards Code of Conduct ensure transparent communication regarding fees, charges, and card features without mis-selling.

Eligibility & Qualifications

* Education: Minimum 10+2 (Higher Secondary) pass; Graduates in any discipline preferred.
* Experience: 0-3 years of experience in field sales, retail sales, banking/BFSI products, telecom, or FMCG. Freshers with strong communication skills and high energy are welcome.
* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Bengali and Hindi, with working knowledge of English.
* Technical Readiness: Comfortable operating Android smartphones/tablets and digital onboarding apps.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strong persuasion, pitch delivery, and objection-handling skills in high-footfall retail environments.
* High resilience, self-motivation, and ability to work standing/on-field during peak retail hours (including weekends/festive rush).
* Strict punctuality and commitment to daily login discipline.

Compensation & Benefits

title: Site incharge civil engineering
description:
**Company Description**
HOG Projects is a family-owned, multidisciplinary construction company with more than 20 years of experience delivering civil engineering projects across transportation, residential, restoration/refurbishment, hospitality, commercial, industrial, and healthcare sectors. The organization is known for a strong client focus, hands-on project delivery, and a high rate of repeat business driven by reliable execution and competitive performance. * Strong civil engineering foundation, including Civil Engineering and Civil Engineering Design skills.
* Experience in project Planning and coordination within multidisciplinary construction projects.
* Knowledge of Stormwater Management and related infrastructure systems.

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Familiarity with relevant codes, standards, and safety regulations.
* Proficiency with engineering and design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Civil 3D or similar tools).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and adapt to changing project requirements.
* Previous experience with EPC contracts or large-scale infrastructure projects is an advantage.

title: US Financial Controller
description:
Job Description :

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a technically strong and analytical
**Financial Controller**
to manage financial governance, accounting operations, statutory compliance, financial reporting, and performance management for US-based clients.

The role requires strong expertise in accounting principles, financial reporting, US GAAP, internal controls, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis. The candidate will be responsible for managing multiple client accounts, ensuring accurate financial deliverables, supporting audit requirements, and providing actionable financial insights to support business decisions.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong ownership, stakeholder management capabilities, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment while meeting strict reporting deadlines.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Financial Governance & Compliance

* Develop, implement, and maintain accounting policies, procedures, and internal financial controls.
* Ensure compliance with applicable US federal and state statutory requirements for client entities.
* Oversee financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and relevant accounting standards.
* Monitor regulatory filings, financial documentation, and compliance requirements.
* Identify financial risks and recommend appropriate control measures.

2. Financial Reporting & Audit Support

* Manage month-end and year-end closing activities and finalization of accounts.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements and management reports.
* Review general ledger accounts, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
* Coordinate internal and external audit requirements.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial disclosures and reports.

3. Performance & Profitability Analysis

* Analyze branch-wise, segment-wise, and overall business profitability.
* Monitor financial performance against budgets, forecasts, and business targets.
* Identify cost leakages, financial deviations, and opportunities for margin improvement.
* Conduct variance analysis and provide recommendations for corrective actions.
* Support management in improving financial efficiency and business performance.

4. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Cash Management

* Lead annual budgeting and periodic forecasting activities.
* Manage fund flow planning, cash flow monitoring, and liquidity management.
* Support financial projections, scenario analysis, and financial modeling.
* Monitor working capital requirements and cash utilization.
* Provide insights to support financial planning and resource allocation.

5. MIS & Management Reporting

* Develop and maintain comprehensive MIS dashboards and financial reports.
* Prepare periodic financial performance reports for management review.
* Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends and business opportunities.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting across multiple client accounts.
* Recommend improvements in reporting processes and financial information systems.

6. Business & Strategic Support

* Support pricing decisions, commercial evaluations, and business case preparation.
* Collaborate with client CFOs, finance teams, and senior management.
* Provide actionable financial insights to support strategic business decisions.
* Drive improvements in accounting processes, systems, and reporting mechanisms.
* Support finance transformation and process optimization initiatives.

Required Qualifications

* Chartered Accountant (CA), CA Inter, or US CMA.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting standards.
* Knowledge of US GAAP and US financial compliance requirements.
* Relevant qualification in Finance or Accounting.

**Experience Required**

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in financial accounting, financial reporting, and controllership.
* Hands-on experience in month-end and year-end closing and finalization of accounts.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and MIS reporting.
* Exposure to US clients, US GAAP, or international accounting environments preferred.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts or stakeholders will be an advantage.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

* US GAAP & Financial Reporting
* Financial Governance & Internal Controls
* Month-End & Year-End Closing
* Finalization of Accounts
* Financial Statement Preparation
* Budgeting & Forecasting
* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* Cash Flow & Fund Flow Management
* Profitability & Variance Analysis
* Financial Modelling
* MIS Reporting & Dashboard Preparation
* Audit Coordination & Compliance
* Advanced MS Excel
* QuickBooks
* NetSuite or Similar Accounting Software

**Communication & Leadership Skills**

* Good written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder and client management capabilities.
* Ability to communicate financial insights clearly to senior management.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* High level of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and strict deadlines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong background in accounting, financial reporting, and financial compliance.
* Practical exposure to US-based clients and US GAAP.
* Capable of independently managing multiple client accounts.
* Strong understanding of financial controls, audit processes, and reporting frameworks.

title: Lead Engineer – Bridges – Ahmedabad / Bangalore / Chennai
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
  
  
CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to detailed design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
  
  
CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with the front office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.
  
  
CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Take responsibility for Rail bridge design, Viaduct & Structure design.
* Having experience designing steel bridges and complex bridges.
* Assisting in the overall project management from conception to development and project completion
* Responsible for managing the Engineers of different ranks, liaising with sub-agencies and building relationship with clients, architects, consultants, contractors.
* Co-ordinating work between different disciplines.
* Prepare reports and calculations in line with International Codes of Practice (AREMA, AASTHO, EURO, BS).
* Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections including recording of all relevant information
* Can perform bridge assessment calculation and report.
* Manage delivery of projects – take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects.
* Take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets.
* Preparation of estimates for work items.
* Identify scope change items.
* Knowledge of working on big multidisciplinary projects on BIM.
* Coordinating work between different disciplines.
* Can prepare contractual claims arising out of any change in the contract conditions.
* Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained
* Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to company ISO standards.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* BE-Civil + M.Tech in Structural Engineering
* 10 to 13 years of experience in the relevant field.
* Experience with software like Sofistik, Midas, Open Bridge and Oasys.
* Actively working towards professional qualification.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary design team.
* Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others.
* Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: District Manager
description:
**WAT ZOEKEN WE?**
Primary responsibilities: Planning  To prepare the seasonal estimates of all stores in advance and to submit proposals for remodeling of existing stores.  To find out new locations and negotiate for our expansion to increase business and market share.  To constantly analyze & inform H.O. about market trends & general economic trends in respective areas & how these trends might affect our business.  To submit proposals for temporary outlets to achieve extra business & clear stock.  In exceptional cases to co-ordinate with chief buyer to prepare specific shoe line collection for specific store to adapt to the market properly. Merchandising/Store Management  To ensure that all stores are always supplied with NOOS articles.  To initiate actions to inter-transfer excess stocks on regular basis.  To monitor and clear store wise aged merchandise and ensure no stock older than 12 months in shops.  To ensure that RM80/60 & other statements are forwarded according to schedule.  To decide to clear the stock which is not in complete assortment  To coordinate with buyers to ensure that we have adequate stock of all price range with high impact in turnover.  To study and report competitors’ actions in the district.  To ensure that customer claims are settled logically and properly as per company policy.  To take specific initiatives to sell slow movers in the stores.  To ensure that physical inventory matches with POS report. Promotion and Display  To ensure that Company Policy & directions on displays are followed to maintain the highest standard of continuous aggressive display & advertising in each store.  To ensure the display of New Arrivals and chosen for you Articles in the prime area in every store.  To ensure that seasonal guidelines are being implemented in the respective stores Administration and Finance:  To ensure that store operation expenses are as per Company Policy and Circulars issued from time to time.  To monitor regularly and arrange settlement of Bulk sale receivable (1042 A/C), Suspense Account (1046), Money-On-Way (1016) Accounts and Goods-On-Way (1302) Account on fortnightly basis. All items in these accounts to be settled within 3 weeks from the date of origin.  To take physical inventories of every store, agency at least once a season and to initiate appropriate action promptly in case of shortage as per Company Policy.  To ensure deposit of sale proceeds in the bank next day. Must pending/ delayed ensure no remittance from any of the store of the district.  To check and ensure that any Price changes as per circulars of the Company are properly implemented.  To prepare a fortnightly traveling and working plan and to submit for approval of Retail Manager.  To ensure that terms and conditions of the tenancy/lease agreement with the landlords of the stores are strictly adhered to and appropriate measures are taken to renew/extend the agreements.  To ensure that company assets are maintained in good condition. All new furniture received by the store is included in the furniture statement of the store. Complete and updated furniture statement must be available at the store.  In case of any loss due to theft, fire or burglary, necessary requirements for Insurance claims are complied with.  To ensure full implementation of Company’s instructions as specified in circulars are applied within the specified deadlines in the district.  To ensure full compliance of the Chart of Authority of the Company issued from time to time.  To initiate disciplinary action against recalcitrant store employees and against manager with inventory shortage above company standard in accordance with the set Rules of the Company. Personnel  To ensure that all stores are within the approved number of personnel.  To ensure that the store personnel are presentable, properly trained, well groomed and provide best service to customers.  To ensure that managers and store personnel are familiar with Company’s objectives and goals and work towards their achievements.  To develop lines of communications which will ensure a continuous flow of information with subordinates as well as management  To ensure that Store Manager is allocating objectives to all personnel on daily/weekly basis and ensure that morning meetings are conducted in the stores.  To participate in selection of shop employees and managers for promotion to higher type shops as and when required.  To train store personnel on ‘Bata 5 Steps of Customer Service’ to render best services to our customers. Business Plan achievement  Prepare, implement, and achieve operational business plan and estimates for the efficient operation of your region.  Work closely with the product development manager and the merchandise manager in the development creation and timely establishment of a shoe line.
  
  
**WAT ZOEKEN WE?**

* **Dig into Policy Questions:**

* **Turn Ideas into Action**

description:
**The Role**

This is a great role for someone who wants to learn fast and grow into a senior client servicing or influencer strategy position.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the day-to-day contact for assigned clients; handle emails, calls and routine updates professionally and promptly.
* Understand client briefs, goals, budgets and target audiences, and translate them into clear campaign briefs for the influencer team.
* Research and shortlist influencers (nano, micro, macro and celebrity) across niches and platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and X, based on audience fit, engagement quality and past work.
* Reach out to influencers and their managers, and coordinate pricing, deliverables, timelines, contracts and payments.
* Manage campaign execution: briefs, content drafts, approvals, posting schedules and usage rights, ensuring brand guidelines and disclosure norms (#ad, #sponsored) are followed.
* Coordinate with internal teams (strategy, creative, content, social media and finance) to meet deadlines and quality standards.
* Track campaign performance (reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, conversions, CPE/CPV/CPA) and prepare reports with insights and recommendations.
* Maintain influencer databases, rate cards, trackers and campaign documents accurately.
* Prepare presentations, creator shortlists, media plans and campaign wrap-up decks under guidance.
* Keep up with social media trends, platform updates, viral content and emerging creators in different industries.
* Flag risks such as delays, content issues and budget changes early, and support the team in solving them.

**Requirements**

* 2–4 years of experience in client servicing, influencer marketing, social media or digital marketing, preferably at an agency. Strong freshers with relevant internships may also apply.
* Good understanding of social media platforms, influencer ecosystems and creator content formats (reels, shorts, stories, videos, blogs).
* Excellent written and spoken English, with professional communication skills for clients and creators.
* Strong organisation and follow-up skills; ability to handle multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Basic knowledge of campaign metrics and reporting, and comfort with Excel/Google Sheets.
* Good presentation skills in PowerPoint/Google Slides/Canva.
* Confident negotiator and relationship builder, comfortable working with creators and agencies.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ownership of tasks.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience with influencer platforms or tools
* Familiarity with influencer contracts, usage rights and ASCI/FTC disclosure guidelines.
* Experience with UGC campaigns, barter collaborations and affiliate or performance-linked influencer programmes.
* Own social media presence or content creation experience.

Suvarnakala Pvt. Ltd. is a heritage jewellery brand that began its journey in 1970 and has grown into a leading name in gold, diamond, and jadtar jewellery. The company is known for meticulous craftsmanship, high quality standards, and designs that blend tradition with contemporary appeal. Suvarnakala focuses on creating jewellery that carries emotional value, using careful design, quality control, and state-of-the-art technology. The brand offers a wide range of finely crafted pieces to make customer selection easier and aims to remain a benchmark of excellence in the jewellery industry. Suvarnakala Jewels continues to expand its presence while maintaining its commitment to beautiful, meaningful jewellery.
  
**Role Description**
The Senior Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Ahmedabad Area. This role is responsible for managing and growing client relationships, driving retail and wholesale sales, and representing Suvarnakala’s brand values to customers. Daily activities include engaging with walk-in and appointment-based customers, understanding their preferences, presenting suitable jewellery collections, and closing sales while ensuring an excellent customer experience. The Senior Sales Executive will maintain product knowledge, track inventory and sales performance, prepare reports, and collaborate with the showroom and management teams on promotions and merchandising. The role also involves identifying new business opportunities, supporting after-sales service, and contributing to overall sales strategy and revenue growth.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with proven experience in retail or luxury goods sales, preferably in jewellery.
* Customer relationship management abilities, including active listening, consultative selling, and after-sales support.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse customers in a professional, respectful manner.
* Solid understanding of jewellery products (gold, diamond, jadtar), design trends, and quality standards, or willingness to rapidly acquire this knowledge.
* Competence in basic computer applications, POS systems, and maintaining accurate sales and inventory records.
* Strong attention to detail, reliability, and a high level of integrity in handling high-value merchandise and financial transactions.
* Ability to work on-site full time, including weekends, holidays, and peak seasons, with a results-driven and team-oriented mindset.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; relevant industry experience can be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Experience in the Greater Ahmedabad jewellery or luxury retail market is an advantage.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Teq Diligent is an end-to-end engineering partner that helps companies design, validate, certify, and scale reliable hardware products. For over 14 years, the company has supported organizations that need production-ready hardware but lack in-house product development capabilities. Teq Diligent’s expertise includes electronic product design, embedded firmware, enclosure design, prototyping, certifications, and volume manufacturing. The team brings deep experience across Industrial IoT, Test & Measurement, Vision Systems, Display Systems, RF systems, and Edge AI hardware. With more than 100 shipped products and a 70% repeat client rate, Teq Diligent combines global engineering standards with India’s cost advantage to deliver dependable hardware solutions.

**Role Description**
The Field Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, responsible for driving business growth by identifying and engaging potential clients in hardware product development and related engineering services. Day-to-day tasks include prospecting and qualifying leads, conducting client meetings and presentations, and understanding customer requirements to position Teq Diligent’s solutions effectively. The role involves managing the entire sales cycle, from initial contact through proposal development, negotiation, and closing, while maintaining accurate records in CRM tools. The Field Sales Executive will collaborate with engineering and project teams to ensure proposals are technically sound and aligned with client needs. This role also includes regular market research, participation in industry events, and building long-term relationships with customers to support repeat business.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in field sales, B2B sales, and account management, with the ability to manage end-to-end sales cycles.
* Ability to conduct client presentations, product demonstrations, and technical discussions in a clear and persuasive manner.
* Experience in or familiarity with hardware product development domains such as electronics, embedded systems, IoT, or industrial solutions.
* Competence in lead generation, pipeline management, and use of CRM or sales management tools.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to build and sustain long-term client relationships.
* Strong problem-solving and consultative selling skills, with the ability to understand and translate client requirements into solutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in technical sales.
* Ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad, travel for client visits as needed, and manage time and territory independently.
* Prior experience selling engineering services, hardware products, or technology solutions is highly beneficial.

title: Automotive Field Sales Executive (Spare Parts)
description:
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years in sales, field sales, or business development

**Motolith is an Ahmedabad-based**
, leading B2B e-commerce and automotive spare parts aggregation platform that simplifies spare parts procurement for workshops through competitive pricing, efficient sourcing, and reliable fulfilment.

We are looking for a Sales Executive to drive business growth by acquiring new workshops, managing spare parts enquiries, coordinating orders from enquiry to fulfilment, and building long-term relationships with workshops.

Key Responsibilities:

**1. Sales & Business Development**

* Generate sales and achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Identify and onboard new workshops to expand Motolith’s network.
* Conduct field visits to workshops to generate leads, understand their requirements, and promote Motolith’s services.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with workshops to drive repeat business.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand Motolith’s presence across Ahmedabad.

**2. Enquiry & Order Management**

* Connect with workshops to understand their requirements and generate spare parts enquiries.
* Follow up with workshops on enquiries, quotations, pricing, and order confirmations.
* Coordinate with internal sourcing and operations teams to ensure timely fulfilment of orders.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from receiving an enquiry to order placement, delivery, and payment collection.
* Proactively update workshops on order status and delivery timelines.
* Resolve order-related issues in coordination with internal teams to ensure a smooth experience for workshops.

**3. Lead Generation & Follow-ups**

* Generate leads through field visits, phone calls, referrals, and other channels.
* Follow up consistently with workshops to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Maintain regular communication with workshops to understand their ongoing requirements and generate repeat orders.
* Re-engage inactive workshops and drive business growth from the existing network.

**4. Sales Operations & Payment Collection**

* Maintain records of enquiries, quotations, orders, and sales follow-ups.
* Track sales performance and progress against assigned targets.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and coordinate collections from workshops.
* Share regular updates with management on sales performance, workshop feedback, and new business opportunities.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in sales, field sales, or business development.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to generate leads, convert enquiries into sales, and achieve business targets.
* Comfortable with field visits, meetings, and regular follow-ups with workshops.
* Good coordination, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM tools is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly sales revenue and achievement of assigned targets.
* Number of new workshops acquired and activated.
* Conversion rate of enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Repeat order rate and revenue generated from existing workshops.
* Timely follow-up and coordination from enquiry to order fulfilment.
* Collection of outstanding payments.
* Workshop engagement and retention.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven individual who enjoys field sales, building relationships, and converting business opportunities into revenue.

The ideal candidate will take ownership of the 
**entire sales cycle—from generating leads and following up on enquiries to ensuring order fulfilment and payment collection.**

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:**

**Email:**
**info@motolith.com**

**Join Motolith and be part of a growing platform transforming the way workshops procure spare parts.**

This role is hands-on and you’ll own it. You’ll run the top of our sales funnel: finding the right prospects, starting conversations, writing winning proposals, and turning interest into meetings and signed clients. We’ll give you goals rather than step-by-step instructions, and we’ll trust you to work out how to reach them.

**What You’ll Do**

* Find and engage CPA firms, accounting firms and business owners in the US & UK
* Run personalised LinkedIn outreach: build prospect lists, connect, follow up and book discovery calls
* Write tailored, winning proposals and bids on Upwork
* Build and grow our Fiverr presence: gig setup, optimisation, buyer communication and reviews
* Support digital marketing, using AI tools to research, write and publish faster
* Track every lead and conversion in a CRM and report results weekly to the CEO
* Spot what isn’t working in the funnel, test new approaches, and bring solutions as well as problems

* AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for prospect research, outreach and proposals
* Prospecting tools (Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay or similar) to build and qualify lead lists
* AI for content: LinkedIn posts, gig copy, email sequences, Canva AI visuals
* Reviewing and refining AI output so every message sounds human, accurate and on-brand

**What We’re Looking For**

* Excellent written and spoken English (this matters most)
* Proven lead generation experience on LinkedIn, Upwork and/or Fiverr
* Bachelor’s degree with 1–3 years in sales or business development
* Experience across the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing
* Strong negotiation, communication and presentation skills
* Proactive and self-driven: you plan your own pipeline and solve problems without handholding
* Working days: Monday to Saturday, with flexible working hours
* CRM experience (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive) preferred; exposure to accounting/outsourcing is a plus

**Compensation & Engagement**

* Fixed pay: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000/month, based on experience and results
* Commission on every client you bring in who converts
* Starts as a contract with clear monthly targets; consistent performers convert to full-time

**Why Join Us**

* Work directly with the CEO and see your impact every week
* Build international sales experience with US & UK firms
* Clear targets, transparent rewards and a real path to growth

title: Senior Client Servicing – Creative Presentations & Pitching
description:
**The Role**

You will be the hands-on creator of our presentations. You will turn briefs, strategy inputs and campaign ideas into visually striking, story-led decks for new-business pitches, proposals, credentials and client reviews, and then present them with confidence. You will work closely with strategy, creative, content and performance teams, and you will own the look, flow and message of every deck that leaves the agency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build creative, high-impact presentations from scratch (pitch decks, proposals, credentials, strategy and campaign decks, business reviews) in PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides or Canva or Similar.
* Turn briefs, RFPs and raw inputs into a clear storyline: opening hook, insight, big idea, solution, proof and a strong close.
* Create visually engaging slides with strong layouts, typography, colour, iconography, infographics and data visualization, aligned with each client's or the agency's brand.
* Collaborate with designers, copywriters and strategists to bring in visuals, mockups, case studies and campaign ideas, and give clear creative direction where needed.
* Lead new-business pitches and RFP/RFI responses end to end, coordinating inputs and deadlines across teams.
* Research prospects, categories, audiences and competitors across domains, and weave sharp insights into every deck.
* Present decks to clients and prospects, in person or on video calls, and handle questions and objections with confidence.
* Build and maintain a master library of editable templates, slide layouts, case studies, credentials and sector-wise content for fast, consistent decks.
* Create campaign performance reports and QBR/annual review decks that turn data into clear, visual stories.
* Track the pitch pipeline and win/loss outcomes, and use feedback to improve future decks.

**Requirements**

* 4–8 years of experience in client servicing, account management or business development at a digital marketing, advertising or media agency.
* A strong portfolio of creative presentations you have personally built, with proven pitch wins.
* Expert-level skills in PowerPoint and/or Keynote/Google Slides, plus Canva or Figma; a strong eye for layout, typography and visual hierarchy.
* Exceptional storytelling and copywriting ability in English, with the skill to simplify complex ideas into persuasive slides.
* Good understanding of digital marketing channels: social media, SEO, paid media, content, email and web.
* Ability to quickly research and understand new industries, audiences and competitors.
* Strong project management skills and comfort working to tight pitch deadlines with multiple teams.
* Confident presenter and communicator, able to handle client questions, negotiations and feedback.

**Good to Have**

* Basic design skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop or After Effects.
* Experience creating animated or interactive presentations (motion, transitions, embedded video, Prezi/Pitch).
* Experience with RFP-driven or tender-based pitches
* Experience building agency credentials, case studies and award entries.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
**Description**
Sikich offers the public and private sectors a varied platform of professional services across consulting, technology and compliance. Highly specialized and hands-on teams deliver integrated solutions rooted in deep industry experience. Our approach is strategically and thoughtfully designed to help our clients, teams, and communities accelerate success.
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity & Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data-driven solutions.
  
  
We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.
  
  
**What will you do in this role?**

* Business Requirements Gathering & Analysis

+ Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
+ Analyze and document functional and non-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
+ Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
+ Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.

* System Configuration and Customization

+ Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
+ Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
+ Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
+ Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.

* SQL Development and Database Management

+ Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
+ Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
+ Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
+ Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
+ Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.

* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation

+ Design and develop interactive forms and data-driven document generation solutions.
+ Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
+ Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.

* Technical Subject Matter Expert & Implementation Support

+ Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
+ Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
+ Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
+ Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.

* Quality Assurance & Testing

+ Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
+ Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
+ Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.

* Documentation & Knowledge Management

+ Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
+ Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
+ Facilitate end-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.

**What do you need to succeed in this role?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.

* Web Services/APIs and ACORD standards experience.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
**Microsoft 365 & Email/Messaging Engineer**
The Senior Microsoft 365 & Email/Messaging Engineer leads Hillenbrand's Exchange Online, Teams and Microsoft 365 collaboration services across a large, global enterprise. The role focuses on standardization, security, cost optimization and resilience. It drives consolidation of acquired and legacy environments into a single Microsoft 365 tenant, directs managed service providers, and owns eDiscovery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead engineering, architecture and operations for Exchange Online, Teams, and OneDrive, including the small on-premises Exchange footprint.
* Own mail flow and messaging: domains, connectors, transport rules, shared and resource mailboxes, permissions, and secure mail relay for applications and devices.
* Lead tenant and domain consolidation toward one tenant, including assessment, migration, coexistence and cutover.
* Manage Microsoft 365 licensing: assign, reclaim and consolidate SKUs and add-ons (Teams Phone, Audio Conferencing, Teams Premium, Teams Rooms) and report cost savings.
* Administer Teams on the Microsoft side: Direct Routing and Calling Plans, policies, call quality and Teams Rooms, coordinating with the telephony team and carriers.
* Own eDiscovery in Microsoft Purview: holds, searches, exports and case management, in partnership with Legal and HR.
* Contribute to Defender for Office 365 and DLP: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, anti-phishing and anti-spam policies, policy tuning and incident follow-up with the security team.
* Share ownership of Entra Connect and hybrid identity sync with the data center team.
* Support retention, sensitivity labels, audit logging, guest and external sharing controls, and mailbox and Teams lifecycle management.
* Direct and hold accountable managed service providers for Microsoft 365 and messaging operations.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, automation and AI to improve efficiency and produce reporting on licenses, mail flow, Teams usage and call quality.
* Define and report KPIs for mail delivery, Teams quality, license utilization, security posture and project progress.
* Partner with identity, infrastructure, network, security, application and service-desk teams, and with ServiceNow for incident, change and CMDB processes.
* Maintain standards, runbooks and documentation, and participate in a light on-call rotation.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of enterprise experience with Exchange (Online and hybrid) and Microsoft 365.
* Deep knowledge of mail flow and messaging security: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, connectors, transport rules, Autodiscover and mailbox permissions.
* Proven M&A experience: tenant-to-tenant migrations, domain and mail-flow consolidation, and legacy rationalization.
* Hands-on Teams administration, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans and meeting rooms.
* Experience with eDiscovery and compliance tooling (Microsoft Purview or equivalent).
* Strong PowerShell and Microsoft Graph skills, plus working knowledge of Entra ID, Entra Connect and hybrid identity.
* Experience managing managed service providers to defined service levels.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration in a multi-tenant enterprise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Teams Phone and PSTN experience (carriers, SBCs, numbering, emergency calling).
* Microsoft 365 licensing and cost optimization (EA/CSP).
* Defender for Office 365, DLP and conditional access within a Zero Trust approach.
* Tenant migration tools (such as Quest or BitTitan) and ServiceNow.

Technology Stack
  
  

* Messaging: Exchange Online, on-premises Exchange, shared mailboxes
* Collaboration and voice: Teams, Teams Phone (Direct Routing, Calling Plans), Teams Rooms, OneDrive
* Identity: Entra ID, Entra Connect, conditional access
* Security and compliance: Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview (eDiscovery, DLP, retention, labels)
* Automation and operations: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Azure, Intune, ServiceNow

We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.
  
  
Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. title: ETP INCHARGE

description:
**Please read JD and Suitable candidate apply.**

Designation: ETP Site In-Charge

Department: Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

Reporting To: O&M Manager /

Industry: Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) Operations

Location:Erode

Salary:30000 to 40000

1. Job Purpose

To independently manage and monitor day-to-day ETP operations, ensure treated water quality meets applicable statutory standards, supervise site operators, maintain equipment, and ensure smooth and efficient plant operations as per customer and company requirements.

2. Roles & Responsibilities

A. ETP Operations

* Monitor daily ETP operations and ensure smooth plant functioning.
* Understand and operate the complete ETP treatment process.
* Monitor raw effluent, treated water quality and process parameters.
* Ensure proper chemical dosing, pH correction and sludge management.
* Monitor aeration, biological treatment, clarification and filtration systems.
* Ensure treated water quality meets applicable TNPCB/CPCB norms and consent conditions.
* Maintain daily operational records and log sheets.

B. Equipment & Maintenance

* Monitor the condition of pumps, blowers, agitators, filters and other equipment.
* Ensure preventive and breakdown maintenance activities.
* Identify equipment failures and coordinate immediate rectification.
* Monitor chemical storage, dosing systems and consumables.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and cleanliness of the ETP area.
* Report major equipment breakdowns to the management immediately.

C. Manpower Management

* Supervise ETP operators, helpers and other site personnel.
* Allocate daily duties and monitor employee attendance.
* Ensure operators follow company SOPs and safety procedures.
* Provide operational training and guidance to operators.
* Maintain discipline and proper manpower utilisation.

D. Laboratory & Quality Control

* Conduct routine laboratory analysis of wastewater.
* Monitor pH, TSS, COD, BOD, TDS and other relevant parameters.
* Maintain daily laboratory testing records.
* Monitor chemical consumption and treatment efficiency.
* Coordinate external laboratory testing whenever required.

E. Statutory Compliance & Safety

* Ensure ETP operations comply with applicable pollution control requirements.
* Maintain statutory records and environmental monitoring reports.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of sludge.
* Ensure PPE usage and workplace safety.
* Report any environmental or safety-related incidents immediately.

F. Customer & Management Coordination

* Coordinate with customer representatives regarding daily ETP operations.
* Attend customer meetings and discuss operational issues.
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly operational reports.
* Inform management about operational challenges and additional requirements.
* Coordinate with the maintenance team for technical support.

3. Daily Reporting Requirements

The Site In-Charge must submit the following reports:

* Daily ETP operational report.
* Raw and treated water quality report.
* Chemical consumption report.
* Electricity and equipment running-hour details.
* Manpower attendance report.
* Equipment breakdown and maintenance report.
* Sludge generation and disposal details.
* Daily plant photographs and operational updates.

4. Qualification & Experience

Criteria

Requirements

Qualification

B.Sc Chemistry / M.Sc Chemistry / Diploma / B.E. Chemical

Experience

Minimum 3–5 years in ETP operations

Technical Knowledge

ETP process, chemical treatment and biological treatment

Laboratory Skills

pH, COD, BOD, TSS and other wastewater analysis

Computer Skills

MS Excel, Word and daily reporting

Additional Skills

Manpower handling and customer coordination

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

* Treated water quality and compliance.
* Smooth plant operation without unnecessary interruptions.
* Proper chemical consumption and cost control.
* Equipment availability and preventive maintenance.
* Effective manpower management.
* Timely submission of daily and monthly reports.
* Customer satisfaction.
* Proper housekeeping and safety compliance.

6. Authority & Accountability

* Responsible for complete ETP site operations.
* Accountable for treated water quality and operational performance.
* Responsible for site manpower and equipment monitoring.
* Must immediately escalate major technical and statutory issues to the O&M Manager.
* Responsible for ensuring all operators follow company SOPs.
