title: UG Research Intern
description:
**Job Description**

***Company Description***

REACT (Real World Engineering and Application through Collaborative Transformation) is an initiative at Kumaraguru Institutions that focuses on innovation, research, and collaborative problem-solving to address real-world challenges. The initiative brings together students, faculty, institutions, and communities to develop solutions through interdisciplinary learning and practical engagement.

REACT works across various domains to identify societal challenges, develop innovative approaches, and create meaningful impact through research, experiential learning, and collaborative initiatives.

***Role Description***

The Education Research & Programme Development Intern will primarily focus on researching existing educational models, frameworks, pedagogical approaches, and innovative learning methodologies to understand their relevance, effectiveness, and potential application in addressing societal challenges. The intern will contribute to the research, conceptualisation, and development of a structured educational methodology at REACT, with a strong emphasis on social impact, experiential learning, and real-world problem-solving.

The role involves studying established education systems and practices, identifying gaps and opportunities, analysing relevant case studies, and translating research findings into practical frameworks and methodologies. The intern will work towards developing programme structures, learning approaches, implementation models, and strategies that integrate education with social innovation and community impact.

Beyond research and framework development, the role requires strong programme management, event coordination, and operational capabilities to support the execution and implementation of the developed methodology. This includes planning and organising workshops, learning interventions, events, and other programme activities, coordinating with stakeholders, managing logistics, and ensuring effective implementation.

The intern will work closely with the REACT team and multidisciplinary stakeholders, contributing across the entire process – from research and conceptualisation to methodology development, programme execution, and continuous improvement.

This is an on-site internship based at Kumaraguru Institutions, Coimbatore, requiring active collaboration with the REACT team and participation in ongoing projects and initiatives.

***Qualifications***

* Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in any discipline.
* Strong interest or experience in educational research, information analysis, and research documentation.
* Ability to study existing educational models, identify gaps, and develop problem statements.
* Interest in programme curation, framework development, and learning and development.
* Familiarity with design thinking, creative problem-solving, and innovative approaches.
* Strong learning agility, adaptability, and willingness to explore new domains.
* Good communication, teamwork, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Event management, programme coordination, and operational execution skills.
* Basic proficiency in digital tools, documentation, spreadsheets, and presentations.
* Prior experience in research, programme development, student initiatives, or event management will be an added advantage but is not mandatory.

***Internship Details***

This is an unpaid, experiential internship designed to provide practical exposure to educational research, methodology development, programme management, and social impact initiatives. The internship emphasises learning through active participation, collaborative problem-solving, and contributing to real-world projects.

Interns are expected to demonstrate curiosity, initiative, accountability, adaptability, and a willingness to learn while contributing to the collective goals of the REACT team.

**We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Business Development Executive to promote and sell our software solutions, API integration services, and technology products to pharmaceutical companies.**

**The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential pharma clients, building relationships with pharmaceutical brands and manufacturers, understanding their business and technology requirements, and generating new business opportunities.**

* Develop marketing strategies targeting pharmaceutical brands and manufacturers.

* Understand our software products, API capabilities, integration services, and technical offerings.
* Explain the business benefits of API integration to pharmaceutical clients.
* Identify opportunities for custom software development and enterprise application integration.
* Coordinate with technical teams to understand client requirements.
* Present suitable technology solutions based on customer business needs.
* Follow up with prospects from initial discussions through technical evaluation and contract closure.

* Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Companies

* Pharma Marketing Companies
* Pharma Distributors and Wholesalers
* Third-Party Pharma Manufacturers
* Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs)
* Pharma Supply Chain Companies
* Healthcare Technology Companies

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Pharmacy, IT, or a related field.

* Knowledge of SaaS products, APIs, ERP systems, and software integration is an advantage.

* Proficiency in MS Office, CRM tools, LinkedIn, and digital marketing platforms.

  We are looking for a sales professional who can build strong relationships within the pharmaceutical industry and generate business opportunities for our software and API-based technology solutions.

description:

With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. **Job Overview**
**Job Title: Lead – Data Migration (ITSM / ServiceNow)**
**Experience:**
9–10 Years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**Lead Data Migration Specialist**
with strong
**Python expertise**
and proven experience in
**migrating data across ITSM platforms**
, particularly
**ServiceNow**
. This role will lead end-to-end data migration initiatives, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and seamless transition while managing stakeholders and technical teams.
  
  
Knowledge of
**Salesforce platform**
will be considered an added advantage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Migration Leadership**

* Lead and oversee end-to-end data migration projects from legacy ITSM tools to modern platforms (preferably ServiceNow).
* Define data migration strategy, approach, and governance framework.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams (developers, analysts, platform SMEs) to execute migration programs.

**Technical Execution**

* Design and implement data extraction, transformation, and load (ETL) pipelines using Python.
* Build reusable scripts and automation frameworks for data validation, reconciliation, and error handling.
* Work with structured and unstructured data across multiple data sources (databases, APIs, files).

**ServiceNow Expertise**

* Perform data migration into ServiceNow modules (Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB, etc.).
* Configure and utilize ServiceNow import sets, transform maps, and integration tools.
* Ensure data model alignment with ServiceNow standards and best practices.

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define data cleansing, deduplication, and validation rules.
* Ensure data integrity, completeness, and compliance throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Conduct reconciliation, auditing, and sign-off processes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and mapping.
* Communicate project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.
* Provide guidance and best practices to internal teams.

**Delivery & Risk Management**

* Identify migration risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery aligned with project timelines and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement and automation in migration processes.

**Experience**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 9–10 years of experience in data migration, data engineering, or integration roles.
* Proven track record of leading large-scale ITSM data migration projects.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Python (data processing, scripting, automation).
* Hands-on experience with: ETL tools and frameworks SQL and relational databases Data mapping, transformation logic, and validation
* Experience with APIs, JSON, XML, and file-based data exchange.

**ITSM & ServiceNow**

* Hands-on experience in ServiceNow data migration (Import Sets, Transform Maps).
* Good understanding of ITIL processes and ITSM data structures.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with Salesforce platform (data migration, integrations, or objects model).
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Familiarity with data governance, compliance, and security standards.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management capabilities
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Effective communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

**Key Success Metrics**

* Successful completion of migrations with high data accuracy and minimal defects
* Adherence to timelines and delivery commitments
* Improved efficiency through automation and reusable assets

Apply on this listing, or email your CV to hr@trademaxacademy.com with the subject line "Chief Sales Officer: Your Name".

Telecalling Executive

activBASE

Rajagiri Valley, Kakkanad, Kochi

Freshers and candidates with up to 6 months of experience can apply

As per industry standards

**About Us**

activBASE is an advanced Orthopaedic and Sports Rehabilitation Centre at Rajagiri Valley, Kakkanad, Kochi. We bring together orthopaedic physiotherapy, sports injury rehabilitation, post-surgical rehabilitation, hydrotherapy, recovery services, and fitness and athletic conditioning under one roof. Our aim is simple: Move Better. Recover Stronger. Rise Above Pain.

**Role Overview**

As a Telecalling Executive, you will be the first point of contact between activBASE and our patients. You will handle enquiries, explain our services and the appointment process, and schedule appointments. You will work closely with the Marketing and Sales, Operations and Clinical teams to give every patient a smooth and professional first experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

·       Respond to patient enquiries received through calls, online channels and referrals

·       Understand the patient's basic concern and explain activBASE and its services clearly

·       Explain the clinical assessment and appointment process

·       Schedule and confirm appointments, and remind patients of their sessions

·       Follow up with patients who need time to decide, and with those who miss or cancel appointments

·       Update lead status accurately in the system and maintain proper call records

·       Coordinate with the operations, counselling and clinical teams when needed

·       Submit daily reports on calls completed, enquiries, confirmed appointments and follow-ups

·       Maintain patient confidentiality at all times

·    Do not diagnose, prescribe exercises or promise recovery outcomes; refer clinical questions to the clinical team

**Requirements**

·       Any graduate or diploma holder

·       Good English communication skills, with Malayalam fluency

·       Basic computer knowledge (MS Office and data entry)

·       Polite, patient and professional telephone manners

·       Confidence and willingness to learn

·     Freshers are welcome; up to 6 months of experience in tele calling, customer support or sales is an added advantage but not mandatory

**Nice to Have**

title: MEP DESIGN ENGINEER
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented MEP Design Engineer to handle the design, planning, and coordination of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing systems for residential and commercial projects. The candidate should have good technical knowledge, design skills, and experience in coordinating with architects, structural engineers, and project execution teams.

**1. MEP Design & Planning**

* Prepare MEP layouts, drawings, and technical designs for residential and commercial projects.

* Ensure MEP designs comply with applicable building codes, safety standards, and regulations.

* Review drawings and ensure design accuracy and quality.

**4. Project Support**

* Coordinate with site engineers and execution teams during project implementation.
* Provide technical clarification and resolve design-related issues.
* Conduct site visits to verify MEP installation as per approved drawings.

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
* 4- 6 years of relevant experience in MEP design.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and Revit MEP.
* Good knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire-fighting systems.
* Understanding of building codes and MEP standards.
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Role**
We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to help shape key areas of the member experience as the Tide app continues to evolve across 55+ products.
  
  
At Tide, we approach design with a relentless focus on our members. We love turning the complexity of a chaotic financial world into simple, beautiful and scalable experiences that make running a business easier.
  
  
In this role, you’ll take ownership of design across high-impact products, working within dedicated cross-functional teams. You’ll have significant autonomy to shape the direction of your work, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to balance exceptional member experiences with technical, regulatory and commercial considerations.
  
  
We’re open to designers operating at Senior, Senior II or Lead level. What matters most is the strength of your craft, the quality of your thinking, your ability to navigate complexity and the impact you’ve had on the products you’ve helped build.
  
  
If you enjoy solving difficult problems, thinking in systems and creating thoughtful experiences that make a genuine difference to small businesses, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own End-to-End Product Design: Take ownership of complex product challenges, from early discovery and problem definition through to detailed design and delivery. Create intuitive, engaging experiences that simplify the way our members run their businesses.
* Shape Product Direction: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations to understand customer and business needs, challenge assumptions and influence product priorities. Bring a strong design perspective to product strategy, not just execution.
* Design for Scale and Simplicity: Translate complex technical requirements, workflows and regulatory constraints into clear, elegant and scalable experiences. Think beyond individual screens to create cohesive journeys across iOS, Android and web.
* Use Research and Data to Drive Decisions: Combine qualitative research, quantitative insights, experimentation and product metrics to understand problems, validate solutions and continuously improve the member experience.
* Set a High Bar for Craft: Deliver exceptional interaction and visual design, with a sharp eye for typography, layout, usability and detail. Contribute to the evolution of Tide’s cross-platform design system and ensure consistency without compromising innovation.
* Influence and Elevate Design Quality: Bring clarity to ambiguous challenges, communicate your thinking effectively and collaborate constructively with stakeholders. Share knowledge, provide thoughtful feedback and help raise the quality of design across the wider team.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Exceptional Product Design Craft: A strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality, end-to-end product design work, including complex digital products, workflows or systems. We’re interested in the problems you’ve solved, the decisions you’ve made and the outcomes you’ve influenced, rather than a specific number of years of experience.
* Strong Systems Thinking: The ability to think holistically about products, user journeys and interconnected experiences rather than isolated features or screens. You understand how design decisions scale across platforms, markets and technical or regulatory constraints.
* Product Thinking and Commercial Awareness: You connect customer needs with business objectives and understand how good design contributes to meaningful product outcomes. You’re comfortable using evidence to inform decisions and making thoughtful trade-offs.
* Collaboration and Influence: A proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams, build strong relationships and constructively challenge assumptions. You can communicate complex design decisions clearly and bring others along with your thinking.
* Advanced Interaction and Visual Design: Strong proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design systems, combined with an excellent understanding of interaction patterns, accessibility and the technical implications of your decisions.
* Autonomy and Comfort with Ambiguity: You’re confident taking ownership of complex challenges, identifying the right problems to solve and creating clarity where requirements aren’t always fully defined. You know when to move independently and when to bring others into the conversation.
* Empathy and Curiosity: You care deeply about understanding the people you’re designing for and are motivated by making their lives easier. You’re curious, open to feedback and continuously looking for ways to improve your work.
* AI and Future-Focused Thinking: You’re curious about how AI is changing the way products are designed and experienced. You’re interested in experimenting with emerging tools, evolving your workflows and exploring how new technologies can create meaningful value for members.

We’re more interested in your capabilities, judgement and impact than your previous job title or the number of years you’ve spent in design. Experience in fintech or other complex, regulated environments is valuable, but not essential.
  
  
**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Compensation – competitive salary
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
  
  
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
  
  
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
  
  
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
  
  
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
  
  
*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*

title: Software Development, Staff
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years building enterprise applications that actually run the business, not just satisfy a spec.
  
  
You are comfortable moving between C# backend work, Angular front ends, Power Apps configurations, and Python scripts without losing sight of what the business actually needs. You have built integrations that connect systems no one thought could talk to each other, and you have done it in a way that the next person can actually maintain.
  
  
You do not wait for perfect requirements. You sit with the GTM team, figure out what they are trying to accomplish, and start building something they can react to. At Synopsys, you will work on applications and AI-enabled workflows that directly affect how our go-to-market teams operate every day, and the solutions you build will matter.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Design and build business applications using C#/.NET, Angular, Power Apps, Python, and Azure that support go-to-market workflows across Synopsys
* Develop AI-enabled applications and automation using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, and Power Automate
* Build and maintain integrations across enterprise systems, APIs, business data sources, and AI solutions
* Own solutions end to end, from gathering requirements and writing technical designs through deployment, monitoring, and production support
* Modernize legacy applications by migrating them to current full-stack, cloud, automation, and AI technologies
* Partner with GTM business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions
* Write and maintain technical documentation that helps the team understand, support, and extend what you built

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve productivity across the go-to-market organization by automating manual workflows and delivering AI-enabled business applications
* Modernize business-critical applications so they are more reliable, easier to support, and aligned with current technology standards
* Turn AI prototypes and business ideas into production-ready solutions that teams actually use
* Build reusable components, integrations, and frameworks that accelerate future development across the team
* Expand the practical use of AI, Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure across GTM operations
* Contribute to Synopsys' broader AI transformation and business application strategy
* Reduce technical debt and improve long-term maintainability of the GTM application portfolio

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of hands-on enterprise application development experience
* Strong proficiency in C#/.NET and modern web technologies such as Angular, React, JavaScript, or TypeScript
* Experience building and deploying solutions using Power Apps, Power Platform, REST APIs, SQL, and Azure
* Track record of supporting applications through the full lifecycle, from development through deployment and production support
* Exposure to Generative AI, Copilot, AI agents, or intelligent automation
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, security best practices, monitoring, and modern development workflows
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Python, Power Automate, or Dataverse is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can sit in a room with a business stakeholder who has a half-formed idea and walk out with a technical plan that actually solves their problem
* You write code that other people can read, debug, and extend six months later without calling you
* You know when to build something custom and when to configure an existing platform, and you are not precious about either
* You are comfortable working across time zones and overlapping with US Pacific hours when the team needs to align
* You push back when a requirement does not make sense or when a proposed solution will create more problems than it solves
* You treat production support as part of the job, not an interruption, because you know that is where you learn what actually matters

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, developing and supporting business applications, automation, and emerging AI capabilities for Synopsys' go-to-market team.
  
  
You will work closely with GTM business and technology teams across full-stack development, Power Platform, Azure, Copilot, and agentic AI to modernize business workflows and deliver practical solutions.
  
  
This onsite role is based in Bengaluru and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific time hours.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Research Analyst (Product)
description:
**About the company:**

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

* **Distributor trust:**
  Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
* **Customer trust:**
  End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
* **Manufacturer trust:**
  Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

**Key highlights: What do we do**

1. **Large, underpenetrated market opportunity:**
   India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. **Differentiated, asset-light social distribution:**
   WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. **Proprietary AI driven tech stack:**
   Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Role Overview:**

The Product & Research Analyst serves as the strategic bridge connecting our clients, product team, and marketing group. In this client-facing role, you will interact directly with customers to gather primary market intelligence, analyze user engagement, and identify performance gaps. Drawing on your hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms, you will synthesize raw client feedback into actionable data, driving cross-functional alignment and continuous product enhancement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct direct interviews, surveys, and feedback sessions with clients to gather qualitative and quantitative research data.
* Analyze customer usage patterns and engagement metrics using platforms like WebEngage, MoEngage, or Braze to identify gaps between client expectations and product capabilities .
* Synthesize raw user feedback and analytics into structured insights, business requirements, and feature requests for the Product and Marketing teams.
* Act as a core liaison between Clients, Product Managers, and Marketing/Tech teams to ensure roadmap priorities align with market needs.
* Serve as a product representative in client interactions, clearly communicating value, feature updates, and upcoming enhancements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 1–3 years of experience in product research, product analysis, or business analysis, ideally within a tech or product-based company.
* Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience using customer engagement platforms such as WebEngage, MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, or equivalent tools.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with both Product and Marketing teams to align strategies and bridge operational gaps.
* Client & Research Expertise: Demonstrated track record of direct client interaction, primary research, and user feedback collection.
* Communication & Synthesis: Strong active listening skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business insights for both internal and external stakeholders.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**
**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**
Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.
  
  
Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.
  
  
This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.
  
  
**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**
**What You'll Do**

* Understand the problem
* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up
* Build the business case
* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact
* Reimagine the solution on Celestara
* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome
* Deliver from UAT to production
* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hypercare and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts
* Own the use case after go-live
* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release
* Be the voice of the customer
* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.
  
  
**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.
  
  
**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.
  
  
**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:
  
  

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.
  
  
**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.
  
  
**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.
  
  
**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.
  
  
**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**
**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.

**Good to have**

* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.
  
  
**The Role:**
In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.
  
  
You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

Batch and real-time pipeline architecture
  
  
Data mesh/data fabric architectures
  
  
Data lake and Lakehouse implementation
  
  
Understanding of API design and development and Microservices architecture is a plus
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

:

:

:

CareerArc Code
  
  
CA-JY

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Success is measured by the trust, scale, and adoption of the data and AI products that ship — and by the business outcomes they unlock.
  
  
**Here is how, through this role, you will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**

* Architecture for Scale (Primary Focus) — Design the reference architecture and delivery patterns that take governed data from the semantic layer to every downstream consumer — dashboards, applications, and AI agents — reliably and at scale, with the build-vs-buy calls and standards that let the platform grow without painful rework.
* AI Data Products & Agents — Architect and build the Data Agent, the natural-language interface that lets business users query governed data without writing SQL; design agentic workflows with orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.
* Semantic Foundation — Co-design the semantic layer (HoneyDew / DBT) — the metrics, dimensions, and governed business meaning that power both analytics and AI — ensuring agents query governed definitions, not raw tables.
* Technical Leadership — Serve as technical lead and trusted advisor; set patterns, run design reviews, and mentor engineers, partnering with the Data Engineer to take designs to production.
* Business Translation — Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements; own stakeholder relationships and move fluently between executive framing and engineering detail.
* Ownership & Execution — Take features and subsystems end-to-end, proactively identifying gaps and driving work forward even when requirements are incomplete or evolving.

**To ensure you're set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**

* 8+ years across data architecture and hands-on engineering, including production systems that held up under real enterprise use.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep, hands-on experience designing and building on Snowflake and DBT.
* Proven experience designing and building LLM / agentic solutions — RAG, function / tool calling, orchestration (LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph), prompt engineering, and evaluation / observability.
* Deep understanding of the semantic layer as the architectural bridge between source data and business meaning — and why it is foundational to trustworthy AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and influence architecture decisions across teams.
* Strong communication and the ability to lead through execution in a fast-moving environment.

**Broad Technical Exposure (depth Not Required In All Areas)**

* Cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* CI/CD and modern engineering practices for data and AI systems.

* HoneyDew or other universal/headless semantic layers (HoneyDew, Cube, AtScale, dbt Semantic Layer).

title: Software Development Engineer - I
description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017. We build syncOS — the industry-first no-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands like Ford, Coca-Cola, and Kimberly-Clark — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.

We started as roboticists ourselves. We know the pain of fragmented, proprietary systems that refuse to talk to each other. syncOS is our answer — and we believe it's what the industry has been waiting for. We are a young, passionate team chasing one big mission: #automateasia. If you love robots, hate inefficiency, and want to build solutions that run on real factory floors — read on.

**The Opportunity:**

As Botsync scales syncOS across a growing base of deployments, this role contributes to the backend engineering behind syncOS's integration platform — building, testing, and maintaining the services and integrations that connect syncOS to automation equipment worldwide.

**The Role:**

* Develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and data components for syncOS's integration platform.
* Implement integration modules in Python and C++ using REST APIs, Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, Websockets, CAN, and TCP/IP.
* Contribute to sync templates and integration frameworks for machine-to-machine and machine-to-software integrations.
* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code; participate in code reviews and follow established engineering standards.
* Build and extend integrations for AMRs, AGVs, fleet managers, Warehouse Management Systems, and sensor OEM platforms.
* Diagnose and resolve backend, API, protocol, and data-flow issues during development and deployment.
* Add automated tests, logging, monitoring, and technical documentation to improve system reliability.
* Work with senior engineers, QA, Customer Success, and deployment teams to execute clearly scoped deliverables.
* Support deployment validation and customer-site troubleshooting, and close issues through root-cause follow-up.

**What we're looking for:**

* 1-3 years of backend software engineering experience, with strong hands-on proficiency in Python and working knowledge of C++.
* Experience building, testing, and debugging backend services, REST APIs, or data-driven applications.
* Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, Websockets, CAN, and TCP/IP.
* Good understanding of backend fundamentals, API design, networking, data handling, automated testing, and debugging.
* Exposure to integrating robotics or automation equipment such as AMRs or AGVs with fleet-management or orchestration software.
* Bonus: experience integrating Warehouse Management Systems or sensor OEM platforms.
* Bonus: working proficiency in Golang alongside Python and C++.

**What does Success look like:**

Success in this role is measured by the quality and timely execution of assigned backend and integration modules, the reliability of the code shipped, effective debugging and collaboration, and smoother syncOS deployments in the field with minimal rework or escalation.

title: Backend Software Development Engineer – Expert
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru, India
  
  
**Function:**
(DEAI HV) Engineering
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
R0132295
  
  
**Our Company**
We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**About The Team**
We build the object storage that AI-era workloads need. Our products help customers in regulated industries like finance, healthcare and legal store, protect and access huge amounts of data. The Object backend team owns the core of the platform: the S3 data path, metadata and database services, replication, data protection, and the distributed services that run large clusters.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a senior backend engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of our core storage services. You'll design and build high-throughput, fault-tolerant server-side systems that work at multi-petabyte and billion-object scale. You'll own complex subsystems from start to finish, set backend engineering standards, mentor senior engineers, and be a go-to technical expert for Product Management, QE, Support and Services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the architecture, design and implementation of core backend services: the S3 request and data path, metadata management, indexing, garbage collection and background services.
* Design distributed, highly available systems with clear consistency, durability and failure-handling guarantees.
* Own the scalability and performance of the data and metadata layers. Profile, tune and remove bottlenecks in throughput, latency and IOPS-heavy workloads.
* Drive the evolution of database and messaging layers, such as PostgreSQL upgrades and tuning, distributed SQL (YugabyteDB), and RabbitMQ-based async processing.
* Design and improve replication, disaster recovery and data integrity features (multi-site replication, failover/recovery, checksum verification).
* Implement S3 API features and compliance, including versioning, Object Lock/WORM, lifecycle policies and multipart upload.
* Lead backend modernization work: runtime and language migrations (for example Python 3), containerization and Kubernetes-based services, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.
* Act as the final escalation point for critical production issues. Lead root cause analysis for problems like JVM heap exhaustion, session or resource leaks, deadlocks and data availability issues, and deliver lasting fixes.
* Work with security teams to fix CVEs and harden backend services (encryption at rest and in transit, key management and rekeying, authentication and authorization).
* Set backend standards for API design, code quality, design reviews, testing and CI/CD, and mentor Senior and Specialist engineers across locations.

**Required Qualifications**

* BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
* 12+ years of backend or systems software development, with a strong record of architecting and shipping enterprise-grade distributed systems.
* Expert-level Java skills, including JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, and heap and thread dump analysis. Strong skills in Go and/or Python.
* Deep knowledge of concurrency, multithreading, networking, data structures and algorithms on Linux.
* Proven experience designing distributed systems: consensus/replication, partitioning, consistency models and fault tolerance.
* Strong hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), including schema design, query optimization and upgrades.
* Experience building and scaling RESTful/HTTP services and asynchronous, message-driven architectures.
* Excellent communication skills, and experience leading technical work across globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep storage domain experience: object storage internals, the S3 API, file or block storage, SAN.
* Experience with erasure coding or RAID, data deduplication or compression, and data integrity (MD5/SHA256).
* Experience with Yuga byte DB or other distributed SQL/NoSQL databases, and RabbitMQ or Kafka.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and with moving monolithic services to cloud-native microservices.
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and with designing operational metrics and telemetry.
* Knowledge of security practices: encryption, KMIP key management, identity and access management, and secure SDLC.
* Experience with GitLab CI/CD and automated testing at the unit, integration and system levels.
* Patents, publications or open-source contributions in storage or distributed systems.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Core services meet scale, performance and reliability targets on large production clusters.
* Critical escalations and backend defect backlog go down measurably, and root cause analyses lead to fixes that stop the issue from coming back.
* Modernization milestones (database, runtime, telemetry upgrades) ship on plan without hurting stability.
* Your designs become standards other teams adopt, and the engineers you mentor grow into technical leaders.

**Why join us**
You'll build the core of mission-critical storage trusted by many of the world's largest enterprises. You'll have real influence on architecture and product direction, in a collaborative and inclusive culture that values innovation and respect.
  
  
**About Us**
We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

You will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for WorkforceOS, translating market opportunities, customer needs and emerging AI capabilities into a differentiated product offering.
  
  
You will build and lead a high-performing global Product Management organization, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to bring the vision to life.
  
  
As a key member of the WorkforceOS leadership team, you will partner directly with the GM to define the product's strategic direction, establish its market positioning and drive its commercial success.
  
  
Beyond WorkforceOS, you will work closely with GMs and product leaders across Cornerstone's business lines to identify strategic opportunities, drive portfolio alignment and create synergies across the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.
  
  
This role requires a combination of product vision, strong execution discipline, customer obsession, commercial acumen and the ability to build a product organization from the ground up.
  
  
**In this role you will...**

1.Product Vision & Strategy
  
  

* Define and own the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for WorkforceOS, aligned with the overall business strategy and growth objectives.

  

* Shape the evolution of WorkforceOS into a unified, AI-native HCM platform connecting the employee lifecycle, workforce data, skills intelligence and organizational capabilities.

  

* Identify opportunities to differentiate WorkforceOS in the competitive HCM landscape through innovation, simplicity, intelligence and superior customer experiences.

  

* Translate market insights, customer needs, competitive intelligence and emerging technology trends into clear product strategies and investment priorities.

  

* Drive a platform-first product philosophy, balancing foundational capabilities, reusable services and differentiated application experiences.

  

* Establish clear product principles, prioritization frameworks and decision-making mechanisms to guide product investments.

  
2. AI-First Product Innovation
  
  

* Champion an AI-first product philosophy, embedding AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics and agentic capabilities into the WorkforceOS experience.

  

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for workforce intelligence, skills inference, personalized employee experiences, talent recommendations and intelligent HR workflows.

  

* Drive the evolution from traditional systems of record and systems of engagement toward intelligent systems of action and decision-making.

  

* Partner with AI, Data Science and Engineering teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into meaningful, commercially viable customer outcomes.

  

* Ensure responsible AI principles, transparency, trust and governance are embedded into product design.

  
3. Product Portfolio & Roadmap Management
  
  

* Own the end-to-end product portfolio and roadmap, balancing new capabilities, platform investments, customer commitments and technical modernization.

  

* Define product requirements, outcomes, success metrics and investment priorities across product areas.

  

* Establish a disciplined product development lifecycle, from discovery and validation through delivery, launch and continuous improvement.

  

* Drive prioritization across competing customer, market and business needs, making clear trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term platform strategy.

  

* Ensure seamless experiences and interoperability across WorkforceOS modules and the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.

  

* Define and track product KPIs, including adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, time to value, retention and revenue contribution.

  
4. Customer & Market Leadership
  
  

* Build a deep understanding of the global HCM market, including customer needs, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies and industry trends.

  

* Engage directly with CHROs, HR leaders, customers and strategic prospects to understand their challenges and validate product direction.

  

* Establish strong customer feedback and product discovery mechanisms to continuously improve product-market fit.

  

* Develop relationships with industry analysts, advisory groups and thought leaders to understand and influence the evolution of the HCM market.

  

* Partner with strategic customers to validate new capabilities, lead design partnerships and accelerate product adoption.

  

* Develop compelling product positioning and differentiation in partnership with Sales and Marketing.

  
5. Commercial & Go-to-Market Leadership
  
  

* Partner with the GM and business leadership to define product packaging, pricing, tiering and monetization strategies.

  

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to develop and execute go-to-market strategies across new customer acquisition, upsell and cross-sell.

  

* Ensure product investments are aligned with commercial opportunities, customer value and business growth objectives.

  

* Support strategic customer engagements, executive briefings and major sales opportunities.

  

* Partner with Customer Success to drive adoption, customer satisfaction, retention and expansion.

  

* Translate product capabilities into compelling value propositions and measurable business outcomes.

  
6. Product Organization & Leadership
  
  

* Build, lead and develop a world-class Product Management organization, including product leaders and individual product managers across multiple product domains.

  

* Establish clear product ownership, organizational structure, accountability and decision-making frameworks.

  

* Develop a strong product management culture grounded in customer obsession, data-driven decisions, speed, innovation and execution excellence.

  

* Set high standards for product discovery, strategy, roadmap management, product specifications and outcome measurement.

  

* Develop future product leaders and create an environment that attracts and retains exceptional talent.

  

* Foster strong partnerships with global Engineering, Design, Data Science and business teams.

  
7. Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
  
  

* Work closely with the GM of WorkforceOS to translate business strategy into product priorities, investment decisions and measurable business outcomes.

  

* Establish strong partnerships with the GMs of Cornerstone's business lines to align product strategy, identify synergies and drive opportunities for integration, collaboration and portfolio-wide innovation.

  

* Work across business lines to identify opportunities for WorkforceOS to leverage, extend and unify existing Cornerstone capabilities, while defining clear product boundaries, ownership and investment priorities.

  

* Partner closely with the VP of Engineering and engineering leadership to jointly drive product delivery, platform evolution, technical feasibility and customer outcomes.

  

* Collaborate with Cornerstone's global Product, Technology and executive leadership teams to ensure alignment between WorkforceOS and the broader company strategy.

  

* Drive effective operating cadences, portfolio reviews, roadmap governance and executive communication across relevant stakeholders.

  

* Represent WorkforceOS in executive forums, strategic customer engagements and industry events.

  
**You've got what it takes if you have:**

* 15+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience building and scaling enterprise B2B SaaS products.

  

* 8+ years of experience leading and developing Product Management teams, including senior product leaders.

  

* Proven experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for complex, multi-product enterprise software platforms.

  

* Demonstrated ability to build products from early-stage concepts through market launch and global scale.

  

* Strong understanding of enterprise HCM, HR technology, workforce management or adjacent enterprise SaaS domains.

  

* Experience building AI-enabled products and translating AI, machine learning, intelligent automation or agentic capabilities into customer value.

  

* Strong commercial acumen, with experience partnering on pricing, packaging, monetization and go-to-market strategy.

  

* Demonstrated ability to engage with senior executives, customers, industry analysts and strategic partners.

  

* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex product portfolio decisions across multiple business lines.

  

* Excellent strategic thinking, communication, influencing and organizational leadership skills.

  

* Experience leading global, distributed and cross-functional teams.

  
Leadership Attributes
  
  

* Product Visionary: Able to see where enterprise HCM and workforce technology are heading and translate that vision into differentiated products.

  

* Customer Obsessed: Deeply understands enterprise customers and consistently advocates for solving their most important problems.

  

* AI-Native Mindset: Thinks beyond incremental AI features and understands how AI can fundamentally transform enterprise workflows and experiences.

  

* Commercially Minded: Connects product decisions to revenue growth, customer adoption, retention and business outcomes.

  

* Strong Operator: Balances long-term strategy with execution discipline, prioritization and measurable results.

  

* Enterprise Influencer: Builds strong relationships across business lines, influences executive stakeholders and navigates complex portfolio-level decisions.

  

* Organizational Builder: Has the ability to attract, develop and lead exceptional product talent.

  

* Collaborative Leader: Builds strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and the broader executive organization.

  
**The Opportunity**  
  
This is a unique opportunity to build a category-defining enterprise platform and shape the future of how organizations understand, develop and activate their workforce, while helping define the next chapter of Cornerstone's broader product portfolio.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
