title: Fullstack Lead
description:
**Job Skills:** Java Microservices Angular

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** Noida/ Hyderabad

**Exp Level:** 8+ years

**Role:** 1

**1. Role Overview**
--------------------

WalkingTree is hiring a Full Stack Lead to own the design and delivery of enterprise web platforms built on Java microservices and Angular microfrontends.

You will lead a team of full-stack engineers, act as the technical voice to US-based stakeholders and customer teams, and stay hands-on in code, reviews and architecture.

The platforms you will work on are data-heavy, workflow-driven products used by operations and planning teams: real-time dashboards, rule-based decision engines, integrations with ERP and telematics systems, and event-driven backends.

Domain knowledge is picked up on the job; engineering depth and customer-facing maturity are what we hire for.

**2. Job Details**
------------------

**Attribute**

**Detail**

  

Role

Full Stack Lead (Java and Angular)

  

Reports To

Delivery Head / Engineering Head

  

Team Size

5 to 10 engineers (frontend, backend, QA)

  

Experience

9 to 14 years total, with at least 3 years leading a team

  

Location

Hyderabad (hybrid); overlap with US Eastern / Central hours required

  

Employment

Full time

**3. Key Responsibilities**
---------------------------

### **A. Technical Leadership**

* Own the architecture of Java (Spring Boot) microservices and Angular microfrontends, including service boundaries, API contracts, shell and remote composition, and shared design systems.
* Lead design reviews, code reviews and technical decision-making; set coding standards, testing strategy and definition of done.
* Stay hands-on: build critical components, prototype solutions, and unblock the team on hard problems.
* Drive non-functional quality: performance, security, observability, resilience and scalability.

### **B. Delivery and Team Management**

* Plan sprints, break down epics, estimate with the team, and commit to delivery dates you can keep.
* Mentor engineers, run hiring interviews, and grow senior developers into future leads.
* Own CI/CD, release readiness and production support practices with the DevOps team.
* Track risks, dependencies and technical debt, and raise them early.

### **C. Customer and USA Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work directly with US-based counterparts (product owners, architects, program managers) in regular working-hour overlaps, including daily or weekly calls, demos and sprint reviews.
* Work with customer team members to gather requirements, clarify integration points, walk through designs, and resolve issues together.
* Present architecture, progress and trade-offs clearly to both technical and business audiences.
* Communicate status, blockers and change requests in writing with clear, concise updates that a US stakeholder can act on without a follow-up call.

**4. Mandatory Requirements**
-----------------------------

**Candidates who do not meet the first three points below will not be shortlisted.**

1. **Direct USA counterpart exposure:** At least 3 years of working daily with US-based clients, product owners or architects, including regular calls in US time-zone overlap, demos, and written status communication. Candidates must be able to describe specific engagements.

2. **Direct customer team collaboration:** Proven experience working side by side with customer engineering, QA and business team members on requirements, integrations, UAT and production issues, not only through a project manager.

3. **Microservices and microfrontends as daily work:** Hands-on delivery of Spring Boot microservices and Angular microfrontends in production, treated as the normal way of building, not a recent experiment.

4. **Overall experience:** 9 to 14 years of total software experience, with at least 5 years in Java and 4 years in Angular (version 12 or later).

5. **Team leadership:** At least 3 years leading a team of 5 or more engineers, with ownership of design, delivery and mentoring.

6. **Communication:** Strong spoken and written English, suitable for customer-facing and executive communication.

**5. Technical Skills**
-----------------------

**Area**

**Expectations**

  

Backend

Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, REST and OpenAPI, JPA/Hibernate, async processing, Kafka or RabbitMQ

  

Microservices

Domain-driven design, API gateway, service discovery, resilience patterns (circuit breaker, retry, idempotency), saga and event-driven patterns

  

Frontend

Angular 14+, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx or similar state management, reactive forms, Angular Material or equivalent

  

Microfrontends

Module Federation or Native Federation, shell and remote apps, shared libraries and design system, independent versioning and deployment

  

Data

PostgreSQL or similar relational database, query tuning, Redis or other caching, familiarity with time-series or analytical data

  

Integration

ERP, telematics or third-party REST and event integrations, contract-first design, adapter patterns

  

DevOps

Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab or Azure DevOps), Git branching strategy, environment promotion

  

Quality

JUnit and Mockito, Jasmine/Jest, Cypress or Playwright, contract testing, SonarQube, static analysis

  

Security and Ops

OAuth2 / OIDC, JWT, role-based access, logging, metrics and tracing (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

  

Cloud

AWS, Azure or GCP fundamentals for deploying and operating containerised services

**6. Good to Have**
-------------------

* Experience with optimisation, forecasting or rule-engine-backed products, or with map and real-time dashboard UIs.
* Exposure to open-source, monorepo-based platforms and multi-team release management.
* Familiarity with Python-based services that your Java services consume.
* Cloud or Kubernetes certification; experience with GitOps.
* Prior experience as a technical interface on enterprise accounts in logistics, manufacturing or supply chain.

**7. Behavioural Competencies**
-------------------------------

* Clear communicator who can explain a design trade-off to a US product owner and a customer developer in the same week.
* Ownership mindset: raises risks early, follows through, and does not wait to be chased.
* Calm under production pressure, with a blameless, root-cause-first approach.
* Coaches rather than dictates; builds a team that can ship without the lead in every review.

**8. What Success Looks Like in the First Year**
------------------------------------------------

**Within 90 days:**

* Understands the platform, the customer landscape and the delivery rhythm.
* Is trusted as the main technical contact by the US counterparts.

**Within 6 months:**

– Microservice and microfrontend standards, CI/CD and review practices are documented and followed by the whole team.

**Within 12 months:**

* Releases are predictable.
* Customer escalations fall.
* At least one engineer has grown into a tech-lead role under you.

Position

**Senior Import & Supply Chain Executive**

Organization

**Chemie Alliance (India) Pvt. Ltd.**

Chemie Alliance (India) Pvt. Ltd. is a leading importer, marketer, and distributor of specialty industrial minerals and chemicals. Our customers include some of India’s largest industrial groups such as Tata Group, Aditya Birla Group, Kajaria Ceramics, H&R Johnson, and other leading manufacturers.

· B.Com / B.Sc. / B.A. / MBA (Supply Chain/Operations preferred)

· Diploma or certification in Import-Export Management, Logistics or Supply Chain Management will be an added advantage.

Experience

· Experience in Import House, Trading Company, Chemical/Industrial Distribution Company, Logistics Company, Freight Forwarding, Supply Chain or Customer Service.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong communication and negotiation skills.

· Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.

· Customer-focused approach.

· Good knowledge of MS Excel and ERP software.

· Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities.

· Strong coordination and follow-up skills.

· Coordinate end-to-end import shipments from overseas suppliers.

· Communicate regularly with overseas principals, suppliers, freight forwarders and shipping lines.

· Track purchase orders, production schedules, vessel movements and shipment timelines.

· Ensure timely receipt of shipping documents.

· Verify Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin, Insurance documents, Letter of Credit and other import documentation.

· Coordinate customs clearance with CHA and ensure compliance with statutory requirements.

· Resolve shipment delays and documentation issues.

· Finalize transport arrangements ensuring timely deliveries.

· Monitor freight, transportation and logistics costs.

· Identify opportunities for logistics cost optimization.

· Coordinate deliveries with customers and transporters.

Warehouse Management

· Monitor inventory levels and stock accuracy.

· Ensure proper storage practices and inventory control.

Inventory Planning

· Prepare inventory reports and ageing reports.

Customer Service

· Process customer orders from receipt to dispatch.

· Coordinate with Sales, Warehouse and Logistics teams for timely execution.

· Provide shipment status and delivery updates to customers.

· Resolve customer queries related to deliveries, documentation and order execution.

· Build strong customer relationships through proactive communication.

Cost Monitoring

· Monitor warehouse, transportation and logistics costs.

· Track operational expenses against budgets.

· Recommend process improvements and cost-saving initiatives.

· Prepare cost analysis reports for management.

Coordination

o Overseas Suppliers

o Shipping Lines

o Freight Forwarders

o Customs House Agents (CHA)

o Transporters

o Warehouse Team

o Sales Team

o Finance Department

o Customers

to ensure smooth execution of the supply chain.

Reporting

Prepare and maintain:

· Sales Reports

· Inventory Reports

· MIS Reports

· Shipment Tracking Reports

· Dispatch Reports

· Pending Order Reports

· Cost Monitoring Reports

· Transport Performance Reports

· Warehouse Performance Reports

· Maintain proper documentation and records.

· Support internal and statutory audits whenever required.

Desired Candidate Profile

· Self-driven and proactive professional.

· Strong ownership and accountability.

· Excellent planning and organizational skills.

· Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

· High attention to detail.

· Team player with leadership potential.

Candidate Preference

description:

1. Role Overview

Mr. Chows is looking for an energetic, results-driven Sales Executive to build our direct and B2B business: orders that come straight to us from housing societies, colleges, offices, hospitals, restaurants, clubs and event organisers, and that repeat every week or month.

You will start on the ground in Andheri, where our kitchen has spare capacity at lunch and dinner, visiting prospects. You will then take on the wider B2B pipeline served from our Mahim and Colaba kitchens. You will report and work with the Head Office team in Worli.

2. Key Responsibilities

Business development (B2B and B2C)

* Map Andheri West and East block by block: offices, colleges, housing societies, small hospitals and local restaurants. Then win corporate accounts in BKC, Lower Parel, Fort and nearby areas for office lunches, meeting meals and festive boxes.
* Sell directly to housing societies and residential buildings with value meals and combos at accessible prices, society tie-ups and bulk festive orders. Offer affordable meal boxes for families near hospitals and student deals at colleges.
* Run door-to-door society visits with flyers and offers, field visits, cold outreach, and presentations to office admin and HR heads. Test prices and combos, and report what works.
* Sell ready noodles, Manchurian, fried rice and sauces to restaurants, bars and canteens that want Chinese on the menu without hiring a chef.
* Support the Director on club, agency and event proposals.

Territory and key account management

* Work every prospect through five touches: personalised introduction, value follow-up, phone qualification, tasting or pilot, then quote and close. Offer tastings only where there is a real requirement and a defined commercial next step.
* Qualify before investing time: decision-maker, order frequency, volume, location, margin and payment terms.
* Issue clear quotes stating quantity, price, tax, delivery, lead time, minimum order and validity.
* Update the pipeline sheet the same day. Every prospect needs a status, last-touch date and next action, and nothing sits at ‘Sent’ without a dated follow-up. Respect the do-not-contact list and never mass-email.

Order handover and account growth

* Pass confirmed orders to operations with complete details: headcount, date, time, address, dietary needs and payment terms.
* Be present for first orders, collect payment on the agreed terms, and turn one-off orders into repeat accounts.
* Collect client feedback after delivery and use it to sharpen our sales approach and service standards.

Head Office alignment and reporting (Worli)

* Present at the weekly sales review: contacts reached, replies, meetings, tastings, quotes, wins, losses, open pipeline value and blockers.
* Prepare regular sales reports, market updates and revenue forecasts for management.
* Work with the marketing, culinary and finance teams on promotions, special menus and pricing.

3. Candidate Profile

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A Hotel Management or hospitality qualification is an advantage, not a requirement.
* Experience: 2 to 5 years of field sales in food service, catering, QSR, hotel banquets, corporate sales or FMCG HoReCa, or a similar on-ground role. Hands-on field experience is essential: you should be as comfortable going door to door one day as presenting to an office admin or HR head the next.
* Languages and skills: Strong spoken and written English and Hindi. Marathi is a strong advantage for society outreach. Good negotiation, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Mobility: Willing to make frequent field visits across Mumbai and travel to the Worli Head Office as needed. You should know Andheri and the western suburbs well. Own two-wheeler preferred.

4. Compensation and Growth

* Competitive fixed salary plus a performance incentive on revenue won and collected.
* Field travel reimbursed as per company policy.
* Room to grow within an expanding hospitality brand.

title: Telecalling Executive – Lead Qualification & Walk-in Conversion
description:
Telecalling Executive – Lead Qualification & Walk-in Conversion

Company: Awdiz Institute

Industry: Training & Placement

Department: Sales & Business Development

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: Bandra West, Mumbai

Experience: 0–3 Years

Salary: ₹2,00,000 – ₹3,00,000 Per Annum

About Awdiz Institute

Awdiz Institute is a Training & Placement Institute focused on helping graduates build successful careers in the IT industry.

With 12+ years of legacy, 8,000+ career transformations and 100+ hiring partners, we help aspiring professionals develop industry-relevant skills and explore employment opportunities in the IT sector.

We offer career-oriented courses across Full Stack Development, Data Science & Analytics, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Networking and IT Infrastructure, with a strong focus on mentor-led training, practical learning and placement support.

Job Overview

We are looking for a highly energetic, aggressive and target-oriented Telecalling Executive who is comfortable handling high-volume outbound calling and converting raw databases and digitally generated leads into qualified walk-in prospects.

The individual will be responsible for connecting with prospective students, understanding their educational backgrounds and career aspirations, generating interest in relevant IT courses and convincing them to visit our training centres at Bandra or Vashi.

The primary objective of this role is to generate maximum qualified walk-ins and ensure that confirmed candidates actually visit the centre.

This is a calling-intensive, performance-driven role that requires excellent communication, persuasion, follow-up and objection-handling skills.

Key Responsibilities

1. High-Volume Outbound Calling

* Make 200+ outbound calls every working day across raw databases and digitally generated leads.

* Maintain a minimum of 100 successful connects per day.

* Maintain 5–6 hours of productive daily talk time.

* Initiate conversations with prospective students through cold calling.

* Follow up consistently with prospects who show interest but have not yet committed to visiting the centre.

* Maintain high calling productivity and ensure effective utilisation of working hours.

2. Level 1 Lead Qualification

* Understand the prospect's highest educational qualification and graduation year.

* Identify whether the candidate belongs to an IT or Non-IT background.

* Capture relevant information such as city, work experience, current employment status and career aspirations.

* Understand the candidate's interest in entering or transitioning into the IT industry.

* Identify the candidate's preferred course or career domain.

* Evaluate the prospect's seriousness, interest level and willingness to explore IT career opportunities.

* Maintain accurate and complete lead information in the CRM.

3. Course Awareness & Interest Generation

* Introduce Awdiz Institute and its career-oriented IT courses to prospective students.

* Generate interest in relevant courses based on the candidate's educational background and career aspirations.

* Explain the benefits of mentor-led training, practical learning, industry-relevant skills and placement support.

* Create awareness about career opportunities across Full Stack Development, Data Science & Analytics, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Networking and IT Infrastructure.

* Handle basic objections related to course relevance, fees, location, duration and career opportunities.

* Build enough interest and confidence to encourage prospects to take the next step.

4. Walk-in Generation & Conversion

* Make walk-in generation the primary objective of every qualified conversation.

* Convince interested candidates to visit the nearest Awdiz Institute centre at Bandra or Vashi.

* Communicate the benefits of an in-person counselling session and detailed course discussion.

* Secure confirmed walk-in appointments with a specific date and preferred time.

* Understand the candidate's availability and address any concerns preventing them from visiting the centre.

* Coordinate with the counselling team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified walk-in prospects.

5. Walk-in Confirmation & Pre-Visit Follow-ups

* Take complete ownership of confirmed walk-in appointments.

* Conduct reminder calls and WhatsApp follow-ups before the scheduled visit.

* Reconfirm the candidate's availability, preferred time and willingness to visit.

* Share the centre location and relevant visit details wherever required.

* Follow up with candidates who do not respond to initial reminders.

* Identify potential drop-offs and proactively address concerns that may prevent the candidate from visiting.

* Coordinate with the counselling team regarding upcoming confirmed visits.

* Track confirmed walk-ins against actual centre visits.

* In case of a no-show, immediately reconnect with the candidate, understand the reason and attempt to reschedule the visit.

Important: The responsibility does not end when a candidate agrees to visit. The executive is accountable for consistent follow-ups and maximising actual walk-in attendance.

6. Lead Management & CRM Updates

* Maintain accurate call records and lead details in the assigned CRM.

* Update lead status after every interaction.

* Categorise leads into Interested, Not Interested, Follow-up Required, Not Connected and Walk-in Confirmed, as applicable.

* Record reasons for rejection and common objections.

* Maintain a structured follow-up pipeline to minimise lead leakage.

* Ensure that no qualified or interested lead is left unattended.

* Maintain proper records of confirmed, attended, rescheduled and missed walk-ins.

Daily Performance Expectations

This role comes with clearly defined daily productivity expectations.

Performance Parameter Daily Target

Outbound Dials 200+

Successful Connects 100+

Productive Talk Time 5–6 Hours

Lead Qualification Consistent daily activity

Walk-in Appointments Target-driven

Pre-Visit Follow-ups 100% of confirmed appointments

CRM Updates 100% of interactions

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on both calling productivity and actual walk-in generation.

1. Calling Productivity: Number of outbound dials and successful connects.

2. Talk Time: Ability to maintain 5–6 hours of productive daily talk time.

3. Lead Qualification: Number of relevant and properly qualified prospects.

4. Walk-in Generation: Number of confirmed appointments generated.

5. Walk-in Attendance: Number of candidates who actually visit the centre.

6. Walk-in Show-up Rate: Percentage of confirmed appointments converted into actual centre visits.

7. No-show Recovery: Ability to reconnect with missed appointments and reschedule visits.

8. CRM Discipline: Accuracy and consistency of lead updates and follow-ups.

Primary KPI: Actual qualified walk-ins generated at the Awdiz Institute centres.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication skills.

* Strong convincing, negotiation and persuasion abilities.

* Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling and cold calling.

* Ability to work extensively with raw databases.

* Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills.

* Ability to generate interest among candidates who may not initially be looking for IT courses.

* Target-oriented mindset with a strong sense of urgency.

* Ability to handle rejection without losing motivation.

* Good listening skills and ability to understand candidate requirements quickly.

* Basic understanding of CRM systems and lead management.

* Fluency in English and Hindi. Marathi will be an added advantage.

Eligibility & Experience

* Graduates and undergraduates with strong communication skills can apply.

* Freshers with excellent communication and convincing abilities are welcome.

* Candidates with 6 months to 3 years of experience in telecalling, outbound sales, education counselling, lead generation or inside sales will be preferred.

* Experience in EdTech, education sales, BPO outbound calling or admission counselling will be an added advantage.

Who Should Apply?

We are specifically looking for individuals who:

* Are confident, energetic and comfortable speaking to new people throughout the day.

* Can consistently make 200+ outbound calls every day.

* Are comfortable maintaining 5–6 hours of daily talk time.

* Have the ability to turn a cold conversation into a genuine sales opportunity.

* Can confidently convince prospective students to visit our centres.

* Understand the importance of follow-ups and appointment confirmations.

* Take ownership of ensuring that confirmed prospects actually show up.

* Thrive in a target-driven environment and are motivated by performance.

Why Join Awdiz Institute?

* Opportunity to work with a growing Training & Placement Institute.

* Exposure to the IT education and career development industry.

* Develop communication, persuasion and sales skills.

* Opportunity to grow within the Sales & Business Development team.

* Work in a performance-driven environment with measurable targets.

Important Note: This is not a customer support, reception or inbound calling role. This is a high-volume outbound telecalling and lead conversion position. The primary responsibility is to generate qualified walk-ins, follow up with confirmed prospects and maximise actual centre footfall.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONSenior Production Executive – Perfume Manufacturing

**Company:** Maniar Trade Industries Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Vasai Kaman, Mumbai  
**Department:** Production  
**Position:** Senior Production Executive  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years (Preferably in Perfume, Cosmetics or FMCG Manufacturing)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Production Executive to manage and supervise our perfume manufacturing operations.

The candidate will be responsible for production planning, daily target achievement, manpower management, production line efficiency, quality control coordination, rejection reduction and timely completion of production orders.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in handling manufacturing operations, preferably in perfume or cosmetics production, including filling, crimping, collar fitting, labelling, packing and finished goods preparation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Production Planning & Execution**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production plans according to sales orders and delivery schedules.
* Allocate production targets to different filling and packing lines.
* Ensure daily production targets are achieved on time.
* Monitor production progress and identify bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with the planning and dispatch departments to ensure timely order completion.

**2. Production Line Management**

* Supervise perfume filling, crimping, collar fitting, labelling and packaging operations.
* Manage multiple production lines and ensure optimum machine utilization.
* Ensure smooth workflow between filling, assembly and packing departments.
* Monitor line efficiency and minimize machine downtime.
* Coordinate maintenance requirements to avoid production interruptions.

**3. Manpower Management**

* Allocate workers and supervisors according to production requirements.
* Monitor worker productivity and attendance.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower.
* Maintain discipline and productivity on the shop floor.

**4. Quality & Rejection Control**

* Monitor production quality at every stage.
* Coordinate with the QC department to reduce rejection and rework.
* Identify recurring production problems and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure correct bottle, pump, cap, collar, label and packaging usage.
* Maintain acceptable rejection and wastage levels.

**5. Raw Material & Inventory Coordination**

* Coordinate with the purchase and stores departments for timely availability of raw materials and packaging materials.
* Ensure production lines do not stop due to missing components.
* Monitor material consumption and wastage.
* Report shortages, defective materials and mismatches before production starts.

**6. Reporting & ERP Management**

* Maintain daily production reports and line-wise output records.
* Track planned versus actual production.
* Maintain records of rejection, wastage, downtime and manpower productivity.
* Update production entries and material consumption in ERP (ZipERP).
* Submit daily production performance reports to management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of daily and monthly production targets.
* Production line efficiency and output per worker.
* Reduction in rejection and wastage percentage.
* Reduction in machine downtime.
* Timely completion of production orders.
* Effective manpower utilization.
* Accurate production reporting and ERP entries.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Graduate or Diploma in Production, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or relevant field.
* 4–8 years of experience in manufacturing operations.
* Experience in perfume, cosmetics, FMCG or similar assembly-line manufacturing preferred.
* Strong knowledge of production planning and shop-floor management.
* Experience managing multiple production lines.
* Good communication, leadership and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of Excel and ERP systems.
* Ability to work under production deadlines and achieve targets.

What We Expect

We need someone who can independently manage day-to-day production operations, take ownership of production targets, solve shop-floor problems and continuously improve productivity.

The candidate should be proactive, disciplined, practical and capable of managing a high-volume manufacturing environment.

**Interested candidates can share their CV along with current salary and expected salary.**

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Job Description: Principal Software Engineer – AI Platforms & Knowledge Graphs
  
  
Role: Principal Software Engineer – AI/LLM Platforms
  
  
Experience: 10–15+ years
  
  
Level: Principal Engineer / Technical Architect
  
  
Domain: Enterprise AI, Knowledge Graphs, Generative AI, Distributed Systems
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms, knowledge graph systems, and intelligent applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in distributed systems, scalable software architecture, knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and production-grade AI engineering.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural depth, and the ability to build, deploy, scale, and maintain complex AI-powered systems for enterprise customers.
  
  
The candidate should have practical experience working with multiple LLMs, understand their capabilities, limitations, and performance trade-offs, and be capable of making informed architectural decisions to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-efficient AI solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Enterprise Knowledge Graph Engineering
* Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise knowledge graph platforms.
* Build knowledge ingestion, entity extraction, relationship mapping, entity resolution, and graph enrichment pipelines.
* Design graph data models, ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic relationships.
* Develop high-performance graph querying, retrieval, and reasoning capabilities.
* Integrate knowledge graphs with enterprise data sources, applications, and AI systems.
* Implement GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, and context-aware search architectures.
* Ensure scalability, reliability, data consistency, and performance of graph-based systems.
* AI & LLM Platform Engineering
* Lead the architecture and development of production-grade AI applications leveraging Large Language Models.
* Design and implement RAG, GraphRAG, agentic AI, and intelligent workflow solutions.
* Integrate and orchestrate multiple proprietary and open-source LLMs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other emerging models.
* Evaluate LLM capabilities, reasoning quality, latency, context handling, accuracy, cost, and suitability for different use cases.
* Develop model-agnostic architectures enabling flexible model selection, routing, and fallback strategies.
* Optimize prompt engineering, context management, inference performance, token consumption, and operational costs.
* Build LLM evaluation frameworks, monitoring, guardrails, and observability capabilities.
* Address hallucinations, retrieval quality, grounding, security, and reliability challenges in enterprise AI applications.
* Scalable Systems Architecture
* Architect highly scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems supporting enterprise workloads.
* Design cloud-native, microservices-based, asynchronous, and event-driven architectures.
* Build high-throughput data pipelines and low-latency APIs.
* Drive performance engineering, horizontal scaling, caching, concurrency, and infrastructure optimization.
* Design secure, multi-tenant systems with robust isolation and enterprise-grade availability.
* Make architectural trade-offs across performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
* Production Engineering & Platform Reliability
* Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production deployment and ongoing maintenance.
* Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident management.
* Implement observability, distributed tracing, performance monitoring, and operational diagnostics.
* Drive system reliability, availability, security, and operational excellence.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed systems, graph databases, and LLM integrations.
* Continuously improve scalability, response times, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs.
* Technical Leadership
* Provide technical direction and architectural leadership across engineering teams.
* Lead complex system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technology evaluations.
* Mentor senior engineers and establish strong software engineering practices.
* Collaborate with product, AI/ML, data engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams.
* Translate complex enterprise requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Take ownership of critical architectural decisions and long-term platform evolution.
* Remain hands-on with design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and performance optimization.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Go, or equivalent backend programming languages.
* Demonstrated experience architecting, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale software platforms.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying knowledge graph or graph-based data systems.
* Strong understanding of graph databases, graph algorithms, semantic modeling, and knowledge retrieval.
* Practical experience building production AI applications using LLMs.
* Experience integrating multiple LLM providers and understanding model-specific capabilities, limitations, and engineering trade-offs.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and hybrid retrieval.
* Expertise in cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and distributed data processing.
* Strong knowledge of system design, scalability, concurrency, reliability, and performance optimization.
* Proven ability to independently drive complex engineering initiatives from design to production.

**Preferred Technical Experience**
Knowledge Graph & Data Technologies
  
  

* Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, RDF, SPARQL, Cypher
* Ontology Modeling, Entity Resolution, Graph Algorithms
* Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Graph Databases
* Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector

Generative AI & LLM Frameworks
  
  

* OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral
* LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph
* GraphRAG, Agentic RAG, Hybrid RAG
* Embedding Models, Reranking, Semantic Search
* Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool Calling
* LLM Evaluation, Observability, Guardrails

Scalable Architecture & Infrastructure
  
  

* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
* Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
* Distributed Systems, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture
* CI/CD, Monitoring, Distributed Tracing
* High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Performance Engineering

What Makes an Ideal Candidate
  
  
**We Are Particularly Interested In Engineers Who**

* Have built and operated real enterprise-scale systems, not just prototypes or proof-of-concepts.
* Have designed knowledge graph platforms and solved real-world challenges around ingestion, retrieval, graph performance, and scalability.
* Understand the nuances of different LLMs and know when and why to use a particular model.
* Have experience taking AI applications from experimentation to secure, reliable, cost-efficient production deployments.
* Can operate comfortably across AI engineering, backend systems, data architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
* Are strong hands-on engineers who can influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams.
* Demonstrate deep technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to solve ambiguous, complex engineering problems.

Success in This Role
  
  
**Success Will Be Measured By The Ability To**

* Deliver robust and scalable knowledge graph and AI platform capabilities.
* Improve platform performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Accelerate the development and production deployment of enterprise AI applications.
* Establish reusable architectural patterns and engineering standards.
* Reduce technical complexity and improve long-term platform maintainability.
* Enable engineering teams to deliver complex AI solutions with greater speed and quality.

Core Keywords: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platform Architect, Enterprise Knowledge Graph, GraphRAG, Generative AI, LLM Engineering, Multi-LLM Orchestration, Agentic AI, RAG, Distributed Systems, Scalable Architecture, Graph Databases, Cloud-Native Systems, LLMOps, AI Observability, Enterprise AI Applications, Technical Leadership.

title: Manager Technology | Python
description:

title: System Administrator
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Job Description**
Manage, secure, and optimize the organization's on-premises and cloud server infrastructure, including Nutanix AHV, Windows and Linux servers, Active Directory, Veeam backup, infrastructure monitoring, and Microsoft Azure. The role focuses on reliable day-to-day operations, backup and disaster recovery readiness, security hardening, and automation of routine tasks using PowerShell or Python in an ITIL-driven environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Administer Nutanix AHV clusters, including VM provisioning, patching, capacity planning, and cluster health.
* Manage Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) and Active Directory, including server builds, patching, GPOs, DNS/DHCP, and replication health.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux servers running RHEL, CentOS, or Ubuntu.
* Own Veeam backup and restore operations, including job configuration, restore testing, retention, and DR readiness.
* Manage Azure infrastructure, including VMs, storage, networking, backup, and cost governance, and support a small Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) footprint.
* Maintain infrastructure monitoring in PRTG, including sensors, thresholds, alerting, and dashboards.
* Automate provisioning, patching, and reporting using PowerShell or Python.
* Manage incidents, requests, changes, and problems in line with ITIL practices and agreed SLAs, and maintain runbooks and documentation.
* Participate in maintenance windows, upgrades, and the on-call rotation.
* Support security hardening and vulnerability remediation across server and cloud infrastructure.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in server and cloud infrastructure administration.
* Production experience with Nutanix AHV.
* Strong Windows Server and Active Directory administration skills.
* Working knowledge of Linux server administration.
* Hands-on experience with Veeam Backup & Replication, including restores and DR drills.
* Monitoring experience with PRTG or an equivalent tool.
* Demonstrated experience managing Azure infrastructure, including compute, storage, networking, and backup.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell or Python.
* ITIL certification and experience working in an ITIL-aligned environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) or Citrix.
* Exposure to VMware, OCI, or cloud migration projects.
* Experience with FreshService or similar ITSM platforms.
* Certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Nutanix Certified Professional (NCP), Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), or Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE).

**Educational Qualification:**
BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

title: GM - Multi Cloud Platform Lead

title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Senior Platform Architect-2
  
  
**Overview**
Infrastructure Design Services is a team of Technology Architects and Engineers responsible for the analysis and design of the infrastructure framework to fit the application, platform or system needs in-line with MasterCard's operational standards and principles.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services is engaged from the beginning of the analysis and design phase to work with the application team(s) and other critical teams within Mastercard to ensure that the completed infrastructure and application architecture aligns with MasterCard’s security, scalability and availability standards.
  
  
Infrastructure Design Services' primary deliverable is the TAD (Technical Architecture Document) which details the infrastructure design for the application, platform or system.
  
  
This job requires experience in internet fundamentals related to web servers, application servers, internet security and other internet technologies.
  
  
This job actively performs designing and delivering internet infrastructure solutions that satisfy member, product, service and backbone requirements.
  
  
Have you ever worked with Microsoft Visio to design middleware infrastructure from the ground up?
  
  
Can you interface with the user(s), application team(s), etc., and all other stakeholders in order to determine their (evolving) needs and requirements?
  
  
Can you generate the highest level of system requirements, based on the given requirements and other constraints?
  
  
Can you ensure that this set of high level requirements is consistent, complete, correct, and operationally defined?
  
  
Role
  
  

* Generating requirements, together with other architects, engineers, application team(s) and user(s), to determine that all of the high level requirements have been met.
* Generating products such as TADs, technical documents, logical flows, and models to keep the user(s), architects and the engineers constantly up to date and in agreement on the application, system or platform to be provided as it is evolving.
* Ensuring that all architectural products and products with architectural input are maintained in the most current state and never allowed to become obsolete.
* Resolve internet architectural and operational problems impacting infrastructure and product availability and performance globally.
* Research and evaluate new technology for possible deployment in MasterCard’s internet infrastructure.
* May assume lead and total accountability for ongoing regional projects as assigned; including responsibility for planning; time and cost control; resource utilization and implementation.
* Implement, manage and support internet infrastructure components while leveraging current standards and best practices.
* Perform problem diagnosis; performance tuning; capacity planning and configuration management for MasterCard internet components.
* Assure system stability and future compatibility by monitoring production execution of all relevant systems.

**All About You**

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of network, operating system principles and web middleware.
* Thorough knowledge in one or more core functions related to internet infrastructure design and/or web administration
* Advanced knowledge of load balancers and web application firewalls
* Working knowledge of Database technologies.
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies
* Must be high-energy, proactive, detail-oriented and able to function under pressure in an independent environment.
* Must have a high degree of initiative and self-motivation and demonstrate the ability to drive results.
* Strong communication skills both verbal and written and strong relationship and collaborative skills and organizational skills with the ability to work as a member of matrix based diverse and geographically distributed project team.
* Willingness and ability to learn and take on challenging opportunities is critical.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture principles and Network Micro-segmentation.
* Experience working with YAML based deployments

**Skills/Abilities**

* Displays leadership and initiative.
* Detailed oriented and customer obsessed.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize efforts.
* Ability to pick up new technologies at a quick pace and learn on-the-go
* Ability to work with team members located in multiple geographies
* Displays excellent collaborative skills with cross-functional teams.
* Provide positive customer service to internal business partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Java Technical Lead - Vice President
description:
Senior Java Developer is a position responsible for establishing, designing, and implementing scalable, high-performance application systems and services in close coordination with the Business and Technology teams. The overall objective of this role is to provide strong technical leadership, drive hands-on system analysis and architecture, and lead programming activities to expand and modernize the Onboarding Management & Coordination (OMC) technology platform.
  
  
A key function within Banking and International Clients Technology is the global client onboarding process at Citi. Our team is responsible for the enterprise platform that orchestrates mission-critical client onboarding workflows across multiple business domains, including Legal, Credit, KYC/AML, and Account Opening. We empower clients and operations teams with real-time event-driven information, interactive tools, and robust APIs to automate, streamline, and accelerate end-to-end onboarding lifecycles.
  
  
We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs
* Architect and implement robust event-driven workflows and real-time streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schemas, and fault-tolerant message processing)
* Design and implement highly concurrent, low-latency solutions utilizing advanced multithreading, concurrency patterns, and JVM performance tuning
* Write clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code following modern software engineering best practices, design patterns, and enterprise security standards
* Lead end-to-end SDLC activities from architectural design, technical specification, and implementation through to automated testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, and production deployment
* Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
* Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
* Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve high-impact technical challenges in distributed production environments, leading root-cause analyses and permanent remediation
* Provide technical leadership, establish coding standards, conduct comprehensive peer code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior developers across the team

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise
* Deep, expert-level proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), object-oriented design, collections, memory management, and multithreading/concurrency models
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade microservices using the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cloud)
* Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Kafka and Event-Driven Architecture, including topic design, consumer groups, offset management, message serialization, and event streaming patterns
* Proven experience in designing, building, securing, and versioning scalable RESTful APIs
* Strong database skills working with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) including query optimization, indexing, and transactions, as well as document stores (e.g., MongoDB)
* Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, caching strategies, and resilient design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, Outbox, Retry/Backoff)
* Hands-on experience with automated unit and integration testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers)
* Familiarity with containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift) and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines
* Exposure to Kotlin is a significant advantage
* Demonstrated technical leadership, excellent analytical and debugging skills, and strong verbal and written communication abilities

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments.
