title: Principal Enablement Experience Architect - India
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Principal Enablement Experience Architect - India****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Pune Office**
Job Description | Principal Enablement Experience Architect - India
  
  
Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University
  
  
**About Cornerstone**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
**About The Role**
Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.
  
  
As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.
  
  
This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.
  
  
The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.
  
  
This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.
  
  
**Scope And Decision Rights**

* You own: Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* You partner on: enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).

**In this role, you will…**
**Key Responsibilities**
*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30-60 days: current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* By 6 months: unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* By 9-12 months: single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* Ongoing measures: front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).

**How You Work**

* Customer obsessed: you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* Innovate and transform: you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* Proactive leadership: you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* Get it done: you ship, measure, and iterate.
* Forward looking: you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* AI native: you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* Get uncomfortable to succeed: you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

title: Director of Engineering Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
As Director of Engineering - Core Commerce Platform, you'll own the technology foundation that powers every commercial transaction across our DTC ecosystem - a portfolio of mission-critical commerce capabilities with direct, visible impact on the business.
  
  
This is a platform-first, API-first engineering leadership role at the heart of how PUMA sells online. You'll architect and deliver a composable commerce foundation built on best-in-class packaged solutions and open-source technologies, making every capability pluggable, scalable, and reusable across channels. AI-native engineering is core to how we build here: you'll embed intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and AI-driven decision-making directly into the commerce engine.
  
  
As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office-based and require regular in-person collaboration to accelerate decision-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world-class engineering capability from the ground up.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:**

* Basket & Checkout - cart management, checkout orchestration, address, tax, and shipping services.
* Payments - payment gateway integrations, payment method management, fraud signals, refunds, and reconciliation.
* Cross Channel Inventory Availability - A centralized availability layer acting as the single source of truth across all channels, governed by real-time ATP calculation and network/channel segmentation.
* Omnichannel Order Management System (OMS) - order lifecycle, inventory allocation, split fulfilment, returns and exchanges.
* Post-Order - fulfilment tracking, consumer notifications, returns portal, and post-purchase experience.
* Social & Agentic Commerce - conversational commerce, social checkout integrations, AI agents for purchase assistance and order management.

**API-First & Composable Commerce Architecture**

* Define and execute a composable, API-first commerce architecture ensuring every capability is exposed as a clean, versioned, and well-documented API consumable by any channel (web, mobile, voice, agentic).
* Own the composable commerce reference architecture for DTC: MACH-aligned (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) services that integrate seamlessly with SFCC, Fluent Commerce, and APIGEE.
* Design for pluggability that ensures payment providers, fulfilment partners, and loyalty engines can be swapped or extended with minimal coupling.
* API governance - versioning strategy, deprecation policy, and contract testing.

**Technology Vision & Product Roadmap Delivery**

* Own the technology strategy and engineering roadmap for the Core Commerce Platform, delivered in partnership with the product organisation.
* Balance investment between packaged solution capabilities (SFCC, Fluent Commerce) and custom open-source components by making principled build/configure/extend/buy decisions.

**Packaged Solutions & Open-Source Engineering**

* Lead Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) platform engineering for commerce services.
* Technical & strategic ownership of OMS configuration, customisation, and integration including order routing rules, inventory network design, SLA management.
* Drive payments engineering: integration with payment gateways (e.g. Adyen, Razorpay), tokenisation, alternative payment methods, and reconciliation.

**Scalability, Reliability & Governance**

* Own SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs for all Core Commerce Platform services by ensuring 99.99%+ availability for checkout and payments during peak commerce events.
* Lead capacity planning, load testing, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery for commerce-critical services.
* Establish security standards for PCI-DSS compliance in payments, data encryption, and consumer PII protection across commerce services.
* Drive engineering standards and governance across the organisation's codebases and third-party integrations.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 15+ years of engineering experience, with 5+ years leading platform or commerce engineering organisations with direct product delivery accountability.
* Strong experience in composable commerce architecture - microservices, event-driven systems, API-first design, and MACH principles.
* Hands-on architectural and implementation experience with Order Management Systems - ideally Fluent Commerce, or strong equivalent (Salesforce OMS, IBM Sterling, Kibo).
* Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) or equivalent platform background will be a plus.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, API management, and event-driven architectures, including API lifecycle management, integration patterns and distributed messaging platforms.
* Payments domain experience - gateway integrations, PCI-DSS compliance, 3DS2, tokenisation, alternative payment methods.
* Strong experience with Java/Spring Boot and distributed systems, including building, modernising, and scaling large-scale commerce services (Preferred experience with Order Orchestration, Inventory, Fulfilment, Returns & Exchanges and Loyalty).
* Experience with Social Commerce integrations (Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok) and/or conversational/agentic commerce implementations.
* Strong understanding of data-intensive systems, distributed data architecture and SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* Track record of managing high-availability commerce systems through peak trading events (e.g. Black Friday, sale events).
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.

**Leadership Expectations:**
At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking & Vision**

* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.

**Ownership & Accountability**

* Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.

**Innovation & Continuous Learning**

* Champion modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.

**Commercial & Consumer Mindset**

* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.

**Building PUMA's Future**

* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Senior Lead - Data Engineering
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Description**
**Responsibilities**

* Expert knowledge of .net, C#, Python, node.js based applications including handling databases such as SQL server
* Develop automated data pipelines and data stores in Snowflake. This includes designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and deploying.
* Build metadata driven solution that is reusable and highly configurable.
* Automate testing and deployment in Snowflake across Azure.
* Partner with business analysts to groom stories and implement those stories.
* Work on an agile team to quickly iterate and release solutions.
* Provide technical advice and assist end-users in solving problems.
* Continuously learn new skills and make improvement in the product.

**Qualifications**
**Experience and Skills**
  
  

* Minimum of a B.S. in Computer Science, MIS or related degree
* 12+ years of overall experince and 3+ years of related experience.
* In depth knowledge of:
* .NET, C#,
* Python, node.js
* Snowflake
* SQL
* Data Vault 2.0 or Dimensional Data Model
* Experience with:
* Data Pipelines, ELT or ETL
* Relational or Columnar databases
* Sigma reporting or Power BI or Tableau
* Agile methodologies, Scrum or Kanban
* CI/CD pipeline
* Azure cloud services
* Experience with one or more of below is desirable:
* Airflow
* Python
* DBT
* Confluence and ADO
* Familiarity with buy-side financial operations and an understanding of related concepts (Portfolio Management, Security Master, Risk, Compliance, Accounting).

  
  
**Competencies**
  
  

* Analysis: Identify and understand issues, problems and opportunities; compare data from different sources to draw conclusions.
* Communication: Clearly convey information and ideas through a variety of media to individuals or groups in a manner that engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
* Exercising Judgment and Decision Making: Use effective approaches for choosing a course of action or developing appropriate solutions; recommend or take action that is consistent with available facts, constraints and probable consequences.
* Technical and Professional Knowledge: Demonstrate a high level of technical and professional skill or knowledge; remains current with developments and trends in areas of expertise.
* Building Effective Relationships: Develop and use collaborative relationships to facilitate the accomplishment of work goals.
* Client Focus: Make internal and external clients and their needs a primary focus of actions; develop and sustain productive client relationships.

  
  
**Working with Us**

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.

* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.

**Senior Consultant - ML Engineering**
with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for consulting clients across Financial Services and other industries. The ideal candidate will combine strong backend engineering expertise in Python with deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks, large language models, and cloud-native architectures, and will collaborate closely with data science, frontend, DevOps, and client-facing consulting teams.

* Design, develop and deploy end-to-end Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLM/Agents-based solutions, including classification, regression, fraud detection, anomaly detection, forecasting and predictive modelling.

* Develop enterprise GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and agentic AI frameworks.
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices covering experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, model registries, monitoring and reproducibility.
* Build scalable Python backend services, REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Flask or Django.
* Deploy and manage AI/ML workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP, leveraging containerization, Kubernetes and cloud-native AI services.

* Train, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models where they outperform off-the-shelf solutions
* Strong understanding of ML algorithms, statistical modelling, feature engineering, model evaluation and optimization, also including model deployment, serving, monitoring, observability, and retraining in production
* Rapidly prototype and validate new ideas, then harden the successful ones into production-grade systems
* Understanding of transformer-based models, distributed or multi-GPU training, checkpointing, mixed precision, data loading, model serving and performance optimization for transformer-based models.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered applications using RAG, embeddings, vector databases and prompt engineering.
* Experience deploying scalable AI applications using containerization and cloud-native services and practical knowledge of cloud compute, storage, and GPU-enabled AI workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP.

title: PLC PROGRAMMER
description:
**Company Description**
Kesher Automation is a control panel and electrical automation solutions provider specializing in high voltage panels, low tension (LT) panels, power factor control panels, and electric control panels. The company delivers a wide range of systems including intelligent motor control panels, variable frequency drive panels, street light control panels, and machine control panels. Kesher Automation also focuses on advanced electrical automation systems such as PLC & HMI automation panels, SCADA systems, and PLC- and SCADA-based control centers. With a commitment to continuously enhancing technical expertise, the company supports diverse industrial and infrastructure applications through reliable panel manufacturing and material supplies.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site PLC Programmer role based in the Greater Ahmedabad Area. The PLC Programmer will design, develop, and program PLC and HMI logic for various control panels and automation systems, ensuring safe and efficient operation of equipment. Daily tasks include creating and modifying ladder logic and function block diagrams, configuring communication networks, integrating SCADA systems, and testing and commissioning control systems at customer sites. The role involves troubleshooting and optimizing existing automation solutions, preparing technical documentation, and collaborating with electrical design, production, and field service teams. The PLC Programmer will also support continuous improvement initiatives, adhere to industry standards, and provide technical guidance to colleagues and clients.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong PLC programming skills (e.g., Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider or similar) and experience with HMI configuration and development.
* Hands-on experience with SCADA systems, industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP), and integration with control panels.
* Knowledge of electrical control circuits, panel wiring practices, motor control (VFDs, soft starters), and industrial automation safety standards.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, P&IDs, and technical documentation, and to prepare clear project reports and test procedures.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues on-site and implement effective corrective actions.
* Relevant technical education such as a diploma or bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related field.
* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, or infrastructure automation projects; familiarity with high voltage and LT panel environments is an advantage.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work safely in field conditions and manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

description:

* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or Google ADK.

* Experience building production grade multi-agent systems (task delegation, coordination, and autonomous decision-making)

* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake)

title: Associate Web Delivery
description:
GCL: C1/C2
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn approved designs and manuscripts into fast, accessible web experiences that reach healthcare professionals and patients worldwide! Want to see your front-end craft directly accelerate how our enterprise communicates, educates, and delivers on its mission.
  
  
This hands-on role involves assembling, testing, and optimizing pages from content in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). It covers both classic authoring in AEM 6.5 and modern Edge Delivery Services (EDS) with DA.Live document-based authoring. You’ll join a high-performing digital team that partners across the business to move quickly, think differently, and ship work that meets high standards of performance, accessibility, and brand excellence.
  
  
You will collaborate with designers, content authors, developers, and QA to bring reusable components and blocks to life, ensuring pixel-perfect execution and strong Core Web Vitals. From day one, your impact will be clear: faster time-to-publish, cleaner page structures, and consistent experiences across devices and markets.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Page Assembly and Authoring: Assemble, configure, and publish pages using AEM 6.5 Sites/Touch UI and EDS with DA.Live, building with approved templates, components, blocks, and content fragments while adhering to brand and design system guidelines.
* Document-Based Authoring: Structure content in DA.Live, SharePoint, or Google Docs (tables, sections, block syntax, section metadata) to ensure reliable EDS rendering and predictable output.
* Asset Management: Manage assets via AEM DAM, including upload, tagging, rendition selection, and improving images for efficient performance and consistency.
* Front-End Implementation: Apply HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript to style and decorate blocks, enable light interactivity, and ensure responsive behavior across breakpoints and browsers.
* SEO and Metadata Management: Implement and verify metadata, SEO tags, canonical URLs, redirects, structured data, and sitemaps to improve discoverability and readiness for modern crawlers.
* Quality Assurance and Debugging: Perform functional, visual, and adaptable QA against Figma/design specs; debug rendering issues using DevTools; validate EDS concerns such as block decoration, lazy loading, LCP/CLS issues, 404s, and publish/preview discrepancies.
* Performance and Accessibility: Run and interpret Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and PageSpeed audits; remediate performance issues; verify WCAG 2.2 AA compliance through semantic markup, alt text, contrast, keyboard navigation, and appropriate ARIA usage.
* Collaboration and Process: Partner with content, editorial, and review teams to action feedback from staging reviews; log and resolve defects in JIRA; follow preview-review-publish workflows with versioning and rollback; document reusable patterns to scale standard processes.
* Continuous Improvement: Use Git/GitHub workflows to handle branches and pull requests; preview content via \*.aem.page and \*.aem.live; chip in to shared standards that shorten time-to-publish and uplift consistency across markets. How will you raise our baseline and lift Core Web Vitals in your first 90 days?

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* 3–6 years of hands-on web development / web production experience
* Strong proficiency in HTML5 (semantic markup), CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, media queries, custom properties), and JavaScript (ES6+) — DOM manipulation, event handling, fetch/async basics
* Practical experience with AEM 6.5 authoring (templates, components, pages, DAM) and/or AEM Edge Delivery Services (EDS) with DA.Live or document-based authoring (SharePoint/Google Docs)
* Understanding of the EDS block model — block structure, decoration via JS/CSS, section metadata, and the boilerplate project layout
* Comfortable with Git/GitHub basics — branches, pull requests, previewing branch content via \*.aem.page / \*.aem.live
* Proficient with Chrome DevTools for debugging layout, script, and network issues
* Solid understanding of web performance (Core Web Vitals: LCP, CLS, INP) and image optimization
* Solid understanding of virtual device testing tools such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA) and semantic procedures
* Meticulous with the ability to match designs precisely (pixel-perfect assembly)
* Good written and verbal communication; able to work with cross-functional, distributed teams

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharma, healthcare, finance) with content review workflows (e.g., MLR/PromoMats)
* Exposure to AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS) or Universal Editor
* Familiarity with Figma for design handoff and copy validation
* Basic experience with analytics tagging (Adobe Analytics / Adobe Launch / GTM) and consent management (OneTrust or similar)
* Experience with localization/translation workflows (multi-market, multi-language sites)
* Exposure to CI/CD concepts, and automated testing basics
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals and AI-crawler readiness (robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt)

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we ignite aggressive thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and high-reaching world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Join a company where digital craft meets purpose. Work with modern platforms like AEM and Edge Delivery Services alongside authorities in design, engineering, and content who bring unexpected teams together to solve complex problems at speed. Your contribution will help the enterprise operate smarter and faster, with a clear line of sight to patient impact. We value ambition and high standards, and we also value patience; you’ll have the freedom to own ideas, take balanced risks, and grow your skills through real-world challenges and supportive collaboration.

title: Software Development, Staff
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years building enterprise applications that actually run the business, not just satisfy a spec.
  
  
You are comfortable moving between C# backend work, Angular front ends, Power Apps configurations, and Python scripts without losing sight of what the business actually needs. You have built integrations that connect systems no one thought could talk to each other, and you have done it in a way that the next person can actually maintain.
  
  
You do not wait for perfect requirements. You sit with the GTM team, figure out what they are trying to accomplish, and start building something they can react to. At Synopsys, you will work on applications and AI-enabled workflows that directly affect how our go-to-market teams operate every day, and the solutions you build will matter.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Design and build business applications using C#/.NET, Angular, Power Apps, Python, and Azure that support go-to-market workflows across Synopsys
* Develop AI-enabled applications and automation using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, and Power Automate
* Build and maintain integrations across enterprise systems, APIs, business data sources, and AI solutions
* Own solutions end to end, from gathering requirements and writing technical designs through deployment, monitoring, and production support
* Modernize legacy applications by migrating them to current full-stack, cloud, automation, and AI technologies
* Partner with GTM business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions
* Write and maintain technical documentation that helps the team understand, support, and extend what you built

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve productivity across the go-to-market organization by automating manual workflows and delivering AI-enabled business applications
* Modernize business-critical applications so they are more reliable, easier to support, and aligned with current technology standards
* Turn AI prototypes and business ideas into production-ready solutions that teams actually use
* Build reusable components, integrations, and frameworks that accelerate future development across the team
* Expand the practical use of AI, Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure across GTM operations
* Contribute to Synopsys' broader AI transformation and business application strategy
* Reduce technical debt and improve long-term maintainability of the GTM application portfolio

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience
* 5+ years of hands-on enterprise application development experience
* Strong proficiency in C#/.NET and modern web technologies such as Angular, React, JavaScript, or TypeScript
* Experience building and deploying solutions using Power Apps, Power Platform, REST APIs, SQL, and Azure
* Track record of supporting applications through the full lifecycle, from development through deployment and production support
* Exposure to Generative AI, Copilot, AI agents, or intelligent automation
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, security best practices, monitoring, and modern development workflows
* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Python, Power Automate, or Dataverse is a plus

Who You Are
  
  

* You can sit in a room with a business stakeholder who has a half-formed idea and walk out with a technical plan that actually solves their problem
* You write code that other people can read, debug, and extend six months later without calling you
* You know when to build something custom and when to configure an existing platform, and you are not precious about either
* You are comfortable working across time zones and overlapping with US Pacific hours when the team needs to align
* You push back when a requirement does not make sense or when a proposed solution will create more problems than it solves
* You treat production support as part of the job, not an interruption, because you know that is where you learn what actually matters

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be part of the Strategic Missions & Technologies (SMT) organization, developing and supporting business applications, automation, and emerging AI capabilities for Synopsys' go-to-market team.
  
  
You will work closely with GTM business and technology teams across full-stack development, Power Platform, Azure, Copilot, and agentic AI to modernize business workflows and deliver practical solutions.
  
  
This onsite role is based in Bengaluru and requires regular collaboration with US-based teams, including overlap with Pacific time hours.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
**Description**
Are you excited by the challenge of launching new business initiatives for Amazon in India?
  
  
India Consumer Technology (ICT) team builds products and services that solve unique customer needs in Amazon’s fastest growing marketplace. Our engineers own the complete consumer and seller experience for Amazon India, work on a wide range of technologies (including AWS and EC2) and build and operate highly scalable, low latency mobile first products and services. We are solving Know Your Customer(KYC), last mile engineering challenges around Mobile, Product Discovery, Delivery, Payments, Logistics, Customer experience, Seller experience and more.
  
  
As a Software Engineer within Amazon India Business team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and deploying solutions to help Amazon significantly expand its selection and drive improved customer experience by enabling a new fulfillment pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a team that will be responsible for building a successful, sustainable and strategic business for Amazon, from the ground up!

* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Product Builder
description:
**Product Builder**

**Department:**
Product & Technology

**About Navigator**

Navigator is a travel-focused ad tech platform built for scale, precision and impact.

Following our recent Series A funding round, we're evolving from a digital consultancy into a data-driven advertising platform that sits at the intersection of travel intelligence and multi-channel media execution.

We ingest second-party data from leading travel companies, including OTAs, airlines and metasearch platforms. We use this data to build sophisticated audience segments and activate them across all major advertising platforms. Wherever our clients' travellers are, we have a way to reach them.

We're building towards an agentic advertising future, where AI-driven automation handles execution, supported by expert human decision-making. This is an opportunity to help shape that platform while working with leading hospitality and travel brands at the forefront of digital advertising.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Builder to join our team and help shape, design and build the next generation of advertising technology products and solutions.

Working at the intersection of product, design, engineering, data and digital advertising, you will take ownership of initiatives from initial idea and customer discovery through to design, development and production.

You will work across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and build products that make advertising smarter, more effective and more efficient. This could include developing internal tools, automating campaign workflows, building data-driven solutions, improving reporting and measurement capabilities, or creating new technology to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between identifying a problem, understanding the user, designing a solution, building a prototype and writing production-ready code.

You will be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking and making independent decisions. You will combine strong product judgement with excellent design and technical skills, using emerging technologies, including AI and agentic systems, to accelerate how we build and deliver value.

Ultimately, you will turn opportunities into working products that create measurable value for our business, our people and our clients.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Product Discovery & Ownership**

* Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through to design, development, launch and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with client-facing teams, internal stakeholders and users to identify opportunities to improve advertising products, services and workflows.
* Understand the challenges facing advertisers, publishers, agencies and internal teams, translating these into practical technology solutions.
* Challenge existing processes and assumptions, identifying where technology can simplify operations, improve efficiency or create new commercial opportunities.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, behavioural analysis, data exploration and experimentation.
* Define clear objectives and success measures for every initiative, ensuring products deliver measurable business and customer value.
* Evaluate whether a new solution needs to be built or whether existing platforms, tools and capabilities can solve the problem.
* Identify and implement improvements across the products and systems you own.

**2. Product Design & User Experience**

* Translate complex business and advertising challenges into intuitive, user-friendly digital products and experiences.
* Lead the design process, from user journeys and wireframes through to polished interfaces and interactive prototypes.
* Apply strong UX and UI principles to create products that are simple, accessible and effective.
* Prototype and test ideas early, using feedback and evidence to validate solutions before investing in full development.
* Develop consistent experiences that align with our design standards and contribute to the evolution of our design systems.
* Balance user needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints when making design decisions.

**3. Technology & Product Development**

* Design, build and launch production-ready applications, tools and technology solutions.
* Write clean, scalable and maintainable code, taking responsibility for the quality and performance of the products you deliver.
* Build solutions with security, reliability, testing, monitoring and future scalability in mind.
* Work across APIs, data integrations and third-party platforms to connect systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Explore opportunities to improve advertising operations through automation, workflow optimisation and intelligent technology.
* Understand the technical and commercial implications of third-party tools, platforms and vendors, including costs, scalability and potential dependencies.
* Take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving issues within your products and technical domain.

**4. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology**

* Identify opportunities to use AI, machine learning and agentic technologies to improve products, services and operational efficiency.
* Build and integrate AI-powered tools and workflows that solve real business and client challenges.
* Understand when to use traditional software logic, automation, APIs or AI models to deliver the most effective solution.
* Develop appropriate testing, evaluation and safeguards to ensure AI-powered solutions are reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Consider the cost, scalability and performance implications of AI technologies when designing solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to bring innovation into our products and ways of working.
* Share knowledge and help colleagues understand how AI and automation can improve the way we work.

**5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively across product, design, engineering, data, media and client teams to deliver cross-functional initiatives.
* Communicate product decisions, technical considerations, progress and potential challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships across the business, understanding different perspectives and translating them into effective solutions.
* Take ownership of decisions within your area of responsibility, knowing when to act independently and when wider input is needed.
* Support and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge and encouraging best practice across product, design and engineering.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our technology, processes, tools and ways of working.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively and encourage a culture of experimentation, innovation and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a naturally curious, commercially minded and technically strong individual who enjoys solving problems and building things.

**Product & Commercial Thinking**

* Experience taking digital products or technology initiatives from concept through to launch.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
* An understanding of digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology or data-driven digital businesses.
* The ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
* Experience using data, research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can drive business performance and efficiency.

**Design & User Experience**

* Experience designing digital products and intuitive user experiences.
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, user journeys and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.
* Familiarity with design systems and modern design tools.

**Technical & Engineering Skills**

* Strong software development experience and the ability to build and ship production-ready products.
* Experience working with modern development frameworks, APIs, databases and integrations.
* Understanding of software architecture, testing, security and scalable application development.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
* Experience connecting systems and working with complex data environments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Practical experience using AI tools, APIs, LLMs or agentic technologies to build products and automate workflows.
* Understanding of how to integrate AI capabilities into real-world products.
* An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to identify where they can create genuine business value.
* A pragmatic approach to innovation, balancing experimentation with reliability, security and commercial viability.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.
* Equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting hands-on with delivery.
* Curious, analytical and able to challenge assumptions.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and with people at different levels.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.
* Pragmatic and commercially minded, with a focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* Enjoys learning, experimenting and continuously improving.

**How We'll Measure Success**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:

* **Build products that matter:**
  Deliver solutions that address genuine customer, client and business needs.
* **Create measurable impact:**
  Improve advertising performance, operational efficiency, user experience or commercial outcomes through the products you build.
* **Own delivery end to end:**
  Take initiatives from initial problem discovery through to successful production launch.
* **Raise the quality bar:**
  Deliver well-designed, reliable and scalable products that people enjoy using.
* **Make smart decisions:**
  Use evidence, commercial awareness and technical judgement to prioritise the right problems and solutions.
* **Drive innovation:**
  Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging technologies to create competitive advantage.
* **Improve how we work:**
  Help build a more effective, collaborative and innovative product and technology culture.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how an ambitious advertising technology business builds and uses technology.

You will have the freedom to identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and take ideas from concept to reality. Rather than being restricted to one discipline, you will have the opportunity to work across product, design and engineering, building solutions that have a direct impact on our clients, our people and our business.

You'll be joining Navigator at an exciting stage of its growth, helping shape the technology, products and AI-powered capabilities that will define the future of travel advertising.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new technologies and building products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Architect
description:
**SOFTWARE ARCHITECT**
**We are looking for a Software Architect to be part of our Nestlé Nespresso Digital and Tech Team. At Nespresso, our Digital & Tech teams are at the heart of our innovation journey, a space where we continue to invest, evolve, and grow.**
**Position Snapshot:**

* Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
* Type of Contract: Permanent
* Grade: Band 2
* Type of work: Hybrid
* Work Language: Fluent Business English

**The Role:**
*As a Software Architect, you will join the engineering team powering Nespresso Digital Commerce business.*

*You will work in a direct-to-customer context with significant volumes and traffic and a very rich feature offering, being part of a large development organization with direct impact to the online business.*
*As a central part of the software engineering community, you will bring deep technical expertise and knowledge to the development team, working very close to design and product teams. You will guide and promote optimal use of process and technology to support the cost-effective delivery of business requirements within the area of expertise.*
**In This Role, You Will:**

* Work closely with the Product Owner and the Lead Designer to provide technical expertise, advising on best technology solutions, translating the business vision into technical vision.
* Estimate development effort for new projects and report progress of developments, to both technical and non-technical communities.
* Lead the design and documentation of software solutions, using commercetools as a composable commerce platform.
* Work with the development team to ensure the quality and its alignment to the Nespresso strategy.
* Recommend, set up and follow development best practices inside the software development teams and ensure their adoption.
* Contribute to the availability and evolution of the Continuous Integration solution (including quality and Security checks) in collaboration with the teams running the service.
* Assist others in resolving complex technical problems and investigating the root cause of problems and recommend smart (specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, timely) solutions.
* Responsible for ensuring that all solutions within their technology area are delivered and maintained secure and compliant with internal standards and external regulations.
* Participate in peer reviews of deliverables and carry out formal and informal reviews of technical designs, standards, documentation and/or implementations.
* Participate in the Nespresso software architecture community.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* More than 10 years of experience in the relevant area of expertise. Ideal experience of 3-5 years as a developer, 2-3 years as a software architect.
* Hand on experience working in the development of eCommerce solutions based on commercetools.
* Previous experience in code inspection, review, and code quality check.
* Experience of resolving technical issues, including those involving 3rd parties.
* Effectively communicates in English at different levels in the organization.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

* Have a deep understanding of agile methods and processes
* Have experiences working in a global environment and with virtual teams
* Ability to understand the long-term ("big picture”) and short-term perspectives of situations.
* Experience of successfully leading technical evaluations.

**We Offer You:**
We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

**The Hiring Process:**

* Your Application: Submit your application, and we'll review it carefully (make sure your CV is in English as the hiring team is international).
* Initial Screening: Relevant candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team for an initial interview.
* Hiring Manager Interview: Selected candidates will then meet with the hiring manager to discuss the role and their experience in more detail.
* Stakeholder Interview: Candidates will engage with potential team members to assess fit and collaboration.
* Leadership & HRBP Interaction: Candidates will have a discussion with our leadership team & HRBP.
* Feedback: After interviews, we provide feedback to all candidates.
* Job Offer: Successful candidates will receive a formal offer.
* First Working Day: Once the offer is accepted, we’ll welcome you on your first day!

**About Nespresso:**
The Nespresso story began with a simple but revolutionary idea: enable anyone to create the perfect cup of espresso coffee.
  
  
Since 1986, Nespresso has redefined and revolutionized the way millions of people enjoy their coffee.
  
  
We are a Company committed with the Climate change and we aim to achieve carbon neutrality as soon as possible and net-zero GHG emissions by 2050 at the latest.
  
  
In 2019 we created the digital hub in Barcelona to offer the best customer experience and innovation to B2C and B2B channels.
  
  
*We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability.*
People are at the heart of our success – all 14,000 of them. We actively cultivate diversity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace. We celebrate individuality, believing that your authenticity and uniqueness can help us to grow and thrive together
  
  
Step outside your comfort zone; share your ideas, way of thinking and working to make a difference to the world, every single day. You own a piece of the action – make it count.
  
  
**Join Nestlé #beaforceforgood**
