title: Software Engineering Technical Leader | Enterprise AI Platforms, Infrastructure & Automation
description:
**Meet the Team**
In Cisco Enterprise AI Platforms & Infrastructure (EAIPI), our vision is to architect, build, and scale world-class agentic AI platforms, foundation infrastructure, and developer ecosystems that power Cisco's next generation of intelligent products and services. We are the engineering organization behind Cisco's flagship AI initiatives, including MyAgent (Cisco's super agent) and the Circuit Enterprise AI platform.
  
  
Our high-velocity team operates at the intersection of frontier generative AI, distributed systems, GPU infrastructure, and modern software engineering. We build with a steadfast focus on engineering craftsmanship, high talent density, principled quality, and developer enablement—empowering thousands of engineers across Cisco to create, validate, and scale multimodal agentic experiences.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Software Engineering Technical Leader in Cisco EAIPI, you will serve as a multi-layered technical authority and system architect. You will design complete and complex frameworks, systems, and platforms that define specifications, interfaces, input/output pipelines, and working parameters for hardware and software compatibility. You will conceive innovative system interfaces and business application prototypes, analyze and eliminate architectural weaknesses, and directly influence the shaping of future products by establishing foundational architecture across multiple systems.
  
  
Rooted in Cisco ‘Design Thinking Principles’, you will place simplification and User Experience (UX) at the core, championing secure coding practices, user privacy, and software engineering excellence. Partnering across product management, UX design, and multi-functional engineering teams, you will author architectural specifications and technical documentation, resolve critical production bottlenecks, drive product innovation, and continuously optimize software delivery pipelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architectural Vision & Complex Problem Solving:**
Apply specialized technical mastery to solve intricate architectural problems, interpret internal and external business issues, and define industry-leading standard methodologies.
  
  
**Cross-Team Leadership & Project Governance:**
Lead multi-team engineering initiatives from inception through completion, leading workload, technical dependencies, and workstreams holistically.
  
  
**Technical Roadmap & Strategy:**
Shape, influence, and drive the multi-year software engineering roadmap, aligning technical architecture with core business and customer outcomes.
  
  
**High-Impact Feature & Framework Delivery:**
Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and delivery of major architectural frameworks, critical platform subsystems, and high-impact features.
  
  
**Gold-Standard Code Craftsmanship:**
Author clean, robust, and highly optimized code and automated test suites that set the gold standard for engineering excellence across the organization.
  
  
**Scalability, Security & Reliability by Design:**
Champion architectural principles centered on steadfast security, substantial scalability, token throughput, and high-availability runtime reliability.
  
  
**Threat Modeling & Security Architecture:**
Drive product threat modeling, identify vulnerability attack surfaces, and enforce zero-trust privacy and compliance standards across platform components.
  
  
**Observability & Proactive Risk Resolution:**
Proactively identify, prioritize, and eliminate systemic risks; design robust observability tooling to monitor telemetry, act on real-time alerts, and optimize runtime performance.
  
  
**Production Operations & SRE Governance:**
Serve as the ultimate technical escalation point for critical production outages, lead blameless postmortems, review RCAs, and govern robust on-call rotations.
  
  
**Multi-Component Domain Authority:**
Serve as a recognized authority on multiple functional components, subsystems, and developer APIs across the broader AI ecosystem.
  
  
**Product Sense, Market Awareness & Metrics:**
Articulate complex design trade-offs, integrate market and competitive dynamics into technical choices, and track product adoption and performance metrics.
  
  
**Scoping & Stakeholder Negotiation:**
Provide accurate project scoping, establish reliable landmark estimations, and negotiate technical trade-offs with multi-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**SDLC & Agile Excellence:**
Advance agile engineering practices, elevate SDLC standards, and establish modern engineering workflows across teams and partner organizations.
  
  
**Mentorship & Engineering Culture:**
Mentor and sponsor senior engineers, tech leads, and peers; develop continuous knowledge sharing through architecture brownbag sessions, technical blogs, and external publications.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM field + 8 years of related experience; OR Master’s degree + 6 years of related experience; OR Ph.D. + 3 years of related experience.
  
  
In-depth conceptual and practical expertise in software engineering, distributed systems, and platform architecture, with a confirmed history of mastering and applying a wide spectrum of modern technologies.
  
  
Mastery of hands-on software development in core languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, C++, or Rust) with demonstrated success in designing and shipping enterprise-scale, critically important systems.
  
  
Consistent track record of serving as a technical lead or systems architect for multi-functional engineering teams, authoring technical design RFCs, and establishing engineering standard methodologies across the SDLC.
  
  
Extensive experience in system profiling, distributed debugging, automated testing strategy, and leading high-severity production root cause analysis (RCA).
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Advanced expertise in Generative AI architectures, Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, LlamaIndex, vLLM, and multi-agent coordination frameworks.
  
  
Deep experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency microservices, event streaming platforms (Kafka), asynchronous state machines, and distributed caching (Redis).
  
  
Proven knowledge of GPU computing infrastructure, CUDA optimization, Triton Inference Server, high-density server architectures, and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  
  
Expertise in enterprise identity, security, and access protocols including OAuth 2.0 / RFC 8693 Token Exchange, Zero Trust architecture, and automated threat modeling.
  
  
Demonstrated experience designing enterprise observability frameworks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) with automated canary and self-healing deployment pipelines.
  
  
Active technical contributions to open-source software, published whitepapers, patents in AI/systems engineering, or prominent tech talks at world-class industry conferences.
  
  
Outstanding executive communication, negotiation, and partner management skills, capable of influencing senior engineering leadership and product direction.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**

title: Sr Software Architect - AI/ML
description:
**Job Description Summary**
GE Vernova’s Grid Software team is at the forefront of the energy transition, delivering the software solutions that power the world’s most critical power grids. We are seeking a Senior Software Architect and AI Services Expert to lead our technological evolution.
  
  
This is not a traditional architecture role. We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who will bridge the gap between high-level architectural strategy and the next generation of AI-assisted software delivery. You will define our AI-enabled Services methodology, ensuring that our teams move beyond ad-hoc experimentation to a disciplined, production-ready, and scalable development workflow. You will be instrumental in driving productivity, optimizing delivery cycles, and generating measurable value for our utility customers.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Core Mission**
You will serve as the solution owner for all AI-assisted Services implementations within the Grid Software portfolio. Your goal is to instill a culture of "AI-assisted discipline"—where AI is a force multiplier for high-quality, secure, and maintainable code, rather than a shortcut for speed at the expense of integrity. You will be required to provide hands on guidance and accelerate the AI adoption into various activities of Grid SW services across the global teams as at any point in time there will be multiple projects running in parallel which will require your intervention
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Define and Maintain Enterprise AI Architectures and Reusable Solution Patterns**

* Design, publish, and maintain enterprise AI reference architectures that provide Grid Software with proven, scalable patterns for common AI solution types (e.g., agentic workflows, RAG-based knowledge systems, time-series forecasting, computer vision).
* Develop and maintain a library of reusable AI solution patterns, components, and design templates that Embedded AI Architects can leverage to accelerate delivery and ensure consistency.
* Establish architecture standards that address data ingestion, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and lifecycle management for AI solutions across Grid Software Services.
* Ensure reference architectures are aligned with GE Vernova enterprise platforms, ARC Foundry capabilities, Digital/IT infrastructure, and approved tooling.
* Regularly review and update architectures as AI technology, enterprise platforms, and Grid Software Services use cases evolve.

**2**
.
**Create and Maintain AI Design Practices**

* Define Grid Software Services’ AI solution design practices, including design review processes, architecture decision records, and technical documentation standards.
* Establish standards for how AI solutions are scoped, designed, validated, deployed, and maintained across the Grid Software Services portfolio.
* Develop design principles that prioritize scalability, reusability and Services workflow integration from the earliest stages of solution design.
* Create and maintain AI architecture review checkpoints within the portfolio stage-gate process, ensuring technical quality is evaluated at key maturity transitions.

**3. Update Services Standard Work and Quality Management Systems with AI Advancements**

* Identify opportunities to embed AI-forward practices into existing Services standard work, design processes, and quality management system (QMS) documentation.
* Lead the integration of AI-assisted workflows into Grid Software Services standard processes, including AI-assisted updates, design review workflows, and validation procedures.
* Ensure that AI tools and capabilities introduced into Services workflows are supported by updated standard work documentation, training materials, and process guidance.
* Work with Services leaders and quality teams to define how AI-generated outputs are reviewed, validated, and incorporated into Services records and decision-making.
* Establish the technical baseline for how AI contributes to Services quality.

**4. Partner with Digital and IT on Platforms, MLOps, and Integration**
Standards
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical liaison between Grid Software Services AI programs and Digital/IT, ARC Foundry, and enterprise platform teams.
* Define MLOps and LLMOps requirements for Grid Software Services, including model training pipelines, deployment automation, performance monitoring, drift detection, and retraining governance.
* Evaluate platform options, integration approaches, and tooling choices that enable scalable, maintainable AI deployment across Grid Software Services Services environments.
* Ensure AI solutions built on enterprise platforms (AMP, AWS, Azure, GE Vernova digital infrastructure) leverage approved integration patterns and do not create technical debt or unsupported dependencies.
* Define and maintain Grid Software Services's AI toolchain standards, covering development environments, model repositories, data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, and deployment targets.

**5**
.
**Review and Guide AI Designs for Scalability and Reuse**

* Conduct architecture reviews for AI solutions being developed within subsystems and functions, evaluating alignment to enterprise standards, scalability, security, maintainability, and reuse potential.
* Identify opportunities where solutions designed for one subsystem could be abstracted and reused across multiple Grid Software Services domains, and drive that reuse proactively.
* Provide technical guidance to project AI solution teams at critical design, integration, and deployment decision points.
* Maintain visibility of the full Grid Software Services AI solution portfolio from a technical architecture perspective, identifying patterns, gaps, redundancies, and cross-subsystem dependencies.
* Ensure solutions are not built in architectural isolation, and that local technical decisions do not foreclose enterprise-scale reuse or create integration complexity.

**6. Mentor and Develop AI Architects**

* Provide consistent technical mentorship, coaching, and development support to the AI Architect community across Grid Software Services.
* Define technical competency expectations for AI practitioners and create structured development pathways aligned to those expectations.
* Facilitate regular technical forums, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions across the AI practitioner community to accelerate cross-pollination of ideas and proven approaches.
* Support AI practitioners in navigating complex technical decisions, vendor evaluations, and architecture tradeoffs within their subsystems.
* Ensure AI practitioners have access to the reference materials, tools, standards, and mentorship needed to deliver high-quality AI solutions within their domain.

**7. Serve as Owner for Complex AI Initiatives**

* Act as the senior technical authority for AI solutions that are high-risk, architecturally novel, cross-subsystem in scope, or under consideration for enterprise-scale deployment.
* Provide technical input to governance reviews, build vs. buy vs. ARC Foundry decisions, and vendor evaluations for AI platforms and tools.
* Support the AI Governance Leader in assessing the technical dimensions of model risk, data integrity, cybersecurity posture, and auditability for AI solutions under governance review.
* Evaluate the technical feasibility, scalability, and sustainability of proposed AI approaches at early stages to prevent costly architectural missteps.
* Maintain technical leadership credibility through direct engagement with complex AI Services problems across Grid Software Services.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of strong hands Software development experience, technical architecture, and working with large scale enterprise systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in services, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, or a related technical field; advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Proven expertise in machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.) and generative AI technologies (LLMs, SLMs, diffusion models, GANs).
* Significant hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying AI or machine learning solutions in complex technical environments, with demonstrated progression to enterprise-level architecture responsibilities.
* Deep technical knowledge across AI/ML domains relevant to industrial Services, including supervised learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, generative AI, agentic workflows, and physics-informed modeling.
* Experience defining technical standards, reference architectures, and design practices across a portfolio of AI solutions.
* Familiarity with MLOps platforms, cloud AI infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), model serving frameworks, and enterprise data platforms.
* Strong ability to focus on business outcomes by AI augmentation into existing processe and Strong trouble shooting skills

**Desired Characteristics**

* Ability to partner effectively with Services leaders, Digital/IT teams, platform owners, and governance stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translate architecture standards into practical guidance.
* Practical experience with AI in Services contexts, including design automation, simulation acceleration, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, or AI-assisted validation workflows.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., n8n, LangGraph, CrewAI) and experience designing multi-agent workflow architectures for Services applications.
* Experience mentoring and developing AI Services talent across distributed teams or matrixed organizations.
* Comfortable with Lean and Services standard work concepts, with the ability to apply AI architecture thinking to process improvement and waste elimination.
* Strong ownership mindset, equally comfortable driving technical strategy at the enterprise level and reviewing detailed subsystem-level design decisions.
* Technical escalations are resolved promptly, with documented architecture decisions and rationale available for future reference.
* Good communication skills and prior experience of working with globally distributed teams

**Why Join GE Vernova?**
At GE Vernova, your work has real-world consequences. You will be building tools that help utilities balance the grid, integrate renewable energy, and ensure power reliability for millions. This role offers the rare opportunity to redefine how an entire industrial Services organization delivers software, setting the global standard for AI-assisted energy innovation.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Senior Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
**Job Summary:**
You are a retrieval-oriented engineer with deep expertise in high-dimensional data, relational structures, and large-scale knowledge representation. You thrive on the challenge of bridging the gap between raw data and semantic understanding, building the backbone for next-generation AI and discovery systems. You are passionate about data topology, latent space optimization, and the performance tuning of complex query engines. You constantly strive to reduce "time-to-insight" and maximize the precision of information retrieval at scale.
  
  
The pace of our growth is incredible—if you want to tackle the foundational challenges of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), knowledge graphs, and semantic search at a global scale, join us!
  
  
**About the Team:**
Join our Video Understanding team as a Senior Software Engineer leading the charge in how we organize and retrieve the world's information. You will be the architect of the "brain" of our platform, solving the hardest problems in semantic search and graph-based reasoning at a scale few companies ever reach. This role offers a unique opportunity to define the data infrastructure strategy that powers our GenAI future.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and development of hybrid retrieval architectures combining vector similarity search with structured graph traversals.
* Architect scalable data pipelines for the ingestion, embedding, and indexing of massive, multi-modal datasets.
* Innovate and prototype advanced retrieval techniques, including multi-stage re-ranking, graph-tooling for LLMs, and dynamic metadata filtering.
* Design and implement schemas for complex knowledge graphs, ensuring high-performance relationship mapping and ontological integrity.
* Build automated data validation and drift detection systems to monitor the quality of embeddings and the health of the vector space.
* Drive technical implementation of "Memory" systems for AI agents, focusing on long-term persistence, observability, and sub-second latency.
* Champion data organization standards, ensuring that disparate data sources are unified into a coherent, searchable knowledge base.
* Collaborate with AI Research and Product teams to evaluate emerging database technologies (e.g., HNSW optimizations, GraphRAG) and integrate them into production.

**Skills and attributes:**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or backend systems with a focus on high-performance data retrieval and storage.
* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent. MS or PhD in a related field is a plus.
* Expert proficiency in Python, Java, or Go, with a strong grasp of distributed system design patterns.
* Deep understanding of Vector Databases, including indexing strategies (HNSW, IVFFlat, PQ) and distance metrics (Cosine, Euclidean, Dot Product). Experience with Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or Qdrant.
* Strong background in Graph Databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune, or ArangoDB) and query languages like Cypher or Gremlin.
* Experience with Data Modeling and organization, specifically in building semantic layers, ontologies, and taxonomies.
* Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and embedding models (OpenAI, HuggingFace, Cohere).
* Proficiency in large-scale data processing using Spark, Flink, or Kafka for real-time indexing and ETL.
* Understanding of Information Retrieval (IR) fundamentals, including BM25, TF-IDF, and reciprocal rank fusion.
* Experience with cloud-native infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

**Preferred Education & Experience:**

* B-Tech or M-Tech in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a reputed university.
* 9+ years of experience in Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles focused on production traffic, automation and API delivery.

* Debug functional application and data issues to determine root cause
* Work closely with an offshore development team
* Keep up to date on the newest technological innovations

  

Required Skills:

* Work experience as a senior web application developer
* Expertise with .NET (C#), ideally .NET 10
* Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL skills: T-SQL, stored procedures, views, query tuning and indexing, and the ability to read and refactor large legacy stored procedures

* Experience with unit, integration and automated regression tests
* Experience with code reviews
* Experience with code deployments
* Work experience in an agile environment
* Understanding of security best practices
* Understanding of application and data architecture, and experience as an architect
* Excellent process discipline and project management skills, including managing dependencies on other teams
* Experience working with business users and groups; highly customer service oriented, responsive and effective
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including technical documentation
* Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or equivalent

  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in private equity, asset management or fund finance, and familiarity with fund performance metrics (IRR, MOIC, DPI, RVPI, carrying value) and portfolio-company financial reporting
* Experience with Databricks (SQL warehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Change Data Feed)
* Experience with Azure Cosmos DB and Blob Storage
* Experience with Azure App Configuration or other feature-flag frameworks
* Experience generating Excel and PDF reports from web applications
* Familiarity with integrations to Salesforce, SharePoint etc.
* Understand discipline of software development life cycle
* A strong appreciation for the importance of usability in web applications, and solid knowledge of CSS
* Possess a solid understanding of tiered distributed systems and common design patterns used in web / enterprise applications
* Strong familiarity with source code control systems (Git preferred)

* Experience using automation testing frameworks / tools

* REST service development and methodologies

description:
About This Role

**4 to 8 years of experience**  
**Skills: Python, Javascript**

**Scope of Work**

**Position Title**

**Software Developer – Nokia NSP Service Template Development & Network Automation**

**Role Summary**

The developer will design, modify, test, and maintain service templates and workflows within the Nokia NSP SDN Controller environment. The role supports network service lifecycle management and intent-based networking use cases across transport, IP, and SDN domains, applying AI-assisted development and intelligent automation techniques where they improve service modelling, workflow quality, operational insight, and engineering efficiency.

The individual will work closely with the Product Owner, network engineering teams, architects, and operations teams to translate service requirements into automated workflows and reusable service templates.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Service Template Development**

* Design and modify Nokia NSP service templates that support consistent service configuration and lifecycle management.
* Develop reusable service models and intent templates supporting customer and network services.
* Customize existing templates to accommodate new network products, services, and operational requirements.

**NSP Integration & Automation**

* Integrate service templates and workflows with relevant Nokia NSP components.
* Support northbound and southbound interfaces within the NSP ecosystem.
* Create automation workflows for provisioning, service modification, and decommissioning activities.

**Service Modeling**

* Translate business and network requirements into service models.
* Design service abstractions supporting IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN, L2VPN, L3VPN, transport, and SDN services.

**Model Driven Management (MDM) Enablement Objective**

Modernize Nokia NSP service templates and supporting workflows to align with Model Driven Management (MDM) architectures and reduce dependency on traditional CLI-based network configuration.

**Template Modernization**

* Analyze existing Nokia NSP service templates that rely on CLI configuration logic.
* Redesign service templates to utilize model-driven interfaces and data models.
* Replace device-specific CLI commands with standardized YANG model-based service definitions wherever supported.
* Develop reusable service abstractions supporting multi-vendor deployments.

**YANG and OpenConfig Integration**

* Support integration of:
* + Native Nokia YANG models
  + OpenConfig models
  + Vendor-specific YANG extensions
* Ensure templates map service parameters directly to model-driven attributes.
* Validate model compliance and schema compatibility across network domains.

**AI-Enabled Network Automation**

* Apply AI and machine learning concepts to identify automation opportunities, analyse network and service data, and improve workflow efficiency.
* Use generative AI tools responsibly to support code development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and service-template optimisation, with appropriate human review and validation.
* Support the development of AI-assisted use cases such as configuration validation, anomaly detection, intent interpretation, predictive assurance, and operational recommendations.
* Integrate AI-enabled components through secure APIs and ensure solutions meet requirements for data quality, explainability, governance, security, and responsible AI.

**Expected Deliverables**

The developer should be able to produce:

* Nokia NSP service templates
* Workflow automation scripts
* API integration components
* AI-assisted automation prototypes and validated use cases
* Test results, model evaluation outputs, and operational guardrails
* Documentation and design specifications
  

Required Technical Skills

**Nokia Platform Knowledge**

Good understanding of:

* Nokia NSP (Network Services Platform)
* Nokia NSP service template and workflow capabilities
* Nokia SDN Controller architecture
* Nokia Network Automation concepts
* Service fulfillment and orchestration frameworks

**Software Development**

Proficiency in:

* Python
* JavaScript (where required)
* REST APIs
* JSON
* YAML
* XML

**Network Knowledge**

Good understanding would be preferred of:

* IP/MPLS
* Segment Routing (SR-MPLS/SRv6)
* EVPN
* VXLAN
* L2VPN / L3VPN
* Network service provisioning
* BGP

**AI and Machine Learning Knowledge**

Practical understanding of:

* Generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, and retrieval-augmented generation concepts
* Machine learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, forecasting, and model evaluation
* AI-assisted software development and test automation using Python-based libraries, APIs, and development tools
* Data preparation, feature quality, observability, and validation for network automation use cases
* Responsible AI principles, including security, privacy, explainability, bias awareness, human oversight, and model governance
* Integration of AI capabilities with SDN controllers, orchestration platforms, telemetry systems, and operational workflows

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with telecom automation platforms
* Experience with Nokia NSP environments
* Experience in large service provider networks
* Familiarity with NETCONF, YANG, OpenConfig, and gNMI
* Experience applying AI, machine learning, or generative AI to network operations, service assurance, or automation use cases
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks, vector databases, model APIs, MLOps practices, and production monitoring

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to work with network architects and engineers
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Requirement gathering and documentation capabilities
* Agile/Scrum experience

title: Staff Software Engineer II
description:
About Blackhawk Network:

Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.

Overview:

The Staff II Software Engineer is a senior individual contributor who provides technical leadership across a platform or domain and drives complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem framing through production outcomes. This role translates business priorities into durable architecture, a sequenced technical roadmap, and high-quality implementation. The engineer remains hands-on while setting direction, resolving consequential technical trade-offs, and influencing teams beyond their immediate group.

The role advances secure, resilient, scalable, and observable systems for Blackhawk Network’s customers and internal teams. It strengthens engineering practices through design leadership, mentoring, and clear technical communication. The Staff II engineer also evaluates emerging capabilities, including AI, with a disciplined focus on customer value, security, privacy, regulatory obligations, and responsible adoption. This is an individual-contributor role and has no direct supervisory responsibility.

Responsibilities:

**Functions**
=============

* Set technical direction for a platform or domain, connecting business outcomes to architecture, platform evolution, and a practical multi-quarter roadmap.
* Own and shape the technical backlog for the area: identify systemic risks and opportunities, prioritize foundational work, and make progress visible through measurable outcomes.
* Lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives spanning multiple teams; clarify the problem, surface dependencies and risks, align stakeholders, and guide delivery through production adoption.
* Design and review architectures for distributed, event-driven, cloud-based systems, documenting key decisions, trade-offs, migration paths, and operational considerations.
* Make sound build, buy, and partner recommendations; evaluate technologies, libraries, vendors, and AI-enabled capabilities against business value, total cost, security, privacy, and operational fit.
* Deliver and evolve secure, performant, scalable, resilient, and observable services, contributing hands-on code and ensuring sound testing, deployment, release, and rollback practices.
* Raise reliability and operational maturity through service health measures, capacity and failure-mode analysis, production readiness, incident learning, and durable corrective actions.
* Partner with Security, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Product, and other stakeholders to embed applicable payment-industry and regulatory requirements in designs and delivery plans.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption within the platform or domain: identify suitable use cases, assess data and model risks, establish appropriate controls and validation, and monitor outcomes before expanding use.
* Establish and promote engineering standards and reusable patterns across teams through design reviews, technical documentation, and communities of practice.
* Coach and mentor engineers, strengthen technical judgment across the organization, and help teams resolve difficult design and delivery challenges without taking over their ownership.
* Communicate technical strategy and material risks clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional partners; influence decisions through evidence and sound reasoning.
* Measure the customer, business, and operational impact of delivered capabilities and use feedback to refine the roadmap.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Competencies**
================

* Demonstrated ability to frame and solve complex, ambiguous technical problems that span services, teams, and business functions.
* Strong systems thinking: understands how architecture, data, security, reliability, developer experience, and operating cost interact over time.
* Makes timely, explainable decisions with incomplete information; weighs reversibility, risk, mitigation, and long-term consequences.
* Influences across organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority; builds alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities.
* Distills business and technical context into clear requirements, options, decision records, roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* Applies strong engineering judgment across design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and continuous improvement.
* Anticipates security, privacy, compliance, reliability, and scalability concerns and incorporates mitigations early in the lifecycle.
* Sets a high bar for technical quality while balancing pragmatic delivery, incremental change, and maintainability.
* Develops other engineers through coaching, constructive feedback, thoughtful reviews, and delegation of meaningful technical ownership.
* Communicates directly and clearly in writing and verbally, including when explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, and production risk.
* Adapts to shifting priorities and technology while sustaining progress on foundational work and longer-term platform health.

Qualifications:

**Required Technical Skills**
=============================

* Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed, service-oriented and event-driven systems in production.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, object-oriented design, and service/API design.
* Expertise in Java 17 or higher and Spring Boot 3.1 or higher, or comparable depth in a modern enterprise programming stack with the ability to work effectively in this stack.
* Strong understanding of transactionality, ACID properties, relational data modeling, SQL, and data integrity in distributed applications.
* Experience designing for security, privacy, availability, resilience, performance, observability, and operational supportability.
* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, incident response, and safe release practices.
* Ability to assess emerging technologies, including AI/ML-enabled systems, for suitability, risk, and responsible use in a regulated or customer-sensitive environment.

**Preferred Technical Skills**
==============================

* Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL data repositories.
* Experience using AWS Cloud Formation to define and deploy infrastructure on AWS; strong knowledge of core AWS services.
* Experience in payment systems, financial technology, or other highly regulated, high-availability environments.
* Experience with AI/ML platform architecture, AI governance, model or output validation, and production controls.
* Experience establishing platform roadmaps, architecture standards, or reusable engineering capabilities across multiple teams.

**Required Education and Experience**
=====================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field and 10+ years of software development experience, or 12+ years of equivalent practical experience.
* Substantial experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership of complex initiatives involving multiple teams, with accountability for architecture and delivery outcomes.
* Programming experience in at least one modern software development language and willingness to remain hands-on.

**Preferred Education and Experience**
======================================

* Experience delivering secure, scalable, resilient services at enterprise scale.
* Experience in an Agile or similarly iterative engineering environment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team or engineering organization.
* Experience working with product, security, compliance, risk, and operations partners on technology decisions.

**Join Us as a Senior Programmer Analyst – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The Senior Programmer Analyst performs advanced bioinformatics programming activities supporting the statistical and computational aspects of clinical research projects.

Additionally, the Senior Programmer Analyst:

* Works independently as a Lead Programmer on moderately complex studies.
* Serves as a study team member under the direction of a Lead Programmer on more complex studies.
* Provides training, guidance, and mentoring to junior team members.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Programming & Bioinformatics Activities**

* Independently create, execute, maintain, and validate programs that:
  + Transfer data across multiple data management systems or operating systems.
  + Combine data from a variety of sources and structures.
  + Generate and store summary data from multiple sources.
  + Generate reports or combine multiple databases.
  + Validate programs that generate listings, tables, and figures using SAS.

### **Study Leadership & Project Management**

* Act as the Lead Programmer on selected studies of moderate complexity.
* Collaborate directly with project team leaders and client representatives.
* Assess and develop project goals and timelines.
* Assume leadership responsibilities as a contributing member of multidisciplinary clinical trial project teams.
* Communicate proactively with cross-functional team members to ensure project success.

### **Assignment & Quality Management**

* Manage and document assignments to meet project timelines and quality expectations.
* Ensure compliance with relevant contractual obligations and project requirements.
* Perform quality control reviews of statistical programming deliverables.

### **Training & Development**

* Continuously enhance expertise in programming technologies, clinical trials, and the pharmaceutical industry.
* Train, mentor, and guide junior programmers.
* Support knowledge sharing within the team.

### **Departmental & Strategic Support**

* Support departmental initiatives and infrastructure by:
  + Representing the company at industry conferences.
  + Presenting at internal department meetings.
  + Assisting in the development of training materials.
  + Contributing to departmental documents, policies, SOPs, and working practice documents.
  + Supporting proposal and bid activities as requested.

**Education & Experience Requirements**
---------------------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

**Master's Degree** in Computer Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related field **with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience**

**OR**

**Bachelor's Degree** in Computer Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, or a related field (or an equivalent relevant academic/vocational qualification) **with a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.**

Relevant experience should demonstrate the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform advanced statistical programming, bioinformatics programming, and clinical trial support responsibilities. Years of experience should be considered alongside technical expertise, leadership capability, and overall proficiency, rather than as the sole selection criterion.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, APJC (Developer Platform) - India Market
description:
### **About Us**

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

### **Location:** **Singapore**

### **About Developer GTM**

The Developer GTM organization is a highly collaborative startup within Cloudflare, dedicated to attracting, inspiring, and growing the next generation of builders. We are redefining developer acquisition in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to create accessible and exciting pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare—whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement.

We are a diverse team of builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the most empowering and exciting place for developers to build.

### **About the Role**

As a Senior Solutions Architect for the Developer Platform, you will shape and lead the regional technical strategy for our customer and partner engagements across APJC.

In this role, you will partner closely with engineering leaders, architects, developers, security teams, and executives to define architectures, validate technical approaches, and confidently transition production workloads onto Cloudflare. Rather than focusing on a single account, you will operate across a dynamic portfolio of engagements, ensuring broad impact.

A central part of your role involves translating your field experience into reusable organizational knowledge. You will create architectural frameworks, provide technical guidance, and champion the needs of regional customers directly to our product teams. This is a senior, individual-contributor role that beautifully balances hands-on architecture, executive collaboration, and regional technical leadership. You will report directly to the Director of Developer GTM, APJC.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Shape Strategy:** Guide the technical strategy for Developer Platform customers and partners across the region.
* **Design & Translate:** Transform business, application, security, and operational requirements into secure, scalable, and highly maintainable architectures on Cloudflare.
* **Collaborate & Advise:** Partner with engineering executives and senior stakeholders to advise on application modernization, distributed systems, AI architecture, and platform strategy.
* **Facilitate Discovery:** Lead architecture discovery sessions, technical workshops, proofs of concept, design reviews, and production-readiness discussions in a supportive, consultative manner.
* **Create Frameworks:** Establish reference architectures, architectural standards, and governance patterns that empower our customers and the broader APJC field organization.
* **Stay Hands-On:** Build, review, and troubleshoot representative applications and integrations.
* **Champion the Region:** Serve as a Developer Platform technical leader through presentations, written guidance, and internal enablement.
* **Mentor & Grow:** Support and mentor fellow solutions architects and technical colleagues navigating complex customer engagements.
* **Bridge Teams:** Build effective, continuous feedback loops between customers, field teams, and product leaders, translating regional needs into actionable product and go-to-market recommendations.

### **What Success Looks Like**

By the end of your first year, you will have:

* Become a trusted technical advisor and collaborative partner to customers, partners, and internal leaders.
* Established clear, actionable technical strategies and adoption plans for priority engagements.
* Helped customers successfully validate and launch their production workloads on Cloudflare.
* Published reusable reference architectures and field guidance that elevate the entire team.
* Improved the field organization's ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare's developer and AI solutions.
* Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.
* Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.
* Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.

### **What We're Looking For**

* **Meaningful Experience:** A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. While candidates often bring 10+ years of experience, we care most about your demonstrated scope, impact, and ability to deliver results.
* **Language Skills:** Professional fluency in English and a major language spoken in India, with the ability to comfortably lead technical and executive discussions in both languages, to support clients in that region. A significant portion of your portfolio will consist of clients based in India.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** A track record of owning complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.
* **Technical Depth:** Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).
* **Hands-On Capability:** Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).
* **Ecosystem Knowledge:** A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.
* **Influential Leadership:** A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.
* **Communication:** Excellent written, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored for developer, architectural, and executive audiences.
* **Travel:** Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India (supported by flexible planning).

### **Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)**

* Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare's Developer Platform.
* Experience designing AI inference, agentic, retrieval-augmented generation, or data-intensive applications.
* Familiarity with customers, technology partners, or developer communities in India.
* A background in public speaking, technical writing, open-source contribution, or community building.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.

**Important Note:** *At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don't need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.*

### **What Makes Cloudflare Special?**

We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers-at no cost.

**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

**1.1.1.1**: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Founding Engineer - Delivery
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to run delivery like it's their own company — not manage tickets, but own outcomes. You'll sit at the center of client relationships, technical architecture, and team growth. This isn't a management role in the corporate sense — it's a build-and-own role for someone hands-on who's ready to stop being told what to build and start deciding it.

If you've been doing solid work for 5-8 years but feel like you're capped, coasting, or just executing someone else's roadmap — this is the opposite of that.

**What you will own.**

* **Client relationships**

  — run requirement calls directly, translate business needs into technical specs without a middleman
* **Architecture decisions**

  — make the calls on how things get built, not just how they get coded
* **Code quality**

  — review the team's work, set the bar
* **Team growth**

  — unblock junior developers, mentor them into stronger engineers
* **Hands-on development**

  — when bandwidth allows, build features yourself; this isn't a pure-management seat
* **Project health**

  — track delivery status, catch issues before the client does, fix them fast

**What we are looking for**

* 5-8 years of full-stack experience (MERN preferred); comfortable across the stack, not siloed
* Real client-facing experience — you've sat in requirement calls and owned the outcome, not relayed messages
* A track record of
  **building and owning**

  something end-to-end — not just maintaining what others designed
* Startup or small-team background preferred — you're used to ambiguity, not process for its own sake
* Some experience mentoring or leading other developers, even informally
* Still writes code regularly — if you haven't shipped anything hands-on in 2+ years, this isn't the fit
* Low job-hop history — we're looking for someone who wants to build something over years, not months

**What this isn't**

* Not a pure people-management role — you'll still write code
* Not a ticket-execution job — we want judgment, not just delivery against a spec
* Not a place for "20 years of experience, comfortable in my lane" — if the title matters more to you than the ownership, this probably isn't it

**Compensation**

Competitive, based on experience — with room to grow as the role and the company do.

**Location**

Chennai, in-office.

Apply at: https://hire.yalabs.tech/apply

* Stay current on advances in AI, ML, and software engineering, guiding thoughtful, value‑driven adoption within the organization

* 10+ years of experience with enterprise Java/J2EE applications
* 5+ years of React.js experience
* Proven experience in AI or LLM application development, evaluation, or operationalization
* Demonstrated experience working with RAG pipelines, tool calling, prompt regression testing, or agent orchestration frameworks
* Proven experience with modern frontend development, including React 18, streaming UI patterns, Storybook, and component driven development
* Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and messaging systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar
* Solid experience with cloud-native solutions
* Proven experience leading and mentoring engineering teams in an offshore or distributed model
* Solid understanding of full stack architectures including JavaScript, React, Redux, Node.js, and Python
* Proven solid grasp of system design, architectural decision-making, and software design patterns
* Proven exposure to Generative AI systems including GitHub Copilot, LangChain, LangGraph, and agent-based solutions
* Proven expertise in relational and NoSQL databases
* Proven solid command of CI/CD pipelines including Jenkins, Git, Maven/Gradle, and SonarQube
* Proven communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance technical depth and leadership accountability

**Job Description**
**At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything.**
Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity.

Director, Product Engineering / ICC
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is seeking a highly capable Forward Deployed Engineer, Full Stack, Lead Engineer to work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering partners to design, build, deploy, and operationalize modern digital solutions in real-world enterprise environments.
  
  
This role will serve as a hands-on technical lead embedded close to users and product teams, translating ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable, and production-ready full stack solutions. The successful candidate will bridge product strategy, solution architecture, engineering execution, deployment, adoption, and operational support across Clinical Development, R&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology capabilities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep full stack engineering expertise, strong systems thinking, customer-facing problem solving, cloud-native delivery experience, DevSecOps discipline, and the ability to rapidly prototype, harden, and scale solutions within regulated enterprise technology environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Forward Deployed Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Act as the technical lead for customer-embedded delivery efforts, owning solution discovery, design, build, deployment, and adoption from concept to production.
* Lead by influence across product managers, architects, engineers, data teams, AI teams, cybersecurity, quality, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex and evolving business needs into actionable technical designs, prototypes, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Mentor engineers on solution design, secure coding, debugging, technical decision-making, and production-readiness practices.

Full Stack Product Engineering
  
  

* Design and build modern web applications, APIs, services, workflow tools, dashboards, portals, automation components, and integration layers.
* Rapidly prototype solutions with users, validate value, iterate based on feedback, and convert prototypes into maintainable production-grade applications.
* Own implementation across front-end, back-end, API, database, identity, integration, observability, and deployment layers.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, accessible, performant, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.

Deployment, Integration & Enterprise Platforms
  
  

* Deploy and integrate solutions within complex enterprise environments, including legacy systems, cloud platforms, identity services, data platforms, and third-party applications.
* Apply cloud-native patterns, microservices, API-first design, event-driven integration, containerization, and managed services where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues, resolve integration blockers, optimize performance, and address edge cases in live business workflows.
* Capture deployment learnings and convert them into reusable engineering patterns, product improvements, accelerators, and reference architectures.

DevSecOps & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, quality gates, security scans, infrastructure automation, and release management practices.
* Establish operational KPIs covering reliability, performance, deployment frequency, incident trends, and service health.
* Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and quality teams to ensure secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Drive root cause analysis, technical debt reduction, application rationalization, and continuous platform improvement.

Stakeholder & Product Delivery
  
  

* Run discovery workshops, technical deep dives, and solution design sessions with business users, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Communicate trade-offs, risks, technical options, and delivery progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with product teams to convert field insights into backlog items, platform enhancements, roadmap inputs, and adoption strategies.
* Balance rapid delivery, business value, user adoption, security, compliance, quality, and long-term maintainability.

Compliance, Security & Quality
  
  

* Ensure applications comply with applicable enterprise security, privacy, quality, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
* Support delivery practices aligned with GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), GDPR, HIPAA, and internal J&J technology standards where applicable.
* Maintain audit-ready engineering documentation, traceability, and release evidence for regulated applications.
* Promote responsible use of data and AI-enabled capabilities within application experiences.

**Required Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's Degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering, full stack development, enterprise application delivery, solution engineering, or digital product engineering.
* 3+ years of experience as a technical lead, lead engineer, solution architect, forward deployed engineer, or senior hands-on engineering owner.
* Proven experience building and deploying production-grade full stack applications using modern front-end, back-end, API, database, and cloud technologies.
* Experience working directly with business users or customers to discover needs, design solutions, implement integrations, troubleshoot issues, and drive adoption.
* Experience with Agile delivery, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, release management, and production support practices.
* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or other regulated industries preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  
**Front-End Engineering**
**Back-End & APIs**
**Cloud & DevSecOps**
**Engineering Practices**

* React / Angular / modern JavaScript frameworks
* TypeScript / JavaScript
* HTML5 / CSS3
* Responsive design
* Accessibility and UX collaboration

* REST APIs and microservices
* API security and authentication

* Agile delivery

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating applications with analytics platforms, AI services, workflow tools, enterprise identity, API gateways, and data products.
* Experience operating in ambiguous environments where requirements evolve and rapid experimentation is required to validate business value.
* Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, software architecture, Agile, DevOps, cybersecurity, or application engineering.

Digital Product Engineering / Clinical IT / ICC Hyderabad

description:
**Job Description**
ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING
  
  
The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.
  
  
Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 3.5 to 5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE
  
  
Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js.
  
  
Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

title: Principal Engineer (MERN)
description:
**Design it, build it, and own it in production.**
Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later.
  
  
Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products
**JustInterview.ai**
(AI hiring) and
**Sparrow**
(API testing). Our systems handle sensitive patient data and real financial transactions at scale. We’re looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape how these platforms are built, write code alongside the team, and stay accountable for how they perform in production.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the architecture: System design, APIs, data models, security, scalability, observability, and cloud cost.
* Build security in: Design PHI and payment flows with compliance part of the architecture, not a retrofit.
* Drive cloud-native delivery: MERN platforms on AWS/GCP/Azure with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and secrets management.
* Make the hard calls: Monolith vs. microservices, event-driven design, integrations, build vs. buy. Decide, document, and stand behind it.
* Own reliability: Uptime, latency, and throughput as usage grows; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Set the standard: Reference architectures, reusable patterns, and practical engineering guidelines.
* Stay hands-on: Write code, run design reviews, and review PRs every week.
* Think like the client: Translate business goals and constraints into architecture that fits.
* Grow leaders: Mentor senior engineers and develop future tech leads.

**Your First 90 Days**

* Days 1–30: Learn our products, codebases, and infrastructure, and identify the biggest architectural risks and opportunities.
* Days 31–60: Lead a significant design decision from proposal to production and take a visible role in design reviews.
* Days 61–90: Introduce standards or patterns that teams adopt, and become the go-to technical authority on a core platform.

**Must Have**

* 6+ years in software engineering with clear ownership of architecture decisions
* Experience running a production system with 100,000+ users
* Proven track record of solving serious scale and performance bottlenecks
* Strong hands-on Node.js and React (MERN preferred) with TypeScript
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure

* Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, databases, and reliability

**Nice to Have**

* HIPAA/PHI, PCI-DSS, GDPR, or SOC 2 compliance experience

* High-availability, event-driven, or microservices systems
* Consultancy or product-studio experience across multiple clients
* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

**Why Techdome**

* Independent and profitable: No investor pressure. We play the long game.
* Real influence: Set engineering standards for an 80+ engineer team.
* Fast path to production: Your designs ship quickly and reach real users.
* Global team: Engineers across India, Dubai, and the US.
