title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
**About QualMinds**

At QualMinds, we design and develop world-class digital products and custom software solutions for Startups, Scale-ups, and Enterprises. Our engineering teams specialize in Frontend, Backend, Full Stack Development, QA Automation, UI/UX, DevOps, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agile Delivery. We are passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest standards of quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
8+ years (3+ years in production LLM/agentic systems, with proven multi-agent architecture experience)

**Job Summary**

We are building
**multi-agent AI systems**
for the automotive dealership ecosystem — networks of specialized, collaborating agents spanning
**customer-facing conversational experiences**
(voice and chat agents on dealership websites that handle inventory search, payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offers, test drive and service scheduling, and lead capture) and
**internal business agents**
(conversational and autonomous operation of campaign management, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — with proactive insights, recommendations, and human-approved actions).

These are not single-chatbot solutions: you will architect
**orchestrated teams of agents**
— planners, retrievers, domain specialists, action executors, and reviewer/critic agents — that coordinate, hand off, and share context to complete complex business workflows reliably. You will own these systems across the
**entire agentic development lifecycle**
: use-case scoping, multi-agent architecture and tool design, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Proven experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures**
  : supervisor/orchestrator patterns, hierarchical and peer-to-peer agent topologies, planner–executor–critic loops, agent handoffs, task decomposition and delegation, shared state/memory design, and failure isolation between agents.
* Hands-on with current agent frameworks and SDKs with strong multi-agent support:
  **LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI, or Vercel AI SDK**
  — including subagents, handoffs, and graph-based orchestration.
* Deep experience with frontier model APIs:
  **OpenAI (GPT-5.x, Realtime API), Anthropic (Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.x), Google (Gemini 3.x, Gemini Live)**
  ; familiarity with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) for per-agent cost/latency routing (e.g., small fast models for routing/critic agents, frontier models for planning).
* Expert in
  **tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  — designing and building MCP servers that expose business systems (inventory, CRM, campaigns, payments, reporting) as governed agent tools; working knowledge of
  **A2A (Agent2Agent)**
  for cross-platform agent interoperability.
* **Realtime voice AI**
  : speech-to-speech pipelines (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live, LiveKit Agents, Pipecat), STT/TTS providers (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia), barge-in/interruption handling, sub-second latency optimization, WebRTC and telephony integration — including voice agents that delegate to backend specialist agents mid-conversation.
* Production
  **RAG and context engineering**
  : vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and reranking, context window management across agent hops, shared and per-agent memory (short-term, long-term, episodic), and freshness strategies for fast-changing data (inventory, offers, pricing).
* **Agent evaluation and observability**
  : LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, or custom harnesses — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge,
  **multi-agent trajectory evals**
  (correct delegation, handoff quality, loop/runaway detection), eval-gated CI/CD; OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions with distributed tracing across agent boundaries.
* **Guardrails and AI safety**
  : prompt-injection defense, jailbreak resistance, PII redaction, content moderation, inter-agent trust boundaries, human-in-the-loop approval flows for consequential actions (payments, campaign sends, customer messaging), and compliance-aware messaging (TCPA).
* Strong
  **Python and TypeScript**
  ; modern backend (FastAPI, Node.js) and frontend (
  **React/Next.js**
  ) development, including streaming and realtime UX (SSE, WebSockets, WebRTC) and generative UI patterns.
* Cloud-native delivery:
  **GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager)**
  or equivalent on AWS/Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; durable execution for long-running agent workflows (e.g., Temporal) is a plus.
* Modern engineering workflow: GitHub (Actions, PR reviews), Jira/Linear, prompt and agent versioning, feature-flagged and eval-gated releases.
* Effective daily use of
  **AI-assisted development tools**
  (GitHub Copilot, coding agents, Claude Code, Cursor) and the judgment to review their output critically.
* PostgreSQL and modern data tooling; event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) for agent-triggered and agent-to-agent workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present AI risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* **Architect multi-agent systems end-to-end**
  : decompose business workflows into specialized agents (routing, retrieval, domain reasoning, action execution, review/critique), choose the right orchestration topology per use case, and define agent contracts, handoff protocols, and shared memory/state.
* Design and build customer-facing voice + chat agent teams covering the full public website capability surface: inventory search and comparison, finance/payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offer discovery, appointment scheduling, and lead capture/qualification — with low-latency realtime voice, streaming chat, graceful fallback, and human handoff.
* Ground all agent responses in live business data with strict accuracy guarantees — no hallucinated prices, VINs, or offers — and implement brand-safe guardrails for public surfaces (prompt injection, jailbreaks, off-topic containment, PII handling).
* Build internal multi-agent workflows that operate backend business platforms conversationally and autonomously: campaigns, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — following the
  **insight → recommendation → approved action**
  pattern with specialist agents collaborating under an orchestrator.
* Expose business capabilities as MCP tools with role-based permissions, audit logging, and approval policies scaled to action risk (read vs. draft vs. send vs. pay); enforce least-privilege tool access per agent.
* Build natural-language analytics: NL-to-SQL/semantic-layer querying, automated forecasting summaries, and scheduled executive digests.
* Own evaluation end-to-end: golden datasets per use case, offline regression suites,
  **multi-agent trajectory and delegation evals**
  , eval gates in CI/CD, A/B testing, and production quality monitoring (containment, conversion, CSAT).
* Establish LLMOps/AgentOps practices: prompt and agent versioning, per-agent model routing and semantic caching for cost control, token/latency budgets across agent chains, and observability dashboards with cross-agent distributed tracing.
* Lead root-cause analysis for agent failures (bad tool calls, wrong delegation, runaway loops, hallucinations, unsafe outputs) with durable systemic fixes and new guardrails.
* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and platform teams to translate business workflows into agent capabilities and clear delivery plans; mentor engineers on multi-agent patterns, context engineering, and evaluation discipline; report AI system health, risks, and trends to leadership with supporting data.

title: Lead SAP ABAP Development & Security Specialist [T500-30751]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**SAP ABAP Developer – GRC Specialist (Access Control)**

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced SAP ABAP Developer with knowledge of SAP GRC Access Control to join our SAP Security team. This role focuses on developing, enhancing, and troubleshooting ABAP-based solutions across GRC Access Control processes — including User Access Management (UAM), Emergency Access Management (EAM), and User Access Review (UAR) — as well as Fiori/UI5 applications and SAP authorization concepts.
* The successful candidate will serve as the go-to technical expert for diagnosing and resolving complex GRC issues at the code level, bridging the gap between functional GRC configuration and deep ABAP development.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* ABAP Development & GRC Customization
* Develop and maintain ABAP enhancements, user exits, BAdIs, and custom reports within SAP GRC Access Control.
* Build and extend GRC workflows, approval processes, and provisioning logic using ABAP and SAP Business Workflow.
* Implement custom risk rules, mitigation controls, and role management logic to meet business and audit requirements.
* Develop ABAP programs to automate access governance tasks such as bulk role assignments, periodic reviews, and audit reporting.
* Create and maintain RFCs, function modules, and BAPIs used by GRC connectors and integration scenarios.

**GRC Debugging & Incident Resolution:**

* Perform end-to-end ABAP debugging of complex GRC incidents — from authorization failures to provisioning errors and workflow breakdowns.
* Analyze and resolve issues across all GRC modules: ARM provisioning workflows, EAM firefighter sessions, and UAR campaign processing.
* Use SAP debugging tools (ABAP Debugger, ST05 SQL trace, SM50/SM66 process monitoring, SLG1 application logs, STAD) to pinpoint root causes.
* Investigate GRC connector failures, RFC destination issues, and LDAP/HR trigger integration problems.
* Support SAP Notes analysis and implement corrections or workarounds at the ABAP level when standard configuration is insufficient.

**Fiori / UI5 & OData Development:**

* Develop and enhance SAP Fiori applications and SAPUI5 solutions supporting GRC processes.
* Build and maintain OData services (SEGW / CAP) consumed by GRC Fiori apps and custom launchpad tiles.
* Troubleshoot authorization failures in Fiori launchpad, OData service errors, and backend ABAP permission issues.
* Analyze browser traces, gateway logs, and ABAP backend dumps to resolve Fiori security issues end to end.

**Authorization & Security Architecture:**

* Design and implement SAP authorization concepts for custom ABAP objects, transactions, and Fiori applications.
* Create and maintain authorization objects, checks (AUTHORITY-CHECK), and role assignments aligned with GRC ruleset definitions.
* Support security reviews of custom ABAP developments to ensure compliance with least-privilege principles.
* Collaborate with GRC functional consultants to translate business risk rules into technical authorization controls.

**Integration & Automation:**

* Develop ABAP-based integrations between GRC Access Control and SAP/non-SAP systems via RFCs, BAPIs, and REST/SOAP APIs.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
* Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
* Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
+ Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. title: Software Engineer, Big Data (829)
description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data. As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn’t just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe.

Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.

**Role Overview**

Our software product development team builds the enterprise data security ecosystem that global organisations rely on to protect their most sensitive data. In this role, you will contribute to research, feature design, and implementation in a fast-paced Agile environment, helping deliver data platform and cloud capabilities from concept to release.

You will learn the technologies behind modern data security while working alongside talented engineers on end-to-end product delivery. This position is ideal for technically strong individuals who enjoy building technology and collaborating across teams. Your work will directly shape how customers secure data across hybrid-cloud, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and maintain new and existing products and features that strengthen Protegrity’s enterprise data security platform.

* Deliver well-engineered, production-quality software by independently applying the team’s development standards, design patterns, frameworks, and tools.

* Participate in Agile practices as both an individual contributor and a team player.

* Grow expertise in data security and the product’s technical environment, including operating systems, cloud technologies, container orchestration, and native programming languages.

* Review the work of peers and junior engineers to raise code quality while contributing independently.

* Collaborate within and across teams to resolve technical requirements and product module dependencies, communicating clearly.

**What You’ll Need**

* 3–7 years of hands-on software engineering experience, preferably in data platforms, cloud platforms, distributed systems, or data security. A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Knowledge of one or more modern, scalable cloud data platforms, such as Databricks, Amazon EMR, Cloudera Data Platform, or Microsoft Fabric.

* Knowledge of one or more large-scale data processing technologies, query engines, and table or storage formats, such as Apache Spark, Hive, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Parquet.

* Strong programming experience in Java or Python, with the ability to design, build, debug, and profile production-quality large-scale data and cloud software, and experience with Linux and shell scripting.

* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools for code analysis, debugging, test generation, documentation, and design exploration while ensuring secure, reliable, production-quality outcomes.

* Hands-on experience with one or more cloud platforms, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, and an understanding of containerised platforms such as Kubernetes.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical content clearly through documentation and presentations and to collaborate effectively with teammates.

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of setting up and operating distributed data clusters in the cloud, such as Spark on Kubernetes or Hadoop/CDP, including networking and IAM concepts.

* Knowledge of performance tuning of large-scale data workloads.

* Understanding of software security requirements and standards, such as NIST, OWASP, and PCI DSS, and knowledge of cryptography and cryptographic algorithms.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code quality tools, and release processes, within Agile development and the software development life cycle (SDLC).

Should you accept this position, you will be required to consent to and successfully complete a background investigation. This may include, subject to local laws, verification of extended education and additional criminal and civil checks.

We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits with generous vacation and holiday time off. All employees are also provided access to ongoing learning & development.

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

title: Software Engineer ( PHP, Node.js & React )
description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.
  
  
If you’re one of the best and brightest, a highly motivated innovator, a fast worker, and a fierce competitor, you might be just the person we’re looking for! Entrata’s Development department is seeking a Software Engineer – PHP, Node.js, and React (P3) based in India. You will work closely with senior engineers and the engineering manager, designing database schemas and scalable application architecture using PHP, Node.js, Express.js, React, and Postgres. You will also independently own projects and see them through from design to production, providing technical guidance to other engineers.
  
  
**Responsibilities will include:**

* Write well-designed, testable, efficient code for PHP and Node.js back-end services and React front-end applications.
* Solve technical problems by working closely with Development Managers, UX, Product Managers, and offshore teams.
* Design high-performance database schemas and application architecture for their products.
* Empower offshore teams to rapidly deliver stable, high-performing, and reliable code. This requires frequent interaction with them by teleconference.
* Review and improve code for quality and design, getting involved in complicated or sensitive code.
* Maintain and optimize Postgres queries, indexes, and aggregation pipelines.
* Own feature delivery across all phases of the development life cycle, including back-end services using PHP, Node.js, and Express.js and front-end interfaces using React.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on implementation, debugging, and code quality.
* Participate in and advocate for Agile and Scrum activities.
* Prepare and produce releases of software components.
* Handle high-traffic website operations, be proactive with maintenance, and exhibit problem-solving skills to ensure optimal working and performance of the websites.
* Build interfaces and improve existing functionality and application logic.
* Understand standard systems development life-cycle processes and apply Agile methodology effectively on client and internal engagements.
* Apply knowledge of industry trends and developments to improve service to the client and internal projects.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of software development experience, including hands-on experience building production applications using PHP, Node.js, Express.js, React, and Postgres.
* Experience working with web-based applications and designing and integrating RESTful APIs.
* Strong proficiency in PHP and JavaScript, including object-oriented programming and design patterns in PHP, asynchronous programming in Node.js, and React components, hooks, and state management.
* Strong Postgres knowledge, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own features from design through production, make technical design decisions, and review code.
* Experience writing automated tests for PHP and Node.js back-end services and React front-end components.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Ambitious, dedicated, and a little eccentric.
* Team-oriented, with a willingness to standardize code and architecture and mentor other engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience working with offshore teams.
* Experience with TypeScript and SQL databases.
* Experience with transitioning from an older monolith to modern microservices.

**AI & Operational Fluency:**

* AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables.
* Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop" by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations.
* Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models.
* Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**#DFO&I2027**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant, Managed Services o r equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Integrate and learn from talented colleagues who specialize in core domains.
* Adopt a growth mindset and invest in expanding your understanding of Deloitte’s integrated solutions and marketplace offerings.
* Develop skills within a portfolio representing the unification of diverse, globally recognized brands and businesses—an exciting opportunity for career advancement.
* Leverage opportunities for career development through exposure to unified, enterprise-level platforms and solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architects, developers, QA, and business stakeholders—to deliver holistic solutions.
* Engage in requirement gathering, solution design, and technical decision-making aligned with client business goal
* Support post-deployment activities, including maintenance, enhancements, and client communication.
* Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement through adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.
* Conduct testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality and resolve issues.
* Deliver high-quality work, ensuring timely completion of tasks and adherence to requirement.
* Demonstrate openness and initiative in learning Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, recognizing their importance for innovation and market competitiveness.
* Strong focus on data-driven decision-making and use of agile methodologies.
* Take ownership of deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or innovation.
* Uphold Deloitte’s values of integrity, client focus, and making an impact that matters.

**The team:**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Understand functional requirements translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designs using standard patterns. Should also be able to communicate this effectively to the team.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Analyse and identify gaps in functional/business requirements and should be able to effectively communicate this to both Business and Functional analysts
* Experience in configuring core Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud)
* Familiarity with declarative tools (Process Builder, Flows, Validation Rules, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modelling, governance, and security within Salesforce
* Should be able to assess the impact on technical designs caused by changes in functional requirements
* Should be able to perform independent code reviews and execute unit tests on modules developed
* Experience in Salesforce.com Development environments (VS Code)
* Knowledgeable in Apex, Visual force, Lightning Components, Lightning Web Components, SFDX
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external AI APIs and managing custom AI deployments within CRM processes
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Einstein features, AI-driven insights, and bot configuration
* Hands-on experience leveraging Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to drive automation.
* Ability to configure and optimize workflows that integrate Agentforce automation with human agent processes.
* Certifications
* Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) certification (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce.com Platform Developer certifications
* Salesforce.com Domain Certifications

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

* Proactivity & Drive: Highly proactive, self-motivated, and eager to learn.

* A family atmosphere , people-centric culture, where your emotional and physical well-being matters.

* A competitive salary , medical insurance for family , retirement benefits Healthy work – life balance

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.

  

About SailPoint:
  
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.

  

About the Role:
  
As a Senior Software Engineer focused on Technical Partner Integrations, you will spearhead technical exploration, rapid prototyping, and proof-of-concept (POC) integrations with strategic technology partners such as AWS, Google, Snowflake, Anthropic, and OpenAI. In this role, you will bridge product strategy and engineering execution by rapidly building, testing, and validating integrations to determine what should be productized into core SailPoint solutions.

You will explore modern agentic workflows and AI-driven platforms, designing flexible integration templates and ensuring all prototypes adhere to SailPoint's engineering architecture and AWS platform standards. When a POC demonstrates high customer value, you will lead the technical transition to core product engineering teams for full-scale development and GA launch.

About the Team:
  
You will join the Product Acceleration Team, working closely with Product Management and technical partner leads while maintaining strong alignment with SailPoint's India engineering organization. Our team is fast-paced, collaborative, and innovation-focused, operating at the intersection of emerging AI technology, ecosystem partnerships, and enterprise identity security. You will work closely with a US based team, so therefore need to be available to work 4-5 overlapping US hours each working day.

  

Roadmap for Success:

30 Days

* Complete SailPoint onboarding and familiarize yourself with our core architecture, AWS platform stack, and development workflows.

* Gain a deep understanding of SailPoint's agentic identity security capabilities, integration framework, and current partner roadmap.

* Establish relationships with Product Management, Technology Partnership leaders, and core engineering counterparts in Pune.

60 Days

* Build, deploy, and evaluate your first partner integration POC in a sandbox environment.

* Establish standard templates, documentation, and evaluation criteria for validating partner technical feasibility and product viability.

* Actively engage in technical discovery discussions with strategic technology partners.

90 Days

* Deliver end-to-end prototypes for 2-3 priority partner integrations (such as cloud data or AI platform partners).

* Establish a streamlined handoff process to package successful POCs, architecture diagrams, and code artifacts for core engineering teams.

* Present technical findings and product recommendations to product and engineering leadership.

6 Months

* Lead technical architecture and development for complex, multi-party integrations involving agentic AI and non-human identity frameworks.

* Serve as the primary technical authority for partner integration feasibility across high-priority partner ecosystems.

* Successfully transition at least one major integration prototype into core product engineering for formal productization.

1 Year

* Define the long-term technical blueprint and framework for rapid partner integration prototyping at SailPoint.

* Expand SailPoint's ecosystem reach by continuously identifying, testing, and onboarding next-generation technology integrations.

Mentor team members and drive best practices for partner engineering, API design, and integration testing across the organization.  

  

Requirements:

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and deploying scalable distributed systems and RESTful APIs.

* Demonstrated hands-on experience building third-party SaaS, cloud, or developer platform integrations.

* Strong proficiency in modern programming languages such as Java, Python, or Go.

* Solid experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, microservices architecture, and modern DevOps/CI/CD pipelines.

* Familiarity with agentic workflows, AI/LLM integration patterns, and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Google Cloud Platform, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs).

* Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to translate partner technical capabilities into product requirements.

* Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-paced prototyping environment.

Be open to working 4-5 overlapping US hours each working day  

  

AI-assisted engineering:

Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: Front End Developer
description:
**About Utsav Fashion & The Role**

Utsav Fashion is a leading global online retailer of Indian ethnic wear, serving customers worldwide. Our storefront runs on Magento 2 with a custom in-house theme and modular architecture.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Frontend Developer to own, enhance, and maintain our customer-facing storefront across mobile, tablet, and desktop. From day one, you will work directly on live production tickets—resolving UI/UX issues, optimizing Core Web Vitals, and shipping customer-facing features across product listings, product detail pages, cart, checkout, wishlist, navigation, and user accounts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Responsive UI Development:** Build, refine, and troubleshoot responsive interfaces using HTML5, CSS3/LESS, and JavaScript across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
* **Theme & Component Implementation:** Develop and update theme templates (phtml/HTML), LESS stylesheets, and RequireJS/jQuery modules.
* **E-commerce Storefront Features:** Enhance styling and interactive behavior across category pages, product pages, cart, and checkout—including AJAX-driven filtering, swatches, and carousels.
* **Code Quality & Reusability:** Write clean, maintainable code by reusing shared JavaScript utilities and adhering strictly to established naming and breakpoint conventions.
* **Performance Optimization:** Maintain fast load times by optimizing images, preventing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and visual flicker, and keeping critical CSS aligned with layout updates.
* **Cross-Browser & Device Testing:** Thoroughly QA changes across real mobile/desktop devices and browsers (including iOS Safari quirks) for both guest and logged-in user journeys.
* **Version Control & Collaboration:** Manage code using Git branches and ticket-referenced commits; collaborate with backend engineers to implement minor PHP/phtml updates when required.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 6 months to 3 years of hands-on front-end web development experience.
* **Location & Work Mode:** Must be based in Delhi NCR (or willing to relocate immediately) and ready for full-time Work From Office (WFO).
* **Core Web Technologies:** Strong command of semantic HTML5 (with basic web accessibility standards) and modern CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, media queries, responsive architecture). Experience with CSS preprocessors (LESS or SASS) is preferred.
* **JavaScript & Libraries:** Solid proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), DOM manipulation, event handling, AJAX/Fetch, and JSON, along with working knowledge of jQuery.
* **Debugging & DevTools:** Proficient with browser developer tools to inspect layouts, debug scripts, and analyze network requests.
* **Git Workflow:** Comfortable with Git branching, merging, pull requests, diff reviews, and resolving merge conflicts.
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Ability to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate coding and debugging while critically reviewing and taking full ownership of output quality.

**Good-to-Have (Preferred) Skills**

* **PHP:** Working knowledge of PHP (reading and making minor edits to templates and classes) — candidates with PHP exposure will be given strong preference.
* **Magento 2:** Familiarity with Magento 2 themes, layout XML, .phtml templates, LESS, RequireJS, and UI components.
* **Web Performance:** Practical understanding of Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, modern image formats (WebP), and minimizing render-blocking assets.
* **E-commerce Domain:** Prior exposure to e-commerce user flows (catalog browsing, cart, and checkout) and cross-browser testing (especially iOS Safari).

**What We Look For**

* **Pixel-Level Attention to Detail:** Pride in crafting smooth, bug-free user interfaces across every screen size.
* **Codebase Adaptability:** Eagerness to navigate a large, established codebase and follow team conventions rather than reinventing the wheel.
* **Proactive Communication:** Clarity in updates and the habit of asking questions early when requirements are ambiguous.
* **End-to-End Ownership:** Accountability for your tasks from ticket pickup through cross-device QA to production release.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.  
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

  
About the team  
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.

**About the UNIT/ Unit Overview**

AIRE (AI-native Requirements Engineering) is a new BMW Group tool for managing vehicle requirements, the descriptions of what a car and its software must do. It keeps the full history of every requirement, shows how requirements are linked to each other and to tests, and shows what is affected when something changes. It helps teams meet automotive standards such as Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262. AIRE is built for AI agents first and a user interface later, and the team uses AI agents to help build it. In this role you build the core storage of AIRE, which keeps every version of every requirement and lets teams look back in time, branch and merge.

  

**Location**

Pune / Bangalore

  

**Experience**

  
  

**Number of openings**

1

  

**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

* Implement and evolve the bitemporal, append-only core model, including revision checksums, time-travel queries and baselines.

* Implement semantic branching and record-level three-way merge with clear conflict semantics.

* Expose core capabilities as typed, idempotent and auditable domain actions together with the Senior Agent & Domain Action Engineer.

* Write specifications, property-based tests and invariants that guide agent-generated code, and act as the accountable human reviewer for bitemporal logic.

* Meet the quality goals for consistency, latency and data volume, and provide measurements for the Go/No-Go evidence.

* Contribute to architecture decisions and keep technical documentation current.

* Ensure security, performance and code quality from the first commit, with automated tests and quality gates for all human and agent work.

  

**What should you bring along**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of six years of backend engineering experience with relational databases in production.

* Demonstrated experience with complex, consistency-critical data models.

  

**Must have technical skill**

* Strong backend engineering experience in Python (for example FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy) building production services.

* Deep PostgreSQL expertise: schema design, indexing, partitioning, query tuning, transaction isolation and concurrency control.

* Experience implementing temporal or versioned data models, for example bitemporal tables, append-only histories, event sourcing or slowly changing dimensions.

* Experience with optimistic concurrency, idempotent writes, integrity checksums and consistent snapshots.

* Strong testing discipline, including unit, integration and property-based testing of complex data logic.

* Proficient AI-native engineering practice: working from specifications with coding agents, constraining them with tests and architecture rules, and rigorously reviewing generated code.

* Experience with API design and typed contracts (for example OpenAPI and JSON Schema).

  

**Good to have technical skills**

* Experience implementing branching and three-way merge for structured data.

* Knowledge of requirements management tools and of Automotive SPICE or ISO 26262 traceability needs.

* Experience with performance testing (for example k6) and observability (OpenTelemetry).

* Experience with Azure Database for PostgreSQL and container-based deployment.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - GenAI Platforms
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description**

We are Citi’s Core AI Platform Group, a start-up with the exciting mission of shaping the direction of travel for the entire bank under the Chief Operating Office. We define the AI and engineering strategy for the bank. We are a team of talented engineers, product managers, and SMEs, taking ambiguous concepts and making them real by engineering cutting-edge products at planetary scale.

We are solely focused on the most modern technology and engineering disciplines: generative AI, cloud-native architectures, security, modern app stacks, open-source, and the latest and greatest in the Kubernetes ecosystem.

Generative AI is a rapidly evolving space. As a Senior Golang Engineer, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for this domain. We ask that you share with us examples of projects that you have architected and scaled. Ideally, these examples should showcase clever distributed architectures, systematic evaluation of LLM behaviors at scale, and your ability to drive technical consensus across large organizations.

9+ Years of Hands-on experience is a must have.

Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.

  
  

**You might be a good fit if you:**

* Bring distinguished, deep-dive software engineering expertise and a track record of architectural leadership.
* Thrive in a results-driven environment, where flexibility fuels impact and your technical decisions shape the enterprise.
* Are a game-changer and thought leader, ready to step beyond your designated role to influence the broader engineering culture.
* Love the synergy of pair programming and hands-on coding—you lead from the front and stay close to the codebase.
* Seize the opportunity to architect machine learning and GenAI applications at an unprecedented global scale.
* Possess a relentless passion to push the boundaries of machine learning and generative AI, bringing your knowledge to shape Citi’s future.
  

  

**What you’ll do within the team:**

* **Engineering at scale:** You will build scaled, robust services and platforms centred around generative AI. This may also include developing CLIs, SDKs, runtimes and more.
* **Thought Leadership:** Drive architectural vision and lead the 0-1 build of foundational, enterprise-grade AI platforms and products.

* **Cross-Org Influence:** You must be able to drive technical alignment across multiple engineering organizations, breaking down silos to deliver cohesive AI capabilities.
