title: Middleware Developer (C&C++) — ADAS
description:
**Position Name:** Middleware Developer (C&C++) — ADAS

**Years of Experience:** 3- 7 years

**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka

#### 

#### **About Vayavya Labs**

Vayavya Labs builds embedded software and firmware for the semiconductor and automotive industries, with deep expertise in low-level device software, driver automation, and safety-critical systems. Our engineers work close to the metal — bringing up silicon, writing production firmware, and validating it to the standards demanded by modern and autonomous vehicles. We are expanding our middleware and platform-software capability to support the next generation of software-defined vehicles, where robust, well-architected middleware is what connects hardware to the applications that run on it.

#### 

#### **About the Role**

We are looking for a C/C++ Middleware Developer to design, implement, and maintain the middleware layer of a vehicle compute platform built for ADAS and autonomous driving. This is the layer where inter-process communication frameworks, service daemons, hardware abstraction interfaces, and system services come together to carry sensor data and control signals between low-level drivers and the autonomy software that depends on them. You will work within and contribute to the team’s in-house C++ middleware frameworks — not building from scratch in isolation, but extending, hardening, and optimizing a shared codebase that other engineers build on.

The role combines strong C++ systems programming with an understanding of how embedded software stacks are organized — from device drivers through middleware services to application interfaces. You will collaborate closely with firmware engineers, driver developers, perception and planning teams, and will be expected to write production-quality, testable, well-documented code that runs in resource-constrained, safety-adjacent environments. You should be comfortable working in a large, shared C++ codebase with established patterns, contributing clean code that other engineers review, extend, and rely on.

#### 

#### **What You’ll Do**

* Design and implement middleware components in C++ (C++14/17) that provide well-defined interfaces between platform services, device drivers, and application software.
* Develop and maintain inter-process communication (IPC) frameworks — D-Bus like services, shared-memory interfaces, zero-copy transports (e.g. Eclipse iceoryx), POSIX message queues, and Unix domain sockets — for reliable, low-latency communication between system daemons, sensor pipelines, and application software.
* Implement system services and background daemons on embedded Linux — managing lifecycle, configuration, logging, health monitoring, and error recovery.
* Write and integrate hardware abstraction layers (HALs) that expose sensor data, actuator controls, and peripheral status to higher-level software through clean, versioned APIs.
* Develop middleware for vehicle communication stacks — receiving and routing CAN, Ethernet, or serial data from the platform’s networking layer and exposing it to application consumers as structured service interfaces.
* Build and maintain configuration management, parameter storage, and runtime-tunable settings frameworks for embedded platforms.
* Work within and contribute to the team’s in-house C++ middleware frameworks — understanding the existing architecture, following established coding patterns and API conventions, and extending the framework with new modules as the platform evolves.
* Integrate third-party and silicon-vendor SDKs into the middleware stack — wrapping vendor libraries behind clean, testable C++ interfaces that isolate the rest of the platform from vendor-specific APIs and versioning.
* Develop middleware components for sensor data routing — receiving high-bandwidth data from camera, lidar, and radar interfaces and delivering it to perception and fusion consumers through well-defined, latency-aware service interfaces.
* Implement platform health monitoring and diagnostics services — collecting hardware status, software health metrics, and error conditions from across the middleware stack and exposing them for logging, alerting, and fleet-level telemetry.
* Profile and optimize middleware for CPU usage, memory footprint, latency, and thread safety using tools such as perf, Valgrind, strace, and GDB.
* Write unit tests (Google Test / Google Mock), integration tests, and system-level tests for middleware components, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
* Collaborate with firmware engineers on bring-up and integration — understanding how middleware depends on driver and BSP behavior, and debugging issues that span the middleware-driver boundary.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, contribute to coding standards, and maintain clear technical documentation for middleware APIs and service interfaces.

#### **What You’ll Bring**

* 3–7 years of hands-on C/C++ software development experience, with at least 2 years focused on middleware, platform services, or system-level software.
* Strong modern C++ skills (C++14 or later) — comfortable with RAII, smart pointers, move semantics, STL containers and algorithms, templates, and lambda expressions in production code.
* Solid understanding of Linux system programming — processes, threads (pthreads / std::thread), synchronization primitives (mutexes, condition variables, semaphores), signals, file descriptors, epoll/select, and the POSIX API.
* Experience designing and implementing IPC mechanisms — at least one of: D-Bus (sd-bus or GDBus), shared memory, POSIX message queues, Unix domain sockets, or named pipes — in a multi-process embedded or systems-software context.
* Working knowledge of the Linux build and packaging ecosystem — CMake (and ideally colcon for ROS 2 workspaces) for build, pkg-config for dependency management, and familiarity with cross-compilation toolchains for ARM targets.
* Comfortable with debugging and profiling tools — GDB, Valgrind (memcheck, helgrind), strace, ltrace, and perf — for diagnosing memory leaks, race conditions, deadlocks, and performance bottlenecks.
* A structured approach to software quality — unit testing with Google Test / Google Mock, static analysis (cppcheck, clang-tidy), and code review discipline.
* Good understanding of version control workflows with Git, and experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Comfort working in a large, shared C++ codebase — reading and understanding existing code, following established patterns and API conventions, writing code that fits the team’s style and passes review.
* Awareness of Linux real-time concepts — PREEMPT\_RT, CPU affinity, scheduling policies, and cgroups — at least enough to reason about latency-sensitive middleware behavior and work with engineers who tune these.

#### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with embedded Linux distribution building — Yocto / OpenEmbedded, Buildroot, or custom rootfs generation — including writing recipes, configuring layers, and integrating middleware packages into a BSP.
* Exposure to Linux device driver development — character drivers, platform drivers, or interfacing with kernel subsystems (sysfs, procfs, ioctl, DMA) — even at the level of reading and debugging existing drivers.
* Experience with embedded firmware development on microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V) and an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or QNX) — helpful for understanding the firmware layer that middleware sits on top of.
* Familiarity with D-Bus system architecture — writing D-Bus services and clients, understanding the session bus vs. system bus, introspection, signal emission, and method calls using sd-bus (systemd) or GDBus (GLib).
* Exposure to automotive middleware and communication protocols — CAN, SOME/IP, AUTOSAR Adaptive, UDS — at any level (application, middleware, or driver).
* Experience with serialization frameworks — Protocol Buffers, FlatBuffers, or Cap’n Proto — for structured, versioned data exchange between middleware services.
* Familiarity with systemd service management — writing unit files, managing dependencies, socket activation, watchdog integration, and journal-based logging.
* Exposure to functional safety concepts (ISO 26262) or safety-critical software development practices (MISRA-C/C++, static analysis, ASPICE).
* Exposure to ROS 2 and DDS-based middleware — node architecture, executors, QoS policies, launch files, and lifecycle management — even at a user level rather than contributor level.
* Familiarity with zero-copy IPC frameworks such as Eclipse iceoryx, or shared-memory DDS transports, for high-bandwidth sensor data paths.
* Working knowledge of ADAS or autonomous driving concepts — perception, sensor fusion, localization, planning — at least enough to understand what the middleware serves and why latency and reliability matter.
* Experience integrating third-party or silicon-vendor SDKs into a larger platform — wrapping vendor APIs, managing ABI/API compatibility, and isolating vendor dependencies.

#### **Why Join Us**

You’ll work on the middleware that carries sensor data and control signals through an ADAS vehicle compute platform — the layer between the hardware and the autonomy software that depends on it. It’s an environment for engineers who care about clean interfaces, low-latency data paths, and code that runs reliably on real hardware in the field. You’ll contribute to a shared C++ codebase alongside firmware, driver, and perception engineers, solving problems that span the full stack.

title: OpenText Workflow Backend Developer – Operations Orchestration (DevOps Team)
description:
**Company Description**

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the chance to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch.

 **Job Description**

**Role summary**

Full-stack backend developer in an Agile DevOps team that builds and runs automation on OpenText Operations Orchestration (OO). Designs, develops, and maintains OO flows, operations, and content packs in OO Studio, automating IT and business processes and integrating OpenText with enterprise systems. Owns the stability of these automations in production, and supports the team's move of selected workflows to ServiceNow by documenting and explaining existing OO logic.

**Job Description or Responsibilities**

***Flow development in OO Studio***

* Design, build, and maintain flows and subflows in OO Studio (and OO Workflow Designer where used), covering inputs, outputs, results, transitions, and responses.
* Develop custom operations using Java, Python/Jython, PowerShell, SSH, SQL, and HTTP/REST operations.
* Build reusable flows and operations, and apply consistent naming, structure, and versioning standards.
* Configure system accounts, system properties, selection lists, and configuration items securely, avoiding hard-coded credentials and environment values.
* Build robust error handling, retries, timeouts, and logging into flows so failures are clear and recoverable.
* Automate IT processes such as user provisioning, server and cloud operations, patching, monitoring remediation, and service request fulfillment.

***Content packs***

* Develop, package, and version custom content packs, and manage dependencies on OpenText base and integration content packs.
* Upgrade out-of-the-box content packs, test impact, and fix broken flows after upgrades.
* Promote content packs across dev, test, and production through OO Central, following the team's release and change process.
* Manage content in source control (Git/SVN with OO Studio SCM integration).

***Integrations***

* Build integrations between OO and enterprise systems, such as ServiceNow, Active Directory/Entra ID, VMware, monitoring tools, databases, and ticketing systems.
* Build and consume REST/SOAP APIs, including authentication (OAuth 2.0, basic auth, API keys, certificates).
* Configure and maintain Remote Action Servers (RAS) and worker groups for executing operations across network zones.
* Support triggers from other systems, for example SMAX processes, monitoring alerts, or schedules, and make sure results flow back correctly.

***Full-stack development***

* Develop backend services and scripts (Java, Python, PowerShell) that support automation.
* Build or maintain simple web front ends, APIs, or dashboards that start or report on automations where needed.
* Work with databases (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) for OO data, reporting, and integration logic.

***Operations (run)***

* Monitor flow runs, schedules, RAS health, and OO Central, and act on failures before users are affected.
* Troubleshoot failed or stuck runs using run logs, debugger, and step-level details.
* Resolve L2/L3 incidents for the automations the team owns, within SLA, and turn permanent fixes into backlog items.
* Take part in the team's on-call or support rotation.
* Support OO platform upgrades, patches, and certificate renewals together with platform administrators.
* Maintain runbooks, flow documentation (purpose, inputs, dependencies, owners), and known-error records.

***Migration support***

* Document existing OO flows and integrations clearly, so the ServiceNow team can assess and rebuild them in Workflow Studio and IntegrationHub.
* Work with ServiceNow developers during migration waves, explaining flow logic, dependencies, and edge cases, and supporting side-by-side testing and cutover.
* Help decommission flows and content packs once replacements are live.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience and qualifications**

* 4 to 8 years in software development or automation engineering, with at least 3 years of hands-on OpenText (or Micro Focus/HPE) Operations Orchestration development.
* Deep experience with OO Studio: flows, subflows, operations, system accounts and properties, and debugging.
* Proven experience building, packaging, and deploying content packs, and upgrading OpenText content packs.
* Strong scripting and programming skills in Java, Python/Jython, and PowerShell, plus SQL.
* Strong integration experience with REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, and authentication methods.
* Experience with OO Central administration basics and Remote Action Servers.
* Good knowledge of infrastructure: Windows and Linux, Active Directory, networking basics, virtualization, and cloud platforms.
* Experience troubleshooting production automation and doing root-cause analysis.
* Experience with source control (Git) and working in Agile DevOps teams.
* Understanding of ITIL processes, especially Request Fulfilment, Incident, and Change.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

 **Additional Information**

**Certifications**

* Preferred: OpenText (Micro Focus) Operations Orchestration training or certification; ITIL 4 Foundation.
* A plus: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) or Certified Application Developer (CAD), useful given the migration to ServiceNow; a cloud associate certification (AWS or Azure).

**Nice to have**

* Experience with OpenText Service Management (SMAX) Studio or Hybrid Cloud Management (HCMX).
* Experience with ServiceNow Workflow Studio or IntegrationHub.
* Experience with other automation tools, such as Ansible, Terraform, or RPA platforms.
* API testing tools such as Postman.

title: QA Engineer – Manual, Automation & AI-Assisted Testing
description:
**QA Engineer – Manual, Automation & AI-Assisted Testing**

**Location:** Remote  
**Experience:** 5–6 years (flexible for candidates with strong technical expertise)  
**Working Hours:** IST  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager  
**Compensation:** ₹15–17 LPA (negotiable depending on experience, technical skills, and interview performance)

**About the Role**

We're looking for a highly skilled, proactive, and detail-oriented **QA Engineer with strong hands-on experience in both Manual and Automation Testing** to join Meera AI's product engineering team.

You'll be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and scalability of our AI-powered SaaS platform through comprehensive testing strategies, automated test development, API validation, database testing, and continuous quality improvement.This is not a manual-testing-only position. We're looking for someone who can independently manage the end-to-end QA lifecycle, write and maintain automation scripts, develop reusable testing frameworks, identify critical defects, and work closely with developers and product teams to deliver high-quality releases.

We're particularly interested in engineers who embrace modern testing practices, including **AI-assisted test case generation, intelligent automation, AI-powered testing tools, and AI-driven defect analysis**, to improve test coverage, reduce repetitive manual effort, and accelerate release cycles. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, exceptional communication skills, and a high level of ownership.

**What You'll Do**

**Manual & Functional Testing**

* Own end-to-end testing activities across web applications, APIs, backend services, and integrated systems.
* Design and execute functional, regression, smoke, sanity, integration, system, exploratory, and end-to-end test cases.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, scenarios, and test cases aligned with user stories, business requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform positive, negative, boundary, edge-case, cross-browser, responsive, and usability testing.
* Support UAT, production validation, and release readiness activities.
* Apply risk-based testing and maintain requirement traceability to ensure coverage of critical business workflows.

**Automation Testing & Framework Development**

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for web applications and APIs.
* Work with automation frameworks such as **Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, or equivalent tools**.
* Write automation scripts using Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Build and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks.
* Implement Page Object Model (POM), data-driven testing, reusable utilities, and appropriate test design patterns.
* Automate repetitive test scenarios, critical business workflows, and regression suites.
* Troubleshoot automation failures, flaky tests, and environment-related issues.
* Improve automation coverage, test execution reliability, and regression efficiency.

**AI-Assisted Testing & Intelligent Automation**

* Explore and utilize AI-powered tools to accelerate test case creation, test script development, and defect identification.
* Leverage tools such as **GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Testim, mabl, or similar AI-enabled testing solutions**.
* Use AI-assisted capabilities for:
  + Generating test cases from requirements and user stories.
  + Developing and optimizing automated test scripts.
  + Identifying missing scenarios, edge cases, and coverage gaps.
  + Generating synthetic test data.
  + Analyzing test failures, application logs, and recurring defects.
  + Improving regression testing efficiency.
* Validate AI-generated test cases and scripts for accuracy, security, and maintainability.
* Recommend practical opportunities to incorporate AI into existing QA workflows.
* Ensure sensitive customer and company data is handled securely when using AI tools.

**API & Integration Testing**

* Perform manual and automated REST API testing using Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, REST Assured, Newman, or similar tools.
* Validate API endpoints, request/response payloads, HTTP status codes, authentication, authorization, and error handling.
* Test OAuth 2.0, JWT, JSON/XML data structures, and API response times.
* Develop reusable automated API test suites.
* Validate integrations between application components, backend services, external platforms, and third-party APIs.
* Verify data consistency and error handling across interconnected systems.
* Exposure to SOAP APIs is an advantage.

**Database & Backend Testing**

* Perform backend and database validation using SQL queries.
* Work with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or equivalent technologies.
* Validate CRUD operations, transactional workflows, data integrity, constraints, and business rules.
* Verify data consistency between UI, API, and database layers.
* Test data synchronization and integration workflows.
* Identify backend defects, data discrepancies, and transaction failures.
* Exposure to MongoDB or other NoSQL databases is an advantage.

**Performance, Load & Non-Functional Testing**

* Perform basic performance, load, and stress testing using JMeter, k6, BlazeMeter, or similar tools.
* Validate application response times, API latency, throughput, and behavior under load.
* Identify performance bottlenecks and collaborate with developers to resolve them.
* Support scalability, reliability, and basic security testing.
* Contribute to accessibility and compatibility testing where applicable.

**CI/CD & Continuous Testing**

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Work with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.
* Support automated smoke, regression, and API testing during build and deployment cycles.
* Investigate pipeline failures and maintain stable automated test execution.
* Promote shift-left testing and early defect identification.
* Collaborate with developers to improve release quality and deployment confidence.

**Defect Management & Quality Ownership**

* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, Bugzilla, or similar tools.
* Provide clear reproduction steps, screenshots, logs, and supporting technical details.
* Collaborate with developers on defect triage, root cause analysis, retesting, and regression validation.
* Maintain test execution reports, defect metrics, automation coverage, and QA dashboards.
* Identify quality risks and provide recommendations before releases.
* Own QA sign-off for assigned features and modules, including documented residual risks.
* Continuously improve testing processes, frameworks, and quality standards.

**Agile Collaboration & Communication**

* Work closely with engineering, product management, business analysts, and cross-functional teams.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release discussions.
* Review requirements and identify ambiguities, missing acceptance criteria, and potential testing risks.
* Communicate defects, blockers, testing progress, and release risks clearly and proactively.
* Maintain comprehensive test documentation and share QA best practices.
* Demonstrate independent ownership, accountability, and strong problem-solving capabilities.

**Required Skills & Experience (Must-Haves)**

* 5–6 years of professional software QA experience, with strong hands-on exposure to **both Manual and Automation Testing**.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience developing, executing, debugging, and maintaining automated test scripts.
* Hands-on experience with at least one automation framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Proficiency in at least one programming language: Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Strong knowledge of functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end testing.
* Practical experience in REST API testing and API automation.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating backend data and business workflows.
* Understanding of test automation framework design, test case optimization, and reusable test components.
* Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test execution.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and defect management processes.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, or equivalent.
* Ability to independently manage testing activities, identify quality risks, and support production releases.
* Strong debugging, analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* **Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (10/10 expected)**, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Testim, or mabl.
* Experience using AI to generate test cases, develop automation scripts, analyze defects, or improve test coverage.
* Experience testing AI-powered applications, conversational AI, LLM-based features, or AI-driven workflows.
* Familiarity with AI testing concepts such as hallucination detection, response consistency, prompt injection testing, and evaluation of nondeterministic outputs.
* Experience with SaaS products, enterprise applications, or high-scale cloud-based platforms.
* Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or BlazeMeter.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, or containerized test environments.
* Knowledge of security testing fundamentals, OWASP principles, and accessibility testing.
* Experience with API contract testing, service virtualization, mocking, and test data management.
* Experience testing CRM integrations, messaging platforms, or communication APIs.
* Exposure to SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, or other customer engagement technologies.
* Experience working in fast-paced product development or startup environments.

**Why Work at Meera AI?**

Joining Meera AI means stepping into a challenging and highly rewarding environment where you'll help build AI-powered outbound and customer engagement innovations from the ground up.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute directly to product quality, establish scalable automation practices, explore emerging AI-driven testing technologies, and help shape our quality engineering standards. If you're ambitious, technically curious, and want to grow fast, this is the place to do it.

**What We Do at Meera AI**

Meera.AI is an AI-powered customer engagement and automation platform designed to help businesses scale conversations, accelerate lead conversions, and drive revenue—without manual outreach.

We combine AI-driven SMS, Voice, and WhatsApp automation with deep CRM integrations to help businesses create meaningful, revenue-generating customer conversations.

**Work-Life Balance at Meera AI**

We foster a healthy work–life balance through strong collaboration and supportive team practices. Employees benefit from direct access to leadership through an open-door policy that encourages transparency and open communication.

title: QA Engineer - SDET
description:
**About Us:**
-------------

Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc.). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators' data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators' data in a simple yet impactful way. Website: https://www.getphyllo.com/

**About the Role**
------------------

As an SDET, you will take ownership of automation quality for assigned product areas across APIs, SDKs and web applications. You will design scalable automation solutions, strengthen regression coverage, integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and proactively identify quality risks before they reach production..  
This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what “working” means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers.

**What you'll be expected to do**
---------------------------------

### **1. Build and own test automation (UI and API)**

* Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing.
* Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs.
* Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy.
* Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code.
* Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits.
* Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on.

### **2. Work closely with product and engineering**

* Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts.
* Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality.
* Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports.
* Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership.

**You'll be a good fit if**
---------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in quality engineering, with at least 2 years building test automation (not only running manual tests).
* Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience.
* Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java.
* Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e.g. Playwright, REST
* Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI.
* Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium.
* Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews.
* Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason.
* Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL.
* Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
* AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic).
* Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA.tech
* Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs).
* Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring.
* Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS.
* Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG.
* API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing.
* Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray.
* Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar).

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance
* Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive
* Innovate and Evolve: We're building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product.

Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Location:**
DGS India - Chennai - Anna Nagar Tyche Towers
  
  
**Brand:**
Paragon
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.

* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.

* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).

* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

**About Supra Its**
Founded in 1999, Supra ITS has grown into a globally trusted IT partner, delivering world-class Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Application Services, and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Services. Headquartered in Mississauga, Supra ITS operates with 650+ employees worldwide, including Network Operations Centers (NOCs) in Canada and India, ensuring 24/7 IT support and seamless service delivery.

With a security-first approach and SLA-driven commitments, Supra ITS takes complete ownership of IT services, allowing clients to focus on growth while ensuring uninterrupted operations.

In 2021, Canon Canada made an equity investment in Supra ITS, recognizing a shared vision to deliver world-class technology and managed services across North America.
  
  
What began as a strategic investment has since evolved into an integrated partnership, combining Canon’s innovation and enterprise solutions with Supra ITS’s agility, customer focus, and managed services expertise.
  
  
Today, we operate as a unified force, driving rapid growth across North America through automation, cloud, cybersecurity, and business process solutions. Together, Canon and Supra ITS are accelerating digital transformation for customers, delivering secure, scalable, and performance-driven IT solutions that redefine what it means to be truly customer-centric.

This partnership fosters innovation, enhances efficiency, and accelerates digital transformation, providing customers with superior IT solutions that are scalable, secure, and customer centric.

**About Atomic North**
Atomic North is the India-based subsidiary of Supra ITS, serving as the global delivery and operations centre behind Supra’s Managed IT, Application Services, and BPO businesses. As an integral part of Supra ITS’ international ecosystem, Atomic North ensures operational transparency, and seamless collaboration with our North American leadership teams. As Supra ITS scales rapidly across North America in partnership with Canon, Atomic North is expanding its leadership team in India to support the company’s next phase of growth, maturity, and operational excellence.

This is your opportunity to join a dynamic company with a team that works very well together and has solid organized structures in place. Supra’s head office is based in Brampton, Ontario with offices across North America and growing, you will be part of a growing team and evolving company.
  
  
Our global delivery operations are in India through our subsidiary, Atomic North. With Canon’s strategic equity partnership and a strong North American customer base, Supra ITS is scaling its India operations to deliver world-class infrastructure services, automation, and cybersecurity solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic technical leader who can balance architecture, reliability, security, cost, and team growth while guiding engineers and driving long-term technical vision.
  
  
As Solution Architect, you'll define the technical strategy for the AI ITSM Agent Platform. You'll make cloud infrastructure decisions, design systems for scale, build and mentor the engineering team, and ensure we execute with excellence. You'll report to the CTO and own the platform's technical roadmap for 18–24 months.

An experienced Solution Architect with 8+ years’ experience in production software engineering
  
  
2+ years’ experience in architecture or technical leadership.
  
  
Can articulate technical vision to C-level and engineers
  
  
Writes clear RFCs and design docs that guide implementation
  
  
Runs effective technical discussions; makes decisive trade-off decisions

Transparent: admits when you don't know; seeks expertise

**Technical Experience**
**Deep Technical Knowledge:**

* Deep understanding of trade-offs between technologies

**Cloud Architecture (AWS, GCP, Or Azure—Deep In One)**

description:

The position plays a critical role in delivering flexible, cost-effective and globally standardized cross-product solutions while maintaining enterprise architecture standards, governance frameworks, security policies and strategic product roadmaps.

* Understand business-critical requirements and their impact on process execution.
* Balance IT system capabilities and constraints with business priorities and end-user requirements.
* Possess knowledge of global core applications.
* Demonstrate deep expertise in EDI integration.

* Work effectively with multicultural and geographically dispersed teams.
* Apply project management, analytical and communication skills.
* Drive change management initiatives and identify opportunities for improvement.

title: Founding Engineer - Delivery
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to run delivery like it's their own company — not manage tickets, but own outcomes. You'll sit at the center of client relationships, technical architecture, and team growth. This isn't a management role in the corporate sense — it's a build-and-own role for someone hands-on who's ready to stop being told what to build and start deciding it.

If you've been doing solid work for 5-8 years but feel like you're capped, coasting, or just executing someone else's roadmap — this is the opposite of that.

**What you will own.**

* **Client relationships**

  — run requirement calls directly, translate business needs into technical specs without a middleman
* **Architecture decisions**

  — make the calls on how things get built, not just how they get coded
* **Code quality**

  — review the team's work, set the bar
* **Team growth**

  — unblock junior developers, mentor them into stronger engineers
* **Hands-on development**

  — when bandwidth allows, build features yourself; this isn't a pure-management seat
* **Project health**

  — track delivery status, catch issues before the client does, fix them fast

**What we are looking for**

* 5-8 years of full-stack experience (MERN preferred); comfortable across the stack, not siloed
* Real client-facing experience — you've sat in requirement calls and owned the outcome, not relayed messages
* A track record of
  **building and owning**

  something end-to-end — not just maintaining what others designed
* Startup or small-team background preferred — you're used to ambiguity, not process for its own sake
* Some experience mentoring or leading other developers, even informally
* Still writes code regularly — if you haven't shipped anything hands-on in 2+ years, this isn't the fit
* Low job-hop history — we're looking for someone who wants to build something over years, not months

**What this isn't**

* Not a pure people-management role — you'll still write code
* Not a ticket-execution job — we want judgment, not just delivery against a spec
* Not a place for "20 years of experience, comfortable in my lane" — if the title matters more to you than the ownership, this probably isn't it

**Compensation**

Competitive, based on experience — with room to grow as the role and the company do.

**Location**

Chennai, in-office.

Apply at: https://hire.yalabs.tech/apply

title: Senior Engineer with Python, Agentic AI, Multi-cloud, MCP along with IAM, Cyber experience
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

description:
**Description**
Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.
  
  
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

**About The Team**
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Job Overview**
The Junior Machine Learning Engineer works within an Applied AI and Machine Learning delivery team to develop, test, deploy, and support AI and machine learning solutions. This early-career role is designed for candidates with strong programming and analytical foundations who want to build scalable, production-ready AI products under the guidance of senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, profiling, and validating structured and unstructured data.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, data quality issues, and potential features.
* Develop and evaluate baseline machine learning models under guidance using appropriate algorithms and metrics.
* Support use cases involving classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting, natural language processing, and Generative AI.
* Write reusable, readable, secure, and testable Python code aligned with team coding standards.
* Help convert notebooks and experiments into modular code, repeatable pipelines, APIs, or scheduled workloads.
* Assist with feature engineering, model comparison, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, and experiment tracking.
* Support deployment of models through APIs, containers, batch jobs, or approved cloud services.
* Help monitor model quality, data drift, model drift, latency, failures, and operational performance.
* Participate in code reviews, pair programming, Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Document datasets, experiments, assumptions, model results, dependencies, limitations, and implementation decisions.
* Identify and escalate data privacy, security, compliance, responsible AI, and model-performance risks.

**Essential Job Functions**
**Data Preparation and Exploration**

* Perform data cleaning, feature preparation, validation, and exploratory analysis.
* Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn.
* Document data quality findings and support corrective actions.

**Model Development**

* Build baseline machine learning models and compare performance using suitable evaluation metrics.
* Support feature engineering, error analysis, and hyperparameter tuning.
* Assist with consumption of foundation models and Large Language Models.

**Machine Learning Engineering**

* Use Git for source control and collaboration.
* Package basic applications or models using Docker.
* Support APIs, pipelines, experiment tracking, and introductory MLOps practices.

**Testing and Monitoring**

* Write unit tests and data validation checks.
* Assist in testing model behavior and production performance.
* Support logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident documentation.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related area.
* 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, research, hackathons, or personal projects.
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
* Understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, supervised learning, and unsupervised learning.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively in a collaborative Agile environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and continuous-learning abilities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, or Azure AI Foundry.
* Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
* Exposure to Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval-augmented generation.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents, used to speed up your own development and to deliver AI-native solutions, with the judgment to review and own what they produce.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, and MLflow or similar experiment tracking.
* Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, explainability, and AI governance.

**Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training**
Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment.
  
  

* Python programming and object-oriented programming
* NumPy, Pandas, data visualization, and SQL
* Statistics and probability for machine learning
* Supervised and unsupervised machine learning
* Model evaluation, feature engineering, and error analysis
* Introduction to deep learning and natural language processing
* Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG
* Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, and Azure AI Foundry
* Git, GitHub, Linux, Docker, REST APIs, and testing fundamentals
* MLOps, experiment tracking, model monitoring, responsible AI, Agile, and Azure DevOps

**Pre-Joining Capstone**
Build and demonstrate an end-to-end machine learning solution covering data preparation, model development, evaluation, packaging, documentation, and basic deployment or inference.
  
  
We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
