title: Senior Combustion Scientist / Engineer
description:
**Senior Combustion Scientist / Engineer**

**About Manastu**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

Build and own the
**complete combustion model**
for Manastu's green monopropellant and bipropellant thrusters, from
**combustion fundamentals and catalyst-surface kinetics**
, through
**reactor networks**
, to
**CFD and transients**
such as cold start, pulse mode and instability. The model will be
**validated against our own hot-fire data**
and will predict the performance of any new thruster design (
**Isp, c\*, chamber pressure and temperature, light-off time and pulse response**
) before hardware is built.

**Role Overview**

This is a
**combustion scientist / engineer**
role in Manastu's Propulsion Department. You will take thruster combustion from first principles (
**mass, species and energy balances, flame dynamics and time-scale reasoning**
) to a validated, multi-level model. You will
**develop and reduce reaction mechanisms**
and write the code behind the model,
**characterise the propellant**
for combustion and safe handling (including
**flash point, flammability limits and minimum ignition energy**
), and
**close the loop between model and hot-fire testing**
with stated uncertainty. Full-time, based in Navi Mumbai.

Your models and designs will go directly into the
**green thrusters Manastu builds for orbital transfer vehicles (OTVs), launch vehicle upper stages, satellites and other in-space platforms**
, from attitude-control thrusters to higher-thrust engines. This is an opportunity to
**develop novel thrusters**
, taking them from first principles through design and hot-fire to flight.

Combustion modelling sits at the centre of how we design green propulsion. A model that is trusted against test lets us
**predict performance before hardware is built**
, size new thrusters with confidence, and move faster from design to flight. You will
**set the standard for combustion analysis**
at Manastu and
**build the team**
that carries it forward.

You will work closely with the
**metallurgy, chemical, manufacturing and AIT (assembly, integration and test)**
teams, as well as injector design, thermal, CFD and test colleagues: on materials for chamber and catalyst bed hardware, propellant chemistry and catalyst inputs, manufacturability of combustion hardware, and integration and hot-fire testing.

**Key Responsibilities**

•
**Break down thruster requirements**
(thrust, Isp, total impulse, minimum impulse bit, response time, duty cycle, life) into combustion requirements such as bed loading, residence time, chamber pressure and L\*, light-off time and stability margin, each traced to the requirement it comes from.

•
**Own the complete fidelity ladder of the thruster combustion model**
, choosing the fidelity each question needs: 0-D equilibrium performance and reactor networks, 1-D and 2-D models with gas and catalyst-surface kinetics and liquid injection into the bed, 3-D CFD where it is needed, and transients such as cold start, pulse mode and instability.

•
**Design novel thrusters from the model**
: size the combustion chamber and catalyst bed for specific applications, take the design through review and release for build, and validate it by hot-fire against its requirements.

•
**Predict what matters**
: Isp, c\*, chamber pressure and temperature, bed pressure drop, light-off time, pulse response and catalyst degradation, each with a stated uncertainty.

•
**Close the loop with test**
: compare predictions against hot-fire data, recalibrate after every campaign, fix the physics where tuning is not enough, and help design tests that answer the model's open questions.

•
**Make the model work across new thruster designs**
, and document it so that others can run it independently.

•
**Develop and reduce reaction mechanisms**
for our propellant, and write and maintain the analysis code behind the model.

•
**Characterise the propellant**
for combustion and safe handling, and turn the results into model inputs and handling limits.

•
**Build and grow the combustion team**
: hire, mentor, and set the standard for combustion analysis.

•
**Work closely with**
the metallurgy, chemical, manufacturing and AIT teams, and with injector design, thermal, CFD and test colleagues.

**Experience & Background**

**PhD**
in combustion, propulsion or a related field, with
**5–10 years**
of experience.

Required, in priority order:

•
**Combustion fundamentals and flame dynamics**
: mass, species and energy balances for a chamber and catalyst bed, and time-scale reasoning (residence versus reaction time, heat release versus heat loss) to explain light-off, complete decomposition, flame holding and pressure oscillation.

•
**Thruster combustion model architecture**
: multi-level combustion models built from equilibrium to reactor networks to CFD, including transients and surface kinetics.

•
**Test-to-model feedback and uncertainty**
: models recalibrated against test data, predictions quoted with uncertainty bands, and the judgement to change the physics rather than the coefficients.

•
**Kinetics and code development**
: reaction mechanisms developed or reduced in Cantera, Chemkin or similar; own code in Python or C++ under version control; CFD (Fluent, STAR-CCM+, CONVERGE or OpenFOAM) at practitioner depth.

•
**Propellant and fire-safety characterisation**
: viscosity, vapour pressure, flash point, fire point and autoignition temperature, plus flammability limits, minimum ignition energy, flame speed and quenching distance, well enough to set safe handling and test limits.

Good to have:

• Experience with green monopropellants or high-concentration hydrogen peroxide.

• Bipropellant combustion experience, including mixing and mixture-ratio effects.

• Catalyst bed loading, preheat characterisation and degradation experience.

• Combustion instability or acoustics analysis.

• Additive manufacturing of combustion hardware (SLM, DMLS).

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

•
**First-principles thinker**
: goes to the governing physics and names the assumptions.

•
**Team builder and mentor**
: has hired and grown people, can say how each of them turned out, and writes things down so the work does not depend on one person.

•
**Detail-oriented**
: checks units, inputs and convergence before any number is used, cross-checks models against hand calculations, states the uncertainty on every result, and keeps records that let anyone rerun the work.

•
**Clear communicator**
: presents complex combustion results simply, with their uncertainty, to design reviews, customers and non-specialists.

•
**Systems thinker**
: sees how a combustion decision lands on injector, thermal, materials, manufacturing, AIT and test.

**What Success Looks Like in this role**

•
**Thruster requirements broken down into combustion requirements**
, each traced to the requirement it comes from.

•
**A working combustion model**
for monopropellant and bipropellant thrusters, used at whatever fidelity each question needs, with its
**error against hot-fire data published and falling**
.

•
**A novel thruster designed from the model**
, through design review and release for build, then
**validated by hot-fire**
against its requirements.

•
**A combustion team hired and grown**
that runs the model independently.

As every control result, every dashboard figure and every application screen reads from the curated data model you build and maintain. If the data is wrong, late or unexplained, nothing above it can be trusted.
  
  
The platform ingests from several enterprise sources into a raw layer that preserves exactly what each source sent and then transforms that into a curated model. You will build and operate the data pipelines, implement the reconciliation and data-quality checks that prove each load is complete, and extend the model as new controls and modules require it.
  
  
You will also implement the control rules themselves. These are written primarily as versioned SQL against the curated model, reviewed like application code, and executed by the controls engine. This is where data engineering meets the business purpose of the platform, and it is a significant part of the role.
  
  
This is not a pure pipeline role. You will also contribute to the application services, and you are expected to be able to pick up backend work when delivery requires it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ingestion pipelines — scheduled extraction from enterprise source systems into the raw layer, including change detection, load history and the recording of source data provenance.
* The curated data model — transformation from raw to a conformed, keyed and de-duplicated model of entitlements, applications, users and their relationships.
* Reconciliation and data quality — checks that prove each load is complete and consistent, with results written to an append-only evidence store and discrepancies raised rather than silently absorbed.
* Pipeline orchestration — scheduling, dependency management, retry and alerting, with a run history that can be interrogated when a question is asked about a past load.
* Control rules as code — the rule base for the control catalogue, written as versioned SQL with accompanying metadata, peer-reviewed and promoted through the same pipeline as application code.
* Reporting data layer — the curated views that the reporting dashboards consume, designed as a stable contract that survives changes to the underlying model.
* Backend services — contributing to the Python application services alongside the Technical Lead.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, at depth. This is the core of the role. Complex joins, aggregation, window functions, set operations; reading and acting on query plans; indexing and performance tuning on large tables. You should instinctively solve a data problem in SQL before reaching for application code.
* Relational data modelling. Designing schemas for analytical and operational use: keys, grain, slowly changing data, handling of deletions and deactivations in source systems. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Python for data engineering. Writing maintainable, tested Python for ETL — not notebooks. Experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable toolkit, and with pandas or Polars for in-flight transformation.
* Pipeline construction and operation. Building pipelines that run unattended: idempotent loads, failure handling, retries, alerting and the ability to re-run a failed load safely.
* Data quality and reconciliation. Practical experience proving that a data load is complete and correct, and designing the controls that detect when it is not.
* Backend development. Sufficient experience building API services in Python — FastAPI, Django or Flask — to contribute to the application layer.
* Testing discipline. Automated tests for transformation logic. Experience with pytest.
* Version control. Disciplined use of Git and pull request review. Treating SQL and pipeline definitions as code, held in a repository rather than on a server.
* Communication in a distributed team. Clear written English, and the judgement to flag a data discrepancy rather than work around it.

**Nice To Have**

* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow in production, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, functional role codes, segregation of duties, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Reporting tools — Power BI, including semantic modelling and designing the views that sit behind a dashboard.
* Regulated-environment experience — working with personal or otherwise sensitive data under data-protection controls, including masking of non-production environments.
* Linux and CI/CD — comfortable deploying and troubleshooting on Linux servers with an automated pipeline.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai

* Own the end-to-end Demand Plan for a part of the Business Unit, covering both Consumer Sales (CS – sales to consumers, based on retail sell-out data) and Selling-In (SI – sales to retail partners) at theme, customer group, and SKU level.
* Shape BU-level CS and SI decisions by balancing commercial ambitions with supply chain constraints, inventory health, and financial implications

* Work with the sales and marketing teams to gain an understanding of past performance and reasons for deviations from expectations, as well as the drivers behind Forecasting KPIs.

As Demand Planning Manager, you will shape the BU demand plan, aligning Sales and Marketing into one clear, data-driven view that drives critical commercial and supply chain decisions. Your work ensures the business commits to the right volumes at the right time

* Bachelor’s Degree with MBA in Operations or Supply chain management from a Tier 1 institute is preferred

description:
**About The Role**
At Purplle, we are building a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands that sell across general trade,
  
  
modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce. To scale them, we need a planning system that puts
  
  
the right product in the right channel at the right time, with the least working capital tied up. We are
  
  
looking for a Product Manager to build the core of that system: the products that power demand and
  
  
supply planning for our FMCG business.
  
  
**This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.**

* Youll work alongside the Senior Product Manager who leads our demand and supply planning

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply
  
  
planning products.
  
  

* Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.
  
  

* Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line
  
  
and on how fast our brands can grow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Roadmap & Execution: Set a prioritised roadmap with the Senior Product Manager and own

delivery.
  
  

* Demand Planning: Build demand forecasting, sensing and planning at range, channel, product

and region level, including new product forecasting.
  
  

* S&OP Collaboration: Build the tool that runs the monthly S&OP cycle and aligns sales, planning

and finance on one plan.
  
  

* Supply Planning: Take FG Buying live and scale it into end-to-end supply planning.
* Stakeholder Management: Work with planners, operations, sales (GT, MT, e-commerce, quick

commerce), finance, data science and engineering to define requirements and drive adoption.
  
  

* Discovery & Delivery: Run discovery with planners, write PRDs and user stories, and manage the

backlog with agile teams.
  
  

* KPI Ownership: Own forecast accuracy and bias, fill rate for modern trade and quick commerce,

inventory health (days, excess, expiry) and adoption of the planning products.
  
  

* AI-Native Building: Identify where AI and LLMs can create outsized value in planning, such as

explaining forecast changes, surfacing demand anomalies and automating routine plan reviews.
  
  
Build these into the products, not as add-ons, and use AI tools to accelerate your own discovery,
  
  
specs and analysis.
  
  
**Desired Skills And Requirements**

* About 2 years of product management experience with clear ownership: you have taken

products from discovery through delivery and adoption, ideally in supply chain, operations or
  
  
internal tools.
  
  

* Hands-on exposure to demand and supply planning: forecasting and how accuracy is measured,

S&OP, and inventory norms (safety stock, reorder points).
  
  

* Exposure to Indian general trade, modern trade and quick commerce.
* Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of SQL; you make decisions backed by data.
* First-principles and systems thinking: you break ambiguous problems into structured pieces and

**Reason About How Forecasting, S&OP And Supply Planning Connect.**

* High ownership and bias for action: you drive problems to resolution without waiting to be told.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and experience working cross-functionally in agile

teams.
  
  

* Engineering undergraduate degree. An MBA from a Tier 1 business school is good to have.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Python for analysis or prototyping.
* BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Metabase.
* Hands-on use of a planning tool such as o9, Kinaxis or SAP IBP.
* Exposure to ML-based forecasting or replenishment products.

**What You Will Gain**

* Zero-to-one ownership of demand and supply planning products for a fast-growing FMCG

portfolio.
  
  

* Monthly S&OP cycle exposure with sales, supply and finance leaders.
* A clear growth path, with your scope expanding as the products scale.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: O9 Supply Planning Expert
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Job Description: o9 Integrated Business Planning (IBP) Expert**
Mondelēz Digital Services (MDS)
  
  
Core Thesis
  
  
A comprehensive Job Description for a senior-level o9 IBP Expert at Mondelēz Digital Services, covering platform configuration across IBP/S&OE/STD/TLB modules, integration design, data modeling, service management, and cross-functional leadership.
  
  
**Company Overview**
Mondelēz International, Inc. — global snacking leader with iconic brands (Oreo, Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone, etc.), 80,000+ colleagues, operating in 150+ countries. Mondelēz Digital Services (MDS) is the digital arm driving technology excellence across supply chain, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
Senior expert role focused on o9 IBP platform configuration, planning engine design, and integration across Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OE, STD, and TLB modules. Responsible for full lifecycle implementations, service management, and enabling Mondelēz's global planning processes through best-in-class o9 solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Configuration (IBP, S&OE, STD, TLB Modules)
* Configure o9 Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, SOE, STD, and TLB workflows aligned with Mondelēz's global processes
* Design Attribute-Based Hierarchies, Time Bucket Profiles, and Aggregation/Disaggregation Rules for multi-level planning (SKU, plant, region)
* Develop custom planning logic using o9's planning engines (heuristics, time-series forecasting) and scripting tools (Python, R)
* Enhancements & CI Initiatives
* Requirements gathering workshops for o9 modules (Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Allocation, Replenishment, S&OP, IBP)
* Fit-gap analysis, BRDs/FRDs, user stories, UAT, and collaboration with development teams
* Design, configure, and test o9 solutions; support integrations with SAP S/4HANA via CI-DS, EDI, IDocs
* o9 Data Model & Planning Engine Design
* Build master data structures (products, locations, customers) and key figures (demand signals, capacity constraints)
* Optimize pegging rules, supply allocation strategies, and exception management workflows for real-time S&OE adjustments
* Configure Scenario Manager for what-if analysis (demand spikes, supply disruptions)
* Integration & Data Requirements
* Design data pipelines using Talend, Kafka, or REST APIs to sync o9 with SAP ECC, APO, BPC, and external market data sources
* Validate data quality via o9 Loader; troubleshoot integration errors with IT teams
* Scenario Management & Analytics
* Develop interactive dashboards using o9's KPI Engine (forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory turnover)
* Configure exception alerts for stockouts, excess inventory, and production bottlenecks
* Testing, Validation & Support
* Execute unit, integration, and UAT testing for o9 configurations
* Resolve post-go-live issues via ServiceNow (Level 2/3 support for planners)
* Service Management
* Ensure SLA compliance, root cause analysis, change/release management adherence
* Weekly/monthly stakeholder reviews; escalation management; continuous improvement planning
* Support transition to new major releases/rollouts; out-of-hours support during critical incidents
* Monitor OLA agreements; own transformation initiatives for AMEA region
* Documentation & Training
* Create technical playbooks (data mappings, calculation logic, user permissions)
* Train regional planners on o9 Tag UI, Workflow Designer, and Scenario Manager

**Qualifications**
**More about this role**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field

**Experience**

* 5–7+ years configuring o9 IBP/S&OE modules (Demand 360, Supply 360) in CPG/FMCG industries
* Hands-on experience with IBP, SOE, STD, TLB, and Segmentation modules
* 2+ full lifecycle implementations of o9 or SAP IBP, including data migration and cutover planning

Technical Skills
  
  

* o9 Platform: Modeler, Workflow Designer, Data Ingestion, KPI Engine, Scenario Manager
* Integration Tools: Snowflake, Talend, Kafka, REST APIs, SAP CPI, Oracle OIC
* Data Modeling: Time-series forecasting, constraint-based supply models
* Analytics: Power BI, Tableau, o9 native dashboards
* Tools: SQL, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

**Preferred Experience**

* End-to-end o9 implementations including Merchandise Financial Planning and Long-Range Planning
* Supply chain domain knowledge in FMCG/consumer goods
* Certifications: o9 Solutions, SAP IBP, or Kinaxis Rapid Response
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven demand sensing or control tower frameworks
* Agile/Scrum methodology with Jira board management

Personal & Leadership Skills
  
  

* Large-scale program/delivery management
* Comfortable with ambiguity; manages risk and uncertainty; results-oriented and accountable
* Highly collaborative; ability to influence cross-functional teams across levels
* Execution discipline with strategic focus and highest standards of delivery
* Naturally curious with a passion for learning and innovation

No Relocation support available
  
  
**Business Unit Summary**
At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.
  
  
We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as
*Oreo*
,
*belVita*
and
*LU*
biscuits;
*Cadbury Dairy Milk*
,
*Milka*
and
*Toblerone*
chocolate;
*Sour Patch Kids*
candy and
*Trident*
gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.
  
  
Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

title: Associate Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Role: Associate System Engineer
  
  
Location: Mumbai(Preferred)/Bangalore
  
  
Schedule: Hybrid
  
  
Shift: Rotational
  
  
**Introduction to the Job:**
As a DevSecOps engineer, you will provide technically skilled in the DevSecOps areas of Vulnerability Scanning, Certificate Management, Password Policy Management, Infrastructure As code for Cloud Resource Provisioning, Data Analysis of security monitoring outputs, coordination of Remediation Patching, and other daily Security and Compliance efforts. Additionally, you will assist in developing an automated security framework for robust deployment tools and processes, leveraging various scripting languages and open-source solutions.
  
  
**Some of the things you will be doing:**

* Familiarity with DevSecOps ecosystem: Terraform, Ansible, GitHub, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, SAST, DAST & SCA
* Terraform, Ansible and AWS, Azure Architecture, Network and Security Certifications.
* Familiarity with API Security, Container Security, AWS and Azure Cloud Security
* Knowledge of Cloud Resource Provisioning, Cloud Network and Architecture, Cloud Standards and Policies.
* Experience with AWS and Azure Policy, Configuration, and Security Management tools.
* Experience with security automation, Cloud resource provisioning.
* Expertise in programming and scripting languages like Python, NodeJS, SQL query, bash, powershell, and Java.
* Experience with Vulnerable Code remediation.
* Experience with Vulnerability Management and executive reporting using PowerBI.

**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?**

* Prior experience (3-5 years) in a Production Engineering or related position.
* Experience working with Developers, DevOps, and Engineering teams in a dynamic environment to promote/implement the DevSecOps program throughout the organization.

* Comprehension in the security areas of Key Management Systems, Certificate Management, Encryption, Penetration Testing, Vulnerability Scanning, Security and Monitoring tools, etc.

* Identify security exposures and develop mitigation plans
* Identify, report and fix technical debt.

* Becomes a subject matter expert for security solutions within the CSC platform, knowledge of SANS 25 and Owasp Top 10.
* Be able to act as a mentor for junior dev, devops and security engineers

* Own and document medium/large epics and follow through until completion.
* Present security solutions to a larger CSC audience.
* Troubleshoot issues and performance bottlenecks.
* Follow Security best practices.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams (Engineering, DevOps, Product) while carrying out day-to-day tasks.
* Participate in requirement gathering with Product/SRE/InfraServices.

description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Agent Orchestration Engineer to design, develop, and scale enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions. You will be responsible for building reliable, observable, and scalable graph-based AI agents that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), tool integrations, and intelligent workflow orchestration. * Extensive experience in asynchronous programming, type-safe application design, and scalable backend systems.
* Strong proficiency with Python type hints, Pydantic models, schema definition, and validation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience developing AI-powered applications using LangChain and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of graph-based workflows, state machines, workflow orchestration, and distributed execution models.
* Experience implementing conditional routing, retries, checkpoints, parallel execution, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Strong understanding of agent lifecycle management, tool orchestration, and multi-agent systems.
* Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of structured outputs, prompt engineering, tool calling, agent memory, and AI guardrails.
* Expertise in REST APIs, microservices, authentication mechanisms, and asynchronous integrations.
* Experience designing highly available, observable, and resilient enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of logging, monitoring, tracing, and operational excellence practices.
* Experience developing automated unit, integration, and workflow tests.
* Proficiency with Git, code reviews, Agile delivery methodologies, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.

title: Java Technical Lead - Vice President
description:

A key function within Banking and International Clients Technology is the global client onboarding process at Citi. Our team is responsible for the enterprise platform that orchestrates mission-critical client onboarding workflows across multiple business domains, including Legal, Credit, KYC/AML, and Account Opening. We empower clients and operations teams with real-time event-driven information, interactive tools, and robust APIs to automate, streamline, and accelerate end-to-end onboarding lifecycles.
  
  
We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs
* Architect and implement robust event-driven workflows and real-time streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schemas, and fault-tolerant message processing)
* Design and implement highly concurrent, low-latency solutions utilizing advanced multithreading, concurrency patterns, and JVM performance tuning
* Write clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code following modern software engineering best practices, design patterns, and enterprise security standards
* Lead end-to-end SDLC activities from architectural design, technical specification, and implementation through to automated testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, and production deployment
* Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
* Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
* Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve high-impact technical challenges in distributed production environments, leading root-cause analyses and permanent remediation
* Provide technical leadership, establish coding standards, conduct comprehensive peer code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior developers across the team

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise
* Deep, expert-level proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), object-oriented design, collections, memory management, and multithreading/concurrency models
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade microservices using the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cloud)
* Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Kafka and Event-Driven Architecture, including topic design, consumer groups, offset management, message serialization, and event streaming patterns
* Proven experience in designing, building, securing, and versioning scalable RESTful APIs
* Strong database skills working with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) including query optimization, indexing, and transactions, as well as document stores (e.g., MongoDB)
* Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, caching strategies, and resilient design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, Outbox, Retry/Backoff)
* Hands-on experience with automated unit and integration testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers)
* Familiarity with containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift) and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines
* Exposure to Kotlin is a significant advantage
* Demonstrated technical leadership, excellent analytical and debugging skills, and strong verbal and written communication abilities

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

title: Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**
to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.
  
  
This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.
  
  
The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. All AI-assisted output must be appropriately reviewed, validated, secured, and tested prior to implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable Java-based enterprise integration solutions using REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.
* The successful candidate is expected to incorporate approved AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day engineering activities, including:
* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for assigned solutions throughout the development and support lifecycle.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and development practices, including responsible use of AI-assisted capabilities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering efficiency.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

* Provide technical direction and engineering leadership for a team of engineers

title: Salesforce Apex Development (Agentforce)-Senior Consultant, Managed Services-DFO&I-Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**#DFO&I2027**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant, Managed Services o r equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Integrate and learn from talented colleagues who specialize in core domains.
* Adopt a growth mindset and invest in expanding your understanding of Deloitte’s integrated solutions and marketplace offerings.
* Develop skills within a portfolio representing the unification of diverse, globally recognized brands and businesses—an exciting opportunity for career advancement.
* Leverage opportunities for career development through exposure to unified, enterprise-level platforms and solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architects, developers, QA, and business stakeholders—to deliver holistic solutions.
* Engage in requirement gathering, solution design, and technical decision-making aligned with client business goal
* Support post-deployment activities, including maintenance, enhancements, and client communication.
* Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement through adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.
* Conduct testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality and resolve issues.
* Deliver high-quality work, ensuring timely completion of tasks and adherence to requirement.
* Demonstrate openness and initiative in learning Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, recognizing their importance for innovation and market competitiveness.
* Strong focus on data-driven decision-making and use of agile methodologies.
* Take ownership of deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or innovation.
* Uphold Deloitte’s values of integrity, client focus, and making an impact that matters.

**The team:**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Understand functional requirements translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designs using standard patterns. Should also be able to communicate this effectively to the team.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Analyse and identify gaps in functional/business requirements and should be able to effectively communicate this to both Business and Functional analysts
* Experience in configuring core Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud)
* Familiarity with declarative tools (Process Builder, Flows, Validation Rules, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modelling, governance, and security within Salesforce
* Should be able to assess the impact on technical designs caused by changes in functional requirements
* Should be able to perform independent code reviews and execute unit tests on modules developed
* Experience in Salesforce.com Development environments (VS Code)
* Knowledgeable in Apex, Visual force, Lightning Components, Lightning Web Components, SFDX
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external AI APIs and managing custom AI deployments within CRM processes
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Einstein features, AI-driven insights, and bot configuration
* Hands-on experience leveraging Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to drive automation.
* Ability to configure and optimize workflows that integrate Agentforce automation with human agent processes.
* Certifications

+ Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) certification (or equivalent experience)
+ Salesforce.com Platform Developer certifications
+ Salesforce.com Domain Certifications

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

**Job Description**
****Engineering Foundation****
*Non-negotiable. This is what we screen on first, and there is no AI in it.*

* Data modelling across SQL and NoSQL, and a clear view of where each one breaks
* Event-driven architecture in production with Kafka, RabbitMQ or equivalent. Ordering, replay, idempotency, dead-letter handling
* Distributed systems failure modes: partial failure, retries, backpressure, timeouts, circuit breakers
* Caching strategy and invalidation, at a scale where getting it wrong hurt
* Observability. You have instrumented a system, not just read someone else's dashboard
* At least one cloud deeply. Not three superficially
* API and integration patterns against real enterprise surfaces such as ERPs, CRMs and data platforms
* CI/CD, containers, release engineering
* You have owned something in production. On-call, incidents, the whole thing

Agent systems are distributed systems with a non-deterministic component in the middle. If the fundamentals are not there, the AI layer does not survive contact with production.
  
  
****AI Engineering****
*Two capabilities that do not come free with an engineering background. These are the ones we probe hardest.*
****Evaluation and Error Analysis****

* You have built an eval set for a non-deterministic system and used it to make a decision
* You can decompose a failure: is this a model problem, a retrieval problem, a data problem or a product problem?
* You debug agent behaviour systematically, with traces and evidence, not by gut feel

****Context Engineering****

* Deliberate management of what enters the model on each turn, and why
* Memory strategy: what persists across steps, across sessions, and what should not
* Tool surface design: what the agent can reach, how it is scoped, what happens when a tool fails
* Cost and latency as first-class design constraints, not something discovered in the invoice

****Consulting and Client Leadership****
*Equal weight to the engineering. This is a client-facing role in a services business.*

* Carry a market point of view on models, tooling and delivery patterns, and translate it into what it means for a specific client, in their language
* Run discovery workshops, solution reviews and delivery cadences with client teams
* Advise clients on standing up their own AI capability: practice structure, operating model, skills, governance, build versus buy, and adoption across their engineering org
* Shape and defend technical proposals, PoC plans and roadmaps. Own the story end to end
* Translate business problems into architectures for CXO-level stakeholders without hiding behind jargon
* Say no when the answer is no. Tell a client when agents are the wrong tool, and be able to explain why

****Delivery and Architecture****
*The work itself.*

* Own end-to-end delivery of AI-native programs, from architecture through production
* Design multi-agent orchestration using LangGraph, CrewAI or equivalent. Agent topology, tool routing, memory, state, fallback and recovery paths
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise systems of record, not toy datasets
* Build RAG where RAG is the right answer, from chunking through retrieval, re-ranking and evaluation
* Run agentic coding workflows with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or equivalent, and lead projects where AI writes significant portions of the codebase while you guide, review and ship it
* Work with MCP and shared-context tooling. Design what agents are permitted to reach and under what controls
* Bring governance into the design from day one: agent identity, privilege scoping, audit, human-in-the-loop, kill switches
* Contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators the wider practice can use

****Team and Practice****

* Build AI engineering capability across the delivery organisation through mentoring, standards and review quality
* Evaluate new models, frameworks and tooling before the hype catches up, and kill the ones that do not earn their place
* Contribute to internal knowledge bases and practice assets

* Someone who lists LLMs on a resume but has only called the API in a notebook
* People who explain everything in terms of frameworks they have never deployed

A distributed systems problem with no LLM in it. Event flow, data model, failure handling, scale. Twenty-five minutes.

**Role : AI Engineer (Agentic AI & LLM Solutions).**
**Team :**
CDC AI Transformation.
  
  
**Focus :**
Cloud and Data Center.
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
The AI Engineer designs, builds, tests, and operates AI and Agentic AI solutions in support of the CDC AI Transformation team.
  
  
CDC is focused on cloud and data center services, so the role applies LLMs and agents to the planning, operation, and optimisation of that environment.
  
  
You will work as a senior individual contributor inside a delivery team.
  
  
You take ownership of your own solutions and workstreams, from design through to production, and work closely with solution architects, platform teams, data teams, and business stakeholders.
  
  
You are accountable for the quality, security, and production readiness of what you build.
  
  
The role does not carry people-management or team-leadership responsibility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI & LLM Solution Development :**

* Design and build agentic solutions, including single-agent, multi-agent, and orchestration topologies.
* Implement tool-calling, state management, memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Integrate LLMs into business and operational workflows through APIs, services, and event-driven components.
* Build solutions for cloud and data center use cases, such as incident triage, capacity planning support, infrastructure knowledge assistants, ticket automation, and operational insights.
* Select models and model tiers based on cost, latency, and quality trade-offs.
* Prototype quickly, run PoCs, and take proven concepts through to production.

**Prompt Engineering & Context Design**

* Design system prompts, few-shot patterns, and chain-of-thought approaches.
* Build context assembly and retrieval strategies for each use case.
* Version, test, and maintain prompts as managed engineering artefacts.
* Optimise prompts continuously based on production feedback and evaluation results.

**RAG & Data Integration**

* Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines : ingestion, chunking, embedding, indexing, and retrieval.
* Select and configure vector databases and embedding models.
* Measure and improve retrieval quality using defined metrics.
* Work with data teams to prepare and connect sources such as runbooks, CMDB data, monitoring data, tickets, and technical documentation.

**Evaluation & Testing**

* Build evaluation harnesses : golden sets, grading rubrics, and pass-bar thresholds.
* Integrate eval suites into CI/CD pipelines so quality is checked automatically.
* Manage non-determinism by checking that eval scores are stable across consecutive runs.
* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for agent behaviour and tool use.
* Support UAT with business users and fix issues found.

**Security, Safety & Governance**

* Apply zero-trust principles : managed identities, no secrets in code, defence in depth.
* Integrate content safety checks on all LLM inputs and outputs.
* Implement guardrails for agent actions, including blast-radius limits and fallback paths, particularly where agents interact with infrastructure.
* Build and run adversarial test packs : prompt injection, jailbreak, and tool misuse.
* Produce the documentation governance needs, such as model cards, explainability notes, and audit evidence.
* Follow applicable regulation and internal policy (for example EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA) and flag registration or inventory obligations to the right owners.

**Deployment, Observability & Operations**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI workloads.
* Implement logging, tracing, telemetry, and cost tracking for AI solutions.
* Set up alerts and support hypercare and on-call arrangements for production systems.
* Monitor token usage and apply cost optimisation and model-tier selection.
* Handle post-deployment monitoring, incident analysis, and continuous improvement.

**Collaboration & Engineering Practice**

* Work with solution architects on design decisions and write clear design documents and ADRs.
* Translate business requirements from CDC stakeholders into working technical solutions.
* Give clear progress updates, estimates, and risk flags on your own workstreams.
* Take part in design reviews, code reviews, and joint go/no-go gates.
* Follow and help improve team coding standards and engineering best practices.
* Share knowledge, reusable components, and lessons learned with other engineers.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years in software engineering, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML solutions.
* Experience building agentic AI systems (multi-agent orchestration, tool-calling, state management).
* Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent).
* Solid understanding of prompt engineering : system prompts, context assembly, retrieval strategies, and evaluation methods.
* Experience with RAG architectures : vector databases, embedding models, chunking strategies, retrieval quality metrics.
* Hands-on experience with a cloud AI platform (Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD for AI workloads.
* Knowledge of identity and security patterns : managed identities, RBAC, content safety, zero-trust.
* Ability to own a workstream, manage your own deliverables, and work independently with limited supervision.

**Desirable Skills**

* Cloud and data center experience : strong understanding of cloud infrastructure (compute, networking, storage, hybrid and on-premises environments).
* Experience applying AI to infrastructure, IT operations, or AIOps use cases (monitoring, incident management, capacity forecasting, automation).
* Familiarity with ITSM tooling and processes (ServiceNow or equivalent).

title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

description:

We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.

We are seeking a customer-focused
**Support Engineer**
who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this
**high-visibility, customer-facing role**
, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
  
  
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
  
  
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.

* Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.

* Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
* On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**

* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
* Technical & Diagnostic Skills:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

* Cloud & Monitoring Systems:

+ Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

* AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* Triage & Operations:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
+ Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:

+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
+ Jenkins & Git
+ Kubernetes and Docker
+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
+ JavaScript

Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans.
