title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior AI Engineer

**Company:**
YoLearn.ai

**Location:**
Noida, India (Hybrid)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2+ years in production software engineering (1+ year shipping LLM or RAG features)

About YoLearn.ai

YoLearn.ai is an AI-powered learning platform built for school students across India (Classes 1–12 and JEE, NEET, and CUET aspirants), trusted by 100,000+ learners on web, Android, and iOS. Our voice-first AI tutors, interactive digital sketchpad, syllabus-aligned notes, and AI Co-Teacher tools help students learn, practise, and prepare for exams while saving teachers valuable time.

AI is the core of our product, not an add-on—backed by
**Pragya**
, India’s first K-12 LLM built on NEP 2020 and NCF 2023 across 12+ Indian languages. We are a small, focused team working with the latest models and shipping fast. Because most of our learners are under 18, safety and privacy shape everything we build.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior AI Engineer to build the AI that students and teachers use every day. Your primary ownership is the
**student memory layer**
: how our AI remembers each student over time and uses that context to teach better. You'll also build features from prompt to production across retrieval, agents, evaluation, and deployment.

This is a small team, so your work goes live quickly—students and teachers will be using it within weeks.

What You'll Work On

**Primary Ownership: The Student Memory Layer**

* Design and own long-term memory for our AI: what it remembers about each student across sessions and features.
* Build the memory pipeline: extracting, storing, updating, and retrieving memories, including summarisation, deduplication, and letting stale facts expire.
* Make memory improve learning: personalised explanations, recall of past mistakes and weak topics, and continuity between conversations.
* Measure memory quality: recall accuracy, relevance, latency, and cost, with evals that catch regressions.
* Keep memory safe for young users: user control, deletion, and privacy by design.

**Also on Your Plate**

* Design, build, and ship LLM-powered features for students and teachers.
* Build and improve retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over educational content.
* Build agentic workflows with tool calling.
* Set up evaluation: test sets, automated scoring, and regression checks for prompts and models.
* Balance quality, latency, and cost across LLM providers.
* Ship and run production Python services, including monitoring, debugging, and reliability.
* Build safety guardrails and privacy-first data handling for young users.
* Work with product and design to turn learning problems into AI features.

What You Need

* 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong Python (async, typing, testing).
* At least one LLM feature in production, not just a notebook or demo—you can explain what broke and how you fixed it.
* Experience building memory or personalisation for LLM applications: conversation summarisation, long-term memory stores, user profiles, or similar. You can explain what to remember, what to forget, and why.
* Hands-on RAG experience: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone, or similar), retrieval tuning, and reranking.
* Experience with LLM APIs and tool/function calling from at least one major provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or open models).
* Ability to build and run REST and WebSocket APIs (FastAPI or similar) backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.
* A data-driven approach to measuring AI quality: eval sets, metrics, and comparing prompts or models on data rather than gut feel.
* Solid engineering fundamentals: Git, Docker, debugging production issues, and writing clear, maintainable code.

Nice to Have

* **Skills:**
  Agent frameworks (such as LangGraph or LangChain), voice or multimodal AI (speech, vision, OCR), or EdTech experience.
* **Startup Mindset:**
  You’ve worked at a startup or built something from zero on your own, have a strong bias to action (ship a working version, learn from real use, iterate), and take end-to-end ownership without being asked.

What We Offer

* **Ownership:**
  Own AI features end-to-end, from architecture and design to production.
* **Real Impact:**
  Your work directly helps school students across India learn and perform better in exams.
* **Hard Problems:**
  Applied AI challenges that go well beyond a basic chatbot.
* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary based on experience.
* **Work Setup:**
  Hybrid work from our Noida office.

How to Apply

* Email
  **contact@yolearn.ai**
  with the subject
  **"Senior AI Engineer"**
  . Include your CV, your GitHub or portfolio, and a few lines on an LLM or RAG system you shipped: what it did, what went wrong, and how you measured it.

title: Head of Engineering: EHR Integration
description:
**Head of Engineering: EHR Integration**

**Pay:**
₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year

**Location:**
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

**Type:**
Full-time

**Hours:**
12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST

**Entity:**
XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)

**Department:**
EHR Integration

**On-site or remote:**
On-site, Monday through Friday

**Reports to:**
Chief Technology Officer

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

**Position Summary**

You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDox’s SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor.

**Key Responsibilities**

In this role you will:

* Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance.
* Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim.
* Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur.
* Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action.
* Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production.
* Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review.
* Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10 or more years building production software.
* 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery.
* Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact.
* Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations.
* Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems.
* Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data.
* Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team.
* Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines.

**Location and Schedule**

This role is on-site at the XIPL office in Noida, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not remote and not hybrid. Candidates outside Delhi NCR must relocate to Noida before the start date. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel.

**Compensation**

* Base salary of ₹80 to ₹120 lakh per year, commensurate with experience.
* Stock options.
* Relocation assistance, reimbursed against receipts.

**Benefits**

* Health insurance, provident fund, and leave per XIPL policy.
* Company cab service for all Noida employees.

**To Apply**

Apply at
https://careers.xpertdox.com/
.

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.

description:

12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST

XpertDox India Private Limited (XIPL)

EHR Integration

**On-site or remote:**
On-site, Monday through Friday

**Reports to:**
Chief Technology Officer

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

**Position Summary**

You own the integrations that move every XpertCoding claim from the EHR to submission. That covers the full portfolio of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance, and the reliability of the claims pipeline: scheduled runs, encounter pickup, coding handoff, claim creation, and submission. You decide how failures are detected, who responds, and what changes after an incident. You lead the EHR Integration team and are responsible for its hiring, performance, standards, and code review. The bots and pipelines handle protected health information under XpertDox’s SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA controls, and you hold the team to them. This is an architecture and leadership role. The team writes the code. You decide what gets built, how, and in what order, and you review what ships. It is not for someone who wants to spend most of the week building bots, and it is not for someone who has only managed an RPA vendor.

**Key Responsibilities**

In this role you will:

* Own the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of RPA and EHR integration across every supported EHR and client instance.
* Own the reliability of the claims pipeline from scheduled run to submitted claim.
* Define the monitoring and alerting that surfaces failures in unattended bots the same day they occur.
* Own incident response and root cause analysis for integration failures, and close every corrective action.
* Set engineering standards for the code: version control, code review, testing, release discipline, and documented configuration changes before they reach production.
* Lead the EHR Integration team: hiring, performance, standards, and code review.
* Report delivery, risks, and capacity to the CTO on a regular cadence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10 or more years building production software.
* 3 or more years leading a software engineering team with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and delivery.
* Has owned production RPA bots or integration pipelines at scale, where failures had direct business impact.
* Current architecture ability in Python for production services and integrations.
* Production experience with AWS, MongoDB, and SQL databases.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* EHR integration experience: HL7 v2, FHIR, or direct connections to major ambulatory EHR systems.
* Experience with applications that handle protected health information or other regulated data.
* Daily use of AI coding tools, such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot, to lead and raise the output of an engineering team.
* Has built monitoring, alerting, and incident ownership for unattended bots or batch pipelines.

title: Product Security Architect IRC286354
description:
**Description**
Looking for a Product Security Architect to lead our offensive and defensive security strategies. You will be embedded with engineering teams to ensure our products are resilient against sophisticated attacks. This is a “hands-on” role: you will write security-centric code, conduct deep-dive penetration tests, and automate threat detection within our pipelines. You are not just an auditor; you are a builder who solves security challenges with engineering solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Technical Mastery Required**
Security Frameworks: OWASP ASVS, SAMM, NIST 800-53, and Cloud Security Alliance (CSA).
  
  
Offensive Tools: Burp Suite Professional, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nmap, and Postman (for API hacking).
  
  
Secure Coding: Deep knowledge of vulnerabilities in Java/.NET and how to prevent them (e.g., SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF).
  
  
Cloud Security: Securing Kubernetes (K8s) secrets, IAM Least Privilege, and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP).
  
  
Identity/Auth: Expert-level understanding of JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and WebAuthn/FIDO2.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Experience: 10+ years in Cybersecurity or Software Engineering, with 4+ years specifically in Product Security or Application Security (AppSec).
  
  
Mindset: A “Breaker” mentality balanced with a “Builder’s” empathy; the ability to explain why a vulnerability matters to a product owner.
  
  
Certifications: OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
  
  
Communication: Ability to translate complex exploitation paths into clear risk assessments for non-technical leadership.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Secure Architecture & Threat Modeling

Threat Modeling: Lead structured threat modeling sessions (using STRIDE or PASTA) during the design phase to identify architectural flaws before a single line of code is written.
  
  
Architecture Reviews: Conduct deep-dive security reviews of system designs, focusing on authentication (OIDC/SAML), authorization (RBAC/ABAC), and data isolation.
  
  
Security Scaffolding: Build and maintain shared security libraries (e.g., standardized encryption wrappers, input validation modules) for use by all engineering teams.
  
  
  

* Offensive Security & Exploitation

In-House Pentesting: Perform regular manual penetration tests on web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure to identify logic flaws that automated tools miss.
  
  
Exploitation Research: Develop PoC (Proof of Concept) exploits for discovered vulnerabilities to demonstrate impact to stakeholders and validate remediation.
  
  
Bug Bounty Management: Oversee the bug bounty program, triaging reports and working directly with developers on high-severity fixes.
  
  
  

* Secure Coding & SDLC Integration

Secure Code Review: Review high-risk pull requests (e.g., changes to auth, payments, or crypto) to ensure compliance with OWASP Top 10 and ASVS.
  
  
Automation (DevSecOps): Integrate and fine-tune SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into the CI/CD pipeline to reduce “false positive” fatigue for developers.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Don’t just find bugs—write the code to fix them. Pair-program with engineers to implement secure patterns.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Senior UX Designer – Full-Stack Product Design
description:
**Role Overview:-**

As a Senior UX Designer, you will independently own and drive design initiatives across the lending product ecosystem, transforming customer insights and business requirements into seamless digital experiences.

You will collaborate closely with Product, Business, Risk, Policy, and Engineering teams to identify user pain points, validate solutions, and deliver high-quality experiences that balance customer needs with business objectives.

You will also explore AI as a design material — creating experiences that make intelligent capabilities understandable, trustworthy, transparent, and genuinely useful to customers.

**Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Product Design:-**

* Own the complete product design lifecycle, from discovery and research to wireframing, interaction design, prototyping, and final UI execution.
* Translate complex business requirements and customer challenges into simple, intuitive, and scalable design solutions.
* Independently drive design initiatives with minimal supervision and strong end-to-end accountability.
* Create seamless customer journeys across digital lending products and experiences.

2. UX Research & Customer-Centric Design

* Conduct user research, customer interviews, usability testing, and competitive benchmarking to understand customer needs and behavioral patterns.
* Identify customer pain points, aspirations, and friction points across product journeys.
* Apply data-driven insights, qualitative research, and heuristic evaluation to validate design decisions.
* Convert research findings into actionable product improvements and experience strategies.

3. UI Design & Interaction Excellence

* Develop high-quality user interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, usability, consistency, and attention to detail.
* Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs, and interactive prototypes using Figma.
* Demonstrate strong visual design sensibilities, interaction design capabilities, and motion design awareness.
* Maintain design consistency through reusable components, design systems, and established Figma best practices.
* Ensure smooth design-to-development handoffs and collaborate with frontend engineers to deliver polished experiences.

4. Product Thinking & Strategic Solutioning

* Understand product objectives and translate product strategy into clear design deliverables.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, technical feasibility, and usability.
* Explore multiple design approaches, evaluate alternatives, and recommend effective solutions.
* Build engaging, intuitive, and habit-forming digital experiences that deliver measurable customer value.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Product Managers, Business, Risk, Policy, and Engineering teams throughout the design process.
* Present and demonstrate design solutions with clarity and confidence.
* Defend design decisions using research findings, usability insights, data, and competitive benchmarking.
* Partner with frontend developers to ensure design intent is accurately translated into production.

6. AI-Powered Experience Design

* Explore AI as a design material to create intelligent, customer-friendly product experiences.
* Design interfaces that communicate AI-generated recommendations and outputs clearly and transparently.
* Make intelligent features understandable, trustworthy, and easy to interact with.
* Consider responsible AI principles, including explainability, user control, trust, and bias awareness.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:-**

* 5+ years of professional experience in Product Design, UX Design, or UI/UX Design.
* At least 3+ years of recent experience working in a product-based company.
* Strong end-to-end design capabilities across UX Research, UX Design, and UI Design.
* Proven ability to independently own projects from discovery through final design delivery.
* Strong product thinking, problem-solving, and customer-centric design approach.
* Hands-on experience with user research, usability testing, competitive analysis, and heuristic evaluation.
* Expertise in wireframing, user flows, interaction design, high-fidelity UI, and prototyping.
* Advanced working knowledge of Figma, including components, auto layout, prototyping, and design systems.
* Strong visual design sensibility, aesthetic judgment, and attention to detail.
* Experience collaborating with product teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to communicate, present, and justify design decisions using research and data.
* Strong understanding of design-to-development handoff and frontend implementation considerations.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent graduation qualification is mandatory. Higher education in Design is preferred.

**Preferred Experience:-**

* Experience in Fintech, Digital Lending, Banking Products, Financial Services, or Consumer Technology.
* Background in high-growth B2C product companies and consumer-facing digital applications.
* Startup experience with the ability to independently manage projects from ideation to launch.
* Familiarity with AI-powered product experiences and responsible AI design principles.
* Understanding of HTML, CSS, frontend technologies, or development workflows is an advantage.

Pay: ₹2,300,000.00 - ₹3,800,000.00 per year

We are Citi’s Core AI Platform Group, a start-up with the exciting mission of shaping the direction of travel for the entire bank under the Chief Operating Office. You'll have access to cutting-edge AI technologies and the latest development tools**,** real autonomy to shape our AI strategy, and opportunities to solve unique challenges at the intersection of AI and finance as you help create the agentic AI future for Northern Trust.

The Enterprise AI team at Northern Trust is part of our Technology group and performs data science research and develops custom prototypes to solve problems that 1) are not adequately addressed by available commercial solutions, 2) enhance the customer and/or employee experience and 3) provide Northern Trust with a competitive advantage. We are at the forefront of rolling out Generative AI solutions and frameworks for the bank from Proof of Concepts to full stack development of solutions and vendor evaluations. We also serve to inspire and empower applied data science practitioners by facilitating high-quality data science education and collaboration within Northern Trust as well as with top universities and research institutions.

We are seeking a highly motivated and enthusiastic Junior AI Engineer to join our dynamic team, focusing on developing and implementing cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence solutions on the Microsoft Azure cloud platform. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals passionate about AI and eager to contribute to impactful projects under the guidance of experienced AI Developer Managers and senior engineers. The AI Engineer will assist in various stages of the AI development lifecycle, from developing python code utilizing various AI frameworks and Large Language Models (LLMs) to deployment of AI solutions and their monitoring.

**As a member on the team, you will be expected to:**

Assist in the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML models and solutions on Microsoft Azure.

Collaborate with senior engineers and data scientists to collect, clean, and preprocess data for AI model training

Contribute to the development of robust and scalable AI applications using Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks

Participate in the testing, debugging, and validation of AI solutions to ensure accuracy and performance.

Help maintain and monitor deployed AI solutions, identifying and resolving issues as they arise.

Learn and apply MLOps & LLMOps best practices for continuous integration, delivery, and deployment of AI solutions.

Collaborate with senior engineers and data scientists to collect, clean, and preprocess data for AI model training.

Stay updated with the latest AI/ML technologies and Azure AI services through continuous learning and training

Implement and optimize AI algorithms and solutions under supervision.

Provide support for existing AI solutions and contribute to their improvement.

Be prepared to develop AI systems leveraging open-source frameworks such as: LangChain, AutoGen, LangGraph and LamaIndex.

Be willing to learn cloud automation concepts such as IAC with various tools, and cloud security concepts and principles.

Participate in an agile (scrum) development process

**To be successful, you will have:**

Python development skills utilizing standard development IDEs

DevOps including CI/CD techniques and tools such as Github repos

Some data science background and course work is desired

Have a good understanding of Generative AI and LLM models and principals

Have a good understanding of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)

Basic level cloud infrastructure understanding

Education required: Computer Science degree

Preferred education: Data Science specific graduate work, Finance sector experience or coursework.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore)
description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore) Responsibilities:**

* Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
* Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
* Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
* Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.
* Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers.
* Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
* Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
* Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engagements with external engineering teams (e.g., Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture) and translate complex business constraints into robust system designs
* Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between field deployments and internal engineering, using hands-on customer insights to directly shape core product and platform roadmaps
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Microsoft Innovation Hub empowers customers to overcome their business challenges through innovative engagements that integrate multiple areas of expertise. We drive AI transformation by leveraging evolving needs and emerging business opportunities. As the future of technologists and enterprise technical sellers, we guide customers from envisioning solutions to implementation. Develop skills in AI management and security, real-time intelligence, and application architecture to support AI transformation initiatives. Stay updated with the market trends and collaborate within technical communities.
* Technical Sales and Sales Leadership: Act as a strategic change agent within the business to shape Microsoft's programs and engineering offerings. Lead the creation of scalable, field-relevant assets through internal communities. Champion Hub engagement success by connecting technical capabilities to sales opportunities and serving as a trusted voice with sales leaders and account teams.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Experience. 15+ years of related experience in Solution Architecture, technical pre-sales and/or technical consulting roles preferred.
* Hands-on experience and exposure to the Microsoft Cloud Apps and Infrastructure including the Agentic AI Stack
* Industry Certifications/accreditations in ‘Architecting & Designing large Scale Enterprise Solutions’ (Azure and/or GCP/AWS) is a must.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.

This position requires deep technical expertise, particularly as a hands-on-architect, as well as possess breadth of experience.

Below are preferred Qualifications

* Enterprise Architect Experience: Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect, designing and implementing large-scale, complex solutions that align with business goals and technical requirements. Ability to integrate various technologies and platforms to create cohesive and scalable architectures.
* Consultative Selling: Proven experience in a consultancy role, providing expert guidance and strategic recommendations to customers. Ability to navigate complex technical landscapes and deliver tailored solutions that meet specific customer needs.
* Strategic & Structured Facilitator: Validated customer experience in requirements capture; prioritization; capturing evidence and impact to quantify business value; issue, risk and constraint identification with a focus on strategic goals and outcomes.
* AI Solution Design Experience: Expertise in designing architectures, building, and deploying AI solutions. Experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, networking, adjacent technologies, architecture designs, migrations, and industry standards. Understanding of AI related Microsoft Cloud services.
* Design Thinking: Proven experience of delivering design thinking; ‘ideation’; or similar context analysis / problem framing.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, Go)**

**Department:** Engineering  
**Role:** Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)  
**Specialization:** Applied AI, Full-Stack Engineering & Systems Integration  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Model:** Remote / Hybrid

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer who can work closely with customers and internal teams to understand business problems, design technical solutions, and deliver production-ready software.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, and customer-facing technical implementation.

You will be responsible for translating loosely defined business requirements into working applications, integrating existing systems and third-party APIs, automating workflows, and deploying solutions into production environments.

The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer comfortable working across the full technology stack, making architectural decisions, troubleshooting infrastructure, and adapting quickly to unfamiliar technologies.

Rather than focusing exclusively on building isolated software components, you will own problems end-to-end — from understanding the requirements to implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

Key Responsibilities1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development

* Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business workflows, technical constraints, and operational challenges.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve existing workflows.
* Build prototypes and proof-of-concept applications to validate proposed solutions.
* Develop customized software solutions using existing platforms, APIs, and frameworks.
* Own technical delivery from initial discovery through production deployment.

2. Full-Stack Application Development

* Design and develop web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
* Build REST APIs, backend services, and asynchronous processing workflows.
* Develop responsive interfaces and interactive dashboards.
* Integrate third-party services, APIs, and content management systems.
* Design and manage relational databases, data models, and application storage.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs between monolithic applications, microservices, and lightweight serverless solutions.
* Maintain and improve existing applications while minimizing unnecessary infrastructure complexity.

3. Applied AI & LLM Integration

* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into business applications using commercial and open-source APIs.
* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for knowledge retrieval and contextual information processing.
* Build AI-powered automation workflows for document processing, content analysis, monitoring, and summarization.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications through APIs and reusable services.
* Evaluate model performance, response quality, latency, and operational costs.
* Implement appropriate validation, error handling, and fallback mechanisms for AI-powered workflows.
* Experiment with agentic workflows and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity.

4. Infrastructure & Deployment

* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and other hosting platforms.
* Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployment environments.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment.
* Manage Linux-based servers, networking, application processes, and system services.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform.
* Implement monitoring, logging, backup, and recovery mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve application reliability.
* Optimize infrastructure costs and operational overhead.

5. System Integration & Automation

* Integrate disparate business systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors.
* Build automation scripts and lightweight services to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
* Work with databases, CMS platforms, spreadsheets, and external data sources.
* Develop data extraction and processing workflows.
* Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate existing software platforms before deciding whether custom development is necessary.

6. Technical Ownership & Collaboration

* Take ownership of assigned technical projects and deliver working solutions independently.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, customer success teams, and other engineers.
* Communicate technical decisions and implementation trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document application architecture, deployment procedures, and integration workflows.
* Identify technical risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Balance implementation speed, maintainability, reliability, and business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

**Programming Languages**

* Strong proficiency in Python or another backend programming language.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux environments.

**Backend Development**

* Experience building APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or equivalent.
* Understanding of REST architecture, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, or similar databases.

**Frontend Development**

* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Svelte, or Vue.
* Experience building responsive web applications.
* Understanding of component-based architecture and frontend-backend integration.

**Applied AI**

Fluency in English

title: Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification
description:
**Date posted** 11/12/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19736****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/12/2026**

**Job Title**: - Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You are a recognized technical leader who thinks in systems, not individual IP blocks. You understand where interoperability challenges emerge at architectural boundaries, configurations, initialization sequences, protocol interactions, firmware dependencies, clock and reset domains, implementation constraints and assumptions made between independently developed IP. Deep hands-on verification expertise combines with your ability to define technical strategy, influence architecture, and lead engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. You are equally comfortable defining a subsystem verification architecture, reviewing SystemVerilog/UVM environments, analyzing coverage, debugging a challenging Controller-PHY interaction in Verdi, developing automation in Python and presenting technical direction to senior R&D leadership. You don't simply debug interoperability problems. You architect them out of the system. The most complex cross-IP technical investigations energize you because solving them well means preventing entire classes of failures before they reach customers. At Synopsys, you will help build the next generation of subsystem interoperability verification across high-speed interface IPs, and you will pioneer how GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows transform verification from reactive debugging into continuous intelligent qualification.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define the technical vision for subsystem interoperability spanning Controller, PHY, firmware, VIP, verification environments, and customer configurations across multiple high-speed interface IP families
* Architect a scalable Interop Verification Platform that enables continuous integration, verification, and qualification across IP releases, solving the configuration challenge across Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Protocol Mode × Customer Configuration using intelligent risk and coverage-based qualification
* Establish reusable verification architectures, methodologies and golden reference environments covering functional verification, protocol compliance, error and stress scenarios, coverage, assertions, CDC/RDC and system initialization
* Lead the most complex cross-IP technical investigations and drive systemic solutions across RTL, PHY, firmware, VIP, testbench and implementation boundaries when interoperability issues surface
* Partner with Controller and PHY architects and R&D teams to influence interfaces, observability, design-for-verification and subsystem architecture early in the development lifecycle
* Pioneer an AI-native verification architecture that applies GenAI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows across the verification lifecycle: specification to verification intent to environment to tests to regression to debug to qualification to learning
* Architect AI-assisted generation of environments and tests, intelligent regression selection, automated log and failure clustering, coverage-gap analysis, protocol and waveform debug, root-cause recommendations, engineering knowledge retrieval and automated qualification evidence

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Transform interoperability from a late-stage integration activity into a continuous product capability that accelerates subsystem bring-up and qualification across Synopsys IP portfolios
* Scale verification across increasingly complex IP configurations, enabling Synopsys to deliver subsystems that work together seamlessly before they reach customer environments
* Convert field issues into permanent prevention tests and reusable engineering knowledge, reducing repeat failures and building institutional memory into the verification platform
* Establish common interoperability methodology across multiple IP families including UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB and AMBA/CHI, creating consistency and reuse across product lines
* Create an AI-native verification architecture capable of scaling engineering expertise across products and organizations, fundamentally changing how Synopsys qualifies complex subsystems
* Define compatibility matrices and qualification criteria that provide clear, evidence-based confidence that a specific Controller-PHY combination is customer ready, reducing integration risk and time-to-market
* Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical authority for subsystem interoperability, raising the bar for verification excellence across the organization

**What You'll Need**

* 15+ years of ASIC/IP/SoC verification experience with demonstrated technical leadership on complex verification programs where you defined architecture, influenced direction, and delivered results across organizational boundaries
* Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, functional and code coverage, verification closure and complex debug, with hands-on experience building and reviewing sophisticated verification environments
* Proven experience architecting reusable verification environments for IP, subsystem or SoC designs that scaled across multiple projects or product lines
* Strong expertise in one or more high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB or AMBA/CHI, with deep understanding of protocol interactions, initialization sequences, and interoperability challenges
* Hands-on expertise with industry-standard simulation and debug tools, VIP and coverage infrastructure, specifically VCS and Verdi or equivalent toolchains
* Strong automation expertise in Python, Tcl or equivalent scripting languages, with a track record of building tools that improve verification productivity
* Experience with CDC/RDC, formal verification, emulation/prototyping, CI/CD or distributed verification infrastructure is highly desirable, as is experience or strong interest in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI and AI-assisted verification

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room where a Controller-PHY integration is failing in a customer configuration, debug the waveforms in Verdi, identify the root cause across firmware, RTL and protocol assumptions, and define the systemic fix that prevents similar issues across all future configurations
* You influence technical direction and align teams without relying on organizational authority, using technical credibility, clear communication and a track record of solving hard problems to drive consensus
* You mentor senior engineers by showing them how to think about verification architecture, not just how to write better tests, raising the technical bar for everyone around you
* You balance deep technical work with strategic thinking, moving fluidly between reviewing a UVM testbench, defining a three-year verification roadmap, and presenting technical direction to R&D leadership
* You see AI and LLMs not as hype but as tools that can fundamentally change how verification scales, and you are ready to architect how GenAI integrates into the verification lifecycle from specification to qualification
* You push back when an interface design creates unnecessary interoperability risk or when a qualification plan lacks evidence, because you care more about building systems that work than making everyone comfortable

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will work within the IP R&D organization at Synopsys, partnering closely with Controller and PHY architects, verification teams, firmware engineers, and VIP developers across multiple high-speed interface IP families. Your role sits at the intersection of these teams, defining the technical architecture and methodology that enables subsystems to work together seamlessly. You will collaborate with engineers in Bangalore and across global R&D sites, influencing technical direction and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. This is a highly visible technical leadership role with direct impact on how Synopsys delivers complex IP subsystems to customers.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**About the UNIT/ Unit Overview**

AIRE (AI-native Requirements Engineering) is a new BMW Group tool for managing vehicle requirements, the descriptions of what a car and its software must do. It keeps the full history of every requirement, shows how requirements are linked to each other and to tests, and shows what is affected when something changes. It helps teams meet automotive standards such as Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262. AIRE is built for AI agents first and a user interface later, and the team uses AI agents to help build it. In this role you set up the AI agents, tools and rules the team uses to build AIRE, and the AI features inside the product.

  

**Location**

Pune / Bangalore

  

**Experience**

  
  

**Number of openings**

1

  

**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

* Design, build and operate the AI-native delivery harness for AIRE across the whole SDLC: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, release and operation.

* Own the shared agent assets: agents, skills, instructions, specification templates and MCP tool configurations. Keep them versioned, reviewed, tested and aligned with the architecture and the requirements.

* Define and implement the verification loops for agent-generated work, including static checks, tests, AI evaluations, architecture fitness functions and the required human approval gates.

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of eight years of software or platform engineering experience, including at least two years of hands-on work with LLM-based agents and AI-assisted software delivery.

The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.

The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Application Development**

* Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
* Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
* Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
* Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**

* Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
* Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
* Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

**Secure Development & Technology Risk**

* Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
* Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
* Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
* Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**

* Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
* Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
* Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**

* Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
* Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.

title: Founding Engineer - Delivery
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to run delivery like it's their own company — not manage tickets, but own outcomes. You'll sit at the center of client relationships, technical architecture, and team growth. This isn't a management role in the corporate sense — it's a build-and-own role for someone hands-on who's ready to stop being told what to build and start deciding it.

If you've been doing solid work for 5-8 years but feel like you're capped, coasting, or just executing someone else's roadmap — this is the opposite of that.

**What you will own.**

* **Client relationships**

  — run requirement calls directly, translate business needs into technical specs without a middleman
* **Architecture decisions**

  — make the calls on how things get built, not just how they get coded
* **Code quality**

  — review the team's work, set the bar
* **Team growth**

  — unblock junior developers, mentor them into stronger engineers
* **Hands-on development**

  — when bandwidth allows, build features yourself; this isn't a pure-management seat
* **Project health**

  — track delivery status, catch issues before the client does, fix them fast

**What we are looking for**

* 5-8 years of full-stack experience (MERN preferred); comfortable across the stack, not siloed
* Real client-facing experience — you've sat in requirement calls and owned the outcome, not relayed messages
* A track record of
  **building and owning**

  something end-to-end — not just maintaining what others designed
* Startup or small-team background preferred — you're used to ambiguity, not process for its own sake
* Some experience mentoring or leading other developers, even informally
* Still writes code regularly — if you haven't shipped anything hands-on in 2+ years, this isn't the fit
* Low job-hop history — we're looking for someone who wants to build something over years, not months

**What this isn't**

* Not a pure people-management role — you'll still write code
* Not a ticket-execution job — we want judgment, not just delivery against a spec
* Not a place for "20 years of experience, comfortable in my lane" — if the title matters more to you than the ownership, this probably isn't it

**Compensation**

Competitive, based on experience — with room to grow as the role and the company do.

**Location**

Chennai, in-office.

Apply at: https://hire.yalabs.tech/apply

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Now (Tez)
description:
**Description**
Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.
  
  
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

**About The Team**
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:

**#DFO&I2027**

The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. **Position Summary**

Senior Consultant, Managed Services o r equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Integrate and learn from talented colleagues who specialize in core domains.
* Adopt a growth mindset and invest in expanding your understanding of Deloitte’s integrated solutions and marketplace offerings.
* Develop skills within a portfolio representing the unification of diverse, globally recognized brands and businesses—an exciting opportunity for career advancement.
* Leverage opportunities for career development through exposure to unified, enterprise-level platforms and solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architects, developers, QA, and business stakeholders—to deliver holistic solutions.
* Engage in requirement gathering, solution design, and technical decision-making aligned with client business goal
* Support post-deployment activities, including maintenance, enhancements, and client communication.
* Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement through adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.
* Conduct testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality and resolve issues.
* Deliver high-quality work, ensuring timely completion of tasks and adherence to requirement.
* Demonstrate openness and initiative in learning Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, recognizing their importance for innovation and market competitiveness.
* Strong focus on data-driven decision-making and use of agile methodologies.
* Take ownership of deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or innovation.
* Uphold Deloitte’s values of integrity, client focus, and making an impact that matters.

Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Understand functional requirements translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designs using standard patterns. Should also be able to communicate this effectively to the team.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Analyse and identify gaps in functional/business requirements and should be able to effectively communicate this to both Business and Functional analysts
* Experience in configuring core Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud)
* Familiarity with declarative tools (Process Builder, Flows, Validation Rules, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modelling, governance, and security within Salesforce
* Should be able to assess the impact on technical designs caused by changes in functional requirements
* Should be able to perform independent code reviews and execute unit tests on modules developed
* Experience in Salesforce.com Development environments (VS Code)
* Knowledgeable in Apex, Visual force, Lightning Components, Lightning Web Components, SFDX
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external AI APIs and managing custom AI deployments within CRM processes
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Einstein features, AI-driven insights, and bot configuration
* Hands-on experience leveraging Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to drive automation.
* Ability to configure and optimize workflows that integrate Agentforce automation with human agent processes.
* Certifications
* Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) certification (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce.com Platform Developer certifications
* Salesforce.com Domain Certifications

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.
