title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

  

  
* Strong ownership and accountability.
  
  
* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.

* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Paragon

Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

title: Assistant Manager
description:
WFM Capacity Planner

**DEPARTMENT : Workforce Management**

**EMPLOYMENT : Full-time**

**REPORTS TO : Assistant Manager/Lead WFM**

**Position Summary**

The WFM Capacity Planner converts demand forecasts into practical, financially responsible workforce plans across programs, sites, channels, and skill groups. The role owns long-range and medium-range capacity views, headcount requirements, hiring and training demand, attrition and shrinkage assumptions, staffing-risk scenarios, and executive-ready recommendations.

The successful candidate connects Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Human Resources, and WFM so that hiring and workforce actions are initiated early enough to protect client service commitments, employee readiness, and cost targets.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**Maintain a clear view of future workforce demand and supply, quantify risks early, and recommend the right staffing action at the right time.**

Key Responsibilities

Capacity planning and modeling

* Build rolling capacity plans by program, site, channel, skill, and planning horizon.
* Translate volume, AHT or productivity, SLA, backlog, shrinkage, occupancy, and hours of operation into required FTE and headcount.
* Maintain base, upside, downside, and contingency scenarios with transparent assumptions.

Hiring and training demand

* Calculate weekly and monthly hiring needs, class timing, training capacity, nesting, learning curves, hiring yield, and production-readiness dates.
* Track approved demand against recruiting supply, training graduation, deployment, and productive headcount.
* Identify the decision deadlines required to prevent staffing gaps.

Headcount supply and staffing risk

* Reconcile rostered, budgeted, scheduled, and productive headcount with approved positions.
* Incorporate attrition, absenteeism, leave, internal movement, shrinkage, training, and productivity ramp into supply plans.
* Quantify surpluses and deficits and recommend hiring, overtime, redeployment, cross-skilling, schedule changes, or other mitigations.

Scenario and sensitivity analysis

* Model changes in demand, AHT, productivity, service targets, channel mix, automation, site allocation, shrinkage, attrition, and hiring performance.
* Explain the FTE, cost, service, and timing implications of each scenario.
* Present a recommended option, alternatives, risks, assumptions, and decision dates.

Financial and stakeholder governance

* Connect capacity decisions to labor cost, overtime, contractors, idle capacity, recruitment, training, transitions, and budget outlook.
* Lead recurring capacity reviews with Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, HR, and WFM.
* Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and unresolved assumptions; escalate missed lead times promptly.

Planning quality and continuous improvement

* Maintain version control, assumption logs, model documentation, data-quality checks, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
* Automate recurring reporting and reduce spreadsheet risk through Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Python, or approved tools.
* Protect confidential workforce and financial data and follow contractual, policy, and labor requirements.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in Workforce Management, capacity planning, workforce planning, forecasting, financial planning, or resource planning in a contact-center, BPO, shared-services, or operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to convert demand forecasts into FTE, headcount, hiring, training, and cost plans across multiple time horizons.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including structured models, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, scenario analysis, data validation, and executive-ready outputs.
* Strong knowledge of contact-center and back-office metrics, including volume, AHT, productivity, shrinkage, occupancy, attrition, service level, backlog, utilization, schedule efficiency, and cost per FTE or transaction.
* Experience with a WFM platform such as NICE IEX, Verint, Alvaria / Aspect, Genesys WFM, Calabrio, or an equivalent planning solution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain assumptions, trade-offs, financial impact, and workforce risk to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work with incomplete data while documenting limitations, confidence levels, and improvement actions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting multi-site, multi-skill, multilingual, omnichannel, or global operations.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other analytics and visualization technologies.
* Understanding of Erlang-based staffing, simulation, backlog planning, deferred-work capacity, and skills-based routing.
* Experience partnering directly with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Operations, and client-facing leadership.
* Recognized WFM, analytics, finance, Lean, or Six Sigma certification.

How Success Will Be Measured

**KPI**

**CADENCE**

**Capacity-plan accuracy**

FTE and HC reconcile to approved demand, productivity, shrinkage, and service objectives.

Monthly / quarterly

**Hiring-plan attainment**

Classes, training capacity, yield, and production-ready dates are tracked against plan.

Weekly / monthly

**Staffing-gap control**

Material deficits and surpluses are identified early, quantified, assigned, and escalated.

Weekly

**Plan-versus-actual variance**

HC, attrition, shrinkage, productivity, and cost variances include root cause and action.

Monthly

**Scenario quality**

Scenarios are complete, traceable, timely, and explain assumptions and trade-offs.

As required

**Governance quality**

Models are controlled, documented, reproducible, accurate, and delivered on schedule.

**Monthly**

What a Strong Candidate Demonstrates

* Clearly distinguishes demand, workload, required FTE, scheduled FTE, productive headcount, rostered headcount, and budgeted headcount.
* Builds transparent models with an auditable assumption chain rather than unexplained or hard-coded outputs.
* Understands that hiring plans must include lead time, hiring yield, training capacity, graduation, nesting, attrition, shrinkage, and productivity ramp.
* Challenges unrealistic assumptions constructively and quantifies the cost, service, and timing consequences.
* Communicates one recommendation, viable alternatives, key risks, owners, and decision deadlines in a concise executive format.

**READY TO SHAPE THE FUTURE WORKFORCE?**

Apply through the official Movate careers channel. Candidates may be asked to complete a capacity-planning case study as part of the selection process.

title: Program Manager - GeoAnalytics
description:
**About us**

WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india.org

**Job Highlight:**

WRI India is seeking a Manager – GeoAnalytics to strengthen the GeoAnalytics team's capabilities in geospatial analytics, software engineering and digital product development. This role will have a dual focus: leading the development and operationalization of Climate Lens, WRI India's integrated climate intelligence and decision-support platform, while managing and contributing to the development of geospatial software applications and analytical solutions across WRI India's programmes.

The position will combine product management, technical leadership, software development and project coordination. The successful candidate will work closely with research and programme teams to translate complex environmental, climate and urban challenges into robust, scalable and user-oriented digital solutions.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that analytical methodologies and research outputs are translated into reusable digital products, supported by sound software architecture, reliable data infrastructure and effective user experiences. The candidate will also contribute to building shared technical capabilities, reusable software components and engineering standards within the GeoAnalytics team.

**What you will do:**

The role will be structured around two complementary areas of responsibility.

1. Climate Lens – Digital Product Development and Management (50%)

Lead the end-to-end development, implementation and continuous improvement of Climate Lens, ensuring that it evolves into a scalable and operational climate intelligence platform supporting evidence-based planning, adaptation and investment decisions.

Product Strategy and Management

* Lead the product development roadmap for Climate Lens, translating the platform vision, strategic objectives and programme requirements into defined product features, development priorities and implementation plans.
* Work closely with GeoAnalytics, Cities and other programme teams to identify user needs, define product requirements and translate climate research methodologies into digital workflows.
* Define product specifications, functional requirements, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and feature-level development plans.
* Coordinate product development activities across research, design, data science and software engineering teams, ensuring alignment between analytical requirements and technical implementation.
* Manage product priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies and delivery milestones.

Technical Development and Integration

* Lead the development and operationalization of Climate Lens
* Oversee the development of shared platform capabilities, including climate data integration, climate hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, adaptation planning, scenario modelling and decision-support functionalities.
* Drive the digital productization of WRI India's Climate Hazard Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) methodology into standardized, configurable and reusable analytical workflows.
* Coordinate the integration of the Urban NbS FinLink finance-search functionality into Climate Lens, ensuring that users can access project assessment and climate finance discovery capabilities across the three geographic applications.
* Work with software developers and technical partners to define system architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines and integration requirements.
* Ensure that the platform is modular, interoperable, scalable and designed for future expansion across cities, states and thematic applications.

Product Quality, Validation and Adoption

* Establish product development processes, including prototyping, technical validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), release management and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate pilot testing and stakeholder consultations with government agencies, urban local bodies and other intended users.
* Define product performance indicators and monitor platform adoption, user engagement, analytical utilization and institutional uptake.
* Translate user feedback and implementation experience into product enhancements and development priorities.
* Develop product documentation, user guides, technical specifications and onboarding materials.
* Support institutional partnerships, technical presentations and resource mobilization related to Climate Lens.

2. GeoAnalytics and Software Development (50%)

Lead and contribute to the development of geospatial software applications, data-driven solutions and reusable technology components across WRI India's programmes and projects.

Application Development

* Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications, geospatial platforms, dashboards and digital tools to address programme and research requirements.
* Develop backend services, APIs and frontend applications using appropriate modern software development frameworks and technologies.
* Develop and maintain geospatial data services and workflows using technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL, GeoPandas and Google Earth Engine.
* Build reusable software components, libraries and modules that can be applied across multiple WRI India products and projects.
* Contribute to the development of open-source, interoperable and publicly accessible digital products, including platforms aligned with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) principles.
* Integrate geospatial analytics, data visualization and AI/ML capabilities into digital applications where relevant.

Engineering Standards

* Establish and promote good software engineering practices, including coding standards, version control, documentation, code reviews and testing.
* Support the implementation of pipelines, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure and application monitoring.
* Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies, open-source frameworks and AI-enabled development approaches for their potential application within WRI India.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, research associates and other members of the GeoAnalytics team.
* Maintain technical documentation, reusable code repositories and institutional knowledge resources.

Project Coordination and Collaboration

* Coordinate with programme teams to understand project requirements, define technical scope and ensure timely delivery of analytical and software development outputs.
* Manage technical work plans, development milestones, resource requirements and project dependencies.
* Provide technical guidance to project teams and support the integration of geospatial and software solutions into programme activities.
* Contribute to research publications, technical reports, proposals, presentations and other institutional knowledge products.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, Geography, Geospatial Science, Remote Sensing or a related technical discipline.
* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience in software development, geospatial technology, digital product development or a related field.

**Potential Salary and Benefits:** *INR 18,00,000 to 24,00,000 Annum*

*“Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.”*

**Location: New Delhi**

**Duration**: 1 Year (Extendable based on performance and project requirements)

**Start date:** As soon as possible

**List of Documents to be attached:**

* **Cover Letter**
* **Resume**

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose.

**How to Apply**

Qualified applicants should apply online at wri-india.org career section. All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position.

*Kindly note that WRI India’s recruitment process does not involve any payment at any stage. Applicants will never be asked to share bank account or financial information as part of the application. All official communication and offer letters are issued only through authorised WRI India email IDs.*

**About Smile Foundation:**

Smile Foundation works for the welfare of underprivileged children and their families through Programmes focused on education, healthcare, skilling and women empowerment and Empowering Grassroots. The organization also holds Special Consultative Status with United Nation’s Economic & Social Council

(ECOSOC), accredited with global organizations like GuideStar, United Way, CAF America, Give2Asia and many more. Furthermore, Smile Foundation has been a Great Place to Work © Certified organization for the last Six years running and is considered ‘Gold Standard’ in identifying and recognizing Great Workplace Cultures.

Currently SF is implementing projects across India directly or with the help of grassroot organizations. These are primarily CSR funded projects of varied scale in both urban and rural settings including aspirational districts in thematic areas. The wealth of knowledge emanating from our work is immense, which is curated systematically for purposes ranging from raising funds to driving programmatic change. towards creating large scale impact.

Visit our website to know more about us and our latest development:

www.smilefoundationindia.org

**Summary of the Project:**

India faces a significant and growing burden of hypertension, with low levels of awareness, treatment and control, particularly in underserved rural communities.

Smile Foundation is implementing a 12-month Hypertension Control Project aimed at strengthening hypertension prevention, detection, treatment linkage and continuity of care in underserved rural communities.

The project aims to strengthen hypertension management through dedicated teams, focusing on community awareness, population-based screening, early identification of hypertension, facilitation of treatment initiation, medication adherence and regular follow-up. It will also leverage digital patient management systems and community-based teams to strengthen the continuum of care.

The project will be implemented in the same areas as Smile on Wheels (SOW-Mobile Medical Units), working in collaboration with state and district health authorities and existing public health systems, particularly the India Hypertension Control Initiative (IHCI).

**Summary of the Role:**

The Project Manager will lead the overall planning, coordination, implementation and monitoring of the Hypertension Control Project across designated states.

The Project Manager will ensure that Project activities are implemented within agreed timelines, operational plans and budgets, and that project deliverables and outcomes are achieved. The role will involve extensive coordination with internal teams, government stakeholders, technical experts, field personnel and implementing partners, with strong ownership, stakeholder engagement and data- driven decision-making.

The position requires a professional with demonstrated experience in implementing Non-Communicable Disease (NCD) Projects, particularly hypertension or other chronic disease interventions, and the ability to work closely with government health departments and district-level health systems. Key duties include program implementation, coordinating with government officials, conducting monitoring& evaluation (M&E), and providing technical expertise, usually requiring clinical background, public health degree and field experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**A. Project Planning and Implementation**

* + Lead the planning, coordination and implementation of the annual and monthly Project implementation plans, including activity schedules, milestones and deliverables, across the designated states, districts and project locations through teams.
  + Ensure timely implementation of community mobilisation, awareness generation, hypertension screening, referral and treatment linkage activities.
  + Monitor field-level implementation and ensure adherence to approved Project protocols, operational guidelines and timelines.
  + Identify implementation challenges and facilitate timely corrective action.

**B. Government Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement**

* + Establish and maintain effective working relationships with State Health Departments, State NCD Cells, District Health Authorities and relevant government health facilities.
  + Coordinate with government stakeholders to secure necessary administrative approvals and facilitate Project implementation.
  + Facilitate linkages with PHCs, CHCs and other public health facilities for diagnosis confirmation, treatment initiation, medicine access and patient follow-up.
  + Organise and participate in government review meetings and project progress discussions.

**C. Operational and Field Management**

* + Oversee day-to-day Project operations across project geographies and ensure effective deployment of personnel and resources.
  + Coordinate the work of 25 Patient Navigation Officers and 50 Community Health Workers, along with the technical consultant and other Project personnel.
  + Ensure timely recruitment, onboarding, training and deployment of project staff.
  + Monitor procurement, distribution and utilisation of BP monitors, tablets, IEC materials and other Project resources.
  + Undertake regular field visits to assess Project implementation, service quality, staff performance and community engagement.
  + Resolve operational bottlenecks and ensure effective coordination between field teams and government health facilities.

**D. Clinical and Technical Coordination**

* + Work closely with the technical consultant to ensure that clinical protocols, screening tools, referral pathways and training materials are developed and implemented in accordance with national and state guidelines.
  + Ensure that field teams are adequately trained in hypertension screening, counselling, referral and patient follow-up.
  + Facilitate the integration of screening, treatment and follow-up activities with existing public health systems.

**E. Monitoring, Evaluation and Reporting**

* + Establish and maintain effective Project monitoring systems to track progress against agreed objectives, targets and indicators.
  + Monitor key Project indicators, including:
  + Linkage established with state and district health system for alignment with government NCD programs
  + Securing administrative approvals for service delivery
  + 100% of project staff recruited, trained and onboarded
  + Number of community awareness sessions.
  + Number of people identified with suspected hypertension and diagnoses confirmed.
  + Number of patients initiated on treatment.
  + Number of patients receiving regular follow-up.
  + Number of patients achieving BP control.
  + Ensure timely and accurate data collection, validation, analysis and reporting.
  + Prepare weekly progress reports, fortnightly updates, monthly reports and periodic donor reports.
  + Identify gaps in the continuum of care and recommend corrective measures to improve treatment adherence, follow-up and BP control.

**F. Project Review and Coordination**

* + Conduct regular internal Project review meetings and monitor progress against the approved implementation plan and Gantt chart.
  + Coordinate fortnightly Project review calls with the technical and Project teams.
  + Facilitate periodic reviews with government stakeholders and other relevant partners.
  + Ensure timely documentation of Project progress, challenges, lessons learnt and good practices.

G. Any other tasks based on project and management requirements.

**Educational Qualifications**

* + Postgraduate degree in Public Health, Health Administration, Hospital Administration or a related discipline.
  + Candidates with a postgraduate qualification in management and a relevant health-sector background may also be considered.

**Experience and Essential Competencies**

* + 5–8 years of relevant professional experience in planning, managing and implementing public health Projects, with demonstrated field experience.
  + Prior experience in hypertension, diabetes or other NCD prevention and control Projects will be strongly preferred.
  + Demonstrated experience in government liaison and coordination with State and District Health Departments, NHM, NCD Cells and public health facilities.
  + Strong operational experience in managing multi-location field Projects, including staff deployment, field monitoring, logistics and implementation oversight.
  + Experience in coordinating community-based screening, referral, treatment linkage and follow-up interventions.
  + Familiarity with government health Projects and national guidelines, particularly IHCI and NPCDCS/NCD-related initiatives, will be an advantage.
  + Experience in Project monitoring, indicator tracking, data analysis, report writing and donor reporting.
  + Working knowledge of digital data collection and patient management systems.

**Key Skills and Attributes**

* + Strong Project management, planning and execution capabilities.
  + Excellent coordination, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  + Ability to work effectively with government officials and multiple institutional stakeholders.
  + Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  + Ability to manage geographically dispersed teams and multiple operational priorities.
  + Good analytical, documentation and report-writing skills.
  + Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  + Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables and meet tight implementation timelines.
  + Willingness and ability to undertake frequent travel to project states and districts.

**Location and Other Requirements**

* + The position will be based at Smile Foundation's office in New Delhi.
  + The role requires regular travel to designated project states and districts for Project implementation, government coordination, field monitoring and review.
  + Candidates must be willing to undertake extensive domestic travel as required by Project needs.

**Key Performance Expectations**

**The Project Manager will be accountable for:**

* + Timely achievement of Project milestones and deliverables as per the approved implementation plan.
  + Effective coordination with government health systems and timely completion of required approvals and linkages.
  + Successful recruitment, deployment and management of Project personnel.
  + Operational readiness and effective implementation across all designated project locations.
  + Quality and completeness of Project data and timely submission of reports.
  + Effective functioning of screening, referral, treatment linkage and patient follow-up mechanisms.
  + Progress towards improved treatment adherence and hypertension control among identified patients.

title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced iOS Developer with 5–7 years of professional experience in building modern iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
  
  
The ideal candidate must have significant experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and a strong grasp of iOS system frameworks and app lifecycle management.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Develop and maintain robust iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.
* Implement and maintain BLE communication, handling connections, pairing, data exchange, and background operations.
* Collaborate with designers and engineers to deliver high-quality user experiences.
* Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code following best practices.
* Optimize applications for performance and memory usage.
* Unit testing, debugging, and performance profiling.
* Contribute to architectural decisions and code reviews.
* Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) in day-to-day delivery to accelerate development, refactoring, debugging, and documentation.
* Review, validate, and take ownership of AI-generated code, ensuring it meets quality, security, performance, and architectural standards before it is merged.
* Leverage AI to generate and improve unit, integration, and UI test cases, and to support code reviews and release notes.
* Contribute to team practices for AI-assisted delivery, including prompt patterns, reusable context or rule files, and guidelines for responsible use of AI on client code.

Required Skills:
  
  

* 5–7 years of hands-on iOS development experience.
* Expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, and Foundation.
* Proven experience working with CoreBluetooth and BLE peripheral/central modes.
* Understanding of iOS app lifecycle, memory management, and background modes.
* Familiarity with MVVM and Clean Architecture in iOS development.
* Proficient in integrating RESTful APIs using URLSession or third-party libraries like Alamofire.
* Experience in managing local data using CoreData or Realm.
* Knowledge of App Store guidelines, provisioning, and deployment.
* Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools in a professional setting, with the judgement to know when to rely on AI output and when to challenge it.
* Strong prompt engineering and context-management skills to get reliable, production-quality output from AI coding tools.
* Awareness of data privacy, IP, and security considerations when using AI tools on client codebases.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Exposure to cross-platform frameworks like Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile, Compose Multiplatform Mobile is a plus.
* Experience with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins.

title: Software Development Engineer, IN Amazon Business
description:
**Description**
Are you excited by the challenge of launching new business initiatives for Amazon in India?
  
  
India Consumer Technology (ICT) team builds products and services that solve unique customer needs in Amazon’s fastest growing marketplace. We are a multi-billion dollar business with a huge potential to grow in a trillion dollar market. Our engineers own the complete consumer and seller experience for Amazon India, work on a wide range of technologies (including AWS and EC2) and build and operate highly scalable, low latency mobile first products and services. We are solving Know Your Customer(KYC), last mile engineering challenges around Mobile, Product Discovery, Delivery, Payments, Logistics, Customer experience, Seller experience and more.
  
  
As a Software Engineer within Amazon India Business team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and deploying solutions to help Amazon significantly expand its selection and drive improved customer experience by enabling a new fulfillment pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a team that will be responsible for building a successful, sustainable and strategic business for Amazon, from the ground up!
  
  
If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of millions of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today! You will work with Principal/Senior Engineers in the team to evolve the design and architecture of the products owned by this team. You will be responsible to set up and hold a high software quality bar besides providing technical direction to a highly technical team of Software Engineers.
  
  
As part of this team you will work to ensure Amazon.in is FAST and has the best shopping experience. It’s a great opportunity to develop and enhance experiences for Mobile devices first. You will be working on a work on a wide range of technologies including AWS EC2, SQS, Amazon WW platforms, ElastcicSearch, Big Data, Machine Learning, Android, iOS, Amazon Horizonte, JavaScript, React JS to create unique experiences for India retail customers.
  
  
You will work on analyzing the latency across the various Amazon.in pages using RedShift, MapReduce, Java, Elastic Search and Machine Learning. You will get the opportunity to code on almost all key pages on retail website building features and improving business metrics. You will also contribute reducing latency for customers by reducing the bytes on wire and adapting the UX based on network bandwidth. You will be part of a team that obsesses about the performance of our customer’s experience and enjoy flexibility to pursue what makes sense. Come enjoy an exploratory and research oriented team of Cowboys working in a fast paced environment, who are always eager to take on big challenges.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Work closely with senior engineers to design, implement and deploy applications that impact the Amazon.in business with an emphasis on Mobile, Payments, and e-Commerce website development.
* Own the delivery of an integral piece of a system or application.
* Management and execution against project plans and delivery commitments
* Assist directly and indirectly in the continual hiring and development of technical talent.
* Create and execute appropriate quality plans, project plans, test strategies and processes for development activities in concert with business and project management efforts.

Candidate will be a leader, quick learner and be able to work independently. He/she should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. The candidate will need to balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI - Karnataka

* Understanding of financial postings, taxation, and financial reporting.
* Experience in SAP configuration, customization, and functional support.

* 3–6 years of experience in SAP BW/4HANA and ABAP development.

* Hands-on experience with DataSources, transformations, DTPs, and process chains.
* Experience with ADSOs, CompositeProviders, and Open ODS Views.
* Strong knowledge of ABAP programming and debugging.
* Experience in developing and optimizing ABAP reports and custom programs.
* Understanding of data extraction, data modeling, and reporting.
* Knowledge of SAP HANA database and performance optimization.
* Experience in troubleshooting and supporting BW/4HANA applications.

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
* Develop, configure, customize, and maintain SAP applications within the respective domain.
* Participate in SAP implementation, enhancement, and support projects.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Prepare technical and functional documentation.
* Ensure solution quality, performance, and adherence to SAP best practices.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

Preferred Skills

* Relevant SAP certifications.
* Experience working on SAP implementation and support projects.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP integration technologies, where applicable.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

* Opportunity to work on enterprise-level SAP projects.
* Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
* Exposure to modern SAP technologies and enterprise solutions.
* Opportunities for professional learning and career development.

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. * Deliver high-quality work, ensuring timely completion of tasks and adherence to requirement.

* Take ownership of deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or innovation.

Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Understand functional requirements translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designs using standard patterns. Should also be able to communicate this effectively to the team.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Analyse and identify gaps in functional/business requirements and should be able to effectively communicate this to both Business and Functional analysts
* Experience in configuring core Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud)
* Familiarity with declarative tools (Process Builder, Flows, Validation Rules, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modelling, governance, and security within Salesforce
* Should be able to assess the impact on technical designs caused by changes in functional requirements
* Should be able to perform independent code reviews and execute unit tests on modules developed
* Experience in Salesforce.com Development environments (VS Code)
* Knowledgeable in Apex, Visual force, Lightning Components, Lightning Web Components, SFDX
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external AI APIs and managing custom AI deployments within CRM processes
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Einstein features, AI-driven insights, and bot configuration
* Hands-on experience leveraging Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to drive automation.
* Ability to configure and optimize workflows that integrate Agentforce automation with human agent processes.
* Certifications
* Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) certification (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce.com Platform Developer certifications
* Salesforce.com Domain Certifications

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: Product Builder
description:
**Product Builder**

**Department:**
Product & Technology

**About Navigator**

Navigator is a travel-focused ad tech platform built for scale, precision and impact.

Following our recent Series A funding round, we're evolving from a digital consultancy into a data-driven advertising platform that sits at the intersection of travel intelligence and multi-channel media execution.

We ingest second-party data from leading travel companies, including OTAs, airlines and metasearch platforms. We use this data to build sophisticated audience segments and activate them across all major advertising platforms. Wherever our clients' travellers are, we have a way to reach them.

We're building towards an agentic advertising future, where AI-driven automation handles execution, supported by expert human decision-making. This is an opportunity to help shape that platform while working with leading hospitality and travel brands at the forefront of digital advertising.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Product Builder to join our team and help shape, design and build the next generation of advertising technology products and solutions.

Working at the intersection of product, design, engineering, data and digital advertising, you will take ownership of initiatives from initial idea and customer discovery through to design, development and production.

You will work across the business to identify opportunities, solve complex problems and build products that make advertising smarter, more effective and more efficient. This could include developing internal tools, automating campaign workflows, building data-driven solutions, improving reporting and measurement capabilities, or creating new technology to deliver better outcomes for our clients.

This is not a traditional Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who can move seamlessly between identifying a problem, understanding the user, designing a solution, building a prototype and writing production-ready code.

You will be comfortable working with ambiguity, challenging conventional thinking and making independent decisions. You will combine strong product judgement with excellent design and technical skills, using emerging technologies, including AI and agentic systems, to accelerate how we build and deliver value.

Ultimately, you will turn opportunities into working products that create measurable value for our business, our people and our clients.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Product Discovery & Ownership**

* Take ownership of product initiatives from initial discovery and problem definition through to design, development, launch and ongoing improvement.
* Work closely with client-facing teams, internal stakeholders and users to identify opportunities to improve advertising products, services and workflows.
* Understand the challenges facing advertisers, publishers, agencies and internal teams, translating these into practical technology solutions.
* Challenge existing processes and assumptions, identifying where technology can simplify operations, improve efficiency or create new commercial opportunities.
* Conduct qualitative and quantitative research, including user interviews, behavioural analysis, data exploration and experimentation.
* Define clear objectives and success measures for every initiative, ensuring products deliver measurable business and customer value.
* Evaluate whether a new solution needs to be built or whether existing platforms, tools and capabilities can solve the problem.
* Identify and implement improvements across the products and systems you own.

**2. Product Design & User Experience**

* Translate complex business and advertising challenges into intuitive, user-friendly digital products and experiences.
* Lead the design process, from user journeys and wireframes through to polished interfaces and interactive prototypes.
* Apply strong UX and UI principles to create products that are simple, accessible and effective.
* Prototype and test ideas early, using feedback and evidence to validate solutions before investing in full development.
* Develop consistent experiences that align with our design standards and contribute to the evolution of our design systems.
* Balance user needs, commercial objectives and technical constraints when making design decisions.

**3. Technology & Product Development**

* Design, build and launch production-ready applications, tools and technology solutions.
* Write clean, scalable and maintainable code, taking responsibility for the quality and performance of the products you deliver.
* Build solutions with security, reliability, testing, monitoring and future scalability in mind.
* Work across APIs, data integrations and third-party platforms to connect systems and unlock new capabilities.
* Explore opportunities to improve advertising operations through automation, workflow optimisation and intelligent technology.
* Understand the technical and commercial implications of third-party tools, platforms and vendors, including costs, scalability and potential dependencies.
* Take ownership of troubleshooting and resolving issues within your products and technical domain.

**4. AI, Automation & Emerging Technology**

* Identify opportunities to use AI, machine learning and agentic technologies to improve products, services and operational efficiency.
* Build and integrate AI-powered tools and workflows that solve real business and client challenges.
* Understand when to use traditional software logic, automation, APIs or AI models to deliver the most effective solution.
* Develop appropriate testing, evaluation and safeguards to ensure AI-powered solutions are reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Consider the cost, scalability and performance implications of AI technologies when designing solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging technologies and identify practical opportunities to bring innovation into our products and ways of working.
* Share knowledge and help colleagues understand how AI and automation can improve the way we work.

**5. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively across product, design, engineering, data, media and client teams to deliver cross-functional initiatives.
* Communicate product decisions, technical considerations, progress and potential challenges clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships across the business, understanding different perspectives and translating them into effective solutions.
* Take ownership of decisions within your area of responsibility, knowing when to act independently and when wider input is needed.
* Support and mentor colleagues, sharing knowledge and encouraging best practice across product, design and engineering.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our technology, processes, tools and ways of working.
* Challenge existing approaches constructively and encourage a culture of experimentation, innovation and accountability.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a naturally curious, commercially minded and technically strong individual who enjoys solving problems and building things.

**Product & Commercial Thinking**

* Experience taking digital products or technology initiatives from concept through to launch.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous business challenges into clear product opportunities.
* An understanding of digital advertising, ad tech, marketing technology or data-driven digital businesses.
* The ability to understand customer needs and translate them into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
* Experience using data, research and experimentation to inform product decisions.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how technology can drive business performance and efficiency.

**Design & User Experience**

* Experience designing digital products and intuitive user experiences.
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, user journeys and interaction design.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes and polished interfaces.
* Familiarity with design systems and modern design tools.

**Technical & Engineering Skills**

* Strong software development experience and the ability to build and ship production-ready products.
* Experience working with modern development frameworks, APIs, databases and integrations.
* Understanding of software architecture, testing, security and scalable application development.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical problems and make sound engineering decisions.
* Experience connecting systems and working with complex data environments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Practical experience using AI tools, APIs, LLMs or agentic technologies to build products and automate workflows.
* Understanding of how to integrate AI capabilities into real-world products.
* An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to identify where they can create genuine business value.
* A pragmatic approach to innovation, balancing experimentation with reliability, security and commercial viability.

**Personal Attributes**

* Highly autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.
* Equally comfortable thinking strategically and getting hands-on with delivery.
* Curious, analytical and able to challenge assumptions.
* Comfortable working across multiple disciplines and with people at different levels.
* A clear communicator who can explain complex technical concepts simply.
* Pragmatic and commercially minded, with a focus on outcomes rather than activity.
* Enjoys learning, experimenting and continuously improving.

**How We'll Measure Success**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through your ability to:

* **Build products that matter:**
  Deliver solutions that address genuine customer, client and business needs.
* **Create measurable impact:**
  Improve advertising performance, operational efficiency, user experience or commercial outcomes through the products you build.
* **Own delivery end to end:**
  Take initiatives from initial problem discovery through to successful production launch.
* **Raise the quality bar:**
  Deliver well-designed, reliable and scalable products that people enjoy using.
* **Make smart decisions:**
  Use evidence, commercial awareness and technical judgement to prioritise the right problems and solutions.
* **Drive innovation:**
  Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation and emerging technologies to create competitive advantage.
* **Improve how we work:**
  Help build a more effective, collaborative and innovative product and technology culture.

**Why Join Us?**

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how an ambitious advertising technology business builds and uses technology.

You will have the freedom to identify opportunities, challenge existing ways of working and take ideas from concept to reality. Rather than being restricted to one discipline, you will have the opportunity to work across product, design and engineering, building solutions that have a direct impact on our clients, our people and our business.

You'll be joining Navigator at an exciting stage of its growth, helping shape the technology, products and AI-powered capabilities that will define the future of travel advertising.

If you enjoy solving complex problems, experimenting with new technologies and building products that make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
We Are

We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Improve productivity across the go-to-market organization by automating manual workflows and delivering AI-enabled business applications
* Modernize business-critical applications so they are more reliable, easier to support, and aligned with current technology standards
* Turn AI prototypes and business ideas into production-ready solutions that teams actually use
* Build reusable components, integrations, and frameworks that accelerate future development across the team
* Expand the practical use of AI, Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure across GTM operations
* Contribute to Synopsys' broader AI transformation and business application strategy

What You'll Need

* Strong proficiency in C#/.NET and modern web technologies such as Angular, React, JavaScript, or TypeScript

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, security best practices, monitoring, and modern development workflows

You will work closely with GTM business and technology teams across full-stack development, Power Platform, Azure, Copilot, and agentic AI to modernize business workflows and deliver practical solutions.

title: Technical Application Lead
description:
**1. Role purpose**

The Technical Application Lead will be responsible for developing, maintaining and continuously improving business-critical applications supporting the organization's global Color IT landscape.

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in modern .NET, C#, Angular and Microsoft Azure, along with the ability to provide technical guidance to Agile development teams. The individual will drive end-to-end application delivery, ensure system stability, implement scalable solutions and progressively modernize existing applications while maintaining business continuity.

**2. Job description**

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain scalable enterprise applications using .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core and Angular.
* Develop and manage REST APIs, Web APIs and microservices.
* Build and maintain cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure services.
* Work with Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Storage Accounts, Key Vault and Application Insights.
* Develop responsive frontend applications using Angular, TypeScript, RxJS and NgRx.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, App Registrations and token-based authentication.
* Manage Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, YAML configurations and deployment processes.
* Work with Entity Framework, SQL Server and T-SQL for efficient data management.
* Apply software engineering best practices, including coding standards, dependency injection, unit testing and code reviews.
* Provide technical guidance and coordinate activities across Agile/Scrum development teams.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Solution Architects, DevOps Engineers and global stakeholders.

* Support modernization of legacy applications by identifying opportunities to migrate suitable functionalities to modern .NET and Azure services.

**Senior Microsoft Full-Stack Developer with strong hands-on expertise in .NET, Angular and Microsoft Azure**

* Strong hands-on development experience in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core and Web API.

* Strong Angular, TypeScript and RxJS knowledge.
* Experience in Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and YAML.

C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Web API, REST API, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure DevOps, CI/CD Pipelines, YAML, Entity Framework, SQL Server, T-SQL, Microservices, Git, Agile, Scrum, Technical Leadership.
