title: Sr. Assoc, Prod Specialist - MSD, WRB TechRB Tech
description:
**Job Summary**

* App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time.
* Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Design & Application Development**

* Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant.
* Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs.
* Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments.
* Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools — such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies — where relevant to the application domain and platform context.

**Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards**

* Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards.
* Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects.
* Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design.

**Secure Development & Technology Risk**

* Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks.
* Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant.
* Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities.
* Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements.

**API, Integration & Data Engineering**

* Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels.
* Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability.
* Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs.
* Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management.

**DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness**

* Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes.
* Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements.
* Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies — such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms — where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability.
* Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed.

**Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability**

* Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments.
* Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics.
* Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions.

**Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency.
* Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt.
* Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment**

* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs.
* Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making.
* Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity.

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**

* Software Engineering
* Programming Principles
* Application Programming Interface
* Database Development
* Distributed Systems
* DevOps
* Software Testing
* Secure Coding
* Web Application Security
* Mobile Security

**Other Skills**

* Platform Management
* Operating Systems
* Computer Network
* Database Administration
* Functional Writing

**Motivations**

* Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity.
* Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions.
* Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued.

**Qualifications**

* Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes.
* Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions.
* Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance.
* Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.
* Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes.
* Business English

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

title: Salesforce Apex Development(Health Cloud) - Senior Consultant, Managed Services - DFO&I - Customer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**#DFO&I2027**
**Customer**
The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experience and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects, balancing business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to help solve the biggest problems that impact customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. We also offer Business Process as a Service, enabling organizations to streamline operations and achieve greater efficiency through scalable, technology-enabled managed insights that guide ongoing transformation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant, Managed Services o r equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**

* Integrate and learn from talented colleagues who specialize in core domains.
* Adopt a growth mindset and invest in expanding your understanding of Deloitte’s integrated solutions and marketplace offerings.
* Develop skills within a portfolio representing the unification of diverse, globally recognized brands and businesses—an exciting opportunity for career advancement.
* Leverage opportunities for career development through exposure to unified, enterprise-level platforms and solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including architects, developers, QA, and business stakeholders—to deliver holistic solutions.
* Engage in requirement gathering, solution design, and technical decision-making aligned with client business goal
* Support post-deployment activities, including maintenance, enhancements, and client communication.
* Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement through adoption of best practices and emerging technologies.
* Conduct testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality and resolve issues.
* Deliver high-quality work, ensuring timely completion of tasks and adherence to requirement.
* Demonstrate openness and initiative in learning Generative AI (GenAI) technologies, recognizing their importance for innovation and market competitiveness.
* Strong focus on data-driven decision-making and use of agile methodologies.
* Take ownership of deliverables and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or innovation.
* Uphold Deloitte’s values of integrity, client focus, and making an impact that matters.

**The team:**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team partners with organizations to rapidly design, build, and scale digital products and experiences that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, and operations specialists, we deliver end-to-end solutions—from initial concept and agile development to ongoing digital operations—enabling clients to experiment, iterate, and scale digital initiatives with confidence and agility. We support clients across domains such as strategy, commerce, marketing, sales, and service, helping them realize their digital ambitions through flexible, scalable teams. Our expertise spans the full digital lifecycle, including customer research, experience design, platform development, content production, and marketing automation. By bridging the gap between strategy and execution, we empower organizations to achieve measurable outcomes and deliver exceptional customer experiences in an ever-evolving digital landscape.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 6-9 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Understand functional requirements translate business needs into technical solutions
* Designs using standard patterns. Should also be able to communicate this effectively to the team.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Analyse and identify gaps in functional/business requirements and should be able to effectively communicate this to both Business and Functional analysts
* Experience in configuring core Salesforce modules (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Experience Cloud)
* Familiarity with declarative tools (Process Builder, Flows, Validation Rules, etc.)
* Solid understanding of data modelling, governance, and security within Salesforce
* Should be able to assess the impact on technical designs caused by changes in functional requirements
* Should be able to perform independent code reviews and execute unit tests on modules developed
* Experience in Salesforce.com Development environments (VS Code)
* Knowledgeable in Apex, Visual force, Lightning Components, Lightning Web Components, SFDX
* Experience integrating Salesforce with external AI APIs and managing custom AI deployments within CRM processes
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Einstein features, AI-driven insights, and bot configuration
* Hands-on experience leveraging Salesforce Agentforce capabilities to drive automation.
* Ability to configure and optimize workflows that integrate Agentforce automation with human agent processes.
* Certifications
* Salesforce Administrator (ADM 201) certification (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce.com Platform Developer certifications
* Salesforce.com Domain Certifications

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

**Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles.

**What You Will Do**

* Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control.
* Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments.
* Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards.
* Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces.
* Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance.
* Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity.
* Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API.
* Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment.

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Analyst-Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**
The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.
  
  
Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 1.5 to 2.5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**
Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js. Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.
  
  
**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
  
  
Please note that our firm has adopted a COVID-19 vaccination requirement for employees who work onsite at any of our U.S. locations to safeguard the health and well-being of all our employees and others who enter our U.S. offices. This role requires the employee to be able to work on-site. As a condition of employment, employees working on-site at any of our U.S. locations are required to be fully vaccinated for COVID-19, and to have either had COVID-19 or received a booster dose if eligible under Centers for Disease Prevention and Control (CDC) guidance, unless prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law.

description:
**Company Description**

SpartanIQ Private Limited is a technology company specializing in software quality and testing services. We help clients deliver reliable, user-centered digital products, with a strong focus on performance, accessibility and usability.

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile QA & Accessibility Tester for a 6-month contract, starting immediately. You’ll own quality and accessibility testing for a student wellness mobile app being built for our US-based education client. The app handles location, payments and sensitive personal data.

* Analyze requirements and write detailed test cases for functional, regression and accessibility scenarios

* Log and track defects clearly in Jira through to closure

* 7+ years of QA experience, with strong manual testing of mobile applications end to end
* Hands-on testing on both iOS and Android, including device farms such as BrowserStack
* Proven accessibility testing experience: WCAG guidelines, screen readers (TalkBack, VoiceOver) and tools such as contrast checkers
* Strong skills in writing structured test cases, analyzing requirements, identifying edge cases and diagnosing complex defects
* Experience with defect tracking in Jira or similar tools, and solid test documentation practices
* Experience working directly with business users, product owners or clients, including supporting UAT
* Clear communication and the ability to work independently with remote, cross-functional teams
* Available to join immediately for a 6-month contract
* Nice to have: API testing with Postman, ISTQB certification, and experience with payments, location/GPS, healthcare or education apps

click Apply on this posting and include your notice period, current CTC and expected CTC.

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
**Autonomize AI**
is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients.

*integrate*
AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure.

You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end.

* You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing
* You've instrumented AI systems for observability - latency, token usage, hallucination rate, drift
* You can reason about model tradeoffs (context length, cost, latency, accuracy) and make architectural calls accordingly
* You've worked with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
* You build robust backend systems
* 6 + years building production web applications from scratch
* Deep Python proficiency; comfortable with FastAPI, Django, or Flask in production
* Experience designing APIs that serve both humans and AI agents (tool schemas, structured outputs, streaming)
* Async-first thinking: asyncio, task queues, event-driven architectures
* Kafka, Redis, or ActiveMQ for real-time data movement
* Postgres, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in production
* You operate at cloud scale
* Docker and Kubernetes in production - this is a hard requirement
* At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) with real operational experience
* Microservices and cloud-native design patterns
* You've been on-call. You know what a bad deploy feels like at 2am.
* You can ship a frontend when the product demands it
* React, TypeScript, or modern JS frameworks
* Enough frontend fluency to build clinical interfaces without a dedicated frontend handoff

**Bonus Points**

* Led a small engineering team - mentored, reviewed, unblocked
* CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes certification
* ML/DL model deployment experience (PyTorch, scikit-learn)
* Built evaluation harnesses or used MLflow, LangSmith, or similar for AI observability
* Healthcare domain experience (FHIR, HL7, clinical workflows)

**What We Value Above Credentials**
**Bias toward action**
- you ship, then iterate. You learn by doing, not by planning.
  
  
**Owner mentality**
- you don't wait for permission. You identify what needs to exist and build it.
  
  
**Intellectual honesty**
- you'd rather say "I don't know, let me find out". When unsure, seek the right information from your peers or leaders.
  
  
**Async-first communication**
- you write clearly, document decisions, and work well across time zones.
  
  
**What You'll Get**
**Ground floor equity**
in a VC-backed healthcare AI company growing fast
  
  
**Full-stack ownership**
- no handoffs, no silos, no "that's not my team"
  
  
**Direct access to founders and customers**
- your technical decisions will be seen and felt
  
  
**Professional development budget**
- conferences, courses, certifications, books
  
  
**Flexible, remote-friendly culture**
built around output, not hours
  
  
*If you've been waiting for a role where AI isn't a feature - it's the foundation - this is it.*

title: Applied Scientist III, Advertising Trust
description:
**Description**
Amazon Advertising Trust is on a mission to redefine how trust is enforced at internet scale, and we are looking for exceptional scientists to help lead the way. We are building systems that reason about advertising content the way a trained human would, at a industry leading volume and speed, and that keep working when the rules change underneath them.
  
  
At Ads Trust Science we leverage machine learning, generative AI, and large-scale retrieval to solve some of the most complex decision problems for ads worldwide. Every ad shown across Amazon's owned-and-operated properties and third-party networks, in every format and every global marketplace, depends on decisions our systems make. We are just getting started.
  
  
As a Senior Applied Scientist you will be at the forefront of this work. You will own science problems end to end, bridging the gap between research and production impact. You will not be handed a specification. You will be given a customer problem, a system that partly solves it, and the latitude to decide what to build next.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of multimodal understanding, large language models, and large-scale retrieval, on a problem where the science is genuinely unsettled. You will work alongside scientists whose models run in front of hundreds of millions of customers, at a scale that changes which approaches are even possible.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Ship a model into production, then find and document where it fails once real traffic reaches it.
* Drive the technical discussion, inside your team and with partner teams, on how to close that gap.
* Bring a fresh angle to a problem that is not yours and help a peer get further than they would have alone, building trust across the team in the process.
* Mentor while staying hands-on. At this level the design and the code are both yours.

**About The Team**
Ads Trust Science is a group of scientists who would rather change what the team measures than optimise the wrong number. We value curiosity, rigour, and a bias for action. We expect people to disagree with evidence, to say clearly what did not work, and to iterate quickly toward the solutions that matter.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large scale machine learning systems such as profiling and debugging and understanding of system performance and scalability
* PhD in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- ADCI - Karnataka

title: Principal Engineer – Core
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Principal Engineer – Core**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. As a key member of the Network Design & Planning team, this individual will be the technical authority for Skylo’s core network and service layer, owning the architecture, design, capacity planning, and performance of our cloud-native 5G core, IMS voice and SMS services, and their integration with Skylo’s NTN RAN. Your work will ensure our core network is reliable, scalable, and high-performance as we support millions of devices across consumer, automotive, and IoT use cases on the world’s first commercial direct-to-device satellite network.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Own the end-to-end architecture and design of Skylo’s 5G core (5GC) and its interworking with EPC, including AMF, SMF, UPF, AUSF/UDM/UDR, PCF, NRF, NSSF and NEF functions.
* Act as the lead technical counterpart to our core network vendors, driving roadmap and feature requirements, design reviews, and release acceptance.
* Design and evolve IMS-based voice and messaging services (VoLTE/VoNR, SMS over NAS, SMS over IP, SMSC and IP-SM-GW interworking) for satellite-connected devices.
* Define how the core integrates with Skylo’s NTN vRAN, including NTN-specific requirements such as extended timers, long round-trip delay, mobility, tracking area design, and satellite/terrestrial roaming.
* Lead core network capacity planning and dimensioning, including traffic forecasting, subscriber growth modelling, and resource planning across cloud and on-prem deployments.
* Define core network KPI frameworks, baselines, and thresholds, and drive performance analysis and optimisation of registration, session, voice, and SMS success rates.
* Design roaming and interconnect architectures with MNO partners (S6a/S8, N32/SEPP, Diameter and HTTP/2 signalling, DEA/DRA, SMS interworking).
* Partner with Regulatory, Security, and Operations teams to ensure the core supports Lawful Intercept, emergency services, and network security requirements.
* Create technical specifications, high- and low-level designs, and engineering documentation for core network elements.
* Conduct proof-of-solutions and lab validation to assess new features, vendors, and architecture options.
* Drive continuous improvement loops with Operations & Implementation teams, including root cause analysis of core network incidents.
* Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across the Network Design & Planning team.

**What We Look For**

* 15+ years of experience in mobile core network engineering, design, or architecture, preferably acquired within a mobile network operator or a core network vendor.
* Deep hands-on experience with 5G Core (SA) and EPC, including the service-based architecture (SBA/SBI) and 3GPP core specifications (e.g. TS 23.501, 23.502, 23.401).
* Hands-on experience with IMS architecture (P/I/S-CSCF, TAS, HSS) and end-to-end call flows for SMS delivery, VoLTE, and VoNR.
* Strong understanding of NAS, NGAP/S1AP, GTP, PFCP, Diameter, SIP, and HTTP/2 protocols.
* Proven ability to perform core network traffic forecasting, capacity planning, and dimensioning.
* Demonstrated expertise in defining KPI frameworks, baselines, and thresholds, and in driving performance optimisation.
* Experience managing core network vendors, including leading technical design reviews and acceptance testing.
* Excellent understanding of inbound and outbound roaming architectures and interconnect.
* Hands-on experience with cloud-native network functions and cloud technologies such as Kubernetes, Docker, and public cloud (AWS, GCP).
* Experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and 3GPP Rel-17+ NTN is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with Lawful Intercept, emergency services, and core network security is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for creating detailed technical documentation and presenting solutions to internal and partner audiences.
* Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical teams.

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive occupational health coverage
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends multi-national characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
**Autonomize AI**
is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients.
  
  
We're looking for engineers who don't just
*integrate*
AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end.
  
  
This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry.
  
  
**You're a Fit If You Have**

* AI-native engineering is your default mode
* You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
* You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
* You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing
* You've instrumented AI systems for observability - latency, token usage, hallucination rate, drift
* You can reason about model tradeoffs (context length, cost, latency, accuracy) and make architectural calls accordingly
* You've worked with LLM SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) and agentic orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar)
* You build robust backend systems
* 6 + years building production web applications from scratch
* Deep Python proficiency; comfortable with FastAPI, Django, or Flask in production
* Experience designing APIs that serve both humans and AI agents (tool schemas, structured outputs, streaming)
* Async-first thinking: asyncio, task queues, event-driven architectures
* Kafka, Redis, or ActiveMQ for real-time data movement
* Postgres, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or graph databases (Neo4j, TigerGraph) in production
* You operate at cloud scale
* Docker and Kubernetes in production - this is a hard requirement
* At least one public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) with real operational experience
* Microservices and cloud-native design patterns
* You've been on-call. You know what a bad deploy feels like at 2am.
* You can ship a frontend when the product demands it
* React, TypeScript, or modern JS frameworks
* Enough frontend fluency to build clinical interfaces without a dedicated frontend handoff

**Bonus Points**

* Led a small engineering team - mentored, reviewed, unblocked
* CKAD or equivalent Kubernetes certification
* ML/DL model deployment experience (PyTorch, scikit-learn)
* Built evaluation harnesses or used MLflow, LangSmith, or similar for AI observability
* Healthcare domain experience (FHIR, HL7, clinical workflows)

**What We Value Above Credentials**
**Bias toward action**
- you ship, then iterate. You learn by doing, not by planning.
  
  
**Owner mentality**
- you don't wait for permission. You identify what needs to exist and build it.
  
  
**Intellectual honesty**
- you'd rather say "I don't know, let me find out". When unsure, seek the right information from your peers or leaders.
  
  
**Async-first communication**
- you write clearly, document decisions, and work well across time zones.
  
  
**What You'll Get**
**Ground floor equity**
in a VC-backed healthcare AI company growing fast
  
  
**Full-stack ownership**
- no handoffs, no silos, no "that's not my team"
  
  
**Direct access to founders and customers**
- your technical decisions will be seen and felt
  
  
**Professional development budget**
- conferences, courses, certifications, books
  
  
**Flexible, remote-friendly culture**
built around output, not hours
  
  
*If you've been waiting for a role where AI isn't a feature - it's the foundation - this is it.*

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design and deliver major features while leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity, operational excellence, and business outcomes. You will build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems, lead feature and subsystem design, and ensure operational readiness through automation, observability, and AI-assisted workflows.

You will work independently on complex projects, collaborate across teams, drive root cause analysis, and identify opportunities to use AI for improving development, testing, troubleshooting, operational efficiency, and customer experience. A key expectation of the role is to use AI-driven insights and automation to reduce operational overhead, improve service reliability, accelerate delivery, and minimize technical debt while delivering scalable, customer-focused solutions.

  

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications.

**Who are we looking for?**

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building next-generation cloud security and compliance solutions, and we’re looking for skilled **Software Engineers** to join our **Cloud Guard / Assurance Service** team. Be part of our mission to create the most secure cloud environment. In this pivotal, hands-on engineering role, you will **architect and develop scalable, innovative solutions** that ensure OCI resources start secure and remain secure. You’ll also build **automated mechanisms** for compliance reporting, control deployment, and exception management. You’ll work closely with top engineers, product managers, and security teams to deliver features that strengthen OCI’s security posture and provide a **unified, single-pane-of-glass experience** for both detective and preventive controls.

We are looking for engineers with distributed systems experience. You should have experience with the design of major features and launching them into production. You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You work on most projects and tasks independently. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations.

The ideal candidate will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low-level systems, as well as design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.

**What are the biggest challenges for the team?**

The biggest challenges for the team are reliability, performance and keep up in cybersecurity space. The dynamic and fast growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns with full coverage that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today.

We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right tradeoffs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution.

We need engineers who can build services that can reliably protect our customer cloud environment. We need engineers who can figure out how we can keep up our solution in a fast pace to securely protect our customers. We need engineers who can build services that enable us to offer even more options to customers and contribute to the overall growth of Oracle Cloud.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment

* Experience driving feature design reviews, documentation, UX reviews, and working with Product Managers through the entire launch process

* Strong development experience in Java, C++, C#, or similar OO languages

* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals

* Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures

* Good understanding of databases, SQL, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies

* Experience building multi-tenant, virtualized infrastructure a strong plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience developing services on a public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Oracle)

* Building continuous integration/deployment pipelines with robust testing and deployment schedules

* Expertise in applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques to develop security solutions

* Experience and understanding of Cryptograph, DDoS, CVE, CIS, SAST, DAST, or similar security and compliance knowledge

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**High Performance Computing, AI and Labs** is a critical element of HPE. We are focused on delivering innovative solutions that accelerate our customers’ digital transformation, enabling them to tackle their complex, and data-intensive workloads. Combining deep expertise and the development of the world’s most cutting-edge, high-performance supercomputers, is defining the next era of computing delivering valuable insight & innovation. Join us and redefine what’s next for you.

**What you’ll do:**

In a typical day as a **master technologist for Data plane development**, you would:

* Experience architecting, designing and implementing complex solutions
* Proficiency in Data path forwarding like linux bridge, FD.io, vRouter etc.
* In-depth knowledge of data networking (IP, Ethernet and related technologies)
* Excellent problem solving and debugging skills, ability to debug and analyse distributed systems
* Excellent C, C++ programming skills and working knowledge of Python programming
* Proficiency in Unix programming, Linux network stack, IPTables/Net Filter, Linux Kernel Modules
* Eagerness to learn and readiness to dive deep into complex problems
* Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize and meet deadlines
* Work in a dynamic Agile development environment and remain adaptable to changing requirements
* Document architectures, procedures, and processes in use and contribute to the improvement of the process
* Continuously review the product and code for optimizations and performance improvements
* Evaluate and recommend new technologies and usecases to bring into the platform
* Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization and cost-benefit analysis for projects
* Prototype / design / Develop software Dataplane, packet processing components
* Work on advanced path finding initiatives collaborating across teams and partners

**What you need to bring:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
* **15+ years** of experience as a Software Developer / Architect in **Layer2/Layer3** networking or related systems area
* Excellent **C, C++** programming skills and working knowledge of Python programming
* Development of **Layer2/Layer3** features like LAG, LACPD, QoS, Mac-Learning, Q-in-Q, Ethernet-OAM, IP Routing
* Experience **architecting**, designing and implementing complex solutions

**Great to Haves:**

* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with teams and influence their technological direction with a combination of hands-on work and technical leadership
* Experience with SAI and SONIC would be an added advantage.

title: Project Lead
description:
### **About Zinnov**

Zinnov is a global management consulting firm that helps organizations make decisions that actually get used — and deliver results that matter. For over two decades, we’ve partnered with leading enterprises, high-growth technology companies, and investors to answer some of the toughest questions they face:

* Where should we invest?
* How do we scale globally?
* What capabilities will win in the next decade?

Our work shapes market entry strategies, global operating models, M&A decisions, and long-term growth bets. We’re known for being **data-led, execution-focused, and outcome-driven** — not opinion-heavy slideware.

At Zinnov, how you work matters as much as what you deliver. We value independent thinking, crisp communication, and early ownership. With 450+ professionals across 10 global offices, we work across industries including Digital Services, ER&D, Enterprise Software, Semiconductors, Healthcare, BFSI, Automotive, Media & Telecom, and Private Equity.

Zinnov isn’t for everyone. It’s for people who want steep learning curves, honest feedback, and the chance to see their work influence real business decisions — not just presentations.

**Why Globalization Excellence (GE)**

Zinnov’s Global Excellence (GE) practice helps enterprises build and scale Global Capability Centers (GCCs) end-to-end — from Design & Discovery to Build, Scale, and Run.

In GE, you don’t work in silos. You:

Own complex, end-to-end client journeys

Work across GCC advisory, managed services, and BOT / outsourcing models

Influence leadership decisions that shape long-term talent and operating strategies

This is where strategy meets execution — and where talent plays a defining role.

**About the role:**

Zinnov helps global enterprises set up and scale their Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India. As part of our innovation offering, we run **open innovation programs** that help enterprises connect with the startup ecosystem — find relevant startup partners against real business challenges, running pilots, and turning them into adopted solutions.

We are looking for a **Project Lead** to run the startup-collaboration engine of the program — owning the startup journey from sourcing and selection, through pilots, to product adoption and go-to-market. This is a high-ownership and client facing role. You will be the first point of contact for founders and for the client, accountable for moving startups from first contact to a landed outcome.

**What makes it distinctive:** This role is built for someone from the **startup ecosystem**, an accelerator or incubator operator, a corporate-innovation or VC professional, or a former founder with existing founder relationships and the judgement to tell a real pilot from theatre. The ecosystem credibility is what you bring and demonstrated in the role.

**What you'll do:**

* **Bring the outside in** **perspective** - Track emerging innovation models, startup-ecosystem shifts, and what leading corporate startup programs are doing and translate that into fresh thinking for how the program evolves. Have a point of view, and challenge how things are done

* **Market Intelligence –** Scan the start-up ecosystem**,** scout, identify, and bring in startups that genuinely fit the program's technology and business challenges, drawing on your own network and building new pipeline. Quality fitment and run custom evaluation to explore synergies between start-up and the Enterprise.

* **Run the program end-to-end -** Own the operational spine day-to-day. Keep every workstream on track, and report progress and outcomes to the senior program owner and enterprise sponsors.

* **Own the startup relationship -** Be the point of contact for founders across the journey. Understand their technical and business needs and be their voice inside the program.

* **Run pilots to a result -** Scope focused, measurable proof-of-concept engagements between startups and the enterprise teams and drive them to a quantified outcome.

* **Drive product adoption and go-to-market -** Move startups from pilot to adoption — working alongside solution architects and enterprise stakeholders — and open co-sell and go-to-market opportunities where they fit.

* **Orchestrate the ecosystem -** Sit at the center of founders, mentors/advisors, enterprise sponsors, and internal Zinnov teams — matching the right startup to the right problem and holding momentum across all parties.

* **Build the outcomes narrative -** Capture and package metrics and results achieved over a time

**What you bring:**

Qualifications & Experience

* 4–9 years' experience with meaningful time in the **startup ecosystem** - Accelerator / incubator, corporate innovation or open-innovation team, VC/PE, or as a founder / early operator.

* A real, active network of startup founders and ecosystem players you can draw on from day one.

* **A point of view, and the curiosity to keep forming one.** You spot patterns across the ecosystem, form original perspectives on where innovation is heading, and can argue against them credibly with senior stakeholders.

* **Direct experience operating a corporate or platform startup program** is highly valued. You understand first-hand about program’s strategy, thesis and operations

* Demonstrated experience running structured programs — Cohorts, accelerators, pilots, or innovation challenges from start to measurable finish.

* Strong stakeholder skills: Equally credible in a founder's Slack and a GCC leader's boardroom.

* A bias for outcomes over activity, you measure success in pilots landed and business value created

* Comfortable being embedded and client-facing and operating with autonomy in a fast-moving program.

**Strong plus**

* Command of enterprise technology or a specific deep tech / AI / data domain, enough to earn credibility in a technical conversation.

* Familiarity with GCCs / global captives is welcome but not required; strong ecosystem candidates will be brought up to speed on the GCC context quickly.

* Prior consulting or client delivery experience is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like – Globalization Excellence (GE)**

* Engagements delivered end-to-end with strong quality, predictability, and stakeholder confidence.

* Teams coached to produce sharper research, stronger insights, and consistently client-ready narratives.

* Strong client trust built through clarity, cadence, and reliable delivery under tight timelines.

* Visible BD contribution through solutioning, proposals, and repeatable sales assets.

* Practice impact through reusable frameworks, thought leadership, and capability building.

**If you enjoy owning consulting engagements end-to-end, leading teams to deliver analysis-rich and client-ready outcomes and shaping solutions that influence senior stakeholders — this role offers both impact and growth.**

**Zinnov is an equal opportunity employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

description:

It works across three time zones (Americas, EMEA and Asia) as one global team, so a customer gets the same quality of engagement wherever they operate. Customer Success Account Managers own the executive relationship, coordinate stakeholders and plan the customer's journey. Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs) turn business needs into working solutions in AI, Copilot and agents, Azure, data and security. We work closely with the account teams, local Customer Success Units (CSUs), delivery and engineering. Our goal is to move customers from buying Microsoft technology to getting real business value from it. iCSU Vision is to be the trusted transformation partner for the world's most global enterprises, so every customer gets measurable business value from Microsoft AI and Cloud in every country where they operate.

As an iCSU CSA manager, you lead CSAs who handle some of Microsoft's most complex and visible customer relationships. You work across countries and functions, and your team's results are measured by customer outcomes. title: BIM Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented BIM Coordinator to coordinate Building Information Modeling (BIM) activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams. The candidate will be responsible for managing BIM models, ensuring model coordination, identifying clashes, maintaining project standards, and supporting the successful delivery of BIM projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate BIM models across architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines.
* Develop, review, and maintain BIM models in accordance with project requirements and BIM execution plans.
* Perform clash detection and model coordination using relevant BIM software.
* Identify, document, and follow up on model clashes, discrepancies, and design conflicts.
* Coordinate with project managers, engineers, architects, and other stakeholders to resolve technical issues.
* Ensure compliance with project-specific BIM standards, naming conventions, LOD requirements, and documentation protocols.
* Manage model updates, revisions, and information exchange among project teams.
* Prepare coordination reports, clash reports, and project documentation.
* Support Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows, model sharing, and version control.
* Monitor BIM deliverables against project schedules and quality requirements.
* Assist in developing and implementing BIM workflows, templates, and best practices.
* Provide technical guidance and support to BIM modelers and project team members.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Autodesk Revit and Autodesk Navisworks Manage.
* Understanding of BIM workflows, model coordination, and clash detection.
* Knowledge of architectural, structural, and MEP systems.
* Familiarity with BIM Execution Plans (BEP), LOD, model federation, and information management.
* Understanding of Common Data Environment (CDE) platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC).
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and project specifications.
* Proficiency in MS Office for reporting and documentation.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* Relevant BIM certifications or training will be an added advantage.
