title: Software Engineering Lead - GenAI Platforms
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**The Team & Culture**
======================

We are a research-driven startup operating within the enterprise. Our mission? Building the bank's next-generation GenAI platforms—Citi Stylus Workspaces and mission-critical AI infrastructure serving Citi employees globally. We move with startup velocity while maintaining enterprise-grade security, compliance, and reliability. We build at the frontier of AI, architecting scalable systems where cutting-edge models meet cloud-native excellence.

  
  

**The Role**
============

We are looking for a **Software Engineering Lead** who architects, codes, and leads. This is a senior technical leadership role (SVP) for someone who wants to drive the backend vision and full-stack execution of enterprise GenAI platforms. You will design high-performance AI systems at the intersection of modern cloud-native development and cutting-edge AI—combining hands-on engineering mastery with strategic technical leadership. You'll work with Claude, Gemini, and proprietary models on OpenShift/Kubernetes, building microservices that transform how employees interact with AI.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Architect at Scale**: Design and build core GenAI platform components serving 180,000+ users with exceptional performance, reliability, and security across distributed systems.

* **Engineer Full-Stack Excellence**: Implement complex features across the entire stack—from Go microservices and document pipelines to React interfaces and real-time streaming architectures.

* **Lead AI/ML Innovation**: Build production-grade LLM applications, architect vector databases, implement agentic capabilities, and optimize AI inference for performance and cost efficiency.

* **Own DevOps & Production**: Design observability solutions, lead incident response and blameless postmortems, build CI/CD pipelines, and ensure production excellence through comprehensive monitoring and alerting.

* **Master Cloud Infrastructure**: Architect Kubernetes/OpenShift deployments, implement service mesh (Istio), drive infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows, and ensure security best practices at every layer.

* **Drive Technical Vision**: Set architectural direction across services and teams, mentor engineering talent, lead cross-functional collaboration with product and AI researchers, and represent engineering in leadership forums.
  

  

**Who You Are**
===============

* **A Technical Architect**: Expert-level Go programmer (5+ years) with deep concurrency knowledge, proficient in TypeScript/React (3+ years), and fluent in microservices architecture, clean code principles, and distributed systems design.

* **A Cloud-Native Expert**: Deep understanding of Kubernetes/OpenShift, service mesh implementations, containerization at scale, and infrastructure-as-code with proven experience in high-throughput, low-latency systems.

* **A Production Leader**: 15+ years software development experience with 5+ years in technical leadership, 5+ years with cloud-native architectures, and 3+ years with AI/ML systems in production—delivering enterprise-scale systems (10,000+ users) successfully.

* **An AI/ML Engineer**: Practical experience implementing production LLM applications, prompt engineering, vector databases, streaming architectures, RAG patterns, and multi-agent orchestration.

* **A Strategic Influencer**: Exceptional communicator who translates complex technical concepts into business value, partners with engineering, security, and business leaders, and drives engineering excellence through mentorship and best practices.

* **Mission-Driven**: Passionate about AI-powered systems, hands-on when needed, comfortable with ambiguity, pragmatic under constraints, and relentlessly focused on quality and innovation.
  

  

**Why Join Us?**
================

This is your opportunity to architect the future of enterprise AI at global scale. You'll work with cutting-edge AI infrastructure, collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers, and build systems with real business impact across a global financial institution. SVP-level technical leadership with startup autonomy, enterprise resources, and the challenge of bringing frontier GenAI capabilities safely, securely, and at scale. If you're ready to define what's possible, we want you on our team.

**Education**: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
  

**Technical Stack**: Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.

title: Principal Architect
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**What will you contribute?**

  

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect who will serve as a recognized enterprise technical authority for Artificial Intelligence architecture. You will set the strategic technical direction for AI capabilities across products, platforms, and business segments, including generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, AI platforms, model integration, evaluation, governance, security, and responsible AI.

Your secondary focus will be cloud and SaaS architecture. You will ensure that enterprise AI strategy is realized through secure, scalable, resilient, multi-tenant, observable, and cost-effective cloud services, while influencing investment priorities, platform evolution, and cross-product adoption

  

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**  
  
Your deliverables as a **[Role Name]** will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Set the enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference patterns, capability roadmaps, and technology strategy across multiple products, platforms, and business segments.

* Provide authoritative architectural direction for generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, model integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation.

* Sponsor and lead strategic AI research, technology evaluations, and Proofs of Concept, translating validated outcomes into reusable, production-grade capabilities with measurable business value.

* Establish enterprise guardrails for responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, observability, auditability, and human oversight in regulated environments.

* Shape cloud-native and SaaS architecture strategy for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, scalability, resilience, availability, metering, subscription models, and cost management.

* Create and drive adoption of reference architectures, reference implementations, patterns, libraries, accelerators, and engineering guidance across product and platform teams.

* Govern and review strategic architecture and design proposals for alignment with AI strategy, cloud and SaaS principles, enterprise standards, security, regulatory obligations, and long-term sustainability.

* Influence executive and senior technical decisions across architecture, engineering, product, data, security, cloud platforms, governance, and business leadership.

* Develop senior architects and principal engineers, and lead enterprise architecture forums, technical councils, workshops, demonstrations, hackathons, and global knowledge-sharing communities.

  
  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

AI Architecture & Strategy

Enterprise-wide AI target architecture, principles, standards, investment roadmaps, technology portfolio decisions, and adoption strategy across products and business segments.

Generative AI & LLM Systems

Strategic direction for LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, model routing, grounding, safety, and production controls at enterprise scale.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Enterprise standards for search, embeddings, vector retrieval, chunking, ranking, grounding, citations, authorization-aware access, and measurable retrieval quality.

Agentic AI

Enterprise patterns and governance for agent orchestration, tool use, workflow design, memory, planning, permissions, human approval, monitoring, and failure containment.

AI Platforms & Integration

Shared model gateways, AI services, APIs, event-driven integration, data pipelines, reusable platform capabilities, and consistent embedding of AI across products.

AI Evaluation & Observability

Enterprise evaluation strategy spanning quality, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, drift, telemetry, red-teaming, and continuous assurance.

Responsible AI & Governance

Organization-wide security, privacy, regulatory alignment, model risk, data governance, explainability, auditability, accountability, and human oversight.

  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

**Secondary Skills: Cloud & SaaS**
==================================

* Cloud-native architecture using Microsoft Azure or comparable hyperscale platforms, including containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed services, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering.

* SaaS architecture covering multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, identity, configuration, extensibility, metering, subscription management, data residency, and zero-downtime evolution.

* Distributed systems, APIs, event-driven integration, data platforms, observability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, operational readiness, and cross-product interoperability.

* FinOps, capacity planning, AI and cloud cost optimization, security architecture, compliance, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and platform operating models.

  

**AI architecture is the primary discipline for this role. Cloud and SaaS architecture are essential secondary capabilities for operationalizing AI securely, reliably, and at enterprise scale** .

  

**Required Experience:**

* **12 years of progressive experience in a corporate IT environment or a IT consulting company with at least 3 years in a senior role**
* **10+ years of experience in building, integrating and delivering large enterprise scale solutions using web based technologies**
* **10+ years of experience designing applications**
* **10+Year** years of experience delivering solutions in an agile environment

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health & Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

* Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - GenAI Platforms
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description**

We are Citi’s Core AI Platform Group, a start-up with the exciting mission of shaping the direction of travel for the entire bank under the Chief Operating Office. We define the AI and engineering strategy for the bank. We are a team of talented engineers, product managers, and SMEs, taking ambiguous concepts and making them real by engineering cutting-edge products at planetary scale.

We are solely focused on the most modern technology and engineering disciplines: generative AI, cloud-native architectures, security, modern app stacks, open-source, and the latest and greatest in the Kubernetes ecosystem.

Generative AI is a rapidly evolving space. As a Senior Golang Engineer, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for this domain. We ask that you share with us examples of projects that you have architected and scaled. Ideally, these examples should showcase clever distributed architectures, systematic evaluation of LLM behaviors at scale, and your ability to drive technical consensus across large organizations.

  
  

**Technical Skillset Required:**

9+ Years of Hands-on experience is a must have.

  
  

**Tech Skillsets required for the role**:

Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.

  
  

**You might be a good fit if you:**

* Bring distinguished, deep-dive software engineering expertise and a track record of architectural leadership.
* Thrive in a results-driven environment, where flexibility fuels impact and your technical decisions shape the enterprise.
* Are a game-changer and thought leader, ready to step beyond your designated role to influence the broader engineering culture.
* Love the synergy of pair programming and hands-on coding—you lead from the front and stay close to the codebase.
* Seize the opportunity to architect machine learning and GenAI applications at an unprecedented global scale.
* Possess a relentless passion to push the boundaries of machine learning and generative AI, bringing your knowledge to shape Citi’s future.
  

  

**What you’ll do within the team:**

* **Engineering at scale:** You will build scaled, robust services and platforms centred around generative AI. This may also include developing CLIs, SDKs, runtimes and more.
* **Thought Leadership:** Drive architectural vision and lead the 0-1 build of foundational, enterprise-grade AI platforms and products.
* **System Design:** Design and build high-quality, highly reliable, and secure distributed systems with developer and user experience at the center.
* **Strategic Direction:** Create "firsts" in the Generative AI space for Citi, acting as a core member of the team that defines the strategic technical direction for the entire bank.
* **Scale & Iterate:** Continually iterate and scale Generative AI products to handle massive throughput, whilst anticipating and listening to the complex needs of internal customers.
* **Cross-Org Influence:** You must be able to drive technical alignment across multiple engineering organizations, breaking down silos to deliver cohesive AI capabilities.
  

  

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed In This Role:**

* **Mastery of Modern Stacks:** Expert-level fluency in Golang is a must-have, with deep experience building concurrent, high-throughput systems. (Python is a strong desirable addition).
* **Cloud-Native & Infrastructure:** Deep expertise in the Kubernetes ecosystem, container orchestration, and modern security paradigms (e.g., Gatekeeper, zero-trust).
* **Applied GenAI:** Understanding of language models, fine-tuning methodologies, and RAG architectures, JIT context retrieval strategies will be useful.
* **AI Infrastructure:** Proven experience designing control planes, sandboxing systems for AI experimentation, and managing large-scale vector stores and search algorithms.
* **Data Engineering:** Extensive experience in large-scale ETL development and data pipeline architecture.
* **Security & Governance:** Experience maintaining and/or contributing to bug bounty, responsible disclosure programs, and AI safety/guardrail implementations.
* **Startup Agility:** Experience leading technical initiatives within fast-paced startup environments or driving startup-like agility within a large enterprise.
  

  

**What We Believe In:**

* We do not have boundaries between engineering and research; we expect our technical leaders to bridge the gap and contribute to both.
* We take a product-focused approach and care deeply about building solutions that are robust, scalable, and easy to use.
* We enjoy working in a fast-paced team tackling cutting-edge problems by constantly testing, learning, and adapting.
* We enjoy pair programming for our products; we are lean in our approach and actively remove bureaucracy where we see it.
* We believe in delivering fast, iterating, and pivoting as we go, rather than defining the perfect solution upfront.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore)
description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore) Responsibilities:**

* Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
* Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
* Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
* Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.
* Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers.
* Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
* Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
* Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engagements with external engineering teams (e.g., Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture) and translate complex business constraints into robust system designs
* Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between field deployments and internal engineering, using hands-on customer insights to directly shape core product and platform roadmaps
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

* Lead end-to-end execution of civil and structural works across assigned projects — excavation, foundations, RCC frame, masonry, plastering, waterproofing and finishing — in line with approved drawings, specifications and the project schedule.

* Plan and allocate manpower, machinery and materials on site daily; sequence activities to avoid idle time and rework.

* Supervise and guide Site Engineers, supervisors, foremen and subcontractor teams; set daily targets and review achievement each evening.

* Ensure formwork, reinforcement, shuttering and concreting are checked and signed off before every pour (pour card / checklist discipline).

* Coordinate with MEP, façade, lift, firefighting and other specialised agencies to ensure work fronts are released on time and interfaces are managed.

**B. Drawings, Technical Coordination & Quantities**

* Study architectural, structural and services drawings in advance; raise RFIs and resolve clashes with Maark Vision Architects (MV A) and structural consultants before work begins.

* Maintain the latest-revision drawing register on site and ensure superseded drawings are withdrawn.

* Prepare and check bar bending schedules (BBS), quantity take-offs and material requirement estimates.

* Verify contractor and subcontractor measurements, prepare and certify running account (RA) bills, and reconcile material consumption (cement, steel, RMC, blocks) against theoretical quantities.

**C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control**

* Implement the project Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs); ensure stage-wise inspections are carried out and recorded.

* Arrange and track material testing — cube tests, steel tests, slump, soil/compaction and block tests — and maintain test records and certificates.

* Coordinate with third-party inspection / QA agencies and structural consultants for milestone inspections; close out all observations and NCRs within agreed timelines.

* Identify defects early, enforce rework where required and maintain a snag list through to handover.

**D. Planning, Progress Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare weekly look-ahead plans and monthly work programmes aligned with the master schedule; flag delays and propose catch-up plans.

* Ensure Daily Progress Reports (DPRs), labour reports and site diaries are prepared accurately and submitted on time.

* Track progress against slab-linked and milestone-linked billing so that demand letters and stage certifications can be raised on schedule.

* Present site progress, issues and risks in weekly project review meetings with the Project Manager and management.

**E. Materials, Procurement Support & Cost Control**

* Raise material indents in advance based on the work programme, with accurate quantities and specifications.

* Inspect materials on receipt for quantity and quality; reject non-conforming deliveries and record them.

* Monitor wastage, pilferage and stock levels on site; support the Purchase team with technical evaluation of vendors and materials.

* Highlight cost overruns, extra items and variations early, with supporting measurements and justification.

**F. Health, Safety & Site Discipline**

* Enforce safety norms on site — PPE, scaffolding, edge protection, lift/shaft barricading, electrical safety and safe working at height.

* Conduct toolbox talks, maintain safety records and report incidents or near-misses immediately.

* Maintain housekeeping, site hygiene, labour camp standards and orderly material storage.

* Ensure statutory requirements on site (labour registers, approvals displayed, permits) are complied with, in coordination with Legal & Compliance.

**G. Team Development & Systems**

* Mentor and train junior and Site Engineers on technical standards, checklists and documentation.

* Help build and follow the group's standard site processes — checklists, formats, registers and reporting templates — as the group formalises its operating systems.

* Maintain complete soft and hard project documentation for handover, audit and future reference.

**H. Project Planning, Contracts & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead pre-construction planning — work breakdown, master schedule, resource plan, site logistics and mobilisation for new projects.

* Prepare and monitor project-level budgets and cash-flow requirements; track actual cost against budget and report variances to management.

* Prepare scopes of work and tender documents for contractors and subcontractors; evaluate quotations and support negotiation and award.

* Manage contractor performance against contract terms — progress, quality, safety and billing; handle extra items, variations and claims.

* Coordinate with architects, structural/MEP consultants, liaison consultants and statutory authorities on technical inputs and site-level approvals, inspections and completion requirements.

* Represent the project in meetings with clients, co-owners and landowners on progress and technical matters, as directed by management.

**SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering; M.Tech or PG in Construction / Project Management is an advantage

* **Experience:** 8–15 years in building construction; proven experience delivering at least one G+10 or taller RCC residential project end-to-end

* **Technical Knowledge:** RCC and structural works, formwork systems, finishing works, waterproofing, MEP coordination, relevant IS codes and NBC requirements

* **Quantities & Billing:** BBS, quantity estimation, RA billing, material reconciliation

* **Planning & Contracts:** Project scheduling, budgeting and cost tracking, contractor tendering and contract administration

* **Software:** AutoCAD (reading / markups), MS Excel, MS Project or Primavera (preferred); comfort with project management and reporting tools

* **Quality & Safety:** Working knowledge of QA/QC procedures, material testing and site safety practices

* **Soft Skills:** Leadership on site, problem-solving, clear communication with contractors and consultants, discipline in documentation, ownership mindset

* **Languages:** English and Kannada; Hindi / Telugu / Tamil preferred for labour management

title: Lead Software & Systems Architect AIRE
description:
Required Experience, minimum: 10 years

  

Required Experience, maximum: 12 years

  

* Minimum Qualification: B.Tech/B.E

  

**Role**

**Lead Software & Systems Architect (Expert)**

  

**Visit our website** **bmwtechworks.in** **to know more.**

  
  

**About the UNIT/ Unit Overview**

AIRE (AI-native Requirements Engineering) is a new BMW Group tool for managing vehicle requirements, the descriptions of what a car and its software must do. It keeps the full history of every requirement, shows how requirements are linked to each other and to tests, and shows what is affected when something changes. It helps teams meet automotive standards such as Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262. AIRE is built for AI agents first and a user interface later, and the team uses AI agents to help build it. In this role you design the overall structure of AIRE and make the key technical decisions.

  

**Location**

Pune / Bangalore

  

**Experience**

Minimum of ten years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in a lead or principal architecture role for data-intensive systems.

  

**Number of openings**

1

  

**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

* Own the target architecture and its documentation (arc42, C4, ADRs). Decide and document the open architecture decisions, for example storage technology, graph store, branching model and deployment platform, based on prototypes and measured evidence.

* Design the bitemporal, append-only core model, including revision checksums, time travel, baselines and the semantics of branching and three-way merge.

* Define the CQRS split between the relational source of truth and the graph read index, including synchronisation, consistency guarantees and rebuild strategies.

* Define the domain-action architecture together with the Senior Agent & Domain Action Engineer: typed contracts, idempotency, error semantics, authorisation hooks, approval gates and audit events. Ensure that agents never access the database directly.

* Translate quality goals into automated fitness functions and architecture checks in CI, and make them part of the definition of done.

* Write and maintain architecture specifications and agent instructions so that coding agents implement consistently with the architecture. Review architecturally significant agent-generated changes as the accountable human.

* Build reference implementations and spikes for high-risk areas such as concurrency, bitemporal queries and large-scale traversal.

* Ensure that the architecture supports conformity evidence for Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262 tool qualification, together with the Functional Safety & Process Compliance Specialist.

* Identify and manage technical risks and technical debt, and advise the Lead Value Flow Engineer on feasibility, sequencing and cost.

* Design the production architecture for security, performance and operability, and define the migration and cut-over architecture.

* Hand over architecture knowledge (ADRs, runbooks, agent skills) to the successor team before first production in 2028 Q3.

  

**What should you bring along**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of ten years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in a lead or principal architecture role for data-intensive systems.

* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering systems with demanding consistency, auditability and performance requirements.

* Proven ability to lead technically through influence and to make evidence-based architecture decisions.

  

**Must have technical skill**

* Proven experience as lead or principal architect for data-intensive, distributed enterprise systems delivered to production.

* Deep knowledge of temporal data modelling, in particular bitemporal models (valid time and transaction time), append-only and event-sourced storage, revision checksums and time-travel queries.

* Strong command of CQRS, polyglot persistence, consistency models, optimistic concurrency, transaction isolation and idempotent write paths.

* Experience designing graph-based traceability or dependency models, including traversal performance, impact propagation and the trade-offs between relational and native graph stores.

* Experience designing agent-first systems: typed, versioned domain contracts as the primary interface, least-privilege tool access for AI agents, approval workflows for risky operations, and complete audit trails.

* Ability to define measurable quality goals and fitness functions (for example traversal latency for 5–8 hops with 50 concurrent users, variant resolution times and data volumes of 100k to 1M objects) and to verify them automatically.

* Hands-on proficiency in Python (for example FastAPI) and PostgreSQL, with the ability to build reference implementations for critical paths.

* Practical use of AI-native engineering: writing architecture specifications, ADRs and constraints that coding agents follow, and reviewing agent-generated designs and code critically.

* Solid understanding of cloud architecture on Microsoft Azure, including private networking, managed identities, container platforms and managed databases.

  

**Good to have technical skills**

* Domain knowledge of automotive requirements engineering, ALM tools (Codebeamer, DOORS, Polarion), ReqIF and product line engineering with 150%/100% variant models.

* Knowledge of Automotive SPICE (SYS.1–5, SWE.1–6), ISO 26262 (including tool qualification in Part 8) and ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148.

* Experience with semantic branching and record-level three-way merge of structured data.

* Experience with graph databases (for example Neo4j, FalkorDB, Apache AGE) and with ontology standards such as RDF/OWL and ISO/IEC 21838.

* Experience with arc42, C4 and architecture decision records in a docs-as-code workflow.

* Familiarity with BMW BASE (BMW Agentic Software Engineering), the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and BMW enterprise architecture governance.

* Define and track outcome, flow and AI-native delivery metrics. Examples include acceptance rate of agent-generated changes, rework rate, evaluation pass rate, defect escape rate and cost per delivered change. Use the findings to improve both the product and the delivery process.

* Own the product-level approval gates in the delivery process, such as release of increments, acceptance of measurement reports and approval of expensive load-test runs. Enforce separation of duties between requesters and approvers.

* Prepare the follow-on engagement, including productisation, the later UI phase, team scaling and the operating model, based on the evidence produced.

* Plan the path from the PoC to first production in 2028 Q3, including migration scenarios, cut-over planning, go-live readiness and hypercare.

* Plan the staffing and handover from the internal team to the new DevOps team that owns AIRE from the idea to operations.

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Informatics, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of eight years of relevant experience in software product development or delivery, including at least three years as a product owner, product manager or value-stream lead for technical platforms.

* Demonstrated track record of delivering complex software products with cross-functional teams and measurable outcomes, ideally in regulated or engineering-heavy domains.

* Proven ability to lead through influence, manage senior stakeholders and make evidence-based product decisions, without requiring prior line-management experience.

  

**Must have technical skill**

* Proven product ownership or value-stream leadership for complex enterprise, engineering or developer platforms from discovery through production, beyond feature-factory delivery.

* Ability to translate stakeholder goals into measurable outcomes, hypotheses and success criteria. Examples include weighted benchmark matrices, service-level objectives, Go/No-Go criteria and adoption metrics. Protect scope through explicit goals and non-goals.

* Practical experience leading AI-native delivery: specification-driven development, agent-generated work products, bounded implementation and verification loops, human approval gates, and measuring flow when agents produce most of the code.

* Ability to write and curate machine-readable backlog items and specifications that agents can execute and humans can verify. These include user stories, acceptance criteria, BDD scenarios and traceable L0–L2 requirements.

* Strong flow and backlog management with the Agile Working Model, Kanban or Scrum, including WIP limits, flow metrics (lead time, throughput, flow efficiency) and dependency management across domain, platform and governance units.

* Stakeholder and expectation management with sponsors, domain departments, system owners of legacy tools, architecture, and data protection and information security functions, including timely escalation of blocking approvals.

* Sound understanding of the automotive requirements engineering and ALM landscape (for example Codebeamer, IBM DOORS, Polarion, ReqIF) and of the regulatory drivers Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262.

* Structured management of risks, assumptions and dependencies, including data approvals, masking, IP and NDA constraints, and the availability of interfaces to legacy systems.

* Excellent communication, facilitation and negotiation skills, with the ability to keep coordination overhead low so that AI-driven delivery speed is not lost in alignment meetings.

  

**Good to have technical skills**

* Prior experience with the BMW Agile Working Model, BMW BASE (BMW Agentic Software Engineering) and BMW-specific governance and release processes.

* Knowledge of product line engineering, feature models and variant management in automotive development.

* Experience with requirements-as-code and docs-as-code approaches such as TRLC (Treat Requirements Like Code), Git-based reviews and CI-driven validation.

* Experience introducing a successor solution alongside a leading legacy system, including shadow runs, co-existence and migration decision-making.

* Understanding of AI operating cost (LLM token and inference cost), FinOps and AI value measurement.

* German language skills for working with domain departments and source material.

title: Associate Engineer - Mechanical
description:
To provide technical and engineering support to the Middle East Power Generation business, primarily covering Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) and Open Cycle Gas Turbine (OCGT) power projects, including new-build projects, expansions, upgrades and existing operational plants.

The role will support projects across feasibility, FEED, tendering, design review, construction, commissioning and operational phases, providing technical advisory services to utility companies, plant owners, developers, lenders and government entities.

The range of activities includes:

* Feasibility and FEED studies for new CCGT, OCGT and associated power generation projects.

* Power plant configuration studies, technology assessments, benchmarking, cost analysis and contract reviews.

* Engineering coordination during project development and execution.

* Preparation of functional specifications, datasheets, formsheets and concept drawings for power plant systems and equipment.

* Technical evaluation of EPC bids and vendor offers, including technical clarifications and evaluation reports.

* Engineering design review of power plant systems, equipment, calculations and technical documentation.

Technical advisory support to utilities, plant owners, developers, lenders and government entities for new-build and existing operational power plants, including pre- and post-financial close assignments.

  

* Provide technical support to Pre-Contract and Project Delivery teams throughout the design, construction, commissioning and operational phases of power generation projects.

* Undertake engineering studies for CCGT and OCGT projects, including thermodynamic cycle and plant performance modelling.

* Review plant performance parameters including output, efficiency, heat rate and technical guarantees.

* Prepare and review technical specifications and datasheets for major power plant systems and equipment.

* Review plant layouts, equipment arrangements, design calculations, drawings and engineering documentation prepared by EPC contractors and vendors.

* Review mechanical and Balance of Plant (BOP) systems and support equipment selection and sizing.

* Coordinate technical interfaces between mechanical, electrical, I&C, civil and other engineering disciplines.

* Participate in project meetings, design reviews, technical clarification meetings and engineering coordination activities.

* Support technical due diligence and operational assessments of new-build and existing power generation assets and prepare associated technical reports.

* Support site inspections, construction monitoring, testing, commissioning and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), as required.

* Monitor and report engineering and construction progress to the Project Manager and/or Client.

* Maintain awareness of technological developments, applicable international standards and industry best practices in the power generation sector.

Key Competencies / Skills

Mandatory Skills

* Minimum relevant experience in thermal power generation projects, particularly CCGT and/or OCGT plants, preferably in an engineering consultancy/design office environment.

* Strong understanding of gas turbines, HRSGs, steam turbines and associated auxiliary systems.

* Experience in thermodynamic power plant cycle analysis, including output, efficiency, heat rate and overall plant performance.

* Good technical knowledge of major CCGT/OCGT systems, including:

* Gas Turbines and auxiliaries
* Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSG)
* Steam Turbines and auxiliaries
* Water-steam cycle
* Condensate and feedwater systems
* Condensing and cooling systems
* Fuel gas systems
* Cooling water systems
* Compressed air systems
* Chemical dosing systems
* Fire protection systems
* Mechanical Balance of Plant systems

* Experience in selection and sizing of mechanical/BOP equipment, including pumps, compressors, heat exchangers, tanks and associated equipment.

* Experience in preparation and review of technical specifications and datasheets for power plant equipment.

* Experience in design and engineering review of CCGT/OCGT plants, particularly mechanical and BOP systems.

* Experience in technical evaluation of EPC bids, OEM/vendor proposals and technical guarantees.

* Experience reviewing power plant performance calculations, equipment sizing calculations and contractor/vendor engineering documentation.

* Familiarity with applicable international codes and standards such as ASME, API, NFPA and ISO.

* Experience working on large power generation projects, preferably in the Middle East/GCC region.

* Ability to coordinate effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams and work independently to meet project deadlines.

* Strong analytical, technical report-writing and communication skills.

* Willingness to travel internationally for project meetings, site visits and FATs.

Desired Skills

* Knowledge and experience with GT PRO or equivalent thermodynamic/performance modelling software.

* Knowledge of IPP/IWPP contractual and project structures.

* Knowledge of power plant CAPEX/OPEX and equipment cost benchmarking.

* Experience with technical due diligence, commissioning and performance testing of power generation assets would be an advantage.

  

* The candidate should be a graduate mechanical engineer with minimum 10 years of relevant experience

* Experienced user of Microsoft Office.

title: C++ & Adaptive AUTOSAR Technical Architect Experts
description:
Job Description Senior Software Engineer –

C++ & Adaptive AUTOSAR (ADAS Vehicle Abstraction Layer)Location [JLR TBSI Bengaluru]Department ADAS Autonomous Driving Software Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer specializing in C++ and Adaptive AUTOSAR to join our ADAS development team.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the Vehicle Abstraction Layer (VAL).

Your primary goal will be to decouple highlevel ADAS perception and planning algorithms from the underlying vehicle hardware and communication protocols, ensuring seamless integration, scalability, and safetycritical performance.

Key Responsibilities Architect & Develop VAL Design and develop robust Vehicle Abstraction Layers that provide a standardized interface for ADAS applications to interact with vehicle actuators (steering, braking, acceleration) and sensors.

Adaptive AUTOSAR Implementation Develop and integrate software components within an Adaptive AUTOSAR framework, focusing on ServiceOriented Architecture (SOA) and SOMEIP communication.

C++ Software Engineering Write highperformance, memoryefficient, and MISRAcompliant C++ code (C++141720) optimized for embedded automotive platforms. Communication Protocols Implement and manage data exchange between highlevel ADAS controllers and lowlevel ECUs using protocols such as SOMEIP, DoIP, CANCANFD, and Ethernet.

Hardware Abstraction Develop drivers and abstraction logic to hide hardware complexity, enabling easier porting of ADAS software across different vehicle platforms.

Safety & Standards Ensure all software development adheres to functional safety standards (ISO 26262) and automotive coding guidelines (MISRA C++, AUTOSAR).

Testing & Validation Perform unit testing, integration testing, and HardwareintheLoop (HiL) testing to validate the reliability and timing constraints of the VAL.

Collaboration Work closely with Perception, Planning, and Control teams, as well as Hardware engineers, to define interface requirements and system specifications.

Required Technical Skills Programming Advanced proficiency in C++ (C++ 11C++14C++17 preffered) and understanding of lowlevel memory management and concurrency.

Strong understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns. Middleware Handson experience with Adaptive AUTOSAR stack (e.g., Vector MICROSAR Adaptive, EB corbos, or similar).

Architecture Strong understanding of ServiceOriented Architecture (SOA) and the concept of Vehicle Abstraction Layers. Automotive Networking Deep knowledge of SOMEIP, Ethernet communication, and traditional CANCANFD protocols.

OS Knowledge Experience working with POSIXbased operating systems (e.g., QNX, LinuxRTOS). Tools Proficiency with Git, CMake, GDB, and debugging tools (Lauterbach, CANalyzer, or CANoe), CICD pipelines.

  

C++,Adaptive AUTOSAR,Vehicle Abstraction Layer (VAL),erviceOriented Architecture (SOA),SOMEIP, DoIP, CANCANFD,Ethernet

  

Advanced C++ Software Development & Design, Adaptive AUTOSAR & Service-Oriented Architecture, Automotive Communication & VAL Expertise, Embedded Systems, Testing & Integration, Functional Safety & Problem Solving

**Leadership & Communication**

* Proven ability to influence architectural decisions across teams and stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex designs clearly.
* Excellent analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in Oil & Gas, subsurface, facilities, or industrial data platforms.
* Familiarity with OSDU aligned architectures and industry data standards.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience working with OSDU (Open Subsurface Data Universe) data models or similar energy industry data standards.

title: ML OPS - devops
description:
About This Role

**5 to 8 years of experience**  
**Skills: Ml Pipelines, CICD workflows, Monitoring tools, Terraforms**

**Senior MLOps Engineer**
-------------------------

**Tech Stack:** Flexible / Cloud-agnostic

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a Senior MLOps Engineer to build and maintain the infrastructure that takes machine learning models from experimentation to production. You will design robust CI/CD pipelines for ML workflows, automate model training and deployment, and ensure our AI systems are reliable, observable, and scalable. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, and data science.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, build, and operate end-to-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, validation, and serving.
* Implement CI/CD workflows for ML models, including automated testing, versioning, and canary deployments.
* Manage and optimize model serving infrastructure (batch and real-time) for latency, throughput, and cost.
* Build monitoring and alerting systems for data drift, model performance degradation, and infrastructure health.
* Maintain experiment tracking platforms and model registries to ensure reproducibility and governance.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation).
* Collaborate with data scientists to containerize models and standardize training environments.
* Implement feature stores, data versioning, and lineage tracking for ML data assets.
* Develop internal tooling and self-service platforms to accelerate the ML development lifecycle.
* Ensure security, compliance, and access controls across the ML platform.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* 5–8 years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or MLOps, with significant focus on ML systems.
* Strong programming skills in Python; working knowledge of Go, Bash, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Argo Workflows, or similar).
* Experience with ML pipeline frameworks (Kubeflow, Airflow, Prefect, Metaflow, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with model serving tools (TorchServe, Triton, TF Serving, Seldon, BentoML, or similar).
* Solid understanding of monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience building or managing GPU clusters for training workloads.
* Familiarity with feature store platforms (Feast, Tecton, or equivalent).
* Knowledge of data versioning tools (DVC, LakeFS, or similar).
* Experience with ML experiment tracking tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, Neptune).
* Background in cost optimization for cloud-based ML workloads.
* Exposure to LLM deployment, vector databases, or RAG infrastructure.

title: Agentic AI Engineer – Mainframe Modernization
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**  
  
You will be an AI & Mainframe Modernization Engineer deploying and scaling KAF and Agentic AI capabilities to accelerate legacy enterprise transformations. Working alongside mainframe SMEs, architects, and cloud teams, you will build code-aware AI workflows, automate reverse engineering and refactoring, and enforce validation guardrails to deliver production-ready modernization outcomes.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Deploy & Optimize AI Workflows:** Configure and scale KAF, Agentic AI workflows, RAG pipelines, and code-aware agents to accelerate legacy discovery, inventory analysis, and automated reverse engineering across COBOL, PL/I, JCL, CICS, IMS, and DB2.
* **Drive Code Transformation:** Extract business rules, dependency maps, and architecture artifacts to support code refactoring and cloud migration.
* **Integrate into Enterprise Pipelines:** Embed AI automation directly into existing enterprise tools, code repositories, and CI/CD development pipelines.
* **Enforce Governance & Quality:** Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) validation workflows to ensure output accuracy and enterprise security compliance.
* **Scale & Mentor:** Continuously refine prompt and orchestration frameworks, build reusable AI accelerators, and mentor cross-functional modernization teams on AI-assisted delivery.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience deploying, configuring, integrating, and optimizing enterprise Agentic AI capabilities, orchestration pipelines, custom workflows, and prompt libraries.
* Strong AI engineering expertise in designing code-aware AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector-based knowledge systems, prompt engineering, and context engineering.
* Hands-on mainframe modernization background covering legacy application discovery, inventory analysis, and automated reverse engineering across COBOL, PL/I, JCL, CICS, IMS, DB2, and related technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to generate application documentation, business rules extraction, dependency maps, and architecture artifacts, converting AI outputs into implementation-ready engineering deliverables.
* Practical experience supporting code transformation, refactoring, and migration activities while automating repetitive tasks across analysis, mapping, testing, and documentation generation.
* Proven ability to integrate AI solutions with enterprise tools, repositories, and development pipelines while monitoring and improving performance, accuracy, reliability, and scalability.
* Strong background in AI quality, validation, and governance—including defining evaluation frameworks, validation mechanisms, guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows, and enterprise security compliance.
Proven collaboration skills with Mainframe SMEs, Architects, Cloud Engineers, and Transformation Leads, including mentoring teams on AI-assisted delivery best practices.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Direct experience working with KAF (Kyndryl Agentic Framework) and contributing to reusable AI assets and modernization accelerators across multiple programs.
* Deep expertise in validating AI-generated code, test assets, migration outputs, and documentation within regulated or security-sensitive enterprise environments.
* Track record of identifying recurring modernization challenges and converting them into reusable AI solutions.
Experience advancing agent orchestration frameworks and legacy-to-cloud transformation architectures.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl:**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important ,you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused , someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless , naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5-8+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI solutions into enterprise production environments.
* Deep expertise in AI & Agentic Engineering, covering Agentic AI Frameworks, Multi-Agent Systems, Prompt Engineering, Context Engineering, and AI Workflow Orchestration.
* Strong proficiency in Python for developing workflow automation, REST APIs, SDK integrations, and third-party tool integrations.
* Hands-on experience with Git/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, SDLC processes, DevSecOps, and secure development practices.
* Proven experience designing AI Knowledge Systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Semantic Search, Embedding Models, Knowledge Graphs, and Context Retrieval Systems.
* Strong software quality background encompassing source code analysis, test automation, quality engineering, and working with code transformation or developer productivity tools.
Solid knowledge of Mainframe Modernization, including legacy application discovery, reverse engineering, code understanding, dependency analysis, modernization patterns, and legacy-to-cloud transformation.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience in code-aware agent development, legacy code context modeling, and mainframe application analysis.
* Proven track record implementing automated code transformation and automated test generation solutions.
* Experience building and scaling enterprise AI platform engineering solutions, multi-agent orchestration platforms, and deep tool/platform integrations.
Strong expertise in AI evaluation frameworks, LLM guardrails and governance, generated code validation, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design and deliver major features while leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity, operational excellence, and business outcomes. You will build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems, lead feature and subsystem design, and ensure operational readiness through automation, observability, and AI-assisted workflows.

You will work independently on complex projects, collaborate across teams, drive root cause analysis, and identify opportunities to use AI for improving development, testing, troubleshooting, operational efficiency, and customer experience. A key expectation of the role is to use AI-driven insights and automation to reduce operational overhead, improve service reliability, accelerate delivery, and minimize technical debt while delivering scalable, customer-focused solutions.

  

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications.

**Who are we looking for?**

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building next-generation cloud security and compliance solutions, and we’re looking for skilled **Software Engineers** to join our **Cloud Guard / Assurance Service** team. Be part of our mission to create the most secure cloud environment. In this pivotal, hands-on engineering role, you will **architect and develop scalable, innovative solutions** that ensure OCI resources start secure and remain secure. You’ll also build **automated mechanisms** for compliance reporting, control deployment, and exception management. You’ll work closely with top engineers, product managers, and security teams to deliver features that strengthen OCI’s security posture and provide a **unified, single-pane-of-glass experience** for both detective and preventive controls.

We are looking for engineers with distributed systems experience. You should have experience with the design of major features and launching them into production. You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You work on most projects and tasks independently. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations.

The ideal candidate will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low-level systems, as well as design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.

**What are the biggest challenges for the team?**

The biggest challenges for the team are reliability, performance and keep up in cybersecurity space. The dynamic and fast growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns with full coverage that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today.

We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right tradeoffs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution.

We need engineers who can build services that can reliably protect our customer cloud environment. We need engineers who can figure out how we can keep up our solution in a fast pace to securely protect our customers. We need engineers who can build services that enable us to offer even more options to customers and contribute to the overall growth of Oracle Cloud.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment

* Experience driving feature design reviews, documentation, UX reviews, and working with Product Managers through the entire launch process

* Strong development experience in Java, C++, C#, or similar OO languages

* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals

* Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures

* Good understanding of databases, SQL, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies

* Experience building multi-tenant, virtualized infrastructure a strong plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience developing services on a public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Oracle)

* Building continuous integration/deployment pipelines with robust testing and deployment schedules

* Expertise in applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques to develop security solutions

* Experience and understanding of Cryptograph, DDoS, CVE, CIS, SAST, DAST, or similar security and compliance knowledge

title: Senior Release Engineer, Patching
description:
Oracle’s Automated Patching Framework (APF) builds and delivers software updates for Oracle Database, Exadata, Fleet Patching and Provisioning (FPP), Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle GoldenGate (OGG), Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and Autonomous Health Framework (AHF), across on-premises and cloud environments. APF is a business-critical platform that helps Oracle deliver patches to customers on schedule and improves the efficiency of development teams across the company.

The framework includes services and tools built with Python, Java, Perl, PL/SQL, and Ant. Our team develops and operates these systems in a large-scale production environment. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from design and implementation to troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support.

We’re looking for strong hands-on software engineers who enjoy solving complex automation problems and working across technologies and teams.

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software for Oracle’s automated patching framework. You’ll build and maintain tools and services using technologies such as Python, Java, Perl, Linux shell scripting, and PL/SQL. The role also includes providing internal production support, investigating and triaging issues, and improving the reliability and performance of the patching infrastructure.

As a member of the software engineering team, you’ll help define and implement software solutions, make changes to existing architecture as needs evolve, and contribute to technical direction across shared projects. The work is varied and often complex, requiring sound judgment and the ability to work independently. You may also lead projects or provide technical guidance to other developers.

  

Design, develop, and maintain APF (Automation Patching Framework) services, tools, and automation.
  
Provide production support and investigate issues reported by internal customers.
  
Lead or contribute to cross-functional technical discussions and shared projects.
  
Improve the framework’s architecture, code quality, reliability, and support processes using AI tools where appropriate.
  
Take ownership of software throughout its lifecycle, including operation in a 24/7 production environment.
  
Provide technical guidance to other developers and, where appropriate, lead projects.

title: AI Engineer II
description:
**Introducing Amex Tech & Enterprise CRM Solutions (eCRMs)**

At American Express, technology is at the core of how we innovate, grow, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. Joining Amex Tech means being part of a global engineering organization that is shaping the future of commerce through cutting-edge platforms, data, and Artificial Intelligence. Our teams build scalable, secure, and intelligent systems that power seamless experiences for customers and colleagues worldwide.

Within this ecosystem, Enterprise CRM Solutions (eCRMs), part of the International Card & Risk Services Technology organization, plays a pivotal role in enabling customer-centric growth. eCRMs brings together engineering, product, and business teams to deliver modern, connected CRM capabilities across both Customer and Sales domains. The organization is focused on transforming the CRM landscape by centralizing customer data, reducing fragmentation, and enabling more personalized, insight-driven interactions at scale.

Artificial Intelligence is a key driver of this transformation. From intelligent automation to advanced decisioning and personalized engagement, we are embedding AI into core sales and customer platforms—while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and responsible use at enterprise scale.

**Role Description**

As an AI Engineer within Enterprise CRM Solutions (eCRMs), you will contribute to advancing AI-driven transformation across customer and sales platforms at American Express. Working at the intersection of data, AI, and CRM modernization, you will help build intelligent, scalable solutions that enhance customer engagement, improve sales effectiveness, and support compliance and governance.

In this role, you will develop and implement AI-powered capabilities that bring greater intelligence and automation into customer and sales processes. This includes building GenAI and Agentic AI solutions for quality monitoring, intelligent workflows, personalized customer experiences, and customer data enrichment. You will work with enterprise data platforms and cloud-native technologies to develop production-ready AI applications that integrate with business systems and enable better decision-making.

You will also contribute to the development of enterprise AI platforms, reusable frameworks, and engineering best practices while ensuring AI solutions are reliable, secure, and aligned with responsible AI and governance standards.

  

* **3–5+ years** of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, or applied AI.
* Hands-on experience building or integrating GenAI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Experience with Agentic AI concepts, including orchestration frameworks, tool calling, context management, or multi-step AI workflows.

* Good problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams.

Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Fullchip Floorplanning Lead
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**T****HE ROLE****:**

We at AECG SSD Custom Silicon are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Full-Chip Floorplan Engineer to drive physical implementation planning for complex SoCs and ASICs. The candidate will be responsible for developing and optimizing full-chip floorplans, partitioning strategies, power planning, interconnect planning, and physical architecture to achieve aggressive PPA (Power, Performance, Area) targets while ensuring design convergence and manufacturability.

The role requires close collaboration with Architecture, RTL, Physical Design, DFT, Power, Package, and Verification teams throughout the SoC development lifecycle. Industry full-chip floorplanning activities commonly include die shaping, macro placement, IO planning, power-domain planning, pin assignment, feedthrough planning, and physical integration strategy development.

**THE PERSON:**

A successful candidate will work with senior silicon design engineers. The candidate will be highly accurate and detail-oriented, possessing good communication and problem-solving skills.  
  
**K****EY RESPONSIBLITIES****:**

* **Full-Chip Floorplanning**
  + Develop and own top-level SoC floorplan architecture.
  + Define chip aspect ratio, die size, partitioning strategy, and hierarchy planning.
  + Perform macro placement and optimization for timing, congestion, power, and thermal considerations.
  + Drive floorplan refinement through design milestones.
  + Define floorplan topology for large-scale SoCs containing multiple subsystems, hard IPs, memories, and third-party IPs.
* **Physical Architecture Planning**
  + Develop and optimize:
    - Power domain strategy
    - Voltage island planning
    - Power grid architecture
    - Isolation and retention planning
    - Feedthrough strategy
    - Repeater insertion strategy
    - Boundary and channel planning
* **IO and Package Planning**
  + Define chip-level IO placement strategy.
  + Collaborate with package teams on bump map optimization.
  + Drive chip-package co-design activities.
  + Optimize high-speed interface placement (PCIe, SerDes, C2C, DDR, Ethernet, etc.).
* **Interconnect & Timing Planning**
  + Develop timing-driven floorplans.
  + Define physical partitions and timing boundaries.
  + Establish timing budgeting methodology across subsystems.
  + Plan clock distribution architecture and clock-domain placement.
* **Congestion, Power & Thermal Optimization**
  + Identify congestion hotspots and implement mitigation strategies.
  + Drive early power estimation and thermal-aware floorplanning.
  + Optimize placement for PPA convergence.
  + Support EMIR-aware floorplan planning.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**
  + Work closely with :
    - Architecture teams
    - RTL designers
    - Physical Design teams
    - DFT engineers
    - Packaging teams
    - Power methodology teams
    - Verification teams
  + Review subsystem floorplans and ensure full-chip integration readiness.
* **Methodology and Automation**
  + Develop scripts and automation for floorplan generation and analysis.
  + Drive methodology improvements and best practices.
  + Enable scalable planning methodologies for next-generation SoCs.

**P****REFERRED EXPERIENCE****:**

* 8+ years of ASIC/SoC Physical Design experience with strong expertise in Full-Chip Floorplanning.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* + Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering
