title: Data Strategy and Execution Lead - Trading Risk Management (TRM)
description:
Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living.

Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come.

**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

The **Data Strategy and Execution Lead** will own the Trading and Risk Management (TRM) data strategy and drive its execution: translating trading ambitions into a prioritized roadmap of trusted, governed and reusable data products, and defining the information architecture required for AI-enabled trading.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone equally credible shaping strategy with executives and challenging a pipeline design with engineers. You will partner with data teams across the organization to drive execution and convert fragmented demand into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* **DATA STRATEGY & ROADMAP:** Defines the TRM data strategy, target state, priorities and value cases. Translates trading and risk-management ambitions into a sequenced roadmap, investment choices, measurable outcomes and an execution backlog, partnering with the product teams across the organization. Leads directly or partners with other data teams to evolve critical datasets into governed, high-quality, reusable data products fit for analytics, AI and trading needs. Works across the organization to define clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards and lifecycle management.
* **INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE:** Shape, balancing corporate standards and specific trading and risk management needs, and steward the TRM information architecture, including data products, domain and semantic models, metadata, lineage and AI-ready foundations. Ensures architecture decisions support discoverability, reuse, interoperability and trusted decision-making. Partners with data functions, data architecture, security and governance teams to adopt common standards and operating models across data capture, storage, transformation and access while defining well-governed exceptions when required to meet distinctive TRM needs.
* **DEEP TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP:** Serves as the technical authority for TRM data engineering. Reviews and challenges platform, pipeline, modeling and integration designs; guides engineers through complex trade-offs; and ensures solutions are scalable, observable, resilient, secure, maintainable and ready for advanced analytics and AI workloads for TRM.Provides leadership and guidance to product teams to address high-value needs and successfully executes the TRM data strategy. Converts fragmented or ad hoc requests into a transparent, prioritized backlog with clear delivery metrics and business outcomes.
* **TRADING DOMAIN PARTNERSHIP:** Builds trusted relationships with trading, risk, operations and technology leaders to understand decision workflows, identify data constraints and shape pragmatic solutions. Communicates complex data and architecture choices clearly to executive and technical audiences.
* **CAPABILITY BUILDING:** Develops and coaches high-performing data resources across teams. Clarifies roles and ways of working across data strategy, architecture, engineering, product ownership and stewardship, while strengthening data-product and AI-readiness capabilities across TRM.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum requirement of 8 years of relevant work experience.
* Preferred candidates will typically bring 10+ years of progressive experience spanning data strategy, information architecture, data products, governance and execution, including leadership in a complex trading, commodities, financial-markets or risk-management environment.

**ROLE-SPECIFIC CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE**

* **DEEP DATA ENGINEERING & PLATFORM EXPERTISE:** Deep, hands-on engineering credibility on a modern cloud data stack in complex, mission-critical environments, combined with the architectural judgement to choose the right platform pattern and make governed data consumable by analytics and AI. Proven depth across data pipelines, distributed processing, data modeling, lineage, data quality, orchestration and production. Strong command of cloud-native and event-driven architectures, batch and streaming patterns, APIs and data contracts, and the judgement to make deliberate platform and cost trade-offs. Familiarity with agent-oriented data access patterns and with the tension between broad, cross-domain access and least-privilege controls is a strong advantage.
* **TRADING & RISK DOMAIN EXPERIENCE:** Demonstrated understanding of front-to-back trading and risk-management processes, decision workflows and data needs. Experience in commodities or another asset-intensive trading environment is strongly preferred.
* **STRATEGIC DATA LEADERSHIP:** Proven ability to translate business strategy into data capabilities, target-state architecture, roadmaps, investment priorities and measurable value.
* **COMMUNICATION AND PARTNERSHIP:** Clear, influential leader who brings clarity to ambiguity, challenges constructively and inspires action across organizational boundaries. Delivers results by mobilizing capabilities across multiple teams and using strong influencing and negotiation skills with business, engineering, architecture and governance stakeholders. Balances speed to market with enterprise standards and sustainable design.
* **EDUCATION:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is valued but not required.

**Our Offer**  
We provide a fast paced stimulating international environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities and are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and workplace. We encourage candidates to let us know if they require any accommodations during the recruitment or interview process so we can support them appropriately.

title: Mainframe Data Modernization Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**  
  
As a Principal Data Modernization Architect, you will define and own the target-state data architecture for enterprise modernization and cloud transformation programs. You will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, guiding teams and executive stakeholders on legacy database transformation, migration strategies, and enterprise data governance.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Data Modernization Architecture:** Assess legacy data environments (DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM), define target-state architectures, develop modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformation, establish enterprise migration standards/frameworks, and guide target platform selection.
* **Database Transformation Strategy:** Design migration approaches for legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native services; drive database decomposition and domain separation; and govern schema transformation, data model redesign, metadata, data quality, and data integrity.
* **Data Migration & Coexistence:** Architect high-volume, near-zero-downtime migrations and cutovers using migration waves, Change Data Capture (CDC), and real-time synchronization to ensure data consistency during coexistence periods.
* **Data Architecture & Governance:** Establish enterprise data modeling, lineage, traceability, security, compliance, privacy, performance, scalability, backup, and disaster recovery (DR) standards while collaborating with application architects.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural oversight across modernization programs, conduct architecture reviews, approve transformation designs, mentor engineering and migration teams, and advise executive stakeholders on strategic decisions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Extensive experience defining target-state enterprise data architectures and modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformations.
* Deep hands-on expertise assessing and migrating legacy mainframe data platforms, including DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, and VSAM.
* Proven track record designing migrations from legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native databases.
* Strong expertise in database decomposition, data domain separation, schema transformation, and data model redesign.
* Demonstrated experience architecting high-volume, near-zero-downtime data migrations, coexistence architectures, and cutover strategies.
* Practical proficiency implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) and real-time data synchronization mechanisms.
* Solid background establishing enterprise data governance, lineage, metadata management, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience defining non-functional database standards, including performance, scalability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery (DR).  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing enterprise-wide migration patterns, frameworks, and architectural review boards.
* Strong background collaborating with application architects to align data and application modernization strategies.
* Proven leadership mentoring database engineers, migration specialists, and cross-functional modernization teams.
* Ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders on complex modernization recommendations and strategic investments.
* Experience managing data consistency and reconciliation across hybrid source and target environments during multi-wave migrations.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native data ecosystems and multi-cloud database services.
Track record governing large-scale enterprise programs with strict regulatory and data traceability requirements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl:**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important ,you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused , someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless , naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 15+ years in data and database architecture, including 7+ years leading enterprise-scale database migration, modernization, synchronization, and coexistence programs from mainframe environments.
* **Legacy Mainframe Technologies:** Deep expertise in IBM DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM, legacy mainframe data architectures, and mainframe data modeling.
* **Modern Database Platforms:** Strong proficiency across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Cosmos DB), and cloud-native database services.
* **Data Engineering & Migration:** Hands-on experience with data modeling, schema transformation, ETL/ELT design, Change Data Capture (CDC), data synchronization, and data migration frameworks.
* **Data Management & Governance:** Proven background in establishing data quality management and enterprise data governance frameworks.
* **Architecture & Operations:** Expertise in enterprise data architecture, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), database security, performance engineering, and capacity planning.
* **High-Volume Execution:** Demonstrated success designing and delivering high-volume migration solutions and complex cutover plans.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Mainframe Modernization Expertise:** Skilled in hierarchical-to-relational transformation, database decomposition strategies, relational-to-NoSQL architecture decisions, mainframe data encoding/data-type/structure transformation, and EBCDIC-to-ASCII/Unicode conversion.
* **Large-Scale Migration & Coexistence:** Experience executing multi-wave migrations using near-zero-downtime cutover strategies, parallel run/synchronization models, CDC architectures, and data reconciliation/validation frameworks.
* **Modernization Governance:** Background in data lineage, impact analysis, mainframe-to-cloud data coexistence, hybrid data architecture, data domain rationalization, and migration risk assessment/mitigation.
* **Industry & Program Governance:** Experience governing enterprise-wide data architecture and modernization programs in mission-critical industries (banking, insurance, retail, or healthcare).
* **Cloud & AI Tooling:** Hands-on experience with cloud database platforms on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, plus exposure to AI-assisted modernization and automated schema transformation tools.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Principal Architect
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**What will you contribute?**

  

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect who will serve as a recognized enterprise technical authority for Artificial Intelligence architecture. You will set the strategic technical direction for AI capabilities across products, platforms, and business segments, including generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, AI platforms, model integration, evaluation, governance, security, and responsible AI.

Your secondary focus will be cloud and SaaS architecture. You will ensure that enterprise AI strategy is realized through secure, scalable, resilient, multi-tenant, observable, and cost-effective cloud services, while influencing investment priorities, platform evolution, and cross-product adoption

  

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**  
  
Your deliverables as a **[Role Name]** will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Set the enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference patterns, capability roadmaps, and technology strategy across multiple products, platforms, and business segments.

* Provide authoritative architectural direction for generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, model integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation.

* Sponsor and lead strategic AI research, technology evaluations, and Proofs of Concept, translating validated outcomes into reusable, production-grade capabilities with measurable business value.

* Establish enterprise guardrails for responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, observability, auditability, and human oversight in regulated environments.

* Shape cloud-native and SaaS architecture strategy for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, scalability, resilience, availability, metering, subscription models, and cost management.

* Create and drive adoption of reference architectures, reference implementations, patterns, libraries, accelerators, and engineering guidance across product and platform teams.

* Govern and review strategic architecture and design proposals for alignment with AI strategy, cloud and SaaS principles, enterprise standards, security, regulatory obligations, and long-term sustainability.

* Influence executive and senior technical decisions across architecture, engineering, product, data, security, cloud platforms, governance, and business leadership.

* Develop senior architects and principal engineers, and lead enterprise architecture forums, technical councils, workshops, demonstrations, hackathons, and global knowledge-sharing communities.

  
  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

AI Architecture & Strategy

Enterprise-wide AI target architecture, principles, standards, investment roadmaps, technology portfolio decisions, and adoption strategy across products and business segments.

Generative AI & LLM Systems

Strategic direction for LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, model routing, grounding, safety, and production controls at enterprise scale.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Enterprise standards for search, embeddings, vector retrieval, chunking, ranking, grounding, citations, authorization-aware access, and measurable retrieval quality.

Agentic AI

Enterprise patterns and governance for agent orchestration, tool use, workflow design, memory, planning, permissions, human approval, monitoring, and failure containment.

AI Platforms & Integration

Shared model gateways, AI services, APIs, event-driven integration, data pipelines, reusable platform capabilities, and consistent embedding of AI across products.

AI Evaluation & Observability

Enterprise evaluation strategy spanning quality, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, drift, telemetry, red-teaming, and continuous assurance.

Responsible AI & Governance

Organization-wide security, privacy, regulatory alignment, model risk, data governance, explainability, auditability, accountability, and human oversight.

  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

**Secondary Skills: Cloud & SaaS**
==================================

* Cloud-native architecture using Microsoft Azure or comparable hyperscale platforms, including containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed services, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering.

* SaaS architecture covering multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, identity, configuration, extensibility, metering, subscription management, data residency, and zero-downtime evolution.

* Distributed systems, APIs, event-driven integration, data platforms, observability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, operational readiness, and cross-product interoperability.

* FinOps, capacity planning, AI and cloud cost optimization, security architecture, compliance, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and platform operating models.

  

**AI architecture is the primary discipline for this role. Cloud and SaaS architecture are essential secondary capabilities for operationalizing AI securely, reliably, and at enterprise scale** .

  

**Required Experience:**

* **12 years of progressive experience in a corporate IT environment or a IT consulting company with at least 3 years in a senior role**
* **10+ years of experience in building, integrating and delivering large enterprise scale solutions using web based technologies**
* **10+ years of experience designing applications**
* **10+Year** years of experience delivering solutions in an agile environment

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health & Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

* Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

As a Product Architect, you will own the complete Radio Unit FPGA architecture, drive integration strategies, and provide technical leadership across RAN software, hardware interfaces, and platform components. This is a ground up opportunity to define architecture, influence long term technology direction, and deliver carrier grade, high performance, high-reliability platforms deployed at a global scale. If you're enthusiastic about wireless communication and excited to solve real-world challenges in connectivity (esp. RU  gNB), scalability, and network efficiency, this is your opportunity to make a direct impact in a dynamic, high-tech environment.

  

* Responsibilities: • Design, verify, and validate the FPGA-based solutions for Radio Access Networks (RAN) – 4G, 5G and 6G.
* Deploy AI-driven RTL design, autonomous agents, and ML models that optimise RAN system architecture and post-system-level verification
* Build multi-agent workflows and LLM-powered agents to automate repetitive engineering tasks and design/verification/validation loops.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including firmware, HW, L1, L2, QA, and product managers to define and deliver features.
* Develop and implement testing procedures to ensure quality control and reliability of FPGA-based solutions.
* Work closely with hardware engineers to bring up new products and support custom hardware features.
* Analyse and troubleshoot issues across hardware, firmware, and software layers to ensure system stability and tune the system for performance.
* Stay current with wireless communication technologies, standards, and best practices, and apply them to product development.

Mandatory Skills

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics and communication engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 15 years of experience in ASIC/FPGA design and development.
* Experience leading multi-disciplinary silicon engineering teams through the full development life cycle from architecture definition to FPGA image release.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-driven RTL design, multi-agent workflows and LLM-powered agents.
* Experience in high-performance or low-power design techniques, handling AMD SoC (MPSoC/RFSoC) and Altera FPGA families.
* Expertise in FPGA clocking schemes, timing constraints development and timing closure
* Debug and troubleshoot FPGA designs.
* Experience with high-speed protocols such as 25G Ethernet and PCIe

title: Engineering Director - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification
description:
**Date posted** 11/12/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19735****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/12/2026**

**Job Title: -** Engineering Director - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You have spent two decades building verification teams and solving the problems that live between IP blocks, where clean interfaces meet messy reality and independently verified components refuse to cooperate. The gap between a Controller that passes all tests and a Controller-PHY-firmware combination that actually works in a customer SoC is where you live, and you have built the instincts to close it.

You are technical enough to review a UVM testbench, debug a protocol violation three layers deep, and make the call on whether a coverage hole is real or academic. But you also know that verification at scale is not about heroic debug sessions, it is about building systems that catch problems before they become customer issues. You think in factories, not fire drills.

What excites you now is ing AI to verification work that has resisted automation for years. You see LLMs, agentic workflows, and intelligent orchestration not as buzzwords but as tools that can finally turn interoperability from a bottleneck into a continuously running capability. You are ready to build that capability from the ground up at Synopsys, where the IP portfolio is real, the customer stakes are high, and the technical challenge is exactly the kind you have been preparing for.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and lead the Central Interoperability team from scratch, defining its technical strategy, organizational structure, verification methodology, execution model, and success metrics across high-speed interface IPs including UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, and USB
* Own end-to-end Controller-PHY interoperability qualification, from UVM environment bring-up and configuration management through verification execution, functional and structural coverage closure, protocol compliance, debug, and generation of customer-ready release evidence
* Establish an always-on Interop Factory where new Controller, PHY, or firmware releases automatically trigger integration, regression suites, qualification workflows, and evidence generation without manual intervention
* Drive interoperability verification beyond basic connectivity into protocol compliance, stress and error injection scenarios, CDC/RDC checks, timing constraints validation, and implementation readiness across the Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Configuration state space
Make the factory AI-native by* ing LLMs, AI agents, RAG, MCP, and intelligent workflow orchestration to environment generation, test plan development, regression selection, failure clustering, root-cause analysis, debug acceleration, and knowledge reuse across releases
* Build a continuous learning loop where customer issues feed directly into root-cause analysis, prevention test creation, regression integration, and future release qualification, systematically converting field learning into improved product quality
* Partner across Controller and PHY R&D teams, architecture, VIP development, firmware, methodology, applications engineering, and product management to create one accountable, transparent subsystem-readiness view for every release

**The Impact You Will Have**

* You will create a new verification capability that shifts interoperability left in the development cycle, reducing subsystem bring-up time for customers and increasing the number of qualified Controller-PHY-firmware configurations available at release
* You will transform interoperability from a customer integration exercise into a continuously verified product capability, with reusable qualification evidence and clear release gates that reduce field issues and support escalations
* Your factory will establish a scalable blueprint for subsystem verification across the broader Synopsys IP portfolio, creating reusable infrastructure, methodology, and AI-enabled automation that other teams can adopt
* You will build a team culture that attracts top verification talent, mentors engineers into technical leadership roles, and keeps the organization technically engaged even as it scales
* You will make AI-assisted verification real and measurable, demonstrating how LLMs and agentic workflows can accelerate debug, improve coverage strategies, and turn tribal knowledge into reusable intelligence
* You will create predictable, data-driven subsystem readiness visibility for executives and customers, replacing subjective assessments with objective qualification metrics tied to real verification evidence
* You will reduce the time from IP release to customer-ready subsystem from months to weeks by automating the integration, qualification, and evidence-generation workflows that currently require manual coordination

**What You'll Need**

* 20+ years of semiconductor design and verification experience with significant technical leadership responsibility building and scaling verification teams
* Deep expertise in ASIC, SoC, IP, or subsystem verification using SystemVerilog, UVM, verification planning, functional and code coverage analysis, assertions, regression infrastructure, and complex multi-IP debug
* Strong hands-on experience with high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, USB, or SerDes, including protocol compliance, Controller-PHY integration, and interoperability challenges
* Proven track record integrating independently developed IP blocks and driving complex cross-functional technical programs across R&D, product, and applications teams
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl, or equivalent for building verification infrastructure, regression frameworks, and intelligent workflow orchestration
* Experience with CDC/RDC verification, formal methods, emulation or prototyping platforms, CI/CD for verification, or physical implementation flows is highly desirable
* Exposure to LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, MCP, AI-assisted verification or debug tools, or intelligent engineering automation is strongly preferred and will differentiate your application

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a technical review with verification engineers debugging a CXL protocol failure and walk out with a clear action plan, then turn around and explain the customer-readiness risk to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
* You do not wait for perfect alignment across teams to get started, you define the interoperability strategy, build the initial environment, and prove the value before asking for full organizational buy-in
* You recruit engineers who are better than you at specific things and you create the conditions for them to do their best work, whether that is deep UVM expertise, AI automation, or protocol-level debug
* You have a point of view on what good verification looks like and you push back when a test plan is too shallow, a coverage model is missing critical scenarios, or a release gate is being bypassed without real justification
* You are energized by building new capabilities from scratch, not inheriting mature organizations, and you are comfortable with the ambiguity, cross-functional negotiation, and technical problem-solving that comes with that
* You stay technical, you still read code, review testbenches, understand coverage reports, and debug failures alongside your team, because that is how you earn credibility and make good decisions

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will build the Central Subsystem Interoperability team from the ground up, establishing its charter, hiring its engineers, and defining its relationship to Controller R&D, PHY R&D, VIP, firmware, and product teams across Synopsys. This is a new capability being created to transform how independently developed IP becomes qualified, customer-ready subsystems. You will report into senior engineering leadership and work closely with architecture, methodology, and product management to establish the vision, execution model, and success metrics for this organization. Your team will become the accountable owner of subsystem readiness across high-speed interface IPs, with the mandate to build an always-on, AI-enabled interoperability factory that scales across the portfolio.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Founding Engineer - Delivery
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to run delivery like it's their own company — not manage tickets, but own outcomes. You'll sit at the center of client relationships, technical architecture, and team growth. This isn't a management role in the corporate sense — it's a build-and-own role for someone hands-on who's ready to stop being told what to build and start deciding it.

If you've been doing solid work for 5-8 years but feel like you're capped, coasting, or just executing someone else's roadmap — this is the opposite of that.

**What you will own.**

* **Client relationships**

  — run requirement calls directly, translate business needs into technical specs without a middleman
* **Architecture decisions**

  — make the calls on how things get built, not just how they get coded
* **Code quality**

  — review the team's work, set the bar
* **Team growth**

  — unblock junior developers, mentor them into stronger engineers
* **Hands-on development**

  — when bandwidth allows, build features yourself; this isn't a pure-management seat
* **Project health**

  — track delivery status, catch issues before the client does, fix them fast

**What we are looking for**

* 5-8 years of full-stack experience (MERN preferred); comfortable across the stack, not siloed
* Real client-facing experience — you've sat in requirement calls and owned the outcome, not relayed messages
* A track record of
  **building and owning**

  something end-to-end — not just maintaining what others designed
* Startup or small-team background preferred — you're used to ambiguity, not process for its own sake
* Some experience mentoring or leading other developers, even informally
* Still writes code regularly — if you haven't shipped anything hands-on in 2+ years, this isn't the fit
* Low job-hop history — we're looking for someone who wants to build something over years, not months

**What this isn't**

* Not a pure people-management role — you'll still write code
* Not a ticket-execution job — we want judgment, not just delivery against a spec
* Not a place for "20 years of experience, comfortable in my lane" — if the title matters more to you than the ownership, this probably isn't it

Competitive, based on experience — with room to grow as the role and the company do.

Chennai, in-office.

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
**About QualMinds**

At QualMinds, we design and develop world-class digital products and custom software solutions for Startups, Scale-ups, and Enterprises. Our engineering teams specialize in Frontend, Backend, Full Stack Development, QA Automation, UI/UX, DevOps, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Agile Delivery. We are passionate about building customer-centric software with the highest standards of quality, scalability, security, performance, and reliability.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
8+ years (3+ years in production LLM/agentic systems, with proven multi-agent architecture experience)

**Job Summary**

We are building
**multi-agent AI systems**
for the automotive dealership ecosystem — networks of specialized, collaborating agents spanning
**customer-facing conversational experiences**
(voice and chat agents on dealership websites that handle inventory search, payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offers, test drive and service scheduling, and lead capture) and
**internal business agents**
(conversational and autonomous operation of campaign management, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — with proactive insights, recommendations, and human-approved actions).

These are not single-chatbot solutions: you will architect
**orchestrated teams of agents**
— planners, retrievers, domain specialists, action executors, and reviewer/critic agents — that coordinate, hand off, and share context to complete complex business workflows reliably. You will own these systems across the
**entire agentic development lifecycle**
: use-case scoping, multi-agent architecture and tool design, orchestration, evaluation, guardrails, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Proven experience designing and shipping multi-agent architectures**
  : supervisor/orchestrator patterns, hierarchical and peer-to-peer agent topologies, planner–executor–critic loops, agent handoffs, task decomposition and delegation, shared state/memory design, and failure isolation between agents.
* Hands-on with current agent frameworks and SDKs with strong multi-agent support:
  **LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, Pydantic AI, or Vercel AI SDK**
  — including subagents, handoffs, and graph-based orchestration.
* Deep experience with frontier model APIs:
  **OpenAI (GPT-5.x, Realtime API), Anthropic (Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.x), Google (Gemini 3.x, Gemini Live)**
  ; familiarity with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral) for per-agent cost/latency routing (e.g., small fast models for routing/critic agents, frontier models for planning).
* Expert in
  **tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP (Model Context Protocol)**
  — designing and building MCP servers that expose business systems (inventory, CRM, campaigns, payments, reporting) as governed agent tools; working knowledge of
  **A2A (Agent2Agent)**
  for cross-platform agent interoperability.
* **Realtime voice AI**
  : speech-to-speech pipelines (OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini Live, LiveKit Agents, Pipecat), STT/TTS providers (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia), barge-in/interruption handling, sub-second latency optimization, WebRTC and telephony integration — including voice agents that delegate to backend specialist agents mid-conversation.
* Production
  **RAG and context engineering**
  : vector stores (pgvector, Qdrant, Vertex AI Search, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and reranking, context window management across agent hops, shared and per-agent memory (short-term, long-term, episodic), and freshness strategies for fast-changing data (inventory, offers, pricing).
* **Agent evaluation and observability**
  : LangSmith, Braintrust, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, or custom harnesses — golden datasets, LLM-as-judge,
  **multi-agent trajectory evals**
  (correct delegation, handoff quality, loop/runaway detection), eval-gated CI/CD; OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions with distributed tracing across agent boundaries.
* **Guardrails and AI safety**
  : prompt-injection defense, jailbreak resistance, PII redaction, content moderation, inter-agent trust boundaries, human-in-the-loop approval flows for consequential actions (payments, campaign sends, customer messaging), and compliance-aware messaging (TCPA).
* Strong
  **Python and TypeScript**
  ; modern backend (FastAPI, Node.js) and frontend (
  **React/Next.js**
  ) development, including streaming and realtime UX (SSE, WebSockets, WebRTC) and generative UI patterns.
* Cloud-native delivery:
  **GCP (Vertex AI, GKE, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, IAM, Secret Manager)**
  or equivalent on AWS/Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform; durable execution for long-running agent workflows (e.g., Temporal) is a plus.
* Modern engineering workflow: GitHub (Actions, PR reviews), Jira/Linear, prompt and agent versioning, feature-flagged and eval-gated releases.
* Effective daily use of
  **AI-assisted development tools**
  (GitHub Copilot, coding agents, Claude Code, Cursor) and the judgment to review their output critically.
* PostgreSQL and modern data tooling; event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) for agent-triggered and agent-to-agent workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present AI risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* **Architect multi-agent systems end-to-end**
  : decompose business workflows into specialized agents (routing, retrieval, domain reasoning, action execution, review/critique), choose the right orchestration topology per use case, and define agent contracts, handoff protocols, and shared memory/state.
* Design and build customer-facing voice + chat agent teams covering the full public website capability surface: inventory search and comparison, finance/payment estimation, trade-in valuation, offer discovery, appointment scheduling, and lead capture/qualification — with low-latency realtime voice, streaming chat, graceful fallback, and human handoff.
* Ground all agent responses in live business data with strict accuracy guarantees — no hallucinated prices, VINs, or offers — and implement brand-safe guardrails for public surfaces (prompt injection, jailbreaks, off-topic containment, PII handling).
* Build internal multi-agent workflows that operate backend business platforms conversationally and autonomously: campaigns, lead management, offers, payments, reporting, forecasting, and email/SMS marketing — following the
  **insight → recommendation → approved action**
  pattern with specialist agents collaborating under an orchestrator.
* Expose business capabilities as MCP tools with role-based permissions, audit logging, and approval policies scaled to action risk (read vs. draft vs. send vs. pay); enforce least-privilege tool access per agent.
* Build natural-language analytics: NL-to-SQL/semantic-layer querying, automated forecasting summaries, and scheduled executive digests.
* Own evaluation end-to-end: golden datasets per use case, offline regression suites,
  **multi-agent trajectory and delegation evals**
  , eval gates in CI/CD, A/B testing, and production quality monitoring (containment, conversion, CSAT).
* Establish LLMOps/AgentOps practices: prompt and agent versioning, per-agent model routing and semantic caching for cost control, token/latency budgets across agent chains, and observability dashboards with cross-agent distributed tracing.
* Lead root-cause analysis for agent failures (bad tool calls, wrong delegation, runaway loops, hallucinations, unsafe outputs) with durable systemic fixes and new guardrails.
* Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and platform teams to translate business workflows into agent capabilities and clear delivery plans; mentor engineers on multi-agent patterns, context engineering, and evaluation discipline; report AI system health, risks, and trends to leadership with supporting data.

title: Principal Engineer (MERN)
description:

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products
**JustInterview.ai**

* Strong hands-on Node.js and React (MERN preferred) with TypeScript

* Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Post Trade
description:
**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Post Trade Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of our brokerage systems. You will work closely with our engineering team and other stakeholders to create scalable, low-latency, and highly available trading systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build new products and features while supporting and enhancing existing ones, owning the technical architecture, design, and delivery of high-performance, low-latency brokerage systems using Java
* Partner with Product and Operations to understand requirements, translate them into implementable technical features, and deliver them
* Design and build event-driven architectures using Kafka, packaged with Docker and deployed on Kubernetes
* Support production applications by triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues, drawing on an understanding of system integration, scripting, and test planning.
* Build observability, resilience, and recoverability into applications.
* Assess the health and performance of software applications and databases, and provide software and technology solutions
* Define specifications, develop components, modify the existing software stack, prepare test data, and prepare functional specifications
* Analyze service and application performance using various programming languages, tools, and techniques

**You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
* At least 7 years of experience in Software Engineering with expertise in Java and spring framework.
* Proficient in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs and implementing sophisticated event-driven architectures using Kafka, deployed on Kubernetes.
* Capital Markets or financial technology background (required), with a focus on the trade lifecycle.
* Experience with Jira, Git, and shell scripting(writing scripts to extract and transform data)
* Proficient in NoSQL, SQL, and stored procedures, such as in PostgreSQL and MySQL
* Understanding of Test-Driven Development and how to write effective unit and integration tests
* Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, such as JFrog Artifactory, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation etc
* Experience with a 24/7, highly available architecture
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (required)
* Experience with Scrum and other Agile processes
* Strong analytical,communication and problem-solving skills

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following locations:
**Hyderabad, IN**

* This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
* If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

**Working at DriveWealth**
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.
  
  
To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.
  
  
For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.
  
  
**How We Think About AI**
We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.
  
  
**Compensation**
Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.





**This position is Hybrid with 2 to 3 times a week working from Hyderabad office.** 
 
**What You'll Do**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**•** Architect, build, and improve enterprise reporting solutions, including dashboards, semantic models, data transformations, embedded analytics, and reusable reporting assets.

**•** Design scalable Power BI semantic layers using dimensional modeling, governed metrics, reusable business logic, and performance-conscious modeling practices.

**•** Build and optimize reporting logic using SQL, DAX, Power Query, views, stored procedures, and cloud-based data-processing patterns.

**•** Work across Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and related data platforms to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable reporting solutions.

**•** Establish reporting engineering standards for source control, testing, documentation, release management, monitoring, and production readiness.

**•** Improve reporting reliability through validation checks, source-to-report reconciliation, refresh monitoring, regression testing, and operational runbooks.

**•** Partner across Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Security, QA, and business teams to translate reporting needs into scalable analytics solutions.

**•** Mentor engineers and analysts by sharing patterns, reviewing designs, creating reference implementations, and helping teams adopt consistent reporting practices.

  

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

**•** 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering reporting, BI, analytics engineering, enterprise data, or cloud data platform solutions.

**•** Deep hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, refresh management, security, and performance optimization.

**•** Experience working with Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and modern cloud-based data environments.

**•** Strong SQL skills, including experience designing and optimizing complex queries, views, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.

**•** Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, semantic-layer design, data warehousing, lakehouse concepts, and governed business metrics.

**•** Experience building dashboards, paginated reports, embedded analytics, shared semantic models, or customer-specific reporting solutions.

**•** Familiarity with engineering practices such as Git-based source control, peer review, CI/CD, automated deployments, and environment management.

**•** Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production reporting issues involving data accuracy, refresh failures, business logic, security, performance, or platform capacity.

  

**And It's Great to Have**
--------------------------

**•** Experience with Databricks or similar lakehouse platforms.

**•** Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Embedded, or advanced Azure analytics services.

**•** Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Power BI Performance Analyzer, deployment pipelines, or related performance and modeling tools.

**•** Experience designing multi-tenant, customer-specific, or embedded reporting solutions at enterprise scale.

**•** Experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, orchestration tools, copilots, or AI-assisted workflows to automate reporting engineering processes.

  

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**•** ABC's reporting solutions follow scalable, consistent patterns that support growing data volumes, customer needs, and analytical workloads.

**•** Power BI models, reports, refreshes, and data flows are reliable, measurable, debuggable, and production-ready.

**•** Teams move faster because reusable models, templates, documentation, and validation checks reduce repeated manual work.

**•** Reporting engineering practices become more consistent across teams through standards, reference implementations, mentoring, and practical enablement.

**•** Stakeholders have greater confidence in the accuracy, performance, usability, and reliability of ABC's reporting solutions.

  




**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam

* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
* Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
* Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
+ Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.

Mumbai

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:

**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The AI-PE team builds AI and data systems across the research lifecycle and across departments, from content production and client products to internal operations and coverage intelligence. We are building many pipelines and products at once, and we need people who can own them, not just build them.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with two parts. First, you will own a portfolio of production systems and build new ones, taking problems from vague business requests to systems that teams rely on every day. Second, you will support multiple teams across the company, setting the engineering standard and growing two junior analysts into strong builders.
  
  

* What You Will Own

You Will Be Accountable For a Portfolio Of Production Pipelines And Products, Each With a Clear Owner, Quality Metrics, And An Operating Schedule. Across The Portfolio, The Work Falls Into Four Areas
  
  

* Data and operations pipelines: scheduled, multi-source jobs that join data from internal and external systems, apply business rules, handle failures, and deliver results to analysts for review.
* LLM-based tools: summarisation, extraction, classification, and search across transcripts, research, and documents, built with retrieval, tool use, and agentic patterns where they fit.
* Client-facing AI products: AI research experiences delivered to institutional clients, with the reliability and compliance needed for external use.
* Coverage and demand intelligence: signals that show where research is thin, where demand is growing, and what to research next.

For each system you own, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Scoping the problem with the business owner and agreeing on success metrics before building.
* Evaluation: a repeatable way to measure quality, catch regressions, and track cost and latency.
* Operations: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and a clear path for handover when priorities change.
* Documentation that another engineer or analyst can use without you in the room.
* Supporting Multiple Teams

The AI-PE Team Works With Business And Functional Teams Across The Company, Including Content, Sales And Client Services, Product, Technology, Compliance, And Data. You Will
  
  

* Act as the technical point of contact for the teams you support, translating fuzzy requests into concrete, shippable scope.
* Prioritise across teams, make trade-offs visible, and escalate conflicts to the VP early.
* Integrate builds into the wider stack with Technology and Data, and clear the path to deployment with Compliance.
* Choose the right tool for each job: a prompt, a retrieval step, an agent, a SQL query, or a rule. Explain the trade-off.
* Diagnose data-quality and performance issues across internal systems, and make pragmatic trade-offs when those systems impose constraints.
* Coach and review the work of junior analysts, so the team's output improves over time.
* What You Bring

**Must have**

* 4+ years building and shipping software or data systems in production, including at least 2 years on LLM-based systems in production.
* Strong Python, with a track record of taking work from prototype to production: tests, monitoring, and iteration.
* Hands-on experience with LLM workflows: tool use or agentic patterns, retrieval over long documents, structured extraction, and evaluation you designed and ran yourself.
* Advanced SQL and a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), including scheduled jobs and data-quality checks.
* Experience matching records across messy sources, and knowing when deterministic rules beat a model.
* Experience owning several systems at once, prioritising between them, and keeping each one running after launch.
* Good judgement about where AI does and does not fit, and the ability to explain a trade-off to technical and non-technical partners.
* Experience reviewing other engineers' work and mentoring people early in their careers.
* Comfort handling sensitive data and access controls, including identity and compliance requirements.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with the Claude API, MCP servers, or similar agent tooling.
* Experience reducing LLM cost and latency at scale.
* Experience working with business teams across several departments, such as sales, client services, or content.
* Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery.
* Interest in private markets, investment research, or expert networks.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and running reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an infrastructure ownership role. You will build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms.
* Not a people-management role at this level. You will mentor and lead by technical example.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end to end.
* Portfolio health: uptime, data quality, and the share of systems with working evaluation and monitoring.
* Autonomy: how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your partnerships with the teams you support.
* The growth of the analysts you mentor, measured by what they can own independently after six months.

**First six months**

* Take ownership of an agreed set of existing pipelines and products, with documented owners, runbooks, and monitoring.
* Ship at least one new production system, with an evaluation harness and an agreed success metric.
* Set team engineering standards for code review, testing, documentation, and LLM cost tracking, and have them in use.
* Publish a prioritised roadmap across the teams you support, including data dependencies and risks.
* Selection Process
* Conversation with the VP on the role, the team, and the work.
* Walkthrough of a production system you built or ran: failure modes, how you measured quality, and what you would change.
* Design exercise: how you would take on a new pipeline request from a business team, from scoping through to monitored production.
* Short take-home or code review of a junior engineer's pull request, followed by a discussion.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems across more than one team, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of analysts.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**What can you expect:**
**🌏 Work From Anywhere:**
Up to 4 weeks per year.
  
  
**🏠 Hybrid Work:**
This role offers hybrid working model
  
  
**📚 Yearly PDA Allowance:**
Dedicated annual budget to support your continuous growth.
  
  
**🛡️ Health & Security:**
Private medical insurance, life insurance and 1to1help mental health support.
  
  
**📆 Time Off:**
Upto 30 days of paid leave in a year

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the embedded Google Cloud delivery authority within partner Global Delivery Centers (GDCs), establishing operational oversight across enterprise cloud transformation engagements to safeguard architectural integrity and milestone adherence.

**Reports to:**
Top management / C-suite

Industry standard
  
  
**About The Company**
India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.
  
  
**About The Role**
ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.
  
  
The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.
  
  
The role will act as the
**primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,**
ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.
  
  
The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management
* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.
* Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight
* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.
* UAT and Solution Acceptance
* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
