title: Allianz - Solution Architect - Enterprise Architecture
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect ready to define the architecture, set technical direction and govern robust enterprise solutions across our business application landscape at Allianz Technology.
  
  
Experience in SAP SuccessFactors architecture, integration architecture, OpenText and the wider HR systems landscape is a strong plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for business applications, define the target architecture and roadmap, and align them with enterprise architecture and business strategy.
* Translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable designs covering application, data, integration and security aspects.
* Lead architecture and design decisions, run design reviews and ensure solutions comply with Allianz Technology architecture principles, standards and the Design Authority process.
* Design and govern integrations between applications and platforms, including APIs, middleware, file-based and event-driven interfaces.
* Define and govern the platform strategy, including high availability, disaster recovery, performance, capacity planning, upgrade paths and cloud (Azure/AWS) readiness.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for 3rd-level support and major incidents, lead root-cause analysis and drive long-term fixes together with vendors and internal teams.
* Steer the management of system updates, patches and enhancements, ensuring compliance with IT security and regulatory requirements.
* Embed data security, access control and compliance with GDPR and other relevant regulations by design in all solutions and integrations.
* Where relevant, contribute to the architecture of the HR application landscape, including SAP SuccessFactors, related integrations and content management solutions such as OpenText.
* Collaborate with IT leadership, business stakeholders, enterprise architects and external vendors, and advise them on technology choices, risks and trade-offs.
* Mentor and coach consultants and developers, set engineering and configuration best practices, and keep architecture documentation and knowledge material current.

**Skills Required**

* Around 12+ years of overall IT experience, including a minimum of 6+ years designing and architecting enterprise applications and solutions, with at least 3+ years in an architect or technical lead role.
* Solid experience in solution and enterprise architecture across application, data, integration and security domains, with a track record of leading implementations from design to go-live.
* Strong knowledge of integration architecture and patterns, including REST/SOAP APIs, messaging, event-driven and file-based interfaces, middleware and API management.
* Strong knowledge of architecture for security, high availability, disaster recovery and performance, including database design and Windows Server/Linux environments.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) and with planning migrations, upgrades and modernisation of enterprise platforms.
* Experience creating and presenting architecture artefacts (e.g. arc42, ADRs, solution designs) and working within architecture governance and design authority processes.
* Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL certification is a major plus) and experience using tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or Remedy.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* Architecture certifications (e.g. TOGAF) are a plus; SAP SuccessFactors and OpenText certifications are nice-to-have.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, mentor others and interact with stakeholders at all levels.

**Preferred Skills**

* SAP SuccessFactors architecture, ideally Employee Central plus further modules (e.g. Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning), including configuration, MDF, business rules and role-based permissions.
* Integration architecture for HR landscapes, such as SAP Integration Suite (CPI) or comparable middleware, SuccessFactors OData/SOAP/REST APIs and SFTP/event-driven patterns.
* OpenText Content Server (OTCS) and Extended ECM, including the Extended ECM for SAP SuccessFactors integration, Archive Center, OTDS and Records Management.
* Knowledge of the wider HR systems landscape, including SAP HCM, payroll, time management and identity/access integration.
* Exposure to AI tools will be an add-on advantage.

**About Allianz**
Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all.
  
  
And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

Job Description | Principal Enablement Experience Architect - India
  
  
Location: India / In Person Team: Cornerstone University
  
  
**About Cornerstone**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
**About The Role**
Today, our customers and partners learn through Cornerstone University training and courses, our knowledge base, live events, community forums, certifications, and conversations with their Customer Success team. These experiences are centralized through the Cornerstone Community, but they live in separate systems and can feel like separate journeys.
  
  
As Product Manager & Architect, Enablement Experiences, you will define and own the enablement platforms vision, strategy, architecture, and execution for one unified Cornerstone University experience: a single front door where customers, partners, and employees find answers, connect with experts and peers, learn in the flow of their work, and prove what they can do. You’ll see where information flows, where it breaks, and where the opportunities are, and you’ll turn that into a roadmap, an architecture, and shipped experiences that drive customer adoption, partner readiness, and renewal.
  
  
This is a senior, high-ownership role: one part product leader, one part architect, one part builder. You’ll report to the leader of Enablement & Community Experiences, who owns the business outcomes for the function. You own the platform that delivers them. You’ll also act as Customer Zero for Cornerstone’s own Workforce AI and learning technology, running our education business on our own products and feeding what we learn back to Product.
  
  
The role joins Cornerstone at an exciting moment, helping shape the company’s future through our Workforce AI tools. This is a new role on the Cornerstone University team for someone with clear vision, sound judgment, and the cross-functional leadership to bring bold ideas to life.
  
  
This role is based in India, with teammates based in global geographic hubs. Weekday hours require flexing to provide overlap with members in EMEA and the Americas.
  
  
**Scope And Decision Rights**

* You own: Cornerstone University product roadmap; prioritization; target-state architecture and standards; integrations and data flows; design and build of AI-powered experiences; build-vs-buy recommendations and vendor evaluations; technical direction for learning system administrators.
* You partner on: enablement and community strategy, program priorities, budget, and executive alignment, content (Learning Design & Content) measurement and insights (Strategy, Insights & Operations); identity and security (IT and Security); CRM and customer health data (Salesforce and Gainsight teams).

**In this role, you will…**
**Key Responsibilities**
*Platform Vision, Strategy & Product Management*

* Define and own the platform vision and multi-year roadmap for the Cornerstone University ecosystem (learning platforms, community, knowledge base, certifications, events, in-product learning, and AI experiences), tied directly to customer adoption and retention, partner readiness, and education as a growth function.
* Map the current customer learning landscape, including platforms, data flows, identity, content, search, and handoffs, and identify where users hit friction, fragmentation, duplication, or unnecessary cost.
* Run continuous product discovery with customers, partners, Customer Success, Services, and Support. Prioritize by business impact and say no clearly.
* Lead build vs. buy vs. partner decisions and platform vendor strategy, backed by business cases. Evaluate vendor roadmaps and market shifts in customer education and community platforms.
* Present the platform roadmap, investment cases, and trade-offs to executives in clear business language.

*Architecture & Standards*

* Define the target-state architecture and standards for the learning ecosystem, including data models, integration patterns, identity and SSO design, content and search, and security and privacy. Partner with Product, IT, and Security to put them into practice.
* Own the shared taxonomy and metadata framework covering products, skills, roles, audiences, and content types, as the foundation for search, personalized learning paths, reporting, and AI retrieval.
* Instrument the ecosystem: define event-level learning telemetry (e.g., xAPI and a learning record store) and data pipelines so learning, community, and certification activity can be measured at account and capability level and connected to adoption, retention, and revenue.
* Ensure the experience is accessible, localized, and performs well for a global audience.

*AI-Powered Experiences*

* Lead the strategy, design, and build of AI-powered experiences across Cornerstone University and Community, such as an authenticated answer experience that blends learning, community, and support content; personalized learning paths and nudges; and AI-assisted practice and assessment. Use native Cornerstone AI first and third-party solutions where justified.
* Own the retrieval approach behind these experiences, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a governed content corpus, permission-aware retrieval, and content freshness, working closely with Content and Product teams.
* Establish evaluation and responsible AI practices: accuracy and hallucination testing, guardrails, human-in-the-loop review, privacy, and cost monitoring.
* Design for an agentic future, including integration through emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and partner agent ecosystems.

*Integration & Execution*

* Own and drive the integrations between the learning ecosystem including Cornerstone platform, Salesforce and Gainsight so learning, community, and certification data syncs to the right account and contact records and appears in Customer Success, Sales, and partner workflows, giving a complete picture of adoption, health, and renewal.
* Lead delivery of platform programs end to end: plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, vendor and implementation-partner management, testing, launch, and change management.
* Own the certification and credentialing platform infrastructure, including proctored exams, digital badges, and certification maintenance and renewal flows, in partnership with the Certification team.
* Deliver learning in the flow of work, including in-product guidance within Cornerstone and experiences embedded in the tools customers, partners, and employees already use.
* Set technical priorities for learning system administrators, review configuration decisions, evaluate platform changes, and define release and testing standards.

*Partnership & Leadership*

* Partner with your manager to translate business goals into platform priorities and to report progress and outcomes.
* Work across Cornerstone University, Customer Success, Services, Support, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and IT.
* Act as Customer Zero: run Cornerstone University on Cornerstone products and give structured feedback to Product.
* Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30-60 days: current-state map, target-state architecture, prioritized roadmap, and investment case agreed with leadership; quick wins identified and underway.
* By 6 months: unified identity and single front door in delivery; agentic experiences serving 60+% of the audience’s needs through agentic front door, learning and community data flowing to Salesforce and Gainsight account records at an agreed data-quality level; telemetry standards in place; first AI experience piloting with defined success metrics.
* By 9-12 months: single front door live for customers and partners serving 80+% of the needs; AI answer experience in production with measured resolution and satisfaction; fewer platforms and lower platform cost; learning engagement visible in account health and used by Customer Success; certification infrastructure supporting proctored, role-based credentials at scale.
* Ongoing measures: front-door adoption, time to answer, integration reliability, data quality, AI resolution rate, and platform cost, plus clear contribution to customer adoption, retention, and partner readiness.

**Required Skills & Experience**
**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

* 10+ years in learning technology, customer education, or enterprise SaaS platforms, including significant time as a platform owner, product manager, or architect who set strategy, not only configured tools.
* Proven ownership of a multi-platform learning ecosystem. You were accountable for the vision, architecture, integrations, and roadmap across learning, community, knowledge, and certification platforms, with evidence that it improved customer and business outcomes.
* Product management depth: discovery, prioritization, road mapping, business cases, build vs. buy decisions, and adoption metrics.
* A track record of leading large-scale, multi-system implementations or consolidations from strategy through delivery, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
* Deep integration experience across learning systems and Salesforce CRM, including REST APIs, webhooks, middleware, SSO (SAML/OIDC), data syncs, and learning standards (SCORM, xAPI, cmi5, LTI).
* Hands-on expertise with at least one enterprise or customer education LMS, preferably Cornerstone, or Skilljar, Docebo, Thought Industries, Intellum, Absorb, or similar.
* AI shipped in production: you have designed and delivered at least one AI-powered experience (e.g., agents, RAG-based answers, or AI workflows) used by real users with measured outcomes, and can speak to evaluation, guardrails, data governance, and cost.
* Ability to set strategy independently and communicate it at executive level.
* Comfort moving between strategy and configuration in the same day.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience integrating online community platforms (Gainsight preferred), including SSO, data, and how learning and community intersect.
* Experience with Gainsight or similar customer success platforms and customer health data.
* Customer and partner education experience at a B2B SaaS company, including certification programs.
* Experience with agent interoperability standards (such as MCP) and enterprise AI platforms.
* Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Integration Architect).

**How You Work**

* Customer obsessed: you start from the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* Innovate and transform: you challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that don’t earn their place.
* Proactive leadership: you see the problem and act before you’re asked.
* Get it done: you ship, measure, and iterate.
* Forward looking: you plan for where the technology and the business are going, not where they have been.
* AI native: you use AI every day to rethink your own work, not just to speed it up.
* Get uncomfortable to succeed: you take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Platform Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting-edge generative AI application design and production-grade cloud infrastructure. * Automate Everything: Build, optimize, and maintain robust, secure GitLab CI/CD pipelines for automated agent testing, deployment, and configuration pinning.

* GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.
* CI/CD Expertise: Proven track record of configuring complex GitLab pipelines, utilizing runners, environment staging, caching, and automated testing blocks.
* Core GCP Architecture: Solid understanding of baseline GCP infrastructure, including GKE, Cloud Run, VPC/Shared VPC networking, Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP), and Cloud Storage.
* Scripting & Orchestration: Strong programming skills in Python (preferred for Agent ADK work) or Go.

**Core Technical Requirements**
Must-Haves
  
  

* GCP AI Ecosystem: Hands-on experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder (or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform components like Agent Studio, Agent Development Kit (ADK), and Agent Engine).
* Advanced Terraform: Deep knowledge of writing reusable, modular Terraform code to manage complex cloud environments, IAM policies, and managed services.

title: Director of Engineering Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION:**
As Director of Engineering - Core Commerce Platform, you'll own the technology foundation that powers every commercial transaction across our DTC ecosystem - a portfolio of mission-critical commerce capabilities with direct, visible impact on the business.
  
  
This is a platform-first, API-first engineering leadership role at the heart of how PUMA sells online. You'll architect and deliver a composable commerce foundation built on best-in-class packaged solutions and open-source technologies, making every capability pluggable, scalable, and reusable across channels. AI-native engineering is core to how we build here: you'll embed intelligent automation, agentic workflows, and AI-driven decision-making directly into the commerce engine.
  
  
As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office-based and require regular in-person collaboration to accelerate decision-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world-class engineering capability from the ground up.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Scope of Ownership:**

* Basket & Checkout - cart management, checkout orchestration, address, tax, and shipping services.
* Payments - payment gateway integrations, payment method management, fraud signals, refunds, and reconciliation.
* Cross Channel Inventory Availability - A centralized availability layer acting as the single source of truth across all channels, governed by real-time ATP calculation and network/channel segmentation.
* Omnichannel Order Management System (OMS) - order lifecycle, inventory allocation, split fulfilment, returns and exchanges.
* Post-Order - fulfilment tracking, consumer notifications, returns portal, and post-purchase experience.
* Social & Agentic Commerce - conversational commerce, social checkout integrations, AI agents for purchase assistance and order management.

**API-First & Composable Commerce Architecture**

* Define and execute a composable, API-first commerce architecture ensuring every capability is exposed as a clean, versioned, and well-documented API consumable by any channel (web, mobile, voice, agentic).
* Own the composable commerce reference architecture for DTC: MACH-aligned (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) services that integrate seamlessly with SFCC, Fluent Commerce, and APIGEE.
* Design for pluggability that ensures payment providers, fulfilment partners, and loyalty engines can be swapped or extended with minimal coupling.
* API governance - versioning strategy, deprecation policy, and contract testing.

**Technology Vision & Product Roadmap Delivery**

* Own the technology strategy and engineering roadmap for the Core Commerce Platform, delivered in partnership with the product organisation.
* Balance investment between packaged solution capabilities (SFCC, Fluent Commerce) and custom open-source components by making principled build/configure/extend/buy decisions.

**Packaged Solutions & Open-Source Engineering**

* Lead Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) platform engineering for commerce services.
* Technical & strategic ownership of OMS configuration, customisation, and integration including order routing rules, inventory network design, SLA management.
* Drive payments engineering: integration with payment gateways (e.g. Adyen, Razorpay), tokenisation, alternative payment methods, and reconciliation.

**Scalability, Reliability & Governance**

* Own SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs for all Core Commerce Platform services by ensuring 99.99%+ availability for checkout and payments during peak commerce events.
* Lead capacity planning, load testing, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery for commerce-critical services.
* Establish security standards for PCI-DSS compliance in payments, data encryption, and consumer PII protection across commerce services.
* Drive engineering standards and governance across the organisation's codebases and third-party integrations.

**YOUR TALENT:**

* 15+ years of engineering experience, with 5+ years leading platform or commerce engineering organisations with direct product delivery accountability.
* Strong experience in composable commerce architecture - microservices, event-driven systems, API-first design, and MACH principles.
* Hands-on architectural and implementation experience with Order Management Systems - ideally Fluent Commerce, or strong equivalent (Salesforce OMS, IBM Sterling, Kibo).
* Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) or equivalent platform background will be a plus.
* Experience with enterprise integrations, API management, and event-driven architectures, including API lifecycle management, integration patterns and distributed messaging platforms.
* Payments domain experience - gateway integrations, PCI-DSS compliance, 3DS2, tokenisation, alternative payment methods.
* Strong experience with Java/Spring Boot and distributed systems, including building, modernising, and scaling large-scale commerce services (Preferred experience with Order Orchestration, Inventory, Fulfilment, Returns & Exchanges and Loyalty).
* Experience with Social Commerce integrations (Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok) and/or conversational/agentic commerce implementations.
* Strong understanding of data-intensive systems, distributed data architecture and SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* Track record of managing high-availability commerce systems through peak trading events (e.g. Black Friday, sale events).
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.

**Leadership Expectations:**
At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.
  
  
**Strategic Thinking & Vision**

* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.

**Ownership & Accountability**

* Take end-to-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.

**Innovation & Continuous Learning**

* Champion modern engineering practices, AI-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.

**Commercial & Consumer Mindset**

* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.

**Building PUMA's Future**

* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
  
  
At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
  
  
PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

- Lead and manage engineering teams across backend, frontend (UI UX), mobile development
- Drive end-to-end delivery of fintech products including mobile applications, B2C applications and lending platforms
- Collaborate with product, business, and leadership teams to translate requirements into technical solutions

Experience: 7–10 years · Work from office · 6 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

title: Technical Scrum Master
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------

The driving force behind our success has always been our people. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and collaboration across product management, architecture, quality, and delivery teams. Our teams build and evolve industry-leading process simulation and design applicationss serving refinery, petrochemical, and energy customers worldwide. You will experience a strong emphasis on Agile, Lean, and SAFe principles, technical excellence, team empowerment, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Your Impact**
---------------

We are seeking a highly motivated **Technical Scrum Master (Agile Team Lead)** to support Agile teams delivering high-quality software solutions for AspenTech’s Manufacturing & Supply Chain portfolio.

This role requires a strong foundation in **software development and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices** , combined with experience serving as a **SAFe Scrum Master** or Agile Team Lead. The ideal candidate is a servant leader and advocate for SAFe who coaches teams, facilitates effective execution, removes impediments, and drives continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.

The Scrum Master will partner with Product Owners, Product Management, Architects, Engineers, and Quality teams to foster predictable delivery, built-in quality, technical excellence, and high-performing Agile teams.

  

**Your Impact**

* Serve as the **SAFe Scrum Master and servant leader** for one or more Agile teams

* Facilitate **Iteration Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Reviews, Retrospectives, PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt events**

* Promote and advocate **SAFe, Agile, Lean, and continuous improvement principles**

* Guide teams in applying **SDLC practices** across planning, development, testing, integration, validation, and release readiness

* Identify, track, and remove impediments while escalating organizational blockers when necessary

* Support Product Owners and teams in maintaining healthy backlogs, clear priorities, and predictable execution

* Foster a culture of **built-in quality, engineering excellence, DevOps adoption, and CI/CD practices**

* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and facilitate collaboration across Agile teams within the ART

* Use Agile metrics, flow metrics, team health indicators, and delivery KPIs to improve transparency and outcomes

* Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile best practices and effective SAFe execution

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

**What You’ll Need**

* **6+ years of total experience** , including:

* **3+ years in software development, technical lead, or engineering roles**

* **3+ years as a Scrum Master, Agile Team Lead, or SAFe Scrum Master**

* Strong understanding of the **Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)** , including requirements, design, development, testing, integration, and release management

* Practical experience implementing **SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery methodologies**

* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and leading distributed, cross-functional teams

* Hands-on experience with Agile lifecycle tools such as **Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or equivalent**

* Strong knowledge of **DevOps, CI/CD, Agile quality practices, and delivery flow management**
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management skills

* Ability to influence teams, encourage accountability, and build alignment without direct authority

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline

**Nice to Have**

* SAFe certifications such as **Certified SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), Advanced Scrum Master (SASM), or RTE**

* Prior experience in **highly technical engineering software solutions**

* Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a large-scale ART environment

Software development experience  

  

**Key Emphasis: Servant Leadership & SAFe Execution**

This role requires a strong servant-leadership mindset and a passion for fostering high-performing Agile teams. Success depends on coaching teams in SAFe principles, enabling continuous improvement, removing impediments, facilitating effective collaboration, and ensuring predictable delivery of customer value. A technical background and deep understanding of SDLC are highly valued, enabling the Scrum Master to partner effectively with engineering teams while promoting Agile excellence, quality, and delivery effectiveness.

title: QA Lead -Salesforce Automation
description:
**Job Description:**

**Senior QA Engineer (Salesforce Test Automation)**

**Experience:** 7–10 Years

**Role:** Senior QA Engineer

**Work Model:** Agile Delivery Pod (client-facing)

**Focus:** Salesforce Automation Testing, Playwright, Selenium, Copado, Test Strategy & Documentation, Client Engagement

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior QA Engineer** with 7–10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on **Salesforce testing and test automation**. The candidate will define and execute test strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, and uphold quality standards across the delivery lifecycle.

The role requires direct engagement with clients. The candidate will take part in requirement discussions, present quality status and risks to client stakeholders, and propose practical suggestions to improve quality and test coverage. The candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Architects, Scrum Masters and business stakeholders.

**Must Have Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on experience in **Salesforce automation testing** across Lightning Experience, Apex, flows, and integrated business processes.
* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on expertise in **Playwright** for end-to-end test automation (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred).
* Hands-on experience with **Selenium WebDriver** and **Copado** for Salesforce release testing and CI/CD-integrated deployments.
* Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks (Page Object Model, data-driven and keyword-driven approaches).
* Experience with functional, regression, integration, smoke and UAT support testing, and with API testing using Postman or REST Assured.
* Working knowledge of Git and of integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail or Xray.

**Quality Practices & Documentation**

* Ability to set up the complete testing lifecycle, including test strategy, test plans, environment and test data setup, entry and exit criteria, and traceability matrices.
* Proven adherence to QA best practices such as risk-based testing, shift-left testing, root cause analysis and defect lifecycle management.
* Strong documentation skills, including test strategies, test reports, automation framework guides and runbooks.

**Communication & Client Engagement**

* Ability to communicate directly with clients, presenting test progress, quality metrics, risks and dependencies in a clear and professional manner.
* Ability to ideate with clients and provide well-reasoned suggestions on automation coverage, quality improvements and process optimization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with comfort in requirement discussions, estimation, and sprint ceremonies within an Agile pod.

**Good to Have Skills**

* **Salesforce Core** experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* **Financial Services Cloud** testing experience, including household and financial account management, relationship management, and compliance-driven workflows.
* Other automation and testing tools such as Provar, Cypress, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), Appium, JMeter or Gearset.
* Experience with Apex unit test validation, SOQL and data validation, and sandbox or environment management strategies.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Financial Services Cloud.
* Experience working with global teams and offshore–onshore delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks for Salesforce and web applications using Playwright, Selenium and Copado.
* Set up and govern the testing process from project inception, including test environments, test data, tooling and quality gates.
* Define test strategies, test plans and test cases aligned to business requirements and process flows.
* Execute functional, regression, integration and smoke testing, and integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Engage directly with clients to clarify requirements, present quality status, and ideate on improvements to coverage and process.
* Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including test reports, defect reports, traceability matrices and automation guides.
* Perform defect triage and root cause analysis, and drive resolution with development teams.
* Support release activities, UAT and production validation, and mentor junior QA engineers on best practices.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience in Salesforce quality assurance and test automation may also be considered. Relevant certifications are preferred.

**Location:**

DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid

**Brand:**

Merkle

**Time Type:**

Full time

**Contract Type:**

Permanent

title: Domain Architect (EDW & GCP) -Deputy General Manager
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced **Domain Architect specialising in Enterprise Data Warehousing (EDW) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** to join the Software Engineering – BIBDA function in Pune, India.

The role will provide technical and architectural leadership for secure, scalable and resilient cloud and data solutions. You will lead architecture practices across EDW and GCP, support cloud migration and modernisation initiatives, establish cloud governance, and collaborate with development, operations and security teams to deliver high-quality cloud-native solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring **18–23 years of overall technology experience**, including significant experience in architecture leadership and GCP.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Design and implement secure, scalable and resilient **GCP-based architectures**.
* Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into effective cloud-native solutions.Lead cloud migration initiatives covering lift-and-shift, modernisation and greenfield implementations.
* Collaborate with application development, operations and security teams to deliver high-quality cloud-native applications.
* Establish cloud governance models and support compliance with security and cost-management policies.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud services, features and technologies based on business and project requirements.
* Optimise data workflows for performance, scalability and cost efficiency using **Terraform, Cloud Monitoring and GCP-native services**.
* Drive innovation through proof-of-concepts and evaluation of emerging cloud technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams.
* Take accountability for end-to-end application scoping, planning, development and delivery while maintaining quality standards.
* Support project management with technical estimations and allocation of technical resources.
* Contribute to process adoption, resource optimisation and tooling improvements to increase efficiency and quality.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have **18–23 years of overall technology experience**, with extensive exposure to cloud and enterprise architecture.
* You bring significant experience in cloud architecture and engineering, including **at least 5 years in GCP architecture**.
* You have **5+ years of experience leading architecture practices**, including areas such as Domain Architecture, EDW, GCP and AWS.You have strong Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) architecture knowledge and experience.
* You have extensive knowledge of key **Google Cloud Platform services**, including:
* BigQuery
* Dataflow
* Dataproc
* Pub/Sub
* Compute Engine
* Cloud Run
* Cloud Functions
* Cloud Storage
* IAM
* Cloud Monitoring

You have end-to-end knowledge of networking, security, containers and CI/CD practices.

You have experience with cloud monitoring, logging, performance tuning and optimisation.

You are familiar with **DevSecOps** practices and tools such as **HashiCorp Vault**.

You have practical knowledge of infrastructure-as-code approaches using **Terraform**.

You can provide architectural direction and technical mentorship while collaborating effectively across engineering, operations, security and business teams.

You hold a relevant qualification such as **B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA, or BSc/MSc in Computer Science or a related discipline**.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

* An opportunity to work on enterprise-scale **EDW and GCP architecture** initiatives.
* Exposure to cloud migration, application modernisation and cloud-native solution design.
* The opportunity to influence cloud governance, security, scalability, performance and cost optimisation.
* Scope to evaluate emerging cloud technologies and develop proof-of-concepts.
* An opportunity to provide technical leadership and mentorship across engineering teams.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

This role provides opportunities to further develop expertise in:

* Enterprise-scale **GCP and EDW architecture**.
* Cloud-native application and data architecture.
* GCP services including **BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub and Cloud Run**.
* Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**.
* Cloud governance, security and cost optimisation.
* DevSecOps, monitoring, logging and cloud performance tuning.
* Architecture leadership and technical mentoring.
* Evaluation and adoption of emerging cloud technologies.

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:

Pune, IN

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.

  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.

  

**We are looking forward to hire Informatica IDMC Professionals in the following areas :**

  

**Experience Level 10+ Years**

  

**Job Title:** Tech LeadInformatica IDMC Data Catalog Implementation Consultant

### **Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) Data Catalog Implementation Consultant** to design, configure, implement, and support enterprise-wide metadata management and data governance solutions using Informatica's cloud platform. The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, governance teams, architects, and engineering teams to establish a trusted data discovery and cataloging framework.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **IDMC Data Catalog Implementation**

* Lead end-to-end implementation of Informatica Cloud Data Catalog (CDGC) and related IDMC services.
* Configure metadata ingestion, profiling, scanning, classification, and lineage capabilities.
* Set up and manage metadata extraction from databases, data warehouses, BI tools, ETL platforms, cloud storage, and SaaS applications.
* Implement automated data discovery, data classification, and business glossary integration.
* Configure technical and business metadata repositories.

### **Data Governance & Metadata Management**

* Collaborate with data governance teams to establish data cataloging standards and best practices.
* Define and implement data stewardship workflows.
* Develop business glossaries, data dictionaries, and metadata standards.
* Support data governance initiatives by enabling data ownership, stewardship, and policy management.

### **Data Lineage & Impact Analysis**

* Configure and validate end-to-end data lineage across data platforms.
* Enable impact analysis for business and technical stakeholders.
* Document source-to-target mappings and metadata relationships.

### **Integration & Connectivity**

* Integrate IDMC Data Catalog with:
  + Snowflake
  + Databricks
  + Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
  + AWS S3
  + SQL Server
  + Oracle
  + SAP
  + Power BI
  + Tableau
  + Informatica Data Quality
  + Informatica MDM
* Configure secure metadata scanning and connectivity using Informatica Secure Agents.

### **Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Data Governance, Metadata Management, or Data Catalog implementation.
* 10+ years of hands-on experience with Informatica IDMC platform.
* Experience implementing Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC) solutions.
* Experience with enterprise data governance initiatives and metadata management frameworks.

### **Technical Skills**

* Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC)
* Cloud Data Governance & Catalog (CDGC)
* Enterprise Data Catalog (EDC) concepts
* Metadata Management
* Data Lineage and Impact Analysis
* Business Glossary Management
* Data Quality concepts
* SQL and database fundamentals
* Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)

### **Preferred Skills**

* Informatica Data Quality (IDQ)
* Informatica MDM
* Informatica Data Integration
* Data Governance tools such as Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview
* Python or scripting for automation
* CI/CD and DevOps concepts

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) Professional Certification
* Informatica Cloud Data Governance & Catalog Certification
* DAMA CDMP Certification
* Azure/AWS/GCP Cloud Certifications

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

  

**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

* Prepare comprehensive GFC drawing sets, including architectural layouts, flooring plans, reflected ceiling plans (RCP), wall elevations, sections, and construction details.

* Develop comprehensive technical specifications covering materials, installation methods, finishing requirements, and workmanship standards.
* Ensure consistency between GFC drawings, BOQ descriptions, quantities, and material schedules.
* Identify missing items, discrepancies, and scope gaps before tender documentation.

**3. Technical Schedules & Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain door, hardware, flooring, wall finish, ceiling, lighting coordination, sanitary fixture, furniture, and joinery schedules.
* Develop material specification sheets with approved brands, product codes, dimensions, thicknesses, and finishes.
* Establish unique identification codes linking BOQ items, drawings, schedules, and material approvals.
* Maintain drawing registers, revision logs, and technical documentation records.

**4. Tender & Consultant Coordination**

* Prepare coordinated technical documentation for tender submissions.
* Review contractor shop drawings for compliance with approved design intent and GFC documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors, specialist fabricators, and consultants to resolve technical design queries.
* Identify and report discrepancies between drawings, specifications, BOQs, and site conditions.
* Support material approval documentation and technical clarification processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent relevant qualification.
* 5–10 years of experience in technical documentation and interior architectural detailing.
* **Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD and Microsoft Excel is mandatory.**
* Strong knowledge of luxury interior materials, joinery, stonework, metal fabrication, glass partitions, ceiling systems, and finishing techniques.
* Proven experience preparing GFC packages, detailed BOQs, quantity take-offs, and technical schedules.
* Ability to interpret architectural drawings, 3D visualisations, and complex design details.
* Working knowledge of construction methodology, material specifications, and coordination requirements.
* Excellent accuracy, organisational skills, and attention to detail.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with luxury residential, hospitality, spa, wellness, and premium commercial interior projects.
* Familiarity with Revit/BIM, SketchUp, and other design coordination software.
* Experience preparing contractor-facing tender packages and comprehensive technical documentation.

Key Deliverables

The candidate will be expected to independently produce:

* Complete, coordinated GFC drawing packages.
* Detailed construction and material junction drawings.
* Category-wise BOQs with supporting measurement/take-off sheets.
* Comprehensive material, fixture, hardware, and finish schedules.
* Tender-ready technical specifications.
* Drawing-to-BOQ cross-referencing and revision-controlled documentation.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a technically strong architect who understands **how interiors are actually constructed**, not just how drawings are prepared. The ideal candidate must be capable of independently developing precise technical documentation, identifying design and construction conflicts, and ensuring that no detail is overlooked between the approved design, GFC drawings, BOQ, and schedules.

**Candidates with strong technical detailing and BOQ experience in high-end interior projects will be preferred.**

The

This is one broad role deployed across Quality & Audit, SOX & Compliance, and Integrations against the funnel of priorities.
  
  
You deliver AI-ready data and eliminate recurring defects at the source, partnering with the Product Owner and Business Analyst to fix the process, not just the record.

* Strong HR data concepts, data-quality controls, and governance; demonstrated SOX/GDPR discipline through testing and audit-ready controls.

title: Transportation Specialist
description:
****DESCRIPTION****
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
  
  
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Purview of a Trans Ops Specialist
  
  
A Trans Ops Specialist at TOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
  
  
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
  
  
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
  
  
A Trans Ops Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To:**

* Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
* Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
* Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by TOC.
* Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
* Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
* Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
* Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24\*7 operating environment.

AWA Teknik Private Limited is an engineering design and MEP consultancy firm based in Palarivattom, Kochi. We provide Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing and Firefighting (MEP) design and consultancy services for residential, commercial, healthcare and institutional projects.

We are inviting applications from motivated Mechanical, Electrical and Civil Engineering graduates who are genuinely interested in developing a career in MEP Design and Building Services Engineering.

This position provides an opportunity to develop practical engineering skills through structured technical training and exposure to real-world consultancy projects.

The selected candidates will work with our engineering team and receive structured training before being involved in active MEP consultancy projects.

The initial two months will focus on comprehensive technical training covering:

* Fundamentals of MEP Engineering and Building Services.
* HVAC system design and engineering fundamentals.
* Electrical system design fundamentals.
* Plumbing and Firefighting system design.
* AutoCAD drafting and preparation of engineering drawings.
* Practical assignments and technical evaluations.
* Understanding engineering standards, drawings and technical documentation.

**Training Compensation:** No stipend during the initial two-month training period.

Stage 2: Remaining 10 Months – Project Work

After successful completion of the initial training period, candidates will be involved in active MEP consultancy projects.

Responsibilities include:

* Assisting in HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing and Firefighting design.
* Preparing engineering drawings and technical documentation.
* Supporting engineering calculations and design coordination.
* Working on MEP layouts and building services drawings.
* Participating in technical discussions and project coordination.

description:
**GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS**

We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options and futures exchanges worldwide. Through our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment research, trading ideas, market information and analysis.

**OPERATIONS**

Operations is a dynamic, multi-faceted function that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develops and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow.

**YOUR IMPACT**

Prime Brokerage & Clearing Operations has the benefit of being located in the nucleus of an investment bank so the exposure and interaction that the successful candidate will gain will be vast. The successful hire will interface with global team across divisions. The successful candidate will be expected to act as a change agent, by improving processes and procedures and contribute meaningfully to the overall strategy of the organization. In depth on the job training will be provided, backed up with on-going support and oversight as the candidate will be responsible for an important function within the team. The role is ideal for a candidate who wants experience of a variety of Prime Brokerage & Clearing functions.

**OUR IMPACT**

Prime Brokerage & Clearing Operations provides clearing, execution and custody services for all major products across over 75 exchanges. Clients include hedge funds, asset managers, governments, corporates, broker dealers, Goldman Sachs franchise traders, other professional investors and market markers. Operations teams supporting the Prime Brokerage and Clearing business are responsible for providing centralized securities clearing and settlement, managing cash inflows and payments, and maintaining the accuracy of clients’ positions and transactions. The Prime Brokerage & Clearing Operations consists of three functional teams, namely, Middle Office, Control & Custody Services. Prime Brokerage & Clearing Operations globally is located in London, Jersey City, Salt Lake City, Singapore and Bengaluru. The department’s key priorities are to mitigate risk, provide exceptional client service and drive strategic change.

  

**JOB SUMMARY AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The position available is with the Prime Brokerage & Clearing Operations team. The reporting line is to a Team Manager as first line management, with further supervision by the Vice President.

Key stakeholders and interactions will be with GS Trading and Sales Desks, Client Services Group, Engineering and Operations Teams, Credit, Legal, Compliance and external counterparties.

The following tasks give an overview of what is required day to day:

* Developing and maintaining strong relationships with all stakeholders – Business, Engineering, Operations and Credit. Actively engage, partner and drive changes, provide excellent service and support
* Delivering transactions in agreed timeframes, as per SLA’s whilst improving quality of processing, reducing errors and inculcating the zero-error culture
* Process payments, journals and securities movements in accordance with Firm guidelines
* Monitoring and resolving trade management exceptions by interacting with clients, brokers & other Ops teams
* Effective pre-matching & fails management tasks to ensure timely settlement of trades with counterparties.
* Investigating and resolving discrepancies of positions (cash and securities) in the firm’s books and records.
* Demonstrate effective client service by dealing with client queries with utmost sensitivity & urgency.
* Effective escalation on critical & high value breaks to senior management
* Provide technical expertise related to the implementation of new processes, global consistency, risk management, efficiency, and technology convergence initiatives among other projects.
* Completing and overseeing daily checklist ensuring all controls, procedures and processes relating to the assigned functions are followed.
* Acting as a change agent solving problems at root cause whilst also taking / making opportunities to automate flows.
  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* We are looking for an enthusiastic and committed individual who is looking to operate in a dynamic working environment where communication and teamwork skills are essential.
* Exceptional client service and relationship building are required to interact with our clients and the team.
* The candidate should have a control focus and be achievement orientated to produce results to ensure that all risk is mitigated.
* Strong organizational skills required.
* Deadlines within this role are very strict with “zero tolerance.”
* Prompt escalation and clear communication is paramount.
* Be flexible, work on projects or aid other team members.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Work experience in a Securities Middle Office, Trade Settlement, Cash Payment functions, trade support for 2+ years.
* Experience of playing a leading role in a team providing task supervision, support and training to more junior members.
* Control/Reconciliation or Prime brokerage operations experience would be a desirable
* Equities Industry and market knowledge would be an advantage.
  

**ABOUT GOLDMAN SACHS**

* Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning.
