title: GDS RMS Independence - PCIP Core Lead Analyst
description:
Location: Gurgaon

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: 13 Nov 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1756389

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Career Family Risk Management Services (Independence)**

**Role Type Lead Analyst**

**Lead Analyst - Independence - Risk Management Services**

  

This role requires the candidate to execute globally defined processes built in accordance with the EY Global (EYG) Independence policies aimed towards safeguarding EY as an Independent auditor. These services are provided to EY country practices across globe enabling them to take decisions on new client acceptances and/or continuances.

  

**The opportunity**

Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Center of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.

  

This role will be part of the largest sub-service functions, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting client-serving teams in maintaining EY’s Independence for its existing and prospective audit/non-audit clients.

  

Auditor Independence is a regulatory requirement that aims to create an ‘arm’s length’ distance between the Accounting Firm, its client serving employees and EY’s audit clients. This is done to ensure that that EY Member Practices and their professionals should be (in fact) and should appear to be (in appearance) free from interests that might be regarded as being incompatible with objectivity, integrity, and impartiality of the audit.

RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centre’s: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.

The role offers opportunities to work in a dynamic, growth-focused environment, with a special emphasis on protecting EY’s reputation as an independent auditor, by providing support on niche profiles to EY member firm practices. It also involves close collaboration with global teams and stakeholders to strengthen the compliance framework and foster a mindset of continuous improvement and client enablement.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

A senior associate/ Lead Analyst in the team will be primarily responsible to develop good working knowledge of firm level Independence concepts. The individual will be performing/reviewing procedures as laid down in the EYG Independence policies along with hands on experience in research and evaluating procedures as mentioned in standard operating model, thereby helping client serving/audit/pursuit teams in mitigating independence-related risk. In this role, candidate will be required to communicate with senior team members from audit/pursuit teams to resolve queries and gather information, thus would be expected to become a subject matter expert in Independence processes.

  

**Technical expertise**

* Thorough understanding and ability to interpret client’s company structure, applicability of different entity attributes and relationships in accordance with audit client and affiliate definition as per EYG Independence policy
* Build working knowledge of different internal Independence tools and systems under teams’ purview.
* Understand audit/pursuit team’s requirement and complete/review all assigned projects/tasks in line with the standard operating procedures
* Strong knowledge of assessing non-audit services and business relationships in accordance with IESBA independence requirements
* Conduct secondary research using internal and external databases
* Build strong credibility by sharing insights and technical acumen, while engaging in relevant discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Develop technical expertise of Independence processes to assume subject matter expert responsibilities.
* Analyse the research findings and provide preliminary recommendation in response to the research requirement
* Take responsibility for high quality execution of the engagement and overall project by using project management methodologies
* Contribute towards process improvement and/or suggest new approaches in the process
* Flags issues/potential challenges (if any) to the team managers, so that timely action can be initiated
* Understand and work towards to meet/exceed the defined individual KPIs for the role

  

**Client Management**

* Staying connected with the client serving/audit/pursuit teams during project/request lifecycle.
* Organizing and leading calls and sharing regular project status updates, addressing queries, performing follow ups and gathering accurate information to complete the procedures.
* Act as a point of contact between the client teams, members of other Independence competencies, and relevant GDS functions to effectively coordinate efforts for a project/request.
* Address and resolve any service delivery issues or escalations

  

**Teaming and Collaboration**

* Providing effective feedback to Associate analysts on projects/requests reviewed to drive highest delivery standards.
* Monitor and manage team performance by evaluating performance of individuals against defined KPI’s and offering constructive feedback.
* Ensure adherence to workflow protocols and tools
* Mentor and coach team members for professional growth and recommend training to address any skill gaps

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Manage day-to-day administrative issues and communicating appropriately to the client serving/audit teams/ team manager at GDS.
* Must possess a client-centric and enablement mindset.
* Possess strong communication and inter-personal skills.
* Prioritize tasks and manage time effectively to meet client expectations without compromising on quality or deadlines.
* Fostering a diverse and inclusive team environment where all members feel valued and included.
* Uphold the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and values.
* Be adaptable and agile in dynamic situations, facilitating change management.
* Innovative mindset with proficiency in using current technologies and willingness to adapt to new digital tools to enhance efficiency.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Masters/post-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* 3 - 5 years of experience in a research and analysis in a professional services firm.
* Candidates with exposure of handing client interaction would be preferred.
* Well-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Basic understanding of type of company structures, Ownership structures, audit and risk management concepts.

**Technologies and Tools**

* Experience in MS Office (Outlook, MS Word, MS Excel, SharePoint etc.)
* Business analytics tool like Power-BI

  

**What you can look for**

* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things
* in this fast-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team that runs on foundational values of trust, respect, integrity and teaming.
* A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with Global teams and stakeholders on strengthening the compliance framework.
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**

  

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked.

We're here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace topower access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from *seeking* to *getting*. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

#### **Your Impact on Our Mission**

A Site Reliability Engineer at Zocdoc plays a foundational role in enabling the entire engineering organization to move quickly, safely, and with confidence. Our mission is to design, automate, and operate the infrastructure and tooling that power every build, deployment, and runtime environment across the company. DevOps engineers ensure that systems are secure by default, observable, cost-efficient, and reliable, while reducing friction for developers and minimizing operational risk.

We strive to eliminate repetitive manual work through thoughtful automation, build standardization, and continuous improvement. title: AI-ML Engineer
description:
**AI-ML Engineer – VoiceArena**

**Location:**

Gurgaon (On-site)

**Type:**

Full-time

**Experience:**

1–2 Years

**About VoiceArena**

At VoiceArena, we believe voice will become the primary interface between humans and machines. We build benchmarks, datasets, and AI systems that power some of the world's most widely used speech models.

**Our mission:**

* Enable machines to communicate as naturally as humans.
* Build benchmarks and datasets that form the backbone of global speech AI progress.
* Drive improvements through high-quality, diverse, real-world data — not just compute.

**What You'll Work On**

*This is not a conventional AI/ML engineering role. You will work on real-world speech AI challenges, build scalable systems, and directly contribute to work that influences the global speech AI ecosystem.*

**Data Preparation & ML Infrastructure**

* Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines, from raw audio ingestion to structured, training-ready datasets.
* Develop reliable, versioned, and reproducible workflows for large-scale speech data processing.
* Optimize data pipelines for efficiency, scalability, and quality.
* Collaborate with research and engineering teams to ensure seamless integration between data infrastructure and model training workflows.

**Benchmarking & Evaluation**

* Design, develop, and maintain evaluation frameworks for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and speech-to-speech systems.
* Benchmark leading speech models to identify real-world strengths, weaknesses, and failure modes.
* Build automated evaluation pipelines to measure model performance across languages, accents, noise conditions, and speaking styles.
* Analyze evaluation results and generate actionable insights to improve speech AI systems.

**Modeling & Fine-Tuning**

* Fine-tune and optimize speech recognition models such as Whisper, wav2vec2, HuBERT, and other open-source architectures.
* Work towards achieving low Word Error Rates (WER), targeting approximately 5% on suitable datasets and evaluation conditions.
* Experiment with multilingual, code-switched, accented, and noisy speech data.
* Develop and improve training, validation, and inference pipelines for speech models.
* Work with large-scale, production-grade speech datasets spanning 20+ Indian languages

**Engineering & Deployment**

* Write clean, efficient, and production-ready Python code for ML workflows.
* Build and optimize model inference pipelines for performance and scalability.
* Use cloud infrastructure and containerization tools to deploy and manage ML workloads.
* Troubleshoot technical challenges across data processing, model training, and evaluation systems.
* Take ownership of engineering tasks from experimentation through implementation.

**Who We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering, preferably in speech AI, NLP, audio processing, or related areas.
* B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related technical field.
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Practical experience building, training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models.
* Familiarity with speech recognition architectures such as Whisper, wav2vec2, HuBERT, or similar models.
* Experience working with large datasets, data preprocessing, and ML pipelines.
* Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, model evaluation metrics, and experimentation workflows.
* Working knowledge of Git, Linux, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently execute technical projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with speech recognition, speech-to-speech systems, or multilingual AI models.
* Experience fine-tuning models on Indian languages, code-switched speech, or low-resource datasets.
* Familiarity with ASR evaluation metrics such as Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER).
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, distributed training, or GPU-based ML infrastructure.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects, published research, or strong GitHub portfolios.
* Experience optimizing model inference, training efficiency, or data processing pipelines.

**Why Join VoiceArena?**

* **Work on meaningful AI problems:**

  Contribute to speech AI systems, benchmarks, and datasets used to evaluate and improve leading AI models.
* **Build at scale:**

  Work with diverse speech datasets across 20+ Indian languages and challenging real-world conditions.
* **Own your work:**

  Take responsibility for building, experimenting, evaluating, and improving ML systems.
* **Learn through execution:**

  Work closely with engineers and researchers solving complex speech AI challenges.
* **Make a real impact:**

  Your work will directly contribute to advancing speech AI for millions of users.

**If you're an engineer who enjoys building ML systems, experimenting with speech models, and solving challenging real-world problems, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant-AI/ML, ProServe
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Excited by using massive amounts of data to develop Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) models? Want to help the largest global enterprises derive business value through the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI)? Eager to learn from many different enterprise’s use cases of AWS ML and DL? Thrilled to be key part of Amazon, who has been investing in Machine Learning for decades, pioneering and shaping the world’s AI technology?
  
  
At AWS ProServe India LLP (“ProServe India”), we are helping large enterprises build ML and DL models on the AWS Cloud. We are applying predictive technology to large volumes of data and against a wide spectrum of problems. Our Professional Services organization works together with our internal customers to address business needs of AWS customers using AI.
  
  
AWS Professional Services is a unique consulting team in ProServe India. We pride ourselves on being customer obsessed and highly focused on the AI enablement of our customers. If you have experience with AI, including building ML or DL models, we’d like to have you join our team. You will get to work with an innovative company, with great teammates, and have a lot of fun helping our customers.
  
  
If you do not live in a market where we have an open Data Scientist position, please feel free to apply. Our Data Scientists can live in any location where we have a Professional Service office.
  
  
A successful candidate will be a person who enjoys diving deep into data, doing analysis, discovering root causes, and designing long-term solutions. It will be a person who likes to have fun, loves to learn, and wants to innovate in the world of AI.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Understand the internal customer’s business need and guide them to a solution using our AWS AI Services, AWS AI Platforms, AWS AI Frameworks, and AWS AI EC2 Instances .
* Assist internal customers by being able to deliver a ML / DL project from beginning to end, including understanding the business need, aggregating data, exploring data, building & validating predictive models, and deploying completed models to deliver business impact to the organization.
* Use Deep Learning frameworks like MXNet, Caffe 2, Tensorflow, Theano, CNTK, and Keras to help our internal customers build DL models.
* Use SparkML and Amazon Machine Learning (AML) to help our internal customers build ML models.
* Work with our Professional Services Big Data consultants to analyze, extract, normalize, and label relevant data.
* Work with our Professional Services DevOps consultants to help our internal customers operationalize models after they are built.
* Assist internal customers with identifying model drift and retraining models.
* Research and implement novel ML and DL approaches, including using FPGA.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Own end-to-end delivery of data science engagements for pharma commercial clients, ensuring quality, timelines, and business impact.

* Champion innovation – sponsor hackathons, incubate new solution frameworks, and contribute to Axtria's data science IP and accelerators.

* Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to translate analytics into commercial impact and ROI.

* Master's or Ph.D. in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

* Hands-on expertise in statistical modelling and AI/ML tools – Python, PySpark, SQL, Databricks, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).

* Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices – CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, and governance.

* Publications, patents, or conference presentations in AI/ML/Gen AI.
* Experience building or scaling a Center of Excellence (CoE) for Data Science/AI within an organization.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, AI/ML, or Generative AI platforms.

Ethara AI is an Indian AI company with more than 2,000 engineers. We build reinforcement-learning environments, evaluation harnesses and post-training data for the world's leading AI labs.

* Strong on reliability: retries, timeouts, idempotency, observability

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

* Track record of using AI and agentic capabilities to increase personal productivity and impact in daily workflows.
* Ability to influence senior partner practice directors, delivery executives, and cross-functional leadership across Sales, PSO, and Engineering.

**About The Job**
Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
  
  
As the Partner Delivery Excellence Lead, you will serve as the principal embedded delivery authority based out of one of our primary tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai or Gurgaon). You will sit directly within strategic Global System Integrators' (GSIs) delivery environments, partnering shoulder-to-shoulder with GSI Google Cloud Platform(GCP) Practice Leaders, Delivery Executives, and Lead Architects. Your core objective is to ensure active GSI-led customer deployments are executing flawlessly without risk of failure, milestone slip, or architectural drift.
  
  
Bringing deep technical depth in Google Cloud, Data & Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (GenAI/Agentic Workflows), you will monitor project health telemetry, identify early delivery friction, and serve as the critical bridge to internal Google stakeholders, mobilizing Professional Services (PSO), Customer Engineering (CE) and Partner Leadership to deploy rapid remediation before issues escalate to the customer. Additionally, you will advocate delivery upskilling across thousands of GSI practitioners, driving adoption of Google Cloud’s Delivery Readiness Portal (DRP), Delivery Navigator (DelNav), reference architectures, and safeguarding programs.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the embedded Google Cloud delivery authority within partner Global Delivery Centers (GDCs), establishing operational oversight across enterprise cloud transformation engagements to safeguard architectural integrity and milestone adherence.
* Identify technical roadblocks and delivery risks early, mobilizing cross-functional Google Cloud teams (PSO, Support, Partner Development Managers, Customer Engineering) to execute closed-loop remediation before issues impact customers.
* Provide authoritative architectural guidance across Data & Analytics and AI/ML (Vertex AI, agentic workflows), validating partner delivery approaches on complex, mission-critical workloads.
* Drive programmatic enablement across partner delivery benches utilizing Google Cloud readiness assets, Delivery Navigator runbooks, and safeguarding programs.
* Synthesize delivery patterns and partner capabilities back to Center of Excellence (CoE) and PSO teams, informing joint service offerings and governance policies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: AI Agent Developer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled AI Engineer to architect and deploy a versatile suite of autonomous AI agents across our core business operations. You will build intelligent, multi-agent systems that automate complex workflows, integrate with existing platforms, and drive operational efficiency. This role requires a deep understanding of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and full-stack development to bring these agents into production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Agent Architecture & Orchestration: Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents capable of executing multi-step workflows, tool-calling, and complex reasoning tasks.
* System Integration: Develop robust backend microservices to integrate AI agents seamlessly with our internal platforms, third-party APIs, and core operational software.
* Database & RAG Pipelines: Configure vector embeddings and manage structured relational data within PostgreSQL to provide accurate context retrieval and long-term memory for the AI agents.
* Full-Stack Development: Connect agent backends to modern web architectures to provide intuitive user interfaces and dashboards for monitoring agent activity.
* Prompt Engineering & Optimization: Design advanced system prompts, configure multi-agent routing, evaluate output accuracy, and implement safeguards to minimize model hallucination.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* AI/LLM Engineering: Proven experience building agentic workflows using direct API orchestration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) or frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AutoGen.
* Backend Development: Strong proficiency in Python and Node.js for building scalable microservices and data pipelines.
* Vector Search & Data: Hands-on experience configuring high-performance vector databases (such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus) and optimizing RAG architectures.
* Full-Stack Integration: Experience connecting AI backends to modern web architectures, specifically Next.js and Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security).
* System Architecture: Deep understanding of agent routing, state management, and building resilient autonomous systems capable of handling real-world operational data.

title: GCM Evidence Generation Study Design & Execution Lead
description:

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Role Objectives :**
As one of the first Statistics for Study Design and Execution Leads to join the Bengaluru GCM team, this role will establish the statistical capability required to support evidence generation study design and execution, covering statistical analysis plan development, programming, and real-world data analysis.
  
  
You will also provide hands-on statistical design and programming support across the evidence generation portfolio, enabling Global Evidence Generation study teams to focus on scientific leadership, endpoint strategy, and final study decisions while GCM delivers analytical execution, statistical planning documentation, and RWD methodology support.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Initial Capability Build :**

* In the early build phase, work closely with Global Evidence Generation study leads and R&D statistical counterparts to document the scope, standards, tools, templates, and handoff protocols that will govern statistical support activities performed by the GCM going forward
* Develop programming standards, analysis templates, SAP shells, output shells, and QC checklists to support consistent and reproducible statistical execution as the team scales to two Leads
* Identify gaps in tool access, data system connectivity, or methodology guidance that need to be resolved before statistical activities can be fully transitioned to the GCM and flag these to the AD in a timely manner
* Support with development of SOPs and onboarding materials for all statistical programming and RWD analysis activities

**Statistical Analysis Planning & Study Design Support:**

* Define appropriate statistical methods for RWD analyses and draft statistical analysis plans in collaboration with the subject matter expert to address evidence generation needs across the drug development life cycle
* Lead the implementation of analytic plans, execute analyses for RWE studies using appropriate data sets, as well as standardized methods aligned with GxP for insights, publications, regulatory and payer submissions
* Help design interventional and non-interventional (real world) studies, including (where appropriate) sample size calculations and probability of success
* Develop and update HTA CTAP (clinical trial analysis plan), post-hoc analysis, and pre-specified analyses
* Work on responder analyses using machine learning
* Support external controls
* Review draft study protocols and synopses for statistical consistency and flag methodological gaps or assumptions requiring retained scientific review and resolution
* Document all statistical planning decisions, assumptions, and rationale in study files in line with repository and audit standards

**Statistical Programming & Analysis Execution:**

* Generate analysis-ready datasets based on defined use cases and implement analytical methods producing guideline-compliant outputs — including tables, listings, and figures (TLFs) with all data preparation steps documented and traceable throughout

description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineering
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**GCL:**
D3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to harness Generative AI and agentic systems to transform how therapies reach patients and sharpen commercial decision-making? As a Senior Consultant in AI/ML Engineering based in Bangalore, you will design, build and ship AI solutions that help clinicians, field teams and partners act faster and smarter—ultimately improving outcomes for millions.
  
  
Do you want to lead end-to-end delivery, from problem framing and experimentation through evaluation, deployment and monitoring? You will work across multiple disease areas and brands, integrating diverse data sources to deliver robust tools. You will join a global community of data scientists, ML engineers and domain experts, providing technical leadership on high-impact projects while deepening your expertise in the latest AI methods.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Generative and Agentic Solutions: Design, build and deploy Generative AI and agentic solutions for commercial use cases, including LLM applications and multi-agent systems on frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
* Fine-tuning and Distillation: Develop and apply fine-tuning and distillation techniques to enhance quality while reducing cost and latency.
* Evaluation and Safety: Build and operate evaluation harnesses and platforms to measure quality, safety and reliability of LLM and agent systems, using results to drive continuous improvements.
* Production Telemetry and Monitoring: Implement telemetry, tracing and monitoring for AI systems in production and respond to quality, drift and cost issues.
* Reinforcement Learning: Explore and apply reinforcement learning and feedback-based optimisation where they add measurable value.
* Classical ML Delivery: Develop and maintain traditional ML models (classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, NLP) for commercial analytics.
* Data Integration: Integrate internal and external structured and unstructured data by partnering with data engineering, informatics and platform teams.
* Technical Leadership and Code Quality: Lead technical workstreams and write production-quality, well-tested and well-documented code that scales.
* Multi-functional Partnerships: Collaborate with Commercial, Medical, IT and other partners to scope problems, define success metrics and deliver scalable solutions.
* Research and Coaching: Research and apply the latest algorithms and methods to business problems, and coach junior data scientists and engineers to set the standard.

**Essential Skills/Experience**
**Minimum Requirements**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field.
* Typically 6+ years of experience building data science and ML solutions, including recent hands-on experience (typically 1+ years) with LLM-based applications.
* A track record of independently leading data science or AI projects to solve business or scientific problems.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and working knowledge of fine-tuning and distillation approaches.
* Agentic AI: experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangGraph, Strands or similar.
* Evaluation: experience designing and running evaluations of LLM and agent systems.
* Machine learning foundations: classical ML (supervised and unsupervised methods, including classification and regression) and deep learning, including transformers, using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Programming and tools: exceptional Python; SQL and familiarity with NoSQL; scikit-learn; Jupyter; Streamlit or similar.
* Cloud: working knowledge of AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock preferred).

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Master’s or PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field. We prioritise demonstrated skills over credentials.
* Familiarity with reinforcement learning, including preference-based optimisation of LLMs.
* Experience with telemetry and observability tooling for AI systems.
* MLOps tooling: MLflow, Docker, CI/CD, and pipeline tools such as Airflow.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, and with structured and unstructured data (text and image).
* Pharmaceutical, healthcare or commercial analytics domain experience.
* Curiosity and a desire to keep learning new technologies and methods in AI.
* Ability to explain complex methods and techniques to a non-technical audience.
* Ability to collaborate closely with multi-functional, global teams.
* Good written and verbal communication skills; fluent English.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, your AI craftsmanship directly accelerates how science reaches patients. You will collaborate with diverse experts who thrive on solving complex, real-world problems—bringing advanced methods in machine learning, LLMs and multi-agent systems to life at scale. We combine bold ambition with genuine support, valuing kindness alongside pace, and we create practical solutions by putting unexpected teams together to unlock new ideas. If you want to push the boundaries of data and AI while seeing tangible impact in the clinic and the marketplace, this is where your work will matter every day.

Take the lead in building AI that changes outcomes for patients and the business—send us your CV and help shape the future of how medicines reach those who need them.

title: ML/AI Intern
description:
ML / AI Intern

Organization: ATRISI (Applied Technology & Research Institute for Social Impact)

Location: Bengaluru, India

Type: Internship

Team: Technical Build & Product

#About ATRISI

ATRISI builds institutional intelligence infrastructure for the AI-native era — through applied research, enablement programs (Amplify with AI, Resonance with AI), and platforms including JoaLLM and TWAI. We ship real systems, experiments, and deployable workflows — not slide-only pilots.

This internship sits on the technical build track: hands-on ML and applied AI work that supports platforms, programs, and internal research — with mentorship and clear deliverables.

Role summary

We are hiring an ML / AI Intern to work on models, data, evaluation, and product-facing AI features inside the ATRISI ecosystem. You will run scoped experiments, document results, and help prototype capabilities such as RAG, retrieval, and workflow intelligence — with code review and guidance from senior builders.

This is a builder internship on real codebases. It is not a passive research observer role or a student-facing program coordination role (see our Learning Experience Associate track for that).

What you will do

ML & model work

- Support training, fine-tuning, or evaluation on well-scoped tasks

- Benchmark models and summarize tradeoffs (quality, latency, cost)

- Help with dataset prep, labeling guidelines, and data quality checks

- Contribute reproducible notebooks or scripts (versioned, reviewable)

AI product features

- Prototype RAG, retrieval, or agent-style workflows aligned with platform and program needs

- Run structured evals: accuracy, failure modes, edge cases, regression checks

- Assist integrating model outputs into APIs or internal tools under senior review

- Participate in code review and testing for AI-related changes

Research & documentation

- Write short experiment summaries for engineering and program teams

- Capture learnings in internal notes or knowledge products

- Support applied research pilots when they need ML instrumentation

How we work

- Async updates via GitHub, Notion, or agreed tools

- Join working sessions when useful

- Raise blockers, data issues, and scope risks early

What we are looking for

Must have

- Pursuing or recently completed a degree in CS, AI, data science, or a closely related field

- Strong Python and comfort with at least one of: PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face

- Solid fundamentals: train/validation split, common metrics, overfitting, training vs inference

- Ability to read documentation or papers and ship a small working experiment

- Git discipline: clear commits, reproducible runs, honest reporting of results

- Genuine interest in LLMs, RAG, or applied AI in products

Strong signals (what we prioritize in review)

- A GitHub or portfolio with ML projects (coursework, capstone, Kaggle, side projects)

- A short write-up of one project: problem → approach → stack → what you learned or shipped

- Evidence you care about evaluation, not only demos (“it runs once”)

- Comfort picking tools (Python, Jupyter, HF, SQL, Docker) and learning the rest on the job

Nice to have

- Vector DBs, embeddings, or orchestration (e.g. LangChain-style) experience

- FastAPI, Node, or light full-stack glue for wiring models to products

- Builder-style work: deployed demo, RAG app, agent workflow, or Amplify-like capstone

- Notebook, blog post, or open-source contribution

Not the right fit if

- You only want generic “AI awareness” or prompt-playground work with no code

- You expect exclusively live teaching or cohort operations (that is a different role)

- You cannot commit to regular async progress and documented deliverables

What you will gain

- Mentorship on production-minded ML and AI feature work

- Exposure to a multi-platform AI-native ecosystem (platforms + programs + research)

- Portfolio artifacts tied to real institutional and student-facing initiatives

- A credible path toward ATRISI Fellowship product engineering, or research associate tracks for strong performers

Logistics

- Employment type: Internship (weekly availability discussed at apply)

- Location: Bengaluru, India

How to apply

- ATRISI site (recommended): https://atrisi.org/collaborate/ml-ai-intern#apply

- Email: analyst@atrisi.org — Subject: Application: ML / AI Intern — resume + GitHub/portfolio link + 1-paragraph project summary

- Builder Challenge:
https://atrisi.org/programs/amplify-with-ai/builder-challenge

In the application, be ready to describe \*an ML or AI project you built (or want to build here) in a few sentences — problem, approach, tools, and outcome.

Within Amazon Ads, Traffic Quality is a critical pillar of advertiser trust and marketplace integrity. Our mission is to build advanced capabilities that work at petabyte scale to detect sophisticated invalid traffic (IVT) which includes sophisticated non-human traffic, bot networks, and fraudulent engagement patterns across programmatic advertising. We are on a journey to establish Amazon Ads as an industry leader in traffic quality standards and transparency. Our research agenda focuses on staying ahead of adversarial actors through continuous innovation in detection methodologies, leveraging state-of-the-art techniques in deep learning and generative modeling, user behavior and multi-modal representation learning, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and sparse labeling methods. title: Associate Technology Consultant - Galaxy Graduate Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team**
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As the
**Celonis Services**
organization, we are the strategic implementation consulting & transformation arm of a unified Customer Organization aligned to four core mandates:
  
  

* Make Celonis Business Critical: Transform the platform into the central nervous system of our customers’ operations.
* Scale Customer Health: Drive full platform adoption to ensure long-term value and stability.
* Focus on High-Value Activities: Prioritize complex, high-impact technical work that moves the needle for Focus & Strategic customers.
* Empower Career Growth: Foster an environment where every Celonaut owns customer success while accelerating their own professional trajectory.

We deliver production-ready
**Celonis Platform**
implementations that drive measurable top, bottom, and green-line impact. Moving beyond “point-in-time” analysis, we utilize a
**Discover-and-Build**
approach to solve the world's most complex operational challenges.
  
  
In close partnership with Value Engineering, we perform data-driven discovery to validate business hypotheses against real-world data. We then build and deploy
**operational, AI-enriched solutions**
on top of the Celonis Platform that automate decisions and optimize workflows at an enterprise scale.
  
  
We don't just implement AI for our customers; we live it. Our project delivery lifecycle is accelerated by
**state-of-the-art AI augmentation**
, allowing our consultants to focus on high-level, strategic problem-solving. By serving as the eyes and ears in the field, we maintain a continuous innovation loop with our Product & Engineering teams, ensuring our frontline learnings directly shape the future of the Celonis Platform.
  
  
**The Role**
As an
**Associate Deployment Engineer within the Galaxy Graduate Program**
, you will support the end-to-end Discover-and-Build journey for our global customers. The Galaxy program unites Celonauts across different locations into one dedicated onboarding program which develops recent graduates into well rounded, skilled Services professionals in 12 months. As part of a consulting team, collaborating with more experienced consultants, you will bridge the gap between complex data landscapes and strategic business value. This role is designed for high-potential university graduates who possess a Business-Critical Mindset and the ability to understand how technical solutions can impact customer operations and improve efficiency, resulting in platform adoption and long-term ROI for our customers.
  
  
**The Work You’ll Do**
  
  

* Support Strategic Implementations: Support the implementation of Celonis Platform as a business-critical tool by connecting customer data to actionable strategic outcomes.
* Execute Discover-and-Build: As part of a project team, participate in process mining discovery activities, data transformation (SQL/Python), and the creation of AI-driven analyses to identify execution gaps.
* AI-Forward Solutioning: Leverage your technical background to build and deploy AI-forward solutions, utilizing Machine Learning and LLM integrations for our most strategic customers.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Actively participate in discovery and requirement workshops, practicing a consulting mindset to communicate technical findings to business stakeholders and continue building the solution with a strong customer centric mindset.
* Operational Excellence: Contribute to project speed and efficiency by maintaining high-quality documentation and ensuring Built-in Quality Control in every line of code or analysis produced.
* Cross team collaboration: Have the opportunity to collaborate with various teams within the Celonis organization, including but not limited to:

+ Business Analytics, Academy and Global Programs
+ Business Apps & Product and Engineering
+ Solution Architecture & Celonis Support

**The Qualifications You Need**

* Academic Background: A recent graduate (or final year student) with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* Technical Foundation: Proven experience building technical solutions during your studies or internships. You should be comfortable with Python, SQL, and have a foundational understanding of Machine Learning and AI architectures.
* Business-Critical Mindset: A strong interest in how technology creates financial value. You are driven by outcomes like ROI, efficiency, and process improvement.
* Consulting DNA: You are curious, solution-driven, and outspoken. You possess the confidence to manage stakeholders and the skills required to navigate complex corporate environments.
* Analytical Rigor: The ability to not only focus on What is the data saying? and also to recommend What should the business do, based on the findings?
* Communication: Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business impact.
* You are available to start working full time from February 1st, 2027 onwards, with the rest of our global cohort.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: Scientist – Computational Molecular Sciences
description:
**Location:**
Bengaluru – Rajarajeshwari Nagar / Onsite

**Organization:**
MetFlux Research Private Limited

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About MetFlux Research**

MetFlux Research is building Ωmex - a biology-grounded intelligence platform combining systems engineering principles, multiscale biological knowledge graphs, quantitative analytics, and mechanistic modeling to understand and predict biological system behavior.

Through MetSolve offering, we work with R&D teams across health, nutrition, personal care, and life sciences to investigate biological mechanisms, evaluate bioactive ingredients, and support evidence-informed product development through computational research.

Our interdisciplinary team brings together biology, chemistry, mathematics, and computation to turn scientific evidence and experimental observations into models, testable hypotheses, and practical research insights.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for Scientists – Computational Molecular Sciences to contribute to MetSolve's molecular modeling and in-silico R&D programs.

The role involves applying
**molecular modeling, docking, ADMET prediction, cheminformatics, and computational approaches**
to investigate small molecules and bioactive peptides, understand their interactions with biological targets, and support ingredient and formulation research.

We are particularly interested in scientists who can connect molecular-level analysis with biological mechanisms and experimental evidence, critically interpret computational predictions, and take ownership of research outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform molecular docking, virtual screening, and structural analysis of small molecules and bioactive peptides.
* Evaluate physicochemical properties, ADMET characteristics, and molecular interactions using suitable computational methods.
* Apply cheminformatics, QSAR, and AI/ML-assisted approaches for molecular property prediction and candidate prioritization.
* Investigate structure–activity relationships and potential mechanisms of action, connecting molecular findings with relevant biological pathways.
* Interpret scientific literature and experimental evidence to assess model predictions, assumptions, and limitations.
* Contribute to reproducible computational workflows, scientific documentation, and research reports.
* Collaborate with systems biologists, physiologists, and other scientists on interdisciplinary R&D projects.
* Senior Scientists: Additionally lead modeling strategies, review scientific outputs, and guide research workstreams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

Education: Master's / MTech / MS / PhD in Computational Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Computational Biology, Computational Biophysics, Structural Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.

**Experience:**

* Scientist: Typically 2–5 years of relevant research or industry experience.
* Relevant doctoral research experience will be considered alongside industry experience.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong understanding of molecular structures, chemical interactions, and biological target–ligand relationships.
* Hands-on experience with molecular docking, virtual screening, or related molecular modeling approaches.
* Working knowledge of ADMET prediction, molecular descriptors, QSAR, or cheminformatics.
* Familiarity with relevant computational tools and scientific data analysis.
* Ability to interpret molecular predictions in the context of biological mechanisms and experimental evidence.
* Strong scientific reasoning, problem-solving, and research documentation skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with molecular dynamics simulations or protein–peptide interaction modeling.
* Familiarity with Python, RDKit, AutoDock Vina, GROMACS, or similar tools.
* Exposure to AI/ML approaches for molecular property prediction or virtual screening.
* Understanding of molecular properties relevant to nutrition, cosmetic, wellness, or bioactive ingredient research.
* Experience developing reproducible molecular modeling pipelines.

**What We Value**

We value scientists who are curious about how molecules interact with biological systems, comfortable questioning computational predictions, and motivated to connect molecular-level evidence with broader physiological understanding. Scientific rigor, research ownership, and collaboration are equally important.

**Why Join Us**

* Work on real-world molecular modeling and computational R&D challenges across health, nutrition, and personal care.
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary scientists working across molecular, cellular, and physiological scales.
* Contribute to developing reusable molecular modeling capabilities within ΩmeX and MetSolve.

**How to Apply**

Apply through this LinkedIn job post or email
**talent@metflux.in**

**Subject:**
Computational Molecular Sciences – Scientist

Please share your CV and a brief description of a relevant molecular modeling or computational research project, highlighting your approach and individual contribution.

Publications, computational workflows, GitHub repositories, or research portfolios are welcome.

title: Analyst, Customer experience
description:
**Analyst - CX (**
**Operations and Data)**

**About the role**

More of our customer experience now runs on systems rather than people: automated decisions, automated conversations, automated outreach, and rules that close a request without an agent. You will be the day-to-day owner of these systems, build the smaller ones yourself, and own the customer experience data underneath all of them.

Product and engineering build the core of each system. You own what happens around it: the rules and settings, the data it reads and writes, the testing before a change goes live, the monitoring after, and the weekly answer to "is it working, and what did it save?"

You will work across our ticketing, telephony, messaging and bot platforms, and our order, pharmacy, vet consultation and clinic data. You work in SQL, Python and scheduled jobs, with version control and code review. You report to the Senior Manager, Customer Experience.

**What makes this role hard**

* **One customer, many identities.**
  A pet parent can show up under two phone numbers, several orders, a pharmacy prescription, a vet consultation and a clinic visit, each in a different system with its own id. Every profile, call list and measurement you build depends on joining them correctly and saying how much of the data each join covers.
* **Systems you do not control.**
  Much of the stack is vendor platforms. Fields get renamed, new values appear without notice, and records are edited days after they are created. You work through their consoles and APIs, inside their limits, and you catch the change before a report goes wrong.
* **Every rule cuts both ways.**
  A threshold that stops bad claims can also slow down a genuine customer. An automated answer that handles more questions can also get some of them wrong. You measure both sides, every week, and bring the trade-off to your manager with numbers.
* **Measuring what a system really did.**
  Operations teams want every customer treated the same way. You set up holdout groups anyway, so impact is measured rather than assumed.
* **Rules that apply to every call and message.**
  Consent, do-not-disturb and telecom rules apply to automated outreach. Prescription and pet health data are sensitive. You build these rules into every campaign and every table, not as an afterthought.
* **Spikes.**
  Sale days and festival weeks double the load in hours. The systems and the data pipelines have to hold, and you are the person who notices first when they do not.

**What you'll do**

**Run the CX systems day to day**

* **Decision systems:**
  keep the scoring and rules that decide customer requests working as agreed, apply approved changes, log every automatic decision, review wrong approvals and wrong declines every week, and flag drift before it costs money or trust.
* **Conversation systems:**
  maintain the content and logic of our automated conversations once changes are approved, and track quality, resolution and handover rates.
* **Outreach systems:**
  own the call flows, routing and campaigns on the CX side, and produce the daily work lists for customer-facing teams, measuring what each list produced.
* **Customer profile:**
  maintain one view of each customer across orders, conversations, calls, pharmacy, consultations and clinic visits, so every system and every person reads the same history.
* Hold every automated conversation and call to the same standard: full context on handover, an outcome on every session, a record for every call. Find and fix a broken flow before customers notice.

**Change and measure them safely**

* Test every rule, prompt or flow change on test records, test numbers or a small slice of customers before it goes live, and read back what was stored.
* Report each system every week: what it decided, how often it was right, what it saved, and what it cost when it was wrong, against the impact assumed when it was approved.
* Be first on call when a system misbehaves: pause it, tell the owner, find the cause, and write down the fix, with a named second on call and a written runbook for each system.

**Build the smaller systems yourself**

* Build tools and automations in Python, spreadsheet scripting, internal-tool builders or with AI coding assistants: quality audits on chats and calls, ticket automation rules, alerts, and small integrations through APIs and webhooks.
* Take over and maintain integrations and prototypes once they are live.
* Make sure automated flows write the right fields into each record: define the payload, test it, check what was stored and alert on failures.
* Keep code in our repositories, reviewed before release and documented. Back up before you overwrite, and read back after you write.
* Review the output of AI coding assistants as carefully as you would a colleague's.

**Own the CX data**

* Own the customer experience tables from source to report: grain, keys, coverage dates, and the pipelines that fill them, with backfills, run logs and look-back reconciliation for records edited later.
* Define metrics in writing (population, date anchor, rule, denominator) and build the CX dashboards on them. When two dashboards disagree, find out why and take the fix to your manager.
* Own the mappings from platform fields, channels, queues, statuses, campaigns, dispositions and agents to analytics columns, with a check after every change and a visible bucket for unknown values.
* Reconcile tables to each source per day and per team, check freshness, catch schema changes, duplicates and blank rates, and handle timezones and late records explicitly.
* Work with least-privilege access, keep secrets out of code, and collect only the personal data a table needs.

**Turn requests into shipped work**

* Write the requirement notes for new automations and changes: problem, rules, data, test plan and how success is measured. Your manager signs them off before they go to Product.
* Take your own projects from first request to rollout: a pilot, then coordination with engineers and vendors.
* Keep the weekly review numbers dependable, and answer ad hoc questions with findings and a recommendation.

**What we're looking for**

* 3 to 6 years in analytics, analytics engineering or product operations, including at least a year owning tables, pipelines or a live system other people depend on.
* Strong SQL: joins, CTEs and window functions, with queries you can explain and tune.
* Python for pipelines, scheduled jobs and automation, and comfort with version control and code review.
* You have run or changed a live automated system (a bot, a rule engine, an outbound calling campaign, a scoring model) and measured what it did.
* You can turn a vague request into a requirement note an engineer can build from, and explain results to non-technical teams.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore)
description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore) Responsibilities:**

* Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
* Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
* Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
* Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.
* Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers.
* Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
* Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
* Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engagements with external engineering teams (e.g., Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture) and translate complex business constraints into robust system designs
* Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between field deployments and internal engineering, using hands-on customer insights to directly shape core product and platform roadmaps
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Develop skills in AI management and security, real-time intelligence, and application architecture to support AI transformation initiatives. Stay updated with the market trends and collaborate within technical communities.
* Technical Sales and Sales Leadership: Act as a strategic change agent within the business to shape Microsoft's programs and engineering offerings. Lead the creation of scalable, field-relevant assets through internal communities. Champion Hub engagement success by connecting technical capabilities to sales opportunities and serving as a trusted voice with sales leaders and account teams.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Industry Certifications/accreditations in ‘Architecting & Designing large Scale Enterprise Solutions’ (Azure and/or GCP/AWS) is a must.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.

This position requires deep technical expertise, particularly as a hands-on-architect, as well as possess breadth of experience.

Below are preferred Qualifications

* Enterprise Architect Experience: Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect, designing and implementing large-scale, complex solutions that align with business goals and technical requirements. Ability to integrate various technologies and platforms to create cohesive and scalable architectures.
* Consultative Selling: Proven experience in a consultancy role, providing expert guidance and strategic recommendations to customers. Ability to navigate complex technical landscapes and deliver tailored solutions that meet specific customer needs.
* Strategic & Structured Facilitator: Validated customer experience in requirements capture; prioritization; capturing evidence and impact to quantify business value; issue, risk and constraint identification with a focus on strategic goals and outcomes.
* AI Solution Design Experience: Expertise in designing architectures, building, and deploying AI solutions. Experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, networking, adjacent technologies, architecture designs, migrations, and industry standards. Understanding of AI related Microsoft Cloud services.
