title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, Go)**

**Department:** Engineering  
**Role:** Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)  
**Specialization:** Applied AI, Full-Stack Engineering & Systems Integration  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Model:** Remote / Hybrid

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer who can work closely with customers and internal teams to understand business problems, design technical solutions, and deliver production-ready software.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, and customer-facing technical implementation.

You will be responsible for translating loosely defined business requirements into working applications, integrating existing systems and third-party APIs, automating workflows, and deploying solutions into production environments.

The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer comfortable working across the full technology stack, making architectural decisions, troubleshooting infrastructure, and adapting quickly to unfamiliar technologies.

Rather than focusing exclusively on building isolated software components, you will own problems end-to-end — from understanding the requirements to implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

Key Responsibilities1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development

* Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business workflows, technical constraints, and operational challenges.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve existing workflows.
* Build prototypes and proof-of-concept applications to validate proposed solutions.
* Develop customized software solutions using existing platforms, APIs, and frameworks.
* Own technical delivery from initial discovery through production deployment.

2. Full-Stack Application Development

* Design and develop web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
* Build REST APIs, backend services, and asynchronous processing workflows.
* Develop responsive interfaces and interactive dashboards.
* Integrate third-party services, APIs, and content management systems.
* Design and manage relational databases, data models, and application storage.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs between monolithic applications, microservices, and lightweight serverless solutions.
* Maintain and improve existing applications while minimizing unnecessary infrastructure complexity.

3. Applied AI & LLM Integration

* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into business applications using commercial and open-source APIs.
* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for knowledge retrieval and contextual information processing.
* Build AI-powered automation workflows for document processing, content analysis, monitoring, and summarization.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications through APIs and reusable services.
* Evaluate model performance, response quality, latency, and operational costs.
* Implement appropriate validation, error handling, and fallback mechanisms for AI-powered workflows.
* Experiment with agentic workflows and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity.

4. Infrastructure & Deployment

* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and other hosting platforms.
* Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployment environments.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment.
* Manage Linux-based servers, networking, application processes, and system services.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform.
* Implement monitoring, logging, backup, and recovery mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve application reliability.
* Optimize infrastructure costs and operational overhead.

5. System Integration & Automation

* Integrate disparate business systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors.
* Build automation scripts and lightweight services to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
* Work with databases, CMS platforms, spreadsheets, and external data sources.
* Develop data extraction and processing workflows.
* Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate existing software platforms before deciding whether custom development is necessary.

6. Technical Ownership & Collaboration

* Take ownership of assigned technical projects and deliver working solutions independently.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, customer success teams, and other engineers.
* Communicate technical decisions and implementation trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document application architecture, deployment procedures, and integration workflows.
* Identify technical risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Balance implementation speed, maintainability, reliability, and business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

**Programming Languages**

* Strong proficiency in Python or another backend programming language.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux environments.

**Backend Development**

* Experience building APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or equivalent.
* Understanding of REST architecture, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, or similar databases.

**Frontend Development**

* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Svelte, or Vue.
* Experience building responsive web applications.
* Understanding of component-based architecture and frontend-backend integration.

**Applied AI**

* Experience integrating LLM APIs into software applications.
* Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-powered automation.
* Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot LLM-based application workflows.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Experience deploying and maintaining applications on Linux servers or cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Exposure to infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

**Engineering Practices**

* Git-based development workflows.
* Debugging and production troubleshooting.
* API integration and documentation.
* Application architecture and technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in customer-facing engineering or implementation roles.
* Experience building internal tools and custom business applications.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with Nix or other declarative environment management tools.
* Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Chroma.
* Experience with browser automation tools such as Playwright.
* Understanding of data visualization and dashboard development.
* Familiarity with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development environments.
* Experience working independently in remote or distributed engineering teams.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks in terms of problems and outcomes rather than being restricted to a particular technology stack.
* Can independently investigate unfamiliar systems and integrate them into working solutions.
* Is comfortable moving between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration tasks.
* Understands the practical challenges of deploying and maintaining production applications.
* Can work with incomplete requirements and turn ambiguity into actionable technical plans.
* Prefers pragmatic engineering solutions over unnecessary complexity.
* Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Success Metrics

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

* **Engineering quality:** Maintainable, reliable, and appropriately architected solutions.

title: Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Licensing & Installation Support
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19733 **Date posted** 11/11/2026

### **Alternate Job Titles**

* EDA Licensing and Installation Support Engineer
* Technical Application Engineer, Licensing Infrastructure
* Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Tools Support
* Licensing and Deployment Applications Engineer

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years keeping the infrastructure running that everyone else depends on to do their jobs, and you know that when a license server goes down at 3 a.m. in Tokyo, someone's tapeout schedule just became your problem. You are the person who can look at a FlexNet debug log, spot the misconfigured options file or the firewall rule that is blocking port 27000, and have it fixed before the customer finishes explaining what went wrong.

You do not just troubleshoot, you think in systems. You understand how a three-server redundant licensing setup should behave, why a migration from on-prem to cloud changes the MAC address binding, and what happens when someone upgrades RHEL without testing the environment variables first. You have been in enough customer environments to know that "it worked in dev" means nothing until it works in production.

You are comfortable talking to a senior CAD engineer about daemon logs and then turning around to explain to a procurement lead why their license count does not match their headcount. You move fast, you document what you learn, and you do not wait for perfect information to start solving the problem. At Synopsys, you will work with global customers who depend on you to keep their design environments operational, and the problems you solve will directly enable the next generation of chips.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Support and troubleshoot Synopsys Common Licensing (SCL) and FlexNet licensing environments for global enterprise customers across Americas, EMEA, Japan, and APAC
* Perform root-cause analysis on complex licensing, installation, deployment, migration, and failover issues, working directly with customer IT, CAD, and engineering teams
* Design, validate, and implement licensing architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments, including three-server redundancy setups and cross-platform configurations
* Lead on-site and remote installation, upgrade, and migration activities for customers deploying or expanding Synopsys EDA toolsets
* Mentor applications engineers and provide technical leadership across support and customer success organizations
* Collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success teams to escalate critical issues, influence product roadmaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable improvements
* Build and maintain technical articles, runbooks, and self-service documentation in the Synopsys Knowledge Base to scale support and reduce resolution time

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Keep customer design environments operational during critical tapeout windows, directly enabling revenue and preventing schedule slips
* Reduce escalation time and resolution cycles for high-priority licensing and deployment issues across Synopsys's largest accounts
* Influence product development by surfacing real-world deployment challenges and customer needs to R&D and product teams
* Scale support effectiveness by creating reusable documentation, automation scripts, and training content that empower frontline engineers and customers
* Strengthen customer relationships by acting as a trusted technical advisor who understands both their infrastructure and their business pressures
* Drive adoption and expansion of Synopsys technologies by ensuring smooth deployments, migrations, and upgrades across diverse customer environments
* Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the broader applications engineering team through knowledge sharing and hands-on collaboration

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or related field with 6+ years of experience, or Master's degree with 4+ years in EDA tool support, CAD/CAE engineering, IT operations, or software application support
* Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration (RHEL, CentOS, SLES), including process management, file permissions, environment variables, and shell scripting
* Hands-on expertise with FlexNet/FLEXlm licensing architecture, including debug logs, options files, daemon configuration, and redundant server setups
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, firewalls, DNS, host IDs, and MAC addresses as they relate to client-server licensing communication
* Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash, Python, Perl, or PowerShell for log parsing, automation, and troubleshooting
* Experience with Windows Server administration for cross-platform EDA tool environments is a plus
* Familiarity with EDA product flows, Synopsys toolsets, or Agentic AI usage is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk a customer through a three-server licensing failover scenario and then write a two-paragraph summary for their VP of Engineering without losing the technical thread
* You stay calm under pressure, especially when a licensing issue is blocking a customer's critical milestone and multiple time zones are waiting for your answer
* You think like a detective when diagnosing issues, you do not stop at the symptom, you trace it back to the root cause even if it means digging through daemon logs and network packet captures
* You are detail-oriented and organized enough to manage multiple high-priority escalations across global accounts without dropping threads or missing follow-ups
* You are curious and self-motivated, you do not wait to be told what to learn, you dig into new licensing models, deployment architectures, and automation opportunities on your own
* You value collaboration and knowledge sharing, you document what you learn, mentor others, and contribute to the collective expertise of the team

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of Synopsys's Technical Sales and Applications Engineering organization, which serves as the critical bridge between customers, sales teams, R&D, and product groups. This team is responsible for enabling customers to successfully adopt, deploy, and expand their use of Synopsys EDA technologies while driving revenue growth and operational excellence. You will work closely with global support engineers, customer success teams, and product engineering across multiple regions, and you will have direct visibility into how the infrastructure you support powers the design workflows behind self-driving cars, AI accelerators, 5G chipsets, and the next wave of smart everything.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification
description:
**Date posted** 11/12/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19736****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **11/12/2026**

**Job Title**: - Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

**We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

**You Are**

You are a recognized technical leader who thinks in systems, not individual IP blocks. You understand where interoperability challenges emerge at architectural boundaries, configurations, initialization sequences, protocol interactions, firmware dependencies, clock and reset domains, implementation constraints and assumptions made between independently developed IP. Deep hands-on verification expertise combines with your ability to define technical strategy, influence architecture, and lead engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. You are equally comfortable defining a subsystem verification architecture, reviewing SystemVerilog/UVM environments, analyzing coverage, debugging a challenging Controller-PHY interaction in Verdi, developing automation in Python and presenting technical direction to senior R&D leadership. You don't simply debug interoperability problems. You architect them out of the system. The most complex cross-IP technical investigations energize you because solving them well means preventing entire classes of failures before they reach customers. At Synopsys, you will help build the next generation of subsystem interoperability verification across high-speed interface IPs, and you will pioneer how GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows transform verification from reactive debugging into continuous intelligent qualification.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Define the technical vision for subsystem interoperability spanning Controller, PHY, firmware, VIP, verification environments, and customer configurations across multiple high-speed interface IP families
* Architect a scalable Interop Verification Platform that enables continuous integration, verification, and qualification across IP releases, solving the configuration challenge across Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Protocol Mode × Customer Configuration using intelligent risk and coverage-based qualification
* Establish reusable verification architectures, methodologies and golden reference environments covering functional verification, protocol compliance, error and stress scenarios, coverage, assertions, CDC/RDC and system initialization
* Lead the most complex cross-IP technical investigations and drive systemic solutions across RTL, PHY, firmware, VIP, testbench and implementation boundaries when interoperability issues surface
* Partner with Controller and PHY architects and R&D teams to influence interfaces, observability, design-for-verification and subsystem architecture early in the development lifecycle
* Pioneer an AI-native verification architecture that applies GenAI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows across the verification lifecycle: specification to verification intent to environment to tests to regression to debug to qualification to learning
* Architect AI-assisted generation of environments and tests, intelligent regression selection, automated log and failure clustering, coverage-gap analysis, protocol and waveform debug, root-cause recommendations, engineering knowledge retrieval and automated qualification evidence

**The Impact You Will Have**

* Transform interoperability from a late-stage integration activity into a continuous product capability that accelerates subsystem bring-up and qualification across Synopsys IP portfolios
* Scale verification across increasingly complex IP configurations, enabling Synopsys to deliver subsystems that work together seamlessly before they reach customer environments
* Convert field issues into permanent prevention tests and reusable engineering knowledge, reducing repeat failures and building institutional memory into the verification platform
* Establish common interoperability methodology across multiple IP families including UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB and AMBA/CHI, creating consistency and reuse across product lines
* Create an AI-native verification architecture capable of scaling engineering expertise across products and organizations, fundamentally changing how Synopsys qualifies complex subsystems
* Define compatibility matrices and qualification criteria that provide clear, evidence-based confidence that a specific Controller-PHY combination is customer ready, reducing integration risk and time-to-market
* Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical authority for subsystem interoperability, raising the bar for verification excellence across the organization

**What You'll Need**

* 15+ years of ASIC/IP/SoC verification experience with demonstrated technical leadership on complex verification programs where you defined architecture, influenced direction, and delivered results across organizational boundaries
* Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, functional and code coverage, verification closure and complex debug, with hands-on experience building and reviewing sophisticated verification environments
* Proven experience architecting reusable verification environments for IP, subsystem or SoC designs that scaled across multiple projects or product lines
* Strong expertise in one or more high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB or AMBA/CHI, with deep understanding of protocol interactions, initialization sequences, and interoperability challenges
* Hands-on expertise with industry-standard simulation and debug tools, VIP and coverage infrastructure, specifically VCS and Verdi or equivalent toolchains
* Strong automation expertise in Python, Tcl or equivalent scripting languages, with a track record of building tools that improve verification productivity
* Experience with CDC/RDC, formal verification, emulation/prototyping, CI/CD or distributed verification infrastructure is highly desirable, as is experience or strong interest in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI and AI-assisted verification

**Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room where a Controller-PHY integration is failing in a customer configuration, debug the waveforms in Verdi, identify the root cause across firmware, RTL and protocol assumptions, and define the systemic fix that prevents similar issues across all future configurations
* You influence technical direction and align teams without relying on organizational authority, using technical credibility, clear communication and a track record of solving hard problems to drive consensus
* You mentor senior engineers by showing them how to think about verification architecture, not just how to write better tests, raising the technical bar for everyone around you
* You balance deep technical work with strategic thinking, moving fluidly between reviewing a UVM testbench, defining a three-year verification roadmap, and presenting technical direction to R&D leadership
* You see AI and LLMs not as hype but as tools that can fundamentally change how verification scales, and you are ready to architect how GenAI integrates into the verification lifecycle from specification to qualification
* You push back when an interface design creates unnecessary interoperability risk or when a qualification plan lacks evidence, because you care more about building systems that work than making everyone comfortable

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will work within the IP R&D organization at Synopsys, partnering closely with Controller and PHY architects, verification teams, firmware engineers, and VIP developers across multiple high-speed interface IP families. Your role sits at the intersection of these teams, defining the technical architecture and methodology that enables subsystems to work together seamlessly. You will collaborate with engineers in Bangalore and across global R&D sites, influencing technical direction and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. This is a highly visible technical leadership role with direct impact on how Synopsys delivers complex IP subsystems to customers.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

  
  

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

* Write and maintain architecture specifications and agent instructions so that coding agents implement consistently with the architecture. Review architecturally significant agent-generated changes as the accountable human.

* Build reference implementations and spikes for high-risk areas such as concurrency, bitemporal queries and large-scale traversal.

* Ensure that the architecture supports conformity evidence for Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262 tool qualification, together with the Functional Safety & Process Compliance Specialist.

* Identify and manage technical risks and technical debt, and advise the Lead Value Flow Engineer on feasibility, sequencing and cost.

* Design the production architecture for security, performance and operability, and define the migration and cut-over architecture.

* Hand over architecture knowledge (ADRs, runbooks, agent skills) to the successor team before first production in 2028 Q3.

  

**What should you bring along**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of ten years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in a lead or principal architecture role for data-intensive systems.

* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering systems with demanding consistency, auditability and performance requirements.

* Proven ability to lead technically through influence and to make evidence-based architecture decisions.

  

**Must have technical skill**

* Proven experience as lead or principal architect for data-intensive, distributed enterprise systems delivered to production.

* Deep knowledge of temporal data modelling, in particular bitemporal models (valid time and transaction time), append-only and event-sourced storage, revision checksums and time-travel queries.

* Hands-on proficiency in Python (for example FastAPI) and PostgreSQL, with the ability to build reference implementations for critical paths.

* Practical use of AI-native engineering: writing architecture specifications, ADRs and constraints that coding agents follow, and reviewing agent-generated designs and code critically.

* Solid understanding of cloud architecture on Microsoft Azure, including private networking, managed identities, container platforms and managed databases.

  

**Good to have technical skills**

title: Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics
description:

**About Broadridge:**
---------------------

Broadridge Financial Solutions is a global fintech leader providing technology, communications and data-driven solutions that power the financial services industry. We help businesses improve operational efficiency, enhance client experiences and make better decisions through innovative technology and data solutions.

At Broadridge, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built around collaboration, innovation, accountability and continuous learning, where employees have the opportunity to work on meaningful, business-critical solutions and build long-term careers.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The **Finance Data Product Lead – Data & Analytics** owns the design and support of data products, interfaces and processes in the Finance data ecosystem, spanning upstream systems (ERP and homegrown), the enterprise data platform, and consuming application integration.

This role is accountable for defining, supporting and governing scalable data products and processes, ensuring data integrity and reliability at enterprise scale, and acting as a trusted speaking partner to IT, Finance, and external service providers.

The role also focuses on monitoring, issue resolution, process standardization, data governance, and stakeholder communication, while guiding Level 1 resources and working closely with Level 2/3 IT support teams to drive long-term stability and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead product discovery by gathering requirements from stakeholders, users, and technical teams.
* Design, implement, and govern data quality controls, reconciliation frameworks, and exception management mechanisms.
* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data products aligned with business goals.
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and delivery plans.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, user needs, and strategic fit.
* Identify high-impact opportunities where data products can improve decision-making, operations, or customer experience.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business leaders to deliver data products.
* Drive implementation of data products in data platforms, dashboards, semantic layers, self-service analytics tools, APIs, and ML-enabled solutions.
* Establish KPIs and success metrics to measure adoption, usability, data quality, and business impact.
* Champion data quality, governance, documentation, and trust across products.
* Ensure data products are intuitive, accessible, and fit for purpose for target users.
* Manage stakeholder communication, expectations, timelines and risks.
* Continuously improve products through feedback, usage insights, and performance measurement.
* Support data ownership, governance frameworks, privacy, and compliance requirements where applicable.

**Qualifications & Skills**
---------------------------

* 7–10+ years of experience in data product management, data, analytics, or platform delivery.
* Extensive hands-on and architectural experience managing enterprise-scale data platforms handling high-volume, business-critical Finance data.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics workflows, and reporting ecosystems.
* Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Familiarity with data governance, metrics design, and data quality principles.
* Experience delivering internal or external data-driven products.
* Advanced proficiency in **SQL and Snowflake**, including performance tuning, complex validations, reconciliation logic, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with data warehousing, ETL frameworks, and cloud data platforms.
* Preferred understanding of enterprise Finance systems and ERP platforms such as **Oracle (EBS / Fusion)** and **SAP (ECC / S/4HANA)**.
* Proven experience working with workload scheduling and automation tools such as **Apache Airflow and Control-M**.
* Solid understanding of data governance, data quality, controls, and reconciliation frameworks in Finance environments.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a stakeholder-facing lead, managing cross-functional dependencies across Finance, IT, and external vendors.
* Strong ability to translate Finance business logic into data rules, controls, and permanent technical solutions.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and executive-level articulation skills.
* Proven track record of driving complex issues to resolution across multiple teams and vendors.

**Why Join Broadridge?**
------------------------

* **Work on meaningful, business-critical solutions:** Contribute to Finance data products and platforms that support enterprise-scale financial operations.
* **Be at the intersection of Finance, Data & Technology:** Work across Finance, IT, data engineering, analytics and business teams.
* **Drive transformation:** Play a key role in improving data quality, governance, automation and decision-making.
* **Collaborative environment:** Partner with diverse teams and senior stakeholders across the organization.
* **Growth & learning:** Build expertise across data products, cloud platforms, Finance systems, analytics and emerging technologies.
* **Global exposure:** Work with teams, stakeholders and technology ecosystems supporting Broadridge's global business.
* **Innovation-driven culture:** Be part of an organization that continuously invests in technology, data and better ways of working.

**Join Us**
-----------

If you are a data and technology professional who understands Finance data, enjoys solving complex business problems, and can bridge the gap between Finance, Data and IT, we would love to hear from you.

**Join Broadridge and help shape the future of Finance Data Products.**

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

============================================

The Supply Chain Operations team plays a critical role in enabling the end-to-end supply chain ecosystem. We are responsible for managing key business processes and supporting the development and execution of capabilities that enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and responsiveness. Our team is collaborative, data-driven, and focused on delivering value through continuous improvement and strategic planning.

===============

The Analyst – Facility Engineering & Asset Management is an individual contributor responsible for executing data analytics, reporting, and performance monitoring activities supporting facility engineering, maintenance excellence, and asset lifecycle management across Target’s supply chain network, with a strong focus on 4-wall operations.

The role analyzes facility maintenance, asset management, and material handling equipment (MHE) data to identify performance gaps and generate actionable insights related to equipment reliability, asset productivity, maintenance optimization, and operational efficiency. * Have an understanding of the engineering aspects of asset functioning to evaluate the maintenance and spare parts details

SQL, Python, R, Power BI, Tableau or similar tools; data extraction, cleaning and validation; advanced Excel; dashboard development and KPI reporting; asset performance and maintenance analytics; reliability metrics systems and material handling equipment.

* Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar visualization tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including interpreting large datasets and identifying meaningful trends.
* Understanding of data validation, data quality, and reporting processes.
* Ability to translate business requirements into analytical outputs and actionable insights.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to independently manage assigned work and meet timelines.
* Willingness to learn facility engineering, asset management, and maintenance processes in a global supply chain environment.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Exposure to facility engineering, maintenance operations, asset management, or MHE in distribution or manufacturing environments.
* Exposure to retail operations, supply chain, distribution centers, warehouse operations, manufacturing, logistics, or industrial engineering environments.
* Familiarity with CMMS/EAM platforms such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo.
* Experience working with operational, equipment, or maintenance datasets.
* Exposure to reporting automation, predictive analytics, AI/ML, or advanced analytics.

Exposure to working in warehouse operations

title: Data Analytics & Management - Assistant Vice President
description:
**AVP – Business Analyst Solutions Lead, Anaplan Solutions**

  

The **Data & Artificial Intelligence (DART) Team** is responsible for providing business and data solutions for our Finance business partners.

  
  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Business Analyst at Assistant Vice President (AVP) level** with strong business analysis, solution design, and change delivery experience, along with **working knowledgeproficient in usage, design and functional development of Anaplan** solutions.

  
  

The successful candidate will act as a key bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, technology teams, and Anaplan developers. The role will be responsible for understanding complex business requirements and **designing fit-for-purpose solutions on Anaplan** , including defining business processes, data requirements, model structures, calculations, workflows, reporting requirements, and user experience.

  
  

This is a **hands-on solution design role** . The individual is expected to challenge requirements, identify opportunities for simplification and automation, and translate business needs into clear functional designs that can be implemented effectively within Anaplan.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Anaplan Solution Design**

* Lead the translation of complex business requirements into **Anaplan functional and solution workflow design** specification **s** .
* Assess business processes and determine how requirements can best be addressed using Anaplan capabilities.
* Design solutions covering:
  + Models, modules and dimensions
  + Lists and hierarchies
  + Calculations and business rules
  + Data inputs and outputs
  + Dashboards and management reporting
  + Workflow and approval processes
  + User roles and access requirements
  + Integration and data requirements
* Develop prototypes or solution concepts to validate requirements with stakeholders before development.
* Work closely with Anaplan developers and technical teams to ensure that the implemented solution aligns with the approved functional design.
* Apply sound Anaplan design principles to ensure solutions are **scalable, maintainable, performant, and user-friendly** .
  

  

**Business Analysis & Requirements Management**

* Partner with senior business stakeholders to understand business objectives, pain points, processes, and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops to gather, challenge, prioritize, and document requirements.
* Translate business requirements into detailed:
  + Business Requirement Documents
  + Functional specifications
  + Process flows
  + Data mappings
  + User stories
  + Acceptance criteria
  + Solution design documentation
* Perform gap analysis between current-state processes and proposed Anaplan capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, spreadsheets, reconciliations, and redundant controls.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability from business requirements through solution design, development, testing, and implementation.
  

  

**Data & Integration**

* Define data requirements and mappings between Anaplan and upstream/downstream systems.
* Work with data and technology teams to understand data structures, hierarchies, reference data, and interfaces.
* Define transformation, validation, reconciliation, and exception-handling requirements.
* Partner with technical teams to design appropriate integration approaches for inbound and outbound data.
* Ensure appropriate data quality and reconciliation controls are incorporated into the solution.
  

  

**Development**

* Experience designing Anaplan UX, including planning/input pages, dashboards, reporting views, workflows, approvals, and role-based user experiences.
* Experience building Data Hub and Connected Planning architectures, including master data, mappings, transactional data, and model-to-model data flows.
* Hands-on experience building data integrations and automation using imports, exports, actions, processes, CloudWorks, Anaplan Connect, and/or APIs.
* Ability to build data validation, reconciliation, security, and controls, including exception reporting, selective access, and Dynamic Cell Access.
* Experience optimizing and troubleshooting models for dimensionality, sparsity, calculation efficiency, model size, data volumes, and overall performance.
* Experience managing application SDLC and production support.
  

  

**Testing & Implementation**

* Define functional test strategies and acceptance criteria.
* Support System Integration Testing and lead/co-ordinate User Acceptance Testing.
* Validate developed Anaplan functionality against approved business and functional requirements.
* Manage defects and work with developers and stakeholders through resolution.
* Support implementation planning, production readiness, migration, and post-implementation stabilization.
  

  

**Stakeholder & Delivery Leadership**

* Act as a **solution lead and trusted advisor** for business stakeholders on Anaplan-enabled transformation.
* Facilitate discussions across business, operations, data, technology, and product teams.
* Challenge requirements constructively and recommend simpler or more scalable approaches where appropriate.
* Communicate solution options, design decisions, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
* Provide functional direction and guidance to Business Analysts and developers working on the initiative.
* Manage multiple priorities and deliverables across complex transformation programs.
  

  

**Required Experience**

* **10+ years of experience** in Business Analysis, change management, transformation, technology delivery, or related roles within financial services or another complex enterprise environment.
* Experience operating at a **Lead Business Analyst / AVP-equivalent level** .
* Demonstrable experience translating business requirements into **functional and solution designs** .
* Working knowledge of **Anaplan** , with the ability to design and articulate how business requirements should be implemented within the platform.
* Understanding of Anaplan concepts including:
  + Models, modules and lists
  + Dimensions and hierarchies
  + Line items and calculations
  + Versions and scenarios
  + Dashboards/pages
  + Roles and selective access
  + Import/export processes and integrations
* Strong understanding of data analysis, data mapping, reconciliation, and integration concepts.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Strong workshop facilitation and requirements elicitation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex solution designs to both business and technical audiences.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing **Anaplan solutions within financial services, finance, regulatory reporting, planning, forecasting, workforce planning, or management reporting** .
* Anaplan Model Builder certification or equivalent practical model-building experience.
* Experience with large-scale transformation or platform implementation programs.
* Familiarity with APIs, ETL/data integration concepts, cloud platforms, and enterprise data architecture.
* Experience working with globally distributed business and technology teams.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore)
description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore) Responsibilities:**

* Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
* Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
* Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
* Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.

description:

**MQ IIB Job Description:**  
Middleware - Enterprise Messaging and Integration Administrator
  
Role Summary
  
NTT DATA is seeking -- years of experienced Enterprise Messaging Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise-grade messaging, integration, and workload automation platforms. This role ensures secure, reliable, high performance communication between distributed applications using IBM, Apache, and open source messaging technologies. The engineer also manages complex scheduling environments and contributes to automation, observability, and continuous improvement of mission critical integration systems.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Messaging Platform Administration (IBM MQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ)
  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and secure messaging platforms.
* Create and manage messaging artifacts: queue managers, queues, topics, channels, listeners, security settings, retention policies.
* Implement HA/DR, clustering, replication, and multi-node failover strategies.
* Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning.
* Monitor health metrics using dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Splunk) and handle incidents proactively.
* Troubleshoot message flow failures, dead-letter queues, consumer lag, stuck messages, and network bottlenecks.

2. Integration Engineering (IBM IIB / ACE)
  

* Design, develop, and deploy message flows using ESQL, Java, mapping nodes, REST/SOAP connectors, MQ/Kafka nodes.
* Build and manage BAR files, integration nodes, servers, policies, and environment overrides.
* Implement integration security: TLS/mTLS, OAuth/JWT, Basic Auth, certificate management.
* Troubleshoot and optimize integration flows for latency, throughput, parser efficiency, and memory footprint.
* Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, unit testing, and environment migrations.

3. IoT Telemetry Messaging (IBM MQXR / MQTT)
  

* Configure and support MQXR Telemetry listeners, MQTT topics, subscriptions, and QoS policies.
* Secure MQTT clients using TLS certificates, access control, and throttling policies.
* Monitor MQTT client connections, sessions, retained messages, and message routing to backend MQ systems.

4. Workload Automation (IBM TWS / IWS)
  

* Install, upgrade, configure, and administer TWS/IWS masters, controllers, and agents.
* Build job streams, calendars, dependencies, event triggers, and SLA monitoring.
* Troubleshoot job failures, optimize schedules, and implement recovery workflows.
* Integrate workload scheduler with MQ, REST APIs, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications.

5. Security, Governance Compliance
  

* Implement end to end security for messaging and integration technologies:

TLS/SSL, mTLS, JAAS, CHLAUTH policies, RBAC, OAuth/SASL.
  

* Perform auditing reporting for security compliance frameworks.
* Ensure platform hardening, certificate rotation, and vulnerability remediation.

6. Automation, DevOps Observability
  

* Create automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for deployments, housekeeping, and monitoring.
* Build IaC templates (Ansible, Terraform) for consistent provisioning.
* Integrate platforms into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
* Maintain dashboards for real time system health and SLA adherence.

7. Documentation Collaboration
  

* Create runbooks, SOPs, operational guidelines, and architectural diagrams.
* Work closely with application teams, architects, network, cloud, and security teams.
* Participate in on call rotation and production support responsibilities.

Required Skills Experience
  

* Strong working knowledge of:

o  IBM MQ (Distributed / MQ Clustering / Security)
  
o  IBM IIB/ACE development administration
  
o  IBM TWS/IWS job scheduling
  
o  MQTT / MQXR messaging
  
o  Apache Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, ACLs, Schema Registry)
  
o  Apache ActiveMQ (Classic/Artemis)
  
o  RabbitMQ (AMQP, mirrored/quorum queues, federation/shovel)
  

* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Strong debugging skills across messaging, network, TLS, and application layers.
* Good understanding of networking (TCP/IP, firewalls, load balancers, proxies).

title: Lead Software & Systems Architect AIRE
description:
Required Experience, minimum: 10 years

  

Required Experience, maximum: 12 years

  

* Minimum Qualification: B.Tech/B.E

  

**Role**

**Lead Software & Systems Architect (Expert)**

  

**Visit our website** **bmwtechworks.in** **to know more.**

  
  

**About the UNIT/ Unit Overview**

AIRE (AI-native Requirements Engineering) is a new BMW Group tool for managing vehicle requirements, the descriptions of what a car and its software must do. It keeps the full history of every requirement, shows how requirements are linked to each other and to tests, and shows what is affected when something changes. It helps teams meet automotive standards such as Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262. AIRE is built for AI agents first and a user interface later, and the team uses AI agents to help build it. In this role you design the overall structure of AIRE and make the key technical decisions.

  

**Location**

Pune / Bangalore

  

**Experience**

Minimum of ten years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in a lead or principal architecture role for data-intensive systems.

  

**Number of openings**

1

  

**What awaits you/ Job Profile**

* Own the target architecture and its documentation (arc42, C4, ADRs). Decide and document the open architecture decisions, for example storage technology, graph store, branching model and deployment platform, based on prototypes and measured evidence.

* Design the bitemporal, append-only core model, including revision checksums, time travel, baselines and the semantics of branching and three-way merge.

* Define the CQRS split between the relational source of truth and the graph read index, including synchronisation, consistency guarantees and rebuild strategies.

* Define the domain-action architecture together with the Senior Agent & Domain Action Engineer: typed contracts, idempotency, error semantics, authorisation hooks, approval gates and audit events. Ensure that agents never access the database directly.

* Translate quality goals into automated fitness functions and architecture checks in CI, and make them part of the definition of done.

* Write and maintain architecture specifications and agent instructions so that coding agents implement consistently with the architecture. Review architecturally significant agent-generated changes as the accountable human.

* Build reference implementations and spikes for high-risk areas such as concurrency, bitemporal queries and large-scale traversal.

* Ensure that the architecture supports conformity evidence for Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262 tool qualification, together with the Functional Safety & Process Compliance Specialist.

* Identify and manage technical risks and technical debt, and advise the Lead Value Flow Engineer on feasibility, sequencing and cost.

* Design the production architecture for security, performance and operability, and define the migration and cut-over architecture.

* Hand over architecture knowledge (ADRs, runbooks, agent skills) to the successor team before first production in 2028 Q3.

  

**What should you bring along**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Minimum of ten years of software engineering experience, including at least four years in a lead or principal architecture role for data-intensive systems.

* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering systems with demanding consistency, auditability and performance requirements.

* Proven ability to lead technically through influence and to make evidence-based architecture decisions.

  

**Must have technical skill**

* Proven experience as lead or principal architect for data-intensive, distributed enterprise systems delivered to production.

* Deep knowledge of temporal data modelling, in particular bitemporal models (valid time and transaction time), append-only and event-sourced storage, revision checksums and time-travel queries.

* Strong command of CQRS, polyglot persistence, consistency models, optimistic concurrency, transaction isolation and idempotent write paths.

* Experience designing graph-based traceability or dependency models, including traversal performance, impact propagation and the trade-offs between relational and native graph stores.

* Experience designing agent-first systems: typed, versioned domain contracts as the primary interface, least-privilege tool access for AI agents, approval workflows for risky operations, and complete audit trails.

* Ability to define measurable quality goals and fitness functions (for example traversal latency for 5–8 hops with 50 concurrent users, variant resolution times and data volumes of 100k to 1M objects) and to verify them automatically.

* Hands-on proficiency in Python (for example FastAPI) and PostgreSQL, with the ability to build reference implementations for critical paths.

* Practical use of AI-native engineering: writing architecture specifications, ADRs and constraints that coding agents follow, and reviewing agent-generated designs and code critically.

* Solid understanding of cloud architecture on Microsoft Azure, including private networking, managed identities, container platforms and managed databases.

  

**Good to have technical skills**

* Domain knowledge of automotive requirements engineering, ALM tools (Codebeamer, DOORS, Polarion), ReqIF and product line engineering with 150%/100% variant models.

* Knowledge of Automotive SPICE (SYS.1–5, SWE.1–6), ISO 26262 (including tool qualification in Part 8) and ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148.

* Experience with semantic branching and record-level three-way merge of structured data.

* Experience with graph databases (for example Neo4j, FalkorDB, Apache AGE) and with ontology standards such as RDF/OWL and ISO/IEC 21838.

* Experience with arc42, C4 and architecture decision records in a docs-as-code workflow.

* Familiarity with BMW BASE (BMW Agentic Software Engineering), the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and BMW enterprise architecture governance.

**You Are**

You have spent two decades building verification teams and solving the problems that live between IP blocks, where clean interfaces meet messy reality and independently verified components refuse to cooperate. The gap between a Controller that passes all tests and a Controller-PHY-firmware combination that actually works in a customer SoC is where you live, and you have built the instincts to close it.

You are technical enough to review a UVM testbench, debug a protocol violation three layers deep, and make the call on whether a coverage hole is real or academic. But you also know that verification at scale is not about heroic debug sessions, it is about building systems that catch problems before they become customer issues. You think in factories, not fire drills.

What excites you now is ing AI to verification work that has resisted automation for years. You see LLMs, agentic workflows, and intelligent orchestration not as buzzwords but as tools that can finally turn interoperability from a bottleneck into a continuously running capability. You are ready to build that capability from the ground up at Synopsys, where the IP portfolio is real, the customer stakes are high, and the technical challenge is exactly the kind you have been preparing for.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Build and lead the Central Interoperability team from scratch, defining its technical strategy, organizational structure, verification methodology, execution model, and success metrics across high-speed interface IPs including UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, and USB
* Own end-to-end Controller-PHY interoperability qualification, from UVM environment bring-up and configuration management through verification execution, functional and structural coverage closure, protocol compliance, debug, and generation of customer-ready release evidence
* Establish an always-on Interop Factory where new Controller, PHY, or firmware releases automatically trigger integration, regression suites, qualification workflows, and evidence generation without manual intervention
* Drive interoperability verification beyond basic connectivity into protocol compliance, stress and error injection scenarios, CDC/RDC checks, timing constraints validation, and implementation readiness across the Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Configuration state space
Make the factory AI-native by* ing LLMs, AI agents, RAG, MCP, and intelligent workflow orchestration to environment generation, test plan development, regression selection, failure clustering, root-cause analysis, debug acceleration, and knowledge reuse across releases
* Build a continuous learning loop where customer issues feed directly into root-cause analysis, prevention test creation, regression integration, and future release qualification, systematically converting field learning into improved product quality
* Partner across Controller and PHY R&D teams, architecture, VIP development, firmware, methodology, applications engineering, and product management to create one accountable, transparent subsystem-readiness view for every release

**The Impact You Will Have**

* You will create a new verification capability that shifts interoperability left in the development cycle, reducing subsystem bring-up time for customers and increasing the number of qualified Controller-PHY-firmware configurations available at release
* You will transform interoperability from a customer integration exercise into a continuously verified product capability, with reusable qualification evidence and clear release gates that reduce field issues and support escalations
* Your factory will establish a scalable blueprint for subsystem verification across the broader Synopsys IP portfolio, creating reusable infrastructure, methodology, and AI-enabled automation that other teams can adopt
* You will build a team culture that attracts top verification talent, mentors engineers into technical leadership roles, and keeps the organization technically engaged even as it scales
* You will make AI-assisted verification real and measurable, demonstrating how LLMs and agentic workflows can accelerate debug, improve coverage strategies, and turn tribal knowledge into reusable intelligence
* You will create predictable, data-driven subsystem readiness visibility for executives and customers, replacing subjective assessments with objective qualification metrics tied to real verification evidence
* You will reduce the time from IP release to customer-ready subsystem from months to weeks by automating the integration, qualification, and evidence-generation workflows that currently require manual coordination

**What You'll Need**

* 20+ years of semiconductor design and verification experience with significant technical leadership responsibility building and scaling verification teams
* Deep expertise in ASIC, SoC, IP, or subsystem verification using SystemVerilog, UVM, verification planning, functional and code coverage analysis, assertions, regression infrastructure, and complex multi-IP debug
* Strong hands-on experience with high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, USB, or SerDes, including protocol compliance, Controller-PHY integration, and interoperability challenges
* Proven track record integrating independently developed IP blocks and driving complex cross-functional technical programs across R&D, product, and applications teams
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl, or equivalent for building verification infrastructure, regression frameworks, and intelligent workflow orchestration
* Experience with CDC/RDC verification, formal methods, emulation or prototyping platforms, CI/CD for verification, or physical implementation flows is highly desirable
* Exposure to LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, MCP, AI-assisted verification or debug tools, or intelligent engineering automation is strongly preferred and will differentiate your application

**Who You Are**

* You can sit in a technical review with verification engineers debugging a CXL protocol failure and walk out with a clear action plan, then turn around and explain the customer-readiness risk to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
* You do not wait for perfect alignment across teams to get started, you define the interoperability strategy, build the initial environment, and prove the value before asking for full organizational buy-in
* You recruit engineers who are better than you at specific things and you create the conditions for them to do their best work, whether that is deep UVM expertise, AI automation, or protocol-level debug
* You have a point of view on what good verification looks like and you push back when a test plan is too shallow, a coverage model is missing critical scenarios, or a release gate is being bypassed without real justification
* You are energized by building new capabilities from scratch, not inheriting mature organizations, and you are comfortable with the ambiguity, cross-functional negotiation, and technical problem-solving that comes with that
* You stay technical, you still read code, review testbenches, understand coverage reports, and debug failures alongside your team, because that is how you earn credibility and make good decisions

**The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will build the Central Subsystem Interoperability team from the ground up, establishing its charter, hiring its engineers, and defining its relationship to Controller R&D, PHY R&D, VIP, firmware, and product teams across Synopsys. This is a new capability being created to transform how independently developed IP becomes qualified, customer-ready subsystems. You will report into senior engineering leadership and work closely with architecture, methodology, and product management to establish the vision, execution model, and success metrics for this organization. Your team will become the accountable owner of subsystem readiness across high-speed interface IPs, with the mandate to build an always-on, AI-enabled interoperability factory that scales across the portfolio.

**Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Technology Product Owner
description:
**Organization**

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward, to progress, make the right financial decisions, and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy contribute to the impact we can make. Together, we can achieve great things.

  

**Our purpose** : Building a brighter future for all.

  

**Business & Team**

As we continue our pursuit of NPS +30, we need to transform how we engage with customers and colleagues. This requires moving from a two-track digital versus assisted approach to a deeply personal and empathic end-to-end digital experience, enriched and augmented by our colleagues.

The Gen AI Domain within CDAO has been established to build the tools and capabilities needed across the Group and to lead the “Transformer Banking” initiative. The domain focuses on solution practices, tools and platforms required to leverage Large Language Models safely and effectively, rather than creating foundation models.

The domain is building technology platforms and tools such as the Gen AI Hub, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access and control planes; business platforms such as Customer Conversation Manager and Customer Activity Manager; and reusable patterns and practices for Gen AI-enabled solutions across CBA.

The team enables crews across CBA to use Generative AI as part of traditional solutions in a heavily regulated environment. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build strong team cultures, remain focused on customer needs, manage risk thoughtfully, and are passionate about enterprise transformation through Gen AI.

  

**Impact & Contribution**

As Product Owner, you will be accountable for a portfolio of Gen AI platforms and services used across CBA to solve important customer and colleague’s needs. You will deeply understand end-customer and internal-consumer needs, own the product roadmap, ensure the products meet those needs, and partner with the Group Practice Lead - Gen AI Solutions to drive customer success.

  

**Reporting Line**

Direct line reporting to CAL, Gen AI.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define the product vision, direction and goals for the development team.

* Work with knowledge engineers, prompt engineers, platform engineers, data scientists and analysts to build reliable, resilient and adaptable Gen AI applications and deployable solutions.

* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, features and user stories, ensuring the development team works on the highest-value outcomes.

* Use your engineering background to understand customer needs for platforms serving internal engineers and assess the feasibility of transformative business capabilities.

* Balance business partner demands with the long-term sustainability of products and services to optimize customer experience, NPS, cost and risk outcomes.

* Partner with SRE teams, consuming service owners, controls teams and risk communities to embed risk management and platform resilience.

* Manage delivery expectations and provide clear status reporting to technology and business stakeholders.

* Own the risks, costs and benefits of platforms and services, while driving reliability, testing practices and Responsible AI.

* Help engineering squads determine which parts of fast-evolving Gen AI solutions require variability and which require stability.

* Continue learning while delivering tangible customer outcomes.

Act as an ambassador for Gen AI transformation across the bank, sharing knowledge and supporting an open learning culture.  

  

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 12-14 years of relevant experience.

* Product ownership experience delivering complex, high-profile digital capabilities, technology platforms and services.

* Strong understanding of banking workflows and customer experiences, such as dispute-management processes and orchestration of multiple workflows to execute a case.

* Engineering background in software development, data engineering or data science.

* Experience building and operating technology platforms used internally or externally within an organization.

* Experience leading engineering teams that build and scale distributed systems, tools and frameworks across public, private or hybrid cloud environments.

* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, attention to detail, and verbal and written communication skills.

* Customer-focused approach with the ability to identify unmet needs and champion innovative experiences and product practices.

* Ability to drive safe and responsible Gen AI solutions by challenging technology limitations and improving systems, processes and methods.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.  

  

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud solution architecture, preferably AWS and Azure; exposure to services such as Amazon SageMaker or equivalent AI platforms is valuable.

* Strong software-development practices, including Git, debugging, automated testing and documentation.

* Experience or exposure to Python, TypeScript and/or C#.

* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Prompt engineering and non-deterministic automated testing.

* System Reliability Engineering, secure coding, and software security pipeline tools for installation, configuration, operation and monitoring.

* Customer engagement systems and workflow platforms.

Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Power Platform, including Copilot Studio.  

  

**Good to Have**

* Understanding of machine-learning models and how generative architectures such as GANs, VAEs and Transformers are deployed at scale across cloud or on-premises infrastructure.

* Hands-on knowledge of scalable AI application patterns, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access or control planes.

Passion for continuous learning and staying current with developments in AI and machine learning.  

  

**People Capabilities**

**Customer Focus:** Creates value in every customer interaction and considers the total customer experience.

**Team and Culture:** Inspires others to demonstrate CBA Group values and contributes to a passionate, high-performing culture.

**Continuous Improvement:** Continuously improves and innovates to make experience simpler for customers and colleagues.

**Effective Communication:** Communicates clearly and with impact to build understanding, engagement and commitment to action.

**Judgement:** Uses CBA knowledge, industry information and financial drivers to guide decisions and actions.

**Drive Results:** Takes initiative and accountability to achieve business outcomes.

  

**Education Qualification**

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management, Technical
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by defining product strategy in ambiguous spaces and building teams that deliver meaningful results at scale? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management - Technical to lead a product management organization at Amazon. In this role, you will own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for a product portfolio that directly impacts how customers experience Amazon's technology. You will set direction in environments where the problem and opportunity may not yet be fully defined, translating complex inputs from customers and stakeholders into a clear, actionable product strategy. Your work will span system design, roadmap prioritization, and cross-functional alignment — all while building and developing a high-performing team of product managers and leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for your portfolio, working backward from customer needs to identify problems worth solving and aligning your roadmap to organizational goals.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers and people leaders, setting the standard for talent development, onboarding, and performance management across your organization.
* Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces by decomposing complex challenges into actionable plans, distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, and making informed trade-offs across opportunity, resources, and sustainability.
* Partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions, integrating generative AI and emerging technologies where they accelerate customer value.
* Establish mechanisms to inspect product quality, operational performance, and customer experience, using data to continuously improve outcomes and communicate progress to senior leadership.

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing a product narrative ahead of a leadership review, sharpening the strategy with your team before presenting to senior stakeholders. Mid-morning, you join a roadmap prioritization session with engineering and science partners, working through trade-offs on upcoming launches. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their career growth and coach them through a challenging stakeholder alignment. Later, you evaluate a proof-of-concept for a new AI-driven feature, assessing feasibility and customer impact before wrapping up with a cross-team sync to unblock a dependency.  
  
About the team  
Our team builds technology products that serve Amazon customers at scale. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where product leaders are empowered to define strategy, experiment with new approaches, and drive meaningful business outcomes. We value thoughtful debate, clear written communication, and a genuine commitment to growing the people around us. We are focused on solving complex problems through innovation and are investing in areas like intelligent automation and generative AI to shape the future of our products. If you are excited about building both great products and great teams, we would love to hear from you.

------------------------

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
