title: Product Manager II
description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**About Tekion**

At Tekion, we're transforming the automotive retail experience through our cloud-native platform, ARC — a modern, intelligent Dealer Management System (DMS) built for the future. We connect OEMs, dealerships, and consumers through powerful, AI-driven solutions that streamline operations, improve profitability, and elevate the customer experience.

The Parts Management module is a core component of ARC, enabling dealerships to efficiently manage warehouse inventory, fulfill service demand, and grow their retail and wholesale parts businesses. We're investing in intelligent, AI-powered capabilities to simplify complex workflows, improve decision-making, and drive operational productivity.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a **Product Manager II** to join our Parts Product team and help build the next generation of B2B wholesale, warehouse/inventory management, and AI-powered product capabilities.

In this role, you'll own key product capabilities across wholesale order management, fulfillment, and inventory operations, while identifying opportunities to leverage AI and automation to solve complex business problems.

You'll work closely with customers, Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, and cross-functional partners to discover opportunities, define scalable solutions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings strong product ownership, analytical thinking, customer empathy, and a bias for action, along with **hands-on experience building and launching AI-powered product features** in B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own product capabilities end-to-end:** Drive discovery, requirements, prioritization, development, launch, and adoption for defined wholesale, warehouse/inventory management, and AI-powered workflows.

* **Build AI-powered product experiences:** Identify opportunities to leverage generative AI, intelligent automation, and predictive insights to simplify workflows, improve decision-making, and enhance user productivity.

* **Solve meaningful customer problems:** Engage with dealership users, enterprise customers, and internal stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify root causes, and translate insights into scalable product solutions.

* **Shape product direction:** Partner with product leadership to contribute to roadmap priorities, evaluate opportunities, and make informed trade-offs based on customer and business impact.

* **Drive product execution:** Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, and AI/ML teams to define clear requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and deliver high-quality solutions.

* **Build for scale:** Design intuitive, efficient workflows supporting high-volume wholesale transactions, order fulfillment, inventory visibility, and multi-location operations.

* **Deliver measurable outcomes:** Define and track product success metrics, including adoption, operational efficiency, fulfillment accuracy, AI effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.

* **Champion product quality and customer success:** Partner with implementation, support, and customer-facing teams to ensure successful launches, resolve critical product gaps, and continuously improve the customer experience.

* **Bring market and technology insights:** Stay informed about B2B wholesale distribution, warehouse/inventory management, generative AI, AI agents, and emerging enterprise technologies to identify product innovation opportunities.

**What You'll Bring**

* **3–5 years of relevant experience**, preferably including hands-on product management and ownership of B2B SaaS or enterprise software capabilities.

* **Hands-on experience building and launching AI-powered product features**, with demonstrated ability to translate business problems into practical AI use cases and measurable customer value.

* Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent automation, including an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and applicability to enterprise workflows.

* Strong understanding of at least one relevant domain: wholesale distribution, order management, warehouse/inventory management, supply chain, logistics, or commerce.

* Demonstrated ability to independently drive product features from problem discovery through delivery, launch, and adoption.

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex workflows, prioritize opportunities, and make data-informed decisions.

* Experience translating business problems into clear product requirements, user experiences, and actionable engineering deliverables.

* Ability to collaborate with Engineering and AI/ML teams to evaluate AI solution feasibility, define success criteria, and ensure reliable, scalable product experiences.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.

* A customer-first mindset, strong accountability, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with vertical SaaS or enterprise applications supporting industry-specific operational workflows.

* Experience building AI-powered enterprise solutions, including AI copilots, agentic workflows, intelligent recommendations, or automation, with familiarity in LLMs, RAG, and AI evaluation frameworks.

* Product management experience in warehouse/inventory management, procurement, supply chain, order management, or ERP systems.

* Knowledge of automotive dealership operations, dealership management systems (DMS), or automotive parts management.

* Experience with integrations and workflows spanning multiple functional areas within an enterprise platform.

description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:  
The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for directing product strategy from conception and definition through implementation. This role identifies new business and market opportunities and creates appropriate business plans. Responsibilities include determining the market for the product, understanding marketplace requirements, and ensuring consistency of new products with the organization’s image and objectives. The Sr. Product Manager functions as a central resource, interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during the product development stage, and formulates and executes long-term plans for cost and profit control. The role also promotes the use of new technologies and industry-leading trends.  
  
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
Key Responsibilities:

* Direct product strategy from conception through implementation.
* Identify new business and market opportunities and develop business plans.
* Determine product market requirements and ensure alignment with organizational objectives.
* Serve as a central resource interacting with systems, marketing, and sales during product development.
* Formulate and execute long-term plans for cost and profit control.
* Promote adoption of new technologies and industry-leading trends.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 8 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience in roles such as product manager, product owner, business process analyst, or sales operations.
* Experience in applying Agile principles across design, development, testing, and product management.
* Experience in developing software capabilities to support sales, service, or customer relationship management functions.
* Experience in multi-tasking, organizing, managing, and implementing complex projects directly or through supervision.
* Experience in cross-functional collaboration with systems, marketing, and sales teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 9 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or 7 or more relevant years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 3 or more years of experience with a PhD.
* Agile certifications such as CSM and CSPO, or their equivalent.
* Experience in identifying, assessing, and managing tradeoffs in product development.
* Experience in identifying points of failure and formulating error-handling approaches for product resiliency.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in full-stack software development and system design.
* Experience with back-end langu,ges (e.g., Java, Python, or C++).
* Experience with front-end languages (e.g., JavaScript or TypeScript).
* Experience working with database technologies (e.g., SQL, NoSQL).

* 2 years of experience with Site Reliability Engineering, Information Security, or DevOps practices, paired with practical experience in enterprise AI solutions.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. title: Senior Golang Engineer - GenAI Platforms
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Description**

We are Citi’s Core AI Platform Group, a start-up with the exciting mission of shaping the direction of travel for the entire bank under the Chief Operating Office. We define the AI and engineering strategy for the bank. We are a team of talented engineers, product managers, and SMEs, taking ambiguous concepts and making them real by engineering cutting-edge products at planetary scale.

We are solely focused on the most modern technology and engineering disciplines: generative AI, cloud-native architectures, security, modern app stacks, open-source, and the latest and greatest in the Kubernetes ecosystem.

Generative AI is a rapidly evolving space. As a Senior Golang Engineer, you will be the technical anchor and visionary for this domain. We ask that you share with us examples of projects that you have architected and scaled. Ideally, these examples should showcase clever distributed architectures, systematic evaluation of LLM behaviors at scale, and your ability to drive technical consensus across large organizations.

  
  

**Technical Skillset Required:**

9+ Years of Hands-on experience is a must have.

  
  

**Tech Skillsets required for the role**:

Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.

  
  

**You might be a good fit if you:**

* Bring distinguished, deep-dive software engineering expertise and a track record of architectural leadership.
* Thrive in a results-driven environment, where flexibility fuels impact and your technical decisions shape the enterprise.
* Are a game-changer and thought leader, ready to step beyond your designated role to influence the broader engineering culture.
* Love the synergy of pair programming and hands-on coding—you lead from the front and stay close to the codebase.
* Seize the opportunity to architect machine learning and GenAI applications at an unprecedented global scale.
* Possess a relentless passion to push the boundaries of machine learning and generative AI, bringing your knowledge to shape Citi’s future.
  

  

**What you’ll do within the team:**

* **Engineering at scale:** You will build scaled, robust services and platforms centred around generative AI. This may also include developing CLIs, SDKs, runtimes and more.
* **Thought Leadership:** Drive architectural vision and lead the 0-1 build of foundational, enterprise-grade AI platforms and products.
* **System Design:** Design and build high-quality, highly reliable, and secure distributed systems with developer and user experience at the center.
* **Strategic Direction:** Create "firsts" in the Generative AI space for Citi, acting as a core member of the team that defines the strategic technical direction for the entire bank.
* **Scale & Iterate:** Continually iterate and scale Generative AI products to handle massive throughput, whilst anticipating and listening to the complex needs of internal customers.
* **Cross-Org Influence:** You must be able to drive technical alignment across multiple engineering organizations, breaking down silos to deliver cohesive AI capabilities.
  

  

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed In This Role:**

* **Mastery of Modern Stacks:** Expert-level fluency in Golang is a must-have, with deep experience building concurrent, high-throughput systems. (Python is a strong desirable addition).
* **Cloud-Native & Infrastructure:** Deep expertise in the Kubernetes ecosystem, container orchestration, and modern security paradigms (e.g., Gatekeeper, zero-trust).
* **Applied GenAI:** Understanding of language models, fine-tuning methodologies, and RAG architectures, JIT context retrieval strategies will be useful.
* **AI Infrastructure:** Proven experience designing control planes, sandboxing systems for AI experimentation, and managing large-scale vector stores and search algorithms.
* **Data Engineering:** Extensive experience in large-scale ETL development and data pipeline architecture.
* **Security & Governance:** Experience maintaining and/or contributing to bug bounty, responsible disclosure programs, and AI safety/guardrail implementations.
* **Startup Agility:** Experience leading technical initiatives within fast-paced startup environments or driving startup-like agility within a large enterprise.
  

  

**What We Believe In:**

* We do not have boundaries between engineering and research; we expect our technical leaders to bridge the gap and contribute to both.
* We take a product-focused approach and care deeply about building solutions that are robust, scalable, and easy to use.
* We enjoy working in a fast-paced team tackling cutting-edge problems by constantly testing, learning, and adapting.
* We enjoy pair programming for our products; we are lean in our approach and actively remove bureaucracy where we see it.
* We believe in delivering fast, iterating, and pivoting as we go, rather than defining the perfect solution upfront.

description:
**T&T | NAT : Innovation | Product Engineer | Bangalore | Manager**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 117239
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**Role Overview**

We are building a next-generation product engineering organization where we are looking for engineers who will be responsible for taking an idea from the concept and design board and convert it into a fully functioning, market ready working product.

The Product Engineer will combine **strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to effectively use AI tools, coding copilots and agentic systems** to design, build, test, and operate product components and services. We are looking for engineers who can use AI as force multiplier.

This role focuses on **system thinking, architecture, validation, and product ownership**, while using AI tools to automate routine development tasks.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Ownership:** Drive end-to-end product development, taking features from concept to production with minimal supervision.
* **Iterative Development:** Build, ship, and iterate rapidly to meet business deadlines and user requirements.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to translate user needs into technical specifications and acceptance criteria.
* **Software Craftsmanship:** Write high-quality, scalable code and ensure the performance and maintainability of the codebase.
* **Technical Problem Solving:** Analyse complex systems and resolve technical issues from development to production.
* **AI-Augmented Software Development:** Use AI coding assistants and agents to accelerate development of product features. Generate, review, and refine code produced by AI tools.
* **Validation:** Take full responsibility of unit testing and ensure bug free code is delivered. Also, validate correctness, security, and performance of AI-generated code.
  

**Product Component Development**

* **Design and implement:** Microservices, APIs and integration services, Data pipelines, Event-driven architectures, Domain services
* **Ensure all components are:** Scalable, Observable, Secure, Cloud-ready and are maintainable for long-term.
* **AI Agent Orchestration:** Use modern AI frameworks to automate engineering workflows such as: Code generation, Test creation, Documentation, Refactoring, Debugging
* **Quality Engineering:** Ensure high product quality by reviewing AI-generated code, writing automated tests, performing performance and security reviews
* **Continuous Delivery and DevOps:** Work with modern DevOps practices which includes adhering to defined CI/CD pipelines and building all components for cloud-native deployment.
  

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in at least one major programming language such as: Java, Python, Go, TypeScript

* Experience withMicroservices architecture, REST / GraphQL APIs, Distributed systems, Databases (SQL and NoSQL)

* Experience using AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.

* Ability to evaluate AI-generated code, integrate AI tools into development workflows

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform with focus on containers and orchestration, infrastructure automation and observability tools

  

**Desired Skills**

* Domain-driven design
* Platform engineering
* AI/ML system integration
* Event-driven architectures
* Product thinking
  

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

Within the first year, you will:

* Build production-grade product services
* Reduce development cycle time using AI tools
* Improve code quality and test coverage
* Contribute to scalable product architecture
* Help define AI-driven engineering practices for the team
  

**Level of Experience Required** 8 to 12 years

  

**Location and way of working**

  

* Location- Bangalore
* Working from the office at least 3 days a week is mandatory, with a hybrid model tailored to each domain’s specific needs
* Education : MCA/ Mtech/ MBA/ B. Tech/ BBA/ BSC/ BE/ B.Com

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore)
description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.  
  
  

### **Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore) Responsibilities:**

* Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
* Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
* Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
* Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.
* Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers.
* Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
* Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
* Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
* Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical engagements with external engineering teams (e.g., Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture) and translate complex business constraints into robust system designs
* Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between field deployments and internal engineering, using hands-on customer insights to directly shape core product and platform roadmaps
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Your Organization**

CommBank’s Gen AI Domain within CDAO builds the platforms, tools and practices that enable teams across the bank to safely adopt Generative AI. The domain focuses on capabilities including Gen AI platforms, RAG, Knowledge Engineering and Prompt Engineering, supporting initiatives such as Transformer Banking.

  

**Job Title** : Engineering Manager

**Location** : Bangalore

  

**Your Business**

As CommBank transforms the way we engage with customers and colleagues, the Gen AI Domain is enabling deeply personalised digital experiences powered by colleagues, AI and APIs.

The domain provides the platforms, services and practices required for teams across the bank to safely and effectively incorporate Generative AI into enterprise solutions within a highly regulated environment.

  

**Your Team**

You will lead a multidisciplinary team of Engineers and Data Scientists specialising in Generative AI. The team works across multiple squads delivering platforms, tools and services including the Gen AI Hub and Transformer Banking Experience, with a particular focus on Prompt Engineering and Knowledge Engineering.

  

**Your Impact & Contribution**

As a Gen AI Chapter Lead, you will lead, manage and develop engineering professionals with diverse technical skillsets and a specialisation in Generative AI.

You will:

* Build and lead high-performing engineering teams.
* Own goal setting, performance management, career development and employee engagement.
* Drive Gen AI engineering capability and technical skill uplift.
* Partner with Technology Product Owners, Principal Engineers and senior stakeholders.
* Support engineers working across multiple squads and priorities.
* Drive continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to engage directly with complex engineering problems and, where required, dive into code.

**Your Reporting Lines**

Direct line reporting into the **Engineering General Manager/CAL, Gen AI, India** .

  

**Your Team and Responsibilities**

**Collaborate & Partner**

* Collaborate with Technology Product Owners across squads to achieve Squad and Chapter goals.
* Cultivate key internal and external partnerships.
* Act as a key liaison between support and cross-functional teams across Australia and India.
* Partner with Squads and Centre of Excellence leads to determine skill and capability requirements.
* Support sustainable resourcing and capability planning across Gen AI teams.
* Work effectively across Engineering, Architecture, Data, AI and Product disciplines.

**Drive & Execute Strategy**

* Elevate engineering craft capabilities across the portfolio to accelerate Gen AI delivery.
* Drive a strong technology culture of continuous improvement.
* Support workforce planning and movement of engineering talent across squads.
* Help squads identify the right technical skills and capabilities.
* Bring demonstrable software development experience and technical credibility.
* Be willing to engage deeply with technical challenges and dive into code where required.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of software design and the Software Development Lifecycle.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, Generative AI capabilities and engineering methodologies.

**Lead & Drive Cultural Change**

* Build an **Engineering Mindset** and **AI-First Mindset** across teams.
* Inspire teams through a collaborative and positive leadership style.
* Develop a high-performing engineering culture aligned with CommBank values.
* Drive a one-team culture across Engineering and other technical disciplines.
* Encourage knowledge sharing and adoption of engineering best practices.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, Go)**

**Department:** Engineering  
**Role:** Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)  
**Specialization:** Applied AI, Full-Stack Engineering & Systems Integration  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Model:** Remote / Hybrid

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer who can work closely with customers and internal teams to understand business problems, design technical solutions, and deliver production-ready software.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, and customer-facing technical implementation.

You will be responsible for translating loosely defined business requirements into working applications, integrating existing systems and third-party APIs, automating workflows, and deploying solutions into production environments.

The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer comfortable working across the full technology stack, making architectural decisions, troubleshooting infrastructure, and adapting quickly to unfamiliar technologies.

Rather than focusing exclusively on building isolated software components, you will own problems end-to-end — from understanding the requirements to implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

Key Responsibilities1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development

* Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business workflows, technical constraints, and operational challenges.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve existing workflows.
* Build prototypes and proof-of-concept applications to validate proposed solutions.
* Develop customized software solutions using existing platforms, APIs, and frameworks.
* Own technical delivery from initial discovery through production deployment.

2. Full-Stack Application Development

* Design and develop web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
* Build REST APIs, backend services, and asynchronous processing workflows.
* Develop responsive interfaces and interactive dashboards.
* Integrate third-party services, APIs, and content management systems.
* Design and manage relational databases, data models, and application storage.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs between monolithic applications, microservices, and lightweight serverless solutions.
* Maintain and improve existing applications while minimizing unnecessary infrastructure complexity.

3. Applied AI & LLM Integration

* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into business applications using commercial and open-source APIs.
* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for knowledge retrieval and contextual information processing.
* Build AI-powered automation workflows for document processing, content analysis, monitoring, and summarization.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications through APIs and reusable services.
* Evaluate model performance, response quality, latency, and operational costs.
* Implement appropriate validation, error handling, and fallback mechanisms for AI-powered workflows.
* Experiment with agentic workflows and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity.

4. Infrastructure & Deployment

* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and other hosting platforms.
* Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployment environments.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment.
* Manage Linux-based servers, networking, application processes, and system services.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform.
* Implement monitoring, logging, backup, and recovery mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve application reliability.
* Optimize infrastructure costs and operational overhead.

5. System Integration & Automation

* Integrate disparate business systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors.
* Build automation scripts and lightweight services to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
* Work with databases, CMS platforms, spreadsheets, and external data sources.
* Develop data extraction and processing workflows.
* Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate existing software platforms before deciding whether custom development is necessary.

6. Technical Ownership & Collaboration

* Take ownership of assigned technical projects and deliver working solutions independently.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, customer success teams, and other engineers.
* Communicate technical decisions and implementation trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document application architecture, deployment procedures, and integration workflows.
* Identify technical risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Balance implementation speed, maintainability, reliability, and business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

**Programming Languages**

* Strong proficiency in Python or another backend programming language.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux environments.

**Backend Development**

* Experience building APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or equivalent.
* Understanding of REST architecture, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, or similar databases.

**Frontend Development**

* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Svelte, or Vue.
* Experience building responsive web applications.
* Understanding of component-based architecture and frontend-backend integration.

**Applied AI**

* Experience integrating LLM APIs into software applications.
* Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-powered automation.
* Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot LLM-based application workflows.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Experience deploying and maintaining applications on Linux servers or cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Exposure to infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

**Engineering Practices**

* Git-based development workflows.
* Debugging and production troubleshooting.
* API integration and documentation.
* Application architecture and technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in customer-facing engineering or implementation roles.
* Experience building internal tools and custom business applications.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with Nix or other declarative environment management tools.
* Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Chroma.
* Experience with browser automation tools such as Playwright.
* Understanding of data visualization and dashboard development.
* Familiarity with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development environments.
* Experience working independently in remote or distributed engineering teams.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks in terms of problems and outcomes rather than being restricted to a particular technology stack.
* Can independently investigate unfamiliar systems and integrate them into working solutions.
* Is comfortable moving between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration tasks.
* Understands the practical challenges of deploying and maintaining production applications.
* Can work with incomplete requirements and turn ambiguity into actionable technical plans.
* Prefers pragmatic engineering solutions over unnecessary complexity.
* Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Takes ownership of solutions beyond writing code.

Success Metrics

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

* **Solution delivery:** Ability to translate business requirements into functional, deployed applications.
* **Integration effectiveness:** Successful integration of third-party services, APIs, and existing systems.
* **Engineering quality:** Maintainable, reliable, and appropriately architected solutions.
* **AI implementation:** Practical adoption of AI capabilities that improve business workflows.
* **Operational ownership:** Ability to deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain production systems.
* **Customer impact:** Measurable improvements in efficiency, automation, and operational processes.

Example Projects

Projects undertaken in this role may include:

* Building an AI-powered knowledge assistant using RAG and internal business documents.
* Automating data extraction and processing across multiple business platforms.
* Developing custom ERP, inventory, and operational management applications.
* Building automated website monitoring and AI-powered change summarization systems.
* Integrating existing CMS platforms with custom frontend applications.
* Developing internal dashboards and reporting tools.
* Deploying containerized applications with automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Building AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive administrative tasks.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate degree or equivalent practical experience is an advantage.
* Demonstrable project experience and the ability to deliver working software are highly valued.

Pay: ₹1,295,000.00 - ₹2,240,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Master's (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Number of openings**

* Own and prioritise the backlog. Ensure every item is agent-ready: it has clear acceptance criteria, traces to the L0/L1/L2 requirements, and has a definition of done that includes tests, AI evaluations, audit evidence and required human approvals.

* Strong flow and backlog management with the Agile Working Model, Kanban or Scrum, including WIP limits, flow metrics (lead time, throughput, flow efficiency) and dependency management across domain, platform and governance units.

* Stakeholder and expectation management with sponsors, domain departments, system owners of legacy tools, architecture, and data protection and information security functions, including timely escalation of blocking approvals.

Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-264304 **Date posted** 11/13/2026

**Job Title:** Senior Consultant, AI/ML Engineering

**Location:** Bangalore

**GCL:** D3

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to harness Generative AI and agentic systems to transform how therapies reach patients and sharpen commercial decision-making? As a Senior Consultant in AI/ML Engineering based in Bangalore, you will design, build and ship AI solutions that help clinicians, field teams and partners act faster and smarter—ultimately improving outcomes for millions.

Do you want to lead end-to-end delivery, from problem framing and experimentation through evaluation, deployment and monitoring? You will work across multiple disease areas and brands, integrating diverse data sources to deliver robust tools. You will join a global community of data scientists, ML engineers and domain experts, providing technical leadership on high-impact projects while deepening your expertise in the latest AI methods.

**Accountabilities:**

* Generative and Agentic Solutions: Design, build and deploy Generative AI and agentic solutions for commercial use cases, including LLM applications and multi-agent systems on frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

* Evaluation and Safety: Build and operate evaluation harnesses and platforms to measure quality, safety and reliability of LLM and agent systems, using results to drive continuous improvements.

* Production Telemetry and Monitoring: Implement telemetry, tracing and monitoring for AI systems in production and respond to quality, drift and cost issues.

* Reinforcement Learning: Explore and apply reinforcement learning and feedback-based optimisation where they add measurable value.

* Classical ML Delivery: Develop and maintain traditional ML models (classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, NLP) for commercial analytics.

* Data Integration: Integrate internal and external structured and unstructured data by partnering with data engineering, informatics and platform teams.

* Technical Leadership and Code Quality: Lead technical workstreams and write production-quality, well-tested and well-documented code that scales.

* Multi-functional Partnerships: Collaborate with Commercial, Medical, IT and other partners to scope problems, define success metrics and deliver scalable solutions.

* Research and Coaching: Research and apply the latest algorithms and methods to business problems, and coach junior data scientists and engineers to set the standard.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

**Minimum Requirements**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field.

* Typically 6+ years of experience building data science and ML solutions, including recent hands-on experience (typically 1+ years) with LLM-based applications.

* A track record of independently leading data science or AI projects to solve business or scientific problems.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and working knowledge of fine-tuning and distillation approaches.

* Agentic AI: experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangGraph, Strands or similar.

* Evaluation: experience designing and running evaluations of LLM and agent systems.

* Machine learning foundations: classical ML (supervised and unsupervised methods, including classification and regression) and deep learning, including transformers, using PyTorch or TensorFlow.

* Programming and tools: exceptional Python; SQL and familiarity with NoSQL; scikit-learn; Jupyter; Streamlit or similar.

* Cloud: working knowledge of AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock preferred).

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Master’s or PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field. We prioritise demonstrated skills over credentials.

* Familiarity with reinforcement learning, including preference-based optimisation of LLMs.

* Experience with telemetry and observability tooling for AI systems.

* MLOps tooling: MLflow, Docker, CI/CD, and pipeline tools such as Airflow.

* Experience with knowledge graphs, and with structured and unstructured data (text and image).

* Pharmaceutical, healthcare or commercial analytics domain experience.

* Curiosity and a desire to keep learning new technologies and methods in AI.

* Ability to explain complex methods and techniques to a non-technical audience.

* Ability to collaborate closely with multi-functional, global teams.

* Good written and verbal communication skills; fluent English.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Here, your AI craftsmanship directly accelerates how science reaches patients. You will collaborate with diverse experts who thrive on solving complex, real-world problems—bringing advanced methods in machine learning, LLMs and multi-agent systems to life at scale. We combine bold ambition with genuine support, valuing kindness alongside pace, and we create practical solutions by putting unexpected teams together to unlock new ideas. title: Billing Transformation – Product (ORMB) - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Functional Job Title : Billing Transformation – Product (ORMB) -Assistant Vice President**
**Reports to : BTP VP**
**Department/ Division : Global Delivery, Chennai**
**Job Description: AVP – Product Management**
**Why this role is important to us.**
Global Billing Operations (“GBO”) is responsible for all of State Street’s client billing processes across the globe. The remit spans across Asset Servicing, Alpha, Global Markets, Global Advisors and the Digital division. GBO is undergoing a multi-year transformation spanning people and operating models, processes and controls, data automation and technology.
  
  
State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Global Finance Center under Controllership, which is responsible for Billing Transformation, Client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in India, Poland and China.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
State Street has committed to significantly automating and streamlining the technology and data associated to its varied billing processes. As part of this commitment, there is a dedicated Billing Transformation organization responsible for developing and implementing the appropriate strategy to migrate from legacy, manual processes to a highly automated environment with more robust controls. A significant component of the Transformation team is located in Global Delivery and is responsible for several key areas of implementing the transformation efforts.
  
  
AVP 2 (ORMB Product Management) – GD will be supporting Billing Transformation Product Owner(s), as the team implements billing transformation strategy across Client Set Up Application, Data Hub, and ORMB billing application. The person will be partnering with onshore product owner(s), developing business requirements (FSDs, BRDs and etc.), track, report progress, targets and outcomes linked to target state of product and applications. This role will be responsible for ensuring all product releases, toll gates within agreed timelines, automation, user acceptance testing of applications, system build out validation in line with the strategy and prioritization defined by the Head of Billing Transformation to achieve the goals of migration to the single, Oracle based billing platform (ORMB).
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Actively participate/contribute to Product workshops along with Product owner, Stakeholders and IT partners.
* Create user stories/Business requirements as needed and work with IT partners to scope those requirements for the future product releases and to document/track the backlog for future releases.
* Work with the product end user teams to identify pain points or tasks that can be automated to reduce the client onboarding/setup duration. Triage with the product owner to add the requirements to the backlog and track them to closure.
* Working knowledge of JIRA / Confluence and Agile / Waterfall methodologies is a must.
* Work across the project/BAU teams of business and technology to analyze and explain any issues/solutions pertaining to the billing product.
* Work along with the Business UAT Team in testing new product features or fixes, as part of the release schedule/cycle.
* Develop/review SOP, Workarounds, checklists to document all the features of the billing product(s)
* The product specialist will work in a fast-paced complex engagement model on a day-to-day basis.
* Collaborate closely with the In-Market Product owner(s) and Platform management team to understand expectations and deliverable timelines and ensure that deliverables of the team are load balanced as compared to team staffing.
* Develop the team to adopt "owner's mind set", work independently, and effectively manage timelines
* Manage/collaborate with resources to assist with ad-hoc projects and new activities to support the GBO controller group and program
* Evolve process for Billing Transformation, performing managerial reasonableness reviews and discussing reporting & analytics deliverables prepared by the team.
* Provide support to key stakeholders of the team to present analytical results, triage findings and identify solutions
* First point of escalation within the local reporting line for dealing with issues (people/process/technology) and ensuring that compliance requirements are adhered to (e.g. company policies surrounding standard of conduct, information security, employment regulations)
* Coaches Strong collaboration with the team and works with onshore leadership to establish the team member goals and gather feedback for performance appraisals.
* Ensure completion of deliverables within the committed timeframe including assistance with development of deliverable plans.
* Promote risk excellence culture and looking at opportunities for continuous improvement.

**What We Value**

* Attention to detail, ownership and accountability
* Ability to navigate and partner with various stakeholders
* Ability to lead teams and manage cross functional domain teams
* Ability to communicate and above-par presentation skills
* Positive attitude, organized, self-starter, with a history of contributing to a successful, diverse team
* Demonstrated experience of multi-tasking and effective time management with attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to influence across siloes and work with broader teams and a collaborative attitude

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in IT/Product Management with an experience minimum of 12 to 15 years working with in Financial/Global Services Organization /Investment banking related IT Industry
* Worked as a product owner, Product specialist or product design owner in a global multi-faceted function.
* Well versed with billing processes in corporate environment
* Exposure to Financial services industry
* Experience within global projects/stakeholders and global organizations
* Complex operational setting involving analysis of financial data
* Engaged in business or migration/conversion processes
* Experience of Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) application is a must have
* Direct support to business or product line management / executives

**Additional Requirements**

* Experience in setting up managing, people, managing and tracking deliverables, setting up reporting cadence ability to summarize – and provide status to key stakeholders
* Understanding of State Street – functional structure- and experience in GD, Operations (would be an added advantage)

**Additional Locations**

description:

---------------

Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.  
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

  
About the team  
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

title: Test Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Automation Lead Test Engineer will define and execute automation test strategies, build robust frameworks using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript or Java, integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and QA partners to ensure requirement clarity, end-to-end test coverage, and defect prevention.

Additional exposure: Performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling, accessibility testing, security testing, and regulated domain experience are preferred.

6–8 years of experience in QA, software testing, or quality engineering.

At least 4 years of hands-on automation testing experience across UI and API automation.

Strong experience building automation frameworks and reusable test components.

Hands-on experience with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript; Java experience is strongly preferred for API automation.

Experience with REST API testing and automation using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, or equivalent tools.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams with distributed stakeholders.

Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to mentor junior QA engineers, conduct automation code reviews, and influence quality practices across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other regulated domains.

Exposure to performance, security, and accessibility testing for web applications.

Working knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms.

Experience improving automation maturity, test stability, release confidence, and sprint quality metrics.

title: Internal Audit Manager - DA and Innovation
description:

* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and information security requirements.
* Maintain analytics and automation documentation, monitor adoption, and drive continuous improvement.
* Support COE governance through KPI tracking, efficiency measurement, and operational excellence initiatives.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, or related field.
* Professional certifications in analytics, audit, AI/ML, or cloud technologies are an advantage.
* 8–12 years of experience in Internal Audit, Data Analytics, Risk Analytics, or Technology‑enabled assurance roles.
* Strong proficiency in analytics tools (Power BI), languages (SQL, Python, R), and automation platforms (e.g., RPA tools).
* Experience designing and embedding data‑driven testing methodologies within audits.
* Comfortable working with ERP systems (SAP/JDE) and large, complex datasets from diverse business processes.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem‑solving, and project management skills.
* Ability to influence and collaborate across global teams, with a strategic and innovation‑focused mindset.

The skills for success

* Data Visualization & Reporting
* Data Governance & Quality Management
* Automation & Continuous Monitoring
* Critical Thinking & Problem Solving

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.

We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt’s potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. title: Applied Scientist II, Sheriff Team- Payroll tech
description:
**Description**
Payroll Tech's Sheriff team develops and maintains ML and Generative AI applications that support Payroll Operations and Amazon employees at scale. Our portfolio includes Pay-Input Anomaly Detection, which improves the pay experience by identifying pay input irregularities such as leaves and insurance discrepancies; Percept, which improves ticket resolution by providing intelligent ticket prioritization via sentiment scoring, ticket summarization, defect classification, and categorization; Penny, a Virtual Assistant that enables payroll operations teams to efficiently retrieve information from multiple sources including policies, Percept data, vendor data, and HR data via Xylem through a single browser interface; Pay Ticket Genie, in process of being integrated with Amazon AZA(A to Z Assistant); Niyam, our rule engine; and Policy as Code Extraction (PoCo), a critical component of SPACE (Single Payroll Autonomous and Computation Engine) Amazon's in-house payroll system built to eliminate third-party vendor dependency for payroll processing. PoCo ensures data accuracy by validating that pay instructions are correct and performing calculations when required. It consists of two components: policy-based rule creation, where business owners select a pay code and provide policy links to generate rules for specific business processes, and rule evaluation, where upstream services send real-time validation or calculation requests and receive results along with rationale for any failures. Sheriff team owns policy-based rule creation and powering the rule evaluation system with rules generated.
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that power these systems: driving model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across the payroll ecosystem.
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on the Sheriff team, you will operate across three core dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
  
  
Invent
  
  
You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches as well as emerging technologies from the research community. You practice customer-obsessed science : working backwards from the needs of Amazon employees and payroll operations teams to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methodologies for anomaly detection, sentiment analysis, ticket classification, prescriptive analysis, intelligent virtual assistance, and automated policy extraction. You identify and define the research agenda for expanding Percept's capabilities including prescriptive analysis feature; lead the scientific strategy for the Penny-AZA integration enabling accurate and low-latency responses to Amazon employee payroll queries, and drive the ML strategy for Policy as Code extraction(PoCo), developing models that extract, interpret, and codify payroll policies into structured, executable rules that power real-time pay instruction validation and calculation within SPACE. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues that validate the novelty of your work, when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
  
  
Implement
  
  
The ML components you develop are directly integrated into production systems or directly support large-scale applications serving Amazon's global payroll operations. You make appropriate tradeoffs between model accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and immediate versus long-term solutions; favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the correct level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI frameworks largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with data sources including USC (Unified Central Service), Xylem, SIM-Ticketing, Pay Code Governance system, and PoCo's rule evaluation engine.
  
  
Influence
  
  
You contribute to tactical and strategic planning for the Sheriff team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for the global expansion of Percept, driving both feature growth and country-level launches own the complex AI track for Penny-AZA integration collaborating across partner teams including Reflect and GREF to ensure seamless data integration and robust ML pipeline workflows, and drive the scientific roadmap for PoCo's expansion to 100K US employees, ensuring the ML models powering policy extraction, rule generation and testing scale reliably to meet this growth. You mentor scientists and engineers on the team and across teams, championing best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) to rapidly increase developer productivity and delivery velocity. You provide peer feedback on research procedures and results within and across teams, help recruit and develop bar-raising talent through interview drives, and grow the team's organizational knowledge of Sheriff team ML solutions. You are visible in the broader internal and external scientific communities as a subject matter expert and regularly serve as a Program Committee (PC) member at peer-reviewed conferences or review articles for journal publications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development
* Experience communicating research findings and analysis in both written and spoken channels
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
* Experience with training and deploying machine learning systems to solve large-scale optimizations, or experience with data infrastructures: relational analytic DBMS, Elastic-Search, and Big Data EMR/EC2/Glue/Lambda
* Experience using strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
Nextpower is seeking a Staff Reliability Engineer to build the quantitative foundation for reliability decisions across the product lifecycle. The role will focus on the early and late stages of new product development: translating operating missions and product architecture into reliability models and targets, then connecting test, manufacturing, warranty, and field evidence to a clear view of fleet performance and cost.
  
  
In this role, you will work with Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Power Electronics, Validation, Quality, Service, Product Management, Finance, and Data teams. Your analyses will help teams make design and launch decisions, understand uncertainty, identify emerging field risks, and feed operational learning back into future product requirements and architectures.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Reliability Analytics and Modeling**

* Translate customer use conditions, service-life expectations, availability needs, and business objectives into measurable reliability requirements, metrics, assumptions, and evidence plans.
* Develop and maintain product mission profiles that describe geography, ambient and internal conditions, operating states, duty cycles, load levels, and exposure over time; document data sources and uncertainty.
* Build and maintain system and subsystem reliability models, including Reliability Block Diagrams and fault trees, to evaluate architecture, redundancy, dominant contributors, reliability allocations, and sensitivity to assumptions.
* Develop component and system reliability predictions using applicable parts-count, parts-stress, supplier, test, and field evidence. Select methods appropriate to the available data and product maturity, and clearly state limitations.
* Apply reliability statistics to life and event data, including Weibull and other life distributions, censored data, confidence bounds, accelerated-life relationships, reliability growth, and Bayesian updating where appropriate.
* Integrate analytical outputs with DFMEA, architecture reviews, design trade studies, and development gates so that quantified risk informs design priorities and readiness decisions.

**Warranty and Field Reliability Analytics**

* Develop and maintain a field reliability data model that connects product configuration and serial or cohort information with exposure, telemetry, service events, returns, failure analysis, and warranty claims.
* Define consistent metric definitions and denominators for field performance, including failure rate, cumulative failures, availability or downtime measures where applicable, and warranty incidence and cost.
* Analyze warranty, service, return, and field data to identify trends, shifts, recurring failure modes, affected populations, and emerging risks; quantify uncertainty and distinguish confirmed findings from hypothesis.
* Develop warranty life and cost analyses that estimate claim frequency and cost over time, assess sensitivity to assumptions, and support product, finance and business planning.
* Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports that present reliability performance by product, configuration, region, age, exposure, and failure mode, with clear definitions and decision-focused interpretation.
* Track early-launch performance and reliability growth using pilot and field evidence; update predictions as exposure accumulates and communicate material changes to forecasts and risk outlooks.
* Feed field findings into future mission profiles, reliability requirements, model assumptions, design priorities, supplier actions, and validation evidence plans.

**Data, Tools and Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Data Engineering and business system owners to improve data availability, traceability, quality, and repeatability across engineering, manufacturing, service and warranty sources.
* Use statistical and analytical tools such as Python, JMP or R and visualization platforms such as Power BI or Tableau to develop reproducible analyses and practical reporting workflows.
* Present results to technical and business audiences, explaining methods, assumptions, confidence, data gaps and recommended actions in clear written reports and product reviews.
* Coach engineering and business partners in the interpretation of reliability metrics and statistical evidence, including the implications of exposure, sample size, censoring and model uncertainty.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Applied Statistics, Data Science or a related quantitative field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 10+ years of experience in reliability engineering, reliability analytics, product quality analytics, or a related quantitative engineering role.
* Demonstrated experience with reliability modeling and statistics, including mission profiles, reliability block diagrams, MTBF or failure-rate analysis, life-data analytics, and confidence intervals.
* Strong proficiency with statistical and modeling packages like JMP, Minitab, Reliasoft Weibull++, BlockSIM plus experience creating dashboards with Python or R and SQL and recurring analytical reports using business intelligence tools.
* Experience analyzing product, test, manufacturing, warranty, service, or field data and translating results into engineering or business decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical results, assumptions, and uncertainty to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred**
