**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field.
* 12+ years of overall professional experience with at least 7–8 years as a Business Analyst or in a similar functional role.
* Seven or more years of experience in technical analysis, process mining, process modeling, data engineering, systems integration, or a related technology discipline.
* Process Mining and Modeling: Hands-on experience with process mining, process modeling, and process analysis, including translating defined business requirements into scalable technical solutions and validating that solutions meet intended business use.
* Data and Integration: Experience preparing, integrating, and validating enterprise data for process analysis, including event logs, data transformations, connectors, integrations, data-quality controls, and source-system dependencies.
* SAP Technology: Experience with SAP Signavio and SAP ERP or SAP S/4HANA environments, including the relationship between source-system data and process-mining solutions.
* Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management: Experience leading technical testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and continuous enhancement of enterprise technology solutions.
* Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate delivery partners, make solution decisions, manage risks and dependencies, and communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management, with ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Hands-on experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, user story definition, and sprint planning.
* Ability to create clear and concise documentation, including process flows, user stories, and test cases.
* Knowledge of data governance tools and practices, with ability to apply governance principles to ServiceNow processes.
* Awareness of cybersecurity requirements related to enterprise platforms.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with ability to translate complex business needs into actionable requiremets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Technical Expertise: Advanced experience with SAP Signavio, including complex implementations, solution design, technical configuration, or development of reusable process-mining and process-modeling solutions.
* Process Modeling: Experience applying BPMN or other recognized process-modeling standards and notation, with the ability to implement models that accurately represent agreed business processes.
* Certifications: Process-mining, SAP Signavio, SAP, data, architecture, or Agile certifications.
* Continuous Improvement: Experience with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement,s or process-excellence methods and the ability to support technology-enabled improvement.
* Global Collaboration: Experience delivering global solutions with teams across regions and time zones.
* Stakeholder Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and partner effectively with process owners, business-facing process-mining practitioners, data owners, and technical delivery partners while maintaining clear technical ownership

title: Associate II, ML Data Operations, GO-AI Operations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Robotics develops state-of-the art robotics for Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers. Come build the future of human-technology interaction with us. We are combining computer vision, mobile robots, advanced end-of-arm tooling, and a high degree of freedom of movement to solve real-world problems on a huge scale. Our team collaborates with a variety of customers across Amazon worldwide to conceive, develop, prototype, and deploy a wide range of robotic systems. Within Amazon Robotics, Global Operations - Artificial Intelligence (GO-AI) enables Amazon to accelerate and scale our machine learning transformation via human-in-the-loop support.
  
  
As an Associate II, ML Data Operations, you will be a vital Human-in-the-Loop expert in a non-technical role, responsible for executing data annotation tasks across highly diverse portfolios. Your work directly supports the training and validation of machine learning models for Amazon Robotics and Fulfillment Technologies, ensuring the quality and integrity of data which is critical for frontier AI improvements. Your work will involve analyzing processes such as packaging innovation, object manipulation, inventory storage, and sortation automation within fulfillment environments. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to make sound judgments using provided resources, and contributes to maintaining fulfillment center quality metrics through precise text/video/image annotation. This role is offered on a contractual basis, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position based on performance and business requirements.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 0.6 - 5 years of experience working with data transcription and annotation.
* English proficiency (C1+ or > C1 fluency) with good business writing skills
* Demonstrate proficiency in generating high quality human insight data across a range of modalities, inclusive of text, image video and audio.
* Specializing in LLM annotation work using amazon internal generative AI tools.
* Proficient research skills with experience to write basic prompts to gather and synthesizing information from multiple sources
* Excellent organizational and time management skills to prioritize complex tasks effectively.
* Comfortable working in a collaborative environment with remote, multi-cultural teams, willing to share knowledge, and able to maintain individual productivity goals.
* Good communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas and provide clear explanations.
* Work in a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Requirements**
This is a non-technical operational role; you will deliver high-quality training data to improve and expand our Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities. That requires adhering to process oriented, not programming skills. The Associate II will perform precise annotation tasks (The process of labeling or tagging data for machine learning training), displays flexibility with the ability to transition immediately between the projects as per business requirements, proactively identifies day-to-day operational friction and bottlenecks within Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and tools, proposing logical conclusion and actionable changes to unblock workflows. The candidate is expected to demonstrate:
  
  
  
  

* Perform precise and consistent annotations across multiple data types (image, video, and text). This includes mastering techniques like object detection, semantic segmentation (pixel-level labeling), object tracking in video, and open-text evaluation.
* Proactively identify and correct errors, ensuring high data integrity and making obsessive precision crucial for model training.
* Write grammatically correct, creative, and technical texts in various styles, strictly adhering to complex project guidelines
* Make strong judgment to address ambiguous situations or incomplete information and, when guidelines fail, propose logical, consistent solutions that contribute to process improvement.
* Quickly learn and efficiently utilize various specialized annotation tools and platforms, adapting to new methodologies as required by evolving programs in domains like packaging, manipulation, storage, and sortation automation.
* Ability to scale and transition between 2-3 programs based on business needs and ability to train associates and provide peer feedback.
* Validate data based on specific annotation guidelines, ensuring the accuracy and quality of the collected information
* You will strive to enhance the productivity and effectiveness of the data generation by contributing to the development and continuous improvement of audit methodologies, checklists, and test frameworks.

A day in the life
  
  
We are looking for an Associate II, ML Data Operations to undertake the task of foundational labelling functions, such as dialogue evaluation on speech, text, audio, and video data – Success in this role requires strong concentration, effective multitasking with familiarity to write basic prompts, dive deep into use case and interpret and implement solutions. associate will be collaborating with a diverse team of specialists, sharing insights on "edge cases" where the data is ambiguous. Associates II work in a 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates II would be working from HYD office with a 9-hour shift. The shift and break timings would be subject to change every 3-4 months or as per business requirement. In case an associate is working in night shift, night shift allowance will be provided as per applicable to Amazon’s work policy.
  
  
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive days off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
  
  
Training Program: Selected candidates will participate in a structured one-week training program to develop essential capabilities and to ensure operational readiness prior to deployment
  
  
Weekly Offs: Rotational two-consecutive day off (it is a 5-day working week with 2 consecutive days off, not necessarily Saturday and Sunday) or as per business discretion.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in natural language data labeling, data annotation, linguistic annotation or other forms of data markup
* Experience with computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Strategy & Ops - Growth, Retention & Engagement
description:
**About the job**

About BharatNXTEvery day, 64 million Indian micro and small businesses build with grit and audacity, and BharatNXT is building the financial infrastructure to fuel that ambition. We help businesses turn existing credit tools like cards into flexible working capital, while enabling them to pay vendors, GST and invoices and manage cards, limits and payouts all on one platform.

Today, BharatNXT serves 2M+ users across 450+ cities, powered by an in-house financial infrastructure with 100+ risk checks, fraud below 0.02%, and a dynamic pricing engine evaluating 20+ parameters across 10,000+ daily transactions. But payments are just the starting point - we’re building India’s MSME Financial Operating System, spanning Run, Manage and Grow, with embedded credit, insurance and personalised financial products powered by signals from every transaction, interaction and GST filing.

Our Predictive Journey Engine interprets 100+ data points per user to continuously personalise pricing, limits, products, reminders and rewards. We’re building towards powering the next 10 million entrepreneurs and rebuilding Bharat’s operational and credit rails from the ground up.

**The Role**

Own our engagement stack end-to-end, powering 15000+ customer touchpoints across multiple products and high-frequency user journeys. Today, it powers campaigns, journeys, cohorts and app personalization across multiple user touchpoints. You will own the platform, the data flowing into it, what gets built on top of it, and the performance of the engagement engine.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You won't be handed a campaign calendar and asked to execute it. You'll identify opportunities, decide what needs to be built, test it, measure it, and kill or scale it based on results.

**What you'll do**

* Own Martech stack end to end - events, user properties, segments, integrations, hygiene and documentation. Data flows in from CRM, our AI calling stack, MMP, Other external platforms and app events; you make sure it's accurate and usable.
* Strategically define and build cohorts using user data, behavioural signals and footprints across platforms.
* Review and rebuild what's live - map every flow and cohort, fix what's broken, retire what isn't working, and put a review cadence on the rest.
* Run campaigns across channels - WhatsApp, RCS, email, push, in-app banners and GIFs, app tiles, website and banners.
* Test relentlessly - structured A/B tests on creative, timing, channel and journey design, with a test log so learnings compound.
* Build cohorts and app personalization - identify new behavioural and transactional cohorts and build cross-sell, upsell, retention and reactivation journeys around them.
* Fix the funnel - use UXCam / Clarity and product data to identify where users struggle, translate those insights into actionable cohorts or interventions, and drive product/UX/engineering fixes to closure.
* Design, Rollout, Monitor and Correct within 48 hours - build dashboards and alerts to catch funnel drops, delivery failures, data issues and integration breaks before they become business problems.
* Partner cross-functionally - work closely with Growth, Product, Business, Data, Design and Engineering to turn user insights into measurable growth initiatives.

What we're looking for

* 2–5 years of hands-on lifecycle marketing, CRM or growth execution in an app-first business.
* You have personally built journeys and campaigns in MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze or WebEngage - not just briefed an agency.
* Practical experience running push, WhatsApp, email and in-app at scale, including deliverability and fatigue management.
* Strong funnel and cohort analysis. You can pull and sanity-check your own data (SQL or BI is a plus).
* Comfortable working with Tech on event tracking, integrations and data requirements.
* Strong attention to detail. Small errors in cohort logic, event tracking or journey conditions can have a large impact.
* You create structure in ambiguity instead of waiting for someone else to create it.
* Familiarity with AI and agentic tools like Claude and Gemini.
* You are comfortable challenging existing processes and asking, "Why are we doing this?" when the data doesn't support it.
* Brownie points if your family comes from a business background and/or you have a degree in analytics or Chartered accountancy.

**Why take it**

* You’ll own an engagement stack that touches every stage of the user lifecycle, in a business where retention and product adoption directly impact revenue.
* There’s a lot to build, iterate and experiment with. That’s exactly what gives you the headroom to stand out, take ownership and make a meaningful mark.
* If you’re looking for a role where nobody counts the hours - we measure the impact you create, this is it.

Who should not take it up

* You’re not deeply driven to build the next large consumer business for India’s micro & small businesses, and would rather optimise for comfort than impact.
* You care more about perks and flexibility than the opportunity to build something meaningful and shape it from the ground up.
* You’re looking for a siloed, low-collaboration role. We work closely across Business, Marketing, Product, Tech and other teams - co-designing, challenging and building together is a big part of the job.
* You prefer clearly defined boundaries over taking ownership, figuring things out and getting things done in an evolving environment.

title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About BharatNXT**

BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch.

**The role**

A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often.

**What you'll do**

* **Own founder priorities**

  - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships.
* **Launch things**

  - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked.
* **Build partnerships**

  - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track.
* **Turn numbers into decisions**

  - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation.
* **Know the market**

  - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now.
* **Run experiments**

  - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill.
* **Strengthen operations**

  - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support.
* **Make us faster**

  - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved.
* **Take on special projects**

  - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet.

**What we're looking for**

* 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions.
* Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased.

**Bonus:**

an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

**Why take it**

You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does.

If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Engineer –**
IT Factory - Python Data Engineer
  
  
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a python data engineer, to own the data foundation of the application. As every control result, every dashboard figure and every application screen reads from the curated data model you build and maintain. If the data is wrong, late or unexplained, nothing above it can be trusted.
  
  
The platform ingests from several enterprise sources into a raw layer that preserves exactly what each source sent and then transforms that into a curated model. You will build and operate the data pipelines, implement the reconciliation and data-quality checks that prove each load is complete, and extend the model as new controls and modules require it.
  
  
You will also implement the control rules themselves. These are written primarily as versioned SQL against the curated model, reviewed like application code, and executed by the controls engine. This is where data engineering meets the business purpose of the platform, and it is a significant part of the role.
  
  
This is not a pure pipeline role. You will also contribute to the application services, and you are expected to be able to pick up backend work when delivery requires it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ingestion pipelines — scheduled extraction from enterprise source systems into the raw layer, including change detection, load history and the recording of source data provenance.
* The curated data model — transformation from raw to a conformed, keyed and de-duplicated model of entitlements, applications, users and their relationships.
* Reconciliation and data quality — checks that prove each load is complete and consistent, with results written to an append-only evidence store and discrepancies raised rather than silently absorbed.
* Pipeline orchestration — scheduling, dependency management, retry and alerting, with a run history that can be interrogated when a question is asked about a past load.
* Control rules as code — the rule base for the control catalogue, written as versioned SQL with accompanying metadata, peer-reviewed and promoted through the same pipeline as application code.
* Reporting data layer — the curated views that the reporting dashboards consume, designed as a stable contract that survives changes to the underlying model.
* Backend services — contributing to the Python application services alongside the Technical Lead.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, at depth. This is the core of the role. Complex joins, aggregation, window functions, set operations; reading and acting on query plans; indexing and performance tuning on large tables. You should instinctively solve a data problem in SQL before reaching for application code.
* Relational data modelling. Designing schemas for analytical and operational use: keys, grain, slowly changing data, handling of deletions and deactivations in source systems. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Python for data engineering. Writing maintainable, tested Python for ETL — not notebooks. Experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable toolkit, and with pandas or Polars for in-flight transformation.
* Pipeline construction and operation. Building pipelines that run unattended: idempotent loads, failure handling, retries, alerting and the ability to re-run a failed load safely.
* Data quality and reconciliation. Practical experience proving that a data load is complete and correct, and designing the controls that detect when it is not.
* Backend development. Sufficient experience building API services in Python — FastAPI, Django or Flask — to contribute to the application layer.
* Testing discipline. Automated tests for transformation logic. Experience with pytest.
* Version control. Disciplined use of Git and pull request review. Treating SQL and pipeline definitions as code, held in a repository rather than on a server.
* Communication in a distributed team. Clear written English, and the judgement to flag a data discrepancy rather than work around it.

**Nice To Have**

* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow in production, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, functional role codes, segregation of duties, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Reporting tools — Power BI, including semantic modelling and designing the views that sit behind a dashboard.
* Regulated-environment experience — working with personal or otherwise sensitive data under data-protection controls, including masking of non-production environments.
* Linux and CI/CD — comfortable deploying and troubleshooting on Linux servers with an automated pipeline.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The AI-PE team builds AI and data systems across the research lifecycle and across departments, from content production and client products to internal operations and coverage intelligence. We are building many pipelines and products at once, and we need people who can own them, not just build them.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with two parts. First, you will own a portfolio of production systems and build new ones, taking problems from vague business requests to systems that teams rely on every day. Second, you will support multiple teams across the company, setting the engineering standard and growing two junior analysts into strong builders.
  
  

* What You Will Own

You Will Be Accountable For a Portfolio Of Production Pipelines And Products, Each With a Clear Owner, Quality Metrics, And An Operating Schedule. Across The Portfolio, The Work Falls Into Four Areas
  
  

* Data and operations pipelines: scheduled, multi-source jobs that join data from internal and external systems, apply business rules, handle failures, and deliver results to analysts for review.
* LLM-based tools: summarisation, extraction, classification, and search across transcripts, research, and documents, built with retrieval, tool use, and agentic patterns where they fit.
* Client-facing AI products: AI research experiences delivered to institutional clients, with the reliability and compliance needed for external use.
* Coverage and demand intelligence: signals that show where research is thin, where demand is growing, and what to research next.

For each system you own, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Scoping the problem with the business owner and agreeing on success metrics before building.
* Evaluation: a repeatable way to measure quality, catch regressions, and track cost and latency.
* Operations: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and a clear path for handover when priorities change.
* Documentation that another engineer or analyst can use without you in the room.
* Supporting Multiple Teams

The AI-PE Team Works With Business And Functional Teams Across The Company, Including Content, Sales And Client Services, Product, Technology, Compliance, And Data. You Will
  
  

* Act as the technical point of contact for the teams you support, translating fuzzy requests into concrete, shippable scope.
* Prioritise across teams, make trade-offs visible, and escalate conflicts to the VP early.
* Integrate builds into the wider stack with Technology and Data, and clear the path to deployment with Compliance.
* Choose the right tool for each job: a prompt, a retrieval step, an agent, a SQL query, or a rule. Explain the trade-off.
* Diagnose data-quality and performance issues across internal systems, and make pragmatic trade-offs when those systems impose constraints.
* Coach and review the work of junior analysts, so the team's output improves over time.
* What You Bring

**Must have**

* 4+ years building and shipping software or data systems in production, including at least 2 years on LLM-based systems in production.
* Strong Python, with a track record of taking work from prototype to production: tests, monitoring, and iteration.
* Hands-on experience with LLM workflows: tool use or agentic patterns, retrieval over long documents, structured extraction, and evaluation you designed and ran yourself.
* Advanced SQL and a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), including scheduled jobs and data-quality checks.
* Experience matching records across messy sources, and knowing when deterministic rules beat a model.
* Experience owning several systems at once, prioritising between them, and keeping each one running after launch.
* Good judgement about where AI does and does not fit, and the ability to explain a trade-off to technical and non-technical partners.
* Experience reviewing other engineers' work and mentoring people early in their careers.
* Comfort handling sensitive data and access controls, including identity and compliance requirements.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with the Claude API, MCP servers, or similar agent tooling.
* Experience reducing LLM cost and latency at scale.
* Experience working with business teams across several departments, such as sales, client services, or content.
* Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery.
* Interest in private markets, investment research, or expert networks.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and running reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an infrastructure ownership role. You will build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms.
* Not a people-management role at this level. You will mentor and lead by technical example.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end to end.
* Portfolio health: uptime, data quality, and the share of systems with working evaluation and monitoring.
* Autonomy: how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your partnerships with the teams you support.
* The growth of the analysts you mentor, measured by what they can own independently after six months.

**First six months**

* Take ownership of an agreed set of existing pipelines and products, with documented owners, runbooks, and monitoring.
* Ship at least one new production system, with an evaluation harness and an agreed success metric.
* Set team engineering standards for code review, testing, documentation, and LLM cost tracking, and have them in use.
* Publish a prioritised roadmap across the teams you support, including data dependencies and risks.
* Selection Process
* Conversation with the VP on the role, the team, and the work.
* Walkthrough of a production system you built or ran: failure modes, how you measured quality, and what you would change.
* Design exercise: how you would take on a new pipeline request from a business team, from scoping through to monitored production.
* Short take-home or code review of a junior engineer's pull request, followed by a discussion.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems across more than one team, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of analysts.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**What can you expect:**
**🌏 Work From Anywhere:**
Up to 4 weeks per year.
  
  
**🏠 Hybrid Work:**
This role offers hybrid working model
  
  
**📚 Yearly PDA Allowance:**
Dedicated annual budget to support your continuous growth.
  
  
**🛡️ Health & Security:**
Private medical insurance, life insurance and 1to1help mental health support.
  
  
**📆 Time Off:**
Upto 30 days of paid leave in a year
  
  
The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

title: Manager - Digital Transformation
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)**
At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries.
  
  
**www.godrejindustries.com**
**About Godrej Agrovet**
Godrej Agrovet Limited (GAVL) is a food and agri conglomerate, dedicated to improving the productivity of Indian farmers by innovating products and services that sustainably increase crop and livestock yields.
  
  
**www.godrejagrovet.com**
The Manager, Data & Analytics leads GAVL's Data Engineering, BI and Data Science team and turns business priorities into analytics products that people actually use. The role covers leading the team, reviewing its work, and working directly with Business Units and corporate functions to understand their problems, interpret data and get dashboards, reports, nudges and self-service tools adopted.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Roadmap and prioritisation: Turn GAVL and Business Unit priorities into a clear analytics roadmap, ranked by value, feasibility and data readiness, with a business owner for each use case.
* Business engagement: Work with sales, manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, finance and other functions to define the decision to be improved, agree baselines and success measures, and pick the right solution, whether a report, forecast, model, alert or self-service tool. Manage dependencies with IT and external partners.
* Team leadership and review: Set priorities and standards for Data Engineers, BI Developers and Data Scientists. Review designs, data models, reports and models at key stages, coach the team and keep ownership clear.
* Analytical rigour: Question assumptions, check methods and interpret results so recommendations are statistically sound and clearly explained. Make sure models are explainable and monitored for drift.
* Data governance: Keep metric definitions, data quality, documentation, access and security consistent, working with data owners, the Data Platform and Governance team, and IT.
* Adoption and value: Plan adoption for each major product with business champions, training and feedback. Track usage and decision impact, improve or retire low-use outputs, and confirm benefits with business owners.
* Platform and cost: Know GAVL's data landscape well enough to guide design, reuse and cost together with the platform team.

**Technical And Functional Capabilities**
Data science and analytical review
  
  

* Working knowledge of hypothesis testing, sampling, bias, confidence intervals and correlation versus causation.
* Understanding of regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, model validation and drift, enough to review the team's work and explain results to the business.

Data, BI and platform landscape
  
  

* Understanding of Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, MLflow and Power BI.
* Good SQL; ability to read Python or PySpark is an advantage.
* Familiarity with data quality, lineage, access control and CI/CD practices.

Business and leadership capabilities
  
  

* Turns loosely defined business problems into clear analytical questions and explains findings plainly to senior and non-technical audiences.
* Influences without authority and builds lasting adoption across business teams.
* Exposure to agri-business, manufacturing, supply chain, sales or finance data is desirable.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science or IT. MBA or master's in analytics or data science preferred.
* Experience: 6+ years in data, analytics or BI roles, including leading or coordinating a team across data engineering, BI and data science.
* Business exposure: Has worked with senior stakeholders and delivered analytics that changed a decision or process.
* Adoption: Evidence of sustained use of analytics products and their contribution to business outcomes.
* Certifications: Databricks, Azure, Power BI or data science certification is desirable.

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Sets clear priorities and standards while letting team members own delivery.
* Challenges with evidence and builds trust across Business Units through clarity and sound judgement.
* Balances speed, rigour and risk when priorities compete, and develops the team's capability.

**Work Experience**
6–8 years
  
  
**Benefits**
**Be an equal parent**
Childcare benefits for the birthing parent, commissioning parent (in case of surrogacy) or adoptive parent, and their partners
  
  

* 6 months of paid leave for primary caregivers, flexible work options on return for primary caregivers
* 2 months paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Caregiver travel for primary caregivers to bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel

Coverage for childbirth and fertility treatment
  
  
**No place for discrimination at Godrej**
Gender-neutral anti-harassment policy
  
  
Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses
  
  
Coverage for gender reassignment surgery and hormone replacement therapy
  
  
Community partnerships and advocacy
  
  
Persons with Disability (PwD) care
  
  
**We Are Selfish About Your Wellness**
Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top-up options
  
  
Elder care for those who might need to extend support to senior family members
  
  
Preventative healthcare support
  
  
Outpatient Department (OPD) coverage, including vaccinations, dental, vision, etc.
  
  
Uncapped sick leave
  
  
Flexible work options, including remote working and part-time work
  
  
Mental wellness and self-care programmes, resources and counselling
  
  
**Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way**
Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business-level achievements
  
  
Digital and offline instant recognition platforms
  
  
**An inclusive Godrej**
Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And it has been over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse - especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities - helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
  
  
We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
  
  
If this sounds like a role for you, apply now!
  
  
We look forward to meeting you.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - AXIS Life - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, AXIS modeller, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering AXIS modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* As a Senior within the Life AXIS actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US/Canada product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on LDTI/ IFRS 17 implementation experience in a modeler or tester capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands-on or Advance level experience in AXIS actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3-6 years of AXIS modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on AXIS) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: APM/PM - FMCG Supply & Demand Planning
description:
**About The Role**
At Purplle, we are building a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands that sell across general trade,
  
  
modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce. To scale them, we need a planning system that puts
  
  
the right product in the right channel at the right time, with the least working capital tied up. We are
  
  
looking for a Product Manager to build the core of that system: the products that power demand and
  
  
supply planning for our FMCG business.
  
  
**This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.**

* Youll work alongside the Senior Product Manager who leads our demand and supply planning

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply
  
  
planning products.
  
  

* Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.
  
  

* Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line
  
  
and on how fast our brands can grow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Roadmap & Execution: Set a prioritised roadmap with the Senior Product Manager and own

delivery.
  
  

* Demand Planning: Build demand forecasting, sensing and planning at range, channel, product

and region level, including new product forecasting.
  
  

* S&OP Collaboration: Build the tool that runs the monthly S&OP cycle and aligns sales, planning

and finance on one plan.
  
  

* Supply Planning: Take FG Buying live and scale it into end-to-end supply planning.
* Stakeholder Management: Work with planners, operations, sales (GT, MT, e-commerce, quick

commerce), finance, data science and engineering to define requirements and drive adoption.
  
  

* Discovery & Delivery: Run discovery with planners, write PRDs and user stories, and manage the

backlog with agile teams.
  
  

* KPI Ownership: Own forecast accuracy and bias, fill rate for modern trade and quick commerce,

inventory health (days, excess, expiry) and adoption of the planning products.
  
  

* AI-Native Building: Identify where AI and LLMs can create outsized value in planning, such as

explaining forecast changes, surfacing demand anomalies and automating routine plan reviews.
  
  
Build these into the products, not as add-ons, and use AI tools to accelerate your own discovery,
  
  
specs and analysis.
  
  
**Desired Skills And Requirements**

* About 2 years of product management experience with clear ownership: you have taken

products from discovery through delivery and adoption, ideally in supply chain, operations or
  
  
internal tools.
  
  

* Hands-on exposure to demand and supply planning: forecasting and how accuracy is measured,

S&OP, and inventory norms (safety stock, reorder points).
  
  

* Exposure to Indian general trade, modern trade and quick commerce.
* Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of SQL; you make decisions backed by data.
* First-principles and systems thinking: you break ambiguous problems into structured pieces and

**Reason About How Forecasting, S&OP And Supply Planning Connect.**

* High ownership and bias for action: you drive problems to resolution without waiting to be told.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and experience working cross-functionally in agile

teams.
  
  

* Engineering undergraduate degree. An MBA from a Tier 1 business school is good to have.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Python for analysis or prototyping.
* BI tools such as Looker, Tableau or Metabase.
* Hands-on use of a planning tool such as o9, Kinaxis or SAP IBP.
* Exposure to ML-based forecasting or replenishment products.

**About the Company**
---------------------

India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.

**About the Role**
------------------

ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.

The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.

The role will act as the **primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,** ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.

The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management**

* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.

* **Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight**

* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.

* **UAT and Solution Acceptance**

* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
* Coordinate retesting with Technology Teams and relevant ColdStar users.
* Obtain formal UAT acceptance from authorized business process owners.
* Recommend production readiness based on functional completeness and business acceptance.

* **Technology Adoption and Change Management**

* Ensure delivered solutions are adopted effectively across ColdStar’s operational teams.
* Develop training, communication and adoption strategies for new systems and features.
* Coordinate user onboarding, demonstrations and operational training.
* Monitor adoption, usage patterns, manual workarounds and user feedback.
* Work with department heads to embed new systems into standard operating procedures.
* Identify and address resistance to change, usability problems and process gaps.
* Measure the operational value realized from technology investments.

* **Innovation, Competitive Intelligence and Digital Roadmap**

* Proactively research digital innovations, emerging technologies and competitive practices in logistics, cold-chain operations, transportation and warehousing.
* Identify opportunities involving process automation, IoT, analytics, AI, GenAI and agentic AI.
* Evaluate technology opportunities based on business value, feasibility, implementation effort and return on investment.
* Work with engineering and innovation teams to evaluate potential solutions.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of business improvements and innovation initiatives.
* Recommend quarterly technology priorities to ColdStar’s leadership.
* Align technology priorities with ColdStar’s business strategy and identify operational problems that can be solved through technology.
* Use AI/ML and analytics to make sense of the data generated by ColdStar’s systems and turn it into insights for operations and leadership.
* Help build technology into ColdStar’s culture and everyday ways of working.
* Track industry developments and identify opportunities to improve ColdStar’s operational efficiency, customer experience and competitive positioning.

* **Technology Team Leadership**

* Build and lead ColdStar’s in-house technology team as the company grows.
* Mentor team members and set clear standards, priorities and ways of working.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* 8–12 years of experience in business analysis, techno-functional consulting, enterprise application implementation or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of logistics, warehousing, transportation, supply chain or distribution operations.
* Proven experience working with software development teams or external technology implementation partners.
* Experience independently preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience managing UAT, business acceptance and technology adoption.
* Working understanding of APIs, databases, SQL fundamentals, integrations, cloud applications and enterprise software architecture.
* Familiarity with WMS, TMS, ERP, fleet management, inventory management or related enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work closely with both business users and technical engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Cold-chain logistics and temperature-controlled supply-chain operations.
* Experience with IoT, real-time tracking, warehouse automation or fleet analytics.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Power BI or enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI and automation use cases in logistics.
* Experience with operational change management and technology adoption programs.

* Role is responsible to manage critical KPI’s of Error Management functions such as ‘Acknowledgement SLA’s’, ‘Resolution SLA’s’ and SLA’s associated with software bugs (development / production), reopen rate, Mean Time To Resolve (MTTR) etc.

description:

Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.

* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.

* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.

title: Senior AI Agent Orchestration Engineer
description:
**About Persistent**
We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q2 FY27 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.
  
  
**About Position**
We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Agent Orchestration Engineer to design, develop, and scale enterprise-grade agentic AI solutions. This role combines strong Python engineering expertise with advanced knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, workflow orchestration, and AI agent architectures. You will be responsible for building reliable, observable, and scalable graph-based AI agents that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), tool integrations, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Working closely with product, engineering, QA, and domain teams, you will drive the development of next-generation AI capabilities that enable automation, decision intelligence, and operational efficiency across enterprise platforms.
  
  

* Role: Senior AI Agent Orchestration Engineer
* Location: All Persistent Locations
* Experience: 8 to 12 years
* Job Type: Full-Time Employment

**What You'll Do**

* Design and implement scalable AI agent architectures using Python, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Define and develop typed agent states, schemas, validation frameworks, and data contracts using Pydantic.
* Build graph-based workflows with conditional routing, parallel execution, retries, checkpoints, sub-agents, and human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms.
* Develop and enhance integrations with AI orchestration frameworks and enterprise AI platforms.
* Create reusable AI agent components, tools, and workflow patterns that promote modularity and maintainability.
* Design robust execution frameworks with strong observability, resilience, monitoring, and operational controls.
* Develop asynchronous tools, connectors, and integrations with enterprise systems and external APIs.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, developers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
* Implement guardrails, validation logic, fallback strategies, and governance controls for enterprise AI applications.
* Troubleshoot production issues, improve workflow reliability, and optimize agent execution performance.
* Contribute to AI engineering standards, architectural patterns, and best practices.
* Develop automated testing frameworks for graph-based workflows and AI agents.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to AI platform engineering, automation, and developer productivity.

**Expertise You'll Bring**

* 8 to 12 years of software engineering experience with strong expertise in Python development.
* Extensive experience in asynchronous programming, type-safe application design, and scalable backend systems.
* Strong proficiency with Python type hints, Pydantic models, schema definition, and validation frameworks.

title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

You will transform data into insights, customer challenges into product opportunities, and ideas into measurable business outcomes. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, customers, and business stakeholders, you will contribute to product innovation, process improvement, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to combine analytical thinking, product understanding, customer engagement, and emerging technologies to shape the future of financial technology solutions.
  
  
Your Contribution
  
  
**Data & Insights**

* Analyze product, customer, and business data to identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities.
* Define, track, and measure key product and business metrics.
* Build dashboards, reports, and scalable analytics solutions that support data-driven decision making.
* Generate actionable insights and recommendations for Product, Engineering, and business teams.
* Support the development and maintenance of reliable data assets, pipelines, and reporting capabilities.
* Assist in building and validating predictive models to support business and product objectives.

**AI & Automation**

* Identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation, automation, and process optimization.
* Design and build analytical tools, automations, and workflow improvements that help teams turn data into action.
* Evaluate and leverage AI technologies, machine learning capabilities, and emerging tools to improve products and internal operations.
* Support the implementation, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI-powered solutions.
* Contribute to reducing operational complexity through scalable, technology-driven solutions.

**Product & Customer Impact**

* Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define requirements, validate product ideas, and measure outcomes.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and feature development through data-driven recommendations.
* Build a deep understanding of customer workflows, product usage patterns, and business requirements.
* Collaborate directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand challenges, resolve issues, and support product adoption.
* Communicate insights and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Own initiatives end-to-end, from problem identification and analysis through delivery and measurable business outcome.

Your Growth
  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, AI, Client Services, and business teams — building fluency across multiple disciplines rather than progressing along a narrow, single-track path.
  
  
**You Will Learn**

* Product Management and End-to-End Product Delivery
* Data analytics, reporting, and visualization
* Data Engineering and modern data platforms
* AI, automation, and data-driven decision making
* Financial technology and enterprise software
* Customer-centric problem solving

**You Will Gain Exposure To**

* Product Strategy and Roadmap Planning
* Customer and Market Insights
* Leadership
* Client interactions, and Stakeholder Management
* Real-world business challenges faced by global institutions

**You Will Develop Expertise In**

* Product Analysis
* Data Analytics & Visualization
* AI &Automation
* Data Engineering
* Product Management
* Customer relationship

**Our Company**
We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.
  
  
Learn more at iongroup.com.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe.
  
  
You'll thrive here, whether you're a product owner who wants to deliver original concepts, an engineer who's determined to build high-performance platforms, or a customer care professional who will personalise our service every step of the way. Our unrivalled energy, innovative insights and exceptional work environments will activate your full potential. Join us to unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Principal Engineer is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-team engineering projects. The role provides technical direction across systems, infrastructure and architecture while ensuring high-quality, timely and predictable delivery.
  
  
AI is central to the engineering approach. The Principal Engineer is expected to lead AI-driven development, including specifying, orchestrating, evaluating and automating engineering workflows, while maintaining strong core software engineering practices.
  
  
The role reports to the Head of Engineering and is part of the Product & Technology India team, working closely with Engineering, Product, Technology and business stakeholders in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Risk Management: Identifies and addresses technical, operational, security and AI-related risks.
* Delivery Management: Owns delivery predictability, quality, productivity and execution metrics across teams.

* Knowledge Sharing: Conducts workshops, shares technical expertise and encourages collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams.

* Recruitment & Performance: Participates in technical interviews and supports Engineering Managers with team performance development.

* Agile & SDLC: Leading end-to-end software delivery through iterative, collaborative and structured development practices.
