* AI & Machine Learning: Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, model routing, evaluation and observability.
* CI/CD & DevOps: Implementing automated testing and deployment pipelines, including AI evaluation gates.
* Cloud Computing: Designing and managing scalable, cost-effective solutions on AWS/GCP.
* IT Security Management: Managing security risks, data protection, access controls and AI-specific security threats.
* Change Management: Driving technology transformation and AI adoption across teams.
* Requirements Gathering: Translating business needs into technical and non-functional requirements.
* Algorithms & Problem Solving: Applying algorithmic thinking and complexity analysis to build efficient, scalable solutions.
* Desired Skills & Competencies
* Experience in the betting and gaming industry.
* Stakeholder Management: Builds strong working relationships and engages effectively with stakeholders.
* Collaboration: Communicates clearly and works well across teams.
* People Development: Invests in developing personal and team capabilities.
* Analytical Thinking: Uses critical thinking and commercial understanding to make informed decisions.
* Strategic Direction: Helps define and drive business and technology priorities.
* Agility: Adapts quickly while managing risks and changing priorities.
* Performance Focus: Continuously improves standards and drives high performance.
* Integrity & Ownership: Takes accountability and makes responsible decisions.
* Results Orientation: Plans effectively and delivers outcomes.

**Additional Information**
At Entain India, we offer a package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:
  
  

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.

title: Lead - Data Scientist
description:
ACSI India is looking for a Lead Data Scientist who will combine strong technical fluency with proven people leadership to build and guide a team of data scientists and AI engineers. You will stay hands-on enough to coach credibly, actively develop the people and capabilities of the team you lead, and partner with technical leads and product on direction and architecture, while collaborating with stakeholders across CAS to develop innovative, data-driven solutions using consultative problem-solving to address complex challenges such as knowledge extraction, classification, search algorithms, and prediction models.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own hiring for a growing team: recruiting, interviewing, and evaluating talent.
* Develop, retain, and motivate data scientists and AI engineers with deep scientific domain expertise; shape and build the team.
* Coach and mentor team members across levels, supporting both technical growth and career progression, including hands-on guidance on complex challenges as needed.
* Manage performance and career development in line with the career framework
* Build bench strength, support succession planning, and sustain a healthy, inclusive, high-expectation team culture.
* Match people to work thoughtfully, balancing team delivery with individual growth and job satisfaction.
* Identify, manage, and resolve conflict within the team.

* Maintain enough fluency across modern AI engineering: LLMs, agentic workflows and tool use, RAG, retrieval and extraction over scientific content, and evaluation — to lead and coach the team credibly.
* Judge the quality of the team’s technical work well enough to give meaningful feedback and guide development.
* Understand the trustworthy-AI principles the team works including CAS’s reliance on curated, provenanced scientific content, and the difference between acceptable model variability and genuine failure — well enough to reinforce them.
* Partner with technical leads and product, who own technical direction, architecture, and roadmap.
* Ensure the team is well-resourced, unblocked, and set up to succeed, working with technical leads and product on prioritization and staffing.
* Remove organizational and people-level obstacles, and escalate and resolve issues that slow the team.
* Support healthy operating practices — delivery rhythm, review, and production health — without owning roadmap outcomes.

* Master's degree in a relevant technical or quantitative discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Computational Chemistry, Physics, Bioinformatics), or equivalent experience.
* A PhD and/or deep scientific domain expertise (chemistry, life sciences, materials science) is valued as a capability the person brings, and is not required.
* 8+ years of relevant experience, including 2-5+ years developing people and leading technical teams.
* Enough hands-on background in AI/ML engineering and data science to lead and coach the work credibly; direct roadmap or delivery ownership is not required at this level.
* Familiarity with modern AI engineering — LLM-based, agentic, and large-scale retrieval and extraction systems.
* Experience building applications using AWS Serverless technologies such as Lambda, SQS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3.
* Experience with Neo4j and graph analytics.
* Overseas experience in working arrangements — working with teams off continent (e.g., N. America, Europe, etc.).
* Proven ability to hire, coach, grow, and retain technical talent.
* Strong people-management, feedback, and career-development skills.
* Team-wide and enterprise-wide perspective, and readiness to lead initiatives beyond one's own reporting line.
* Ability to represent the team's work fluently and confidently to internal and external audiences.
* Sound judgment on team health, culture, and prioritization.
* Sufficient technical fluency to earn the trust of a team of data scientists and AI engineers.

title: Assistant Vice President - Product control Valuations
description:

To be successful as an Assistant Vice President - Product control Valuations, you should have experience with:

* Experience in Valuation Control, Product Control or a related valuation/risk function within a financial services environment.
* Good understanding of IPV, valuation adjustments, fair value measurement and valuation control principles.
* Strong understanding of financial derivatives, valuation methodologies and associated market risk factors.

The role is based out of Pune.

To conduct the accurate and timely valuation of financial instruments, and establishment of valuation methodologies, monitoring of market conditions, and provision of valuation insights to support financial reporting, risk management, and business decisions.

title: Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Manager Strategic Forecasting**
**Position Overview**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology, as we
*invent for life*
on behalf of patients around the world. We are seeking those who have a passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision making, that will allow us to tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats. Within our commercial Insights, Analytics, and Data organization we are transforming to better power decision-making across our end-to-end commercialization process, from business development to late lifecycle management.
  
  
Market Access Insights and Forecasting (MAIF) is a global function encompassing long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across the product lifecycles of all assets within Human Health (Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital Specialty / Primary care). Assets include early and late-stage molecules in clinical development, companies under considerations by business development for partnering and/ or acquisition as well as currently launched products. Forecasting deliverables support division planning and decision making across multiple functional areas such as finance, manufacturing, product development and commercial. In addition to ensuring high-quality deliverables, our team drives synergies across divisions, fosters innovation and best practices, and creates solutions to bring speed, scale and shareability to our planning processes. As we endeavor, we are seeking a dynamic talent for the role of “Senior Manager – Strategic Forecasting”
  
  
We are looking for a team member within strategic forecasting team based out of Pune. Robust forecasting is a priority for businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines. While forecasting of realistic potential can be arrived through both qualitative and quantitative methods, the challenge lies in selecting and deploying the right methodology. Thus, it is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement advanced analytics techniques such as Monte Carlo simulations, agent-based modeling, conjoint frameworks, NLP, clustering etc. within forecasting vertical.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Responsible for conceptualizing and delivering forecasts and analytical solutions, using both strategic as well as statistical techniques
* Drive continuous enhancements to evolve the existing forecasting capabilities in terms of value-add, risk/ opportunity/uncertainty - identify and elevate key forecasting levers/insights/findings to inform decision making
* Collaborate across stakeholders – Human Health, Finance, Research, Country, and senior leadership – to build and robust assumptions, ensuring forecast accuracy improves over time to support decision making
* Drive innovation and automation to bring in robustness and efficiency gains in forecasting/process; incorporate best-in-class statistical forecasting methods to improve the accuracy
* Communicate effectively across stakeholders and proactively identify and resolve conflicts by engaging with relevant stakeholders
* Responsible for managing team and delivery of forecasts in a timely manner with allocated resources
* Determine the optimal method for forecasting, considering the context of the forecast, availability of data, the degree of accuracy desired, and the timeline available
* Contribute in evolving our offerings through standardization/ automation of various offerings, models and processes
* Participate in selection, talent development and trainings of employees

**Qualification And Skills**

* Engineering / Management / Pharma post-graduates with 8+ years of experience in the relevant roles; with at least 8+ years of experience in pharmaceutical strategic forecasting or analytics
* Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques (expertise in Spotfire will be added advantage)
* Proven ability to work collaboratively across large and diverse functions and stakeholders
* Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of business
* Strong analytical skills; an aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking
* Hands on experience on Monte Carlo simulations and range forecasting
* Exposure/sound understanding of advanced modeling techniques like Agent based and dynamic transmission model
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights
* Proven ability to communicate effectively across all levels of stakeholders
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, supply chain and marketing functions

Agent Based Modeling, Biopharmaceutics, Business Analysis, Business Management, Business Partnerships, Immunotherapy, Manufacturing, Marketing, Numerical Analysis, Oncology, Pharmaceutical Development, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Forecasting, Strategic Planning, Veterinary Medicine, Veterinary Pathology, Waterfall Model

team in

* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)

* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
  
  
Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused
**Support Engineer**
who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this
**high-visibility, customer-facing role**
, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
  
  
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
  
  
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
**Location & Shift**

* Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.
* Hybrid Work: Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
* Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST
* On-Call: Participation in an on-call rotation is required to provide after-hours support when needed.

* Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.
* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting & RCA: Assist in root-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud & LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation & Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**

* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
* Technical & Diagnostic Skills:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command-line tools.

* Cloud & Monitoring Systems:

+ Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.

* AI & LLM Exposure: Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* Triage & Operations:

+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
+ Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer-facing teams.
* Strong active problem-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:

+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
+ Jenkins & Git
+ Kubernetes and Docker
+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
+ JavaScript

title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

We're seeking a Semarchy / Reltio Developer to build, configure, and maintain Reltio MDM solutions that power accurate, unified, and governed master data across the enterprise. You'll be responsible for hands-on development within the Reltio platform, including data modeling, API integrations, and custom workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and configure Reltio data models, including entity types, attributes, relationships, and reference data.
* Build and customize match & merge rules, survivorship rules, and validation logic to ensure high-quality master data.
* Hands-on in developing integrations using Reltio REST APIs, Reltio Integration Hub, and event-driven mechanisms (e.g., Reltio Connect, Kafka).
* Write and maintain custom scripts (e.g., JavaScript) for Reltio workflows, business rules, and data transformations.
* Build and support batch and real-time data loads into Reltio using ETL/integration tools (Informatica or similar).
* Develop and maintain Reltio workflows (RIH pipelines, match rules, survivorship configs) and troubleshoot data quality issues.
* Collaborate with data architects and business analysts to translate data requirements into technical Reltio configurations.
* Perform unit testing, debugging, and performance tuning of Reltio integrations and configurations.
* Support data migration activities, including data mapping, profiling, and cleansing prior to load.
* Maintain technical documentation for data models, integrations, and custom development work.
* Provide L2/L3 production support for Reltio-related issues, including root cause analysis and resolution.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of hands-on Reltio MDM development experience.
* Strong knowledge of Reltio core concepts: entities, relationships, match & merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and data models.
* Proficiency in REST APIs, JSON, and integration development.
* Experience with Reltio Integration Hub (RIH), Reltio Console, and Reltio workflow/business rules engine.
* Scripting experience in JavaScript, or Python for custom Reltio logic.
* Familiarity with at least one ETL/integration platform (GCP, Informatica, or Kafka etc.,)
* Strong SQL skills and experience with relational/NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and master data management principles.
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Reltio certification(s).
* Experience working in Manufacturing, healthcare, retail, or financial services domains.
* Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with data privacy/compliance requirements (GDPR, HIPAA) as they relate to MDM.
* Customer Domain Expeirence
  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: QA Lead -Salesforce Automation
description:
**Job Description:**

**Senior QA Engineer (Salesforce Test Automation)**

**Experience:** 7–10 Years

**Role:** Senior QA Engineer

**Work Model:** Agile Delivery Pod (client-facing)

**Focus:** Salesforce Automation Testing, Playwright, Selenium, Copado, Test Strategy & Documentation, Client Engagement

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior QA Engineer** with 7–10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on **Salesforce testing and test automation**. The candidate will define and execute test strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, and uphold quality standards across the delivery lifecycle.

The role requires direct engagement with clients. The candidate will take part in requirement discussions, present quality status and risks to client stakeholders, and propose practical suggestions to improve quality and test coverage. The candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Architects, Scrum Masters and business stakeholders.

**Must Have Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on experience in **Salesforce automation testing** across Lightning Experience, Apex, flows, and integrated business processes.
* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on expertise in **Playwright** for end-to-end test automation (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred).
* Hands-on experience with **Selenium WebDriver** and **Copado** for Salesforce release testing and CI/CD-integrated deployments.
* Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks (Page Object Model, data-driven and keyword-driven approaches).
* Experience with functional, regression, integration, smoke and UAT support testing, and with API testing using Postman or REST Assured.
* Working knowledge of Git and of integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail or Xray.

**Quality Practices & Documentation**

* Ability to set up the complete testing lifecycle, including test strategy, test plans, environment and test data setup, entry and exit criteria, and traceability matrices.
* Proven adherence to QA best practices such as risk-based testing, shift-left testing, root cause analysis and defect lifecycle management.
* Strong documentation skills, including test strategies, test reports, automation framework guides and runbooks.

**Communication & Client Engagement**

* Ability to communicate directly with clients, presenting test progress, quality metrics, risks and dependencies in a clear and professional manner.
* Ability to ideate with clients and provide well-reasoned suggestions on automation coverage, quality improvements and process optimization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with comfort in requirement discussions, estimation, and sprint ceremonies within an Agile pod.

**Good to Have Skills**

* **Salesforce Core** experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* **Financial Services Cloud** testing experience, including household and financial account management, relationship management, and compliance-driven workflows.
* Other automation and testing tools such as Provar, Cypress, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), Appium, JMeter or Gearset.
* Experience with Apex unit test validation, SOQL and data validation, and sandbox or environment management strategies.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Financial Services Cloud.
* Experience working with global teams and offshore–onshore delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks for Salesforce and web applications using Playwright, Selenium and Copado.
* Set up and govern the testing process from project inception, including test environments, test data, tooling and quality gates.
* Define test strategies, test plans and test cases aligned to business requirements and process flows.
* Execute functional, regression, integration and smoke testing, and integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Engage directly with clients to clarify requirements, present quality status, and ideate on improvements to coverage and process.
* Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including test reports, defect reports, traceability matrices and automation guides.
* Perform defect triage and root cause analysis, and drive resolution with development teams.
* Support release activities, UAT and production validation, and mentor junior QA engineers on best practices.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience in Salesforce quality assurance and test automation may also be considered. Relevant certifications are preferred.

**Senior Specialist - Information Security - IN**  
  
**Lead Endpoint Security Engineer**

**Position Summary**

The Lead Endpoint Security Engineer provides technical leadership for the engineering, maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity technologies deployed across the enterprise endpoint environment. The role provides lead-level technical ownership and direction for endpoint security applications, agents, integrations, and supporting services, ensuring security controls remain operationally healthy, resilient, effectively configured, supportable, scalable, and performant. This engineer serves as a technical authority and escalation point for complex endpoint cybersecurity issues and provides engineering direction across the lifecycle of endpoint security technologies, from evaluation and architecture through testing, deployment, production support, optimization, and eventual retirement. The Lead Endpoint Security Engineer works closely with Cybersecurity, Endpoint Engineering, infrastructure, application, architecture, security operations, and technology partners to deliver secure and reliable endpoint protections. The role leads complex technical initiatives, establishes engineering practices and standards, provides technical guidance to other engineers, and influences decisions affecting the enterprise endpoint security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Endpoint Security Engineering**
---------------------------------

* Lead the engineering, configuration, deployment, maintenance, and support of enterprise endpoint cybersecurity technologies.
* Provide lead technical ownership for security agents and controls deployed across workstation, server, virtual desktop, cloud-hosted, and other supported endpoint environments.
* Provide technical direction for endpoint security architecture, technology integrations, platform upgrades, migrations, and control enhancements.
* Lead evaluation of endpoint security configurations to ensure controls operate reliably, securely, and without unacceptable impact to endpoint functionality or user experience.
* Establish engineering standards and technical requirements for the implementation, configuration, testing, and operation of endpoint cybersecurity technologies.
* Lead technical design reviews and evaluate proposed changes for security effectiveness, architectural alignment, integration dependencies, operational supportability, performance, and implementation risk.
* Partner with Endpoint Engineering, infrastructure, architecture, and device-management teams to define engineering approaches for endpoint agent and management-platform integrations.

* Define and monitor operational health measurements for endpoint security platforms, including agent coverage, connectivity, application health, policy compliance, version currency, telemetry availability, and remediation status.
* Identify technical debt, recurring operational issues, and architectural limitations and develop engineering solutions to increase service reliability.

* Lead root-cause analysis for significant or recurring technical issues and ensure appropriate corrective and preventative actions are implemented.
* Coordinate multi-team troubleshooting involving infrastructure, desktop engineering, application,
* Ensure appropriate regression, rollback, recovery, and failure-mode testing is performed prior to significant production deployments
* Lead interoperability and coexistence testing between endpoint cybersecurity controls such as EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, host firewall, DLP, application control, vulnerability management, privilege management, browser security, and other endpoint agents.
* Define technical **go/no-go criteria** for endpoint cybersecurity deployments based on security effectiveness, stability, compatibility, operational readiness, and performance.
* Partner with cybersecurity architecture and adjacent engineering teams to ensure endpoint controls integrate appropriately with broader enterprise security capabilities such as SIEM, SOAR, IAM/PAM, vulnerability management, network security, and incident response.

* Provide technical input into project planning, technology roadmaps, vendor evaluations, and endpoint cybersecurity strategy.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to endpoint cybersecurity engineers and other technology professionals.

* Extensive experience in endpoint security engineering, endpoint management, cybersecurity engineering, or endpoint infrastructure engineering.
* Advanced expertise troubleshooting complex enterprise endpoint security applications, agents, integrations, and supporting services.
* Advanced knowledge of Windows endpoint architecture, services, processes, networking, system performance, and operating-system security.
* Strong working knowledge of additional enterprise endpoint environments such as Windows Server, macOS, Linux, VDI, and cloud-hosted endpoints.
* Extensive experience with endpoint security technologies such as EDR/XDR, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, host firewall, device control, DLP, application control, privilege management, browser security, or comparable endpoint controls.

Experience operating cybersecurity technologies at scale within a large enterprise environment.  



**Preferred Qualifications**

* Extensive experience with enterprise-scale EDR/XDR platforms and Microsoft endpoint-management and security technologies.
* Experience supporting and engineering security solutions across physical endpoints, Windows Server, virtual desktop/VDI, cloud-hosted, macOS, and Linux environments.

* Experience developing automation for platform health checks, testing, engineering workflows, application maintenance, or operational remediation using technologies such as **PowerShell, Python, APIs, or equivalent automation frameworks** .
* Experience integrating endpoint controls with SIEM, SOAR, vulnerability management, IAM/PAM, network security, incident response, and other enterprise security platforms.
* Experience leading security technology POCs, product evaluations, architecture reviews, and production-readiness assessments.
* Strong understanding of security frameworks and control models such as **NIST CSF** and Zero Trust principles.
* Relevant cybersecurity, Microsoft, cloud, endpoint-management, or security-product certifications.

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

description:

title: Business Strategy & AI Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy & AI Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Strong academic background; graduates from leading engineering or management institutes preferred. MBA is an advantage.

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

title: Director, Competitive Intelligence
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
  
  
The Digital Transformation practice is part of the Global Solutions Advisory business group, which is one of five strategic business groups at Ankura
  
  
**Practice Overview**
Ankura Consulting Group is recognized as one of the five fastest-growing consulting companies, with 2,500 employees across 32 offices in 4 continents. The Company provides services to its client on expert witness, bankruptcy and corporate restructuring, litigation support, forensic accounting, geopolitical risk assessment, and general management consulting services. Ankura Consulting Group's headquarters is based in Washington, USA.
  
  
Ankura's Digital Transformation practice helps clients modernize their organizations by leveraging data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes. Within this practice, our Competitive Intelligence capability helps clients turn market, pricing, and customer data into decisions that grow revenue, protect margin, and strengthen enterprise value.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Director to lead the design and hands-on delivery of Competitive Intelligence solutions across multiple client engagements. This is a builder role, not a strategy-only role: the ideal candidate has personally built pricing models, elasticity curves, and forecasting pipelines — writing the queries, building the models, and validating the numbers. The Director will combine that hands-on technical depth with delivery ownership, solution design, and team leadership, acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders while remaining able to get into the data personally when engagements demand it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Personally build and validate pricing, elasticity, and demand models - using tools such as Python or R, SQL, and statistical/econometric or machine learning techniques.
* Define and own the solution design for Competitive Intelligence engagements, including dynamic and elastic pricing models, competitor and market monitoring, and customer/segment analytics.
* Lead delivery of pricing and market intelligence programs for clients, tying each initiative to measurable business outcomes (revenue, margin, operating efficiency, working capital).
* Design, build, and continuously recalibrate price elasticity models by SKU, segment, and geography — including cross-elasticity and scenario simulation — to support data-driven pricing and promotion decisions.
* Build or directly oversee the technical build of competitor price/promotion scraping and monitoring pipelines, supplier and sourcing intelligence feeds, and demand/supply forecasting models.
* Apply and evaluate machine learning and AI techniques (e.g., demand forecasting models, customer segmentation/clustering, propensity and churn models, NLP-based market signal extraction) where they improve on traditional analytics.
* Establish reference architectures, delivery standards, and best practices for Competitive Intelligence solutions built on the firm's Enterprise Data Platform.
* Estimate, plan, and govern delivery across multiple client engagements and workstreams.
* Partner with client stakeholders to align Competitive Intelligence roadmaps with business objectives and timelines.
* Mentor, coach, and develop data scientists, analysts, and technical leads, staying hands-on enough to review code, models, and analysis rather than only reviewing slides.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for analytical rigor, accuracy, scalability, and time-to-value.
* Support pre-sales and business development activities, including hands-on proof-of-concept analysis, solution design, technical estimates, and client pitches.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, market/competitive intelligence, or advanced analytics, with significant leadership responsibility — including recent, genuinely hands-on technical work, not purely oversight.
* Bachelors in Engineering, computer science preferred.
* Certification in cloud platform or relevant data platforms
* Demonstrated, hands-on track record of having personally built dynamic pricing, price elasticity, demand forecasting, or revenue management models — able to speak to the data, methodology, and code, not just the resulting recommendations.
* Proficiency in a data science/analytics stack such as Python or R, SQL, and common ML/statistics libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, pandas, statsmodels), sufficient to build or debug models directly.
* Working knowledge of applied machine learning and AI techniques relevant to pricing and market intelligence — forecasting, clustering/segmentation, propensity modeling, and increasingly, LLM-based tools for market/text signal extraction.
* Comfort working directly in data platforms and analytics tooling (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalents), including writing and reviewing data pipelines, not only architecting them.
* Demonstrated ability to estimate, plan, and govern complex delivery programs.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, governance, and security principles as they relate to market and pricing data.
* Excellent communication skills and experience in senior, client-facing roles, including presenting to executive audiences — balanced with genuine willingness to be in the data day-to-day.
* Consulting experience in a front-ending, client-facing role: understanding and clarifying client requirements, setting and managing expectations, proactively anticipating needs and risks, and communicating clearly and effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong business acumen and results-oriented mindset, with a track record of connecting hands-on analytics work to business outcomes.
* Preferred to have experience leading multi-team or multi-vendor delivery models.
* Preferred to have experience working with private equity firms or portfolio companies.
* Preferred to have a graduate degree or equivalent depth in a quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, data science, or similar).
* Cloud or platform certifications (any major provider) is preferred.
* Must be fluent in English.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager with 1–2 years of experience who is excited about building user-focused products and solving real customer problems. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Business teams to take ideas from discovery to execution and continuously improve the product experience.

This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, curious, highly execution-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

Location: Vasant Kunj, Delhi - Hybrid

**What you'll do**

*Understand the problem*

* Talk to users regularly. Run interviews, sit in on support and sales calls, watch people use the product, and read the feedback nobody else reads.
* Separate what users ask for from what they actually need, and turn scattered input into a clear, prioritized problem list.
* Bring evidence, not opinions. Every proposal should trace back to something a real user said or did.

*Build and design*

* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes using AI tools like Claude, Lovable, or whatever gets you to a real interaction fastest, so users, stakeholders, engineers, and QA can all experience the thing before it's built.
* Design the experience end to end: the main flow, the empty states, the error messages, the edge cases.
* Use AI to multiply your output. Synthesizing research, building internal tools, analyzing data, testing ideas in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Help ship AI-powered features, and think hard about what happens when the model gets it wrong.

*Own delivery*

* Keep a clear, prioritized backlog for your area. Be able to explain why something is next, including what you're not doing and why.
* Write short and plainly: the problem, the user, one success metric, what's in scope and what isn't.
* Work with engineering and QA through backlog grooming, sprint planning, and QA. Answer questions, resolve ambiguity, test the release yourself before it ships.
* Help plan and run launches with the people who need to know: support, sales, marketing, and leadership.

**What we're looking for**

* **A portfolio we can open:** Projects, tools, prototypes, or products you've built.
* **User curiosity:** You open an app and can't help asking why people keep coming back to it, and what you'd steal.
* **AI fluency:** You've gone past basic prompting. You know how to give a model the right context, you've seen where models fail, and you've thought about what to do about it.
* **Taste:** Shown two versions of a screen, you can say which is better and explain why in terms of the user. You notice layout, hierarchy, spacing, and what a screen does when it's empty or broken.
* **Comfort with data:** You can pull numbers out of a sheet or a dashboard, spot when something looks off, and back a conclusion with them.
* **Clear thinking under ambiguity:** You can break a vague problem into something testable.
* **Strong communication:** You can explain a decision to an engineer, a designer, and a business stakeholder without changing the substance.
* **Attention to detail:** In the product, and in your own work.

**Nice to have**

* You've written an eval, or tuned LLM model settings and can say what changed.
* Fluency in Figma, or formal design training.
* Hands-on time with an analytics tool (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Metabase, GA).
* A side project with real users you didn't have to recruit.
* Interest in education, careers, or working with students.

No MBA required. No prior PM title required. If you're short on experience, product depth and the drive to build make up for it. What matters is what you've built.

ü **Location:** Patparganj (initially), later Noida

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a dynamic, strategic, and results-oriented Brand Manager to strengthen our brand positioning, enhance product visibility, and drive market growth across our six key publishing segments: Medical, Nursing, PGME (Postgraduate Medical Education), Technical, Pharmacy, and Allied Health Sciences.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing effective brand strategies, understanding market dynamics, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring that our books, educational resources, and digital learning products achieve strong recognition and market penetration.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, creativity, market intelligence, strong execution skills, and the ability to work closely with editorial, sales, digital marketing, and business development teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Brand Strategy & Positioning**

Ø Develop and implement comprehensive brand strategies for all six business segments.

Ø Establish clear brand identities, positioning, and value propositions for individual products, authors, and publishing imprints.

Ø Strengthen brand recognition, credibility, and differentiation in a competitive publishing market.

Ø Ensure consistency in brand messaging, visual identity, and communication across all marketing channels.

Ø Develop strategies to establish our products as preferred resources among students, educators, healthcare professionals, and institutional buyers.

**2. Product Marketing & Promotion**

Ø Develop effective marketing plans for new launches, revised editions, flagship titles, and existing product portfolios.

Ø Create compelling product positioning, promotional messaging, and campaign strategies based on target audiences.

Ø Work closely with editorial and sales teams to communicate product features, benefits, competitive advantages, and market relevance.

Ø Develop targeted promotional strategies for individual books, authors, subject categories, and high-potential products.

**3. Market Research & Competitive Intelligence**

Ø Monitor market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, pricing, product launches, and promotional strategies.

Ø Identify emerging opportunities across medical education, nursing education, postgraduate medical examinations, technical education, pharmaceutical sciences, and life sciences.

Ø Gather insights from students, faculty, clinicians, institutions, distributors, retailers, and online marketplaces.

Ø Translate market intelligence into actionable brand and product strategies.

Ø Recommend improvements to product positioning, packaging, pricing communication, and promotional activities.

**4. Digital Marketing & Brand Visibility**

Ø Lead and coordinate digital campaigns to increase product awareness, audience engagement, and conversions.

Ø Strengthen the company’s presence across relevant social media platforms, websites, e-commerce marketplaces, and digital learning channels.

Ø Develop engaging content, product showcases, author-led campaigns, testimonials, educational videos, and other promotional assets.

Ø Collaborate with digital marketing teams on SEO, paid campaigns, email marketing, and performance marketing initiatives.

Ø Track campaign effectiveness and continuously optimise activities based on measurable results.

**5. Author, Faculty & Institutional Engagement**

Ø Develop marketing initiatives featuring authors, subject experts, faculty members, clinicians, and industry professionals.

Ø Coordinate webinars, academic events, book launches, conferences, workshops, and institutional promotional activities.

Ø Identify opportunities for academic partnerships, influencer collaborations, and professional community engagement.

Ø Build campaigns that strengthen trust and credibility among students, educators, and subject specialists.

**6. Cross-Functional Coordination**

Ø Work closely with editorial, sales, distribution, production, design, and digital teams to ensure successful product launches and sustained market performance.

Ø Develop marketing calendars aligned with publication schedules, academic sessions, entrance examinations, and relevant industry events.

Ø Provide sales teams with product presentations, promotional materials, competitive insights, and campaign support.

Ø Ensure timely execution of marketing initiatives and consistent communication across departments.

**7. Budgeting, Analytics & Performance Management**

Ø Prepare annual and quarterly brand plans, marketing budgets, and campaign calendars.

Ø Define measurable KPIs for brand awareness, product reach, engagement, lead generation, and sales growth.

Ø Monitor campaign expenditure, return on marketing investment, product performance, and market penetration.

Ø Prepare regular reports for management, highlighting achievements, challenges, insights, and recommended actions.

Ø Take ownership of marketing outcomes and ensure accountability for assigned targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated against measurable outcomes, including:

Ø Improvement in brand awareness and market positioning.

Ø Growth in sales and market penetration across the six segments.

Ø Successful execution of new product launches and promotional campaigns.

Ø Increased digital reach, engagement, qualified leads, and conversion rates.

Ø Improved visibility and performance across retail and e-commerce channels.

Ø Effectiveness of author, faculty, institutional, and professional engagement initiatives.

Ø Achievement of marketing budgets, timelines, and agreed performance targets.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

Ø Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline.

Ø 2-3 years of relevant experience in brand management, product marketing, or integrated marketing.

Ø Experience in academic publishing, educational products, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or related sectors will be preferred.

Ø Strong understanding of brand positioning, consumer behaviour, market research, and product life cycle management.

Ø Working knowledge of digital marketing, social media, SEO, performance campaigns, and marketing analytics.

Ø Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ø Strong project management, planning, coordination, and execution capabilities.

Ø Proficiency in preparing presentations, marketing reports, campaign plans, and management updates.

Ø Ability to manage multiple brands, product categories, and deadlines simultaneously.

**Ideal Candidate**

The successful candidate will be a proactive and commercially astute marketing professional who can combine strategic brand thinking with hands-on execution.

They should be capable of understanding the unique requirements of each of our six segments, identifying what differentiates our products, and translating these insights into marketing initiatives that strengthen brand equity and generate tangible business growth.

The candidate must demonstrate initiative, accountability, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

title: Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager
description:
Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

GIS and spatial analytics | Digital evidence | Data assurance

**LOCATION NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS 01**

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

It sits at the intersection of business, product and operations, working closely with Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI and Sales teams, as well as external partners.
