**Role and responsibilities**

 

**Revenue and P&L**

* Own the On Demand P&L and deliver monthly and annual revenue targets, tracking performance on both a gross booking value and a realised revenue (net of partner share) basis.
* Build and maintain the monthly forecast and revenue bridge, breaking performance down by product, channel, city and building to explain what moved, why, and what needs to change.
* Drive growth across every lever (volume, price, product mix and capacity) while protecting realisation on discounted and partner-led sales.
* Reconcile On Demand revenue across booking systems, partner reports and finance records, including monthly aggregator invoicing and partner settlements, and resolve revenue leakage, unbilled bookings and data gaps.

**On Demand products**

* Own the full product suite (Day Pass, Day Pass Plus, 5 and 10 Day Pass Bundles, Meeting and Conference Rooms, Bookable Private Offices and B2B bulk bookings), including positioning, terms and policies, and lifecycle decisions.
* Track how each product performs and how it affects the rest of the portfolio (incremental revenue versus cannibalisation), and decide when to scale, reposition, reprice or retire a product.
* Grow B2B bulk bookings and Bookable Private Office demand from companies and teams, working with the All Access Sales team and myHQ’s B2B team.
* Identify frequent On Demand users and teams and work with the All Access Sales team to move them up the product ladder to All Access Plus, All Access Basic or All Access Pay Per Use.

**Pricing and promotions**

* Own building-level pricing for all On Demand products, including periodic price reviews, phased price revisions and measuring their impact on orders, revenue and realisation.
* Plan and govern offers and discounts across WeWork and partner channels: set budgets and approval rules, avoid discounting in buildings already at capacity, and run post-offer readouts on incremental volume and cost.
* Set up partner, co-marketing and member offers on the Offer Engine (coupon codes), and work with the Tech team on new offer formats where needed.

**Operations and inventory**

* Manage day-to-day operations. Member queries, coordination with myHQ. Responding to tickets etc.
* Own day-to-day On Demand operations across locations, including product and inventory set-up, building launches and exits, booking issues, cancellations and refunds, and escalations, in coordination with Community and Regional Operations teams.
* Manage inventory and capacity: monitor building-level utilisation, flag buildings that are at capacity or under-used, and work with Community teams on adding desks, reallocating inventory and opening new locations to On Demand.
* Manage the dynamic private office inventory behind Day Pass Plus and Bookable Private Offices, including planning ahead for upcoming private office move-outs.
* Monitor member experience through post-visit surveys (NPS), support tickets and on-ground feedback, and close the loop on recurring issues such as booking friction, crowding and service gaps.

**myHQ and channel partnerships**

* Manage the myHQ partnership end to end, covering joint business planning, inventory and pricing alignment, campaigns and offers, customer support and escalations, B2B opportunities and monthly revenue-share settlements.
* Run regular performance reviews with myHQ on volume, discount levels, new-user acquisition and revenue quality, and agree actions and governance for future offers.
* Manage other aggregator and API partners, from onboarding and booking flows to monthly invoicing and reconciliation, and build new distribution channels such as corporate, employer and HR benefits partnerships.

**Product and digital experience**

* Own the On Demand booking journey on the WeWork India app and website (discovery, product pages, checkout, payment and confirmation), working with Tech & Product teams to improve conversion, reduce drop-offs and grow the share of direct bookings.
* Write clear business requirements and user stories, prioritise the On Demand roadmap and backlog, run UAT and manage launches for new features and products.
* Own On Demand tracking and analytics requirements: define funnels and events (e.g. Mixpanel), make sure bookings, revenue and failed transactions are captured accurately and in line with data privacy requirements, and use the data to run experiments.
* Work with Marketing on demand generation, including website and in-app content, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, performance marketing and building-level activations.

**Strategy and new initiatives**

* Shape the On Demand strategy and annual plan, including targets, growth levers, business cases and the product roadmap.
* Generate and test new revenue ideas (new products, bundles, corporate offerings, partnerships and channels) through quick, low-cost pilots with clear success and stop criteria.
* Keep track of the market, including flexible workspace operators, aggregators, pricing and customer trends, and feed those insights into pricing, product and posit

  ioning decisions.

**Reporting and stakeholder management**

* Run the On Demand operating cadence: weekly performance checks and monthly business reviews that end in clear decisions, owners and timelines.
* Maintain the On Demand tracker and dashboards (revenue versus target; product, channel, city and building views; AOV and utilisation) and prepare leadership reviews and presentations.
* Partner with BI to fix data quality issues and close data gaps such as order counts, repeat rates, funnel conversion and utilisation.
* Act as the single point of contact for On Demand across Tech & Product, Marketing, Community and Regional Operations, Finance, BI, Legal and Sales, keeping everyone aligned on priorities, timelines and one shared set of numbers.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree required in a related field; an MBA is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience (preferably in Product, Category, Business Operations or Revenue Management within consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, travel/hospitality or flexible workspace)
* Proven ownership of revenue targets or a P&L, with a track record of moving business metrics
* Strong analytical skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and comfort working with large booking and revenue datasets
* Experience working with Tech & Product teams on requirements, prioritisation, testing and launches
* Good understanding of pricing, promotions and unit economics
* Experience managing external partners, aggregators or marketplace channels is a plus
* Exposure to product analytics and BI tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Tableau) is a plus; SQL is a plus
* Excellent communication, writing and presentation skills, including presenting to senior leadership
* Ownership mindset and comfort working across teams without direct authority in a fast-paced environment

title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst- Digital Channels for Sexual & Reproductive Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Overview**
Despite India’s rapid growth in digital adoption and e-commerce, the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) space remains relatively nascent online, with contraception and fertility products accounting for only $4.23M of the digital health market. At the same time, significant gaps persist the unmet need for family planning among married women stands at 8.5%, and modern contraceptive use has actually declined (from 56.4% to 52.7%), pointing to continued unmet demand for trustworthy information and access (NFHS-6, 2023-24). While users seeking FP-SRH information prefer a discreet, trustworthy path from awareness to action, the same is not achievable through traditional clinic-based counselling models and as a consequence, users often turn to digital channels where they encounter fragmented, stigmatising, or unreliable content. There is, therefore, a need for digital platforms which can offer comprehensive and reliable information.
  
  
Since 2024, WJCF has deepened its focus on Alternative Service Delivery (ASD), i.e., identifying, testing, and scaling non-traditional channels, beyond public health facilities and frontline workers, through which underserved populations can access SRH products, services, and information.
  
  
Our hypothesis is twofold. First, there is significant unmet demand for reliable, accessible FP-SRH information, and authoritative, cohort-tailored digital content can measurably shift awareness. Second, when users are offered trustworthy, stigma-free content alongside a discreet, low-friction path to purchase or counselling on platforms they already use, a meaningful share will convert from awareness to action — i.e., verified uptake of FP-SRH products and services.
  
  
Our ASD work began with a structured landscaping exercise that reviewed 56 service delivery and demand generation models across health and non-health sectors in India and globally, identifying digital and private-sector channels with the strongest potential for reach, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  
  
This approach was validated through a 2025 pilot with a leading e-pharmacy partner. WJCF co-designed and ran a 4-month, multi-channel FP-SRH demand-generation campaign which reached 0.98M users and achieved a 3% reach-to-conversion rate among new-to-category buyers. Monthly SRH purchasers rose 62% over the pre-pilot baseline - 64% of them new to the category - with growth across priority products (condoms +51%, ECPs +48%, and OCPs +57%). Average time on the campaign microsite was 4 minutes against a 1-minute benchmark, signalling strong content engagement.
  
  
Building on this foundation, WJCF has secured a multi-year grant to scale and diversify its digital SRH work across two parallel workstreams one that deepens and scales e-pharmacy partnerships into a structured, ongoing test-and-learn engine to drive users to category adoption, and another that expands into additional digital ecosystems to identify which channels can reliably move users from awareness to verified uptake, and overall, understanding the conditions under which such partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
  
  
**Position Overview**
WJCF is seeking a highly motivated
**Analyst/ Senior Analyst**
to lead analytical, strategic, and implementation workstreams for our ASD work. The Associate will drive high-quality analyses, design frameworks for intervention models, lead research activities, and manage relationships with donors and partners across digital ecosystems (e-pharmacy, e-commerce, and other consumer platforms). They will guide components of program execution, develop strategic documentation, and ensure delivery of key outputs. The role requires strong problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities, comfort working in complex environments, and the ability to independently own and drive major workstreams.
  
  

* Lead analytical workstreams for our ASD work, driving evidence-based decision-making and strategic planning.
* Lead partner scoping and due diligence efforts, defining engagement criteria and shortlisting frameworks to inform strategic partnership decisions.
* Design and run structured campaign test-cycles in partnership with digital platforms, building and testing hypotheses to optimize program performance.
* Oversee periodic reviews of campaign test-cycles to guide program strategy.
* Distil learnings from these test-cycles and develop the business case and conditions under which partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
* Design and steer scalable intervention models, frameworks, and implementation pathways in collaboration with partner organizations.
* Build and oversee measurement frameworks, dashboards, and reporting tools that track performance across the awareness-to-uptake funnel and enable data-driven decisions.
* Build and sustain relationships with digital platform partners, brand partners, donors, and technical stakeholders to strengthen alignment, negotiate partnership terms, and drive impact.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of program outputs, including strategic notes, donor reports, partnership documentation, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Mentor and supervise analysts and junior staff, providing guidance on research design, analytical approaches, and deliverable development.
* Provide operational leadership to ensure seamless planning, coordination, and execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Lead identification of new opportunities, contribute to proposal development, and craft compelling pitch materials to secure funding and partnerships across ASD, SRH, and allied areas.
* Ensure effective and prompt communication across internal teams and external stakeholders, including rapid response to critical situations with structured action plans.
* Represent WJCF in high-level forums and public engagements, leveraging strong communication and public relations skills to advocate for ASD and SRMNCH priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Public Health, Economics, Business, Population Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in demanding, result-oriented environments across public and/or private sectors; experience with digital platforms is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large projects, design interventions, and contribute to proposal/concept note development
* Excellent analytical (qualitative and quantitative) skills and strong written and oral communication abilities, including preparation of high-quality presentations and analyses for multiple audiences
* Entrepreneurial mindset with demonstrated ability to work independently on complex projects in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to multi-task with a high degree of ownership and commitment to excellence
* Strong diplomatic and interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain relationships across diverse stakeholders
* Fluency in English, written and verbal; working proficiency in Hindi is an advantage

**Advantages**

* Experience working with or within digital platforms (E-Comm/Q-Comm/E-Pharmacy/FinTech/Consumer Tech) in a partnerships, growth, or strategy capacity.
* Management consulting/experience in the healthcare industry or consumer health brands, or other relevant private or public-sector experience
* Experience designing or analysing digital marketing campaigns (channel strategy, cohort segmentation, A/B testing, funnel analysis, etc.).
* Familiarity with India's family planning and SRH landscape, including public sector supply chains and private sector market dynamics.
* Willingness to travel as and when required

***Last Date to Apply 13th December, 2026***

title: Senior Consultant - ML Engineering
description:
**About SiriusAI**

Sirius AI is a US headquartered AI Consulting services and products company with operations in India. * Experience building production grade multi-agent systems (task delegation, coordination, and autonomous decision-making)

* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake)

* Exposure to complex, high-impact Financial Services AI transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to work on enterprise AI platforms, reusable accelerators and next-generation AI products.

title: Business Strategy & AI Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy & AI Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Strong academic background; graduates from leading engineering or management institutes preferred. MBA is an advantage.

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

The role requires hands-on expertise in market sizing, TAM/SAM/SOM estimation, market forecasting and GTM strategy.**

**The Consultant will present insights and strategic recommendations to clients, ensure client satisfaction, develop proposals and drive new and repeat business. Additionally, the role involves leading and mentoring a team of analysts, strengthening research methodologies and contributing to organizational growth through strategic insights and industry best practices.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Research Project Management & Delivery**

**• Lead and oversee multiple research projects, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables.**

**• Define project scope, objectives, research methodologies and execution plans.**

**• Lead market sizing and opportunity assessment studies, including Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Available Market (SAM) and Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM), using top-down and bottom-up approaches.**

**• Develop market forecasts through clearly defined assumptions, demand drivers, scenario analysis and validation of primary and secondary research findings.**

**• Develop actionable GTM strategies covering customer segmentation, target market prioritisation, competitive positioning, pricing and distribution channels.**

**• Conduct hypothesis building, model mapping and data validation.**

**• Perform sanity checks, proofread deliverables and develop strategic recommendations.**

**• Ensure alignment of deliverables with client expectations.**

**• Maintain communication with clients throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating feedback to refine deliverables.**

**2. Client Engagement**

**• Develop compelling client proposals, including responses to RFPs and tenders for government bodies.**

**• Present research findings to prospective clients and generate repeat business.**

**• Build strong client relationships to support long-term partnerships.**

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

**• Build and manage a high-performing team of Research Associates, Analysts and Senior Analysts.**

**• Oversee day-to-day operations, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.**

**• Provide mentorship, skill enhancement and career development opportunities.**

title: Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager
description:
Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

GIS and spatial analytics | Digital evidence | Data assurance

**LOCATION NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS 01**

We are seeking a specialist who can convert thousands of field submissions, service traces and facility records into a reliable, mapped evidence base. The role calls for strong data modelling, spatial validation and the discipline to trace every headline indicator back to a verifiable observation.

Your mandate

Own the spatial data framework and independent data-quality rules that connect mobile records, service areas, facilities, routes, scorecards and dashboards.

What you will lead

* **Establish authoritative spatial boundaries.**
  Organise current area boundaries, locality identifiers, facility points, street networks and relevant base layers. Use validated external reference maps where available, document missing layers and maintain consistent identifiers across project databases.
* **Build digital sampling geography.**
  Translate survey design into assigned geographic cells and visit points, with clear coverage rules. Support the field manager in preventing duplicate visits, gaps between localities and records captured outside the permitted area.
* **Specify rigorous evidence data standards.**
  Create required field definitions, unique keys, coordinate formats, time and photograph associations, allowed value sets, change logs and version conventions for households, businesses, stations, generators, vehicles and facilities.
* **Run spatial and record-level quality checks.**
  Detect absent coordinates, photo mismatches, implausible trajectories, repeated images, time anomalies and records outside authorised boundaries. Maintain an auditable correction process and an exception list for re-verification by independent field teams.
* **Map infrastructure and service deficits.**
  Generate mapped views of transfer locations, waste-treatment assets, service gaps, vulnerable accumulation points, collection catchments and generator locations; ensure that spatial analysis can be reconciled with the technical and financial baseline.
* **Support fleet-network evaluation.**
  Supply street-network and service-boundary layers for primary and secondary collection, GPS-track cleaning, route-overlap analysis, fleet catchments and new route files. Reconcile route IDs and operating-unit codes with the field teams.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Geospatial Intelligence & Data Quality Manager

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Coordinate specialist aerial evidence.**
  Work with an authorised aerial survey provider on two permitted measurement rounds, using photogrammetric outputs or an approved alternative. Document spatial reference systems, comparable surfaces, calculation assumptions and confidence limits for legacy-waste volume analysis.
* **Produce verifiable local scorecards.**
  Create area-level indicators and map attachments that can be traced from the summary metric to an underlying record, date, image and quality decision. Help build usable consolidated service performance views.
* **Prepare open and reusable handover data.**
  Structure validated exports in open formats such as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefiles, alongside map layers, metadata and data dictionaries. Keep raw submissions separate from verified master copies and derived views.
* **Power the monitoring and reporting layers.**
  Supply spatial data to the public-service portal, mobile application, dashboard and management indicator model. Agree refresh schedules, geographic aggregation logic, user filters and mapping quality controls with technology colleagues.
* **Safeguard integrity and reproducibility.**
  Maintain access rights, backups, lineage documentation and version history; support source-to-report reconciliation when findings are challenged or field records are corrected.

What you will help deliver

* Spatial data model, survey-frame layers and automated validation rules.
* Quality-controlled GIS database linking locations, dates, photos and operational evidence.
* Service maps, facility catchments, area scorecard geography and route-ready map files.
* Open-format dataset, metadata, change history and documented handover package.

Who should apply

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering or a related discipline, or a master's qualification in GIS, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing, Geography or an allied field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in GIS, spatial data systems and location-enabled field records.
* Prior delivery of at least one municipal geospatial dataset backed by photograph-verified observations.
* Hands-on command of GIS tooling, geofencing, geospatial file standards, field-data quality and stakeholder reporting.

title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst- Digital Channels for Sexual & Reproductive Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Overview**
Despite India’s rapid growth in digital adoption and e-commerce, the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) space remains relatively nascent online, with contraception and fertility products accounting for only $4.23M of the digital health market. At the same time, significant gaps persist the unmet need for family planning among married women stands at 8.5%, and modern contraceptive use has actually declined (from 56.4% to 52.7%), pointing to continued unmet demand for trustworthy information and access (NFHS-6, 2023-24). While users seeking FP-SRH information prefer a discreet, trustworthy path from awareness to action, the same is not achievable through traditional clinic-based counselling models and as a consequence, users often turn to digital channels where they encounter fragmented, stigmatising, or unreliable content. There is, therefore, a need for digital platforms which can offer comprehensive and reliable information.
  
  
Since 2024, WJCF has deepened its focus on Alternative Service Delivery (ASD), i.e., identifying, testing, and scaling non-traditional channels, beyond public health facilities and frontline workers, through which underserved populations can access SRH products, services, and information.
  
  
Our hypothesis is twofold. First, there is significant unmet demand for reliable, accessible FP-SRH information, and authoritative, cohort-tailored digital content can measurably shift awareness. Second, when users are offered trustworthy, stigma-free content alongside a discreet, low-friction path to purchase or counselling on platforms they already use, a meaningful share will convert from awareness to action — i.e., verified uptake of FP-SRH products and services.
  
  
Our ASD work began with a structured landscaping exercise that reviewed 56 service delivery and demand generation models across health and non-health sectors in India and globally, identifying digital and private-sector channels with the strongest potential for reach, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  
  
This approach was validated through a 2025 pilot with a leading e-pharmacy partner. WJCF co-designed and ran a 4-month, multi-channel FP-SRH demand-generation campaign which reached 0.98M users and achieved a 3% reach-to-conversion rate among new-to-category buyers. Monthly SRH purchasers rose 62% over the pre-pilot baseline - 64% of them new to the category - with growth across priority products (condoms +51%, ECPs +48%, and OCPs +57%). Average time on the campaign microsite was 4 minutes against a 1-minute benchmark, signalling strong content engagement.
  
  
Building on this foundation, WJCF has secured a multi-year grant to scale and diversify its digital SRH work across two parallel workstreams one that deepens and scales e-pharmacy partnerships into a structured, ongoing test-and-learn engine to drive users to category adoption, and another that expands into additional digital ecosystems to identify which channels can reliably move users from awareness to verified uptake, and overall, understanding the conditions under which such partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
  
  
**Position Overview**
WJCF is seeking a highly motivated
**Analyst/ Senior Analyst**
to lead analytical, strategic, and implementation workstreams for our ASD work. The Associate will drive high-quality analyses, design frameworks for intervention models, lead research activities, and manage relationships with donors and partners across digital ecosystems (e-pharmacy, e-commerce, and other consumer platforms). They will guide components of program execution, develop strategic documentation, and ensure delivery of key outputs. The role requires strong problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities, comfort working in complex environments, and the ability to independently own and drive major workstreams.
  
  

* Lead analytical workstreams for our ASD work, driving evidence-based decision-making and strategic planning.
* Lead partner scoping and due diligence efforts, defining engagement criteria and shortlisting frameworks to inform strategic partnership decisions.
* Design and run structured campaign test-cycles in partnership with digital platforms, building and testing hypotheses to optimize program performance.
* Oversee periodic reviews of campaign test-cycles to guide program strategy.
* Distil learnings from these test-cycles and develop the business case and conditions under which partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
* Design and steer scalable intervention models, frameworks, and implementation pathways in collaboration with partner organizations.
* Build and oversee measurement frameworks, dashboards, and reporting tools that track performance across the awareness-to-uptake funnel and enable data-driven decisions.
* Build and sustain relationships with digital platform partners, brand partners, donors, and technical stakeholders to strengthen alignment, negotiate partnership terms, and drive impact.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of program outputs, including strategic notes, donor reports, partnership documentation, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Mentor and supervise analysts and junior staff, providing guidance on research design, analytical approaches, and deliverable development.
* Provide operational leadership to ensure seamless planning, coordination, and execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Lead identification of new opportunities, contribute to proposal development, and craft compelling pitch materials to secure funding and partnerships across ASD, SRH, and allied areas.
* Ensure effective and prompt communication across internal teams and external stakeholders, including rapid response to critical situations with structured action plans.
* Represent WJCF in high-level forums and public engagements, leveraging strong communication and public relations skills to advocate for ASD and SRMNCH priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Public Health, Economics, Business, Population Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in demanding, result-oriented environments across public and/or private sectors; experience with digital platforms is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large projects, design interventions, and contribute to proposal/concept note development
* Excellent analytical (qualitative and quantitative) skills and strong written and oral communication abilities, including preparation of high-quality presentations and analyses for multiple audiences
* Entrepreneurial mindset with demonstrated ability to work independently on complex projects in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to multi-task with a high degree of ownership and commitment to excellence
* Strong diplomatic and interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain relationships across diverse stakeholders
* Fluency in English, written and verbal; working proficiency in Hindi is an advantage

**Advantages**

* Experience working with or within digital platforms (E-Comm/Q-Comm/E-Pharmacy/FinTech/Consumer Tech) in a partnerships, growth, or strategy capacity.
* Management consulting/experience in the healthcare industry or consumer health brands, or other relevant private or public-sector experience
* Experience designing or analysing digital marketing campaigns (channel strategy, cohort segmentation, A/B testing, funnel analysis, etc.).
* Familiarity with India's family planning and SRH landscape, including public sector supply chains and private sector market dynamics.
* Willingness to travel as and when required

***Last Date to Apply 13th December, 2026***

title: Manager Data Engineering
description:
**Job Description**

title: Principal, Tech (GAITech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced software developer to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, Strike team is a new sub team, within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm both to consult on ideas and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will work independently, exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion, and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. You will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional and clear communication skills. Lastly, you will be expected to mentor the staff from respective groups to allow for a smooth handover of projects, which will be a key part of the job.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field with 7 to 12 years of relevant industry work experience as a specialist/individual contributor
* Proficiency in Python with exceptional coding and debugging abilities
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* GAI academic qualifications/certifications
* Experience as a tech solution architect

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrncplGAITechJuly26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Application Administrator
description:
As an Application Administrator your primary responsibly is to manage, optimize and maintain enterprise (business) application software for the AVI-SPL organization. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams – including Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and HR to design workflows, manage user access, build custom reports, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure maximum system efficiency. In addition, you will partner with other members of the IT organization including business analysts, software engineers, and other platform managers to ensure optimal utilization of our applications.
  
  
**Who We Are**
AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. Our success starts with our people; and a workplace that champions culture and belonging ensures we grow and thrive together.

As an Application Administrator your primary responsibly is to manage, optimize and maintain enterprise (business) application software for the AVI-SPL organization. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all software operations, ensuring that applications align with business processes while supporting organizational growth initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams – including Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and HR to design workflows, manage user access, build custom reports, and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure maximum system efficiency. * Experience with NetSuite ERP modules (Finance, Inventory, CRM).

* Ability to build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders across all levels of the organization leveraging direct, clear and confident communication.

* Four-year degree in Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), or related field is preferred.
* ITIL Certification

title: Senior Consultant - ML Engineering
description:
**About SiriusAI**

Sirius AI is a US headquartered AI Consulting services and products company with operations in India. Sirius AI focuses on Financial Services enterprises and solutions / services delivered across multiple geographies. We are an innovation-driven AI and data driven consulting services firm with a high focus on delivering business outcomes for our clients. The Sirius AI team is a mix of talent from a diverse background of Consulting, Industry and Product companies which bring together their Data, Platform, Ecosystem, Technology, Project management and AI skills to develop new solutions and deliver client engagements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly skilled
**Senior Consultant - ML Engineering**
with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for consulting clients across Financial Services and other industries. The ideal candidate will combine strong backend engineering expertise in Python with deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks, large language models, and cloud-native architectures, and will collaborate closely with data science, frontend, DevOps, and client-facing consulting teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and deploy end-to-end Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLM/Agents-based solutions, including classification, regression, fraud detection, anomaly detection, forecasting and predictive modelling.
* Build and operationalize end-to-end ML pipelines covering data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
* Develop enterprise GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and agentic AI frameworks.
* Implement MLOps and LLMOps practices covering experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, model registries, monitoring and reproducibility.
* Build scalable Python backend services, REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Flask or Django.
* Deploy and manage AI/ML workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP, leveraging containerization, Kubernetes and cloud-native AI services.
* Work with GPU-enabled infrastructure and distributed computing for model training, inference and performance optimization.
* Design and optimize data processing and pipeline orchestration workflows using PySpark, Airflow, Kubeflow or managed cloud services.
* Develop secure, scalable and reliable AI systems with appropriate observability, access controls, governance and cost optimization.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and client-facing teams on solution architecture, technical design, POCs and enterprise delivery.
* Drive engineering best practices, technical reviews, code quality and mentoring of team members.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with production-quality coding, Git-based development practices, hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow and Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask or Django, REST APIs.
* Train, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models where they outperform off-the-shelf solutions
* Strong understanding of ML algorithms, statistical modelling, feature engineering, model evaluation and optimization, also including model deployment, serving, monitoring, observability, and retraining in production
* Rapidly prototype and validate new ideas, then harden the successful ones into production-grade systems
* Understanding of transformer-based models, distributed or multi-GPU training, checkpointing, mixed precision, data loading, model serving and performance optimization for transformer-based models.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered applications using RAG, embeddings, vector databases and prompt engineering.
* Experience deploying scalable AI applications using containerization and cloud-native services and practical knowledge of cloud compute, storage, and GPU-enabled AI workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience designing and operating training, evaluation, batch-scoring and deployment pipelines using Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker or Vertex AI.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, model registries, experiment tracking and reproducible environments.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or Google ADK.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in Financial Services use cases such as credit risk, fraud detection, AML, transaction monitoring and customer analytics.
* Exposure to Foundation Models, domain-specific model development, fine-tuning and GPU infrastructure.
* Experience building production grade multi-agent systems (task delegation, coordination, and autonomous decision-making)
* Use AI coding tools and agents throughout design, development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience with computer vision, reinforcement learning and continuous self-learning.
* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake)
* Knowledge of responsible AI, AI safety, and model explain ability.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build cutting-edge AI, GenAI, Agentic AI and Foundation Model solutions for global enterprises.
* Exposure to complex, high-impact Financial Services AI transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to work on enterprise AI platforms, reusable accelerators and next-generation AI products.
* High ownership, technical challenges and collaboration with experienced AI architects and technology leaders.
* Competitive compensation, continuous learning and accelerated career growth.

title: Manager - Data Management Strategy & Product
description:
**Job Description**
As a Manager within Global Servicing Data Management, you will play a key role in advancing our semantic, analytical, and data management capabilities to enable trusted, scalable, and reusable data solutions across Global Servicing.
  
  
You will partner with business, analytics, technology, and enterprise data teams to strengthen semantic modeling capabilities, enable the development of curated data products, and drive consistent data management practices that support reporting, self-service analytics, and emerging AI use cases.
  
  
The role requires a combination of strong technical understanding, data management expertise, product-oriented thinking, and cross-functional execution to help modernize our data ecosystem and improve the quality, reliability, and usability of data.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the evolution of Global Servicing's semantic platform capabilities, enabling scalable, consistent, and governed data consumption across business functions.
* Partner with business and analytics teams to design, develop, and enhance semantic models, including reusable metrics, dimensions, relationships, and business calculation logic.
* Establish and promote standardized semantic modeling practices, ensuring alignment with approved business definitions, underlying data products, and enterprise architecture standards.
* Enable federated semantic development through reusable modeling patterns, documentation, testing practices, and controlled publishing processes.
* Drive semantic model quality and reliability through validation of calculations, aggregation logic, joins, lineage, access controls, and performance.
* Identify opportunities to simplify analytical consumption, improve metric consistency, and enable self-service reporting and AI-driven analytics.
* Support the development and execution of the Global Servicing Data Strategy and roadmap, with a focus on scalable, reusable, and well-governed data solutions.
* Support the design, development, and enhancement of curated data assets and reusable data products, promoting common data foundations across servicing functions.
* Embed data quality, metadata, lineage, access, privacy, retention, and lifecycle requirements into data solutions in partnership with governance and technology teams.
* Drive opportunities for automation, modernization, and simplification across data onboarding, transformation, and analytical environments.
* Lead cross-functional data initiatives from requirements definition through solution design, implementation, validation, and adoption.
* Build strong partnerships with business stakeholders, analytics teams, Technology, and enterprise data management functions to align priorities and drive delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 5+ years of relevant experience across data management, data engineering, semantic modeling, data architecture, analytics, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, SQL, ETL/ELT pipelines, and analytical data architectures.
* Good understanding of semantic layers, dimensional modeling, business metrics and BI or self-service analytics consumption patterns.
* Understanding of data governance principles, including data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership, access, retention, and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting cross-functional data initiatives, managing dependencies, and delivering measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Exposure to AI-ready data architectures, GenAI-enabled analytics, or modern self-service consumption capabilities.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

title: Global Data Steward - Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As part of the Data team within HR, the BCG Global Data Stewards are responsible for the design and implementation of an enterprise-wide Data Governance strategy that supports the efficient usage of data across the firm by ensuring key sets of fully governed, curated, and globally integrated data products & assets.
  
  
Under the guidance of the Global Data Owner, each Global Data Steward supports key data initiatives (both functional and technical) in the domain, including defining and executing principles, harmonized definitions, quality assessments, and governance processes to ensure safe usage and evolution of enterprise-wide products and assets.
  
  
Specifically, the Learning Data Steward will develop a data governance strategy for BCG’s Learning data domain. This role will first be embedded within a Learning Transformation project, working to ensure that Learning data governance aligns with broader transformation objectives. You will collaborate with HR, Data, and Enterprise Services leaders, as well as their corresponding Business Intelligence, Operations, and Technology teams, to ensure a strong, compliant, and strategically valuable Learning data ecosystem. After the transformation, this role will continue to maintain data governance as the number of data sources increases/changes and new data use-cases are identified.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a goal-oriented mindset and enjoy working with cross-functional teams to deliver Data Governance capabilities and support exceptional Data Products. They will have 8+ years of experience in Data Governance (preferably in Learning, or HR data), and be well-versed in in common data opportunities in these areas. Additionally, they should have strong communication skills with proven experience in stakeholder engagement, including working with senior business and technical teams to showcase the business benefits of Data Governance.
  
  
**Among Your Responsibilities, You Will**
**Define an overall vision, roadmap, and priorities for our Learning Data Governance Strategy**

* Work closely with the Global HR Data Governance Director, the HR Data Owner, and other Global Data Stewards (e.g., Worker data) to develop a Learning data strategy
* Understand end-to-end Learning data flows across BCG, and Learning platforms
* Understand Learning data opportunities from our data consumers and business leads, especially our BI&A, and HR stakeholders. Work to define an overall strategy and roadmap for the Learning data, including a set of initiatives with clear accountabilities, goals and objectives ensuring efficient Data Governance capability implementation.
* Align the Learning Data Governance strategy with broader BCG HR, and Data leadership priorities
* Create and enforce data quality policies and standards to maintain compliance and support decision-making
* Ensure that data structures, processes, and governance mechanisms support Learning Transformation objectives
* Work with HR Technology and IT teams to integrate governance controls into new Learning systems and platforms

**Ensure sustainable delivery of customer value on the agreed Data Governance roadmap**

* Collaborate with other Global Data Stewards and IT teams to ensure consistency across BCG’s Data Governance strategy
* Ensure that areas of priority are identified (e.g. Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Quality) and a cohesive action plan is developed to ensure impactful value-add to end customers
* Clear narrative and articulation of Data Governance principles linked to business value-add, communicating these regularly to senior stakeholders across Data and HR.
* Track and report on specific and measurable aligned KPIs and key results, developing metrics to measure maturing with Learning data
* Prioritise identified data opportunities clearly communicating with required stakeholders to ensure efficient delivery
* Proactively identify and escalate risks and mitigation plans, along with key decisions, to relevant stakeholders
* Foster collaboration with Learning, HR, and Data teams to ensure alignment on data opportunities and priorities

**Engage with the Data Governance community to ensure alignment and best practices**

* Collaborate with other Global Data Stewards and data teams to ensure consistency across BCG’s Data Governance strategy
* Foster collaboration with Learning, HR, and Data teams to ensure alignment of data opportunities and priorities
* Provide training and guidance on Learning data best practices, compliance, and governance frameworks

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data, HR, or related fields
* 5+ years of experience working in data-related or project roles (e.g. Data Management, Data Governance, CDO Office or BI & Analytics team). Prior experience working with Learning data is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of total Learning data concepts, and other HR concepts including compliance

title: Business Strategy & AI Analyst
description:
**Business Strategy & AI Analyst**

**Zavya | Gurugram | Full-Time | Work From Office**

**Experience:**
1–3 years

**Education:**
Strong academic background; graduates from leading engineering or management institutes preferred. MBA is an advantage.

**About the Role**

Zavya is looking for a Business Strategy & AI Analyst to work directly with the co-founders and business leadership on some of the company’s most important growth and operational priorities.

This is not a conventional reporting or presentation-focused analyst role. The problems will often be ambiguous, cross-functional and without an established playbook.

You will be expected to structure these problems, analyze the underlying drivers, develop practical solutions and help implement them. A major part of the role will involve finding meaningful ways to use AI, automation and data to improve how the business operates.

We are looking for someone who combines structured thinking with speed, curiosity and a strong bias

for execution.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Solve unstructured business problems**

* Work with leadership to identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks and operating inefficiencies.
* Break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, analyses and action plans.
* Investigate root causes instead of treating visible symptoms.
* Take projects from problem definition through solution design and implementation.

**2. Build practical AI and automation solutions**

* Identify repetitive, slow or error-prone processes that can be improved using AI and automation.
* Build and test AI-powered workflows, internal tools, analytical models and automations.
* Evaluate new tools based on business impact—not novelty.
* Document successful solutions so they can be adopted and scaled across teams.
* Measure the time saved, errors reduced or business outcomes improved.

**3. Drive strategic and cross-functional initiatives**

* Own high-priority projects across growth, profitability, commerce, operations and customer experience.
* Coordinate across teams to move initiatives from concept to execution.
* Establish clear outcomes, owners, timelines and success metrics.
* Identify opportunities proactively instead of waiting for projects to be assigned.
* Follow initiatives through until measurable results are achieved.

**4. Turn data into decisions**

* Analyse business performance and identify the drivers behind growth, decline and operational gaps.
* Build models, dashboards and decision frameworks that help teams act faster.
* Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for leadership.
* Replace repetitive manual reporting with scalable systems wherever possible.

**Examples of Projects You May Work On**

* Diagnose why a business channel, product category or customer segment is underperforming.
* Build an AI-assisted workflow that reduces manual work for a business team.
* Identify revenue leakage, unnecessary costs or process bottlenecks.
* Develop a framework for evaluating new products, channels or growth opportunities.
* Automate recurring analysis and convert it into an actionable decision system.
* Run a cross-functional initiative from initial hypothesis to measurable outcome.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Core requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in strategy, consulting, analytics, growth, technology-led business roles or a high-ownership startup environment.
* Strong quantitative reasoning and the ability to work confidently with business data.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL experience is preferred.
* Practical experience using AI for research, analysis, automation or prototyping.
* At least one credible example of something useful you have built, automated or significantly improved.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to work from our Gurugram office.

**The qualities that matter most**

**Structured problem-solving:**
You can turn an unclear question into a logical problem statement, analysis and action plan.

**AI fluency:**
You use AI as a working tool and understand how to combine it with data, automation and human judgment.

**High agency:**
You identify what needs attention, propose a way forward and take responsibility for progress.

**Commercial judgment:**
You connect analysis to revenue, profitability, customer experience or operating efficiency.

**Execution discipline:**
You track owners, timelines and outcomes rather than stopping at recommendations.

**Intellectual honesty:**
You are willing to challenge assumptions—including your own—when evidence points elsewhere.

**Learning velocity:**
You can quickly understand unfamiliar functions, tools and business problems.

**Preferred Background**

* Graduates from IITs, NITs, IIITs, BITS, VIT or comparable engineering institutions.
* Graduates from leading business schools or candidates with an MBA.
* Experience in consulting, a founder’s office, business operations, growth, analytics or an early-stage company.
* Exposure to SQL, Python, APIs, no-code automation or AI workflow tools.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business impact of projects owned
* Revenue growth, cost savings or productivity improvement generated
* Adoption and reliability of AI or automation solutions built
* Speed from problem identification to implementation
* Quality and clarity of analysis and recommendations
* Ability to drive cross-functional actions to closure
* Reduction in repetitive reporting and manual work
* Trust built with leadership and operating teams

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct exposure to the co-founders and business leadership
* Ownership of projects that influence real business decisions
* Freedom to test new tools and challenge inefficient processes
* Experience across growth, commerce, operations, data and technology
* Responsibility that expands based on demonstrated ability and results

**Before You Apply**

This role is best suited to someone who enjoys working through uncertainty, learns new tools independently and wants to be accountable for outcomes—not only analysis.

It may not be the right fit if you require highly defined instructions, prefer working within a single function or are primarily interested in producing reports and presentations.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
**About Pluang**

Pluang is Indonesia's leading multi-asset investment platform, offering products such as Crypto, US Stocks, Indonesian Stocks, Mutual Funds, and Gold. Our mission is to make investing accessible, seamless, and secure — so more Indonesians can achieve financial independence. Backed by $120M+ in funding from global investors like Accel and Openspace Ventures, we're one of Indonesia's fastest-growing fintechs.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to own the analytics layer behind Pluang's product decisions. You will work directly with Product Managers across our asset classes — Global Stocks, Crypto and Indonesian Equities — to define how we measure success, find where users drop off or thrive, and turn data into clear product recommendations.

This is a product role, not a reporting role. We want someone who frames the right question before running the query, works independently through ambiguous problems, and brings a point of view to the table. You will have high ownership and a direct line of sight from your analysis to what ships. You will use AI tools like Claude as a core part of how you work, to take analysis deeper and faster than traditional approaches allow.

**What You'll Do**

**Shape Product Decisions with Data**

* Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, guardrails and North Star measures for features and product lines.
* Frame ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and drive them end to end: from hypothesis to recommendation.
* Bring a point of view to roadmap discussions — size opportunities, quantify trade-offs, and flag what the data does and does not support.
* Present insights clearly to product, design, engineering and leadership audiences.

**Own Product Health and Funnels**

* Build and maintain funnels across key investor journeys: onboarding and KYC, funding, first trade, repeat trading and retention.
* Run cohort, retention and engagement analyses to understand how different investor segments behave across asset classes.
* Track feature adoption and post-launch performance, and turn findings into concrete next steps for the product team.
* Set up dashboards and alerts that let PMs self-serve on day-to-day metrics, so analysis time goes to deeper questions.

**Drive Experimentation**

* Design A/B tests with PMs: hypotheses, sample sizes, success criteria and test duration.
* Analyse results rigorously, call out biases and noise, and give a clear ship / iterate / stop recommendation.
* Help build a consistent experimentation practice across product teams.

**Strengthen the Analytics Layer**

* Work hands-on in BigQuery and Mixpanel (and similar tools) to query, model and interpret product and user behaviour data.
* Define event tracking and instrumentation requirements with PMs and engineers, and ensure data is reliable before decisions are made on it.
* Work closely with the Data Engineering team, who own pipelines and infrastructure, so the right data is available for product questions.

**Use AI for Deeper, Faster Analysis**

* Use AI tools such as Claude as a core part of your workflow: to explore data, write and review SQL and Python, test hypotheses and surface patterns faster.
* Go deeper than manual analysis allows: synthesise user feedback at scale, root-cause metric movements, and model scenarios quickly.
* Check AI-generated output rigorously: the logic, the data and the numbers must hold up before they inform a decision.
* Build reusable AI-assisted workflows and share them, so PMs and the wider team can answer more questions themselves.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.
* 3–4 years of experience in product analytics, ideally embedded within a product team rather than a central data or BI function.
* Experience in fintech, with a strong preference for brokerage, trading or investment platforms.
* Strong SQL skills and comfort working with large, event-level datasets.
* Hands-on experience with funnel, cohort, retention and experimentation analysis.
* Structured problem-solving: able to break an open-ended question into a clear analytical approach without step-by-step direction.
* A track record of high ownership — analyses you drove to a decision, not just delivered.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn findings into a crisp recommendation.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) in your analytical work, with good judgement on when to rely on their output and when to verify it.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with GCP / BigQuery and Mixpanel, or equivalent product analytics tools (Amplitude, CleverTap, Looker, Metabase).
* Python or R for deeper statistical analysis.
* Understanding of retail investing journeys — KYC, funding, order placement, portfolio and P&L.
* Exposure to Indian/US/Indonesian equities or Crypto markets.
* Experience working with distributed teams across countries.
* Personal interest in investing and financial markets.

**Why Join Pluang?**

* Competitive compensation package and performance-based incentives.
* Direct impact: your analysis shapes what ships across a multi-asset investing platform.
* High ownership and close work with Product, Engineering, Design and leadership.
* Exposure to global and Indonesian investing products and financial markets.
* Learning and development opportunities with strong mentorship and career growth.
* Flexible policies that support work-life balance and employee well-being.
