title: Deep Learning Engineer – Vision
description:
**This role is NOT suitable for candidates whose experience is primarily in LLMs, generative AI, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, or API integration**

**Role Summary-**

Role Name -
**Deep Learning Engineer – Vision**

Experience- 1-3 years

Location - Sector 132, Noida

**About ZOID**

ZOID is a deep-tech R&D startup working on advanced technologies for the defence and aerospace sector. We build customised solutions for the Indian Military and UAV manufacturers, with our strength being hands-on expertise in AI, electronics, UAVs and robotics.

Current projects include:

* AI-based FOD detection software for naval air stations
* Reusable Off-board Missile Decoy for anti-ship missile defence
* GNSS-Denied Navigation Suite
* Aerial Intelligent Mapping Suite
* Vision-based Kinetic Strike Solution
* Swarming Solutions

**Role Brief:**

We are looking for an
Deep Learning Engineer – Vision
to handle computer-vision data operations through field data collection, image annotation, dataset QC, and test-set analysis for UAV/defence applications. The role involves working with field teams during runway/track tests and maintaining accurate, traceable datasets and test logs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the optics testing end to end (FOV, focal length and depth-of-field calculations) for detecting 3 x 3 x 3 mm objects.
* Plan and conduct optics testing including camera & lens settings (focus, motion-blur budget, exposure, gain, FPS, binning, etc).
* Build and manage the dataset, annotation and QA/QC rules, data versioning, and backup (Raid Configuration).
* Analyse the type of datasets which should be collected for any specific task.
* Develop the detection & classification model for millimetre-scale objects at high resolution.
* Optimise models for real-time inference on the GPU servers such that multiple cameras can simultaneously operate on a single GPU without any accuracy loss.
* Implement object localisation and geo-referencing of detections using RTK/GNSS and frame timestamps and validate CEP in the field.
* Maintain a model registry with regression tests so no release degrades detection performance; run the false-positive review loop with operations staff.
* Analyse why false positives are occurring and how to eliminate them?
* Recommend computation hardware (GPU, memory, storage, camera network cards) based on model and data-rate requirements.
* Apply AI methods to 3D photogrammetry data. Run segmentation, object detection and change detection, and extend the 3D processing pipeline where required. (Good to have)

**Must Have:**

* Fluency in Python.
* Strong computer vision fundamentals
* Knowledge of PyTorch & implementation of object detection at high resolution and small object scale (YOLO/DETR family or equivalent).
* Dataset engineering: annotation tooling (CVAT/Label Studio), QC methods, data versioning (DVC), experiment tracking (W&B/MLflow).
* TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX, INT8 quantisation, multi-GPU inference.
* Optics knowledge: FOV, IFOV, GSD, focal length, MTF, exposure & experience with machine-vision cameras and NIR imaging (Good to have)
* Object localisation and geo-referencing: pixel-to-ground mapping, CEP estimation, working with RTK/GNSS and time-synchronised frames. (Good to have)
* 3D data handling: point clouds and meshes (Open3D, PCL, PDAL or equivalent), knowledge of 3D deep learning models (PointNet/PointNet++, KPConv or similar) for segmentation and detection on 3D models. (Good to have)
* Linux, Git and CI; comfortable deploying and debugging on field hardware.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with multi-camera systems: synchronisation, overlapping fields of view, and stitching or fusing outputs from a camera array.
* Familiarity with GigE-Vision/GenICam camera SDKs and PoE camera networks, enough to debug frame drops and timing with the software team.
* Active learning or semi-automatic labelling to cut annotation effort on large field datasets.
* Exposure to anomaly detection or unsupervised methods for finding objects that were never in the training set.
* LiDAR or depth-sensor data handling, useful for cross-checking optical detections and for AIMS 3D work.
* Understanding of EO/IR sensor behaviour beyond NIR (SWIR/MWIR), for future sensor upgrades.
* Basic Docker and model-serving experience for reproducible field deployments

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

**Experience And Education**

title: Systems Engineer, AI Platforms - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the Global AI & Knowledge Organization (GAIKO), which leads A&M’s AI strategy, enablement, and knowledge infrastructure. Within GAIKO’s AI & Data organization, the AI Tools team manages the enterprise AI platforms practitioners use in their daily work. The team brings together business needs, vendor capabilities, and firm requirements to evaluate, introduce, and continually improve AI tools for thousands of global practitioners.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As a
**Systems Engineer**
, you will provide technical direction and oversight for A&M’s Enterprise AI tools offering. You will help shape the technology strategy, manage and evolve existing platforms, evaluate new AI capabilities, oversee the enterprise API offering, and govern the MCP integrations and connectors that extend the core platforms.
  
  
This hands-on role requires strong technical expertise in Enterprise AI and SaaS platform management, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and the governance and controls needed to operate these capabilities securely at scale. You will assess capabilities from a technical standpoint, configure approved services, implement appropriate guardrails, and support reliable operation at scale.
  
  
You will work closely with the Product and colleagues across Architecture & Engineering, Enterprise IT, Security, Risk, and Legal to take capabilities from technical evaluation through pilot, deployment, and ongoing operation
  
  

* Manage Existing AI Platforms
* Platform administration: Own configuration and administration of approved platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, including workspaces, feature settings, provisioning, groups, roles, and permissions; automate recurring administrative tasks.
* Capability evaluation: Define and apply technical evaluation criteria for new models, features, and agents within approved platforms, documenting capabilities, performance, and limitations to inform adoption decisions.
* Controls and governance: Identify security and risk control gaps, recommend guardrails, and work with compliance teams (security, risk, legal) to review risks and implement agreed controls for safely rollout capabilities
* Deployment management: Manage the deployment lifecycle for approved capabilities and configuration changes, including approval gates, controlled pilots, phased rollout, post-launch validation, and rollback procedures.
* Service operations: Maintain platform health, operational documentation, and support arrangements; coordinate incident resolution and vendor escalations.
* Manage the Enterprise API Offering
* Offering management: Define and evolve the enterprise API offering, including supported services, technical configurations, service standards, and support requirements
* Access governance: Provision and govern access for approved teams and applications, managing accounts, projects, service identities, model permissions, credential lifecycles, and access ownership.
* Consumption management: Configure available usage limits, budgets, and alerts; monitor consumption and spend and recommend adjustments.
* Service operations: Support API consumers with onboarding, documentation, and troubleshooting; manage service reliability and coordinate responses to vendor changes, deprecations, and incidents.
* Manage MCPs and Connectors
* Integration enablement: Assess and enable MCP connections and native connectors between core AI platforms and enterprise applications, data, and services, including the use of approved MCP wrappers for existing APIs.
* Connection governance: Configure and validate authentication, tool permissions, data boundaries, and permitted actions; conduct access reviews and maintain ownership, dependency, and configuration records.
* Lifecycle and operations: Manage connection health, changes, and support issues; assess capacity and scaling requirements and coordinate improvements or retirement.
* Evaluate New AI Tools
* Evaluation framework: Establish reusable technical frameworks for assessing AI tools and capabilities, defining evaluation criteria, test scenarios, evidence requirements, and decision gates.
* Technical evaluation: Run hands-on security and risk assessments of candidate tools, models, and agents for technical fit and enterprise readiness, including performance, integration requirements, scalability, and supportability; document capabilities, limitations, and gaps.
* Risk and control assessment: Work with Architecture, Security, and other stakeholders to assess technical risks, identify control gaps, and agree requirements for enterprise approval.
* Adoption recommendation: Recommend whether and how to introduce new offerings, documenting the rationale, deployment options, dependencies, implementation effort, and operational requirements.

**Qualifications**

* (At least 8-10+ years of relevant professional experience in systems engineering, SaaS administration, Enterprise AI platform management, or a related discipline.
* Hands-on experience managing Enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor, including configuration, access management, platform controls, and production support.
* Strong understanding of LLM platform capabilities, including models, features, and agents.
* Advanced knowledge of AI workflow design, security, and risk management
* Experience defining and applying technical evaluation criteria, with strong judgment in assessing architectural fit, performance, integration dependencies, controls, scalability, and deployment options.
* Strong working knowledge of REST APIs and webhook integrations, including authentication, service identities, credential management, usage limits, consumption monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of MCP, including client-server interactions, tool discovery and invocation, authentication, permission scopes, and how existing APIs can be exposed through MCP wrappers.
* Working knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, including SSO, SAML or OpenID Connect, SCIM provisioning, and role-based access controls.
* Ability to use administrative consoles, logs, API testing tools, and lightweight scripts in Python, PowerShell, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Experience managing SaaS service lifecycles, including controlled pilots, release testing, deployment, change management, monitoring, incident resolution, vendor escalation, and retirement.
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings, communicate controls and guardrails, document operational procedures, and work effectively across product, engineering, IT, and security teams.
* Experience supporting MCP services at enterprise scale, including hosted service dependencies, capacity planning, and operational efficiency
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 integrations, or Power Automate.
* Experience with risk monitoring and enterprise controls such as data loss prevention, audit logging, retention, and access reviews.
* Experience in consulting, professional services, or another environment with complex client-data requirements.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Digital Verification Senior Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 11/12/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19577****Date Posted** **11/12/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent the last few years building verification environments that actually catch bugs before tapeout, and you know the difference between a testbench that looks complete and one that actually stresses the design. UVM is not just a framework you have heard about, it is something you have used to build real testbenches, debug real failures, and close coverage gaps that mattered.

You are comfortable reading a specification, asking the questions that are not written down, and turning that into a verification plan that makes sense. When a simulation fails at 3pm, you do not wait for someone to tell you what to do. You dig into waveforms, trace the issue, and figure out whether it is a test problem, an environment problem, or an actual design bug.

Protocols are not intimidating to you. Maybe you have worked with one already, maybe you have not, but you know how to read a spec, understand timing diagrams, and build checkers that enforce the rules. You are the kind of engineer who wants to get better, who asks good questions, and who does not need to be the smartest person in the room to contribute something real.

At Synopsys, you will work with people who have been doing this for years and who will help you grow.

  
  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Analyze design specifications and identify what needs to be verified, including functionality, interfaces, edge cases, and protocol compliance
* Build and extend UVM-based verification environments in System Verilog, working alongside a technical lead to define architecture and reusable components
* Write directed and constrained-random tests, implement functional checkers, and develop coverage models to track verification progress
* Debug simulation failures by analyzing waveforms, logs, and coverage reports to isolate root causes in the testbench or design
* Collaborate with design engineers to understand RTL changes and with the VIP team to integrate and leverage verification IP effectively
* Contribute to test planning, code reviews, and process improvements that help the team close verification faster and with higher quality
* Follow established verification methodologies and quality standards while identifying opportunities to improve flow efficiency
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your verification environments will catch critical design issues before they reach silicon, saving months of debug time and reducing tapeout risk
* The test scenarios and checkers you build will directly improve functional coverage closure and give the team confidence in design correctness
* Your collaboration with design engineers will surface ambiguities and corner cases early, leading to cleaner RTL and fewer late-stage surprises
* The verification IP and reusable components you help develop will be leveraged across multiple projects, accelerating future verification efforts
* Your contributions to test planning and coverage analysis will help the team make data-driven decisions about when a block is ready to integrate
* The questions you ask and the gaps you identify will strengthen specifications and improve the overall quality of the product
* Your willingness to learn new protocols and methodologies will expand the team's capability and enable support for more complex designs
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience in digital design verification
* Proficiency in Verilog and System Verilog, with a working understanding of UVM methodology and testbench architecture
* Experience writing and debugging testbenches, including constrained-random testing, functional coverage, and assertion-based verification
* Ability to read and interpret design specifications, timing diagrams, and interface protocols
* Experience with a standard protocol such as AXI, PCIe, USB, or Ethernet is a plus
* Familiarity with simulation tools like VCS, Questa, or Xcelium is a plus
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can take a 50-page specification, pull out what matters for verification, and turn it into a test plan without needing someone to walk you through every line
* When a test fails, you do not stop at "it is broken," you trace it back to the root cause and explain what went wrong in a way that helps the designer fix it quickly
* You manage your own work without needing daily direction, you know what is blocking you, what is next, and when to ask for help
* You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in conversation, whether you are documenting a coverage gap or explaining a simulation failure in a team meeting
* You are comfortable working with people across functions, design engineers who need clear bug reports, VIP teams who need integration feedback, and leads who need status without fluff
* Learning a new protocol or verification technique does not intimidate you, it is just part of the job, and you are willing to put in the work to get up to speed
  

  

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

  
About the team  
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Drone Analytics – Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform
description:
**Drone Analytics – Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform**  
Experience: 4+ Years | 2+ Years in Computer Vision on Video or Aerial Imagery

**Primary Focus:**  
Model accuracy, per-customer fine-tuning, evaluation benchmarks, drift monitoring.

**Technology Stack:**   
PyTorch, OpenCV, Ultralytics YOLO / RT-DETR / Detectron2, SAM, ByteTrack/BoT-SORT, SAHI, CVAT/Label Studio, DVC, MLflow, ONNX, TensorRT, Albumentations, pandas, scikit-learn.

**Role Summary:**   
Data Scientists own the quality of the models behind the platform’s drone video and image analytics. You will improve detection, segmentation and tracking accuracy on aerial imagery, adapt models to each customer’s domain, and build the benchmarks and monitoring that keep results trustworthy in production.

**Key Responsibilities:**   
**A. Modelling:**   
1. Train and improve object detection and instance/semantic segmentation models for drone footage (e.g. YOLO family, RT-DETR, Faster/Mask R-CNN, U-Net, SAM-assisted labelling).  
2. Address small and dense objects, oblique angles, scale variation with altitude, motion blur and lighting using tiling/slicing inference (SAHI), multi-scale training, mosaic and photometric augmentation, and altitude-aware sampling.  
3. Implement multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT) with camera-motion compensation; produce persistent object IDs across frames and flights.  
4. Work with the Drone Data Architect to convert pixel detections to geographic coordinates using camera pose and terrain data, and quantify positional error.

**B. Data and Fine-tuning:**   
1. Build versioned datasets (DVC or equivalent) with annotation guidelines, labelling QA (inter-annotator agreement), class-balance analysis and leakage-safe splits by site and flight rather than by frame.  
2. Select high-value samples using uncertainty and embedding diversity; run labelling in CVAT or Label Studio.  
3. Define a repeatable fine-tuning workflow (transfer learning, freezing strategies, LoRA/adapters where applicable) with hard guarantees that one tenant’s data never trains another tenant’s model unless explicitly permitted.

**C. Evaluation and Monitoring:**  
1. Create golden test sets and report mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95, per-class precision/recall/F1, confusion matrices, tracking metrics (MOTA, IDF1) and latency/throughput per model version.  
2. Define regression thresholds that block promotion of a model that underperforms the current production version.  
3. Monitor input drift (image statistics, embeddings, PSI/KS tests) and output drift (class distribution, confidence); set retraining triggers and alerts.  
4. Provide confidence calibration and failure-mode analysis for product and customers.

**D. Optimisation and Handoff:**   
1. Export models to ONNX; support TensorRT optimisation with FP16/INT8 calibration and verify accuracy loss against benchmarks.  
2. Hand over model artefacts, pre/post-processing specs and test sets to the Python AI/ML developer; validate MVP-to-SaaS result parity for migrating customers.

**Required Skills and Experience:**   
1. 4+ years in applied machine learning, including 2+ years in computer vision on video or aerial imagery.  
2. Strong PyTorch and OpenCV; experience training detection and segmentation models end to end.  
3. Rigorous evaluation methodology: mAP, PR curves, per-class analysis, statistical validation.  
4. Dataset curation, annotation tooling and augmentation pipelines.  
5. Python engineering practices: testing, packaging, reproducibility, experiment tracking (MLflow or W&B).  
6. Working knowledge of ONNX export and GPU training.

**Preferred / Added Advantage:**  
1. SAHI/tiled inference, SAM or foundation-model-assisted labelling.  
2. Multi-object tracking and video analytics.  
3. Drift detection tooling (Evidently or similar).  
4. TensorRT quantisation; edge deployment (Jetson).  
5. Vision-language models for search or auto-labelling.  
6. Remote sensing or geospatial ML.

**Key Deliverables:**   
1. Baseline and improved models with benchmark reports per release.  
2. Versioned datasets and labelling guidelines.  
3. Fine-tuning pipeline and tenant-isolation rules.  
4. Drift monitoring spec and dashboards.  
5. Model cards for each production model.

**Education:**   
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or related field

title: Account Manager, FSI-Fintech, Account Manager, FSI-Fintech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  
  
Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world-class candidates to join our–FSI Fintech business.  
  
As a Fintech Account Leader for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase adoption, and market penetration in large Fintech accounts to build long-term business and marketing opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess a business development/sales background that enables them to engage at all levels of a customer and partner organization, including C-levels of the business and Tech. You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a coverage plan business objectives. This is a high visibility role needing to engage CXOs of Fintechs as well as leverage internal executives to drive transformational outcomes for large Fintechs in the long term.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop long-term strategic relationships with the C-levels of Business & Tech for the given Accounts.
* Work closely with the Channels team to ensure that AWS India is the partner's preferred cloud computing platform across all service lines.
* Maintain an accurate forecast and various business reports.
* Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS Cloud Offerings and AI offerings
* Possess the technical ability to explain (not implement) Cloud Computing, GenAI and Agentic AI, Infrastructure solutions (Server, Storage, DC Services) & Internet architectures (firewalls, load balancers, etc)
* Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
* Ensure customer satisfaction

  
A day in the life  
Research on the FSI Fintech domain and preparation for the day’s customers meetings and calls. Collaborate with Cross functional teams on pitches and solution demos for,  
  
Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls  
Stakeholder mapping  
Ensure high standards and maintain SFDC hygiene  
Ensure timely communication with External and Internal stakeholders  
  
About the team  
This team is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from enterprise-level FSI customers. The team interacts with leading FSI and Fintech companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or IaaS/SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience
* Bachelor's degree or above
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of positioning cloud technology to CXOs in assigned region experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.  
  
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience
* Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 2+ years of scripting language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud computing such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Ingénieur(e) En Gestion De Données ML
description:
**Faites Carrière Avec Nous**
-----------------------------

### **À propos de l'opportunité**

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne expérimentée pour le poste d'**Architecte Cloud Hybride** à **Montréal**. Dans ce rôle hybride, vous concevrez, mettrez en œuvre et superviserez des solutions infonuagiques sécurisées, évolutives et rentables, principalement sur **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**, avec une possible implication sur **GCP** et **Microsoft Azure**. Vous dirigerez des initiatives d'architecture, établirez des bonnes pratiques, soutiendrez la modernisation des applications et favoriserez l'automatisation des infrastructures, tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, la sécurité et la conformité.

### **Ce que vous ferez**

* Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des zones d'atterrissage, des stratégies multi-comptes et des architectures réseau sur AWS
* Créer et gérer des VPC, sous-réseaux, UDR et VPC Peering dans des environnements HCP
* Provisionner l'infrastructure via des outils IaC tels que **Terraform** et **CloudFormation**
* Développer des fonctions **Lambda** pour automatiser les tâches opérationnelles
* Mettre en place des pipelines **GitOps et CI/CD** pour le déploiement d'infrastructure
* Gérer des charges de travail **Kubernetes** via **AKS** et **EKS**
* Assurer la gestion des correctifs, des sauvegardes et de l'**IAM**
* Surveiller les environnements cloud avec **CloudWatch**, **Prometheus** et **Grafana**
* Optimiser les coûts cloud selon les pratiques **FinOps**
* Intégrer des approches basées sur l'**IA** pour faire progresser les capacités Cloud Hybride

### **Ce que vous apportez**

* **8 à 15 ans** d'expérience en TI, dont au moins **5 ans** sur AWS
* Solide expérience en conception réseau et développement sur AWS
* Maîtrise d'**Ansible, Python et AWS CLI**
* Connaissance des services **PaaS** (RDS, SageMaker) et de l'administration **Linux**
* Expérience avec les processus **ITIL** et la gestion des changements
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration interfonctionnelle
* Expérience en mentorat et gestion des parties prenantes

**Grow With Us**
----------------

### **About the Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced **Hybrid Cloud Architect** to join our team in **Montreal** in a hybrid capacity. You will design, implement, and govern secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions primarily on **AWS**, with potential involvement across **GCP** and **Microsoft Azure**. You will lead architecture initiatives, establish best practices, support application modernization, and drive automation — all while ensuring operational excellence, security, and compliance.

### **What You Will Do**

* Design and implement landing zones, multi-account strategies, and network architectures on AWS
* Create and manage VPCs, Subnets, UDRs, and VPC Peering within HCP networks
* Provision cloud infrastructure using IaC tools such as **Terraform** and **CloudFormation**
* Write **Lambda functions** to automate operational tasks
* Implement **GitOps and CI/CD pipelines** for infrastructure deployment
* Manage **Kubernetes** workloads using **AKS** and **EKS**
* Perform patching, backup management, and **IAM** administration
* Monitor environments using **CloudWatch**, **Prometheus**, and **Grafana**
* Optimize cloud spending using **FinOps** best practices
* Apply **AI-driven approaches** to advance Hybrid Cloud capabilities

### **What You Will Bring**

* **8–15 years** of IT experience, with at least **5 years** hands-on with AWS
* Strong background in AWS design, development, and networking
* Proficiency with **Ansible, Python, and AWS CLI**
* Knowledge of **PaaS services** (RDS, SageMaker) and **Linux OS** administration
* Familiarity with **ITIL processes** and change management

**Pourquoi se joindre à Ericsson?**

Chez Ericsson, vous aurez une occasion exceptionnelle. La chance d'utiliser vos compétences et votre imagination pour repousser les limites de ce qui est possible. Trouver des solutions inédites à certains des problèmes les plus difficiles du monde. Vous serez mis au défi, mais vous ne serez pas seul. Vous vous joindrez à une équipe d'innovateurs diversifiés, tous déterminés à aller au-delà du statu quo pour créer l’avenir.

**Que se passe-t-il une fois que vous avez présenté votre demande?**  
Cliquez ici pour trouver tout ce que vous devez savoir sur notre processus d'embauche typique.

Ericsson utilise une approche d'embauche fondée sur le mérite, qui valorise les personnes ayant des expériences, des perspectives et des compétences différentes. Nous croyons sincèrement que cette approche stimule l'innovation, essentielle à notre croissance future. Nous encourageons les gens de tous horizons à postuler et à réaliser leur plein potentiel au sein de notre équipe Ericsson. Ericsson est fier d'être un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances, en savoir plus.

Si vous avez besoin d'aide ou si vous souhaitez demander une mesure d'adaptation en raison d'un handicap, veuillez communiquer avec Ericsson au hr.direct.americas@ericsson.com.

Puisque ce rôle nécessite d'interagir avec d’autres entités d’Ericsson à l’échelle mondiale ainsi qu’avec des collègues et intervenant.es dans d’autres provinces canadiennes, la connaissance du français et de l’anglais est exigée pour ce poste.

**AVIS DE NON-RESPONSABILITÉ :** Les énoncés ci-dessus visent à décrire la nature générale et le niveau de travail effectué par les employés occupant ce poste. Il ne s'agit pas d'une liste exhaustive de toutes les responsabilités, fonctions et compétences requises pour ce poste, et vous pourriez être amené à effectuer des tâches supplémentaires selon les tâches.

À l'heure actuelle, Ericsson Canada Inc. n'offre pas d'aide à l'immigration ni de parrainage pour ce poste, que ce soit maintenant ou à l'avenir.

**Pays et ville principaux :** Canada (CA), Montreal (Country/ City)

**Détails du poste :** ICT Engineer

**Rémunération et avantages sociaux chez Ericsson**

Chez Ericsson, nous savons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès. Nous offrons un forfait compétitif pour répondre à vos besoins et objectifs individuels.

**Votre salaire**

Le salaire offert dépend de divers facteurs, y compris, mais sans s'y limiter, l'emplacement, la combinaison de connaissances liées à l'emploi, les qualifications, les compétences, l'éducation, la formation et l'expérience du candidat.

Votre paie comprend également la possibilité d'une prime annuelle. Les primes réelles sont basées sur le rendement de l'entreprise par rapport aux objectifs de l'unité, au rendement individuel et à la cible de primes individuelles. Certaines règles d'admissibilité et de calcul au prorata s'appliquent.

Ericsson offre d'excellents avantages en santé, incluant le choix de 3 options de régime médical et dentaire qui permettent à un employé de choisir le niveau de couverture qui correspond à ses besoins. La couverture de base est entièrement financée par Ericsson.

Ericsson offre également une contrepartie de 50% de la contribution de l'employé au Régime d'épargne-retraite enregistré, jusqu'à 8% de la contribution de l'employé (un maximum de 4% de contrepartie). Les employés ont aussi la possibilité de participer au plan d'achat d'actions d'Ericsson.

**Votre temps**

Votre équilibre travail-vie personnelle est important pour nous. Les nouveaux employés bénéficient d'un minimum de 18 jours de congés accumulés, plus au moins 3 jours personnels, un minimum de 10 jours fériés, 1 jour de bénévolat et des jours de maladie. Veuillez noter que les congés payés sont calculés au prorata selon la date de début de l'employé. De plus, Ericsson offre jusqu'à 10 semaines de congé de maternité payé et 6 semaines de congé parental ou d'adoption à 100% du salaire.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Web App
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Stryker is one of the world's leading medical technology companies and, together with our customers, is driven to make healthcare better. We offer innovative products and services in Orthopedics, Medical and Surgical,

Neurotechnology and Spine that help improve patient and hospital outcomes.

**Who you are:**

As part of Mako and Enabling Technologies, our pre-operative clinical applications team provides high quality software to ease and improve the pre-operative flow of surgeries, as well as ensuring the link with core technology from products across Stryker including surgical robotics, image guided interventions, mixed reality solutions and patient specific implants.

We are looking for an ambitious and self-motivated Senior Front-End Engineer to design and develop rich, high-quality user interfaces for our clinical web applications. You will work closely with backend engineers building our micro-services ecosystem to deliver seamless, intuitive and reliable experiences for surgeons and clinical staff. You will have the flexibility and communication skills to operate effectively with other teams across Stryker.

**What you will do:**

* Design, develop and validate front-end applications and components, from proof of concept to product, in alignment with requirements and architecture defined,
* Be involved in technical choices definition for the UI layer, in collaboration with peers,
* Contribute to design tradeoff decisions while developing components of the system,
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers working on our micro-services ecosystem (Python/FastAPI, Rust/Axum, .NET) to define clean, efficient API contracts and integration patterns,
* Establish a working relationship with product, UX and other engineering groups across the organization to successfully implement business and clinical requirements while applying the latest available tools and technology,
* Work in collaboration with the DevOps team to ensure proper build, test and deployment of front-end solutions,
* Ensure on-schedule delivery of high-quality, accessible and performant user interfaces that meet technical and clinical requirements,
* Understand clinical workflows to enhance product usability and user experience.

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering/ Computer Science or related discipline & 10+ years of work experience
* 4+ years of work experience in front-end / web development, with a strong focus on modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems,
* Strong experience with React (production-grade); experience with Vue.js or Angular is also valued,
* Experience with TypeScript, component architecture and testing practices (unit and end-to-end),
* Experience designing and consuming REST/JSON APIs; comfortable working alongside micro-services built in Python, Rust and/or .NET,
* Experience with cloud services either on AWS or Azure would be appreciated,  
  Knowledge of agile software principles and software development life cycle in a domain with strong regulatory constraints,
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English,
* Experience in web-based development using WASM or similar technologies would be appreciated,
* Experience in WebGL or data visualization libraries would be appreciated,
* Experience in medical software development would be appreciated.

  
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Software Development Engineer, IN Amazon Business
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you excited by the challenge of launching new business initiatives for Amazon in India?  
India Consumer Technology (ICT) team builds products and services that solve unique customer needs in Amazon’s fastest growing marketplace. We are a multi-billion dollar business with a huge potential to grow in a trillion dollar market. Our engineers own the complete consumer and seller experience for Amazon India, work on a wide range of technologies (including AWS and EC2) and build and operate highly scalable, low latency mobile first products and services. We are solving Know Your Customer(KYC), last mile engineering challenges around Mobile, Product Discovery, Delivery, Payments, Logistics, Customer experience, Seller experience and more.  
As a Software Engineer within Amazon India Business team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and deploying solutions to help Amazon significantly expand its selection and drive improved customer experience by enabling a new fulfillment pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a team that will be responsible for building a successful, sustainable and strategic business for Amazon, from the ground up!  
If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of millions of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today! You will work with Principal/Senior Engineers in the team to evolve the design and architecture of the products owned by this team. You will be responsible to set up and hold a high software quality bar besides providing technical direction to a highly technical team of Software Engineers.  
As part of this team you will work to ensure Amazon.in is FAST and has the best shopping experience. It’s a great opportunity to develop and enhance experiences for Mobile devices first. You will be working on a work on a wide range of technologies including AWS EC2, SQS, Amazon WW platforms, ElastcicSearch, Big Data, Machine Learning, Android, iOS, Amazon Horizonte, JavaScript, React JS to create unique experiences for India retail customers.
  
You will work on analyzing the latency across the various Amazon.in pages using RedShift, MapReduce, Java, Elastic Search and Machine Learning. You will get the opportunity to code on almost all key pages on retail website building features and improving business metrics. You will also contribute reducing latency for customers by reducing the bytes on wire and adapting the UX based on network bandwidth. You will be part of a team that obsesses about the performance of our customer’s experience and enjoy flexibility to pursue what makes sense. Come enjoy an exploratory and research oriented team of Cowboys working in a fast paced environment, who are always eager to take on big challenges.  
Position Responsibilities:
  

* Work closely with senior engineers to design, implement and deploy applications that impact the Amazon.in business with an emphasis on Mobile, Payments, and e-Commerce website development.
* Own the delivery of an integral piece of a system or application.
* Management and execution against project plans and delivery commitments
* Assist directly and indirectly in the continual hiring and development of technical talent.
* Create and execute appropriate quality plans, project plans, test strategies and processes for development activities in concert with business and project management efforts.

  
Candidate will be a leader, quick learner and be able to work independently. He/she should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. The candidate will need to balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. description:

Exposure to enterprise file transfer/integration tools like Globalscape.

title: Mainframe Data Modernization Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**  
  
As a Principal Data Modernization Architect, you will define and own the target-state data architecture for enterprise modernization and cloud transformation programs. You will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, guiding teams and executive stakeholders on legacy database transformation, migration strategies, and enterprise data governance.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Data Modernization Architecture:** Assess legacy data environments (DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM), define target-state architectures, develop modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformation, establish enterprise migration standards/frameworks, and guide target platform selection.
* **Database Transformation Strategy:** Design migration approaches for legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native services; drive database decomposition and domain separation; and govern schema transformation, data model redesign, metadata, data quality, and data integrity.
* **Data Migration & Coexistence:** Architect high-volume, near-zero-downtime migrations and cutovers using migration waves, Change Data Capture (CDC), and real-time synchronization to ensure data consistency during coexistence periods.
* **Data Architecture & Governance:** Establish enterprise data modeling, lineage, traceability, security, compliance, privacy, performance, scalability, backup, and disaster recovery (DR) standards while collaborating with application architects.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural oversight across modernization programs, conduct architecture reviews, approve transformation designs, mentor engineering and migration teams, and advise executive stakeholders on strategic decisions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Extensive experience defining target-state enterprise data architectures and modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformations.
* Deep hands-on expertise assessing and migrating legacy mainframe data platforms, including DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, and VSAM.
* Proven track record designing migrations from legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native databases.
* Strong expertise in database decomposition, data domain separation, schema transformation, and data model redesign.
* Demonstrated experience architecting high-volume, near-zero-downtime data migrations, coexistence architectures, and cutover strategies.
* Practical proficiency implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) and real-time data synchronization mechanisms.
* Solid background establishing enterprise data governance, lineage, metadata management, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience defining non-functional database standards, including performance, scalability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery (DR).  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing enterprise-wide migration patterns, frameworks, and architectural review boards.
* Strong background collaborating with application architects to align data and application modernization strategies.
* Proven leadership mentoring database engineers, migration specialists, and cross-functional modernization teams.
* Ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders on complex modernization recommendations and strategic investments.
* Experience managing data consistency and reconciliation across hybrid source and target environments during multi-wave migrations.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native data ecosystems and multi-cloud database services.
Track record governing large-scale enterprise programs with strict regulatory and data traceability requirements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl:**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important ,you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused , someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless , naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 15+ years in data and database architecture, including 7+ years leading enterprise-scale database migration, modernization, synchronization, and coexistence programs from mainframe environments.
* **Legacy Mainframe Technologies:** Deep expertise in IBM DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM, legacy mainframe data architectures, and mainframe data modeling.
* **Modern Database Platforms:** Strong proficiency across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Cosmos DB), and cloud-native database services.
* **Data Engineering & Migration:** Hands-on experience with data modeling, schema transformation, ETL/ELT design, Change Data Capture (CDC), data synchronization, and data migration frameworks.
* **Data Management & Governance:** Proven background in establishing data quality management and enterprise data governance frameworks.
* **Architecture & Operations:** Expertise in enterprise data architecture, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), database security, performance engineering, and capacity planning.
* **High-Volume Execution:** Demonstrated success designing and delivering high-volume migration solutions and complex cutover plans.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Mainframe Modernization Expertise:** Skilled in hierarchical-to-relational transformation, database decomposition strategies, relational-to-NoSQL architecture decisions, mainframe data encoding/data-type/structure transformation, and EBCDIC-to-ASCII/Unicode conversion.
* **Large-Scale Migration & Coexistence:** Experience executing multi-wave migrations using near-zero-downtime cutover strategies, parallel run/synchronization models, CDC architectures, and data reconciliation/validation frameworks.
* **Modernization Governance:** Background in data lineage, impact analysis, mainframe-to-cloud data coexistence, hybrid data architecture, data domain rationalization, and migration risk assessment/mitigation.
* **Industry & Program Governance:** Experience governing enterprise-wide data architecture and modernization programs in mission-critical industries (banking, insurance, retail, or healthcare).
* **Cloud & AI Tooling:** Hands-on experience with cloud database platforms on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, plus exposure to AI-assisted modernization and automated schema transformation tools.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

AIRE (AI-native Requirements Engineering) is a new BMW Group tool for managing vehicle requirements, the descriptions of what a car and its software must do. It keeps the full history of every requirement, shows how requirements are linked to each other and to tests, and shows what is affected when something changes. It helps teams meet automotive standards such as Automotive SPICE and ISO 26262. AIRE is built for AI agents first and a user interface later, and the team uses AI agents to help build it. In this role you set up the AI agents, tools and rules the team uses to build AIRE, and the AI features inside the product.

Pune / Bangalore

  

**Experience**

1

* Design, build and operate the AI-native delivery harness for AIRE across the whole SDLC: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, release and operation.

* Own the shared agent assets: agents, skills, instructions, specification templates and MCP tool configurations. Keep them versioned, reviewed, tested and aligned with the architecture and the requirements.

* Define and implement the verification loops for agent-generated work, including static checks, tests, AI evaluations, architecture fitness functions and the required human approval gates.

title: Process Simulation Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Process Simulations Engineer designs and maintains quantitative models to forecast business outcomes and stress-test strategic scenarios across GE Vernova's Greenfield and Brownfield capital projects.
  
  
This role builds high-fidelity simulations of supply chains, operational workflows, and market shifts; uses them to quantify risk and project the impact of variables such as resource constraints, policy changes, or demand fluctuations; and translates simulation outputs into clear, objective recommendations that inform capital allocation and lean/continuous improvement decisions.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Model Architecture:**
Develop high-fidelity simulations replicating complex business environments (supply chains, operational workflows, market/demand shifts) grounded in a detailed understanding of current-state (as-is) operations
  
  
**Scenario Analysis**
Use models to stress-test initiatives, quantify risk, and project the impact of variables like resource constraints, OEE drift, or economic fluctuations.
  
  
**Translating Insights**

* Convert raw, stochastic simulation outputs into clear, objective, decision-ready recommendations for executives and program leadership.
* Support the lean transformation roadmap by validating process and capacity scenarios ahead of investment decisions
* Build high-value business cases for capital investment (headcount, layout, capacity) grounded in simulation-validated data
* Support Kaizens and continuous improvement projects with scenario modeling, what-if analysis, and efficiency recommendations
* Validate and refine models iteratively against real production data to maintain accuracy over time.

**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
  
  
**Requirement**

* 3+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, supply chain, or lean/operations excellence roles.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing principles (VSM, takt time, line balancing, standard work)
* Hands-on experience with DES or business/process simulation tools (e.g., AnyLogic, FlexSim, Arena, Simio)
* Experience with data cleaning and statistical analysis such as t-testing, ANOVA, and regression.
* Have basic knowledge on Java program.
* Demonstrated ability to translate operational data into quantitative models and back into business recommendations
* Experience supporting Greenfield site design, Brownfield capacity/efficiency projects, or automation business-case validation
* Strong data analysis skills to convert production/operational data into model inputs
* Ability to communicate complex, stochastic simulation results simply and objectively to non-technical/executive stakeholders
* Comfort working directly with plant/site teams to gather ground-truth process data
* Intellectual curiosity and a builder's mindset; energized by creating new modeling approaches and simulation capabilities in a function that is still taking shape, rather than following an established playbook

**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.

* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
