title: Junior AI Functional Consultant
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Job Overview**

The Junior AI Functional Consultant is embedded with the Business Units to support the identification, analysis, documentation, ROI computation, data validation, and delivery of AI-enabled business solutions. The role works across business stakeholders, product teams, technical teams, and project leadership to convert business needs into clear, testable, and traceable solution requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct in-depth analysis of business processes, workflows, and data to map opportunities for automation by leveraging process mining and task mining tools (e.g., Microsoft Process Mining, Celonis, Minit, Apromore, ServiceNow)
* Analyze business processes, workflows, pain points, and improvement opportunities.
* Support stakeholder interviews, discovery sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and requirements-gathering meetings.
* Document business, user, functional, non-functional, data, security, reporting, and adoption requirements.
* Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, scope diagrams, data mappings, use cases, and prototypes.
* Assist in identifying, assessing, and prioritizing AI and automation use cases.
* Support feasibility assessments covering business value, data readiness, technical complexity, risk, and adoption readiness.
* Translate business requirements into solution requirements in collaboration with technical teams.
* Support proof-of-concept activities by documenting hypotheses, expected outcomes, test scenarios, and findings.
* Participate in backlog refinement, sprint reviews, testing, defect triage, demonstrations, and release-readiness activities.
* Maintain requirements traceability, assumptions, decisions, dependencies, risks, and change records.
* Support user acceptance testing and validation of delivered functionality.
* Prepare meeting notes, action items, status reports, presentations, user guides, and client-facing deliverables.

**Essential Job Functions**

**Business Analysis**

* Gather and document stakeholder needs.
* Analyze current-state and future-state processes.
* Identify gaps, dependencies, exceptions, and business rules; develop clear and testable requirements.

**AI Use-Case Analysis**

* Evaluate use cases such as document processing, content generation, summarization, classification, search, recommendation, prediction, and workflow automation.
* Help define success measures, business outcomes, assumptions, risks, constraints, and data needs.

**Product and Delivery Support**

* Support backlog creation and prioritization.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and maintain assigned work items.
* Assist with testing, demonstrations, release documentation, and value tracking.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Prepare presentations, decision summaries, meeting outputs, and workshop materials.
* Communicate technical concepts in accessible business language.
* Support client and internal stakeholder sessions under guidance.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Economics, or a related discipline.
* 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, consulting projects, or business-analysis assignments.
* Basic knowledge of business analysis, product development, and software development concepts.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, presentation, and facilitation abilities.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Interest in AI, Generative AI, automation, responsible AI, and digital transformation.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with user stories, acceptance criteria, process models, use cases, prototypes, and data models.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Platform, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, or process-mining tools.
* Basic familiarity with Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, or Azure AI Foundry.
* Awareness of prompt engineering, user acceptance testing, traceability, risk management, and change management.

**Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training**

Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment.

* Business analysis, stakeholder analysis, and requirements elicitation
* User stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability
* Process mapping, BPMN fundamentals, data modeling, and analysis basics
* Software Development Life Cycle and Product Development Life Cycle
* Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Azure DevOps
* Functional and non-functional requirements, testing, defect management, and UAT
* AI, machine learning, Generative AI, prompt engineering, and responsible AI
* Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI services, Power Platform, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, and Power BI
* Process mining and Task mining tools and methodology (using MS process mining, Celonis, Apromore, etc.)
* AI use-case discovery, prioritization, feasibility, and value assessment
* Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams, SharePoint, consulting communication, and workshop facilitation

**Pre-Joining Capstone**

Convert a business problem into an AI use-case assessment, requirements package, process model, prioritized product backlog, test approach, and stakeholder presentation.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

description:
Application Engineer - MDM

Proprietary software solutions and innovation are at the core of what differentiates Citco in the alternative investment space. Through our network of global development centres , Citco invests heavily in technology development, security, and infrastructure to ensure our clients continue to receive award-winning products that underpin our commitment to service excellence.

* Participate and collaborate across multi-functional groups in the operational support model

* Manage upgrades, patches and technical enhancements of the MDM platform in coordination with vendors and internal teams.

* Monitor system health, perform root cause analysis and proactively resolve performance issues.

* Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture diagrams, workflows and operational manuals.

* Collaborate closely with relevant stakeholders to ensure technical solutions meet business requirements and compliance standards.

* Work with IT Security team to implement security controls, access management and data privacy policies on the platform.

* Automate routine operational tasks using scripting to improve efficiency and reduce errors.

* Support capacity planning, disaster recovery and backup strategies for Informatica MDM.

* Participate in development cycles, coordinating with DevOps for integration related to MDM platform deployments.

**Preferred Qualifications and Background**

* Bachelors’ Degree or equivalent experience in a related field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems.

* 4+ years’ experience in Enterprise Development or Application Support

* Experience supporting 3rd party vendor applications and interfaces

* Informatica certifications such as Informatica MDM Developer or Administrator certifications.

* Experience as platform owner overseeing Informatica MDM.

* Knowledge of Informatica Cloud services and hybrid deployment models.

* Familiarity with API integrations and service orchestration related to MDM.

* Experience with third party scheduler tools like StoneBranch or Control M.

* Experience supporting and operating Cloud environments, e.g., AWS

* Ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies

* Strong listening, questioning and analytic skills

* Excellent oral/written communication skills

**Our Benefits**

Your well-being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

We recognize diversity as a source of organizational pride and strength. We have made it a priority to reflect our nation’s evolving diversity in the people we hire, and the culture we create in our organization.

Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

title: Business Analytics Lead Analyst - HIH - Evernorth
description:
**INTRODUCTION TO EVERNORTH:**  
Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group’s existing presence in India.
  
  
**About Evernorth Health Services:**  
Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group - a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.
  
  
**About Cigna:**  
The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group.
  
The Opportunity
  
We are looking for anAdvisor, Business Analytics to join our Prospect Analytics team in Hyderabad.
  
In this role, you will use healthcare and pharmacy data to answer meaningful business questions, identify trends and opportunities, and develop insights that support prospective client opportunities and business decisions.
  
You will work across the analytical lifecycle, from understanding the business question and evaluating incoming data to developing analyses, validating results, and communicating what the findings mean.
  
This is an opportunity for an analyst who wants to build deeper expertise at the intersection ofhealthcare, analytics, technology, and business strategy, while gaining exposure to complex analytical challenges and collaborating with experienced colleagues across the organization.
  
What youll do
  
Analyze complex healthcare and pharmacy data
  
  

* Perform analyses supporting prospective client opportunities, RFPs, and other business needs.
* Work with large healthcare and pharmacy datasets to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and opportunities.
* Assess source data for completeness, consistency, and usability.
* Transform, validate, and analyze data using established analytical methodologies and business rules.
* Investigate unexpected results and resolve data-quality or analytical issues.
* Document analytical methods, assumptions, business rules, and findings.
* Produce accurate, reproducible, and decision-ready analytical outputs.

Turn analysis into insight
  
  

* Analyze healthcare utilization, population characteristics, cost drivers, and pharmacy trends.
* Support analyses involving pharmacy utilization, formulary considerations, member disruption, pharmacy networks, specialty pharmacy, and clinical trends.
* Look beyond individual metrics to identify relationships and meaningful patterns within the data.
* Work with subject-matter experts to understand the healthcare and business context behind analytical results.
* Translate findings into clear observations and implications that business partners can understand and use.

Solve analytical problems
  
  

* Translate defined business questions into structured analytical approaches.
* Apply sound analytical judgment when working with incomplete or complex datasets.
* Identify inconsistencies or unusual results and investigate potential causes.
* Determine when established approaches can be applied and when a problem requires additional investigation or escalation.
* Balance analytical rigor, business priorities, and delivery expectations.

Build scalable analytics
  
  

* Identify opportunities to make recurring analytical work more efficient and consistent.
* Develop and maintain reusable workflows, queries, datasets, reports, and analytical components.
* Help automate manual analytical and data-processing activities.
* Contribute to documentation, quality controls, and analytical standards.
* Work with platforms and technologies such asSQL, Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, AWS, PostgreSQL, or Teradata, depending on the analytical need.
* Explore responsible uses of automation and AI to improve productivity, quality, and insight generation.

Collaborate across the business
  
  

* Partner with colleagues across Analytics, Sales, Clinical, Underwriting, Product, Finance, Data, and Technology.
* Ask thoughtful questions to understand the business need behind an analytical request.
* Clearly explain findings, methodologies, assumptions, and limitations.
* Present analyses in concise, business-friendly formats.
* Incorporate feedback from technical experts, business partners, and analytical leaders.
* Develop trusted relationships through responsiveness, analytical quality, and follow-through.

Continue developing your expertise
  
  

* Build deeper knowledge of healthcare, pharmacy benefits, claims data, and prospective-client analytics.
* Strengthen technical capabilities and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Learn from more experienced analysts and subject-matter experts.
* Share new techniques, findings, and lessons with colleagues.
* Stay curious about developments in healthcare, analytics, automation, and AI.

What youll bring
  
Required qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics, data science, statistics, economics, computer science, engineering, pharmacy, public health, business, or a related discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience
* Professional experience in business analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, data analytics, claims analytics, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience withSQL or comparable analytical querying tools.
* Experience working with large or complex datasets.
* Understanding of data transformation, validation, data quality, analytical workflows, reporting, or visualization.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work in a collaborative environment.

Preferred qualifications
  
  

* Experience in healthcare, health insurance, pharmacy benefits, life sciences, healthcare consulting, or claims analytics.
* Experience analyzing medical or pharmacy claims, healthcare utilization, or healthcare cost data.
* Exposure to RFPs, pricing, underwriting, sales analytics, client analytics, US Pharmacy business or commercially focused analytics.
* Hands-on experience with one or more technologies such asPython, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, Databricks, AWS, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
* Knowledge ofpharmacy utilization, specialty pharmacy, formulary, pharmacy-network, or member-disruption analytics.
* Experience creating reusable analytical workflows or automating recurring processes.
* Advanced education or professional development in an analytical, technical, healthcare, or related discipline.

What will help you succeed
  
Youre curious about the data.
  
When something looks unusual, you want to understand why.
  
You care about accuracy.
  
You recognize that an analytical result has to be trustworthy before it can influence a business decision.
  
You connect details to the bigger picture.
  
You want to understand the business question behind an analysis, not simply complete the requested output.
  
Youre comfortable solving problems.
  
You can work through complex data and imperfect information systematically.
  
You communicate clearly.
  
You can make analytical findings understandable to people who dont spend their day working with data.
  
Youre willing to challenge assumptions.
  
When the evidence points in a different direction, you investigate and raise the question constructively.
  
You look for better ways to work.
  
When a process is repetitive or unnecessarily manual, you look for opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate it.
  
Youre committed to learning.
  
You want to deepen your knowledge of healthcare, pharmacy, analytics, technology, automation, and AI.
  
Why join us?
  
This role provides an opportunity to build a career at the intersection ofhealthcare, analytics, technology, and business decision-making.
  
You will work with complex healthcare and pharmacy data, solve real analytical problems, learn from experienced business and technical professionals, and develop insights that help support prospective client opportunities.
  
Youll also have the opportunity to develop expertise that goes beyond technical execution by learning how to connectdata to insight, insight to business context, and analytical work to better decisions.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Statement
  
Evernorth is an Equal Opportunity Employer actively encouraging and supporting organization-wide involvement of staff in diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts to educate, inform and advance both internal practices and external work with diverse client populations.
  
  
About Evernorth Health Services
  
Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Security Engineer
description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/13/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry Technology
* Work Experience 5+ years
* City Hyderabad
* State/Province Telangana
* Country India
* Zip/Postal Code 500032

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job description**
===================

We are seeking a talented Security Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in production security, DevSecOps, and extensive experience with SDLC practices and multiple security tools, including but not limited to Qualys, Black Duck, and Prisma. As a Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring robust security practices and implementing cutting-edge security measures to protect our systems and data.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Vulnerability Management:**
  -----------------------------

* Own end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle for a given Business Unit consisting of multiple enterprise level products. (SaaS & on-prem).
* Triage, track, Correlate and remediate vulnerabilities from tools like Black Duck, Prisma Cloud, Qualys, Jfrog Xray etc. Understanding the working of these tools and mapping in a common tool.
* Co-ordinate with business security leads to plan patching strategies and risk mitigation.

* **Security Automation:**
  ------------------------

* Integrate security scanning tools into common tools.
* In progress and SLA tracking for all the vulnerabilities and work closely with respective business units.
* Develop dashboards and reports for compliance and leadership visibility.
* Write high level design to automate a few of the manual work.

title: VP, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**

**VP, Product Management**
==========================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Vice President, Product Management**  
  
**Cornerstone OnDemand | Executive Leadership**
  
  
**About Cornerstone**
  
  
Cornerstone helps organizations unlock the potential of their people through technology, content, expertise and specialized focus. Its solutions span learning, talent management, performance, recruiting and workforce development, serving millions of users across thousands of organizations worldwide.
  
  
Cornerstone is embarking on a transformative journey to build WorkforceOS, a next-generation, AI-native Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that unifies the employee lifecycle into a single, intelligent operating system for the modern workforce.
  
  
WorkforceOS will connect employee data, skills intelligence, learning, performance, talent and workforce capabilities to help organizations make smarter workforce decisions, develop their people and build the capabilities needed for the future.
  
  
**About the Opportunity:**
  
  
We are seeking a Vice President, Product Management to be a founding member of the WorkforceOS leadership team.
  
  
This is an opportunity to shape and lead the product strategy for a new generation of enterprise HCM software. You will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for WorkforceOS, translating market opportunities, customer needs and emerging AI capabilities into a differentiated product offering.
  
  
You will build and lead a high-performing global Product Management organization, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to bring the vision to life.
  
  
As a key member of the WorkforceOS leadership team, you will partner directly with the GM to define the product's strategic direction, establish its market positioning and drive its commercial success.
  
  
Beyond WorkforceOS, you will work closely with GMs and product leaders across Cornerstone's business lines to identify strategic opportunities, drive portfolio alignment and create synergies across the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.
  
  
This role requires a combination of product vision, strong execution discipline, customer obsession, commercial acumen and the ability to build a product organization from the ground up.
  
  
**In this role you will...**

1.Product Vision & Strategy
  
  

* Define and own the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for WorkforceOS, aligned with the overall business strategy and growth objectives.

  

* Shape the evolution of WorkforceOS into a unified, AI-native HCM platform connecting the employee lifecycle, workforce data, skills intelligence and organizational capabilities.

  

* Identify opportunities to differentiate WorkforceOS in the competitive HCM landscape through innovation, simplicity, intelligence and superior customer experiences.

  

* Translate market insights, customer needs, competitive intelligence and emerging technology trends into clear product strategies and investment priorities.

  

* Drive a platform-first product philosophy, balancing foundational capabilities, reusable services and differentiated application experiences.

  

* Establish clear product principles, prioritization frameworks and decision-making mechanisms to guide product investments.

  
2. AI-First Product Innovation
  
  

* Champion an AI-first product philosophy, embedding AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics and agentic capabilities into the WorkforceOS experience.

  

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for workforce intelligence, skills inference, personalized employee experiences, talent recommendations and intelligent HR workflows.

  

* Drive the evolution from traditional systems of record and systems of engagement toward intelligent systems of action and decision-making.

  

* Partner with AI, Data Science and Engineering teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into meaningful, commercially viable customer outcomes.

  

* Ensure responsible AI principles, transparency, trust and governance are embedded into product design.

  
3. Product Portfolio & Roadmap Management
  
  

* Own the end-to-end product portfolio and roadmap, balancing new capabilities, platform investments, customer commitments and technical modernization.

  

* Define product requirements, outcomes, success metrics and investment priorities across product areas.

  

* Establish a disciplined product development lifecycle, from discovery and validation through delivery, launch and continuous improvement.

  

* Drive prioritization across competing customer, market and business needs, making clear trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term platform strategy.

  

* Ensure seamless experiences and interoperability across WorkforceOS modules and the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.

  

* Define and track product KPIs, including adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, time to value, retention and revenue contribution.

  
4. Customer & Market Leadership
  
  

* Build a deep understanding of the global HCM market, including customer needs, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies and industry trends.

  

* Engage directly with CHROs, HR leaders, customers and strategic prospects to understand their challenges and validate product direction.

  

* Establish strong customer feedback and product discovery mechanisms to continuously improve product-market fit.

  

* Develop relationships with industry analysts, advisory groups and thought leaders to understand and influence the evolution of the HCM market.

  

* Partner with strategic customers to validate new capabilities, lead design partnerships and accelerate product adoption.

  

* Develop compelling product positioning and differentiation in partnership with Sales and Marketing.

  
5. Commercial & Go-to-Market Leadership
  
  

* Partner with the GM and business leadership to define product packaging, pricing, tiering and monetization strategies.

  

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to develop and execute go-to-market strategies across new customer acquisition, upsell and cross-sell.

  

* Ensure product investments are aligned with commercial opportunities, customer value and business growth objectives.

  

* Support strategic customer engagements, executive briefings and major sales opportunities.

  

* Partner with Customer Success to drive adoption, customer satisfaction, retention and expansion.

  

* Translate product capabilities into compelling value propositions and measurable business outcomes.

  
6. Product Organization & Leadership
  
  

* Build, lead and develop a world-class Product Management organization, including product leaders and individual product managers across multiple product domains.

  

* Establish clear product ownership, organizational structure, accountability and decision-making frameworks.

  

* Develop a strong product management culture grounded in customer obsession, data-driven decisions, speed, innovation and execution excellence.

  

* Set high standards for product discovery, strategy, roadmap management, product specifications and outcome measurement.

  

* Develop future product leaders and create an environment that attracts and retains exceptional talent.

  

* Foster strong partnerships with global Engineering, Design, Data Science and business teams.

  
7. Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
  
  

* Work closely with the GM of WorkforceOS to translate business strategy into product priorities, investment decisions and measurable business outcomes.

  

* Establish strong partnerships with the GMs of Cornerstone's business lines to align product strategy, identify synergies and drive opportunities for integration, collaboration and portfolio-wide innovation.

  

* Work across business lines to identify opportunities for WorkforceOS to leverage, extend and unify existing Cornerstone capabilities, while defining clear product boundaries, ownership and investment priorities.

  

* Partner closely with the VP of Engineering and engineering leadership to jointly drive product delivery, platform evolution, technical feasibility and customer outcomes.

  

* Collaborate with Cornerstone's global Product, Technology and executive leadership teams to ensure alignment between WorkforceOS and the broader company strategy.

  

* Drive effective operating cadences, portfolio reviews, roadmap governance and executive communication across relevant stakeholders.

  

* Represent WorkforceOS in executive forums, strategic customer engagements and industry events.

  
**You've got what it takes if you have:**

* 15+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience building and scaling enterprise B2B SaaS products.

  

* 8+ years of experience leading and developing Product Management teams, including senior product leaders.

  

* Proven experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for complex, multi-product enterprise software platforms.

  

* Demonstrated ability to build products from early-stage concepts through market launch and global scale.

  

* Strong understanding of enterprise HCM, HR technology, workforce management or adjacent enterprise SaaS domains.

  

* Experience building AI-enabled products and translating AI, machine learning, intelligent automation or agentic capabilities into customer value.

  

* Strong commercial acumen, with experience partnering on pricing, packaging, monetization and go-to-market strategy.

  

* Demonstrated ability to engage with senior executives, customers, industry analysts and strategic partners.

  

* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex product portfolio decisions across multiple business lines.

  

* Excellent strategic thinking, communication, influencing and organizational leadership skills.

  

* Experience leading global, distributed and cross-functional teams.

  
Leadership Attributes
  
  

* Product Visionary: Able to see where enterprise HCM and workforce technology are heading and translate that vision into differentiated products.

  

* Customer Obsessed: Deeply understands enterprise customers and consistently advocates for solving their most important problems.

  

* AI-Native Mindset: Thinks beyond incremental AI features and understands how AI can fundamentally transform enterprise workflows and experiences.

  

* Commercially Minded: Connects product decisions to revenue growth, customer adoption, retention and business outcomes.

  

* Strong Operator: Balances long-term strategy with execution discipline, prioritization and measurable results.

  

* Enterprise Influencer: Builds strong relationships across business lines, influences executive stakeholders and navigates complex portfolio-level decisions.

  

* Organizational Builder: Has the ability to attract, develop and lead exceptional product talent.

  

* Collaborative Leader: Builds strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and the broader executive organization.

  
**The Opportunity**  
  
This is a unique opportunity to build a category-defining enterprise platform and shape the future of how organizations understand, develop and activate their workforce, while helping define the next chapter of Cornerstone's broader product portfolio.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. title: Analyst, Global Safety and Security Operations
description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash is one of the world's most trusted on-demand logistics platforms. The Global Safety and Security team exists to keep it that way, protecting our people, property, operations, brand, and reputation across all our markets. We manage risk and create value through agility, technology, and a people-first approach. Our DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands now span more than 40 countries, dozens of offices, and tens of thousands of employees. We strive to stay ahead of emerging threats and be there for our people anytime, anywhere.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring an **Analyst, Global Safety and Security Operations** to support DoorDash's 24/7 physical security operations center. The Regional Security Operations Center monitors physical security threats and coordinates responses to incidents affecting our people, facilities, and operations around the world. This is an in-person position based in Hyderabad, India. This is not a cybersecurity role.  
  
Reporting to the Manager, Regional Security Operations Center, you will monitor threats, triage incidents, and coordinate real-time responses to protect DoorDash's people, assets, and operations. As a frontline operator, you will assess risks, follow standard operating procedures, and escalate issues quickly and accurately. You will also validate information, distinguish signal from noise, and provide clear context to support timely escalation and informed decision-making.

**You are excited about this opportunity because you will…**
------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operate the ROC in Real Time:** Monitor dashboards, alerts, inbound reports, and open-source signals to identify security, safety, and operational incidents as they emerge.
* **Execute Incident Response with Precision:** Triage incidents, follow established SOPs, and support incident command activities through accurate documentation, coordination, and information validation.
* **Maintain Situational Awareness:** Track ongoing incidents, relevant global events, and operational conditions to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of risk across shifts and regions.
* **Apply Foundational Analytical Intelligence Tradecraft:** Conduct initial fact-finding and source validation to distinguish signal from noise and support effective escalation in accordance with established Risk Intelligence guardrails
* **Support Escalation and Decision-Making:** Identify when issues exceed thresholds and escalate to the GOC Manager or Risk Intelligence team with clear, structured, and decision-ready information, without owning strategic risk interpretation.
* **Ensure Seamless Shift Handover:** Produce concise shift reports and conduct disciplined handovers that capture incident status, risk context, and outstanding actions.
* **Contribute to Operational Excellence:** Participate in drills, retrospectives, and continuous improvement efforts to strengthen ROC readiness, workflows, and analytical rigor.
* **Operate Calmly Under Pressure:** Demonstrate professionalism, composure, and sound judgment during fast-moving or high-impact incidents.

**We are excited about you because...**
---------------------------------------

* **Experience and education:** Three or more years in a GSOC, RSOC, SOC, or comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional or military experience.
* **Incident response and judgment:** Ability to triage incidents, assess risk, follow playbooks, and escalate decisively under pressure.
* **Analytical and technical skills:** Ability to validate information, identify trends, and use monitoring, ticketing, communication, and basic analytics tools. Basic OSINT familiarity preferred; training provided as needed.
* **Communication and reliability:** Clear incident documentation, effective communication with leaders and partners, attention to detail, and consistent adherence to procedures.
* **Adaptability and availability:** Willingness to learn and work rotating or extended shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, to support 24/7 global operations.

**About DoorDash**
==================

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
  
  
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.

* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js. title: Principal BI Engineer
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.





**This position is Hybrid with 2 to 3 times a week working from Hyderabad office.** 
 
**What You'll Do**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**•** Architect, build, and improve enterprise reporting solutions, including dashboards, semantic models, data transformations, embedded analytics, and reusable reporting assets.

**•** Design scalable Power BI semantic layers using dimensional modeling, governed metrics, reusable business logic, and performance-conscious modeling practices.

**•** Build and optimize reporting logic using SQL, DAX, Power Query, views, stored procedures, and cloud-based data-processing patterns.

**•** Work across Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and related data platforms to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable reporting solutions.

**•** Establish reporting engineering standards for source control, testing, documentation, release management, monitoring, and production readiness.

**•** Improve reporting reliability through validation checks, source-to-report reconciliation, refresh monitoring, regression testing, and operational runbooks.

**•** Partner across Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, Security, QA, and business teams to translate reporting needs into scalable analytics solutions.

**•** Mentor engineers and analysts by sharing patterns, reviewing designs, creating reference implementations, and helping teams adopt consistent reporting practices.

  

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

**•** 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering reporting, BI, analytics engineering, enterprise data, or cloud data platform solutions.

**•** Deep hands-on experience with Power BI, including Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, Power Query, semantic models, refresh management, security, and performance optimization.

**•** Experience working with Azure, Azure Synapse, Power BI, AWS, and modern cloud-based data environments.

**•** Strong SQL skills, including experience designing and optimizing complex queries, views, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.

**•** Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, semantic-layer design, data warehousing, lakehouse concepts, and governed business metrics.

**•** Experience building dashboards, paginated reports, embedded analytics, shared semantic models, or customer-specific reporting solutions.

**•** Familiarity with engineering practices such as Git-based source control, peer review, CI/CD, automated deployments, and environment management.

**•** Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production reporting issues involving data accuracy, refresh failures, business logic, security, performance, or platform capacity.

  

**And It's Great to Have**
--------------------------

**•** Experience with Databricks or similar lakehouse platforms.

**•** Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Embedded, or advanced Azure analytics services.

**•** Experience with Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, Power BI Performance Analyzer, deployment pipelines, or related performance and modeling tools.

**•** Experience designing multi-tenant, customer-specific, or embedded reporting solutions at enterprise scale.

**•** Experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, orchestration tools, copilots, or AI-assisted workflows to automate reporting engineering processes.

  

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

**•** ABC's reporting solutions follow scalable, consistent patterns that support growing data volumes, customer needs, and analytical workloads.

**•** Power BI models, reports, refreshes, and data flows are reliable, measurable, debuggable, and production-ready.

**•** Teams move faster because reusable models, templates, documentation, and validation checks reduce repeated manual work.

**•** Reporting engineering practices become more consistent across teams through standards, reference implementations, mentoring, and practical enablement.

**•** Stakeholders have greater confidence in the accuracy, performance, usability, and reliability of ABC's reporting solutions.

  




**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION** : ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com** .

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Senior Combustion Scientist / Engineer
description:
**Senior Combustion Scientist / Engineer**

**About Manastu**

Manastu Space is a
**Space Safety and Logistics company**
focused on making space
**safe, sustainable, and accessible**
. We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
**space debris mitigation and green propulsion**
, enabling safer satellite operations, and long-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.

Our work sits at the intersection of
**advanced engineering, applied research, and mission-critical systems**
, requiring deep technical capability and long-term thinking.

**Website:**
https://www.manastuspace.com

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu-space/

**Email:**
careers@manastuspace.com

**Role Objective**

Build and own the
**complete combustion model**
for Manastu's green monopropellant and bipropellant thrusters, from
**combustion fundamentals and catalyst-surface kinetics**
, through
**reactor networks**
, to
**CFD and transients**
such as cold start, pulse mode and instability. The model will be
**validated against our own hot-fire data**
and will predict the performance of any new thruster design (
**Isp, c\*, chamber pressure and temperature, light-off time and pulse response**
) before hardware is built.

**Role Overview**

This is a
**combustion scientist / engineer**
role in Manastu's Propulsion Department. You will take thruster combustion from first principles (
**mass, species and energy balances, flame dynamics and time-scale reasoning**
) to a validated, multi-level model. You will
**develop and reduce reaction mechanisms**
and write the code behind the model,
**characterise the propellant**
for combustion and safe handling (including
**flash point, flammability limits and minimum ignition energy**
), and
**close the loop between model and hot-fire testing**
with stated uncertainty. Full-time, based in Navi Mumbai.

Your models and designs will go directly into the
**green thrusters Manastu builds for orbital transfer vehicles (OTVs), launch vehicle upper stages, satellites and other in-space platforms**
, from attitude-control thrusters to higher-thrust engines. This is an opportunity to
**develop novel thrusters**
, taking them from first principles through design and hot-fire to flight.

Combustion modelling sits at the centre of how we design green propulsion. A model that is trusted against test lets us
**predict performance before hardware is built**
, size new thrusters with confidence, and move faster from design to flight. You will
**set the standard for combustion analysis**
at Manastu and
**build the team**
that carries it forward.

You will work closely with the
**metallurgy, chemical, manufacturing and AIT (assembly, integration and test)**
teams, as well as injector design, thermal, CFD and test colleagues: on materials for chamber and catalyst bed hardware, propellant chemistry and catalyst inputs, manufacturability of combustion hardware, and integration and hot-fire testing.

**Key Responsibilities**

•
**Break down thruster requirements**
(thrust, Isp, total impulse, minimum impulse bit, response time, duty cycle, life) into combustion requirements such as bed loading, residence time, chamber pressure and L\*, light-off time and stability margin, each traced to the requirement it comes from.

•
**Own the complete fidelity ladder of the thruster combustion model**
, choosing the fidelity each question needs: 0-D equilibrium performance and reactor networks, 1-D and 2-D models with gas and catalyst-surface kinetics and liquid injection into the bed, 3-D CFD where it is needed, and transients such as cold start, pulse mode and instability.

•
**Design novel thrusters from the model**
: size the combustion chamber and catalyst bed for specific applications, take the design through review and release for build, and validate it by hot-fire against its requirements.

•
**Predict what matters**
: Isp, c\*, chamber pressure and temperature, bed pressure drop, light-off time, pulse response and catalyst degradation, each with a stated uncertainty.

•
**Close the loop with test**
: compare predictions against hot-fire data, recalibrate after every campaign, fix the physics where tuning is not enough, and help design tests that answer the model's open questions.

•
**Make the model work across new thruster designs**
, and document it so that others can run it independently.

•
**Develop and reduce reaction mechanisms**
for our propellant, and write and maintain the analysis code behind the model.

•
**Characterise the propellant**
for combustion and safe handling, and turn the results into model inputs and handling limits.

•
**Build and grow the combustion team**
: hire, mentor, and set the standard for combustion analysis.

•
**Work closely with**
the metallurgy, chemical, manufacturing and AIT teams, and with injector design, thermal, CFD and test colleagues.

**Experience & Background**

**PhD**
in combustion, propulsion or a related field, with
**5–10 years**
of experience.

Required, in priority order:

•
**Combustion fundamentals and flame dynamics**
: mass, species and energy balances for a chamber and catalyst bed, and time-scale reasoning (residence versus reaction time, heat release versus heat loss) to explain light-off, complete decomposition, flame holding and pressure oscillation.

•
**Thruster combustion model architecture**
: multi-level combustion models built from equilibrium to reactor networks to CFD, including transients and surface kinetics.

•
**Test-to-model feedback and uncertainty**
: models recalibrated against test data, predictions quoted with uncertainty bands, and the judgement to change the physics rather than the coefficients.

•
**Kinetics and code development**
: reaction mechanisms developed or reduced in Cantera, Chemkin or similar; own code in Python or C++ under version control; CFD (Fluent, STAR-CCM+, CONVERGE or OpenFOAM) at practitioner depth.

•
**Propellant and fire-safety characterisation**
: viscosity, vapour pressure, flash point, fire point and autoignition temperature, plus flammability limits, minimum ignition energy, flame speed and quenching distance, well enough to set safe handling and test limits.

Good to have:

• Experience with green monopropellants or high-concentration hydrogen peroxide.

• Bipropellant combustion experience, including mixing and mixture-ratio effects.

• Catalyst bed loading, preheat characterisation and degradation experience.

• Combustion instability or acoustics analysis.

• Additive manufacturing of combustion hardware (SLM, DMLS).

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

•
**First-principles thinker**
: goes to the governing physics and names the assumptions.

•
**Team builder and mentor**
: has hired and grown people, can say how each of them turned out, and writes things down so the work does not depend on one person.

•
**Detail-oriented**
: checks units, inputs and convergence before any number is used, cross-checks models against hand calculations, states the uncertainty on every result, and keeps records that let anyone rerun the work.

•
**Clear communicator**
: presents complex combustion results simply, with their uncertainty, to design reviews, customers and non-specialists.

•
**Systems thinker**
: sees how a combustion decision lands on injector, thermal, materials, manufacturing, AIT and test.

**What Success Looks Like in this role**

•
**Thruster requirements broken down into combustion requirements**
, each traced to the requirement it comes from.

•
**A working combustion model**
for monopropellant and bipropellant thrusters, used at whatever fidelity each question needs, with its
**error against hot-fire data published and falling**
.

•
**A novel thruster designed from the model**
, through design review and release for build, then
**validated by hot-fire**
against its requirements.

•
**A combustion team hired and grown**
that runs the model independently.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Engineer –**
IT Factory - Python Data Engineer
  
  
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a python data engineer, to own the data foundation of the application. As every control result, every dashboard figure and every application screen reads from the curated data model you build and maintain. If the data is wrong, late or unexplained, nothing above it can be trusted.
  
  
The platform ingests from several enterprise sources into a raw layer that preserves exactly what each source sent and then transforms that into a curated model. You will build and operate the data pipelines, implement the reconciliation and data-quality checks that prove each load is complete, and extend the model as new controls and modules require it.
  
  
You will also implement the control rules themselves. These are written primarily as versioned SQL against the curated model, reviewed like application code, and executed by the controls engine. This is where data engineering meets the business purpose of the platform, and it is a significant part of the role.
  
  
This is not a pure pipeline role. You will also contribute to the application services, and you are expected to be able to pick up backend work when delivery requires it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ingestion pipelines — scheduled extraction from enterprise source systems into the raw layer, including change detection, load history and the recording of source data provenance.
* The curated data model — transformation from raw to a conformed, keyed and de-duplicated model of entitlements, applications, users and their relationships.
* Reconciliation and data quality — checks that prove each load is complete and consistent, with results written to an append-only evidence store and discrepancies raised rather than silently absorbed.
* Pipeline orchestration — scheduling, dependency management, retry and alerting, with a run history that can be interrogated when a question is asked about a past load.
* Control rules as code — the rule base for the control catalogue, written as versioned SQL with accompanying metadata, peer-reviewed and promoted through the same pipeline as application code.
* Reporting data layer — the curated views that the reporting dashboards consume, designed as a stable contract that survives changes to the underlying model.
* Backend services — contributing to the Python application services alongside the Technical Lead.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, at depth. This is the core of the role. Complex joins, aggregation, window functions, set operations; reading and acting on query plans; indexing and performance tuning on large tables. You should instinctively solve a data problem in SQL before reaching for application code.
* Relational data modelling. Designing schemas for analytical and operational use: keys, grain, slowly changing data, handling of deletions and deactivations in source systems. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Python for data engineering. Writing maintainable, tested Python for ETL — not notebooks. Experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable toolkit, and with pandas or Polars for in-flight transformation.
* Pipeline construction and operation. Building pipelines that run unattended: idempotent loads, failure handling, retries, alerting and the ability to re-run a failed load safely.
* Data quality and reconciliation. Practical experience proving that a data load is complete and correct, and designing the controls that detect when it is not.
* Backend development. Sufficient experience building API services in Python — FastAPI, Django or Flask — to contribute to the application layer.
* Testing discipline. Automated tests for transformation logic. Experience with pytest.
* Version control. Disciplined use of Git and pull request review. Treating SQL and pipeline definitions as code, held in a repository rather than on a server.
* Communication in a distributed team. Clear written English, and the judgement to flag a data discrepancy rather than work around it.

**Nice To Have**

* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow in production, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, functional role codes, segregation of duties, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Reporting tools — Power BI, including semantic modelling and designing the views that sit behind a dashboard.
* Regulated-environment experience — working with personal or otherwise sensitive data under data-protection controls, including masking of non-production environments.
* Linux and CI/CD — comfortable deploying and troubleshooting on Linux servers with an automated pipeline.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. title: Commercial & Investment Bank - Payments Data Scientist Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**About ChaseNet**

ChaseNet is JPMorganChase's proprietary closed-loop payments network that connects Chase-issued cardholders directly with merchants acquired by Chase Merchant Services. By routing eligible transactions through a single Chase-owned rail rather than the traditional open-loop network, ChaseNet simplifies the economics of card acceptance, enables customized pricing constructs, and delivers richer transaction data to both merchants and the firm. ChaseNet supports some of the largest merchants in the United States and plays a central role in Chase's merchant services growth strategy.

As a ChaseNet Data Scientist, Associate in the ChaseNet Analytics team, you will work with large and complex payments datasets to generate insights that inform pricing strategy, merchant profitability, portfolio performance, and strategic decision-making.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage, transform, and analyze large payments datasets to support ChaseNet pricing, profitability, and portfolio optimization initiatives.
* Design, build, and maintain recurring and ad-hoc reporting that provides visibility into ChaseNet performance, revenue drivers, and merchant economics.
* Develop analytical frameworks and models to evaluate pricing scenarios, interchange impacts, repricing opportunities, and merchant business cases.
* Partner with product, pricing, finance, and relationship management teams to translate business questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.
* Write efficient, well-documented SQL and Python code to extract, process, and analyze data from large-scale payments platforms.
* Support governance, quality control, and process improvement across analytics workflows, including automation and documentation.
* Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences through written narratives, visualizations, and presentations.
* Contribute to innovation initiatives, including the use of AI and emerging technologies to improve analytical capabilities and decision support.

* Ability to synthesize data sets into streamlined, clear, and actionable messages.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* AI/ML and automation skills, AI/ML solutions creation, and software engineering skills preferred.
* Experience in the payments industry and/or technology-enabled industries (preferred but not required).
* Working knowledge of the credit card value chain, including the roles of issuers, acquirers, networks, processors, and merchants.

Morgan and Chase brands. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

title: Lead Engineer - Arc Management and Simulation
description:
**What You’ll Do**
Lead the development and deployment of advanced Arc Management & Simulation (AMS) capabilities for electrical power distribution products by leveraging deep expertise in plasma physics, hands-on experimentation, and multiphysics simulation. Drive the execution of arc management & simulation (AMS) technology roadmap through the development of niche simulation methodologies, enhancement of model maturity, and rigorous verification and validation using experimental and product test data. Deploy validated simulation capabilities across new and existing product-development programs to enable simulation-led design decisions, optimize product performance, improve reliability, and reduce physical testing, development cycle time, and overall engineering cost. The role contributes to strategic initiatives within the Global AMS CoE by advancing complex physical and numerical models, supporting AI/ML-enabled simulation workflows, fostering collaborations with universities and research institutions, and strengthening simulation excellence across electrical power distribution technologies. Additionally, the position provides technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while demonstrating strong customer focus, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration skills to successfully drive cross-functional projects, capability-building initiatives, and innovation programs across the AMS CoE.
  
  
"
  
  

* Develop and drive the Arc Management & Simulation technology roadmap aligned with product and business priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and develop niche simulation methods for arc initiation, motion, cooling, interruption, dielectric recovery, contact erosion, gas flow, and plasma-material interaction.
* Lead plasma experimentation, diagnostics, and characterization to generate validation data for model verification.
* Build coupled multiphysics plasma models (MHD) incorporating fluid-flow, heat transfer, electromagnetics, radiation, and code coupling.
* Improve model maturity through verification, calibration, sensitivity studies, uncertainty assessment, test correlation, validation, documentation, standardization, and reuse.
* Apply state-of-the-art commercial and in-house tools and improve simulation workflows, automation, robustness, and computational efficiency.
* Deploy developed and validated capabilities on new and existing product-development projects and translate results into design recommendations and risk-reduction actions.
* Optimize arc chambers, flow paths, materials, contact systems, and operating parameters to improve product performance, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Demonstrate business impact by reducing physical test iterations, development time, and cost while improving simulation accuracy, first-pass yield, and design confidence.
* Collaborate with global product teams, laboratories, universities, and research institutes to accelerate capability development, validation, and technology transfer.
* Mentor young engineers, review technical work, establish modeling guidelines, and build organizational competency in arc physics and simulation."

**Qualifications**
PhD / Masters in Plasma Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Physics, Computational Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
7-10 years of relevant industry or research experience in plasma physics, arc physics, experimentation, and modeling and simulation.
  
  
**Skills**
"
  
  

* Strong depth in plasma physics, switching arcs, transport phenomena, arc interruption, and plasma-material interaction.
* Hands-on experience in plasma/arc experimentation, diagnostics, test planning, and validation with test data.
* Experience in developing complex simulation capabilities with advanced software development skills (e.g. C/C++, Python/Perl, F90).
* Proven expertise in CFD, FEM, heat transfer, electromagnetics, radiation, MHD, and coupled multiphysics simulation.
* Proficiency in ANSYS, COMSOL, OpenFOAM, or equivalent simulation tools.
* Ability to develop, verify, calibrate, correlate, validate, document, standardize, and deploy complex numerical models.
* Experience applying simulation to new or existing product-development projects, optimizing designs, and reducing test iterations, time, and cost.
* Experience with circuit breakers, switchgear, or other electrical products is an added advantage."

"
  
  

* Technology-roadmap development and execution
* Technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring of young engineers
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Collaboration across global and cross-functional teams
* Accountability, learning agility, and customer focus"

Integrate data from multiple on premise and cloud based systems, APIs, and third-party sources.

Build orchestration workflows in ADF, including pipelines, triggers, linked services, integration runtimes, and parameterized datasets.

Develop scalable transformation scripts using PySpark on Databricks, applying advanced optimizations like caching, partitioning, and Delta Lake capabilities.
  
  
Implement Delta Lake features—ACID transactions, schema enforcement, schema evolution, and time travel—across the data lifecycle.

description:

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. We are seeking a customer-focused
**Support Engineer**
who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this

, you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.
  
  
You will drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.
  
  
A key part of this role will also involve hands-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
  
  
**Location & Shift**

* Location: This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.

* Hours: Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM IST

* Incident & Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high-stakes escalations.
* Database & Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
