title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

**Position Overview**
At our company, we are leveraging analytics and technology, as we
*invent for life*

Market Access Insights and Forecasting (MAIF) is a global function encompassing long-range pharmaceutical asset forecasting across the product lifecycles of all assets within Human Health (Oncology, Vaccines, Hospital Specialty / Primary care). Assets include early and late-stage molecules in clinical development, companies under considerations by business development for partnering and/ or acquisition as well as currently launched products. Robust forecasting is a priority for businesses, as the product potential has major implications to a wide range of disciplines. While forecasting of realistic potential can be arrived through both qualitative and quantitative methods, the challenge lies in selecting and deploying the right methodology. Thus, it is essential to have someone who understands and aspires to implement advanced analytics techniques such as Monte Carlo simulations, agent-based modeling, conjoint frameworks, NLP, clustering etc. within forecasting vertical.

* Ability to manage ambiguous environments, and to adapt to changing needs of business

* Strong computer programming and software development experience, with specific experience in one or more of these languages: C++, C, or FORTRAN

description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a dynamic and strategic Development Team Manager to lead our Active Integration R&D team in Pune. title: Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Response
description:
**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join our GIS Team at Marsh. This role will be based in Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  

**Specialist - Cyber Security Incident Management**

**We will count on you to:**

* To oversee and manage the security posture of the organizations entire cloud environment across all regions globally.
* This critical role requires a deep understanding of cloud security principles, Cloud Service Provide (CSP) platforms, and the ability to leverage sophisticated cloud tooling to proactively identify, detect, assess, report vulnerabilities and threats.

**What you need to have:**

**Cloud Security Management**

1. Multi Cloud Expertise: Possess in depth knowledge of leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and their security best practices.

2. Develop and implement a comprehensive cloud security strategy aligned with industry standards and the organization’s risk tolerance.

3. Proactively access and harden cloud infrastructure configurations to minimize attack surface and potential vulnerabilities.

4. Identity and Access Management (IAM): Enforce and maintain granular IAM policies across all cloud environments to ensure least privilege access.

**Vulnerability Detection and Threat Response**

1. Perform continuous asset discovery to identify and track all cloud resources, including servers, databases, storage, network devices, etc.

2. Conduct regular, continuous, and adhoc vulnerability scanning to identify and prioritize security vulnerabilities and potential threats.

3. Monitor for emerging threats and zero day vulnerabilities utilizing threat detection and response program.

4. Identify and remediate misconfigurations that can lead to security breaches.

5. Container Security. Ensure the security of containerized workloads by scanning images for vulnerabilities and enforcing best practices.

6. Collaborate and lead remediation teams on plans for identified vulnerabilities, leveraging the security cloud vulnerability’s automation capabilities where applicable.

7.Prioritization of security patch management to ensure timely patching of security vulnerabilities in cloud infrastructure and applications based on vendor recommendation.

8. Generate regular reports on vulnerabilities, trends, remediation progress, and security cloud posture.

**Cloud Security VM Operations**

1. Standardization: Enforce established security policies and procedures across all cloud environments.

2. Compliance Management: Maintain compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, NYDFS, Privacy, etc.) and internal security policies.

3. Security Incident Response: Assist in IR investigations and remediation of cloud security incidents, leveraging the security cloud system’s vulnerability tool to analyze activities, logs, and identify root causes.

**Security Cloud System’s Vulnerability Tool**

1. Advance the tool’s configuration: Assessment of configurations policies, rules, and alerts to maximize its effectiveness in identifying and mitigating cloud vulnerabilities and security risks.

2. Analyze data generated by the tool to identify trends, patterns, and potential security issues.

3. Maintain and support custom automation workflows within the tool streamline remediations processes and improve efficiency.

4. Integrate the tool with broader security tools (SIEM, CMDB, SOAR, SOC, etc.) to create a comprehensive security informed program

5. Actively monitor the tool’s alerts and notifications, prioritizing critical security vulnerabilities and issues.

a. Alert triage and prioritization to accurately assess the severity and potential impact of alerts, assigning appropriate priority levels.

b. Ensure remediation management to create and manage remediation tasks to timely resolve identified vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.

c. Maintain SLA adherence to monitor and resolve alert response and remediation times.

d. Conduct thorough root cause analysis through investigations to determine the root cause of vulnerability remediation failures and implement alternative solutions.

e. Generate regular reporting and metrics on vulnerabilities and threats for alert trending and remediation effectiveness.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Security Cloud Tools: Assist with the evaluation and selection of vulnerability management tools that integrate seamlessly with various cloud environments and provide fine granular access controls and CMDB attributers such as asset ownership.
* Integration: Integrate the security cloud tools with other security tools and systems, including the SIEM solutions, change ticketing systems, etc
* Launch awareness campaigns to promote secure practices and vulnerability management, emphasizing the unique challenges of cloud environments.
* Collaborate with development, business CISOs, operations, and cloud teams to ensure effective vulnerability management practices throughout the SDLC, cloud, and production environments.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Sr. Consultant - SAP BTP Job
  
  
Date: Oct 16, 2026
  
  
Job Requisition Id: 66657
  
  
Location:
  
  
Bangalore, KA, IN
  
  
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire SAP BTP Professionals in the following areas :**
**Job Description:**
Project Delivery Manager (PDM)
  
  

* External Role: Project Delivery Manager – SAP BTP
* Function: BTP Demands & Projects Management
* Reporting To: Head of BTP Demands & Projects / BTP Portfolio Management

Role Purpose
  
  

* The Project Delivery Manager (PDM) is accountable for the end-to-end delivery of SAP BTP projects across the complete BTP Operating Model.
* The role ensures predictable, governed, and high-quality delivery of BTP demands by acting as the single point of accountability between:

+ Business
+ Sector IT
+ BTP CoE teams (Design, Development, Platform)
+ Architecture
+ Governance
+ Validation
+ AMS teams

* The standard project execution within the BTP is primarily Agile Scrum based. In specific cases, it may be a Waterfall approach as well.
* The role will be involved in both types of project execution and therefore needs to be flexible between the models.
* Depending on skills, assignments will be done. An Agile project will include the Scrum Master role as well.

Role Objectives
  
  
**The Project Delivery Manager Is Responsible To:**

* Ensure consistent execution of the BTP Operating Model.
* Own delivery from Demand Intake to Closure.
* Reduce delivery friction, escalations, and stakeholder dissatisfaction.
* Provide clear accountability and transparency to Business and IT leadership.
* Enable development and platform teams to focus on execution by removing coordination overhead.

Scope of Accountability
  
  
The Project Delivery Manager owns delivery across the entire BTP lifecycle:
  
  

* Requirements
* Feasibility
* Design
* Estimation
* Approvals
* Preparation
* Build
* Test
* KT
* Deploy
* Hypercare
* Closure

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Demand Intake & Requirement Management
  
  

* Act as the single BTP coordinator for assigned demands/projects.
* Drive and coordinate URS requirement workshops.
* Ensure requirement clarity, completeness, and formal sign-off.
* Prevent duplication of requirement discussions across teams.

Feasibility, Design & Estimation
  
  

* Coordinate feasibility assessments across:

+ BTP Design Team
+ Development teams
+ Platform & Integration teams
+ Architecture and Governance

* Plan and chair design workshops and design demos.
* Consolidate effort estimates, capacity, timelines, and cost inputs.
* Coordinate estimation outcomes and validate feasibility with stakeholders.

Governance, Approvals & Readiness
  
  

* Coordinate approvals with:

+ Business Leads
+ Sector IT
+ BTP IT Leadership

* Ensure governance, architecture, security, validation, and compliance readiness.
* Track dependencies, constraints, and approval milestones.
* Maintain delivery readiness before build start.

Build, Test & Deployment Control
  
  

* Own delivery control during build and test phases.
* Run weekly status and dependency calls.
* Track milestones, risks, issues, and mitigations.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies (Design, Dev, Platform, ERP, Non-ERP).
* Ensure test readiness, defect tracking, and deployment coordination.

KT, Hypercare & Closure
  
  

* Coordinate AMS knowledge transfer and hypercare.
* Ensure smooth transition from Project to Run.
* Drive formal project closure:

+ Deliverable confirmation
+ Lessons learned
+ Final reporting

Communication & Reporting
  
  

* Provide consistent status reporting to Business and IT leadership.
* Maintain delivery dashboards, risks, issues, and action trackers.
* Proactively escalate risks and decision points.
* Ensure leadership visibility across the BTP portfolio.

Meeting & Coordination Ownership
  
  

* The Project Delivery Manager is the owner and coordinator for all project lifecycle engagements, including but not limited to:

+ Intake & prioritization meetings
+ Requirement & design workshops
+ Feasibility & estimation discussions
+ Governance & approval forums
+ Weekly delivery reviews
+ Hypercare & AMS KT sessions

* The PDM ensures one coordinated engagement model, replacing fragmented, multi-team coordination.

Key Interfaces
  
  
**The Project Delivery Manager Works Closely With:**

* Business Requestors & Business Project Leads
* Sector IT Project Leads
* BTP Demands Team
* BTP Design Team
* BTP Development Teams
* BTP Platform Services Team
* BTP Integration Team
* ERP Workstreams
* Non-ERP & AppTech Team
* Architecture & Governance Teams
* GxP / Validation Teams
* AMS / Run Teams

What This Role Is NOT
  
  
**To Avoid Ambiguity, The Project Delivery Manager Role:**

* Is not limited to Jira task or dashboard management.
* Is not scoped only to development teams.
* Is not responsible for Agile coaching or ceremonies.
* Agile Masters remain methodology-specific roles for Agile-qualified initiatives.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
Core Skills
  
  

* Strong project delivery and governance expertise.
* Experience with Waterfall or Hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to manage complex, cross-team enterprise projects.
* Stakeholder management across Business and IT.
* Risk, dependency, and issue management.

Functional Knowledge
  
  

* SAP BTP landscape and services (high-level understanding).
* Enterprise integration environments (ERP, Non-ERP, ABAP).
* Governance, security, and validation driven IT environments.
* Demand and portfolio management concepts.

Organizational Skills
  
  

* Excellent planning and coordination capabilities.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills.
* Structured documentation and reporting approach.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Experience & Qualification
  
  

* 8–12 years of experience in IT Project / Delivery Management (enterprise context).
* Proven experience delivering cross-functional, governance-driven projects.
* Experience working with platform, architecture, and compliance teams.
* PMP / PRINCE2 / equivalent project management certification (preferred).

Success Measures (KPIs)
  
  

* On-time and in-scope delivery of BTP projects.
* Reduction in escalations and rework.
* Improved business satisfaction.
* Predictable milestone tracking and reporting.
* Consistent adherence to the BTP Operating Model.

Strategic Importance of the Role
  
  

* The Project Delivery Manager is a foundational role for scaling the SAP BTP Portfolio.
* It enables predictable delivery, improves stakeholder confidence, and ensures BTP projects are executed as enterprise initiatives, not ad-hoc development efforts.

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  
**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.
  
  
Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
  
  
**Title: Manager, Software Engineering**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a skilled Software Engineering Manager passionate about delivering exceptional software experiences and leading high-performing teams. As a key leader on the Digital Banking team, this individual will guide the development of features that enhance our clients’ customer experience, ensuring high-quality execution from concept through production. They will work closely with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, impactful solutions that align with business goals.
  
  
The Engineering Manager will lead by example—simplifying complex problems into scalable architectures, championing engineering best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In a fast-paced Agile environment, they will balance hands-on technical contributions with strategic leadership, empowering engineers to consistently deliver production-ready code. Ideal candidates are collaborative, solutions-focused, and committed to team development, mentoring others while driving technical excellence and operational efficiency.
  
  
Product Summary – Banking Foundations
  
  
The Banking Foundations Engineering team builds modern, consumer-facing digital experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and highly reliable. We focus on creating products that users interact with daily—prioritizing simplicity, performance, and seamless design.
  
  
Our engineers work on translating complex backend systems into clean, engaging, and responsive experiences across platforms. From enhancing usability to ensuring resilience at scale, the team plays a critical role in shaping how consumers engage with technology.
  
  
Banking Foundations Engineering brings together product thinking, engineering excellence, and user empathy to build experiences that are trusted, accessible, and future ready.
  
  
**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Define product technology strategy and vision
* Manage and prioritize technology roadmap and initiatives
* Own engineering key results and performance metrics

**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**

* Partner with Product Managers to develop a technology-aligned product vision and roadmap
* Participate in PI planning and agile ceremonies to provide technical insights for prioritization and delivery
* Identify technology enhancements, product gaps, and feature ideas to inform the roadmap
* Recommend strategic technology investments aligned with business goals and user needs
* Support product teams in translating complex business needs into user stories and technical solutions

**Product Design and Development**

* Oversee design, development, deployment, and maintenance of software solutions across product teams
* Establish and enforce technical standards, guidelines, and best practices for consistency and quality
* Collaborate with Architects and Engineering Managers to manage system dependencies and risks
* Participate in agile development events such as demos and reviews
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams with a focus on career development and innovation
* Foster an environment where engineers are encouraged to experiment and contribute new technical ideas
* Provide constructive feedback through code reviews to enhance technical value and quality

**Performance Measurement and Optimization**

* Monitor delivery and quality metrics at the product level to identify trends and drive technical improvements

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technology roles, with increasing responsibilities in engineering management
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant, cloud-based, high-transaction systems
* Experience in full-stack enterprise Java development, including React Web and Native
* Expertise in Scaled Agile (e.g., SAFe), Scrum, Lean quality, and test automation methodologies
* Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java), cloud technologies, and tools such as Jira
* Strategic technical thinker capable of developing and communicating a product-aligned technology roadmap
* Proven leadership skills to develop and manage cross-functional engineering teams
* Effective collaboration skills to support teams in problem-solving and decision-making
* Experience working with RTEs, STEs, and stakeholders to align and execute strategic themes
* Strong knowledge of continuous delivery and agile at scale practices
* Ability to serve as an Agile coach and advisor, promoting a self-directed and accountable team culture
* Balances technical oversight with empowering teams to innovate and own their solutions
* Drive automation.
* Leverage AI for efficiency and building new functional capability.

**Product Specific Qualifications / Skillsets**

* Experience in Digital banking, Payments and/or Cards domain
* Java, JEE, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Rest
* React, React Native
* Hibernate, JPA
* Postgres
* Redis
* GCP Cloud

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**
**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**
Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.
  
  
Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.
  
  
This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.
  
  
**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**
**What You'll Do**

* Understand the problem
* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up
* Build the business case
* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact
* Reimagine the solution on Celestara
* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome
* Deliver from UAT to production
* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hypercare and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts
* Own the use case after go-live
* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release
* Be the voice of the customer
* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.
  
  
**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.
  
  
**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.
  
  
**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:
  
  

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.
  
  
**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.
  
  
**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.
  
  
**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.
  
  
**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**
**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Engineering Manager - Ads & Mar Tech
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our software engineering team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role. You'll spend roughly half your time writing and shipping production code — React, modern JavaScript— alongside the team. The other half is people, process, and direction: growing engineers, making architectural calls, and keeping delivery on track.
  
  
You'll lead a team of Staff ReactJS/NodeJS Frontend Engineers, Senior Backend Engineers, and Senior Quality Engineers. We also expect you to be an active AI engineer — someone who uses tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot in daily work, not just someone who knows they exist.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership & Development:

+ Lead, mentor, and coach a team of software engineers (Frontend, and Backend) to foster their professional growth, career development, and technical capabilities.
+ Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback to team members.
+ Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-trust team environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
+ Participate in the recruitment and hiring process to attract top engineering talent.

* Technical & Architectural Guidance:

+ Make architectural decisions for both frontend (ReactJS, Node.js) and backend (Java, Node.js, distributed systems) components — and be the person the team comes to when those decisions get hard.
+ Work closely with Staff Engineers to define technical roadmaps and resolve complex technical challenges.
+ Guide the team on AI engineering practices: how to use agentic tools effectively, where they help and where they don't, and how to build systems that incorporate AI thoughtfully rather than just bolting it on.
+ Build alongside the team, not above it. When the team is using Claude Code, Cursor, or other agentic tools to ship features, you're in there with them — pairing, reviewing AI-generated code critically, and raising the bar on what good looks like in an AI-assisted workflow.
+ Hold the team to coding standards, quality metrics, and security practices across all deliverables.
+ Stay current with the team's stack: ReactJS, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and CI/CD pipelines.
+ Contribute directly to production features. About half your time is coding.

* Project Delivery & Execution:

+ Oversee the end-to-end delivery of features and projects, from planning and estimation to execution, testing, and deployment.
+ Collaborate with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate product requirements into actionable engineering plans.
+ Ensure efficient execution of Agile/Scrum processes, managing project risks and dependencies effectively.
+ Champion a strong quality mindset within the team, working closely with the Senior Quality Engineer to establish robust testing strategies and automation.

* Strategic Planning & Vision:

+ Contribute to the broader engineering strategy and technical vision for the organization.
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in web development, distributed systems, and quality assurance.
+ Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation, and innovation within the team's operations.

* Communication & Collaboration:

+ Serve as a key liaison between the engineering team and other departments, effectively communicating progress, challenges, and technical insights.
+ Drive cross-team collaboration and knowledge sharing to ensure alignment and leverage expertise across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, including at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role.
* Technical Acumen: Strong foundational knowledge and practical experience in modern web development technologies, including:

+ Frontend: Deep understanding of ReactJS, modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and related state management libraries.
+ Backend: Expertise in building scalable distributed systems using Java/J2EE (Spring Boot preferred) and/or Node.js.
+ Databases: Experience with relational (e.g., Oracle) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
+ APIs: Proficiency with RESTful and/or GraphQL API design and consumption.

* Quality Assurance Mindset: A strong understanding of software quality principles, test automation strategies (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress), and CI/CD pipelines, with a commitment to delivering high-quality software.
* System Design: Experience in designing and architecting highly scalable, performant, and resilient web applications and services.
* Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Agile Methodologies: Demonstrated experience leading teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Leadership & Mentorship: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow engineering teams. Strong communication skills, written and verbal.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical and decision-making ability in complex technical and organizational situations.
* AI Engineering: Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in real production work. You should have opinions on how these tools change the way code gets written and reviewed — not just awareness that they exist.
* Hands-on React and JavaScript: You must be comfortable shipping React and modern JavaScript to production. This is not a role where frontend experience is optional.
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a high-growth or startup environment.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures.
* Knowledge of performance optimization for large-scale web applications.
* Experience with spec-driven development frameworks such as GitHub SpecKit, SuperPower, GSD, or similar. We use these workflows to keep AI-assisted development structured and reviewable.

**Additional Details**
eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
  
  
We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

title: Principal/Lead Consultant – Program Director
description:
Project Management: Experience in agile methodologies, have led as Project Manager, Product Owner and Scrum Master roles within SAFe projects and helped build Agile Ways of working transformation programs for client IT organizations. Proven ability to lead teams and be committed to mentor junior consultants. Should be able to collaborate and work across client teams, vendor, stakeholders etc. At least one recognized project management certification (e.g., PMI-PMP, SAFe, PRINCE2, CAPM, CSM). Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Power-point, Excel and PM Tools like Jira, Clarizen, Clarity, Change-point, Planview etc.
  
  

* Be responsible for driving complex engagements for large-medium-small sized companies across the globe.
* Drive Project Management tracks and pursuits with focus on Digital offerings, Digital transformation Roadmap & Digital Innovation methodologies.
* Lead and deliver engagement focused on transformation management office and Agile work methodologies.

**About The Role**
As a Staff AI Quality Engineer for the Qira AI Platform, you will lead the technical test strategy and architectural validation for Lenovo’s cross-device agentic AI ecosystem. You will serve as the technical authority on evaluating non-deterministic systems, designing automated quality platforms that operate across personal computing form factors (PCs, tablets, and smartphones). You will drive non-functional quality standards—ensuring that privacy, security, accessibility, internationalization, and device thermals/battery efficiency are safeguarded—while acting as a crucial release partner alongside Product Management and PMO leads.
  
  
What Will You Do
  
  

* Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness.

* Hardware Runtime Resource Profiling: Formulate automated performance and endurance soak suites to benchmark on-device SLM execution against cloud fallback paths, monitoring thermal throttling, memory leaks, and battery draw across hardware device tiers.
* Non-Functional Quality Standards: Lead automated verification across non-functional pillars: red-teaming indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities, securing inter-process data barriers, standardizing automated accessibility (screen-reader verbosity, dynamic token streaming), and validating semantic fidelity across international locales.
* CI/CD Quality Pipelines Gating: Drive the technical implementation of shift-left gating in continuous integration pipelines, establishing automated failure analytics, regression detection, and flakiness isolation frameworks.
* Cross-Functional Peer Leadership: Serve as a core technical gatekeeper alongside Product Management and PMO; establish release acceptance criteria, lead data-informed risk assessments during schedule compressions, and influence platform design for enhanced testability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

* 3+ years of experience leading quality strategy and automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic AI workflows, or conversational platforms.
* Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons.
* Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation.
* Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on expertise implementing and tuning non-deterministic evaluation platforms (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, TruLens) in production pipelines.
* Direct experience testing local NPU runtimes and quantized models (INT4/INT8 vs. FP16) on client silicon (Qualcomm, Intel, AMD).
* Background designing automated testing for multimodal inputs (synchronized voice injection, screen-capture parsing, synthetic system events).
* Demonstrated ability to resolve complex release-gating disputes with Product Management and PMO using objective risk metrics and clear mitigation trade-offs.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Python Testing)
description:
**Software Development Engineer Test Engineer (Python Testing)**

**Experience: 9-12yrs**

**Location: Bangalore**

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Automation Architecture & Hands-On Engineering

○ Architect, scale, and maintain a modular, zero-flake E2E, API, and integration automation framework built on Python 3.10+ (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright.

○ Build resilient Playwright automation for complex stateful browser interactions, including interactive canvas and node-graph workflow editors, real-time token-streaming chat interfaces (SSE and WebSockets), multi-tab and multi-user RBAC sessions, Shadow DOM elements, and network route interception and mocking.

○ Treat test infrastructure as production software by enforcing strict static typing (mypy), fast linting (ruff), strict schema validation (Pydantic), clean design patterns (Page Object, Screenplay, and Fixture factories), and rigorous pull-request code reviews.

2. Full-Stack Platform, Data & GenAI Quality

○ Validate REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, including optimistic concurrency and locking, idempotency, rate limiting, and asynchronous background workflows.

○ Build automated validation pipelines across heterogeneous data backends, verifying SQL query generation, semantic metric calculations, enterprise ontology graph traversals, cloud object storage ingestion, and vector similarity search retrieval.

○ Partner with AI Engineers to operationalize automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge, and golden dataset benchmarks) measuring hallucination rates, groundedness, context recall, tool-call accuracy, Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), and token/cost regressions.

3. CI/CD Release Governance, Performance & Security

○ Orchestrate containerized, parallelized (pytest-xdist and Playwright sharding) smoke, contract, and regression suites inside CI/CD pipelines with sub-15-minute PR feedback loops and automated QA to UAT to Production promotion gates.

○ Drive performance, concurrency, load, and fault-injection testing (Locust and k6) to validate high-throughput agent executions, concurrent workflow graphs, and graceful degradation during upstream LLM or database throttling.

○ Validate enterprise security boundaries including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML/SSO, RBAC/ABAC permissions, multi-tenant data isolation, and OWASP Top 10 risks for both Web and LLM Applications (prompt injection, PII leakage, and excessive agency).

○

4. Engineering Leadership & Operational Excellence

○ Recruit, mentor, and upskill top-tier SDETs, coaching engineers from script-level testing into modern software engineering and system-level architectural thinking.

○ Partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and SRE leaders during design reviews to enforce shift-left testability and observability from day one.

○ Own platform quality SLAs and executive reporting, driving measurable improvements in Defect Escape Rate (DER), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Automation Stability (>99% non-flaky pass rate), and Release Lead Time.

**COMPLETE TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE**

Should bring deep hands-on mastery of our core automation stack and strong working fluency across our broader platform ecosystem:

○ Core Languages & Tooling: Python 3.10+ (asyncio, typing, uv, Poetry, ruff, mypy), TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+, Node.js), SQL (ANSI SQL, CTEs, analytical queries), Bash / Zsh.

○ UI & Browser Automation: Microsoft Playwright (Python and TypeScript bindings, BrowserContexts, storageState authentication reuse, Trace Viewer, HAR replay, Network Interception, Canvas and Visual Regression), Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Axe-core (WCAG accessibility testing).

○ Python Testing Ecosystem: pytest, pytest-xdist (parallel sharding), pytest-asyncio, Pydantic v2, httpx, aiohttp, requests, Hypothesis and Faker (property-based and synthetic test data generation).

○ API, Streaming & Contract Testing: REST (OpenAPI 3.x), GraphQL, gRPC / Protobuf, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Schemathesis, Pact, WireMock.

○ AI, LLM & Agent Evaluation: DeepEval, RAGAS, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines, Golden Dataset curation, RAG retrieval metrics (precision, recall, faithfulness, groundedness), deterministic NLP metrics (F1, Exact Match), prompt and model regression harnesses.

○ Databases, Vector & Storage Systems: PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), Vector Databases (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph and Ontology Stores (Property Graphs, RDF), Redis, Cloud Object Storage (Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Azure Blob).

○ Asynchronous & Event Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery (testing distributed task queues, retries, dead-letter queues, and eventual consistency).

○ Performance, Load & Resilience: Locust (Python-native distributed load testing), k6, API and LLM latency profiling (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/second), fault and latency injection.

○ CI/CD, Cloud & Containers: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (K8s), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GCP / AWS / Azure.

○ Test Reporting & Observability: Allure Report, ReportPortal, TestRail / Xray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Langfuse / Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing and diagnostics).

○ Security & Identity: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML / SSO, JWT, Multi-tenant RBAC / ABAC, OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 for Web and LLM Applications.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

○ 9+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering in Test (SDET) or Quality Engineering, including 3+ years directly managing, mentoring, and scaling SDET teams on complex SaaS, cloud, data, or AI platforms.

○ Expert-level proficiency designing production-grade Python (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright automation frameworks from scratch, including custom fixtures, parallel execution runners, dynamic state handling, and anti-flake architecture.

○ Strong experience testing distributed microservices, stateful workflows, real-time streaming APIs, and relational and non-relational data layers.

○ Proven track record embedding containerized automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to gate multi-environment enterprise releases without slowing developer velocity.

○ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• Direct experience building automated evaluation and regression pipelines for LLM Agents, RAG architectures, Semantic Layers, or Workflow Orchestration platforms.

• Hands-on experience automating visual canvas or DAG builders (such as React Flow, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL interfaces) and MCP-based tool integrations.

• Prior experience building internal developer productivity tools, synthetic test-data platforms, or ephemeral preview test environments on Kubernetes.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
WFM Capacity Planner

**DEPARTMENT : Workforce Management**

**EMPLOYMENT : Full-time**

**REPORTS TO : Assistant Manager/Lead WFM**

**Position Summary**

The WFM Capacity Planner converts demand forecasts into practical, financially responsible workforce plans across programs, sites, channels, and skill groups. The role owns long-range and medium-range capacity views, headcount requirements, hiring and training demand, attrition and shrinkage assumptions, staffing-risk scenarios, and executive-ready recommendations.

The successful candidate connects Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Human Resources, and WFM so that hiring and workforce actions are initiated early enough to protect client service commitments, employee readiness, and cost targets.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**Maintain a clear view of future workforce demand and supply, quantify risks early, and recommend the right staffing action at the right time.**

Key Responsibilities

Capacity planning and modeling

* Build rolling capacity plans by program, site, channel, skill, and planning horizon.
* Translate volume, AHT or productivity, SLA, backlog, shrinkage, occupancy, and hours of operation into required FTE and headcount.
* Maintain base, upside, downside, and contingency scenarios with transparent assumptions.

Hiring and training demand

* Calculate weekly and monthly hiring needs, class timing, training capacity, nesting, learning curves, hiring yield, and production-readiness dates.
* Track approved demand against recruiting supply, training graduation, deployment, and productive headcount.
* Identify the decision deadlines required to prevent staffing gaps.

Headcount supply and staffing risk

* Reconcile rostered, budgeted, scheduled, and productive headcount with approved positions.
* Incorporate attrition, absenteeism, leave, internal movement, shrinkage, training, and productivity ramp into supply plans.
* Quantify surpluses and deficits and recommend hiring, overtime, redeployment, cross-skilling, schedule changes, or other mitigations.

Scenario and sensitivity analysis

* Model changes in demand, AHT, productivity, service targets, channel mix, automation, site allocation, shrinkage, attrition, and hiring performance.
* Explain the FTE, cost, service, and timing implications of each scenario.
* Present a recommended option, alternatives, risks, assumptions, and decision dates.

Financial and stakeholder governance

* Connect capacity decisions to labor cost, overtime, contractors, idle capacity, recruitment, training, transitions, and budget outlook.
* Lead recurring capacity reviews with Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, HR, and WFM.
* Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and unresolved assumptions; escalate missed lead times promptly.

Planning quality and continuous improvement

* Maintain version control, assumption logs, model documentation, data-quality checks, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
* Automate recurring reporting and reduce spreadsheet risk through Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Python, or approved tools.
* Protect confidential workforce and financial data and follow contractual, policy, and labor requirements.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in Workforce Management, capacity planning, workforce planning, forecasting, financial planning, or resource planning in a contact-center, BPO, shared-services, or operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to convert demand forecasts into FTE, headcount, hiring, training, and cost plans across multiple time horizons.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including structured models, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, scenario analysis, data validation, and executive-ready outputs.
* Strong knowledge of contact-center and back-office metrics, including volume, AHT, productivity, shrinkage, occupancy, attrition, service level, backlog, utilization, schedule efficiency, and cost per FTE or transaction.
* Experience with a WFM platform such as NICE IEX, Verint, Alvaria / Aspect, Genesys WFM, Calabrio, or an equivalent planning solution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain assumptions, trade-offs, financial impact, and workforce risk to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work with incomplete data while documenting limitations, confidence levels, and improvement actions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting multi-site, multi-skill, multilingual, omnichannel, or global operations.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other analytics and visualization technologies.
* Understanding of Erlang-based staffing, simulation, backlog planning, deferred-work capacity, and skills-based routing.
* Experience partnering directly with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Operations, and client-facing leadership.
* Recognized WFM, analytics, finance, Lean, or Six Sigma certification.

How Success Will Be Measured

**KPI**

**CADENCE**

**Capacity-plan accuracy**

FTE and HC reconcile to approved demand, productivity, shrinkage, and service objectives.

Monthly / quarterly

**Hiring-plan attainment**

Classes, training capacity, yield, and production-ready dates are tracked against plan.

Weekly / monthly

**Staffing-gap control**

Material deficits and surpluses are identified early, quantified, assigned, and escalated.

Weekly

**Plan-versus-actual variance**

HC, attrition, shrinkage, productivity, and cost variances include root cause and action.

Monthly

**Scenario quality**

Scenarios are complete, traceable, timely, and explain assumptions and trade-offs.

As required

**Governance quality**

Models are controlled, documented, reproducible, accurate, and delivered on schedule.

**Monthly**

What a Strong Candidate Demonstrates

* Clearly distinguishes demand, workload, required FTE, scheduled FTE, productive headcount, rostered headcount, and budgeted headcount.
* Builds transparent models with an auditable assumption chain rather than unexplained or hard-coded outputs.
* Understands that hiring plans must include lead time, hiring yield, training capacity, graduation, nesting, attrition, shrinkage, and productivity ramp.
* Challenges unrealistic assumptions constructively and quantifies the cost, service, and timing consequences.
* Communicates one recommendation, viable alternatives, key risks, owners, and decision deadlines in a concise executive format.

**READY TO SHAPE THE FUTURE WORKFORCE?**

Apply through the official Movate careers channel. Candidates may be asked to complete a capacity-planning case study as part of the selection process.

It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
  
  
Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
  
  
Context
  
  
SYSTRA India is growing its Transport Modelling team to primarily cater to the Global Transport Modelling Demand (Including UK/Ireland, Middle East, Australia). We are inviting applicants for Transport Planner – Strategic Modelling (Various grades) preferably for Bangalore Location (remote/hybrid working could also be considered)
  
  
The ideal candidate will be able to demonstrate a range of experience within the Civil Engineering/ Transportation/ Infrastructure sectors. This is a great opportunity for enthusiastic Transport Planners to further their career in a highly motivated and inspirational environment.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Development and calibration/validation of transport models
* Undertake analysis of model results
* Learn new techniques and software packages
* Preparing technical reports

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Master’s degree level qualification or above in relevant subject (e.g., Transport Planning/Engineering or Civil Engineering)
* We will accept candidates between 5-10 years of relevant experience. Candidates with slightly higher experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Experience in Transport Modelling Software (e.g. SATURN, CUBE, VISUM, EMME)
* Some familiarity with UK transport modelling guidance (e.g. TAG)
* Knowledge of Economic Appraisal using TUBA, COBALT, QUADRO
* Data analysis (including spreadsheets and databases) and problem-solving
* Experienced in using Python, R, Visual Basic for Applications, or similar, to aid analysis and processing of data
* Knowledgeable user of data analytics and mapping tools (GIS) and ability to interpret quantitative transport models
* Reporting of model results
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience in helping mentor more junior colleagues.

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure.It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: Manager, Payments Pricing
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
  
  
**Payments Pricing Team:**
The Toast Payments Pricing team plays a pivotal role in the financial success of Toast by determining competitive and transparent payments pricing strategies for our largest customers. Collaborating closely with sales, product and finance, the team is responsible for ensuring decisions align with overall business objectives and provides data-driven insights to refine Toast’s pricing strategy in a constantly evolving landscape. The Payments Pricing Manager will help scale and manage the Payments Pricing team. Responsibilities include strategic deal pricing and consulting, sales enablement, key initiative execution, team management and process improvement
  
  
**A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)**

* Lead and manage day to day activities in Payments Pricing including analysis pipeline and escalations
* Be the key point of contact for Payments Pricing local functions in the region
* Coach and mentor a team of Payments Pricing Analysts, responsible for payments analysis, operations and ad hoc project support
* Develop and collaborate in the creation of performance metric dashboards for team
* Identify and propose process improvement opportunities, with a focus on AI and automation, and participate in department process efficiency efforts
* Deliver a best-in-class payments experience to Toast customers and prospects through successful communication and maintain SLAs accountability
* Become a subject matter expert regarding Toast’s payment solutions, deeply understand the payments value proposition, and how Toast Payments specifically meets business needs
* Understand all of Toast Payments’s processes and procedures; constantly improving upon them to gain greater efficiency and accuracy
* Report and analyze on our customer base to identify trends and help drive future recommendations
* Serve as an escalation point as needed
* Collaborate as needed across all levels of the Fintech organization by developing an understanding of Toast’s business model, company goals, and internal processes

**What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)**

* Bachelor's Degree, 5+ years of experience in Financial Services, Business Operations, Analytics, Consulting, or similar experience
* 3+ years of people management experience
* Deep financial and analytical capabilities; Advanced Excel skills
* Metric driven and operationally minded
* Comfortable working with SQL/Snowflake/Excel/G-Suite/data visualization tools
* Prior experience mentoring/training junior employees; leading or managing a team is strongly preferred
* Strong leadership, organizational, decision making, and communication skills
* Strong process and change management skills

**What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)**

* Experience working in the payments or FinTech industry, and/or POS solutions

**AI at Toast**
At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
  
  
**Our Total Rewards Philosophy**
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.
  
  
**How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process**
Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring
  
  
**Our Approach to Hybrid Working**
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast
  
  
**People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success**
At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

title: FP&A Manager
description:
Founded in 2003, GAIN Credit is a tech-forward, inclusive, and responsible business using world-class innovative technology and data science to provide endless gaining opportunities for customers, employees, and merchants alike. At GAIN Credit, our mission is to empower lives, which is about providing solutions that meet the credit needs of society in an affordable and responsible manner, ensuring that we always treat customers fairly, helping our customers when they need it most by providing access to credit and giving them realistic timelines to re-pay.

Our flagship brands – Lending Stream & Drafty – enjoy 4.4 & 4.3 ratings on TrustPilot respectively (UK’s leading customer review website). Drafty – our pioneering credit-line product – is a first-of-its-kind, no-fee credit line and has been awarded ‘Innovation of the Year’ for 2017 and 2018 by the Consumer Credit Awards. In India, we are among the top 55 Great places to work. People at GAIN Credit – ‘GAINers’ as we call them – are our assets. We believe happy people lead to happy customers. And this is why a great work culture is a super high priority at GAIN Credit. We make that happen through living our company values in every interaction we have with each other. In fact, we believe the only way to ‘gain’ at GAIN Credit is through living our company values.

**To know more about us:**

Website: www.gaincredit.com

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gaincredit/mycompany/

**Is this the place for you?**

As a GAINer, you will get to focus on your personal and professional gains, experience an award-winning workplace culture, access to perks, maintain work-life balance, and contribute to the community in meaningful ways. As a GAINer, integrity will guide everything you do, with a service mindset that puts others first. You will foster curiosity to drive learning, focus on continuous improvement, and take accountability for your actions to deliver exceptional outcomes.

**We strongly believe in:**

At GAIN Credit, we believe that our fantastic teams help build the best products that enable us to understand and attract more customers. Therefore, we completely support and welcome diversity across thoughts, people, and actions. We care about our employees, and their well-being and have many on-going activities to boost their physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. We encourage people from diverse backgrounds, culture, age, gender, orientation, and abilities to apply for all our openings and offer reasonable support to achieve their professional goals.

**Our core strength:**

We are at the core, an analytics company, founded by people who, about 30 years ago, were pioneers in applying predictive modelling to solve business problems. As we morphed into a financial services company from being an analytics consultant, we continued to train our scientists to apply these techniques, as well as cutting-edge advances, and become a transformative leader in credit underwriting in the UK.

**Work Location**
– Chennai, India

**Role type**
– Full-time

**Office presence**
– contracted for up to 5 days per week in office; current requirement
**is**
2-3 days per week

**Role Purpose**

The FP&A Manager is responsible for the accuracy and quality of everything the FP&A team produces. You'll review and collate the work of analysts, check that the numbers are right, and synthesize them into clear, meaningful insight. You'll directly own the areas that don't warrant a dedicated analyst and act as steward of the planning and forecast models the team relies on.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-line review and challenge of all analyst output before it goes further
* Check that figures reconcile, tie across outputs, and are consistent with source systems
* Interrogate the reasoning behind an analyst's conclusion, not only the arithmetic
* Ensure assumptions and definitions are explicit and consistently applied
* Escalate issues, data problems, and emerging risks promptly
* Consolidate analyst output into a coherent view of performance across products and entities
* Turn analysis into insight: articulate what has moved, why, what it means, and what should be considered
* Prepare the monthly performance and forecast position for the Head of FP&A with commentary that stands alone
* Identify the two or three things that matter each month and give them prominence
* Own operating expenditure and headcount analysis, including budget versus actual reporting
* Own cashflow forecasting, funding-related analysis, and balance sheet forecasting
* Run the budget and rolling forecast cycle to timetable
* Act as owner of planning and forecast models, maintaining documentation, version control, and audit trail
* Lead and develop FP&A analysts, setting clear outcomes, priorities, and deadlines
* Identify and implement automation opportunities across recurring FP&A work

**Skills and Capabilities**

* FPAC, FMVA (or equivalent)
* Demonstrable experience reviewing and challenging the work of others, with accountability for its accuracy
* Ability to synthesize detailed analysis into a clear, concise view for a senior audience
* Experience owning a budget and forecast cycle, or a substantial part of one
* Strong financial modelling skills, sufficient to interrogate and maintain models rather than only operate them
* Demonstrable experience using AI to improve processes and output
* Methodical approach with high standards of accuracy
* Sound judgment about what matters; confidence to leave out what does not
* An instinct for when a number looks wrong, with persistence to find out why
* Ability to write clearly and concisely, explaining a movement without restating the workings
* Comfortable being challenged on the team's work and your own
* Ability to develop others rather than absorbing work yourself
* Clear communicator across time zones; confident raising an issue early
* Desirable: experience in lending, consumer credit, or financial services; line management of analysts; Python, SQL, or planning tooling beyond Excel; Power BI, Tableau, or comparable visualization tools; NetSuite or comparable ERP; support of external audit and complex information requests

**What Success Looks Like**

* You understand the planning and forecast models, the product and entity P&Ls, and the source systems the numbers come from. You've met the accounting and MI teams and agreed how actuals, accruals, and portfolio data reach FP&A.
* You own operating expenditure and headcount analysis with budget versus actual reporting and commentary. You've established the review routine — nothing leaves FP&A without a first-line check and a stated view attached. You've run one full monthly cycle, reconciled and synthesized before it reaches the Head of FP&A.
* You run the rolling forecast cycle to timetable with a light-touch review from the Head of FP&A. The planning and forecast models are documented, version controlled, and under a clear audit trail. You have an agreed automation plan for recurring FP&A work with the first change delivered. You own cashflow forecasting, funding-related analysis, and balance sheet forecasting with an independent view of forecast accuracy.
