The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Location:**
DGS India - Chennai - Anna Nagar Tyche Towers
  
  
**Brand:**
Paragon
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Permanent

title: ENGINEER - CMDB DATA QUALITY
description:
Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
  
  
GCL: C1/C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
  
  
In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
  
  
From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
  
  
CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
  
  
Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
  
  
Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
  
  
CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
  
  
Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.
  
  
Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.
  
  
Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data / Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, IT asset or configuration management, technology operations, data quality or technology data analysis.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
* Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
* Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing operational reports and dashboards.
* Ability to collaborate across technology teams, drive stakeholder remediation and manage competing priorities independently.
* Clear written and verbal communication and documentation skills.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with CMDB 360, ServiceNow Data Manager, Certification and Predictive Intelligence.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, and IRE and reconciliation.
* SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
* Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
This role supports the technical solution design for Operational Transfer Pricing and other Tax capabilities or part of a cross functional component. title: Assistant Manager
description:
WFM Capacity Planner

**DEPARTMENT : Workforce Management**

**EMPLOYMENT : Full-time**

**REPORTS TO : Assistant Manager/Lead WFM**

**Position Summary**

The WFM Capacity Planner converts demand forecasts into practical, financially responsible workforce plans across programs, sites, channels, and skill groups. The role owns long-range and medium-range capacity views, headcount requirements, hiring and training demand, attrition and shrinkage assumptions, staffing-risk scenarios, and executive-ready recommendations.

The successful candidate connects Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Human Resources, and WFM so that hiring and workforce actions are initiated early enough to protect client service commitments, employee readiness, and cost targets.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

**Maintain a clear view of future workforce demand and supply, quantify risks early, and recommend the right staffing action at the right time.**

Key Responsibilities

Capacity planning and modeling

* Build rolling capacity plans by program, site, channel, skill, and planning horizon.
* Translate volume, AHT or productivity, SLA, backlog, shrinkage, occupancy, and hours of operation into required FTE and headcount.
* Maintain base, upside, downside, and contingency scenarios with transparent assumptions.

Hiring and training demand

* Calculate weekly and monthly hiring needs, class timing, training capacity, nesting, learning curves, hiring yield, and production-readiness dates.
* Track approved demand against recruiting supply, training graduation, deployment, and productive headcount.
* Identify the decision deadlines required to prevent staffing gaps.

Headcount supply and staffing risk

* Reconcile rostered, budgeted, scheduled, and productive headcount with approved positions.
* Incorporate attrition, absenteeism, leave, internal movement, shrinkage, training, and productivity ramp into supply plans.
* Quantify surpluses and deficits and recommend hiring, overtime, redeployment, cross-skilling, schedule changes, or other mitigations.

Scenario and sensitivity analysis

* Model changes in demand, AHT, productivity, service targets, channel mix, automation, site allocation, shrinkage, attrition, and hiring performance.
* Explain the FTE, cost, service, and timing implications of each scenario.
* Present a recommended option, alternatives, risks, assumptions, and decision dates.

Financial and stakeholder governance

* Connect capacity decisions to labor cost, overtime, contractors, idle capacity, recruitment, training, transitions, and budget outlook.
* Lead recurring capacity reviews with Operations, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, HR, and WFM.
* Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, and unresolved assumptions; escalate missed lead times promptly.

Planning quality and continuous improvement

* Maintain version control, assumption logs, model documentation, data-quality checks, and plan-versus-actual analysis.
* Automate recurring reporting and reduce spreadsheet risk through Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Python, or approved tools.
* Protect confidential workforce and financial data and follow contractual, policy, and labor requirements.

Required Qualifications

* At least 3 years of experience in Workforce Management, capacity planning, workforce planning, forecasting, financial planning, or resource planning in a contact-center, BPO, shared-services, or operational environment.
* Demonstrated ability to convert demand forecasts into FTE, headcount, hiring, training, and cost plans across multiple time horizons.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including structured models, PivotTables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, scenario analysis, data validation, and executive-ready outputs.
* Strong knowledge of contact-center and back-office metrics, including volume, AHT, productivity, shrinkage, occupancy, attrition, service level, backlog, utilization, schedule efficiency, and cost per FTE or transaction.
* Experience with a WFM platform such as NICE IEX, Verint, Alvaria / Aspect, Genesys WFM, Calabrio, or an equivalent planning solution.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to explain assumptions, trade-offs, financial impact, and workforce risk to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work with incomplete data while documenting limitations, confidence levels, and improvement actions.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting multi-site, multi-skill, multilingual, omnichannel, or global operations.
* Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, or other analytics and visualization technologies.
* Understanding of Erlang-based staffing, simulation, backlog planning, deferred-work capacity, and skills-based routing.
* Experience partnering directly with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Training, Operations, and client-facing leadership.
* Recognized WFM, analytics, finance, Lean, or Six Sigma certification.

How Success Will Be Measured

**KPI**

**CADENCE**

**Capacity-plan accuracy**

FTE and HC reconcile to approved demand, productivity, shrinkage, and service objectives.

Monthly / quarterly

**Hiring-plan attainment**

Classes, training capacity, yield, and production-ready dates are tracked against plan.

Weekly / monthly

**Staffing-gap control**

Material deficits and surpluses are identified early, quantified, assigned, and escalated.

Weekly

**Plan-versus-actual variance**

HC, attrition, shrinkage, productivity, and cost variances include root cause and action.

Monthly

**Scenario quality**

Scenarios are complete, traceable, timely, and explain assumptions and trade-offs.

As required

**Governance quality**

Models are controlled, documented, reproducible, accurate, and delivered on schedule.

**Monthly**

What a Strong Candidate Demonstrates

* Clearly distinguishes demand, workload, required FTE, scheduled FTE, productive headcount, rostered headcount, and budgeted headcount.
* Builds transparent models with an auditable assumption chain rather than unexplained or hard-coded outputs.
* Understands that hiring plans must include lead time, hiring yield, training capacity, graduation, nesting, attrition, shrinkage, and productivity ramp.
* Challenges unrealistic assumptions constructively and quantifies the cost, service, and timing consequences.
* Communicates one recommendation, viable alternatives, key risks, owners, and decision deadlines in a concise executive format.

**READY TO SHAPE THE FUTURE WORKFORCE?**

Apply through the official Movate careers channel. Candidates may be asked to complete a capacity-planning case study as part of the selection process.

* Own operating expenditure and headcount analysis, including budget versus actual reporting
* Own cashflow forecasting, funding-related analysis, and balance sheet forecasting

**Skills and Capabilities**

* FPAC, FMVA (or equivalent)
* Demonstrable experience reviewing and challenging the work of others, with accountability for its accuracy
* Ability to synthesize detailed analysis into a clear, concise view for a senior audience
* Experience owning a budget and forecast cycle, or a substantial part of one
* Strong financial modelling skills, sufficient to interrogate and maintain models rather than only operate them
* Demonstrable experience using AI to improve processes and output
* Methodical approach with high standards of accuracy
* Sound judgment about what matters; confidence to leave out what does not
* An instinct for when a number looks wrong, with persistence to find out why
* Ability to write clearly and concisely, explaining a movement without restating the workings
* Comfortable being challenged on the team's work and your own
* Ability to develop others rather than absorbing work yourself
* Clear communicator across time zones; confident raising an issue early
* Desirable: experience in lending, consumer credit, or financial services; line management of analysts; Python, SQL, or planning tooling beyond Excel; Power BI, Tableau, or comparable visualization tools; NetSuite or comparable ERP; support of external audit and complex information requests

**What Success Looks Like**

* You understand the planning and forecast models, the product and entity P&Ls, and the source systems the numbers come from. You've met the accounting and MI teams and agreed how actuals, accruals, and portfolio data reach FP&A.
* You own operating expenditure and headcount analysis with budget versus actual reporting and commentary. You've established the review routine — nothing leaves FP&A without a first-line check and a stated view attached. You've run one full monthly cycle, reconciled and synthesized before it reaches the Head of FP&A.
* You run the rolling forecast cycle to timetable with a light-touch review from the Head of FP&A. The planning and forecast models are documented, version controlled, and under a clear audit trail. You have an agreed automation plan for recurring FP&A work with the first change delivered. You own cashflow forecasting, funding-related analysis, and balance sheet forecasting with an independent view of forecast accuracy.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Process Simulation Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Process Simulations Engineer designs and maintains quantitative models to forecast business outcomes and stress-test strategic scenarios across GE Vernova's Greenfield and Brownfield capital projects.
  
  
This role builds high-fidelity simulations of supply chains, operational workflows, and market shifts; uses them to quantify risk and project the impact of variables such as resource constraints, policy changes, or demand fluctuations; and translates simulation outputs into clear, objective recommendations that inform capital allocation and lean/continuous improvement decisions.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Model Architecture:**
Develop high-fidelity simulations replicating complex business environments (supply chains, operational workflows, market/demand shifts) grounded in a detailed understanding of current-state (as-is) operations
  
  
**Scenario Analysis**
Use models to stress-test initiatives, quantify risk, and project the impact of variables like resource constraints, OEE drift, or economic fluctuations.
  
  
**Translating Insights**

* Convert raw, stochastic simulation outputs into clear, objective, decision-ready recommendations for executives and program leadership.
* Support the lean transformation roadmap by validating process and capacity scenarios ahead of investment decisions
* Build high-value business cases for capital investment (headcount, layout, capacity) grounded in simulation-validated data
* Support Kaizens and continuous improvement projects with scenario modeling, what-if analysis, and efficiency recommendations
* Validate and refine models iteratively against real production data to maintain accuracy over time.

**Education**
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
  
  
**Requirement**

* 3+ years of experience in manufacturing operations, supply chain, or lean/operations excellence roles.
* Working knowledge of lean manufacturing principles (VSM, takt time, line balancing, standard work)
* Hands-on experience with DES or business/process simulation tools (e.g., AnyLogic, FlexSim, Arena, Simio)
* Experience with data cleaning and statistical analysis such as t-testing, ANOVA, and regression.
* Have basic knowledge on Java program.
* Demonstrated ability to translate operational data into quantitative models and back into business recommendations
* Experience supporting Greenfield site design, Brownfield capacity/efficiency projects, or automation business-case validation
* Strong data analysis skills to convert production/operational data into model inputs
* Ability to communicate complex, stochastic simulation results simply and objectively to non-technical/executive stakeholders
* Comfort working directly with plant/site teams to gather ground-truth process data
* Intellectual curiosity and a builder's mindset; energized by creating new modeling approaches and simulation capabilities in a function that is still taking shape, rather than following an established playbook

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About the Role:**
-------------------

As a Business Data Analyst, you turn data into actionable answers that drive operational and tactical business decisions. You split your time between answering ad-hoc analytical questions, qualifying and delivering data requests, and providing analytical support for ongoing business projects.

You act as a trusted analytical partner to business stakeholders understanding the core problem behind their questions, ensuring existing reporting tools are utilized before pulling raw datasets, leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate delivery, and translating complex data into clear, practical insights.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* **Business Problem Framing:** Meet with stakeholders to clarify requirements, challenge baseline assumptions, and translate broad business questions into structured analytical tasks.
* **Ad-Hoc & Diagnostic Analysis:** Independently run exploratory and deep-dive analyses on operational data to uncover patterns, identify root causes, and explain the "why" behind business performance trends.
* **Project Analytics Support:** Deliver data analyses, establish baseline metrics, and track progress for cross-functional initiatives and business projects.
* **Data Request** Gatekeeping & Qualification: Critically evaluate incoming requests for data extracts. Determine whether the business question can already be answered via existing Tableau dashboards or standard reports before generating custom outputs.
* **Access Control & Governance:** Confirm that stakeholders have appropriate data access rights and verify that a standalone extract is genuinely needed before sharing data.
* **Data Extract Delivery:** Write and execute verified SQL queries to extract, filter, and deliver validated datasets when existing reporting solutions do not meet the need.
* **Analysis Storytelling & Visual Presentation:** Build project-specific Tableau dashboards, charts, and visual decks to present analytical findings and communicate key takeaways clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* **BI Handover & Industrialization:** Identify recurring reporting needs arising from your analyses and work with the central Business Intelligence (BI) team to hand over requirements for production, automated, and recurring enterprise dashboards.
* **AI-Assisted Efficiency:** Actively leverage modern AI tools (e.g., LLMs, code assistants) to accelerate SQL query generation, debug scripts, structure ad-hoc analyses, and streamline routine analytical workflows.
* **Data Quality & Validation:** Inspect source data across databases and cloud platforms to ensure all analyses, extracts, and presentations are reliable, consistent, and accurate.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Information Management, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience: 2 to 4+ years of practical experience in a data analysis role supporting business decision-making.
* Technical Skills:
  + Strong SQL skills to independently query, join, filter, and aggregate data across relational databases and cloud environments.
  + Practical experience creating visuals and analytical dashboards in Tableau (or similar modern BI tools) to present insights.
  + Practical familiarity with AI-assisted coding and productivity tools (such as Gemini, Claude, or similar LLM assistants) to speed up analysis, query writing, and documentation.
  + Working knowledge of Python or R for exploratory analysis, statistical evaluation, or data manipulation is an advantage.
* Data Platforms: Practical familiarity with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google Cloud BigQuery) and data warehouse concepts.
* Analytical Mindset & Gatekeeping: Strong ability to frame ambiguous business problems, paired with the assertiveness to challenge requests and guide users toward existing dashboards instead of defaulting to raw data dumps.
* Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; capable of translating technical findings into plain business language and collaborating effectively with the central BI team for reporting handovers.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* A versatile analytics role balancing strategic project analysis with rapid operational problem-solving.
* Direct access to modern cloud data platforms and analytics tools (GCP BigQuery, Tableau).
* A forward-looking work culture that encourages the use of modern AI assistants to boost day-to-day productivity.
* Clear interfaces between exploratory analysis and central BI delivery.
* High autonomy and visibility across business departments.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

----------------------------

TVH is a global business with a family atmosphere, where people are at the center. We value clarity, mutual respect, kindness and open communication. Our people are down-to-earth, easy to work and engage with. We welcome differences and celebrate new ideas.

**ABOUT TVH:**
--------------

TVH is a parts specialist for quality parts and accessories for material handling, industrial vehicles, and construction and agricultural equipment. Working at TVH is opting for a company that excels as an international market leader and is well-known for its unstoppable craving for innovation.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - AXIS Life - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, AXIS modeller, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**

* Be part of a high-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry

Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering AXIS modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals
  
  
You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Key Requirements**

* As a Senior within the Life AXIS actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
* Good understanding of US/Canada product lines and regulatory standards; hands-on LDTI/ IFRS 17 implementation experience in a modeler or tester capacity (desirable)
* Experience of handling a small to moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Ability to maneuver around existing modeling setup to incorporate the GAAP or STAT or LDTI / IFRS 17 cashflows
* Understanding of AoC concept and AoC steps (unwinding, roll forward, assumption changes, experience variances)
* Strong excel skills, capable of running and modifying macros used to transform Actuarial Cashflows
* Ability to develop regression models on excel to test the model developments
* Hands-on or Advance level experience in AXIS actuarial valuation software.
* Strong experience on Excel is must and experience on VBA would be good
* Good experience of preparing PPT decks
* In-depth understanding of insurance products and regulations of US, Canada and other geographies
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3-6 years of AXIS modelling experience or valuation / reporting / pricing experience (while working on AXIS) in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good analytical skills
* Ability to do investigations in models / reporting process and independently solve problems
* Willingness to learn and apply learning actively in project work Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good actuarial exam progress
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**

* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**commerce**

title: Ecommerce Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ecommerce Operations Executive to own the operational backbone of our marketplace business, with
**stock availability across ecommerce & quick commerce**
channels. This role keeps priority products in stock and dispatch-ready in coordination with the inventory tean, manages the day-to-day machinery of marketplace operations, and ensures the numbers behind it stay clean and traceable.

The responsibilities span availability and fulfillment, payment reconciliation and recovery, account health and compliance, dispatch SLAs, returns and claims, and reporting. Above all, this is an ownership role: when an operational issue surfaces, you are expected to catch it, chase it, and close it.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Warehouse Fulfillment & Stock Availability**

* Own in-stock availability across Amazon (FBA and FBM/Easy Ship)Blinkit and Myntra with priority SKUs never allowed to hit zero.
* Track Days of Inventory (DOI) and replenishment cadence per SKU per channel; raise replenishment/shipment plans well ahead of cutoffs.
* Create and monitor FBA shipments against deficit quantities and cut-off dates; ensure timely warehouse dispatch to Amazon FCs and Blinkit dark stores/warehouses.
* Monitor FBA shipment health, receiving discrepancies, and inbound issues; flag and resolve before they turn into stockouts.
* Maintain a live view of stock across the warehouse, marketplace FCs, and quick-commerce inventory, so availability decisions are always data-backed.

**2. Marketplace Operations, Account Health & Compliance**

* Keep account health metrics green across Amazon and Blinkit — order defect rate, late dispatch, cancellation rate, and policy compliance.
* Monitor and respond to policy warnings, listing suppressions, and compliance flags; file appeals where required.
* Ensure catalog and listing compliance (category, brand, and product-detail-page requirements) and coordinate fixes with the listing team.
* Manage seller support cases end-to-end and maintain a clean, compliant seller standing on every platform.

**3. Order Processing & Dispatch SLA**

* Ensure orders are processed, labelled, and dispatched within marketplace SLA windows (Easy Ship / FBM and Blinkit fulfillment).
* Monitor late-dispatch rate and on-time handover to carriers; drive it to target.
* Ensure accurate tracking upload and clean handover so orders don't slip into cancellations or defects.

**4. Returns & Marketplace Claims**

* Manage the returns lifecycle — customer returns, RTO, and damaged/lost inventory — across Amazon and Blinkit.
* File and follow up on FBA reimbursement claims and marketplace claims for lost, damaged, or wrongly-deducted units, tracking each to recovery.
* Analyze return reasons and surface patterns (SKU, defect, courier, listing mismatch) back to the relevant team.

**5. Reporting, Coordination & Ownership**

* Maintain daily and weekly operations dashboards covering availability, dispatch SLA, account health, reconciliation, and claims status.
* Act as the coordination point between warehouse, finance, and the marketing/performance teams — making sure ops issues don't fall between functions.
* Take end-to-end ownership of operational problems: identify, drive resolution, and communicate status without needing to be chased.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 1–3 years of hands-on ecommerce marketplace operations experience, ideally on
  **Amazon Seller Central**
  and/or
  **quick commerce (Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart)**
  .
* Working knowledge of FBA — shipment creation, inventory/DOI management, and reimbursement claims.
* Comfort with payment reconciliation and reading settlement reports; familiarity with a reconciliation tool (Unireco or similar) is a strong plus.
* Strong Excel and AI skills — able to work with settlement, inventory, and dispatch data and tie numbers back to source.
* Detail-oriented and process-disciplined, with a genuine ownership mindset for chasing issues to closure.

title: Third Party Risk Management Coordinator, Ahmedabad (India)

**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of Third Party Risk Management Coordinator based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The position is primarily responsible for performing day-to-day activities of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) lifecycle for the third parties, covering inherent risk assessment, due diligence, onboarding checks, continuous monitoring and offboarding, applying the TPRM Framework and the team’s procedures and templates consistently, gathering and evaluating due diligence evidence, documents assessment outcomes and rationale, keeping TPRM records audit-ready, and work directly with User Departments and specialist, identifying issues, gaps and adverse findings and refers them to the Third Party Risk Manager, who approves assessment outcomes and handling contentious or high exposure matters functions to obtain the information required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for User Departments and relationship owners on third party risk requirements, providing practical guidance on process, templates and evidence, and builds effective working relationships with User Departments and specialist functions to secure timely input,
* Identify recurring difficulties, inefficiencies and practical obstacles in applying the team’s procedures, templates and guidance, and propose improvements.
* Record where assessment outcomes differ from the provisional tier, to support recalibration of the scoping rules,
* Contribute to the implementation, testing and ongoing improvement of the third-party risk tooling, uses it effectively, and maintain the quality of data within the TPRM system of record,
* Manage allocated caseload of assessments in line with the team’s assessment standards, turnaround times and key performance indicators, and flags early where these are at risk,
* Perform Inherent Risk Assessments for third parties handed over to the central team, running working sessions with relationship owners and subject matter experts to obtain operational facts and specialist input, and prepares the assessment outcome and, where applicable, the rationale for a change in tier for review by the Third Party Risk Manager,
* Challenge responses and scoring that are not supported by evidence, ensures consistency across assessments, and refers unresolved differences to the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Perform due diligence proportionate to the assessed level of risk, collecting, validating and evaluating evidence such as audited financial and credit reports, certifications, data protection documentation, and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening results,
* Request and follows up specialist input from functions such as, but not limited to, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, the Data Protection Office and Procurement, and consolidates their responses into the assessment record,
* Prepare clear, evidence-based due diligence summaries setting out findings, gaps, residual concerns and a proposed risk disposition for review and approval by the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Escalate adverse findings, refused information requests and potential mandatory decline indicators immediately upon identification,
* Maintain the inventory of in-scope third parties allocated to them, keeping risk classification, relationship owner, contract references and key dates complete and current,
* Check all prerequisite lifecycle stages are complete and formally closed before a third party is onboarded, and reports any exceptions,
* Run screening and continuous monitoring at the defined cadence, reviews and dispositions alerts, discounts false positives with documented rationale, and escalates genuine trigger events,
* Support User Departments in performance review cycles and in the structured offboarding of third parties, including confirmation of data return or destruction, access revocation and record closure,
* Maintain the TPRM system of record so that assessments, evidence, approvals and decisions are complete, current and audit-ready,
* Prepare routine reporting on assessment completion, overdue items, open findings and monitoring status, and flag emerging trends to the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Deliver agreed remediation and evidence in support of Internal Audit recommendations relating to third party management.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**

You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification

**Job Specific Skills/ Essentials**

* Awareness of third-party risk and risk management frameworks and standards, including but not limited to COSO, ISO 31000 and ISO 27001,
* Experience of working with a GRC / third party risk platform, case management or workflow tooling,

title: Senior Release Engineer, Patching
description:
Oracle’s Automated Patching Framework (APF) builds and delivers software updates for Oracle Database, Exadata, Fleet Patching and Provisioning (FPP), Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle GoldenGate (OGG), Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and Autonomous Health Framework (AHF), across on-premises and cloud environments. APF is a business-critical platform that helps Oracle deliver patches to customers on schedule and improves the efficiency of development teams across the company.

The framework includes services and tools built with Python, Java, Perl, PL/SQL, and Ant. Our team develops and operates these systems in a large-scale production environment. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from design and implementation to troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support.

We’re looking for strong hands-on software engineers who enjoy solving complex automation problems and working across technologies and teams.

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software for Oracle’s automated patching framework. You’ll build and maintain tools and services using technologies such as Python, Java, Perl, Linux shell scripting, and PL/SQL. The role also includes providing internal production support, investigating and triaging issues, and improving the reliability and performance of the patching infrastructure.

As a member of the software engineering team, you’ll help define and implement software solutions, make changes to existing architecture as needs evolve, and contribute to technical direction across shared projects. The work is varied and often complex, requiring sound judgment and the ability to work independently. You may also lead projects or provide technical guidance to other developers.

  

Design, develop, and maintain APF (Automation Patching Framework) services, tools, and automation.
  
Provide production support and investigate issues reported by internal customers.
  
Lead or contribute to cross-functional technical discussions and shared projects.
  
Improve the framework’s architecture, code quality, reliability, and support processes using AI tools where appropriate.
  
Take ownership of software throughout its lifecycle, including operation in a 24/7 production environment.
  
Provide technical guidance to other developers and, where appropriate, lead projects.

title: Mainframe Data Modernization Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**  
  
As a Principal Data Modernization Architect, you will define and own the target-state data architecture for enterprise modernization and cloud transformation programs. You will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, guiding teams and executive stakeholders on legacy database transformation, migration strategies, and enterprise data governance.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Data Modernization Architecture:** Assess legacy data environments (DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM), define target-state architectures, develop modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformation, establish enterprise migration standards/frameworks, and guide target platform selection.
* **Database Transformation Strategy:** Design migration approaches for legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native services; drive database decomposition and domain separation; and govern schema transformation, data model redesign, metadata, data quality, and data integrity.
* **Data Migration & Coexistence:** Architect high-volume, near-zero-downtime migrations and cutovers using migration waves, Change Data Capture (CDC), and real-time synchronization to ensure data consistency during coexistence periods.
* **Data Architecture & Governance:** Establish enterprise data modeling, lineage, traceability, security, compliance, privacy, performance, scalability, backup, and disaster recovery (DR) standards while collaborating with application architects.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural oversight across modernization programs, conduct architecture reviews, approve transformation designs, mentor engineering and migration teams, and advise executive stakeholders on strategic decisions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Extensive experience defining target-state enterprise data architectures and modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformations.
* Deep hands-on expertise assessing and migrating legacy mainframe data platforms, including DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, and VSAM.
* Proven track record designing migrations from legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native databases.
* Strong expertise in database decomposition, data domain separation, schema transformation, and data model redesign.
* Demonstrated experience architecting high-volume, near-zero-downtime data migrations, coexistence architectures, and cutover strategies.
* Practical proficiency implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) and real-time data synchronization mechanisms.
* Solid background establishing enterprise data governance, lineage, metadata management, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience defining non-functional database standards, including performance, scalability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery (DR).  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing enterprise-wide migration patterns, frameworks, and architectural review boards.
* Strong background collaborating with application architects to align data and application modernization strategies.
* Proven leadership mentoring database engineers, migration specialists, and cross-functional modernization teams.
* Ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders on complex modernization recommendations and strategic investments.
* Experience managing data consistency and reconciliation across hybrid source and target environments during multi-wave migrations.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native data ecosystems and multi-cloud database services.
Track record governing large-scale enterprise programs with strict regulatory and data traceability requirements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl:**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important ,you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused , someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless , naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 15+ years in data and database architecture, including 7+ years leading enterprise-scale database migration, modernization, synchronization, and coexistence programs from mainframe environments.
* **Legacy Mainframe Technologies:** Deep expertise in IBM DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM, legacy mainframe data architectures, and mainframe data modeling.
* **Modern Database Platforms:** Strong proficiency across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Cosmos DB), and cloud-native database services.
* **Data Engineering & Migration:** Hands-on experience with data modeling, schema transformation, ETL/ELT design, Change Data Capture (CDC), data synchronization, and data migration frameworks.
* **Data Management & Governance:** Proven background in establishing data quality management and enterprise data governance frameworks.
* **Architecture & Operations:** Expertise in enterprise data architecture, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), database security, performance engineering, and capacity planning.
* **High-Volume Execution:** Demonstrated success designing and delivering high-volume migration solutions and complex cutover plans.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Mainframe Modernization Expertise:** Skilled in hierarchical-to-relational transformation, database decomposition strategies, relational-to-NoSQL architecture decisions, mainframe data encoding/data-type/structure transformation, and EBCDIC-to-ASCII/Unicode conversion.
* **Large-Scale Migration & Coexistence:** Experience executing multi-wave migrations using near-zero-downtime cutover strategies, parallel run/synchronization models, CDC architectures, and data reconciliation/validation frameworks.
* **Modernization Governance:** Background in data lineage, impact analysis, mainframe-to-cloud data coexistence, hybrid data architecture, data domain rationalization, and migration risk assessment/mitigation.
* **Industry & Program Governance:** Experience governing enterprise-wide data architecture and modernization programs in mission-critical industries (banking, insurance, retail, or healthcare).
* **Cloud & AI Tooling:** Hands-on experience with cloud database platforms on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, plus exposure to AI-assisted modernization and automated schema transformation tools.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Our engineers own the complete consumer and seller experience for Amazon India, work on a wide range of technologies (including AWS and EC2) and build and operate highly scalable, low latency mobile first products and services. We are solving Know Your Customer(KYC), last mile engineering challenges around Mobile, Product Discovery, Delivery, Payments, Logistics, Customer experience, Seller experience and more.  
As a Software Engineer within Amazon India Business team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and deploying solutions to help Amazon significantly expand its selection and drive improved customer experience by enabling a new fulfillment pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a team that will be responsible for building a successful, sustainable and strategic business for Amazon, from the ground up!  
If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of millions of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today! You will work with Principal/Senior Engineers in the team to evolve the design and architecture of the products owned by this team. You will be responsible to set up and hold a high software quality bar besides providing technical direction to a highly technical team of Software Engineers.  
As part of this team you will work to ensure Amazon.in is FAST and has the best shopping experience. It’s a great opportunity to develop and enhance experiences for Mobile devices first. You will be working on a work on a wide range of technologies including AWS EC2, SQS, Amazon WW platforms, ElastcicSearch, Big Data, Machine Learning, Android, iOS, Amazon Horizonte, JavaScript, React JS to create unique experiences for India retail customers.
  
You will work on analyzing the latency across the various Amazon.in pages using RedShift, MapReduce, Java, Elastic Search and Machine Learning. You will get the opportunity to code on almost all key pages on retail website building features and improving business metrics. You will also contribute reducing latency for customers by reducing the bytes on wire and adapting the UX based on network bandwidth. You will be part of a team that obsesses about the performance of our customer’s experience and enjoy flexibility to pursue what makes sense. Come enjoy an exploratory and research oriented team of Cowboys working in a fast paced environment, who are always eager to take on big challenges.  
Position Responsibilities:
  

* Work closely with senior engineers to design, implement and deploy applications that impact the Amazon.in business with an emphasis on Mobile, Payments, and e-Commerce website development.
* Own the delivery of an integral piece of a system or application.
* Management and execution against project plans and delivery commitments
* Assist directly and indirectly in the continual hiring and development of technical talent.
* Create and execute appropriate quality plans, project plans, test strategies and processes for development activities in concert with business and project management efforts.

  
Candidate will be a leader, quick learner and be able to work independently. He/she should be able to operate in a very fast paced environment where time to hit market is super critical. The candidate will need to balance technical leadership and savvy with strong business judgment to make the right decisions about technology choices.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**About Trellix**
  
Trellix is a global cybersecurity leader helping organizations build cyber resilience for the AI era. Combining AI-native security, operational threat intelligence, and automated detection and response, Trellix provides defense-grade protection at machine speed across on-premises, air-gapped, operational technology, hybrid, and cloud environments. Trellix helps customers anticipate threats, scale effective security operations, maintain business continuity, and adapt their security posture for the modern threat landscape. Working with a broad partner ecosystem and global intelligence collaborators, Trellix helps strengthen the collective defense against cybercriminals and state-sponsored attacks. At Trellix, we empower professionals at all career stages to expand their technical expertise, lead strategic initiatives, and make a tangible global impact. Whether you are an industry pioneer or an emerging specialist, Trellix provides the tools and opportunities to enhance and expand your skill set. Join our mission to scale AI-driven cyber defense alongside an AI-accelerated threat landscape, and help build a safer, more resilient future. More at https://trellix.com.

***Role Overview:***

We are looking for a Software Engineer (2+ Years) to join our Customer Digital Experience. In this role, you will help build and improve the applications that power Trellix’s global support network. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, deploy apps to the cloud, and get hands-on exposure to emerging AI tools.

**About the Team**
------------------

Customer Digital Experience (CDX) is dedicated to designing, building, and maintaining robust platforms that power our global support operations. By driving digital transformation through specialized tool development, we deliver solutions that empower both our external customers and our internal support employees, ensuring a seamless and efficient support ecosystem across Trellix. We foster an environment grounded in Trellix’s core values:

* **Open:** We honor our clients' and teams' needs by being collaborative, inclusive of diverse thoughts, aware of our own biases, and receptive to feedback.
* **Tenacious:** We pursue goals relentlessly with a tireless quest for quality and fearless determination to drive significant achievements.
* **Curious:** We maintain a continuous thirst for knowledge to fuel reimagination while staying engaged and caring about the people and technology around us.
* **Fun:** We are easy on people and hard on performance, fostering an environment where everyone is free to be their authentic self.

**About Role:**

* Develop and maintain full-stack web applications using Python and React.js.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and implement software solutions.
* Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that meets industry standards and best practices.
* Design and optimize database queries and schemas using PostgreSQL.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues in existing applications and provide timely resolutions.
* Assist in containerizing applications using Docker and deploying to Dev, QA, Stage, and Production environments on AWS or GCP.
* Conduct unit tests, peer code reviews, and maintenance of web applications.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members.
* Gain exposure to GenAI workflows, including basic RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and LLM integration.
* Work with structured and unstructured data formats, maintaining data integrity across services.
* Write and execute automated test suites to ensure the reliability and functionality of code.
* Document technical specifications and user guides to ensure effective communication and knowledge transfer.

**About You:**
--------------

* Minimum 2+ years of software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python programming language.
* Strong proficiency in React.js and Redux for front-end development.
* Solid hands-on experience with relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).
* Hands-on experience with containerization using Docker.
* Basic exposure to or foundational understanding of GenAI concepts (RAG, LLM integrations).
* Knowledge of RESTful web services and API development.
* Knowledge of markup and data serialization formats such as JSON and XML.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and Agile/JIRA workflows.
* Understanding of software development principles and methodologies.
* Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate effectively with other developers and stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Experience with C# .NET Core back-end development.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB) and caching systems (Redis).
* Familiarity with orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
* Understanding of message queues and event streaming tools (MQTT, Kafka, or RabbitMQ).
Exposure to enterprise file transfer/integration tools like Globalscape.
Familiarity with WPF or AngularJS.  

Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer or GCP Associate).

***Company Benefits and Perks:***

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We work hard to create a dynamic workforce where we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.

* Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement

We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

***Our Commitment to You:***

At Trellix, we are committed to creating a safe and trustworthy experience for our customers, employees, and candidates. Please be aware that fraudulent recruiting activity can occur through fake job postings or impersonated communications.

Trellix conducts interviews through professional channels only and does not use text messages, instant messaging, or group chats for interviews. We will never request sensitive personal information—such as your date of birth, Social Security number, or national ID number—during the interview process.

Trellix also does not require candidates to pay fees, purchase products or services, or process payments of any kind as part of the recruiting or hiring process. And Trellix will never keep any original work authorization documents that we may be required to review during the hiring process.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Web App
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Stryker is one of the world's leading medical technology companies and, together with our customers, is driven to make healthcare better. We offer innovative products and services in Orthopedics, Medical and Surgical,

Neurotechnology and Spine that help improve patient and hospital outcomes.

As part of Mako and Enabling Technologies, our pre-operative clinical applications team provides high quality software to ease and improve the pre-operative flow of surgeries, as well as ensuring the link with core technology from products across Stryker including surgical robotics, image guided interventions, mixed reality solutions and patient specific implants.

We are looking for an ambitious and self-motivated Senior Front-End Engineer to design and develop rich, high-quality user interfaces for our clinical web applications. You will work closely with backend engineers building our micro-services ecosystem to deliver seamless, intuitive and reliable experiences for surgeons and clinical staff. You will have the flexibility and communication skills to operate effectively with other teams across Stryker.

* Design, develop and validate front-end applications and components, from proof of concept to product, in alignment with requirements and architecture defined,
* Be involved in technical choices definition for the UI layer, in collaboration with peers,
* Contribute to design tradeoff decisions while developing components of the system,
* Collaborate closely with backend engineers working on our micro-services ecosystem (Python/FastAPI, Rust/Axum, .NET) to define clean, efficient API contracts and integration patterns,
* Establish a working relationship with product, UX and other engineering groups across the organization to successfully implement business and clinical requirements while applying the latest available tools and technology,
* Work in collaboration with the DevOps team to ensure proper build, test and deployment of front-end solutions,
* Ensure on-schedule delivery of high-quality, accessible and performant user interfaces that meet technical and clinical requirements,

  Knowledge of agile software principles and software development life cycle in a domain with strong regulatory constraints,
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English,
* Experience in web-based development using WASM or similar technologies would be appreciated,
* Experience in WebGL or data visualization libraries would be appreciated,
