Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Data Strategy and Execution Lead - Trading Risk Management (TRM)
description:
Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living.

Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come.

**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

The **Data Strategy and Execution Lead** will own the Trading and Risk Management (TRM) data strategy and drive its execution: translating trading ambitions into a prioritized roadmap of trusted, governed and reusable data products, and defining the information architecture required for AI-enabled trading.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone equally credible shaping strategy with executives and challenging a pipeline design with engineers. You will partner with data teams across the organization to drive execution and convert fragmented demand into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* **DATA STRATEGY & ROADMAP:** Defines the TRM data strategy, target state, priorities and value cases. Translates trading and risk-management ambitions into a sequenced roadmap, investment choices, measurable outcomes and an execution backlog, partnering with the product teams across the organization. Leads directly or partners with other data teams to evolve critical datasets into governed, high-quality, reusable data products fit for analytics, AI and trading needs. Works across the organization to define clear ownership, stewardship, quality standards and lifecycle management.
* **INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE:** Shape, balancing corporate standards and specific trading and risk management needs, and steward the TRM information architecture, including data products, domain and semantic models, metadata, lineage and AI-ready foundations. Ensures architecture decisions support discoverability, reuse, interoperability and trusted decision-making. Partners with data functions, data architecture, security and governance teams to adopt common standards and operating models across data capture, storage, transformation and access while defining well-governed exceptions when required to meet distinctive TRM needs.
* **DEEP TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP:** Serves as the technical authority for TRM data engineering. Reviews and challenges platform, pipeline, modeling and integration designs; guides engineers through complex trade-offs; and ensures solutions are scalable, observable, resilient, secure, maintainable and ready for advanced analytics and AI workloads for TRM.Provides leadership and guidance to product teams to address high-value needs and successfully executes the TRM data strategy. Converts fragmented or ad hoc requests into a transparent, prioritized backlog with clear delivery metrics and business outcomes.
* **TRADING DOMAIN PARTNERSHIP:** Builds trusted relationships with trading, risk, operations and technology leaders to understand decision workflows, identify data constraints and shape pragmatic solutions. Communicates complex data and architecture choices clearly to executive and technical audiences.
* **CAPABILITY BUILDING:** Develops and coaches high-performing data resources across teams. Clarifies roles and ways of working across data strategy, architecture, engineering, product ownership and stewardship, while strengthening data-product and AI-readiness capabilities across TRM.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum requirement of 8 years of relevant work experience.
* Preferred candidates will typically bring 10+ years of progressive experience spanning data strategy, information architecture, data products, governance and execution, including leadership in a complex trading, commodities, financial-markets or risk-management environment.

**ROLE-SPECIFIC CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE**

* **DEEP DATA ENGINEERING & PLATFORM EXPERTISE:** Deep, hands-on engineering credibility on a modern cloud data stack in complex, mission-critical environments, combined with the architectural judgement to choose the right platform pattern and make governed data consumable by analytics and AI. Proven depth across data pipelines, distributed processing, data modeling, lineage, data quality, orchestration and production. Strong command of cloud-native and event-driven architectures, batch and streaming patterns, APIs and data contracts, and the judgement to make deliberate platform and cost trade-offs. Familiarity with agent-oriented data access patterns and with the tension between broad, cross-domain access and least-privilege controls is a strong advantage.
* **TRADING & RISK DOMAIN EXPERIENCE:** Demonstrated understanding of front-to-back trading and risk-management processes, decision workflows and data needs. Experience in commodities or another asset-intensive trading environment is strongly preferred.
* **STRATEGIC DATA LEADERSHIP:** Proven ability to translate business strategy into data capabilities, target-state architecture, roadmaps, investment priorities and measurable value.
* **COMMUNICATION AND PARTNERSHIP:** Clear, influential leader who brings clarity to ambiguity, challenges constructively and inspires action across organizational boundaries. Delivers results by mobilizing capabilities across multiple teams and using strong influencing and negotiation skills with business, engineering, architecture and governance stakeholders. Balances speed to market with enterprise standards and sustainable design.
* **EDUCATION:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is valued but not required.

**Our Offer**  
We provide a fast paced stimulating international environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities and are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and workplace. We encourage candidates to let us know if they require any accommodations during the recruitment or interview process so we can support them appropriately.

**Interested? Then make sure to send us your CV and cover letter in English today:**  
**Follow us on LinkedIn:** **https://www.linkedin.com/company/cargill**

Cargill is committed to being an inclusive employer. Click here to find out more https://careers.cargill.com/diversity/

Unfortunately, there are scams out there where individuals pretend to be Cargill recruiters to try to collect personal information or request payment. Please know that Cargill will* ***never*** *ask you for money during the hiring process, and in most cases, we only accept applications through our official* *careers site**, with the exception of some roles in our production plants. If something doesn't feel right or you have questions, don't hesitate to* *contact us**. To learn more, visit our* *Notice on Fraudulent Job Offers**.*

title: Support Engineer III, AMC, Ad-Tech Solutions
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) is a new secure, privacy-safe, and dedicated cloud-based environment in which advertisers can easily perform analytics across multiple, pseudonymized data sets to generate insights. Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.  
  
This is a customer-facing role that demands strong technical depth across AWS services, excellent communication skills, and a project management mindset. You will be the bridge between customers and internal teams, ensuring a seamless onboarding experience while advocating for customer needs.  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.
* Use case management tools to manage and prioritize issues based on multiple factors including customer impact.
* Build & Contribute to training material and documentation for both internal and customer-facing users.
* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.
* Providing support directly to data analysts who are using Amazon Marketing Cloud.
* Writing queries, code samples, tutorials, and technical articles for the customer community
* Working with customers to understand how they are using our services, and providing feedback to development teams
* Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive timely customer communication
* Driving internal projects that improve support-related processes and our customer's user experience
* Customer Onboarding: Own end-to-end technical onboarding of customers onto Amazon Ads solutions, ensuring smooth and timely implementation.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues across the AWS stack, working closely with customers and internal engineering teams to drive resolution.
* Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer — collect and synthesize VOC (Voice of the Customer) feedback, and translate customer questions, pain points, and feature requests into engineering and program-level requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, product, and program teams to drive resolution of customer issues and influence the product roadmap based on customer insights.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
* 3+ years of technical support experience
* 2+ years of scripting language experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and cloud computing such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.

title: Principal Architect
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**What will you contribute?**

  

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect who will serve as a recognized enterprise technical authority for Artificial Intelligence architecture. You will set the strategic technical direction for AI capabilities across products, platforms, and business segments, including generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, AI platforms, model integration, evaluation, governance, security, and responsible AI.

Your secondary focus will be cloud and SaaS architecture. You will ensure that enterprise AI strategy is realized through secure, scalable, resilient, multi-tenant, observable, and cost-effective cloud services, while influencing investment priorities, platform evolution, and cross-product adoption

  

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**  
  
Your deliverables as a **[Role Name]** will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Set the enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference patterns, capability roadmaps, and technology strategy across multiple products, platforms, and business segments.

* Provide authoritative architectural direction for generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, model integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation.

* Sponsor and lead strategic AI research, technology evaluations, and Proofs of Concept, translating validated outcomes into reusable, production-grade capabilities with measurable business value.

* Establish enterprise guardrails for responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, observability, auditability, and human oversight in regulated environments.

* Shape cloud-native and SaaS architecture strategy for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, scalability, resilience, availability, metering, subscription models, and cost management.

* Create and drive adoption of reference architectures, reference implementations, patterns, libraries, accelerators, and engineering guidance across product and platform teams.

* Govern and review strategic architecture and design proposals for alignment with AI strategy, cloud and SaaS principles, enterprise standards, security, regulatory obligations, and long-term sustainability.

* Influence executive and senior technical decisions across architecture, engineering, product, data, security, cloud platforms, governance, and business leadership.

* Develop senior architects and principal engineers, and lead enterprise architecture forums, technical councils, workshops, demonstrations, hackathons, and global knowledge-sharing communities.

  
  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

AI Architecture & Strategy

Enterprise-wide AI target architecture, principles, standards, investment roadmaps, technology portfolio decisions, and adoption strategy across products and business segments.

Generative AI & LLM Systems

Strategic direction for LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, model routing, grounding, safety, and production controls at enterprise scale.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Enterprise standards for search, embeddings, vector retrieval, chunking, ranking, grounding, citations, authorization-aware access, and measurable retrieval quality.

Agentic AI

Enterprise patterns and governance for agent orchestration, tool use, workflow design, memory, planning, permissions, human approval, monitoring, and failure containment.

AI Platforms & Integration

Shared model gateways, AI services, APIs, event-driven integration, data pipelines, reusable platform capabilities, and consistent embedding of AI across products.

AI Evaluation & Observability

Enterprise evaluation strategy spanning quality, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, drift, telemetry, red-teaming, and continuous assurance.

Responsible AI & Governance

Organization-wide security, privacy, regulatory alignment, model risk, data governance, explainability, auditability, accountability, and human oversight.

  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

**Secondary Skills: Cloud & SaaS**
==================================

* Cloud-native architecture using Microsoft Azure or comparable hyperscale platforms, including containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed services, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering.

* SaaS architecture covering multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, identity, configuration, extensibility, metering, subscription management, data residency, and zero-downtime evolution.

* Distributed systems, APIs, event-driven integration, data platforms, observability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, operational readiness, and cross-product interoperability.

title: Sr Manager, Engineering - Engineer
description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Senior Engineering Manager (L6), whether you are leading a "team of teams" focused on hyper-personalizing the Uber Eats feed through cutting-edge ML, or overseeing the distributed compute platforms and payment systems that support millions of global earners, you are building for real-world impact at massive scale.  
  
This role requires a leader who can navigate high-stakes ambiguity and make hard calls under pressure. You’ll be responsible for setting long-term technical vision while managing the weight of decisions that affect global reliability and business outcomes. You won't just follow a playbook; you will help write it by building high-performing teams in an environment where the pace is relentless and the stakes are high. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and thrive in the "messy" reality of doing big things—this is where you’ll make your mark.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization of managers and staff-level ICs, fostering a culture of technical excellence, operational rigor, and continuous learning.
* Define and execute the strategic roadmap for your domain, ensuring technical investments align with high-impact use cases and long-term business objectives.
* Drive architectural decisions for large-scale distributed systems, challenging your teams to design robust, scalable solutions for batch compute, ML orchestration, or global payments.
* Partner deeply across disciplines—including Product, Data Science, Design, and Finance—to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver seamless platform integrations.

Navigate a diverse set of opinions among global stakeholders, synthesizing different perspectives to drive decisions effectively and unblock execution.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering management and 4+ years as a manager of managers.
* Proven track record of setting direction for an organization, constructing visions that unify multiple engineering teams and align with primary customer needs.
* Demonstrated ability to drive high productivity and a bias to action across direct teams while proactively unblocking dependencies across the larger organization.

Education: Master’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* PhD in a technical field with a research or applied focus on large-scale ML systems, distributed computing, or related paradigms.

* Deep understanding of product experimentation, including the statistical mechanics and analysis needed to challenge experimental results.
* Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas to C-level executives and non-technical audiences.
A "Driver" mindset: You are biased toward action, a master disambiguator, and stay resilient through constant change.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Job ID** R-264304 **Date posted** 11/13/2026

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to harness Generative AI and agentic systems to transform how therapies reach patients and sharpen commercial decision-making? As a Senior Consultant in AI/ML Engineering based in Bangalore, you will design, build and ship AI solutions that help clinicians, field teams and partners act faster and smarter—ultimately improving outcomes for millions.

Do you want to lead end-to-end delivery, from problem framing and experimentation through evaluation, deployment and monitoring? You will work across multiple disease areas and brands, integrating diverse data sources to deliver robust tools. You will join a global community of data scientists, ML engineers and domain experts, providing technical leadership on high-impact projects while deepening your expertise in the latest AI methods.

**Accountabilities:**

* Generative and Agentic Solutions: Design, build and deploy Generative AI and agentic solutions for commercial use cases, including LLM applications and multi-agent systems on frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

* Fine-tuning and Distillation: Develop and apply fine-tuning and distillation techniques to enhance quality while reducing cost and latency.

* Evaluation and Safety: Build and operate evaluation harnesses and platforms to measure quality, safety and reliability of LLM and agent systems, using results to drive continuous improvements.

* Production Telemetry and Monitoring: Implement telemetry, tracing and monitoring for AI systems in production and respond to quality, drift and cost issues.

* Reinforcement Learning: Explore and apply reinforcement learning and feedback-based optimisation where they add measurable value.

* Classical ML Delivery: Develop and maintain traditional ML models (classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, NLP) for commercial analytics.

* Data Integration: Integrate internal and external structured and unstructured data by partnering with data engineering, informatics and platform teams.

* Technical Leadership and Code Quality: Lead technical workstreams and write production-quality, well-tested and well-documented code that scales.

* Multi-functional Partnerships: Collaborate with Commercial, Medical, IT and other partners to scope problems, define success metrics and deliver scalable solutions.

* Research and Coaching: Research and apply the latest algorithms and methods to business problems, and coach junior data scientists and engineers to set the standard.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

**Minimum Requirements**

* BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field.

* Typically 6+ years of experience building data science and ML solutions, including recent hands-on experience (typically 1+ years) with LLM-based applications.

* A track record of independently leading data science or AI projects to solve business or scientific problems.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and working knowledge of fine-tuning and distillation approaches.

* Agentic AI: experience building agents or multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LangGraph, Strands or similar.

* Evaluation: experience designing and running evaluations of LLM and agent systems.

* Machine learning foundations: classical ML (supervised and unsupervised methods, including classification and regression) and deep learning, including transformers, using PyTorch or TensorFlow.

* Programming and tools: exceptional Python; SQL and familiarity with NoSQL; scikit-learn; Jupyter; Streamlit or similar.

* Cloud: working knowledge of AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock preferred).

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Master’s or PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field. We prioritise demonstrated skills over credentials.

* Familiarity with reinforcement learning, including preference-based optimisation of LLMs.

* Experience with telemetry and observability tooling for AI systems.

* MLOps tooling: MLflow, Docker, CI/CD, and pipeline tools such as Airflow.

* Experience with knowledge graphs, and with structured and unstructured data (text and image).

* Pharmaceutical, healthcare or commercial analytics domain experience.

* Curiosity and a desire to keep learning new technologies and methods in AI.

* Ability to explain complex methods and techniques to a non-technical audience.

* Ability to collaborate closely with multi-functional, global teams.

* Good written and verbal communication skills; fluent English.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. You will collaborate with diverse experts who thrive on solving complex, real-world problems—bringing advanced methods in machine learning, LLMs and multi-agent systems to life at scale. We combine bold ambition with genuine support, valuing kindness alongside pace, and we create practical solutions by putting unexpected teams together to unlock new ideas. title: ENGINEER - CMDB DATA QUALITY
description:
Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
  
  
GCL: C1/C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
  
  
In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
  
  
From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
  
  
CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
  
  
Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
  
  
Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
  
  
CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
  
  
Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.

title: Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant - SAP PaPM
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
This role supports the technical solution design for Operational Transfer Pricing and other Tax capabilities or part of a cross functional component. The role is a key position on the Axial Programme IT design team taking a central role in defining the global design template for AstraZeneca in line with our ambition of Fit to Standard using SAP best practice as far as possible. You will be a member of a wider Axial IT Design Team that will lead on defining the IT solution that will support our global standardised business processes. Ensuring integration between business process definition, SAP solution definition and SAP data objects definition.
  
  
In addition, you will be responsible for ensuring that the global standard solution is fully and accurately documented and tested according to project standards and will guide the core design through the required governance forums. You will work closely with IT Enterprise Business Partners, others IT Product Managers and SMEs across the design team to ensure that solutions are efficiently integrated into a wider AstraZeneca global standard design. This will also include working with SMEs from our external partners to ensure that the AZ solution adopts standard and groundbreaking technology in fulfilling business capabilities and outcomes.
  
  
As the project moves to the deployment phase you will continue to play a pivotal role in ensuring that the localisation requirements of individual operating units are properly represented in the solution, whilst retaining the integrity of a fit to standard best practice template. You will also support the deployment teams with deploying the business change journey and ensuring successful migration and cutover to the standard design for each entity. You will be a key participant in hypercare management, ensuring that any issues related to your capability are resolved in a timely and effective way.
  
  
In the role of SAP PaPM Consultant, you will apply knowledge of SAP best practices to enable core business capability and a standard global template for your respective domain.
  
  
PaPM is a new SAP capability and as such not all potential candidates may have the necessary skill sets. However, if you have a good functional knowledge within the domain or experience with other technologies mentioned in this role profile, then please apply as AstraZeneca can support your career development.
  
  
**Essential For The Role**

* Good functional knowledge/experience in Operational transfer pricing, financial performance and analytics and financial allocation processes
* Experience and knowledge in one or more mentioned SAP technologies: SAP PAPM (Required), SAP Datasphere (Preferred), SAP SAC (Optional) and SAP HANA Modelling (Optional)
* Understanding of defining the data models in PaPM, integration of finance actuals, forecasting (SAP and non-SAP systems), standard capabilities in PaPM and design of business rule
* Handle multiple data sources, data objects and integrate them effectively
* Creation and review of technical design documentation addressing user requirements
* Confident to challenge the status quo and facilitate different perspectives to drive solutions
* Able to think out of the box, thrive in ambiguous and stressful situations
* Understanding of Cost and Revenue allocation process design and implementation

**Desirable for the role**

* Comfortable with ambiguity and possessing an agile and open approach.
* Self-motivated with the ability to prioritise efficiently to ensure project goals are achieved.
* Skilled in business operations, communications, customer and partner engagement.
* Understanding of various transfer pricing calculation methods , P&L Segmentation, monitoring, true-ups process design and implementation
* Understanding of supply chains of multinationals and how they are reflected in system landscapes
* Understanding of SAP FICO, SAP SD & MM pricing

**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

title: Director - Business Intelligence
description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability — owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on.
  
  
This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner — using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Core Skills & Requirements**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning.
* Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale.
* Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance — building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery.
* Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus.

AI-Assisted Data Development
  
  

* Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling — Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents.
* Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality.
* A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty.

Media & Marketing Data Fluency
  
  
*You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means.*

* Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate.
* Understanding of how reach and frequency work — served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping — and the implications for how data must be modeled.
* Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics — pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows.
* Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes.
* Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data.

Leadership
  
  

* Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model.
* Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team.
* Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns.
* Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform.
* Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics).
* Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment.
* CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines.

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity.
* Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production.
* Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Engineer with Python, Agentic AI, Multi-cloud, MCP along with IAM, Cyber experience
description:
**Job Description**

**Senior Engineer, IAM, Chennai/Pune**

NielsenIQ is looking for an individual who can join our Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program. We are evolving our enterprise Identity and Access ecosystem by embedding AI and machine learning to improve security posture, automation, and user experience at scale. To support this effort, we are seeking a Senior AI/ML Engineer with strong experience in architecting, designing, building, and operationalizing machine learning systems in complex, distributed, and cloud-based environments.
  
  
In this role, you will lead the development of AI-driven identity, access, and security intelligence solutions, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, and AI teams. You will be responsible for designing ML architectures, building production-grade pipelines, deploying models at scale, and driving measurable outcomes through applied AI for supporting out Identity Security initiative. This is a hands-on Senior Engineering role with significant technical ownership and architectural influence.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a self-driven problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Cloud platforms, and automation, and who wants to be part of growing NIQ global IAM program.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design and evolution of the IAM technology stack, ensuring adherence to top-tier security practices across architecture, implementation, monitoring, maintenance, and enhancements.
* Design, build, and evolve AI/ML solutions that analyze identity, access, and behavioral data to detect anomalies, reduce risk, and automate identity security services to enforce IAM, PAM and Secrets Management controls.
* Lead the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Architect and implement scalable ML pipelines using Python, cloud-native services, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and other Engineering teams to integrate ML models into enterprise IAM, PAM, and Secrets Management workflows and drive roadmap decisions and enterprise-scale adoption and enforcement.
* Apply advanced security engineering principles to analyze, design, develop, deploy, and support complex software solutions and infrastructure upgrades, setting standards for best practices.
* Develop and deploy real-time and batch inference services for identity and access pattern recognition.
* Apply advanced ML techniques (anomaly detection, clustering, classification, graph-based models, etc.,) to human and non-human identity use cases.
* Design model monitoring, drift detection, and performance metrics aligned to security KPIs and business outcomes.
* Leverage cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) for distributed training, model serving, and data processing.
* Drive the adoption of MLOps best practices, including CI/CD for models, versioning, reproducibility, and observability.
* Collaborate with product owners and stakeholders to translate security problems into well-defined ML use cases.
* Communicate technical concepts, trade-offs, and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Mentor junior engineers and help establish Cybersecurity engineering standards for applied AI across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer science, Computer Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on architecting and designing AI/ML systems at global scale (Cybersecurity preferred).
* Strong proficiency in Python and experience building ML systems using modern frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Hands-on experience with data pipelines, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Broad knowledge of IAM capabilities, identity stores, authentication/authorization, strong authentication, privileged access methodologies, and Zero Trust principles
* Experience deploying and operating ML models in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Practical knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and automation.
* Experience working with identity, security, or behavioral data (IAM, access logs, telemetry, or similar domains).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, Git-based workflows, containerization, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Understanding of non-human identities, service accounts, secrets, and automation-driven access patterns is a strong plus.
* Ability to design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, explainability, and operational reliability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills in ambiguous, real-world environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to work independently while driving complex initiatives across large organizations.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment, balancing risk reduction with business objectives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ability to work autonomously while influencing cross-functional teams and have proven track record of driving adoption of security best practices across large organizations.

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Bioinformatics Lead
description:
**Job description**

We are seeking an experienced Bioinformatics Technical Lead to drive our computational biology initiatives. The ideal candidate will have 68 years of industry or academic experience (PhD or Masters in a relevant field) with a proven track record in developing and refining high-throughput pipelines for omics data, including RNA-seq, methylation, and new NGS modalities. This highly technical position requires creativity and an aptitude for developing novel computational algorithms. You will work directly with distinguished professors from leading institutions such as MIT, Caltech, Harvard, and others. This role is primarily an individual contributor position with limited leadership responsibilities, guiding a small team (24 highly qualified bioinformaticians) in a technical capacity rather than acting as a full-time manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Pipeline Development & Optimization

* Design, implement, and optimize scalable, production-grade pipelines for NGS data analysis (RNA-seq, whole-genome, whole-exome, methalomics, NIPT development, novel PCR analysis etc.).
* Ensure reproducibility, efficiency, and accuracy of computational workflows.

* Algorithm & Data Analysis

* Develop and apply novel computational algorithms for gene expression profiling, variant calling, haplotype calls and other genomic analyses.
* Perform rigorous data mining and statistical analyses to extract actionable insights from large datasets.

* Technical Leadership

* Guide and mentor junior bioinformaticians and computational scientists.
* Conduct code reviews, provide technical feedback, and champion best practices across the team.

* Collaboration & Cross-Functional Engagement

* Work closely with molecular biologists, data scientists, and software engineers to translate project goals into robust computational strategies.
* Communicate results, provide data-driven recommendations, and contribute to scientific publications and intellectual property (as appropriate).

* Quality & Compliance

* Maintain high standards of data integrity, documentation, and version control.
* Implement quality control checks and validation strategies for all workflows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education:
* + PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or related field; or
  + Masters degree with significant, demonstrable experience.
* Experience:
* + 6-8 years of hands-on experience analyzing high-throughput NGS data, with an emphasis on RNA-seq.
  + Proven track record of developing and deploying production-level bioinformatics pipelines.
* Technical Skills:
* + Strong programming background in at least one major language.
  + Familiarity with HPC clusters or cloud computing environments.
  + Expertise in data mining, machine learning, or statistical modeling techniques relevant to genomics.
* Leadership & Communication:
* + Prior experience in a lead role, supervising or mentoring junior team members.
  + Excellent written and oral communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in a regulated environment (e.g., CLIA, CAP, or similar).
* Familiarity with workflow management systems (e.g., Nextflow, Snakemake, Cromwell).
* Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Singularity) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Publications or patents in computational genomics or related areas.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
* Adaptability and willingness to embrace new technologies and methodologies.

title: Test Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Automation Lead Test Engineer will define and execute automation test strategies, build robust frameworks using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript or Java, integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and QA partners to ensure requirement clarity, end-to-end test coverage, and defect prevention.

Key Skills

UI automation: Strong hands-on experience with Playwright as the preferred tool, with Selenium as a plus.

API testing and automation: Strong experience with REST API testing using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, and Java or JavaScript/TypeScript based API automation.

Framework design: Ability to design and enhance scalable automation frameworks using hybrid, keyword-driven, data-driven, BDD, and Page Object Model approaches.

Programming: Strong coding proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Java with an automation-first engineering mindset.

End-to-end testing: Ability to connect UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and functional test coverage across application flows.

CI/CD and DevOps: Experience with Jenkins, Git, pipelines, test reporting, debugging tools, and continuous testing practices.

Quality engineering fundamentals: Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, quality gates, defect prevention, and test coverage strategy.

Cloud and infrastructure: Working knowledge of AWS or cloud-based device/browser farms such as BrowserStack.

AI-assisted testing: Ability to use tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate script creation, refactoring, and documentation.

Additional exposure: Performance testing tools such as JMeter or Gatling, accessibility testing, security testing, and regulated domain experience are preferred.

Required Qualifications

6–8 years of experience in QA, software testing, or quality engineering.

At least 4 years of hands-on automation testing experience across UI and API automation.

Strong experience building automation frameworks and reusable test components.

Hands-on experience with Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript; Java experience is strongly preferred for API automation.

Experience with REST API testing and automation using RestAssured, Postman, Newman, or equivalent tools.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams with distributed stakeholders.

Strong analytical, debugging, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to mentor junior QA engineers, conduct automation code reviews, and influence quality practices across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other regulated domains.

Exposure to performance, security, and accessibility testing for web applications.

Working knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms.

Experience improving automation maturity, test stability, release confidence, and sprint quality metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Requirement clarification: Partner with Product Owners, developers, Lead Engineers, and technical teams to ensure test scenarios align with business intent and acceptance criteria.

Backlog and test planning: Participate in grooming and sprint planning, refine acceptance criteria, define test coverage, and ensure automation opportunities are embedded into sprint scope.

Automation framework ownership: Design, develop, maintain, and enhance scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, RestAssured, Postman, and Newman.

UI and API test development: Build reusable test components, utilities, test data strategies, service validations, API contracts, and end-to-end automated test flows.

Execution and reporting: Execute automated regression, smoke, functional, integration, and API test suites; analyze results, identify failure trends, and communicate actionable insights.

CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into Jenkins/Git-based pipelines to support continuous testing, quality gates, and faster release feedback.

Defect identification and RCA: Identify defects early, perform root cause analysis, collaborate with developers on permanent fixes, and improve defect prevention practices.

Testability and engineering partnership: Collaborate with UI and backend engineers to improve testability through stable selectors, test IDs, API readiness, mocks, data setup, and service-level validation.

UAT and business support: Support business users during UAT cycles with test clarification, quick triage, and validation support.

Documentation and best practices: Maintain test documentation, automation guidelines, reusable templates, framework standards, and coding best practices.

AI-assisted quality engineering: Use AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Playwright AI-assisted locators, and test generators to accelerate automation creation, refactoring, documentation, and productivity.

Continuous improvement: Drive improvements in automation coverage, test reliability, execution efficiency, sprint quality metrics, and release confidence.

Team leadership: Mentor junior QA engineers, support automation code reviews, promote knowledge sharing, and influence quality-first engineering behaviors.

Work shift: Work in overlapping time zones with US teams as required to support collaboration and delivery continuity.

The candidate will be responsible for fiber optic network installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of FTTH (Fiber to the Home) networks. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in fiber optic cable installation, splicing, testing, and customer connectivity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform FTTH fiber optic network installation and maintenance.
* Supervise and execute fiber cable laying, pulling, and routing activities.
* Install and maintain OLT, FAT, FDT, FDH, FDB, and customer termination points.
* Perform fiber optic splicing and joint closure installation.
* Conduct fiber testing using OTDR, optical power meter, and light source.
* Troubleshoot fiber optic network faults and connectivity issues.
* Install and configure ONT/ONU devices at customer premises.
* Perform fiber termination, connectorization, and patch cord installation.
* Monitor network performance and ensure service quality.
* Prepare daily progress reports, site inspection reports, and work completion reports.
* Coordinate with project managers, technicians, contractors, and customers.
* Ensure all work complies with project specifications and safety standards.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Diploma / ITI / Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, or Electrical Engineering preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in FTTH or fiber optic network projects.
* Good knowledge of fiber optic cable installation and network architecture.
* Hands-on experience with fiber splicing and OTDR testing.
* Knowledge of OLT, ONT/ONU, FAT, FDT, and FDB equipment.
* Understanding of GPON/EPON technology is an advantage.
* Ability to troubleshoot fiber network faults.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and customer locations.

**Technical Skills**

* FTTH Network Installation
* Fiber Optic Cable Pulling and Laying
* Fiber Splicing and Termination
* OTDR Testing and Troubleshooting
* Optical Power Meter Testing
* GPON / EPON Technology
* OLT and ONT Configuration

title: Lead Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Skills:** Team Handling Business Analysis Gathering Requirements UAT

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** mumbai

**Exp Level:** 8-14 Years

**Role:** 1

**Company:** ColdStar Logistics
  
**Experience:** 8–12 years
  
**Department:** Digital Transformation / Technology
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, on ColdStar Logistics payroll
  
**Location:** Mumbai (in-person, onsite role), with visits to warehouses and operational facilities
  
**Reports to:** Top management / C-suite
  
**Compensation:** Industry standard

**About the Company**
---------------------

India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.

**About the Role**
------------------

ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.

The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.

The role will act as the **primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,** ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.

The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management**

* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.

* **Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight**

* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.

* **UAT and Solution Acceptance**

* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
* Coordinate retesting with Technology Teams and relevant ColdStar users.
* Obtain formal UAT acceptance from authorized business process owners.
* Recommend production readiness based on functional completeness and business acceptance.

* **Technology Adoption and Change Management**

* Ensure delivered solutions are adopted effectively across ColdStar’s operational teams.
* Develop training, communication and adoption strategies for new systems and features.
* Coordinate user onboarding, demonstrations and operational training.
* Monitor adoption, usage patterns, manual workarounds and user feedback.
* Work with department heads to embed new systems into standard operating procedures.
* Identify and address resistance to change, usability problems and process gaps.
* Measure the operational value realized from technology investments.

* **Innovation, Competitive Intelligence and Digital Roadmap**

* Proactively research digital innovations, emerging technologies and competitive practices in logistics, cold-chain operations, transportation and warehousing.
* Identify opportunities involving process automation, IoT, analytics, AI, GenAI and agentic AI.
* Evaluate technology opportunities based on business value, feasibility, implementation effort and return on investment.
* Work with engineering and innovation teams to evaluate potential solutions.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of business improvements and innovation initiatives.
* Recommend quarterly technology priorities to ColdStar’s leadership.
* Align technology priorities with ColdStar’s business strategy and identify operational problems that can be solved through technology.
* Use AI/ML and analytics to make sense of the data generated by ColdStar’s systems and turn it into insights for operations and leadership.
* Help build technology into ColdStar’s culture and everyday ways of working.
* Track industry developments and identify opportunities to improve ColdStar’s operational efficiency, customer experience and competitive positioning.

* **Technology Team Leadership**

* Build and lead ColdStar’s in-house technology team as the company grows.
* Mentor team members and set clear standards, priorities and ways of working.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* 8–12 years of experience in business analysis, techno-functional consulting, enterprise application implementation or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of logistics, warehousing, transportation, supply chain or distribution operations.
* Proven experience working with software development teams or external technology implementation partners.
* Experience independently preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience managing UAT, business acceptance and technology adoption.
* Working understanding of APIs, databases, SQL fundamentals, integrations, cloud applications and enterprise software architecture.
* Familiarity with WMS, TMS, ERP, fleet management, inventory management or related enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work closely with both business users and technical engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Cold-chain logistics and temperature-controlled supply-chain operations.
* Experience with IoT, real-time tracking, warehouse automation or fleet analytics.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Power BI or enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI and automation use cases in logistics.
* Experience with operational change management and technology adoption programs.
