title: Senior Lead Associate - Backup, Resilience and DR
description:
### **Description**

  

* The Senior Lead Associate - Backup, Resilience and DR is the service owner and senior technical authority for enterprise backup, recovery, disaster recovery and technology resilience across the Davies Group estate. Reporting to the Manager - Security, Resilience and DR, the role leads the strategy, governance, engineering direction and operational assurance required to protect critical services and data across on-premises, cloud and SaaS environments.
* The role works across Hosting, Cloud, Network, Security Operations, IAM, Digital Workplace, Service Management, Architecture, Applications, Data, Risk, Compliance, Business Continuity, Procurement and third-party providers. It translates business impact and risk requirements into tested recovery capabilities, clear recovery objectives, measurable controls and leadership-level assurance.
* This is a senior individual-contributor / technical-lead role that may or may not have direct reports. Irrespective of line-management responsibility, the postholder is expected to lead through influence, set standards, coordinate delivery across multiple teams, challenge weak controls and provide clear updates to senior leadership.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy, ownership and governance**

* Own the group-wide backup, recovery, disaster recovery and technology resilience service roadmap, operating model, standards and control framework.
* Define target-state capabilities, service tiers and improvement priorities aligned to business criticality, risk appetite, architecture standards and regulatory obligations.
* Establish clear accountability across infrastructure, application and business service owners for backup coverage, recovery design, testing, evidence and remediation.
* Chair or lead resilience governance forums, track decisions and exceptions, and escalate material risks with clear options and recommended actions.

**Backup and recovery leadership**

* Provide technical and service leadership for enterprise backup platforms across on-premises, Azure and other approved cloud or SaaS environments.
* Govern backup policies, schedules, retention, encryption, immutability, access controls, capacity, performance and secure off-site or isolated recovery copies.
* Ensure critical workloads, databases, virtual platforms, file services, cloud resources and relevant SaaS data are identified, protected and recoverable.
* Lead restoration assurance through risk-based restore testing, integrity validation and evidence that recovery outcomes meet approved requirements.
* Drive remediation of failed, missed or degraded backups and recurring defects, with root-cause analysis, ownership and prevention actions.

**Disaster recovery and resilience**

* Own the technology DR lifecycle, including service dependency mapping, recovery strategies, DR plans, runbooks, exercise schedules, test scenarios, evidence and post-exercise improvement plans.
* Partner with Business Continuity, service owners and application teams to translate business impact analysis into achievable recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Lead tabletop, component, application and end-to-end recovery exercises, including cyber-recovery and loss-of-platform scenarios where applicable.
* Coordinate technical recovery during major incidents or declared disasters, providing decision support, status reporting, risk escalation and recovery sequencing.
* Validate resilience for new services, major changes, acquisitions and migrations before production acceptance.

**Security, risk and compliance**

* Work with Security Operations and IAM to protect backup administration, credentials and recovery environments using least privilege, segregation of duties and strong authentication.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence for backup execution, restore results, DR tests, exceptions, risk acceptance and remediation.
* Assess resilience risks arising from ransomware, platform concentration, third-party dependency, data corruption, regional outage, capacity constraint and technology obsolescence.
* Ensure control gaps and overdue remediation are visible through the appropriate risk, change and service-governance processes.

**Service performance and continual improvement**

* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs, including backup success, restore success, protection coverage, recovery objective attainment, test completion, open risks and remediation ageing.
* Use trend analysis, automation and monitoring to reduce manual effort, improve early warning and prevent repeat failures.
* Maintain service documentation, architectural records, policy standards, support models, recovery runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Govern supplier performance, licensing, support arrangements, lifecycle plans and commercial inputs for resilience platforms and services.

**Stakeholder and leadership communication**

* Provide concise, evidence-based updates to senior leadership on resilience posture, test outcomes, material risks, incidents, investment needs and delivery progress.
* Build effective working relationships across Davies Group technology and business teams, external suppliers and assurance functions.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads, promote standardisation and strengthen recovery ownership across delivery teams.
* Support recruitment, objective setting and performance direction for team members if direct reports are assigned.

**Experience & Education\***  
  
**Essential**

* 9-15 years of relevant experience in enterprise infrastructure, backup, recovery, disaster recovery or technology resilience, including significant senior technical-lead or service-owner responsibility.
* Proven track record of leading backup, resilience and DR capabilities in a large, complex or global organisation.
* Demonstrable experience defining and governing enterprise backup and recovery strategies across hybrid environments.
* Demonstrable experience planning and leading DR exercises, coordinating multi-team recovery activity and driving closure of test findings.
* Experience communicating service posture, risks, incidents, investment needs and remediation progress to senior leadership.
* Experience working across infrastructure, application, security, architecture, service management, business continuity, risk and supplier teams.
* Experience producing governance documentation, service roadmaps, technical standards, recovery playbooks, dashboards and audit evidence.
* Bachelor degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Desirable**

* Experience within insurance, financial services, professional services or another regulated environment.
* Experience supporting organisational integrations, acquisitions, data-centre exits, cloud transformation or major resilience uplift programmes.
* Prior people-leadership, matrix-leadership or supplier-management experience.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**Essential**

* Deep knowledge of enterprise backup architecture, recovery patterns, retention, encryption, immutability, air-gapped or isolated recovery, replication and capacity management.
* Strong working knowledge of Commvault Cloud / Backup & Recovery for Azure, Veeam and Metallic, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure, Windows Server, Linux, VMware or other virtualisation, storage, databases, networking, identity and cloud-native protection patterns.
* Expert understanding of RPO, RTO, service criticality, dependency mapping, recovery sequencing, DR testing and cyber-recovery principles.
* Ability to convert business and regulatory requirements into pragmatic engineering controls, service levels, test plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong governance, risk management, problem management, change control and major-incident leadership capability.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify systemic weaknesses from operational data and drive sustainable corrective action.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief senior leadership and explain complex resilience risks in business terms.
* Ability to lead through influence across geographically dispersed teams and competing priorities.
* Strong documentation discipline and commitment to accurate, audit-ready evidence.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of Azure Site Recovery, cloud-native backup services and recovery automation.
* Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST guidance and relevant resilience or operational-risk expectations.
* Understanding of AIOps, anomaly detection and predictive analytics for backup and resilience monitoring.

**Essential requirement (non-negotiable) \***

* Proven ability to own enterprise backup, recovery, DR and resilience outcomes across a complex, multi-team technology estate.
* 9-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of resilience or recovery services for a large organisation.
* Availability to support planned DR exercises, major incidents and critical recovery activity outside normal working hours when required.
* Ability to communicate confidently with senior leadership, auditors, risk stakeholders and technical teams.
* Willingness to challenge control weaknesses, maintain clear accountability and escalate material risk appropriately.
* Strong commitment to data protection, service reliability, security and continual improvement.

**Essential / preferred**

* Relevant enterprise backup certification, such as Commvault Certified Professional or Veeam Certified Engineer / Architect, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.

**Desirable**

* Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
* Business continuity or resilience certification such as CBCI or CBCP.
* Security or governance certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or ISO 22301 / ISO 27001 practitioner or lead implementer / auditor.

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Project Implementation Engineer - Construction Product
description:
Role summary

The Visual Planning Product Implementation Specialist- trains project teams on NirmaanXD, sets up projects on the platform, and supports them through execution. The role owns the model-to-schedule link on each project: auditing the model, configuring it, building activity templates, and keeping the model current as the project moves.

About the Visual Planning Product - NirmaanXD

NirmaanXD is vConstruct's model-based construction planning and production tracking platform. It connects BIM models (Revit, IFC, Navisworks) to the construction schedule: model-based WBS creation, quantity-backed activity durations, 4D visualization, field-ready lookaheads, and progress tracking. Schedules exchange with Primavera P6 and MS Project through XML import/export.

Key responsibilities

Product training and onboarding

* Deliver NirmaanXD training to project teams: VDC, planners and schedulers, project engineers, superintendents, and trade partners.
* Onboard new users and projects; tailor sessions to each role's workflow.
* Maintain training material and act as first-line product support for assigned projects.

Project setup

* Model audit: review incoming models in Navisworks or similar tools and decide whether each model is usable as-is or needs modification. Check element categorization, parameters, levels and zones, naming, completeness, and level of detail against NirmaanXD's requirements.
* Document audit findings and the remediation required, with owner and timeline.
* Model configuration: set up element filtering and exclusion rules, WBS mapping, and location or zone breakdown.
* Activity template configuration: build activity mapping rules, quantity links, and production rates aligned to the project schedule.

Implementation support

* Support project teams through execution: model updates and re-imports, schedule alignment, lookaheads, and progress tracking setup.
* Troubleshoot data and configuration issues; escalate product defects to the NirmaanXD product team with clear reproduction steps.
* Capture user feedback and feature requests from projects.

Model queries

* Resolve model-related questions from project teams: missing or misclassified elements, quantity discrepancies, mapping gaps.
* Trace issues to source (model, configuration, or schedule) and fix or route them.

Project meetings

* Attend and lead weekly project meetings: Project Kick-off, Scope alignment, timeline, project setup and onboarding, open model and configuration issues, lookahead reviews, progress status.
* Track action items to closure.

Model changes

* Make model changes needed for NirmaanXD: add or correct parameters, split elements by pour or zone, reclassify elements, and fix naming.
* Coordinate larger changes with the model author.

Required skills

* Working understanding of BIM and VDC processes: model coordination, model structure, and how models feed downstream construction workflows.
* Hands-on experience performing model audits in Navisworks or similar tools: search and selection sets, property review, completeness checks.
* Ability to edit model data at least at the property and selection level to support configuration.
* Clear spoken and written English for training delivery and client-facing meetings with US project teams.
* Model authoring experience in Revit, Tekla, or similar tools.

Good-to-have skills

* Planning or scheduling experience: CPM scheduling in Primavera P6 or MS Project, WBS development, lookahead planning.
* Exposure to lean planning methods (Last Planner System, pull planning, TAKT) or 4D tools (Synchro, Navisworks TimeLiner).
* Quantity takeoff from models and familiarity with production rates by trade.
* Experience supporting US construction projects or field teams.

Competency

* Training delivery: explains a model-based workflow to users with no BIM background, including superintendents and trade foremen.
* Structured problem solving: isolates whether an issue sits in the model, the configuration, or the schedule before acting.
* Meeting ownership: runs a weekly meeting to an agenda, drives decisions, and closes actions.
* Data discipline: documents audit findings, configuration decisions, and model changes so another specialist can pick up the project.
* Product feedback: reports defects and gaps to the product team with evidence, not anecdotes

title: Senior Lead Associate - Backup, Resilience and DR
description:
### **Description**

  

* The Senior Lead Associate - Backup, Resilience and DR is the service owner and senior technical authority for enterprise backup, recovery, disaster recovery and technology resilience across the Davies Group estate. Reporting to the Manager - Security, Resilience and DR, the role leads the strategy, governance, engineering direction and operational assurance required to protect critical services and data across on-premises, cloud and SaaS environments.
* The role works across Hosting, Cloud, Network, Security Operations, IAM, Digital Workplace, Service Management, Architecture, Applications, Data, Risk, Compliance, Business Continuity, Procurement and third-party providers. It translates business impact and risk requirements into tested recovery capabilities, clear recovery objectives, measurable controls and leadership-level assurance.
* This is a senior individual-contributor / technical-lead role that may or may not have direct reports. Irrespective of line-management responsibility, the postholder is expected to lead through influence, set standards, coordinate delivery across multiple teams, challenge weak controls and provide clear updates to senior leadership.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy, ownership and governance**

* Own the group-wide backup, recovery, disaster recovery and technology resilience service roadmap, operating model, standards and control framework.
* Define target-state capabilities, service tiers and improvement priorities aligned to business criticality, risk appetite, architecture standards and regulatory obligations.
* Establish clear accountability across infrastructure, application and business service owners for backup coverage, recovery design, testing, evidence and remediation.
* Chair or lead resilience governance forums, track decisions and exceptions, and escalate material risks with clear options and recommended actions.

**Backup and recovery leadership**

* Provide technical and service leadership for enterprise backup platforms across on-premises, Azure and other approved cloud or SaaS environments.
* Govern backup policies, schedules, retention, encryption, immutability, access controls, capacity, performance and secure off-site or isolated recovery copies.
* Ensure critical workloads, databases, virtual platforms, file services, cloud resources and relevant SaaS data are identified, protected and recoverable.
* Lead restoration assurance through risk-based restore testing, integrity validation and evidence that recovery outcomes meet approved requirements.
* Drive remediation of failed, missed or degraded backups and recurring defects, with root-cause analysis, ownership and prevention actions.

**Disaster recovery and resilience**

* Own the technology DR lifecycle, including service dependency mapping, recovery strategies, DR plans, runbooks, exercise schedules, test scenarios, evidence and post-exercise improvement plans.
* Partner with Business Continuity, service owners and application teams to translate business impact analysis into achievable recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Lead tabletop, component, application and end-to-end recovery exercises, including cyber-recovery and loss-of-platform scenarios where applicable.
* Coordinate technical recovery during major incidents or declared disasters, providing decision support, status reporting, risk escalation and recovery sequencing.
* Validate resilience for new services, major changes, acquisitions and migrations before production acceptance.

**Security, risk and compliance**

* Work with Security Operations and IAM to protect backup administration, credentials and recovery environments using least privilege, segregation of duties and strong authentication.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence for backup execution, restore results, DR tests, exceptions, risk acceptance and remediation.
* Assess resilience risks arising from ransomware, platform concentration, third-party dependency, data corruption, regional outage, capacity constraint and technology obsolescence.
* Ensure control gaps and overdue remediation are visible through the appropriate risk, change and service-governance processes.

**Service performance and continual improvement**

* Define and report meaningful KPIs and KRIs, including backup success, restore success, protection coverage, recovery objective attainment, test completion, open risks and remediation ageing.
* Use trend analysis, automation and monitoring to reduce manual effort, improve early warning and prevent repeat failures.
* Maintain service documentation, architectural records, policy standards, support models, recovery runbooks and knowledge articles.
* Govern supplier performance, licensing, support arrangements, lifecycle plans and commercial inputs for resilience platforms and services.

**Stakeholder and leadership communication**

* Provide concise, evidence-based updates to senior leadership on resilience posture, test outcomes, material risks, incidents, investment needs and delivery progress.
* Build effective working relationships across Davies Group technology and business teams, external suppliers and assurance functions.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads, promote standardisation and strengthen recovery ownership across delivery teams.
* Support recruitment, objective setting and performance direction for team members if direct reports are assigned.

**Experience & Education\***  
  
**Essential**

* 9-15 years of relevant experience in enterprise infrastructure, backup, recovery, disaster recovery or technology resilience, including significant senior technical-lead or service-owner responsibility.
* Proven track record of leading backup, resilience and DR capabilities in a large, complex or global organisation.
* Demonstrable experience defining and governing enterprise backup and recovery strategies across hybrid environments.
* Demonstrable experience planning and leading DR exercises, coordinating multi-team recovery activity and driving closure of test findings.
* Experience communicating service posture, risks, incidents, investment needs and remediation progress to senior leadership.
* Experience working across infrastructure, application, security, architecture, service management, business continuity, risk and supplier teams.
* Experience producing governance documentation, service roadmaps, technical standards, recovery playbooks, dashboards and audit evidence.
* Bachelor degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related field.

**Desirable**

* Experience within insurance, financial services, professional services or another regulated environment.
* Experience supporting organisational integrations, acquisitions, data-centre exits, cloud transformation or major resilience uplift programmes.
* Prior people-leadership, matrix-leadership or supplier-management experience.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

**Essential**

* Deep knowledge of enterprise backup architecture, recovery patterns, retention, encryption, immutability, air-gapped or isolated recovery, replication and capacity management.
* Strong working knowledge of Commvault Cloud / Backup & Recovery for Azure, Veeam and Metallic, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Azure, Windows Server, Linux, VMware or other virtualisation, storage, databases, networking, identity and cloud-native protection patterns.
* Expert understanding of RPO, RTO, service criticality, dependency mapping, recovery sequencing, DR testing and cyber-recovery principles.
* Ability to convert business and regulatory requirements into pragmatic engineering controls, service levels, test plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong governance, risk management, problem management, change control and major-incident leadership capability.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify systemic weaknesses from operational data and drive sustainable corrective action.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief senior leadership and explain complex resilience risks in business terms.
* Ability to lead through influence across geographically dispersed teams and competing priorities.
* Strong documentation discipline and commitment to accurate, audit-ready evidence.

**Desirable**

* Knowledge of Azure Site Recovery, cloud-native backup services and recovery automation.
* Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST guidance and relevant resilience or operational-risk expectations.
* Understanding of AIOps, anomaly detection and predictive analytics for backup and resilience monitoring.

**Essential requirement (non-negotiable) \***

* Proven ability to own enterprise backup, recovery, DR and resilience outcomes across a complex, multi-team technology estate.
* 9-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of resilience or recovery services for a large organisation.
* Availability to support planned DR exercises, major incidents and critical recovery activity outside normal working hours when required.
* Ability to communicate confidently with senior leadership, auditors, risk stakeholders and technical teams.
* Willingness to challenge control weaknesses, maintain clear accountability and escalate material risk appropriately.
* Strong commitment to data protection, service reliability, security and continual improvement.

**Essential / preferred**

* Relevant enterprise backup certification, such as Commvault Certified Professional or Veeam Certified Engineer / Architect, or equivalent demonstrable expertise.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.

**Desirable**

* Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
* Business continuity or resilience certification such as CBCI or CBCP.
* Security or governance certification such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or ISO 22301 / ISO 27001 practitioner or lead implementer / auditor.

### **About Davies**

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  
  
We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation & risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation & change management.  
  
Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK & the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20-fold, investing heavily in research & development, innovation & automation, colleague development, and client service. Today the group serves more than 1,500 insurance, financial services, public sector, and other highly regulated clients.

title: Technical Support Executive (Vicidal)
description:
Winet Infratel is a technology company working across telecom, VoIP, EV charging infrastructure and IT services. Our VoIP practice designs, deploys and supports ViciDial and Asterisk-based contact-centre platforms for clients ranging from small inbound teams to multi-server, 100+ agent outbound clusters. More details on the product can be obtained at https://next2call.com.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Support Executive to install, configure, monitor and troubleshoot ViciDial contact-centre systems for our clients. You will be the first line of technical support for client supervisors and agents, resolve telephony and dialer issues quickly, and work with our senior engineers on deployments, upgrades and escalations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ViciDial administration**

* Install and configure ViciDial (ViciBox / scratch install on Rocky/AlmaLinux) on single-server and clustered setups.
* Create and manage campaigns, lists, lead loading, in-groups, DIDs, call menus (IVR), user groups, agents and phones.
* Configure dial methods (RATIO, ADAPT, INBOUND\_MAN, blended), drop/abandon settings, hopper, call times and DNC lists.
* Set up dispositions, scripts, web forms, recording settings and CRM/API integrations (Agent API, Non-Agent API).
* Generate and explain real-time and historical reports (agent performance, campaign stats, drop rates, CDR) for client supervisors.

**Telephony, SIP & Asterisk**

* Configure SIP trunks/carriers, dial plans, outbound CID and inbound DID routing.
* Troubleshoot one-way/no audio, call drops, registration failures, NAT, codec and DTMF issues.
* Use Asterisk CLI, sngrep, tcpdump and SIP traces to diagnose call-flow problems.
* Support softphones (Zoiper, MicroSIP, WebRTC/ViciPhone) and IP phones at agent desks.

**Linux, database & server health**

* Perform routine Linux administration: services, logs, cron, disk/CPU/memory checks, firewall (firewalld/iptables) and fail2ban.
* Run basic MySQL/MariaDB queries for lead lookups, data fixes and report extraction; manage backups and restores.
* Monitor server load, replication and keepalive processes across cluster nodes; flag capacity issues early.
* Apply updates and security hardening under the guidance of senior engineers.

**Client support & coordination**

* Respond to client tickets, calls and WhatsApp/email support requests within agreed SLAs.
* Diagnose and resolve L1/L2 issues; escalate L3 issues with clear logs and reproduction steps.
* Coordinate with carriers/ITSPs on trunk, routing and quality issues.
* Train client supervisors and agents on ViciDial usage, agent screen and reports.
* Visit client sites when needed for go-live, network checks or agent-floor support.

**Documentation**

* Maintain configuration records, network/IP details and change logs for every client.
* Write SOPs, troubleshooting notes and go-live checklists.
* Keep tickets updated with root cause and resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc (IT/CS/Electronics) or equivalent.
* 1–3 years of hands-on experience with ViciDial or Asterisk-based dialers.
* Working knowledge of SIP, RTP, codecs (G.711, G.729), NAT and basic call-flow concepts.
* Comfortable on the Linux command line (CentOS/Rocky/AlmaLinux).
* Basic MySQL/MariaDB skills (SELECT, UPDATE, export).
* Understanding of networking basics: IP addressing, VLANs, ports, firewalls, VPN.
* Good written and spoken communication in English and Hindi (regional language a plus).

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience with multi-server ViciDial clusters (DB, web and telephony separation).
* Asterisk dialplan (extensions.conf) and AGI scripting knowledge.
* Shell or PHP/Python scripting for automation.
* Experience with Issabel, FreePBX, or other PBX platforms.
* Familiarity with TRAI/DoT telemarketing regulations and DND/DLT compliance.
* Certifications such as dCAP, CCNA, RHCSA or equivalent.

**Soft Skills**

* Calm, methodical approach to troubleshooting under pressure (live call-centre floors).
* Customer-first attitude with clear, patient communication.
* Ownership of issues until closure; disciplined about documentation.
* Willingness to learn and to work in rotational shifts.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* First-response and resolution time against client SLAs.
* Ticket closure rate and repeat-issue rate.
* System uptime and call-quality metrics for supported clients.
* Client feedback / CSAT.
* Quality and completeness of documentation.

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on exposure to live contact-centre deployments, telecom and VoIP infrastructure.
* Mentoring from senior VoIP engineers and a clear growth path to VoIP Engineer / Solutions Engineer.
* Opportunity to work across telecom, EV charging and IT services projects.

The Salesforce Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for the ongoing operation, enhancement, and engineering of the Salesforce platform. This position combines Salesforce development expertise with platform administration responsibilities to ensure a stable, efficient, and scalable environment.

The role focuses on applying engineering best practices to automate routine administrative and deployment activities, minimizing manual effort and operational risk while enabling reliable, version-controlled delivery through robust CI/CD processes.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, and Salesforce Developers, the Salesforce Engineer translates business requirements into scalable, sustainable technical solutions. In addition, the role supports the growth and technical management of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including platform operations, data management, user support, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* Own core Salesforce administration activities including user management, permissions, security, configuration, data quality and declarative automation using Flow.
* Identify repeatable manual administration and deployment activities and automate them where practical using Salesforce metadata, APIs, scripting and engineering tooling.
* Develop and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and other appropriate Salesforce technologies.
* Develop and support integrations using Salesforce REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies.
* Use Git, sandboxes and CI/CD processes for version control, validation, testing and deployment, helping to reduce manual release steps and deployment risk.
* Support and improve Salesforce platform reliability, maintainability, governance and technical best practice.
* Work directly with business users to understand requirements, resolve platform issues and translate needs into high-quality, scalable solutions.
* Carry out general Salesforce platform activities including validation rules, queues, assignment rules, templates, data migration, reports and dashboards.
* Integrate, maintain and administer business applications connected to Salesforce, such as Formstack, Survey Monkey, SMS Magic and RIO.
* Raise, monitor and resolve support cases with Salesforce Support and assist with Salesforce-related Service Desk tickets.
* Develop capability in Salesforce Marketing Cloud and progressively support Journey Builder, user management, data extensions, lists, data quality, platform support and governance.
* Support and maintain data synchronisation between Salesforce CRM and Marketing Cloud, working with business teams to ensure data is accurate and appropriately governed.
* Support business users in the effective use of Marketing Cloud while business teams retain ownership of campaign content and marketing decisions.
* Collaborate with Salesforce Developers, Solution Architects and other IT teams on integrations, platform improvements and delivery.
* Maintain appropriate technical and operational documentation and follow Salesforce engineering, security and release best practices.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Salesforce Platform Developer I or equivalent demonstrable development experience.
* Salesforce Administrator certification or strong demonstrable Salesforce administration capability is desirable.
* Marketing Cloud certification is desirable but not required.
* Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, SOQL and Lightning technologies.
* Practical Salesforce administration experience including users, permissions, security, objects, fields, configuration and Flow.
* Experience working with integrations and APIs, including REST and/or SOAP.
* Experience using Git and working within a structured deployment or CI/CD process.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable technical or administrative activities.
* Strong engineering and problem-solving mindset, with a focus on automation, reliability and continuous improvement.
* Data management and relational database knowledge, including data formats, joins and ETL concepts.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce development, deployment and platform best practices.

The Principal Technical Architect provides technical leadership for complex data and analytics solutions across multiple programs and business domains. The architect combines strong solution design expertise with practical technical depth to ensure architecture standards, patterns, and best practices are successfully implemented in delivery.

* Define solution architecture direction, standards, and reference patterns for complex data and analytics initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles.

* Partner with Data Governance and Security teams to embed data privacy, access control, and compliance requirements into solution designs.
* Lead proof-of-concepts and technical evaluations for new platforms, frameworks, advanced analytics capabilities, and architectural approaches to determine business applicability and architectural fit.
* Partner with engineering teams to resolve complex performance, quality, scalability, reliability, integration, and operational challenges.
* Provide technical mentorship to engineers and architects through active engagement in solution design, implementation planning, and delivery reviews.
* Create, maintain and represent architecture documentation, standards, and decision records for the Data and Analytics vertical.

**Knowledge and Capabilities:**

* Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture, including data warehousing, Lakehouse, and real-time streaming architecture.

* Ability to design solutions that balance scalability, performance, cost, and maintainability.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills applied to ambiguous, cross-functional technical challenges.
* Effectively communicates architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and executive audiences.
* Builds credibility and influence across engineering, product, and governance teams without direct authority.
* Proven capability to influence technical decisions through expertise, collaboration, and hands-on technical leadership rather than formal authority.
* Stays current with industry trends and emerging technologies relevant to data and analytics architecture.

**Preferred Skills / Engineering tools:**

* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and Lakehouse technologies, including Azure Data Services, Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, or equivalent enterprise analytics platforms.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and modern data engineering concepts, including ETL/ELT, CDC, dimensional modeling, star-schema design, medallion architecture, distributed data processing, and workload performance optimization.
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns and ERP ecosystems such as oracle, JDE, SFDC, SAP S/4HANA, including commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, and finance data domains (modern as well as legacy).
* Experience designing governed data products across bronze, silver, and gold layers, with clear lineage, data quality controls, reconciliation expectations, and consumption-ready semantic layers.
* Experience designing scalable analytics, reporting, semantic model, and business intelligence architectures, including Power BI semantic models, DAX, row-level security, refresh patterns, and performance optimization.

10+ years of experience in data engineering, solution architecture, or technical design roles, including significant architecture ownership.

title: Global Practice Lead – Supply Chain Tech & Transformation PMO
description:
**Create a better future!**
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future.
  
  
**Global Practice Lead – Supply Chain Tech & Transformation PMO**
We are seeking a commercially focused programme leader to shape how strategic supply chain technology initiatives and external partnerships are selected, governed and delivered. The mission is to ensure that investments in systems, integrations and digital capabilities move from business case to measurable operational value.
  
  
You are not here simply to manage checklists or produce status reports. You will build the governance, visibility and execution discipline that help programmes move faster, protect business value and respond early when risks, dependencies or partner commitments threaten outcomes.
  
  
Working across operational functions, Digital & IT, Enterprise PMO and external partners, you will connect technology delivery with business priorities. This is an opportunity to influence a strategic enterprise portfolio and establish how future supply chain capabilities are governed and brought to life.
  
  
**Essential Functions & Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
**Build the Business-Centric PMO System: Portfolio Governance (30%)**

* Business-First PMO Architecture: Establish a practical PMO operating system rooted in advanced project and portfolio-management disciplines. Create clear decision rights, stage gates and an intake process that prioritises initiatives based on strategic value, operational impact, feasibility and delivery readiness.
* Outputs: External PMO Governance Handbook, business-aligned chartering standards, partner-integration playbooks, stage-gate framework, decision-rights matrix and central initiative portfolio prioritised by value.

**Protect Business Value: Strategic Execution & Delivery Control (25%)**

* Outcome-Driven Delivery: Establish cross-functional controls focused on business outcomes rather than administrative completion. Connect project milestones, budgets and delivery progress to operational impact, time-to-value and financial performance.
* Outputs: Integrated portfolio roadmap, approved stage-gate records, milestone accountability matrix, benefits-realisation tracker, budget-control report and executive action log.

**Anticipate What Could Disrupt Delivery: Portfolio Risk & Scenarios (20%)**

* Strategic Portfolio Intelligence: Provide early visibility of delivery, budget, capacity, technology and partner risks. Use scenario analysis to assess dependencies, test response options and protect business continuity and value.
* Outputs: Portfolio risk register, partner performance reviews, dependency map, scenario assessments, mitigation playbooks and early-warning reports linked to business impact.

**Shape Critical Decisions: Executive Steering & Partner Alignment (15%)**

* Decision-Ready Programme Leadership: Translate complex programme information into clear decisions, trade-offs and required actions. Align operational priorities, technology roadmaps and external partner commitments through structured governance.
* Outputs: SteerCo packs, portfolio health reviews, decision papers, partner governance packs, escalation summaries and management action trackers.

**Raise Delivery Maturity: PMO Excellence & Talent (10%)**

* Professional PMO Capability: Develop Project Managers and Vendor Integration Specialists while strengthening common standards, commercial awareness and execution discipline across the portfolio.
* Outputs: PMO capability framework, role-based learning plans, professional certification roadmap, standard delivery toolkit, lessons-learned repository and succession pipeline.

**Parameters for Success**

* Strategic Value: Technology initiatives deliver the capabilities and value defined in their approved business cases.
* Execution Reliability: Milestones, budgets, dependencies and partner commitments remain visible and controlled.
* Risk Protection: Critical delivery risks are identified and addressed before materially affecting business outcomes.
* Decision Quality: Portfolio priorities, trade-offs and investment choices are supported by trusted evidence.
* Partner Performance: External partners remain accountable for delivery, quality, value and agreed commitments.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Technology, Business Administration or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Minimum 10-15 years of experience in enterprise PMO, portfolio strategy, technology transformation or complex external integrations.
* Proven experience connecting technology programmes to measurable operational and financial outcomes.
* Experience governing external vendors, strategic partners and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to protect governance while enabling business speed.

**Technical & Certifications**

* PMP certification required.
* PgMP or PfMP certification preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of portfolio management, stage gates, risk governance and value tracking.
* Experience with enterprise PMO systems and AI-enabled project tracking.
* Understanding of EPICOR, Coupa, D365 or equivalent enterprise platforms.

**Personal Capabilities**

* Strong commercial and business judgement.
* Clear executive communication without unnecessary PMO jargon.
* Confident negotiation and partner management.
* Structured thinking and decisive escalation.
* Ability to balance delivery speed, risk, value and governance.

**What We Offer**

* A global and inclusive workplace focused on sustainability and innovation
* Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities
* Competitive benefit package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options

We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. In our commitment to equal opportunity and eliminating bias, we kindly request that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, marital status, number of children, and photographs from your application materials*

title: Global Practice Lead – Continuous Improvement & Process Intelligence
description:
**Create a better future!**
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future.
  
  
**Global Practice Lead – Continuous Improvement & Process Intelligence**
We are seeking a thoughtful and highly experienced Continuous Improvement leader to shape how operational excellence is delivered across the enterprise. This role brings together proven Lean methodologies, Process Mining, automation and practical AI applications to simplify work, remove structural waste and deliver measurable business value.
  
  
While operational teams focus on daily execution, you will create the improvement system that helps the business understand why recurring delays, rework and manual workarounds occur. You will convert operational experience and process evidence into focused interventions that improve productivity, quality, service, working capital and cost performance.
  
  
The mission extends beyond individual improvement projects. You will build an enterprise capability that moves the business from reactive firefighting to proactive execution, converts local successes into common standards and develops the specialist talent required to sustain continuous improvement and AI-enabled transformation.
  
  
**Essential Functions & Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
**Create the Improvement System: Enterprise CI & AI Governance (30%)**

* Enterprise Improvement Architecture: Own the Continuous Improvement framework, governance model and improvement portfolio. Integrate Lean, Kaizen, Process Mining, automation and practical AI into a common system for identifying, prioritising and delivering improvement opportunities based on business value.
* Outputs: Enterprise CI Governance Handbook, portfolio prioritisation model, benefit-validation framework, Process Mining roadmap, improvement methodology standards and central opportunity portfolio.

**Deliver Measurable Business Value: Operational Transformation (25%)**

* Value-Led Improvement: Lead cross-functional initiatives that address recurring delays, process variation, rework, manual activity and structural inefficiencies. Ensure teams move beyond symptoms, identify root causes and deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.
* Outputs: Approved improvement charters, root-cause assessments, future-state process designs, implementation roadmaps, corrective-action records, validated benefits reports and confirmed P&L savings.

**Scale What Works: Process Intelligence, Automation & AI (20%)**

* AI-Enabled Improvement at Scale: Use Process Mining, operational data and AI-enabled tools to expose hidden waste, identify emerging constraints and guide automation opportunities. Translate proven local improvements into scalable digital processes and common enterprise standards.
* Outputs: Process opportunity heatmaps, automation business cases, predictive intervention models, scalable process standards, portfolio value reports and global deployment plans.

**Shape Leadership Decisions: Portfolio Steering & Business Alignment (15%)**

* Decision-Ready Improvement Leadership: Translate complex process findings into clear business choices, financial implications, delivery risks and recommended actions. Use governance forums to align priorities, remove barriers and maintain accountability for value delivery.
* Outputs: SteerCo packs, decision papers, portfolio health reviews, value-realisation updates, risk escalations and management action trackers.

**Build Future Capability: Talent, Culture & Succession (10%)**

* Specialist Capability Leadership: Develop CI Specialists, Lean Engineers and Process Mining Analysts while building broader confidence in Lean, automation and AI-enabled improvement. Establish succession plans and create a community that shares knowledge and scales proven practices.
* Outputs: Capability framework, role-based learning paths, coaching plans, certification roadmap, specialist development plans, succession pipeline and reusable knowledge library.

**Parameters for Success**

* Business Value: Validated financial and operational benefits delivered through the improvement portfolio.
* Process Performance: Measurable reduction in delays, rework, process variation, manual work and avoidable complexity.
* Digital Enablement: Adoption of Process Mining, automation and AI-enabled improvement solutions.
* Enterprise Scale: Proven improvements translated into repeatable standards and adopted across functions and regions.
* Capability Strength: A strong specialist team, visible succession pipeline and growing improvement maturity across the business.

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Minimum 15-20 years of experience in supply chain operations, manufacturing, Operational Excellence or enterprise transformation.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional improvement programmes under a global mandate.
* Demonstrated delivery of measurable productivity, quality, service and financial improvements.
* Experience integrating Process Mining, automation, analytics or AI into Continuous Improvement practices.

**Technical & Certifications**

* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt required.
* Deep knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, DMAIC, process control and benefits validation.
* Strong working knowledge of Process Mining, automation and AI-enabled improvement tools.
* Understanding of enterprise platforms such as EPICOR, Coupa, D365 or equivalent systems.

**Personal Capabilities**

* Strong business judgement and practical leadership.
* Clear executive communication and constructive influence.
* Ability to simplify complexity and convert evidence into action.
* Confidence to uphold enterprise standards while building collaborative relationships.
* Strong coaching, talent development and succession-planning capability.

**What We Offer**

* A global and inclusive workplace focused on sustainability and innovation
* Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities
* Competitive benefit package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options

*As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is. In our commitment to equal opportunity and eliminating bias, we kindly request that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, marital status, number of children, and photographs from your application materials*
FLSmidth is a full flowsheet technology and service supplier to the global mining industries. We help our customers to improve performance, lower operating costs and reduce environmental impact. – for more information please visit https://fls.com/en
  
  
We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

FLS works alongside mining companies as their performance partner, helping them increase output, improve recovery and maximise uptime. Through full flowsheet technologies, aftermarket services and digital solutions, we improve productivity while reducing energy and water consumption, enabling more sustainable mining operations. www.fls.com

title: BIM Coordinator / Senior BIM Lead
description:
**Summary**

We are looking for an experienced
**BIM Coordinator / Senior BIM Lead**
to own and govern end-to-end Building Information Modeling (BIM) deliverables across our development lifecycle. Acting as the central technical authority between our internal project management team, external design consultants, precast manufacturers, and MEPF contractors, you will drive model accuracy, clash-free coordination, and information compliance from initial concept design (
**LOD 100**
) through precast factory fabrication (
**LOD 400**
) to field-verified As-Built and Facility Management handover (
**LOD 500**
).

**Key Responsibilities**

* **BIM Governance & Execution Planning (ISO 19650).**
  Author, implement, and enforce the project-specific
  **Employer’s Information Requirements (EIR)**
  and
  **BIM Execution Plan (BEP)**
  across all consultants, precast vendors, and subcontractors.
* **Design Consultant Auditing (LOD 100 – LOD 350).**
  Audit and validate Architectural, Structural, and MEPF models submitted by external design consultants at every stage gate to ensure geometric accuracy, naming compliance, and constructability before tender or GFC release.
* **Precast & Multi-Discipline Coordination (LOD 350 – LOD 400).**
  Lead weekly multi-discipline clash detection and resolution workshops using
  **Navisworks Manage**
  . Enforce strict
  **MEP freeze milestones**
  prior to precast casting, auditing
  **Tekla Structures**
  models and Cast Unit drawings for exact embedded plates, lifting anchors, grouting sleeves, and MEP penetrations.
* **Construction & Fabrication Oversight (LOD 400).**
  Track precast piece marks, erection sequencing (4D BIM), and shop drawing approvals between design consultants, precast plants, and site execution teams to eliminate on-site rework.
* **As-Built & Asset Handover Management (LOD 500).**
  Oversee the transition from LOD 400 to
  **LOD 500**
  , ensuring all approved site RFIs, redline markups, and field-verified deviations (via laser scan/point cloud or site surveys) are captured. Enforce structured
  **COBie**
  asset data, serial numbers, warranties, and O&M manuals for seamless handover to Facility Management.
* **Common Data Environment (CDE) Administration.**
  Manage project folder structures, model versioning, approval workflows, and issue tracking on
  **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360**
  .
* **Quantity Take-Offs (5D BIM Support).**
  Extract and validate accurate model-based Quantity Take-Offs (QTO) and precast element schedules to support procurement, billing, and cost control teams.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* **Education.**
  Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Civil or Structural Engineering, B.Arch, or equivalent technical qualification with deep construction execution knowledge.
* **Experience.**
  5 to 10 years of progressive BIM experience, including at least 3+ years leading BIM coordination on commercial, residential, or industrial projects involving
  **precast concrete structures**
  .
* **Core Software Proficiency.**
* **Autodesk Revit**
  (Architecture, Structure, MEP) – Advanced model auditing and family standards.
* **Navisworks Manage**
  – Advanced clash matrix setup, rule-based clash detection, and 4D simulation.
* **Tekla Structures**
  – Strong working knowledge of precast elementization, cast-in embeds, MEP sleeves, rebar cages, and IFC coordination.
* **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360**
  – CDE administration and issue management.
* **Standards & Handover Expertise.**
  Proven hands-on experience with
  **ISO 19650**
  workflows, BIMForum LOD specifications (LOD 100–500),
  **COBie**
  data standards, and Scan-to-BIM / As-Built verification protocols.
* **Leadership & Communication.**
  Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to hold external consultants and precast/MEP contractors accountable to project deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working on the
  **Client / Project Developer**
  or
  **PMC**
  side rather than purely in a modeling production role.

description:
**Functional Job Title : Billing Transformation – Product (ORMB) -Assistant Vice President**
**Reports to : BTP VP**
**Department/ Division : Global Delivery, Chennai**
**Job Description: AVP – Product Management**
**Why this role is important to us.**
Global Billing Operations (“GBO”) is responsible for all of State Street’s client billing processes across the globe. The remit spans across Asset Servicing, Alpha, Global Markets, Global Advisors and the Digital division. GBO is undergoing a multi-year transformation spanning people and operating models, processes and controls, data automation and technology.
  
  
State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Global Finance Center under Controllership, which is responsible for Billing Transformation, Client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in India, Poland and China.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
State Street has committed to significantly automating and streamlining the technology and data associated to its varied billing processes. As part of this commitment, there is a dedicated Billing Transformation organization responsible for developing and implementing the appropriate strategy to migrate from legacy, manual processes to a highly automated environment with more robust controls. A significant component of the Transformation team is located in Global Delivery and is responsible for several key areas of implementing the transformation efforts.
  
  
AVP 2 (ORMB Product Management) – GD will be supporting Billing Transformation Product Owner(s), as the team implements billing transformation strategy across Client Set Up Application, Data Hub, and ORMB billing application. The person will be partnering with onshore product owner(s), developing business requirements (FSDs, BRDs and etc.), track, report progress, targets and outcomes linked to target state of product and applications. This role will be responsible for ensuring all product releases, toll gates within agreed timelines, automation, user acceptance testing of applications, system build out validation in line with the strategy and prioritization defined by the Head of Billing Transformation to achieve the goals of migration to the single, Oracle based billing platform (ORMB).
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Actively participate/contribute to Product workshops along with Product owner, Stakeholders and IT partners.
* Create user stories/Business requirements as needed and work with IT partners to scope those requirements for the future product releases and to document/track the backlog for future releases.
* Work with the product end user teams to identify pain points or tasks that can be automated to reduce the client onboarding/setup duration. Triage with the product owner to add the requirements to the backlog and track them to closure.
* Working knowledge of JIRA / Confluence and Agile / Waterfall methodologies is a must.
* Work across the project/BAU teams of business and technology to analyze and explain any issues/solutions pertaining to the billing product.

* Develop the team to adopt "owner's mind set", work independently, and effectively manage timelines
* Manage/collaborate with resources to assist with ad-hoc projects and new activities to support the GBO controller group and program
* Evolve process for Billing Transformation, performing managerial reasonableness reviews and discussing reporting & analytics deliverables prepared by the team.
* Provide support to key stakeholders of the team to present analytical results, triage findings and identify solutions
* First point of escalation within the local reporting line for dealing with issues (people/process/technology) and ensuring that compliance requirements are adhered to (e.g. company policies surrounding standard of conduct, information security, employment regulations)
* Coaches Strong collaboration with the team and works with onshore leadership to establish the team member goals and gather feedback for performance appraisals.
* Ensure completion of deliverables within the committed timeframe including assistance with development of deliverable plans.
* Promote risk excellence culture and looking at opportunities for continuous improvement.

**What We Value**

* Attention to detail, ownership and accountability
* Ability to navigate and partner with various stakeholders
* Ability to lead teams and manage cross functional domain teams
* Ability to communicate and above-par presentation skills
* Positive attitude, organized, self-starter, with a history of contributing to a successful, diverse team
* Demonstrated experience of multi-tasking and effective time management with attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to influence across siloes and work with broader teams and a collaborative attitude

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in IT/Product Management with an experience minimum of 12 to 15 years working with in Financial/Global Services Organization /Investment banking related IT Industry
* Worked as a product owner, Product specialist or product design owner in a global multi-faceted function.
* Well versed with billing processes in corporate environment
* Exposure to Financial services industry
* Experience within global projects/stakeholders and global organizations
* Complex operational setting involving analysis of financial data
* Engaged in business or migration/conversion processes

**Additional Requirements**

* Experience in setting up managing, people, managing and tracking deliverables, setting up reporting cadence ability to summarize – and provide status to key stakeholders

title: Head of Enterprise Strategy & Administration
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Capability Expansion**

* Develop and execute the strategy to expand Chennai-based enterprise capabilities across First Line Risk & Controls, Controls Quality Assurance Testing, Marketing, and Customer Experience, aligned with enterprise priorities and functional objectives.
* Translate identified opportunities into near-term tactical priorities and a strategic, multi-year roadmap that increases GCC penetration, capability depth, organizational scale, and enterprise impact.
* Position USBIPL as a strategic delivery partner for these enterprise capabilities by developing compelling business cases, demonstrating measurable value, and building stakeholder confidence in Chennai delivery.
* Build governance and stakeholder routines to sustain the expansion agenda, track delivery outcomes, and identify the next set of opportunities across First Line Risk & Controls, Controls Quality Assurance Testing, Marketing, and Customer Experience.

**GCC Functional Support & Administration**

* Establish and manage Corporate Real Estate & Procurement, Public Affairs, and Communications capabilities to provide reliable, ongoing support to USBIPL and its employees.
* Define the operating model, service scope, governance, service standards, and accountability mechanisms for each GCC support function.
* Oversee day-to-day delivery across Corporate Real Estate & Procurement, Public Affairs, and Communications, using clear service metrics and data-driven performance management.
* Partner with enterprise functional leaders and local stakeholders to ensure GCC support services remain responsive to evolving business, employee, regulatory, and workplace needs.
* Ensure these support capabilities are scalable, well controlled, financially disciplined, and integrated with U.S. Bank enterprise standards and USBIPL priorities.

**Financial Management & Resource Optimization**

* Own the financial performance of the Enterprise Strategy & Administration organization within USBIPL.
* Develop and manage annual operating plans, budgets, workforce strategies, and headcount plans aligned to business growth objectives.
* Ensure disciplined management of operating expenses, investments, and resource allocation across the organization.
* Understand and actively manage the operational and financial levers that influence performance, including productivity, capacity utilization, automation, workforce mix; service levels, and location economics.
* Establish robust forecasting, workforce planning, financial reporting, and governance routines to drive transparency and accountability.
* Deliver efficiency improvements while balancing customer experience, operational performance, talent investment, growth, and risk management.

**Transformation & Innovation**

* Lead the transformation and capability-building agenda for Enterprise Strategy & Administration within USBIPL in alignment with the broader enterprise strategy.
* Drive initiatives leveraging automation, artificial intelligence, digital capabilities, analytics, process reengineering, and operating model simplification.
* Partner with Technology, Data, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Operations leaders to modernize workflows and improve enterprise outcomes.

**Risk, Controls & Governance**

* Establish and maintain a strong first-line risk management and control culture across all functions supported from Chennai.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, enterprise policies, audit standards, controls testing requirements, and operational control frameworks.
* Proactively identify operational and enterprise risks and establish sustainable preventive and detective controls.
* Partner closely with Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and enterprise control partners to strengthen governance, issue management, controls testing, and risk oversight.
* Embed risk awareness, control discipline, and accountability into day-to-day operational management and decision-making.

**Stakeholder Management & Enterprise Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior Enterprise Strategy & Administration stakeholders across First Line Risk & Controls, Controls Quality Assurance Testing, Marketing, and Customer Experience, while partnering with Corporate Real Estate & Procurement, Public Affairs, and Communications leaders to establish and sustain effective GCC support.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives requiring alignment across businesses, functions, and geographies.
* Act as a connector across teams to remove barriers, accelerate execution, and deliver enterprise outcomes.
* Establish governance forums and operating routines that foster transparency, accountability, and collaboration.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing organization that can scale enterprise delivery capabilities while providing reliable, ongoing functional support to USBIPL.
* Be a talent magnet who attracts, develops, and retains strong talent across operations, transformation, analytics, and leadership roles.
* Drive employee engagement and foster an inclusive culture grounded in collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Champion succession planning, leadership development, workforce capability building, and internal mobility.
* Serve as a cultural ambassador for U.S. Bank, ensuring its values, leadership expectations, and customer-focused culture are consistently reflected within USBIPL.

**Customer-Focused Leadership**

* Champion a customer-first mindset across all supported functions.
* Ensure operational strategies and decisions improve outcomes for customers and business partners.
* Drive measurable improvements in service quality, customer experience, and process effectiveness.
* Balance customer experience with operational efficiency, financial performance, risk management, and business growth objectives.

title: Founding Engineer - Delivery
description:
We're looking for someone who wants to run delivery like it's their own company — not manage tickets, but own outcomes. You'll sit at the center of client relationships, technical architecture, and team growth. This isn't a management role in the corporate sense — it's a build-and-own role for someone hands-on who's ready to stop being told what to build and start deciding it.

If you've been doing solid work for 5-8 years but feel like you're capped, coasting, or just executing someone else's roadmap — this is the opposite of that.

**What you will own.**

* **Client relationships**

  — run requirement calls directly, translate business needs into technical specs without a middleman
* **Architecture decisions**

  — make the calls on how things get built, not just how they get coded
* **Code quality**

  — review the team's work, set the bar
* **Team growth**

  — unblock junior developers, mentor them into stronger engineers
* **Hands-on development**

  — when bandwidth allows, build features yourself; this isn't a pure-management seat
* **Project health**

  — track delivery status, catch issues before the client does, fix them fast

**What we are looking for**

* 5-8 years of full-stack experience (MERN preferred); comfortable across the stack, not siloed
* Real client-facing experience — you've sat in requirement calls and owned the outcome, not relayed messages
* A track record of
  **building and owning**

  something end-to-end — not just maintaining what others designed
* Startup or small-team background preferred — you're used to ambiguity, not process for its own sake
* Some experience mentoring or leading other developers, even informally
* Still writes code regularly — if you haven't shipped anything hands-on in 2+ years, this isn't the fit
* Low job-hop history — we're looking for someone who wants to build something over years, not months

**What this isn't**

* Not a pure people-management role — you'll still write code
* Not a ticket-execution job — we want judgment, not just delivery against a spec
* Not a place for "20 years of experience, comfortable in my lane" — if the title matters more to you than the ownership, this probably isn't it

**Compensation**

Competitive, based on experience — with room to grow as the role and the company do.

**Location**

Chennai, in-office.

title: Analyst - SP Product Control
description:
Date live: 11/13/2026

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Finance

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000133051

  

Join Barclays as an Analyst - SP Product Control, where you'll play a pivotal role in working with Line PC team for completeness and accuracy of the books and records that comprises of P&L (Profit & Loss) and Balance Sheet substantiation and reporting. At Barclays, we believe in the power of innovation. Your role will be responsible for monitoring trading activity for compliance with various related policies and providing management with technical and operational analysis of the business unit. You will have the opportunity of working closely with Front Office business, Financial Control, Technical Accounting Group, PC Change Management, Technology, and other infrastructure area.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should have:

  
  

* Experienced with MS office toolkit.
* Qualified accountant.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings & ability to interact with the region and UK / US as part of a global team (written and verbal).
* strong control awareness – in particular, the ability to identify and escalate potential control breakdowns and to streamline processes in an effective and efficient manner.
  

  

Some other highly values skills include:

  
  

* Financial engineering would be an advantage.
* Article ship / Industrial trainee in mid to large sized firms.
* Audit exposure in large financial institutions / banks preferred.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

This role will be based out of Chennai and Pune.

**Purpose of the role**

To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.

**Accountabilities**

* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
