title: Data Entry and MIS Analyst
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

The Data Entry & MIS Analyst will support GEM Drytech's Sales, Marketing, and Management teams by researching, extracting, validating, organizing, analyzing, and maintaining high-quality prospect and business data.

The role will also be responsible for preparing and maintaining accurate **MIS reports, dashboards, trackers, sales reports, lead-generation reports, campaign reports, and management summaries** to support better business decision-making.

The position combines data management, online research, MIS reporting, AI-enabled productivity tools, client communication support, and structured outbound communication through email, WhatsApp, and CRM-based follow-up to improve lead-generation efficiency for industrial drying and process-equipment markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Research and identify relevant companies, industries, decision-makers, and contact persons using LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, company websites, online directories, search engines, AI research tools, and approved databases.

· Extract and maintain structured prospect data including company name, contact person, designation, location, industry, email ID, phone/WhatsApp number, LinkedIn profile, website, application, lead source, and other relevant sales intelligence.

· Source and verify business email IDs and contact information through approved tools such as Apollo, Snov.io, Skrapp, Hunter, LinkedIn, and manual web research, with strong emphasis on accuracy and data validity.

· Enter, update, validate, clean, and maintain prospect and client data in MS Excel, Google Sheets, CRM/ERP systems, internal trackers, and campaign databases.

· Perform duplicate removal, formatting, data cleansing, bounced-email cleanup, invalid-contact identification, and periodic database hygiene to maintain usable and reliable lead lists.

· Prepare and maintain **daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports** for Sales, Marketing, Lead Generation, Outreach, CRM activities, and other assigned business functions.

· Develop and maintain **Excel/Google Sheets dashboards, trackers, pivot tables, summary reports, lead-source reports, salesperson-wise reports, campaign-performance reports, and management MIS**.

· Consolidate data from multiple sources and prepare accurate management reports showing targets vs achievements, pending activities, lead status, outreach performance, conversion status, and other defined KPIs.

· Use formulas including **VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, SUMIF/SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, data validation, filters, and other Excel functions** required for MIS preparation and data analysis.

· Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, missing entries, unusual variances, duplicate records, and reporting errors and coordinate with responsible teams for correction.

· Maintain standardized reporting formats, naming conventions, master databases, MIS templates, and management trackers.

· Use AI-enabled research and productivity tools to accelerate company research, prospect classification, data enrichment, contact prioritization, spreadsheet analysis, reporting, and preparation of structured summaries while ensuring human verification before final use.

· Support outbound email campaigns by preparing clean contact lists, applying approved templates, personalizing basic fields, scheduling or sending approved campaigns, and recording outreach status in CRM/trackers.

· Support WhatsApp outreach using approved templates and contact lists, and coordinate responses or qualified interest with the responsible Sales Executive / Sales Manager.

· Handle professional email correspondence with prospects or clients for basic information, acknowledgements, follow-up, document sharing, and coordination within approved communication templates and escalation guidelines.

· Coordinate with Sales and Marketing teams to understand target industries, geographies, customer profiles, priority applications, campaign requirements, reporting requirements, and management KPIs before starting research or outreach activities.

· Maintain accurate CRM/MIS records for new contacts, outreach attempts, responses, follow-ups, lead status, source, campaign, assigned salesperson, and opportunity progression.

· Prepare daily and weekly activity reports covering contacts researched, valid emails sourced, data uploaded, emails/WhatsApp messages sent, responses received, invalid data removed, CRM updates, pending actions, and team performance where applicable.

· Support Management with ad-hoc MIS reports, data analysis, database summaries, comparison reports, and information required for business reviews and decision-making.

· Protect company databases, prospect information, client records, campaign lists, MIS reports, credentials, and confidential business data in accordance with company policy.

· Meet defined productivity and quality KPIs, including approximately **25–30 researched leads per working day, 100–150 valid prospect records per week, 80%+ verified email availability where applicable, 60–100 approved emails per day / 300+ per week, 50–100 WhatsApp outreach messages per week, 100% timely CRM/MIS updates, and weekly data cleanup.**

**Mandatory Requirements**

· 1–2 years of experience in **MIS, data research, data management, lead generation, sales support, client service, back-office operations, reporting, outreach, or related roles**. Strong freshers with relevant MIS and tool exposure may also be considered.

· Strong working knowledge of **MS Excel and Google Sheets**, including formatting, sorting, filtering, duplicate removal, data validation, conditional formatting, basic and intermediate formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, COUNTIF/COUNTIFS, SUMIF/SUMIFS, Pivot Tables, and structured data handling.

· Practical knowledge of **MIS reporting**, including preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly reports, management trackers, KPI reports, dashboards, target-vs-achievement reports, and summary reports.

· Ability to consolidate data from different Excel sheets, Google Sheets, CRM systems, and internal databases and convert the data into structured management reports.

· Good internet research capability and the ability to identify correct companies, relevant decision-makers, business roles, and credible contact information from multiple sources.

· Working familiarity with LinkedIn and online research. Ability to learn or use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Snov.io, Skrapp, Hunter, mail-merge tools, or similar lead-research platforms.

· Good written English and professional email communication skills, with the ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct business correspondence.

· High attention to detail, numerical accuracy, data consistency, confidentiality, and the ability to work with large volumes of repetitive information without compromising quality.

· Ability to follow SOPs, templates, MIS formats, naming conventions, campaign instructions, reporting timelines, and daily/weekly targets with disciplined execution and minimal supervision.

· Working knowledge of MS Word, PowerPoint, Outlook/Gmail, PDF handling, file management, and basic CRM or sales-tracking systems.

· Ability to work independently as well as coordinate effectively with Marketing, Sales, Management, Accounts, HR, or other departments where MIS information is required.

**Preferred Requirements**

· Previous experience in B2B lead generation, MIS reporting, industrial / engineering / manufacturing companies, technical sales support, export marketing, or capital-goods businesses will be preferred.

· Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Snov.io, Skrapp, Hunter, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Smartlead, Mailchimp, Gmail mail merge, or similar research/outreach platforms will be an advantage.

· Strong practical experience in **Advanced Excel, Pivot Tables, data analysis, MIS dashboards, Power Query, charts, automated reports, or Google Sheets reporting** will be an advantage.

· Experience researching international markets, identifying decision-makers across multiple countries, and working with export-oriented prospect databases will be preferred.

· Familiarity with AI tools for research, data enrichment, summarization, classification, spreadsheet assistance, MIS preparation, and productivity improvement, with the ability to verify AI-generated information before use.

· Basic understanding of sales funnels, lead qualification, email deliverability, bounced-email management, campaign lists, CRM stages, follow-up workflows, and sales performance reporting is desirable.

· Experience handling client email correspondence or customer-service coordination and maintaining professional communication standards will be an advantage.

· Ability to prepare **management-ready Excel MIS reports, pivot tables, dashboards, lead-source summaries, salesperson-wise performance reports, outreach reports, campaign reports, and KPI trackers** will be strongly preferred.

**Qualifications**

· Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university / institute. **B.Com, BBA, BCA, B.Sc., BA, or equivalent qualification** is acceptable.

· Qualification or certification in **Computer Applications, Advanced Excel, MIS, Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, CRM, AI productivity tools, or related areas** will be an added advantage.

· Candidates should demonstrate strong computer literacy, MIS reporting capability, internet research ability, numerical accuracy, business communication skills, and comfort working with structured data and outreach tools.

· 1–2 years of relevant experience is preferred. Candidates with demonstrated practical capability in **MIS reporting, Advanced Excel, data research, lead generation, CRM/data handling, dashboards, or outreach** may also be considered.

Pay: ₹12,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - Governance and Policy Research
description:
**About Pravi**

Pravi is a team of highly motivated, intellectually curious, and impact-oriented professionals working with governments, businesses, development partners, and multilateral institutions to solve complex challenges at scale. We bring together strategists, researchers, technologists, and implementation specialists to turn ambitious ideas into measurable outcomes. We combine analytical rigour with practical execution to help organisations navigate complexity, strengthen capabilities, and deliver sustainable impact. From evidence-based strategy to systems and on-the-ground execution, we work alongside clients as an extension of their teams. 

**Role Overview**

As an Analyst, you will be part of teams supporting government departments and public institutions across multiple policy domains. The role offers hands-on exposure to how policies are framed, approved, budgeted for, and implemented within government systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Dig into Policy Questions:**

  Conduct policy reviews, regulatory analysis, and comparative research to develop sharp policy notes, concept papers, and strategy documents.
* **Turn Priorities into Programmes:**

  Help design government programmes, reform initiatives, and implementation frameworks that respond to departmental and state priorities.
* **Move Projects Forward:**

  Build project charters, implementation roadmaps, review frameworks, and monitoring systems that keep initiatives on track.
* **Improve How Institutions Work:**

  Assess governance structures, institutional arrangements, and administrative processes to identify gaps and shape practical reforms.
* **Bring Stakeholders Together:**

  Coordinate with departments, agencies, and external partners to move cross-cutting government initiatives forward.
* **Make Complex Ideas Clear:**

  Prepare concise presentations, briefing notes, and decision-support materials for senior government stakeholders.
* **Engage on the Ground:**

  Participate in meetings, consultations, reviews, and workshops with government officials, departments, and public institutions.

**Why Pravi?**

* **Be in the Room Where Change Happens**

  : Work directly on live policy and governance initiatives with government institutions and contribute to policies, programmes, and decisions that shape outcomes
* **Turn Ideas into Action**

  : Follow the journey from concept notes and strategy to implementation on the ground
* **Learn at Accelerated Speed**

  : Gain hands-on exposure to public administration, programme design, and project management
* **Grow Through Ownership**

  : Take on meaningful responsibility, receive close mentorship, and engage with clients early in your career

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for intellectually curious problem-solvers who are excited by complex challenges, interested in governance and public policy, and motivated to create impact at scale.

The ideal candidate should have:

* A strong academic background in law, public policy, economics, political science, sociology, public administration, development studies, or related disciplines, with an interest in research and evidence-based problem-solving
* Proven ability to conduct structured research, analyse complex issues, and translate insights into practical solutions
* A natural knack for breaking down messy problems, asking sharp questions, and taking ownership of deliverables
* 0–2 years of experience for Analyst roles; 3–6 years for Senior Analyst roles
* Comfort with policy research, data synthesis, stakeholder engagement, and navigating ambiguity
* Excellent analytical writing, communication, and presentation skills
* The ability to thrive in fast-paced environments
* Prior exposure to government, public policy, or the development sector is a plus
* Experience preparing for or appearing in UPSC or State Public Service examinations is a plus
* Knowledge of Gujarati is a plus, but not mandatory

title: QA Engineer - SDET
description:
**About Us**
Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc.). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators' data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators' data in a simple yet impactful way. Website: https://www.getphyllo.com/
  
  
**About The Role**
As an SDET, you will take ownership of automation quality for assigned product areas across APIs, SDKs and web applications. You will design scalable automation solutions, strengthen regression coverage, integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and proactively identify quality risks before they reach production..
  
  
This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what “working” means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers.
  
  
What you'll be expected to do
  
  

* Build and own test automation (UI and API)
* Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing.
* Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs.
* Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy.
* Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code.
* Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits.
* Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on.
* Work closely with product and engineering
* Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts.
* Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality.
* Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports.
* Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership.

**You'll be a good fit if**

* 3–5 years of experience in quality engineering, with at least 2 years building test automation (not only running manual tests).
* Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience.
* Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java.
* Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e.g. Playwright, REST
* Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI.
* Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium.
* Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews.
* Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason.
* Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL.
* Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers.

**Nice to Have**

* AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
* AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic).
* Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA.tech
* Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs).
* Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring.
* Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS.
* Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG.
* API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing.
* Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray.
* Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar).

**What We Offer**

* Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance
* Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive
* Innovate and Evolve: We're building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact

**What's in it for you?**
We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product.
  
  
Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.

description:
**Software Development Engineer Test Engineer (Python Testing)**

**Experience: 9-12yrs**

**Location: Bangalore**

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Automation Architecture & Hands-On Engineering

○ Architect, scale, and maintain a modular, zero-flake E2E, API, and integration automation framework built on Python 3.10+ (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright.

○ Build resilient Playwright automation for complex stateful browser interactions, including interactive canvas and node-graph workflow editors, real-time token-streaming chat interfaces (SSE and WebSockets), multi-tab and multi-user RBAC sessions, Shadow DOM elements, and network route interception and mocking.

○ Treat test infrastructure as production software by enforcing strict static typing (mypy), fast linting (ruff), strict schema validation (Pydantic), clean design patterns (Page Object, Screenplay, and Fixture factories), and rigorous pull-request code reviews.

2. Full-Stack Platform, Data & GenAI Quality

○ Validate REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, including optimistic concurrency and locking, idempotency, rate limiting, and asynchronous background workflows.

○ Build automated validation pipelines across heterogeneous data backends, verifying SQL query generation, semantic metric calculations, enterprise ontology graph traversals, cloud object storage ingestion, and vector similarity search retrieval.

○ Partner with AI Engineers to operationalize automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge, and golden dataset benchmarks) measuring hallucination rates, groundedness, context recall, tool-call accuracy, Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), and token/cost regressions.

3. CI/CD Release Governance, Performance & Security

○ Orchestrate containerized, parallelized (pytest-xdist and Playwright sharding) smoke, contract, and regression suites inside CI/CD pipelines with sub-15-minute PR feedback loops and automated QA to UAT to Production promotion gates.

○ Drive performance, concurrency, load, and fault-injection testing (Locust and k6) to validate high-throughput agent executions, concurrent workflow graphs, and graceful degradation during upstream LLM or database throttling.

○ Validate enterprise security boundaries including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML/SSO, RBAC/ABAC permissions, multi-tenant data isolation, and OWASP Top 10 risks for both Web and LLM Applications (prompt injection, PII leakage, and excessive agency).

○

4. Engineering Leadership & Operational Excellence

○ Recruit, mentor, and upskill top-tier SDETs, coaching engineers from script-level testing into modern software engineering and system-level architectural thinking.

○ Partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and SRE leaders during design reviews to enforce shift-left testability and observability from day one.

○ Own platform quality SLAs and executive reporting, driving measurable improvements in Defect Escape Rate (DER), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Automation Stability (>99% non-flaky pass rate), and Release Lead Time.

**COMPLETE TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE**

Should bring deep hands-on mastery of our core automation stack and strong working fluency across our broader platform ecosystem:

○ Core Languages & Tooling: Python 3.10+ (asyncio, typing, uv, Poetry, ruff, mypy), TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+, Node.js), SQL (ANSI SQL, CTEs, analytical queries), Bash / Zsh.

○ UI & Browser Automation: Microsoft Playwright (Python and TypeScript bindings, BrowserContexts, storageState authentication reuse, Trace Viewer, HAR replay, Network Interception, Canvas and Visual Regression), Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Axe-core (WCAG accessibility testing).

○ Python Testing Ecosystem: pytest, pytest-xdist (parallel sharding), pytest-asyncio, Pydantic v2, httpx, aiohttp, requests, Hypothesis and Faker (property-based and synthetic test data generation).

○ API, Streaming & Contract Testing: REST (OpenAPI 3.x), GraphQL, gRPC / Protobuf, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Schemathesis, Pact, WireMock.

○ AI, LLM & Agent Evaluation: DeepEval, RAGAS, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines, Golden Dataset curation, RAG retrieval metrics (precision, recall, faithfulness, groundedness), deterministic NLP metrics (F1, Exact Match), prompt and model regression harnesses.

○ Databases, Vector & Storage Systems: PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), Vector Databases (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph and Ontology Stores (Property Graphs, RDF), Redis, Cloud Object Storage (Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Azure Blob).

○ Asynchronous & Event Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery (testing distributed task queues, retries, dead-letter queues, and eventual consistency).

○ Performance, Load & Resilience: Locust (Python-native distributed load testing), k6, API and LLM latency profiling (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/second), fault and latency injection.

○ CI/CD, Cloud & Containers: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (K8s), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GCP / AWS / Azure.

○ Test Reporting & Observability: Allure Report, ReportPortal, TestRail / Xray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Langfuse / Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing and diagnostics).

○ Security & Identity: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML / SSO, JWT, Multi-tenant RBAC / ABAC, OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 for Web and LLM Applications.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

○ 9+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering in Test (SDET) or Quality Engineering, including 3+ years directly managing, mentoring, and scaling SDET teams on complex SaaS, cloud, data, or AI platforms.

○ Expert-level proficiency designing production-grade Python (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright automation frameworks from scratch, including custom fixtures, parallel execution runners, dynamic state handling, and anti-flake architecture.

○ Strong experience testing distributed microservices, stateful workflows, real-time streaming APIs, and relational and non-relational data layers.

○ Proven track record embedding containerized automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to gate multi-environment enterprise releases without slowing developer velocity.

○ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• Direct experience building automated evaluation and regression pipelines for LLM Agents, RAG architectures, Semantic Layers, or Workflow Orchestration platforms.

• Hands-on experience automating visual canvas or DAG builders (such as React Flow, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL interfaces) and MCP-based tool integrations.

• Prior experience building internal developer productivity tools, synthetic test-data platforms, or ephemeral preview test environments on Kubernetes.

Design, develop, and maintain APF (Automation Patching Framework) services, tools, and automation.

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6-12 Months**
The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
  
  
Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.

* Hands-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML.
* Strong Boomi troubleshooting and debugging skills, including analyzing process execution logs, implementing error handling, and enhancing existing integrations using documentation and logs.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, such as SQL Server.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred**

**What You’ll Gain**

description:
Specialist, IT Infrastructure

**Summary**
The Linux Desktop Engineer will own the design, deployment, configuration, and structural maintenance of Celestica's high-performance Linux computing platform. This role directly supports the Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) engineering group by managing a fleet of approximately 50 HP ZBook Mobile Workstations preinstalled with Ubuntu and optimized for advanced AI-based software development.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of enterprise endpoint compliance and agile engineering infrastructure , the successful candidate will use HCL BigFix as the primary Endpoint Management framework. Responsibilities include developing deployment packages for core endpoint security software , managing monthly patching cycles , and troubleshooting highly specialized developer toolchains to maximize engineering velocity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Fleet Configuration & Baseline Optimization: Own the baseline golden imaging, mass deployment, and configuration maintenance of the HP ZBook workstation fleet utilizing HCL BigFix.
* Silent Software Packaging: Architect and deploy automated, silent installation packages for all enterprise and custom engineering endpoint software via BigFix fixlets.
* Endpoint Security Management: Install and administer Celestica’s standard security applications, including CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker, and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Persona Customization: Configure application controls specifically for the engineering developer workspace. This involves deploying ThreatLocker in a persistent Learning Mode with dedicated sandbox path exceptions (such as ~/Workspace) to prevent process blocks during source compilation.
* Exclusion Path Auditing: Implement and maintain required anti-malware scan exclusions across engineering build paths (e.g., /home/\*/src/, make, gcc, cargo) to ensure frictionless local compilation.
* Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Support and execute monthly operating system and application patching cycles. Ensure critical security patches are vetted and pushed to engineering systems within a mandatory 24-hour window when required.
* Privileged Access Governance: Administer scoped sudo access on developer workstations using secure alternative authentication models (such as SSH agent-based PAM) and manage compliance audits via session recording tools like tlog.
* Engineering Toolchain Support: Act as the primary technical interface for HPS Software Engineers, ensuring local access to build essentials, containerization software, and integrated development environments.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  
**Preferred Technical Qualifications**

* Operating Systems: Expert-level administration of native Ubuntu Linux (specifically 22.04 LTS and 24.04 LTS Desktop environments).

title: AI Agent Engineer Intern
description:
Lexsi Labs is a frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe AI systems for real-world deployment. Our work spans agentic AI, alignment, interpretability, evaluation systems, enterprise AI, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and enterprise data.

We build AI systems where transparency, auditability, robustness, and controllability are first-class constraints. Our environment is fast-moving, research-driven, and highly hands-on. We value people who bring open ideas, take ownership, and turn ambiguity into meaningful outcomes.

The Role

We are looking for
****AI Agent Interns****

to work on high-impact agentic AI problems across applied, research, and product directions.

This is not a narrow internship focused on building small internal bots. You will work on real agentic systems, evaluation infrastructure, enterprise use cases, research prototypes, and product tooling that can shape how AI agents are built, tested, aligned, and deployed.

Depending on your interests and strengths, you may contribute across one or more of three tracks:

1. Applied Agentic AI

On the applied side, you will work on high-impact enterprise agentic use cases. This may involve building agents that reason over complex workflows, interact with tools and data systems, execute multi-step processes, evaluate outcomes, and operate reliably in real-world environments.

Example work may include enterprise workflow agents, agents over structured or proprietary data, human-in-the-loop agent systems, decision-support agents, and applied prototypes that can evolve into production-grade components.

Success in this track means building useful, reliable, and high-value agentic systems that solve real enterprise problems.

2. Agent R&D and Evaluation

On the R&D side, you will work on new ideas in agent architecture, harness design, evaluations, long-horizon reasoning, alignment, and interpretability.

This may include building new agent harnesses, designing evaluation frameworks, studying agent failure modes, benchmarking tool use and planning, or contributing to research papers, technical reports, and reusable research infrastructure.

Success in this track means producing research-quality insights, evaluation systems, benchmarks, or technical contributions that improve how agentic systems are understood and assessed.

3. Product and Tooling Agents

On the product and tooling side, you will help build agents that improve how researchers, engineers, and users interact with Lexsi systems.

This may include an
****AlignTune Agent****

for alignment workflows, AI Scientist-style agents for hypothesis generation and experiment execution, tools for evaluating and debugging agents, or product prototypes that turn research capabilities into usable workflows.

Success in this track means building tools that compound the productivity of researchers, engineers, or enterprise users.

Responsibilities

You will explore open-ended agentic AI problems and convert promising ideas into working prototypes, experiments, research artifacts, or product capabilities. You may build applied agents, design evaluations, create harnesses, experiment with planning and memory architectures, analyze failures, document findings, and collaborate with research, engineering, and product teams.

The expected outcome may be a production-grade applied component, a research contribution, a paper, a benchmark, an internal tool, or a product prototype.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with strong programming skills, preferably in Python, hands-on experience with LLMs or AI systems, and a strong interest in agents, evaluation, alignment, interpretability, or enterprise AI.

You should be comfortable working on ambiguous problems, building prototypes quickly, reading papers or technical material, documenting findings clearly, and independently identifying high-value directions.

Bonus signals include experience with agent frameworks, long-horizon agents, evaluation pipelines, research projects, open-source tools, backend systems, enterprise data, or AI safety and interpretability.

Our Culture

We move quickly and value substance over polish. This internship is for people who want to work near the frontier of agentic AI, bring original ideas, build seriously, test honestly, and create work that matters.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.

description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. multiple product lines.

title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About BharatNXT**

BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch.

**The role**

A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often.

**What you'll do**

* **Own founder priorities**

  - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships.
* **Launch things**

  - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked.
* **Build partnerships**

  - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track.
* **Turn numbers into decisions**

  - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation.
* **Know the market**

  - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now.
* **Run experiments**

  - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill.
* **Strengthen operations**

  - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support.
* **Make us faster**

  - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved.
* **Take on special projects**

  - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet.

**What we're looking for**

* 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions.
* Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased.

**Bonus:**

an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

**Why take it**

You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does.

If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.

title: Sr. Specialist, Advisory Services
description:

Women’s World Banking is looking for a team member to join a forward thinking, cross-functional, high-performing, collaborative team focused on delivering innovative customer experiences, banking services and products, that create business and customer value to serve low-income women.

The Sr. Specialist will lead the design & implementation of advisory solutions in the field in collaboration with our Financial Service Partners. The candidate will be expected to understand business and customer needs, design solutions across functional teams, coordinate and lead sales/ channel teams, last mile marketing & sales agencies and bank stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation and drive project results. The ideal candidate will have either a background in banking / insurance / financial services or in management consulting. You must be a strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and propose new ideas for ways of engaging Women’s World Banking’s target audience.

**Design of Financial Solutions**
in the space of savings, micro-credit, micro-insurance, digital financial services, or last mile solutions for low income women that are viable and scalable for Financial Service Providers:

* Develop research based perspective on financial products for low income women - the current context, challenges for women, trends and solutions for increasing financial inclusion of women in this sector.
* Conduct industry assessments that provide detailed insights into the competitive landscape and best practices; Collect and analyze complex data in the sector that can help define solutions.
* Establish relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and customer needs, continually enhance project processes, service offering and delivery for partners.
* Identify, scope and find implementation paths for needed product and/or customer experience enhancements;
* Develop business cases for new product and product enhancements to enable prioritization and justify investments into new and existing products.

**Delivery of Solutions in Field**
across various initiatives, locations and stakeholders to ensure project milestones and metrics are met. Drive execution of solutions for low income women with institution partners.

* Able to implement project in field across multiple geographies and last mile channels.
* Establish relationships and work with a cross-functional teams (internal and partner bank's) to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
* Coordinate among various external support organisations such as last mile agencies (training, sales promotions etc.) and local government bodies (state / region level) to drive project success.
* Lead project management including the development, delivery and monitoring of work plans, milestones, targets, budgets, and both internal and external reporting. Projects may vary in number, size and complexity.

**Mange & Deepen Relationships with Institutional Partners:**

* Develop, and drive execution of high priority business initiatives, financial products and services for the partner FSPs
* Establish and maintain positive and constructive relationships with key client contacts
* Initiate and hand hold the project through all stages of the project
* Ensure positive client satisfaction results.
* Be the “voice of the clients” by interpreting the clients’ business plans and strategic intent into the Women’s World banking organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* MBA or Master’s degree in related field
* 8+ years or more experience in banking, financial services, consulting or other relevant role.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and successfully manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Proven collaborative, negotiation, and persuasion skills to influence field teams and senior management at partner institutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Interest in the field of women’s financial inclusion and economic empowerment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present fact-based recommendations in a clear, logical and concise way to tell a story with the data.
* Track record of superior creativity and problem solving abilities.

**Measure of Success**

**Success within the first 75 days:**

* Embrace Women’s World Banking’s values – Think Big, Own and commit to it, Smarter together
* Assume full responsibility of the position;
* Forge positive working relationships with cross-functional staff and fully integrate in the India team
* Become trained in and fully integrate the use of Women’s World Banking systems and policies into your day-to-day activities;
* Learn and comprehend the Women’s World Banking business model and work closely with the team to understand and build upon existing plans.

title: Partner Associate (Mornings)
description:
Hey there!
  
  
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.
  
  
Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  
  
Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.
  
  
Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?
  
  
To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!
  
  
Ready to be part of the experience?
  
  
Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* You will be responsible for the entire life cycle management of big events since the sales and legal team has signed the commercial contract till the events' final closing
* You will be the main point of contact between all the stakeholders, from the event organizer to all the internal teams involved.
* Although being the overall owner of the whole process you will work as part of a team, you will be in charge of making things happen in time and form by managing other department's tasks.
* Communicate product needs (Fever usability) and process needs to HQ, and work with product/engineering to deliver on them. to have a consolidated list of all the requirements and prioritize them with the product team.
* Create and maintain exhaustive Q&A to have an answer to potential user incidences managed by our user support team.
* Make sure that all the requirements needed to achieve the project goals have all the necessary documentation
* Depending on the event, your presence on-site might be required during the launch or other important dates
* The person will work from 7:00am to 4:00pm

**Who You Are:**
You are degree qualified, with a project management background. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and pride yourself on your flexible, detail-oriented, analytical, and organized mindset.
  
  
In order to be successful in this role, you will be expected to be an entrepreneurial individual. The role requires a mix of project management and operational experience. You will have to be very comfortable coordinating other departments to ensure the delivery of requirements on time, also delivering results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail-oriented while looking around corners.
  
  

* 1+ years in a project management role partner management or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background, but having event experience is a plus.
* Fluent level of English, other languages are a plus!
* Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
* You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
* You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
* Highly organized and efficient
* Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
* Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
* Ability to think strategically when faced with an events partnership brief or with our proprietary data on what events work
* Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
* Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
* Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
* Strong academic background is a plus

**Why You'll Love It Here**

* Attractive compensation package with room to grow.
* Opportunity to make a real impact in a high-growth global category leader.
* Professional and personal growth from day one with real responsibility.
* 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher.
* Private health insurance: Niva-Bupa personal coverage fully paid by Fever.
* Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons.
* Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central (New Delhi/Mumbai) office location.
* Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment.

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!
  
  
If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch
  
  
Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!
  
  
If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

As an EICA Associate at WSP you will lead and manage, design projects within the Water sector. You will be responsible for overseeing EICA engineering design work and ensuring compliance with best practices and UK regulations.
  
  
At WSP, our Associates are adaptable in various situations and possess an innovative mindset, willing to take on new challenges and are comfortable in working within significant and complex projects or programmes of work. We collaborate closely with external Clients and with internal multi-disciplinary project teams and, to deliver most effectively, we utilise WSP offices, Client offices and/or site locations to deliver programmes of strategic regional and national importance.

* Agree the project deliverables and programme.
* Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost.
* Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme.

title: Partner Delivery Excellence Lead, Google Cloud
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in cloud professional services delivery or enterprise solutions architecture.
* 5 years of technical architecture and Google Cloud delivery experience in enterprise Data and Analytics (Data warehousing, streaming/ETL, distributed systems) and AI/ML (Vertex AI, GenAI frameworks, predictive modeling).
* Experience working with Global System Integrators (GSIs), systems consulting delivery centers, or offshore delivery operations.
* Ability to travel up to 40% domestically across partner Global Delivery Center hubs as required.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience managing complex enterprise project escalations, turnaround interventions, or technical risk mitigation for cloud engagements.
* Experience deploying structured practitioner enablement frameworks, certification programs, or readiness portals at scale.
* Track record of using AI and agentic capabilities to increase personal productivity and impact in daily workflows.
* Ability to influence senior partner practice directors, delivery executives, and cross-functional leadership across Sales, PSO, and Engineering.

**About The Job**
Google's line of products and services to our clients never stops growing. The Partnerships Development team is responsible for seeking and exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Equipped with your business acumen and extensive product knowledge, you are right on the front line of interacting with our partners, and helping them find ways to grow using Google's newest product offerings. Your knowledge of relevant verticals and relationships with key industry players will help shape our great applications and content for products such as YouTube, Google TV and Commerce.
  
  
As the Partner Delivery Excellence Lead, you will serve as the principal embedded delivery authority based out of one of our primary tech hubs (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai or Gurgaon). You will sit directly within strategic Global System Integrators' (GSIs) delivery environments, partnering shoulder-to-shoulder with GSI Google Cloud Platform(GCP) Practice Leaders, Delivery Executives, and Lead Architects. Your core objective is to ensure active GSI-led customer deployments are executing flawlessly without risk of failure, milestone slip, or architectural drift.
  
  
Bringing deep technical depth in Google Cloud, Data & Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (GenAI/Agentic Workflows), you will monitor project health telemetry, identify early delivery friction, and serve as the critical bridge to internal Google stakeholders, mobilizing Professional Services (PSO), Customer Engineering (CE) and Partner Leadership to deploy rapid remediation before issues escalate to the customer. Additionally, you will advocate delivery upskilling across thousands of GSI practitioners, driving adoption of Google Cloud’s Delivery Readiness Portal (DRP), Delivery Navigator (DelNav), reference architectures, and safeguarding programs.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the embedded Google Cloud delivery authority within partner Global Delivery Centers (GDCs), establishing operational oversight across enterprise cloud transformation engagements to safeguard architectural integrity and milestone adherence.
* Identify technical roadblocks and delivery risks early, mobilizing cross-functional Google Cloud teams (PSO, Support, Partner Development Managers, Customer Engineering) to execute closed-loop remediation before issues impact customers.
* Provide authoritative architectural guidance across Data & Analytics and AI/ML (Vertex AI, agentic workflows), validating partner delivery approaches on complex, mission-critical workloads.
* Drive programmatic enablement across partner delivery benches utilizing Google Cloud readiness assets, Delivery Navigator runbooks, and safeguarding programs.
* Synthesize delivery patterns and partner capabilities back to Center of Excellence (CoE) and PSO teams, informing joint service offerings and governance policies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Snr Manager Design Engineering - India, Data Center Engineering
description:
**Description**
As the Senior Manager, Design Engineering - India, at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), you'll play an integral role in our engineering leadership team. A highly effective group of architects and structural, civil, mechanical, electrical and controls engineers. This team is responsible for continuously innovating on behalf of our customers whilst delivering the highest quality engineering solutions for our capacity delivery projects. You will have a direct hand in project outcomes. You'll shape design direction and improve design delivery across all India projects. You'll also set the design procedures and protocols for developing future systems.
  
  
You'll work with many parts of the AWS organisation, with external engineering partners, with permitting and regulatory bodies. You'll also engage the wider community in India on technical matters relating to data center development. That means bringing an AWS engineering view to industry bodies and forums, standards and building code committees, and policymakers.
  
  
Amazon's data centers are industry-leading examples of innovation in sustainability, energy efficiency, resiliency and cost-effectiveness. We're known for our speed to market and reliability. This role sits within the team responsible for the design of critical data center facilities in India. Our design team is at the forefront of creating and delivering innovative products. It's a diverse, upbeat group that is changing the face of cloud computing.
  
  
We continue to grow and are looking for team members who can support our speed to market, raise the bar and want to keep growing professionally. Amazon's work environment is unique and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate. We give strong support to continuous learning and employee development.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
Leading a multidisciplinary team of engineers in the design of critical data center infrastructure systems across India.
  
  
Chairing weekly design meetings with internal engineering teams, internal customers and external consultants to resolve design issues, keep design milestones on track and escalate where needed.
  
  
Driving process improvements across design delivery.
  
  
Creating and tracking metrics on the cost, quality and duration of design. This includes collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented, so lessons learned feed back into future designs.
  
  
Establishing capital project design budgets, contributing to complex business cases for existing and new AWS Region deployments in India, and working with AWS Finance to secure project funding.
  
  
Working with AWS engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs.
  
  
Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables.
  
  
Engaging the wider community in India - industry bodies and forums, standards and building code committees, and government and regulatory agencies - on technical matters relating to data center development, in partnership with AWS Public Policy.
  
  
Owning design document control, including the document controller's workflow and audits of deliverables.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Leading a team of engineers/architect in the design of data center critical infrastructure systems in India
  
  

* Facilitating weekly meetings with internal stakeholders, external consultants, permitting authorities and community stakeholders to address design issues, meet design milestones and escalate as needed.
* Driving process improvements.
* Creating and tracking metrics related to cost, quality and duration of design as well as collecting data from construction and commissioning teams as designs are implemented.
* Establishing capital project design budgets and contributing to complex business cases for existing region and new region deployment in India.
* Collaborating with AWS finance teams to secure funding for projects.
* Working in partnership with AWS Engineering leads to schedule engineering resources and influence design changes based on internal customer needs.
* Partnering with internal customers to establish project scope, schedule and deliverables.
* Managing document controller’s workflow and audit of deliverables
* Lead weekly staff and project readiness meetings with stakeholder teams;
* Drive best practices on the team, deal with ambiguity and competing objectives, and proactively identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks;
* Use creativity, good judgment and significant innovation in evaluating, simplify and developing project procedures including document control, tracking project metrics and inter-team information dependencies;
* Identify continuous improvement strategies focused on variety of project phases including real estate due diligence, planning, design, permitting and construction;
* Engage with an experienced engineering discipline leads, influencing roadmaps, priorities and process working across multiple teams including capacity delivery, site selection, utilities, due diligence, design, construction and commissioning.;
* Report on status of development, quality, operations, and performance to management;
* Write effective narratives and present them concisely and effectively to Directors and VPs;
* Establish a mature team optimized for operational excellence, using standard project management, communication protocols and automated systems;
* Have joint managerial oversight of additional employees in India including but not limited to, all Architects, Electrical, Mechanical, Colo, Structural, Controls, and Field Engineers in India;

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Electrical, Mechanical, Structural Engineering or equivalent field
* 10+ years of data center design, HVAC design, or related product development experience
* Experience leading multidisciplinary design across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural and controls disciplines on large-scale capital projects. Experience managing design budgets, schedules and delivery teams comprising internal resources supplemented with external design consultants.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience defining data center system-level architecture, documenting performance and equipment requirements, creating and communicating conceptual designs, and creating and maintaining project documentation
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience engaging industry bodies, standards or building code committees, regulators or government agencies on technical matters, e.g. Bureau of Indian Standards committees, including the National Building Code

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Digital Transformation Deployment Specialist - PLM Windchill
description:
As a Digital Transformation Specialist, you will lead a high-impact portfolio, connecting technology and business needs and delivering concrete results. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and executing IT capabilities within this area of expertise, planning and building IT solutions from business functions. You will work in a multinational team, conducting one or more projects/programs, and be the single focal point (SPOC) between IT Technology and the business for these transformation projects/programs. They will also be responsible for interacting with functional leaders and business units to monitor and execute projects/programs.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Execute the PLM strategy, aligning it with digital transformation objectives and driving business value in the engineering and manufacturing areas
* Integrate PLM with ERP, MES, and downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow and process integration
* Act as a promoter of the Digital Thread and configuration management, expanding traceability, collaboration and decision-making along the value chain
* Optimize cross-functional processes using Lean and Six Sigma, with a focus on BOMs, process plans, roadmaps, and supply chain integration
* Engage business and IT stakeholders, capturing complex requirements and facilitating global collaboration
* Drive PLM governance and change management, supporting the adoption of new tools and continuous improvement initiatives
* Act as a reference expert in PLM, guiding teams and supporting training on platforms such as Windchill or Teamcenter
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable internal and external standards, procedures and guidelines.

**Your background**

* Relevant experience in IT and digital transformation, with a strong background in Computer Science or Engineering and deep knowledge in PLM systems and strategy
* Experience in leading global PLM transformation programs in engineering and manufacturing, with hands-on experience in Windchill, Teamcenter or similar platforms
