title: Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert- BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
  
  
SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
  
  
SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
  
  
Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc.
  
  
Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
  
  
Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert is the key position in these BIDs.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* System Integration Strategy & Planning: 📝 Develop the comprehensive Master Testing and Commissioning Plan (MTCP). This includes defining the T&C strategy, budget, schedule, and necessary resources for all railway subsystems (Signaling, Power, Rolling Stock, Telecoms, Track, etc.) and ensuring their successful technical and operational integration.
* Statutory Compliance and Safety Certification: Act as the primary technical point of contact for obtaining Statutory Clearances and Safety Certification from regulatory authorities (e.g., Commissioner of Railway Safety). This involves managing the preparation and submission of all critical safety dossiers and test reports.
* Lead System Integration Testing (SIT): 🔗 Direct the complex interface testing between major subsystems, such as validating the communication and functional response between the Signaling System (e.g., ETCS), the Rolling Stock (trains), and the Power Supply/Traction system.
* Operational Readiness & Trial Run Management: Oversee all stages of trial and dynamic testing, including running trains at maximum projected speeds to validate ride quality, braking performance, and system stability under real-world conditions. This culminates in declaring the line ready for shadow operation.
* Defect Management and Resolution: Establish and enforce a rigorous process for managing Non-Conformities (NCs) and defects found during T&C. The expert is responsible for tracking all open items to closure and verifying that corrective actions do not negatively impact other system interfaces.
* Handover, Training, and Documentation: Lead the formal Handover Process to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) team. This includes approving final system manuals, maintenance procedures, and ensuring the operational staff is fully trained and competent to safely run the railway.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Qualification: Graduate in Engineering with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English [additional marks for PG in Engineering]
* Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit System [additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit System\*]
* Relevant Experience: 5 years’ experience for two works of Planning and supervising Trial tests and commissioning of subsystems of Rail based Passenger Transit system and obtaining statutory approvals for Commercial operation as Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert or equivalent position [additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
* Eligible Assignment\*\*(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert or equivalent position for a full-time continuous deployment period not less than 2 years [additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
* Rail-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
* High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR
* Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) [excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
* Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer’s Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 160 kmph or more comprising:
* Construction of Civil structures (at-grade/elevated/underground) AND
* Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction & Power Supply, Signalling)

Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing & Commissioning
  
  
We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

title: Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Licensing & Installation Support
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19733 **Date posted** 11/11/2026

### **Alternate Job Titles**

* EDA Licensing and Installation Support Engineer
* Technical Application Engineer, Licensing Infrastructure
* Staff Applications Engineer, EDA Tools Support
* Licensing and Deployment Applications Engineer
* CAD/EDA Support Engineer, Staff Level

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent years keeping the infrastructure running that everyone else depends on to do their jobs, and you know that when a license server goes down at 3 a.m. in Tokyo, someone's tapeout schedule just became your problem. You are the person who can look at a FlexNet debug log, spot the misconfigured options file or the firewall rule that is blocking port 27000, and have it fixed before the customer finishes explaining what went wrong.

You do not just troubleshoot, you think in systems. You understand how a three-server redundant licensing setup should behave, why a migration from on-prem to cloud changes the MAC address binding, and what happens when someone upgrades RHEL without testing the environment variables first. You have been in enough customer environments to know that "it worked in dev" means nothing until it works in production.

You are comfortable talking to a senior CAD engineer about daemon logs and then turning around to explain to a procurement lead why their license count does not match their headcount. You move fast, you document what you learn, and you do not wait for perfect information to start solving the problem. At Synopsys, you will work with global customers who depend on you to keep their design environments operational, and the problems you solve will directly enable the next generation of chips.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Support and troubleshoot Synopsys Common Licensing (SCL) and FlexNet licensing environments for global enterprise customers across Americas, EMEA, Japan, and APAC
* Perform root-cause analysis on complex licensing, installation, deployment, migration, and failover issues, working directly with customer IT, CAD, and engineering teams
* Design, validate, and implement licensing architectures for large-scale enterprise deployments, including three-server redundancy setups and cross-platform configurations
* Lead on-site and remote installation, upgrade, and migration activities for customers deploying or expanding Synopsys EDA toolsets
* Mentor applications engineers and provide technical leadership across support and customer success organizations
* Collaborate with Engineering, R&D, Sales, and Customer Success teams to escalate critical issues, influence product roadmaps, and translate customer feedback into actionable improvements
* Build and maintain technical articles, runbooks, and self-service documentation in the Synopsys Knowledge Base to scale support and reduce resolution time

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Keep customer design environments operational during critical tapeout windows, directly enabling revenue and preventing schedule slips
* Reduce escalation time and resolution cycles for high-priority licensing and deployment issues across Synopsys's largest accounts
* Influence product development by surfacing real-world deployment challenges and customer needs to R&D and product teams
* Scale support effectiveness by creating reusable documentation, automation scripts, and training content that empower frontline engineers and customers
* Strengthen customer relationships by acting as a trusted technical advisor who understands both their infrastructure and their business pressures
* Drive adoption and expansion of Synopsys technologies by ensuring smooth deployments, migrations, and upgrades across diverse customer environments
* Mentor and elevate the technical capabilities of the broader applications engineering team through knowledge sharing and hands-on collaboration

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or related field with 6+ years of experience, or Master's degree with 4+ years in EDA tool support, CAD/CAE engineering, IT operations, or software application support
* Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration (RHEL, CentOS, SLES), including process management, file permissions, environment variables, and shell scripting
* Hands-on expertise with FlexNet/FLEXlm licensing architecture, including debug logs, options files, daemon configuration, and redundant server setups
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, firewalls, DNS, host IDs, and MAC addresses as they relate to client-server licensing communication
* Working knowledge of scripting languages such as Bash, Python, Perl, or PowerShell for log parsing, automation, and troubleshooting
* Experience with Windows Server administration for cross-platform EDA tool environments is a plus
* Familiarity with EDA product flows, Synopsys toolsets, or Agentic AI usage is a plus

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk a customer through a three-server licensing failover scenario and then write a two-paragraph summary for their VP of Engineering without losing the technical thread
* You stay calm under pressure, especially when a licensing issue is blocking a customer's critical milestone and multiple time zones are waiting for your answer
* You think like a detective when diagnosing issues, you do not stop at the symptom, you trace it back to the root cause even if it means digging through daemon logs and network packet captures

The Senior Cost Engineer is part of the Engineering Services organization and is responsible for performing cost management activities on a capital project or portfolios of projects. **Key responsibilities:**

* Manage and control project changes for approved budgets. Ensure changes are incorporated into project cost forecasts and schedules.
* Support and participate in the cost and schedule assurance process and risk management process.

You will partner with KSM and CSD resources to provide customer experience never seen at NetApp. Your role involves monitoring, diagnosing and troubleshooting NetApp Keystone environments, including hardware, software, and multi-system/multi-vendor/multi-network interoperability issues. Fluency in English is required. This is a new role within NetApp and an exciting opportunity.

Data Management: Utilize data management tools to oversee Keystone capacity utilization on an estate-wide and per-customer basis, including performance levels, capacity committed and consumed, physical capacity consumed, data efficiency ratio, IOPS delivered, latency delivered, capacity thresholds, and performance thresholds.

Problem-Solving: Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex issues using advanced analytical and creative problem-solving skills. Capacity to proactively identify potential issues, raise concerns early, and propose innovative, preventative resolutions.
  
Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills to effectively manage stressful or ambiguous situations and deliver superior customer service.
  
Technical Expertise: Familiarity with ancillary technologies such as DNS, NIS, and Active Directory. Expertise in performance troubleshooting, including diagnosing issues in NetApp systems (throughput, latency, high-load bottlenecks).

Fluency in English

IC - Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience.Mgr & Exec - Typically requires a minimum of 3 years of related experience.

**MQ IIB Job Description:**  
Middleware - Enterprise Messaging and Integration Administrator
  
Role Summary
  
NTT DATA is seeking -- years of experienced Enterprise Messaging Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, administering, and supporting enterprise-grade messaging, integration, and workload automation platforms. This role ensures secure, reliable, high performance communication between distributed applications using IBM, Apache, and open source messaging technologies. The engineer also manages complex scheduling environments and contributes to automation, observability, and continuous improvement of mission critical integration systems.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Messaging Platform Administration (IBM MQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ)
  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and secure messaging platforms.
* Create and manage messaging artifacts: queue managers, queues, topics, channels, listeners, security settings, retention policies.
* Implement HA/DR, clustering, replication, and multi-node failover strategies.
* Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning.
* Monitor health metrics using dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Splunk) and handle incidents proactively.
* Troubleshoot message flow failures, dead-letter queues, consumer lag, stuck messages, and network bottlenecks.

2. Integration Engineering (IBM IIB / ACE)
  

* Design, develop, and deploy message flows using ESQL, Java, mapping nodes, REST/SOAP connectors, MQ/Kafka nodes.
* Build and manage BAR files, integration nodes, servers, policies, and environment overrides.
* Implement integration security: TLS/mTLS, OAuth/JWT, Basic Auth, certificate management.
* Troubleshoot and optimize integration flows for latency, throughput, parser efficiency, and memory footprint.
* Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, unit testing, and environment migrations.

3. IoT Telemetry Messaging (IBM MQXR / MQTT)
  

* Configure and support MQXR Telemetry listeners, MQTT topics, subscriptions, and QoS policies.
* Secure MQTT clients using TLS certificates, access control, and throttling policies.
* Monitor MQTT client connections, sessions, retained messages, and message routing to backend MQ systems.

4. Workload Automation (IBM TWS / IWS)
  

* Install, upgrade, configure, and administer TWS/IWS masters, controllers, and agents.
* Build job streams, calendars, dependencies, event triggers, and SLA monitoring.
* Troubleshoot job failures, optimize schedules, and implement recovery workflows.
* Integrate workload scheduler with MQ, REST APIs, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications.

5. Security, Governance Compliance
  

* Implement end to end security for messaging and integration technologies:

TLS/SSL, mTLS, JAAS, CHLAUTH policies, RBAC, OAuth/SASL.
  

* Perform auditing reporting for security compliance frameworks.
* Ensure platform hardening, certificate rotation, and vulnerability remediation.

6. Automation, DevOps Observability
  

* Create automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for deployments, housekeeping, and monitoring.
* Build IaC templates (Ansible, Terraform) for consistent provisioning.
* Integrate platforms into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
* Maintain dashboards for real time system health and SLA adherence.

7. Documentation Collaboration
  

* Create runbooks, SOPs, operational guidelines, and architectural diagrams.
* Work closely with application teams, architects, network, cloud, and security teams.
* Participate in on call rotation and production support responsibilities.

Required Skills Experience
  

* Strong working knowledge of:

o  IBM MQ (Distributed / MQ Clustering / Security)
  
o  IBM IIB/ACE development administration
  
o  IBM TWS/IWS job scheduling
  
o  MQTT / MQXR messaging
  
o  Apache Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, ACLs, Schema Registry)
  
o  Apache ActiveMQ (Classic/Artemis)
  
o  RabbitMQ (AMQP, mirrored/quorum queues, federation/shovel)
  

* Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
* Strong debugging skills across messaging, network, TLS, and application layers.
* Good understanding of networking (TCP/IP, firewalls, load balancers, proxies).

title: Coordinator, Document Controls
description:

title: Associate Engineer - Mechanical
description:
To provide technical and engineering support to the Middle East Power Generation business, primarily covering Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) and Open Cycle Gas Turbine (OCGT) power projects, including new-build projects, expansions, upgrades and existing operational plants.

The role will support projects across feasibility, FEED, tendering, design review, construction, commissioning and operational phases, providing technical advisory services to utility companies, plant owners, developers, lenders and government entities.

The range of activities includes:

* Feasibility and FEED studies for new CCGT, OCGT and associated power generation projects.

* Power plant configuration studies, technology assessments, benchmarking, cost analysis and contract reviews.

* Engineering coordination during project development and execution.

* Preparation of functional specifications, datasheets, formsheets and concept drawings for power plant systems and equipment.

* Technical evaluation of EPC bids and vendor offers, including technical clarifications and evaluation reports.

* Engineering design review of power plant systems, equipment, calculations and technical documentation.

Technical advisory support to utilities, plant owners, developers, lenders and government entities for new-build and existing operational power plants, including pre- and post-financial close assignments.

  

* Provide technical support to Pre-Contract and Project Delivery teams throughout the design, construction, commissioning and operational phases of power generation projects.

* Undertake engineering studies for CCGT and OCGT projects, including thermodynamic cycle and plant performance modelling.

* Review plant performance parameters including output, efficiency, heat rate and technical guarantees.

* Prepare and review technical specifications and datasheets for major power plant systems and equipment.

* Review plant layouts, equipment arrangements, design calculations, drawings and engineering documentation prepared by EPC contractors and vendors.

* Review mechanical and Balance of Plant (BOP) systems and support equipment selection and sizing.

* Coordinate technical interfaces between mechanical, electrical, I&C, civil and other engineering disciplines.

* Participate in project meetings, design reviews, technical clarification meetings and engineering coordination activities.

* Support technical due diligence and operational assessments of new-build and existing power generation assets and prepare associated technical reports.

* Support site inspections, construction monitoring, testing, commissioning and Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), as required.

* Monitor and report engineering and construction progress to the Project Manager and/or Client.

* Maintain awareness of technological developments, applicable international standards and industry best practices in the power generation sector.

Key Competencies / Skills

Mandatory Skills

* Minimum relevant experience in thermal power generation projects, particularly CCGT and/or OCGT plants, preferably in an engineering consultancy/design office environment.

* Strong understanding of gas turbines, HRSGs, steam turbines and associated auxiliary systems.

* Experience in thermodynamic power plant cycle analysis, including output, efficiency, heat rate and overall plant performance.

* Good technical knowledge of major CCGT/OCGT systems, including:

* Gas Turbines and auxiliaries
* Heat Recovery Steam Generators (HRSG)
* Steam Turbines and auxiliaries
* Water-steam cycle
* Condensate and feedwater systems
* Condensing and cooling systems
* Fuel gas systems
* Cooling water systems
* Compressed air systems
* Chemical dosing systems
* Fire protection systems
* Mechanical Balance of Plant systems

* Experience in selection and sizing of mechanical/BOP equipment, including pumps, compressors, heat exchangers, tanks and associated equipment.

* Experience in preparation and review of technical specifications and datasheets for power plant equipment.

* Experience in design and engineering review of CCGT/OCGT plants, particularly mechanical and BOP systems.

* Experience in technical evaluation of EPC bids, OEM/vendor proposals and technical guarantees.

* Experience reviewing power plant performance calculations, equipment sizing calculations and contractor/vendor engineering documentation.

* Familiarity with applicable international codes and standards such as ASME, API, NFPA and ISO.

* Experience working on large power generation projects, preferably in the Middle East/GCC region.

* Ability to coordinate effectively within multidisciplinary engineering teams and work independently to meet project deadlines.

* Strong analytical, technical report-writing and communication skills.

* Willingness to travel internationally for project meetings, site visits and FATs.

Desired Skills

* Knowledge and experience with GT PRO or equivalent thermodynamic/performance modelling software.

* Knowledge of IPP/IWPP contractual and project structures.

* Knowledge of power plant CAPEX/OPEX and equipment cost benchmarking.

* Experience with technical due diligence, commissioning and performance testing of power generation assets would be an advantage.

  

* The candidate should be a graduate mechanical engineer with minimum 10 years of relevant experience

* Experienced user of Microsoft Office.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design and deliver major features while leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity, operational excellence, and business outcomes. You will build secure, scalable, and maintainable systems, lead feature and subsystem design, and ensure operational readiness through automation, observability, and AI-assisted workflows.

You will work independently on complex projects, collaborate across teams, drive root cause analysis, and identify opportunities to use AI for improving development, testing, troubleshooting, operational efficiency, and customer experience. A key expectation of the role is to use AI-driven insights and automation to reduce operational overhead, improve service reliability, accelerate delivery, and minimize technical debt while delivering scalable, customer-focused solutions.

  

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges.

We offer unique opportunities for smart, hands-on engineers with the expertise and passion to solve difficult problems in distributed highly available services and virtualized infrastructure. At every level, our engineers have a significant technical and business impact designing and building innovative new systems to power our customer’s business critical applications.

**Who are we looking for?**

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building next-generation cloud security and compliance solutions, and we’re looking for skilled **Software Engineers** to join our **Cloud Guard / Assurance Service** team. Be part of our mission to create the most secure cloud environment. In this pivotal, hands-on engineering role, you will **architect and develop scalable, innovative solutions** that ensure OCI resources start secure and remain secure. You’ll also build **automated mechanisms** for compliance reporting, control deployment, and exception management. You’ll work closely with top engineers, product managers, and security teams to deliver features that strengthen OCI’s security posture and provide a **unified, single-pane-of-glass experience** for both detective and preventive controls.

We are looking for engineers with distributed systems experience. You should have experience with the design of major features and launching them into production. You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You work on most projects and tasks independently. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations.

The ideal candidate will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle’s Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a rock-solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low-level systems, as well as design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.

**What are the biggest challenges for the team?**

The biggest challenges for the team are reliability, performance and keep up in cybersecurity space. The dynamic and fast growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns with full coverage that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today.

We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right tradeoffs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution.

We need engineers who can build services that can reliably protect our customer cloud environment. We need engineers who can figure out how we can keep up our solution in a fast pace to securely protect our customers. We need engineers who can build services that enable us to offer even more options to customers and contribute to the overall growth of Oracle Cloud.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment

* Experience driving feature design reviews, documentation, UX reviews, and working with Product Managers through the entire launch process

* Strong development experience in Java, C++, C#, or similar OO languages

* Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals

* Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures

* Good understanding of databases, SQL, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies

* Experience building multi-tenant, virtualized infrastructure a strong plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience developing services on a public cloud platform (e.g., AWS, Azure, Oracle)

* Building continuous integration/deployment pipelines with robust testing and deployment schedules

* Expertise in applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques to develop security solutions

* Experience and understanding of Cryptograph, DDoS, CVE, CIS, SAST, DAST, or similar security and compliance knowledge

title: Cloud Solutions Architect Manager - Global Accounts
description:
**Overview**

iCSU is Microsoft's Customer Success organisation for our largest multinational customers. It works across three time zones (Americas, EMEA and Asia) as one global team, so a customer gets the same quality of engagement wherever they operate. Customer Success Account Managers own the executive relationship, coordinate stakeholders and plan the customer's journey. Cloud Solution Architects (CSAs) turn business needs into working solutions in AI, Copilot and agents, Azure, data and security. We work closely with the account teams, local Customer Success Units (CSUs), delivery and engineering. Our goal is to move customers from buying Microsoft technology to getting real business value from it. iCSU Vision is to be the trusted transformation partner for the world's most global enterprises, so every customer gets measurable business value from Microsoft AI and Cloud in every country where they operate.

As an iCSU CSA manager, you lead CSAs who handle some of Microsoft's most complex and visible customer relationships. It's a role for leaders who want global scope, close contact with senior executives, and the chance to shape how Microsoft delivers AI transformation at scale.

By leveraging your business and technical expertise, you will coach and empower your team to drive outcomes through AI Business Solutions and Unified Support. This is a people management role, with accountability for a portfolio of customers and aligned Microsoft business metrics.

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Drive business value and BDM engagement skilling, coaching your team on how articulate the business value impact of transforming with AI. Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within your team that includes sharing experiences/learnings with the broader CSA community.
* Resolve blockers with urgency: Drive team to anticipate, identify, escalate and mitigate blockers to accelerate solution deployment and usage.
* Operational Excellence: Focus on operational excellence by aligning technical & business value paths to metrics, ensuring accurate milestone creation and implementing rigorous execution to drive usage excellence across the portfolio.
* Unified & VAS growth: Ensure team delivers with excellence to give customers great Unified experience that helps realize the value they invest in. Coach the team to use all available engagement opportunities to create VAS or Unified opportunities that the STU will drive, leading to Unified VAS growth.

**Required Qualifications (RQs)**

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field

title: Ingénieur(e) En Gestion De Données ML
description:
**Faites Carrière Avec Nous**
-----------------------------

### **À propos de l'opportunité**

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne expérimentée pour le poste d'**Architecte Cloud Hybride** à **Montréal**. Dans ce rôle hybride, vous concevrez, mettrez en œuvre et superviserez des solutions infonuagiques sécurisées, évolutives et rentables, principalement sur **Amazon Web Services (AWS)**, avec une possible implication sur **GCP** et **Microsoft Azure**. Vous dirigerez des initiatives d'architecture, établirez des bonnes pratiques, soutiendrez la modernisation des applications et favoriserez l'automatisation des infrastructures, tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, la sécurité et la conformité.

### **Ce que vous ferez**

* Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des zones d'atterrissage, des stratégies multi-comptes et des architectures réseau sur AWS
* Créer et gérer des VPC, sous-réseaux, UDR et VPC Peering dans des environnements HCP
* Provisionner l'infrastructure via des outils IaC tels que **Terraform** et **CloudFormation**
* Développer des fonctions **Lambda** pour automatiser les tâches opérationnelles
* Mettre en place des pipelines **GitOps et CI/CD** pour le déploiement d'infrastructure
* Gérer des charges de travail **Kubernetes** via **AKS** et **EKS**
* Assurer la gestion des correctifs, des sauvegardes et de l'**IAM**
* Surveiller les environnements cloud avec **CloudWatch**, **Prometheus** et **Grafana**
* Optimiser les coûts cloud selon les pratiques **FinOps**
* Intégrer des approches basées sur l'**IA** pour faire progresser les capacités Cloud Hybride

### **Ce que vous apportez**

* **8 à 15 ans** d'expérience en TI, dont au moins **5 ans** sur AWS
* Solide expérience en conception réseau et développement sur AWS
* Maîtrise d'**Ansible, Python et AWS CLI**
* Connaissance des services **PaaS** (RDS, SageMaker) et de l'administration **Linux**
* Expérience avec les processus **ITIL** et la gestion des changements
* Excellentes aptitudes en communication, résolution de problèmes et collaboration interfonctionnelle
* Expérience en mentorat et gestion des parties prenantes

**Grow With Us**
----------------

### **About the Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced **Hybrid Cloud Architect** to join our team in **Montreal** in a hybrid capacity. You will design, implement, and govern secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions primarily on **AWS**, with potential involvement across **GCP** and **Microsoft Azure**. You will lead architecture initiatives, establish best practices, support application modernization, and drive automation — all while ensuring operational excellence, security, and compliance.

### **What You Will Do**

* Design and implement landing zones, multi-account strategies, and network architectures on AWS
* Create and manage VPCs, Subnets, UDRs, and VPC Peering within HCP networks
* Provision cloud infrastructure using IaC tools such as **Terraform** and **CloudFormation**
* Write **Lambda functions** to automate operational tasks
* Implement **GitOps and CI/CD pipelines** for infrastructure deployment
* Manage **Kubernetes** workloads using **AKS** and **EKS**
* Perform patching, backup management, and **IAM** administration
* Monitor environments using **CloudWatch**, **Prometheus**, and **Grafana**
* Optimize cloud spending using **FinOps** best practices
* Apply **AI-driven approaches** to advance Hybrid Cloud capabilities

### **What You Will Bring**

* **8–15 years** of IT experience, with at least **5 years** hands-on with AWS
* Strong background in AWS design, development, and networking
* Proficiency with **Ansible, Python, and AWS CLI**
* Knowledge of **PaaS services** (RDS, SageMaker) and **Linux OS** administration
* Familiarity with **ITIL processes** and change management

title: Software Engineering Lead - GenAI Platforms
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**The Team & Culture**
======================

We are a research-driven startup operating within the enterprise. Our mission? Building the bank's next-generation GenAI platforms—Citi Stylus Workspaces and mission-critical AI infrastructure serving Citi employees globally. We move with startup velocity while maintaining enterprise-grade security, compliance, and reliability. We build at the frontier of AI, architecting scalable systems where cutting-edge models meet cloud-native excellence.

  
  

**The Role**
============

We are looking for a **Software Engineering Lead** who architects, codes, and leads. This is a senior technical leadership role (SVP) for someone who wants to drive the backend vision and full-stack execution of enterprise GenAI platforms. You will design high-performance AI systems at the intersection of modern cloud-native development and cutting-edge AI—combining hands-on engineering mastery with strategic technical leadership. You'll work with Claude, Gemini, and proprietary models on OpenShift/Kubernetes, building microservices that transform how employees interact with AI.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Architect at Scale**: Design and build core GenAI platform components serving 180,000+ users with exceptional performance, reliability, and security across distributed systems.

* **Engineer Full-Stack Excellence**: Implement complex features across the entire stack—from Go microservices and document pipelines to React interfaces and real-time streaming architectures.

* **Lead AI/ML Innovation**: Build production-grade LLM applications, architect vector databases, implement agentic capabilities, and optimize AI inference for performance and cost efficiency.

* **Own DevOps & Production**: Design observability solutions, lead incident response and blameless postmortems, build CI/CD pipelines, and ensure production excellence through comprehensive monitoring and alerting.

* **Master Cloud Infrastructure**: Architect Kubernetes/OpenShift deployments, implement service mesh (Istio), drive infrastructure-as-code and GitOps workflows, and ensure security best practices at every layer.

* **Drive Technical Vision**: Set architectural direction across services and teams, mentor engineering talent, lead cross-functional collaboration with product and AI researchers, and represent engineering in leadership forums.
  

  

**Who You Are**
===============

* **A Technical Architect**: Expert-level Go programmer (5+ years) with deep concurrency knowledge, proficient in TypeScript/React (3+ years), and fluent in microservices architecture, clean code principles, and distributed systems design.

* **A Cloud-Native Expert**: Deep understanding of Kubernetes/OpenShift, service mesh implementations, containerization at scale, and infrastructure-as-code with proven experience in high-throughput, low-latency systems.

* **A Production Leader**: 15+ years software development experience with 5+ years in technical leadership, 5+ years with cloud-native architectures, and 3+ years with AI/ML systems in production—delivering enterprise-scale systems (10,000+ users) successfully.

* **An AI/ML Engineer**: Practical experience implementing production LLM applications, prompt engineering, vector databases, streaming architectures, RAG patterns, and multi-agent orchestration.

* **A Strategic Influencer**: Exceptional communicator who translates complex technical concepts into business value, partners with engineering, security, and business leaders, and drives engineering excellence through mentorship and best practices.

* **Mission-Driven**: Passionate about AI-powered systems, hands-on when needed, comfortable with ambiguity, pragmatic under constraints, and relentlessly focused on quality and innovation.
  

  

**Why Join Us?**
================

This is your opportunity to architect the future of enterprise AI at global scale. You'll work with cutting-edge AI infrastructure, collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers, and build systems with real business impact across a global financial institution. SVP-level technical leadership with startup autonomy, enterprise resources, and the challenge of bringing frontier GenAI capabilities safely, securely, and at scale. If you're ready to define what's possible, we want you on our team.

**Education**: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  
  

**Technical Stack**: Go microservices, React 19+/TypeScript, OpenShift/Kubernetes, MongoDB/Redis/S3, REST/gRPC/WebSockets, Claude/Gemini/proprietary LLMs, OAuth/JWT/Vault, GitOps CI/CD, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK.

title: Silicon Formal Verification Engineer III
description:

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in the formal verification domain, including working with one or more tools (e.g., Jasper, VC Formal, Questa Formal, 360-DV).

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.

**About the job**
-----------------

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Plan the formal verification strategy and create the properties and constraints for complex digital design blocks.
* Utilize formal property verification tools combined with formal verification closure techniques to verify properties.
* Resolve difficult to verify properties. Contribute improvements to methodologies to enhance formal verification results.

title: Mainframe Data Modernization Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**  
  
As a Principal Data Modernization Architect, you will define and own the target-state data architecture for enterprise modernization and cloud transformation programs. You will provide technical leadership across multiple initiatives, guiding teams and executive stakeholders on legacy database transformation, migration strategies, and enterprise data governance.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Data Modernization Architecture:** Assess legacy data environments (DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM), define target-state architectures, develop modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformation, establish enterprise migration standards/frameworks, and guide target platform selection.
* **Database Transformation Strategy:** Design migration approaches for legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native services; drive database decomposition and domain separation; and govern schema transformation, data model redesign, metadata, data quality, and data integrity.
* **Data Migration & Coexistence:** Architect high-volume, near-zero-downtime migrations and cutovers using migration waves, Change Data Capture (CDC), and real-time synchronization to ensure data consistency during coexistence periods.
* **Data Architecture & Governance:** Establish enterprise data modeling, lineage, traceability, security, compliance, privacy, performance, scalability, backup, and disaster recovery (DR) standards while collaborating with application architects.
* **Technical Leadership:** Provide architectural oversight across modernization programs, conduct architecture reviews, approve transformation designs, mentor engineering and migration teams, and advise executive stakeholders on strategic decisions.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Extensive experience defining target-state enterprise data architectures and modernization roadmaps aligned with cloud transformations.
* Deep hands-on expertise assessing and migrating legacy mainframe data platforms, including DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, and VSAM.
* Proven track record designing migrations from legacy hierarchical and relational databases to modern relational, NoSQL, and cloud-native databases.
* Strong expertise in database decomposition, data domain separation, schema transformation, and data model redesign.
* Demonstrated experience architecting high-volume, near-zero-downtime data migrations, coexistence architectures, and cutover strategies.
* Practical proficiency implementing Change Data Capture (CDC) and real-time data synchronization mechanisms.
* Solid background establishing enterprise data governance, lineage, metadata management, data quality, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance.
Experience defining non-functional database standards, including performance, scalability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery (DR).  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing enterprise-wide migration patterns, frameworks, and architectural review boards.
* Strong background collaborating with application architects to align data and application modernization strategies.
* Proven leadership mentoring database engineers, migration specialists, and cross-functional modernization teams.
* Ability to advise and influence executive stakeholders on complex modernization recommendations and strategic investments.
* Experience managing data consistency and reconciliation across hybrid source and target environments during multi-wave migrations.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native data ecosystems and multi-cloud database services.
Track record governing large-scale enterprise programs with strict regulatory and data traceability requirements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl:**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important ,you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused , someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless , naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 15+ years in data and database architecture, including 7+ years leading enterprise-scale database migration, modernization, synchronization, and coexistence programs from mainframe environments.
* **Legacy Mainframe Technologies:** Deep expertise in IBM DB2, IMS DB, FOCUS, VSAM, legacy mainframe data architectures, and mainframe data modeling.
* **Modern Database Platforms:** Strong proficiency across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Cosmos DB), and cloud-native database services.
* **Data Engineering & Migration:** Hands-on experience with data modeling, schema transformation, ETL/ELT design, Change Data Capture (CDC), data synchronization, and data migration frameworks.
* **Data Management & Governance:** Proven background in establishing data quality management and enterprise data governance frameworks.
* **Architecture & Operations:** Expertise in enterprise data architecture, High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), database security, performance engineering, and capacity planning.
* **High-Volume Execution:** Demonstrated success designing and delivering high-volume migration solutions and complex cutover plans.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Mainframe Modernization Expertise:** Skilled in hierarchical-to-relational transformation, database decomposition strategies, relational-to-NoSQL architecture decisions, mainframe data encoding/data-type/structure transformation, and EBCDIC-to-ASCII/Unicode conversion.
* **Large-Scale Migration & Coexistence:** Experience executing multi-wave migrations using near-zero-downtime cutover strategies, parallel run/synchronization models, CDC architectures, and data reconciliation/validation frameworks.
* **Modernization Governance:** Background in data lineage, impact analysis, mainframe-to-cloud data coexistence, hybrid data architecture, data domain rationalization, and migration risk assessment/mitigation.
* **Industry & Program Governance:** Experience governing enterprise-wide data architecture and modernization programs in mission-critical industries (banking, insurance, retail, or healthcare).
* **Cloud & AI Tooling:** Hands-on experience with cloud database platforms on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, plus exposure to AI-assisted modernization and automated schema transformation tools.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**What will you contribute?**

  

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect who will serve as a recognized enterprise technical authority for Artificial Intelligence architecture. You will set the strategic technical direction for AI capabilities across products, platforms, and business segments, including generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, AI platforms, model integration, evaluation, governance, security, and responsible AI.

Your secondary focus will be cloud and SaaS architecture. You will ensure that enterprise AI strategy is realized through secure, scalable, resilient, multi-tenant, observable, and cost-effective cloud services, while influencing investment priorities, platform evolution, and cross-product adoption

  

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**  
  
Your deliverables as a **[Role Name]** will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Set the enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference patterns, capability roadmaps, and technology strategy across multiple products, platforms, and business segments.

* Provide authoritative architectural direction for generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, model integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation.

* Sponsor and lead strategic AI research, technology evaluations, and Proofs of Concept, translating validated outcomes into reusable, production-grade capabilities with measurable business value.

* Establish enterprise guardrails for responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, observability, auditability, and human oversight in regulated environments.

* Shape cloud-native and SaaS architecture strategy for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, scalability, resilience, availability, metering, subscription models, and cost management.

* Create and drive adoption of reference architectures, reference implementations, patterns, libraries, accelerators, and engineering guidance across product and platform teams.

* Govern and review strategic architecture and design proposals for alignment with AI strategy, cloud and SaaS principles, enterprise standards, security, regulatory obligations, and long-term sustainability.

* Influence executive and senior technical decisions across architecture, engineering, product, data, security, cloud platforms, governance, and business leadership.

* Develop senior architects and principal engineers, and lead enterprise architecture forums, technical councils, workshops, demonstrations, hackathons, and global knowledge-sharing communities.

  
  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

AI Architecture & Strategy

Enterprise-wide AI target architecture, principles, standards, investment roadmaps, technology portfolio decisions, and adoption strategy across products and business segments.

Generative AI & LLM Systems

Strategic direction for LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, model routing, grounding, safety, and production controls at enterprise scale.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Enterprise standards for search, embeddings, vector retrieval, chunking, ranking, grounding, citations, authorization-aware access, and measurable retrieval quality.

Agentic AI

Enterprise patterns and governance for agent orchestration, tool use, workflow design, memory, planning, permissions, human approval, monitoring, and failure containment.

AI Platforms & Integration

Shared model gateways, AI services, APIs, event-driven integration, data pipelines, reusable platform capabilities, and consistent embedding of AI across products.

AI Evaluation & Observability

Enterprise evaluation strategy spanning quality, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, drift, telemetry, red-teaming, and continuous assurance.

Organization-wide security, privacy, regulatory alignment, model risk, data governance, explainability, auditability, accountability, and human oversight.

  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

**Secondary Skills: Cloud & SaaS**
==================================

description:

**Company:**
Kriyal

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from home

**Experience:**
2–4 years

**About Kriyal**

Kriyal is building personal intelligence that can think, act, and interact with the real world while remaining fully owned and controlled by the individual.

We are creating secure, privacy-preserving systems that allow people to leverage advanced AI without giving up autonomy, control, or ownership of their data.

Our platform spans personal AI, multimodal intelligence, edge inference, private infrastructure, AI agents, memory, and robotics.

Security and privacy are foundational principles of the platform, not features added after deployment.

Kriyal offers engineers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge infrastructure at the intersection of
**AI, cloud, edge computing, security, and privacy**
.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Cloud Infrastructure & DevSecOps Engineer — Security & Compliance**
to help build and operate Kriyal’s secure cloud infrastructure.

You will work closely with the engineering team to deploy reliable infrastructure, automate operations, strengthen cloud security, and establish the technical controls required for security and compliance programs such as
**SOC 2 and HIPAA**
.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will be expected to build, automate, troubleshoot, document, and continuously improve our infrastructure.

You do not need to be an expert in every compliance framework on day one. We are looking for someone with strong infrastructure fundamentals who is interested in growing into cloud security and compliance ownership.

**ResponsibilitiesCloud Infrastructure**

* Deploy and maintain production infrastructure on
  **AWS and/or Google Cloud**
  .
* Configure secure networking, compute, storage, databases, and supporting services.
* Manage Linux-based cloud infrastructure and system administration.
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational dashboards.
* Support high availability, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Monitor cloud usage and help optimize infrastructure costs.
* Maintain separate development, staging, and production environments.

**DevSecOps & Automation**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using
  **Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools**
  .
* Integrate security checks into CI/CD workflows.
* Automate operational and security tasks wherever practical.
* Manage containerized workloads and deployment infrastructure.
* Improve deployment reliability, repeatability, and observability.

**Cloud Security**

* Implement and maintain IAM and least-privilege access.
* Configure security groups, firewalls, VPNs, private networking, and other cloud security controls.
* Manage secrets, credentials, certificates, and encryption.
* Monitor infrastructure for security issues and misconfigurations.
* Assist with vulnerability scanning, patching, and remediation.
* Maintain centralized security and audit logs.
* Participate in incident investigation and response.
* Conduct regular infrastructure security reviews.

**Security & Compliance**

Work with engineering leadership and external compliance/security advisors to implement technical controls supporting:

* **SOC 2**
* **HIPAA**
* ISO 27001 and other applicable security frameworks

Responsibilities may include:

* Maintaining access-control evidence.
* Supporting security and compliance audits.
* Maintaining asset inventories.
* Documenting infrastructure and security configurations.
* Supporting vulnerability and penetration testing.
* Maintaining evidence for security controls.
* Supporting security policies and operational procedures.
* Tracking remediation activities.
* Helping automate compliance evidence collection.

**What We Are Looking ForRequired**

* 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, Cloud Security, or a related engineering role.
* Hands-on experience with
  **AWS, GCP, or both**
  .
* Strong Linux/Unix fundamentals.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and network security.
* Hands-on experience with
  **Terraform or another Infrastructure-as-Code tool**
  .
* Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Git and modern software-development workflows.
* Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
* Understanding of IAM, secrets management, encryption, and access control.
* Experience with cloud monitoring and logging.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to document infrastructure, configurations, and procedures clearly.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with both AWS and GCP.
* Kubernetes experience.
* Experience with cloud security tooling.
* Experience with vulnerability scanning and remediation.
* Experience with security incident response.
* Experience with
  **SOC 2 or HIPAA**
  environments.
* Experience with Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, or similar compliance platforms.
* Experience implementing ISO 27001 controls.
* Experience supporting penetration testing or security audits.
* Experience securing AI/ML infrastructure.
* Experience with edge computing or hybrid cloud infrastructure.
* AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, or security certifications.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

**What You’ll Learn**

This role provides an opportunity to develop expertise across:

**Cloud Infrastructure → DevSecOps → Cloud Security → Privacy → Compliance → AI Infrastructure**

You will work directly with engineers building a next-generation personal AI platform and gain exposure to the security requirements involved in taking AI systems into production.

**What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you will help Kriyal establish infrastructure that is:

* Secure by default.
* Reproducible through Infrastructure-as-Code.
* Observable and auditable.
* Reliable and resilient.
* Automated wherever practical.
* Cost-conscious.
* Prepared for SOC 2 and HIPAA requirements.
* Designed to protect sensitive and private data.

**Ideal Candidate**

You are someone who enjoys figuring out how systems work and fixing problems when they don’t.

You don’t just want to operate infrastructure — you want to understand
**why**
it works, how to make it safer, and how to automate it.

You are comfortable working in an early-stage environment where you will have significant ownership and where the infrastructure will evolve rapidly.

Most importantly, you are excited about building the infrastructure and security foundation for
**personal AI that people can actually own and control**
.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
* Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
* Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
+ Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

description:

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The AWS Data Center Supply Solutions team is looking for a Real Estate Development Manager to drive our infrastructure strategy execution in India. As a Real Estate Development Manager with Amazon Web Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help build data centers, the physical backbone of Amazon Web Services. As the contract owner, you will interface with property developers and partners on technical, commercial and legal negotiations as well as ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and commitments. The role will be the single point of escalation for multiple internal stakeholders, technical teams, legal, and finance to resolve conflicts and set expectations. You should have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions. A successful candidate will have the aptitude to strategically plan, make decisions, act tactically, write effectively, and display strong analytical and critical thinking skills. You must be a proven problem solver, and possess the ability to influence cross platform functions and business stakeholders to achieve regional strategic goals.
  
  
As this position involves direct contact with senior AWS leaders you must have a professional demeanor, strong business acumen, and be able to communicate ideas in a clear and articulate manner. Additionally this role requires deep knowledge of the Indian developer and construction market as well as a solid understanding of the full development lifecycle - from local permitting and development approvals, best practices in design, procurement, construction, and ultimately successful project delivery. The role is to be based in Mumbai and will require 10~20% business travel to support regional expansion activities, training, and team off-sites.

**Location:** Mumbai (in-person, onsite role), with visits to warehouses and operational facilities
  
**Reports to:** Top management / C-suite
  
**Compensation:** Industry standard

**About the Company**
---------------------

India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.

**About the Role**
------------------

ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.

The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.

The role will act as the **primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,** ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.

The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management**

* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.

* **Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight**

* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.

* **UAT and Solution Acceptance**

* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
