title: AWS Cloud & DevSecOps Consultant
description:
We are building a secure, enterprise-grade AWS platform for our PERN-stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js) ERP applications. A detailed blueprint (about 170 documented steps) already exists from our first setup. We need a hands-on cloud engineer to build the same setup for two more group companies, from the first AWS account to a live production application, and to hand everything over with full documentation.

Responsibilities (for each company)

1. Account & billing - AWS account creation, root MFA, company billing and GST invoicing, budgets and cost-anomaly alerts .

2.AWS Organization -Organization with Dev / Prod / Security OUs; Dev, Prod and Audit accounts; centralized root access

3. Guardrails (SCPs)-Region lock (Mumbai), CloudTrail protection, data-protection and security-lock policies, all tested.

4.Identity & access -IAM Identity Center, enforced MFA, groups and permission sets, least privilege, emergency admin, no IAM users or long-term keys.

5. Security & monitoring- Organization CloudTrail with protected log bucket, GuardDuty (incl. RDS protection), IAM Access Analyzer, Security Hub, EventBridge + SNS alerting, encryption by default, default-VPC removal.

6.Network -VPC and CIDR planning, 3-tier subnets, route tables, NAT, VPC endpoints, security groups, VPC flow logs.

7. Data layer- RDS PostgreSQL (private, encrypted, Multi-AZ for production), database roles (app / migrator / read-only), Secrets Manager, ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis) with RBAC, AWS Backup with vault lock.

8. Compute & delivery- EC2 launch templates (Graviton), user-data bootstrap, Session Manager (no SSH), ALB + Auto Scaling for production, CloudFront + S3 for the React frontend, WAF, ACM certificates, Route 53.

9.CI/CD & GitHub -GitHub organization setup, fork → pull request → owner-approval flow, GitHub Actions (secret scanning, dependency audit), OIDC deployment to AWS without stored keys, owner-only production release, rollback

10.Cost control -Right-sizing, start/stop schedules for Dev, Savings Plans guidance, staying within approved budgets.

11. Handover -Setup checklist, handover document, runbooks, incident plan, knowledge-transfer sessions for the internal IT team.

Must Have - 2–4 years in cloud / DevOps, with at least 1–2 years of hands-on AWS (real projects, not only training)

* Has worked with AWS Organizations, SCPs and IAM Identity Center (or is able to follow our documented blueprint step by step)

* Strong in VPC networking, security groups, RDS PostgreSQL, EC2, ALB, Auto Scaling, CloudFront, S3 and WAF

* Security-first mindset: least privilege, encryption, secrets management, audit logging
* CI/CD with GitHub Actions and OIDC to AWS; deploying Node.js and React applications.

.Linux (Amazon Linux) and Bash; basic PostgreSQL administration

* Clear written documentation and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

Good to have • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK / CloudFormation), so later companies are built from code

* AWS Control Tower / landing-zone experience
* ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis), AWS Backup, Security Hub
* Experience with Indian billing (AISPL, GST) and SME-sized budgets.

Working rules

* The company keeps ownership of root logins, payment methods, GitHub organization ownership and production releases.
* The consultant receives time-bound administrator access through IAM Identity Center only; access is removed at contract end.
* No access to real business data beyond what is strictly needed to set up production.
* NDA and confidentiality agreement required. No company code or data in personal accounts or AI tools without approval.
* Every completed step is recorded in the setup checklist with date and time.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: Senior Consultant - ML Engineering
description:
**About SiriusAI**

Sirius AI is a US headquartered AI Consulting services and products company with operations in India. Sirius AI focuses on Financial Services enterprises and solutions / services delivered across multiple geographies. We are an innovation-driven AI and data driven consulting services firm with a high focus on delivering business outcomes for our clients. The Sirius AI team is a mix of talent from a diverse background of Consulting, Industry and Product companies which bring together their Data, Platform, Ecosystem, Technology, Project management and AI skills to develop new solutions and deliver client engagements.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly skilled
**Senior Consultant - ML Engineering**
with 2-4 years of experience to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for consulting clients across Financial Services and other industries. The ideal candidate will combine strong backend engineering expertise in Python with deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks, large language models, and cloud-native architectures, and will collaborate closely with data science, frontend, DevOps, and client-facing consulting teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and deploy end-to-end Machine Learning, Deep Learning, LLM/Agents-based solutions, including classification, regression, fraud detection, anomaly detection, forecasting and predictive modelling.

* Develop enterprise GenAI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and agentic AI frameworks.

* Design and optimize data processing and pipeline orchestration workflows using PySpark, Airflow, Kubeflow or managed cloud services.
* Develop secure, scalable and reliable AI systems with appropriate observability, access controls, governance and cost optimization.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and client-facing teams on solution architecture, technical design, POCs and enterprise delivery.
* Drive engineering best practices, technical reviews, code quality and mentoring of team members.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with production-quality coding, Git-based development practices, hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow and Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Flask or Django, REST APIs.
* Train, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models where they outperform off-the-shelf solutions
* Strong understanding of ML algorithms, statistical modelling, feature engineering, model evaluation and optimization, also including model deployment, serving, monitoring, observability, and retraining in production
* Rapidly prototype and validate new ideas, then harden the successful ones into production-grade systems
* Understanding of transformer-based models, distributed or multi-GPU training, checkpointing, mixed precision, data loading, model serving and performance optimization for transformer-based models.
* Practical experience building LLM-powered applications using RAG, embeddings, vector databases and prompt engineering.
* Experience deploying scalable AI applications using containerization and cloud-native services and practical knowledge of cloud compute, storage, and GPU-enabled AI workloads across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience designing and operating training, evaluation, batch-scoring and deployment pipelines using Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker or Vertex AI.
* Hands-on experience with Docker, CI/CD, model registries, experiment tracking and reproducible environments.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or Google ADK.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in Financial Services use cases such as credit risk, fraud detection, AML, transaction monitoring and customer analytics.
* Exposure to Foundation Models, domain-specific model development, fine-tuning and GPU infrastructure.
* Experience building production grade multi-agent systems (task delegation, coordination, and autonomous decision-making)
* Use AI coding tools and agents throughout design, development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience with computer vision, reinforcement learning and continuous self-learning.
* Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Databricks, Snowflake)
* Knowledge of responsible AI, AI safety, and model explain ability.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build cutting-edge AI, GenAI, Agentic AI and Foundation Model solutions for global enterprises.
* Exposure to complex, high-impact Financial Services AI transformation initiatives.
* Opportunity to work on enterprise AI platforms, reusable accelerators and next-generation AI products.
* High ownership, technical challenges and collaboration with experienced AI architects and technology leaders.
* Competitive compensation, continuous learning and accelerated career growth.

title: Lead AI Solutions & Security Architect
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Lead AI Solutions & Security Architect to spearhead the development, deployment, and governance of our artificial intelligence capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end creation and dispatch of enterprise AI tools, ensuring all systems are secure by design. You will champion the implementation of industry-leading compliance standards and act as the primary liaison between our technical teams and executive leadership, translating highly complex technical and security concepts into clear strategic insights.

Key Responsibilities

* **AI Tool Development & Dispatch:** Design, build, and operationalize custom AI tools, machine learning models, and autonomous agents. Oversee the successful dispatch, integration, and scaling of these tools across enterprise systems.
* **Framework Implementation & Governance:** Architect and govern AI implementations in strict alignment with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) and relevant ISO standards (including ISO/IEC 42001 for AI Management Systems and ISO/IEC 27001 for Information Security).
* **Cybersecurity Integration:** Embed robust cybersecurity protocols into the AI lifecycle. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate AI-specific threat vectors (e.g., data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion) and secure the underlying data pipelines and infrastructure.
* **Executive Storytelling & Stakeholder Alignment:** Serve as the strategic bridge between deep technical execution and business leadership. Distill complex AI mechanisms, security postures, and implementation risks into easily digestible, actionable presentations for C-suite executives, board members, and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Continuous Monitoring:** Establish automated monitoring and auditing processes to ensure dispatched AI tools continuously meet performance, ethical, and security benchmarks post-deployment.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Technical Experience:** 3+ years of experience in AI engineering, software development, or systems architecture, with a proven track record of creating and dispatching AI tools into production environments.
* **Cybersecurity Expertise:** Deep practical knowledge of enterprise cybersecurity, secure coding practices, cloud security architecture, and AI vulnerabilities.
* **Framework Proficiency:** Demonstrated hands-on experience applying NIST and ISO/IEC frameworks to technology implementations and managing compliance audits.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Must demonstrate the ability to present complex technical roadmaps and security strategies to non-technical executives with clarity, confidence, and business context.
* **Technical Stack:** Proficiency in Python, modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), LLM orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex), and secure cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent enterprise experience). Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISA, Security+, or AI-specific credentials) are highly preferred.

title: ENGINEER - CMDB DATA QUALITY
description:
Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
  
  
GCL: C1/C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
  
  
In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
  
  
From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
  
  
CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
  
  
Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
  
  
Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
  
  
CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
  
  
Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.
  
  
Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.
  
  
Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data / Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, IT asset or configuration management, technology operations, data quality or technology data analysis.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
* Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
* Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing operational reports and dashboards.
* Ability to collaborate across technology teams, drive stakeholder remediation and manage competing priorities independently.
* Clear written and verbal communication and documentation skills.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with CMDB 360, ServiceNow Data Manager, Certification and Predictive Intelligence.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, and IRE and reconciliation.
* SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
* Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, technology and science meet at scale to make a tangible difference for patients. You will join an inclusive, cross-functional community that pairs deep domain expertise with modern platforms, data and AI to remove friction, simplify processes and unlock speed across the enterprise. We back bold ideas with real investment, value kindness alongside ambition, and give you the ownership to experiment, learn and deliver lasting impact. Your contribution will improve how teams plan change, respond to incidents and protect critical services that keep our medicines moving to those who need them.

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

title: RR-0345080- Associate Manager Infrastructure Services
description:
**Job Description:**

**1. Primary Function**

The L3 Network Security Engineer will serve as the **escalation point for complex network security incidents** and ensure smooth operations of enterprise security infrastructure. Responsibilities include:

  

* Leading incident management and problem resolution for security-related events.
* Guiding L1 & L2 teams in day-to-day network security operations.
* Configuring, reviewing, and optimizing firewalls, load balancers, and monitoring tools.
* Monitoring and analyzing incidents to ensure SLA compliance.
* Identifying root causes and implementing preventive measures.
* Participating in security design, implementation, and audits.

**2. Qualifications and Skills**

**2.1 Primary Skills**

  

* Strong troubleshooting skills in **network security incidents**.
* Knowledge of **ITSM processes** (ITIL Foundation preferred).
* Ability to design and manage **secure network solutions**.
* High commitment to quality, customer responsiveness, and service delivery.
* Ability to communicate complex technical security concepts simply.
* Consulting mindset with flexibility and resourcefulness.
* Proven experience in environments requiring stringent uptime and compliance.

**2.2 Qualifications**

  

* Graduation/Diploma from a recognized university with **10+ years of experience in Networking & Security**.
* Preferred Certifications:
* **Palo Alto (PA)**
* **Checkpoint**
* **Cisco CCNP Security** or equivalent
* **Fortinet NSE** (added advantage)
* **F5 Certified Administrator / Specialist** (mandatory for LTM/GTM, APM added advantage)
* **ITIL Certification**

**2.3 Experience**

* 5+ years in **LAN/WAN support and configuration**.

* 5+ years in **firewall support, configuration, and security policy management**.
* Hands-on experience with **F5 load balancers (LTM/GTM mandatory, APM preferred)**.
* Experience with **network monitoring and security tools**.

**3. Hands-On L3 Experience Required**

* **Technology** **OEM** **Remarks** **Switching** Cisco / HPN Mandatory; others added advantage **Routing** Cisco / HPN Mandatory; others added advantage **Firewalls** Checkpoint & Palo Alto Mandatory; Fortinet added advantage **Load Balancer (LTM/GTM)** F5 Mandatory; APM added advantage **Security Tools** NNMi, SolarWinds, WhatsUp Gold, Wireshark, TCPDump User-level knowledge required

**4. Technical Expertise**

* + Strong understanding of **OSI 7-layer model** and **TCP/IP**.
  + Deep knowledge of **LAN/WAN technologies** with a focus on **secure configurations**.
  + Prior experience in **network security design and implementation**.
  + Expertise in **Network Management Systems** (HP OpenView, SolarWinds).
  + Experience in **multi-data center and branch office security environments**.
  + BFSI sector experience is a plus.
  + Incident & Change Management expertise.
  + Strong customer handling and stakeholder communication skills.

**5. Behavioral & Professional Skills**

  

* Self-motivated, capable of working independently and in teams.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making abilities.
* Effective communication with clients, vendors, and internal teams.
* Willingness to work in **24×7 rotational shifts and on-call operations**.

**6. Managerial & Leadership Skills**

* **Team Leadership & People Management:** Lead and mentor Network L1/L2/L3 engineers, allocate responsibilities, provide technical direction, and drive team accountability.

* **Operational Governance:** Own day-to-day Network operations, service reviews, operational KPIs, incidents, problems, changes, and overall service stability.
* **SLA & Service Delivery Management:** Ensure Network services meet contractual SLA/KPI commitments, proactively identify potential breaches, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* **Major Incident Leadership:** Take ownership during P1/P2 network incidents, coordinate technical teams and OEM/vendor support, establish recovery priorities, and ensure timely stakeholder communication. This builds on the existing L3 escalation and incident-management responsibilities.
* **Problem & RCA Governance:** Review major incident RCAs, ensure permanent corrective actions are implemented, and track recurring issues to closure.
* **Change & Risk Management:** Review high-risk network changes, ensure proper impact/risk assessment and rollback planning, and participate in CAB/change governance.
* **Capacity & Availability Management:** Monitor network utilization, availability, resilience, and performance trends and proactively plan capacity upgrades.
* **Stakeholder & Customer Management:** Act as the primary Network Domain contact for customer leadership, internal delivery teams, security teams, OEMs, and service providers.
* **Vendor/OEM Management:** Coordinate escalations with technology partners such as **Cisco, HPE/HPN, Palo Alto, Check Point, F5, and Fortinet**, which align with the technologies already required in the role.
* **Resource & Shift Management:** Plan shift coverage, on-call support, backups, workload distribution, and resource availability for a 24×7 Network operation. The existing role already requires rotational and on-call support.
* **Team Capability Development:** Identify skill gaps, conduct technical reviews/knowledge-sharing sessions, develop cross-skilling plans, and build L1/L2 capability to reduce unnecessary L3 escalations.
* **Performance & Governance Reporting:** Prepare and present operational dashboards covering incidents, SLA, availability, recurring problems, changes, capacity, risks, and improvement initiatives.
* **Continuous Service Improvement:** Identify automation, monitoring, standardization, and process-improvement opportunities to improve network reliability and operational efficiency.
* **Audit & Compliance Readiness:** Ensure network configurations, changes, documentation, access, and operational processes are compliant with organizational/customer security and audit requirements. The existing JD already calls for experience in stringent uptime/compliance environments and participation in audits.
* **BCP/DR Coordination:** Ensure Network readiness for DR exercises, failover activities, resilience testing, and business continuity requirements.
* **Decision-Making & Escalation Management:** Make timely operational decisions during critical situations and provide clear escalation to senior management where service, security, SLA, or business impact is at risk.
* **Documentation & Knowledge Management:** Ensure network architecture documents, SOPs, runbooks, configuration standards, escalation matrices, and knowledge articles remain current.

* Exposure to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and ISO 17025 compliance.

* Understanding of relational databases and SQL queries.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**
**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**
Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.
  
  
Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.
  
  
This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.
  
  
**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**
**What You'll Do**

* Understand the problem
* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up
* Build the business case
* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact
* Reimagine the solution on Celestara
* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome
* Deliver from UAT to production
* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hypercare and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts
* Own the use case after go-live
* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release
* Be the voice of the customer
* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.
  
  
**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.
  
  
**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.
  
  
**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:
  
  

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.
  
  
**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.
  
  
**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.
  
  
**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.
  
  
**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**
**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-PYTHON and SQL-STAFF
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Staff – Python & Advanced SQL**
**Staff – Software Engineering**
**Experience: Strictly 2+ years**
**Eligibility requirement:**
Candidates must have 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on cloud experience. Freshers, candidates with less than 2 years of experience, and candidates without cloud experience are not eligible for this role.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a financial crime technology team building data-driven solutions for global financial services clients. This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.
* Write complex, optimized SQL for data extraction, transformation, reconciliation, profiling, and investigation use cases.
* Work with large financial datasets, including customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data.
* Translate Financial Crime Compliance requirements into technical designs, data rules, scenarios, and reusable components.
* Support KYC and AML workflows such as customer onboarding, customer risk rating, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, and periodic review.
* Contribute to Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud solutions, including rule implementation, threshold logic, alert generation, data validation, and issue analysis.
* Develop APIs, batch jobs, automation scripts, and integration components using Python.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, debugging, root-cause analysis, and production support.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, business analysts, data engineers, QA teams, and client stakeholders in Agile delivery teams.
* Follow secure coding, version-control, documentation, and deployment practices.

**Primary Skills – Must Have**

* Python: Strong hands-on programming experience, including data structures, functions, object-oriented programming, exception handling, modules, logging, testing, and performance-conscious coding.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.
* Databases: Practical experience with at least one relational database such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or MySQL.
* Data engineering: Experience processing structured data using Python libraries such as pandas and integrating with databases, files, or APIs.
* APIs and services: Working knowledge of REST APIs and Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Engineering practices: Git, unit testing, code review, debugging, documentation, and CI/CD fundamentals.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Candidates should have practical experience developing, deploying, or supporting data-driven applications or services in a cloud environment.

**Good to have**

* Experience with PySpark or distributed data processing.
* Familiarity with orchestration or ETL tools such as Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Experience with data visualization or reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of model or rule performance measures, threshold tuning, false-positive reduction, and data lineage.
* Exposure to Agile delivery tools and practices, including Jira or Azure DevOps.

**Financial Crime domain knowledge**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, and remediation.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators, typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario or rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, back-testing, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlist concepts, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 2–4 years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, or technology delivery.
* Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with less than 2 years of relevant experience will not be considered.
* Cloud experience: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP is mandatory.
* Domain experience: Relevant delivery experience in KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud is good to have.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Production-quality Python and SQL that is accurate, maintainable, secure, and efficient.
* Clear understanding of the business purpose and regulatory context behind the solution being built.
* Strong ownership of assigned deliverables, defects, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to explain technical findings and data issues clearly to both engineering and compliance stakeholders.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Analyst, Customer experience
description:
**Analyst - CX (**
**Operations and Data)**

**About the role**

More of our customer experience now runs on systems rather than people: automated decisions, automated conversations, automated outreach, and rules that close a request without an agent. You will be the day-to-day owner of these systems, build the smaller ones yourself, and own the customer experience data underneath all of them.

Product and engineering build the core of each system. You own what happens around it: the rules and settings, the data it reads and writes, the testing before a change goes live, the monitoring after, and the weekly answer to "is it working, and what did it save?"

You will work across our ticketing, telephony, messaging and bot platforms, and our order, pharmacy, vet consultation and clinic data. You work in SQL, Python and scheduled jobs, with version control and code review. You report to the Senior Manager, Customer Experience.

**What makes this role hard**

* **One customer, many identities.**
  A pet parent can show up under two phone numbers, several orders, a pharmacy prescription, a vet consultation and a clinic visit, each in a different system with its own id. Every profile, call list and measurement you build depends on joining them correctly and saying how much of the data each join covers.
* **Systems you do not control.**
  Much of the stack is vendor platforms. Fields get renamed, new values appear without notice, and records are edited days after they are created. You work through their consoles and APIs, inside their limits, and you catch the change before a report goes wrong.
* **Every rule cuts both ways.**
  A threshold that stops bad claims can also slow down a genuine customer. An automated answer that handles more questions can also get some of them wrong. You measure both sides, every week, and bring the trade-off to your manager with numbers.
* **Measuring what a system really did.**
  Operations teams want every customer treated the same way. You set up holdout groups anyway, so impact is measured rather than assumed.
* **Rules that apply to every call and message.**
  Consent, do-not-disturb and telecom rules apply to automated outreach. Prescription and pet health data are sensitive. You build these rules into every campaign and every table, not as an afterthought.
* **Spikes.**
  Sale days and festival weeks double the load in hours. The systems and the data pipelines have to hold, and you are the person who notices first when they do not.

**What you'll do**

**Run the CX systems day to day**

* **Decision systems:**
  keep the scoring and rules that decide customer requests working as agreed, apply approved changes, log every automatic decision, review wrong approvals and wrong declines every week, and flag drift before it costs money or trust.
* **Conversation systems:**
  maintain the content and logic of our automated conversations once changes are approved, and track quality, resolution and handover rates.
* **Outreach systems:**
  own the call flows, routing and campaigns on the CX side, and produce the daily work lists for customer-facing teams, measuring what each list produced.
* **Customer profile:**
  maintain one view of each customer across orders, conversations, calls, pharmacy, consultations and clinic visits, so every system and every person reads the same history.
* Hold every automated conversation and call to the same standard: full context on handover, an outcome on every session, a record for every call. Find and fix a broken flow before customers notice.

**Change and measure them safely**

* Test every rule, prompt or flow change on test records, test numbers or a small slice of customers before it goes live, and read back what was stored.
* Report each system every week: what it decided, how often it was right, what it saved, and what it cost when it was wrong, against the impact assumed when it was approved.
* Be first on call when a system misbehaves: pause it, tell the owner, find the cause, and write down the fix, with a named second on call and a written runbook for each system.

**Build the smaller systems yourself**

* Build tools and automations in Python, spreadsheet scripting, internal-tool builders or with AI coding assistants: quality audits on chats and calls, ticket automation rules, alerts, and small integrations through APIs and webhooks.
* Take over and maintain integrations and prototypes once they are live.
* Make sure automated flows write the right fields into each record: define the payload, test it, check what was stored and alert on failures.
* Keep code in our repositories, reviewed before release and documented. Back up before you overwrite, and read back after you write.
* Review the output of AI coding assistants as carefully as you would a colleague's.

**Own the CX data**

* Own the customer experience tables from source to report: grain, keys, coverage dates, and the pipelines that fill them, with backfills, run logs and look-back reconciliation for records edited later.
* Define metrics in writing (population, date anchor, rule, denominator) and build the CX dashboards on them. When two dashboards disagree, find out why and take the fix to your manager.
* Own the mappings from platform fields, channels, queues, statuses, campaigns, dispositions and agents to analytics columns, with a check after every change and a visible bucket for unknown values.
* Reconcile tables to each source per day and per team, check freshness, catch schema changes, duplicates and blank rates, and handle timezones and late records explicitly.
* Work with least-privilege access, keep secrets out of code, and collect only the personal data a table needs.

**Turn requests into shipped work**

* Write the requirement notes for new automations and changes: problem, rules, data, test plan and how success is measured. Your manager signs them off before they go to Product.
* Take your own projects from first request to rollout: a pilot, then coordination with engineers and vendors.
* Keep the weekly review numbers dependable, and answer ad hoc questions with findings and a recommendation.

**What we're looking for**

* 3 to 6 years in analytics, analytics engineering or product operations, including at least a year owning tables, pipelines or a live system other people depend on.
* Strong SQL: joins, CTEs and window functions, with queries you can explain and tune.
* Python for pipelines, scheduled jobs and automation, and comfort with version control and code review.
* You have run or changed a live automated system (a bot, a rule engine, an outbound calling campaign, a scoring model) and measured what it did.
* You can turn a vague request into a requirement note an engineer can build from, and explain results to non-technical teams.

title: Support Engineer

* You ensure observability is built-in, with structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing, making systems are easier to monitor and debug.

Participate in rotational shifts, including night shifts and US timings, to provide continuous support for business-critical Oracle database and Exadata environments.

* **Customer Interaction:**

* **Communication & Collaboration:**

* **Shift Flexibility:**

* **Work Location:**

**Good-to-Have Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience administering, troubleshooting, or optimizing
  **Oracle Exadata Engineered Systems**
  .
* Knowledge of Oracle Exadata hardware and software platforms, including X8, X9M, or newer generations.
* Experience with
  **Oracle GoldenGate**

* Exposure to
  **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**

* Familiarity with
  **Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA)**
  .
* Advanced database performance tuning experience, including SQL optimization, wait-event analysis, AWR/ASH analysis, and performance troubleshooting.

  **BE, BTech, MCA, CA, or equivalent**

title: ENGINEER - CMDB DATA QUALITY
description:
Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
  
  
GCL: C1/C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
  
  
In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
  
  
From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
  
  
CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
  
  
Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
  
  
Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
  
  
CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
  
  
Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.
  
  
Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.
  
  
Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data / Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, IT asset or configuration management, technology operations, data quality or technology data analysis.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
* Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
* Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing operational reports and dashboards.
* Ability to collaborate across technology teams, drive stakeholder remediation and manage competing priorities independently.
* Clear written and verbal communication and documentation skills.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with CMDB 360, ServiceNow Data Manager, Certification and Predictive Intelligence.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, and IRE and reconciliation.
* SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
* Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, technology and science meet at scale to make a tangible difference for patients. You will join an inclusive, cross-functional community that pairs deep domain expertise with modern platforms, data and AI to remove friction, simplify processes and unlock speed across the enterprise. We back bold ideas with real investment, value kindness alongside ambition, and give you the ownership to experiment, learn and deliver lasting impact. The
**S/4HANA Data Transformation Manager SD & PP**
is responsible for supporting the employment of Lonza’s new SAP S/4HANA ERP system as part of the multi-year global transformation program “Nexus”. Key deliverables include supporting Lonza’s global CDMO sites in achieving data readiness as well as supporting them during the actual deployment activities including Data Migration, Go-Live and post-go live support incl. related Data Management.
  
  
This role requires a deep understanding of
**S/4HANA SD & PP**
modules, incl. data models and objects, dependencies as well as Data Management processes. The role is permanent and based in Hyderabad, embedded into a new central data team with full dedication to the global Nexus transformation program. The role requires strong coordination and communication with stakeholders at different levels, including the 3rd party S/4HANA integration partner, local business, central functions and other Nexus team members
  
  
**What You Will Get**

* Opportunity to work in a global life sciences company.
* Ownership across the employee life cycle.
* Collaboration with cross‑functional and regional teams.
* Platform to contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives.

**What You Will Do**
**Data Readiness Support**

* Support Lonza’s global CDMO sites in achieving data readiness for the S/4HANA deployment by preparing, orchestrating the finalization of all data preparation activities within the data domains of S/4HANA Sales & Distribution (SD) and Production Planning (PP). This concerns mainly data models and objects linked to business processes Plan-to-Make (P2M) and Order-to-Cash (O2C).
* Establish and develop standardized best-in class delivery plans, processes, tools and templates to support data preparation activities and continuously improve them.
* Mobilize local data owners / key users and facilitate their enablement by preparing and delivering onboarding, training, alignment meetings and workshops.
* Closely coordinate with the 3rd party integration partner to support the finalization of key deliverables, such as data designs, mappings, construct files, transformations etc. as well as achieving formal sign-off from data owners and other stakeholders.
* Orchestrate multiple integrated Data Harmonization initiatives together with other Data Domains towards their finalization, approval to be built into Data Migration.

**Data Migration and Deployment Support**

* Support Lonza’s global CDMO sites end-to-end during S/4HANA deployment with all data-related activities, mainly Data Migration but, cutover and post-go live support.
* Orchestrate and coordinate migration activities between the 3rd party integration partner, the Nexus project teams and data owners / key users. Support migration activities such as testing, mock loads incl. validation, defect fixing in line with the migration plan. Identify and document issues promptly and drive timely resolution.
* Ensure Project & Quality-relevant documentation requirements are adhered to.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities for automation and adopting new technologies, such as AI and Machine Learning.

**Data Governance and SAP MDG Support**

* Support the rollout of the SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) system for Master Data Management along with the global S/4HANA deployments.
* Coordinate and support central transactional Master Data Management teams with training, handover during deployments to facilitate strong data governance and high data quality effective from Day +1 after go-live.
* Identify, manage and coordinate change requests concerning the S/4HANA data model and/or data management processes as well as SAP MDG workflows and data quality rulesets or exceptions such as mass data loads. Ensure alignment and formal approval by Nexus Data Information Architects to ensure the integrity of the S/4HANA process template including its data model and data designs.
* Monitor and resolve data-management related issues and service ticket management. Ensure disruptions and issues are assigned and addressed promptly.

**Project Management, Documentation and Training**

* Formalize all detailed activities into a comprehensive deployment toolkit incorporating a structured and disciplined approach, to enable standardized, repeatable process execution during future deployments with consistent quality.
* Monitor quality of work by performing reviews against standards and follow-ups.
* Ensure adhere to plan by continuous progress tracking and reporting.
* Proactively identify and monitor risks and issues and report them to project management. Define and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Ensure compliant documentation of all data activities is established in line with program requirements.
* Provide training and support to data owners to support consistent execution.
* Document lessons learned and contributed to continuous improvement efforts.

**Collaboration and Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate all activities closely with the 3rd party integration partner, internal Nexus Data, IT/Tech and Business Process teams to ensure continuous alignment of all activities with program planning and the Data Migration and Harmonization Strategy.
* Ensure continuous alignment with Data & Information Architects and continuous improvement of operational data management.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA SD & PP, Data Management, Data Migration and/or Digital Transformation projects and/or consulting.

title: NOC Tier 2 Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
Role Summary
  
  
The Tier-2 NOC Engineer takes escalations from Tier-1 and restores service across our customer contracts, which span on-premises, Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, each with its own SLA. You will troubleshoot across network, compute, operating system, database, application and cloud layers, engage vendors and internal teams, and keep customers informed during major incidents.
  
  
You will also make the NOC better over time: tuning noisy alerts, writing and automating runbooks, and raising problem records so recurring issues are fixed for good. You will work closely with the SOC, providing infrastructure data during security investigations.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Key Responsibilities**
Diagnose and Restore
  
  

* Take escalated tickets from Tier-1 and troubleshoot across network, compute, OS, database, application and cloud layers.
* Restore service through fixes, failover, scaling, or rolling back a bad change, within contract SLAs.
* Identify the likely root cause and record it, with resolution notes, in the ticket.

Change Management
  
  

* Raise and implement emergency changes needed to restore service.
* Roll back changes that cause incidents, and check whether a recent change caused an incident.
* Execute critical out-of-band patches when requested by the SOC and validate service health after patching.

Coordination and Communication
  
  

* Engage vendors (Oracle, Microsoft, AWS, ISPs and others) and internal infrastructure and application teams.
* Send status updates to customers and stakeholders on each contract's schedule during P1/P2 incidents.
* Collect and provide data (logs, configurations, flow data) to the SOC on request during security investigations.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Raise problem records for recurring or unexplained issues.
* Tune alerts: remove noisy ones, adjust thresholds, and action false-positive tuning requests from Tier-1.
* Write and improve runbooks and automate common fixes so Tier-1 can resolve more issues at first contact.
* Coach Tier-1 analysts on troubleshooting and runbook use.

**Scope and Escalation Boundaries**
Inputs this role works from
  
  

* Escalated tickets from Tier-1 with triage evidence
* Monitoring data across all tools, CMDB/service maps per contract, change records and vendor contacts
* Requests from SOC Tier-2 for infrastructure data

Escalate to NOC Tier-3 / engineering when
  
  

* The root cause is outside standard operations (code defect, architecture limit, product/IoT firmware, capacity design).
* A fix needs a significant change or design decision.
* The issue is not resolved within the P1/P2 time limit (e.g., 1 hour of active work on a P1).

Escalate to the Incident Commander (war room) when
  
  

* There is a major incident: several contracts affected, a full customer outage, a likely SLA breach with penalties, or a possible security cause.

**Required Skills**
Technical Depth
  
  

* Hands-on depth in at least two of the following, with working knowledge of the rest:
* Network: TCP/IP, OSI model, routing and switching, firewalls, VPN, DNS, DHCP, load balancers, network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Systems: Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux administration.
* Databases: Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server (performance, blocking, storage, job failures).
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure and AWS (compute, networking, identity, monitoring).
* Applications: Java-based applications, web and application servers, application logs.
* Working knowledge of the products and IoT devices for the contracts supported.
* Log analysis across firewalls, routers, switches, servers and applications.

Monitoring and Observability Tools
  
  

* SolarWinds: NPM, NetFlow analysis, node and interface health.
* AppDynamics: transaction tracing and application performance analysis.
* Oracle Enterprise Manager: database and middleware performance analysis.
* Site24x7: synthetic monitoring and availability checks.
* Azure Monitor and AWS CloudWatch: metrics, alarms and log queries.
* PRTG Network Monitor and Nagios
* Ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Jira or similar) and Microsoft 365.

**Scripting standards this role follows:**

* All scripts kept in Git in an approved, peer-reviewed library.
* Read-only by default: diagnostic scripts never change anything; scripts that make changes need a change or ticket reference.
* No hard-coded credentials: credentials are pulled from a vault.
* Parameterized by contract and CI, safe to run twice, and logging what they did into the ticket.

Process Skills
  
  

* ITIL incident, problem and change management, including emergency changes and rollbacks.
* Vendor escalation and management.
* Shift handover and incident documentation.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Structured, analytical troubleshooting under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal technical updates for both technical and customer audiences.
* Attention to detail, and the ability to manage several incidents at once.

**Preferred Skills**

* Python for automation that spans several systems (e.g., one script that checks a service across Azure, AWS and on-premises).
* Splunk SPL basics.
* Network device CLI for reading switch, router and firewall state.
* Experience in a multi-customer or managed services NOC with contract-specific SLAs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* ITIL 4 Foundation
* CCNA or CompTIA Network+
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate
* CompTIA Security+
