title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Engineer –**
IT Factory - Python Data Engineer
  
  
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a python data engineer, to own the data foundation of the application. As every control result, every dashboard figure and every application screen reads from the curated data model you build and maintain. If the data is wrong, late or unexplained, nothing above it can be trusted.
  
  
The platform ingests from several enterprise sources into a raw layer that preserves exactly what each source sent and then transforms that into a curated model. You will build and operate the data pipelines, implement the reconciliation and data-quality checks that prove each load is complete, and extend the model as new controls and modules require it.
  
  
You will also implement the control rules themselves. These are written primarily as versioned SQL against the curated model, reviewed like application code, and executed by the controls engine. This is where data engineering meets the business purpose of the platform, and it is a significant part of the role.
  
  
This is not a pure pipeline role. You will also contribute to the application services, and you are expected to be able to pick up backend work when delivery requires it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ingestion pipelines — scheduled extraction from enterprise source systems into the raw layer, including change detection, load history and the recording of source data provenance.
* The curated data model — transformation from raw to a conformed, keyed and de-duplicated model of entitlements, applications, users and their relationships.
* Reconciliation and data quality — checks that prove each load is complete and consistent, with results written to an append-only evidence store and discrepancies raised rather than silently absorbed.
* Pipeline orchestration — scheduling, dependency management, retry and alerting, with a run history that can be interrogated when a question is asked about a past load.
* Control rules as code — the rule base for the control catalogue, written as versioned SQL with accompanying metadata, peer-reviewed and promoted through the same pipeline as application code.
* Reporting data layer — the curated views that the reporting dashboards consume, designed as a stable contract that survives changes to the underlying model.
* Backend services — contributing to the Python application services alongside the Technical Lead.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, at depth. This is the core of the role. Complex joins, aggregation, window functions, set operations; reading and acting on query plans; indexing and performance tuning on large tables. You should instinctively solve a data problem in SQL before reaching for application code.
* Relational data modelling. Designing schemas for analytical and operational use: keys, grain, slowly changing data, handling of deletions and deactivations in source systems. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Python for data engineering. Writing maintainable, tested Python for ETL — not notebooks. Experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable toolkit, and with pandas or Polars for in-flight transformation.
* Pipeline construction and operation. Building pipelines that run unattended: idempotent loads, failure handling, retries, alerting and the ability to re-run a failed load safely.
* Data quality and reconciliation. Practical experience proving that a data load is complete and correct, and designing the controls that detect when it is not.
* Backend development. Sufficient experience building API services in Python — FastAPI, Django or Flask — to contribute to the application layer.
* Testing discipline. Automated tests for transformation logic. Experience with pytest.
* Version control. Disciplined use of Git and pull request review. Treating SQL and pipeline definitions as code, held in a repository rather than on a server.
* Communication in a distributed team. Clear written English, and the judgement to flag a data discrepancy rather than work around it.

**Nice To Have**

* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow in production, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, functional role codes, segregation of duties, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Reporting tools — Power BI, including semantic modelling and designing the views that sit behind a dashboard.
* Regulated-environment experience — working with personal or otherwise sensitive data under data-protection controls, including masking of non-production environments.
* Linux and CI/CD — comfortable deploying and troubleshooting on Linux servers with an automated pipeline.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The AI-PE team builds AI and data systems across the research lifecycle and across departments, from content production and client products to internal operations and coverage intelligence. We are building many pipelines and products at once, and we need people who can own them, not just build them.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with two parts. First, you will own a portfolio of production systems and build new ones, taking problems from vague business requests to systems that teams rely on every day. Second, you will support multiple teams across the company, setting the engineering standard and growing two junior analysts into strong builders.
  
  

* What You Will Own

You Will Be Accountable For a Portfolio Of Production Pipelines And Products, Each With a Clear Owner, Quality Metrics, And An Operating Schedule. Across The Portfolio, The Work Falls Into Four Areas
  
  

* Data and operations pipelines: scheduled, multi-source jobs that join data from internal and external systems, apply business rules, handle failures, and deliver results to analysts for review.
* LLM-based tools: summarisation, extraction, classification, and search across transcripts, research, and documents, built with retrieval, tool use, and agentic patterns where they fit.
* Client-facing AI products: AI research experiences delivered to institutional clients, with the reliability and compliance needed for external use.
* Coverage and demand intelligence: signals that show where research is thin, where demand is growing, and what to research next.

For each system you own, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Scoping the problem with the business owner and agreeing on success metrics before building.
* Evaluation: a repeatable way to measure quality, catch regressions, and track cost and latency.
* Operations: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and a clear path for handover when priorities change.
* Documentation that another engineer or analyst can use without you in the room.
* Supporting Multiple Teams

The AI-PE Team Works With Business And Functional Teams Across The Company, Including Content, Sales And Client Services, Product, Technology, Compliance, And Data. You Will
  
  

* Act as the technical point of contact for the teams you support, translating fuzzy requests into concrete, shippable scope.
* Prioritise across teams, make trade-offs visible, and escalate conflicts to the VP early.
* Integrate builds into the wider stack with Technology and Data, and clear the path to deployment with Compliance.
* Choose the right tool for each job: a prompt, a retrieval step, an agent, a SQL query, or a rule. Explain the trade-off.
* Diagnose data-quality and performance issues across internal systems, and make pragmatic trade-offs when those systems impose constraints.
* Coach and review the work of junior analysts, so the team's output improves over time.
* What You Bring

**Must have**

* 4+ years building and shipping software or data systems in production, including at least 2 years on LLM-based systems in production.
* Strong Python, with a track record of taking work from prototype to production: tests, monitoring, and iteration.
* Hands-on experience with LLM workflows: tool use or agentic patterns, retrieval over long documents, structured extraction, and evaluation you designed and ran yourself.
* Advanced SQL and a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), including scheduled jobs and data-quality checks.
* Experience matching records across messy sources, and knowing when deterministic rules beat a model.
* Experience owning several systems at once, prioritising between them, and keeping each one running after launch.
* Good judgement about where AI does and does not fit, and the ability to explain a trade-off to technical and non-technical partners.
* Experience reviewing other engineers' work and mentoring people early in their careers.
* Comfort handling sensitive data and access controls, including identity and compliance requirements.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with the Claude API, MCP servers, or similar agent tooling.
* Experience reducing LLM cost and latency at scale.
* Experience working with business teams across several departments, such as sales, client services, or content.
* Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery.
* Interest in private markets, investment research, or expert networks.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and running reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an infrastructure ownership role. You will build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms.
* Not a people-management role at this level. You will mentor and lead by technical example.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end to end.
* Portfolio health: uptime, data quality, and the share of systems with working evaluation and monitoring.
* Autonomy: how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your partnerships with the teams you support.
* The growth of the analysts you mentor, measured by what they can own independently after six months.

**First six months**

* Take ownership of an agreed set of existing pipelines and products, with documented owners, runbooks, and monitoring.
* Ship at least one new production system, with an evaluation harness and an agreed success metric.
* Set team engineering standards for code review, testing, documentation, and LLM cost tracking, and have them in use.
* Publish a prioritised roadmap across the teams you support, including data dependencies and risks.
* Selection Process
* Conversation with the VP on the role, the team, and the work.
* Walkthrough of a production system you built or ran: failure modes, how you measured quality, and what you would change.
* Design exercise: how you would take on a new pipeline request from a business team, from scoping through to monitored production.
* Short take-home or code review of a junior engineer's pull request, followed by a discussion.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems across more than one team, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of analysts.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**What can you expect:**
**🌏 Work From Anywhere:**
Up to 4 weeks per year.
  
  
**🏠 Hybrid Work:**
This role offers hybrid working model
  
  
**📚 Yearly PDA Allowance:**
Dedicated annual budget to support your continuous growth.
  
  
**🛡️ Health & Security:**
Private medical insurance, life insurance and 1to1help mental health support.
  
  
**📆 Time Off:**
Upto 30 days of paid leave in a year
  
  
The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

title: Oracle GoldenGate Specialist - VOIS

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

The role is focused on developing and integrating new data sources using Oracle GoldenGate, configuring GoldenGate environments from scratch and implementing data-quality checks following integration.
  
  
You will also contribute to infrastructure setup for high availability (HA) and migration activities from Berlin to Ratingen. This role requires 4–8 years of relevant experience, strong Oracle GoldenGate knowledge and the ability to independently analyse problems and make sound technical judgements while working to agreed deadlines.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Develop and integrate new data sources using Oracle GoldenGate, including configuring and setting up GoldenGate environments from scratch.
  
  
Implement data-quality checks following the integration of new data sources, supporting accurate and reliable data delivery.
  
  
Contribute to Berlin-to-Ratingen migration activities and infrastructure configuration, including high-availability setup.
  
  
Take accountability for end-to-end testing within scope and contribute to quality processes supporting service delivery.
  
  
Identify opportunities for cost savings, effort optimisation, resource optimisation, process adoption and tooling improvements to increase delivery efficiency and quality.
  
  
Support both GoldenGate development and operational activities, working closely with stakeholders supporting the Greece environment.
  
  
Plan and organise work effectively, prioritising activities to meet agreed deadlines.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You have 4–8 years of relevant professional experience, with strong expertise in Oracle GoldenGate and experience working across development and operational activities.
  
  
You have knowledge of Oracle SQL (11g or 12c), Oracle databases and other database technologies, alongside strong data interpretation, manipulation and analysis skills.
  
  
You have experience or knowledge of Oracle Veridata, Linux, Oracle GoldenGate for Kafka, GCP and cloud technologies.
  
  
You are a detail-conscious problem solver who can independently analyse technical challenges, develop appropriate solutions and work effectively under pressure and to tight deadlines.

Experience contributing to high-availability infrastructure and migration activities.
  
  
Opportunity to work with stakeholders supporting Greece GoldenGate development.
  
  
Scope to improve delivery through process adoption, resource optimisation, tooling and quality improvements.

Advanced implementation and configuration of Oracle GoldenGate for enterprise data integration.
  
  
Data quality validation and end-to-end testing of newly integrated data sources.
  
  
High-availability infrastructure configuration and migration practices.
  
  
Broader integration capabilities involving Oracle GoldenGate for Kafka, Oracle databases, Linux and GCP/cloud environments.
  
  
Continuous improvement techniques focused on delivery efficiency, service quality and effort optimisation.

title: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
description:
Role: MarkLogic Solutions Architect
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
ACS-I India is looking for an experienced MarkLogic architect to design and own the technical architecture of MarkLogic solutions for Content Engine, the big data function that maintains and grows the data-lake repository and architecture. The role combines platform architecture on MarkLogic with solution architecture from requirements to production across connected systems. This is a working role. The architect designs, prototypes, reviews, and troubleshoots alongside the team, and answers for the design quality, performance, security, and operability of what the team releases. The role also covers AI and generative AI, including how the team prepares CAS content for retrieval and how AI tools reach it safely.
  
  
The architect has technical authority over the team’s designs and no line-management duties. The MarkLogic team lead manages the team’s people, capacity, and sprint commitments. The architect decides data models, indexing and search design, integration patterns, cluster and cloud topology, release track, and AI retrieval patterns, and works with the team lead on delivery.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
Architecture and solution design
  
  

* Own the end-to-end architecture of MarkLogic solutions that deliver CAS content, products, and solutions, including XML and JSON data models, indexing strategy, search design, content processing, and service interfaces.
* Turn business requirements into solution designs with clear scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria, and explain each design to product owners, client teams, and engineers.
* For each significant decision, present at least two workable options with their pros, cons, cost, and risk; recommend one; and record the decision, its assumptions, and the evidence that would change it.
* Define non-functional requirements for each solution as measurable targets covering performance, scalability, availability, security, data governance, recoverability, operability, and cost. Test the targets before release and monitor them in production.
* Design and govern integrations between upstream content sources and downstream consumers, including REST services, bulk and batch processing with CoRB and Flux, event streaming, and index synchronization. Own the interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* Run architecture and design reviews, and confirm that solutions follow enterprise standards for security, data governance, and compliance.

End-to-end delivery and technical leadership
  
  

* Stay accountable for each solution from requirement to production support. Work with product owners to groom the backlog, estimate effort, and split large items into deliverable increments.
* Act as the technical authority on architecture for stakeholders and client teams, and report architecture risks and dependencies early.
* Review code, queries, and configuration. Pair with engineers on the hardest problems. Troubleshoot production incidents and lead root-cause analysis through to a permanent fix.
* Mentor and coach engineers through design walk-throughs, code reviews, and pair programming, and take part in technical hiring.
* Set coding standards and quality gates, and drive automated builds, automated testing, and continuous delivery.

Platform, cloud, and operations
  
  

* Own the target-state architecture and the plan for moving MarkLogic workloads from on-premises infrastructure to AWS, starting with lift-and-shift and then adopting managed services where they fit. Compare self-managed AWS deployment, Kubernetes, and Progress Data Cloud, and recommend one.
* Set the release and upgrade strategy, including the choice between the long-term support and innovation release tracks, and plan upgrades and patching with minimal disruption to consumers.
* Set standards for capacity, scaling, replication, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring, and alerting, and maintain the runbooks that support them.
* Lead query and index tuning at scale with XQuery, CTS, and Optic, using MarkLogic profiling and query-plan tools to find root causes and set performance baselines.

AI and generative AI
  
  

* Design AI-ready content and retrieval on MarkLogic, including the embedding and chunking approach, hybrid search that combines full-text, semantic, and vector retrieval, relevance tuning, and grounding of generated answers in CAS content.
* Define how AI assistants and agents reach MarkLogic content through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other interfaces, with access control, an audit trail, and content filtering applied before data reaches a model.
* Evaluate MarkLogic releases and generative AI tools, and lead proofs of concept with written success criteria for retrieval accuracy, latency, and cost before the team adopts a change.
* Set rules for the team’s use of AI coding and testing assistants on XQuery, JavaScript, and test code, including human review and data-handling limits.

Technologies and tools
  
  
MarkLogic Server 10 or later, XQuery, XSLT, XPath, Optic API, CTS queries, Template-Driven Extraction (TDE), REST APIs, CoRB, Flux, Java, Linux, Bash, Git, Jenkins, AWS (EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch), CI/CD, Jira, and Confluence.
  
  
Job requirements
  
  

* Education: Four-year degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: At least 12 years in application development, solution delivery, and operations, including at least seven years of hands-on MarkLogic work and at least three years as an architect or technical design authority, formally or informally, for a production data platform.
* MarkLogic: Advanced knowledge of MarkLogic Server 10 or later, including XQuery, XSLT, XPath, the CTS and Optic search APIs, indexing, Template-Driven Extraction, security, query tuning, and cluster administration, plus working knowledge of MarkLogic 12 features such as native vector search and virtual views.
* Data modeling: Experience designing XML and JSON document models for large content repositories, with working knowledge of semantics (RDF triples and SPARQL).
* Solution architecture: Experience architecting solutions for large content or data platforms, from requirements to design documents that engineers can build from.
* Decision-making: Ability to compare alternative solutions on pros, cons, cost, and risk, recommend one with clear reasoning, record the decision and the evidence that would change it, and revisit it when that evidence appears.
* Non-functional requirements: Strong experience defining measurable targets for a production platform and verifying them through load, failure, and security testing.
* Integration: Experience designing integrations across multiple systems, including REST services, batch and bulk processing, and event streaming, with defined interface contracts, error handling, and reconciliation.
* End-to-end delivery: Experience owning a product or platform through design, build, release, and production support.
* Stakeholders: Ability to work directly with product owners, client teams, and non-technical stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and explain trade-offs in writing and in meetings.
* Java, Linux, and scripting: Strong experience with Java, Linux, application servers, and backend processing, and mid-level to advanced Bash or Kshell.
* AWS: Working knowledge of EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and CloudWatch, and experience designing or running a production data platform on AWS.
* Generative AI: Working knowledge of retrieval patterns (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, and retrieval-augmented generation) and of access control and data-privacy limits for AI features, shown through a design, a proof of concept, or a production system. No minimum number of years applies.
* CI/CD and testing: Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins pipelines, including automated deployment of MarkLogic code and configuration, and with test-driven development.
* Production operations: Experience with monitoring, incident response, backup and recovery, and capacity planning for production data platforms.
* Technical leadership: Ability to set direction without line authority, run design reviews, give clear code-review feedback, estimate work, mentor engineers at junior and senior levels, and pair with others when it helps.
* Ownership: Accountability for design quality, delivery, and production stability; early escalation of risks; and continued learning in MarkLogic and AI.

Nice to have
  
  

* MarkLogic Data Hub Framework for ingestion, harmonization, curation, and metadata enrichment.
* Server-Side JavaScript, MLCP, and the Data Movement SDK.
* Exposure to GraphQL.
* Bi-temporal and geospatial features in MarkLogic.
* Running MarkLogic on AWS with the Managed Cluster feature and CloudFormation templates, or on Kubernetes.
* AWS certification, such as Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Scala, Hadoop, and Solr/Lucene.
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, and GitLab CI alongside Jenkins.
* LangChain or langchain4j, LLM evaluation, and hands-on work with MCP servers.
* Scrum or SAFe delivery experience in a distributed global team across time zones.
* Familiarity with large content repositories, XML publishing standards, and scientific or patent content.

description:

Design end to end data engineering solutions using Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and other Azure-native services.

title: Faculty Head - Education Sector
description:
**Location:** Indirapuram, Ghaziabad

Position Summary

The Service Coordinator in the education sector is responsible for facilitating effective communication between parents and the educational institution, ensuring a seamless counseling experience for prospective students and their families. This role involves coordinating and assigning candidates, addressing inquiries, and supporting the overall enrollment process.

Key Responsibilities

1. Counseling and Support

* **Engage with Parents:**
* Provide information and guidance to parents regarding educational programs and services.
* Address queries and concerns through in-person meetings, phone calls, and emails.
* **Conduct Assessments:**
* Assess the needs and preferences of families to recommend suitable educational pathways for their children.

2. Coordination and Administration

* **Candidate Assignment:**
* Coordinate the assignment of candidates to appropriate educational programs based on their needs and interests.
* Maintain a database of candidates and track their progress through the enrollment process.
* **Schedule Appointments:**
* Organize and manage counseling sessions and meetings with parents and prospective students.
* Ensure that all appointments are well-coordinated and that all relevant materials are prepared in advance.

3. Collaboration

* **Work with Educational Staff:**
* Collaborate with teachers, administrators, and counselors to align services with student needs.
* Communicate any specific requirements or concerns raised by parents to the appropriate educational personnel.

4. Documentation and Reporting

* **Maintain Records:**
* Keep accurate records of counseling sessions, communications with parents, and candidate assignments.
* Generate reports on enrollment statistics and feedback for management.

5. Continuous Improvement

* **Feedback Collection:**
* Gather feedback from parents and candidates to improve counseling services and educational offerings.
* Participate in training and professional development to enhance counseling skills and knowledge.

Qualifications

* **Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
* **Experience:**
* Previous experience in counseling, educational coordination, or customer service, preferably within the education sector.
* **Skills:**
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to build rapport with parents and students.
* Organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with CRM software.

Key Competencies

* **Empathy:** Ability to understand and relate to the concerns of parents and students.
* **Problem-Solving:** Proactive in identifying issues and finding effective solutions.
* **Team Player:** Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and educational staff.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently on-site at the Neemrana facility.

**Job Description: Senior Technology Consultant – Capital Markets (Calypso Specialist)**
**Job Purpose:**

* Need to work as a Senior Technology Consultant in the capacity of Capital Market – Calypso Implementation Specialist in Capital Market core modernisation and migration projects.
* Should exhibit deep experience in financial services during the client discussions and be able to convince the client on the solution.

* Work Experience Requirements
* Functional Experience

+ 4 to 8 years of hands on experience in Capital Markets with strong exposure to Front to Back trade lifecycle.
+ Solid understanding of:

- Securities trading, settlements, confirmations, reconciliation, and clearing.
- Middle office processes including trade validation, enrichment, allocation, and reporting.
- Regulatory reporting and compliance across capital markets.

+ Demonstrates experience interacting with business stakeholders, product controllers, operations, and risk teams.
+ Prior exposure to transformation, modernization, or migration programs in Capital Markets.

* Strong implementation experience in Calypso, particularly Version 14+ (preferred), across:

+ System configuration in trading, static data, settlement, and middle office modules.
+ Workflow design and exception handling.
+ Integration with upstream and downstream systems.

* Hands on experience with:

+ Trade processing engines
+ Static and reference data frameworks
+ Interfaces, messaging standards (ISO15022/20022, FIX), and APIs

* Experience working in Agile environments and contributing to functional & technical design workshops.

**Mandatory Skills**
**Functional Skills**

* Calypso platform expertise, including:

+ Calypso Securities Instance (CSI)
+ Trade Representation & Processing
+ Static Data Configuration
+ Workflow creation & orchestration
+ Trade Validation & Enrichment logic
+ Loss & Claim Management module
+ Settlement Status Processing
+ Middle Office Reporting Framework
+ Block Allocation – Vinci SS1 enrichment
+ Archiving concepts and strategy

* Ability to write and analyze SQL queries.
* Good understanding of system integration, APIs (SOAP/REST), and messaging.
* Ability to interpret technical logs, troubleshoot issues, and guide development teams.
* Strong knowledge of financial instruments:

+ Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Listed & OTC Derivatives, Repos, and Structured Products.

* Understanding of:

+ Trade lifecycle from booking to settlement
+ Risk factors, pricing inputs, and PnL drivers
+ Collateral management fundamentals
+ Treasury and liquidity processes

* Experience in requirements gathering, gap analysis (OOTB vs. custom), and functional documentation.
* Exposure to Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban).

**Technical Skills**

* Application and Solution (workflow, interface) technical design.
* Business requirements, definition, analysis, and mapping.
* Understanding of technology landscape and providing system configuration design in Market, Static and Reference data.
* Knowledge of databases, infrastructure, application servers, Technical Architecture, Security and Performance management.
* Expertise in writing integration specifications and knowledge of Soap or Rest APIs.

**One or more of following Tech skill categories:**

* Database skills – Able to write SQL queries of moderate complexity,
* Programming/ Scripting skills: One of {Python, Java, C#} - able to write methods calling APIs
* Experience in Cloud and CI/CD (Devops Automation environment)
* Data Visualization – Dashboard analysis with Tableau, Power Bi

* MBA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent degree.
* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets, preferably within banking, investment banking, or financial technology domains.

title: Application Architect-SAP
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

As an Application Architect specializing in SAP solutions, you will integrate various SAP modules, set up environments, and provide infrastructure support. You will design applications that run on multiple platforms and are composed of multiple software packages.

* Design Applications: Design applications that meet performance, availability, and scalability requirements, ensuring seamless integration with the application infrastructure.
* Integrate SAP Modules: Integrate various SAP modules to create cohesive solutions, setting up environments and providing infrastructure support as needed.
* Maintain Functional Interface: Maintain the functional interface to the application infrastructure, ensuring smooth operation and optimal system performance.
* Ensure Performance and Scalability: Ensure the performance, availability, and scalability of applications, identifying and addressing potential issues proactively.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* SAP Solutions Integration: Experience with integrating various SAP modules to create cohesive solutions, including setting up environments and providing infrastructure support.
* Multi-Platform Application Design: Experience with designing applications that run on multiple platforms and are composed of multiple software packages, ensuring performance, availability, and scalability.
* Application Infrastructure Management: Experience with maintaining the functional interface to the application infrastructure, ensuring smooth operation and optimal system performance.
* Performance and Scalability Optimization: Experience with ensuring the performance, availability, and scalability of applications, identifying and addressing potential issues proactively.
* Cross-Platform Compatibility: Experience with designing applications that meet performance, availability, and scalability requirements across multiple platforms.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Deep Expertise in SAP Configuration: Experience with advanced SAP configuration, including custom code development, to enhance system functionality and performance.
* Knowledge of IT Service Management: Familiarity with IT service management principles and practices, such as ITIL, to ensure alignment with organizational standards.

US Shift (6 PM to 3 AM)

* Ensure API security, governance, monitoring, and compliance standards are met.
* Participate in solution design discussions and contribute to enterprise integration strategies.

* Experience integrating Salesforce with: SAP Oracle Workday ServiceNow Banking/ERP applications Third-party systems
* Strong understanding of: REST APIs SOAP Web Services JSON XML RAML OpenAPI Specifications
* Experience with Salesforce technologies: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Salesforce APIs Platform Events Bulk API Streaming API
* Knowledge of messaging technologies: Kafka JMS MQ Event-driven architectures
* Experience with databases: SQL Server Oracle MySQL PostgreSQL

* Ability to drive technical discussions and solution reviews.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience estimating effort and planning project deliverables.

* MuleSoft Certified Developer (MCD - Level 1/2).
* MuleSoft Platform Architect Certification.
* Salesforce Administrator or Salesforce Platform Developer Certification.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Knowledge of integration patterns, enterprise architecture, and security best practices.

* API Design & Development
* Enterprise Integration
* Salesforce Integration
* Technical Leadership
* Problem Solving
* Performance Optimization
* Stakeholder Management
* Agile Delivery
* Team Mentoring

title: Analyst II, Information Security
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
09
  
  
**About the Role:**
This role helps reduce the cyber risk posed by third parties and protects S&P Global brands against possible attacks against our information assets by threat actors via backdoor created by our vendors. Primary responsibilities will include assessing Cybersecurity, Business Continuity controls for S&P third parties by conducting control risk assessments, risk recertifications, and continuously monitoring the vendors engaged by S&P.
  
  
**The Team**
As part of Vendor Risk Management, the Vendor Cyber Risk Management team manages the Supply Chain Cyber risks by performing risk assessments of third-party engagements to identify and reduce the risks posed by third parties. This is an extremely important role, considering the fact that large number of data breaches happen due to third parties. It involves working with internal stake holders as well as third parties to achieve the results.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**
Working in Vendor Risk Management offers the opportunity to continuously enhance processes to meet the evolving requirements of various regulators. This challenging environment provides ample opportunities to expand your knowledge and expertise.
  
  
In addition to risk assessments, recertifications, and continuous monitoring, you will participate in various projects, allowing you to showcase and further develop your skills and experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct thorough Cybersecurity, Business Continuity, Artificial Intelligence assessments for various vendors such as Cloud Service Prover evaluating their information security policies, procedures, and controls.
* Effectively collaborate with internal teams to identify critical vendors and assess their potential impact on the organization's cyber risk profile.
* Communicate risk assessment findings and recommendations to key stakeholders, including senior management, legal, and compliance teams.
* Work closely with vendors to address identified security gaps and ensure they meet the organization's cybersecurity requirements.
* Review the vendors on the continuous monitoring program utilizing various attack surface monitoring tools and assisting in driving the periodical review the vendors.
* Monitor and stay abreast of evolving cybersecurity threats and industry trends to enhance the effectiveness of the risk assessment process.
* Review the cyber security contracts for various clauses to cover for data Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability.
* Lead and support enhancement and strategic projects aligning with business objectives within Vendor Risk Management to meet various business and regulatory requirements.
* Assist the team members in balancing the load and managing Ad-hoc projects.
* Where required, lead the team for BAU (Business as Usual) tasks mentioned above.

**What We’re Looking For**
**Basic Required Qualifications:**

* Master/bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering or equivalent
* 6+ years of experience in Information Security or Technology Risk Management
* Any prior exposure to Cyber vendor risk management and/ or privacy laws and regulations is a plus.
* Demonstrable understanding of the concepts of technology controls and information security controls.
* Exposure to cloud technologies and cloud security is highly desired; the familiarity with public cloud technologies such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is highly preferred.
* Exposure to Attack Surface Monitoring tools is a plus.
* Exposure to vendor cyber security contracts is highly desired.
* Excellent communication skills - a must. The resource should have the ability to communicate with cross-functional teams and vendors, both written and oral communication is critical.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* This position is required to work in UK Shift; flexibility is a must, especially when it comes to vendor and internal meetings held during US business hours.

+ Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize while maintaining close attention to detail.
+ Ability to build strategic partnerships with internal stakeholders.
+ Must be a critical thinker with strong qualitative skills.

* Information Security/Risk Management certification would be an advantage.

**You?**
**Our Mission**
Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  
**Our People**
We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
  
  
**Our Values**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Benefits**

for global customers, supporting LAN/WAN/Firewalls /SD-WAN environments. While responding to Level 1 and 2 service tickets, you will work closely with the team to address complex network problems escalated by NOC engineers. You will be responsible for escalating issues to next-level support and engaging third-party vendors for any
**network or connectivity impairments**
.
  
  
This is an
**onsite**
role.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Resolve level 1 and 2 network support cases, incidents, and work orders associated with routing, switching, WAN, SD-WAN and firewall environments following ECI defined SLAs.
* Set client expectations appropriately throughout the troubleshooting process, ensuring clear communication.
* Resolve incidents and requests from centralized monitoring systems related to, but not limited to the following:
* Alarm validation and alert correlation
* Routing protocol (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) and switching issues (VLAN, STP)
* WAN/MPLS/VPLS/Express Route/Internet circuit issues
* SD-WAN related alerts (tunnel status, edge device health, policy issues)
* Connectivity issues, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization
* Firewall issues (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet — NAT, policies, sessions)
* Wireless network-related issues (controllers, AP connectivity)
* Perform troubleshooting, problem analysis, and isolation of network events in accordance with incident management guidelines.
* Follow ECI change control process for performing changes such as PAN-OS, IOS and Meraki upgrades, configuration changes, and SD-WAN updates during approved maintenance windows.
* Incident Management via ServiceNow tool.
* Follow client escalation procedures and handle customer calls for diagnosing network-related issues.
* Provide timely and accurate end-to-end support via phone, email, and ticketing documentation.
* Accurately document incidents, diagnostics, correlations, and resolutions in the ticketing system.
* Maintain WAN links and engage ISPs and vendors for circuit outages, latency, packet loss or bandwidth issues.
* Escalate outage events and network impairments to appropriate stakeholders when unresolved within SLA timelines.
* Monitor and track scheduled network maintenance activities, analyzing impact and ensuring alignment with approved windows.
* Coordinate with internal teams and respond to communications promptly.
* Act as an escalation point for NOC Engineers on network related issues.
* Produce reports such as RCA, investigation reports, and network health summaries.
* Provide training for new hires in lower roles on network troubleshooting and monitoring.
* Provide feedback for continuous improvement of NOC network operations.
* Ability to work on Major Incident Management (MIM) tickets (P1/P2) for Network related issues.

**Who you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology/computer science or related field.
* 5 years of relevant experience in network support & monitoring.
* Minimum 2 years as a NOC Engineer in network operations.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical network issues clearly.
* Strong prioritization and customer centric mindset.
* Strong troubleshooting skills: ability to identify and analyze network issues, traffic behavior and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to multitask in a high-volume NOC environment.
* Ability to prioritize tasks in high-pressure situations.
* Highly self-motivated and proactive.
* Willingness to work in 24x7x365 operational environment.
* Strong experience in configuration, management, and monitoring of:
* Routers and switches (Cisco or equivalent)
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA, Fortinet)
* Wireless LAN controllers and access networks
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals
* Experience with routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, EIGRP
* Experience with switching technologies: VLANs, STP, trunking
* Experience in WAN technologies: MPLS, Internet circuits, VPNs (IPSec, SSL)
* Hands-on experience with SD-WAN technologies and Firewalls such as:
* Cisco SD-WAN (Viptela) / VMware (Velocloud) / Fortinet / Palo Alto
* Monitoring tools such as LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, or similar SNMP-based platforms
* Ticketing tools experience such as ServiceNow
* Basic packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark – preferred)
* Certifications/Training Recommendations: CCENT or CCNA or CCNP or PCNSE or training equivalent. Knowledge of TCP/IP, Cisco routing, switching technologies and ITIL Exposure

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience with Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments
* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM
* Experience with network monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, SolarWinds, ConnectWise Automate etc.)
* Knowledge of DNS and network-related services
* Relevant advanced network certifications

ECI’s culture is all about connection – connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and so much more! If you believe you would be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever,
**we would like to hear from you!**

title: Principal Analyst - SOC | On-site, Bangalore
description:
*This team provides 24/7 support. This role requires shift flexibility, including the ability to rotate between days, mids, and nights.*
The Principal Analyst will provide deep-level analysis for client investigations utilizing customer-provided data sources, audit, and monitoring tools at both the government and enterprise levels. The Principal Analyst will work closely with our Technology Engineers, Architects, and Threat Analysts to service customers.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Operate independently in a geographically dispersed team, while maintaining situational awareness and keeping the team up to date
* Perform security monitoring and incident response activities across the networks, leveraging a variety of tools and techniques
* Detect incidents through proactive “hunting” across security-relevant data sets
* Thoroughly document incident response analysis activities
* Review investigations conducted by more junior analysts to ensure quality standards are met
* Develop new, repeatable methods for finding malicious activity across the networks
* Provide recommendations to enhance detection and protection capabilities
* Regularly present technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences
* Develop and follow detailed operational processes and procedures to appropriately analyze, escalate, and assist in the remediation of information security incidents
* Prioritize multiple high-priority tasks and formulate responses/recommendations to customers and team members in a fast-paced environment
* Provide assistance to other security teams
* Continually develop new technical skills and push overall team capabilities forward
* Engage with and mentor other team members
* Work with other teams on major engineering and architecture initiatives
* Be innovative with their understanding of attack methodologies, malware analysis, malicious toolkits, and how those may manifest within various security technologies
* Advanced proactive threat hunting
* Understands advanced adversary emulation concepts
* Advanced use case design for insider threat, operational, threat detection and response
* Review of defensive and detective controls to reduce client attack surface

**What We’re Looking For**

* 9+ years of hands-on cybersecurity operations experience across complex security investigations, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, and security control assessment in enterprise environments.
* Experience in Cortex XSOAR, Proofpoint, Egress, MS Azure, MS Defender, Azure ADX, Crowdstrike.
* Advanced understanding of the cyber threat landscape and adversary TTPs, with extensive experience applying MITRE ATT&CK to investigations, threat hunting, detection engineering, adversary behavior analysis, and detection coverage assessment.
* Lead complex, multi-source investigations using endpoint, network, identity, cloud, SaaS, memory, disk, and log evidence; preserve evidence, reconstruct attacker timelines, determine root cause and scope, and produce technically defensible findings.
* Investigate identity- and cloud-centric attacks involving privileged accounts, federation, OAuth applications, tokens, service identities, control-plane/API activity, cloud workloads, SaaS audit records, and cross-account or cross-tenant access.
* Demonstrated proficiency in SIEM, EDR/XDR, UEBA, and security data platforms, including developing and optimizing complex queries and correlating telemetry across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, and network environments.
* Use Python, PowerShell, or comparable scripting languages, REST APIs, and orchestration/SOAR platforms to automate enrichment, evidence collection, threat hunting, detection deployment, and repeatable response activities.
* Own the detection lifecycle end-to-end, including requirements, data validation, use-case and rule development, peer review, testing, deployment, performance monitoring, tuning, documentation, and retirement, with analysis of both false positives and false negatives.
* Design and execute hypothesis-driven and exploratory threat hunts based on adversary behavior, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK coverage gaps, and incident learnings, converting validated findings into detections, analytics, or response content.
* Assess telemetry quality and detection visibility, identify logging, ingestion, normalization, retention, and coverage gaps, and collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to improve security monitoring and investigation capabilities.
* Serve as technical lead for significant security incidents, defining investigative priorities, evidence-preservation requirements, scoping decisions, containment strategies, remediation validation, and technical handoffs while considering operational and business impact.
* Demonstrate advanced endpoint and network investigation capabilities, including Windows/Linux security artifacts, EDR/XDR telemetry, packet captures, DNS, proxy, firewall, flow, and related data to identify command-and-control, lateral movement, persistence, exfiltration, and attacker infrastructure.
* Operationalize threat intelligence by translating adversary TTPs, infrastructure, vulnerabilities, and campaign intelligence into prioritized hunts, behavioral analytics, detection logic, investigation guidance, and defensive-control improvements.
* Perform advanced phishing and malware analysis, including malicious URLs, attachments, sender infrastructure, authentication artifacts, behavioral/static malware analysis, persistence, execution, and communications; advanced reverse engineering is not required.
* Provide Principal-level technical leadership, including reviewing complex investigations and detections for quality and accuracy, mentoring analysts, developing repeatable investigation and response methodologies, and collaborating with Security Engineering, Architecture, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Cloud, and Identity teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a globally distributed environment and communicate complex technical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent English fluency required. This role is Work from Office position
* This role demands to be flexible for rotational shifts 24/7.

**What You Can Expect From Optiv**

* A company committed to our inclusive value through our Employee Resource Groups
* Work/life balance
* Professional training resources
* Creative problem-solving and the ability to tackle unique, complex projects
* Volunteer Opportunities. “Optiv Chips In” encourages employees to volunteer and engage with their teams and communities.
* The ability and technology necessary to productively work remotely/from home (where applicable)

title: Level 3 SOC Analyst
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**L3 SOC Analyst**
**Role Overview**
The L3 SOC Analyst is the senior technical escalation point within the Security Operations Centre (SOC). This role is responsible for leading complex cyber investigations, directing incident response activities, providing threat intelligence expertise, mentoring L1/L2 analysts, and driving continuous improvement of detection and response capabilities. The role combines advanced technical investigation, threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence, incident command, and operational leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary technical escalation point for high-severity and complex cyber incidents.
* Lead investigations involving ransomware, business email compromise, insider threats, cloud compromise, identity attacks, and advanced persistent threats.
* Perform detailed scoping, root-cause analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery activities during active incidents.
* Provide incident command support and coordinate response activities across Cybersecurity, IT, Legal, HR, Privacy, and business stakeholders.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting using intelligence, behavioural analytics, SIEM, EDR, NDR, identity, and cloud telemetry.
* Collect, analyse, operationalise, and disseminate cyber threat intelligence from internal and external sources.
* Track threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and map activity to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Develop, tune, and improve detection use cases, correlation rules, analytics, and automated response workflows.
* Own and maintain SOC playbooks, incident response procedures, escalation criteria, and communication templates.
* Provide coaching, mentorship, and quality oversight for L1 and L2 analysts.
* Review alert triage quality, escalation decisions, documentation standards, and investigation outcomes.
* Produce executive-ready incident summaries, threat assessments, lessons learned, and risk-based recommendations.
* Drive continuous improvement activities including post-incident reviews, threat modelling, detection coverage reviews, and operational readiness exercises.
* Support compliance, audit, and regulatory activities including NIST CSF, CMMC, TISAX, and incident response evidence requirements.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in SOC Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Digital Forensics, Detection Engineering, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
* Advanced understanding of cyber attack methodologies, adversary behaviour, and incident response frameworks.
* Strong experience with SIEM, EDR, NDR, email security, identity security, and cloud security platforms.
* Experience leading complex investigations and coordinating response activities across multiple teams.
* Strong analytical, investigative, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with both technical and executive audiences.
* Ability to operate independently in high-pressure situations and make risk-based decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* GCIH, GCIA, GCTI, CISSP, GCFA, GREM, CEH or equivalent certifications.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, WIZ, SIEM/SOAR platforms, and cloud-native security tools.
* Experience within a global enterprise SOC or regulated environment.
* Experience leveraging AI, generative AI, and agentic security capabilities to enhance threat detection, investigation, response, and SOC operational efficiency.
* Scripting and automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Information Security Incident Analyst - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**We are Omnissa!**
The world is evolving fast, and organizations everywhere—from corporations to schools—are under immense pressure to provide flexible, work-from-anywhere solutions. They need IT infrastructure that empowers employees and customers to access applications from any device, on any cloud, all while maintaining top-tier security. That’s where Omnissa comes in.
  
  
The Omnissa Platform is the first AI-driven digital work platform that enables smart, seamless and secure work experiences from anywhere. It uniquely integrates multiple industry-leading solutions including Unified Endpoint Management, Virtual Apps and Desktops, Digital Employee Experience, and Security & Compliance through common data, identity, administration, and automation services. Built on the vision of autonomous workspaces - self configuring, self-healing, and self-securing - Omnissa continuously adapts to the way people work; delivering personalized and engaging employee experiences, while optimizing security, IT operations and costs. we're experiencing rapid growth—and this is just the beginning of our journey!
  
  
At Omnissa, we’re driven by a shared mission to maximize value for our customers. Our five Core Values guide us:
**Act in Alignment, Build Trust, Foster Inclusiveness, Drive Efficiency,**
and
**Maximize Customer Value**
—all with the aim of achieving shared success for our clients and our team.
  
  
As a global private company with over 4,000 employees, we’re always looking for passionate, talented individuals to join us. If you're ready to make an impact and help shape the future of work, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
**What is the opportunity?**
**Required Skills**

* 6 to 12 years in product security, PSIRT, vulnerability response, or security incident response, including coordination of multi-team remediation under time pressure.
* Hands-on experience running or coordinating security incidents and vulnerability disclosures end to end.
* Working knowledge of CVSS, CWE, CVE/CNA processes, VEX, SBOM, and ISO/IEC 29147 and 30111 concepts.
* Ability to investigate vulnerabilities and exploits and understand common classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25).
* Practical experience using AI tooling in security operations workflows, with sound judgment on validation and data protection.
* Ability to translate business objectives into execution strategy and prioritize in a dynamic environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive briefings.
* Self-motivated and effective across functional teams.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, risk management, or a similar field strongly preferred

The Work: What type of work will you be doing?
  
  

* Vulnerability response and incident coordination
* Own end-to-end coordination of externally reported and actively exploited product vulnerabilities, from intake and triage through remediation, coordinated disclosure, and customer communication, for on-premises and SaaS products.
* Act as incident coordinator for high-severity product security events: set severity, run the bridge, assign owners, track timelines, and drive decisions with Engineering, Product, Support, Legal, and Communications.
* Coordinate security engineers and external stakeholders (researchers, CERTs, vendors, customers, coordinators) to remediate high-profile vulnerabilities within tight timeframes.
* Run coordinated disclosure, including embargo management, CVE assignment, advisory publication, and researcher relations.
* Perform RCCA and post-incident reviews, and present findings and trends to executive staff.
* AI-driven vulnerability operations
* Design, deploy, and govern AI-assisted workflows for intake deduplication, triage, exploitability and impact analysis, severity scoring, and advisory drafting, with human review at decision points.
* Evaluate and operationalize AI-enabled tooling and automation to raise speed and scale while managing accuracy, hallucination, data handling, and tenant-isolation risks.
* Triage and respond to the rising volume of AI-generated vulnerability reports, including low-quality submissions, and to AI-accelerated exploitation that shortens the time from disclosure to attack.
* Assess and coordinate response to vulnerabilities in AI features and components shipped in Omnissa products (for example prompt injection, model and agent integrations, and AI supply chain dependencies).
* Define metrics for AI-assisted operations: time to triage, time to remediate, false positive rate, and report quality.
* Program and process
* Build and maintain process, policy, and runbook documentation; identify and implement team improvements.
* Define and report program roadmap, status, and success metrics (SLAs, backlog, aging, disclosure timelines).
* Support regulatory and customer obligations tied to vulnerability handling and disclosure (for example EU Cyber Resilience Act reporting, CNA responsibilities, customer and audit inquiries).
* Answer customer and field "am I impacted by CVE X" inquiries using SBOM, scanner, and threat intelligence data.
* Monitor threat intelligence, exploit activity, and KEV-class signals to maintain situational awareness and drive prioritization.
* Engage the security community: researchers, bug bounty participants, vendors, and conferences.
* Work with stakeholders from engineering to executive level.

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior software engineering or architecture experience, including secure coding practices.
* Scripting or automation skills (Python, APIs, Jira/Confluence automation) to build workflows.
* Experience with SAST, SCA, and vulnerability scanners, and code platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket).
* Experience with bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs.
* Customer-facing experience.
* Experience with Jira Service Management and Confluence.
* Relevant certifications (for example FIRST PSIRT Services Framework training, GCIH, GCFA, CISSP) are a plus.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
**Threat Intelligence Analyst – Early Career**
Role Overview
  
  
The Threat Intelligence (TI) Analyst supports the collection, analysis, and dissemination of cyber threat intelligence to improve ADI’s ability to anticipate, detect, and respond to cyber threats. Working closely with the SOC, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, and Cyber Defence teams, this role helps identify emerging threats, track adversary activity, and translate intelligence into practical defensive actions. This is an early-career role intended for individuals looking to build expertise in cyber threat intelligence, adversary analysis, threat hunting, and intelligence-driven defence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collect and analyse cyber threat intelligence from open-source, deep web, dark web, commercial, vendor, and industry sources.
* Monitor emerging threats, vulnerabilities, malware campaigns, credential exposures, data leaks and threat actor activity relevant to ADI.
* Support the creation and distribution of threat intelligence briefings, reports, and summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Maintain awareness of threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
* Assist SOC and Incident Response teams by providing contextual intelligence during security investigations.
* Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs) and support operationalisation into security tools and detection platforms.

**Job Description**
The Application Vulnerability Management Specialist is a security-focused individual contributor responsible for identifying, prioritising and coordinating the remediation of vulnerabilities across WSP’s COTS and Microsoft 365 application portfolio. The estate includes:
  
  

* Collaboration — tools that connect people and teams (e.g. Zoom, Teams).
* Productivity — applications that support day-to-day business output (e.g. Microsoft 365 Apps, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, Smartsheet).
* Utilities — general end-user desktop utilities that support the estate (e.g. WinZip / 7-Zip, TeamViewer, Notepad++, Snagit).

Using Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Intune and ServiceNow, you will turn vulnerability data into clear priorities, coordinate remediation with technical teams and suppliers, and report progress to stakeholders. You will apply risk factors such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, asset criticality and business impact to reduce exposure while maintaining operational stability across a global environment.

**Product Security Engineer**

We have an opportunity for a
**Product Security Engineer**
to join our Product Security Engineering team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Security Engineering. In this pivotal role, you will identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across Infoblox products, cloud infrastructure, containers, and software-as-a-service (SaaS) services.

Collaborating closely with engineering and DevOps teams, you will help strengthen product security while building your skills across security engineering and incident response. You will use approved AI and large language model (LLM) tools to accelerate vulnerability triage, CVE analysis, reporting, and remediation guidance, while applying sound judgment and human oversight. You will also help automate the vulnerability-management lifecycle so the team can scale without adding manual effort.

**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Run regular vulnerability scans and assessments across Infoblox products, containers, Kubernetes environments, and cloud infrastructure using industry-standard tools
* Analyze scan results, Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), penetration-test findings, and security advisories
* Prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability, exposure, risk, business impact, and applicable service-level agreements (SLAs), with guidance from senior engineers on complex cases
* Validate vulnerability exploitability using established procedures, diagnostic scripts, and available environmental evidence, then provide clear remediation guidance
* Coordinate with engineering and DevOps teams to assign findings, track remediation, follow up on overdue items, and verify closure
* Monitor vendor notifications, security advisories, and cyber threat intelligence to identify vulnerabilities that affect Infoblox products and services
* Produce vulnerability reports and metrics, including time to remediate, vulnerability aging, risk trends, and SLA adherence
* Deploy, manage, troubleshoot, and maintain vulnerability-management and security tools with minimal oversight
* Handle tier-two operational tasks and incidents with manager oversight, and participate in incident response when vulnerabilities are actively exploited
* Use approved AI and LLM tools daily to triage findings, assess CVE applicability, summarize advisories, draft remediation guidance, and improve security-team productivity

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* Two or more years of experience in vulnerability management, security engineering, product security, or a related security role; an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience will also be considered
* Working knowledge of vulnerability-management principles, CVE and Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) scoring, common vulnerabilities, attack vectors, exploitation techniques, and risk-based prioritization; basic penetration-testing knowledge is a plus
* Hands-on experience with vulnerability-scanning tools such as Wiz, Qualys, Nessus, or Trivy, and vulnerability databases such as the National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
* Familiarity with at least one cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, as well as Kubernetes and container technologies
* Scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, or a similar language, including experience working with APIs and integrating security tools with ticketing or workflow systems
* Ability to break complex problems into smaller parts, follow diagnostic procedures, assess evidence, and communicate practical remediation recommendations
* Hands-on experience using AI and LLM tools for security research, vulnerability triage, analytics, automation, documentation, or decision support, with the judgment to validate outputs and protect confidential information
* Interest in building AI-assisted workflows or agents; experience with prompt engineering, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent frameworks is a plus
* Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, or comparable security frameworks as they relate to vulnerability management
* Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, DevOps, and security teams; a Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Technology degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related field is preferred. CEH, CompTIA Security+, or cloud-security certifications are a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:**
Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short- and long-term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Understand the scope of Infoblox products, cloud infrastructure, containers, and SaaS services that require vulnerability management
* Understand the vulnerability-management process, tools, SLAs, reporting requirements, and related compliance obligations
* Build working relationships with key engineering, DevOps, cloud, and security stakeholders
* Triage and prioritize vulnerabilities with moderate guidance, then track findings through remediation and closure
* Use the team’s approved AI tools and automation as a routine part of daily vulnerability-management work

**One Year:**

* Contribute reliably to the product vulnerability-management program across multi-cloud infrastructure, on-premises environments, containers, and SaaS products
* Help reduce average time to remediate vulnerabilities and improve SLA adherence
* Build or improve at least one automation or AI-assisted workflow, with senior-engineer oversight, that reduces manual vulnerability-management effort
* Produce accurate, actionable vulnerability metrics and remediation guidance for engineering stakeholders
* Gain exposure to other Product Security Engineering capabilities, such as security engineering and incident response

**Belong —**
**Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

**Be Rewarded —**
**Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

**Location:**
Bangalore, India — Hybrid

title: Product Security Engineer (Cloud Sec)
description:

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold
**“what if.”**
**What if**
your ideas could ignite global innovation?
