your curiosity could redefine the future?
  
  
We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of
**your**
career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect
**70% of the Fortune 500**
, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.
  
  
How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a
**Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024**
— clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you?
**Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**
In a world where you can be anything,
**Be Infoblox.**
**Product Security Engineer II**
We have an opportunity for a
**Product Security Engineer II**
to join our Product Security Engineering team in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Security Engineering. In this role, you will help strengthen the security of Infoblox products, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure across the software development lifecycle. You will assess security risks, guide engineering teams toward practical mitigations, and help automate security testing and vulnerability management at scale. Collaborating closely with product engineering, cloud, DevOps, architecture, and security teams, you will contribute to secure design, threat modeling, application security testing, and continuous improvement of our security practices.
  
  
**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Design, implement and harden security controls across AWS, Azure or GCP, Kubernetes, identity systems and product infrastructure
* Deploy, manage and tune security tools such as cloud-native application protection platforms (CNAPP), cloud security posture management (CSPM), endpoint detection and response (EDR) and security information and event management (SIEM) platforms
* Investigate, scope and contain security incidents as a second- and third-line escalation partner, and drive remediation with the SOC and engineering teams
* Perform root cause analysis after incidents and turn findings into lasting control and detection improvements
* Validate the exploitability of vulnerabilities and security findings, write diagnostic scripts and recommend risk-based remediation
* Contribute to threat modeling and security reviews of cloud architecture and product deployments, and advise on solution design
* Build security automation and guardrails as code with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines and scripting
* Build and maintain AI agents and AI-assisted workflows for alert enrichment, incident investigation, log analysis and vulnerability triage. Validate outputs for accuracy and security
* Automate incident response steps, including evidence collection, containment actions and stakeholder notifications, to shorten response times
* Use AI and large language model (LLM) tools to accelerate engineering, investigation and documentation, and assess AI systems and agentic integrations for identity, access and data exposure risks
* Mentor junior engineers, document runbooks and playbooks, participate in PI planning and improve team processes, tools and methodologies
* Coordinate with North American teams and maintain a few hours of daily work overlap

* Hands-on experience securing at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP); multi-cloud experience is a plus
* Experience with security tools such as Wiz, CrowdStrike, SIEM platforms and vulnerability scanners; Kubernetes and container security experience is strongly preferred
* A solid understanding of security fundamentals, including firewalls, VPNs, authentication, certificates and intrusion detection, plus networking, cloud architecture and common attack paths
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Go, Bash or similar, including diagnostic scripts and integrations with security-tool APIs
* Experience using AI and LLM tools in security engineering, with sound judgment to validate their output
* Experience building AI-assisted workflows or agents using prompt engineering, MCP or agent frameworks is strongly preferred; understanding of risks such as prompt injection and over-permissioned agents is important
* The ability to break complex problems into manageable parts, work methodically, pay close attention to detail and communicate technical issues clearly across teams
* Experience with SOAR platforms or automated response playbooks, offensive security, or certifications such as OSCP, GCIH, GCIA, CISSP or a cloud security specialty is a plus
* A BS/B.Tech, MS/M.Tech or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical, electronics or communication engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short- and long-term goals.

* Deploy and manage at least one security tool or infrastructure security domain.
* Participate in the incident response rotation and understand the SOC escalation process.
* Build relationships with stakeholders across engineering, platform, IT and the SOC.
* Deliver at least one AI-assisted or automated workflow that reduces risk or manual effort

title: Governance, Risk and Compliance Analyst (Information Security)
description:
Our Information Security team is a trusted partner to the business, integrating security, privacy, and trust into Talkdesk's operations and customer service. We emphasize practical, scalable controls that safeguard customers and employees while allowing the business to operate swiftly. As Talkdesk leads in Customer Experience Automation, our team is crucial in building and maintaining customer trust in our AI development, deployment, and governance.

Are you someone who prefers to automate controls rather than chase evidence quarterly?

As a GRC Analyst on the Information Security team, you will actively manage Talkdesk's compliance programs from start to finish — overseeing our GRC platform, collaborating with engineering to gather audit evidence, and preparing for new certifications as our customer base grows.

**What you'll do**

* Manage Talkdesk's GRC platform daily, including control owner assignments, evidence requests, automated test configurations, and exception tracking.
* Maintain integrations between the GRC platform and source systems (cloud providers, identity, ticketing, code repositories) to automate evidence collection wherever possible.
* Identify manual control activities suitable for automation and collaborate with security and engineering teams to implement them.
* Oversee the evidence collection cycle for SOC 2 (Type II), ISO surveillances, recertifications, and HIPAA assessments.
* Work with engineering, IT, HR, and platform teams to gather, validate, and prepare audit artifacts, addressing evidence gaps before they escalate into findings.
* Manage the control library and framework crosswalks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, HIPAA), ensuring mappings are current as standards evolve.
* Conduct initial gap assessments against new frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP Moderate, HITRUST, StateRAMP, ISO 42001 expansions), document control gaps and effort estimates, and support readiness once leadership approves a path forward.
* Track the remediation of any non-conformities to closure.
* Utilize AI-assisted tools (control narrative drafting, evidence summarization, policy review) to minimize manual effort while ensuring output accuracy.
* Maintain compliance documentation in Confluence and track work in Jira for team visibility.
* Foster a culture of compliance — making controls easier to follow than bypass.

**Must have**

* 5-8 years of experience in GRC, IT audit, or information security operations, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Working knowledge of common security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF) and privacy regulations (GDPR).
* Hands-on experience with GRC platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, OneTrust, Hyperproof, AuditBoard).
* Comfortable collaborating with engineers: able to read cloud architecture diagrams and discuss IAM, logging, and encryption choices, with basic terminal or cloud console skills.
* Familiarity with the SDLC and the implementation of security controls in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Confluence, and Jira.
* Understanding of AI security and governance topics (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating compliance requirements into clear, actionable requests for engineering and partner teams.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken).
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* Comfortable in fast-paced, high-pressure situations, including audit periods.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to ISO 27701, ISO 22301, ISO 42001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, StateRAMP, or HITRUST.
* Experience supporting a new framework certification from gap assessment through the first audit.
* Basic scripting skills (Python, Bash, SQL) for evidence gathering and ad-hoc analysis.
* Experience with AWS or other major cloud providers — audit log fluency, IAM, Config rules.
* Familiarity with additional security standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-53, CIS Benchmarks, OWASP, SANS).
* Relevant certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CompTIA Security+.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world’s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid® Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements:**

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. To that end, we will hire, promote, work along, cheer for, bond with, and warmly welcome into the Talkdesk family all persons without regard to ethnic and racial identity, indigenous heritage, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

description:

* Competence in managing assessment workflows and defining CCM rules.
* Solid background in connector setup and master data management practices.

title: Senior Cyber Security Partner
description:
**About the role**
We are the trusted security advisors for Tesco Technology. Our purpose is to collaborate seamlessly with the product and engineering teams, leveraging our deep expertise in cyber security to design and implement robust, resilient solutions that protect our business and customers from cyber threats.  We are a dynamic and expanding global team of 15+ experts, serving as the strategic link between the wider security group and software engineering teams that develop cutting-edge services at scale to support the retail business.  Tesco Technology comprises of several technology domains with over 100+ teams, each entrusted with their own security. These teams enjoy significant autonomy, balanced by the responsibility to make customer-centric decisions and security. Rather than imposing controls through rigid processes and security gates, we empower these engineering teams to innovate by providing security guidance that helps them make informed decisions for Tesco. Encouragingly, these teams are enthusiastic partners in enhancing security, working more efficiently, and integrating security into every aspect of their ways of working. This collaborative approach sets us apart from traditional security teams. We proudly identify ourselves as Security Partners, not security police, emphasizing our role as the “trusted advisors” rather than enforcers.  Partners engage key people in engineering to make security contextual and frictionless. After all, security is a journey and there is no one-size-fits-all. Join the team and be part of this exciting journey!  
  
  
**You will be responsible for**
As a Senior Security Partner, you will transform the security maturity of key product areas and teams. You will be the face of security group for them. Everything you do is in the context of the product, roadmap, its risk acceptance level, the technology stack, and its architecture.  You build a comprehensive understanding of the threat landscape and its potential risks to the business. Through effective partnership, you engage the leadership to make wellinformed decisions about security and privacy.  Being the trusted advisor As enterprise applications become more distributed, adaptive to technological advancements, and run from hybrid infrastructure, teams need to navigate through different complexities and make key security decisions along the way. A trusted security advisor empowers teams to achieve scalable and sustainable security maturity throughout the SDLC (software development lifecycle) process.   In this job, I am accountable for: Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities: • Provide product and engineering teams with direction and guidance on all security matters. There is a whole security group to back you up, so it is not as scary as it sounds.  • Influence security outcomes through collaboration, expertise and constructive challenge.  • Define and review security requirements for critical business programmes, new products, services and technology initiatives. • Engage engineering leadership on security roadmap and oversee security posture, while balancing security requirements with business objectives.  • Co-own the security roadmap, discuss, prioritise, and co-develop plans for remediation for the product areas, while building trusted relationships • Enabling security champions to succeed and creating a strong feedback loop for improvements.  • Represent security in all product and architecture meet-ups. Be part of critical decisions about security.  • Oversee product security activities, from the early development of security requirements, architecture reviews, and threat modelling, to strengthening application security, mitigating supply-chain risks, securing secrets, pipelines, reviewing vulnerabilities, and infrastructure security.  • Perform security architecture reviews of third-party services.  • Identify acceptable risk levels and assist with action plan, policy, and procedural changes for risk mitigation. Prioritise security investment based on risk.  • Adopt a contextual risk-based approach and guide management in identifying business risks and potential impact to Tesco. Continuously seek both tactical and strategic solutions to enhance security.  • As the trusted security expert & advisor for the product area, engage across the security group to strengthen controls across identification, protection, detection, response, and recovery.  • Oversee assurance activities like security testing, purple testing, assurance, auditing.  • Reduce security fatigue for engineering and provide faster feedback within existing developer workflows, not adding another tool for them to check.  • Empower the teams you work with, but also challenge the status-quo.  • Advise on secure adoption of AI, GenAI and agentic technologies.  • Assess security risks associated with AI-powered products and services.  • As a senior member of the team, engage across the security group on new ideas and initiatives. • Contribute to strengthen organisation standards and policies, develop cookbooks, secure patterns, take part in security research and tool evaluations.  • You are committed to continuous improvement, seizing opportunities, and inspire change for the team.  • Mentor others in the team and take part in enhancing their skills and career development.  
  
  
**You will need**
To excel in this position, we expect you to have the following: • Experience in having lead security assessments of large, complex, critical business programmes involving technical implementation and integrations. • Possess experience across multiple sectors and have undertaken diverse roles in engineering and security. Demonstratable accomplishments of collaborating with leadership and management on security programmes and initiatives. • Good knowledge of various security domains, and solid experience in architecture practices and design patterns – the technology might have changed but most of the security challenges have not.  • Experience in designing security and privacy controls with sound understanding of standards and regulation. • Experience in threat modelling, attack trees, vulnerability chaining, applying MITRE ATT&CK framework.  • Good understanding of web applications, REST APIs, micro services, eventing, modern application frameworks, and mobile apps.  • Good understanding of software architecture, network topologies, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS (infrastructure as a service).  • Proficient in applying industry standards such as OWASP ASVS (Application Security Verification Standard), OWASP Top 10, CIS (Centre of Internet Security) controls and benchmarks.  • Experience with cloud native and hybrid architectures with an emphasis on containerised workloads and Kubernetes.  • Some development experience is always a plus - Java, cloud, Golang, python. You do not need to “be a developer” but we need you to understand the implications of security on engineering velocity.  • Experience in designing, deploying and operationalizing GenAI and Agentic AI solutions aimed at increasing efficiency and enhancing productivity • Experience in driving measurable risk reduction and security maturity improvements.  • Degree in computer science / information systems or engineering field, or equivalent experience. • Experience with regulations like GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), PCI-DSS is desirable.  • Azure or AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud security certifications is desirable.  • Excellent interpersonal skills and leadership skills. • Stay informed on emerging threats, attack techniques and industry trends.   
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.
  
 
  
When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

Continuously seek both tactical and strategic solutions to enhance security.  • As the trusted security expert & advisor for the product area, engage across the security group to strengthen controls across identification, protection, detection, response, and recovery.  • Oversee assurance activities like security testing, purple testing, assurance, auditing.  • Reduce security fatigue for engineering and provide faster feedback within existing developer workflows, not adding another tool for them to check.  • Empower the teams you work with, but also challenge the status-quo.  • Advise on secure adoption of AI, GenAI and agentic technologies.  • Assess security risks associated with AI-powered products and services.  • As a senior member of the team, engage across the security group on new ideas and initiatives. • Contribute to strengthen organisation standards and policies, develop cookbooks, secure patterns, take part in security research and tool evaluations.  • You are committed to continuous improvement, seizing opportunities, and inspire change for the team.  • Mentor others in the team and take part in enhancing their skills and career development.  
  
  
**You will need**
To excel in this position, we expect you to have the following: • Experience in having lead security assessments of large, complex, critical business programmes involving technical implementation and integrations. • Possess experience across multiple sectors and have undertaken diverse roles in engineering and security. Demonstratable accomplishments of collaborating with leadership and management on security programmes and initiatives. • Good knowledge of various security domains, and solid experience in architecture practices and design patterns – the technology might have changed but most of the security challenges have not.  • Experience in designing security and privacy controls with sound understanding of standards and regulation. • Experience in threat modelling, attack trees, vulnerability chaining, applying MITRE ATT&CK framework.  • Good understanding of web applications, REST APIs, micro services, eventing, modern application frameworks, and mobile apps.  • Good understanding of software architecture, network topologies, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS (infrastructure as a service).  • Proficient in applying industry standards such as OWASP ASVS (Application Security Verification Standard), OWASP Top 10, CIS (Centre of Internet Security) controls and benchmarks.  • Experience with cloud native and hybrid architectures with an emphasis on containerised workloads and Kubernetes.  • Some development experience is always a plus - Java, cloud, Golang, python. You do not need to “be a developer” but we need you to understand the implications of security on engineering velocity.  • Experience in designing, deploying and operationalizing GenAI and Agentic AI solutions aimed at increasing efficiency and enhancing productivity • Experience in driving measurable risk reduction and security maturity improvements.  • Degree in computer science / information systems or engineering field, or equivalent experience. • Experience with regulations like GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), PCI-DSS is desirable.  • Azure or AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud security certifications is desirable.  • Excellent interpersonal skills and leadership skills. • Stay informed on emerging threats, attack techniques and industry trends.

title: Security Architect - AI-Powered Security Engineering
description:
Security Architect - AI-Powered Security Engineering
  
  
**About The Team**
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this, with zero downtime! We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. By 2030, Meesho will be the world’s most trusted and secure digital ecosystem, operating on an AI-native, Zero-Trust, self-healing architecture. As we shift toward an era where autonomous agents generate and deploy code, we want to ensure our security scales seamlessly with engineering velocity. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member, fostering a strong 'Founder’s Mindset' that helps us move fast.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Security Architect (Individual Contributor) to guide and lead our AI-Powered Security Engineering charter. In this role, you will bridge the gap between conventional DevSecOps, infrastructure security, and the rapidly evolving landscape of AI. You will optimize our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by designing secure-by-default guardrails for both human developers and AI coding agents. Your mission is to ensure near-zero vulnerabilities from application and data security failures reach production. A significant portion of your focus will involve advanced Red Teaming, utilizing LLMs to improve Meesho's security posture, and architecting defenses for our autonomous AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, and jailbreaking attacks.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead AI Security Architecture: Drive the technical roadmap and high-level design to continuously prevent, detect, and autonomously contain threats across our systems and AI agents.

* Hands-on Prototyping & POCs: Build proof-of-concepts for autonomous agent harnesses that automatically detect, analyze, and mitigate security vulnerabilities in real-time.
* AI SDLC Optimization: Architect non-bypassable security guardrails across the SDLC for both developers and AI coding agents to ensure production systems are secured by default.
* Red Teaming & Adversarial Validation: Proactively execute adversarial testing by simulating real attack scenarios across APIs, AI systems, and infrastructure to validate defense mechanisms.
* Protect AI Systems: Design deep technical defenses to protect all AI agents and experimental features from prompt injection, system misuse, manipulation, and unauthorized actions.
* Zero-Trust Governance: Architect a Zero Trust Identity Control Plane that eliminates implicit trust, ensuring access for both humans and autonomous agents is time-bound, least-privileged, and continuously verified.
* Technical Leadership & Influence: Act as a security expert and IC leader. Mentor security engineers, provide architectural guidance across the organization, and partner closely with ML, DevOps, and Platform teams to evangelize secure coding practices without direct reporting lines.

**What You Will Need**

* Experience: 10+ years of hands-on technical experience across different areas of security, including infrastructure security, product security, system design, and DevSecOps.

* AI/ML Security Expertise: Proven track record of leveraging coding agents and LLMs for security workflows, Red Teaming GenAI models, and building defenses against jailbreaking, adversarial ML, and model hallucination risks.
* DevSecOps & Cloud Mastery: Deep technical proficiency with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, including their security tools, Docker, and containerization technologies.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Node.js, and Python, combined with hands-on experience securing production code, developing security tooling, and performing manual source code reviews.
* Strategic Vision & Threat Modeling: Ability to architect secure-by-default platform capabilities so all services inherit baseline security automatically, paired with advanced threat modeling skills for AI-native and distributed architectures.

**Bonus Points**

* Relevant certifications such as GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) or OffSec’s Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (WEB-300).

* Strong understanding of emerging AI security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF).
* Experience participating in bug bounty programs or speaking at meetups/conferences.
* Developing Security products and frameworks.

title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Detection Engineer – Early Career
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.

Success Measures
  
  

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

title: GMS-Senior-Web Application Firewall
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description: Senior Web Application Firewall (WAF) Engineer**
**Experience Level: 3–5 Years**
**Role Type: Full-Time**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Web Application Firewall (WAF) Engineer to own and drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our application security gateway infrastructure. Spanning the complete service delivery model—Assess, Build, Transition, and Operations—this role requires deep technical proficiency in protecting modern web applications, APIs, and microservices against sophisticated Layer 7 attacks (including OWASP Top 10, botnets, and DDoS). The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience tuning advanced WAF rule sets, managing positive and negative security models, and collaborating closely with application development and DevOps teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Assess (Architecture Review & Threat Modeling)**

* Conduct thorough security assessments of existing web applications, API endpoints, and ingress traffic architectures.
* Analyze current WAF policies, anomaly scores, and signature rulesets to identify coverage gaps against the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10.
* Collaborate with development and architecture teams to threat-model upcoming applications and define WAF integration requirements.
* Audit SSL/TLS termination configurations, cipher suites, and certificate lifecycles at the edge.

**Build (Deployment & Policy Engineering)**

* Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise WAF solutions (e.g., Cloudflare Enterprise, Akamai Kona, Imperva, F5 Advanced WAF/BIG-IP ASM, or AWS WAF).
* Design and implement both negative security models (signatures, regex blocks) and positive security models (strict schema validation, OpenAPI/Swagger enforcement).
* Configure advanced bot mitigation, rate limiting, geo-fencing, and API security inspection layers.
* Integrate WAF infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines (Infrastructure as Code) for automated policy deployment and version control.

**Transition (Testing, Cutover & Handover)**

* Transition WAF policies from monitoring/audit mode to blocking mode safely, minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate user traffic.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and application functional sign-offs prior to production traffic routing.
* Produce comprehensive "As-Built" documentation, tuning guidelines, escalation playbooks, and topology diagrams.
* Conduct training and knowledge transfer sessions for operations and application support teams.

**Operations & Continuous Management**

* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex Layer 7 security incidents, DDoS attacks, and web traffic anomalies.
* Perform continuous rule tuning, signature optimization, and exception handling based on application updates and vulnerability scan results.
* Monitor WAF performance, backend latency, error rates, and evasion technique indicators.
* Ensure seamless log ingestion and telemetry forwarding to the SIEM/SOAR platforms for deep forensic investigation and continuous compliance reporting.
* Understanding of ITIL-based Change Management, managing end-to-end change lifecycle activities, CAB coordination, and compliant implementation of infrastructure and application changes

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–5 years of specialized experience in web application security, WAF administration, or application delivery controller (ADC) management.
* Core Technologies: Deep, hands-on expertise with leading cloud or on-premise WAF platforms (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai, Imperva, F5 Advanced WAF, or AWS/Azure WAF).
* Security Principles: Comprehensive understanding of the OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Remote Code Execution (RCE), and XML/JSON attacks.
* Networking & Protocols: Solid grasp of HTTP/HTTPS protocols, RESTful APIs, JSON/XML payloads, DNS, SSL/TLS handshakes, and reverse proxy architectures.
* Automation & Scripting: Familiarity with automation tools, Python or Bash scripting, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) for policy management.
* Certifications: Industry certifications (e.g., Certified AppSec Practitioner (CAP), CISSP, CCSP, or vendor-specific WAF/Cloud security credentials) are highly preferred.
* Soft Skills: Excellent stakeholder management skills, ability to bridge security requirements with developer workflows, and strong analytical problem-solving abilities.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: IT Analyst (SAP SPP) - Returnship
description:
**Career Area:**

Students and Graduates

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Caterpillar Returnship is a 24-week company paid**; office-based program designed to enable a soft launch for experienced professionals on a career break. This initiative includes, networking sessions, coaching, trainings, and a project / work scope assignment.

**Eligibility to apply – Career break of minimum 6 months**.

**Job Summary**

Supports the IT function in the implementation, maintenance, support, testing, and continuous improvement of SAP Supply Chain Management solutions, with primary focus on SAP Service Parts Planning (SPP). Works with business partners and IT teams to analyze requirements, troubleshoot application and integration issues, support change requests, and ensure reliable operation of business-critical SCM processes.

**What You Will Do**:

* Supports, maintains, and improves SAP SPP and SCM business processes, including SPP Planning Engine, Demand Capture, DRP and Deployment, SNC, CIF, Global ATP, Segmentation, Stocking/De-Stocking, Manage Demand, Forecasting, EOQ, and Safety Stock.
* Performs root cause analysis of application, process, interface, and integration issues and recommends appropriate solutions.
* Supports and improves existing SAP interfaces, functions, and integrated business processes.
* Performs functional/component testing, manual unit testing, and integration testing to validate solutions against agreed business requirements.
* Supports error analysis and resolution during testing and production support activities.
* Follows established ITSM incident management processes and supports resolution of P2, P3, and P4 incidents.
* Communicates with business partners to understand issues, assess business impact, explain resolutions, and coordinate with relevant support teams.
* Performs end-to-end Change Request Management, including requirement gathering, preparation and review of functional requirement documentation, testing, implementation support, and required controls.
* Ensures adherence to applicable governance and control requirements, including SOX compliance.
* Collaborates with other application and technical teams to ensure successful integration across SAP SCM, ECC, APO, CRM, and EWM landscapes.
* Contributes to the implementation, customization, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Global Template / SCM Core Solution.
* Ensures timely delivery of high-quality solutions and documentation.
* Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, with flexibility to support rotational shifts as required.

**Degree Requirement**:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech), or equivalent relevant experience where applicable.

**What You Have:**:

Core Application Systems

Knowledge of major production application systems used to support supply chain and service parts planning processes, ability to apply functional knowledge of SAP SCM and SAP SPP in support, maintenance, testing, and implementation activities.

Working Knowledge

* Demonstrates functional knowledge of SAP SCM Procurement / Materials Management and related business processes.
* Demonstrates knowledge of SAP SPP, including Planning Engine, Demand Capture, DRP, Deployment, Forecasting, EOQ, Safety Stock, and stocking/de-stocking processes.
* Understands key business functions and services supported by SAP SCM applications.
* Uses functional specifications, process documentation, support procedures, and Global Template documentation to troubleshoot and support applications.
* Applies 3–5 years of relevant SCM/SAP functional experience to application support and improvement activities.

Problem Solving

Knowledge of approaches, tools, and techniques for recognizing, analyzing, and resolving application, operational, integration, and process problems; ability to apply structured problem-solving techniques to diverse support situations.

Working Knowledge:

* Performs structured root cause analysis for SAP SPP process, application, and interface issues.
* Follows established problem reporting, incident management, and escalation procedures.
* Analyzes P2/P3/P4 incidents and coordinates resolution with appropriate technical, functional, and business teams.
* Evaluates business impact and identifies appropriate corrective or preventive actions.
* Demonstrates analytical thinking and applies disciplined troubleshooting techniques to complex application issues.

Application Design, Architecture

Knowledge of SAP application design and functional solution principles:

Ability to translate business requirements and process needs into appropriate functional solutions within the SAP SCM landscape.

Working Knowledge:

* Understands the functional architecture of SAP SPP and SCM solutions and their interaction with related SAP systems.
* Participates in the evaluation and design of changes to existing SAP SCM/SPP functionality.
* Understands dependencies between business processes, application functionality, interfaces, master data, and integration components.
* Contributes to functional solution design while considering performance, reliability, integration, security, and Global Template standards.
* Understands the implications of solution changes across integrated systems and business processes.

System Testing:

Knowledge of system and software testing, ability to plan, execute, document, and support functional, unit, and integration testing to ensure quality throughout the application life cycle.

Working Knowledge

* Executes assigned functional/component and unit testing against agreed business and functional requirements.
* Performs manual unit and integration testing for new functionality and change requests.
* Documents test results, defects, issues, and supporting evidence in accordance with established processes.
* Supports analysis and resolution of errors identified during testing.
* Validates fixes and application changes before implementation into production environments.
* Coordinates with functional, technical, integration, and business teams to ensure end-to-end solution quality.
* Communication and Collaboration

Support:

Ability to communicate effectively with business partners, application teams, technical teams, and other stakeholders to support effective delivery and resolution of SAP SCM/SPP requirements and issues.

Working Knowledge:

* Communicates effectively with business partners to understand application issues and requirements.
* Clearly explains issue impact, root cause, proposed resolution, and implementation considerations.
* Collaborates with other functional and technical teams to resolve cross-application and integration issues.
* Produces clear functional, testing, change, and support documentation.
* Demonstrates strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and cross-team communication skills.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience with strong functional knowledge of SCM Procurement or Materials Management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/B.Tech).
* Experience working with SAP SPP and relevant planning and supply-chain processes.
* Experience in implementation, customization, or maintenance of a Global Template / SCM Core Solution.
* Knowledge of integration between SCM and other SAP components.
* Experience with integrated ECC, APO, CRM, and EWM landscapes is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of Tidal or similar job-scheduling tools is an added advantage.
* Knowledge or experience related to S/4HANA conversions is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability and flexibility to work in rotational shifts.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers.

**Final Details:**

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. title: Senior Prisma Cloud Consultant
description:
**Prisma Cloud - Senior Professional Services Consultant**

**Job Description**

***Your Career***

As a Professional Services Engineer, you’ll get into the details of our platform. You will push the buttons, flip the levers, turn the knobs. You do not shy away from difficult challenges as it relates to cybersecurity, implementations, and integrations. You are the technical authority and will interact directly with our customers to help them secure their digital environments. The customers are counting on you to perform this work and train their staff. And while experience on the company’s platform is desired, even more important is having a solid foundation in networking and security technologies. In fact, extensive experience with a competitor’s technology can play to your advantage. Many of the opportunities involve a client migrating to our platform for the first time, so understanding the nuances of that technology will enable you to be a better Palo Alto Networks consultant. And don't worry, we will send you to our Professional Services Academy to prepare you for the role, so you are experienced with our suite of services and products before you first meet the customer.

***Your Impact***

* Design and Integrate/deploy Palo Alto Networks Cloud Security (Prisma) solutions into the customer’s environment in either public cloud (AWS/AZURE/GPC) or private cloud (Kubernetes, Openstack) environments
* Be at the forefront of all Palo Alto Networks Cloud security technologies
* Build custom security policies and application signatures, configured for our client’s needs
* Migrate customers from legacy firewall technologies to Palo Alto Networks platforms
* Progress and uphold expertise in deploying advanced Palo Alto Networks features and functionality
* Provide after hours and weekend on-call support as needed to support maintenance activities Analyze logs and events from the solution to perform initial troubleshooting and issue identification
* Work with our Technical Assistance Center to troubleshoot and diagnose support cases
* Maintain the Company's solution and provide mentorship on code upgrades and best practices
* Ensure client needs are met and deliverables produced on time according to specified project deliverables and scope

***Qualifications***

* Your Experience
* Experience with network, security solutions, and technologies leading security solutions in large environments
* Extensive hands-on experience with delivering infrastructure solutions and related security aspects in Public / Private / Hybrid cloud solutions
* Experience with troubleshooting skills related to cloud technology such as orchestration, provisioning, work load balancing and auto scaling scenarios
* Experience with troubleshooting skills related to networking, routing, IP, NAT, IPSEC VPNs and knowledge of how these interact with applications and users
* Experience with installation, configuration and operation of high-end firewall appliances, ideally with Palo Alto Networks products
* Possess one of more of the following industry certifications - CISSP, CNSE, JNCIE-SEC, CCSE, CCSM, PCNSE, RHCSA, CKA, GCP PCSE, AWS CS
* Effectively handle multiple projects and work calmly under pressure
* An excellent writer, with strong verbal social skills, with demonstrated ability to communicate to senior leaders, technical peers, and non-technical partners
* Ability to work with the customers security & network teams to build confidence across the business units impacted by the change with the addition Palo Alto Networks

***About Us:***  
Saddleback Solutions offer Consultancy and Professional Services to our Partners and Clients. We partner Palo Alto Networks, Juniper Networks and Arista worldwide, and we indirectly Partner AWS, so there are always lots of varying opportunities that come up.

We have long standing and close relationships with our consultants and our partners so we can represent you fully. We offer free training for all our consultants should they wish to expand their knowledge and profiles while with us.

We have an education services arm also, so our consultants once qualified can also offer their services running workshops or bootcamps between projects or even full time.

We will support you the best way we know how

**Job Details**
===============

Position Summary
  
The Insider Risk Manager will help to establish and lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, India. This role is responsible for overseeing daily insider risk operations, coordinating investigations, and ensuring the team provides timely, consistent, and effective response support. The Insider Risk Manager will strengthen insider risk detection and response capabilities across the full incident lifecycle, including triage, investigation coordination, containment, remediation, and process improvement. The role requires strong technical expertise in incident response, SOC operations, and security tooling, as well as the leadership skills to hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team in India.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

* Team Leadership: Lead the Insider Risk team in Pune, including hiring, onboarding, training, mentoring, coaching, and performance management for analysts and responders.

* Incident Operations: Oversee daily insider risk detection and response activities, ensuring incidents are triaged, investigated, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner.

* Escalation Management: Serve as the escalation point for high-priority or complex insider risk incidents, coordinating response actions and communications with global stakeholders.

* Process Development: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve insider risk response playbooks, runbooks, standard operating procedures, and response workflows.

* Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with HR, Legal, Privacy, CSIRT, IT, Compliance, and Corporate Security teams to align investigation processes, technology use, reporting standards, and stakeholder communications.

* Cyber Defense Collaboration: Collaborate with threat intelligence, vulnerability management, digital forensics, and CSIRT teams to support a unified cyber defense strategy.

* Reporting and Metrics: Provide executive-level reporting on incident trends, operational performance, key metrics, and emerging risks.

* Continuous Improvement: Drive ongoing enhancements to insider risk detection rules, automation opportunities, response processes, and operational effectiveness.

  

Education and Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related discipline required; Master’s degree preferred.

* Strong knowledge of incident response methodology, SOC operations, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST, MITRE ATT&CK).

* Familiarity with global privacy and compliance requirements relevant to incident handling.

  

Preferred Certifications

* GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)

* GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)

* GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)

* Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

.

Work Experience

* 8+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, with at least 6 years focused on Insider risk reponse, data loss prevention triage and investigation, SOC operations or incident response.

* Minimum of 4 years in a people management role, leading incident response or SOC analyst teams.

* Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, DLP, SOAR, and forensic tools.

* Proven experience responding to advanced threats, large scale data exfiltration campaigns, data loss prevention detection engineering and tuning, and insider incidents.

* Demonstrated success in building or scaling security operations and incident response teams in a global enterprise environment.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to brief technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.

title: Technical Consultant-Threat Detection Response & Intelligence
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Technical Consultant: Threat Detection Response & Intelligence, you play a vital role in safeguarding an organization's digital infrastructure by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating cyber threats. This position involves using a variety of cybersecurity tools to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Conduct Event Investigations: Investigate security incidents using SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, and apply industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
* Manage Incident Reports: Prioritize and manage incident reports, providing actionable recommendations and responses to strengthen the client's security posture.
* Analyze Network and Endpoint Events: Interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
* Engage in Vulnerability Management: Participate in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
* Provide Actionable Recommendations: Deliver recommendations and responses to clients to enhance their security posture.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Cybersecurity Tools: Familiarity with a variety of cybersecurity tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
* Understanding of Industry Frameworks: Knowledge of industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
* Experience with Network and Endpoint Analysis: Ability to interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
* Exposure to Vulnerability Management: Participation in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
* Certification in Security Technologies: Familiarity with security technologies and certifications related to threat detection, response, and intelligence.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash is beneficial for automating tasks and interacting with various cybersecurity tools.
* Knowledge of Cloud Security: Understanding cloud security principles and experience working with cloud-based security solutions can be advantageous in identifying and mitigating cyber threats.
* Exposure to Threat Intelligence Platforms: Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and feeds can aid in staying up-to-date with emerging threats and improving incident response capabilities.

description:
General Information

238600

India-Ahmedabad CDC

**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of Third Party Risk Management Coordinator based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The position is primarily responsible for performing day-to-day activities of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) lifecycle for the third parties, covering inherent risk assessment, due diligence, onboarding checks, continuous monitoring and offboarding, applying the TPRM Framework and the team’s procedures and templates consistently, gathering and evaluating due diligence evidence, documents assessment outcomes and rationale, keeping TPRM records audit-ready, and work directly with User Departments and specialist, identifying issues, gaps and adverse findings and refers them to the Third Party Risk Manager, who approves assessment outcomes and handling contentious or high exposure matters functions to obtain the information required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for User Departments and relationship owners on third party risk requirements, providing practical guidance on process, templates and evidence, and builds effective working relationships with User Departments and specialist functions to secure timely input,
* Identify recurring difficulties, inefficiencies and practical obstacles in applying the team’s procedures, templates and guidance, and propose improvements.
* Record where assessment outcomes differ from the provisional tier, to support recalibration of the scoping rules,
* Contribute to the implementation, testing and ongoing improvement of the third-party risk tooling, uses it effectively, and maintain the quality of data within the TPRM system of record,
* Manage allocated caseload of assessments in line with the team’s assessment standards, turnaround times and key performance indicators, and flags early where these are at risk,
* Perform Inherent Risk Assessments for third parties handed over to the central team, running working sessions with relationship owners and subject matter experts to obtain operational facts and specialist input, and prepares the assessment outcome and, where applicable, the rationale for a change in tier for review by the Third Party Risk Manager,
* Challenge responses and scoring that are not supported by evidence, ensures consistency across assessments, and refers unresolved differences to the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Perform due diligence proportionate to the assessed level of risk, collecting, validating and evaluating evidence such as audited financial and credit reports, certifications, data protection documentation, and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening results,
* Request and follows up specialist input from functions such as, but not limited to, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, the Data Protection Office and Procurement, and consolidates their responses into the assessment record,
* Prepare clear, evidence-based due diligence summaries setting out findings, gaps, residual concerns and a proposed risk disposition for review and approval by the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Escalate adverse findings, refused information requests and potential mandatory decline indicators immediately upon identification,
* Maintain the inventory of in-scope third parties allocated to them, keeping risk classification, relationship owner, contract references and key dates complete and current,
* Check all prerequisite lifecycle stages are complete and formally closed before a third party is onboarded, and reports any exceptions,
* Run screening and continuous monitoring at the defined cadence, reviews and dispositions alerts, discounts false positives with documented rationale, and escalates genuine trigger events,
* Support User Departments in performance review cycles and in the structured offboarding of third parties, including confirmation of data return or destruction, access revocation and record closure,
* Maintain the TPRM system of record so that assessments, evidence, approvals and decisions are complete, current and audit-ready,
* Prepare routine reporting on assessment completion, overdue items, open findings and monitoring status, and flag emerging trends to the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Deliver agreed remediation and evidence in support of Internal Audit recommendations relating to third party management.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification
  
  

* High School / Diploma or Equivalent with minimum 3 years of job-related work experience or Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 2 years of job-related work experience.

**Job Specific Skills/ Essentials**

* Professional certification in risk, audit, compliance or third party / vendor risk management (e.g. CRMA, CIA, CRISC, CTPRP),
* Awareness of third-party risk and risk management frameworks and standards, including but not limited to COSO, ISO 31000 and ISO 27001,
* Experience of working with a GRC / third party risk platform, case management or workflow tooling,
* Experience in third party / vendor risk management, procurement, internal control, risk management, compliance, audit or a comparable evidence-based assessment role,
* Ability to read and interpret due diligence evidence (audited financials and credit reports, certifications, data protection documentation, and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening results) and to identify what is missing or inconsistent,
* Lead structured working sessions with business stakeholders and challenge their input constructively,
* Competent in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with data sets, trackers and reporting,
* Good Command of English language with good written and verbal communication skills as well as strong interpersonal skills.

**About Qatar Airways Group**
Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.
