title: Senior Cyber Security Partner
description:
**About the role**
We are the trusted security advisors for Tesco Technology. Our purpose is to collaborate seamlessly with the product and engineering teams, leveraging our deep expertise in cyber security to design and implement robust, resilient solutions that protect our business and customers from cyber threats.  We are a dynamic and expanding global team of 15+ experts, serving as the strategic link between the wider security group and software engineering teams that develop cutting-edge services at scale to support the retail business.  Tesco Technology comprises of several technology domains with over 100+ teams, each entrusted with their own security. These teams enjoy significant autonomy, balanced by the responsibility to make customer-centric decisions and security. Rather than imposing controls through rigid processes and security gates, we empower these engineering teams to innovate by providing security guidance that helps them make informed decisions for Tesco. Encouragingly, these teams are enthusiastic partners in enhancing security, working more efficiently, and integrating security into every aspect of their ways of working. This collaborative approach sets us apart from traditional security teams. We proudly identify ourselves as Security Partners, not security police, emphasizing our role as the “trusted advisors” rather than enforcers.  Partners engage key people in engineering to make security contextual and frictionless. After all, security is a journey and there is no one-size-fits-all. Join the team and be part of this exciting journey!  
  
  
**You will be responsible for**
As a Senior Security Partner, you will transform the security maturity of key product areas and teams. You will be the face of security group for them. Everything you do is in the context of the product, roadmap, its risk acceptance level, the technology stack, and its architecture.  You build a comprehensive understanding of the threat landscape and its potential risks to the business. Through effective partnership, you engage the leadership to make wellinformed decisions about security and privacy.  Being the trusted advisor As enterprise applications become more distributed, adaptive to technological advancements, and run from hybrid infrastructure, teams need to navigate through different complexities and make key security decisions along the way. A trusted security advisor empowers teams to achieve scalable and sustainable security maturity throughout the SDLC (software development lifecycle) process.   In this job, I am accountable for: Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities: • Provide product and engineering teams with direction and guidance on all security matters. There is a whole security group to back you up, so it is not as scary as it sounds.  • Influence security outcomes through collaboration, expertise and constructive challenge.  • Define and review security requirements for critical business programmes, new products, services and technology initiatives. • Engage engineering leadership on security roadmap and oversee security posture, while balancing security requirements with business objectives.  • Co-own the security roadmap, discuss, prioritise, and co-develop plans for remediation for the product areas, while building trusted relationships • Enabling security champions to succeed and creating a strong feedback loop for improvements.  • Represent security in all product and architecture meet-ups. Be part of critical decisions about security.  • Oversee product security activities, from the early development of security requirements, architecture reviews, and threat modelling, to strengthening application security, mitigating supply-chain risks, securing secrets, pipelines, reviewing vulnerabilities, and infrastructure security.  • Perform security architecture reviews of third-party services.  • Identify acceptable risk levels and assist with action plan, policy, and procedural changes for risk mitigation. Prioritise security investment based on risk.  • Adopt a contextual risk-based approach and guide management in identifying business risks and potential impact to Tesco. Continuously seek both tactical and strategic solutions to enhance security.  • As the trusted security expert & advisor for the product area, engage across the security group to strengthen controls across identification, protection, detection, response, and recovery.  • Oversee assurance activities like security testing, purple testing, assurance, auditing.  • Reduce security fatigue for engineering and provide faster feedback within existing developer workflows, not adding another tool for them to check.  • Empower the teams you work with, but also challenge the status-quo.  • Advise on secure adoption of AI, GenAI and agentic technologies.  • Assess security risks associated with AI-powered products and services.  • As a senior member of the team, engage across the security group on new ideas and initiatives. • Contribute to strengthen organisation standards and policies, develop cookbooks, secure patterns, take part in security research and tool evaluations.  • You are committed to continuous improvement, seizing opportunities, and inspire change for the team.  • Mentor others in the team and take part in enhancing their skills and career development.  
  
  
**You will need**
To excel in this position, we expect you to have the following: • Experience in having lead security assessments of large, complex, critical business programmes involving technical implementation and integrations. • Possess experience across multiple sectors and have undertaken diverse roles in engineering and security. Demonstratable accomplishments of collaborating with leadership and management on security programmes and initiatives. • Good knowledge of various security domains, and solid experience in architecture practices and design patterns – the technology might have changed but most of the security challenges have not.  • Experience in designing security and privacy controls with sound understanding of standards and regulation. • Experience in threat modelling, attack trees, vulnerability chaining, applying MITRE ATT&CK framework.  • Good understanding of web applications, REST APIs, micro services, eventing, modern application frameworks, and mobile apps.  • Good understanding of software architecture, network topologies, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS (infrastructure as a service).  • Proficient in applying industry standards such as OWASP ASVS (Application Security Verification Standard), OWASP Top 10, CIS (Centre of Internet Security) controls and benchmarks.  • Experience with cloud native and hybrid architectures with an emphasis on containerised workloads and Kubernetes.  • Some development experience is always a plus - Java, cloud, Golang, python. You do not need to “be a developer” but we need you to understand the implications of security on engineering velocity.  • Experience in designing, deploying and operationalizing GenAI and Agentic AI solutions aimed at increasing efficiency and enhancing productivity • Experience in driving measurable risk reduction and security maturity improvements.  • Degree in computer science / information systems or engineering field, or equivalent experience. • Experience with regulations like GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), PCI-DSS is desirable.  • Azure or AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud security certifications is desirable.  • Excellent interpersonal skills and leadership skills. • Stay informed on emerging threats, attack techniques and industry trends.   
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.
  
 
  
When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

  **XVigil**

title: Senior Cyber Security Partner
description:
**About the role**
We are the trusted security advisors for Tesco Technology. Our purpose is to collaborate seamlessly with the product and engineering teams, leveraging our deep expertise in cyber security to design and implement robust, resilient solutions that protect our business and customers from cyber threats.  We are a dynamic and expanding global team of 15+ experts, serving as the strategic link between the wider security group and software engineering teams that develop cutting-edge services at scale to support the retail business.  Tesco Technology comprises of several technology domains with over 100+ teams, each entrusted with their own security. These teams enjoy significant autonomy, balanced by the responsibility to make customer-centric decisions and security. Rather than imposing controls through rigid processes and security gates, we empower these engineering teams to innovate by providing security guidance that helps them make informed decisions for Tesco. Encouragingly, these teams are enthusiastic partners in enhancing security, working more efficiently, and integrating security into every aspect of their ways of working. This collaborative approach sets us apart from traditional security teams. We proudly identify ourselves as Security Partners, not security police, emphasizing our role as the “trusted advisors” rather than enforcers.  Partners engage key people in engineering to make security contextual and frictionless. After all, security is a journey and there is no one-size-fits-all. Join the team and be part of this exciting journey!  
  
  
**You will be responsible for**
As a Senior Security Partner, you will transform the security maturity of key product areas and teams. You will be the face of security group for them. Everything you do is in the context of the product, roadmap, its risk acceptance level, the technology stack, and its architecture.  You build a comprehensive understanding of the threat landscape and its potential risks to the business. Through effective partnership, you engage the leadership to make wellinformed decisions about security and privacy.  Being the trusted advisor As enterprise applications become more distributed, adaptive to technological advancements, and run from hybrid infrastructure, teams need to navigate through different complexities and make key security decisions along the way. A trusted security advisor empowers teams to achieve scalable and sustainable security maturity throughout the SDLC (software development lifecycle) process.   In this job, I am accountable for: Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities: • Provide product and engineering teams with direction and guidance on all security matters. There is a whole security group to back you up, so it is not as scary as it sounds.  • Influence security outcomes through collaboration, expertise and constructive challenge.  • Define and review security requirements for critical business programmes, new products, services and technology initiatives. • Engage engineering leadership on security roadmap and oversee security posture, while balancing security requirements with business objectives.  • Co-own the security roadmap, discuss, prioritise, and co-develop plans for remediation for the product areas, while building trusted relationships • Enabling security champions to succeed and creating a strong feedback loop for improvements.  • Represent security in all product and architecture meet-ups. Be part of critical decisions about security.  • Oversee product security activities, from the early development of security requirements, architecture reviews, and threat modelling, to strengthening application security, mitigating supply-chain risks, securing secrets, pipelines, reviewing vulnerabilities, and infrastructure security.  • Perform security architecture reviews of third-party services.  • Identify acceptable risk levels and assist with action plan, policy, and procedural changes for risk mitigation. Prioritise security investment based on risk.  • Adopt a contextual risk-based approach and guide management in identifying business risks and potential impact to Tesco. Continuously seek both tactical and strategic solutions to enhance security.  • As the trusted security expert & advisor for the product area, engage across the security group to strengthen controls across identification, protection, detection, response, and recovery.  • Oversee assurance activities like security testing, purple testing, assurance, auditing.  • Reduce security fatigue for engineering and provide faster feedback within existing developer workflows, not adding another tool for them to check.  • Empower the teams you work with, but also challenge the status-quo.  • Advise on secure adoption of AI, GenAI and agentic technologies.  • Assess security risks associated with AI-powered products and services.  • As a senior member of the team, engage across the security group on new ideas and initiatives. • Contribute to strengthen organisation standards and policies, develop cookbooks, secure patterns, take part in security research and tool evaluations.  • You are committed to continuous improvement, seizing opportunities, and inspire change for the team.  • Mentor others in the team and take part in enhancing their skills and career development.  
  
  
**You will need**
To excel in this position, we expect you to have the following: • Experience in having lead security assessments of large, complex, critical business programmes involving technical implementation and integrations. • Possess experience across multiple sectors and have undertaken diverse roles in engineering and security. Demonstratable accomplishments of collaborating with leadership and management on security programmes and initiatives. • Good knowledge of various security domains, and solid experience in architecture practices and design patterns – the technology might have changed but most of the security challenges have not.  • Experience in designing security and privacy controls with sound understanding of standards and regulation. • Experience in threat modelling, attack trees, vulnerability chaining, applying MITRE ATT&CK framework.  • Good understanding of web applications, REST APIs, micro services, eventing, modern application frameworks, and mobile apps.  • Good understanding of software architecture, network topologies, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS (infrastructure as a service).  • Proficient in applying industry standards such as OWASP ASVS (Application Security Verification Standard), OWASP Top 10, CIS (Centre of Internet Security) controls and benchmarks.  • Experience with cloud native and hybrid architectures with an emphasis on containerised workloads and Kubernetes.  • Some development experience is always a plus - Java, cloud, Golang, python. You do not need to “be a developer” but we need you to understand the implications of security on engineering velocity.  • Experience in designing, deploying and operationalizing GenAI and Agentic AI solutions aimed at increasing efficiency and enhancing productivity • Experience in driving measurable risk reduction and security maturity improvements.  • Degree in computer science / information systems or engineering field, or equivalent experience. • Experience with regulations like GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), PCI-DSS is desirable.  • Azure or AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud security certifications is desirable.  • Excellent interpersonal skills and leadership skills. • Stay informed on emerging threats, attack techniques and industry trends.   
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging.  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. * Multi Cloud Expertise: Possess in depth knowledge of leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.) and their security best practices.

* Identity and Access Management (IAM): Enforce and maintain granular IAM policies across all cloud environments to ensure least privilege access.

**Vulnerability Detection and Threat Response**

* Perform continuous asset discovery to identify and track all cloud resources, including servers, databases, storage, network devices, etc.
* Conduct regular, continuous, and adhoc vulnerability scanning to identify and prioritize security vulnerabilities and potential threats.
* Monitor for emerging threats and zero day vulnerabilities utilizing threat detection and response program.
* Identify and remediate misconfigurations that can lead to security breaches.

* Collaborate and lead remediation teams on plans for identified vulnerabilities, leveraging the security cloud vulnerability’s automation capabilities where applicable.
* Prioritization of security patch management to ensure timely patching of security vulnerabilities in cloud infrastructure and applications based on vendor recommendation.
* Generate regular reports on vulnerabilities, trends, remediation progress, and security cloud posture.

* Standardization: Enforce established security policies and procedures across all cloud environments.
* Compliance Management: Maintain compliance with industry regulations (e.g., GDPR, NYDFS, Privacy, etc.) and internal security policies.

**Security Cloud System’s Vulnerability Tool**

* Advance the tool’s configuration: Assessment of configurations policies, rules, and alerts to maximize its effectiveness in identifying and mitigating cloud vulnerabilities and security risks.
* Analyze data generated by the tool to identify trends, patterns, and potential security issues.
* Maintain and support custom automation workflows within the tool streamline remediations processes and improve efficiency.
* Integrate the tool with broader security tools (SIEM, CMDB, SOAR, SOC, etc.) to create a comprehensive security informed program
* Actively monitor the tool’s alerts and notifications, prioritizing critical security vulnerabilities and issues.
* Alert triage and prioritization to accurately assess the severity and potential impact of alerts, assigning appropriate priority levels.
* Ensure remediation management to create and manage remediation tasks to timely resolve identified vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
* Maintain SLA adherence to monitor and resolve alert response and remediation times.
* Conduct thorough root cause analysis through investigations to determine the root cause of vulnerability remediation failures and implement alternative solutions.
* Generate regular reporting and metrics on vulnerabilities and threats for alert trending and remediation effectiveness.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Security Cloud Tools: Assist with the evaluation and selection of vulnerability management tools that integrate seamlessly with various cloud environments and provide fine granular access controls and CMDB attributers such as asset ownership.
* Integration: Integrate the security cloud tools with other security tools and systems, including the SIEM solutions, change ticketing systems, etc
* Launch awareness campaigns to promote secure practices and vulnerability management, emphasizing the unique challenges of cloud environments.
* Collaborate with development, business CISOs, operations, and cloud teams to ensure effective vulnerability management practices throughout the SDLC, cloud, and production environments.

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be joining the Digital Risk Consulting Team.

We’re looking for Senior Consultant with expertise in Cloud Security and Risk Assessment’ to lead the audit/review of security architecture and controls across hybrid cloud environments. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.

* Evaluate key cloud security solutions such as Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP), Identity and Access Management (IAM), Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Cloud encryption and key management services, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), and security automation tools with respect to hybrid cloud security posture (AWS, Azure, GCP, and on-premises).

* Evaluate DevSecOps implementation to embed security into CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployments.
* Evaluate the current practice followed of cloud security monitoring and incident management
* Conducting risk assessments and vulnerability analyses in cloud environments and propose mitigation strategies
* Support larger Internal Audit and Cyber security audits engagements especially on domains related to cloud security
* Develop cloud security policies/procedures to protect data in the cloud and prevent unauthorized access.
* Good understanding of cloud security standards/regulations globally and within the MENA region (KSA, UAE, Qatar)
* Communicate cloud security risks, strategies, and remediation plans clearly to technical teams and senior management
* Ability to translate complex technical details into clear, business-understandable language for effective communication with stakeholders/business users

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong technical knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and on-premises security architectures and controls.
* Proven ability to evaluate cloud security technologies, policies and processes.
* Experience conducting cloud risk assessments against global/MENA specific standards/regulations
* Experience managing cloud security metrics, reporting, and audit readiness.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in incident management and response in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps and secure CI/CD practices in Cloud

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5–8 years of experience in cloud security, with hands-on expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, CSA CCM, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading client workshops, assessments, cloud security strategy engagements, and preparing executive-level reports and recommendations.
* Open to travel to MENA (up to 50% of the time)
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in B. TECH/B. E, MS in computer science, MBA (IT or Systems) or a related discipline.
* Certifications such as CCSP, CCSK, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, or CISM preferred.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer)

description:

**Job Description: Senior Web Application Firewall (WAF) Engineer**
**Experience Level: 3–5 Years**
**Role Type: Full-Time**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Web Application Firewall (WAF) Engineer to own and drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our application security gateway infrastructure. Spanning the complete service delivery model—Assess, Build, Transition, and Operations—this role requires deep technical proficiency in protecting modern web applications, APIs, and microservices against sophisticated Layer 7 attacks (including OWASP Top 10, botnets, and DDoS). The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience tuning advanced WAF rule sets, managing positive and negative security models, and collaborating closely with application development and DevOps teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Assess (Architecture Review & Threat Modeling)**

* Analyze current WAF policies, anomaly scores, and signature rulesets to identify coverage gaps against the OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10.
* Collaborate with development and architecture teams to threat-model upcoming applications and define WAF integration requirements.
* Audit SSL/TLS termination configurations, cipher suites, and certificate lifecycles at the edge.

**Build (Deployment & Policy Engineering)**

* Deploy, configure, and manage enterprise WAF solutions (e.g., Cloudflare Enterprise, Akamai Kona, Imperva, F5 Advanced WAF/BIG-IP ASM, or AWS WAF).
* Design and implement both negative security models (signatures, regex blocks) and positive security models (strict schema validation, OpenAPI/Swagger enforcement).
* Configure advanced bot mitigation, rate limiting, geo-fencing, and API security inspection layers.
* Integrate WAF infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines (Infrastructure as Code) for automated policy deployment and version control.

**Transition (Testing, Cutover & Handover)**

* Transition WAF policies from monitoring/audit mode to blocking mode safely, minimizing false positives and disruption to legitimate user traffic.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and application functional sign-offs prior to production traffic routing.
* Produce comprehensive "As-Built" documentation, tuning guidelines, escalation playbooks, and topology diagrams.
* Conduct training and knowledge transfer sessions for operations and application support teams.

**Operations & Continuous Management**

* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex Layer 7 security incidents, DDoS attacks, and web traffic anomalies.
* Perform continuous rule tuning, signature optimization, and exception handling based on application updates and vulnerability scan results.
* Monitor WAF performance, backend latency, error rates, and evasion technique indicators.
* Ensure seamless log ingestion and telemetry forwarding to the SIEM/SOAR platforms for deep forensic investigation and continuous compliance reporting.
* Understanding of ITIL-based Change Management, managing end-to-end change lifecycle activities, CAB coordination, and compliant implementation of infrastructure and application changes

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 3–5 years of specialized experience in web application security, WAF administration, or application delivery controller (ADC) management.
* Core Technologies: Deep, hands-on expertise with leading cloud or on-premise WAF platforms (e.g., Cloudflare, Akamai, Imperva, F5 Advanced WAF, or AWS/Azure WAF).
* Security Principles: Comprehensive understanding of the OWASP Top 10, API Top 10, SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Remote Code Execution (RCE), and XML/JSON attacks.
* Networking & Protocols: Solid grasp of HTTP/HTTPS protocols, RESTful APIs, JSON/XML payloads, DNS, SSL/TLS handshakes, and reverse proxy architectures.
* Automation & Scripting: Familiarity with automation tools, Python or Bash scripting, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) for policy management.
* Certifications: Industry certifications (e.g., Certified AppSec Practitioner (CAP), CISSP, CCSP, or vendor-specific WAF/Cloud security credentials) are highly preferred.
* Soft Skills: Excellent stakeholder management skills, ability to bridge security requirements with developer workflows, and strong analytical problem-solving abilities.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Network Engineer, Technical Regulatory
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
  
  
Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
  
  
At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
  
  
When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
  
  
**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**Summary Of How You Will Impact Skylo**
Skylo is hiring a
**Principal Network Engineer, Technical Regulatory**
to help fulfill Skylo’s mission of making satellite connectivity available to all. As part of the Network Design & Planning team, this individual will own the technical side of Skylo’s regulatory obligations, leading the design, implementation, and certification of Lawful Intercept and Wireless Emergency Alerts / cell broadcast capabilities across Skylo’s satellite NTN network. You will be Skylo’s technical voice with regulators and carrier partners, ensuring our network meets its compliance obligations in every market we serve while maturing these services for scale.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Own the technical architecture and roadmap for Lawful Intercept (LI) across Skylo’s 5G core, EPC, IMS, and messaging platforms, in line with ETSI and 3GPP LI standards (e.g. 3GPP TS 33.126/33.127/33.128, ETSI TS 103 221, ETSI TS 102 232).
* Lead Lawful Intercept compliance across Skylo’s markets, including DoT licence and LI requirements in India, CALEA in the US, and ETSI-based regimes in Europe and other regions, covering capability design, compliance documentation, and technical coordination with law enforcement agencies and trusted third parties.
* Design and deliver public warning and cell broadcast capabilities (CBC/CBE, CBS/PWS, 3GPP TS 23.041), including Wireless Emergency Alerts (WEA) in the US and equivalent national alerting systems in India and other markets, for satellite-connected devices, including NTN-specific geo-targeting and delivery considerations.
* Define and track technical regulatory requirements for satellite/NTN networks across markets, including emergency calling and messaging (911/E911, 112), location, and network security obligations.
* Work directly with regulators (e.g. DoT and TRAI in India, FCC and FEMA/IPAWS in the US, and other national regulators) and MNO partners to interpret requirements, support filings and audits, and represent Skylo’s technical position.
* Partner with core network vendors, Carriers, and LI mediation vendors to specify, integrate, test, and certify LI and WEA functions.
* Drive service maturity for regulatory capabilities, including operational processes, monitoring, test cadences, runbooks, and audit readiness.
* Collaborate with Legal, Security, Product, and Operations teams to translate regulatory obligations into engineering requirements and delivery plans.
* Track and contribute to standards and industry bodies (e.g. 3GPP SA3-LI, ETSI TC LI, TSDSI/TEC, ATIS, CTIA) relevant to Lawful Intercept, emergency alerts, and NTN.
* Create technical specifications, compliance documentation, and engineering plans, and conduct proof-of-solutions to validate technical approaches.

**What We Look For**

* 15+ years of experience in mobile network engineering, with a significant focus on Lawful Intercept, emergency services, or technical regulatory compliance at a mobile network operator, network vendor, or LI solution provider.
* Deep knowledge of ETSI and 3GPP Lawful Intercept standards, including handover interfaces (HI1/HI2/HI3), internal interfaces (X1/X2/X3), and LI for 5GC, EPC, and IMS.
* Hands-on experience with national LI compliance regimes, such as India’s DoT LI requirements and/or CALEA (including J-STD-025), and working with law enforcement agencies and trusted third parties.
* Hands-on experience with public warning systems and cell broadcast (CBC, CBS/PWS), and familiarity with national alerting requirements such as India’s public alerting framework and US WEA (FCC Part 10).
* Strong understanding of 4G/5G core and IMS architectures and end-to-end call flows for voice, SMS, and data.
* Experience engaging directly with regulators, government agencies, and carrier partners on technical compliance matters.
* Knowledge of emergency services requirements (911/E911, NG911, 112) and location delivery is a strong plus.
* Experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) or satellite communications regulation is highly preferred.
* Ability to pass background checks associated with Lawful Intercept responsibilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics to legal, regulatory, and executive audiences.
* A track record of driving cross-functional compliance initiatives to completion with a high degree of ownership and discretion.

**What We Offer**
With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive occupational health coverage
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
* Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends multi-national characteristics

**EEO Statement**
Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

--------------

* Solid hands-on experience with relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL.

* Knowledge of RESTful web services and API development.
* Knowledge of markup and data serialization formats such as JSON and XML.
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and Agile/JIRA workflows.
* Understanding of software development principles and methodologies.
* Ability to work in a team environment and collaborate effectively with other developers and stakeholders.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Experience with C# .NET Core back-end development.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases (MongoDB) and caching systems (Redis).
* Familiarity with orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
* Understanding of message queues and event streaming tools (MQTT, Kafka, or RabbitMQ).
Exposure to enterprise file transfer/integration tools like Globalscape.
Familiarity with WPF or AngularJS.  

Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer or GCP Associate).

We believe that the best solutions are developed by teams who embrace each other's unique experiences, skills, and abilities. We're serious about our commitment to a workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute to our industry-leading products and customer support, which is why we prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

title: Principal Architect
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

**What will you contribute?**

  

We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Architect who will serve as a recognized enterprise technical authority for Artificial Intelligence architecture. You will set the strategic technical direction for AI capabilities across products, platforms, and business segments, including generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, AI platforms, model integration, evaluation, governance, security, and responsible AI.

Your secondary focus will be cloud and SaaS architecture. You will ensure that enterprise AI strategy is realized through secure, scalable, resilient, multi-tenant, observable, and cost-effective cloud services, while influencing investment priorities, platform evolution, and cross-product adoption

  

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**  
  
Your deliverables as a **[Role Name]** will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  

* Set the enterprise AI architecture vision, principles, standards, reference patterns, capability roadmaps, and technology strategy across multiple products, platforms, and business segments.

* Provide authoritative architectural direction for generative AI, RAG, agentic AI, model integration, orchestration, prompt and context engineering, and AI evaluation.

* Sponsor and lead strategic AI research, technology evaluations, and Proofs of Concept, translating validated outcomes into reusable, production-grade capabilities with measurable business value.

* Establish enterprise guardrails for responsible AI, security, privacy, model risk, data governance, observability, auditability, and human oversight in regulated environments.

* Shape cloud-native and SaaS architecture strategy for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, scalability, resilience, availability, metering, subscription models, and cost management.

* Create and drive adoption of reference architectures, reference implementations, patterns, libraries, accelerators, and engineering guidance across product and platform teams.

* Govern and review strategic architecture and design proposals for alignment with AI strategy, cloud and SaaS principles, enterprise standards, security, regulatory obligations, and long-term sustainability.

* Influence executive and senior technical decisions across architecture, engineering, product, data, security, cloud platforms, governance, and business leadership.

* Develop senior architects and principal engineers, and lead enterprise architecture forums, technical councils, workshops, demonstrations, hackathons, and global knowledge-sharing communities.

  
  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

AI Architecture & Strategy

Enterprise-wide AI target architecture, principles, standards, investment roadmaps, technology portfolio decisions, and adoption strategy across products and business segments.

Generative AI & LLM Systems

Strategic direction for LLM integration, prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, model routing, grounding, safety, and production controls at enterprise scale.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation

Enterprise standards for search, embeddings, vector retrieval, chunking, ranking, grounding, citations, authorization-aware access, and measurable retrieval quality.

Agentic AI

Enterprise patterns and governance for agent orchestration, tool use, workflow design, memory, planning, permissions, human approval, monitoring, and failure containment.

AI Platforms & Integration

Shared model gateways, AI services, APIs, event-driven integration, data pipelines, reusable platform capabilities, and consistent embedding of AI across products.

AI Evaluation & Observability

Enterprise evaluation strategy spanning quality, relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, cost, drift, telemetry, red-teaming, and continuous assurance.

Responsible AI & Governance

Organization-wide security, privacy, regulatory alignment, model risk, data governance, explainability, auditability, accountability, and human oversight.

  

**Primary Skills: Artificial Intelligence**
===========================================

  

**Secondary Skills: Cloud & SaaS**
==================================

* Cloud-native architecture using Microsoft Azure or comparable hyperscale platforms, including containers, Kubernetes, serverless, managed services, infrastructure automation, and platform engineering.

* SaaS architecture covering multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, identity, configuration, extensibility, metering, subscription management, data residency, and zero-downtime evolution.

* Distributed systems, APIs, event-driven integration, data platforms, observability, reliability, performance, disaster recovery, operational readiness, and cross-product interoperability.

* FinOps, capacity planning, AI and cloud cost optimization, security architecture, compliance, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and platform operating models.

  

**AI architecture is the primary discipline for this role. Cloud and SaaS architecture are essential secondary capabilities for operationalizing AI securely, reliably, and at enterprise scale** .

  

**Required Experience:**

* **12 years of progressive experience in a corporate IT environment or a IT consulting company with at least 3 years in a senior role**
* **10+ years of experience in building, integrating and delivering large enterprise scale solutions using web based technologies**
* **10+ years of experience designing applications**

title: Engineer
description:
Job Description: We are seeking a passionate, skilled ASIC/FPGA Engineer with specialisations in wireless communications to join our Wireless FPGA team at Tejas Networks and help develop the next generation of RAN hardware. As an Engineer, you will own the FPGA design, Top-level integration of various IP’s, design verification and pre-validation, and provide technical support across RAN software, hardware interfaces, and platform components.

  

* Responsibilities: • Design, integrate, verify, and validate the specific IPs for Radio Access Networks (RAN) – 4G, 5G and 6G.
* Develop and implement testing procedures to ensure quality control and reliability of FPGA-based solutions.
* Work closely with hardware engineers to bring up peripherals and support custom hardware features.
* Analyse and troubleshoot issues across hardware, firmware, and software layers to ensure system stability and tune the system for performance.
* Stay current with wireless communication technologies, standards, and best practices, and apply them to product development.

Mandatory Skills

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electronics and communication engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in ASIC/FPGA design and development.
* Firsthand experience in AMD SoC (MPSoC/RFSoC) and Altera FPGA families.
* Hands-on experience in building an AI-driven RTL design and verification environment and C++ based/Python based validation setup.
* Expertise in FPGA clocking schemes, timing constraints development and timing closure
* Debug and troubleshoot FPGA designs.
* Experience with high-speed protocols such as 25G Ethernet and PCIe
* Experience with peripherals: I2S, SPI, I2C, eMMC and PMBUS
* Good at documentation and writing technical articles

Desired Skills

* Master's degree or PhD in Electrical/Communication Engineering
* Experience with FPGA IP integration and memory system architecture.
* Knowledge of high-performance and low-power design techniques.
* Experience in RF communication systems, Software-defined radio, and related technologies
* Experience in antenna array steering, MIMO systems

  

Qualifications: Education: BE/B.Tech in ECE, ETE, EEE or related fields

Experience: 0-3 years of experience in telecommunication industry.

  

About Us: Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.

**Diversity and Inclusion Statement:**

* Tejas Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating all inclusive environment for all employees.
* We welcome applicants of all backgrounds regardless of race color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or veteran status.
* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

  

About the Team: Tejas Networks provides scalable and innovative 4G/5G solutions. Our portfolio encompasses Radio Access Network solutions including Remote Radio Heads (RRHs) or Radio Units (RUs), Massive MIMO Radios (Advanced Antenna Systems, AAS) and Base Band Units (BBUs), Distributed Units (DUs) and Centralized Units (CUs), Mobile Packet Core and an Advanced Network management solution.

Tejas Networks has invested in Wireless product development since 2012 with a vision to create globally deployable telecom solutions. Several of the key components developed by the Wireless R&D team have been installed and commissioned across multiple continents. We are an active partner for 4G and 5G in the Indian Ecosystem and have significantly contributed to India’s standardization efforts in 3GPP and TSDSI.

The wireless team has over 100 patents. As part of the Wireless team, you will work on developing products for next generation wireless systems.

Tejas solutions are unique with inhouse Radio designs developed by seasoned experts in ASIC chip design involving 4G LTE Radio and 5G NR Radios.

Tejas offers best Network Management solution for the entire portfolio of 4G and 5G device ecosystem management.

Tejas Wireless offering include an advanced Mobile Packet Core, solution is critical for ensuring seamless, high-performance connectivity.

title: Engineer I
description:
**Overview**
------------

The role is for a design engineer for UK / Any geography Rail sector within the Telecoms and Information Systems team.

The candidate shall be responsible for the production and co-ordination of Communication Systems designs. The candidate must be aware of UK Rail process and worked on Network Rail and London Underground rail projects.

**Your role**
-------------

The candidate is required to have a proven working knowledge of the activities necessary to produce fully assured designs for the following systems:

* Public Address / Voice Alarm systems,
* Closed Circuit Television systems,
* Access Control systems,
* Passenger Help Point systems,
* Emergency Telephone systems
* Station Management Systems
* TCP / IP Networks,
* Clock and Master Clock Systems
* Public Wifi
* Wifi simulation and planning - Appreciated

The candidate is also expected to have an appreciation of the interfaces (physical and other) with other railway system disciplines.

The candidate's responsibilities will comprise of the production of the communications elements of both discipline-integrated and stand-alone station designs. This will involve;

* Co-ordination with other disciplines (internal and external) in the placement and integration of communication equipment within the overall design.
* Production of design deliverables including specifications, reports, schedules, drawings, and technical schematics.
* Producing designs in CAD using AutoCAD, MicroStation – 2D and 3D, AECOSIM, Revit
* Management of 3rd party design resource utilised in producing elements of the design (e.g., acoustic consultants, Lifts, Escalators etc).
* Management of 3rd party equipment manufactures and suppliers to ensure proposed equipment is suitable for the individual project requirements.
* Verification of the design against customer requirements and standards.
* Attendance at internal and external co-ordination, progress, and design review meetings.
* Undertake design reviews of other concurrent Communication Systems designs.

**About you**
-------------

* Ability to complete work on time and on budget within the parameters of the project scope of works.
* A minimum of 5 to 9 years' experience in a similar role.
* Knowledge of fundamental engineering and communication systems standards and best practice.
* Knowledge and experience of the requirements for designing safety critical and safety related systems.
* High proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit and Open building design is essential.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. title: Customer Support Solutions Lead Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Join the Grid Automation Customer Support Center of Excellence (CoE) and play a key role in shaping the future of customer support and technical solutions across our global Grid Automation business.
  
  
As a Customer Support Solutions Lead Engineer, you will act as a global technical expert supporting regional teams in the design, promotion, delivery, and lifecycle management of advanced Grid Automation solutions across Transmission, Distribution, Generation, and Industry applications.
  
  
You will be at the intersection of technology, customers, engineering, product management, and operations, helping regional teams solve complex technical challenges while developing innovative and differentiated solutions that deliver measurable value to our customers.
  
  
The role combines hands-on technical expertise, solution architecture, customer engagement, technical leadership, and knowledge sharing. You will work closely with regional engineering teams, Global Supply Chain, Quality, Product Management, R&D, Sales, Tendering, and Operations to resolve critical customer issues and continuously improve our customer support offering.
  
  
This is an opportunity to become a global technical reference for Grid Automation solutions, influence engineering standards and best practices, and contribute to the development of the next generation of digital and automated power networks.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Complex Grid Automation Solutions**
Support GA regional teams in the development and execution of innovative and technically challenging customer projects.
  
  

* Design and review solutions for substation control, protection, monitoring, and automation.
* Assess customer requirements and determine the suitability of standard GA solutions, identifying where customization or specific development may be required.
* Develop innovative technical solutions that balance performance, flexibility, reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, and total cost of ownership.
* Define system engineering strategies covering:

+ System and network architecture
+ Interfaces with primary equipment
+ IED and SCADA communications
+ Physical and logical communication networks
+ Network redundancy and system availability
+ Protection and control functions
+ Data modeling and engineering databases
+ Maintenance and lifecycle management

**Essential**
Qualifications & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or a related field.
* Strong experience leading the technical execution of complex Grid Automation, Substation Automation, Protection & Control, or Power System projects.
* Solid knowledge of power system and substation control and protection applications across Transmission, Distribution, Generation, and/or Industry.
* Strong experience in:

+ Protection and control system design
+ System architecture
+ Engineering and validation
+ Commissioning and troubleshooting
+ Customer technical support
+ Communication networks and protocols

* Good knowledge of industrial and power-system communication technologies, including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-103, Modbus, DNP3, TCP/IP, and Ethernet.DS Agile digital control system
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify, explain, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Customer-oriented mindset with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects and priorities under demanding timelines.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound technical judgment, and collaborate effectively with international stakeholders.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity, functional safety, FMEA/HAZOP, reliability, and quality metrics such as MTBF.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 25% of the time.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in digital substations and IEC 61850 engineering.
* Experience with Grid Automation or substation automation platforms such as DS Agile and associated products.
* Demonstrated experience in technical mentoring, coaching, and knowledge transfer.
* Proven ability to influence and inspire technical teams without direct hierarchical responsibility.
* Strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on technical execution.
* Experience with Lean / Six Sigma methodologies.
* Experience working in a global, multicultural engineering organization.

**The Profile We Are Looking For**
We are looking for a
**technically strong and customer-oriented engineering leader**
who enjoys solving complex problems, working across organizational boundaries, and sharing knowledge with others.
  
  
You are comfortable moving from
**high-level system architecture to detailed technical troubleshooting**
, from customer discussions to engineering design reviews, and from solving an individual project issue to turning the experience into a global best practice.
  
  
If you are passionate about
**Grid Automation, digital substations, power systems, and technical innovation**
, and want to have a global impact beyond individual projects, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant contribution to the future of our business and our customers.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

description:

This role will provide technical expertise for work associated with the HVDC reference solutions across the full solution lifecycle, with primary focus on working with the Solution Owner – Technical Lead on solution architecture, deployment support, regional enablement, technical governance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The successful candidate will own technical activities for elements of the HVDC reference solutions, enabling consistent, scalable, and high-quality execution across regions. This Engineer will also work with colleagues in the SL and Regions to progress and conclude these technical activities in a coordinated and collaborative manner to always ensure the best overall outcome for the business.

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As part of the Global engineering Team, this position will be responsible for engineering and consulting services and solutions to Global team across protection, control, and automation applications, with special focus on power industry applications such as microgrid control systems, remedial action schemes, renewable integration, substation automation, and digital substations. The successful candidate should have proven project experience and an electrical an engineering background.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Design and delivery of complex protection solutions for generation, transmission, distribution systems for electrical utilities and industrial clients.
* Participate in the design and development of microgrid solutions including power flow optimization and dispatching algorithms.

title: Senior Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer (ESP32 / Raspberry Pi)
description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (On-site)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer (Technical Lead) to own the end-to-end development and integration of our IoT ecosystem, spanning ESP32-based embedded systems, Raspberry Pi controllers, connected devices, and cloud infrastructure. The role involves firmware development, hardware debugging, device provisioning, secure OTA updates, system integration, and deployment of reliable connected products.

You will lead the IoT engineering team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering, working closely with hardware manufacturers and internal cloud, application, and product teams. From defining the IoT architecture and developing firmware to troubleshooting PCBs, integrating electronics, and managing device fleets in production, you will take ownership of the complete IoT engineering lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities1. IoT Architecture & Technical Leadership

* Own the end-to-end IoT architecture, including cloud services, Control Core, Raspberry Pi-based local master, microcontrollers, connected devices, and peripherals.
* Define the architecture and communication mechanisms between cloud systems, local controllers, ESP32 boards, and connected devices.
* Lead and mentor the IoT engineering team, including firmware, device integration, and test engineers.
* Set technical priorities, review firmware and integration code, and ensure timely delivery of engineering milestones.
* Work closely with cloud, mobile application, and product teams to define device APIs, integration standards, and system interfaces.
* Drive technical decisions around reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of the IoT ecosystem.

2. Embedded Firmware Development

* Develop, modify, maintain, and optimize embedded firmware using C/C++ for ESP32, ESP32-S3, and other microcontroller platforms.
* Work with ESP-IDF, Arduino, or PlatformIO for firmware development and debugging.
* Implement GPIO control, PWM, UART, I2C, SPI, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Ethernet connectivity (W5500).
* Develop firmware for controlling smart locks, LED lighting, fans, motors, relays, load switches, sensors, displays, and other peripherals.
* Implement watchdogs, brown-out detection, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms to ensure reliable device operation.
* Manage firmware flashing, configuration, versioning, releases, and testing records.
* Debug firmware issues independently and coordinate with the engineering team to resolve complex hardware-software integration problems.

3. Raspberry Pi & Linux System Integration

* Set up, configure, and maintain Raspberry Pi 5-based controllers running Linux.
* Develop and maintain local master services and device integration scripts using Python and/or Node.js.
* Integrate GPIO, HAT peripherals, motor drivers, displays, cameras, audio/video equipment, and other connected hardware.
* Establish reliable communication between Raspberry Pi controllers, ESP32 boards, and connected peripherals.
* Implement local control, device coordination, offline operation, and recovery mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot Linux, hardware drivers, peripheral connectivity, and system-level integration issues.

4. Hardware Testing & Electronics Troubleshooting

* Inspect, validate, and functionally test PCBs received from contract manufacturers and hardware vendors.
* Identify manufacturing defects, component failures, power supply issues, GPIO faults, communication problems, and wiring defects.
* Read and interpret circuit diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and component datasheets.
* Troubleshoot electronics at board and component level using multimeters, bench power supplies, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Validate communication interfaces, sensors, actuators, connectors, and power systems.
* Coordinate with hardware manufacturers to resolve PCB design and production issues.
* Define repeatable board-level testing procedures, acceptance criteria, and quality-control processes.

5. Device Provisioning, Security & OTA Updates

* Develop and maintain factory flashing and device provisioning workflows.
* Implement device identity, authentication, registration, and pod-binding mechanisms using claim codes, tokens, and device credentials.
* Manage firmware signing keys and secure device provisioning.
* Implement secure OTA firmware updates, including firmware validation, version management, and rollback mechanisms.
* Work with security mechanisms such as TLS, device certificates, secure boot, and signed firmware.
* Ensure secure communication between devices, local controllers, and cloud services.

6. IoT Cloud Connectivity & Fleet Management

* Implement device-to-cloud communication using MQTT, HTTP/REST APIs, WebSockets, and other relevant IoT protocols.
* Integrate embedded devices with cloud services and backend APIs.
* Develop and maintain telemetry, device heartbeats, status reporting, and remote diagnostics.
* Implement fleet monitoring, alerting, logging, and device health management for deployments across multiple locations.
* Design mechanisms for handling network failures, offline operation, reconnection, and synchronization.
* Collaborate with cloud and application teams on device APIs and the Nova SDK, including door unlock, administrator device control, and kiosk status integrations.

7. Product Assembly & System Integration

* Assemble and integrate PCBs, sensors, displays, motors, cables, connectors, power supplies, and electronic components into the final physical product.
* Perform wiring, cable harness assembly, connector termination, soldering, and cable management.
* Integrate smart locks, LED lighting, fans, camera shutters, screens, and other electronic subsystems.
* Validate communication and coordination across the complete electronic system.
* Perform end-to-end product testing and troubleshoot issues across firmware, hardware, power, wiring, and software integration.
* Ensure every assembled product meets functional, reliability, and quality requirements before deployment.

8. Manufacturing, Testing & Documentation

* Work closely with contract manufacturers and board vendors on hardware bring-up, production testing, and quality assurance.
* Define test plans, acceptance criteria, and repeatable end-of-line testing procedures for every board and complete product unit.
* Coordinate factory flashing, firmware upgrades, hardware validation, and production releases.
* Maintain firmware release records, hardware revisions, test reports, and manufacturing documentation.
* Prepare technical architecture diagrams, wiring diagrams, troubleshooting guides, operational runbooks, and engineering handover documents.
* Support product deployment, field troubleshooting, and continuous improvement based on operational feedback.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5+ years of experience in embedded systems, IoT product development, electronics engineering, or connected hardware products.
* At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers in a technical capacity.
* Strong hands-on experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for ESP32, ESP32-S3, or similar microcontrollers.
* Good understanding of ESP-IDF, Arduino framework, or PlatformIO.
* Strong understanding of GPIO, UART, I2C, SPI, PWM, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Ethernet.
* Practical experience with Raspberry Pi and Linux-based embedded systems.
* Working knowledge of Python and/or Node.js for device services, scripting, and hardware integration.
* Experience with IoT communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/REST, WebSockets, and TLS.
* Hands-on experience with OTA updates, device provisioning, firmware version management, and device authentication.
* Strong understanding of electronics, circuit diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and component-level troubleshooting.
* Practical experience using multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and bench power supplies.
* Hands-on experience with soldering, wiring, connectors, cable harnesses, and electronic product assembly.
* Experience integrating microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, displays, motors, and other peripherals into complete products.
* Experience working with hardware manufacturers, contract manufacturers, or PCB vendors.
* Strong debugging, problem-solving, technical ownership, and team coordination skills.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams in India and the USA.
* Familiarity with Git and firmware development workflows.

Good to Have

* Experience with STM32, Nordic nRF, RP2040, or other embedded microcontroller platforms.
* Experience with ESP32-S3, W5500 Ethernet modules, and custom PCB development.
* Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, hardware security keys, and device certificates.
* Experience managing large-scale IoT device fleets across multiple locations.
* Experience with smart locks, access-control systems, kiosks, or commercial AV equipment.
* Familiarity with HDMI switching, cameras, audio systems, and display integration.
* Experience with Android Device Owner, Android kiosk mode, or dedicated-device management.
* Experience with motor drivers, relays, power electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems.
* Experience taking connected hardware products from prototype to manufacturing and field deployment.
* Experience building consumer electronics, smart devices, appliances, or other physical IoT products.

Our vision is to turn Microsoft Cloud customers into fans.
  
  
We are customer obsessed problem-solvers. We orchestrate deep engagements in areas like incident management, support and enablement. We analyze and amplify those customer voices, both within our own team, and across the Cloud + AI team, bringing the customer connection to the Quality vision for Azure. We innovate ways to scale what we learn across our customer base. Diversity and inclusion are central to who we are, how we work, and what we enable our customers to achieve. We know that empowering our customers starts with empowering our team to show up authentically, work in ways that are best for them, and achieve their career goals.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing teams within Microsoft Azure Engineering? Are you constantly customer-obsessed, and focused on enhancing customer experience? Are you passionate about cloud computing and love the challenge of solving the most complex technical problems?
  
  
Come join us and surround yourself with people who are passionate about cloud computing and believe that extraordinary support is critical to customer success.

You will also act as the voice of the customer within Azure to escalate problems and to drive prioritization of platform/support improvement needs for customers.
  
  
In this role, you will work together with field teams (Customer Success Account Managers, Cloud Solution Architects, Support Escalation Engineers) and Azure engineering teams with our mission to turn Azure customers into fans with a world-class engineering-led support experience.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
