title: Email Deliverability Engineer
description:
**Proximus Global**
, combining the strengths of
**Telesign, BICS, and Route Mobile**
, is transforming the future of communications and digital identity. Together, our solutions fuel innovation across the world’s largest companies and emerging brands. Our unrivaled global reach empowers businesses to create engaging experiences with built-in fraud protection across the entire customer lifecycle.
  
  
Our comprehensive suite of solutions – from our super network for voice, messaging, and data, to 5G and IoT; and from verification and intelligence to CPaaS for personalized omnichannel engagement – enables businesses and communities to thrive. Reaching over 5 billion subscribers, securing more than 180 billion transactions annually, and connecting 1,000+ destinations, we honor our commitment to connect, protect and engage everyone, everywhere.
  
  
**Key Highlights**

* Powering over 13 billion digital communications each month.
* Supporting 3,500+ active customers — including enterprises, OTTs, and mobile operators — through a presence in 50+ global offices across 100+ countries.
* Managing 50% of the world’s roaming data traffic and connecting 150 million IoT devices.
* Driving innovation in 5G, private networks, and IoT enablement, positioning Proximus Global as a leader in next-generation communication technologies.
* Committed to a unified vision, Proximus Global is unlocking new opportunities and enabling seamless global communications for businesses worldwide.

SendClean
  
  
An Email Platform by Route Mobile Limited
  
  

* Proximus Group

**Email Deliverability Engineer**
Location Hyderabad, India (on-site)
  
  
Function Email Deliverability & Platform Operations
  
  
Experience 4–7 years in email deliverability / MTA operations
  
  
Type Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Route Mobile Limited is a publicly listed Cloud Communications (CPaaS) provider, in the business since
  
  
2004, serving enterprises, OTT players and mobile operators across BFSI, retail, travel and e-commerce.
  
  
SendClean is our high-volume email platform.
  
  
SendClean is Route Mobile’s high-volume email platform. We push billions of transactional and
  
  
marketing emails a month for banks, fintechs, retail and OTT customers across India, LATAM, the
  
  
Middle East and now the US market. At that scale, deliverability is not a marketing checkbox – it is an
  
  
engineering problem. Every point of inbox placement we lose is revenue our customers lose.
  
  
We are looking for a Deliverability Engineer who can live in both worlds: someone who understands
  
  
sender reputation, ISP policy and authentication as deeply as any deliverability consultant, but who is
  
  
also comfortable on a Linux box at 2 AM reading MTA logs to find out why a sending IP suddenly started
  
  
getting 421s from Google. If you can read a bounce log, tell the difference between a real block and a
  
  
transient defer, and explain to a customer why their list quality is killing their reputation – in the same
  
  
afternoon – you are the person we want.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. You will own inbox placement for a large book of enterprise senders, work
  
  
directly with the SRE and platform teams on the sending infrastructure, and be the person the delivery
  
  
team escalates to when something is genuinely on fire.
  
  
**What You’ll Actually Do**
– Own deliverability end-to-end. Own inbox placement and sender reputation across our sending IP
  
  
pools and domains – monitor it, defend it, and recover it when it drops.
  
  
– Debug on the server. Read the logs. Dig through MTA logs (receiving and sending nodes), SMTP
  
  
transaction logs and bounce data to root-cause why mail is deferring, bouncing or landing in spam.
  
  
You should be able to tell a 4xx defer from a 5xx block and know what to do about each.
  
  
– Warm-up & IP hygiene. Manage IP warm-up schedules for new ranges and new customers, and
  
  
know when to slow a sender down before they burn a range.
  
  
– Authentication. Set up and read SPF, DKIM, DMARC (and BIMI where it applies). Diagnose
  
  
alignment failures and fix authentication issues for customers who bring their own domains.
  
  
– ISP & mailbox provider policy. Stay ahead of Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft sender requirements
  
  
and enforcement changes, and translate them into concrete actions before they hit our customers –
  
  
not after.
  
  
– Blocklist monitoring & remediation. Watch Spamhaus, SURBL, Barracuda and the other
  
  
blocklists. When we get listed, you find out why, fix the root cause, and drive the delisting.
  
  
– Bounce & complaint handling. Classify and act on bounces and FBL/complaint feedback, keep
  
  
suppression clean, and use complaint and bounce signatures to catch list-quality and spamtrap
  
  
problems early.
  
  
– Metrics & reporting. Build and read dashboards (Kibana / Grafana or similar) for delivery, bounce
  
  
and latency metrics. Turn raw delivery data into something a customer or an account manager can
  
  
act on.
  
  
– Customer-facing deliverability. Work directly with customers on their sending practices – list
  
  
hygiene, content, cadence, authentication – and hold the line on our compliance and anti-abuse
  
  
standards.
  
  
– Cross-team work. Partner with SRE, platform and support engineering on MTA config, queue
  
  
behaviour and infrastructure changes that affect delivery. Deliverability doesn’t happen in isolation
  
  
from the platform.
  
  
– Audits & compliance. Run regular audits of our sending infrastructure and practices against
  
  
industry standards and mailbox-provider requirements, and keep us compliant with anti-spam
  
  
regulation (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL and the rest).
  
  
– Vendor & postmaster relationships. Own the external relationships that decide our fate – blocklist
  
  
operators, feedback-loop and seed-list / inbox-placement providers, and mailbox-provider
  
  
postmaster channels – to troubleshoot issues and push delistings through.
  
  
– Documentation. Keep deliverability SOPs, runbooks and playbooks current so the delivery and
  
  
support teams can handle the routine cases without escalating every time.
  
  
– Mentoring & training. Coach the delivery and support teams on deliverability fundamentals – turn
  
  
tribal knowledge into something the whole team can actually use.
  
  
– Tooling & continuous improvement. Evaluate new deliverability, monitoring and inbox-placement
  
  
tooling, and make the call on what’s worth adopting – we’re actively investing in better tooling, not
  
  
standing still.
  
  
**What we’re looki**
**ng for**
– Real email-industry exposure. 4+ years working hands-on in email deliverability, ideally at an ESP,
  
  
CPaaS or a serious high-volume sender – not just campaign-side marketing.
  
  
– You understand SMTP properly. Solid working knowledge of SMTP: response codes, bounce
  
  
codes, deferrals, connection behaviour, and what mailbox providers do and don’t tell you.
  
  
– Server-level comfort. Comfortable on Linux. You can SSH into a box, grep through logs, follow a
  
  
message through the pipeline, and use basic scripting (bash / Python) to pull the answer out of a
  
  
large log file.
  
  
– Authentication in your bones. Hands-on with SPF, DKIM, DMARC, DNS records, and comfortable
  
  
diagnosing them when they break.
  
  
– You know the ecosystem. You know Postmaster Tools, SNDS, feedback loops, blocklists and the
  
  
reputation systems that actually decide inbox placement.
  
  
– Analytical and evidence-driven. When mail is going to spam, you form a hypothesis, test it against
  
  
the data, and fix the actual cause instead of guessing.
  
  
– Clear communicator. You can explain a deliverability problem to a customer, an account manager
  
  
and an engineer – three different audiences – and influence stakeholders at every level without
  
  
losing any of them.
  
  
**Nice to have (not deal-breakers)**
– Hands-on experience with MTA –Postfix, PowerMTA or similar.
  
  
– Familiarity with Elasticsearch / Kibana or another log-analytics stack for delivery monitoring.
  
  
– Exposure to AWS (or another cloud) and how sending infrastructure runs on it.
  
  
– Working knowledge of Redis, message queues (RabbitMQ ) or the moving parts of a sending
  
  
pipeline.
  
  
– HTML email and rendering know-how – enough to spot when the content is the problem.
  
  
– Prior time in a deliverability lead or expert role – if you’ve owned this for an organisation before, that
  
  
counts.
  
  
– A bachelor’s in marketing, CS/IT or a related field – or equivalent real-world experience.
  
  
**Why PXS Global?**

* 🌍 Global & Inclusive – Work with diverse teams across 100+ countries, embracing a truly international culture.
* 📈 Growth-Focused – Develop your career through tailored learning, leadership programmes, and internal mobility.
* 💡 Innovation-Driven – Contribute to cutting-edge projects in 5G, IoT, and next-gen communication technologies.
* 🏠 Flexible Workstyle – Enjoy hybrid working with the option to work remotely and even from abroad for up to 10 days a year.
* 🚀 Efficient & Scalable – Be part of a company that values simplicity, operational excellence, and smart growth.
* 🎁 Comprehensive Benefits – Enjoy a competitive and thoughtfully designed salary package, with a wide range of benefits.

A bachelor’s in marketing, CS/IT or a related field – or equivalent real-world experience.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Security and Compliance Platform Engineering organization presents a rare opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation, AI-driven cybersecurity solutions at cloud scale. This effort centers on ingesting and processing massive volumes of telemetry and security event data across OCI, leveraging advanced techniques including generative AI (GenAI), large language models (LLMs), and machine learning (ML) to build intelligent detection, response, and mitigation systems. The goal is to deliver autonomous, adaptive security capabilities that protect OCI, Oracle, and our global customer base against evolving threat landscapes. Inviting you to build along the high scale, low latency, distributed systems including massive data pipelines and database.

  

Key Responsibilities
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
  
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
  
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
–Implements performance and load testing.
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
  
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
  
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
  
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
  
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
  
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
  
Compliance & Security:
  
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
  
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
  
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
  
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.

Core Responsibilities
  
Planning & Execution:
  
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
  
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
  
Problem Solving:
  
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
  
Continuous Learning:
  
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

title: Senior Deal Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Deal Strategy leader to own the deal strategy operations and execution for our high-volume Commercial Segment. This role partners strategically with Sales and Customer Success leadership to drive efficient deal execution at scale, optimize processes, and enable sales teams to navigate complex commercial requirements with minimal friction.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise with Salesforce and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), a deep understanding of the quote-to-close process, and a proven track record optimizing operations at scale. This individual will lead Commercial segment deal strategy—owning process design, team enablement, and continuous improvement. They'll operate as both a strategic advisor to Sales leadership and hands-on executor, identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce friction, and build repeatable playbooks that accelerate deal velocity.

This role requires a strategic, process-oriented leader who can own high-volume operations, lead and mentor team members, drive continuous process improvement, and balance sales enablement with company controls. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with operational excellence and the ability to influence and align Sales leadership around deal strategy priorities.

Who you are::

* 5+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Deal Strategy, Sales Operations, or similar roles, with at least 2+ years in a leadership capacity (team lead, manager, or senior IC with mentoring responsibilities).
* Advanced hands-on expertise with Salesforce, including custom configuration and workflow optimization.
* Expert-level hands-on experience with CPQ tools; demonstrated ability to optimize configurations and workflows for process improvement.
* Extensive experience designing and managing deal processes at scale; demonstrated ability to handle high volumes while maintaining quality and compliance.
* Proven track record establishing standards and processes for high-volume deal environments.
* Expert-level understanding of pricing strategies, discount models, and commercial term structuring.
* Demonstrated experience designing and optimizing approval processes; skilled at coordinating cross-functional teams.
* Deep expertise in the quote-to-close process and deal lifecycle; ability to identify efficiency opportunities.
* Extensive experience leading cross-functional partnerships and initiatives; ability to align multiple stakeholder groups.
* Advanced analytical skills with ability to analyze operational data, identify trends, and drive data-informed improvements.
* Exceptional attention to detail combined with strong project management and follow-through capabilities.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to influence and align leadership on priorities.
* Ability to manage complex, high-volume operations while maintaining strategic focus and team engagement.

What you'll be doing::

* Own the end-to-end deal strategy operations for the Commercial Segment; partner closely with Sales and Customer Success leadership to ensure efficient, scalable execution of high-volume deals from initial request through close.
* Lead the design, optimization, and continuous improvement of Commercial Segment workflows in Salesforce and CPQ; oversee quote creation, pricing logic, and approval processes to maximize efficiency and minimize manual touches.
* Establish and maintain Commercial Segment deal standards and policies; conduct quality assurance reviews and provide coaching to ensure consistent, compliant deal execution across the high-volume pipeline.
* Lead analysis of deal structures and commercial patterns; identify optimization opportunities and recommend process improvements that reduce friction, accelerate velocity, and improve profitability across the Commercial Segment.
* Build and maintain Commercial Segment pricing frameworks, discount models, and playbooks; enable Sales teams with tools, training, and guidance to navigate complex scenarios and make sound decisions with minimal escalation.
* Own the approval workflow design and SLA management for Commercial deals; drive continuous improvement in approval speed and efficiency while maintaining appropriate controls.
* Lead CPQ optimization initiatives; troubleshoot system and process issues; partner with Revenue Operations and IT to implement enhancements that improve Commercial deal execution.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration on Commercial deal strategy and process improvements; represent deal strategy priorities in partnership conversations with Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, and other functions.
* Establish and communicate clear escalation criteria for non-standard Commercial deals; ensure executive visibility and decision-making support when needed.
* Build a risk management framework for Commercial deals; train team members to identify risk flags early; escalate material issues to deal strategy leadership and sales management.
* Implement quality control processes for Commercial deals; conduct periodic audits to ensure data integrity and compliance; address systemic issues through process refinement.
* Establish deal monitoring and SLA frameworks for the Commercial Segment; track deal velocity metrics and identify bottlenecks; drive corrective action to maintain pipeline health.
* Lead Commercial Segment execution during high-volume periods; implement surge planning and team coordination to maintain quality and timelines; identify lasting solutions to recurring high-volume challenges.
* Systematically analyze deal data and process performance; identify patterns and opportunities for improvement; develop business cases and lead implementation of process enhancements.
* Own the development and maintenance of Commercial Segment playbooks, policies, training materials, and best practices; keep documentation current and relevant as business evolves.
* Lead strategic initiatives with Revenue Operations to enhance Salesforce, CPQ, and deal workflows; articulate Commercial Segment requirements and advocate for improvements that drive scale.
* Represent Commercial Segment deal strategy in cross-functional forums; advocate for Commercial-specific requirements in process and system discussions.
* Build and deliver training programs for Sales and Customer Success teams on Commercial deal processes, pricing, CPQ, and best practices; conduct regular enablement sessions.
* Partner with Sales leadership to establish deal strategy priorities for the Commercial Segment; align on process standards, escalation criteria, and success metrics.
* Analyze Commercial Segment deal trends, metrics, and performance; provide regular reporting to leadership on volume, velocity, pricing, and process metrics; identify data-driven improvement opportunities.
* Lead, mentor, and develop team members responsible for Commercial Segment deal execution; provide coaching, feedback, and career development guidance (if managing a team); or serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert to junior team members (if individual contributor).

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Analyst-Software Engineering
description:
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.

Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 1.5 to 2.5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js. Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

title: Lead Functional Consultant
description:
**Job Skills:** Team Handling Business Analysis Gathering Requirements UAT

**Job Type:** Full Time

**Job Location:** mumbai

**Exp Level:** 8-14 Years

**Role:** 1

**Company:** ColdStar Logistics
  
**Experience:** 8–12 years
  
**Department:** Digital Transformation / Technology
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, on ColdStar Logistics payroll
  
**Location:** Mumbai (in-person, onsite role), with visits to warehouses and operational facilities
  
**Reports to:** Top management / C-suite
  
**Compensation:** Industry standard

**About the Company**
---------------------

India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.

**About the Role**
------------------

ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.

The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.

The role will act as the **primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,** ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.

The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management**

* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.

* **Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight**

* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.

* **UAT and Solution Acceptance**

* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
* Coordinate retesting with Technology Teams and relevant ColdStar users.
* Obtain formal UAT acceptance from authorized business process owners.
* Recommend production readiness based on functional completeness and business acceptance.

* **Technology Adoption and Change Management**

* Ensure delivered solutions are adopted effectively across ColdStar’s operational teams.
* Develop training, communication and adoption strategies for new systems and features.
* Coordinate user onboarding, demonstrations and operational training.
* Monitor adoption, usage patterns, manual workarounds and user feedback.
* Work with department heads to embed new systems into standard operating procedures.
* Identify and address resistance to change, usability problems and process gaps.
* Measure the operational value realized from technology investments.

* **Innovation, Competitive Intelligence and Digital Roadmap**

* Proactively research digital innovations, emerging technologies and competitive practices in logistics, cold-chain operations, transportation and warehousing.
* Identify opportunities involving process automation, IoT, analytics, AI, GenAI and agentic AI.
* Evaluate technology opportunities based on business value, feasibility, implementation effort and return on investment.
* Work with engineering and innovation teams to evaluate potential solutions.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of business improvements and innovation initiatives.
* Recommend quarterly technology priorities to ColdStar’s leadership.
* Align technology priorities with ColdStar’s business strategy and identify operational problems that can be solved through technology.
* Use AI/ML and analytics to make sense of the data generated by ColdStar’s systems and turn it into insights for operations and leadership.
* Help build technology into ColdStar’s culture and everyday ways of working.
* Track industry developments and identify opportunities to improve ColdStar’s operational efficiency, customer experience and competitive positioning.

* **Technology Team Leadership**

* Build and lead ColdStar’s in-house technology team as the company grows.
* Mentor team members and set clear standards, priorities and ways of working.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* 8–12 years of experience in business analysis, techno-functional consulting, enterprise application implementation or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of logistics, warehousing, transportation, supply chain or distribution operations.
* Proven experience working with software development teams or external technology implementation partners.
* Experience independently preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience managing UAT, business acceptance and technology adoption.
* Working understanding of APIs, databases, SQL fundamentals, integrations, cloud applications and enterprise software architecture.
* Familiarity with WMS, TMS, ERP, fleet management, inventory management or related enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work closely with both business users and technical engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Cold-chain logistics and temperature-controlled supply-chain operations.
* Experience with IoT, real-time tracking, warehouse automation or fleet analytics.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Power BI or enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI and automation use cases in logistics.
* Experience with operational change management and technology adoption programs.

description:

We Saved a Spot for You

We welcome talented and ambitious graduates from all backgrounds who will help us shape the future of engineering and our company. The Transmission and Distribution industry is evolving rapidly, driven by data centers, renewables, and the need for resilience. The grid has never been more critical. * Strong analytical capability.
* Flexibility to work in different roles for different clients both locally and worldwide.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Multi-Cloud Platform Engineer to build, automate, and manage secure, scalable cloud infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Microsoft Azure.

The role involves cloud infrastructure automation, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Terraform, DevOps, monitoring, and production deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI applications. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on GCP experience along with working experience in Azure.

* Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure across GCP and Azure.
* Build and manage cloud environments, landing zones, shared services, and network configurations.
* Provision and manage GCP services such as Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Workflows, and Vertex AI.
* Build infrastructure and deployment pipelines to take Generative AI applications from POC to production.

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Docker.
* Manage Kubernetes environments, including GKE and AKS, cluster scaling, deployment, and operational support.

* Manage cloud security, IAM, Azure Entra ID, access controls, and governance policies.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of GCP services: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud Scheduler, and Vertex AI.
* Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Experience managing Kubernetes platforms (GKE / AKS) and Docker containers.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions and Jenkins.
* Scripting knowledge in Python or Bash.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, and Azure Monitor.
* Understanding of cloud networking, IAM, security, and access management.
* Knowledge of cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.

Good to Have

* Experience with Vertex AI, Azure AI Foundry, MLOps, or Generative AI platform deployment.
* Exposure to Agentic AI, LLM, RAG, and AI application infrastructure.

Education

BE / BTech / MCA / MS / BS in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Operations Engineer to join our GNO Enterprise Connectivity-Tech Ops team in Pune. This role is focused on providing expert-level third-line network operations support across a highly resilient and secure enterprise infrastructure. The successful candidate will act as a key escalation point for critical incidents, drive operational excellence, support continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborate with multiple technology and business teams to maintain and enhance network performance, reliability, and security.

title: Senior System Engineer- Digital Platform
description:
Are you ready to turn machine data into real-time insights that strengthen manufacturing operations worldwide? We’re looking for a hands-on Senior System Engineer with deep expertise in industrial connectivity, automation and IoT to create seamless connections between production equipment and our digital platform.
  
  
**Here, you get the opportunity to:**

* Work with advanced digital solutions and data generated directly from the shop floor.
* Gain broad exposure to global manufacturing technologies and information flows.
* Join a product environment offering varied challenges and opportunities to grow.

**About Your Job**
In this global position, you ensure reliable connectivity between industrial machines at our production units and the digital platform. By collecting, transferring and integrating machine data, you enable real-time analysis, informed decision-making and improved machine performance.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Establish and maintain reliable data connections between industrial machines and the digital platform.
* Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.
* Develop, test and deploy protocols, interfaces and APIs that connect machines with backend systems.
* Integrate machine-generated data with digital platforms and cloud services in collaboration with data engineers and IT teams.
* Diagnose connectivity issues across Ethernet, Modbus and industrial networks, both remotely and on-site.
* Drive connectivity best practices and identify improvements that strengthen data integrity, machine uptime and infrastructure performance.

Location
  
  
This is an on-site position based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden or Pune in India. As close collaboration with production is essential, you need to be located near one of these manufacturing sites.
  
  
Your profile
  
  
You’re an experienced engineer with a strong background in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. Combining broad technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, you independently drive connectivity activities across a global manufacturing environment.
  
  
Your background includes
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree om electronics and communication engineering, instrumentation, computer science or a related field.
* Extensive experience in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT.

description:

For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
  
  
SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
  
  
SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
  
  
Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc.
  
  
Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
  
  
Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Telecommunications Expert is the key position in these BIDs.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* System Architecture and Design: Define the overall communication architecture (wired and wireless), leading the design of the high-speed, redundant Fiber Optic Transmission System (FOTS) and IP/MPLS backbone network.
* Operational Communication Systems: Oversee the implementation of safety-critical operational systems like GSM-R (or equivalent radio systems) for train-to-ground communication and SCADA for remote monitoring of power infrastructure.
* Passenger and Station Systems (SISS): Direct the design and integration of all Station Information and Surveillance Systems (SISS), including CCTV, Public Address (PA), Passenger Information Displays (PIDS), and station Wi-Fi/access networks.
* Interface and Integration Management: Ensure seamless, fail-safe integration of the telecom network with core railway systems, particularly Signaling (Train Control/ETCS) and Power Supply, as critical communication links depend on it.
* Technical Compliance and Standards: Act as the final technical authority, ensuring all telecommunication designs, equipment, and installation procedures adhere to international railway standards and project-specific technical specifications.
* Testing, Commissioning, and Handover: Develop and execute the comprehensive testing and commissioning plan, including Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and manage the final technical handover of systems to the maintenance authority.

+ Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in Telecom out of which atleast 10 (ten) years in any Rail based Passenger Transit System [additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit System\*]

The role is for a design engineer for UK / Any geography Rail sector within the Telecoms and Information Systems team.
  
  
The candidate shall be responsible for the production and co-ordination of Communication Systems designs. The candidate must be aware of UK Rail process and worked on Network Rail and London Underground rail projects.
  
  
Your role
  
  
**Required**
The candidate is required to have a proven working knowledge of the activities necessary to produce fully assured designs for the following systems:
  
  

* Public Address / Voice Alarm systems,
* Closed Circuit Television systems,
* Access Control systems,
* Passenger Help Point systems,
* Emergency Telephone systems
* Station Management Systems
* TCP / IP Networks,
* Clock and Master Clock Systems
* Public Wifi
* Wifi simulation and planning - Appreciated

The candidate is also expected to have an appreciation of the interfaces (physical and other) with other railway system disciplines.
  
  
The candidate's responsibilities will comprise of the production of the communications elements of both discipline-integrated and stand-alone station designs. This will involve;
  
  

* Co-ordination with other disciplines (internal and external) in the placement and integration of communication equipment within the overall design.
* Production of design deliverables including specifications, reports, schedules, drawings, and technical schematics.
* Producing designs in CAD using AutoCAD, MicroStation – 2D and 3D, AECOSIM, Revit
* Management of 3rd party design resource utilised in producing elements of the design (e.g., acoustic consultants, Lifts, Escalators etc).
* Management of 3rd party equipment manufactures and suppliers to ensure proposed equipment is suitable for the individual project requirements.
* Verification of the design against customer requirements and standards.
* Attendance at internal and external co-ordination, progress, and design review meetings.
* Undertake design reviews of other concurrent Communication Systems designs.

**About You**

* Ability to complete work on time and on budget within the parameters of the project scope of works.
* A minimum of 5 to 9 years' experience in a similar role.
* Knowledge of fundamental engineering and communication systems standards and best practice.
* Knowledge and experience of the requirements for designing safety critical and safety related systems.
* High proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel & PowerPoint).
* Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit and Open building design is essential.

title: System & Network Support Engineer
description:
A **Network Support Engineer** maintains, monitors, and troubleshoots an organization's computer networks and IT infrastructure to ensure reliable, high-speed, and secure operations.

Core Responsibilities

* **Network Monitoring & Maintenance:** Track network performance, bandwidth usage, and system health using specialized monitoring tools. Perform routine health checks, firmware updates, and patch management.
* **Troubleshooting & Incident Response:** Diagnose and resolve connectivity dropouts, slow speeds, hardware malfunctions, and software faults. Act as a primary point of contact for technical support calls and ticket escalations.
* **Hardware & Software Configuration:** Install, configure, and maintain networking gear such as routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and VPNs. Manage IP addressing, DNS, and DHCP services.
* **Security & Access Control:** Implement and enforce network security policies, configure firewalls, manage user accounts, and support intrusion detection systems (IDS/IPS).
* **Documentation & Backup:** Keep detailed logs of network configurations, runbooks, support tickets, and post-mortem incident reports. Ensure network backup and disaster recovery processes are active.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with system administrators, cybersecurity teams, and vendors during network deployments, upgrades, or major outages.

Pay: ₹216,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior RAN Engineer, Telecom Engineer, RAN Operations Lead, Nokia RAN Engineer, Network Operations Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Nescom Tele Infra Pvt. Ltd. operates in the telecommunications infrastructure sector, supporting network deployment, optimization, and maintenance for leading service providers. The company focuses on delivering reliable wireless and mobile network solutions that meet high performance and quality standards. Team members collaborate closely with operators and technology vendors to ensure robust connectivity and efficient network operations. Nescom Tele Infra offers opportunities to work with advanced telecom technologies and contribute to large-scale network projects in a dynamic environment.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site role is based in Noida and combines responsibilities typically associated with Senior RAN Engineer, Telecom Engineer, RAN Operations Lead, Nokia RAN Engineer, and Network Operations Engineer positions. The professional in this role will handle day-to-day Radio Access Network (RAN) operations, including configuration, optimization, and performance monitoring of multi-vendor, with emphasis on Nokia RAN equipment. Responsibilities include analyzing network KPIs, identifying and resolving issues, and implementing changes to improve coverage, capacity, and quality of service. The role involves performing root cause analysis for network incidents, coordinating with field and core network teams, and ensuring timely resolution of faults and degradations. The engineer will also participate in network design reviews, support rollout and integration activities, maintain documentation, and adhere to operational and safety standards.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Network Performance analysis and optimization, including KPI monitoring and reporting.
* Candidates should possess robust Troubleshooting skills, including fault diagnosis, root cause analysis, and incident resolution.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Wireless Networking and Wireless Technologies, with practical experience in mobile network standards (e.g., 2G/3G/4G/5G).
* Candidates should possess capabilities in Network Design, including RAN planning, capacity design, and configuration management.
* Hands-on experience with Nokia RAN equipment and associated tools is highly desirable.
* Solid understanding of telecom protocols, RF principles, and end-to-end mobile network architecture.
* Ability to interpret drive test data and other performance reports to derive actionable optimization plans.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced certifications in telecom or wireless technologies are an advantage.
* Willingness to work on-site in Noida and, when required, support field activities and extended hours during critical network events.

title: Systems Engineering Advisor - Endpoint Management
description:
**POSITION DETAILS**
Job Title: ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer – Enterprise Endpoint Management
  
  
Location: India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-Time (Permanent)
  
  
Experience: 9–12 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with proven technical leadership in large-scale ManageEngine and Microsoft Intune environments, ideally within an India-based global delivery model.
  
  
Compensation: Competitive CTC commensurate with seniority. Comprehensive benefits including health insurance (self, spouse, children, and parents), PF, gratuity, performance bonus, LTA, NPS, and professional certification reimbursement.
  
  
Work Hours: IST-aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex ManageEngine/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise ManageEngine/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with ManageEngine/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment & Provisioning
  
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation & Integration
  
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement & Delivery Governance
  
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

**Required Skills**

* ManageEngine Endpoint Management Tool (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) — required
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect or Security Engineer certifications
* Experience with Microsoft Endpoint Analytics and Intune Advanced Analytics
* Prior India-based delivery leadership for Fortune 500 global accounts (10,000+ endpoints)
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, India IT Act compliance, and global data residency considerations in EPM

**MINIMUM EDUCATION**
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/MCA/B.Sc. CS or IT) from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent enterprise experience and advanced Microsoft certifications will be considered.
  
  
NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, religion, caste, gender, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable Indian law.

title: Technical Consultant-Threat Detection Response & Intelligence
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Technical Consultant: Threat Detection Response & Intelligence, you play a vital role in safeguarding an organization's digital infrastructure by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating cyber threats. This position involves using a variety of cybersecurity tools to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Conduct Event Investigations: Investigate security incidents using SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, and apply industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
* Manage Incident Reports: Prioritize and manage incident reports, providing actionable recommendations and responses to strengthen the client's security posture.
* Analyze Network and Endpoint Events: Interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
* Engage in Vulnerability Management: Participate in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
* Provide Actionable Recommendations: Deliver recommendations and responses to clients to enhance their security posture.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to Cybersecurity Tools: Familiarity with a variety of cybersecurity tools, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and XDR platforms, to monitor, prioritize, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
* Understanding of Industry Frameworks: Knowledge of industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain to understand and counter adversary tactics effectively.
* Experience with Network and Endpoint Analysis: Ability to interpret security tools and logs from Windows, MAC, and Linux systems to identify potential threats.
* Exposure to Vulnerability Management: Participation in vulnerability management and cyber threat intelligence activities to identify and anticipate potential threats.
* Certification in Security Technologies: Familiarity with security technologies and certifications related to threat detection, response, and intelligence.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash is beneficial for automating tasks and interacting with various cybersecurity tools.
* Knowledge of Cloud Security: Understanding cloud security principles and experience working with cloud-based security solutions can be advantageous in identifying and mitigating cyber threats.
* Exposure to Threat Intelligence Platforms: Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and feeds can aid in staying up-to-date with emerging threats and improving incident response capabilities.

title: Technical Support Executive (Vicidal)
description:
Winet Infratel is a technology company working across telecom, VoIP, EV charging infrastructure and IT services. Our VoIP practice designs, deploys and supports ViciDial and Asterisk-based contact-centre platforms for clients ranging from small inbound teams to multi-server, 100+ agent outbound clusters. More details on the product can be obtained at https://next2call.com.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Support Executive to install, configure, monitor and troubleshoot ViciDial contact-centre systems for our clients. You will be the first line of technical support for client supervisors and agents, resolve telephony and dialer issues quickly, and work with our senior engineers on deployments, upgrades and escalations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**ViciDial administration**

* Install and configure ViciDial (ViciBox / scratch install on Rocky/AlmaLinux) on single-server and clustered setups.
* Create and manage campaigns, lists, lead loading, in-groups, DIDs, call menus (IVR), user groups, agents and phones.
* Configure dial methods (RATIO, ADAPT, INBOUND\_MAN, blended), drop/abandon settings, hopper, call times and DNC lists.
* Set up dispositions, scripts, web forms, recording settings and CRM/API integrations (Agent API, Non-Agent API).
* Generate and explain real-time and historical reports (agent performance, campaign stats, drop rates, CDR) for client supervisors.

**Telephony, SIP & Asterisk**

* Configure SIP trunks/carriers, dial plans, outbound CID and inbound DID routing.
* Troubleshoot one-way/no audio, call drops, registration failures, NAT, codec and DTMF issues.
* Use Asterisk CLI, sngrep, tcpdump and SIP traces to diagnose call-flow problems.
* Support softphones (Zoiper, MicroSIP, WebRTC/ViciPhone) and IP phones at agent desks.

**Linux, database & server health**

* Perform routine Linux administration: services, logs, cron, disk/CPU/memory checks, firewall (firewalld/iptables) and fail2ban.
* Run basic MySQL/MariaDB queries for lead lookups, data fixes and report extraction; manage backups and restores.
* Monitor server load, replication and keepalive processes across cluster nodes; flag capacity issues early.
* Apply updates and security hardening under the guidance of senior engineers.

**Client support & coordination**

* Respond to client tickets, calls and WhatsApp/email support requests within agreed SLAs.
* Diagnose and resolve L1/L2 issues; escalate L3 issues with clear logs and reproduction steps.
* Coordinate with carriers/ITSPs on trunk, routing and quality issues.
* Train client supervisors and agents on ViciDial usage, agent screen and reports.
* Visit client sites when needed for go-live, network checks or agent-floor support.

**Documentation**

* Maintain configuration records, network/IP details and change logs for every client.
* Write SOPs, troubleshooting notes and go-live checklists.
* Keep tickets updated with root cause and resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc (IT/CS/Electronics) or equivalent.
* 1–3 years of hands-on experience with ViciDial or Asterisk-based dialers.
* Working knowledge of SIP, RTP, codecs (G.711, G.729), NAT and basic call-flow concepts.
* Comfortable on the Linux command line (CentOS/Rocky/AlmaLinux).
* Basic MySQL/MariaDB skills (SELECT, UPDATE, export).
* Understanding of networking basics: IP addressing, VLANs, ports, firewalls, VPN.
* Good written and spoken communication in English and Hindi (regional language a plus).

**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Experience with multi-server ViciDial clusters (DB, web and telephony separation).
* Asterisk dialplan (extensions.conf) and AGI scripting knowledge.
* Shell or PHP/Python scripting for automation.
* Experience with Issabel, FreePBX, or other PBX platforms.
* Familiarity with TRAI/DoT telemarketing regulations and DND/DLT compliance.
* Certifications such as dCAP, CCNA, RHCSA or equivalent.

**Soft Skills**

* Calm, methodical approach to troubleshooting under pressure (live call-centre floors).
* Customer-first attitude with clear, patient communication.
* Ownership of issues until closure; disciplined about documentation.
* Willingness to learn and to work in rotational shifts.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* First-response and resolution time against client SLAs.
* Ticket closure rate and repeat-issue rate.
* System uptime and call-quality metrics for supported clients.
* Client feedback / CSAT.
* Quality and completeness of documentation.

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on exposure to live contact-centre deployments, telecom and VoIP infrastructure.
* Mentoring from senior VoIP engineers and a clear growth path to VoIP Engineer / Solutions Engineer.
* Opportunity to work across telecom, EV charging and IT services projects.

title: Engineer - Electrical
description:
:

It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.

Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in

Context:

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.

CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.

CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.

CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.

  
Missions/Main Duties:

* Lead the design, specification, and integration of low voltage systems in rail infrastructure projects, including power supply, lighting, cabling, communications, and auxiliary systems.
* Design and develop detailed catenary profiles, sectioning plans, and layout drawings for rail electrification projects in Sweden, the UK, and Australia.
* Analyze route alignment and geometry to determine support placements, wire runs, stagger, uplift, and wind load impact.
* Perform tensioning and mechanical calculations for different OLE types (simple, compound, regulated, unregulated, and auto-tensioned systems).
* Prepare mast location plans, BOMs, and foundation details based on local terrain and climatic conditions.
* Ensure designs adhere to national and international electrification standards (EN 50119, Network Rail OLEMI, ARTC standards, Trafikverket design rules).
* Use industry-standard OLE design tools like Bentley OpenRail Overhead Line Designer, AutoCAD, or similar.
* Support complete project lifecycle from concept design through to detailed design and site execution.
* Collaborate with signaling, civil, and traction power teams to resolve multidisciplinary interface issues.
* Participate in technical reviews, design validation.

Profile/Skills:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical.
* 6–10 years of focused experience in railway low voltage engineering, overhead line electrification with significant work on rail infrastructure projects.
* Deep knowledge of LV systems for rail applications: station and trackside LV distribution, lighting, control panels, power supplies, UPS systems.
  + Proven experience with country-specific standards:
  + Sweden: Trafikverket standards and cold-weather OLE adaptations.
  + Australia: ARTC and relevant Australian standards.
  + UK: Network Rail standards (OLEMI, Series 1/2, Master Series).
* Strong knowledge of catenary mechanics, tensioning equipment, and construction techniques.
* Proficiency in design tools like Bentley OpenRail, AutoCAD, and Revit.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills with multinational teams.
* Familiarity with RAMS and SIL-appropriate design for safety-critical systems.
* Preferred Certifications & Competencies:
* Prior experience with electrification projects involving high-speed rail or metro systems.
* Experience with ERTMS or other advanced railway signaling systems integration.
* Exposure to BIM workflows and digital twin integration in OLE projects.
* Understanding of safety regulations and environmental factors specific to Sweden, UK, and Australia.

description:
:

Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in

Context:

CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.

CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2.

CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.

Missions/Main Duties:

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a competent and motivated Railway System Engineer to contribute to the delivery and integration of railway systems across international projects. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of railway systems engineering, system architecture, requirements management, interfaces, verification and validation, safety, and systems integration across disciplines such as Signalling, Telecom, Electrical/OLE, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Track, and Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage railway system requirements, system architecture, functional specifications, and technical documentation in accordance with applicable project and national standards.
* Support system engineering activities across the project lifecycle, from bid/tender and concept/design through integration, testing, commissioning, and project closure.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary interfaces and system integration between Signalling, Telecom, Electrical/OLE, SCADA, Rolling Stock, Track, Civil, and Operations.
* Prepare and maintain System Requirement Specifications (SRS), Interface Control Documents (ICD), System Architecture documents, compliance matrices, verification and validation plans, and other system engineering deliverables.
* Perform requirements analysis, traceability, allocation, impact assessment, and verification to ensure that system requirements are correctly implemented and demonstrated.
* Support RAMS and safety engineering activities in accordance with applicable standards, including CENELEC EN 50126, EN 50128, and EN 50129 where applicable.
* Contribute to technical reviews, design assurance, compliance assessments, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of system engineering processes and workflows.

Profile/Skills:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Systems, Railway, Control & Instrumentation, or a related engineering discipline (Master’s preferred).
* 6–10 years of professional experience in railway systems engineering, systems integration, railway design, or a related discipline.
* Good understanding of railway system lifecycle, system engineering processes, requirements management, interface management, verification & validation, and configuration/change management.
* Experience working across one or more railway disciplines such as Signalling/ERTMS, Telecom, SCADA/OCC, Electrical/OLE, Rolling Stock, Track, or Operations.
* Exposure to international railway standards and client requirements, particularly Australia (ARTC/MTM), UK (Network Rail), and Sweden (Trafikverket).
* Understanding of ERTMS/ETCS, conventional signalling, railway telecom, SCADA/OCC, traction power/OLE, or other railway subsystems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with engineering and documentation tools such as MicroStation, AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, requirements-management tools, interface-management tools, or project collaboration platforms.
* Good understanding of safety-critical engineering, RAMS, hazard management, and regulatory/compliance requirements for railway systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and technical documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* IRSE License or equivalent national/international railway certification.
* Certification or training in Systems Engineering, Requirements Engineering, RAMS, or Functional Safety.
* Knowledge or training in CENELEC railway standards (EN 50126/8/9).
* OEM-specific railway systems training (e.g., Siemens, Alstom, Hitachi, Thales, or equivalent).
* Relevant rail safety worker certifications such as RIW (Australia) or Sentinel (UK) are a plus.
