title: Quality Analyst - Customer support
description:
Quality Analyst (Customer support)
  
  
Job Title: Quality Analyst – Customer Experience Team (CET)
  
Location: Bangalore
  
Job Type: Full-time
  
Reports To: Quality Lead
  
Experience: 2–3 years
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Quality Analyst to join our Customer Experience Team and take ownership of interaction quality across multiple customer support channels.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for auditing customer interactions across voice, chat, ticketing and email channels, identifying performance gaps, and converting audit findings into actionable feedback and coaching to improve agent performance.
  
  
The role involves end-to-end ownership of the quality cycle, including audits, critical error identification, agent feedback, calibration, training needs identification and quality reporting. The candidate will work closely with the Training and Operations teams to drive continuous improvement in customer experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Audit and Evaluation
  
  
- Audit customer interactions across voice, chat, ticketing and email channels against defined quality parameters.
  
- Meet agreed monthly audit targets per agent and line of business.
  
- Ensure accurate and objective scoring of customer interactions.
  
- Record specific validation reasons and clear observations for every failed parameter.
  
- Maintain detailed audit records with specific instances and justifications for scores.
  
  
2. Critical Error Management
  
  
- Identify and mark critical errors accurately, distinguishing between customer impact and business impact.
  
- Apply the fatal error framework consistently.
  
- Identify recurring critical errors by agent and parameter.
  
- Escalate compliance-related and customer-risk issues to the Quality Lead immediately.
  
  
3. Feedback and Coaching
  
  
- Conduct structured one-to-one feedback sessions with agents.
  
- Use audited interactions as evidence during coaching sessions.
  
- Apply recognised feedback mechanisms and coaching models.
  
- Define measurable improvement actions with agents and team leaders.
  
- Track performance improvements in subsequent audit cycles.
  
- Conduct joint feedback sessions with Operations and Training teams whenever required.
  
  
4. Calibration
  
  
- Participate in weekly calibration sessions with Quality Analysts, the Quality Lead and Training team.
  
- Maintain scoring consistency within agreed thresholds.
  
- Justify audit scores during calibration discussions.
  
- Contribute to improvements in evaluation forms, quality parameters and scoring guidelines.
  
  
5. Training Needs Identification (TNA/TNI)
  
  
- Identify training needs at agent, team and process levels based on audit findings.
  
- Analyse recurring errors and quality gaps.
  
- Coordinate with the Training team for appropriate interventions.
  
- Differentiate between training gaps, process issues, tool limitations and knowledge gaps.
  
- Support refresher and improvement training for low-performing agents.
  
  
6. Reporting and Analysis
  
  
- Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly quality reports.
  
- Track audit volume, average quality scores, critical error rates and parameter-wise performance.
  
- Analyse trends across agents, teams, channels and lines of business.
  
- Present quality insights and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
  
  
7. Process Improvement
  
  
- Identify recurring process issues, unclear SOPs and tool-related challenges.
  
- Highlight customer pain points through audit observations.
  
- Contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) analysis.
  
- Support new-hire nesting by auditing initial interactions and providing timely feedback.
  
  
Qualifications and Skills
  
  
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.
  
- 2–3 years of experience as a Quality Analyst in a customer service, customer support or contact centre environment.
  
- Hands-on experience in auditing customer interactions across voice, chat or ticketing channels.
  
- Exposure to multiple customer interaction channels is preferred.
  
- Knowledge of quality management tools, audit processes and quality frameworks.
  
- Understanding of quality parameters, critical error frameworks and audit governance.
  
- Practical experience in agent feedback and coaching models.
  
- Experience in calibration sessions and maintaining scoring consistency.
  
- Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables and Lookups.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
- Strong observation, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet audit and reporting deadlines.
  
- Ability to provide objective feedback while maintaining empathy towards agents.
  
  
Language Requirements
  
  
- Proficiency in English and Hindi is mandatory.
  
- Knowledge of one additional Indian language will be an added advantage.
  
  
Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  
- Immediate joiners preferred.
  
- Candidates must have experience in customer service, customer support or contact centre quality.
  
- Experience in multi-channel quality auditing is desirable.
  
- Candidates with experience working closely with Training teams on TNI, coaching and performance improvement plans will be preferred.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning — to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Trusted by 120+ institutions in 60+ countries, Provenir processes over 4 billion decisions annually — turning architectural coherence into sustained risk performance and measurable value. Ready to solve meaningful challenges, work with enterprise customers, and help shape the future of AI-powered decisioning? Join us.
  
  
The QA Engineer will be responsible for assuring the quality of our products, creating automated tests, and managing builds and continuous integration. You will automate tests for microservices and their related front ends, and manage infrastructure across development and production cloud environments.
  
  
This role goes beyond conventional application testing. Our platform combines graph data stores, graph analytics, machine learning models, and agentic AI workflows — systems whose outputs are probabilistic, whose correctness is contextual, and whose decisions carry regulatory weight. You will help define what “passing” means for components that don’t return the same answer twice, and build the harnesses that hold them to it.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Core Test Automation**

* Build and maintain end-to-end and component test suites using modern browser automation with auto-waiting, trace-based debugging, and parallel execution as the default
* Shape coverage around the test pyramid rather than the UI — API and contract tests as the primary safety net, with UI reserved for genuine user journeys
* Embed quality gates directly in CI/CD pipelines — sharded parallel runs, risk-based test selection, and pass/fail criteria that block promotion without manual sign-off
* Provision ephemeral, containerised test environments on demand through infrastructure-as-code, with synthetic and masked test data generated per run instead of maintained by hand
* Treat test reliability as a product: track flake rates, quarantine and fix unstable tests, and hold suites to explicit stability and runtime SLAs
* Use AI-assisted tooling for test authoring, coverage gap analysis, and locator resilience — while owning the judgement call on what the generated tests are actually worth
* Work shift-left alongside engineers — contributing test coverage with the feature, not after it — and partner on triage to drive issues to root cause

**Graph Data and Analytics**

* Design and automate validation for graph database layers — schema integrity, relationship correctness, and query behaviour across Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL
* Build regression coverage for graph analytics outputs: pathfinding, centrality, community detection, and link analysis used in fraud-ring identification and network risk scoring
* Validate graph ingestion and transformation pipelines for data completeness, deduplication, and referential accuracy at scale

**AI/ML and Agentic Systems**

* Develop evaluation harnesses for ML model behaviour — accuracy thresholds, drift detection, bias and fairness checks, and explainability outputs required for regulatory review
* Build automated test suites for agentic workflows: tool-calling correctness, multi-step orchestration, context handling, failure recovery, and guardrail enforcement
* Design assertion strategies for non-deterministic outputs, including golden-set comparison, semantic similarity scoring, and LLM-as-judge evaluation
* Establish prompt and model regression testing so behavioural changes are caught before release
* Validate feature pipelines and training/serving consistency in partnership with data science teams

**Process and Platform**

* Incorporate best practices into dev/test/deploy processes and recommend improvements
* Support application onboarding to the defined target operating model to achieve build and release automation
* Document, track, and escalate issues as appropriate

**What’s Required**
**Education:**
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  
  
**Experience:**
Proven track record of extensive hands-on experience in automated testing of web applications and services, including designing, developing, and executing automated tests in Python using a modern browser automation framework (Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or equivalent).
  
  
**Qualifications, Strengths And Skills**

* Demonstrated understanding of maintainable test architecture — Page Object Model or equivalent patterns — for end-to-end testing
* Extensive hands-on experience on Python scripting
* Experience testing web services and REST APIs (Postman, Swagger)
* Working knowledge of graph databases — Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph, JanusGraph or similar — including writing and validating graph queries
* Exposure to testing AI/ML-backed features, and a clear grasp of why probabilistic systems need different assertions than deterministic ones
* Scripting experience beyond Python: Unix shell, Ruby, or similar
* Continuous integration and pipeline-based delivery (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
* Experience with SQL
* Experience recommending process improvements

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with agentic frameworks — LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or comparable orchestration tooling
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation tooling and practices: golden datasets, rubric-based scoring, hallucination and jailbreak testing, red-teaming
* Graph analytics libraries such as Neo4j GDS, Apache Spark GraphX, or NetworkX
* Observability-driven testing — synthetic monitoring, canary analysis, and validation through traces, logs and metrics
* Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible; microservices, container deployment and service orchestration
* Cloud APIs (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* JIRA for issue tracking and escalation

Our employees are our top priority; we offer comprehensive health and wellness plans. You will enjoy paid time off and company holidays, flexible and remote-friendly opportunities, and maternity/paternity leave.
  
  
*At Provenir, we recognize that diversity and inclusion make our teams stronger. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, domestic partner status, citizenship, or veteran status or medical condition. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.*

○ Orchestrate containerized, parallelized (pytest-xdist and Playwright sharding) smoke, contract, and regression suites inside CI/CD pipelines with sub-15-minute PR feedback loops and automated QA to UAT to Production promotion gates.

○ Drive performance, concurrency, load, and fault-injection testing (Locust and k6) to validate high-throughput agent executions, concurrent workflow graphs, and graceful degradation during upstream LLM or database throttling.

○ Validate enterprise security boundaries including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML/SSO, RBAC/ABAC permissions, multi-tenant data isolation, and OWASP Top 10 risks for both Web and LLM Applications (prompt injection, PII leakage, and excessive agency).

○

4. Engineering Leadership & Operational Excellence

○ Recruit, mentor, and upskill top-tier SDETs, coaching engineers from script-level testing into modern software engineering and system-level architectural thinking.

○ Partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and SRE leaders during design reviews to enforce shift-left testability and observability from day one.

○ Own platform quality SLAs and executive reporting, driving measurable improvements in Defect Escape Rate (DER), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Automation Stability (>99% non-flaky pass rate), and Release Lead Time.

**COMPLETE TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE**

Should bring deep hands-on mastery of our core automation stack and strong working fluency across our broader platform ecosystem:

○ Core Languages & Tooling: Python 3.10+ (asyncio, typing, uv, Poetry, ruff, mypy), TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+, Node.js), SQL (ANSI SQL, CTEs, analytical queries), Bash / Zsh.

○ UI & Browser Automation: Microsoft Playwright (Python and TypeScript bindings, BrowserContexts, storageState authentication reuse, Trace Viewer, HAR replay, Network Interception, Canvas and Visual Regression), Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Axe-core (WCAG accessibility testing).

○ Python Testing Ecosystem: pytest, pytest-xdist (parallel sharding), pytest-asyncio, Pydantic v2, httpx, aiohttp, requests, Hypothesis and Faker (property-based and synthetic test data generation).

○ API, Streaming & Contract Testing: REST (OpenAPI 3.x), GraphQL, gRPC / Protobuf, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Schemathesis, Pact, WireMock.

○ AI, LLM & Agent Evaluation: DeepEval, RAGAS, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines, Golden Dataset curation, RAG retrieval metrics (precision, recall, faithfulness, groundedness), deterministic NLP metrics (F1, Exact Match), prompt and model regression harnesses.

○ Databases, Vector & Storage Systems: PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), Vector Databases (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph and Ontology Stores (Property Graphs, RDF), Redis, Cloud Object Storage (Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Azure Blob).

○ Asynchronous & Event Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery (testing distributed task queues, retries, dead-letter queues, and eventual consistency).

○ Performance, Load & Resilience: Locust (Python-native distributed load testing), k6, API and LLM latency profiling (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/second), fault and latency injection.

○ CI/CD, Cloud & Containers: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (K8s), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GCP / AWS / Azure.

○ Test Reporting & Observability: Allure Report, ReportPortal, TestRail / Xray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Langfuse / Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing and diagnostics).

○ Security & Identity: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML / SSO, JWT, Multi-tenant RBAC / ABAC, OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 for Web and LLM Applications.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

○ 9+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering in Test (SDET) or Quality Engineering, including 3+ years directly managing, mentoring, and scaling SDET teams on complex SaaS, cloud, data, or AI platforms.

○ Expert-level proficiency designing production-grade Python (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright automation frameworks from scratch, including custom fixtures, parallel execution runners, dynamic state handling, and anti-flake architecture.

○ Strong experience testing distributed microservices, stateful workflows, real-time streaming APIs, and relational and non-relational data layers.

○ Proven track record embedding containerized automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to gate multi-environment enterprise releases without slowing developer velocity.

○ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• Direct experience building automated evaluation and regression pipelines for LLM Agents, RAG architectures, Semantic Layers, or Workflow Orchestration platforms.

• Hands-on experience automating visual canvas or DAG builders (such as React Flow, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL interfaces) and MCP-based tool integrations.

• Prior experience building internal developer productivity tools, synthetic test-data platforms, or ephemeral preview test environments on Kubernetes.

* Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience.

If you’re eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research and you’re smart, nice, and driven to make an impact we’d love to hear from you!

**Apply now to be part of our journey.**

title: Staff Quality Engineer — Qira AI Platform
description:

**About The Role**
As a Staff AI Quality Engineer for the Qira AI Platform, you will lead the technical test strategy and architectural validation for Lenovo’s cross-device agentic AI ecosystem. You will serve as the technical authority on evaluating non-deterministic systems, designing automated quality platforms that operate across personal computing form factors (PCs, tablets, and smartphones). You will drive non-functional quality standards—ensuring that privacy, security, accessibility, internationalization, and device thermals/battery efficiency are safeguarded—while acting as a crucial release partner alongside Product Management and PMO leads.
  
  
What Will You Do
  
  

* Test Automation Architecture: Architect scalable, distributed, cross-platform test automation infrastructure capable of executing synchronized, multi-device end-to-end tests across Windows and Android devices without reliance on UI flakiness.
* Agentic AI Quality Frameworks: Design automated evaluation methodologies to validate multi-step agent reasoning, tool-calling graphs, autonomous error recovery, and transactional rollback mechanisms; establish statistical release gates for non-deterministic model behaviors.
* Hardware Runtime Resource Profiling: Formulate automated performance and endurance soak suites to benchmark on-device SLM execution against cloud fallback paths, monitoring thermal throttling, memory leaks, and battery draw across hardware device tiers.
* Non-Functional Quality Standards: Lead automated verification across non-functional pillars: red-teaming indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities, securing inter-process data barriers, standardizing automated accessibility (screen-reader verbosity, dynamic token streaming), and validating semantic fidelity across international locales.
* CI/CD Quality Pipelines Gating: Drive the technical implementation of shift-left gating in continuous integration pipelines, establishing automated failure analytics, regression detection, and flakiness isolation frameworks.
* Cross-Functional Peer Leadership: Serve as a core technical gatekeeper alongside Product Management and PMO; establish release acceptance criteria, lead data-informed risk assessments during schedule compressions, and influence platform design for enhanced testability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive software quality engineering, test architecture, and automation experience covering multi-device hardware ecosystems (Windows and Android).
* 3+ years of experience leading quality strategy and automated evaluation frameworks for LLMs, agentic AI workflows, or conversational platforms.
* Advanced programming and architecture skills in Python, C++, C#, or Java, with a track record of building scalable test harnesses and mock environments for OS IPC, APIs, and background daemons.
* Proven experience architecting automated non-functional test frameworks: deep profiling of device performance (NPU/GPU/CPU, battery mA/h, memory), security red-teaming/prompt-injection defense, automated accessibility (WCAG), and i18n semantic evaluation.
* Deep technical expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, test orchestration, and statistical quality gating.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on expertise implementing and tuning non-deterministic evaluation platforms (e.g., RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, TruLens) in production pipelines.
* Direct experience testing local NPU runtimes and quantized models (INT4/INT8 vs. FP16) on client silicon (Qualcomm, Intel, AMD).
* Background designing automated testing for multimodal inputs (synchronized voice injection, screen-capture parsing, synthetic system events).
* Demonstrated ability to resolve complex release-gating disputes with Product Management and PMO using objective risk metrics and clear mitigation trade-offs.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

With more than four decades of industry‑leading FPGA expertise, our singular mission is to deliver the programmable technologies that help customers differentiate, innovate, and scale across rapidly evolving markets like AI, cloud, networking, and edge. As an independent company, we move faster, invest deeper, and partner more closely—empowering our teams to drive breakthrough innovation and shape the future of the FPGA industry.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced DDR5 / LPDDR5 Memory Validation Engineer to join our Silicon and Platform Validation organization. In this role, you will drive validation, characterization, and debug activities for advanced DDR5 and LPDDR5 memory interfaces on next-generation FPGA devices.
  
  
You will work closely with architecture, silicon design, board design, firmware, signal integrity, and software teams to ensure industry-leading quality, reliability, performance, and interoperability across memory subsystems and high-speed I/O platforms.
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to work hands-on with cutting-edge memory technologies, advanced PHY architectures, and high-speed validation infrastructure while influencing future FPGA platform capabilities and validation methodologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own DDR5 and LPDDR5 memory subsystem validation, including defining and executing validation strategies across multiple FPGA programs.
* Create, define, and develop comprehensive system-level validation environments and test suites for advanced memory interface validation.
* Perform pre-silicon and post-silicon functional and electrical validation of DDR5 and LPDDR5 controllers, PHYs, and associated high-speed interfaces.
* Develop and execute validation plans covering:

+ Memory initialization and training
+ Read/write functional validation
+ System margining and stress testing
+ Frequency scaling
+ Memory controller features validation
+ Stability and reliability validation
+ Error injection and recovery testing

* Perform timing characterization, compliance checks, interoperability testing, and performance validation according to JEDEC specifications.
* Analyze signal integrity and timing behavior for high-speed memory interfaces, including eye diagrams, jitter, and timing margins.
* Debug complex silicon, firmware, board-level, and system-level issues involving memory subsystems and PHY behavior.
* Collaborate with hardware board design teams on high-speed memory channel implementation, including:

+ Stack-up reviews
+ Routing strategies
+ SI/PI considerations
+ Memory topology optimization
+ Termination and power delivery schemes

* Review schematics, layouts, and board design guidelines for DDR5 and LPDDR5 implementations.
* Utilize industry-standard protocol analyzers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and traffic generators for debug and characterization.
* Develop, standardize, and maintain validation methodologies, automation frameworks, and measurement flows to improve validation scalability and efficiency.
* Partner with silicon design, package, board, firmware, and software teams to drive root-cause analysis and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with pre-silicon validation teams to improve post-silicon coverage and future debug capabilities.
* Drive innovation in validation infrastructure, automation, and platform enablement to improve throughput and test coverage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum of 8+ years of industry experience in memory subsystem validation, silicon validation, or high-speed interface validation.

Regular

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II, Alexa Connectivity Devices
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about building reliable, high-quality software that customers can depend on? As a Quality Assurance Engineer II at Amazon, you will play a critical role in ensuring our products meet the highest quality standards before they reach customers. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies, build automation that scales, and collaborate closely with engineering teams to catch defects early and prevent them from happening in the first place.
  
  
This is a hands-on role where your analytical mindset and technical skills will directly influence product quality. You will own test planning for complex features and services, write automated test cases that provide meaningful end-to-end coverage, and drive continuous improvements to how we measure and deliver quality. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving problems and making systems more reliable, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end test strategy for device software features and wireless connectivity — defining what to test, how to test it, and what lab infrastructure is needed, even when requirements are ambiguous or evolving across kernel, firmware, and RF domains.
  
  
Create and execute test plans for complex test scenarios including system integration, wireless protocol conformance (Wi-Fi, BLE, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Sidewalk), power profiling, and hardware-software co-validation across firmware, OS, and connectivity boundaries.
  
  
Design and build Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test rigs and automated test solutions that are maintainable, reusable, and reliable — enabling other engineers to run and extend them independently against real device hardware.
  
  
Develop RF test automation scripts for wireless performance benchmarking, packet error rate measurement, sensitivity testing, and production line calibration support.
  
  
Own power profiling and battery life testing — current measurement, sleep/wake analysis, duty cycle optimization validation using tools such as Nordic PPK2 or Keysight power analyzers.
  
  
Create and maintain protocol conformance test suites for Wi-Fi Alliance, Zigbee Alliance, CSA Matter, and Amazon Sidewalk certification requirements.
  
  
Build regression test infrastructure that runs on every CI/CD build against real hardware targets, integrated with the team's Yocto-based build pipeline.
  
  
Isolate, document, and validate defects with detailed evidence and root-cause analysis across embedded software, wireless stacks, and peripheral interfaces (SPI, I²C, UART), enabling development teams to triage and resolve issues efficiently.

title: Manufacturing Specialist - Operation Management
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The VAT & Protection Testing Engineer is responsible for ensuring the end-to-end quality validation of protection and control panels before dispatch through the Verification After Test (VAT) process.
  
  
This role involves performing IED configuration, secondary injection testing, functional verification, and documentation, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, customer specifications, and internal quality standards.
  
  
The engineer also contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, defect reduction, and cross-functional technical coordination to enhance product quality and testing efficiency.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**VAT Execution and Panel Validation**

* Perform Verification After Test (VAT) for all manufactured panels to confirm correct wiring, logic functionality, and performance as per engineering drawings and customer requirements.
* Conduct functional testing of protection, interlock, and control circuits to ensure operational integrity
* Validate panel performance under simulated field conditions and record results in standardized formats.
* Identify and document deviations, discrepancies, or rework requirements during testing.
* Ensure VAT checklists, reports, and test records are properly completed and archived.

**IED Configuration and Testing**

* Perform configuration and parameterization of Intelligent Electronic Devices (IEDs) including protection relays, meters, and communication units.
* Carry out secondary injection testing to verify relay operation, tripping logic, and scheme correctness.
* Creating the MCL & ICD files for integration with scada systems.
* Maintain configuration templates and settings files for traceability and repeatability
* Ensure all test instruments and software tools are used as per calibration and procedure requirements.
* Quality Improvement and FPY Enhancement
* Support initiatives aimed at improving First Pass Yield (FPY) and reducing Defects per Panel (DPP).
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of test failures or repetitive issues.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Production teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Track testing trends and provide feedback for design and process improvement.

**Technical Coordination and Support**

* Act as a technical interface between Testing and Engineering teams for all protection-scheme-related discussions.
* Provide on-floor feedback on design errors, wiring deviations, and testing difficulties.
* Assist in reviewing engineering drawings, protection logic diagrams, and control schemes for accuracy and completeness.
* Support customer FATs (Factory Acceptance Tests) and technical audits as & when required

title: ENGINEER - CMDB DATA QUALITY
description:
Job Title: Engineer - CMDB Data Quality
  
  
GCL: C1/C2/C3
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to transform complex configuration data into trusted insight that powers critical services and, ultimately, helps patients receive life-changing medicines faster? Do you enjoy transforming messy datasets into reliable maps of how applications run, so teams can make faster, safer decisions?
  
  
In this role you will be the engine behind the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of our ServiceNow CMDB. You will work with global colleagues across time zones to raise data standards, strengthen governance and deliver reliable configuration data for Incident, Change, Security and Asset processes. Your work will remove noise, reduce risk and give our technology and product teams the confidence to move at speed.
  
  
From day one, you will own measurable improvements in CMDB health for priority classes and applications. As you scale your impact, you will shape automated controls, streamline certification cycles and provide the insights that steer remediation, modelling decisions and operational resilience.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
CMDB Data Quality Monitoring and Standards: Monitor and improve health across key CI classes and domains, focusing on completeness, accuracy, compliance, freshness and relationships; define measurable targets, track trends and drive actions that move the metrics.
  
  
Root Cause Analysis and Controls: Profile data, distinguish isolated vs. systemic issues and document causes; validate against the Data Dictionary; strengthen quality rules and controls to prevent recurrence.
  
  
CI Remediation and Lifecycle Integrity: Eliminate duplicates, stale/orphaned CIs and shadow datasets; confirm operational status with owners, correct lifecycle states and retire records appropriately to keep the CMDB trustworthy.
  
  
Discovery and Integration Quality: Monitor source-specific exceptions across ServiceNow Discovery, AWS, Azure, Intune, Tanium, VMware, Qualys, Wiz, Claroty and other sources; investigate identification and load anomalies; validate data after changes and engage SMEs for complex fixes.
  
  
Service Mapping and Relationship Integrity: Assure the ongoing quality of maps for onboarded applications, identifying missing or broken relationships, stale dependencies and incorrect links; coordinate remediation with owners and track to closure.
  
  
CSDM and Modelling Compliance: Review Business/Application Services and infrastructure CIs against modelling standards; flag non-compliance and missing links; coordinate corrections while partnering with SMEs on design decisions.
  
  
Ownership, Certification and Governance: Validate CI ownership and support groups; coordinate periodic certification and attestations for CIs and service maps; track overdue actions, escalate through governance and retain evidence of completion.
  
  
Build and maintain dashboards and governance reports on CMDB health, ownership, certification, and mapping. Explain issues, root causes, and required actions clearly to collaborators and leadership.
  
  
Continuous Improvement and Automation: Identify recurring issues, recommend and operate automated classification, retirement and remediation controls; reduce manual effort and improve time-to-remediation.
  
  
**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data / Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in IT Service Management, CMDB, IT asset or configuration management, technology operations, data quality or technology data analysis.
* Practical experience with ServiceNow CMDB, CMDB Health and reporting, including CI classes, attributes and relationships.
* Understanding of ITIL Configuration, Asset, Change and Incident processes and data-quality principles: completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness/freshness.
* Experience analysing large configuration, asset or technology data sets, identifying trends, and remediating data-quality issues using profiling, de-duplication, normalisation and root-cause analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience developing operational reports and dashboards.
* Ability to collaborate across technology teams, drive stakeholder remediation and manage competing priorities independently.
* Clear written and verbal communication and documentation skills.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with CMDB 360, ServiceNow Data Manager, Certification and Predictive Intelligence.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, Service Graph Connectors, and IRE and reconciliation.
* SQL/querying and Power BI or equivalent reporting skills; basic scripting or workflow automation experience.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or CMDB micro-certifications.
* Experience in biopharmaceuticals, life sciences or another regulated environment.
* Experience working across cultures and time zones, including a Global Technology Centre operating model.
* Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, technology and science meet at scale to make a tangible difference for patients. You will join an inclusive, cross-functional community that pairs deep domain expertise with modern platforms, data and AI to remove friction, simplify processes and unlock speed across the enterprise. We back bold ideas with real investment, value kindness alongside ambition, and give you the ownership to experiment, learn and deliver lasting impact. Your contribution will improve how teams plan change, respond to incidents and protect critical services that keep our medicines moving to those who need them.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help

**Job Description**
**Primary Function:**
At Intuitive, our mission is to advance minimally invasive care through innovation. As a Supplier Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring suppliers can consistently deliver high-quality, innovative products that meet Intuitive's stringent quality, delivery, capacity, and cost requirements.
  
  
The Supplier Engineer serves as the technical interface between suppliers and internal cross-functional teams, including Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations. This role is responsible for supplier qualification, process validation, new product introduction (NPI), supplier performance improvement, and ongoing supplier development.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
*Supplier Development & Qualification*

* Assess, qualify, and develop suppliers to meet Intuitive's technical, quality, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Lead supplier manufacturing readiness activities for new products and process changes.
* Evaluate supplier processes, capacity, quality systems, and technical capabilities.
* Support supplier selection and sourcing activities through technical assessments and on-site audits.

*New Product Introduction (NPI)*

* Partner with Design Engineering and suppliers to support Design for Manufacturability (DFM) initiatives.
* Drive supplier readiness for product launches and scale-up activities.
* Ensure supplier qualification deliverables are completed on schedule, including:

+ Process Flow Diagrams
+ pFMEA
+ Control Plans
+ Process Capability Studies
+ First Article Inspection (FAI)
+ Measurement System Analysis (MSA)
+ PPQP/PPAP submissions

* Facilitate successful transfer from development to production.

Supplier Quality & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Monitor supplier performance against quality, delivery, cost, and capacity metrics.
* Lead supplier corrective action activities utilizing structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Drive root cause investigations and verify effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.
* Support supplier audits and quality system assessments.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects, improve process capability, and increase operational efficiency.

Technical Manufacturing Support
  
  

* Provide expertise in various manufacturing processes. SME in either Metals or Electronics is a plus.
* Review engineering drawings and specifications, including GD&T requirements.
* Identify manufacturing risks and implement mitigation strategies.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Manage supplier-related project plans, timelines, and risk mitigation activities.
* Coordinate with engineering, sourcing, quality, and operations teams to achieve project objectives.
* Present supplier performance, project status, and risk assessments to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
**Skills/Job Requirements:**
*Education*
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field.
  
  
**Experience**
5+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
  
  

* Supplier Engineering
* Manufacturing Engineering
* Supplier Quality Engineering
* Process Engineering
* New Product Introduction

*Technical Competencies*

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and supplier development.
* Experience with APQP, PPAP, PPQP, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and capability studies.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Experience conducting supplier audits and technical assessments.
* Structured problem-solving skills (5 Whys, Fishbone, CAPA, SCAR).
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or ISO 13485 quality systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in medical device, aerospace, robotics, or regulated manufacturing environments.
* Exposure to global supply chains and international supplier management.
* Project management experience with concurrent programs and multiple suppliers.
* Familiarity with machining, castings, and complex electromechanical assemblies.

*Travel*

* Ability to travel to suppliers (domestic and international) as needed: minimum 30%

*Key Success Metrics*

* On-time supplier qualification and NPI launches.
* Supplier quality performance and defect reduction.
* Supplier delivery and capacity readiness.
* Successful completion of PPQP/PPAP activities.
* Supplier risk reduction and business continuity improvements.
* Achievement of cost, quality, and operational improvement goals.

title: Plant Quality Inspector
description:
At Olystra Special Tools (a brand of Olympic Industrials), precision isn't a goal, it's a standard. We design and manufacture special service tools (SSTs) for the automotive industry, and we're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented Plant Quality Inspector to help us keep the product standard high.
  
  
Location: Vichoor, Chennai
  
Department: Quality
  
Designation: Quality Inspector
  
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech, Mechanical / Mechatronics
  
Experience: 2 to 5 years
  
  
**About the Role**
You'll inspect and verify the quality of special tools manufactured at our plant before dispatch, making sure every tool meets customer specifications, engineering drawings and internal quality standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
• Inspect finished tools before dispatch to confirm they meet customer requirements
  
• Interpret engineering drawings, dimensions, tolerances and technical specifications
  
• Perform dimensional and visual inspections using the right measuring instruments
  
• Verify tool functionality, assembly and workmanship before final approval
  
• Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists and dispatch quality documents
  
• Coordinate with Production and NPD teams to resolve quality issues
  
• Identify non-conformities and report deviations to the concerned departments
  
• Ensure corrective actions are implemented
  
• Support continuous improvement to enhance product quality and reduce defects
  
  
**Required Skills**
• Strong Mechanical Engineering fundamentals
  
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
  
• Knowledge of GD&T, dimensional tolerances and inspection methods
  
• Hands-on experience with Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, Bore Gauge and Dial Gauge
  
• Familiarity with 7 QC Tools, 5 Why Analysis and Root Cause Analysis
  
• Basic knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems
  
• Proficiency in MS Excel and quality documentation
  
  
**Added Advantage**
Experience in precision engineering, tooling or automotive manufacturing.
  
  
**Eligibility**
• B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics
  
• 2 to 5 years of experience in Quality Inspection within a manufacturing environment
  
• Male candidates preferred for the current vacancy requirement
  
  
**Why Join Olystra Special Tools?**
Work with a team committed to delivering precision-engineered tooling solutions that meet the expectations of leading automotive OEMs. Grow your career in a quality-driven manufacturing environment where your attention to detail truly matters.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Engineer –**
IT Factory - Python Data Engineer
  
  
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
We are looking for a python data engineer, to own the data foundation of the application. As every control result, every dashboard figure and every application screen reads from the curated data model you build and maintain. If the data is wrong, late or unexplained, nothing above it can be trusted.
  
  
The platform ingests from several enterprise sources into a raw layer that preserves exactly what each source sent and then transforms that into a curated model. You will build and operate the data pipelines, implement the reconciliation and data-quality checks that prove each load is complete, and extend the model as new controls and modules require it.
  
  
You will also implement the control rules themselves. These are written primarily as versioned SQL against the curated model, reviewed like application code, and executed by the controls engine. This is where data engineering meets the business purpose of the platform, and it is a significant part of the role.
  
  
This is not a pure pipeline role. You will also contribute to the application services, and you are expected to be able to pick up backend work when delivery requires it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ingestion pipelines — scheduled extraction from enterprise source systems into the raw layer, including change detection, load history and the recording of source data provenance.
* The curated data model — transformation from raw to a conformed, keyed and de-duplicated model of entitlements, applications, users and their relationships.
* Reconciliation and data quality — checks that prove each load is complete and consistent, with results written to an append-only evidence store and discrepancies raised rather than silently absorbed.
* Pipeline orchestration — scheduling, dependency management, retry and alerting, with a run history that can be interrogated when a question is asked about a past load.
* Control rules as code — the rule base for the control catalogue, written as versioned SQL with accompanying metadata, peer-reviewed and promoted through the same pipeline as application code.
* Reporting data layer — the curated views that the reporting dashboards consume, designed as a stable contract that survives changes to the underlying model.
* Backend services — contributing to the Python application services alongside the Technical Lead.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* SQL, at depth. This is the core of the role. Complex joins, aggregation, window functions, set operations; reading and acting on query plans; indexing and performance tuning on large tables. You should instinctively solve a data problem in SQL before reaching for application code.
* Relational data modelling. Designing schemas for analytical and operational use: keys, grain, slowly changing data, handling of deletions and deactivations in source systems. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Python for data engineering. Writing maintainable, tested Python for ETL — not notebooks. Experience with SQLAlchemy or a comparable toolkit, and with pandas or Polars for in-flight transformation.
* Pipeline construction and operation. Building pipelines that run unattended: idempotent loads, failure handling, retries, alerting and the ability to re-run a failed load safely.
* Data quality and reconciliation. Practical experience proving that a data load is complete and correct, and designing the controls that detect when it is not.
* Backend development. Sufficient experience building API services in Python — FastAPI, Django or Flask — to contribute to the application layer.
* Testing discipline. Automated tests for transformation logic. Experience with pytest.
* Version control. Disciplined use of Git and pull request review. Treating SQL and pipeline definitions as code, held in a repository rather than on a server.
* Communication in a distributed team. Clear written English, and the judgement to flag a data discrepancy rather than work around it.

**Nice To Have**

* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow in production, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, functional role codes, segregation of duties, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Reporting tools — Power BI, including semantic modelling and designing the views that sit behind a dashboard.
* Regulated-environment experience — working with personal or otherwise sensitive data under data-protection controls, including masking of non-production environments.
* Linux and CI/CD — comfortable deploying and troubleshooting on Linux servers with an automated pipeline.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. * 3+ years of experience hands on writing software for autonomy/robotics applications.

title: QA Test Engineer (Night Shift)
description:
Location: Gurgaon
  
  
Employment: India
  
  
Salary: Negotiable
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC)
* Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation according to the requirements, design and solutions
* Design, implement, and conduct test and evaluation procedures to ensure system requirements are met.
* Perform manual test execution (including, but not limited to: functional, regression and integration testing), identifying defects and conducting root cause analysis of the issues discovered.
* Thoroughly document defects with steps to reproduce and triage them through the defect lifecycle.
* Collaborate with product owners to develop an understanding of user stories and use cases to formulate test approaches, write test plans, and effectively analyze outcomes.
* Work within and across our customer service, development, and product teams to validate products and find new and interesting ways to break those products.
* Complete test preparation, including participation in peer reviews, test environment setup, identification of pre-conditions, and test plan documentation and review.
* Develop strategies on how best to automate tests for maximum efficiency and coverage then write and maintain test scripts using Selenium or similar tools.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement automated test tools and strategies. Develop, maintain, and upgrade automated test scripts and architectures for application products.
* Ensure product compliance with external software quality requirements, as needed.
* Write, implement, and report status for system test cases for testing.
* Generate quality metrics and reports with insight into the status and health of our products, including the logging or tracking of both manual and automated efforts.
* Review and collect feedback on test plans and test cases from the QA team and product owner(s) to allow the team to collectively assess use case and edge case coverage.
* Analyze test cases and provide regular progress reports.
* Serve as specialist providing testing know-how for the support of user requirements of complex to highly complex applications.
* Direct and/or participate in all phases of risk management assessments and software/hardware development with emphasis on analysis of user requirements, test design and test tools selection.
* Other duties as assigned

**Job Description**
We are looking for a seasoned and motivated QA Test Engineer with demonstrated 6-7 years of experience to provide Test Automation support. Candidates are expected to be focused and solution-oriented individuals who work well independently while working with a cross-functional team of experts. We want someone passionate and adept at running testing efforts to ensure product quality, learning and implementing new quality assurance (QA) activities and procedures, but we also need an innovative and flexible team member who will do what it takes to help us shape amazing products.
  
  
**Skills And Requirements**

* A BS degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
* Knowledge of or experience with test engineering methodology
* 6 or more years of specific testing experience required.
* Proven work experience in software quality assurance
* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes
* Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases
* Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing
* Hands-on experience with automated testing tools
* Solid knowledge of SQL and scripting
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
* Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus

**Additional Skills**

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, along with Zoho, Bitbucket, Jenkins and Git. Familiarity with common third-party APIs, Payment Gateways, etc.

Apply for this job
  
  
To apply, please send your resume and a cover letter to careers@moonpreneur.com (preferably in pdf format)

description:
**Description**
Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) — is one of Amazon's largest and fastest-growing businesses, operating across 8+ marketplaces (India, MENA, North America, EU, UK, Japan) and powering adjacent businesses like India Fresh and Healthcare. The platform handles >0.7MM orders/day, scaling to 2MM by year-end.
  
  
As an SDE2 on the Tez CX PIXEL team, you would work at the heart of Amazon Now's quick commerce platform. IXEL owns the end-to-end in-store shopping experience, from homepage and browse surfaces through personalization, live cart, single cart and checkout, deals and value surfacing, AI-driven merchandising, and geospatial CX.
  
  
The systems are Tier 1, serving 2,000+ TPS as the canonical worldwide platforms for shopping, ordering, and savings. The role directly impacts conversion, basket size, and checkout completion — the metrics that turn platform growth into revenue. The defining product shift ahead is the adaptive, agentic store — moving from a fixed storefront to one that intelligently composes itself around each customer's habits, context, and intent, making this a compelling charter for an SDE2 looking to drive high-impact, customer-facing systems at scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices.
* You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant.
* You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). Your solutions are pragmatic.
* You consider the legacy of the code you produce and write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand.
* You limit the use of short-term workarounds. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity).
* You create flexible software without over-engineering. You make appropriate trade-offs, re-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies.
* You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.)
* You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers

**About The Team**
We are fast-paced and focussed team made of passionate and ambitious Amazonians who strive to build industry leading products while closely collaborating and having fun. The team is made of multiple Sr. SDEs and are working on first time in Amazon initiatives which will scale beyond India and grocery. The team follows a flexible and collaborative work culture with ample mentoring and guidance from PEs. The team values high ownership, bias for action and insist on highest standards and follows build fast and iterate fast methodology. The team is suitable for passionate engineers who are equally interested in contributing to business and product roadmap.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 3+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI - Karnataka

title: BCM-CapitalMarket-BA-Senior-C2H
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description: Senior Technology Consultant – Capital Markets (Calypso Specialist)**
**Job Purpose:**

* Need to work as a Senior Technology Consultant in the capacity of Capital Market – Calypso Implementation Specialist in Capital Market core modernisation and migration projects.
* Should exhibit deep experience in financial services during the client discussions and be able to convince the client on the solution.

* Work Experience Requirements
* Functional Experience

+ 4 to 8 years of hands on experience in Capital Markets with strong exposure to Front to Back trade lifecycle.
+ Solid understanding of:

- Securities trading, settlements, confirmations, reconciliation, and clearing.
- Middle office processes including trade validation, enrichment, allocation, and reporting.
- Regulatory reporting and compliance across capital markets.

+ Demonstrates experience interacting with business stakeholders, product controllers, operations, and risk teams.
+ Prior exposure to transformation, modernization, or migration programs in Capital Markets.

* Technical Experience
* Strong implementation experience in Calypso, particularly Version 14+ (preferred), across:

+ System configuration in trading, static data, settlement, and middle office modules.
+ Workflow design and exception handling.
+ Integration with upstream and downstream systems.

* Hands on experience with:

+ Trade processing engines
+ Static and reference data frameworks
+ Interfaces, messaging standards (ISO15022/20022, FIX), and APIs

* Experience working in Agile environments and contributing to functional & technical design workshops.

**Mandatory Skills**
**Functional Skills**

* Calypso platform expertise, including:

+ Calypso Securities Instance (CSI)
+ Trade Representation & Processing
+ Static Data Configuration
+ Workflow creation & orchestration
+ Trade Validation & Enrichment logic
+ Loss & Claim Management module
+ Settlement Status Processing
+ Middle Office Reporting Framework
+ Block Allocation – Vinci SS1 enrichment
+ Archiving concepts and strategy

* Ability to write and analyze SQL queries.
* Good understanding of system integration, APIs (SOAP/REST), and messaging.
* Ability to interpret technical logs, troubleshoot issues, and guide development teams.
* Strong knowledge of financial instruments:

+ Equities, Fixed Income, FX, Listed & OTC Derivatives, Repos, and Structured Products.

* Understanding of:

+ Trade lifecycle from booking to settlement
+ Risk factors, pricing inputs, and PnL drivers
+ Collateral management fundamentals
+ Treasury and liquidity processes

* Experience in requirements gathering, gap analysis (OOTB vs. custom), and functional documentation.
* Exposure to Agile delivery models (Scrum/Kanban).

**Technical Skills**

* Application and Solution (workflow, interface) technical design.
* Business requirements, definition, analysis, and mapping.
* Understanding of technology landscape and providing system configuration design in Market, Static and Reference data.
* Knowledge of databases, infrastructure, application servers, Technical Architecture, Security and Performance management.
* Expertise in writing integration specifications and knowledge of Soap or Rest APIs.

**One or more of following Tech skill categories:**

* Database skills – Able to write SQL queries of moderate complexity,
* Programming/ Scripting skills: One of {Python, Java, C#} - able to write methods calling APIs
* Experience in Cloud and CI/CD (Devops Automation environment)
* Data Visualization – Dashboard analysis with Tableau, Power Bi

**Education And Experience**

* MBA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent degree.
* 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Capital Markets, preferably within banking, investment banking, or financial technology domains.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Automation Engineer
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Automation Engineering Manager
  
  
  
  
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
In this role, you will have the opportunity to support engineering activities in all types of project sizes and complexities, under the supervision of senior engineers. Each day, you will complete the tasks cost-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also showcase your knowledge by collecting data and supporting production of the engineering design.
  
  
The work model for the role is: - Onsite
  
  
This role is contributing to the machine automation within ABB's Automation division in
**Faridabad**
-India region. Main stakeholders include Customers, Application Engineering Team, Project Management Team, Testing & Commissioning Team, and Product Development Team.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Planning, monitoring, and executing application development tasks, including new product development, incremental modifications, and timely closure of assigned work.
* Providing technical support for testing, installation, commissioning, debugging, and diagnostics activities.
* Translating conceptual designs into detailed engineering documentation through modelling, prototyping, simulation, and calculations, while applying design thinking and best practices.
* Assisting in preparing engineering proposals and presentations and maintaining effective communication with customers and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Identifying and managing project risks/issues, ensuring compliance with organizational standards, and promoting teamwork, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical / Instrumentation / Automation or related discipline).
* Minimum 1-3 years of application development and support experience.
* Well-developed understanding of Industrial Automation systems like PLCs, motors, drives, motion control and robotic systems
* Demonstrable experience in building strong and enduring customer relationships within highly dynamic and competitive markets
* Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a global environment.
* Willing to travel for site support and commissioning as required.

**More about us:**
B&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics & Discrete Automation division.
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Warning
  
  
ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
  
  
View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home
  
  
For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Senior Automotive Software Developer - Android OS
description:
We are looking for an Android Lead Developer to own Android platform development and SoC integration for automotive infotainment systems. You will work across the Android Framework, native layers, HAL, kernel and board bring-up, lead complex technical topics from analysis through closure, and guide the team on design and debugging.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead development and customization of Android Framework and AOSP components for automotive platforms.
* Own Android/SoC topics independently and drive issues to closure.
* Develop and integrate Android HALs (AIDL/HIDL) and JNI layers.
* Handle Android BSP and SoC integration, including board bring-up.
* Integrate and validate SoC peripherals such as display, audio, camera, connectivity, USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and storage.
* Debug system-level issues across Application, Framework, Native, HAL and Kernel layers.
* Manage AOSP builds and customization using the Soong/Make build system.
* Work with Git, Gerrit and CI/CD pipelines for code management, review and delivery.
* Mentor team members and provide technical guidance on design and debugging.

**Required Skills**

**Android Platform**

* 6-8+ years of Android development experience, preferably in Automotive Android.
* Strong hands-on experience with Android Framework and AOSP.
* Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and automotive infotainment.
* Good understanding of Android architecture, system services and Binder IPC.
* Hands-on experience with the Android build system (Soong/Make) and AOSP customization.

**Programming**

* Strong Java/Kotlin and C/C++ programming skills.
* Experience with Android HAL (AIDL/HIDL) and JNI.

**BSP and Kernel**

* Experience in Android BSP / SoC integration and board bring-up.
* Good knowledge of the Linux Kernel, Device Tree and Android drivers.

**Peripheral Integration**

* Experience integrating display, audio, camera, connectivity, USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, storage or other SoC peripherals.

**Debugging and Tools**

* Strong Android system-level debugging using ADB, logcat, dumpsys, systrace/perfetto and similar tools.
* Experience with Git, Gerrit and CI/CD.

**Who You Are**

* You have deep Android platform and AOSP experience and are comfortable working from application layer down to kernel.
* You have hands-on experience with Android Automotive OS and automotive infotainment systems.
* You take ownership of complex Android/SoC problems and see them through to closure.
* You are a strong system-level debugger with sound analytical skills.
* You collaborate well with BSP, HAL, Framework, Application and Validation teams.

title: Integration Consultant
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Integration Consultant with strong enterprise application integration expertise to support the implementation of Adrenaline HCM and integrate it with various enterprise applications across GCC and other regions.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop and maintain inbound and outbound enterprise integrations.

Integrate HCM with ERP, Finance, Banking, Payroll, WPS and Attendance systems.

Build integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, Web Services, JSON, XML, CSV and SFTP.

Work with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SAP CPI or Azure Integration Services.

Strong SQL and database knowledge (Oracle / SQL Server).

Experience with OAuth 2.0, SAML, certificates and secure file transfers.

Excellent communication, analytical and troubleshooting skills.
