Experience integrating HCM/Payroll platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM or PeopleSoft.

GCC experience with WPS, banking and payroll integrations.

ERP integration experience with Oracle, SAP or Microsoft Dynamics.

Exposure to Azure AD / Entra ID and Single Sign-On (SSO).

Experience working with international teams across different time zones.

title: Product Owner - AI
description:
Join Barclays as a Product Owner - AI role, where you will be driving delivery of enterprise AI initiatives with strategic business impact. You'll collaborate with world-class engineers to develop cutting-edge technology while ensuring meaningful value is delivered safely and responsibly. Own the full product lifecycle from discovery through deployment, balancing innovation with governance in a complex, regulated environment. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.
  
  
**To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:**

* Manages senior stakeholder expectations and articulates product vision with clarity at executive level.
* Sets the strategic direction for AI capabilities, balancing complex competing priorities to shape use cases that deliver measurable value.
* Converts business strategy into technical roadmaps, aligning engineering teams around shared priorities.
* Leads enterprise-scale product delivery through agile frameworks (Scrum and Kanban), with a record of driving outcomes across complex organizations.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**

* Brings strong familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and their AI/ML service offerings to inform enterprise technology strategy.
* Combines product management, business analysis, and technical domain expertise to guide investment and delivery decisions.
* Has led enterprise agile transformations, building capability and coaching leadership teams through organizational change.
* Has navigated regulated environments, establishing governance frameworks that manage risk while enabling technology change at pace.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Bengaluru and Pune office.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Product Owner II - Data
description:
The Data & Analytics Product Owner translates data and analytics strategy into clear, prioritized, and executable work that delivers measurable customer and business value. This role owns day-to-day execution for assigned data products and capabilities, partnering with Product Management, Data Engineering, Analytics, Architecture, and business stakeholders to move work from discovery through delivery and adoption.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own day-to-day execution of assigned data and analytics roadmap priorities from discovery and requirements through delivery, validation, and release.
* Partner with Product Manager to translate strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into executable data and analytics capabilities.
* Own backlog quality, prioritization, and readiness, ensuring epics and stories are clearly defined, appropriately sequenced, and ready for delivery.
* Confirm business definitions, source-system expectations, metric logic, data grain, edge cases, and acceptance criteria with appropriate stakeholders before development begins.
* Serve as a consistent coordination point across geographically distributed Product, Data, Analytics, and Engineering teams, maintaining clear decisions, requirements, handoffs, and delivery status across time zones.
* Maintain clear documentation of product decisions, assumptions, unresolved questions, business rules, and requirement changes throughout delivery
* Own backlog refinement and delivery discussions, ensuring teams understand what is being built, why it matters, and how success will be measured.
* Evaluate new requests and requirement changes against committed scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery impact; escalate trade-offs when appropriate.
* Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, analytical needs, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* Monitor adoption and performance of released capabilities and identify opportunities to improve usability, trust, scalability, and value.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4+ years of experience in product ownership, product analysis, business analysis, data products, analytics, or a similar role.
* Experience translating complex business and analytical needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to understand datasets and validate requirements or results.
* Experience working with modern data platforms, data warehouses, business intelligence tools, or analytics products.
* Understanding of core data concepts including data models, dimensions and measures, data grain, transformations, data quality, refresh cadence, and access controls.
* Experience working across Product, Data Engineering, Analytics, Architecture, QA, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, ambiguity, dependencies, and cross-functional delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with urgent care, ambulatory care, physician billing, professional claims, or multi-location healthcare organizations.
* Familiarity with agentic AI systems, MCP (Model Context Protocol), retrieval-augmented generation, or similar AI orchestration frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform.
* Experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics platforms.
* Experience with semantic layers, governed metrics, reusable data models, or self-service analytics.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

title: Category Manager
description:
**Category Manager – Travel Business**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
6–12 years

**About Thrillophilia**

Thrillophilia is one of India’s leading experiential travel platforms, helping millions of travellers discover and book curated holidays and experiences across India and international destinations.

We are building destination-led travel businesses where each category is managed with clear ownership across product, pricing, suppliers, marketing, sales, customer experience, revenue, and profitability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

This is not a procurement-only or operations-only role.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

A strong Category Manager should be able to say:

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**What You Will Own**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Create clear product USPs that make the category easier to sell and harder to replicate.
* Ensure the product portfolio serves different customer segments, budgets, and travel styles.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality suppliers, hotels, DMCs, transport partners, and experience providers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.
* Ensure the sales team has the right products, pricing, and information to close effectively.

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, CRM, and Brand teams.
* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

**Customer Experience**

* Track customer feedback, NPS, complaints, cancellations, and service failures.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.
* Identify recurring issues and fix them at the product or supplier level.
* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in category management, business ownership, travel product management, P&L management, or a related role.
* Experience in travel, consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, hospitality, or a high-growth business.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, margins, pricing, and profitability.
* Ability to analyse market demand and translate insights into products and business decisions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
* High ownership and comfort working across multiple teams.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience owning a destination, category, geography, or business line.
* Experience in outbound or domestic holiday packages.
* Exposure to sales-led or high-consideration customer journeys.
* Experience managing both product and commercial outcomes.
* MBA or equivalent business education is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Category revenue
* Contribution margin and profitability
* Booking conversion
* Product performance
* Supplier competitiveness
* Customer satisfaction and NPS
* Cancellation and refund rates
* Sales productivity
* New product success

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Leucine And Celestara**
**12 of the top 15 generic pharma companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.**
Leucine builds AI-powered software that helps pharmaceutical manufacturers stay compliant, audit-ready and productive, so medicines reach patients faster. Manufacturing, QA and QC teams use Leucine across thousands of regulated workflows, from material receipt to batch release, for small molecules, biologics, vaccines and more.
  
  
Celestara is our platform for building and running those solutions: data pipelines, agnotology that models the customer's operations, agentic workflows and applications on top.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will sit with our customers, understand how their work really gets done, and turn their highest-value problems into live solutions on Celestara. You own each use case end to end: from discovery and business case, through design and build, to UAT, go-live in production, and then its adoption, maintenance and ongoing iteration.
  
  
This is a hybrid role. Think product manager, solution architect and hands-on builder in one person, working inside the customer's four walls rather than from a distance. Most of our customers are in pharma, but you do not need prior pharma experience. We care far more about curiosity, empathy for users and the ability to learn a new domain fast.
  
  
**Location - India and United States, deployed on-site at customer locations**
**What You'll Do**

* Understand the problem
* Embed with customer teams on the shop floor, in QA/QC labs and in offices; shadow users and learn how work actually happens
* Run discovery workshops and interviews; build empathy for users' pain points, constraints and incentives
* Produce clear as-is process maps: steps, roles, hand-offs, systems, data sources and where time, cost and errors pile up
* Build the business case
* Run ROI assessments: baseline current effort, cycle time, error and rework rates, and quantify the value of the future state
* Prioritise use cases with the customer by value, feasibility and time to impact
* Reimagine the solution on Celestara
* Design the to-be process and solution in the context of the platform, not as a one-off workaround
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data sources and transformation pipelines, ontology and data model, agentic workflows, application screens and user journeys, integrations and access controls
* Write crisp specs and user stories; make trade-offs and say no when scope does not serve the outcome
* Deliver from UAT to production
* Configure and build on Celestara, hands-on, working with our product and engineering teams for anything new
* Plan and run UAT with customer users; triage feedback, fix issues and drive sign-off
* Lead go-live, hypercare and adoption; measure the outcomes against the ROI baseline
* Support validation and documentation needed in a regulated environment, with help from our domain experts
* Own the use case after go-live
* Drive adoption: train users, track usage and close the gaps that stop people from relying on the solution
* Maintain the use case in production: monitor pipelines, workflows and agents, resolve issues and manage changes under the customer's change-control process
* Iterate continuously: gather feedback, measure impact against the ROI baseline and ship improvements release after release
* Be the voice of the customer
* Feed field insights back to product: patterns across customers, gaps in the platform, ideas for reusable components and templates
* Build trusted relationships with users, process owners and senior stakeholders; identify the next use cases to expand into

**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Customer and problem obsession**
. You listen first, ask sharp questions and can explain a user's problem better than they can.
  
  
**Product thinking.**
Experience as a product manager, solutions consultant, business analyst or similar; you can go from a messy problem to a prioritised, well-specified solution.
  
  
**Process and value analysis.**
You have done as-is/to-be process mapping and can build a credible ROI or business case with real numbers.
  
  
**Technical fluency.**
You already understand, or can quickly learn, how modern data and AI platforms fit together:
  
  

* data integration, transformation and pipelines (ETL/ELT)
* data modelling and ontologies (entities, relationships, semantics)
* agentic and LLM-powered workflows, automation and orchestration
* application design: user journeys, screens, roles and permissions
* APIs and enterprise system integration

**Hands-on builder.**
Comfortable configuring a platform, writing SQL, and scripting (e.g. Python) to get things working; you do not wait for someone else to build.
  
  
**Delivery ownership.**
You have taken work through UAT and into production and stayed accountable for adoption and outcomes.
  
  
**Communication.**
Clear written and verbal English; equally at ease with an operator on the floor and a VP in a steering committee.
  
  
**Ready to be on the ground.**
Willing to be deployed at customer sites in India or the US and travel as needed.
  
  
**Fast learner**
. Comfortable picking up a complex, regulated domain like pharma manufacturing and quality. No prior pharma knowledge required.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or implementation lead at an enterprise SaaS, data or AI platform company
* Exposure to platforms built on ontologies or semantic layers, or to low-code/no-code application builders
* Hands-on work with LLMs, prompt design, RAG or agent frameworks
* Background in manufacturing, life sciences, quality or other regulated industries (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, CSV/CSA)
* An engineering, computer science, data or operations degree, or equivalent experience
* 3-8 years experience (indicative; strong builders with less are welcome)

**Benefits**
**What success looks like**

* By 30 days - Learned Celestara hands-on, shadowed a live deployment and grasped the basics of pharma manufacturing and quality workflows
* By 90 days - Owned discovery for a customer use case: as-is map, ROI case and a Celestara solution design the customer has signed off
* By 180 - days Taken at least one use case through UAT into production, with measurable adoption and impact, and identified the next use cases with that customer

**Why join**

* Real impact. Your work helps medicines get made right and reach patients faster. Ownership. You own outcomes, not tickets, with direct access to customers, product and leadership
* Breadth. Product, data, AI and operations in one role; a fast track into product leadership, solution architecture or customer leadership
* Frontier tech in the real world. Put agentic AI and ontology-driven applications into production in one of the most demanding industries

**Other Benefits**

* Market leading compensation + uncapped variable
* Opportunity for fast-track growth & leadership
* Work with a purpose-driven, global team transforming an essential industry
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Product Line Management III
description:
**Who We Are**
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
**Experience**

* Demonstrated experience in component obsolescence management, project or product management, component engineering, engineering change management, inventory management, planning, change control, and/or manufacturing operations.
* Hands-on experience working with semiconductor manufacturing equipment and associated systems and components.
* Strong knowledge of parts and components used in semiconductor equipment, including an understanding of their basic functions, applications, interfaces, and impact on equipment performance.
* Strong engineering mindset with the ability to interpret technical data, engineering analysis, qualification results, and field performance data to support sound business and technical decisions.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and coordinate effectively with Engineering, Quality, Safety, Component Engineering, Supply Chain, Materials, Field Support, and other stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex issues, evaluate risks and trade-offs, and drive timely solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to define strategy, scope, qualification requirements, and execution plans for new or replacement parts, while building organizational alignment around the proposed approach.
* Strong organizational and project management capabilities, including maintaining clear project status, qualification documentation, decision records, risk assessments, and technical data packages.

**Requirements**

* Strong knowledge and practical experience in product lifecycle analysis, Product Change Notification (PCN), component obsolescence management, and supply chain management.
* Proven problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to proactively identify risks, develop solution options, and drive decisions aligned with organizational priorities and business requirements.
* Experience in project and/or program management, including cross-functional planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Good understanding of Bill of Material (BOM) structures, component relationships, product configurations, and change impacts.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions across cross-functional organizations, including situations where direct authority may be limited.
* Working knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, with the ability to analyze data and communicate complex information clearly.
* Detail-oriented with strong analytical, prioritization, and multitasking skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with component engineering and lifecycle-management tools such as Silicon Expert, or equivalent platforms.
* Working knowledge of SAP, ERP, and/or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems.
* Strong technical foundation in electrical, mechanical, materials engineering, or a related discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**
Component Obsolescence & Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Perform comprehensive technical, supply chain, and business assessments for incoming and ongoing obsolescence projects, including review of SPS, ATOM, historical shipments, forecasted demand, part usage, material availability, inventory position, and projected stock-out dates.
* Develop and execute component obsolescence and lifecycle strategies that balance supply continuity, technical requirements, customer expectations, cost, inventory exposure, and implementation risk.
* Own and execute component roadmaps covering part obsolescence, replacement parts, alternate suppliers, redesigns, qualification requirements, and cost-reduction opportunities.
* Proactively identify lifecycle and supply risks and develop mitigation plans to minimize potential impact to manufacturing, installed-base support, and customer commitments.

Qualification & Change Implementation
  
  

* Define the strategy, scope, qualification plan, resources, milestones, and implementation approach for replacement and newly qualified parts.
* Lead cross-functional teams through technical evaluation, onsite qualification, approval, and implementation, ensuring actions and deliverables are completed according to plan.
* Manage the cut-in/change implementation process, including readiness reviews, material transition, stakeholder alignment, and post-implementation monitoring.
* Monitor field performance following implementation and coordinate corrective actions when performance, quality, reliability, or customer issues are identified.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the central point of coordination across Engineering, Quality, Safety, Component Engineering, Field Support, Materials, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, escalation paths, and communication mechanisms to drive projects to completion.
* Facilitate cross-functional decision-making and build consensus on complex technical, supply, cost, and customer-related issues.
* Maintain accurate and organized project plans, status reports, technical data packages, qualification records, risks, decisions, and action items.

Product & Common Module Roadmap
  
  

* Own the common-module roadmap and implementation activities following Phase 5 of ePLC, ensuring lifecycle, cost, supply, and product requirements remain aligned.
* Facilitate intercompany and cross-business-unit alignment on product and component strategies, product roadmaps, market proliferation, pricing guidance, spare-level content, and restricted-part ordering.
* Drive alignment between product strategy and component lifecycle plans to support long-term product availability, serviceability, and cost competitiveness.

Cost & Supply Chain Management
  
  

* Develop and execute cost-reduction roadmaps in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain, Commodity Management, and other functional teams.
* Identify opportunities involving alternate suppliers, component redesign, part substitutions, standardization, and sourcing strategies while ensuring technical, quality, and reliability requirements are maintained.
* Manage strategic supplier issues, coordinating cross-functional teams to address supply continuity, quality, capacity, cost, lifecycle, and technical risks.
* Evaluate trade-offs among cost, inventory, qualification investment, customer impact, and supply continuity to support fact-based business decisions.

**Functional Knowledge**

* Demonstrates strong conceptual and practical expertise within the discipline, with working knowledge of related areas such as component engineering, product lifecycle management, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, materials, and field support.
* Applies technical and business knowledge to evaluate component lifecycle risks, qualification requirements, supply constraints, and implementation strategies.

**Business Expertise**

* Understands industry best practices and how the function integrates with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Product Management, and customer-facing organizations.
* Understands key business drivers including cost, supply continuity, inventory, quality, product lifecycle, customer commitments, and time-to-implementation.
* Maintains awareness of market, supplier, and competitive factors that may influence product and component strategies.

**Leadership**

* Serves as a subject-matter resource and trusted partner for colleagues and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Leads complex cross-functional projects with defined resource requirements, dependencies, risks, and business objectives.
* Drives accountability across functional boundaries and influences decisions without relying solely on direct authority.
* Provides guidance to less-experienced team members and promotes consistent processes and best practices.

**Problem Solving**

* Solves complex, cross-functional technical and business problems by integrating multiple sources of information and evaluating technical, supply, cost, schedule, and customer impacts.
* Takes a fresh perspective on existing solutions and identifies alternatives when traditional approaches are insufficient.
* Exercises sound judgment under time constraints and makes data-driven recommendations with clearly understood risks and trade-offs.

**Impact**

* Influences a broad range of customers, operational, supply chain, cost, product lifecycle, and project outcomes across multiple teams.
* Drives successful execution of component transitions and lifecycle strategies while minimizing supply disruption, customer impact, excess inventory, and business risk.
* Contributes to improvements in product availability, cost competitiveness, operational efficiency, and long-term serviceability.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Communicates complex, technical, and sensitive information clearly and effectively to stakeholders at different organizational levels.
* Builds productive relationships across functional and organizational boundaries.
* Effectively facilitates discussions involving competing priorities and works to build consensus, resolve conflicts, and drive timely decisions.

**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 10% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
No

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Product Manager for AI at GE Vernova plays a crucial role in the development and execution of AI-powered products that transform business processes. This role is essential to our mission of pioneering AI-driven innovation and enhancing user experiences across the enterprise.
  
  
The Product Manager will work with across GE Vernova and with the AI Portfolio Manager to identify, prioritize and build out AI products. These products (several) focus on delivering improvements and value through the lens of the Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) framework, measuring the impact of AI initiatives.
  
  
Additionally, the Product Manager facilitates cross-business coordination, leveraging AI applications to drive operational improvements and foster innovation across Vernova. Expertise in AI, combined with strong business acumen, is pivotal in translating complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities that propel the organization forward. These duties extend to not only internally developed solutions, but also to external suppliers (e.g. 3rd party software).
  
  
As a GE Vernova accelerator, GE Vernova Advanced Research is driving strategy and leading research & development efforts to execute on the business’s mission to help power the energy transition. We forge the collaborations and help invent the technologies required to electrify and decarbonize for a zero-carbon future.
  
  
Representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline, our researchers are collaborating with GE Vernova’s businesses, the U.S. government, and more than 420 entities at the forefront of technology to execute on 150+ energy-focused projects. Collectively, these research programs and initiatives aim to solve near term technical challenges, deliver next generation product advances, and drive long term breakthrough innovation to enable more affordable, reliable, sustainable, and secure energy.
  
  
**Job Description**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Product Ownership and Development: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business, engineering, and research, to develop and execute product roadmaps that align with strategic objectives.
* Roadmap input: Provide input, alongside the Portfolio manager, to build the product roadmaps
* Technical Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists, IT, and designers to ensure the development of robust AI solutions, maintaining technical rigor and introducing new methods for verifying success and identifying risks.
* User Experience: Focus on delivering exceptional user experiences by understanding and addressing user needs in AI applications.
* Cross-Business Coordination: Support the coordination of AI applications to drive improvements and innovations across Vernova.
* Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize data analytics to measure product performance and make informed decisions. Define and monitor metrics and KPIs to ensure the success and impact of AI initiatives.
* Post-Launch Support: Monitor product performance post-launch, gather user feedback, and iterate on product features to enhance value delivery.
* 3rd party solutions: Oversee the interjection of AI products coming from 3rd party software suppliers and determine best technology fit.

**Position Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience with GE/GE Vernova highly preferred.
* Business Acumen: Ability to integrate business strategy with technical initiatives.
* Leadership: Proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and projects.
* Communication Skills: Excellent communication and presentation skills to engage with diverse stakeholders and occasionally C-Suite executives.
* Experience building and deploying AI applications.
* Problem-Solving Skills: Analytical skills to identify and solve risks and challenges.
* Technical Proficiency and Data-Driven Mindset

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Product Manager - II
description:
**We are looking for someone who has built consumer-facing products, brings strong analytical depth, has worked on data-heavy problem spaces, has built AI-first products and personalisation experiences, and can solve complex product problems through structured thinking and workflows. Candidates from Tier 1 institutes such as IITs, BITS, NITs, and IIMs are strongly preferred.**
**About The Role**
As Product Manager - II at ShopDeck, you will work closely with the Founder and Leadership team to build AI-first products that help Indian D2C sellers operate and grow their businesses more effectively. You will own complex seller problems end-to-end from understanding user pain points and defining product strategy to shipping solutions, driving adoption, and delivering measurable business impact.
  
  
This is not a conventional product role focused only on writing PRDs, managing backlogs, or coordinating feature delivery. It is a high-ownership mandate for someone who can identify the right problem, use data and customer insights to make decisions, work closely with Engineering and Design, and stay accountable for the business outcome after launch.
  
  
The role will involve building AI-native and workflow-led products across seller management, business automation, growth, conversion, onboarding, and operational efficiency. You should be equally comfortable speaking with sellers, analysing funnels, designing experiments, challenging technical possibilities, and driving execution in an ambiguous environment.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on product management experience in an e commerce, marketplace, consumer-tech, or B2B SaaS company. Experience building AI powered products, agentic workflows, seller-facing platforms, growth products, or products designed for Indian SMBs will be a strong advantage.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Product Strategy & Problem Discovery
* AI-First Product Development
* Seller Experience, E-commerce & Growth
* Product Execution
* Cross-Functional Leadership

**Experience & Background**

* 3 – 6 years of total experience, including at least 2+ years of hands-on product

management experience.
  
  

* Tier - 1 Pedigree (IIT's, BIT's, NIT's & IIM's)
* Experience independently owning a significant product, customer journey, or business

charter from discovery through measurable impact.
  
  

* Experience in an e-commerce, marketplace, consumer-tech, or B2B SaaS company.
* Strong preference for candidates who have built products for merchants, sellers,

SMBs, business users, or large-scale Indian consumer segments.
  
  

* Experience with one or more of the following:
* AI products, AI agents, LLM-based experiences, or intelligent workflow

automation
  
  

* Seller, merchant, or business-management products
* B2B SaaS platforms and operational workflows
* Growth, acquisition, activation, conversion, or retention products
* Checkout, discovery, decision-to-buy, or transaction journeys
* CRM, onboarding, reporting, or process-automation products
* Strong analytical capability, including practical experience with SQL, product

analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, and experimentation.
  
  

* Demonstrated success in improving metrics such as conversion, retention, adoption,

revenue, GMV, customer satisfaction, or operational efficiency.
  
  

* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams in a fast-moving

product environment.
  
  

* A strong academic background from a leading engineering, technology, or

management institution is preferred.
  
  

* Prior experience in companies such as Meesho, Flipkart, Amazon, Razorpay, CARS24,

Zomato, Swiggy, Urban Company, GoKwik, Chargebee, Freshworks, Cogoport, or similar
  
  
product-led businesses will be relevant.
  
  
**Skills & Mindset**

* Problem-First Thinking – Starts by identifying and validating the real customer or

business problem before proposing a feature.
  
  

* Customer Obsession – Builds a deep understanding of sellers and remains close to

their actual workflows and pain points.
  
  

* Business Ownership – Connects product work to GMV, revenue, conversion, retention,

cost, or seller success—not just feature delivery.
  
  

* AI-First Thinking – Recognises where AI can materially improve a workflow and

distinguishes meaningful applications from superficial additions.
  
  

* Product Judgment – Makes sound prioritisation and experience decisions despite

imperfect information and competing demands.
  
  

* Analytical Depth – Uses data to identify problems, form hypotheses, measure impact,

and understand trade-offs.
  
  

* Experimentation Mindset – Runs structured tests, learns quickly, and changes

direction when evidence does not support the original hypothesis.
  
  

* Execution Ownership – Takes responsibility from problem discovery through launch,

adoption, iteration, and final business impact.
  
  

* Technical Fluency – Works effectively with Engineering and understands technical

constraints without needing to be an engineer.
  
  

* Structured Communication – Communicates complex problems and decisions clearly

through writing, data, and logical reasoning.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Influence – Aligns multiple teams around shared outcomes without

depending on hierarchy.
  
  

* Startup Agility – Operates effectively with ambiguity, limited structure, evolving

priorities, and tight timelines.
  
  

* Bias for Action – Moves quickly from insight to experiment while maintaining clarity

on the expected outcome.
  
  

* High Standards – Challenges weak assumptions, incomplete thinking, and low-quality

execution while remaining pragmatic about speed.
  
  
**At ShopDeck, You'll**

* Build AI-First Products: Create AI-powered products and agentic workflows that

solve real operating and growth problems for Indian D2C sellers.
  
  

* Own Meaningful Business Outcomes: Work on products directly connected to seller

growth, GMV, conversion, retention, and operational efficiency.
  
  

* Partner with Leadership: Work closely with the Founders and Product leadership on

ShopDeck's product strategy and most important business problems.
  
  

* Build from Zero to One: Discover new opportunities, validate ideas, launch products,

and build repeatable product systems from the ground up.
  
  

* Operate at Scale: Build for a diverse base of Indian sellers with different levels of

business and technology maturity.
  
  

* Work Across Functions: Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth, Sales,

and Operations to deliver complete outcomes.
  
  

* Own Outcomes, Not Outputs: Be accountable for product adoption and business

impact—not simply the number of features shipped.
  
  

* Shape the Product Culture: Raise the bar for product thinking, experimentation,

customer understanding, execution, and written clarity at ShopDeck.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate closely with senior leaders to shape a dynamic product strategy that solves for user problems, business and partner objectives. This role will require you to define the commerce experience on JioHotstar across multiple categories that enables users to get inspired and transact without disrupting their content watching experience. You will also be required to look at the commerce funnel and identify innovative ways to grow the conversion. We are very early in our commerce journey and growing rapidly. Come join this rocketship!
  
  
**About the Team:**
JioHotstar is embarking on a journey to grow Content Commerce on the platform. We believe that there is true value to be unlocked for our large user base by building inspiration, consideration and transactions all while watching their favourite content. We have traditionally had 2 monetisation channels: Advertising and Subscriptions. This team intends to work with our partners and build commerce as the third monetisation channel.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct thorough research and analysis to generate actionable insights and determine ROI
* Translate abstract problem statements into clear requirements by assessing market trends and shifts
* Influence roadmaps within and outside the functional area to enhance the overall ecosystem
* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, contributing to roadmaps and prioritization beyond the immediate domain
* Show agility in responding to external signals, enabling swift roadmap adjustments, and ensuring transparent communication of impacts
* Take ownership of at least one key KPI that directly aligns with Product Objectives and Key Results
* Develop deep expertise in at least one functional area, driving strategic advancements through innovation and transformation
* Actively participate in team-building initiatives, including contributing to hiring processes

Skills and attributes for success:
  
  

* Communicate clearly and effectively, with precise articulation and logical progression of ideas
* Apply structured frameworks and logical thinking to address complex problems, asking the right questions for deeper understanding
* Demonstrate a diverse range of ideas and prioritize effectively, focusing on the end outcomes
* Leverage a data-driven mindset to derive insights from metrics and make well-informed product decisions
* Show strong user empathy, using structured problem-solving to address pain points through hypothesis-building and solution development
* Benchmark competitors and validate findings through experimentation, maintaining high standards for product roadmap inclusion
* Confidently tackle ambiguous problems with minimal supervision, taking decisive action across the organization
* Foster a collaborative, respectful work environment, open to feedback, while mentoring junior PMs to success and effectively influencing without formal authority

Preferred education and experience:
  
  

* Bachelors/Masters degree or equivalent preferred. Overall 4-6 years of experience in building scalable consumer products

Perched at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, as well as overseeing the end-to-end product lifecycle. The ideal
  
  
candidate will have a deep understanding of data-related technologies, experience in SaaS product management, and a

title: Research Analyst (Product)
description:
**About the company:**

India's first social distribution AI fintech platform for the underserved aspirational middle-class- delivering Secured & Unsecured loans, Insurance, and Investment products across 5,000+ small cities of India (referred as India-2). Founded in 2019, WeRize is at an annualized-run-rate of $60 Mn (Gross revenues) and $32Mn (Net) and $7Mn+ of net profits before taxes (3x Y-o-Y growth) with ROE > 20%. We are projecting ~2x growth in topline and ~3x growth in profits over the next 12 months.

WeRize operates as a “category creator” three-sided marketplace connecting 17,000+ trained local freelancers with India-2 customers and partner financial institutions, all powered by a full-stack AI operating layer that creates a “flywheel of trust” with self-reinforcing network effects.

* **Distributor trust:**
  Freelancers are empowered through AI-led tools that help them act in the long-term best interests of their customers.
* **Customer trust:**
  End customers rely on WeRize’s assisted distributor, data-driven recommendations across both asset and liability products
* **Manufacturer trust:**
  Financial Institutions rely on WeRize’s data, risk management and distribution intelligence to reach small city customers that they can’t serve on their own.

**Key highlights: What do we do**

1. **Large, underpenetrated market opportunity:**
   India’s 300Mn+ aspirational middle-class captures ~30% of GDP, yet remains financially underserved across credit, insurance, and investments. Pure-digital models lack the required trust, while physical branches are economically unviable.
2. **Differentiated, asset-light social distribution:**
   WeRize leverages 17,000+ financially literate freelancers across 5,000+ small cities. This branchless, zero-sales-team model delivers high-trust human touchpoints, superb unit economics, and strong freelancer retention through a broad product suite.
3. **Proprietary AI driven tech stack:**
   Trained on 20Bn+ data points across 4Mn+ households, WeRize’s AI powers end-to-end operations. For distribution, it optimizes lead gen, selling, and engagement—turning freelancers into professional advisors. For manufacturing, it sharpens risk management, underwriting, and product structuring for high-margin expansion.

To know more about the company, please visit: https://www.werize.com/

**Role Overview:**

The Product & Research Analyst serves as the strategic bridge connecting our clients, product team, and marketing group. In this client-facing role, you will interact directly with customers to gather primary market intelligence, analyze user engagement, and identify performance gaps. Drawing on your hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms, you will synthesize raw client feedback into actionable data, driving cross-functional alignment and continuous product enhancement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct direct interviews, surveys, and feedback sessions with clients to gather qualitative and quantitative research data.
* Analyze customer usage patterns and engagement metrics using platforms like WebEngage, MoEngage, or Braze to identify gaps between client expectations and product capabilities .
* Synthesize raw user feedback and analytics into structured insights, business requirements, and feature requests for the Product and Marketing teams.
* Act as a core liaison between Clients, Product Managers, and Marketing/Tech teams to ensure roadmap priorities align with market needs.
* Serve as a product representative in client interactions, clearly communicating value, feature updates, and upcoming enhancements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience: 1–3 years of experience in product research, product analysis, or business analysis, ideally within a tech or product-based company.
* Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience using customer engagement platforms such as WebEngage, MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, or equivalent tools.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with both Product and Marketing teams to align strategies and bridge operational gaps.
* Client & Research Expertise: Demonstrated track record of direct client interaction, primary research, and user feedback collection.
* Communication & Synthesis: Strong active listening skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business insights for both internal and external stakeholders.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

Are you looking to be in a role where you can have a significant impact on the company’s growth and success?
  
  
Does the prospect of making the most pragmatic technical decisions, which will drastically shape the future of the products excite you?
  
  
Are you someone who takes immense pride in building excellent products for customers that are technically designed for scalability and extensibility, and just work all the time?
  
  
If you answered yes to these, come join us!
  
  
The HR Products organization is looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager to join the team which owns one of the most critical and strategic product lines for Rippling - Employment Products which is among the most foundational products of Rippling. The areas of ownership for this role will require you to be a key owner of our Global Expansion efforts, which comes with high visibility and growth opportunities. * Product Development Experience: Hands-on experience building scalable products end-to-end. Should have been closely involved in defining and delivering both small and large-scale projects.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, both within India and globally. Strong collaboration and coordination skills are essential.
* Execution-Driven: Should be execution-oriented with a clear understanding of how to set up roadmaps, define milestones, and drive outcomes.

* Communication Skills: Clear and effective communication is a must, especially when working with distributed teams and stakeholders.

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Senior Manager - Business Growth
description:
**About GoKwik**

GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, powering 15,000+ merchants globally. With a mission to democratise the shopping experience, GoKwik leverages technology, data, and AI to help brands maximise conversions, improve customer experience, and drive profitable growth. Its suite of solutions spans checkout, payments, customer engagement, performance marketing, shipping, and returns, enabling brands to optimise every stage of the customer journey.

**Why This Role Matters**

At GoKwik, we don't just power the growth of D2C brands; we also manage the end-to-end business operations of select brands, driving their growth, profitability, and long-term success.

As a Senior Manager - Business Growth, you will take complete ownership of the business performance and P&L of the brands you manage. You will work closely with brand founders, GoKwik's leadership, and cross-functional teams to define growth strategies, drive execution, and build scalable operating models.

Beyond managing individual brands, you will play a pivotal role in developing a repeatable business playbook that will enable GoKwik to onboard and scale multiple D2C brands.

**What You’ll Own**

**1. Business Strategy & P&L Ownership**

* Own the overall D2C business P&L, including revenue, gross margins, CAC, contribution margins, and cash flows.
* Develop annual operating plans, quarterly business targets, and growth strategies in collaboration with brand founders and GoKwik leadership.
* Identify growth opportunities across categories, pricing, hero SKUs, new product launches, and channel mix.
* Drive monthly business reviews, identifying opportunities to scale, optimise, or discontinue initiatives.

**2. Growth Strategy & Performance Marketing**

* Define customer acquisition strategies and marketing budgets across Meta, Google, influencers, and affiliate channels.
* Drive performance against key metrics such as ROAS, CAC, and new customer acquisition.
* Plan and execute seasonal campaigns and large-scale sale events, including forecasting, execution, and performance analysis.
* Drive customer retention and lifetime value through CRM, WhatsApp marketing, loyalty programmes, and subscriptions.

**3. Website Performance & Conversion Optimisation**

* Own the end-to-end D2C website funnel, tracking traffic, conversion rates, AOV, checkout success, and RTO.
* Identify and prioritise opportunities to improve product pages, bundles, offers, and checkout experiences in collaboration with GoKwik's product teams.
* Optimise COD and prepaid payment mix to drive order growth while maintaining healthy RTO levels.

**4. Business Operations & Supply Chain**

* Work closely with brand teams on demand forecasting, inventory planning, and new product launch timelines.
* Monitor fulfilment efficiency, delivery timelines, returns, and customer support metrics.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and drive improvements through root-cause analysis and cross-functional execution.

**5. Business Analytics & Performance Management**

* Build and maintain business dashboards and metric frameworks covering the entire funnel, from traffic and acquisition to contribution margins.
* Conduct detailed analysis across customer cohorts, SKUs, channels, and campaigns to identify growth opportunities.
* Establish and drive a structured weekly business review cadence across marketing, operations, customer experience, and agency partners.
* Translate business data into actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.

**6. Multi-Brand Strategy & Business Expansion**

* Build and document scalable operating playbooks covering business diagnostics, 90-day growth plans, dashboards, and team structures.
* Evaluate prospective D2C brands through business diagnostics, opportunity assessments, and business case development.
* Lead the onboarding and growth of new brands as GoKwik expands its managed brand portfolio.
* Over time, build and manage a team of brand managers to drive business performance across multiple brands.

**7. Stakeholder & Leadership Management**

* Act as the primary business partner for brand founders, ensuring alignment on business priorities, strategies, and performance.
* Collaborate with internal product, data, marketing, and operations teams to drive business outcomes.
* Present business performance, strategic recommendations, and key trade-offs to GoKwik leadership.

**Who You Are**

* MBA from a premier institute such as IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR, or an equivalent global business school.
* 2–4 years of post-MBA experience in management consulting, preferably with MBB firms, Big 4 strategy practices, or reputed boutique strategy consulting firms. Pre-MBA experience will be an added advantage.
* Strong structured problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down complex business challenges, identify root causes, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Strong understanding of P&L, business metrics, and unit economics, with hands-on experience building financial models using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Strong bias for action, with the ability to translate strategies into execution, experiment, measure outcomes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Comfortable taking end-to-end accountability for business performance and driving outcomes rather than limiting responsibilities to strategy and recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and align founders, agencies, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
* Thrives in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments and is comfortable building processes and operating models from the ground up.

**Why GoKwik**

At GoKwik, you'll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, commerce, and business strategy. You will get the ownership to build and scale businesses, work directly with founders and leadership teams, and create operating models that shape how GoKwik manages and grows its D2C brand portfolio. If you enjoy solving complex business challenges, driving execution, and building something from the ground up, GoKwik offers an opportunity to make a meaningful business impact.

title: North Star Market Implementation Programme Manager
description:
**Job title:**
**North Star Market Implementation Programme Manager**

* Digital Platforms in IWPB is responsible for the core Mobile and Browser based platforms to meet the everyday banking needs of HSBC Wealth & Personal Banking’s customer base. Supporting markets across the world and up to 20m customer daily, the team is focussed on three key platforms: 1) Mobile Platform; 2) Dynamic Experience Platform; and 3) Security as a Platform. The Change Execution team within Digital Platforms drives the delivery of incremental and strategic change across four value stream structures – Mobile Channel Experience, Digital Authentication & Identity, Mobile & Web Enablers and Messaging & Content. The team is seeking an Implementation Programme manager to work across the value streams on complex, multi capability, multi market change – the role holder will work with value stream and sub-value stream delivery leads, market based digital teams, GTC and supporting function to shape and deliver these change programmes effectively.

In addition to strong change delivery skills (through prior experience in large, complex change programmes), the programme is seeking a candidate with strong core consulting skills (prior consulting experience – internal or external - is a definite advantage). It should be noted that this is a substantive role driving complex delivery in multiple markets simultaneously – the role holder should have similar experience within HSBC or a similarly matrixed organisation.
  
  
**Key Areas Of Focus Are**

* Own the Digital Platforms Change Execution strategy, target operating model, standards and portfolio priorities.
* Accountable for the mobilisation, delivery, recovery and adoption of major, complex, multi-market transformation programmes.
* Own the integrated portfolio view, including delivery sequencing, market congestion, cross-programme dependencies, resource prioritisation and transformation risk.
* Translate Digital Platforms strategy and investment into executable roadmaps, measurable outcomes, benefits and key performance indicators.
* Lead executive governance and provide clear recommendations, credible challenge and decisive intervention on scope, funding, sequencing, readiness and risk.
* Establish consistent, scalable and reusable approaches for programme execution, market implementation and sustainable change adoption.
* Determine the optimum deployment of Change Adoption, Implementation Programme Management and Market Activation capacity across strategic priorities.
* Build and lead a high-performing, geographically distributed team of senior change and programme leaders, with wider stewardship of aligned virtual resources.
* Represent Digital Platforms Change Adoption and Change Execution at senior leadership, governance and decision-making forums.
* Build the organisational capability, community and culture required to execute complex change consistently and at scale.
* This is a senior enterprise leadership role requiring significant strategic judgement, broad organisational influence and direct accountability for customer, colleague, financial, operational and reputational outcomes.

**Principal Accountabilities: key activities and decision making areas**
**Impact on the Business/Function**
**People**

* Ensure effective governance structures are in place across markets, this will include facilitation of key forums, with quality/timely material preparation. Forums will include the Steering Committees, regular working groups and ad hoc Senior Executives Forums.
* Deliver Programme level reporting, devise programme plans and make delivery related interventions which may include re-planning and re-prioritization.
* Establish Change controls: To ensure deliveries are in line with HSBC’s risk appetite and change standards. The role-holder will be expected to establish effective controls, procedures and quality assurance processes; including driving the adoption of HSBC change standards and working in alignment with HSBC project methodology at all times.
* Contribute to the uplift of delivery excellence across IWPB Digital Platforms by being an active participant in the guild model which seeks to drive cross value stream and cross functional best practice

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* Excellent stakeholder management skills
* Passionate about customer experience and engagement
* Cost management and budget tracking
* Strong strategy, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Experience translating business strategy and analysis into consumer facing digital products.
* Team leadership & people management skills
* Strong thought leadership and influencing skills.

**To Be Successful You Will**
**Certifications, Qualifications & Experience**
(For the Job – not the Job holder. Minimum requirements of the Job) Data driven in their decision making and prioritisation. Experience in building real time dashboards to better manage programme delivery and/or programme outcomes is an advantage

+ Significant experience (12 years plus) defining and leading complex change programmes in a highly matrixed environment
+ Proven ability to shape change from the start, including business case definition, establishment of governance structures, definition of change approach and movement of programmes from initiation into delivery. Experience in reshaping and remediating failing programmes is a distinct advantage
+ A polished and confident communicator with experience working with a broad range of senior stakeholders – equally confident in written and verbal communication

title: Senior Manager - Strategy & Growth
description:
**About GoKwik**

GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping merchants drive higher conversions, improve customer experiences and accelerate business growth. With a strong presence across India, the UK, Europe and the US, GoKwik works with 15,000+ merchants and processes over $2 billion in annual GMV.

**Why This Role Matters**

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Strategy & Growth to work closely with the Business Head of KwikEngage and drive the overall business agenda. This is a high-ownership role that combines business strategy, financial analysis and cross-functional execution.

You will be responsible for understanding business performance, identifying the biggest growth opportunities, translating them into actionable priorities and ensuring execution across teams. You will act as a strategic partner to the Business Head, helping drive key business decisions while ensuring that critical initiatives move forward without constant leadership intervention.

This role is ideal for someone who can go beyond analysing business problems and take ownership of driving solutions through execution.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Business Performance & P&L Management**

* Closely track the KwikEngage P&L, including revenue, contribution margins, channel costs and overall business performance.
* Monitor merchant acquisition, movement, retention and churn trends to identify business opportunities and potential risks.
* Analyse business metrics regularly, identify performance gaps and proactively highlight areas requiring intervention.
* Build a strong understanding of the key drivers impacting business growth and profitability.

**2. Strategy & Growth Initiatives**

* Identify and prioritise 3–5 high-impact business initiatives every quarter based on business performance and growth opportunities.
* Translate business priorities into structured action plans with clear ownership, measurable outcomes and timelines.
* Drive strategic initiatives around revenue growth, contribution margin improvement, pricing, customer retention and business expansion.
* Evaluate new business opportunities, product bets and competitive developments to support strategic decision-making.

**3. Cross-functional Execution**

* Drive execution of key initiatives across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing teams.
* Work with functional stakeholders to establish accountability, track progress and resolve execution bottlenecks.
* Ensure key business priorities are delivered within agreed timelines and translate into measurable business outcomes.
* Take ownership of follow-ups and closure of critical action items without requiring constant intervention from the Business Head.

**4. Business Reviews & Operating Rhythm**

* Own the weekly business review cadence, ensuring business performance, priorities and execution progress are consistently tracked.
* Build dashboards and performance trackers to monitor key business metrics and strategic initiatives.
* Identify deviations from business plans and work with relevant stakeholders to drive corrective actions.
* Establish structured review mechanisms to improve visibility, accountability and execution across teams.

**5. Business Analysis & Decision Support**

* Conduct detailed business analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks and areas of improvement.
* Prepare structured business recommendations, decision memos and presentations for the Business Head and leadership.
* Evaluate different business scenarios and provide data-backed recommendations on strategic decisions.
* Support leadership discussions around pricing changes, new product opportunities, competitive responses and business expansion.

**6. Special Projects & Strategic Priorities**

* Lead high-impact strategic projects that may not fall within the ownership of any single function.
* Drive initiatives related to business transformation, operational efficiency and revenue or margin improvement.
* Support the development of leadership and board-level business narratives, strategic updates and business reviews.
* Take ownership of emerging business priorities and drive them from problem identification to successful execution.

**Who You Are**

* 3–5 years of overall professional experience, with at least 1–2 years in a Chief of Staff, Founder's Office or Business Head's Office role.
* Experience working closely with a senior business leader who owns a P&L or business function.
* Ability to break down complex business problems, identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable business priorities.
* Proven experience driving cross-functional initiatives and getting things done through teams that do not directly report to you.
* Strong understanding of P&L, revenue drivers, contribution margins and business performance metrics.
* Comfortable working with data and independently extracting insights using SQL, Metabase or similar BI tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create crisp business presentations, decision memos and leadership updates.
* Ability to take end-to-end responsibility for initiatives, manage multiple priorities and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

**Why GoKwik**

At GoKwik, you will get the opportunity to work closely with business leadership and influence the growth trajectory of a rapidly scaling business. This role offers end-to-end exposure to business strategy, financial performance, product, sales and operations, giving you the opportunity to work on decisions that directly impact business outcomes. If you enjoy solving complex problems, taking ownership and turning ideas into measurable results, this is an opportunity to build towards larger business leadership and P&L responsibilities.

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset

****Hybrid Working****

Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. ****Equal Opportunities****
