title: AFC Technology – Data and/or Records Specialist, AVP
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: AFC Technology – Data and/or Records Specialist**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Bangalore, India**
**Role Description**

* The Compliance and Anti-Financial Crime (C-AFC) Divisional Data Office (DDO) sits within Anti-Financial-Crime (AFC) Technology – a 1000-person organization responsible for :€90m annual change book of work across London and Bangalore to align with our businesses.
* The key responsibility for the C-AFC DDO is to partner with the C-AFC functions to deliver data and platforms to cover a wide range of Compliance and Financial Crime Risk Controls, including Transaction Monitoring, Trade Surveillance, Employee Compliance, Name List Screening, Transaction Screening and others.
* Reporting within theC-AFC Data Office, you lead complex data transformation and governance initiatives across C-AFC, driving strategic outcomes across data management, controls, lineage, data quality and regulatory remediation. Act as a senior advisor to business, technology and data leaders, shaping solutions and influencing delivery across multiple programmes. A key element of your role will be to support the build and management of the delivery function across C-AFC DDO.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Delivery of data initiatives: Manage the end-to-end delivery of defined data management, governance and transformation workstreams, ensuring agreed scope, milestones, dependencies and outcomes are clearly understood and delivered.
* Planning and coordination: Develop and maintain delivery plans, coordinate activities across business, technology, data and change teams, and support the prioritisation and sequencing of work.
* Business analysis: Analyse business and regulatory requirements, document current-state processes, identify gaps and translate requirements into practical process, control, data or technology solutions.
* Analysis and problem solving: Apply deep analytical thinking to complex data, governance and delivery challenges, breaking down ambiguous problems, identifying root causes, assessing options and developing pragmatic, evidence-based solutions.
* Data governance implementation: Support the implementation and ongoing operation of data governance requirements across data ownership, metadata, Critical Data Elements, data lineage, data quality and controls.
* Regulatory and audit delivery: Contribute to regulatory, audit and remediation initiatives by coordinating deliverables, maintaining clear evidence and supporting the development of sustainable processes and controls.
* Risk and issue management: Proactively identify and assess delivery risks, issues and dependencies; maintain appropriate logs; drive actions to resolution; and escalate material matters promptly.
* Governance and reporting: Produce accurate, concise and decision-focused management information, status reports, governance materials and executive presentations.
* Stakeholder engagement: Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across C-AFC, Technology, the Chief Data Office and data-producing divisions, managing expectations and facilitating timely decisions.
* Process improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and improve data management and delivery processes, contributing to more efficient and sustainable ways of working.
* Team contribution: Provide guidance and quality review to junior colleagues, share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, disciplined and high-performing delivery culture.

These activities ensure support ensuring the data required by C-AFC is complete, accurate and timely to support effective operation of controls to mitigate Compliance & Financial Crime risks.
  
  
**Your Skills And Experience**

* Relevant experience: 5+ years’ experience delivering data, governance, regulatory or transformation initiatives within financial services or another highly regulated environment; experience in Compliance and/or Anti-Financial Crime is desirable.
* Project and change delivery: Proven ability to manage defined projects or workstreams through the full delivery lifecycle, including planning, dependency management, governance, risk management and reporting.
* Data management knowledge: Strong understanding of data governance and data management principles, including data ownership, metadata, Critical Data Elements, lineage, data quality and control frameworks – ideally as they relate to Compliance and/or Anti-Financial Crime.
* Business analysis: Strong capability in requirements gathering, process mapping, gap analysis, problem definition and the development of clear business and functional requirements.
* Stakeholder management: Demonstrated ability to build productive relationships, coordinate across cross-functional teams and constructively challenge stakeholders where required.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving: Strong analytical and critical-thinking capability, with the ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems, identify root causes, challenge assumptions, connect issues across data, process and technology, and develop pragmatic, evidence-based solutions.
* Governance and reporting: Experience preparing high-quality management information, governance packs, status reports, action logs and executive-level presentations.
* Data tools and technologies: Familiarity with data governance, data quality, analytics or visualisation tools such as Collibra and Tableau is desirable.
* Regulatory awareness: Understanding of regulatory remediation – especially as it relates to Compliance and/or Anti-Financial Crime, audit evidence and control environments, with a focus on traceability, accuracy and sustainable outcomes.
* Organisation and execution: Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail and deliver high-quality work to agreed deadlines with limited supervision.
* Teamwork and development: Collaborative working style, willingness to share knowledge and experience supporting or mentoring more junior colleagues.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
  
  
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Manager - Onboard Experience Performance and Tech Integration
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
Delta's Onboard Experience organization is transforming how customers experience food, beverage, amenities, and digital capabilities across the travel journey. The Manager, Onboard Experience Performance & Technology Integration, will own the analytics, performance measurement, and technology integration capabilities that support decision-making and enable the successful delivery of onboard experiences across the portfolio.
  
  
This role will partner closely with leaders and teams in Atlanta to drive the integration of business processes, data, and technology platforms; evolve analytics capabilities; and deliver actionable insights that inform strategic priorities and business decisions.
  
  
Success in this role requires a balance of technical expertise, business acumen, and stakeholder influence. The ideal candidate can move seamlessly between technology strategy, data architecture, reporting and analytics, business process optimization, executive storytelling, and cross-functional leadership to drive measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field.
* 14+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, reporting, data strategy, or related disciplines.
* 5+ years of experience in a people leadership role.
* Advanced SQL proficiency and experience developing scalable reporting, dashboard, and analytical solutions.
* Experience with Python and data automation, transformation, and analytics workflows.
* Demonstrated experience designing and managing reporting ecosystems, KPI frameworks, and performance measurement solutions.
* Experience integrating multiple data sources and translating complex data into actionable business insights.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality management, and reporting best practices.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and strategic recommendations.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong communication and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to present insights and recommendations to senior leaders.
* Ability to balance strategic priorities with operational execution in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to champion a collaborative environment by empowering team members, demonstrating resilience, being inclusive and building a culture of trust.
* Ability to build and sustain robust networks across internal and external stakeholders.
* Being a coach/mentor/advisor to drive continuous team development and growth.
* Use systemic thinking to drive business results and strategic decisions that enhance organizational outcomes.
* Ability to advocate for customer-focused innovations, model empathy in decision-making, inspiring others to approach problems from the customer’s perspective and decisions that reflect an uncompromising commitment to customer safety, fostering trust and loyalty.

**What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience with AWS, cloud-based analytics environments, and modern data platforms.
* Experience in airline, hospitality, retail, customer experience, or operational analytics.
* Experience supporting digital products, technology implementations, or product analytics.
* Experience developing executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, and performance measurement systems.
* Experience with AI-enabled analytics, predictive modeling, sentiment analysis, or customer insights.
* Experience working in global, highly cross-functional organizations.

**About The Company**
What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service.
  
  
Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good.
  
  
In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience.
  
  
**About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore**
The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com
  
  
**Why join?**

* Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience.
* Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs –exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships.
* Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture.
* Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions.
* Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Benefits and Perks to Help You Keep Climbing**
**Analytics Strategy & Business Performance**

* Define and drive the roadmap for Onboard Experience analytics capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Establish performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, and reporting methodologies that support informed decision-making.
* Identify emerging trends, risks, and opportunities through analysis of customer, operational, financial, and technology data.
* Translate complex business challenges into analytical approaches that drive actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes.

**Data & Reporting Infrastructure**

* Own the evolution of reporting environments, analytical tools, dashboards, and data assets supporting the Onboard Experience portfolio.
* Partner with enterprise technology and data teams to improve data accessibility, scalability, reliability, and governance.
* Lead efforts to automate reporting processes, modernize analytical capabilities, and expand self-service reporting solutions.
* Establish standards for data quality, reporting consistency, documentation, and analytical best practices.

**Technology Integration & Product Analytics**

* Serve as the lead for Onboard Experience technology initiatives, including Menu Management System (MMS), Pre-Select, Buy Before You Fly, Digital Menu Builder, and future platform enhancements.
* Define success metrics, reporting requirements, and measurement strategies throughout the technology lifecycle.
* Evaluate technology performance and business impact, providing recommendations that inform future enhancements and investment decisions.
* Ensure data and reporting requirements are incorporated into technology design, testing, implementation, and optimization efforts.

**Insights & Executive Decision Support**

* Lead development of executive reporting, scorecards, dashboards, and business reviews.
* Synthesize quantitative data, customer feedback, operational insights, and business context into compelling narratives.
* Deliver clear, data-driven recommendations that influence strategic priorities and leadership decision-making.
* Support long-term planning through forecasting, scenario analysis, and performance modeling.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Influence**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across Customer Experience, Digital, Commercial, and Operations organizations.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives that improve analytical capabilities, reporting effectiveness, and organizational decision-making.
* Influence priorities and align stakeholders around key business objectives, measurement approaches, and performance outcomes.
* Represent Onboard Experience in enterprise analytics, technology, and data governance forums.

title: Fund Accounting and Administration Product Owner - Insurance Accounting, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are seeking a
**business Product Owner**
to support the Insurance Accounting product within State Street’s Fund Accounting and Administration platform. This role represents accounting, operational, regulatory, and client needs within the product and serves as the business authority for assigned functional areas.
  
  
This is
**not a technical product owner role**
. While the position partners closely with technology and development teams, accountability is focused on
**business requirements, accounting logic, client outcomes, and regulatory compliance**
, rather than system architecture or technical solution design.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Product Owner plays a critical role in ensuring that product enhancements accurately reflect insurance and investment accounting requirements and deliver meaningful value to clients. By acting as the voice of the business, this role ensures solutions are fit for purpose, compliant, and aligned with product strategy, while enabling efficient and effective delivery through agile development teams.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As the Product Owner, you will act as the
**business lead and subject matter expert**
for assigned product areas. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Serving as the primary business authority for insurance accounting functionality and related reporting
* Acting as the key business lead on product initiatives and enhancements
* Communicating directly with clients and internal stakeholders to understand needs, priorities, and impacts
* Leading business analysis and functional design efforts; creating clear business design documents and requirements
* Defining accounting ledger entries, multi-cost basis behavior, and accounting outcomes for enhancements
* Designing reporting solutions
* Translating business and accounting requirements into well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria
* Providing business use cases and functional testing scenarios
* Executing high-level and functional testing to validate accounting accuracy and business outcomes
* Overseeing delivery of enhancements through iterative planning, prioritizing business value and client impact
* Partnering with development, product management, and other stakeholders to support prioritization and backlog management
* Providing input into product roadmaps and longer-term functional direction
* Creating and maintaining user documentation
* Delivering training sessions and product demonstrations for internal teams and current or prospective clients
* Supporting software maintenance and client service teams with business-level troubleshooting, as needed
* Assisting onboarding teams and clients with conversions and implementations, as needed

**What We Value**
The following skills and attributes will help you succeed in this role:
  
  

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Deep analytical and research capabilities
* Sound accounting judgment and attention to financial details
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and initiatives simultaneously
* Clear and effective communication with a wide range of stakeholders
* Strong presentation and written communication skills
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools (Copilot, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field
* 10+ years of experience as a business product owner or end user of insurance, fund accounting, or financial software

**OR**
10+ years of experience as a
**business analyst or business product owner**
supporting financial or accounting platforms
  
  

* Strong experience with insurance accounting and/or investment accounting, including complex asset classes (e.g., fixed income, derivatives, mortgage loans, alternative investments)
* Knowledge of inbound and outbound data flows across the investment lifecycle (e.g., trade processing, cash, market data)
* Experience working within an agile software development environment as a business product owner or business analyst
* Experience working directly with clients
* Experienced with AI tools and implementing into daily use cases

*This role does not require hands-on software development, system architecture design, or technical solution ownership.*
**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
  
  
**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
  
  
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
  
  
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced PMO Manager - Finance & Accounting to lead our finance transformation efforts within our Global Shared Services organization. This important position is based in Bangalore and will focus on the global e-invoicing rollout and its impact on operations and processes. You will work closely with AP Operations, Billing Operations, Indirect Tax, and other global collaborators, ensuring smooth project delivery and operational readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Management & Execution: Lead and coordinate large-scale, cross-functional projects, managing timelines, achievements, dependencies, risks, and partner alignment to ensure successful delivery.
* E-Invoicing Transformation: Lead and coordinate international e-invoicing deployment activities from a project management perspective, working closely with Tax, Regulatory, and Technology teams to ensure regulatory requirements and changes are appropriately translated into project plans, system implementations, processes, and controls.
* Work together with the teams to understand business requirements, assess operational impacts, support development, testing and deployment, and ensure a smooth transition to standard operations.
* Cross-Functional Teamwork: Work closely with internal and external collaborators to align business, regulatory, and technical requirements.
* Governance & Change Management: Guarantee efficient project governance, problem-solving, communication with partners, and operational preparedness during implementation.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong PMO / Project Management Expertise: Consistent track record of independently driving complex, cross-functional projects in a global environment, with strong execution, governance, and collaborator management skills.
* Finance & Accounting Knowledge: Solid understanding of accounting processes.
* Communication & Collaboration: Proven ability to collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones, effectively managing priorities and getting results in multinational environments.
* Action-Focused Attitude: Proactive, structured, and hands-on approach, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to drive progress independently.
* Familiarity with the global e-invoicing landscape, including key regulatory requirements, implementation approaches, and their impact on accounting operations, would be an advantage.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Accounting, Finance, or a related field required. Professional qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent certification, is a plus.
* Project management qualifications, certifications, or relevant training
* Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience, including demonstrated ownership of complex cross-functional projects.
* Experience with ERP systems (SAP or equivalent) and project management tools.
* Prior involvement in global e-invoicing projects is highly desirable.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer (Python, Go)**

**Department:** Engineering  
**Role:** Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)  
**Specialization:** Applied AI, Full-Stack Engineering & Systems Integration  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Model:** Remote / Hybrid

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineer who can work closely with customers and internal teams to understand business problems, design technical solutions, and deliver production-ready software.

This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, and customer-facing technical implementation.

You will be responsible for translating loosely defined business requirements into working applications, integrating existing systems and third-party APIs, automating workflows, and deploying solutions into production environments.

The ideal candidate is a versatile engineer comfortable working across the full technology stack, making architectural decisions, troubleshooting infrastructure, and adapting quickly to unfamiliar technologies.

Rather than focusing exclusively on building isolated software components, you will own problems end-to-end — from understanding the requirements to implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.

Key Responsibilities1. Customer Engineering & Solution Development

* Work directly with customers and stakeholders to understand business workflows, technical constraints, and operational challenges.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve existing workflows.
* Build prototypes and proof-of-concept applications to validate proposed solutions.
* Develop customized software solutions using existing platforms, APIs, and frameworks.
* Own technical delivery from initial discovery through production deployment.

2. Full-Stack Application Development

* Design and develop web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies.
* Build REST APIs, backend services, and asynchronous processing workflows.
* Develop responsive interfaces and interactive dashboards.
* Integrate third-party services, APIs, and content management systems.
* Design and manage relational databases, data models, and application storage.
* Evaluate architectural trade-offs between monolithic applications, microservices, and lightweight serverless solutions.
* Maintain and improve existing applications while minimizing unnecessary infrastructure complexity.

3. Applied AI & LLM Integration

* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into business applications using commercial and open-source APIs.
* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for knowledge retrieval and contextual information processing.
* Build AI-powered automation workflows for document processing, content analysis, monitoring, and summarization.
* Integrate AI capabilities into existing applications through APIs and reusable services.
* Evaluate model performance, response quality, latency, and operational costs.
* Implement appropriate validation, error handling, and fallback mechanisms for AI-powered workflows.
* Experiment with agentic workflows and AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity.

4. Infrastructure & Deployment

* Provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and other hosting platforms.
* Containerize applications using Docker and manage deployment environments.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated application deployment.
* Manage Linux-based servers, networking, application processes, and system services.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform.
* Implement monitoring, logging, backup, and recovery mechanisms.
* Troubleshoot production issues and improve application reliability.
* Optimize infrastructure costs and operational overhead.

5. System Integration & Automation

* Integrate disparate business systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and custom connectors.
* Build automation scripts and lightweight services to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
* Work with databases, CMS platforms, spreadsheets, and external data sources.
* Develop data extraction and processing workflows.
* Build internal tools that improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate existing software platforms before deciding whether custom development is necessary.

6. Technical Ownership & Collaboration

* Take ownership of assigned technical projects and deliver working solutions independently.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, customer success teams, and other engineers.
* Communicate technical decisions and implementation trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document application architecture, deployment procedures, and integration workflows.
* Identify technical risks early and propose practical solutions.
* Balance implementation speed, maintainability, reliability, and business requirements.

Required Technical Skills

**Programming Languages**

* Strong proficiency in Python or another backend programming language.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases.
* Familiarity with shell scripting and Linux environments.

**Backend Development**

* Experience building APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Django, or equivalent.
* Understanding of REST architecture, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, SQLite, or similar databases.

**Frontend Development**

* Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Svelte, or Vue.
* Experience building responsive web applications.
* Understanding of component-based architecture and frontend-backend integration.

**Applied AI**

* Experience integrating LLM APIs into software applications.
* Understanding of embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-powered automation.
* Ability to evaluate and troubleshoot LLM-based application workflows.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Experience deploying and maintaining applications on Linux servers or cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
* Exposure to infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

**Engineering Practices**

* Git-based development workflows.
* Debugging and production troubleshooting.
* API integration and documentation.
* Application architecture and technical documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working in customer-facing engineering or implementation roles.
* Experience building internal tools and custom business applications.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with Nix or other declarative environment management tools.
* Familiarity with vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, or Chroma.
* Experience with browser automation tools such as Playwright.
* Understanding of data visualization and dashboard development.
* Familiarity with agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development environments.
* Experience working independently in remote or distributed engineering teams.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate:

* Thinks in terms of problems and outcomes rather than being restricted to a particular technology stack.
* Can independently investigate unfamiliar systems and integrate them into working solutions.
* Is comfortable moving between frontend, backend, infrastructure, and AI integration tasks.
* Understands the practical challenges of deploying and maintaining production applications.
* Can work with incomplete requirements and turn ambiguity into actionable technical plans.
* Prefers pragmatic engineering solutions over unnecessary complexity.
* Communicates effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Takes ownership of solutions beyond writing code.

Success Metrics

Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:

* **Solution delivery:** Ability to translate business requirements into functional, deployed applications.
* **Integration effectiveness:** Successful integration of third-party services, APIs, and existing systems.
* **Engineering quality:** Maintainable, reliable, and appropriately architected solutions.
* **AI implementation:** Practical adoption of AI capabilities that improve business workflows.
* **Operational ownership:** Ability to deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain production systems.
* **Customer impact:** Measurable improvements in efficiency, automation, and operational processes.

Example Projects

Projects undertaken in this role may include:

* Building an AI-powered knowledge assistant using RAG and internal business documents.
* Automating data extraction and processing across multiple business platforms.
* Developing custom ERP, inventory, and operational management applications.
* Building automated website monitoring and AI-powered change summarization systems.
* Integrating existing CMS platforms with custom frontend applications.
* Developing internal dashboards and reporting tools.
* Deploying containerized applications with automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Building AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive administrative tasks.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate degree or equivalent practical experience is an advantage.
* Demonstrable project experience and the ability to deliver working software are highly valued.

### **Job Title**

Global Product Marketing Manager-DXR

### **Job Description**

**Global Product Marketing Manager-DXR**

  

In this role, you will own and drive product marketing for the assigned Diagnostic X-ray (DXR) portfolio, shaping product positioning, value propositions and go-to-market strategies across the product lifecycle. Translate customer, clinical and competitive insights into compelling product narratives, effective sales enablement and market activation strategies that drive portfolio growth and commercial success.

Strong business acumen with the ability to translate customer, clinical and competitive insights into compelling value propositions and growth opportunities.

title: Senior Manager, Product Management, Technical
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you energized by defining product strategy in ambiguous spaces and building teams that deliver meaningful results at scale? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Product Management - Technical to lead a product management organization at Amazon. In this role, you will own the strategic vision and multi-year roadmap for a product portfolio that directly impacts how customers experience Amazon's technology. You will set direction in environments where the problem and opportunity may not yet be fully defined, translating complex inputs from customers and stakeholders into a clear, actionable product strategy. Your work will span system design, roadmap prioritization, and cross-functional alignment — all while building and developing a high-performing team of product managers and leaders.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Define and communicate the long-term product vision and strategy for your portfolio, working backward from customer needs to identify problems worth solving and aligning your roadmap to organizational goals.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product managers and people leaders, setting the standard for talent development, onboarding, and performance management across your organization.
* Drive clarity in ambiguous problem spaces by decomposing complex challenges into actionable plans, distinguishing reversible from irreversible decisions, and making informed trade-offs across opportunity, resources, and sustainability.
* Partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable technical solutions, integrating generative AI and emerging technologies where they accelerate customer value.
* Establish mechanisms to inspect product quality, operational performance, and customer experience, using data to continuously improve outcomes and communicate progress to senior leadership.

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing a product narrative ahead of a leadership review, sharpening the strategy with your team before presenting to senior stakeholders. Mid-morning, you join a roadmap prioritization session with engineering and science partners, working through trade-offs on upcoming launches. After lunch, you hold a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their career growth and coach them through a challenging stakeholder alignment. Later, you evaluate a proof-of-concept for a new AI-driven feature, assessing feasibility and customer impact before wrapping up with a cross-team sync to unblock a dependency.  
  
About the team  
Our team builds technology products that serve Amazon customers at scale. We operate in a collaborative, inclusive environment where product leaders are empowered to define strategy, experiment with new approaches, and drive meaningful business outcomes. We value thoughtful debate, clear written communication, and a genuine commitment to growing the people around us. We are focused on solving complex problems through innovation and are investing in areas like intelligent automation and generative AI to shape the future of our products. If you are excited about building both great products and great teams, we would love to hear from you.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6+ years of team management experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

title: VP, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**

**VP, Product Management**
==========================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Vice President, Product Management**  
  
**Cornerstone OnDemand | Executive Leadership**
  
  
**About Cornerstone**
  
  
Cornerstone helps organizations unlock the potential of their people through technology, content, expertise and specialized focus. Its solutions span learning, talent management, performance, recruiting and workforce development, serving millions of users across thousands of organizations worldwide.
  
  
Cornerstone is embarking on a transformative journey to build WorkforceOS, a next-generation, AI-native Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that unifies the employee lifecycle into a single, intelligent operating system for the modern workforce.
  
  
WorkforceOS will connect employee data, skills intelligence, learning, performance, talent and workforce capabilities to help organizations make smarter workforce decisions, develop their people and build the capabilities needed for the future.
  
  
**About the Opportunity:**
  
  
We are seeking a Vice President, Product Management to be a founding member of the WorkforceOS leadership team.
  
  
This is an opportunity to shape and lead the product strategy for a new generation of enterprise HCM software. You will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for WorkforceOS, translating market opportunities, customer needs and emerging AI capabilities into a differentiated product offering.
  
  
You will build and lead a high-performing global Product Management organization, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to bring the vision to life.
  
  
As a key member of the WorkforceOS leadership team, you will partner directly with the GM to define the product's strategic direction, establish its market positioning and drive its commercial success.
  
  
Beyond WorkforceOS, you will work closely with GMs and product leaders across Cornerstone's business lines to identify strategic opportunities, drive portfolio alignment and create synergies across the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.
  
  
This role requires a combination of product vision, strong execution discipline, customer obsession, commercial acumen and the ability to build a product organization from the ground up.
  
  
**In this role you will...**

1.Product Vision & Strategy
  
  

* Define and own the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for WorkforceOS, aligned with the overall business strategy and growth objectives.

  

* Shape the evolution of WorkforceOS into a unified, AI-native HCM platform connecting the employee lifecycle, workforce data, skills intelligence and organizational capabilities.

  

* Identify opportunities to differentiate WorkforceOS in the competitive HCM landscape through innovation, simplicity, intelligence and superior customer experiences.

  

* Translate market insights, customer needs, competitive intelligence and emerging technology trends into clear product strategies and investment priorities.

  

* Drive a platform-first product philosophy, balancing foundational capabilities, reusable services and differentiated application experiences.

  

* Establish clear product principles, prioritization frameworks and decision-making mechanisms to guide product investments.

  
2. AI-First Product Innovation
  
  

* Champion an AI-first product philosophy, embedding AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics and agentic capabilities into the WorkforceOS experience.

  

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI for workforce intelligence, skills inference, personalized employee experiences, talent recommendations and intelligent HR workflows.

  

* Drive the evolution from traditional systems of record and systems of engagement toward intelligent systems of action and decision-making.

  

* Partner with AI, Data Science and Engineering teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into meaningful, commercially viable customer outcomes.

  

* Ensure responsible AI principles, transparency, trust and governance are embedded into product design.

  
3. Product Portfolio & Roadmap Management
  
  

* Own the end-to-end product portfolio and roadmap, balancing new capabilities, platform investments, customer commitments and technical modernization.

  

* Define product requirements, outcomes, success metrics and investment priorities across product areas.

  

* Establish a disciplined product development lifecycle, from discovery and validation through delivery, launch and continuous improvement.

  

* Drive prioritization across competing customer, market and business needs, making clear trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term platform strategy.

  

* Ensure seamless experiences and interoperability across WorkforceOS modules and the broader Cornerstone ecosystem.

  

* Define and track product KPIs, including adoption, engagement, customer satisfaction, time to value, retention and revenue contribution.

  
4. Customer & Market Leadership
  
  

* Build a deep understanding of the global HCM market, including customer needs, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies and industry trends.

  

* Engage directly with CHROs, HR leaders, customers and strategic prospects to understand their challenges and validate product direction.

  

* Establish strong customer feedback and product discovery mechanisms to continuously improve product-market fit.

  

* Develop relationships with industry analysts, advisory groups and thought leaders to understand and influence the evolution of the HCM market.

  

* Partner with strategic customers to validate new capabilities, lead design partnerships and accelerate product adoption.

  

* Develop compelling product positioning and differentiation in partnership with Sales and Marketing.

  
5. Commercial & Go-to-Market Leadership
  
  

* Partner with the GM and business leadership to define product packaging, pricing, tiering and monetization strategies.

  

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to develop and execute go-to-market strategies across new customer acquisition, upsell and cross-sell.

  

* Ensure product investments are aligned with commercial opportunities, customer value and business growth objectives.

  

* Support strategic customer engagements, executive briefings and major sales opportunities.

  

* Partner with Customer Success to drive adoption, customer satisfaction, retention and expansion.

  

* Translate product capabilities into compelling value propositions and measurable business outcomes.

  
6. Product Organization & Leadership
  
  

* Build, lead and develop a world-class Product Management organization, including product leaders and individual product managers across multiple product domains.

  

* Establish clear product ownership, organizational structure, accountability and decision-making frameworks.

  

* Develop a strong product management culture grounded in customer obsession, data-driven decisions, speed, innovation and execution excellence.

  

* Set high standards for product discovery, strategy, roadmap management, product specifications and outcome measurement.

  

* Develop future product leaders and create an environment that attracts and retains exceptional talent.

  

* Foster strong partnerships with global Engineering, Design, Data Science and business teams.

  
7. Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
  
  

* Work closely with the GM of WorkforceOS to translate business strategy into product priorities, investment decisions and measurable business outcomes.

  

* Establish strong partnerships with the GMs of Cornerstone's business lines to align product strategy, identify synergies and drive opportunities for integration, collaboration and portfolio-wide innovation.

  

* Work across business lines to identify opportunities for WorkforceOS to leverage, extend and unify existing Cornerstone capabilities, while defining clear product boundaries, ownership and investment priorities.

  

* Partner closely with the VP of Engineering and engineering leadership to jointly drive product delivery, platform evolution, technical feasibility and customer outcomes.

  

* Collaborate with Cornerstone's global Product, Technology and executive leadership teams to ensure alignment between WorkforceOS and the broader company strategy.

  

* Drive effective operating cadences, portfolio reviews, roadmap governance and executive communication across relevant stakeholders.

  

* Represent WorkforceOS in executive forums, strategic customer engagements and industry events.

  
**You've got what it takes if you have:**

* 15+ years of experience in Product Management, with significant experience building and scaling enterprise B2B SaaS products.

  

* 8+ years of experience leading and developing Product Management teams, including senior product leaders.

  

* Proven experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for complex, multi-product enterprise software platforms.

  

* Demonstrated ability to build products from early-stage concepts through market launch and global scale.

  

* Strong understanding of enterprise HCM, HR technology, workforce management or adjacent enterprise SaaS domains.

  

* Experience building AI-enabled products and translating AI, machine learning, intelligent automation or agentic capabilities into customer value.

  

* Strong commercial acumen, with experience partnering on pricing, packaging, monetization and go-to-market strategy.

  

* Demonstrated ability to engage with senior executives, customers, industry analysts and strategic partners.

  

* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex product portfolio decisions across multiple business lines.

  

* Excellent strategic thinking, communication, influencing and organizational leadership skills.

  

* Experience leading global, distributed and cross-functional teams.

  
Leadership Attributes
  
  

* Product Visionary: Able to see where enterprise HCM and workforce technology are heading and translate that vision into differentiated products.

  

* Customer Obsessed: Deeply understands enterprise customers and consistently advocates for solving their most important problems.

  

* AI-Native Mindset: Thinks beyond incremental AI features and understands how AI can fundamentally transform enterprise workflows and experiences.

  

* Commercially Minded: Connects product decisions to revenue growth, customer adoption, retention and business outcomes.

  

* Strong Operator: Balances long-term strategy with execution discipline, prioritization and measurable results.

  

* Enterprise Influencer: Builds strong relationships across business lines, influences executive stakeholders and navigates complex portfolio-level decisions.

  

* Organizational Builder: Has the ability to attract, develop and lead exceptional product talent.

  

* Collaborative Leader: Builds strong partnerships across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and the broader executive organization.

  
**The Opportunity**  
  
This is a unique opportunity to build a category-defining enterprise platform and shape the future of how organizations understand, develop and activate their workforce, while helping define the next chapter of Cornerstone's broader product portfolio.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

title: The Core Engineering-L2-Hyderabad-Analyst-Software Engineering
description:
**ABOUT LEGAL ENGINEERING**

The Legal Division advances and protects the interests of the firm by providing high-quality legal advice and helping identify and address legal, regulatory and reputational risk. Legal Engineering supports this mission by designing, building and operating user-facing, workflow, data and AI-enabled platforms that help legal professionals work effectively and make well-informed decisions.

Our engineers work directly with business partners and cross-functional teams. We combine modern software engineering, cloud platforms, data capabilities and responsible artificial intelligence to solve complex problems in a controlled environment.

**YOUR IMPACT**

As an Analyst or Associate Software Engineer, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle. You will turn business needs and written specifications into tested, maintainable solutions, while using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and remaining accountable for the quality, security and correctness of the resulting code.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* Design, develop, test, deploy and support full-stack applications, APIs, workflows and data-processing services used by Legal Division stakeholders. Relevant 1.5 to 2.5 years of experience.
* Provide ongoing application support and work directly with users to understand and resolve day-to-day needs, questions and production issues; troubleshoot problems, communicate status clearly and implement sustainable fixes that improve reliability and the user experience.
* Partner with legal professionals, product managers, designers and engineers to understand problems, clarify requirements and deliver practical end-to-end solutions.
* Participate in a spec-driven design process by helping convert business objectives into clear functional requirements, technical specifications, acceptance criteria, interfaces and test scenarios before implementation.
* Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code grounded in strong software engineering fundamentals, while effectively leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate delivery.
* Exercise sound engineering judgment by critically evaluating, validating and refining AI-generated solutions to ensure they are correct, secure, scalable and appropriate for the problem being solved.
* Build intuitive user experiences and reliable backend services using technologies appropriate to the product, including TypeScript, React, Python, Java and API frameworks.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, including data mapping, transformation, search and integration patterns.
* Operate collaboratively in an agile environment, communicate trade-offs clearly and continuously learn new technologies and domain concepts.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or a closely related technical field.
* Foundational knowledge of computer science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional design, databases, networking and software testing.
* Hands-on programming experience in one or more modern languages. Experience with TypeScript / JavaScript, Python and Java is especially relevant to this role.
* Experience building or contributing to web applications, backend services or APIs
* Understanding of software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, continuous integration and deployment concepts.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot or Claude Code, together with the judgment to independently inspect, test and challenge generated code rather than accept it without review.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and a willingness to learn the legal domain, new technologies and emerging AI engineering practices.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, data modeling, data manipulation or data mapping.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of API design, event-driven architectures, search platforms or real-time processing.
* Experience with modern AI / machine learning ecosystems, including retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, model evaluation or prompt and context engineering.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office.js, is a plus.
* Interest in financial services, legal technology, compliance, risk or other highly controlled business environments.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* You deliver working software that meets its specification and acceptance criteria, with appropriate tests and documentation.
* You use AI-assisted tools to improve development effectiveness without lowering engineering, security or review standards.
* You identify uncertainty early, ask precise questions and make technical trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* You contribute constructively to design discussions, code reviews, operational support and continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

**CORE TECHNOLOGY EXPOSURE**

Depending on the product and team, the role may involve: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, FastAPI, Flask, Java, REST APIs, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, search technologies, messaging platforms, Kubernetes, cloud services, automated testing, RAG and agent frameworks, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Office.js. Technology choices vary by solution. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed; strong engineering fundamentals, learning agility and disciplined delivery are essential.

description:
**Category Manager – Travel Business**

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

6–12 years

**About Thrillophilia**

Thrillophilia is one of India’s leading experiential travel platforms, helping millions of travellers discover and book curated holidays and experiences across India and international destinations.

We are building destination-led travel businesses where each category is managed with clear ownership across product, pricing, suppliers, marketing, sales, customer experience, revenue, and profitability.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Category Manager**
who can take complete ownership of a destination or travel category and build it like an independent business.

This is not a procurement-only or operations-only role.

You will be responsible for identifying market opportunities, creating differentiated products, building the right supplier ecosystem, improving pricing and margins, enabling sales, working with marketing, and driving customer satisfaction.

A strong Category Manager should be able to say:

**“This destination is my business. Revenue, margins, product quality, suppliers, conversion, customer experience, and growth are all my responsibility.”**

**What You Will Own**

**Category Strategy**

* Build the growth strategy for an assigned destination or travel category.
* Identify demand opportunities based on seasonality, customer trends, visa changes, airline connectivity, search demand, and competitor activity.
* Define the right customer segments, product mix, pricing strategy, and growth priorities.
* Create quarterly and annual plans for revenue, margins, and market share.

**Product Development**

* Build differentiated itineraries and travel products based on customer demand.
* Continuously improve existing packages based on conversion, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Create clear product USPs that make the category easier to sell and harder to replicate.
* Ensure the product portfolio serves different customer segments, budgets, and travel styles.

**Supplier and Commercial Management**

* Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality suppliers, hotels, DMCs, transport partners, and experience providers.
* Negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, service standards, and commercial agreements.
* Build alternate supplier options to reduce dependency and operational risk.
* Improve contribution margins without compromising customer experience.

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Own category-level revenue, gross margins, conversion, and profitability.
* Monitor demand, pricing, sales performance, cancellations, refunds, and operational costs.
* Take corrective action when performance drops.
* Build plans to scale successful products and discontinue weak ones.

**Sales Enablement**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve product understanding and conversion.
* Create destination training, sales playbooks, objection-handling guides, and product comparison tools.
* Analyse sales calls and customer objections to improve products and communication.
* Ensure the sales team has the right products, pricing, and information to close effectively.

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Partner with Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, CRM, and Brand teams.
* Identify high-potential campaigns, destinations, customer segments, and seasonal opportunities.
* Share customer insights, product USPs, pricing hooks, and market intelligence with marketing teams.
* Measure whether campaigns are generating the right demand and quality of customers.

**Customer Experience**

* Track customer feedback, NPS, complaints, cancellations, and service failures.
* Work with Operations and Customer Support to improve the end-to-end travel experience.
* Identify recurring issues and fix them at the product or supplier level.
* Ensure category growth does not come at the cost of quality.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in category management, business ownership, travel product management, P&L management, or a related role.
* Experience in travel, consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplaces, hospitality, or a high-growth business.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, margins, pricing, and profitability.
* Ability to analyse market demand and translate insights into products and business decisions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier-management skills.
* High ownership and comfort working across multiple teams.
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Comfort working with data, dashboards, and performance metrics.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience owning a destination, category, geography, or business line.
* Experience in outbound or domestic holiday packages.
* Exposure to sales-led or high-consideration customer journeys.
* Experience managing both product and commercial outcomes.
* MBA or equivalent business education is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Category revenue
* Contribution margin and profitability
* Booking conversion
* Product performance
* Supplier competitiveness
* Customer satisfaction and NPS
* Cancellation and refund rates
* Sales productivity
* New product success
* Market share growth

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 6 months, you should be able to:

* Build a clear understanding of the assigned destination or category.
* Identify the biggest gaps in product, pricing, suppliers, and conversion.
* Create a structured category growth plan.
* Improve product quality, supplier competitiveness, and sales readiness.
* Establish clear performance dashboards and operating reviews.

Over time, you should build and scale the category into a significant, profitable business with strong customer trust and clear market differentiation.

**Why Join Thrillophilia?**

* Own a business, not just a function.
* Work directly on revenue, margins, products, suppliers, sales, and customer experience.
* Build destinations and categories at meaningful scale.
* Work closely with senior leaders across business, marketing, sales, product, and operations.
* Get the opportunity to grow into a Category Head, Business Head, or P&L leader.

We are looking for someone who thinks like a founder, acts like an operator, and takes complete responsibility for outcomes.

title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About BharatNXT**

BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch.

**The role**

A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often.

**What you'll do**

* **Own founder priorities**

  - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships.
* **Launch things**

  - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked.
* **Build partnerships**

  - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track.
* **Turn numbers into decisions**

  - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation.
* **Know the market**

  - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now.
* **Run experiments**

  - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill.
* **Strengthen operations**

  - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support.
* **Make us faster**

  - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved.
* **Take on special projects**

  - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet.

**What we're looking for**

* 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions.
* Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased.

**Bonus:**

an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

**Why take it**

You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does.

If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.
