title: New Product Development Lead - Foods
description:
**Company Description**
Vitalpro Consumer Pvt Ltd is an emerging leader in India’s hospitality and food and beverage sector, known for its innovative and quality-driven approach. The company builds beloved brands such as Saffron & Mishri, which reimagines traditional Indian mithai, and 224 Craftery, which blends global chocolate-making craft with flavors tailored to Indian tastes. Vitalpro focuses on creating memorable culinary experiences that balance tradition with modernity, backed by data-driven insights, precision marketing, and hyper-personalized engagement. With a strong emphasis on creativity, excellence, and people development, the company aims to transform India’s food culture while offering team members a growth-oriented, purpose-led career journey.

**Experience:**
6–12 Years

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Reporting To:**
Founder / Business Head

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and experienced New Product Development Lead to drive food innovation across our brands.

The role will be responsible for conceptualising, developing and commercialising differentiated food products across traditional Indian sweets, contemporary confectionery, chocolates, snacking and other food categories.

The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of food science, ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and consumer trends, combined with the creativity to develop exciting products and the execution capability to scale them commercially.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Innovation & Concept Development

* Drive the end-to-end new product development pipeline across food categories.
* Identify emerging consumer trends, consumption occasions and product opportunities.
* Develop innovative concepts across mithai, confectionery, chocolates, snacks and other food categories.
* Experiment with new ingredients, flavours, textures, formats and processing techniques.
* Develop differentiated products combining Indian food heritage with contemporary tastes and formats.
* Create product concepts aligned with brand positioning and consumer expectations.

2. Formulation & Product Development

* Lead product formulation, ingredient selection and recipe development.
* Conduct kitchen and laboratory trials to optimise taste, texture, appearance and overall product experience.
* Work on sugar reduction, ingredient optimisation, nutritional profiles and shelf-life enhancement.
* Explore new ingredients, functional ingredients and food technologies.
* Develop alternatives to existing formulations wherever required.
* Ensure products meet applicable FSSAI and food safety requirements.

3. Process Development & Commercialisation

* Translate prototype formulations into scalable commercial products.
* Develop manufacturing processes, process parameters and standard operating procedures.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to establish production feasibility.
* Identify suitable equipment, technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Drive pilot batches, production trials and product validation.
* Ensure consistency and repeatability across production batches.

4. Quality, Shelf Life & Packaging

* Develop products with appropriate shelf life and stability.
* Work on preservation technologies, packaging compatibility and storage conditions.
* Conduct sensory evaluations, stability studies and shelf-life trials.
* Establish product specifications, quality benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with packaging teams to identify suitable packaging solutions.

5. Costing & Commercial Viability

* Develop product costing and optimise ingredient costs.
* Ensure formulations meet target gross margins without compromising product quality.
* Identify alternative ingredients and vendors.
* Evaluate scalability, manufacturing efficiency and commercial viability.
* Work towards improving product economics through formulation and process optimisation.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with marketing and brand teams to translate consumer insights into product propositions.
* Collaborate with procurement on ingredient sourcing and vendor development.
* Partner with manufacturing and quality teams for product commercialisation.
* Coordinate with packaging, sales and business teams to ensure successful launches.
* Build and maintain a structured product development calendar and innovation pipeline.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–12 years of experience in food product development, R&D or food innovation.
* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of food ingredients, formulations and processing technologies.
* Experience in developing and commercialising food products at scale.
* Knowledge of shelf-life enhancement, preservation systems and food packaging technologies.
* Understanding of food safety standards, FSSAI regulations and quality systems.
* Strong analytical, experimentation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance creativity, product quality, cost and commercial feasibility.
* Experience working in FMCG, food manufacturing, confectionery or packaged foods preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of successful new product launches.
* Speed and efficiency of product development.
* Product quality, consistency and consumer acceptance.
* Shelf-life and product stability performance.
* Achievement of target product costs and gross margins.
* Successful scale-up from laboratory trials to commercial production.
* Innovation pipeline and launch calendar delivery.

The Ideal Candidate

A food innovator who combines the mind of a food scientist with the creativity of a product developer and the execution mindset of an FMCG professional.

Someone who is passionate about food, constantly curious about ingredients and technologies, and capable of converting exciting ideas into differentiated, scalable and commercially successful products.

title: Strategy & Ops - Growth, Retention & Engagement
description:
**About the job**

About BharatNXTEvery day, 64 million Indian micro and small businesses build with grit and audacity, and BharatNXT is building the financial infrastructure to fuel that ambition. We help businesses turn existing credit tools like cards into flexible working capital, while enabling them to pay vendors, GST and invoices and manage cards, limits and payouts all on one platform.

Today, BharatNXT serves 2M+ users across 450+ cities, powered by an in-house financial infrastructure with 100+ risk checks, fraud below 0.02%, and a dynamic pricing engine evaluating 20+ parameters across 10,000+ daily transactions. But payments are just the starting point - we’re building India’s MSME Financial Operating System, spanning Run, Manage and Grow, with embedded credit, insurance and personalised financial products powered by signals from every transaction, interaction and GST filing.

Our Predictive Journey Engine interprets 100+ data points per user to continuously personalise pricing, limits, products, reminders and rewards. We’re building towards powering the next 10 million entrepreneurs and rebuilding Bharat’s operational and credit rails from the ground up.

**The Role**

Own our engagement stack end-to-end, powering 15000+ customer touchpoints across multiple products and high-frequency user journeys. Today, it powers campaigns, journeys, cohorts and app personalization across multiple user touchpoints. You will own the platform, the data flowing into it, what gets built on top of it, and the performance of the engagement engine.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You won't be handed a campaign calendar and asked to execute it. You'll identify opportunities, decide what needs to be built, test it, measure it, and kill or scale it based on results.

**What you'll do**

* Own Martech stack end to end - events, user properties, segments, integrations, hygiene and documentation. Data flows in from CRM, our AI calling stack, MMP, Other external platforms and app events; you make sure it's accurate and usable.
* Strategically define and build cohorts using user data, behavioural signals and footprints across platforms.
* Review and rebuild what's live - map every flow and cohort, fix what's broken, retire what isn't working, and put a review cadence on the rest.
* Run campaigns across channels - WhatsApp, RCS, email, push, in-app banners and GIFs, app tiles, website and banners.
* Test relentlessly - structured A/B tests on creative, timing, channel and journey design, with a test log so learnings compound.
* Build cohorts and app personalization - identify new behavioural and transactional cohorts and build cross-sell, upsell, retention and reactivation journeys around them.
* Fix the funnel - use UXCam / Clarity and product data to identify where users struggle, translate those insights into actionable cohorts or interventions, and drive product/UX/engineering fixes to closure.
* Design, Rollout, Monitor and Correct within 48 hours - build dashboards and alerts to catch funnel drops, delivery failures, data issues and integration breaks before they become business problems.
* Partner cross-functionally - work closely with Growth, Product, Business, Data, Design and Engineering to turn user insights into measurable growth initiatives.

What we're looking for

* 2–5 years of hands-on lifecycle marketing, CRM or growth execution in an app-first business.
* You have personally built journeys and campaigns in MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze or WebEngage - not just briefed an agency.
* Practical experience running push, WhatsApp, email and in-app at scale, including deliverability and fatigue management.
* Strong funnel and cohort analysis. You can pull and sanity-check your own data (SQL or BI is a plus).
* Comfortable working with Tech on event tracking, integrations and data requirements.
* Strong attention to detail. Small errors in cohort logic, event tracking or journey conditions can have a large impact.
* You create structure in ambiguity instead of waiting for someone else to create it.
* Familiarity with AI and agentic tools like Claude and Gemini.
* You are comfortable challenging existing processes and asking, "Why are we doing this?" when the data doesn't support it.
* Brownie points if your family comes from a business background and/or you have a degree in analytics or Chartered accountancy.

**Why take it**

* You’ll own an engagement stack that touches every stage of the user lifecycle, in a business where retention and product adoption directly impact revenue.
* There’s a lot to build, iterate and experiment with. That’s exactly what gives you the headroom to stand out, take ownership and make a meaningful mark.
* If you’re looking for a role where nobody counts the hours - we measure the impact you create, this is it.

Who should not take it up

* You’re not deeply driven to build the next large consumer business for India’s micro & small businesses, and would rather optimise for comfort than impact.
* You care more about perks and flexibility than the opportunity to build something meaningful and shape it from the ground up.
* You’re looking for a siloed, low-collaboration role. We work closely across Business, Marketing, Product, Tech and other teams - co-designing, challenging and building together is a big part of the job.
* You prefer clearly defined boundaries over taking ownership, figuring things out and getting things done in an evolving environment.

We are a small team of highly motivated people and want people who have a strong sense of ownership and passion for what they do. If you are expecting a 9-5 types, very well defined structured role - this is not the place for you. But if you are looking for a steep learning curve building innovation in the payment space and are ready to roll up your sleeves to get work done, we would love to hear from you!

title: Sr. Specialist, Advisory Services
description:

Women’s World Banking is looking for a team member to join a forward thinking, cross-functional, high-performing, collaborative team focused on delivering innovative customer experiences, banking services and products, that create business and customer value to serve low-income women.

The Sr. Specialist will lead the design & implementation of advisory solutions in the field in collaboration with our Financial Service Partners. The candidate will be expected to understand business and customer needs, design solutions across functional teams, coordinate and lead sales/ channel teams, last mile marketing & sales agencies and bank stakeholders to ensure smooth implementation and drive project results. This role is responsible for managing project and providing excellent service delivery for our clients and stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will have either a background in banking / insurance / financial services or in management consulting. You must be a strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and propose new ideas for ways of engaging Women’s World Banking’s target audience.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Design of Financial Solutions**
in the space of savings, micro-credit, micro-insurance, digital financial services, or last mile solutions for low income women that are viable and scalable for Financial Service Providers:

* Develop research based perspective on financial products for low income women - the current context, challenges for women, trends and solutions for increasing financial inclusion of women in this sector.
* Conduct industry assessments that provide detailed insights into the competitive landscape and best practices; Collect and analyze complex data in the sector that can help define solutions.
* Establish relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business and customer needs, continually enhance project processes, service offering and delivery for partners.
* Identify, scope and find implementation paths for needed product and/or customer experience enhancements;
* Develop business cases for new product and product enhancements to enable prioritization and justify investments into new and existing products.

**Delivery of Solutions in Field**
across various initiatives, locations and stakeholders to ensure project milestones and metrics are met. Drive execution of solutions for low income women with institution partners.

* Able to implement project in field across multiple geographies and last mile channels.
* Establish relationships and work with a cross-functional teams (internal and partner bank's) to ensure timely delivery of milestones.
* Coordinate among various external support organisations such as last mile agencies (training, sales promotions etc.) and local government bodies (state / region level) to drive project success.

title: Lead Functional Consultant
description:
**Company:**
ColdStar Logistics
  
  
**Experience:**
8–12 years
  
  
**Department:**
Digital Transformation / Technology
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time, on ColdStar Logistics payroll
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai (in-person, onsite role), with visits to warehouses and operational facilities
  
  
**Reports to:**
Top management / C-suite
  
  
**Compensation:**
Industry standard
  
  
**About The Company**
India’s logistics sector is large but highly fragmented. ColdStar Logistics is building an integrated, technology-led network for new-age logistics, serving quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C food, FMCG, QSR, & pharma companies. From 30+ warehouses to a reach of 7,000+ pincodes, ColdStar keeps India’s fastest-growing consumer brands stocked and on time.
  
  
**About The Role**
ColdStar Logistics is undergoing a company-wide digital transformation, rebuilding the core platforms that run its warehousing, transportation and distribution operations. It is looking for a Lead Techno-functional professional to drive this transformation, along with business technology initiatives, operational innovation and adoption of technology solutions across the organization. As ColdStar grows, the role will also build and lead an in-house technology team.
  
  
The individual will work closely with ColdStar’s business leadership, warehouse operations, transportation teams, finance, customer service and other departments to understand business challenges and identify opportunities for improvement.
  
  
The role will act as the
**primary bridge between ColdStar’s business stakeholders and its external technology partner,**
ensuring that business requirements are clearly defined, technology investments address the right problems, delivered solutions are thoroughly validated, and employees successfully adopt new systems.
  
  
The successful candidate must combine strong business analysis capabilities with a practical understanding of enterprise applications, software engineering, data, automation and emerging AI technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Process Analysis and Requirements Management
* Understand ColdStar’s end-to-end logistics, warehousing, inventory, transportation, distribution and customer-service operations.
* Engage with business leaders, process owners and frontline users to identify operational challenges and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews and operational process reviews.
* Document current processes, pain points, business rules, exception scenarios and future-state workflows.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Define detailed scopes of work in collaboration with engineering and solution architecture teams.
* Ensure requirements are complete, unambiguous, prioritized and formally agreed upon before development begins.
* Manage requirement changes and ensure their business implications are understood.
* Technology Partner Coordination and Delivery Oversight
* Serve as ColdStar’s primary techno-functional point of contact for Technology Teams.
* Translate operational requirements into actionable inputs for software developers, architects, QA engineers and data/AI specialists.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, demonstrations and release discussions.
* Validate proposed solutions against ColdStar’s operational requirements and business priorities.
* Monitor delivery progress, dependencies, risks, functional gaps and scope changes.
* Coordinate with ColdStar stakeholders to resolve requirement ambiguities and business decisions.
* Ensure delivered technology is practical, scalable, secure and aligned with business needs.
* UAT and Solution Acceptance
* Own ColdStar’s overall business UAT planning and acceptance process.
* Review and approve UAT scenarios, test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Perform initial functional validation of important workflows.
* Identify actual business users who must participate in UAT.
* Ensure users test solutions against real operational scenarios, including exceptions and failure cases.
* Track defects, functional gaps and usability issues through resolution.
* Coordinate retesting with Technology Teams and relevant ColdStar users.
* Obtain formal UAT acceptance from authorized business process owners.
* Recommend production readiness based on functional completeness and business acceptance.
* Technology Adoption and Change Management
* Ensure delivered solutions are adopted effectively across ColdStar’s operational teams.
* Develop training, communication and adoption strategies for new systems and features.
* Coordinate user onboarding, demonstrations and operational training.
* Monitor adoption, usage patterns, manual workarounds and user feedback.
* Work with department heads to embed new systems into standard operating procedures.
* Identify and address resistance to change, usability problems and process gaps.
* Measure the operational value realized from technology investments.
* Innovation, Competitive Intelligence and Digital Roadmap
* Proactively research digital innovations, emerging technologies and competitive practices in logistics, cold-chain operations, transportation and warehousing.
* Identify opportunities involving process automation, IoT, analytics, AI, GenAI and agentic AI.
* Evaluate technology opportunities based on business value, feasibility, implementation effort and return on investment.
* Work with engineering and innovation teams to evaluate potential solutions.
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of business improvements and innovation initiatives.
* Recommend quarterly technology priorities to ColdStar’s leadership.
* Align technology priorities with ColdStar’s business strategy and identify operational problems that can be solved through technology.
* Use AI/ML and analytics to make sense of the data generated by ColdStar’s systems and turn it into insights for operations and leadership.
* Help build technology into ColdStar’s culture and everyday ways of working.
* Track industry developments and identify opportunities to improve ColdStar’s operational efficiency, customer experience and competitive positioning.
* Technology Team Leadership
* Build and lead ColdStar’s in-house technology team as the company grows.
* Mentor team members and set clear standards, priorities and ways of working.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in business analysis, techno-functional consulting, enterprise application implementation or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of logistics, warehousing, transportation, supply chain or distribution operations.
* Proven experience working with software development teams or external technology implementation partners.
* Experience independently preparing BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Hands-on experience managing UAT, business acceptance and technology adoption.
* Working understanding of APIs, databases, SQL fundamentals, integrations, cloud applications and enterprise software architecture.
* Familiarity with WMS, TMS, ERP, fleet management, inventory management or related enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar tools.
* Strong analytical thinking, communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work closely with both business users and technical engineering teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Cold-chain logistics and temperature-controlled supply-chain operations.
* Experience with IoT, real-time tracking, warehouse automation or fleet analytics.
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Power BI or enterprise data platforms.
* Understanding of AI/ML, GenAI and automation use cases in logistics.
* Experience with operational change management and technology adoption programs.

title: Sr. Property Development Expert – BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
  
  
SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
  
  
SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
  
  
Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc.
  
  
Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
  
  
Currently, we are bidding for Metro Rail projects across India. The position of Sr. Property Development Expert is the key position in these BIDs.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Property Development Strategy: Develop and implement strategies for property development and commercial utilization of metro assets (stations, land, air spaces, etc.).
* Site Assessment & Planning: Identify potential property development sites and perform feasibility assessments considering urban planning, zoning, market demand, and community impact.
* Business Model & Revenue Generation: Formulate and evaluate business models (e.g., Transit-Oriented Development - TOD) to maximize non-fare revenue streams such as real estate leasing, station retail spaces, and advertisements.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with municipal authorities, urban planners, developers, legal advisors, and other stakeholders for approvals and partnerships.
* Tender & Contract Management: Prepare and review tender documents, manage bidding processes, evaluate proposals, and administer contracts related to property development.
* Design Integration: Work with architects, engineers, and commercial teams to ensure property development plans are technically and aesthetically integrated with metro infrastructure.
* Financial Analysis: Conduct financial appraisals and risk assessments for proposed property development projects, including investment analysis and return-on-investment projections.
* Compliance: Ensure all property development activities comply with relevant laws, regulations, master plans, and environmental guidelines.
* Project Monitoring: Oversee implementation of property development projects, monitor progress, and ensure timely completion and handover.
* Reporting: Prepare regular progress reports, presentations, and documentation for internal management and external stakeholders.
* Market Analysis & Innovation: Monitor market trends and introduce innovative property development initiatives to enhance metro’s commercial viability.
* Dispute Resolution: Address and resolve property development-related issues and disputes among stakeholders.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Graduate in Civil Engineering
* minimum 20 years of experience in railways or railway related industry.
* minimum 5 years’ experience in urban rail based passenger carrying system

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!

The H1 Platform unites agentic AI solutions with security researchers ingenuity to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. **AI Product Manager, Agentic Vulnerability Elimination**
Location: Pune, India (In-office)
  
  
Working timing : UK Shift
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
HackerOne is seeking a hands-on, technically curious Product Manager to join the team building Agentic Vulnerability Elimination (AVE). AVE is how HackerOne brings AI agents and human expertise together to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. The agents do the heavy lifting on every finding, while our triage analysts and security researchers keep them accurate and trustworthy. In this role, you will drive improvements to the quality and performance of these agents and the harness they run in, working closely with our Pune triage and offensive security teams and partnering closely with product development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
  
  
This is an ideal role for someone who is energized by AI, comfortable getting into the details of how an agent actually behaves, and motivated by close collaboration with the operators, security researchers, and customers who use and pressure-test our products every day.
  
  
This hybrid role is located in Pune, India, and reports to the Principal Product Manager for Agentic Vulnerability Elimination.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Success in the Product Manager role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne:
  
  

* Lead the definition and delivery of improvements to AI agent quality, performance, and cost management across validation, prioritization, exploitation, deduplication, and remediation, balancing model capabilities, operational workflows, customer outcomes, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Own the evolution of the evaluation framework and agent harness, establishing scalable evaluation methodologies, quality gates, and feedback loops that improve agentic capabilities over time.
* Partner with triage, engineering, offensive security researchers, and product teams to align priorities, influence product direction, and translate operational workflows into scalable, AI-driven product capabilities.
* Work closely with our offensive security researchers to validate exploitability, adversarially stress-test agent decisions, and improve how the agents reason about real-world attack scenarios.
* Partner with customer-facing teams in EMEA and the US to join customer calls and understand user workflows, gather feedback, and keep agent improvements grounded in real-world needs.
* Define the product health metrics for your area, design experimentation frameworks, and use evidence to make prioritization decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
* Own significant product initiatives, independently defining problem statements, success metrics, and execution plans while influencing the broader product strategy alongside senior product leadership and partnering closely with development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
* Navigate ambiguous product problems where customer needs, AI capabilities, and security workflows are still emerging, bringing structure, prioritization, and clear execution plans to cross-functional teams.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on technical or AI/LLM products at high-growth tech or SaaS companies.
* A track record of building products with close cross-functional collaboration across engineering, design, and operations.
* Hands-on experience with LLM-based solutions, including prompting, evaluations, quality control, and the practical realities of building features on top of generative AI.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data to define metrics, run experiments, and make decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and operational staff.
* Experience working with distributed/async product development teams in different time zones.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate, and able to work on-site there on a hybrid basis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with cybersecurity, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, or bug bounty and penetration testing.

title: Principal Release Train Engineer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is a global leader in industrial AI and asset optimization software, enabling innovation in highly complex industrial environments. We are seeking a highly capable Principal SAFe Release Train Engineer / Specialist (RTE) to lead the execution and continuous improvement of Agile Release Trains (ARTs) within our organization. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a servant leader and coach, driving program alignment, delivery excellence, and continuous improvement across multiple Agile teams.
  
  
In this pivotal role, you will act as the operational and facilitative backbone of the ART—ensuring effective coordination, removing impediments, and fostering collaboration across product, engineering, and business functions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role at the heart of our Agile transformation. You will directly influence how teams deliver customer value, ensuring strategic alignment, predictability, and flow across large-scale initiatives. If you thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and are passionate about Lean-Agile leadership, this opportunity offers the chance to make a lasting organizational impact.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Program Execution & Facilitation:**

* Lead and facilitate the execution of one or more Agile Release Trains (ARTs), aligning 50–125+ team members across multiple Agile teams.
* Plan and orchestrate all key SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, ART Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, and Inspect & Adapt sessions.
* Ensure continuous flow of value by proactively identifying and resolving cross-team dependencies, risks, and impediments.

**Stakeholder Alignment**

* Partner with Product Management, System Architects, and Business Owners to align on vision, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Promote transparency and data-driven decision-making through effective communication, reporting, and metrics tracking.

**Leadership & Coaching:**

* Act as a servant leader to Agile teams, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners—providing guidance on Lean-Agile principles, practices, and mindsets.
* Mentor and develop Scrum Masters to strengthen team-level agility and performance.
* Champion a culture of empowerment, collaboration, and continuous learning across the ART.

**Metrics & Performance Management:**

* Establish and monitor ART-level performance metrics including velocity, predictability, and quality.
* Analyze trends to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable performance gains.
* Provide clear visibility into ART progress and outcomes for leadership and stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Lead Inspect & Adapt sessions to identify systemic improvement actions.
* Promote best practices in DevOps, Lean flow, and Agile governance.
* Foster innovation by supporting teams in experimenting and adopting new practices that enhance delivery performance.

What You'll Need
  
  
**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in Agile delivery roles within large-scale software, technology, or systems environments.
* Minimum 3 years in a leadership or coordination role such as Release Train Engineer, Program Manager, or Agile Delivery Lead within a SAFe environment.
* Proven success in facilitating large, cross-functional initiatives and driving delivery in a matrixed organization.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Deep understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Lean-Agile principles, and DevOps practices.
* Strong facilitation and servant leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence without authority.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business functions.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools such as Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent platforms.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret and leverage metrics for performance optimization.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with an ability to navigate complex delivery environments.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) — Required
* SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist (SA), or other relevant Agile certifications — Preferred

title: Project Manager
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. As a key member of the country, vertical, region, or zone Services organization, the Services Program Manager leads a comprehensive services program made up of related projects or manages multiple independent projects to drive customer value realization and impactful business outcomes.

description:
“130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it.”
  
  
**Position Title: Manager- Sustainability**
**Role Overview**
The Manager- Sustainability plays a pivotal role in driving environmental sustainability across the Americas region and beyond. This position serves mainly as the regional owner of the Environmental Reporting process for the Consolidation Unit (ConsUnit), acting as the central point of contact for data providers and key stakeholders, but also will contribute to the wider global sustainable operations strategy. The role combines strategic environmental governance with hands-on operational coordination, ensuring alignment with Global Environmental Office (GEO) guidelines and Allianz Group sustainability targets.
  
  
**Environmental Reporting & Governance**
Own and manage the end-to-end regional (ConsUnit) Environmental Reporting process for the Americas, including documentation, data provider management, contact structures, and reporting timelines.
  
  
Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) under supervision by the central reporting expert for all data providers, cultivating trusting, long-term relationships to ensure data quality and timely submissions.
  
  
Within the wider Sustainable Operations team, support the other regional environmental reporting activities in other regions to ensure compliant reporting and monitoring of our net zero commitments, e.g. sample checks, four eye checks, etc. Govern and enforce the minimum building standards catalogue for the ConsUnit in alignment with Global Guidelines set by the GEO.
  
  
**Emissions Monitoring & Footprint Reduction**
Monitor, analyze, and report on emissions data, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for footprint reduction.
  
  
Propose and drive actionable measures to reduce the environmental footprint in close collaboration with expert functions such as Global Real Estate (GRE) and Operational Sustainability & Facility Management (OSFM).
  
  
Lead local coordination and collaboration with other OEs to achieve shared targets in common buildings and co-located facilities.
  
  
**Sustainability Initiatives & Stakeholder Engagement**
Develop, promote, and coordinate local and global (e.g. World Clean Up Day) sustainability initiatives, in collaboration with relevant internal and external stakeholders to raise awareness and drive engagement across the regional organization.
  
  
Contribute to the development of a standardized methodology with clear KPIs for evaluating the effectiveness and impact of sustainability initiatives.
  
  
Steer regular tracking of initiative progress and measure outcomes within the regional context, ensuring transparency and accountability.
  
  
**Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**
Actively support the Reporting & Analytics function by articulating the value and impact of prioritized sustainability initiatives.
  
  
Identify areas for improvement, define requirements, and implement recommendations to enhance the organisation's contribution to AGCS and Allianz Group sustainability targets.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes, data accuracy, and stakeholder communication.
  
  
With the wider Sustainable Operations Team, support with the yearly/bi-yearly update of progress dashboards
  
  
**EV100 & Fleet Sustainability**
Manage the global EV100 data collection process, including kilometres driven, fleet contract details, vehicle transition tracking, and related sustainability metrics.
  
  
Ensure data integrity and timely reporting in support of Allianz's EV100 commitments.
  
  

* Qualifications & Experience
* Proven experience in managing environmental topics, including emissions reporting, carbon footprint analysis, and sustainability governance.
* Demonstrated project management skills, with a track record of successfully leading and delivering cross-functional projects.
* Strong understanding of environmental reporting frameworks and sustainability standards (e.g., GHG Protocol, CDP, CSRD/ESRS).
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence across organisational boundaries.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Effective communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to present complex topics clearly to diverse audiences.

**Preferred Skills**

* Additional track record in one or more of the following areas:
* Real Estate Management and sustainable building operations
* Renewable Energy sourcing and implementation
* Community Management and employee engagement programs
* Experience in Facility Management, with a focus on utilities, energy consumption, and operational efficiency.
* Familiarity with EV100 or fleet electrification programs and reporting.
* Experience working in a multinational or matrix organisation, ideally within the insurance or financial services sector.
* Experience building dashboards on PowerBi

title: Assistant General Manager
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION
  
## Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Business Operations
  
  
\*\*Company:\*\* 24 Bluebell Ventures Pvt. Ltd.
  
\*\*Industry:\*\* Real Estate – Sales & Marketing Mandate
  
\*\*Location:\*\* Pune, Maharashtra
  
\*\*Department:\*\* Business Operations
  
\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Directors / General Manager
  
\*\*Experience:\*\* 6–10 Years (Real Estate Preferred)
  
\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time
  
  
### About 24 Bluebell Ventures
  
  
24 Bluebell Ventures Pvt. Ltd. is a growing real estate sales and marketing mandate company working with leading developers to deliver exceptional sales performance, operational excellence, and customer experiences.
  
  
We are looking for a \*\*proactive, organised, and result-oriented Assistant General Manager – Business Operations\*\* who can independently manage day-to-day operations, coordinate multiple project sites, streamline processes, and ensure accountability across the organisation.
  
  
### Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
\*\*1. Business & Operational Management\*\*
  
- Oversee daily operational activities across the corporate office and project sites.
  
- Ensure smooth coordination between site heads, sales teams, CRM, HR, and administration.
  
- Implement company policies, SOPs, and management directives.
  
- Identify operational gaps and take timely corrective actions.
  
- Ensure operational consistency and efficiency across all projects.
  
  
\*\*2. Project & Site Coordination\*\*
  
- Monitor the functioning of multiple real estate mandate sites.
  
- Conduct regular site reviews and operational audits.
  
- Coordinate with site heads for manpower requirements, site readiness, and operational support.
  
- Ensure timely resolution of site-level challenges.
  
- Maintain operational discipline and accountability.
  
  
\*\*3. Sales Operations & Performance\*\*
  
- Monitor daily bookings, site visits, lead conversions, and sales productivity.
  
- Coordinate with site heads to review targets and achievements.
  
- Identify performance gaps and recommend improvements.
  
- Support the implementation of sales strategies and management decisions.
  
- Ensure systematic follow-ups and customer engagement.
  
  
\*\*4. CRM & MIS Management\*\*
  
- Ensure 100% adherence to Kylas CRM processes.
  
- Monitor lead allocation, follow-ups, site visits, and customer communication.
  
- Ensure accuracy and timely updating of all customer and sales records.
  
- Review daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports.
  
- Present performance summaries and operational concerns to management.
  
  
\*\*5. Team Management & HR Coordination\*\*
  
- Coordinate manpower planning and recruitment requirements with HR.
  
- Monitor attendance, punctuality, productivity, and team discipline.
  
- Support employee onboarding, training, and performance reviews.
  
- Promote accountability, teamwork, and professional conduct.
  
- Escalate performance or disciplinary concerns appropriately.
  
  
\*\*6. Developer & Internal Coordination\*\*
  
- Coordinate with developer representatives for day-to-day project requirements.
  
- Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues.
  
- Maintain professional relationships with developer teams.
  
- Support management in executing developer commitments.
  
  
\*\*7. Administration & Process Improvement\*\*
  
- Supervise administrative requirements across the office and sites.
  
- Coordinate with vendors and support services.
  
- Monitor resource utilisation and operational expenses.
  
- Improve reporting systems, workflows, and internal controls.
  
- Ensure compliance with organisational policies.
  
  
### Candidate Requirements
  
  
\*\*Qualifications & Experience\*\*
  
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or related field.
  
- MBA preferred.
  
- 6–10 years of experience, preferably in real estate operations or sales management.
  
- At least 2–3 years of experience managing teams or multiple business locations.
  
- Experience with real estate developers, mandate companies, or channel sales organisations will be an advantage.
  
  
\*\*Core Competencies\*\*
  
- Strong leadership and people management skills.
  
- Excellent organisational and multitasking abilities.
  
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  
- Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  
- Proficiency in CRM, MIS, Excel, and reporting.
  
- Ability to independently manage operational responsibilities.
  
- High levels of integrity, ownership, and accountability.
  
  
### What We Expect
  
  
The AGM – Business Operations will serve as a key link between management and execution teams, ensuring that daily operations are managed efficiently, processes are followed consistently, and operational challenges are resolved proactively.
  
  
The candidate should be a \*\*hands-on leader, strong executor, effective coordinator, and dependable decision-maker\*\* who can bring structure and discipline to a growing organisation.
  
  
### Our Vision for This Role
  
  
\*\*To build an operationally strong, process-driven, accountable, and scalable organisation where every department and project functions efficiently, allowing the leadership to focus on business growth and expansion.\*\*
  
  
\*\*Salary:\*\* As per experience and industry standards
  
\*\*Location:\*\* Pune and PCMC , with regular travel to project sites

title: Principal Release Train Engineer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is a global leader in industrial AI and asset optimization software, enabling innovation in highly complex industrial environments. We are seeking a highly capable Principal SAFe Release Train Engineer / Specialist (RTE) to lead the execution and continuous improvement of Agile Release Trains (ARTs) within our organization. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a servant leader and coach, driving program alignment, delivery excellence, and continuous improvement across multiple Agile teams.
  
  
In this pivotal role, you will act as the operational and facilitative backbone of the ART—ensuring effective coordination, removing impediments, and fostering collaboration across product, engineering, and business functions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role at the heart of our Agile transformation. You will directly influence how teams deliver customer value, ensuring strategic alignment, predictability, and flow across large-scale initiatives. If you thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and are passionate about Lean-Agile leadership, this opportunity offers the chance to make a lasting organizational impact.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Program Execution & Facilitation:**

* Lead and facilitate the execution of one or more Agile Release Trains (ARTs), aligning 50–125+ team members across multiple Agile teams.
* Plan and orchestrate all key SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, ART Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, and Inspect & Adapt sessions.
* Ensure continuous flow of value by proactively identifying and resolving cross-team dependencies, risks, and impediments.

**Stakeholder Alignment**

* Partner with Product Management, System Architects, and Business Owners to align on vision, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Promote transparency and data-driven decision-making through effective communication, reporting, and metrics tracking.

**Leadership & Coaching:**

* Act as a servant leader to Agile teams, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners—providing guidance on Lean-Agile principles, practices, and mindsets.
* Mentor and develop Scrum Masters to strengthen team-level agility and performance.
* Champion a culture of empowerment, collaboration, and continuous learning across the ART.

**Metrics & Performance Management:**

* Establish and monitor ART-level performance metrics including velocity, predictability, and quality.
* Analyze trends to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable performance gains.
* Provide clear visibility into ART progress and outcomes for leadership and stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Lead Inspect & Adapt sessions to identify systemic improvement actions.
* Promote best practices in DevOps, Lean flow, and Agile governance.
* Foster innovation by supporting teams in experimenting and adopting new practices that enhance delivery performance.

What You'll Need
  
  
**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in Agile delivery roles within large-scale software, technology, or systems environments.
* Minimum 3 years in a leadership or coordination role such as Release Train Engineer, Program Manager, or Agile Delivery Lead within a SAFe environment.
* Proven success in facilitating large, cross-functional initiatives and driving delivery in a matrixed organization.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Deep understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Lean-Agile principles, and DevOps practices.
* Strong facilitation and servant leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence without authority.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business functions.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools such as Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent platforms.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret and leverage metrics for performance optimization.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with an ability to navigate complex delivery environments.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) — Required
* SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist (SA), or other relevant Agile certifications — Preferred

title: GM - Multi Cloud Platform Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology leader to own and govern a diverse portfolio of technology products, multi-cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and enterprise transformation initiatives. This role combines Technology Portfolio Management, Strategic Account Management, Product Leadership, and Enterprise Transformation responsibilities to deliver business value, accelerate modernisation, enhance service excellence, and strengthen VOIS as a trusted strategic technology partner.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the primary technology engagement lead between Vodafone markets and VOIS, collaborating with senior stakeholders including Product Managers, IT Leaders, Architects, Engineering Leaders, and CIO-level decision-makers. They will drive strategy, governance, cloud adoption, transformation programmes, and portfolio execution across complex technology environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and govern a portfolio of technology products, cloud platforms, infrastructure services, and transformation initiatives aligned to strategic business objectives.
* Lead strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of multi-cloud platforms across Azure, AWS, OCI, and future cloud service providers.
* Act as the primary engagement interface between Vodafone markets and VOIS, building trusted and collaborative stakeholder relationships.
* Lead multiple Agile delivery teams to achieve portfolio objectives, customer outcomes, and strategic priorities.
* Contribute to business growth by supporting pre-sales activities and identifying opportunities across existing and new customers.
* Drive enterprise-wide transformation, cloud migration, cloud adoption, platform engineering, automation, resilience, and operational excellence programmes.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to translate objectives into roadmaps, epics, features, and user stories.
* Champion SAFe Agile, Portfolio Management, DevOps, and modern engineering practices.
* Govern delivery performance, budgets, risks, dependencies, escalations, and stakeholder communications.
* Lead executive governance forums, service reviews, steering committees, portfolio reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
* Identify opportunities to expand technology services and increase business value delivery

**Who You Are**

* Extensive experience in Technology Delivery, Product Management, Cloud, Infrastructure, Transformation, or Service Leadership roles.
* Strong programme management expertise delivering large-scale transformation initiatives across multiple teams and business functions.
* Proven experience leading cloud migration, cloud adoption, and modernisation programmes in enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple Agile engineering teams within SAFe delivery models.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platform governance across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, and related cloud ecosystems.
* Experience managing platform lifecycle, resilience, security, performance, and cost optimisation.
* Strong understanding of cloud financial management, cloud efficiency, and value realisation principles.
* Proven ability to influence and engage CIOs, Product Leaders, IT Heads, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience defining technology roadmaps, governance frameworks, investment priorities, and portfolio strategies.
* Strong capability in:
* Multi-cloud strategy and governance
* Growth planning
* Capacity planning
* Product and platform management

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

Opportunity to lead strategic, global-scale technology portfolios and transformation programmes.Exposure to senior executive stakeholders and enterprise technology leadership forums.Ability to influence cloud strategy, platform modernisation, and technology investment decisions.Opportunity to work across multiple markets, functions, and technology domains.A highly collaborative environment focused on innovation, customer value, and continuous improvement.Experience shaping the future direction of cloud, infrastructure, and platform services within a global organisation.

Advanced portfolio governance and strategic technology planning.Executive stakeholder management and strategic account leadership.Enterprise-scale cloud transformation and multi-cloud governance.SAFe Agile portfolio execution and large-scale delivery management.Cloud financial management, optimisation, and value realisation.Service excellence, resilience, and platform engineering best practices.Business growth identification and technology consulting capabilities.Enterprise transformation leadership across global teams and markets.

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Sr Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is hiring a Product Engineer to own a domain inside our ERP — the financial system of record for state and local government. You will own a product area end to end: customer discovery, the roadmap, the user experience, the build, the launch, and the adoption number. This is a new kind of role, born from AI's ability to handle execution work that once required three specialists. What AI cannot do is decide what matters, sit with a finance director through a budget cycle, make the right call in an ambiguous compliance question, or own whether a product succeeds. That is what Product Engineers do.
  
  
The shift to Product Engineering is primarily about owning the product — not becoming an engineer. The best Product Engineers are obsessed with the who and the why: who are these customers, what do they actually need, and what business outcomes depend on solving their problems. The how — writing code, building interfaces — is a skill you grow into using AI-native tooling. It is a career accelerator, not a job requirement on day one.
  
  
"Product Engineer" is two words — but the first word is the one that matters most. The second is how you get there.
  
  
We are hiring for judgment. You will own a domain where the decisions are load-bearing: a chart-of-accounts choice that a county lives with for a decade, a reporting model that either satisfies an auditor or does not. We expect you to make those calls, write down why, and defend them when the facts change.
  
  
**The Domain**
**Role**
ERP at OpenGov is a suite, and this role owns a domain within it. Depending on fit, that domain sits in or across:
  
  

* Financial Management — general ledger and the chart of accounts, accounts payable, accounts receivable and cash receipts, fixed assets, purchase card, requisitions, bank reconciliation, project accounting.
* Budgeting & Performance — budget creation and proposals on the ERP chart of accounts, worksheets, multi-period adoption, amendments and transfers, workforce planning, performance measures.
* Reporting & Financial Statements — the financial report engine, multi-hierarchy and multi-entity reporting, GASB-compliant statements, the datasets and pipelines beneath them, and the transparency surfaces governments publish to residents.
* Procurement — intake through solicitation, evaluation, award, and contract management, and the vendor record that connects procurement to AP.

Adjacent domains — payroll and HCM, utility billing, tax and revenue, permitting, asset management — sit alongside yours in the same platform. You will not own them, but your decisions will touch them, and you are expected to coordinate rather than escalate.
  
  
The hard, specific problems in this domain right now include chart-of-accounts migration and mutation, multi-entity and blended component-unit structures (a county and its school district, a city and its authorities), reporting parity for customers moving off a legacy product, and audit-readiness as a product capability rather than a services engagement. If those problems sound interesting rather than tedious, this is the right role for you.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* A domain. A defined set of customers, problems, and measurable business outcomes you are accountable for driving. You are the DRI — the directly responsible individual — for all things product in that domain.
* The roadmap. What gets built, in what order, and why, informed by customer research, competitive context, and business goals. You set it, defend it publicly, and update it when facts change. Aha and the Roadmap Portal stay the source of truth so GTM can work from it.
* The end-to-end user experience. From first interaction to last, you define the flow and validate the design within the design system — not just the requirements.
* The ship. From idea to live in customers' hands. You drive intent, design, build coordination, launch, and iteration without handing off across three roles. Engineers review your PRs the way they review each other's.
* The number. Adoption, go-live and retention targets, and the revenue tied to your domain. The outcome belongs to you.
* Field time. Product Engineers are members of Customer Product Squads alongside an Engagement Lead and a Solution Architect, and stay on accounts after go-live. Expect roughly 20–25 hours per implementation — concentrated in discovery, with lighter oversight through configuration and training — capped at about a quarter of your time. The other three quarters is your domain. When a bug surfaces on site, you fix it on site rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work.
  
  

* Spec writing. The prototype is the spec. You build first, in the product repo, with AI skills that carry our standards; the product brief is generated from what you built. Nobody writes a PRD first.
* UX design. AI generates screens from the design system based on your flow definitions, and design-review agents sanity-check what you built. You make the product decisions within the system and escalate genuinely new patterns.
* Research synthesis. AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, support cases, and product usage. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content. AI drafts release notes, in-app announcements, demo data, and enablement material from what you shipped.
* Code review and test coverage. Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues; AI generates test cases from your acceptance criteria. You stay accountable for quality outcomes, and your acceptance criteria have to be precise enough to verify.
* Competitive and regulatory monitoring. AI surfaces competitor moves and changes in accounting standards and state reporting requirements. You form the point of view and decide what it means for the roadmap.

What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.
  
  
You are also expected to improve the tooling itself — identify gaps in AI harnesses, skills, and design system coverage, and surface them as platform investment requests with a clear business case.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your domain, grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals — not inherited from committee.
* Conduct and synthesize discovery with government finance staff: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to platform and design when a genuinely new system-level pattern is required.
* Build. Use AI-native tooling to move from intent to working software in the product repo, validate with customers, and iterate. Own your PRs through review.
* Write acceptance criteria precise enough for automated tests to verify, and treat quality as a pipeline property rather than a hardening phase.
* Partner with engineering leads and squad engineers to unblock builds and resolve ambiguity in real time without becoming a bottleneck.
* Embed with Professional Services on implementations and migrations: run discovery, close the gap between what the product does and what the customer configured, and feed what you learn straight back into the roadmap.
* Track adoption, usage, go-live health, and business outcomes; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your domain in customer conversations, QBRs, steering committees, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Coordinate directly with adjacent domains when a customer need spans more than one, and bring a recommendation rather than a question.

**Core Skill Sets — Non-Negotiables**
Ranked in order of importance and impact. The first three are the screen; the rest are the bar.
  
  

* Ownership under ambiguity. You make good decisions with incomplete information and iterate faster than you wait for certainty. One DRI means there is nobody else to point to, and that energizes you rather than worrying you. Candidates who have only operated inside a PM-designer-engineer trio, with someone else accountable for the outcome, will struggle here.
* Demonstrated product ownership with a track record. Product management, product design, or a closely adjacent role, where you shipped things customers actually use and can point precisely to what you owned versus what the team owned. This is an individual-contributor role, not a management one.
* Depth in a complex, workflow-heavy, compliance-bound B2B domain. Financial software, ERP, accounting, or a comparably regulated enterprise domain. The general requirement is that you have owned a product where being wrong had consequences beyond a churned subscription.
* Customer discovery you have actually run. You have conducted discovery, synthesized the research yourself, and changed a roadmap or a design because of what you learned — with a specific example.
* Written communication. You can articulate a product decision clearly enough that engineering, design, services, and leadership all walk away aligned, without a follow-up meeting. Expect a writing signal in the process.
* Willingness to build. You do not need to arrive as a developer, but code fluency has to read to you as a career accelerator rather than a threat. Experience in AI-native workflows is a plus; willingness to become proficient in them is required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Government finance, public sector accounting, or GovTech SaaS — or direct experience as a finance officer, budget analyst, auditor, or controller.
* Familiarity with fund accounting, chart-of-accounts design, GASB reporting, the annual budget cycle, or external audit workflows.
* Experience with data migration or platform replacement programs, where the hard part was the customer's existing data rather than the new feature.
* Multi-entity or multi-organization data models, consolidated reporting, or component-unit structures.
* Hands-on time with AI development tooling — Claude Code, Cursor, or similar — and with design systems and component libraries.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.
