title: Test / Integration Engineer I
description:
Job Title
  
  
Test / Integration Engineer I
  
  
**Job Description**
**Test Integration Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time**
If you are an experienced testing and integration professional who enjoys leading complex system validation activities and working directly with customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams, this is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering Vanderlande’s advanced automation solutions.
  
  
**Your Role**
As a Test Integration Engineer I, you will provide functional leadership for testing activities across the project lifecycle. You will own the overall testing strategy, coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead customer test workshops, and ensure the system is ready for successful acceptance.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Leaders, Engineering teams, customers, and other stakeholders to ensure that testing activities are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with project requirements.
  
  
**What You Will Do / Key Responsibilities**
Test Strategy & Project Ownership
  
  

* Own and drive the testing strategy across the project lifecycle.
* Define and manage test approaches, test plans, test readiness criteria, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with project requirements, system specifications, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational scenario validation to ensure the system performs effectively under realistic operating conditions.
* Approve test readiness and ensure required prerequisites are in place before testing activities commence.
* Lead and coordinate FAT, IHT, SFT, SAT, and other system acceptance activities as applicable.
* Monitor overall testing progress and provide clear reporting to project leadership.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Lead customer test workshops and facilitate technical discussions related to system testing and acceptance.
* Act as the key testing interface between the customer and internal engineering teams.
* Present test results, issues, risks, and mitigation plans to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and ensure alignment between customer requirements and testing outcomes.
* Participate in engineering discussions, design reviews, and system-level technical meetings.

Multidisciplinary Integration
  
  

* Coordinate testing activities across software, controls, electrical, mechanical, simulation, and other engineering disciplines.
* Drive system integration activities and ensure interfaces between disciplines are properly validated.
* Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues.
* Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team.
* Support and mentor junior engineers and promote consistent testing practices.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify testing-related project risks and support the development of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Drive defect investigations and ensure critical issues are followed through to resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, methodologies, and system validation.
* Promote standardisation and reuse of test procedures and best practices across projects.
* Ensure complete and accurate test documentation and project handover deliverables.

**What You Bring**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, E&TC, or Computer Engineering.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in system integration, software testing, system testing, or a related engineering environment, with demonstrated experience in a testing or integration lead role.
* Strong understanding of software testing and development life cycles, including V-Model, CMMI, Agile, and test processes.
* Strong hands-on experience with Polarion, Jira, Oracle PL/SQL, and Unix.
* Strong experience in developing and reviewing test strategies, test plans, test cases, integration plans, system designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Proven ability to lead testing activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in leading defect investigations and technical issue resolution.
* Strong ownership, leadership, and mentoring capabilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support customer projects based on business requirements.
* Knowledge of airport baggage handling, material handling, distribution systems, PLC, and SCADA is highly advantageous.
* Previous experience in airport automation or a similar complex automation environment is an advantage.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to
  
  
customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* 8 sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering and project teams

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

title: Manager - Network Security
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Manager, Network Security Engineering and Operations**
will provide technical and operational leadership for enterprise network security services across traditional firewall, remote-access, identity-based access, and cloud-delivered Zero Trust technologies.
**12 to 16 years**
of experience in enterprise networking or network security, including substantial experience in technical leadership or service management.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing Network Security engineering or operations teams in a large, distributed enterprise
  
  
**Role**
The role will be accountable for service strategy, architecture governance, engineering delivery, operational stability, security compliance, major-incident leadership, and team capability across:
  
  

* Enterprise firewalls, preferably Cisco ASA/FTD and Palo Alto Networks
* Remote Access VPN using Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect
* Site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Cisco Identity Services Engine
* Zscaler Internet Access
* Zscaler Private Access
* Zero Trust Network Access and Secure Access Service Edge

**In This Role, You Will**
1. Service Ownership and Leadership
  
  

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise Network Security services, including strategy, architecture, engineering, transition, operations and optimisation
* Establish clear service ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths and accountability across internal technology teams.
* Define annual service roadmaps covering platform upgrades, security improvements, automation, technology refresh, resilience and legacy retirement.
* Manage service performance, capacity, availability, risks, dependencies, technical debt and operational readiness.
* Act as the management escalation point for significant service, delivery, stakeholder and vendor issues.
* Balance operational stability with security transformation and business delivery priorities.
* Architecture and Design Governance
* Provide design authority for network security solutions across corporate environments, data centres, remote users, cloud platforms, business units, merged entities and isolated environments.
* Review and approve high-level and low-level designs, security patterns, traffic-flow diagrams, migration approaches, implementation plans and operational acceptance criteria.
* Govern technical standards for firewalls, RAVPN, IPSec tunnels, Cisco ISE, ZIA, ZPA, App Connectors, traffic forwarding and endpoint posture.
* Ensure architecture decisions align with Zero Trust, least privilege, segmentation and defence-in-depth principles.
* Technology and Engineering Leadership

Maintain Sufficient Technical Depth To Guide Engineering Teams, Challenge Vendor Recommendations, Approve Designs And Support Critical Escalations Across The Following Domains
  
  
**Firewalls**

* Cisco ASA/FTD, Firewall Management Center, Palo Alto Networks and Panorama
* Security policies, ACLs, NAT, segmentation, routing and high availability
* IPS/IDS, URL filtering, SSL inspection and threat prevention
* Rule optimisation, recertification and removal of obsolete policies
* Platform lifecycle, patching and vulnerability remediation

**Remote Access and IPSec VPN**

* Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect architecture
* SSL VPN, IKEv1/IKEv2 and site-to-site IPSec VPN
* Authentication, authorization, SAML, RADIUS and certificates
* Tunnel profiles, split tunnelling, routing, NAT and resiliency
* Migration from conventional VPN access to application-based Zero Trust access

**Cisco ISE**

* Authentication and authorization policies
* RADIUS, TACACS+, 802.1X, profiling and posture
* Certificate and identity integrations
* VPN posture, device compliance and access enforcement
* Node health, upgrades, high availability and disaster recovery

**Zscaler ZIA and ZPA**

* ZIA traffic forwarding through ZCC, GRE, IPSec, Cloud Connectors and service edges
* URL filtering, SSL inspection, DNS security, cloud firewall, threat prevention and DLP integration
* ZPA App Connectors, application segments, access policies, Browser Access, posture and identity integration
* Managed, unmanaged and isolated-device access patterns
* App Connector placement, capacity, application discovery and segmentation
* ZIA/ZPA policy governance, administrative access and logging
* Operations, Delivery and Problem Management
* Ensure effective L3/L4 support for firewall, RAVPN, IPSec, ISE, ZIA and ZPA services.
* Lead or oversee P1/P2 incidents, technical war rooms and executive escalations.
* Coordinate troubleshooting across network, security, endpoint, identity, cloud, application, vendor and service-management teams.
* Ensure Network Security platforms comply with corporate security baselines, internal standards and applicable control frameworks.
* Partner with Corporate Security and Audit teams to provide evidence for firewall governance, endpoint posture, identity enforcement, vulnerability remediation and access controls.
* Support NIST, ISO, internal audit and regulatory evidence requirements as applicable.
* Lead security transformation programmes involving RAVPN-to-ZPA migration, firewall optimisation, application segmentation and cloud-security adoption.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of Network Security engineers and technical leads.
* Build effective relationships with Corporate Security, Architecture, IAM, Endpoint, Cloud, Network Operations, Service Management and business stakeholders.
* Translate technical issues and risks into clear business impact, decisions and investment requirements.
* Manage engineering and escalation relationships with Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and implementation partners.
* Review vendor proposals, statements of work, architecture recommendations and product roadmaps.
* Hold vendors accountable for defect resolution, root-cause findings, security fixes, platform reliability and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate complex incidents and interoperability issues involving multiple providers.
* Ensure all material decisions, responsibilities and dependencies are captured through documented RACI and governance structures.

**These will help you succeed**
**Preferred Certifications**

* CCNP Security or equivalent Cisco security certification
* Palo Alto Networks PCNSE
* Zscaler ZIA/ZPA Administrator or Zscaler Digital Transformation certification
* ITIL Foundation or advanced IT service-management certification
* Relevant cloud certification in Azure, AWS or GCP

**Work model –**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2-3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pune, Maharashtra. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Manager of Supply Chain Planning has broad responsibilities for assisting the Business Unit and Sales and Operations Planning in developing and ensuring effective execution of the processes within the supply chains. The overall span of responsibilities involves leading across all supply chain processes, specifically, raw materials procurement & planning, warehousing & transport management & international trade transactions. In addition, managing inventory levels and capacity to meet customer service levels and working capital targets for the business is critical. This position is an integral part of the business unit & responsibility to deliver on its service and execution component of their value proposition.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own strict adherence to organisation safety policies while carrying out entire supply chain operations.

* Achieving business unit objectives – KPIs.

* Works with management to organise schedule changes due to backlogs, design changes, and material/labour shortages.

The position will have supervisory responsibilities for respective team members working for Raw Material Procurement & Planning, Logistics & Warehousing, and International Trade & Customer Service.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

Join us as an “Assistant Manager – Commercial Execution”, where you will support the development and delivery of strategic business communications, helping translate business priorities, performance and key outcomes into clear, compelling and impactful narratives for senior leadership and wider stakeholder audiences.

The role holder will work across business and functional teams to connect the dots between strategy, delivery and outcomes, turning complex information, data and activity into winning stories that demonstrate business impact and progress against strategic priorities.

A key part of the role will be supporting high-quality executive and business communications, including MBR/QBR materials, strategic presentations, leadership updates, business reviews and other senior management content.

The successful candidate will combine strong strategic thinking, excellent written communication and storytelling capability with the ability to understand business context, challenge inputs and create a coherent narrative rather than simply consolidate information.

Key Accountabilities

* Translate business priorities, performance and key outcomes into clear, concise and compelling strategic narratives.

* Connect individual initiatives and outcomes to the broader strategic priorities and business agenda, ensuring communications clearly articulate impact and the “so what”.
* Work with stakeholders across the business to gather inputs, identify the most important messages and turn disparate information into a coherent business story.
* Simplify complex topics, data and business information into communications that are accessible, engaging and appropriate for different senior audiences.
* Support the development of executive-level presentations and storytelling, ensuring a clear narrative flow from strategic priorities through progress, outcomes and forward-looking focus.
* Apply strong judgement to determine what information is most relevant for senior stakeholders, distinguishing key strategic messages from operational detail.
* Maintain a consistent standard and quality across business communications, ensuring messages are accurate, aligned and outcome-led.
* Build effective relationships across teams and functions to understand emerging priorities, key developments and outcomes that should feature in leadership communications.
* Manage multiple communication deliverables and stakeholder inputs, often working to tight deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality.

Required Skillsets / Essential Skills

* Demonstrable experience in strategic communications, business communications, strategy, business management or a related role.
* Strong experience developing materials for senior leadership and executive audiences, particularly strategy and business performance presentations.
* Experience creating and coordinating MBR/QBR, business review or equivalent senior management materials.
* Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex information into simple, sharp and compelling narratives.
* Strong business storytelling capability, including the ability to connect data, outcomes and initiatives to broader strategic priorities.
* Excellent PowerPoint skills with experience developing executive-quality strategy decks and presentations, not simply formatting existing content.
* Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with the ability to review large amounts of information and identify the key messages, themes and implications.
* Ability to understand business strategy and translate it into meaningful communications for different audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders across multiple teams.
* Ability to challenge and refine inputs constructively to ensure the final narrative is strategic, concise and outcome-focused.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing consistently high-quality outputs.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and working to tight deadlines.

Preferred Skillsets / Desirable Skills

* Experience within financial services, banking, consulting or another complex corporate environment.
* Previous experience supporting a Strategy, COO, Chief of Staff, Business Management, Corporate Affairs or Executive Office function.
* Experience developing materials for Executive Committees, leadership teams or senior governance forums.
* Experience translating business performance, transformation, client, commercial or operational outcomes into executive-level narratives.
* Good understanding of performance reporting and the ability to interpret business metrics and identify the story behind the data.
* Experience creating communications across different formats, for example leadership presentations, written updates, town halls, internal communications and strategic announcements.
* Strong visual storytelling instincts, including the ability to structure information effectively within PowerPoint.
* Understanding of the financial services environment and ability to quickly build knowledge of unfamiliar business areas.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.

To support coverage to grow income for both new and existing customers by providing marketing leading tools, a world class learning & development programme as well as analytical support in terms of sales management tools to contribute to the overall success of UKC.

**Accountabilities**

* Design, execution and embedding of an ongoing roadmap to provides market leading Tools for RDs and Coverage.

* Support the delivery of market leading client collateral to provide a competitive advantage to RDs. .

* Maximise the positive impact of UCRM and Salesforce as a tool for Corporate Banking.
* Implementation of agreed minimum standards and best practices across UK Corporate and support this with sales management tools to drive overall success.

**Analyst Expectations**

* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Description**

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

**Role Purpose**

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **Premier Banking** team.

As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans. You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions. Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Business Impact:**

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products.

**Client Management:**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling.
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration:**

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence:**

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development:**

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* For GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager
* For GCB 5: More than 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager.
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licenses and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

**Additional Notes :**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable*.*

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Head of E-commerce & Growth, UltraCare PRO
description:
**Head of E-commerce & Growth, UltraCare PRO**

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, in office ·
**Reports to:**
Director ·
**Team:**
5 ·
**Experience:**
8–12 years

**Why this role exists**

UltraCare PRO sells on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart and our Shopify store. Most of our revenue comes from these channels. We need one leader who owns that revenue and its profitability.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the plan, and you can also open Seller Central or the ads console and fix things yourself. You’ll make day-to-day channel decisions without escalating them to management.

**What you’ll own**

**Channel growth and P&L**

* Own revenue and contribution margin targets for every online channel.
* Build monthly and quarterly channel plans, budgets and forecasts.
* Decide where ad money goes across marketplaces, quick commerce and D2C.

**Marketplaces**

* Drive the Amazon Ads strategy, with clear ACoS and TACoS targets.
* Own listing performance: search rank, conversion, reviews and ratings.
* Plan sale events, deals and coupons with a clear margin view.

**Quick**
**commerce**

* Grow availability, visibility and sales across cities and dark stores.
* Manage platform relationships and in-app ads.
* Spot stock-outs early and work with operations on replenishment.

**D2C**

* Grow Shopify revenue through Meta and Google Ads, conversion rate optimisation and retention.
* Improve conversion rate, average order value and repeat purchases.

**Team and collaboration**

* Lead, hire and coach the commerce team, with clear KRAs and monthly reviews.
* Work with the Brand Lead so that brand and performance pull in the same direction. You brief the design team on listing, A+ content, ad and quick commerce creative. The Brand Lead owns the brand guidelines.
* Work with operations, supply chain and finance on stock, pricing and margins.
* Run one weekly performance review with management, using a single channel dashboard.

**What success looks like**

Variable pay is linked to these goals. Exact targets are agreed in your first 30 days.

* Online revenue grows against target, channel by channel.
* Contribution margin after ads improves.
* ACoS, TACoS and ROAS move in the right direction.
* Rank and in-stock rate are healthy on key products.
* Fewer decisions come to management. One weekly review replaces daily follow-ups.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must have**

* 8–12 years in e-commerce, including at least 4 years hands-on with Amazon or quick commerce for a D2C brand.
* Hands-on use of Seller Central and Amazon Ads.
* Ownership of revenue and margin targets, not just marketing metrics.
* Experience leading a team that includes managers.
* Strong with data, using Excel or Sheets, dashboards and channel reports.

**Good to have**

* Experience in health, wellness, personal care, consumer electronics or FMCG.
* Experience with Shopify, Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Exposure to Flipkart, Myntra, Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart.

**Not a fit if**

* You have only managed marketplaces through agencies, never hands-on.
* You want a strategy-only role.

**Why join us**

* **Real ownership.**
  You’ll have a clear P&L and a direct say in how we grow.
* **Demand to build on.**
  Our products already sell on India’s biggest platforms.
* **Work that matters.**
  Our products help people with everyday aches and pains.

title: Senior Manager-Content Strategy & SEO
description:
**Do You Love Seeing Your Content Rank #1 on Google and Get Recommended by ChatGPT?**

If you get excited when your content climbs search rankings, attracts thousands of visitors, or gets discovered through AI-powered search, this role is for you. Join BonMinds to create, optimise, and scale content that drives real business growth.

Senior Manager – Content Strategy & SEO

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala (Hybrid Remote)  
**Employment:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Department:** Content & Organic Growth

**About BonMinds**

BonMinds is an AI-first digital growth and technology agency helping businesses acquire more customers, improve conversions, and scale revenue through marketing, technology, analytics, content, and AI-powered solutions.

We work with select clients to build sustainable growth through search visibility, compelling content, high-performing websites, and data-driven marketing strategies. Our approach combines human expertise, creative thinking, technology, and AI to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**About the Role**

**Important: This is an advanced SEO role that combines technical expertise with content strategy, creation, and optimisation to drive measurable organic growth.**

We're looking for an experienced, commercially minded, and hands-on Senior Manager – Content Strategy & SEO to lead content planning, production, optimisation, and organic growth initiatives for BonMinds and our clients.

You'll develop content strategies based on business objectives, search opportunities, audience needs, and competitive insights. You'll personally research topics, create content briefs, write and edit important pages, optimise existing content, and analyse performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

This is not a role limited to managing writers or reviewing reports. We need someone who enjoys getting into the details, understands what makes content perform, and can take an idea from research to publication and measurable results.

You'll also build and coordinate a network of freelance writers, editors, subject matter experts, and content creators, ensuring consistent quality, deadlines, and output across multiple projects.

The ideal candidate combines excellent writing and editorial judgement with strong SEO expertise and understands how content contributes to search visibility, customer acquisition, and revenue.

**What You'll Do in this role?**  
**1. Content Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and execute content strategies aligned with business objectives, target audiences, customer journeys, and organic growth opportunities.
* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor research, and content gap assessments to identify high-value opportunities.
* Create content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and publishing priorities for multiple websites and client accounts.
* Plan landing pages, service pages, product content, blog articles, destination guides, and other content assets that support business goals.
* Build topic clusters, pillar pages, and internal linking strategies that strengthen topical coverage and improve discoverability.
* Prioritise content initiatives based on search demand, competition, commercial relevance, and expected business impact.

**2. Hands-On Content Creation & Editing**

* Personally research, write, edit, and optimise important website pages, articles, landing pages, and other high-value content assets.
* Create detailed content briefs outlining audience intent, key topics, structure, references, search opportunities, and editorial expectations.
* Review, edit, and improve content produced by internal teams, freelance writers, and external contributors.
* Ensure all content is accurate, original, useful, engaging, well-researched, and aligned with the brand's tone of voice.
* Improve headlines, introductions, content flow, readability, storytelling, calls to action, and overall editorial quality.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts to incorporate first-hand knowledge, credible sources, and meaningful insights.
* Maintain high editorial standards while balancing content quality, production speed, and business priorities.

**3. SEO & Organic Search Optimisation**

* Optimise content for relevant keywords, search intent, topical relevance, and user experience without compromising writing quality.
* Improve page titles, meta descriptions, headings, content structure, internal linking, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Identify keyword cannibalisation, duplicate content, outdated pages, and gaps in existing content coverage.
* Analyse underperforming articles and landing pages to develop content refresh, expansion, consolidation, or restructuring strategies.
* Work with technical SEO specialists and developers to address content-related indexing, crawling, canonicalisation, and website architecture issues.
* Ensure published content follows Google's people-first content principles and applicable search policies.
* Continuously analyse and improve existing content to increase search visibility, qualified traffic, engagement, and conversions.

**4. AI Search & Answer Engine Optimisation**

* Develop content strategies that support brand discoverability across Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging AI-powered search platforms.
* Research how users discover brands, products, services, and information through conversational and AI-assisted search experiences.
* Structure content to answer relevant questions clearly while improving factual accuracy, topical depth, and information accessibility.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand authority, entity associations, credible references, and visibility across relevant third-party sources.
* Experiment with Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) approaches while measuring outcomes where reliable data is available.
* Monitor developments in AI search and adapt content strategies based on evidence rather than unverified optimisation tactics.

**5. Freelancer & Content Operations Management**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and coordinate freelance writers, editors, researchers, subject matter experts, and other content contributors.
* Build and maintain a dependable network of freelance professionals who can deliver quality content across industries and formats.
* Prepare clear content briefs, assign work, communicate editorial expectations, and establish realistic delivery timelines.
* Review freelancer submissions for writing quality, factual accuracy, originality, search intent alignment, and brand consistency.
* Provide constructive editorial feedback and guide contributors towards consistently higher-quality work.
* Manage editorial calendars, content production trackers, approval workflows, and publishing schedules across multiple projects.
* Monitor freelancer productivity, delivery timelines, revision requirements, and content production costs.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external contributors to ensure content moves efficiently from planning to publication.

**6. Content Performance & Analytics**

* Analyse content performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, and other relevant tools.
* Track organic impressions, clicks, keyword rankings, website traffic, engagement, leads, and conversions.
* Identify high-potential keywords and pages that can generate additional traffic and business through targeted optimisation.
* Monitor content decay, ranking changes, competitive movements, and changes in search demand.
* Evaluate which articles and landing pages need to be created, updated, expanded, consolidated, or removed.
* Build clear reports that connect content initiatives with organic visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and revenue.
* Use performance data to continuously refine content strategies, editorial priorities, and production investments.

**7. AI-Powered Content Workflows**

* Use AI tools to accelerate topic research, keyword analysis, content ideation, competitor research, brief creation, and editing workflows.
* Develop practical AI-assisted processes for content audits, optimisation, editorial reviews, and performance analysis.
* Evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy, originality, factual consistency, usefulness, and alignment with brand requirements.
* Explore opportunities to automate repetitive content operations while maintaining editorial quality and human oversight.
* Combine AI efficiency with strong human judgement, storytelling, first-hand expertise, and original research.

**8. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Ownership**

* Work closely with SEO specialists, performance marketers, designers, developers, analysts, and client-servicing teams.
* Collaborate with designers and developers to publish well-structured, visually engaging, and technically optimised content.
* Work with clients and subject matter experts to understand their products, services, target customers, and competitive positioning.
* Present content strategies, editorial plans, recommendations, and performance findings to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Take ownership of content projects from initial research and planning through production, publication, and performance measurement.
* Manage multiple projects, priorities, contributors, and deadlines without compromising quality.

**What We're Looking For**

* Minimum **5 years of experience** in content strategy, SEO content marketing, editorial management, or a related role.
* Excellent English writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, with the ability to personally produce high-quality content.
* Proven experience developing and executing content strategies that improve search visibility, organic traffic, leads, or conversions.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, search intent, on-page SEO, content structure, topical relevance, and internal linking.
* Hands-on experience using Google Search Console, GA4, and keyword research tools to analyse content performance.
* Ability to independently create content briefs, write and optimise landing pages, and edit long-form articles.
* Experience recruiting, briefing, managing, and reviewing the work of freelance writers or external contributors.
* Strong editorial judgement, research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain consistent content quality.
* Experience managing content calendars, production workflows, priorities, and deadlines across multiple projects.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted tools for research and content production while maintaining strong editorial oversight.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organisational, and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience managing content for large websites with hundreds or thousands of pages and fixing content and technical issues
* Experience with WordPress, Shopify, or other content management systems.
* Working knowledge of Ahrefs, or similar SEO and analytics platforms.
* Experience developing content strategies for international markets and audiences.
* Familiarity with AI search, Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).
* Experience building scalable editorial operations using freelance writers and subject matter experts.
* Knowledge of digital PR, content distribution, earned media, and link-building strategies.
* Basic understanding of HTML, structured data, and website publishing workflows.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency, content studio, publishing company, or growth-focused business.

**What Success Looks Like**

We believe successful content strategy is about more than publishing articles. It's about creating content that people discover, trust, engage with, and act upon.

* Consistent growth in qualified organic leads (**not traffic)** across priority websites and content categories.
* Improved search visibility and rankings for commercially relevant topics and keywords.
* Increased leads, enquiries, conversions, or revenue attributable to content initiatives.
* High editorial quality, factual accuracy, and consistency across published content.
* Successful execution of content roadmaps and publishing calendars within agreed timelines.
* Effective management of freelance contributors, production costs, deadlines, and editorial workflows.
* Measurable improvements in existing content through research, rewriting, consolidation, and optimisation.
* Greater content production efficiency through thoughtful adoption of AI-powered tools and processes.

**Why Join BonMinds?**

* Own content strategies that directly influence brand visibility, customer acquisition, and measurable business growth.
* Work across different industries, business models, content categories, and international markets.
* Combine hands-on writing and editing with strategic ownership, experimentation, and leadership responsibilities.
* Build and manage a network of talented writers, editors, and subject matter experts.
* Experiment with emerging AI technologies and help shape the next generation of search-driven content.
* Collaborate with professionals across SEO, digital marketing, product, technology, design, and analytics.
* Work in an environment that values creativity, accountability, learning, execution, and results.

**Application Requirement**

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate both excellent writing ability and measurable content performance.

Please share your resume along with examples of published articles, landing pages, content strategies, or SEO projects you have personally worked on.

If you have managed freelance writers or content production workflows, please briefly describe the scale of your responsibilities and the results you achieved.

Examples of improvements in organic traffic, search rankings, leads, or conversions would be especially valuable. Applications with a writing portfolio or relevant case studies will receive stronger consideration.

Job Details

**Position:** Senior Manager – Content Strategy & SEO  
**Department:** Content & Organic Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Hybrid Remote, Kochi, Kerala  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 Years  
**Compensation:** Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

Ready to Create Content That Ranks, Gets Recommended & Drives Growth?

If you love seeing your content reach the top of Google, enjoy discovering new opportunities through data, and get excited when brands are mentioned in AI-powered search results, we'd love to hear from you.

Join BonMinds to combine your passion for writing, SEO, content strategy, and AI with the opportunity to deliver measurable growth for ambitious brands.

**To apply:** Please send your resume, writing portfolio, relevant SEO case studies, and a brief description of your experience managing content contributors or freelancers.

**Email:** careers@bonminds.com

**Subject:** Application for Senior Manager – Content Strategy & SEO

description:
**Head of EDA Sales**

**Company Overview**

Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design

**Position Overview**

As India continues to emerge as a global center for semiconductor innovation, investment, and talent, we are seeking an accomplished commercial leader to serve as Head of EDA Sales, India.

This is an opportunity to lead a highly respected business with a strong track record of market success, deep customer relationships, and an exceptional team. Building on that foundation, you will help shape the next phase of growth by accelerating customer engagement, expanding strategic partnerships, strengthening our position across India's semiconductor ecosystem, and further developing a culture that enables teams and individuals to thrive.

The successful candidate will combine deep industry expertise, strategic leadership, and a passion for people development to drive business growth while serving as a visible and influential leader across the broader EDA Sales organization in India.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the overall strategy and commercial performance of Siemens EDA in India, accelerating revenue growth through customer acquisition, account expansion, and increased adoption of Siemens EDA solutions, while identifying and capitalizing on emerging opportunities across India's rapidly expanding semiconductor market and shaping growth strategies that strengthen market leadership and deliver sustainable business results.
* Build trusted relationships with senior executives at strategic customers, serving as a customer advocate and strategic partner who helps customers realize value from Siemens EDA's portfolio of products, platforms, and solutions, and strengthening engagement with government stakeholders, industry associations, academic institutions, and ecosystem partners supporting India's semiconductor ambitions, while representing Siemens EDA within the broader semiconductor community and advancing the company's leadership position in the market.
* Serve as the senior site leader for the EDA Sales organization in India, championing employee engagement, talent development, leadership growth, and organizational health, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and high performance, building on an already strong culture while developing the next generation of sales leaders, and providing visible, inspiring leadership that connects employees to Siemens EDA's strategy, priorities, and values.
* Drive disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, resource allocation, and business planning, ensure effective governance, compliance, and commercial risk management, and partner closely with global EDA leadership, R&D, Services, Marketing, Finance, and technical teams to achieve business objectives.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in the semiconductor and/or EDA industry, with proven success leading enterprise sales organizations and delivering sustained business growth.
* Deep understanding of semiconductor design methodologies, EDA workflows, and industry trends, along with a strong understanding of the Indian semiconductor market and broader technology ecosystem.
* Demonstrated ability to build executive-level customer relationships and influence strategic outcomes, with experience engaging senior stakeholders across customers, industry organizations, and public-sector institutions.
* Track record of leading and developing high-performing teams in complex, matrixed environments.
* Strong commercial and operational leadership capabilities, including forecasting, resource planning, and budget management, combined with exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or a related discipline, and willingness to travel as required.

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.

You’ll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. title: Business Head
description:
Business Head – School Partnerships & Sales

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented **Business Head – School Partnerships & Sales** to lead business development, build strategic partnerships with schools, and drive revenue growth for BBTA.

The ideal candidate should have strong B2B sales experience, excellent negotiation and relationship management skills, and the ability to engage with school principals, directors, management teams, and other key decision-makers.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential schools, developing business opportunities, presenting BBTA's offerings, closing deals, and maintaining long-term partnerships with educational institutions.

Key Responsibilities

**1. School Identification & Business Strategy**

* Identify and prioritise potential schools and target locations for business expansion.
* Work closely with the School Development Executive to shortlist and evaluate prospective schools.
* Understand the challenges and requirements of schools and identify opportunities where BBTA can add value.
* Develop effective strategies to expand BBTA's school partnership network.

**2. Business Development & Client Meetings**

* Schedule and conduct meetings with school principals, directors, management teams, and other key decision-makers.
* Present BBTA's products, services, and partnership opportunities.
* Understand school requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
* Build strong relationships with school management and establish long-term business partnerships.

**3. Sales Conversion & Partnership Development**

* Identify suitable entry opportunities such as apparel audits, sample collections, and initial orders for school house uniforms, sportswear, and other apparel requirements.
* Lead sales discussions, proposals, presentations, and commercial negotiations.
* Convert prospective schools into active business accounts.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and revenue objectives.

**4. Pricing & Commercial Management**

* Approve pricing, profit margins, payment terms, and commercial proposals within the company's guidelines.
* Coordinate with the production team to confirm product availability, production capacity, and delivery feasibility before making commitments to clients.
* Ensure all commercial agreements are beneficial to both the company and the school.

**5. Order Closure & Internal Coordination**

* Secure confirmed purchase orders and written agreements from schools.
* Ensure all agreed commercial terms, product specifications, delivery timelines, and client commitments are properly documented.
* Coordinate with the internal operations and execution teams for a smooth project handover.
* Monitor key accounts and ensure commitments made during sales discussions are fulfilled.

**6. Client Relationship & Escalation Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with school management and key decision-makers.
* Handle escalated customer complaints and resolve commercial issues.
* Support delayed payment collections and manage exceptional commercial situations.
* Identify opportunities for repeat orders, upselling, and long-term business growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or strategic partnerships.
* Experience in institutional sales, school partnerships, uniforms, apparel, textiles, or education-sector sales will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to engage with senior management and decision-makers.
* Strong commercial understanding, including pricing, margins, and payment terms.
* Excellent leadership, relationship management, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to travel for school visits and client meetings.
* Target-oriented with a strong focus on business growth and revenue generation.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* A confident business leader who can independently manage the complete sales cycle.
* Someone with an established understanding of B2B or institutional sales.
* Capable of building relationships with school management and converting opportunities into business.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with production, operations, and execution teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new school partnerships acquired.
* Revenue generated through school partnerships.
* Conversion rate of prospective schools into confirmed orders.
* Profit margins achieved on confirmed orders.
* Repeat business and long-term client retention.
* Timely order closure and successful internal handovers.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Manager
description:
RenewCO₂ commercializes electrochemical processes to convert CO₂ emissions into carbon-negative materials. What distinguishes us from other CO₂ reduction approaches is our proprietary catalyst, which enables an energy-efficient and selective pathway to existing valuable commodity chemicals, such as formic acid, ammonia, monoethylene glycol, sustainable aviation fuel, and more. Our products can access existing markets, and our economics are projected to be competitive or advantageous compared to current fossil-based production. We will be in a position to offer differentiated carbon-negative products at competitive prices, thereby having a significant impact on emissions and society. We're seeking highly motivated team leaders and members who want to make a significant positive impact on climate change and are excited to work in a collaborative team setting.

The RenewCO₂ leadership team includes experts in electrochemical catalysis and industrial systems, including Dr. Anders Laursen, Dr. Karin Calvinho, and Dr. Chock Karuppaiah, along with industry leaders such as Arne Ballantine (Founder, Ohmium; former Bloom Energy CEO) and Srushti Parhar (ex-Bloom Energy, software industry veteran). Additional leadership team members bring deep expertise from the chemicals and oil & gas sectors across U.S. and Japanese markets and will actively mentor and support selected candidates.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

RenewCO2 is hiring a technical Project Manager to plan and drive the development and deployment of CO₂ electrolyzer equipment. The project manager will coordinate the Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, and Process teams, as well as suppliers and fabrication vendors, to move projects from design through procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, and commissioning. The responsibilities will include building and maintaining project schedules, tracking engineering deliverables and procurement, and driving open issues to resolution.

Type: Full-time, in person at our office and laboratory in Chikkaballapur (Bengaluru region).

**Roles and responsibilities:**
-------------------------------

* Coordinate engineering projects from design and development through fabrication, assembly, and testing
* Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and action-item trackers
* Work closely with mechanical, electrical, process, and other engineering teams to coordinate project activities
* Track engineering deliverables, including drawings, BOMs, specifications, and test documentation
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to track procurement, fabrication, and delivery of project hardware
* Follow up on project actions, identify delays or issues, and help drive them to resolution
* Organize meetings and maintain clear action items and follow-ups
* Prepare regular status updates for management
* Support prototype builds, system assembly, testing, and commissioning activities
* Maintain project documentation and ensure that key project information is kept up to date
* Coordinate with external partners and suppliers as required

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Process, or a related engineering discipline
* 3+ years of experience in engineering, project coordination, or a similar technical role
* Good understanding of engineering design and development processes
* Ability to work effectively with engineers, suppliers, and vendors
* Good organizational and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple activities
* Ability to understand engineering drawings, BOMs, specifications, and technical requirements
* Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned activities
* Good spoken and written English communication skills

**Working at an Early-Stage Startup**
-------------------------------------

RenewCO2 is an early-stage company. Priorities shift as the technology and commercial opportunities evolve, internal processes are still being established, and team members are expected to exercise sound judgment without close supervision. Candidates who do their best work in highly structured environments with clearly defined paths are unlikely to find this role a good fit. Candidates who are comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative on incomplete information, and work effectively alongside colleagues across functions are likely to thrive here.

**Why Join RenewCO2**
---------------------

* Work on cutting-edge CO₂ electrolysis and climate technologies
* Direct exposure to scale-up and real-world system building, from laboratory testers through pilot systems
* Mentorship from operating leaders with prior experience building electrolyzer and fuel cell companies
* Opportunity to set up the project management practices of a growing deep-tech company and grow with the role
* Opportunity to work with a global team across India and the U.S.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

RenewCO2 is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Submit your application at https://www.renewco2.com/careers (https://www.renewco2.com/careers)

title: Consultant - Project Coordinator (Midwifery Initiatives)
description:
**Job Description**

The Consultant – Project Coordinator (Midwifery Initiatives) will provide technical assistance and support to the Government of Karnataka and to the Midwifery Initiative programme team at Aastrika.

The Consultant will serve as the nodal point of contact with the concerned officials, including the Deputy Director – Maternal Health (DD-MH) at the Directorate of Health & Family Welfare, Arogya Soudha, Bengaluru, for implementing the Midwifery Initiative (Nurse Practitioner in Midwifery programme) in the state, and is expected to be co-located with the relevant departments as required. The role involves day-to-day coordination to support programme planning and implementation, including developing the Programme Implementation Plan (PIP) and participating in NHM review meetings.

The Consultant will also work with the government to develop and implement policies, programmes and services that improve the health and well-being of mothers and newborns.

Key Responsibilities

* **Nodal coordination:** Serve as the nodal point between Aastrika Foundation and the NHM / Department of Health & Family Welfare for all aspects of the Midwifery Initiative, ensuring programme timelines, goals and objectives are met.
* **NMTI/SMTI set-up:**  Assist and support the programme team, partner institutions and other stakeholders to operationalise the National Midwifery Training Institute (NMTI), which trains Midwife Educators, and the State Midwifery Training Institutes (SMTIs), which train the NPMs
* **Internal coordination:** Keep the Aastrika team, colleagues and supervisors apprised of all deliverables, and plan with them to build effective partnerships across all initiatives.
* **Trainings:** Assist the programme team with logistical support for NPM and NPME training, in coordination with the NMTI/SMTIs, training institutions and other relevant stakeholders
* **Stakeholder engagement and meetings:** Assist in organising periodic review meetings with stakeholders, including preparing data sets, presentations and minutes. Attend monthly NHM review meetings to capture district needs and share requirements for strengthening midwifery services.
* **Field support:** Assist and support field activities, such as identifying groups/teams for advocacy and sensitisation programmes of midwifery initiative
* **NHM planning:** Work with the NHM team and stakeholders to meet the midwifery training targets set in the annual Programme Implementation Plan (PIP) and support the NHM team in preparing the annual PIP budget. Prepare budget guidelines, issue financial guidelines to districts, and facilitate the periodic release of funds for the NMTI and SMTI batches.
* **Reporting and monitoring:** Support the DD-MH with monthly and quarterly reports as per GoI requirements; improve documentation of midwifery services at all service delivery sites (including MLCUs); and strengthen state-level programme monitoring with the state team.
* **NPM deployment:** Assist in tracking the deployment of trained Nurse Practitioners in Midwifery (NPMs) and ensure they are supported to start and sustain midwife-led services.
* **Technical assistance:** Provide technical assistance to the government on maternal and reproductive health, as required.

Qualifications

* Master’s degree in public health, nursing, medicine or a related field, with a minimum of 4+ years of experience in maternal and reproductive health.
* Familiarity with NHM processes (PIP preparation, review mechanisms, GoI reporting) and the NPM initiative will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication skills in Kannada and English, with a proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders, including government officials.
* Self-driven, accountable and detail-oriented; able to work independently and in a lean team.
* Passion for midwifery and respectful maternity care; willing to travel and work in remote areas, if required.
* Flexibility to work with timelines applicable to the Government of Karnataka.

Salary and Benefits

* Competitive salary, commensurate with experience and ability.
* Opportunity to work on a challenging and important public health issue.
* Chance to make a real difference in the lives of mothers and newborns.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and cover letter to **mahua@aastrika.org**

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Flexible to work with timelines applicable to the Government of Karnataka?

Experience:

* Maternal & Reproductive Health: 4 years (Required)

Language:

* fluent English and Kannada (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Project Engineer (Civil)
description:
**Job Title** : Senior Project Engineer

**Department** : Projects

**Entity** : MV Projects

**Reports To** : Senior Manager – Projects

**Team Supervised** : Project / Site Engineers, Supervisors, Foremen and Subcontractor teams

**Location** : Bengaluru – project sites (site-based role)

**Employment Type** : Full-time, Permanent

**Experience** : 7–15 years in building construction, with at least 4–5 years handling end-to-end project execution on residential / high-rise projects

**Qualification** : B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering (M.Tech / PG in Construction Management preferred)

**Working Days** : Monday to Saturday

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Site Execution & Supervision**

* Lead end-to-end execution of civil and structural works across assigned projects — excavation, foundations, RCC frame, masonry, plastering, waterproofing and finishing — in line with approved drawings, specifications and the project schedule.

* Plan and allocate manpower, machinery and materials on site daily; sequence activities to avoid idle time and rework.

* Supervise and guide Site Engineers, supervisors, foremen and subcontractor teams; set daily targets and review achievement each evening.

* Ensure formwork, reinforcement, shuttering and concreting are checked and signed off before every pour (pour card / checklist discipline).

* Coordinate with MEP, façade, lift, firefighting and other specialised agencies to ensure work fronts are released on time and interfaces are managed.

**B. Drawings, Technical Coordination & Quantities**

* Study architectural, structural and services drawings in advance; raise RFIs and resolve clashes with Maark Vision Architects (MV A) and structural consultants before work begins.

* Maintain the latest-revision drawing register on site and ensure superseded drawings are withdrawn.

* Prepare and check bar bending schedules (BBS), quantity take-offs and material requirement estimates.

* Verify contractor and subcontractor measurements, prepare and certify running account (RA) bills, and reconcile material consumption (cement, steel, RMC, blocks) against theoretical quantities.

**C. Quality Assurance & Quality Control**

* Implement the project Quality Assurance Plan (QAP) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs); ensure stage-wise inspections are carried out and recorded.

* Arrange and track material testing — cube tests, steel tests, slump, soil/compaction and block tests — and maintain test records and certificates.

* Coordinate with third-party inspection / QA agencies and structural consultants for milestone inspections; close out all observations and NCRs within agreed timelines.

* Identify defects early, enforce rework where required and maintain a snag list through to handover.

**D. Planning, Progress Monitoring & Reporting**

* Prepare weekly look-ahead plans and monthly work programmes aligned with the master schedule; flag delays and propose catch-up plans.

* Ensure Daily Progress Reports (DPRs), labour reports and site diaries are prepared accurately and submitted on time.

* Track progress against slab-linked and milestone-linked billing so that demand letters and stage certifications can be raised on schedule.

* Present site progress, issues and risks in weekly project review meetings with the Project Manager and management.

**E. Materials, Procurement Support & Cost Control**

* Raise material indents in advance based on the work programme, with accurate quantities and specifications.

* Inspect materials on receipt for quantity and quality; reject non-conforming deliveries and record them.

* Monitor wastage, pilferage and stock levels on site; support the Purchase team with technical evaluation of vendors and materials.

* Highlight cost overruns, extra items and variations early, with supporting measurements and justification.

**F. Health, Safety & Site Discipline**

* Enforce safety norms on site — PPE, scaffolding, edge protection, lift/shaft barricading, electrical safety and safe working at height.

* Conduct toolbox talks, maintain safety records and report incidents or near-misses immediately.

* Maintain housekeeping, site hygiene, labour camp standards and orderly material storage.

* Ensure statutory requirements on site (labour registers, approvals displayed, permits) are complied with, in coordination with Legal & Compliance.

**G. Team Development & Systems**

* Mentor and train junior and Site Engineers on technical standards, checklists and documentation.

* Help build and follow the group's standard site processes — checklists, formats, registers and reporting templates — as the group formalises its operating systems.

* Maintain complete soft and hard project documentation for handover, audit and future reference.

* Lead invoice processing harmonization and automation initiatives, including electronic invoicing, improved invoice capture and touchless processing, and coordinate operational requirements, testing, deployment, documentation and training with GPOs and technology teams
