* Lead assigned AI, automation and harmonization transformation projects across invoice processing and AP Helpdesk, mobilizing cross-functional teams, driving implementation and change adoption, and tracking measurable benefits in collaboration with operations, GPOs and technology teams

**Are you the One?**

* Relevant years of international business experience, including hands-on operational experience in accounts payable and proven experience managing or coordinating high-volume AP service delivery across multiple countries and regions in a global shared services or business services environment;
* Practical experience across end-to-end AP operations, including PO and non-PO invoice processing, invoice validation, matching, coding, approval workflows, exception resolution, supplier queries, payment readiness and period-end activities
* Demonstrated experience coordinating AP operations across delivery centers, time zones and local finance organizations, balancing global standardization with country-specific tax, statutory and invoicing requirements
* Proven experience managing AP service levels and operational KPIs, including processing accuracy, throughput time, backlog and aging, on-time processing and automation rates, with a track record of translating performance gaps into measurable improvements
* Hands-on experience in workload and capacity planning, backlog recovery, operational escalations and business continuity, ensuring stable AP delivery during volume peaks, period-end close and organizational or system changes
* Practical experience applying AP internal controls, including duplicate invoice prevention, approval compliance, segregation of duties and audit trails, and supporting audits and remediation of operational control gaps
* Demonstrated experience implementing AP process improvements, service transitions or automation across countries, with practical use of SAP and invoice workflow solutions, electronic invoicing and operational reporting to improve service quality and touchless processing
* Ability to drive for, and manage change
* Ability to influence people and work in a matrix environment
* understanding on how a service is being set-up and managed for helpdesk, including utilization of technology in providing the services to multiple KONE units globally
* Proven track record of understanding processes and linkages between different tools

* Ability to identify priorities and turn ideas/issues into action

title: Manager - Project Control
description:
### **Summary**

#LI-Hybrid
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Relocation Support: This role is based in Hyderabad, India. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.
  
  
Take a key role in delivering capital investment projects that shape the future of our manufacturing sites, laboratories and offices worldwide. As Manager - Project Control, you will coordinate, control and report on capital expenditure projects across our global organization, keeping a close watch on project costs, schedules and progress against plan. Working closely with engineering and project teams, you will identify potential gaps, provide clear project insights and help keep complex initiatives on track. This is an opportunity to combine strong project management expertise with an understanding of pharmaceutical engineering and contribute to projects across Novartis sites globally.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with project and engineering teams to plan and execute capital investment projects effectively.
* Manage project budgets, cost baselines, forecasts, commitments, accruals and estimates through the project lifecycle.
* Develop and monitor integrated project schedules, ensuring alignment with key deliverables, milestones and work plans.
* Monitor project cost, schedule, scope, quality and risk, identifying variances and emerging issues early.
* Lead forecasting, variance analysis and performance reviews, coordinating corrective actions to keep projects on track.
* Provide clear project reports, performance indicators, dashboards and updates for leadership and steering committees.
* Manage project changes, ensuring impacts on cost, schedule and scope are assessed, approved and reflected in forecasts.
* Coordinate project risk and opportunity management, including identification, assessment, mitigation, escalation and reporting.
* Support tendering and contractor selection, including technical-commercial evaluations, cost estimates and contract documentation.
* Apply pharmaceutical engineering knowledge to support facility design, project reviews, benchmarking and continuous improvement.
  

**Essential Requirements**

* Degree in Engineering or equivalent, ideally with a specialization in project controls; additional business education is beneficial.
* More than 8 years of hands-on project management and project controls experience within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Strong knowledge of project cost, schedule and quality control, including forecasting, trend analysis and performance reporting.
* Demonstrated experience developing and reviewing detailed engineering and construction schedules and monitoring progress against project plans.
* Strong analytical, data management and interpretation skills, with the ability to translate project data into meaningful insights and actions.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project, with experience using SAP and project reporting tools such as Microsoft Power BI.
* Fluent English, with strong stakeholder management skills and experience coordinating internal and external project resources.
  

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse team representative of the patients and communities we serve.

  
  

**Accessibility and Accommodation**

Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversityandincl.india@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

**Why Novartis:** Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

title: Senior Project Manager — DPDP Act Compliance & Grievance Management
description:
**Location:**

**Applications are invited from candidates based out of or ready to relocate to: Patna, Guwahati, Ranchi, Raipur, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Mumbai, Hyderabad**

**1. JOB OVERVIEW, JOB BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE1.**

**JOB OVERVIEW, JOB BACKGROUND AND**

The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025 (most obligations commencing May 2027) require organisations to process personal data lawfully and transparently, protect it with reasonable security safeguards, and give Data Principals an accessible way to exercise their rights and raise grievances.

This role leads the implementation of the
**DPDP Act 2023**
in the business unit to ensure that all digital personal data collection and processing is lawful, transparent, and secured by reasonable security safeguards and runs the grievance and rights-request function. It is the bridge between legal requirements, information security controls and programme operations.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIESEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES**

**1. DPDP Act 2023 Compliance, Consent Management**

·      Drive the DPDP readiness roadmap and track compliance milestones ahead of the May 2027 commencement.

·      Implement notice and consent capture, management and withdrawal across digital, offline and field channels as per the DPDP Act 2023.

·      Implement verifiable parental consent for children’s data, and consent from lawful guardians for persons with disabilities.

·      Implement and manage
**Consent Management**
**System**
and ensure channels and processes for Data principal to exercise their rights as per DPDP Act 2023.

·      Maintain the data inventory and Record of Processing Activities (RoPA), mapping data flows, purposes and lawful bases, including legitimate uses

·      Ensure all contracts, MoUs, service agreements are DPDPA compliant.

**2. Data Retention & Erasure**

·      Define and enforce retention schedules so data is erased once the specified purpose is served or consent is withdrawn, unless law requires retention, and run the erasure process including advance notice to Data Principal.

**3. Grievance Redressal and Data Principal Rights**

·      As per DPO guidelines, set up and run the grievance redressal mechanism: intake channels, triage, escalation matrix, resolution and closure.

·      Maintain the grievance MIS and report it monthly to the DPO, maintain case records and documentation to support any proceedings.

·      Establish workflows to fulfill Data Principal rights as per DPDP Act 2023.

**4. Technical Safeguards and Breach Management**

·      Work with IT team to implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breaches, aligning with applicable policies.

·      Oversee encryption, anonymization, and pseudonymization techniques for data at rest and in transit.

·      Manage
**Data Breach Notifications**
: In the event of a breach, you must lead the process of informing the DPO and every affected Data Principal and work with DPO and legal team for required reporting and responses.

·      Maintain breach registers and run post-incident reviews, and coordinate CERT-In reporting where applicable.

**5. Other governance and regulatory functions**

·      Work closely with
**Data Protection Officer (DPO)**
for regulatory filings and independent audits and governance reporting, SoP development.

**6. Vendor & Cross-Border Management**

* Run privacy due diligence on processors and partners, and draft or review Data Sharing Agreements and monitor processor compliance through audits and assessments.
* Guide and monitor donor and program teams on cross-border data transfers to ensure compliance.

**7. Training, Audit & Reporting**

* Train staff, field teams and volunteers on DPDP obligations, consent and data handling.
* Conduct internal privacy audits and DPIAs for all programmes, apps and systems.
* Prepare quarterly DPDP compliance reports for the DPO and leadership.
* Track regulatory updates from MeitY and the DPBI, and initiate the update process of policies and SOPs accordingly.

**3.SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTESILLS AND ATTRIBUTE**

**Technical / Domain**

·      Strong working knowledge of the DPDP Act 2023 and Rules 2025, the IT Act 2000 and CERT-In Directions; familiarity with GDPR is a plus.

·      Proficiency in GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) software, identity management, and data discovery tools.

·      Ability to design SLAs, workflows and SOPs, and to translate legal requirements into operational processes.

**Behavioural**

·      
**Collaboration, coordination, s**
takeholder management and the ability to build consensus across technical and programme teams and engage with business-line senior leadership.

·      Sound judgement, discretion and integrity in handling sensitive personal data.

·      Structured, detail-oriented and deadline-driven.

·      Clear written and verbal communication, plain-language drafting, and de-escalation skills when handling Data Principal grievances. Proficiency in English and Hindi an advantage.

**4.ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:**

**3. ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENC**

·      
**Education: Degree in Law, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.**

·      
**Work Experience: 6-8 years in data privacy, compliance or information security, including ISO 27001 implementation or a privacy programme.**

·      Experience in grievance or complaint handling, or customer or beneficiary redressal, is preferred.

·      Certifications: ISO 27001 LI, ISO 27701 LI will be added advantage.

title: Project Coordinator – Project Costing & Finance
description:
WE ARE HIRING!Project Coordinator – Project Costing & Finance

**Company:** Durall Systems India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Mumbai / Project & Factory Coordination  
**Department:** Projects & Finance  
**Experience:** 3–6 Years  
**Qualification:** MBA Finance (Preferred)

Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator with strong financial and analytical skills to manage project cost allocation, cost reconciliation, budget monitoring and financial evaluation of ongoing projects.

The candidate must have a good understanding of the real estate, construction or façade industry, including project execution processes, material costing and vendor-related expenses.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Project Cost Allocation & Monitoring**

* Allocate project costs under respective cost heads and project codes.
* Monitor project-wise budgets against actual expenses.
* Track material, labour, installation, logistics and subcontractor costs.
* Identify cost variations and highlight budget overruns.

**2. Financial Reconciliation**

* Reconcile project-wise expenses with finance and accounts records.
* Verify vendor bills, purchase orders, invoices and payment records.
* Monitor advances, outstanding payments and project-related expenses.
* Ensure accurate cost allocation to individual projects.

**3. Project Financial Evaluation**

* Prepare project-wise cost analysis and profitability reports.
* Compare estimated project costs with actual expenditure.
* Identify cost leakages and financial deviations.
* Support management in project financial reviews and decision-making.

**4. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare project-wise financial MIS and cost dashboards.
* Maintain expense trackers, budget sheets and reconciliation statements.
* Submit periodic reports to management.
* Coordinate with Project, Procurement, Stores, Accounts and Finance teams.

Mandatory Requirements

* MBA Finance preferred; B.Com / M.Com with relevant experience may also be considered.
* 3–6 years of experience in project costing, cost control, finance coordination or project MIS.
* Practical knowledge of Real Estate, Construction or Façade industry is mandatory.
* Understanding of material costing, labour costing, vendor billing and project expenses.
* Strong knowledge of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP and financial reporting.
* Good reconciliation, analytical and coordination skills.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience in aluminium, glass, glazing, façade or construction projects.
* Exposure to project budgeting and cost-to-completion analysis.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and project sites.
* Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy.

**Compensation:** As per experience and industry standards.

**Interested candidates may share their updated resume with the HR Team.**

**Durall Systems India Pvt. Ltd.**

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹43,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

title: Allianz - Scrum Master - Agile Methodologies
description:
**Job Description**
The Scrum Master has full responsibility for coaching and facilitating the work of cross-functional Agile teams.
  
  
They create stable and self-organized teams with a clear and engaging direction and help to identify and resolve impediments.
  
  
They are accountable for successfully assessing their teams' needs and provide a suitable Agile approach in addition to Agile consultation services to the broader organization upon request.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Acts as a servant leader.
* Champions change across the organization.
* Enables teams to remove organizational, environmental and mindset impediments.
* Coaches teams in self-organization, cross-functionality and Agile practices.
* Helps teams deliver high-value, high-quality products.
* Fosters openness, collaboration and continuous improvement across teams and the organization.
* Ensures Agile ceremonies take place.
* Facilitates Agile events as needed.
* Advises Product Owners on backlog organization and prioritization to maximize value.
* Leads and coaches teams through Agile adoption.
* Collaborates with fellow Agile Masters.
* Provides strategic Agile coaching to teams, Product Owners and leaders.
* Mentors Agile Masters and aligns coaching and facilitation practices.
* Partners with leaders to resolve systemic impediments, dependencies and risks.
* Uses data and insights to improve team maturity, delivery flow and outcomes.
* Uses generative AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Claude, to improve productivity and work quality.
* Validates and refines AI-generated outputs before use or sharing.
* Uses AI responsibly within Allianz data-protection, information-security and regulatory requirements.
* Builds communities of practice to strengthen knowledge sharing, alignment and continuous improvement.

**Requirements**

* Min. 3 years of work experience as a Scrum Master with hands-on experience on various frameworks like, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe.
* Min. 2 years of work experience in an MNC with a global team.
* Experience in working with leadership and coaches on any transformational activity.
* Having an Agile mind-set - Demonstrated ability to cultivate and promote an Agile mindset across multiple teams and departments.
* Critical thinking generated by observation, experience, reflection, reasoning, and communication - Advanced critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze complex situations and develop strategic solutions.
* Living the four Allianz People Attributes: Customer & Market Excellence, Collaborative Leadership, Entrepreneurship and Trust - Ability to foster these attributes within teams and across the organization.
* Higher education degree in business administration, change management, economics, IT or comparable education.
* Relevant work experience in Agile practices and roles, enterprise transformations, change management, and / or consultancy business - Experience in leading Agile transformations and managing complex projects.
* Experience in different Agile and Lean approaches such as Scrum, Kanban, Extreme Programming practices or similar.
* Experience in mentoring, coaching, collaboration, communication, facilitation, conflict management, team building.

**Competencies**

* Servant leadership and the ability to influence without formal authority.
* Advanced coaching, mentoring and facilitation skills across teams and leadership levels.
* Strong communication, active listening, stakeholder management and conflict-resolution skills.
* Systems thinking and the ability to identify organizational impediments, dependencies and risks.
* Change leadership, adaptability and resilience in complex, evolving environments.
* Critical thinking and data-informed decision-making to improve team maturity and delivery flow.
* Collaboration and community-building across teams, functions and organizational boundaries.
* AI fluency, including effective tool selection, validation of outputs and responsible use in line with Allianz requirements.

title: Technical Scrum Master
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
The driving force behind our success has always been our people. We foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and collaboration across product management, architecture, quality, and delivery teams. Our teams build and evolve industry-leading process simulation and design applicationss serving refinery, petrochemical, and energy customers worldwide. You will experience a strong emphasis on Agile, Lean, and SAFe principles, technical excellence, team empowerment, and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We are seeking a highly motivated
**Technical Scrum Master (Agile Team Lead)**
to support Agile teams delivering high-quality software solutions for AspenTech’s Manufacturing & Supply Chain portfolio.
  
  
This role requires a strong foundation in
**software development and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices**
, combined with experience serving as a
**SAFe Scrum Master**
or Agile Team Lead. The ideal candidate is a servant leader and advocate for SAFe who coaches teams, facilitates effective execution, removes impediments, and drives continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
The Scrum Master will partner with Product Owners, Product Management, Architects, Engineers, and Quality teams to foster predictable delivery, built-in quality, technical excellence, and high-performing Agile teams.
  
  
**Your Impact**

* Serve as the SAFe Scrum Master and servant leader for one or more Agile teams
* Facilitate Iteration Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Reviews, Retrospectives, PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt events
* Promote and advocate SAFe, Agile, Lean, and continuous improvement principles
* Guide teams in applying SDLC practices across planning, development, testing, integration, validation, and release readiness
* Identify, track, and remove impediments while escalating organizational blockers when necessary
* Support Product Owners and teams in maintaining healthy backlogs, clear priorities, and predictable execution
* Foster a culture of built-in quality, engineering excellence, DevOps adoption, and CI/CD practices
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and facilitate collaboration across Agile teams within the ART
* Use Agile metrics, flow metrics, team health indicators, and delivery KPIs to improve transparency and outcomes
* Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile best practices and effective SAFe execution

What You'll Need
  
  
**What You’ll Need**

* 6+ years of total experience, including:
* 3+ years in software development, technical lead, or engineering roles
* 3+ years as a Scrum Master, Agile Team Lead, or SAFe Scrum Master
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, development, testing, integration, and release management
* Practical experience implementing SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery methodologies
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and leading distributed, cross-functional teams
* Hands-on experience with Agile lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or equivalent
* Strong knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, Agile quality practices, and delivery flow management
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to influence teams, encourage accountability, and build alignment without direct authority
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline

**Nice to Have**

* SAFe certifications such as Certified SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), Advanced Scrum Master (SASM), or RTE
* Prior experience in highly technical engineering software solutions
* Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a large-scale ART environment
* Software development experience

**Key Emphasis: Servant Leadership & SAFe Execution**
This role requires a strong servant-leadership mindset and a passion for fostering high-performing Agile teams. Success depends on coaching teams in SAFe principles, enabling continuous improvement, removing impediments, facilitating effective collaboration, and ensuring predictable delivery of customer value. A technical background and deep understanding of SDLC are highly valued, enabling the Scrum Master to partner effectively with engineering teams while promoting Agile excellence, quality, and delivery effectiveness.

title: Java Tech Lead
description:
Join us as a Java Tech Lead at Barclays, responsible for supporting the successful delivery of Location Strategy projects to plan, budget, agreed quality and governance standards. You'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
To be successful Java Tech Lead you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Strong hands-on expertise in:

+ Java (Core Java, Java 8+) and Spring Boot
+ Microservices architecture & REST APIs
+ SQL/NoSQL databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.)

* Experience with:

+ Distributed systems, event-driven architecture (Kafka/MQ)
+ CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows
+ Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
* Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes / OpenShift)
* UI technologies (Angular / React) for full-stack exposure
* Knowledge of risk, finance, or investment banking domains
* Exposure to AI/ML integration or data platforms
* Performance engineering, observability, and monitoring tools

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop, and execute testing strategies to validate functionality, performance, and user experience, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve defects, and continuously improve testing processes and methodologies, to ensure software quality and reliability.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and implementation of comprehensive test plans and strategies to validate software functionality and ensure compliance with established quality standards.
* Creation and execution automated test scripts, leveraging testing frameworks and tools to facilitate early detection of defects and quality issues.         .
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to analyse requirements, participate in design discussions, and contribute to the development of acceptance criteria, ensuring a thorough understanding of the software being tested.
* Root cause analysis for identified defects, working closely with developers to provide detailed information and support defect resolution.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Overview**
**Overview**
Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity
  
  
With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, The StoneX Group is made up of five segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Payments**
: A Swift-accredited service bureau and member, our Payments division provides NGOs, Financial institutions and non-profits the ability to make a local difference, globally – with transparent pricing across 180+ countries and 140+ currencies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Position Purpose:
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and skilled Production Support Engineer to join our dynamic team to support mission critical Payment Applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in supporting production environments, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and ensuring the smooth operation of applications and databases. You will play a critical role in resolving incidents, performing root cause analysis, and supporting database and application-related issues in a 24x7 environment.
  
  
**Production Support & Incident Management:**

* Monitor and maintain production systems to ensure high availability and performance.
* Respond promptly to incidents, provide technical support, and resolve issues in line with SLAs.
* Perform root cause analysis for production incidents and propose long-term solutions to prevent recurrence.
* Providing advanced troubleshooting and resolution.
* Develop and implement automation scripts to streamline incident resolution and system monitoring.

**Application Support for Payments Applications (Java/.NET, MongoDB, SQL, Azure Cloud):**

* Provide support for applications, troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring performance and availability.
* Collaborate with development teams to address code-related issues and support application deployment.
* Optimize application performance and conduct regular health checks to ensure system stability.
* Assist in the design and implementation of new features and enhancements for payment applications.

**Cloud Technologies Support:**

* Work with cloud technologies (Azure) to ensure seamless integration, deployment, and management of production applications and databases.
* Resolve cloud infrastructure issues.
* Implement and manage cloud security measures to protect sensitive data and applications.
* Monitor cloud resource usage and optimize costs through efficient resource management.

**ITIL Process Adherence:**

* Ensure compliance with ITIL processes, particularly Incident Management and Problem Management, to ensure service continuity and minimize downtime.
* Contribute to the implementation and improvement of ITIL best practices within the organization.
* Participate in Change Management processes to assess and mitigate risks associated with production changes.

**Collaboration & Coordination:**

* Work closely with development, QA, and infrastructure teams to facilitate problem resolution and continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective communication during high-severity incidents, providing regular updates to stakeholders and managing customer expectations.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers to resolve complex technical issues.

**Documentation & Reporting:**
Maintain accurate records of incidents, problems, changes, and resolutions.
  
  
Generate and analyze reports on service performance, identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.
  
  
Create and maintain detailed technical documentation and knowledge base articles for support teams
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Experience:**
**5-7 years**
of experience in production support, with a focus on databases (MongoDB, SQL), Java/.NET applications, cloud technologies, and ITIL processes.
  
  
**Technical Skills:**

* Databases: experience with MongoDB, SQL including queries, stored procedures, debugging of stored procedures.
* Programming: knowledge of Java or .NET for supporting applications in production.
* Cloud Technologies: Hands-on experience with any of the major cloud platforms (preferred is Azure) and cloud infrastructure management.
* ITIL Concepts: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks, with hands-on experience in Incident Management and Problem Management.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools, logging, and incident tracking systems.

**Certifications (Preferred/Good To Have):**

* Cloud certifications (Foundational or Intermediate).
* ITIL certification (ITIL Foundation or higher).

**Soft Skills:**

* Excellent communication skills to interact with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

title: Principal Release Train Engineer
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
  
  
**The Role**
AspenTech is a global leader in industrial AI and asset optimization software, enabling innovation in highly complex industrial environments. We are seeking a highly capable Principal SAFe Release Train Engineer / Specialist (RTE) to lead the execution and continuous improvement of Agile Release Trains (ARTs) within our organization. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a servant leader and coach, driving program alignment, delivery excellence, and continuous improvement across multiple Agile teams.
  
  
In this pivotal role, you will act as the operational and facilitative backbone of the ART—ensuring effective coordination, removing impediments, and fostering collaboration across product, engineering, and business functions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role at the heart of our Agile transformation. You will directly influence how teams deliver customer value, ensuring strategic alignment, predictability, and flow across large-scale initiatives. If you thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and are passionate about Lean-Agile leadership, this opportunity offers the chance to make a lasting organizational impact.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Program Execution & Facilitation:**

* Lead and facilitate the execution of one or more Agile Release Trains (ARTs), aligning 50–125+ team members across multiple Agile teams.
* Plan and orchestrate all key SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, ART Syncs, Scrum of Scrums, and Inspect & Adapt sessions.
* Ensure continuous flow of value by proactively identifying and resolving cross-team dependencies, risks, and impediments.

**Stakeholder Alignment**

* Partner with Product Management, System Architects, and Business Owners to align on vision, priorities, and delivery commitments.
* Promote transparency and data-driven decision-making through effective communication, reporting, and metrics tracking.

**Leadership & Coaching:**

* Act as a servant leader to Agile teams, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners—providing guidance on Lean-Agile principles, practices, and mindsets.
* Mentor and develop Scrum Masters to strengthen team-level agility and performance.
* Champion a culture of empowerment, collaboration, and continuous learning across the ART.

**Metrics & Performance Management:**

* Establish and monitor ART-level performance metrics including velocity, predictability, and quality.
* Analyze trends to identify improvement opportunities and drive measurable performance gains.
* Provide clear visibility into ART progress and outcomes for leadership and stakeholders.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Lead Inspect & Adapt sessions to identify systemic improvement actions.
* Promote best practices in DevOps, Lean flow, and Agile governance.
* Foster innovation by supporting teams in experimenting and adopting new practices that enhance delivery performance.

What You'll Need
  
  
**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in Agile delivery roles within large-scale software, technology, or systems environments.
* Minimum 3 years in a leadership or coordination role such as Release Train Engineer, Program Manager, or Agile Delivery Lead within a SAFe environment.
* Proven success in facilitating large, cross-functional initiatives and driving delivery in a matrixed organization.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Deep understanding of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), Lean-Agile principles, and DevOps practices.
* Strong facilitation and servant leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence without authority.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business functions.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools such as Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent platforms.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret and leverage metrics for performance optimization.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with an ability to navigate complex delivery environments.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) — Required
* SAFe Program Consultant (SPC), SAFe Agilist (SA), or other relevant Agile certifications — Preferred

title: Test / Integration Engineer I
description:

**Your Role**
As a Test Integration Engineer I, you will provide functional leadership for testing activities across the project lifecycle. You will own the overall testing strategy, coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead customer test workshops, and ensure the system is ready for successful acceptance.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Leaders, Engineering teams, customers, and other stakeholders to ensure that testing activities are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with project requirements.
  
  
**What You Will Do / Key Responsibilities**
Test Strategy & Project Ownership
  
  

* Own and drive the testing strategy across the project lifecycle.
* Define and manage test approaches, test plans, test readiness criteria, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with project requirements, system specifications, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational scenario validation to ensure the system performs effectively under realistic operating conditions.
* Approve test readiness and ensure required prerequisites are in place before testing activities commence.
* Lead and coordinate FAT, IHT, SFT, SAT, and other system acceptance activities as applicable.
* Monitor overall testing progress and provide clear reporting to project leadership.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Lead customer test workshops and facilitate technical discussions related to system testing and acceptance.
* Act as the key testing interface between the customer and internal engineering teams.
* Present test results, issues, risks, and mitigation plans to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and ensure alignment between customer requirements and testing outcomes.
* Participate in engineering discussions, design reviews, and system-level technical meetings.

Multidisciplinary Integration
  
  

* Coordinate testing activities across software, controls, electrical, mechanical, simulation, and other engineering disciplines.
* Drive system integration activities and ensure interfaces between disciplines are properly validated.
* Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues.
* Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team.
* Support and mentor junior engineers and promote consistent testing practices.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify testing-related project risks and support the development of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Drive defect investigations and ensure critical issues are followed through to resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, methodologies, and system validation.
* Promote standardisation and reuse of test procedures and best practices across projects.
* Ensure complete and accurate test documentation and project handover deliverables.

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, E&TC, or Computer Engineering.

* Strong understanding of software testing and development life cycles, including V-Model, CMMI, Agile, and test processes.

* Proven ability to lead testing activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in leading defect investigations and technical issue resolution.
* Strong ownership, leadership, and mentoring capabilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support customer projects based on business requirements.

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to
  
  
customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

We are seeking an experienced
**Java Integration & DevSecOps Engineer**
to develop, maintain, secure, test, and support enterprise integration solutions connecting complex business applications and services.
  
  
This role combines Java application development, systems integration, software security, automated deployment, application testing, and operational support. The successful candidate will have experience developing and supporting integrations using web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity within a secure enterprise environment.
  
  
The engineer is also expected to effectively use approved artificial intelligence-assisted development tools, including Copilot, throughout the software development lifecycle to improve development efficiency, testing effectiveness, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall code quality. All AI-assisted output must be appropriately reviewed, validated, secured, and tested prior to implementation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, maintain, and support secure, scalable Java-based enterprise integration solutions using REST and SOAP web services, application programming interfaces, and database connectivity.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, interface, data-processing, and service-related issues while implementing enhancements to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
* Apply secure software-development practices and remediate vulnerabilities identified through application security testing while maintaining system functionality and reliability.
* Manage application security requirements, including certificate, credential, and password rotations, and resolve related authentication and authorization issues.
* Maintain and enhance automated build, test, and deployment pipelines to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Support application releases, deployment validation, production issue resolution, and appropriate testing of application changes prior to implementation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for applications, integrations, interfaces, deployment processes, and supported solutions.
* The successful candidate is expected to incorporate approved AI-assisted development tools into day-to-day engineering activities, including:
* Accelerating code development, refactoring, integration development, and maintenance of existing solutions.
* Supporting development and refinement of unit and integration tests, code reviews, defect identification, debugging, and root-cause analysis.
* Assisting with analysis and remediation of application security findings.
* Supporting build and deployment automation, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Identifying opportunities to responsibly use AI-assisted capabilities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* 9+ years of overall experience.
* Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise application using Java 8 or later and Spring Framework.
* Experience developing and supporting web services, application programming interfaces, and relational database integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, and production issues.
* Experience with source control, automated build and deployment pipelines, and modern software-development lifecycle practices.
* Knowledge of secure software-development practices, including application vulnerability identification, security testing, and remediation.
* Experience with application security concepts, including digital certificates, credentials, authentication, authorization, and password management.
* Experience developing and executing unit, integration, regression, and interface testing.
* Strong technical documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting complex, business-critical enterprise applications and integrations.
* Experience modernizing or migrating on-premises application and integrations to cloud-based environments.
* Experience with application security, certificate and credential management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated build and deployment pipelines.
* Experience using Copilot or similar approved AI-assisted development tools to enhance software development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code quality.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to independently investigate complex issues and drive them through resolution.
* Strong focus on quality, security, reliability, and operational readiness.
* Ability to effectively collaborate across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, operations, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and solutions.
* Demonstrated ownership and accountability for assigned solutions throughout the development and support lifecycle.
* Adaptability and willingness to adopt new technologies, tools, and development practices, including responsible use of AI-assisted capabilities.
* Commitment to continuous improvement, automation, and engineering efficiency.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

A key function within Banking and International Clients Technology is the global client onboarding process at Citi. Our team is responsible for the enterprise platform that orchestrates mission-critical client onboarding workflows across multiple business domains, including Legal, Credit, KYC/AML, and Account Opening. We empower clients and operations teams with real-time event-driven information, interactive tools, and robust APIs to automate, streamline, and accelerate end-to-end onboarding lifecycles.
  
  
We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs
* Architect and implement robust event-driven workflows and real-time streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schemas, and fault-tolerant message processing)
* Design and implement highly concurrent, low-latency solutions utilizing advanced multithreading, concurrency patterns, and JVM performance tuning
* Write clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code following modern software engineering best practices, design patterns, and enterprise security standards
* Lead end-to-end SDLC activities from architectural design, technical specification, and implementation through to automated testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, and production deployment
* Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
* Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
* Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve high-impact technical challenges in distributed production environments, leading root-cause analyses and permanent remediation
* Provide technical leadership, establish coding standards, conduct comprehensive peer code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior developers across the team

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise
* Deep, expert-level proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), object-oriented design, collections, memory management, and multithreading/concurrency models
* Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade microservices using the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cloud)
* Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Kafka and Event-Driven Architecture, including topic design, consumer groups, offset management, message serialization, and event streaming patterns
* Proven experience in designing, building, securing, and versioning scalable RESTful APIs
* Strong database skills working with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, PostgreSQL) including query optimization, indexing, and transactions, as well as document stores (e.g., MongoDB)
* Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, caching strategies, and resilient design patterns (Circuit Breaker, Saga, Outbox, Retry/Backoff)
* Hands-on experience with automated unit and integration testing frameworks (JUnit 5, Mockito, Testcontainers)
* Familiarity with containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift) and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines
* Exposure to Kotlin is a significant advantage
* Demonstrated technical leadership, excellent analytical and debugging skills, and strong verbal and written communication abilities

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred

title: Release and Change Management, CI/CD and Automation, Middleware / Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As a Release and Environment Management Specialist you’ll manage application releases, production changes, deployment activity and environment stability across enterprise platforms. This role sits at the point where change meets operational resilience - ensuring deployments are controlled, evidenced and safe and that environments remain stable before and after change. You’ll own delivery from planning through implementation, validation and handover while partnering closely with application, infrastructure and support teams. Day to day success is measured through high-quality change documentation, controlled deployments and clear stakeholder communication. You’ll also play a key role in reducing deployment failures, build issues and repeat incidents through strong troubleshooting and practical preventative actions. The work requires disciplined change management and the technical depth to execute deployments and site switching with care.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Own release and environment delivery from planning through implementation, validation, closure and handover
* Create and manage change orders with 100% quality assurance against approved change requirements
* Execute code and configuration deployments across relevant environments including retrofit activities after fixes and emergency change
* Perform site switching using F5 load-balancing technology including pre-change checks and post-change validation
* Resolve deployment and release issues using fix-forward approaches in line with approved change, release, security and operational procedures
* Manage Git repositories including branch management, code promotion, merge coordination and repository hygiene
* Investigate build and pipeline issues affecting release workflows including Jenkins troubleshooting and log analysis
* Maintain environment stability through proactive checks, incident investigation, root-cause analysis and preventative actions

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring proven experience in release management, deployment management, application support or production operations
* Demonstrate hands-on capability managing production and non-production deployments end to end
* Use Jenkins across the release workflow including pipeline execution, monitoring, troubleshooting and release validation
* Apply strong Git experience including branching and merging strategies, pull requests, code reviews, conflict resolution and traceability
* Work with WebSphere Application Server (WAS) and IBM HTTP Server (IHS) including deployment, configuration, log analysis and issue resolution
* Use AppDynamics for end-to-end application performance monitoring and service health verification
* Apply working knowledge of Ansible Automation Platform including playbook execution, job monitoring and troubleshooting
* Operate effectively within formal change-management processes including standard, emergency and retrospective changes

Deliver controlled releases at pace
  
  
If you’re looking for a role where release quality and production stability genuinely matter this is an opportunity to make that impact every day. You’ll oversee deployments that protect service health, reduce repeat issues and strengthen operational readiness through clear handovers and effective support engagement. The role offers breadth across CI/CD, middleware and environment troubleshooting with strong governance expectations and practical outcomes. If this scope matches the work you want to own we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Product Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.
  
  
**How AI Works In This Role**
AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:
  
  

* Spec writing: AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* UX design: AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* Shipping code: AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* Research synthesis: AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* Release content: AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* Code review: Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* Test coverage: AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* Competitive intelligence: AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*
**What You'll Own**

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Projct Cordinator-MEP
description:
**Project Coordinator – MEP**

**Reports to:**
Project Lead

**Location:**
Full-time on site (Noida)

**Engagement:**
For the project duration (5 months)

**Role summary**

The Project Coordinator – MEP monitors and coordinates all MEP works by the Client-appointed contractors. They make sure the services are installed to the approved drawings and specifications, tested and commissioned, and handed over with complete documentation.

**Qualifications and experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised university.
* At least 7-8 years of hands-on experience on construction sites, preferably MEP in commercial office or interior fit-out projects.
* Working knowledge of the NBC, relevant IS codes and fire-safety requirements for commercial buildings.

**Key responsibilities**

**Pre-start and submittals**

* Study the MEP contract drawings, specifications and contract scope given by the Client.
* Track the status of MEP submittals: shop drawings, material approvals and method statements. Escalate any delays to the Project Lead.
* Review contractors' MEP mobilisation, manpower and material delivery plans.

**Site monitoring and coordination**

* Monitor installation of:
* **HVAC:**
  ducting, diffusers, FCU/AHU connections, insulation
* **Electrical:**
  lighting, DBs, cabling, earthing, small power
* **Plumbing:**
  water supply, drainage, sanitary fixtures in the common toilets
* **Fire and ELV:**
  sprinklers, fire alarm, PA, CCTV and access control, as applicable
* **AV System including VC equipment’s**
* Coordinate the interfaces between MEP and ceilings, partitions and finishes. Flag clashes and site constraints to the Project Lead and the designers. The designers resolve them.
* Coordinate with the base-building facility team on tie-ins to existing services, shutdowns and work permits, especially on occupied floors.

**Quality**

* Inspect MEP workmanship against the approved drawings and specifications, raise observations and track them to closure.
* Check that installed materials match the approved makes and samples.

**Testing and commissioning**

* Prepare and track the T&C schedule, and witness tests: pressure and leak tests, insulation resistance, earthing, air balancing, and fire alarm and sprinkler tests.
* Keep the test records and commissioning certificates.

**Reporting and handover**

* Provide MEP progress, constraints, quality observations and photographs for the Weekly Project Report.
* Attend weekly review meetings and track MEP action items.
* Compile the MEP snag list and check rectifications.
* Collect the MEP handover documents: as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties, test certificates and the spares list.

**Skills and competencies**

* Can read and interpret MEP drawings; AutoCAD working knowledge preferred.
* Good with MS Excel for trackers and logs.
* Organised and thorough at site documentation; communicates well with contractors and facility teams.

**Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities:**

The Lead Engineer – Electrical Component will play a key role in supporting the sales and business development by providing technical expertise in the design of electrification solutions for the EHV/HV Substations. * HV (Primary) designs for 132 kV and above GIS/AIS Substation Engineering for Grid Interconnected Projects
* Preparation of basic Single Line Diagram, Layout Plan & Section of Overall plant, Equipment control room, Earthing Layout, DSLP Layout, Trench Layout etc

* Preparation of all Distribution/Auxiliary system.
* Evaluation of vendor Drawings, GTP, Calculation & Technical Specs

* Co-ordination of site & office team for execution of project
* Flexible and quick to learn global developments in renewable technologies and adopt.
* Know-how of IEEE / IEC codes, safety in design/EHS aspects, AC substation industry engineering practices.
* Good Communication skills & capability to lead project independently along with Client handling.
* Team handling & development.

* FACTS project engg i.e. STATCOM, FSC, Synchronous Condenser
* HVDC/FACTS integrated project applications.
* Competency on specialized tools like CANECO, ETAP, CDGES or equivalent
* Working experience with 3D Design Tools.

* Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma in electrical engineering or related field, from an accredited college or university.
* Minimum of 12+ years of experience with Degree or 15+ years with Diploma in EHV/ HV AIS & GIS Substation design.
* Good understanding of power system components (transformers, switchgear, protection systems) and renewable energy integration.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance technical requirements and business needs.
* Ability to work collaboratively across teams and with clients.
* Ability to guide/groom team and execute project in line with client/project requirement.
* Ability to expand the competency domain, being able to take new learning challenges.
* Flexible for travel globally

**Key Competencies**

* Customer-Centric Approach: Ability to translate customer needs into technical solutions that are practical, cost-effective, and compliant with industry standards.
* Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of electrical system design, material selection, and quantity estimation tailored for oil and gas projects.
* Project Management: Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and provide leadership throughout the design and implementation phases.
* Safety & Compliance: Strong commitment to safety and regulatory compliance, with a focus on delivering designs that meet industry-specific standards.

title: Clinical Trial Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Lambda Therapeutic Research is a leading full-service global Clinical Research Organization (CRO) headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, with additional operations in the USA, Canada, the UK, Spain, and Poland. The organization delivers end-to-end clinical research services to innovator, biotech, and generic pharmaceutical companies, supported by a team of over 1,200 professionals. Lambda leverages advanced technology and innovative approaches to provide a full spectrum of clinical trial solutions, including early- and late-phase trials, bioanalytical services, and pharmacovigilance. With more than two decades of experience, the company has been recognized with multiple industry awards for excellence, workplace culture, regulatory performance, and strategic partnership. Its comprehensive services span Phase 1 studies, BA/BE, data management, medical imaging, drug safety, biosimilars development, medical and scientific writing, and clinical lab services.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Clinical Trial Project Manager role based in Ahmedabad. The Clinical Trial Project Manager will oversee the planning, execution, and completion of clinical trials, ensuring studies are conducted in accordance with protocols, regulatory requirements, and organizational timelines. Daily responsibilities include coordinating cross-functional project teams, managing study timelines and budgets, and maintaining effective communication with sponsors and internal stakeholders. The role involves monitoring project risks and issues, preparing status reports and documentation, and supporting quality assurance activities to maintain compliance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and relevant regulations. The Clinical Trial Project Manager will also contribute to process improvement initiatives and mentor team members to support efficient and high-quality project delivery.

* Strong project management skills, including planning, timeline management, budgeting, and risk mitigation.
* Experience in clinical research operations, such as site management, trial coordination, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Solid understanding of GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements for clinical trials.
* Proficiency in documentation, reporting, and use of clinical trial management systems or related tools.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead and motivate teams, manage multiple projects, and make data-driven decisions.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in a CRO or pharmaceutical environment; prior experience as a project manager or senior clinical research professional is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and quality.
* Willingness to work on-site in Ahmedabad and collaborate with teams across india.

description:
General Information

238600
