**Description**
Qatar Airways is recruiting for the role of Third Party Risk Management Coordinator based at our Global Business Services (GBS) in Ahmedabad, Gujarat (India).
  
  
The position is primarily responsible for performing day-to-day activities of the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) lifecycle for the third parties, covering inherent risk assessment, due diligence, onboarding checks, continuous monitoring and offboarding, applying the TPRM Framework and the team’s procedures and templates consistently, gathering and evaluating due diligence evidence, documents assessment outcomes and rationale, keeping TPRM records audit-ready, and work directly with User Departments and specialist, identifying issues, gaps and adverse findings and refers them to the Third Party Risk Manager, who approves assessment outcomes and handling contentious or high exposure matters functions to obtain the information required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as a day-to-day point of contact for User Departments and relationship owners on third party risk requirements, providing practical guidance on process, templates and evidence, and builds effective working relationships with User Departments and specialist functions to secure timely input,
* Identify recurring difficulties, inefficiencies and practical obstacles in applying the team’s procedures, templates and guidance, and propose improvements.
* Record where assessment outcomes differ from the provisional tier, to support recalibration of the scoping rules,
* Contribute to the implementation, testing and ongoing improvement of the third-party risk tooling, uses it effectively, and maintain the quality of data within the TPRM system of record,
* Manage allocated caseload of assessments in line with the team’s assessment standards, turnaround times and key performance indicators, and flags early where these are at risk,
* Perform Inherent Risk Assessments for third parties handed over to the central team, running working sessions with relationship owners and subject matter experts to obtain operational facts and specialist input, and prepares the assessment outcome and, where applicable, the rationale for a change in tier for review by the Third Party Risk Manager,
* Challenge responses and scoring that are not supported by evidence, ensures consistency across assessments, and refers unresolved differences to the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Perform due diligence proportionate to the assessed level of risk, collecting, validating and evaluating evidence such as audited financial and credit reports, certifications, data protection documentation, and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening results,
* Request and follows up specialist input from functions such as, but not limited to, Compliance, Legal, Information Security, the Data Protection Office and Procurement, and consolidates their responses into the assessment record,
* Prepare clear, evidence-based due diligence summaries setting out findings, gaps, residual concerns and a proposed risk disposition for review and approval by the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Escalate adverse findings, refused information requests and potential mandatory decline indicators immediately upon identification,
* Maintain the inventory of in-scope third parties allocated to them, keeping risk classification, relationship owner, contract references and key dates complete and current,
* Check all prerequisite lifecycle stages are complete and formally closed before a third party is onboarded, and reports any exceptions,
* Run screening and continuous monitoring at the defined cadence, reviews and dispositions alerts, discounts false positives with documented rationale, and escalates genuine trigger events,
* Support User Departments in performance review cycles and in the structured offboarding of third parties, including confirmation of data return or destruction, access revocation and record closure,
* Maintain the TPRM system of record so that assessments, evidence, approvals and decisions are complete, current and audit-ready,
* Prepare routine reporting on assessment completion, overdue items, open findings and monitoring status, and flag emerging trends to the Third-Party Risk Manager,
* Deliver agreed remediation and evidence in support of Internal Audit recommendations relating to third party management.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**
Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
  
  
Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
Together, everything is possible
  
  
Qualification
  
  

* High School / Diploma or Equivalent with minimum 3 years of job-related work experience or Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent with minimum 2 years of job-related work experience.

**Job Specific Skills/ Essentials**

* Professional certification in risk, audit, compliance or third party / vendor risk management (e.g. CRMA, CIA, CRISC, CTPRP),
* Awareness of third-party risk and risk management frameworks and standards, including but not limited to COSO, ISO 31000 and ISO 27001,
* Experience of working with a GRC / third party risk platform, case management or workflow tooling,
* Experience in third party / vendor risk management, procurement, internal control, risk management, compliance, audit or a comparable evidence-based assessment role,
* Ability to read and interpret due diligence evidence (audited financials and credit reports, certifications, data protection documentation, and sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening results) and to identify what is missing or inconsistent,
* Lead structured working sessions with business stakeholders and challenge their input constructively,
* Competent in Microsoft Excel and comfortable working with data sets, trackers and reporting,
* Good Command of English language with good written and verbal communication skills as well as strong interpersonal skills.

**About Qatar Airways Group**
Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
  
  
So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.

description:
**About Company:**

Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operates in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark and North cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners to make a personalized statement through ,customization.

While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.

For more about Group Bayport, please visit

**Website:**
https://groupbayport.com/about-us/

**LinkedIn:**
https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/

**Designation: Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**About the Role**

This role owns end-to-end execution of Bayport's outbound and inbound logistics operation — from raw material import through SEZ export compliance, carrier management, international transit, and final delivery with proof of delivery — while also owning full financial control of the freight and 3PL spend that flows through the department. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run high-volume international parcel/express operations before and can bring immediate rigor, carrier relationships, and operational and financial discipline to a fast-scaling, compliance-intensive environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

● International Carrier & Freight Management: Own the relationship and performance of FedEx, UPS, Emirates and other carrier partners — rate negotiation, annual contracts, service-level management, escalation handling, and carrier score carding across air, sea, and surface.

● Inbound & Outbound Logistics: Own inbound raw material import logistics with a focus on cost and lead-time reduction, alongside full ownership of outbound sea and air shipments across B2B, B2C, and marketplace channels.

● SEZ & Trade Compliance: Ensure disciplined, audit-ready execution of shipping bill filing, customs documentation, and SEZ regulatory requirements, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and Importer of Record (IOR) procedures across key markets (US, Canada, UK, Australia, EU, China).

● 3PL Vendor Bill Audit & Financial Control: Own the checking and audit of all 3PL/carrier vendor bills against contracted rates and actual service delivered and drive timely payment and reconciliation in coordination with Finance and the vendor — this is a named, direct accountability of this role, not a shared or informal responsibility.

● End-to-End Operational Ownership: Drive the full flow from production handover through packing, carrier dispatch, in-transit visibility, destination customs, last-mile delivery, and signed proof of delivery (POD).

● Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Logistics Manager and the wider team covering domestic/non SEZ vendor operations, SEZ compliance, night operations, MIS/sea freight/refund & reship, and Atlanta linked shipping — building capability and accountability at every level.

● Performance & MIS Reporting: Own a KPI-driven daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting cadence — cycle time by stage, on-time pickup/delivery, freight cost, exception and lost-shipment tracking, and POD closure — with full visibility to the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics.

● Cost & Network Optimization: Continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost per shipment, improve carrier mix, and eliminate avoidable delays or rework across the network.

● Business Expansion & Vendor Development: Identify and onboard logistics partners in new geographies as Bayport's brands expand into new international markets.

● Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Production Planning, Material Planning, and Vendor Management to tighten the handover from production to logistics and resolve root-cause issues jointly rather than in isolation.

● Exception & Escalation Ownership: Personally own resolution of high-impact exceptions — customs hold, lost shipments, delivery disputes — ensuring timely closure and clear communication.

● Marketplace Logistics: Build the roadmap and business case for bringing marketplace last mile fulfilment in-house

**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**

● A fully visible, stage-wise logistics dashboard covering the complete order lifecycle — inbound through final delivery, not just packing-to-carrier-handover

● A clean, current, reconciled 3PL vendor billing process with no payment disputes or aged discrepancies with Finance

● Measurable improvement in on-time pickup and on-time delivery percentages across all three carriers

● A formalized, audit-ready SEZ and customs compliance process with clear ownership and turnaround times

● A functioning POD/exception closure process with defined liability and resolution timelines

● A stable, accountable, well-led Logistics team operating on clear KPIs and a regular performance cadence

**Required Experience**

● 10–15 years in international logistics/parcel-express operations, with substantial experience managing outbound and inbound volume through global carriers

● Prior experience with FedEx, DHL, UPS, or a comparable global express/parcel carrier is strongly preferred — this significantly shortens the learning curve for Bayport's carrier-heavy, SLA-driven model

● Demonstrated experience with export/import compliance, customs documentation, duties/tariffs, and ideally SEZ or bonded-warehouse environments

● Direct experience auditing 3PL/carrier invoices and managing reconciliation with Finance

● Track record of leading and developing operational teams of meaningful size, with a hands-on, floor present leadership style

● Experience building or owning KPI dashboards and driving performance through data, not just tenure or relationships

**Preferred Qualifications**

● Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree or equivalent is a plus

● Six Sigma / Lean or equivalent process-improvement certification is an advantage

**Key Competencies**

● Operational and financial rigor under time-sensitive, SLA-driven conditions

● Strong carrier and vendor negotiation skills, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and IOR procedures across key international markets ● Direct, transparent communication style with the ability to hold a team accountable while developing them

● Proficient in logistics software, MS Office Suite, and ERP systems

● Comfortable operating in a fast-scaling, still-formalizing process environment — able to build structure, not just follow it

description:
**About Company:**
Group Bayport is a rapidly growing global e-Commerce, B2B2C, B2B, and B2C organization and an industry leader in print technology, operating across the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, UK, and India through its family of brands – Banner Buzz, Covers & All, Vivyx Printing, Circle One, Giant Media, Neon Earth, Optamark, and North Cape. From full suites of trade show and small business marketing solutions to sophisticated outdoor living covers, signages, and shades to eclectic personal accents and home decor, we help our customers, clients, and partners make a personalized statement through customization.

While our advanced technology and customer focus are certainly our salient attributes, our true strength comes from our team of 1800+ people. We are seeking exceptional talent across the board to join us in our exciting growth journey.

For more about Group Bayport, please visit:

* **Website:**
  https://groupbayport.com/about-us/
* **LinkedIn:**
  https://www.linkedin.com/company/groupbayport/mycompany/

**Designation:**
HR Business Partner (HRBP) – Manufacturing Operations

**Location:**
Gandhinagar ( Gujarat )

**About the Role**

As an HR Business Partner (HRBP) for our Manufacturing Plant, you will serve as a strategic consultant and on-ground people leader for our production, supply chain, quality, and plant operations teams. You will align human capital strategy with manufacturing output, safety, and quality goals. In this role, you will drive shop-floor workforce planning, oversee industrial and employee relations, manage statutory factory compliance, and leverage people analytics to foster a high-performing, safe, and engaged plant culture.

Key Responsibilities

**Strategic Business Partnering & Shop-Floor Workforce Planning**

* Partner closely with the Plant Head, production managers, and operational leaders to design and execute HR strategies that directly support manufacturing KPIs, productivity targets, and turnaround times.
* Lead strategic workforce planning for both on-roll and contractual/off-roll shop-floor staff, managing shift scheduling alignments, seasonal volume ramp-ups, and succession planning for critical technical roles.
* Drive change management efforts on the plant floor by effectively communicating process changes, automation upgrades, and organizational shifts to minimize resistance and maintain operational continuity.

**Talent Management, Retention & Technical Capability Development**

* Oversee the end-to-end talent lifecycle for plant personnel, from blue-collar/technical hiring and onboarding to retention and performance management.
* Partner with production and quality leads to identify skill gaps, design targeted technical/safety training interventions, implement skill-matrix programs, and build career progression frameworks for operators and supervisors.
* Facilitate performance appraisal cycles, shop-floor KPI tracking, and structured performance improvement plans (PIPs).

**Industrial Relations (IR), Employee Engagement & Plant Culture**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to plant leadership and workers on shop-floor grievances, conflict resolution, disciplinary proceedings, and domestic inquiries.
* Foster a collaborative, safe, and high-morale shop-floor environment through regular town halls, skip-level meetings, worker welfare committees, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Manage vendor and labor contractor relationships to ensure seamless manpower supply, fair treatment, and adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).

**Statutory Compliance, Safety & Governance**

* Ensure 100% adherence to statutory labor and factory laws (including the Factories Act, Contract Labour (R&A) Act, Industrial Disputes Act, PF, ESIC, Minimum Wages, and Payment of Bonus/Gratuity Acts) and manage external labor inspections and audits.
* Partner with the Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) team to promote a zero-incident safety culture, ensuring timely compliance with safety training and statutory welfare requirements.
* Develop, update, and audit plant HR policies, standing orders, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain operational excellence.

**Compensation, Timekeeping & HR Analytics**

* Oversee shift rosters, biometric attendance tracking, overtime (OT) governance, and accurate payroll inputs for both on-roll employees and contract workers.
* Collaborate on wage benchmarking, production-linked incentive structures, and employee welfare/benefits administration.
* Leverage HR analytics and plant metrics (absenteeism, attrition, overtime costs, productivity per headcount) to deliver data-backed insights to leadership.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree, MBA in HR, or MSW / Post Graduate Diploma in Industrial Relations & Personnel Management (IRPM) is strongly preferred.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum of 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 4–5 years as a Plant HRBP or HR Manager in a manufacturing, printing, packaging, or industrial production environment.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Hands-on experience working with modern HRMS and time-office/biometric systems; direct experience with Keka HR is a distinct advantage.
* **Certifications:**
  Professional HR credentials (SHRM-SCP, SPHR) or certifications in Labor Laws & Industrial Relations are highly desirable.

**Knowledge, Skills & Competencies**

* **Industrial & Labor Law Mastery:**
  In-depth, practical knowledge of Indian factory regulations, contract labor management, statutory filings, and handling labor authorities.
* **Shop-Floor Acumen:**
  Ability to connect HR initiatives directly to manufacturing efficiency, safety, quality, and cost control.
* **Stakeholder & Conflict Management:**
  Strong mediation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels—from machine operators to senior plant leadership.
* **Agility & Resilience:**
  Proven ability to handle high-pressure situations, shift-based operations, and rapid scale-up demands in a fast-paced manufacturing setup.
* **Data Fluency:**
  Capability to track and interpret plant workforce metrics (shrinkage, attrition, OT trends) to drive proactive people decisions.

title: Design System/UX Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
* UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without friction
* Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
* Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
* The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
* Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who ships
* Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
* You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slower
* You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs.
* Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly.
* Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted.
* Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build.
* Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture.
* Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day.
* Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts.
* Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't.
* Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite.
* Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities.
* Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies.
* A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Post Trade
description:
**About Us**
DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Post Trade Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of our brokerage systems. You will work closely with our engineering team and other stakeholders to create scalable, low-latency, and highly available trading systems.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build new products and features while supporting and enhancing existing ones, owning the technical architecture, design, and delivery of high-performance, low-latency brokerage systems using Java
* Partner with Product and Operations to understand requirements, translate them into implementable technical features, and deliver them
* Design and build event-driven architectures using Kafka, packaged with Docker and deployed on Kubernetes
* Support production applications by triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues, drawing on an understanding of system integration, scripting, and test planning.
* Build observability, resilience, and recoverability into applications.
* Assess the health and performance of software applications and databases, and provide software and technology solutions
* Define specifications, develop components, modify the existing software stack, prepare test data, and prepare functional specifications
* Analyze service and application performance using various programming languages, tools, and techniques

**You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
* At least 7 years of experience in Software Engineering with expertise in Java and spring framework.
* Proficient in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs and implementing sophisticated event-driven architectures using Kafka, deployed on Kubernetes.
* Capital Markets or financial technology background (required), with a focus on the trade lifecycle.
* Experience with Jira, Git, and shell scripting(writing scripts to extract and transform data)
* Proficient in NoSQL, SQL, and stored procedures, such as in PostgreSQL and MySQL
* Understanding of Test-Driven Development and how to write effective unit and integration tests
* Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, such as JFrog Artifactory, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation etc
* Experience with a 24/7, highly available architecture
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (required)
* Experience with Scrum and other Agile processes
* Strong analytical,communication and problem-solving skills

**Location**
This role is open to candidates in the following locations:
**Hyderabad, IN**

* This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
* If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.

**Working at DriveWealth**
We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.
  
  
To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.
  
  
For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.
  
  
**How We Think About AI**
We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.
  
  
**Compensation**
Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
  
  
**Agency Disclaimer**
DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead
description:
**Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead**
**Department: IT Factory**
**About Business line/Function:**
The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
  
  
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
* Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
* Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
* Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
* Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.

**Specific Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
* Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
* SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
* Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
* Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
* Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
* Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
* Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
* Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.

**Nice To Have**

* Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
* Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
* Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
* Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
* Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
* Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
+ Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**

title: QA Lead -Salesforce Automation
description:
**Job Description:**

**Senior QA Engineer (Salesforce Test Automation)**

**Experience:** 7–10 Years

**Role:** Senior QA Engineer

**Work Model:** Agile Delivery Pod (client-facing)

**Focus:** Salesforce Automation Testing, Playwright, Selenium, Copado, Test Strategy & Documentation, Client Engagement

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Senior QA Engineer** with 7–10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a strong focus on **Salesforce testing and test automation**. The candidate will define and execute test strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, and uphold quality standards across the delivery lifecycle.

The role requires direct engagement with clients. The candidate will take part in requirement discussions, present quality status and risks to client stakeholders, and propose practical suggestions to improve quality and test coverage. The candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Developers, Business Analysts, Architects, Scrum Masters and business stakeholders.

**Must Have Skills**

**Technical Skills**

* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on experience in **Salesforce automation testing** across Lightning Experience, Apex, flows, and integrated business processes.
* **MANDATORY:** Strong hands-on expertise in **Playwright** for end-to-end test automation (TypeScript or JavaScript preferred).
* Hands-on experience with **Selenium WebDriver** and **Copado** for Salesforce release testing and CI/CD-integrated deployments.
* Experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks (Page Object Model, data-driven and keyword-driven approaches).
* Experience with functional, regression, integration, smoke and UAT support testing, and with API testing using Postman or REST Assured.
* Working knowledge of Git and of integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail or Xray.

**Quality Practices & Documentation**

* Ability to set up the complete testing lifecycle, including test strategy, test plans, environment and test data setup, entry and exit criteria, and traceability matrices.
* Proven adherence to QA best practices such as risk-based testing, shift-left testing, root cause analysis and defect lifecycle management.
* Strong documentation skills, including test strategies, test reports, automation framework guides and runbooks.

**Communication & Client Engagement**

* Ability to communicate directly with clients, presenting test progress, quality metrics, risks and dependencies in a clear and professional manner.
* Ability to ideate with clients and provide well-reasoned suggestions on automation coverage, quality improvements and process optimization.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with comfort in requirement discussions, estimation, and sprint ceremonies within an Agile pod.

**Good to Have Skills**

* **Salesforce Core** experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* **Financial Services Cloud** testing experience, including household and financial account management, relationship management, and compliance-driven workflows.
* Other automation and testing tools such as Provar, Cypress, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber (BDD), Appium, JMeter or Gearset.
* Experience with Apex unit test validation, SOQL and data validation, and sandbox or environment management strategies.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Financial Services Cloud.
* Experience working with global teams and offshore–onshore delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks for Salesforce and web applications using Playwright, Selenium and Copado.
* Set up and govern the testing process from project inception, including test environments, test data, tooling and quality gates.
* Define test strategies, test plans and test cases aligned to business requirements and process flows.
* Execute functional, regression, integration and smoke testing, and integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Engage directly with clients to clarify requirements, present quality status, and ideate on improvements to coverage and process.
* Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including test reports, defect reports, traceability matrices and automation guides.
* Perform defect triage and root cause analysis, and drive resolution with development teams.
* Support release activities, UAT and production validation, and mentor junior QA engineers on best practices.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience in Salesforce quality assurance and test automation may also be considered. Relevant certifications are preferred.

DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid

Merkle

**Time Type:**

Full time

Permanent

title: Civic Digital Platforms Lead
description:
Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Web and mobile architecture | GIS workflows | Live management reporting

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are hiring a senior solution leader to shape and deliver a public-service platform that connects on-ground observations with maps, management reporting and infrastructure information. The challenge is not only to build screens, but to make the entire workflow reliable, secure and usable by different categories of public officials and field teams.

Your mandate

Own solution architecture, build coordination, quality testing, controlled deployment and technical handover of the digital components.

What you will lead

* **Launch a live evidence-viewing layer.**
  Lead a location-enabled dashboard that is usable from the early rollout and expands as verified data arrive. It must allow multi-level drill-down from an overall indicator to local records, timestamps, coordinates and relevant photographs.
* **Specify practical field-data workflows.**
  Design mobile forms, visit allocation, location validation, image capture, review queues, rejected-record correction and supervisor approvals. Address connectivity, ease of use and duplicate prevention with field operations and spatial-data colleagues.
* **Create an infrastructure information system.**
  Define the web and mobile records for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, materials recovery, transfer, construction-waste and other facilities. Include ownership, GPS position, design and current capacity, operating status, input/output quantities and reject destinations where applicable.
* **Build secure user and stakeholder access.**
  Map separate user groups to appropriate permissions and views. Include strong authentication, an audit trail, documented APIs, clear approval controls and responsible handling of photographs and location-linked records.
* **Unify different analytical sources.**
  Connect survey submissions, spatial layers, facility data, generator checks, operator-performance measures and fleet information without repeated manual data entry. Coordinate interfaces with any parallel public-sector information architecture.
* **Turn field results into management indicators.**
  Develop scorecard and reporting structures for service areas, operations providers, waste streams, planning targets and facility performance. Support clear geographic roll-ups, filters, trend views and exports for review meetings.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Civic Digital Platforms Lead

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Plan the release sequence carefully.**
  Organise early dashboard availability, functional design review, a working version for structured user acceptance and final production release. Match technical sprint plans to the assignment's inception, interim, draft-final and handover checkpoints.
* **Lead testing and technical assurance.**
  Coordinate developers, mobile teams, data engineers and interface designers. Require testing of GIS behavior, user permissions, audit logs, performance, security, incomplete evidence and error recovery before release.
* **Design future management-room compatibility.**
  Document the definition, source, refresh frequency and geographic roll-up of priority indicators. Keep the data model compatible with a broader command and monitoring environment without claiming to operate that facility.
* **Prepare full transfer of knowledge.**
  Arrange administrator orientation, user guides, architecture diagrams, API notes, source-code handover, database exports, deployment procedures and access credentials in an agreed controlled handover package.
* **Provide for support beyond project close.**
  Set up documented hosting, issue-handling, access and maintenance arrangements that enable a twelve-month continuity period for the client, without assuming the individual appointment lasts beyond the stated 3-4 months.

What you will help deliver

* Approved platform architecture and mobile/portal functional requirements.
* Working evidence dashboard and facility-management portal, with controlled user access.
* Test results, fixes, user-acceptance records, release documentation and training guides.
* Code, data, administrator handover and a defined continuity/support operating model.

Who should apply

* B.E., B.Tech or MCA qualification.
* At least 10 years designing and delivering portals and mobile applications for government or municipal use.
* At least one successfully delivered GIS-enabled, role-based portal combining a dynamic dashboard and a mobile application.
* Solution architects or technology delivery heads with skills across API design, databases, GIS integration, security and user acceptance.

How to apply mail to careers@humanmatrix.co.in

description:

Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC)
* Develop flowcharts, layouts and documentation according to the requirements, design and solutions
* Design, implement, and conduct test and evaluation procedures to ensure system requirements are met.
* Perform manual test execution (including, but not limited to: functional, regression and integration testing), identifying defects and conducting root cause analysis of the issues discovered.

* Develop strategies on how best to automate tests for maximum efficiency and coverage then write and maintain test scripts using Selenium or similar tools.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement automated test tools and strategies. Develop, maintain, and upgrade automated test scripts and architectures for application products.
* Ensure product compliance with external software quality requirements, as needed.
* Write, implement, and report status for system test cases for testing.

We want someone passionate and adept at running testing efforts to ensure product quality, learning and implementing new quality assurance (QA) activities and procedures, but we also need an innovative and flexible team member who will do what it takes to help us shape amazing products.

* A BS degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering.
* Knowledge of or experience with test engineering methodology
* 6 or more years of specific testing experience required.
* Proven work experience in software quality assurance
* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes
* Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases
* Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing
* Hands-on experience with automated testing tools
* Solid knowledge of SQL and scripting
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
* Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus

**Additional Skills**

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment, along with Zoho, Bitbucket, Jenkins and Git. Familiarity with common third-party APIs, Payment Gateways, etc.

Apply for this job
  
  
To apply, please send your resume and a cover letter to careers@moonpreneur.com (preferably in pdf format)

description:

**About the Company**

Brevitaz is a technology consulting and product engineering firm headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, founded in 2014. We are a focused team of 60+ professionals who build data-intensive enterprise software for clients across North America and Europe (DACH, UK, Nordics). We are not a generic IT body shop. We are engineers who go deep — specializing in Elasticsearch, data engineering, AI/ML, and full-stack product development. Our clients choose us because we operate as an extension of their engineering teams, not as a vendor on the sidelines.

We want a QA Analyst who is strong at the fundamentals (critical thinker, clear requirements, crisp test cases, sharp bug reports) and who treats AI as a daily tool and a new category of thing to test.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a QA Analyst who asks thoughtful questions, investigates beyond the happy path, and communicates quality risks clearly. You will own manual testing for assigned features and use approved LLM assistants to improve test preparation and analysis, while applying your own judgment to every result.

**What you Bring**

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of manual testing experience on web or enterprise applications.
* Strong verbal English communication and analytical skills.
* Ability to understand and explain a requirement clearly and ask the necessary questions to remove ambiguity.
* Ability to write crisp and clear test cases and test steps.
* Hands-on use of at least one AI assistant in your testing work (test-case generation, test data, bug-report writing, or exploratory testing), and the judgment to spot when its output is wrong or incomplete.
* Ability to communicate ideas effectively, in writing and on calls with clients.
* Passion for delivering top-quality software; a good team player with a positive attitude.
* High level of integrity and accountability; a proactive nature and a habit of working with ownership.

**Good to have**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science.
* Exposure to performance/stress testing
* Experience in data testing and the ability to write complex SQL queries will be a big plus.
* Automation testing experience with Java/Typescript, Selenium, Playwright, or WDIO will be a big plus.
* Knowledge of version control (Git) and how software is delivered (CI/CD) is a plus.
* Willingness to get out of your comfort zone by learning new things. The AI tooling landscape changes every few months; you should enjoy that rather than resist it.
* Basic understanding of how LLM features are built (prompts, context windows, retrieval / RAG, embeddings) so you can reason about where they break.
* Experience testing an AI or LLM-powered feature (chatbot, search, recommendation, summarisation), including deciding how to judge non-deterministic output.
* Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools (natural-language test authoring, self-healing locators, AI visual testing) or AI-native automation approaches such as Playwright with an AI agent.

**Responsibilities**

* Understand requirements specs & acceptance criteria
* Actively participate in client calls for requirement grooming and design
* Participate in test-case brainstorming sessions for major features
* Prepare test cases for manual testing as well as SQL data testing
* Come up with appropriate SQL queries for data testing
* Own development and review of test cases & test steps
* Identify and record bugs
* Participate in meetings to discuss test strategies for QA process improvement
* Timely execution of test cases
* Mentor junior team members

Position Overview
  
  
The Telecom Designer is responsible for performing telecom engineering and design activities for assigned project scope under the direction of a senior designer or lead. This role prepares technical drawings, documents, schedules, and data required for successful project execution, ensuring compliance with project requirements and internal engineering procedures.
  
  
The position supports the development of practical and accurate telecom design outputs, coordinates with related disciplines, and contributes to the timely issue of deliverables. The Telecom Designer is expected to maintain technical quality, support document revisions, and respond to project comments and design changes efficiently.
  
  
The position supports integrated telecom and communications solutions covering communication networks, radio, CCTV, access control, public address and related systems required for safe and effective project operations. It is expected to coordinate closely with electrical, instrumentation, process, layout, vendor, construction, and commissioning teams so that telecom deliverables are technically complete, constructible, and aligned with project standards and operational needs.
  
  
At this level, the role independently executes assigned activities, coordinates interfaces, and supports timely completion of deliverables while applying established procedures and professional judgment. The position is expected to contribute practical solutions, maintain document and data quality, and support continuous improvement through disciplined execution and active collaboration.
  
  
Key Responsibility
  
  

* Prepare telecom design deliverables such as layouts, diagrams, cable schedules, equipment lists, and installation details for assigned scope
* Develop design documents in accordance with project specifications, standards, and guidance from senior team members
* Support preparation of telecom equipment data, MTOs, and design input/output documents
* Coordinate with other disciplines to ensure design consistency and proper interface alignment
* Review comments from internal reviewers, clients, and vendors and incorporate approved changes into deliverables
* Support vendor document review and technical clarification activities under supervision
* Participate in model reviews, interdisciplinary checks, and design meetings as required
* Maintain drawing quality, document traceability, and revision control in accordance with project procedures
* Assist in resolving routine design issues and support site or fabrication queries where needed
* Follow engineering procedures, standard templates, and quality requirements throughout the design process

Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline
* Typically 4~8 years of relevant experience in telecom engineering or design work
* Knowledge of common telecom systems and related engineering deliverables
* Understanding of EPC engineering workflow, design review process, and multidisciplinary project environment
* Working familiarity with AutoCAD and relevant engineering/document management tools
* Ability to interpret specifications, vendor data, and engineering instructions accurately
* Good coordination, communication, and document preparation skills
* English communication capability preferred

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
About UHP Technologies

UHP Technologies Pvt. Ltd., part of the KAS Group, Bengaluru, specializes in ultra-high-purity (UHP) gas delivery systems, chemical distribution systems, cleanroom EPC and utility infrastructure for semiconductor and solar manufacturing clients. With around 17 years in the market and nearly 40 GW of solar manufacturing projects served, UHP delivers both package-wise gas and chemical systems and full utility turnkey solutions for fabs and cell/module factories across India.

Role Summary

We are looking for technically strong Chemical or Mechanical engineers who can turn a customer's enquiry into a winning techno-commercial proposal. You will sit at the centre of the BD team: reading RFQs, BOQs and drawings, working out the technical solution with the design team, building the costing, and presenting a clear, professional offer to the customer. You will work directly with the GM – BD & Sales and will be involved from first enquiry through negotiation and order handover.

Key Responsibilities1. Proposal preparation

* Study RFQs, tender documents, technical specifications, P&IDs, layouts and BOQs, and identify scope, battery limits, exclusions and risks.
* Prepare complete techno-commercial proposals for UHP's packages: specialty / process gas (PGS), bulk gas (BGS), bulk chemical distribution (PCH), process exhaust (PEX), cleanroom and utility turnkey packages (CDA, N₂, PCW, UPW, vacuum, etc.).
* Write technical write-ups, scope of supply, deviation / compliance statements, project schedules and qualifying notes.
* Prepare proposal presentations and company credential decks in UHP's standard format.
* Maintain a library of standard proposal templates, technical write-ups and past offers for quick re-use.

2. Estimation & costing

* Prepare BOQ-based cost estimates using UHP's costing sheets and markup method (material, installation, spares, testing, warranty).
* Float enquiries to vendors (gas cabinets, VMB/VMP, purifiers, tubing & fittings, valves, instrumentation, electrical, exhaust/scrubbers, etc.), and prepare technical and commercial bid evaluations (TBE / CBE).
* Benchmark prices against past bids and maintain an up-to-date rate database.
* Support margin analysis and price negotiations with the GM – BD & Sales.

3. Customer & technical interface

* Attend pre-bid meetings, technical clarification meetings and site visits with customers and consultants.
* Respond to technical queries and clarifications within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with UHP's design, procurement (SCM) and projects teams to make sure what we offer can be delivered on time and within cost.

4. Business development support

* Track enquiries, submissions, follow-ups and win/loss status in the proposal tracker / CRM.
* Support market mapping of semiconductor, solar (cell, module, ingot/wafer) and allied manufacturing projects in India.
* Prepare win/loss analysis and lessons learnt after each major bid.
* Ensure a clean handover of won orders (scope, price, commitments) to the projects team.

Technical Knowledge Required

**Must have (any one strong area, working knowledge of others):**

* Process / utility systems: gas, chemical, compressed air, nitrogen, cooling water, exhaust or water systems.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, GA drawings, isometrics, datasheets and BOQs.
* Piping materials and fundamentals – SS316L (BA / EP), PFA, PVDF, PP, CS; fittings, valves, welding and testing basics.
* Basic engineering calculations: line sizing, pressure drop, flow and consumption estimates, exhaust volume.

**Good to have:**

* Exposure to semiconductor fabs, solar cell / module plants, pharma, specialty chemicals or similar cleanroom / high-purity environments.
* Familiarity with UHP gas delivery components – gas cabinets, VMB/VMP, purifiers, orbital welding, helium leak and particle testing.
* Awareness of relevant standards: SEMI (S2, F-series), NFPA, ASME B31.3, ISO 14644 (cleanrooms), PESO requirements.
* Prior experience preparing proposals or estimates in an EPC / contracting company.

Skills & Competencies

* **Excel:**
  strong – BOQs, costing sheets, lookups, pivots, comparison tables.
* **PowerPoint & Word:**
  able to produce clean, professional, customer-ready documents.
* **AutoCAD / Navisworks viewer:**
  able to read drawings and take quantities (modelling not required).
* **Communication:**
  clear written and spoken English; confident in customer meetings.
* Structured, detail-oriented and deadline-driven – able to handle multiple bids in parallel.
* Commercial sense: understands cost, margin, payment terms, warranty and risk.
* Team player who works well across design, SCM and projects teams.

What We Offer

* Direct exposure to India's fast-growing semiconductor and solar manufacturing sector.
* Work on high-value bids – from individual gas / chemical packages to full utility turnkey projects.
* Close mentoring by the BD leadership and a clear growth path into Senior Proposal Engineer / Proposal Manager / Key Account roles.
* Competitive salary [CTC range – to be confirmed] and performance-linked incentives.

description:

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

description:

**Position Summary**

Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Senior Consultant, Coupa, where you will support digital procurement transformation initiatives across source-to-pay environments. In this role, you will contribute to discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and support activities for Coupa solutions across procurement, sourcing, contracts, supplier management, invoicing, and related modules. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions, deliver quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation and post-go-live activities across the solution lifecycle.

As a Senior Consultant, Coupa on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for supporting source-to-pay transformation initiatives across client environments.

* Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Bachelor of Technology (BTech), Master of Computer Applications (MCA), Master of Technology (MTech), or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:

* Experience supporting service-level agreement-based application support, ticket management, or root cause analysis

* Experience supporting quarterly release management, upgrade planning, or post-go-live optimization
* Coupa or procurement platform certifications

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Mechanical CAD Engineer - Intern
description:
Company Description

Founded in 2024, Kramay Enterprises Private Limited has rapidly become a leading designer and manufacturer of high-performance RF and microwave components. Based in India, Kramay specializes in the research, design, and production of custom-built microwave solutions for a global clientele. With a commitment to continuous development and innovation, Kramay utilizes cutting-edge research and state-of-the-art in-house tools to deliver high-spec, reliable, and specialized components that meet stringent technical demands across various industries.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Intern to join our Mechanical CAD Engineering Team. The ideal candidate will support the creation, modification, and analysis of 2D and 3D mechanical designs using CAD software. You will be essential in ensuring the accuracy, functionality, and manufacturability of mechanical components and systems.

Key Responsibilities:

* Assist in creating and updating 2D & 3D CAD models, assemblies, and detailed engineering drawings for mechanical components and systems.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and R&D, to transform concepts into detailed designs.
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards, company policies, and relevant regulations.
* Assist in conducting tolerance analysis, selecting materials, and applying geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T).
* Assist to perform feasibility studies and simulations for structural and/or thermal analysis to evaluate design feasibility and manufacturability.
* Assist in prototyping and testing processes, integrating feedback into design revisions.
* Contribute to organize a database of CAD files and associated documentation.
* Identify design issues and develop solutions to enhance functionality and cost-efficiency.
* Keep up-to-date with the latest advancements in CAD tools and trends in mechanical engineering.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* Ongoing or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, CAD Design, or a related field.
* Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, AutoCAD, CATIA, or Siemens NX).
* Proficiency in Simulation software (e.g. Solidworks, Ansys Fluent, Icepak, Ansys Mechanical)
* Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of GD&T and tolerance analysis.
* Experience with FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and other simulation tools is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.
* Effective communication skills for collaboration and presenting design concepts.

**Duration and Start Date:**

* Duration: 6 Months
* Start Date: 1st January 2027 or before
* Paid Internship

4. **AI Opportunity Identification:**

11. **Domain Business Engagement:**

    Coordinate with business, IT, data, AI, architecture, and implementation teams to ensure successful delivery of business-aligned technology initiatives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 8–15 years of experience in IT Business Partnering, Digital Transformation, Business Consulting, Product Ownership, or Enterprise Applications.

* Ability to develop business cases, ROI models, and cost-benefit analyses.

* Working knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents.
* Familiarity with AI platforms such as Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Gemini, and OpenAI.
* Understanding of SAP, enterprise application ecosystems, APIs, and system integration concepts.
* Knowledge of AI governance, data privacy, security, and Responsible AI.
* Strong communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills.

Exposure to one or more of the following business domains:

* Manufacturing
* Supply Chain Management
* Procurement
* Packaging
* Quality Management
* FMCG

A business-oriented technology professional who can understand enterprise business challenges, identify AI-driven opportunities, translate business needs into technology initiatives, and facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.

title: Senior-BC sector-Health-Interoperability Specialist-DHEC-Health Consulting-Germany-EU
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Consultant – Interoperability Specialist, Digital Health Consulting (Germany / EU)**
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior Consultant – Interoperability Specialist within EY’s EMEIA-based Digital Health Excellence Center (DHEC), you will support healthcare providers, public administrations, and digital health stakeholders across Germany and the EU in designing and delivering interoperable healthcare ecosystems. The role focuses on improving health outcomes and patient experiences by enabling seamless data exchange across clinical, administrative, and digital health platforms. You will work alongside international experts across technology, business, and healthcare to strengthen DHEC’s delivery capabilities in openEHR, clinical data repositories, and healthcare interoperability.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This role is positioned at Senior Consultant level and requires a strong combination of healthcare interoperability expertise, client-facing consulting skills, and practical delivery experience. You will act as a bridge between clinical, technical, and business stakeholders, helping clients define interoperability priorities, select appropriate standards, design integration approaches, and implement scalable solutions across complex healthcare IT landscapes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Healthcare Interoperability Consulting

+ Advise healthcare clients on interoperability strategies, standards, implementation roadmaps, and target-state integration architectures.
+ Lead or support client workshops with clinical teams, administrators, IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to identify interoperability requirements and pain points.
+ Translate healthcare business and clinical needs into practical interoperability solutions that support patient care, operational efficiency, and data-driven decision-making.
+ Provide technical advisory support for digital health transformation programs involving EHRs, EMRs, clinical systems, medical devices, and data platforms.

* System Integration & Clinical Data Exchange

+ Design and support seamless integration and communication between diverse healthcare IT systems, including Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Electronic Health Records (EHR), Clinical Information Systems (CIS), Clinical Data Repositories (CDR), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), communication servers, interoperability platforms, and medical devices.
+ Support integration of clinical data repositories based on openEHR, including platforms such as Better or vitagroup, where applicable.
+ Define integration patterns and data exchange approaches across clinical domains, administrative systems, and digital health platforms.
+ Coordinate with vendors and external partners to ensure integration solutions are consistent, reliable, scalable, and aligned to client requirements.

* Interoperability Standards & Frameworks

+ Evaluate and recommend healthcare-specific interoperability standards, frameworks, and formats based on client needs and regional requirements.
+ Apply expert knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards including HL7, FHIR, IHE, xDT, and DICOM.
+ Support the use of standardized clinical data models such as SNOMED CT, OMOP, and openEHR for clinical data mapping, harmonization, and exchange.
+ Develop or review mapping approaches between different clinical data formats, terminologies, and integration standards.

* Health Consulting & Client Delivery

+ Work as part of multidisciplinary consulting teams to deliver digital health transformation projects for healthcare providers, public sector organizations, and health ecosystem stakeholders.
+ Prepare client-ready deliverables including assessment reports, solution options, architecture documentation, implementation plans, technical specifications, and executive presentations.
+ Support business development activities through technical input into proposals, client discussions, demos, and healthcare interoperability thought leadership.
+ Provide training, knowledge transfer, and stakeholder enablement to support adoption of interoperability solutions.

* Technology & Delivery Enablement

+ Use hands-on experience with interface formats and protocols such as REST, SOAP, XML, and XSD to support integration design and delivery.
+ Read, review, or develop code in programming languages such as Java, C++, C#, Python, or PHP as required for solution validation or technical delivery.
+ Apply knowledge of agile delivery methods, project management standards, and frameworks such as Scrum or SAFe to support structured project execution.
+ Track industry technology trends and emerging digital health technologies and assess how they can be applied to client projects.

**Experience & Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* Minimum 4–5 years of working experience in a healthcare context with a focus on designing and implementing interoperability solutions; higher experience may align to Manager or Senior Manager levels.
* Experience working in healthcare IT, digital health, medical informatics, system integration, provider technology environments, or healthcare consulting.
* Proven experience working with clinical, business, technical, vendor, and administrative stakeholders.
* Experience supporting multiple project deliveries in parallel and working under tight timelines.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep understanding of system integration in medical system landscapes across software products from multiple clinical domains.
* Expert knowledge and proven work experience with interoperability formats including HL7, FHIR, IHE, xDT, and DICOM.
* Good understanding of standardized clinical data models including SNOMED CT, OMOP, and openEHR.
* Experience with clinical data mapping between different healthcare formats, systems, and terminologies.
* Hands-on experience with REST, SOAP, XML, and XSD.
* Ability to read or develop code in languages such as Java, C++, C#, Python, or PHP.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Medical Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, Health Informatics, or another related field with a strong IT focus.
* Master’s degree, further certifications, or relevant healthcare interoperability certifications are advantageous.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills for both technical and business audiences.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to communicate complex interoperability concepts in a clear and practical way for executive, clinical, and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work across international teams and multicultural project environments.
* Ability and flexibility to travel based on client and project requirements.

**Language Requirements**

* Fluency in English, written and verbal, is required.
* German language capability is strongly preferred for Germany/EU client delivery; additional European languages are advantageous.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* A reliable network in the healthcare industry and a consulting track record.
* A strong overview of healthcare technology trends, emerging technologies, and how these trends apply to healthcare clients.
* Experience driving adoption of modern interoperability and digital health solutions into client projects.
* Good knowledge of agile project management standards, processes, procedures, and delivery frameworks.

**What We Look For**

* We are looking for an experienced Interoperability Specialist with strong technical skills, a proven track record in healthcare, and the consulting mindset required to support complex digital health transformation programs. The ideal candidate can connect healthcare domain needs with technology delivery, work effectively with clients and vendors, and help build interoperable systems that improve patient experience, clinical workflows, and health data exchange.

**Preferred Profile**

* A consulting-oriented healthcare interoperability professional who can advise and deliver across Germany and the EU by combining interoperability standards expertise, clinical data model knowledge, system integration experience, and strong stakeholder management capabilities.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
