title: Lead Design Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Principal Customer Support Manager**
**Artisan Foundation IP Group, Cadence | Bangalore, Hyderabad or Noida**
**Role Summary**
Lead end-to-end customer support for Artisan Physical IP products, including standard cells, embedded memories, GPIO and mixed-signal/foundation IP. Serve as the senior customer advocate and technical bridge between customers and Physical IP R&D, from issue intake and triage through solution evaluation, technical resolution, communication and verified closure. Partner across Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Operations, Sales and IT to protect customer commitments and convert recurring issues into scalable improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own case intake, prioritization, assignment, escalation, aging, resolution tracking, customer validation and closure for Physical IP product and delivery issues.
* Lead customer-facing technical reviews and complex escalations, clearly communicating the problem definition, investigation status, solution alternatives, risks, required actions and closure criteria.
* Act as the technical bridge between customers and Physical IP R&D, translating customer requirements and SoC integration issues into actionable engineering problems, evaluating alternative solutions and trade-offs, and driving the most appropriate path to resolution.
* Apply structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis to distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and develop practical containment, workaround and long-term corrective solutions.
* Drive technical issue qualification and reproduction by ensuring customer use conditions, SoC integration context, configuration data, reports, logs and test cases are sufficiently documented for effective investigation across engineering and partner teams.
* Establish support governance and review cadences; maintain dashboards covering responsiveness, time to containment and resolution, backlog aging, recurrence, reopened cases, corrective-action progress and customer impact.
* Translate support trends into product, collateral, documentation, training, knowledge-base, delivery-platform and process improvements.
* Partner with Artisan Product Management and Engineering on support readiness for new Physical IP products, foundry technologies, platform releases and delivery changes.
* Build reusable troubleshooting guides, FAQs and playbooks; coach teams on case ownership, escalation and customer communication; advance automation, self-service, analytics and AI-enabled support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
* 10+ years in customer support, applications engineering, product engineering, technical program management or a related semiconductor/EDA customer-facing role.
* Working knowledge of the Physical IP lifecycle, including development, characterization, qualification, release and secure customer delivery, together with a strong understanding of Physical IP integration into SoC implementation flows.
* Strong technical problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex customer issues, develop and evaluate alternative solutions and trade-offs, and communicate recommendations clearly to customers and R&D teams.
* Experience leading complex customer escalations and coordinating technical resolution across distributed engineering and business teams.
* Ability to establish operating processes, service metrics, management reporting and accountability without direct authority.
* Excellent analytical, prioritization and executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting standard cells, embedded memories, GPIO, mixed-signal IP or related foundation IP in foundry and advanced-node environments.
* Familiarity with PDKs, product collateral, customer portals, entitlement/access workflows, licensing, secure data delivery and issue-management systems.
* Experience with Jira, Salesforce or similar case-management tools, plus Power BI, advanced Excel, Confluence, automation or AI-enabled workflows.

**Critical Success Factors**
Customer advocacy with balanced technical and business judgment | Structured problem-solving and solution orientation | Effective customer-to-R&D translation | Calm leadership during high-impact escalations | Ownership through verified closure | Clear, concise communication | Scalable support capability rather than individual heroics
  
  
**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Principal Engineer Global NPI
description:
**Job Description**
The Principal Engineer, Customer Advocacy Engineering (CAE), is a senior individual contributor who provides technical leadership for Global New Product Introduction across optical networking products and solutions. The role drives product quality, serviceability, and customer experience from concept through First Customer Ship (FCS) and General Availability (GA) by translating field and customer needs into actionable engineering requirements. Working across Technical Support, Product Line Management, Hardware and Software Engineering, System Test, Services, and customers, the Principal Engineer serves as a trusted technical authority for product readiness, onboarding, and complex issue resolution.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Provide technical leadership for customer onboarding, trials, certifications, demonstrations, and early deployment of new optical hardware and software.
* Define and drive clear, testable Serviceability Requirements across the product lifecycle.
* Lead resolution of complex product-introduction issues through cross-functional root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Assess product readiness, deployment risks, supportability, and customer adoption needs from concept through FCS and GA.
* Convert customer and field feedback into improvements in product reliability, usability, diagnosability, and maintainability.
* Influence product architecture, feature design, test strategy, documentation, tooling, training, and support models.
* Develop reusable readiness criteria, best practices, automation, and technical knowledge assets to scale NPI execution.
* Mentor engineers and stakeholders through design reviews, troubleshooting, and technical knowledge sharing.
* Track technical readiness, serviceability, adoption, and issue-resolution indicators, and communicate risks and recommendations.
* Represent CAE in customer and cross-functional forums, building alignment on technical priorities, trade-offs, and plans.

**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant industry experience in Optical Networking, Technical Support, Product Introduction, System Test, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, including demonstrated leadership of complex cross-functional technical initiatives.
* Deep knowledge of long-haul and/or metro optical networks, with strong experience in customer onboarding, product introduction, deployment readiness, and critical escalation resolution.
* Proven ability to influence architecture, engineering, product management, quality, services, and support organizations without formal authority, using sound technical judgment and evidence-based recommendations.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to engineering teams, customers, and senior leaders.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on exposure to automation and management technologies such as Python, SDN, NETCONF, gNMI, OpenROADM, SNMP, network management systems, and domain or network controllers.
* Experience developing serviceability requirements, readiness frameworks, operational metrics, technical training, or reusable deployment and troubleshooting practices.
* Relevant optical networking, systems engineering, automation, cloud, or project/program leadership

title: Senior Content Marketer
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
We're hiring a Senior Content Marketer to help Sprinto create content that stands out in a category full of sameness.
  
  
This role is much more than churning out blog posts from a brief or turning top-ranking articles into another version of the same thing.
  
  
We want someone who can think critically, research deeply, write exceptionally well, and
**find angles that make our content genuinely useful to the people**
buying compliance automation.
  
  
You'll work across blogs, guides, landing pages, comparison pages, and other content formats.
  
  
You'll collaborate with subject-matter experts, organic growth, product marketing, and demand generation to turn complex ideas into clear, compelling
**content that earns attention**
and builds trust.
  
  
AI has made content easier to produce. Your job is to
**make Sprinto's content worth reading**
.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**
What you'll do
  
  
  

* Own content from initial research and ideation through writing, editing, and publication across blogs, in depth guides, landing pages, comparison pages, and other relevant formats.
* Make complex topics like security compliance, audit readiness, risk management, and compliance automation accessible and engaging without compromising technical accuracy or depth.
* Build compelling narratives and well reasoned arguments rather than relying on generic introductions, predictable structures, or recycled perspectives.
* Understand who you're writing for, what they already know, the problems they're trying to solve, and the decisions they're looking to make. Shape your content accordingly.
* Write with clarity, precision, and a distinct voice. Know when to explain, when to demonstrate, and when to get straight to the point.
* Go beyond surface level research. Work with subject matter experts, ask thoughtful questions, validate claims, and uncover insights that make the content genuinely valuable.
* Take ownership of editorial quality, ensuring every piece meets a high standard for accuracy, structure, readability, consistency, and attention to detail.
* Approach feedback with an open mind and independent judgment. Know when to incorporate it, when to challenge it constructively, and how to make every revision meaningfully better.

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**
What we're looking for
  
  
  

* Typically 5 to 8 years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism, or a related field.
* You're an exceptional writer and an even better editor. You know the difference between content that's technically accurate and content that's genuinely worth reading.
* You're intellectually curious. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and dig deeper to find insights and perspectives that others might miss.
* You understand the commercial purpose of content. Whether it's building category credibility, driving organic discovery, educating buyers, or supporting sales conversations, you know what good content needs to accomplish.
* You're comfortable navigating complexity. You can quickly understand unfamiliar or technical subjects and turn them into clear, engaging narratives without sacrificing accuracy or depth.
* You have strong research instincts. You know how to validate claims, interview subject matter experts, uncover original insights, and build arguments grounded in evidence.
* You bring independent editorial judgment. You can identify compelling angles, shape narratives, challenge briefs when needed, and take ownership of content from idea to publication.
* You use AI thoughtfully to improve your research and creative process, without compromising originality, accuracy, or editorial quality.

What you'll bring
  
  
  

* A strong portfolio that demonstrates exceptional writing, editorial judgment, original thinking, and the ability to make complex subjects accessible.
* Experience creating content for B2B SaaS audiences. Exposure to cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, or other technical categories is a plus.
* A track record of developing original content through research, expert conversations, and a strong understanding of the audience.
* A solid understanding of SEO fundamentals and how content contributes to organic discovery and business outcomes.
* Experience using AI

**Your portfolio matters more than your title. Show us the work you're proud of, explain the thinking behind it, and tell us what made it effective.**
**How we care for our Sprinters?**

* Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
* Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
* We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
* We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
* Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
* Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Lead Analyst - Credit Data Solutions
description:

Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition:**
Shaping the Future of Enterprise Data & Analytics. Contribute to the evolution of data culture by building and enhancing data infrastructure, reporting frameworks, optimizing data pipelines, Data remediation for Regulatory Reporting needs and mentoring teams on data storytelling and visualization best practices with advanced data technologies and experience.
  
  
**Job Details**

* Position Title: Lead Analyst - Credit Data Solutions
* Career Level: P3
* Job Category: Manager/SME
* Role Type: Hybrid
* Job Location: Bangalore

**About The Team**
This role will join an Agile pod to support the data environment that enables Regulatory Reporting teams to file complete and accurate Y-14 regulatory reports. This role focuses on bridging business needs and technical solutions by gathering requirements, analyzing data processes, and ensuring the data environment aligns with data governance and regulatory compliance objectives. Working collaboratively with cross-functional pod members, the Business Analyst will drive efficient workflows, optimize data systems, and support iterative delivery in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  
  
**Impact**
This role requires a strong experience in Data Remediation for reg reporting with mix of data expertise, relationship-building, operational rigor, and the ability to partner across global teams. This role will work closely with Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Data Governance, Technology, Architecture, and Operations to identify data challenges, prioritize remediation initiatives, and advance the bank’s data maturity
  
  
**Key Deliverables**

* Requirements Gathering - Collaborate with Regulatory Reporting teams, and stakeholders to elicit, document, and prioritize business requirements for the FR Y-14
* Agile Collaboration - Participate in Agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) to align on pod goals, refine user stories, and deliver incremental improvements
* Stakeholder Communication - Act as a liaison between Regulatory Reporting teams, data engineers, and developers to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements.
* Data Quality & Governance - Support the implementation of data quality rules and controls to ensure compliance with data governance and regulatory requirements
* Testing & Validation - Assist in defining acceptance criteria for data-related user stories and support testing to ensure the data environment meets regulatory and business needs
* Documentation - Create and maintain clear documentation, requirements specifications, and user guides, as well as source-to-target mapping and metadata documentation in Collibra, to support regulatory audits and team workflows
* Understand Regulatory Edit Checks and other data quality controls and work with stakeholders to strengthen the risk and control environment
* Root Cause Analysis - Conduct thorough root cause analysis of data gaps and data quality issues and formulate the resulting remediation initiatives
* Regulatory Responses - Formulate responses to Regulatory Edit Checks and other inquiries that result from FR Y-14Q filings
* Understanding of data environments, including databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, Snowflake, Netezza), both on-prem and in cloud. And familiarity with ETL and data virtualization tools. Good understanding of SQL

**Functional Skills:**
**Data Quality, Controls & Remediation**

* Strengthen end-to-end data controls, including lineage, reconciliation, validations, monitoring, and issue management.
* Identify data breakages, root causes, and impactful remediation pathways in partnership with global stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvements aligned with enterprise data governance policies and regulatory expectations.

**Finance & Regulatory Reporting Enablement**

* Support data requirements for key regulatory filings (e.g., FR Y-14, Y-9C, Call Reports, Liquidity, and other finance data needs).

* Follow enterprise data governance policies, standards, and controls across critical data domains.
* Partner with Data Governance to ensure business terms, data definitions, lineage, and critical data elements meet required standards.
* Drive adoption of governance frameworks and champion data stewardship across Finance and Regulatory Reporting

**Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management**

* Build and sustain strong working relationships with across Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Data Governance, Engineering, Architecture, and Operations.
* Ensure clear, transparent, and proactive communication with global teams and stakeholders at multiple levels.

**Strategic Data Migration & Modernization**

* Help identify and prioritize strategic data migration opportunities to modern platforms (e.g., cloud environments, Snowflake) in partnership with Engineering & Architecture teams.
* Ensure data migrations contribute to improvements in data quality, governance maturity, and operational resilience.
* Drive adoption of modern data tools and capabilities across enterprise teams.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands on experience in database connectivity, SQL Server / Dev, Oracle, Snowflake, Netezza, both on-prem and in cloud. And familiarity with ETL and data virtualization tools.
* Experience in data governance tools like Collibra or equaling
* 8 to 10+ years of experience in data management, data quality, data remediation, data governance, preferably within banking or financial services.
* Prior banking experience in large financial institutions and experience supporting regulatory reporting functions is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of Finance and Regulatory Reporting data needs.
* Experience working with enterprise data quality tools, frameworks, and control processes.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Technology, and Governance.
* Demonstrated experience identifying data issues, driving root cause analysis, and leading remediation initiatives.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Data, Engineering, Finance, Computer Science, or related field.

* Able to work effectively as part of a diverse team of auditors and independently.
* Ability to communicate fluently in both oral and written English.
* Must have efficiently written technical reports and effectively presented the information related to assessments.
* Strong ability to coach and educate team members and laboratory staff.

title: DFM/SMT Engineer
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Review PCB designs, Gerber/ODB++ files, BOMs, and technical documentation to assess manufacturability and assembly feasibility.
* Conduct DFM/DFA analysis and provide recommendations to improve yield, quality, cost, and production efficiency.
* Support RFQ, NPI, and manufacturing industrialization activities by translating design requirements into scalable manufacturing solutions.
* Collaborate with design, production, quality, supply chain, and business teams to align product requirements with factory capabilities.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to PCB fabrication, component selection, assembly processes, and production readiness.
* Support SMT process validation activities, including stencil design reviews, SMT setup, reflow profiling, AOI readiness, and process qualification.
* Generate manufacturability assessments, risk reports, cost-impact analyses, and technical recommendations for customer and internal reviews.
* Drive resolution of design-for-manufacturing issues through direct engagement with customers, design teams, and suppliers.
* Analyze production yield, defect trends, and process performance data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Develop and maintain DFM guidelines, best practices, and reusable knowledge assets to enhance future product launches.

**Qualifications**

title: Consultant, Ops Compliance (Sustainability/Environment)
description:

is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
  
  
Our
**Consulting Delivery Hub**
(CDH) in India is a critical part of ERM’s global consulting model enabling scalable, high-quality delivery across regions and service lines. CDH teams work in close partnership with regional consultants to support global client projects, providing specialist expertise, driving consistency, and enhancing delivery efficiency across our most important programmes.
  
  
As part of the Consulting Delivery Hub, you will collaborate with colleagues worldwide, contribute to complex sustainability projects, and play a key role in shaping the future of global consulting delivery.
  
  
**Why this role matters?**
As a
**Operational Compliance Consultant**
, you will support ERM’s global consulting delivery by contributing to the design, implementation, and management of operational compliance programs, supporting governance, and helping clients manage regulatory and operational risk. You will work within the Safe & Sustainable Operations (SSO) service line, partnering with global consultants to deliver digitally enabled compliance solutions, regulatory reporting, and managed compliance services.
  
  
This role involves supporting stakeholders, contributing to workstream delivery, and translating compliance obligations into practical solutions, while also supporting the development of the CDH-SSO team.
  
  
**What your impact is?**

* Support US team on operational compliance, environmental permitting, audit readiness, compliance engagements, including diagnostics, gap assessments, and implementation support.
* Support translating regulatory requirements into procedures, and support governance improvements that strengthen compliance performance through QA/QC frameworks.
* Manage a workstream or support multiple workstreams, while maintaining quality, budget, and timeline commitments.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with stakeholders and cross-functional teams across operations, risk, legal, sustainability, and HSE.
* Support the CDH-SSO team by coaching CL1 and CL1S through project delivery, onboarding, and learning initiatives.

**What will you bring?**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, chemical engineering, occupational health and safety, or a related discipline; equivalent experience considered.
* Typically, 5+ years of relevant experience in consulting, operational compliance, regulatory compliance, environmental management, or a related advisory role.
* Experience in operational compliance, EHS, or sustainability consulting, with strong understanding of regulatory frameworks and operational requirements across air, water, waste, chemicals, reporting, due diligence, impact assessment, and remediation.
* Ability to support workstreams, proposals, and projects while managing scope, risk, and quality.
* Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality outputs within a QA/QC framework.

* Experience working with global teams, diverse industries, and cross-functional stakeholders, with strong collaboration and communication skills.

* Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.

The Compliance Specialist is responsible for supporting and managing the organization’s information security, privacy, and regulatory compliance activities. **Key Responsibilities**
**ISMS & Governance**

* Maintain and continually improve the Information Security Management System (ISMS), including policies, procedures, controls, and records
* Coordinate risk assessments, risk treatment plans, Statement of Applicability (SoA), and management review activities
* Maintain compliance registers, control matrices, evidence repositories, and documented information
* Support security awareness initiatives and communicate compliance requirements to relevant stakeholders

**Standards & Regulatory Compliance**

* Support implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of ISO/IEC 27001-based ISMS requirements
* Demonstrate working knowledge of ISO/IEC 42001 requirements for an Artificial Intelligence Management System (AIMS), including AI governance and risk management
* Coordinate compliance activities for PCI DSS and SOC 2, including control mapping, evidence collection, gap assessments, and remediation tracking

**Audit & Assessment Management**

* Coordinate internal audits, external certification audits, surveillance audits, and customer assessments
* Prepare audit plans, evidence packs, control narratives, and supporting documentation
* Track nonconformities, observations, risks, and corrective and preventive actions through closure
* Work with control owners to validate evidence, address audit findings, and demonstrate control effectiveness

**Risk Management & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify compliance gaps and assess risks related to information security, privacy, AI governance, and applicable standards
* Maintain risk registers, corrective action plans, compliance calendars, and periodic review records
* Monitor changes to standards and regulatory requirements and assess their impact on organizational controls
* Recommend practical improvements to strengthen governance, documentation, and control maturity

* Experience managing security incidents and crisis situations
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills

4. **UAV Testing & Validation:**
   Conduct ground testing, flight testing, system validation, and performance evaluation of multirotor, fixed-wing, and VTOL UAV platforms.
5. **Troubleshooting:**
   Identify and resolve hardware and software integration issues related to flight controllers, motors, ESCs, power distribution, sensors, and communication systems.
6. **Mission Planning & Navigation:**
   Configure and test waypoint navigation, autonomous flight operations, mission planning, and Ground Control Station (GCS) functionalities.
7. **Performance Optimization:**
   Evaluate and optimize UAV flight performance, stability, endurance, payload capacity, and overall system reliability.
8. **Technical Documentation:**
   Prepare system integration reports, test procedures, troubleshooting records, and technical documentation for UAV development activities.

Educational Qualification & Skills

1. Bachelor's degree in
   **Aeronautical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Avionics, ECE, EEE, Robotics, or Mechatronics**
   .
2. 2–3 years of hands-on experience in UAV development, system integration, testing, or related aerospace domains.
3. Strong working knowledge of flight controllers, particularly
   **Pixhawk, ArduPilot, PX4**
   , and their configuration.
4. Practical experience with UAV components, including BLDC motors, ESCs, propellers, batteries, GPS, IMU, telemetry, and power distribution systems.
5. Knowledge of communication protocols such as
   **UART, I2C, SPI, CAN, and MAVLink**
   , along with experience using Mission Planner or QGroundControl.
6. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently conduct UAV integration, ground testing, and flight testing.

title: Startup Success and Execution Manager
description:
**FORGE Startup Success and Execution Manager**

Hyderabad | Approximately ₹50,000 per month | Minimum 2 years of relevant experience

**About The Big Blind**

The Big Blind is a venture studio working with early-stage founders to strengthen their businesses and prepare for growth. Through FORGE, we help startups sharpen their business models, address execution gaps, improve commercial readiness and build the materials and evidence needed for meaningful investor conversations.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for someone who loves startups and can turn founder discussions into completed work. You will be the continuous point of contact for assigned founders throughout FORGE, owning programme timelines, startup readiness and growth execution with The Big Blind team and specialist mentors. This is a hands-on business-building role, not just programme administration or investment research.

FORGE combines approximately two months of business building and readiness work with investor outreach and connections from the third month. You will help founders move from diagnosis to focused action, while developing their pitch, financials and diligence readiness in parallel. Delivery must follow each startup’s agreed scope and milestones.

**What you will own**

Startup diagnosis and execution plans: Understand the product, customer, market, traction and founder priorities. Identify the most important gaps and translate them into a practical plan with owners, deadlines and evidence of completion.

Business models and growth execution: Assess each startup’s customer segments, pricing, revenue streams and unit economics. Translate strategy into go-to-market, customer acquisition and partnership experiments, track results and help founders make decisions across different business models.

Financial models and analysis: Build or improve spreadsheet models covering revenue, costs, cash flow, burn, runway and relevant unit economics. Test assumptions and scenarios, reconcile available actuals and explain the numbers clearly to founders.

Pitch and business materials: Develop and refine pitch decks, one-pagers and business narratives. Ensure the market story, growth plan and financial model are consistent, supported and easy to understand.

Continuous founder engagement: Stay actively connected with founders throughout the programme, not only during sessions. Run the twice-weekly working cadence, set pre-work, follow up between sessions, resolve bottlenecks and keep founders accountable and supported.

Diligence readiness: Organise the data room and supporting evidence, identify missing information and track closure of readiness gaps. Coordinate legal, tax or other specialist inputs where needed rather than substituting for professional advice.

Mentors and network coordination: Bring the right internal or external expertise into each startup’s work. Support approved customer, partner and investor introductions with relevant materials, clear follow-through and accurate feedback tracking.

Timeline and readiness ownership: Own milestones, dependencies and delivery dates for each startup. Track commercial and investor-readiness gaps, flag slippage early and agree recovery actions. Maintain accurate records and weekly updates through programme close and handover.

**What you should bring**

At least 2 years of relevant experience in startup operations, a founder’s office, venture building, an accelerator or incubator, consulting, or another role involving hands-on work with early-stage businesses.

A genuine interest in startups and the judgement to work constructively with founders through ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.

A practical understanding of multiple startup business models, such as SaaS, marketplaces, D2C, services and product-led businesses. Know how pricing, sales cycles, margins, working capital and growth drivers differ, and adapt the execution plan accordingly.

Confidence building and reviewing financial models in Excel or Google Sheets. You should understand how revenue, costs, cash flow, burn and runway connect, and be able to challenge assumptions without inventing missing data.

The ability to turn complex ideas and analysis into clear pitch decks, one-pagers and action plans using PowerPoint, Google Slides or similar tools.

Strong project ownership: managing multiple workstreams, following up consistently and producing high-quality deliverables on time.

Strong analytical and presentation skills: interpret financial and business data, structure recommendations clearly and present them confidently to founders and stakeholders. Communicate clearly in writing and facilitate productive discussions.

Discretion with startup information and a habit of distinguishing verified facts, founder claims and working assumptions.

**Helpful but not essential**

Ideally, an MBA, a master’s degree in finance, or relevant hands-on finance experience. A specific degree is not required; practical ability and relevant experience matter.

Experience supporting pre-seed or seed-stage startups through business building, fundraising preparation or investor diligence.

Exposure to customer discovery, sales experiments, partnership development or operating metrics across different business models.

Familiarity with cap tables, startup data rooms and investor-facing materials.

Experience coordinating mentors, specialists or cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority.

**What good performance looks like**

Founders stay engaged throughout the programme. Each startup has a current plan, clear owners and dates, with timely follow-ups and recovery actions when milestones slip.

Sessions lead to completed actions and useful evidence, not just meeting notes. Blockers and scope changes are surfaced early.

Financial models are usable and internally consistent; assumptions and gaps are transparent. Pitch materials accurately reflect the business.

Startups make measurable progress against agreed growth priorities and readiness milestones, backed by evidence rather than activity alone, and finish with usable materials and clear next steps.

Introductions and investor conversations are well prepared and followed through. Success is not defined by promising funding or guaranteeing growth.

* Configure and support Coupa modules based on project scope, including Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, and Spend Analytics.
* Support integration design and execution between Coupa and enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, and Workday Financials, including connectors, flat-file integrations, and related data flows.

* Experience configuring Coupa modules such as Procurement, Sourcing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Information Management, Invoicing, Expenses, Coupa Pay, or Spend Analytics

* Experience supporting procurement transformation, roadmap assessments, process re-engineering, or tool selection activities
* Experience with software-as-a-service procurement platforms such as Ivalua, SAP Ariba, or SAP Concur
* Experience supporting service-level agreement-based application support, ticket management, or root cause analysis
* Experience delivering training, user enablement materials, or software demonstrations for procurement platforms
* Experience supporting quarterly release management, upgrade planning, or post-go-live optimization
* Coupa or procurement platform certifications

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

title: Manager – ERC Innovation Product Assurance
description:
**Summary**
ERC Innovation develops and supports a portfolio of products and technology-enabled solutions that strengthen Ethics, Risk & Compliance capabilities. These products support a range of business processes and user groups across the organization.
  
  
The Product Assurance function ensures that ERC products are reliable, well-supported and continuously improved throughout their lifecycle. The scope includes digital platforms, applications, workflow solutions, reporting products, automation and AI-enabled capabilities, together with their related processes and integrations.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Manager, ERC Innovation Product Assurance supports the ongoing operations, quality, adoption and continuous improvement of products in the ERC Innovation portfolio. The role works closely with Business System Owners/Product Owners, business stakeholders, vendors and IT/digital teams to keep assigned products reliable, user-friendly, well-supported and aligned with agreed business requirements.
  
  
This is a product assurance and operational support role. It does not carry Business/System Owner or Product Owner accountability.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Product Operations & Support**

* Provide operational support for assigned ERC products, including user queries, service requests and coordination of product-related issues.
* Monitor support trends, user feedback, open defects and enhancement requests to support prioritization and continuous improvement.
* Support incident, change and release activities in partnership with IT/digital teams, vendors, Business/System Owners and business stakeholders.

**Testing & Release Assurance**

* Execute and coordinate testing for defect fixes, enhancements, configuration and workflow updates, integrations and new functionality across assigned products.
* Prepare and execute test cases in appropriate test environments, document outcomes and run readiness checks before production deployment.
* Help maintain practical testing standards and structured test records for product changes.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Business/System Owners, GPOs, Business Coordinators, vendors and IT/digital teams to keep communication clear and follow-up on product changes tight.
* Track actions on defects, enhancements, release items, user feedback, training needs and operational improvements.
* Support structured discussions with process and business stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify impacts and confirm operational readiness.

**Configuration & Administration Support**

* Support product configuration and administration, including master data maintenance, user onboarding/offboarding, access management coordination, organizational unit updates and activity/category changes.
* Maintain configuration documentation, operating procedures, release documentation and support records.
* Escalate technical, functional or data issues to the right owners and follow through to resolution.

**User Enablement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and maintain training materials, quick reference guides, user communications, knowledge articles and product support content.
* Provide functional guidance to users on business processes and product usage, under the guidance of the relevant Business/System Owner or Product Owner.
* Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, Power BI reports and operational insights covering product support, adoption and service quality.
* Identify automation, simplification and productivity opportunities, including AI-enabled ones, to improve user experience and product effectiveness.

**Essential Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in product operations, business applications support, service management, digital product support or technology-enabled business processes.
* Proven experience supporting enterprise products and platforms, working across business, technology, vendor and operational teams in a global environment.
* Hands-on experience in testing, defect management, release support, incident management, change management, application support or platform operations.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving follow-up on system enhancements, operational improvements and user adoption.
* Experience creating and interpreting KPIs, dashboards, Power BI reports and operational metrics.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, planning and organizational skills.
* University degree or equivalent experience in Business, Technology, Operations, Life Sciences or a related discipline.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Understanding of Ethics, Risk & Compliance processes and how they are supported by digital products.
* Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and its business context.
* Experience with enterprise workflow platforms, ServiceNow, Power BI, Excel or AI-enabled solutions.

title: Senior Engineer – LCC HVDC Control and Protection Systems
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The energy transition drives an unprecedented growth in demand for and generation of electricity. High voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission systems play a key role in connecting remote and offshore renewables and reinforcing AC grids. GE Vernova Grid Systems Integration business line offers control and protection solutions for Line Commutated Converter (LCC) HVDC valve technologies. The "brain" of these stations consists of control and protection systems that ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation.
  
  
GE Vernova HVDC NPI team requires a Senior Engineer to act as the technical authority for LCC HVDC systems. This role serves as a technical consultant and gatekeeper, ensuring design excellence, leading state-of-the-art technology improvements, and mentoring the next generation of engineering talent.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the recognised expert in LCC HVDC control and protection systems, both internally and externally
* Lead the authoring, review, and governance of system-level and functional requirements for LCC HVDC systems
* Own validation strategies for functional requirements, ensuring performance, reliability, and safety standards are met
* Direct the creation and maintenance of high-quality design specifications across complex sub-systems
* Drive internal and external standardisation, including representation in IEC, CIGRE, and similar professional bodies
* Lead root cause analysis and provide technical authority on major quality, supplier, and field issues
* Support R&D programmes from concept through industrialisation and promote technology synergies across GE Vernova businesses
* Mentor engineering talent, support competence development, and provide technical consultation across the business

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related field with a focus on control systems
* Experience working in industrial applications such as HVDC, power electronics, or power systems in a technical lead capacity
* Experience writing formal system and functional requirements and managing validation and verification activities
* Strong experience in control and protection algorithm development using MATLAB/Simulink and conducting EMT studies
* Deep technical understanding of LCC technology, including firing angle control, synchronization logic, commutation failure prediction and mitigation, DC line protection and recovery sequences, and AC/DC interaction and reactive power control
* Strong understanding of large-scale, high-reliability, high-performance real-time control systems
* Ability to apply advanced technology to resolve complex technical challenges

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to interface with senior leadership and customers
* Proven ability to lead complex engineering processes in demanding environments
* Recognised industry expertise in LCC HVDC control and protection
* Willingness to travel for business and technical consultation as required

We do not expect applicants to meet all of the requirements listed. If your skills, experience, and strengths align with several key aspects of the role, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Why Join GE Vernova**
This is an opportunity to work on critical HVDC technology at the centre of the global energy transition. You will help shape advanced control and protection solutions, influence long-term technical direction, and contribute to reliable, resilient power transmission infrastructure used around the world.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Every action shapes our future. That’s why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.
  
  
Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.
  
  
Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world’s electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!
  
  
**We're determined to be the best place to grow**
We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We’re committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.
  
  
We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.
  
  
**Inclusion & Diversity**
We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.
  
  
As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.
  
  
Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About BharatNXT**

BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch.

**The role**

A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often.

**What you'll do**

* **Own founder priorities**

  - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships.
* **Launch things**

  - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked.
* **Build partnerships**

  - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track.
* **Turn numbers into decisions**

  - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation.
* **Know the market**

  - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now.
* **Run experiments**

  - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill.
* **Strengthen operations**

  - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support.
* **Make us faster**

  - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved.
* **Take on special projects**

  - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet.

**What we're looking for**

* 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions.
* Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased.

**Bonus:**

an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

**Why take it**

You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does.

If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.

This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member.

* Participation in sales negotiations, corresponding preparation, and follow-up in co-operation with sales department
* Attend clarification meetings with clients as required and provide all necessary support to Sales to ensure the offered solution meets specification/customer requirement while highlighting our competitive advantage
* Leading technical negotiations with subcontractors
* Ensuring a complete and successful order handover to project team
* Regular maintenance of our sales systems and the data contained therein

**Work experience**
: >5 years
  
  
**Expertise (e.g. Professional, Technical)**

* Successfully completed technical studies (ideally mechanical engineering, industrial engineering or process engineering or equal)

What we offer you
  
  
Medical insurance for self and family
  
  
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

title: Sustainability and Climate Data Product Associate
description:

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented
**Associate / Senior Associate**
to join our team in Mumbai (/Pune). This role will focus on supporting and enhancing data distribution in MSCI’s Sustainability and Climate business, with a particular focus on ensuring our Climate data products and distribution are ready for the era of AI. The ideal candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders to enhance data distribution channels, prepare datasets for use in AI tools and workflows, contribute to data catalog development, and support client communication on new features and enhancements.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Distribution Channels: Contribute to initiatives that enhance MSCI’s Sustainability and Climate data distribution platforms (e.g., Snowflake, feeds, MCP, portals), ensuring scalability and client satisfaction.

title: Sector Specialist
description:

Sector Specialist
  
  
**Reporting To**
RH - Corporate and Government Advisory
  
  
**Business Unit**
Corporate and Government Advisory
  
  
**Location**
Mumbai
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To primarily drive the execution of Advisory assignments / preparing knowledge reports for Corporate and Government clients and to bring depth, context, and credibility to the engagements in the identified sectors with actionable research and insights to enable outreach and engagement with clients as also to support the business development efforts
  
  
**SECTION IV: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & KPIS OF THE ROLE**
**Responsibilities**

* Core Responsibilities
* Drive proactive policy engagement with municipal corporations, state climate agencies, and nodal government bodies (e.g., BEE, MoEFCCC) to support formulation of new methodologies/ projects, facilitate the adoption of best practices and alignment with NDCs
* Development of a Decarbonization and Carbon Markets advisory offerings, and areas of opportunity so as to act as a bridge between evolving government climate mandates and MSME clients.
* Source advisory mandates and execute seamlessly in advising MSMEs and corporate clients on complex climate-impact related business barriers, (such as CBAM) in export markets and impending domestic climate rules /carbon markets
* Work on Policy-to-Action frameworks such as translating policy landscapes and national climate targets into actionable business strategies for clients, and opportunities for transition / green finance.
* Technical Excellence & Oversight support for MSMEs in emission measurement / reduction requirements, including best practices, aligning CCTS opportunities, GHG accounting, and carbon market readiness, and developing these into comprehensive business advisory solutions.
* Build an intelligence and advocacy network with industry associations, verification agencies, and market integrity bodies, institutions in the climate finance / blended finance ecosystem and sources of such capital, and provide clients with insights on shifts in rules and market developments.
* Knowledge champion to compile data analyzed into a specific sector to generate insightful, actionable knowledge aligned to clients’ areas of interest and business strategy and to lead sectoral initiatives and develop sector-specific insights, reports, event partnerships, policy advocacy and similar thought leadership
* Build own capabilities for deeper understanding of other sectors of focus for the team.
* Work independently to originate and execute advisory mandates, collaborating closely with internal coverage, transaction banking, and product teams for them to explore other business opportunities
* Internal Communication, database management, reporting.
* Number of Advisory engagements
* Facilitate new client acquisition, relationship deepening to generate Banking spin-offs through incremental Asset, Liabilities business
* Number of Knowledge Initiatives undertaken / Knowledge Reports/ Newsletters/ Knowledge Platforms
* Compliance with the Operational Manual

**Essential Competencies**
Domain Expertise:
  
  

* 5–10 years of experience in climate policy, carbon markets, GHG accounting, or decarbonization strategy, with deep knowledge of GHG Protocol, and preferably of other protocol such as CCTS methodologies, and global reporting frameworks.
* Proven ability to translate complex governmental NDCs and climate mandates into practical business strategies, specifically tailored to the operational realities of MSMEs and corporate clients.
* Technical Advisory Skills: Hands-on expertise in emissions quantification, baseline setting, and MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification) workflows.
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of the intersection between climate risk and corporate business objectives, including non-tariff trade barriers and export market dynamics.
* Past experience of offering support clients in preparing for both mandatory and voluntary carbon disclosures, including scope‑wise emissions assessment, activity data validation, EF application, uncertainty evaluation, and verification preparation. Experience advising corporates on emissions computation, mitigation pathways, climate risk, or transition planning.
* Stakeholder Navigation: Demonstrated experience in building and managing high-level relationships with industry associations and preferable experience with municipal/state-level government bodies, Nodal authorities.
* Scalable Advisory Design: Ability to develop and maintain inhouse advisory tools, calculation templates, and playbooks to enable scalable service delivery across diverse sectors.
* Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the capacity to influence senior stakeholders and provide clear, strategic guidance to clients navigating the climate transition.
* Execution Focus: Proven capability to operate with high independence, managing multiple advisory assignments under tight deadlines with extreme attention to detail and data integrity.
* Preferable hands‑on exposure to emissions quantification, emission factor (EF) selection, baseline formula application, MRV workflows, and corporate GHG inventory building and emissions baselining, aligned with Indian regulatory requirements, CCTS methodologies, and global standards (GHG Protocol).
* Deep understand of approaches to Net-Zero framework and goals.
* Ability to building working relationships with clients and work under tight deadlines
* Excellent communication, interpersonal skills and teamwork
* Computing skills – Advanced skills in MS Office, Excel, Power point and use of consulting related tools, databases
* Highly customer focused, with high level of integrity and attention to detail
* Willingness to travel when required
* Ability and interest to build working relationships with business and basic knowledge of Banking products for corporates and governments is preferable

**SECTION VI: ROLE PROFILE REQUIREMENTS**

**Essential:**
MBA/Equivalent from a Tier I institute, with 8-10 years experience and exception can be made for highly meritorious candidates with relevant experience or certifications
  
  
**Preferred:**
Economics / Engineering /Environmental Science background
  
  
**Experience**
**Essential:**
5-10 years post qualification experience consulting with corporate clients, Government Relations, and/or government advisory
  
  
**Preferred:**

you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

title: Sr. Traction Expert- BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems
  
  
Context
  
  
In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations.
  
  
Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
  
  
SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
  
  
SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
  
  
Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc.
  
  
Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
  
  
Currently, we are bidding for Metro Rail projects across India. The position of Sr. Traction Expert is the key position in these BIDs.
  
  
Missions/Main Duties
  
  

* Design Review & Approval: Review and approve designs and technical specifications for traction power supply systems (include substations, Overhead Equipment (OHE)/Third rail systems, and associated components).
* System Analysis & Optimization: Analyze traction system design, load assessment, and power flow to ensure reliability, efficiency, and optimal energy use.
* Installation Supervision: Oversee the installation and integration of traction components, ensuring adherence to project requirements, standards, and timelines.
* Interface Coordination: Coordinate with multi-disciplinary teams (signaling, power supply, rolling stock, SCADA, civil) to ensure seamless system integration.
* Testing & Commissioning: Lead and supervise traction system testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting to ensure safe and successful commissioning.
* Quality & Safety Assurance: Ensure all traction works comply with quality assurance and safety protocols, as well as local and international standards.
* Documentation & Reporting: Prepare and review technical documents, construction drawings, test reports, progress updates, and handover documentation.
* Contractor/Vendor Management: Review contractor/vendor submissions, manage interfaces, and assess compliance of supplied equipment and works.
* Problem Resolution: Provide technical solutions for traction system issues during design, installation, and operation stages.
* Training & Guidance: Train and mentor project staff and O&M teams in operation, troubleshooting, and maintenance of traction power equipment.
* Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant electrical codes, project specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Continuous Improvement: Propose and implement enhancements to traction system design, technology, and methodologies for better performance and safety.

Profile/Skills
  
  

* Graduate in Electrical Engineering
* minimum 20 years of experience in railways or railway related industry.
* minimum 5 years’ experience in urban rail based passenger carrying system

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job - it’s a career!
  
  
Workplace Type

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a premier client’s business while achieving significant personal and professional growth. With over 60 years of consistent growth, FICO’s world-class solutions empower thousands of businesses worldwide to make smarter fraud, risk, and customer management decisions. **What We’re Seeking**

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Associate - Strategy & Operations
description:
**About BharatNXT**

BharatNXT is a business payments platform on a mission to transform how Indian MSMEs manage their working capital. By enabling credit cards for business payments, we unlock liquidity and growth potential for entrepreneurs across the country. With a growing user base and robust product roadmap, we’re now setting our sights on building a high-conversion, high-traffic website from scratch.

**The role**

A generalist role working directly with the founders on whatever matters most: a launch, a partner going live, a pricing call, a broken workflow. You'll own each from first analysis to shipped outcome and be judged on what moved, not on the deck. Expect to switch problems often.

**What you'll do**

* **Own founder priorities**

  - take the initiatives the founders are driving from rough idea to launch. Research the problem, write the brief, set milestones, get product, tech, ops and growth moving, and follow through until it ships.
* **Launch things**

  - plan and run go-to-market for new products, features and partners, from positioning and pricing to phased rollout. Get the field and telecalling teams ready, and close each launch with a review of what worked.
* **Build partnerships**

  - help find, evaluate and pitch new lending and payment partners. Once they're signed, keep integrations and timelines on track.
* **Turn numbers into decisions**

  - own the dashboards and weekly reviews the business runs on: transactions, payment volume, activation, retention and unit economics. Find what's moving the numbers and turn it into a clear recommendation.
* **Know the market**

  - track competitors, MSME behaviour, and RBI and card-network rules. Turn it into a monthly brief that changes what teams do, and flag anything that needs a decision now.
* **Run experiments**

  - design small product and growth tests on pricing, offers and onboarding. Size each one, read the results with the growth team, and recommend what to scale or kill.
* **Strengthen operations**

  - build and fix the processes behind the company: vendor and partner agreements, renewals, finance and compliance follow-ups, and hiring support.
* **Make us faster**

  - find manual, repetitive work across ops, support and reporting. Replace it with better process, automation or AI tools, and measure the time and cost saved.
* **Take on special projects**

  - anything important, urgent and without an owner yet.

**What we're looking for**

* 2 - 4 years at a startup, ideally working directly with founders and across several functions.
* Structured thinking and clear writing - you can turn a messy problem into a plan, and a plan into a one-pager founders can decide on.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you follow through without being chased.

**Bonus:**

an MBA, IIT, IIM or CA and a business background. If you grew up around a family business or have run your own, MSME working-capital problems won't be abstract to you.

**Why take it**

You'll see every part of the business up close, from the founders' desk, and be trusted with real problems early. Pay is competitive, and the role grows as the company does.

If you want a 9-to-5 with a tightly defined scope, this isn't it. If you want a steep learning curve and problems that are yours to solve, it is.
