description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
  
  
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Manager to manage and grow the assigned technology portfolio. The role will be responsible for driving vendor relationships, business planning, product lifecycle management, demand generation, profitability, and market growth across Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge, vendor management experience, and the ability to work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Channel Partners to achieve revenue and profitability objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product & Vendor Management**

* Own and manage the complete product portfolio for Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs and technology vendors.
* Develop and execute business plans to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market penetration.
* Manage vendor programs, rebates, incentives, pricing, and business reviews.
* Drive quarterly and annual business planning with technology vendors.

**Revenue & Profitability Management**

* Achieve assigned revenue, gross margin, and market share targets.
* Monitor business performance and implement strategies to maximize profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities across existing and new customer segments.
* Work with sales teams to accelerate pipeline creation and opportunity conversion.

**Demand Planning & Inventory Management**

* Forecast demand and manage inventory levels to ensure product availability.
* Optimize working capital through effective stock planning and inventory control.
* Monitor inventory ageing and implement corrective actions.
* Coordinate with operations and procurement teams to ensure timely product availability.

**Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy**

* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches and technology solutions.
* Plan promotions, channel programs, incentives, and partner engagement activities.
* Work with marketing teams on events, webinars, campaigns, and lead-generation initiatives.
* Monitor effectiveness of marketing programs and recommend improvements.

**Channel & Sales Enablement**

* Support channel partners and internal sales teams with product positioning and competitive strategies.
* Conduct product training sessions, technical workshops, and partner enablement programs.
* Develop sales kits, presentations, solution briefs, and competitive battle cards.
* Assist sales teams in strategic opportunities and large deal closures.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis**

* Track industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
* Analyze market demand and customer requirements.
* Develop competitive positioning strategies to strengthen market presence.
* Provide insights and recommendations for portfolio expansion.

**Customer & Partner Engagement**

* Engage with key customers, system integrators, and channel partners.
* Participate in customer meetings, solution discussions, and business reviews.
* Support the development of strategic customer relationships.
* Work closely with partners to create and close business opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Vendor teams.
* Drive alignment between business objectives and execution plans.
* Prepare business reports, forecasts, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Ensure smooth execution of commercial and operational processes.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Server, Storage, Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Data Protection solutions.
* Excellent vendor and product management skills.
* Business planning and revenue management expertise.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
* Inventory planning and working capital management knowledge.
* Data-driven and analytical approach to decision-making.
* Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong communication and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Sector Specialist
description:
**SECTION I: ROLE INTRODUCTION**
**Job Title**
Sector Specialist
  
  
**Reporting To**
RH - Corporate and Government Advisory
  
  
**Business Unit**
Corporate and Government Advisory
  
  
**Location**
Mumbai
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To primarily drive the execution of Advisory assignments / preparing knowledge reports for Corporate and Government clients and to bring depth, context, and credibility to the engagements in the identified sectors with actionable research and insights to enable outreach and engagement with clients as also to support the business development efforts
  
  
**SECTION IV: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & KPIS OF THE ROLE**
**Responsibilities**

* Core Responsibilities
* Drive proactive policy engagement with municipal corporations, state climate agencies, and nodal government bodies (e.g., BEE, MoEFCCC) to support formulation of new methodologies/ projects, facilitate the adoption of best practices and alignment with NDCs
* Development of a Decarbonization and Carbon Markets advisory offerings, and areas of opportunity so as to act as a bridge between evolving government climate mandates and MSME clients.
* Source advisory mandates and execute seamlessly in advising MSMEs and corporate clients on complex climate-impact related business barriers, (such as CBAM) in export markets and impending domestic climate rules /carbon markets
* Work on Policy-to-Action frameworks such as translating policy landscapes and national climate targets into actionable business strategies for clients, and opportunities for transition / green finance.
* Technical Excellence & Oversight support for MSMEs in emission measurement / reduction requirements, including best practices, aligning CCTS opportunities, GHG accounting, and carbon market readiness, and developing these into comprehensive business advisory solutions.
* Build an intelligence and advocacy network with industry associations, verification agencies, and market integrity bodies, institutions in the climate finance / blended finance ecosystem and sources of such capital, and provide clients with insights on shifts in rules and market developments.
* Knowledge champion to compile data analyzed into a specific sector to generate insightful, actionable knowledge aligned to clients’ areas of interest and business strategy and to lead sectoral initiatives and develop sector-specific insights, reports, event partnerships, policy advocacy and similar thought leadership
* Build own capabilities for deeper understanding of other sectors of focus for the team.
* Work independently to originate and execute advisory mandates, collaborating closely with internal coverage, transaction banking, and product teams for them to explore other business opportunities
* Internal Communication, database management, reporting.
* Number of Advisory engagements
* Facilitate new client acquisition, relationship deepening to generate Banking spin-offs through incremental Asset, Liabilities business
* Number of Knowledge Initiatives undertaken / Knowledge Reports/ Newsletters/ Knowledge Platforms
* Compliance with the Operational Manual

**Essential Competencies**
Domain Expertise:
  
  

* 5–10 years of experience in climate policy, carbon markets, GHG accounting, or decarbonization strategy, with deep knowledge of GHG Protocol, and preferably of other protocol such as CCTS methodologies, and global reporting frameworks.
* Proven ability to translate complex governmental NDCs and climate mandates into practical business strategies, specifically tailored to the operational realities of MSMEs and corporate clients.
* Technical Advisory Skills: Hands-on expertise in emissions quantification, baseline setting, and MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification) workflows.
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of the intersection between climate risk and corporate business objectives, including non-tariff trade barriers and export market dynamics.
* Past experience of offering support clients in preparing for both mandatory and voluntary carbon disclosures, including scope‑wise emissions assessment, activity data validation, EF application, uncertainty evaluation, and verification preparation. Experience advising corporates on emissions computation, mitigation pathways, climate risk, or transition planning.
* Stakeholder Navigation: Demonstrated experience in building and managing high-level relationships with industry associations and preferable experience with municipal/state-level government bodies, Nodal authorities.
* Scalable Advisory Design: Ability to develop and maintain inhouse advisory tools, calculation templates, and playbooks to enable scalable service delivery across diverse sectors.
* Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the capacity to influence senior stakeholders and provide clear, strategic guidance to clients navigating the climate transition.
* Execution Focus: Proven capability to operate with high independence, managing multiple advisory assignments under tight deadlines with extreme attention to detail and data integrity.
* Preferable hands‑on exposure to emissions quantification, emission factor (EF) selection, baseline formula application, MRV workflows, and corporate GHG inventory building and emissions baselining, aligned with Indian regulatory requirements, CCTS methodologies, and global standards (GHG Protocol).
* Deep understand of approaches to Net-Zero framework and goals.
* Ability to building working relationships with clients and work under tight deadlines
* Excellent communication, interpersonal skills and teamwork
* Computing skills – Advanced skills in MS Office, Excel, Power point and use of consulting related tools, databases
* Highly customer focused, with high level of integrity and attention to detail
* Willingness to travel when required
* Ability and interest to build working relationships with business and basic knowledge of Banking products for corporates and governments is preferable

**SECTION VI: ROLE PROFILE REQUIREMENTS**
**Education**
**Essential:**
MBA/Equivalent from a Tier I institute, with 8-10 years experience and exception can be made for highly meritorious candidates with relevant experience or certifications
  
  
**Preferred:**
Economics / Engineering /Environmental Science background
  
  
**Experience**
**Essential:**
5-10 years post qualification experience consulting with corporate clients, Government Relations, and/or government advisory
  
  
**Preferred:**
NA

title: Associate Director - Bid Management
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Sales Enablement COE team, part of our People and Investments business at Marsh. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**Associate Director - Bid Management**
Sales Enablement CoE supports various Marsh businesses worldwide primarily across Proposal & Bid Management, Client Research and Creative Services. As a part of the Proposal & Bid Management Practice, the CoE teams are responsible for end-to-end management of bids and winning more business for key Marsh businesses. The purpose of this role is to lead a team of bid managers and content managers and provide end-to-end bid support and independently manage production of high-quality RFP responses and Pitch presentations for Marsh’s OCIO business.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**
Lead Marsh’s CoE bid center team for the OCIO - Investments Solutions
  
  

* Strategic leadership: Set bid strategy and operating model across regions; align bids to business priorities and influence pursuit decisions at senior (Partner/C-suite) levels.
* Team, hiring & capability build: Own recruitment, resource planning and retention for the bids function; hire, onboard and retain high-calibre bid managers and specialists; design career paths and succession plans.
* Learning & development: Create and run training, coaching and L&D programmes (APMP, proposal writing, storytelling, AI tools) to uplift team capability and standardize best practice.
* People & performance management: Set KPIs, conduct performance reviews, manage promotions and PIPs, and foster a high-performance culture.
* Escalation management & governance: Act as senior escalation point for bid-related issues; establish and chair pursuit governance forums, escalation protocols and decision gates to accelerate approvals and de-risk submissions.
* Business performance & governance: Own bid KPIs (win rate, turnaround time, quality score), budget for bid operations, vendor/agency relationships and resource planning. Drive process governance, quality assurance, audit and version control.
* End-to-end delivery: Lead complex/high-stakes RFIs, RFPs and pitches — define timelines, run pursuit governance, coordinate cross-functional inputs and ensure timely, compliant submissions.
* Win strategy & value proposition: Develop tailored win plans; craft differentiated client value propositions and executive-level messaging that articulate “Why Marsh.”
* Stakeholder management: Collaborate with senior sales, delivery, legal, finance and product leaders; present to and influence executive stakeholders and clients.
* Risk & compliance: Identify and mitigate technical, commercial and reputational risks; ensure regulatory and contractual compliance.
* Content & brand excellence: Oversee high-quality proposal narratives and visuals that meet Marsh brand standards; partner with design and content teams to elevate outputs.
* Continuous improvement & innovation: Drive adoption of best practices, bid methodology, digital tools (AI, content management/Seismic, MPower/QorusDocs, SharePoint) and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and win rates. Lead initiatives to improve throughput, quality and cost-efficiency.
* Thought leadership & external engagement: Represent the bids function in global forums, lead training programs, and introduce new capabilities (e.g., AI-enabled personalization, proposal analytics).
* Provide strategic leadership and expertise in the Wealth & Investment business, ensuring bid strategies are fully aligned with Marsh’s service offerings and overarching business priorities.
* Oversee the creation of persuasive executive summaries and key proposal sections that clearly articulate Marsh’s competitive advantage and “why us” messaging.
* Ensure all bid content and visuals meet Marsh’s brand standards and effectively support the overall messaging, working closely with design teams to elevate proposal quality.

**What you need to have:**

* 15+ years’ experience in pre-sales/bid management, with a strong record of owning large, complex, high-value bids across multiple regions.
* Proven people leader with experience scaling teams, setting KPIs, hiring, and managing budgets.
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior (Partner/C-suite) stakeholders.
* Strong project management, commercial acumen, and risk management skills.
* Exceptional written and executive-level presentation skills; outstanding proofreading and business-writing capability.
* Comfortable leading virtual, cross-functional teams and managing cultural sensitivities across operating companies.
* Proficient with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel; familiarity with MPower, QorusDocs, SharePoint and AI-content tools preferred.
* Preferred: MBA or relevant postgraduate degree; certifications such as APMP, PMP; CFA Level 1 or equivalent a plus.
* Strategic thinker with a results-first mindset.
* High emotional intelligence and stakeholder orientation.
* Resilient under pressure with strong prioritization skills.
* Continuous improvement and innovation mindset.
* Leverage efficient document management platforms such as SharePoint, Google Drive, and specialized systems to securely organize, share, and manage access to information.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Experience on sales lifecycle and content/proposal management tools like Salesforce, QorusDocs, Qvidian, SharePoint etc. would be preferred.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial markets is preferred
* Experience of directly dealing with senior internal stakeholders
* preferredStrong analytical and problem-solving skillsCFA level 1 or similar is preferred
* Preferred certifications include the Association of Proposal Management Professionals (APMP), Certified Proposal and Bidding Professional, and Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Strong understanding of AI-driven content personalization.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Business Architect
description:
**Project Role :**
Business Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Microsoft Dynamics CRM Technical
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Business Architect, you will identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Your typical day will involve collaborating with various stakeholders to translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. You will support transformation initiatives by developing comprehensive business cases and guiding the implementation of key projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives. Engaging with cross-functional teams, you will facilitate discussions that drive innovation and efficiency, ultimately contributing to the overall success of the organization.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to be an SME.
* Collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather requirements and feedback from stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain documentation that outlines business processes and technology solutions.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics CRM Technical.
* Strong understanding of business process modeling and analysis.
* Experience with stakeholder management and communication.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into technical specifications.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM Technical.
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Technical Project Coordinator
description:
**Designation: Technical Project Coordinator**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ years**

**Summary:**

We are looking for a Project Coordinator with around 1 year of experience and a basic IT/technical background. The candidate will support project managers and technical teams with day-to-day project coordination, documentation, tracking, scheduling, and communication activities.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist Project Managers with day-to-day project coordination and administrative activities.
* Maintain project documentation, trackers, status reports, meeting minutes, and action items.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, and document key discussions and decisions.
* Track project tasks, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and pending actions.
* Follow up with team members to collect updates and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Maintain project plans, schedules, resource information, and other project-related records.
* Prepare basic weekly/monthly project status reports and dashboards.
* Coordinate communication between technical teams, project managers, and other stakeholders.
* Assist with project onboarding, documentation, and process-related activities.
* Maintain organized project repositories and ensure documents are properly updated and accessible.
* Identify basic project risks, delays, or dependencies and escalate them to the Project Manager.
* Support other project management and coordination activities as required.

**Requirements and skills:**

* **IT/Technical Understanding:**
  Basic understanding of software development, applications, databases, cloud, or IT project environments.
* **Project Coordination:**
  Ability to track tasks, timelines, deliverables, and follow-ups effectively.
* **Documentation:**
  Good skills in preparing and maintaining project documents, meeting minutes, trackers, and reports.
* **Communication:**
  Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate with technical and non-technical teams.
* **Organization:**
  Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* **MS Office / Google Workspace:**
  Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, Word/Docs, PowerPoint/Slides, and email tools.
* **Project Management Tools:**
  Basic familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Trello, Asana, or similar platforms is preferred.

**Company Overview:**

Aventior is a leading provider of innovative technology solutions for businesses across a wide range of industries. At Aventior, we leverage cutting-edge technologies like AI, ML Ops, DevOps, and many more to help our clients solve complex business problems and drive growth.

We also provide a full range of data development and management services, including Cloud Data Architecture, Universal Data Models, Data transformation and ETL, Data Lakes, User Management, Analytics and visualization, and automated data capture (for scanned documents and unstructured/semi-structured data sources). Our team of experienced professionals combines deep industry knowledge with expertise in the latest technologies to deliver customized solutions that meet the unique needs of each of our clients. Whether you are looking to streamline your operations, enhance your customer experience, or improve your decision-making process, Aventior has the skills and resources to help you achieve your goals.

We bring a well-rounded, cross-industry, and multi-client perspective to our client engagements. Our strategy is grounded in design, implementation, innovation, migration, and support. We have a global delivery model, a multi-country presence, and a team well-equipped with professionals and experts in the field.

title: Allianz - OpenText PowerDocs Consultant
description:
**Role & Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced OpenText Consultant PowerDocs with strong hands-on expertise in OpenText PowerDocs template development as your main skill, ready to design, build and maintain large-scale document template solutions across our enterprise content management landscape at Allianz Technology.
  
  
**You Will**

* Design, build, and manage large-scale document template libraries (e.g. up to 200 templates with 50+ complex layouts) using OpenText PowerDocs.
* Manage unit testing, validate data transformations using XSLT, and resolve complex code defects across the template lifecycle.
* Connect PowerDocs with enterprise systems such as OpenText Extended ECM (xECM) and SAP SuccessFactors via REST or SOAP web services.
* Provide expert-level troubleshooting, configure Smart UI, and handle Content Server administration tasks.
* Support the full template lifecycle, from requirements analysis and design through development, testing, and deployment.
* Contribute to solution documentation, keeping template libraries and configurations aligned with the overall Allianz Technology landscape.
* Provide guidance, technical training, and best practices to junior team members.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* OpenText PowerDocs (template configuration and development) as your main and primary skill, with around 5+ years of relevant experience in software development, enterprise content management, or OpenText template administration, including maintaining OpenText Content Server (OTCS) and Extended ECM (xECM) in large enterprise environments.
* Good working knowledge of core OpenText modules, including LiveReports, WebReports, Workflows, Classification, and Records Management.
* Good to have knowledge of the wider OpenText product stack : Content Server, Archive Center/Server, OTDS, Brava, Blazon, and Records Management.
* Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, XML, and XSLT for document transformations.
* Familiarity with OpenText Content Server, Directory Services, and Smart UI configuration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex template and integration issues.
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills and experience coordinating project delivery.
* Ability to exchange ideas and information effectively in a concise and logical way, with attention to cost-effective and secure design choices.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Coupa – Consultant, Technical Transformation**

title: Manager - Quality Management System (QMS)
description:
**VACANCY FOR**

**MANAGER – QMS**
(
*Quality Management System and Process Owner*
)

**Company Description:**

Established in 2009, Revata Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer of high-performance elastomers, sealing solutions, precision-machined components and oilfield products, serving customers primarily in the oil and gas sector. The company's head office and manufacturing facility are located at M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune. Revata is certified to ISO 9001:2015 and operates its own NABL-accredited material testing laboratory.

**Role Description:**

We are seeking an experienced
**Manager – QMS**
to take complete ownership of the company's Quality Management System. The incumbent will build the QMS around the actual flow of an order, from enquiry and contract review through purchase, production and inspection to dispatch. This includes defining what information each department receives, records and hands over, so that orders move through the plant without delays and every failure can be traced to its root cause.

A key objective of the role is to
**take the company through API Spec Q1 certification**
. The role covers the design, implementation and maintenance of the QMS in line with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001:2015, including processes, SOPs, forms and formats, internal and external audits, customer QMS requirements and root cause analysis of nonconformities. The position reports to the Director, Operations & Technology, with direct access to the Managing Director on audit results, customer nonconformities and management review. Product inspection and release will continue to be handled by the QC team.

**This is a hands-on role that requires close interaction with all departments and a regular presence on the shop floor.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

·      Own and maintain the company-wide QMS in accordance with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001:2015, and drive its continual improvement.

·      Lead the company to API Spec Q1 certification, including the gap assessment against the 10th Edition, the implementation plan and timeline, internal readiness audits and the certification audit.

·      Map the end-to-end business process from enquiry to dispatch, covering contract review, engineering, planning, purchase, stores, production, inspection and dispatch, and define clear inputs, outputs and responsibilities at each interface between departments.

·      Prepare and maintain all QMS documentation, including system procedures, work instructions, SOPs, master lists, forms and formats, and ensure they are practical and easy to use on the shop floor.

·      Establish and manage document and record control, including numbering, revision, approval, distribution, control of obsolete documents and record retention as per API Spec Q1.

·      Define ownership for every procedure, form and record, and conduct training for each department on its applicable documents.

·      Ensure contract review is carried out for every purchase order, and establish order-level quality planning, including inspection and test plans, material traceability and the documentation package issued by QC (inspection reports, material certificates and certificates of conformance).

·      Manage the nonconformance and CAPA system across all departments, lead cross-functional root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, fishbone) and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions before closure.

·      Handle customer audits and respond to customer complaints and QMS nonconformities with root cause and corrective action reports within agreed timelines, including completion of customer supplier-qualification questionnaires.

·      Plan, coordinate and face ISO 9001:2015 surveillance and recertification audits, as well as API Spec Q1 audits once certification is achieved, and ensure timely closure of all findings.

·      Plan and conduct internal audits as per the annual audit schedule, ensuring auditor independence.

·      Prepare inputs for management review, conduct the review with the Managing Director and track action items to closure.

·      Establish and maintain the risk assessment, contingency planning and management of change (MOC) processes as required by API Spec Q1.

·      Work with Purchase on supplier evaluation and approval, maintenance of the approved supplier list, supplier performance monitoring and supplier corrective action requests.

·      Ensure calibration, preventive maintenance, training and competency records are maintained by the respective departments as per the QMS.

·      Define quality objectives and present a monthly QMS performance report covering nonconformities, CAPA status, customer complaints, audit findings, on-time delivery and cost of poor quality.

·      Support the ERP implementation team in moving QMS forms and records onto the ERP platform.

·      Coordinate with the NABL-accredited laboratory, which operates under ISO/IEC 17025, to ensure clear interfaces between the laboratory and the QMS.

·      Raise nonconformities against any department where required and escalate unresolved issues to the Managing Director.

**Who Should Apply:**

Candidates who have independently established or restructured a QMS in a manufacturing organization under API Spec Q1, IATF 16949 or ISO 9001:2015, and led it through certification and customer audits. The candidate should have experience in defining cross-functional processes and preparing procedures and formats that are used across departments.

Experience in a make-to-order, low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment such as oilfield equipment, valves, sealing products, forgings or precision machining will be preferred. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to present sample procedures or formats prepared by them, with confidential information removed.

**Must Have Qualifications:**

BE / BTech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Polymer Engineering, or equivalent.

10 to 15 years of experience in manufacturing quality, with at least 5 years in a role responsible for the company's QMS.

Proven experience in establishing a QMS from scratch or restructuring an existing one within the last seven years, including leading the certification audit.

Has led, or played a key role in, taking an organization through API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949 certification, along with hands-on experience in implementing ISO 9001:2015.

Experience in facing customer audits and responding to customer complaints and nonconformities through 8D / CAPA reports.

Strong skills in process mapping and preparation of QMS documentation.

Internal auditor training in ISO 9001:2015, API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949.

Working knowledge of root cause analysis tools, FMEA and control plans.

Proficiency in MS Excel for tracking and analysis of quality data.

Ability to communicate in Marathi or Hindi with shop floor staff, and good written and spoken English for customer communication and documentation.

**Optional / Preferred Qualifications:**

Experience in oilfield equipment, valves, wellhead equipment, elastomer seals, forgings or precision machining industries.

Experience as Management Representative or Deputy Management Representative for API Spec Q1.

Experience with API Spec Q1 10th Edition certification, or exposure to the API Monogram Program.

Lead Auditor certification in ISO 9001:2015, API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949.

Exposure to customer-specific QMS requirements of oil and gas operators or OEMs.

Experience in implementing an ERP-based or digital QMS.

Exposure to NABL / ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory systems.

**Location:**
M.I.D.C., Bhosari, Pune - 411026

**Office Timings:**
Monday - Saturday (8:30 AM to 5:30 PM)

**Remuneration:**
CTC will be as per industry standard.

**revata.hr@gmail.com**

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country.

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation.

• Install and commission AMRs (autonomous mobile robots) and AGVs (automated guided vehicles) at customer sites: mapping, navigation and route setup, fleet configuration, trial runs and handover.

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running.

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation.

Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds).

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR and mobile robot deployment.

Must Have

• Diploma / BE / BTech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation.

• 1–4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering.

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills.

• Willingness to travel to customer sites from the Pune base.

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP.

• Hands-on experience with Yasaka, FAIRINO, Unitree or other industrial robots, cobots, humanoids or quadruped robots.

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience.

Hands-on work with robots built in-house and with Yasaka, FAIRINO and Unitree platforms, including new-age humanoid robots and robot dogs, principal and OEM training and certifications, a clear path to Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist or Field Application Manager roles, performance incentives, travel support as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits.

title: waste systems & resource recovery advisor
description:
Waste Systems & Resource Recovery Advisor

Waste operations | Segregation | Recovery infrastructure

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are looking for an accomplished waste-sector practitioner who can go beyond desk research to establish how collection, separation, transfer and treatment systems perform in real conditions. The successful candidate will turn operational evidence into realistic service and infrastructure recommendations.

Your mandate

Lead technical interpretation of the waste-services baseline, with particular attention to the four main material streams and the operational reasons behind service gaps.

What you will lead

* **Examine separation across the full chain.**
  Assess handling of wet, dry, sanitary and special-care household waste from source to the point of transfer and onward treatment. Distinguish actual material purity and cross-contamination from self-reported segregation figures.
* **Guide rigorous transfer-site testing.**
  Define technical review parameters for incoming-load counts on three randomly chosen days at active transfer and secondary storage sites. Check use of portable weighing equipment, before-tipping photographs, material classification and reconciliation with station logs.
* **Diagnose collection and neighbourhood issues.**
  Interpret household, shop and field-observation findings on missed door-to-door collection, secondary-bin dependence, overflow hotspots and underserved settlement types. Recommend changes to achieve near-universal service coverage and better separation compliance.
* **Assess processing and recovery performance.**
  Review operating status, incoming tonnage, design versus effective capacity, output quality and rejection destinations for waste-to-energy, bio-gas, material-recovery, composting and related facilities. Separate verified observations from administrative inventory figures.
* **Scrutinise large waste generators.**
  Review the survey of generators above the defined daily-volume threshold and the sampled smaller establishments. Check real waste quantities from measured sub-samples, on-site processing actually in use, service-provider arrangements and final destinations of each waste stream.
* **Benchmark operator delivery.**
  Provide technical inputs for scoring private collection and transport providers on service coverage, segregation, route adherence, staffing, attendance and record reliability. Identify recurring exceptions that are significant enough to feature in a monthly performance review.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Waste Systems & Resource Recovery Advisor

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Prepare an infrastructure needs assessment.**
  Specify practical requirements for transfer capacity, partitioning, compaction, bins, service vehicles, decentralised processing and material-recovery facilities. Derive indicative volumes and costs from verified generation, catchments and service gaps rather than untested norms.
* **Interpret financial and institutional constraints.**
  Review operating expenditure per tonne, user-fee recovery, field monitoring, enforcement records and awareness spending as inputs to service sustainability and improvement priorities.
* **Contribute to phased improvement plans.**
  Help build an overarching service strategy and local implementation plans with clear monthly milestones for complete collection and proper separation. Account for difficult-access areas and the operational capacity of existing operators and plants.
* **Support training and validation.**
  Brief enumerators and supervisors on waste classifications, load-purity recording, facility checklists and evidence expectations; review questionable observations and recommend targeted rechecks before technical sign-off.
* **Work within the agreed study boundaries.**
  Coordinate with specialist analysts and external research partners; rely on existing government records for waste categories outside the core field-measurement streams, and provide technical priorities for awareness strategy without duplicating campaign execution.

What you will help deliver

* Technical findings on collection, segregation, transfer efficiency and waste processing.
* Verifiable facility-capacity and high-volume-generator assessments with clear evidence gaps.
* Service and infrastructure requirements supported by quantity, cost and catchment logic.
* Inputs to phased service plans, operator ratings and public-awareness priorities.

Who should apply

* Degree in Engineering or Environmental Science.
* Minimum 10 years of solid waste operations, technical evaluation or system-planning experience.
* Demonstrated exposure to segregation, transfer stations and processing or material-recovery facilities in Indian cities.
* Environmental engineers, senior consultants and plant/service specialists comfortable with field audits and technical writing.

title: Analyst/ Senior Analyst- Digital Channels for Sexual & Reproductive Health
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
**Project Overview**
Despite India’s rapid growth in digital adoption and e-commerce, the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) space remains relatively nascent online, with contraception and fertility products accounting for only $4.23M of the digital health market. At the same time, significant gaps persist the unmet need for family planning among married women stands at 8.5%, and modern contraceptive use has actually declined (from 56.4% to 52.7%), pointing to continued unmet demand for trustworthy information and access (NFHS-6, 2023-24). While users seeking FP-SRH information prefer a discreet, trustworthy path from awareness to action, the same is not achievable through traditional clinic-based counselling models and as a consequence, users often turn to digital channels where they encounter fragmented, stigmatising, or unreliable content. There is, therefore, a need for digital platforms which can offer comprehensive and reliable information.
  
  
Since 2024, WJCF has deepened its focus on Alternative Service Delivery (ASD), i.e., identifying, testing, and scaling non-traditional channels, beyond public health facilities and frontline workers, through which underserved populations can access SRH products, services, and information.
  
  
Our hypothesis is twofold. First, there is significant unmet demand for reliable, accessible FP-SRH information, and authoritative, cohort-tailored digital content can measurably shift awareness. Second, when users are offered trustworthy, stigma-free content alongside a discreet, low-friction path to purchase or counselling on platforms they already use, a meaningful share will convert from awareness to action — i.e., verified uptake of FP-SRH products and services.
  
  
Our ASD work began with a structured landscaping exercise that reviewed 56 service delivery and demand generation models across health and non-health sectors in India and globally, identifying digital and private-sector channels with the strongest potential for reach, cost-effectiveness, and scalability.
  
  
This approach was validated through a 2025 pilot with a leading e-pharmacy partner. WJCF co-designed and ran a 4-month, multi-channel FP-SRH demand-generation campaign which reached 0.98M users and achieved a 3% reach-to-conversion rate among new-to-category buyers. Monthly SRH purchasers rose 62% over the pre-pilot baseline - 64% of them new to the category - with growth across priority products (condoms +51%, ECPs +48%, and OCPs +57%). Average time on the campaign microsite was 4 minutes against a 1-minute benchmark, signalling strong content engagement.
  
  
Building on this foundation, WJCF has secured a multi-year grant to scale and diversify its digital SRH work across two parallel workstreams one that deepens and scales e-pharmacy partnerships into a structured, ongoing test-and-learn engine to drive users to category adoption, and another that expands into additional digital ecosystems to identify which channels can reliably move users from awareness to verified uptake, and overall, understanding the conditions under which such partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
  
  
**Position Overview**
WJCF is seeking a highly motivated
**Analyst/ Senior Analyst**
to lead analytical, strategic, and implementation workstreams for our ASD work. The Associate will drive high-quality analyses, design frameworks for intervention models, lead research activities, and manage relationships with donors and partners across digital ecosystems (e-pharmacy, e-commerce, and other consumer platforms). They will guide components of program execution, develop strategic documentation, and ensure delivery of key outputs. The role requires strong problem-solving and stakeholder management abilities, comfort working in complex environments, and the ability to independently own and drive major workstreams.
  
  

* Lead analytical workstreams for our ASD work, driving evidence-based decision-making and strategic planning.
* Lead partner scoping and due diligence efforts, defining engagement criteria and shortlisting frameworks to inform strategic partnership decisions.
* Design and run structured campaign test-cycles in partnership with digital platforms, building and testing hypotheses to optimize program performance.
* Oversee periodic reviews of campaign test-cycles to guide program strategy.
* Distil learnings from these test-cycles and develop the business case and conditions under which partnerships can become self-sustaining with reduced donor support.
* Design and steer scalable intervention models, frameworks, and implementation pathways in collaboration with partner organizations.
* Build and oversee measurement frameworks, dashboards, and reporting tools that track performance across the awareness-to-uptake funnel and enable data-driven decisions.
* Build and sustain relationships with digital platform partners, brand partners, donors, and technical stakeholders to strengthen alignment, negotiate partnership terms, and drive impact.
* Ensure quality and timeliness of program outputs, including strategic notes, donor reports, partnership documentation, and presentations for diverse audiences.
* Mentor and supervise analysts and junior staff, providing guidance on research design, analytical approaches, and deliverable development.
* Provide operational leadership to ensure seamless planning, coordination, and execution across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Lead identification of new opportunities, contribute to proposal development, and craft compelling pitch materials to secure funding and partnerships across ASD, SRH, and allied areas.
* Ensure effective and prompt communication across internal teams and external stakeholders, including rapid response to critical situations with structured action plans.
* Represent WJCF in high-level forums and public engagements, leveraging strong communication and public relations skills to advocate for ASD and SRMNCH priorities.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Public Health, Economics, Business, Population Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field
* Minimum 2 years of professional experience in demanding, result-oriented environments across public and/or private sectors; experience with digital platforms is a strong plus.

description:

Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
  
  
SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. title: Manager, Learning Design & Program Management
description:
**About ETS:**

ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization driven by our mission to empower human progress through the science of measurement. We are at an exciting and pivotal moment, rapidly expanding our focus beyond traditional assessments into dynamic learning and skills development solutions, championing a future-ready, AI-powered, skills-based economy. Our Human Progress Commitment pledges to prepare over 100 million people for the next generation of jobs by 2035, leveraging our deep research in psychometrics, innovative solutions, and global partnerships to drive equity, opportunity, and impactful outcomes worldwide.

**Job Description:**

As Manager, Learning Design & Program Management, you will be the engine room of the Talent Management & Learning team. You will use AI to design and build personalized learning content, and you will run the operations behind every talent program (cohorts, calendars, communications, logistics, and participant tracking) so programs land on time across the portfolio. Where many organizations buy, ETS builds, and this role is how we build.

You will also own the day-to-day running of our talent systems once they are live, including the Workday talent modules, the learning platform, the survey platform, and our skills data, along with the compliance training campaigns that run on them. You will produce the data and reporting that the team, HR Business Partners, and leaders rely on, and over time you will take on the running of our existing assessments.

This is a transversal role by design. You will support every area the team owns (leadership and management development, AI and skills enablement, and employee experience and growth), with a growth path toward owning programs end to end. The role carries a strong cross-functional implementation mandate, partnering across HR functions, business units, and geographies. This role reports to the AVP, Talent Management & Learning.

**AI-Enabled Learning Design & Content**

* Design and build in-house learning experiences, learning paths, and program content (manager and leadership development, AI and skills enablement, onboarding, performance and growth), favoring internal builds over off-the-shelf purchases.
* Use AI tools to produce and personalize content quickly and to a high standard, turning source material such as guides, policies, and decks into engaging formats: short videos, audio, digital modules, and job aids.
* Apply sound instructional design and adult learning principles across live, digital, and blended formats, and develop facilitator guides and participant materials.

**Program Management Across the Talent Portfolio**

* Run the operations behind every talent program: cohorts, calendars, communications, logistics, vendor coordination, and participant tracking.
* Maintain one portfolio calendar across the team so programs land on time and do not collide.
* Manage several cohort-based programs running at the same time, such as people manager programs, emerging leader cohorts, and AI champion networks, from enrollment through completion and feedback.

**Talent Systems (Day-to-Day Running)**

* Once the systems are live, own their day-to-day running: the HR system's talent modules (performance, learning, talent), the learning platform, the survey platform, and skills data.
* Manage catalogs, assignments, user support, data quality, and release testing, working with HR systems, IT, and vendors.
* Work alongside the team's systems lead during the implementation of the new HR system and take over steady-state administration after go-live.

**Compliance Training**

* Deploy and monitor enterprise compliance training campaigns (e.g., information security, harassment prevention, workplace safety, and client-required programs) across ETS and its subsidiaries.
* Track completions, manage reminders and escalations, and maintain audit-ready records for internal and external audits.

**Data & Reporting**

* Produce the dashboards and reports the team, HR Business Partners, and leaders use: program participation and completion, learning activity, compliance status, survey results, and performance cycle progress.
* Keep data clean and consistent across systems so reporting is trusted.

**Assessments**

* Over time, take on the running of existing assessments (e.g., strengths and leadership assessments): access codes, scheduling, reporting, and participant support.

**Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Implementation**

* Gather feedback and results for each program and fold what is learned into the next cycle.
* Partner across HR functions, business units, and geographies to implement programs end to end, balancing enterprise consistency with local needs.

**Required Experience:**

* Significant experience (5+ years) in learning design, learning and development, or talent program management, ideally in a global or matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated instructional design capability, with a portfolio of learning experiences or content built in-house, including examples built with AI tools.
* Experience running cohort-based or enterprise programs at scale, including communications, logistics, and participant tracking.
* Hands-on experience administering a learning management system or the talent modules of an HR system.
* Strong data analysis and reporting skills (Excel or similar; dashboard tools a plus).
* Excellent written communication and organization.
* Ability to partner across HR, business units, and geographies to implement programs end to end.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Workday talent or learning modules.
* Experience running compliance training campaigns and supporting audits.
* Experience administering survey platforms or assessments.
* Video, audio, or multimedia production skills.
* Professional certifications in instructional design, project management, or HR (e.g., ATD, CPTD, PMP, SHRM, CIPD) are a plus but not required

**Knowledge/Skills**

* **AI-Enabled Content Creation:**
  Hands-on skill using AI tools to draft, design, and produce learning content (text, video, audio, interactive), with good judgment about quality and responsible use.
* **Learning Experience Design:**
  Strong instructional design across live, digital, and blended formats; able to take a program from concept to polished, ready-to-deliver materials.
* **Program & Project Management:**
  Runs several programs at once with clear plans, calendars, communications, and follow-through.
* **Talent Systems Fluency:**
  Comfortable administering HR and learning systems (HCM talent modules, LMS, survey tools) and solving user and data issues.
* **Data & Reporting:**
  Builds clear dashboards and reports and explains what the numbers mean.
* **Compliance Rigor:**
  Careful attention to tracking, documentation, and audit readiness.
* **Communication:**
  Writes clearly for program audiences and works well with facilitators, vendors, and participants.
* **Collaboration & Service Mindset:**
  Supports several internal partners at once and manages competing requests through clear priorities.
* **Adaptability & Resilience:**
  Pivots quickly as priorities shift while keeping quality high in a fast-moving, global environment.

**Ownership:**
Builds end to end in an environment where structures are still forming, and grows toward leading programs

title: Projct Cordinator-MEP
description:
**Project Coordinator – MEP**

**Reports to:**
Project Lead

**Location:**
Full-time on site (Noida)

**Engagement:**
For the project duration (5 months)

**Role summary**

The Project Coordinator – MEP monitors and coordinates all MEP works by the Client-appointed contractors. They make sure the services are installed to the approved drawings and specifications, tested and commissioned, and handed over with complete documentation.

**Qualifications and experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised university.
* At least 7-8 years of hands-on experience on construction sites, preferably MEP in commercial office or interior fit-out projects.
* Working knowledge of the NBC, relevant IS codes and fire-safety requirements for commercial buildings.

**Key responsibilities**

**Pre-start and submittals**

* Study the MEP contract drawings, specifications and contract scope given by the Client.
* Track the status of MEP submittals: shop drawings, material approvals and method statements. Escalate any delays to the Project Lead.
* Review contractors' MEP mobilisation, manpower and material delivery plans.

**Site monitoring and coordination**

* Monitor installation of:
* **HVAC:**
  ducting, diffusers, FCU/AHU connections, insulation
* **Electrical:**
  lighting, DBs, cabling, earthing, small power
* **Plumbing:**
  water supply, drainage, sanitary fixtures in the common toilets
* **Fire and ELV:**
  sprinklers, fire alarm, PA, CCTV and access control, as applicable
* **AV System including VC equipment’s**
* Coordinate the interfaces between MEP and ceilings, partitions and finishes. Flag clashes and site constraints to the Project Lead and the designers. The designers resolve them.
* Coordinate with the base-building facility team on tie-ins to existing services, shutdowns and work permits, especially on occupied floors.

**Quality**

* Inspect MEP workmanship against the approved drawings and specifications, raise observations and track them to closure.
* Check that installed materials match the approved makes and samples.

**Testing and commissioning**

* Prepare and track the T&C schedule, and witness tests: pressure and leak tests, insulation resistance, earthing, air balancing, and fire alarm and sprinkler tests.
* Keep the test records and commissioning certificates.

**Reporting and handover**

* Provide MEP progress, constraints, quality observations and photographs for the Weekly Project Report.
* Attend weekly review meetings and track MEP action items.
* Compile the MEP snag list and check rectifications.
* Collect the MEP handover documents: as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties, test certificates and the spares list.

**Skills and competencies**

* Can read and interpret MEP drawings; AutoCAD working knowledge preferred.
* Good with MS Excel for trackers and logs.
* Organised and thorough at site documentation; communicates well with contractors and facility teams.

title: Bioinformatics Trainer
description:
**Company Description**
Bio Help Learning is a specialized training and learning platform focused on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biotechnology, Genomics, and Data Science for Life Sciences. The organization bridges the gap between academic knowledge and industry-ready skills through hands-on, project-based programs for students, researchers, educators, and life-science professionals. Training covers emerging areas such as NGS data analysis, multi-omics, workflow development, and computational drug discovery, with strong emphasis on practical tools like Python, R, Nextflow, and Docker. Learners engage with real-world datasets, interactive sessions, coding exercises, and research-oriented case studies to build confidence in analyzing biological data and designing reproducible workflows. Bio Help Learning is committed to strengthening the global ecosystem for bioinformatics and computational biology education and career development.
  
**Role Description**
The Bioinformatics Trainer will design and deliver online training sessions and workshops on topics such as NGS data analysis, genomics, transcriptomics, multi-omics integration, and computational workflows. The role includes preparing teaching materials, practical labs, coding notebooks, and case studies using real-world datasets, as well as updating content to reflect current tools and best practices in bioinformatics. The Trainer will mentor learners, answer technical questions, provide feedback on mini-projects, and support participants in applying concepts to research and industry use cases. Responsibilities also involve collaborating with the team to refine curricula, contribute to new course development, and maintain high standards of learner engagement and satisfaction. This is a part-time, remote role, offering flexible scheduling aligned with live online sessions and learner support needs.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, and Transcriptomics, with practical experience analyzing NGS (e.g., RNA-Seq, WGS/WES, single-cell RNA-Seq) and related omics datasets.
* Proficiency in programming and data analysis using Python and/or R for bioinformatics, including experience with relevant libraries, packages, and scripting for reproducible workflows.
* Hands-on experience with workflow management tools and environments such as Nextflow, Snakemake, Docker, Git, and high-performance computing (HPC) for scalable bioinformatics pipelines.
* Familiarity with specialized domains such as metagenomics, microbiome analysis, cancer genomics, molecular docking, molecular dynamics, and computational drug discovery is highly beneficial.
* Demonstrated ability to teach, train, or mentor learners, including creating clear instructional materials, explaining complex concepts, and guiding project-based learning.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to present technical content to diverse audiences (students, researchers, and professionals) in a structured, accessible manner.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As part of our Consulting team, you will play a key role in supporting clients across the individual and group life insurance and annuity value chain. You will contribute to complex transformation programs by applying deep product, process, and platform knowledge, while helping clients achieve their business objective. This role provides the opportunity to work across multi vendor environments, influence strategic business decisions, and contribute to large scale transformation initiatives for insurance careers.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support clients across the full policy lifecycle, including new business, underwriting, policy servicing, billing, claims, disbursements, and regulatory updates.
* Create comprehensive business process maps, future state architectures, and work breakdown structures (WBS) for conversion and transformation programs.
* Lead requirements elicitation through JAD sessions, workshops, and collaboration with product owners to develop BRDs, FSDs, and other documentation.
* Challenge new requirements and change requests by proposing optimized, value driven solutions that align with business strategy and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with product design and development teams to evaluate functional enhancements and ensure they meet business objectives.
* Support clients through product configuration decisions, acceptance criteria definition, and user acceptance testing.
* Contribute to data migration and data governance activities, ensuring quality, compliance, and seamless system transitions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by delivering clear insights, process improvements, and best practice recommendations
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A proactive, detail‑oriented professional who thrives in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.
* Strong business acumen combined with deep expertise in life and annuity insurance domains.
* Ability to collaborate effectively and bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions.
* A strategic problem‑solver who challenges assumptions and recommends innovative, future‑ready approaches.
* A committed team player focused on delivering value, driving transformation, and building lasting client relationships

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Bachelors degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.)
* Approximately 5 to 10 years of experience working in Life & Annuity insurance domain.

**Additionally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands‑on experience with policy lifecycle processes and insurance operational workflows.
* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, functional, and business stakeholders.

**Ideally, good to have**

* Experience working on data migration projects and applying data governance best practices.
* Knowledge of insurance COTS platforms such as FAST, ALIP, OIPA, wmA etc
* Certifications such as AAPA or LOMA.
* Understanding of upstream and downstream integrations across the policy lifecycle
* Knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, TFS, Azure DevOps

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. **Company:** vTech Solution

**Experience:** 6 Months – 2 Years  
**Shift Timing:** US Shift (Night Shift)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About vTech Solution

vTech Solution is a global IT services and technology solutions company specializing in IT staffing, workforce solutions, technology consulting, and digital transformation services. We work with clients across industries, including US Federal, State, and Local Government (SLED) sectors, delivering technology and professional services solutions.

We offer an opportunity to work with experienced professionals, gain exposure to the US government contracting ecosystem, and build a career in federal and SLED proposal development.

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented **Proposal Writer – US Federal / SLED** with 6 months to 2 years of experience in proposal writing, bid management, or responding to US Federal and SLED opportunities.

The candidate should have basic knowledge of US government procurement processes and exposure to RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs. The role involves supporting the development of high-quality, compliant, and compelling proposals for US Federal, State, and Local Government opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in preparing and developing responses to US Federal and SLED RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs.
* Review solicitation documents and understand proposal requirements, instructions, and evaluation criteria.
* Assist in preparing compliance matrices and proposal response checklists.
* Draft, edit, and format proposal sections, including:

* Company profiles and capabilities.
* Past performance and project experience.
* Staffing plans and candidate resumes.
* Management approach and service delivery models.
* Coordinate with internal teams, including recruitment, sales, subject matter experts (SMEs), and leadership, to gather proposal inputs.
* Ensure proposal content is accurate, consistent, and aligned with customer requirements.
* Track proposal deadlines, milestones, and submission schedules.
* Maintain proposal documentation, templates, reusable content, and knowledge repositories.
* Support proposal reviews, proofreading, and quality checks before submission.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 6 months to 2 years of experience in proposal writing, bid management, or business documentation.
* Exposure to US Federal or SLED (State, Local, and Education) RFP/RFQ/RFI responses is preferred.
* Basic understanding of US government contracting and procurement processes.
* Familiarity with proposal documentation, compliance requirements, and bid submission processes.
* Excellent written English, grammar, editing, and communication skills.
* Good research, analytical, and documentation skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assignments.
* Willingness to work in a US night shift.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work under tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Exposure to US Federal agencies or State and Local Government procurement opportunities.
* Basic understanding of FAR/DFARS requirements.
* Familiarity with government contracting portals and procurement platforms.
* Knowledge of MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Exposure to proposal management tools such as Loopio, RFPIO, or SharePoint.

Work Environment

* Work from Office (WFO).
* US Night Shift to support US business hours and proposal deadlines.
* Collaborative and performance-driven work environment.
* Opportunity to learn and work on US Federal and SLED government contracting opportunities.

Why Join vTech Solution?

* Opportunity to build expertise in US Federal and SLED proposal development.
* Hands-on exposure to government RFPs, RFQs, and RFIs.
* Learn from experienced professionals in US staffing and IT services.
* Career growth opportunities in proposal management, federal contracting, and business development.
* Work with a growing global organization and international clients.

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Document Controller II
description:
**About Us**
Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Purpose of Role**
Document Control lead on a project. Act as main interface between project personnel and client for any document control issues. Ensure that all project documentation is accurately logged, managed and issued via the Electronic Document Management System. It is imperative that each project has an accurate database containing each revision of all documents/drawings issued on a project and capturing all necessary meta-data for each record including every document that is issued to each Company throughout the life of the project.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Senior Document Controller with Worley***
, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* Responsible for performing difficult and complex work assignments involving independent judgment to determine a course of action consistent with established functional and organization's policies and goals. Ability to lead and/or train lesser seasoned individuals.
* Performs difficult technical support assignments, requiring the application of advanced techniques, and engineering and mathematical principles, in accordance with established standards and procedures. May act as lead to lower-level team members.
