title: UG Research Intern
description:
**Job Description**

***Company Description***

REACT (Real World Engineering and Application through Collaborative Transformation) is an initiative at Kumaraguru Institutions that focuses on innovation, research, and collaborative problem-solving to address real-world challenges. The initiative brings together students, faculty, institutions, and communities to develop solutions through interdisciplinary learning and practical engagement.

REACT works across various domains to identify societal challenges, develop innovative approaches, and create meaningful impact through research, experiential learning, and collaborative initiatives.

***Role Description***

The Education Research & Programme Development Intern will primarily focus on researching existing educational models, frameworks, pedagogical approaches, and innovative learning methodologies to understand their relevance, effectiveness, and potential application in addressing societal challenges. The intern will contribute to the research, conceptualisation, and development of a structured educational methodology at REACT, with a strong emphasis on social impact, experiential learning, and real-world problem-solving.

The role involves studying established education systems and practices, identifying gaps and opportunities, analysing relevant case studies, and translating research findings into practical frameworks and methodologies. The intern will work towards developing programme structures, learning approaches, implementation models, and strategies that integrate education with social innovation and community impact.

Beyond research and framework development, the role requires strong programme management, event coordination, and operational capabilities to support the execution and implementation of the developed methodology. This includes planning and organising workshops, learning interventions, events, and other programme activities, coordinating with stakeholders, managing logistics, and ensuring effective implementation.

The intern will work closely with the REACT team and multidisciplinary stakeholders, contributing across the entire process – from research and conceptualisation to methodology development, programme execution, and continuous improvement.

This is an on-site internship based at Kumaraguru Institutions, Coimbatore, requiring active collaboration with the REACT team and participation in ongoing projects and initiatives.

***Qualifications***

* Currently pursuing an undergraduate degree in any discipline.
* Strong interest or experience in educational research, information analysis, and research documentation.
* Ability to study existing educational models, identify gaps, and develop problem statements.
* Interest in programme curation, framework development, and learning and development.
* Familiarity with design thinking, creative problem-solving, and innovative approaches.
* Strong learning agility, adaptability, and willingness to explore new domains.
* Good communication, teamwork, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Event management, programme coordination, and operational execution skills.
* Basic proficiency in digital tools, documentation, spreadsheets, and presentations.
* Prior experience in research, programme development, student initiatives, or event management will be an added advantage but is not mandatory.

***Internship Details***

This is an unpaid, experiential internship designed to provide practical exposure to educational research, methodology development, programme management, and social impact initiatives. The internship emphasises learning through active participation, collaborative problem-solving, and contributing to real-world projects.

Interns are expected to demonstrate curiosity, initiative, accountability, adaptability, and a willingness to learn while contributing to the collective goals of the REACT team.

The Customer Success Executive protects revenue and drives product/service adoption across a high-volume Mid-Market or SMB books ensuring customers realize baseline value and renew. This role monitors health and usage signals at scale, intervenes early on renewal and churn risk, and drives adoption of core services through repeatable, one-to-many playbooks.

* Manage Renewals

* Partner on renewal terms within defined guardrails.
* Track renewal pipeline and forecast accuracy.

* Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience in Customer Success, Retention, or Account Management.

* Comfortable managing a high-volume book using standardized playbooks and health-score triggers.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret health-score and usage data.
* Self-motivated, organized, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to escalate appropriately without absorbing expansion, executive-relationship, or transformation work outside scope.

**Success Measures**

* Retain: Renewal Rate, Revenue at Risk, Churn
* Adopt: Adoption Rate / Activation, Playbook Completion / Coverage.

**Job Description**

The Strategy & Market Intelligence Analyst supports strategic decision-making across business by combining structured problem solving, commercial judgment, market intelligence, and rigorous analysis.

The role will support priority initiatives across service lines, geographies, and strategic themes, including growth strategy, market entry, portfolio choices, partnerships, M&A screening, and strategic planning.

**Responsibilities**:

**Strategic Problem Solving & Recommendation Development**

* Structure complex and ambiguous business questions into clear, hypothesis-driven workplans.
* Identify the underlying drivers of business performance, market evolution, and competitive advantage.

**Growth Strategy & Business Case Development**

* Assess growth opportunities across service lines, customer segments, regions, and countries.
* Evaluate market attractiveness, strategic fit, competitive intensity, required capabilities, and potential economics.
* Build business cases, scenarios, and sensitivities to inform investment and resource-allocation decisions.
* Support market-entry, geographic expansion, service-line development, and portfolio-prioritization initiatives.
* Translate market and customer evidence into clear growth theses and practical action plans.

**Market & Competitive Strategy**

* Develop fact-based perspectives on market size, growth, customer demand, and competitive dynamics.
* Assess competitors’ service offerings, capabilities, geographic footprints, strategic moves, and partnerships.
* Identify emerging market patterns, disruption risks, capability gaps, and potential sources of differentiation.

**Corporate Development & Strategic Projects**

* Support M&A screening, partnership assessments, and selected strategic due diligence activities.
* Develop market landscapes, target screens, strategic rationales, and investment narratives.
* Contribute to assessments of new services, business models, capabilities, and geographic opportunities.

**Executive Communication & Storytelling**

* Produce clear, structured, and executive-ready PowerPoint materials.
* Distill large volumes of information into concise insights, choices, and recommendations.
* Develop insight-led storylines that connect evidence with business implications.

**Stakeholder Interaction & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Strategy Manager and broader Strategy team as a thought partner and workstream owner.
* Engage stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Services, Operations, and other functions to gather evidence and test hypotheses.
* Coordinate cross-functional project activities and ensure outputs are accurate, timely, and decision-relevant.

**Analytical Quality & Knowledge Development**

* Ensure analyses are transparent, defensible, and appropriately documented.
* Triangulate internal and external evidence while recognizing data limitations, biases, and uncertainty.
* Use business intelligence, automation, and AI-enabled tools where they improve the quality, speed, or consistency of insight generation.

.

**Educational Background:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Strategy, Economics, Business, Finance, Life Sciences, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field.

**Work Experience:**

* Approximately 3 to 5 years of experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, business development, transaction advisory, market intelligence, or another role supporting strategic decisions.
* Experience in a top-tier management consulting firm, or comparable experience in a high-performing internal strategy team, is strongly preferred.

title: HR Executive
description:

Pehchaan Media is a growing media and influencer marketing company working across content creation, digital marketing, financial markets and events.

* Proactive, organized and confident personality.

* Creative and enthusiastic about office events and employee engagement.
* Responsible, punctual and professional.

**Join Pehchaan Media and help us build an exciting workplace!**

title: Presales Specialist
description:
**Presales Specialist
  
  
  
About Us**
Connect2Learn is a fast-growing global EdTech platform dedicated to delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences across academic and non-academic disciplines. Our mission is to empower students by connecting them with passionate and qualified educators from around the world.
  
Through live one-on-one sessions, customized lesson plans, and student-focused learning approaches, we help learners unlock their full potential and achieve academic success with confidence.

**Key Responsibilities**
Make outbound calls to students and parents to explain Connect2Learn’s programs and offerings.
  
Schedule free demo classes by engaging families in meaningful and informative conversations.
  
Handle inbound inquiries and provide accurate information regarding courses and learning options.
  
Conduct regular follow-ups to ensure demo classes are scheduled and attended successfully.
  
Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate lead details and interaction status.
  
Coordinate with counselors and operations teams to ensure a seamless demo experience.
  
Achieve daily and weekly demo booking targets.
  
  
**Requirements**
Freshers and interns are welcome — complete training will be provided.
  
Strong verbal communication and spoken English skills.
  
Confidence in interacting with parents and students professionally.
  
Goal-oriented mindset with enthusiasm to achieve targets.
  
Basic knowledge of MS Office, Google Sheets, and CRM tools.
  
Candidates must be based in Kolkata or willing to relocate immediately.
  
**Perks & Benefits**
Fixed salary with attractive performance-based incentives.
  
Technology allowance and travel reimbursement (where applicable).
  
Excellent growth opportunities in counseling and sales domains.
  
Supportive, energetic, and youthful work culture.
  
Exposure to international markets including the UK, USA, Canada, and Australia.
  
  
**Selection Process**
Shortlisted candidates will receive a quick introductory call from our team.
  
Your first job shapes your future — choose growth, learning, and opportunity with Connect2Learn.
  
Start your professional journey with us today.

title: Bid Manager - GeM Tendering
description:
Job Description:

Bid Manager – GeM Tendering

Role: Bid Manager – GeM Tendering

Department: Business Development / Tendering

Location: Kolkata / On-site

Employment Type: Full-time

Company Role Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Bid Manager to handle tender search, bid preparation, documentation, and submission on the GeM portal and other government/private procurement platforms. The candidate will manage tendering activities across a multi-service portfolio including IT services, software, manpower, consulting, support services, hardware, and other business offerings.

Key Responsibilities

● Search and identify relevant tenders on GeM, eProcurement portals, PSU portals, state government portals, and private tender platforms

● Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical requirements, commercial terms, EMD/PBG requirements, and submission deadlines.

● Prepare bid summaries for management review, covering scope, eligibility, deadline, documentation needs, risks, and commercial points.

● Coordinate with internal teams for technical write-ups, financial quotes, product/service details, certifications, and supporting documents.

● Prepare compliance sheets, technical bid documents, commercial bid documents, declarations, undertakings, and authorization letters.

● Manage end-to-end bid submission on GeM and other tendering platforms.

● Track corrigendums, clarifications, pre-bid queries, reverse auctions, technical evaluation, financial opening, and award status

. ● Maintain tender trackers, bid calendars, submitted bid records, and documentation repositories.

● Ensure all statutory/company documents are updated, including PAN, GST, MSME, ISO, financial statements, experience certificates, work orders, completion certificates, and company profiles.

● Support management in bid strategy, pricing coordination, tender presentations, and post-submission follow-ups. Required Skills

● Working knowledge of GeM portal and government tendering process.

● Ability to read and interpret tender documents, eligibility clauses, BOQ, and compliance requirements.

● Strong documentation, coordination, and deadline management skills.

● Basic commercial understanding of EMD, PBG, GST, payment terms, BOQ, and pricing formats.

● Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Google Sheets, PDF handling, and email communication.

● Ability to coordinate with multiple internal stakeholders under strict timelines.

● High attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.

● Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Experience

● 1–5 years of experience in bid management, tendering, GeM bidding, business coordination, or proposal documentation.

● Prior experience in IT services, software, manpower services, facility services, consulting, hardware, or multi-service portfolios will be preferred.

● Experience with PSU, government, or enterprise procurement processes will be an advantage. Educational Qualification

● Graduate in any discipline.

● MBA/PGDM in Business Administration, Marketing, Operations, or related field will be preferred but not mandatory.

title: Online Bidder
description:
**Company Description**
Truepid Technologies Private Limited is a digital-first technology company that helps entrepreneurs and enterprises deliver seamless omni-channel experiences to their customers. The organization focuses on end-to-end digital transformation, supporting clients from ideation through execution with mobility and technology solutions. With a strong emphasis on collaboration, Truepid works closely with clients to shape effective marketing and technology strategies. Core services include website and mobile app development, SEO/SEM, social media management and marketing, and ecommerce solutions.

**Role Description**
The Online Bidder at Truepid Technologies Private Limited will be responsible for identifying and qualifying new business opportunities on online platforms such as Upwork, Freelancer, and similar portals. On a day-to-day basis, this role includes researching potential projects, preparing tailored proposals, writing clear and compelling bids, and communicating with prospective clients to understand their requirements. The Online Bidder will coordinate with internal technical and sales teams to align proposals with service capabilities and pricing, maintain accurate records of bids and outcomes, and support continuous improvement in bidding strategies. This is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area.

**Qualifications**

* Min 5 years of experience as a Bidder
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills for client interaction, requirement gathering, and proposal presentation.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills and Research abilities to evaluate project requirements, platforms, and market trends.
* Candidates should possess proficient Writing skills to create clear, persuasive, and customized online bids and proposals.
* Candidates should possess Training and self-learning capabilities to stay updated on bidding best practices, platforms, and service offerings.
* Relevant experience in online bidding or pre-sales for IT, web, mobile, or digital marketing services is highly beneficial.
* Understanding of website development, mobile app development, SEO/SEM, social media marketing, and ecommerce solutions is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple bids simultaneously, and meet deadlines with attention to detail.

title: Real Estate Telesales Executive (Lead Qualification & Site Visits)
description:
**Company Description**
SAACHI VENTURES is a growing real estate firm focused on delivering reliable property solutions and professional services to homebuyers and investors. The company emphasizes transparent transactions, customer-centric support, and efficient handling of property inquiries. Team members collaborate closely to guide clients through the property selection and purchase process. SAACHI VENTURES values strong communication, ethical practices, and long-term relationships with clients and partners.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Real Estate Telesales Executive role based in Kolkata. The role involves responding to incoming inquiries, making outbound calls to prospective buyers, and qualifying leads based on budget, location preferences, and readiness to buy. The executive will schedule and coordinate site visits, follow up with clients after visits, and maintain detailed records of interactions in CRM or internal systems. * Proficiency with phone-based outreach, CRM tools, and standard office software is preferred.
* Prior experience in telesales, real estate, or related customer-facing roles is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: high school diploma or equivalent; higher education in business or related fields is a plus.
* 2 yrs+ work experience will be preferred.

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Astro Freight & Logistics Pvt Ltd is a growing logistics and freight services provider specializing in reliable, cost-effective transport solutions for businesses. The company focuses on efficient movement of goods, customer-centric service, and strong operational support. Team members collaborate closely with clients and internal operations to ensure timely deliveries and smooth coordination. Astro Freight & Logistics offers opportunities to work in a dynamic environment where sales and service directly impact business growth.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Kolkata. The Salesperson will identify and pursue new business opportunities, build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective clients, and promote the company’s logistics and freight services. Day-to-day tasks include prospecting, cold calling, visiting client locations, preparing and presenting proposals, and negotiating pricing and terms in line with company guidelines. The role involves working closely with operations and customer service teams to ensure accurate information, timely service, and high client satisfaction. The Salesperson will also track sales activities, update CRM or sales reports, and support management with market feedback and competitor insights.

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present services clearly and build long-term client relationships.
* Proven sales aptitude, including prospecting, negotiation, and closing skills, preferably in logistics, freight, transportation, or related sectors.
* Ability to understand client business needs and match them with suitable logistics solutions and service offerings.
* Basic proficiency in using office software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email) and maintaining accurate sales records or CRM entries.
* Solid organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple leads and follow-ups in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort with on-site client visits in Kolkata and surrounding areas; willingness to travel locally as required.
* Minimum high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Logistics, or a related field is an advantage.
* Prior experience in B2B sales is preferred; familiarity with logistics operations, freight terms, and industry practices is beneficial.

title: ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist (manufacturing model experience is mandatory)
description:
**Company Description**
HR TEAM is a professional services organization focused on delivering tailored HR and technology solutions to businesses. The company supports clients in optimizing their workforce, streamlining processes, and improving operational efficiency. HR TEAM works with diverse industries and leverages modern tools and platforms to meet client requirements. The environment encourages continuous learning, collaboration, and practical problem-solving. Team members are expected to contribute to client success through quality service and domain expertise.
  
**Role Description**
The ERPNext Functional Expert & Implementation Specialist will lead end-to-end implementation and optimization of ERPNext, with a mandatory focus on the manufacturing module. This full-time, on-site role is based in the Kolkata metropolitan area and involves working closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, map business processes, and configure ERPNext accordingly. Daily responsibilities include analyzing manufacturing workflows, defining functional specifications, performing functional testing, coordinating integrations, and preparing documentation and training materials. The specialist will collaborate with technical teams to resolve issues, support go-live activities, and ensure stable, efficient system operation. The role also includes ongoing support, troubleshooting, and recommending improvements based on user feedback and performance metrics.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong analytical skills to assess business requirements, manufacturing workflows, and system performance.
* Effective communication skills for collaborating with stakeholders, documenting processes, and delivering user training.
* Proven experience in business process mapping and optimization, especially within manufacturing operations.
* Hands-on experience with functional testing of ERPNext modules to validate configurations and ensure quality.
* Knowledge of system integration concepts, including coordinating ERPNext integrations with other business applications.
* Demonstrated expertise in ERPNext functional configuration, particularly in the manufacturing module (mandatory).
* Experience in end-to-end ERP implementation projects, from requirements gathering through go-live and post-implementation support.
* Ability to work on-site in the Kolkata metropolitan area and collaborate in cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with reporting, data analysis, and basic project management practices is beneficial.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
ACCE GLOBAL SOFTWARE PVT LTD is a technology-driven company focused on delivering modern, customer-centric solutions in line with current market trends. Founded in 2017, ACCE has experienced steady growth and has become one of India’s trusted product developers and suppliers, with strong multichannel retail experience. The company offers customized solutions in Mobile Anti-Theft applications, website and app development, consumer electronics, and smart home AI technologies. ACCE is committed to innovation, quality, and service, and proudly develops products under the “Make in India” initiative, offering team members the opportunity to contribute to homegrown technology solutions.

**Role Description**
The Regional Sales Manager role is a full-time, hybrid position based in Rajarhat, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. The Regional Sales Manager will oversee sales operations within the assigned region, including managing key accounts, identifying new business opportunities, and building long-term relationships with channel partners and customers. Daily responsibilities include setting and tracking regional sales targets, leading and coaching the sales team, conducting market analysis, and preparing regular sales forecasts and performance reports. The role involves close collaboration with marketing, product, and operations teams to support product launches, optimize retail strategies, and ensure a consistent customer experience across channels. The Regional Sales Manager is expected to travel within the region as needed to support partners, attend client meetings, and participate in events that promote ACCE’s technology solutions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong regional sales management experience, including setting sales targets, forecasting, and driving revenue growth.
* Proficiency in account management, channel partner development, and relationship-building with customers and distributors.
* Skills in sales strategy, territory planning, and market analysis to identify opportunities and competitive trends.
* Experience collaborating with marketing and product teams to support go-to-market plans for technology and consumer electronics solutions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Demonstrated leadership abilities, including team coaching, performance management, and motivating sales teams toward targets.
* Comfort with CRM tools, sales reporting, and data-driven decision-making to track pipeline and performance metrics.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Relevant experience in technology, software, consumer electronics, or smart home products is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment in Rajarhat, with readiness for regional travel when required.

**Join** **us at Accor,** **where** **life pulses** **with** **passion!**

As a pioneer in the art of responsible hospitality, the Accor Group gathers more than 45 brands, 5,600 hotels, 10,000 restaurants, and lifestyle destinations in 110 countries. While each brand has its own personality, where you will be able to truly find yourself, they all share a common ambition: to keep innovating and challenging the status-quo.

By joining us, you will become a Heartist®, because hospitality is, first and foremost, a work of heart.

You will join a caring environment and a team where you can be all you are. You will be in a supportive place to grow, to fulfil yourself, to discover other professions and to pursue career opportunities, in your hotel or in other hospitality environments, in your country or anywhere in the world!

You will enjoy exclusive benefits, specific to the sector and beyond, as well as strong recognition for your daily commitment.

Everything you will do with us, regardless of your profession, will offer a deep sense of meaning, to create lasting, memorable and impactful experiences for your customers, for your colleagues and for the planet.

**Hospitality****is** **a** **work** **of** **heart****,**
  
**Join** **us and** **become** **a** **Heartist****®.**

 **Job Description**

We're looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented F&B Executive to join our dynamic team in Gandhinagar, India. In this pivotal role, you will oversee food and beverage operations, ensuring exceptional service delivery and maintaining the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction. As an F&B Executive, you will work collaboratively with our culinary and service teams to create memorable dining experiences while driving operational excellence and profitability.

* Oversee daily F&B outlet operations during peak and off-peak hours, ensuring seamless service delivery and strict adherence to operational standards and company policies
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of all F&B services, menus, outlets, and hotel services to provide informed guidance to staff and guests
* Supervise and mentor F&B team members, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment while promoting professional development, growth, and continuous learning
* Implement and monitor quality assurance protocols to ensure consistent service excellence, food safety standards, and compliance with local health regulations across all outlets
* Manage inventory, cost control, budgeting, and vendor relationships to optimize profitability while maintaining premium service quality and operational efficiency
* Analyze operational metrics, financial data, and guest feedback to identify improvement opportunities and implement data-driven solutions that enhance performance and revenue
* Coordinate scheduling and resource planning to ensure adequate staffing during all service periods while maintaining labor cost efficiency
* Respond promptly to guest concerns and complaints with empathy and professionalism, resolving issues decisively and transparently to ensure guest satisfaction
* Ensure compliance with fire safety, life safety, emergency procedures, and local food safety regulations, maintaining a secure and compliant environment for guests and staff
* Collaborate with management to develop and execute innovative F&B programs, promotions, and initiatives that enhance guest experiences and drive business growth
* Train and develop staff on service protocols, menu knowledge, customer engagement techniques, and operational procedures to elevate team performance and consistency
* Maintain professional presentation and grooming standards while modeling organizational values, behaviors, and commitment to excellence
* Build and maintain strong vendor relationships to support operational efficiency, cost management, and quality standards
* Drive revenue initiatives and upselling opportunities while maintaining service quality and guest satisfaction

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management or equivalent Diploma in Hospitality/F&B Management
* Minimum 2-3 years of progressive experience in F&B operations, preferably in a hotel or upscale restaurant environment
* Strong leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to motivate, develop, and inspire team members
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a customer-focused mindset and guest relations management experience
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively under pressure and in high-stress situations while maintaining composure and resilience
* Proficiency in inventory management, cost control, budget management, and basic financial analysis
* Comprehensive knowledge of food safety standards, health regulations, and emergency procedures, including India-specific compliance requirements
* Strong organizational and time management skills with meticulous attention to detail
* Problem-solving abilities and analytical mindset to drive operational improvements and innovation
* Proficiency in F&B management software and point-of-sale (POS) systems
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as required by the hospitality industry
* Team player with a collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across departments
* Self-motivated, resilient, and adaptable to changing operational demands and business priorities
* Vendor relationship management experience and negotiation skills
* Quality assurance implementation and monitoring capabilities
* Experience with staff scheduling and resource allocation
* Proven ability to handle guest complaints and conflict resolution with empathy and professionalism
* Experience in driving revenue initiatives and profitability improvements

  
**Additional Information**

3–4 years of experience in F&B Service within a midscale or branded hotel.

Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Hotel Management or an equivalent qualification.

title: Audit Executive
description:
The Audit Executive is responsible for reviewing and verifying the company's financial transactions, accounting records, project expenses, vendor payments, and internal financial procedures. The role ensures financial accuracy, transparency, regulatory compliance, and adherence to company policies. The Audit Executive will also identify financial discrepancies, assess internal controls, and provide recommendations to improve financial operations.

**Key ResponsibilitiesA. Financial Audit & Verification**

* Conduct regular internal audits of financial transactions and accounting records.
* Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices, bills, vouchers, and payment records.
* Review cash transactions, bank statements, and financial documents.
* Identify errors, irregularities, and financial discrepancies.
* Ensure proper maintenance of accounting records and supporting documents.
* Prepare audit reports and submit findings to management.

**Project Cost & Expense Audit**

* Conduct project-wise audits to monitor construction expenses.
* Verify material purchase bills, labour expenses, and subcontractor payments.
* Cross-check project expenses against approved budgets.
* Review material consumption records and purchase statements.
* Identify unnecessary expenses and potential cost leakages.
* Verify site expenses and petty cash utilization.
* Ensure proper documentation of project-related financial transactions.

**Vendor & Payment Audit**

* Verify vendor invoices, quotations, purchase orders, and payment requests.
* Cross-check supplier payments against approved bills and supporting documents.
* Review outstanding payments and vendor account statements.
* Identify duplicate payments, incorrect billing, or unauthorized transactions.
* Ensure all payments follow the company's approval procedures.

**Internal Control & Compliance**

* Monitor compliance with company financial policies and procedures.
* Review internal accounting and financial control systems.
* Ensure proper authorization for financial transactions.
* Verify compliance with applicable GST, TDS, and other statutory requirements.
* Identify financial risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Coordinate with external auditors during statutory audits.

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly audit reports.
* Maintain audit observations and supporting documentation.
* Report financial irregularities to management.
* Prepare project-wise expense verification reports.
* Follow up on corrective actions taken by the concerned departments.
* Maintain confidentiality of financial and company information.

**Departmental Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Accounts Department for financial verification.
* Work closely with project managers and site engineers to verify project expenses.
* Coordinate with the Procurement Department regarding material purchases.
* Communicate audit findings and discrepancies to the concerned departments.
* Follow up on pending clarifications and supporting documents.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, or Finance.
* Professional qualifications such as CA Inter, CMA Inter, or relevant audit certifications are preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in auditing or accounting (preferred).
* Knowledge of accounting principles and auditing procedures.
* Understanding of GST, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software such as Tally or Zoho Books.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Ability to identify financial discrepancies and recommend improvements.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

With extensive experience in field technology sales, applies professional principles and aligns with company goals to address complex challenges both creatively and efficiently. * As part of the Customer Success team, the ATS is responsible for assessing the potential application of Citrix products to meet customers’ business needs.

* They should serve as an external spokesperson and evangelist for Citrix’s vision and associated technologies.

* Seen as a sales professional that can function as a sales representative as needed.
* Ability to present\communicate at an executive level to multiple customers\prospects

* Citrix Technology Proficiency and Competitive Positioning - The individual demonstrates a high level of proficiency in Citrix Technologies, with a solid understanding of the key platforms such as Desktop as a Service (DaaS), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Application Delivery Controller (ADC), and Enterprise Browser solutions. This expertise includes knowledge of competing products, allowing for effective comparison and strategic positioning. The individual can communicate Citrix Technologies’ unique value, showcasing their strengths to secure a competitive edge and meet customer needs.

**Required Experience/Skills**

* They must have a solid understanding of Citrix's competitive domain and technologies.
* Ability to diffuse complicated technical and political situations with partners and customers.

* Exhibits a positive attitude, represents Citrix to business partners as well as customers in the best possible fashion, and fosters interest in our offerings

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
About UHP Technologies

UHP Technologies Pvt. Ltd., part of the KAS Group, Bengaluru, specializes in ultra-high-purity (UHP) gas delivery systems, chemical distribution systems, cleanroom EPC and utility infrastructure for semiconductor and solar manufacturing clients. With around 17 years in the market and nearly 40 GW of solar manufacturing projects served, UHP delivers both package-wise gas and chemical systems and full utility turnkey solutions for fabs and cell/module factories across India.

Role Summary

We are looking for technically strong Chemical or Mechanical engineers who can turn a customer's enquiry into a winning techno-commercial proposal. You will sit at the centre of the BD team: reading RFQs, BOQs and drawings, working out the technical solution with the design team, building the costing, and presenting a clear, professional offer to the customer. You will work directly with the GM – BD & Sales and will be involved from first enquiry through negotiation and order handover.

Key Responsibilities1. Proposal preparation

* Study RFQs, tender documents, technical specifications, P&IDs, layouts and BOQs, and identify scope, battery limits, exclusions and risks.
* Prepare complete techno-commercial proposals for UHP's packages: specialty / process gas (PGS), bulk gas (BGS), bulk chemical distribution (PCH), process exhaust (PEX), cleanroom and utility turnkey packages (CDA, N₂, PCW, UPW, vacuum, etc.).
* Write technical write-ups, scope of supply, deviation / compliance statements, project schedules and qualifying notes.
* Prepare proposal presentations and company credential decks in UHP's standard format.
* Maintain a library of standard proposal templates, technical write-ups and past offers for quick re-use.

2. Estimation & costing

* Prepare BOQ-based cost estimates using UHP's costing sheets and markup method (material, installation, spares, testing, warranty).
* Float enquiries to vendors (gas cabinets, VMB/VMP, purifiers, tubing & fittings, valves, instrumentation, electrical, exhaust/scrubbers, etc.), and prepare technical and commercial bid evaluations (TBE / CBE).
* Benchmark prices against past bids and maintain an up-to-date rate database.
* Support margin analysis and price negotiations with the GM – BD & Sales.

3. Customer & technical interface

* Attend pre-bid meetings, technical clarification meetings and site visits with customers and consultants.
* Respond to technical queries and clarifications within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with UHP's design, procurement (SCM) and projects teams to make sure what we offer can be delivered on time and within cost.

4. Business development support

* Track enquiries, submissions, follow-ups and win/loss status in the proposal tracker / CRM.
* Support market mapping of semiconductor, solar (cell, module, ingot/wafer) and allied manufacturing projects in India.
* Prepare win/loss analysis and lessons learnt after each major bid.
* Ensure a clean handover of won orders (scope, price, commitments) to the projects team.

Technical Knowledge Required

**Must have (any one strong area, working knowledge of others):**

* Process / utility systems: gas, chemical, compressed air, nitrogen, cooling water, exhaust or water systems.
* Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, GA drawings, isometrics, datasheets and BOQs.
* Piping materials and fundamentals – SS316L (BA / EP), PFA, PVDF, PP, CS; fittings, valves, welding and testing basics.
* Basic engineering calculations: line sizing, pressure drop, flow and consumption estimates, exhaust volume.

**Good to have:**

* Exposure to semiconductor fabs, solar cell / module plants, pharma, specialty chemicals or similar cleanroom / high-purity environments.
* Familiarity with UHP gas delivery components – gas cabinets, VMB/VMP, purifiers, orbital welding, helium leak and particle testing.
* Awareness of relevant standards: SEMI (S2, F-series), NFPA, ASME B31.3, ISO 14644 (cleanrooms), PESO requirements.
* Prior experience preparing proposals or estimates in an EPC / contracting company.

Skills & Competencies

* **Excel:**
  strong – BOQs, costing sheets, lookups, pivots, comparison tables.
* **PowerPoint & Word:**
  able to produce clean, professional, customer-ready documents.
* **AutoCAD / Navisworks viewer:**
  able to read drawings and take quantities (modelling not required).
* **Communication:**
  clear written and spoken English; confident in customer meetings.
* Structured, detail-oriented and deadline-driven – able to handle multiple bids in parallel.
* Commercial sense: understands cost, margin, payment terms, warranty and risk.
* Team player who works well across design, SCM and projects teams.

What We Offer

* Direct exposure to India's fast-growing semiconductor and solar manufacturing sector.
* Work on high-value bids – from individual gas / chemical packages to full utility turnkey projects.
* Close mentoring by the BD leadership and a clear growth path into Senior Proposal Engineer / Proposal Manager / Key Account roles.
* Competitive salary [CTC range – to be confirmed] and performance-linked incentives.

title: CRM Architect
description:
**About Avanade**
Avanade is the world’s leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7,000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft’s Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results.
  
  
Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60,000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165,000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India’s Business Applications practice is looking for a Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to take overall architectural ownership of our CRM projects. This is a senior, functionally led role for someone whose career has been built on Dynamics 365 CRM — who understands how sales, service, marketing and field teams actually work, and can design a CRM solution that fits those processes rather than forcing them to fit the product.
  
  
You will lead solution design across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules and the Power Platform, run the functional conversation with business stakeholders, and give the technical team a design they can build.
  
  
The emphasis is on functional depth — process design, fit-gap, configuration-first solutions and adoption — backed by enough technical understanding to make sound decisions on integration, data, security and extension, and to hold the build team to a good standard. The role also carries a strong presales element: you will be the CRM solution lead on pursuits for Dynamics 365 and Power Apps opportunities — shaping the solution, demonstrating it, estimating it and helping us win it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end solution architecture for Dynamics 365 CRM projects — from discovery and requirements through design, build, testing, go-live and hypercare.
* Lead business process workshops with client stakeholders, map current and future-state processes, and translate them into a Dynamics 365 solution design.
* Run fit-gap analysis against standard Dynamics 365 capability, favouring configuration over customisation, and make clear recommendations where gaps need Power Platform or custom extension.
* Design functional solutions across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules: Sales (lead-to-opportunity, forecasting, sales accelerator), Customer Service and Contact Center (case management, SLAs, entitlements, knowledge, omnichannel routing), Field Service (work orders, scheduling, resources, assets, inventory), Customer Insights – Journeys and Customer Insights – Data (marketing journeys, segmentation, unified customer profile), and Project Operations where project-based selling and delivery are in scope.
* Design the Dataverse data model and security model — tables, relationships, business units, security roles, teams, field-level security and hierarchy security — to match the client’s organisation.
* Design Power Platform extensions: model-driven apps for core CRM processes, canvas apps for task-focused and mobile scenarios, Power Pages portals for customers and partners, and Power Automate for workflow and automation.
* Bring Copilot and AI capabilities into the CRM solution where they add value — Copilot in Sales and Customer Service, Copilot Studio agents and AI-assisted productivity features.
* Define the integration approach with ERP, marketing, telephony, websites and third-party systems — at design level, with the technical team owning detailed build.
* Define data migration strategy from legacy CRM platforms (Salesforce, older Dynamics CRM versions or others) — mapping, cleansing, sequencing and reconciliation.
* Author and own solution design documents, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and architecture decisions, and walk client stakeholders through them.
* Guide functional consultants and developers during build, review configuration and design quality, and resolve functional and architectural escalations.
* Oversee testing strategy with QA and business teams — scenario coverage, UAT support and business sign-off — and support cutover and go-live readiness.
* Set ALM, environment and governance standards with the technical lead — solutions, environments, deployment approach and Power Platform governance.
* Lead presales solutioning for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps opportunities — understanding the client’s business problem, qualifying scope and shaping the right solution from the Dynamics 365 modules and Power Platform components.
* Run presales discovery workshops, business-process walkthroughs and high-level fit-gap to define the solution scope and approach.
* Build and deliver tailored solution demos and proofs of concept on Dynamics 365 and Power Apps, showing the client’s own scenarios rather than generic product tours.
* Prepare solution architecture, scope, assumptions, effort estimates, phasing and team structure for proposals, RFP/RFI responses and statements of work.
* Advise on Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing during presales and position the solution against competing platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow.
* Work with sales, bid management, delivery and Microsoft account and partner teams on pursuits, including Microsoft co-sell and funded programmes where applicable.
* Present the solution and delivery approach in client orals and executive presentations and support negotiation of scope through to contract and handover to delivery.
* Mentor CRM functional consultants and contribute reusable process models, demo assets and accelerators to the practice.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 11–15 years of overall experience, with the substantial majority focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM / Customer Engagement and its predecessor Dynamics CRM versions.
* Deep functional expertise in Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Customer Service, with strong working knowledge of at least one of Field Service, Customer Insights (Journeys / Data), Contact Center or Project Operations.
* Proven experience as solution or functional architect on multiple end-to-end Dynamics 365 CRM implementations, including at least two full lifecycle projects from design to go-live.
* Strong grounding in CRM business processes — lead and opportunity management, account and contact management, quote and order, case management, service scheduling and marketing journeys.
* Demonstrated ability to run discovery and process workshops, lead fit-gap analysis and produce clear solution designs and functional specifications.
* Strong command of the Power Platform: model-driven apps, canvas apps, Power Pages and Power Automate — knowing which to use for which scenario.
* Good understanding of Dataverse — data model, security model, business rules, business process flows and configuration capability.
* Technical implementation understanding sufficient to guide the build team: plug-ins and JavaScript extension points, integration patterns (APIs, connectors, Azure integration services), data migration tooling and ALM — hands-on development is not required.
* Experience designing data migration from legacy CRM platforms and managing data quality through cutover.
* Awareness of Dynamics 365 and Power Platform licensing and how it shapes solution design.
* Strong client-facing skills — credible with sales, service and marketing leaders, and able to defend design decisions with business and IT stakeholders.
* Experience guiding and reviewing the work of functional consultants and developers on medium-to-large projects.
* Solid presales experience for Dynamics 365 CRM and Power Apps based solutions — discovery, solution shaping, demos, estimation and proposal writing — with a track record of contributing to won deals.
* Understanding of the presales lifecycle from qualification through RFP response, orals and negotiation, and of how estimates and assumptions translate into commercial risk.
* Ability to build and deliver compelling Dynamics 365 and Power Platform demos tailored to the client’s industry and processes.

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Microsoft certifications: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst (MB-280), Customer Service Functional Consultant (MB-230), Field Service Functional Consultant (MB-240), Power Platform Solution Architect (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910).
* Hands-on experience with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and with Copilot Studio agents in a CRM context.
* Experience migrating clients from Salesforce or other CRM platforms to Dynamics 365.
* Experience integrating Dynamics 365 CRM with Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Business Central or SAP.
* Experience with Microsoft FastTrack or Success by Design reviews.
* Industry depth in one or more of BFSI, manufacturing, retail, professional services, healthcare or public sector.
* Exposure to Power BI reporting for CRM and to Customer Insights – Data for customer analytics.
* Experience in a consulting, global delivery or SI environment
* Experience with Microsoft partner motions — co-sell, Microsoft-funded engagements (e.g. Business Applications workshops and envisioning programmes) and joint pursuits with Microsoft account teams.
* Competitive knowledge of Salesforce, ServiceNow and other CRM platforms for positioning and migration pursuits.

title: Customer Engagement Manager
description:
**What We Do**
 At GoGuardian, we’re helping build a future where all learners are ready and inspired to solve the world’s greatest challenges. Our award-winning system of learning solutions is purpose-built for K-12 and trusted by school leaders to promote effective teaching and equitable engagement while helping empower educators to keep students safe.  
**What It’s Like to Work at GoGuardian**

We are an outcomes-focused learning company with a steadfast focus on improving learning environments, one classroom at a time. Working with us means joining a remote team of diverse, committed, mission-driven employees who are inspired by our vision, dedicated to our customers, and ready to roll up their sleeves. Guardians put their heads together to solve problems, learn together from experiments that fail, and stand together by their work with full accountability. We balance our diligence with an inclusive culture that invites everyone to bring their whole self to work. Join us and learn why “I love the people here” is one of the most frequent comments we hear from Guardians.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Customer Engagement Manager to help identify and address customer engagement, adoption, and churn risks across GoGuardian’s Curriculum and Instruction products.

This is a data-driven, customer-facing role that combines customer investigation, analytics, product knowledge, and cross-functional problem-solving. You’ll use customer and product data to identify strategic and at-risk customers, deep dive into their behavior and engagement patterns to understand the underlying causes, and work with Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering to determine and drive appropriate actions.

You’ll also work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand issues, answer questions, and support customers who require additional attention. This position sits within the Product Team and serves as a bridge between customers and the teams responsible for improving the product experience.

This is a remote opportunity for candidates located in India and requires regular overlap with U.S. working hours.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer Engagement & Risk Management (~40%)**

* Partner with Customer Success to identify and support strategic and at-risk customers.
* Maintain a data-informed view of customer engagement, adoption, and churn risk.
* Provide support to identified at-risk customers and help ensure their concerns are addressed.
* Participate in customer meetings and product discussions to understand customer goals and challenges.
* Help identify and drive actions that improve customer engagement, adoption, and retention.

**Analytics & Customer Investigation (~20%)**

* Regularly examine dashboards and customer/product usage data to identify customers with declining engagement, adoption risks, or other signals of churn.
* Deep dive into individual customer behavior and usage patterns to understand why engagement or adoption is changing.
* Investigate customer history, product usage, and other relevant signals to identify root causes.
* Develop clear, actionable findings and recommendations based on customer and product data.
* Track the impact of actions taken and use data to determine whether customer engagement or risk is improving.
* Build and maintain a reliable, data-informed list of customers requiring attention.

**Product Partnership & Customer Advocacy (~20%)**

* Bring customer findings, recurring issues, and product opportunities to Product Managers in a clear and actionable way.
* Partner with Product Management to investigate customer problems and validate potential solutions or workflows.
* Capture and synthesize customer feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring product challenges.
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Engineering when customer issues require deeper technical investigation or resolution.
* Validate new features and workflows with customers and share feedback to help improve the product experience.

**Cross-Functional Customer & Product Support (~20%)**

* Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address customer questions and issues.
* Help troubleshoot customer-reported product and data issues and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Support customer data onboarding, integrations, and account maintenance where applicable.
* Communicate customer issues and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Follow issues through to resolution and ensure relevant customer-facing teams are kept informed.

**Who You Are**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Technical Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Experience working directly with U.S.-based customers and confidently leading customer conversations, presentations, and business reviews.
* Experience supporting or retaining strategic or at-risk customers and understanding customer engagement or churn risk.
* Analytical and data-driven, with experience using customer, product, or business data to identify risks, investigate customer behavior, and inform actions.
* Strong investigative and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dig into customer issues, identify root causes, and determine appropriate next steps.
* Familiarity with customer-facing web applications, data integrations, APIs, and common web technologies, with the ability to troubleshoot issues and work effectively with technical teams.
* Ability to work effectively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Engineering teams.
* Strong communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and priorities.
* Comfortable learning new products, workflows, and technical concepts quickly.

* Ability and willingness to regularly work during required U.S. working hours.

Nice to Have

* Experience with SQL, APIs, data integrations, reporting tools, BI platforms, or CRM systems.

*Plus the intangible:*

title: Senior AI Data Architect / Solution Engineer - India based
description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!"**
**Description And Requirements**
CareerArc Code
  
  
CA-JY
  
  
**Hybrid**
BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior AI Data Architect / Solution Engineer to design the architecture that delivers trusted data at scale — and to build the AI products that put it directly in the hands of the business. This is a hands-on, senior role for someone who can set the technical blueprint, build the agents on top of it, and act as the bridge between business needs and technical reality.
  
  
You will work closely with the Director and Enterprise Architect, serve as technical lead and advisor to the team, and partner with the Senior AI Data Engineer to take designs from blueprint to production. Success is measured by the trust, scale, and adoption of the data and AI products that ship — and by the business outcomes they unlock.
  
  
**Here is how, through this role, you will contribute to BMC's and your own success:**

* Architecture for Scale (Primary Focus) — Design the reference architecture and delivery patterns that take governed data from the semantic layer to every downstream consumer — dashboards, applications, and AI agents — reliably and at scale, with the build-vs-buy calls and standards that let the platform grow without painful rework.
* AI Data Products & Agents — Architect and build the Data Agent, the natural-language interface that lets business users query governed data without writing SQL; design agentic workflows with orchestration, tool/function calling, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails.
* Semantic Foundation — Co-design the semantic layer (HoneyDew / DBT) — the metrics, dimensions, and governed business meaning that power both analytics and AI — ensuring agents query governed definitions, not raw tables.
* Technical Leadership — Serve as technical lead and trusted advisor; set patterns, run design reviews, and mentor engineers, partnering with the Data Engineer to take designs to production.
* Business Translation — Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements; own stakeholder relationships and move fluently between executive framing and engineering detail.
* Ownership & Execution — Take features and subsystems end-to-end, proactively identifying gaps and driving work forward even when requirements are incomplete or evolving.

**To ensure you're set up for success, you will bring the following skillset & experience:**

* 8+ years across data architecture and hands-on engineering, including production systems that held up under real enterprise use.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with deep, hands-on experience designing and building on Snowflake and DBT.
* Proven experience designing and building LLM / agentic solutions — RAG, function / tool calling, orchestration (LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph), prompt engineering, and evaluation / observability.
* Deep understanding of the semantic layer as the architectural bridge between source data and business meaning — and why it is foundational to trustworthy AI.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and influence architecture decisions across teams.
* Strong communication and the ability to lead through execution in a fast-moving environment.

**Broad Technical Exposure (depth Not Required In All Areas)**

* Cloud-native architecture across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval evaluation.
* CI/CD and modern engineering practices for data and AI systems.
* Containerization and distributed systems (Docker, Kubernetes, microservices).

**Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills:**

* HoneyDew or other universal/headless semantic layers (HoneyDew, Cube, AtScale, dbt Semantic Layer).
* Snowflake Cortex / Snowflake Intelligence, or production text-to-SQL systems.
* Prior technical-lead or principal-engineer role with mentorship responsibility.
* Background bridging pre-sales / solution engineering and hands-on delivery.

**Our commitment to you!**
BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!
  
  
If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!
  
  
BMC is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, age, sex, creed, color, religion, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy, disabled veteran or status as a protected veteran. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.
  
  
BMC Software maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.
  
  
At BMC we believe in pay transparency and have set the midpoint of the salary band for this role at 4,700,000 INR. Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.
  
  
The salary listed is just one component of BMC's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.
  
  
We are committed to ensuring that our employees are paid fairly and equitably, and that we are transparent about our compensation practices.

title: Supply Chain Integrated Business Planning
description:
**Description -**
**Planning Business System Expert \ IBP Principal Consultant**
**Business Environment**
HP creates new possibilities for technology to have a meaningful impact on people, businesses, governments and society. The world’s largest technology company and ranked 10 on the Fortune 500 list for 2012, HP brings together a portfolio that spans printing, personal computing, software, services and IT infrastructure to serve more than 1 billion customers in over 170 countries on six continents. HP invents, engineers, and delivers technology solutions that drive business value, create social value, and improve the lives of our clients.
  
  
**About The Engagement**
The
**Print Planning Excellence (PPE) team**
is responsible for managing and advancing production planning systems, data, and processes supporting global and regional Print and Personal Systems businesses within HP. The team focuses on delivering robust, scalable, and reliable planning capabilities that enable effective demand and supply planning across the organization.
  
  
The
**Planning Business System Expert and IBP Principal Consultant**
would provide deep functional and solution expertise across demand and supply planning processes. The role would independently lead the resolution of
**complex and business-critical planning issues**
, perform advanced root-cause analysis, define solution approaches, and develop sustainable solutions rather than relying only on predefined procedures.
  
  
The expert would work closely with business, IT, project teams, and planning stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into effective planning solutions. The role would lead or contribute to
**solution design, development, testing, implementation, and stabilization of critical planning projects and system capabilities**
, while ensuring alignment with established architecture, technical standards, and industry best practices.
  
  
The role would also drive planning process improvements, identify opportunities for automation and standardization, strengthen planning KPIs and controls, and provide subject-matter expertise for strategic and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
The objective of the role is to
**solve complex planning challenges, design scalable solutions, drive critical implementations, and continuously enhance the organization's end-to-end planning capabilities**
.
  
  
**Planning Business System Expert and IBP Principal Consultant**
*Diagnose → Design → Solve → Implement → Transform*
**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own and lead complex demand and supply planning processes for global and regional businesses, ensuring accurate and timely completion of critical planning cycles.
* Manage planning systems, processes, and data end-to-end, ensuring planning reliability, master data accuracy, and operational continuity.
* Independently diagnose and resolve complex planning, system, process, and data issues, defining the appropriate solution approach rather than relying only on predefined procedures.
* Lead root-cause analysis for critical and recurring issues, assess business impact, and develop sustainable corrective actions and mitigation plans.
* Serve as a key functional expert and focal point between Business, Planning, and IT, translating complex business requirements into effective planning and system solutions.
* Design and implement advanced planning solutions, models, and capabilities, ensuring alignment with established architecture, technical standards, business requirements, and industry best practices.
* Provide subject-matter expertise and guidance to the planning community, including advising teams on planning processes, master data, system functionality, data quality, and complex planning scenarios.
* Lead and contribute to high-priority and business-critical projects, providing innovative insights, solution recommendations, functional design, testing, implementation, go-live, and stabilization support.
* Define, monitor, and leverage demand and supply planning KPIs to identify performance gaps and drive improvements in planning effectiveness and reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement and digital transformation across planning processes by identifying opportunities for standardization, simplification, automation, and scalable solutions.
* Ensure robust solution development and testing, including functional design, validation, unit testing, and adherence to established standards and best practices.
* Act as a core functional member of strategic Demand and Supply Planning initiatives, connecting planning strategy, system capabilities, and operational execution.

**Skills Required**
**Advanced Demand & Supply Planning Expertise**
Deep functional understanding of end-to-end demand, supply, inventory, forecasting, and integrated business planning processes.
  
  
**Advanced SAP IBP / APO Expertise**
Strong functional and solution knowledge of
**SAP IBP, SAP IBP, SAP HANA, ARIBA, Enterprises Business Wearhouse**
, or equivalent enterprise planning platforms, including upstream/downstream planning dependencies.
  
  
**Complex Problem Solving**
Ability to independently diagnose complex planning, process, data, and system issues and define sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Solution Design & Architecture**
Ability to translate business requirements into scalable planning solutions, process designs, functional requirements, and system capabilities.
  
  
**Advanced Root-Cause Analysis**
Strong ability to perform deep-dive analysis across processes, systems, master data, interfaces, and planning outputs to identify underlying causes of critical issues.
  
  
**Project Design & Implementation**
Experience contributing to or leading critical planning projects from
**requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, go-live, and stabilization**
.
  
  
**Planning Transformation & Continuous Improvement**
Ability to drive process standardization, automation, simplification, and transformation across demand and supply planning.
  
  
**Data, Integration & Technical Understanding**
Strong understanding of planning data flows, master data, system integrations, interfaces, and how upstream/downstream systems affect planning outcomes.
  
  
**Business & IT Leadership**
Ability to act as the bridge between Business, Planning, IT, and project teams, providing clear solution direction for complex business requirements.
  
  
**Strategic & Consulting Skills**
Ability to look beyond immediate issues, identify future planning requirements, develop recommendations, challenge existing approaches, and support strategic planning and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Masters in Supply Chain, or a related discipline. BTech, BE, MCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
* 5–8 years of overall experience, with significant experience in Supply Chain Planning, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, or Integrated Business Planning.
* Strong hands-on functional experience with SAP APO and/or SAP IBP, including managing complex planning scenarios and system/process issues.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Demand and Supply Planning, planning data, master data, planning KPIs, and upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Experience in solution design, functional requirements, testing, implementation, go-live, and stabilization of planning solutions.

title: Startup Success and Execution Manager
description:
**FORGE Startup Success and Execution Manager**

Hyderabad | Approximately ₹50,000 per month | Minimum 2 years of relevant experience

**About The Big Blind**

The Big Blind is a venture studio working with early-stage founders to strengthen their businesses and prepare for growth. Through FORGE, we help startups sharpen their business models, address execution gaps, improve commercial readiness and build the materials and evidence needed for meaningful investor conversations.

**The opportunity**

We are looking for someone who loves startups and can turn founder discussions into completed work. You will be the continuous point of contact for assigned founders throughout FORGE, owning programme timelines, startup readiness and growth execution with The Big Blind team and specialist mentors. This is a hands-on business-building role, not just programme administration or investment research.

FORGE combines approximately two months of business building and readiness work with investor outreach and connections from the third month. You will help founders move from diagnosis to focused action, while developing their pitch, financials and diligence readiness in parallel. Delivery must follow each startup’s agreed scope and milestones.

**What you will own**

Startup diagnosis and execution plans: Understand the product, customer, market, traction and founder priorities. Identify the most important gaps and translate them into a practical plan with owners, deadlines and evidence of completion.

Business models and growth execution: Assess each startup’s customer segments, pricing, revenue streams and unit economics. Translate strategy into go-to-market, customer acquisition and partnership experiments, track results and help founders make decisions across different business models.

Financial models and analysis: Build or improve spreadsheet models covering revenue, costs, cash flow, burn, runway and relevant unit economics. Test assumptions and scenarios, reconcile available actuals and explain the numbers clearly to founders.

Pitch and business materials: Develop and refine pitch decks, one-pagers and business narratives. Ensure the market story, growth plan and financial model are consistent, supported and easy to understand.

Continuous founder engagement: Stay actively connected with founders throughout the programme, not only during sessions. Run the twice-weekly working cadence, set pre-work, follow up between sessions, resolve bottlenecks and keep founders accountable and supported.

Diligence readiness: Organise the data room and supporting evidence, identify missing information and track closure of readiness gaps. Coordinate legal, tax or other specialist inputs where needed rather than substituting for professional advice.

Mentors and network coordination: Bring the right internal or external expertise into each startup’s work. Support approved customer, partner and investor introductions with relevant materials, clear follow-through and accurate feedback tracking.

Timeline and readiness ownership: Own milestones, dependencies and delivery dates for each startup. Track commercial and investor-readiness gaps, flag slippage early and agree recovery actions. Maintain accurate records and weekly updates through programme close and handover.

**What you should bring**

At least 2 years of relevant experience in startup operations, a founder’s office, venture building, an accelerator or incubator, consulting, or another role involving hands-on work with early-stage businesses.

A genuine interest in startups and the judgement to work constructively with founders through ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.

A practical understanding of multiple startup business models, such as SaaS, marketplaces, D2C, services and product-led businesses. Know how pricing, sales cycles, margins, working capital and growth drivers differ, and adapt the execution plan accordingly.

Confidence building and reviewing financial models in Excel or Google Sheets. You should understand how revenue, costs, cash flow, burn and runway connect, and be able to challenge assumptions without inventing missing data.

The ability to turn complex ideas and analysis into clear pitch decks, one-pagers and action plans using PowerPoint, Google Slides or similar tools.

Strong project ownership: managing multiple workstreams, following up consistently and producing high-quality deliverables on time.

Strong analytical and presentation skills: interpret financial and business data, structure recommendations clearly and present them confidently to founders and stakeholders. Communicate clearly in writing and facilitate productive discussions.

Discretion with startup information and a habit of distinguishing verified facts, founder claims and working assumptions.

**Helpful but not essential**

Ideally, an MBA, a master’s degree in finance, or relevant hands-on finance experience. A specific degree is not required; practical ability and relevant experience matter.

Experience supporting pre-seed or seed-stage startups through business building, fundraising preparation or investor diligence.

Exposure to customer discovery, sales experiments, partnership development or operating metrics across different business models.

Familiarity with cap tables, startup data rooms and investor-facing materials.

Experience coordinating mentors, specialists or cross-functional teams without relying on formal authority.

**What good performance looks like**

Founders stay engaged throughout the programme. Each startup has a current plan, clear owners and dates, with timely follow-ups and recovery actions when milestones slip.

Sessions lead to completed actions and useful evidence, not just meeting notes. Blockers and scope changes are surfaced early.

Financial models are usable and internally consistent; assumptions and gaps are transparent. Pitch materials accurately reflect the business.

Startups make measurable progress against agreed growth priorities and readiness milestones, backed by evidence rather than activity alone, and finish with usable materials and clear next steps.

Introductions and investor conversations are well prepared and followed through. Success is not defined by promising funding or guaranteeing growth.
